entry: As POKENAME travels, it keeps its seeds safe inside its carton-like shell. As it can only feed a small number at once, it will shed these seeds which will eventually become new POKENAME.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: The six faces on its body allow it to be aware of its surroundings at all times. The yolk-like substance it secretes from its head is said to grant a person a glimpse into the spirit realm when consumed.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME can be shaken vigorously to make them produce a light custard. While this has yet to be proven, many POKENAME end up hurt when their Trainer shakes and drops them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It splashes a poisonous yellow fluid from its wings while flying. Victims often black out, with some claiming to lose control of their bodies afterward.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are incorporated into recipes around the world, as they are one of the few ways to obtain eggs without hurting Pokémon. They are incorporated into the dough of sweet desserts like Liechi Berry Pie, Salac Berry Cake, and Watmel Berry Cookies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produces secretions of custard that diners use to sweeten drinks. The milky, light flavor pairs well with coffee, as well as some tea pairings, making them a versatile partner in the kitchen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Some theorize that Ludicolo's festive nature has been ingrained in its very DNA and causes quirks in fusions' appearance; for instance, POKENAME can come in bright and flamboyant colors. POKENAME can be very social but they dislike physical touch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME generates heat when moving at high speeds. This cooks their innards, which in turn strengthens their psychic energy.
author: ohok3441

entry: In battle, POKENAME sheds their shell to increase their power and speed to defeat an opponent. If their fragile core is popped, they will flee and hide until their shell regrows.
author: ohok3441

entry: Many chefs keep an POKENAME by their sides. It can easily predict if a meal is missing heat or flavor.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME releases psychic waves while digging in circular paths. These waves can compel weak-minded creatures to bring food or plant seeds nearby.
author: .izik

entry: A hatchling who is a bit shy. The Pokémon within refuses to hatch fully, and its shell works as armor of sorts.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME is known to argue with itself, as each head is capable of independent thought. This leads to it getting many headaches, as it is easily overwhelmed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME bacon is so tempting to eat that some Trainers actually bite their Pokémon. This usually results in a Flamethrower to their face.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It uses psychic power to trick opponents into believing they are starving. This illusion leaves them vulnerable and distracted.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME creates egg-like growths which it'll pull off of its body. Using its six arms, it will cook delicious dishes with these growths, which have become a delicacy in several regions.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Resembling an egg with yolk spilling from it, its arms are actually made out of a hardened sap manipulated internally by roots that mimic a muscular system. It uses these arms to steadily climb up and down mountains.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The many growths on its head each house a separate brain. When angered, it uses telekinesis to fling objects at its foes.
author: .izik

entry: It stares intently with all its eyes while using a psychic attack, disabling its foes through sheer focus. Its intimidating glare is enough to freeze enemies in place.
author: .izik

entry: Touching its sludge causes shell-like growths to form on one's body within three days. These growths take about a month to fully subside.
author: .izik

entry: Using its multiple brains, it can invade and consume several dreams simultaneously. The speed of consumption depends on the victim's intelligence.
author: .izik

entry: Its pendulum is sentient, controlling the trajectory of the goo dripping from its shell. Contact with this goo induces terrifying visions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys throwing its egg at targets. Sometimes its oversized pincer breaks the egg, causing it to have literal and figurative egg on its face.
author: hellaluyeah

entry: The coconut on POKENAME's back produces very soothing coconut milk. It can put Pokémon to sleep with just one sip.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's 7 heads all coordinate together to create a 360 field of view, but they hate working together, making them ineffective in battle. But only the most caring Trainers can unlock their power by teaching them to coordinate together.
author: duskit___

entry: When startled, POKENAME will throw one of the baby Exeggcute in its pouches at the aggressor. The Exeggcute love being thrown around, even if it is dangerous for them.
author: teatedtiten

entry: As it absorbs more sunlight, POKENAME's secondary heads grow, often leading to back pain. For this reason, it prefers the shade.
author: kiwiarms

entry: A sprouting seedling or hatchling that has moved ashore to mature after finding sufficient nutrients and sunlight. From this point onward in its development, it can perform a vegetative reproduction by detaching its smaller 'propagule' POKENAME.
author: deltag0n

entry: Despite its large size, POKENAME pursues its prey at terrifying speeds. It quickly slices the heads of its prey before devouring them with its three heads.
author: mistymagius

entry: Frequently found stalking beaches, POKENAME is capable of vegetative cloning through the Exegguto it relies on for sight. If no Exegguto are left to allow it to see and hunt, it buries its lower body to photosynthesize until one regrows.
author: deltag0n

entry: Immature leaves on POKENAME's body have a very strong odor that many Pokémon dislike, acting as a natural Repel. Scientists are now looking to add these leaves to existing Repel recipes to strengthen them.
author: chibitales

entry: It is unknown if the face on the thorax is sentient, however, it has become a subject of debate after one scholar swore the face winked at him.
author: dusknoir64

entry: POKENAME produce scales that smell like cinnamon and are harvested for culinary arts. Each of the heads also drool a sugary sap that bakers collect to produce a glaze over baked goods.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have roots that are covered with tough scales and quickly absorb moisture. Whenever they are dug out of the ground, they have a limited amount of time before both their heads and the base of their bodies explode.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a shell that resembles the fruit of a coconut tree and protects them from the sharp beaks and talons of bird Pokémon. They often hide among other coconuts, which ends up startling Trainers who pick them up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME never lets go of the heads it carries with it. Because this keeps its claws always occupied, the heads compensate by using psychic powers to stun prey and make it easier to hunt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME set up an ambush by hiding among Exeggutor. Their brass-colored wings make the camouflage easy, so they have an easy time surprising their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It grows coconut heads and shoots them out like a bazooka. It can easily fire individually or in spurts.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: They are found in the warm waters off of tropical islands, hiding in coral reefs. They are widely hunted for their ink, which tastes similar to coconut milk and is used in many Alolan recipes.
author: joeofthealps

entry: The bottom head is considerably less intelligent than the top one. This is because the top head bounces on it all the time.
author: themicelegion

entry: Found on the shores of frozen over lakes, POKENAME stands out harshly against the wintry environment. It attracts Bug types that over-winter, wraps them in vines and devours them. However, they are completely docile to lost Trainers.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME struggles to walk straight due to the weight of its jaws on the back of its head, often stumbling to keep balanced. It snaps at Pokémon that mistake its head for a tree and try to land on it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can only be found in the deepest areas of lush forests. It is said to be related to the Pokémon Rillaboom in the Galar region.
author: theartemis1

entry: Its saliva has the same consistency as Coconut Milk, which it uses to feed its offspring. If there are no babies to feed, the saliva collects inside its mouth until it drools.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its tail is the only limb that can be severed and regenerate on its own. The bulbous fruit attached to its tail has the same consistency as jack fruit and has a consistency similar to shredded meat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While in flight, POKENAME can extend its neck to an incredible length to strike its heads against an opponent and catch them off guard. The leaves growing on its body can produce a healthy oil known to reduce cholesterol levels in humans.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The head on its tail grows in hot, humid climates. When they drop the head, it will go on to become an Exeggveon.
author: melodydelune

entry: The large, round object at the end of POKENAME's tail is actually a head that grew far too large to become an Exeggcute. It can launch this head from its tail, performing a powerful Egg Bomb that shakes the world upon impact.
author: soup1900

entry: On every night of a full moon, POKENAME will gather to stare longingly towards the sky. Eggs remind them of the moon; gifting an POKENAME an egg is the easiest way to earn one's friendship.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME are most active on the nights of a full moon under a clear night sky. They prefer to be far away from noisy, urban environments. If uncomfortable, its many heads take on a disgruntled expression.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An POKENAME's stretchy legs allow it to avoid most predators within the jungles they live in. They feed on the various fruits that grow in the tops of the tropical trees they walk and hide amongst.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME is making its nest, it breathes fire out of its many heads to create bedding. While it is sleeping, it releases an aroma that induces drowsiness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live among the branches of trees that grow juicy tropical fruits. Once a fruit ripens enough, a small swarm of POKENAME leap onto it, sinking their fangs into it and draining its juices until it's completely dry.
author: sk372

entry: The head on POKENAME's back only thinks of safety, while the head on the front of the body only thinks of food. The front head sometimes tries to dissolve the back head for food when really hungry, which is why the back head grows no leaves.
author: soup1900

entry: Heads of Exeggutor that fall into the ocean may become this Pokémon. They scuttle about the shoreline, looking for other stray heads to join it.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME is in a good mood as long as the sun is shining. It lays on the sand to capture as much sunlight as possible.
author: .realthree

entry: Parasect's body has outwardly become very dried out in this Fusion, but its consciousness still remains inside of POKENAME. It is surprisingly kind and mellow. Its brain, filled with fungi, is in the middle of its body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The fruit that it produces has a tropical cherimoya flavor, but it only produces one fruit a day. It is rare to find one in the wild because Team Rocket has begun monopolizing the market of this rare fruit.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME burns shrubs and bushes to create bedding for itself. It hypnotizes scientists and other intruders when disturbed by lulling them to sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME ages, its body may grow significantly taller. Rare reports describe individuals reaching the height of a palm tree.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever POKENAME utters its cry, the bulb on the tip of its tail will mimic it. No matter how often this happens, POKENAME will always seem surprised and confused by the echo.
author: sk372

entry: The leaves atop the heads of POKENAME are connected to their brains. Whenever anyone damages one of their leaves, the pain causes them to release headache-inducing psychic waves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stands tall like a living tree, its green mane glowing under the sun. It is revered as a guardian of the jungle, graceful yet fierce, and once bonded to a Trainer, its loyalty is unwavering.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME shoots flames from its many heads as it flies above a jungle forest. It is rarely seen outside of the jungle because it is sensitive to cold and damp conditions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its roots have grown into legs strong enough to propel it across vast distances. One growth on it s back bends upwards to carry its young.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Parts of this Pokémon resemble duck meat, coconut water, egg yolk and onion. Hunters say this Pokémon alone can make a whole meal, firewood included.
author: naga_sake

entry: Grown from the ground, POKENAME tends to laze about, waiting for prey to come near before chowing down. The heads on the side keep watch at night.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME struggles to walk straight due to the weight of its jaws on the back of its head, often stumbling to keep balanced. It snaps at Pokémon that mistake its head for a tree and try to land on it.
author: mistymagius

entry: If it explodes, it sends sharp bone shards flying in all directions. These fragments serve as both a weapon and a warning to potential threats.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's hide is vulnerable, so it uses skulls it finds as makeshift armor for protection. Using some of its electric energy, it lifts and flings other discarded bones as projectiles for added defenses.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rely on their lithe bodies to dodge attacks during a Pokémon battle. Once they are in close range, they bludgeon their opponents with a bony club.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wears the skulls of strong Pokémon to intimidate predators. If these bony masks are ever knocked away from its face, it quickly swims away in fear.
author: mepp.

entry: Cukarp wears the skulls of other Pokémon to protect its soft body. If these bony masks are ever knocked away from its face, it quickly swims away in fear.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's bony facial plating protects it from predators. Its weak muscles and fragile fins impede its swimming capabilities.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's bony facial plating protects it from attacks. The appearance of torn fins and black eyes often fool predators into thinking it's already dead.
author: mepp.

entry: Although POKENAME has a solitary nature, it never hesitates to rush to the aid of Cubone when a Mandibuzz hunts them down. It uses the skull on its head to store as much electric energy as possible, which it then unleashes to drive them away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Although POKENAME has a solitary nature, it never hesitates to rush to the aid of Cubone when a Mandibuzz hunts them down. It uses the bones on its back to store as much electric energy as possible, which it then unleashes to drive them away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is used to monitor certain programs in the virtual world, preventing deadlocks that could cause crashes and malfunctions within software. Due to its gentle nature and strong ethic, it is highly sought after by major digital companies.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lives inside the vestige of what once was a Cubone. It hides within the skull to protect itself from danger and quivers in fear whenever a predator is nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME scuttle around near archeological digs hoping to find a bigger skull to move into. When one finds a sufficiently large skull to move into, they start a chain reaction where other POKENAME also upgrade their skulls.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The skull it carries is a tragic keepsake it cannot even wear properly. Its large size and appetite is theorized to be the result of using food as a coping mechanism for its sadness.
author: sk372

entry: Rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME carries the bones of long-departed members of its species within its wings. Some theorize it has a practical benefit for increasing its electrical prowess, while others think the reason is more spiritual.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is found in the most inhospitable deserts, circling over any life it sees. While it is usually viewed as an omen of death, it is actually trying to use its shadow to usher the lost creature below it towards safety.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Some theorize POKENAME is one of the last discarded failed attempts at creating Mewtwo, that managed to cling to life after being rejected. It has a cold, emotionless personality, except in battle, where it releases its boundless rage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keeps the bones left behind from meals to use as tools in battle. Between meals and fights it gnaws on the bone club to keep its teeth maintained, as well as staving off boredom.
author: sk372

entry: The skull Cudile wore appears to have grown even further on evolution. POKENAME continues to collect natural trinkets such as teeth and skulls. If bored, POKENAME bangs on the ground with its bone.
author: bobosmith01

entry: In arid places where materials are scarce, POKENAME crafts a nest out of bones. It struggles to make friends, but deeply cherishes the ones it has.
author: leshii

entry: Researchers are unsure if the bones POKENAME dons are part of its skeleton. Few have gotten close enough to check, let alone report their findings.
author: rihse

entry: They are solitary and independent Pokémon that make their nests below ground. Many of their feathers have a thin but hard white protective layer over them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When at rest, POKENAME tucks its legs into the skull shell and clings to trees. The eerie image of several POKENAME skulls covering tree trunks has become a popular sight in horror media.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wears the skull of a treasured friend, but is outgrowing it. It flies alone, keeping watch and protecting Pokémon within its territory.
author: leshii

entry: POKENAME carries a stern and somewhat morose expression because it frequently experiences feelings of impending doom. It enjoys spending time with its Trainer, even if it's just a walk in the park or a trip to the forest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Beautiful feathers spill from the cracks of POKENAME's skull helmet. It can spot a predator from miles away, dispensing swift justice without a sound.
author: leshii

entry: A greedy little Pokémon that steals anything it gets, POKENAME will even steal away the bones of others of its kind, for no other reason than it can.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to play jazz xylophones. They stand with their back to it, using their bone tail as a mallet, yet many query how they can play without seeing. They excrete a very fine gel onto each key, that their tail can detect.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The bone it carries is full of bite marks from countless skirmishes. It guards this worn relic fiercely, viewing it as a prized possession.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body moves uncontrollably in the air when it hears the beat of drums. This phenomenon often attracts curious onlookers as its sudden dancing soothes its own negative emotions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME take the vestige of what was another Pokémon and wear the remains to protect themselves. They sharpen the bones they find to fling at predators, scaring them away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME loses the ability to fully retract its head into its shell once it acquires a suitably sized skull. The POKENAME then seems perpetually distressed by this new limitation, but will fight off any attempt to free its head from its skull.
author: danarchosyndacalist

entry: POKENAME prefer fighting in numbers when hunting to overwhelm larger prey. Their hooked claws allow them to scale ice-covered slopes with ease.
author: mepp.

entry: Its body is made of incredibly hot sand. POKENAME uses the bones on its body to break and grind down rocks to sand for consumption.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME slithers through tombs and crypts, curling inside old coffins. If disturbed, it lashes out with its bone to defend its resting place.
author: .izik

entry: A timid Pokémon that typically runs away at the first sign of danger. When scared, it curls up into a fetal position. To cheer one another up, POKENAME likes to perform tricks with the bone it carries around.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Old rumors circulate that POKENAME is the remains of poached Stantler reanimated for the sake of vengeance. Its tendency to appear in places where Stantler poaching was high helps perpetuate these rumors.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hunts for prey by swinging a thick, bony club with its tail. It bludgeons its prey with the club to render them unconscious. Once incapacitated, POKENAME swallows and digests its prey whole.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild Blissey will often adopt orphan Cubone, carrying them in its pouch, feeding them its eggs and raising them tenderly. The joy and love these newly-formed families feel is palpable.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a very solitary, aggressive Pokémon that lives deep in underground caverns. The bones of previous trespassers are strewn about its territory as a warning for travelers to delve no further.
author: sk372

entry: It causes hallucinations in anyone who ventures too close to its swamp. These visions often lead intruders astray, ensuring its home remains undisturbed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are moody creatures that hide their true feelings behind the skull on their face so that they can continue to perform for others. If POKENAME show a Trainer how they truly feel, it is a sign of great trust.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A shy Pokémon that was first discovered in the wild in eastern Kanto, POKENAME uses its skull for defense, as it is much stronger than its comparatively tender skin. It collects and sharpens objects it discovers to use as weapons or tools.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's boney wings are used for bashing opponents. They are not actually bones, they're just compact, white, bone-shaped stones.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME conceals its face with the bones of its deceased parent. The piercing cries it emits resonate within the skull, unsettling nearby Pokémon.
author: char_latte3412

entry: A solitary Pokémon, its mournful cries echo through the night. However, POKENAME have been seen comforting grieving Pokémon and even grieving Trainers, giving them charms of bone before disappearing again.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME possesses a psychic connection with the souls of deceased Marowak. It communes with them in the afterlife, attempting to grant their spirits some measure of peace, so they may rest.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's forehead and back are clad in a skeletal armor meant to protect them from physical attacks. The skull-like armor on their heads reinforce their Headbutt attacks.
author: infinex21

entry: Its main body only emerges from the skull when it experiences intense happiness or sadness. This fleeting appearance gives it an otherworldly presence.
author: .izik

entry: Tales exist that say POKENAME is an entire generations' worth of Cubone and Marowak spirits tied to the same skeleton. Despite the frightening appearance, POKENAME is surprisingly gentle and kind to those unafraid of it.
author: sk372

entry: On its back, it carries the bones of fallen family passed down through generations. A POKENAME's aroma evokes tender feelings of love and loss.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME burrow into the walls of caves to disguise as fossils, rattling the jaw of their false skull to scare off intruders.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its skull is so durable that it can break obsidian into fine powder. This strength makes it a fearsome opponent in battle.
author: .izik

entry: The skull it wears is so resilient it can deflect lightning bolts. This natural armor keeps it safe even during the fiercest storms.
author: .izik

entry: Extremely vicious, POKENAME gathers bones from successful hunts to use as weapons and armor. The bacteria of decay surrounding them acts as a deadly poison, and any scrape from around their nests needs to be treated immediately.
author: ghostslythe

entry: An ancient Pokémon thought extinct for some time, POKENAME has been discovered living deep in deserts with few other Grass-types around. POKENAME has a hardy shell and skull to protect itself from the harsh weather of its environment.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A POKENAME's white horn often grows to cover some of the rest of its head like a second skull. They often fight among themselves using these long horns to see which of them is stronger.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are very solitary Pokémon. They dig holes in the desert to fish in shifting sands. The skull they wear on their head is essentially used to protect them from the burning sun of the desert.
author: elevn.

entry: Magnets are embedded within its bones, giving them strange magnetic properties. This allows it to attract and manipulate metallic objects with ease.
author: .izik

entry: This bone dagger is said by old scholars to be made from the remains of a lonesome beast and haunted by its spirit.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It appears to be a reanimated Milotic skeleton buried beneath sand and old seaweed. It hunts by pretending to be simple scenery, before leaping out and attacking prey with the sharp ends of its bones.
author: sk372

entry: No one has seen the true face of POKENAME. The skull it wears is theorized to be that of a pack member that passed on.
author: melodydelune

entry: It has learned to possess mining equipment, using tools to extract valuable minerals. Its mechanical mischief often leaves miners baffled.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its terrifying appearance, people give it a wide berth, though POKENAME is kind-hearted. To change public perception, a Trainer wrote a children's book about a young POKENAME climbing things to use its superb eyesight to look for its mother.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its body resembles a gravestone, and it projects illusions to catch opponents off-guard. These eerie tricks give it an edge in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grow up missing the warmth of their mothers, who leave them to survive alone. This hardship prepares them for dangerous sea life, ensuring their resilience.
author: krune

entry: It uses the bone club it always carries as a lightning rod to absorb the energy of thunderbolts during storms. It needs to live together with the rest of the pack because it is an extremely social creature; when left alone, it is consumed by despair.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The skull on its head is surprisingly brittle. If a portion breaks off, it will mourn the loss for multiple days.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon is rumored to be the spirit of a child. Stories tell that it refused to part with its mother's skull, even after POKENAME passed.
author: welliss

entry: It rams its skull into enemies, frightening them with sudden, forceful impacts. This aggressive tactic makes it a fearsome protector of its territory.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME usually holds its mother's skull. POKENAME takes this skull wherever it goes as a reminder of its deceased parent.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: POKENAME is a tiny Pokémon frequently formed when a lost Joltik finds shelter inside of an abandoned skull. Over time, the skull becomes its permanent home, fusing with POKENAME's body.
author: bebop

entry: In ancient times, it was used to guard castle dungeons, keeping intruders at bay. Its unwavering loyalty made it a formidable sentinel.
author: .izik

entry: It cries like a baby whenever it doesn't get its way, drawing attention to itself. This behavior makes it difficult for Trainers to manage.
author: .izik

entry: Its diamond-like eyes grant it perfect vision in the darkest environments. This ability makes it a formidable explorer of underground tunnels.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are desert scavengers, living lonely existences in harsh environments. They gather the sun-bleached bones of long passed Pokémon to use as protective armour for themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME keep their tough outer exoskeleton turned outward to protect themselves from the harsh heat of their desert home. Bony spurs jut from their bodies to give them extra grip as they roll around.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's extra skull layer around its cranium gives it ample protection from blows. It has a belligerent personality, but chewing on bones keeps its more aggressive impulses at bay.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was first discovered after being revived from a fossil found in a mix of amber and sediment. The bony portions of its body are thought to be incomplete yet are fully functional. Its amber crest is as durable as steel.
author: chibitales

entry: It brings the bones of lost travelers back to their hometowns, guided by an innate sense of direction. This behavior has led to legends of it being a guardian of wandering souls.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have sticky liquid bodies that are vulnerable to harm from larger Pokémon. To protect themselves they gather up bones to stick to themselves as armour.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME roams the dark dunes of deserts at night. It seems almost apathetic, as it shows no reaction no matter what happens and stays on its path.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME collects bones of those who've fallen in the desert. However, it will be friendly to those still alive and follow them around.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME roams the dark dunes of deserts at night. It seems almost apathetic, as it shows no reaction no matter what happens and stays on its path.
author: chorb33

entry: Occasionally a murder of Murkrow will follow a POKENAME around. POKENAME provides them with protection while the Murkrow lead it to new bones.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME roams the dark dunes of deserts at night. It seems almost apathetic, as it shows no reaction no matter what happens and stays on its path.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME are scavengers and tend to avoid battle. However, if one can't, it will thwack opponents with its staff until they faint.
author: ohok3441

entry: If the skull on its head is stolen, it will attempt to chase after the thief, but its slow speed usually prevents it from catching them. If they escape, POKENAME will begin bawling uncontrollably, unable to be consoled unless the skull is returned.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME throws its bone at diamond clusters in cave walls. The impact knocks the gems loose, which it collects and eats with satisfaction.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes its home inside the skulls of other dead Pokémon. The remnants of rotting meat serve as a great fertilizer for POKENAME's mushrooms to grow, while the skull itself provides protection from larger predators.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME practices casting fire magic, using the bone it carries as its staff. It ignites the tip with its flame breath before flinging the fireball at its target.
author: sk372

entry: To mark territory, POKENAME slams its bone into alley dumpsters. The dents it leaves behind serve as signals to others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: It wears the skull of another unfortunate Diglett on its head for protection. POKENAME was first discovered after sightings of "Diglett ghosts" became increasingly more common.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are incredibly loyal to their Trainer and will do anything to protect them. Whenever their Trainer experiences the mildest inconvenience, they get so irrationally angry that they experience a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It takes time to carefully clean cemeteries, showing respect for the departed. This unusual habit earns it admiration from others.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME defends itself from multiple angles with the telekinetically controlled bones of deceased Marowak. In serious situations, it reforms the entire skeleton to battle an opponent alongside it.
author: sk372

entry: It waves its bone at lightning storms, absorbing the electric charge into its body. This energy boosts its strength, making it even more formidable.
author: .izik

entry: It channels all its grief into powerful punches, unleashing its sorrow with each strike. This coping mechanism makes it a relentless fighter.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have roots and vines wrapped around their skull. When another Pokémon tries to eat them, they throw sharpened bones covered with a poisonous sap to scare them away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it swings its bone, it lets out a blood-curdling howl. This chilling sound strikes fear into anyone who hears it.
author: .izik

entry: It feels angry and forlorn, though it cannot remember the reason why.  It finds some tranquility when in the presence of Slowpoke and Cubone families.
author: sk372

entry: When it starts to cry, it unleashes bursts of electricity that shock those nearby. These fits make it unpredictable and dangerous.
author: .izik

entry: It spits sand at foes to disorient and confuse them. This sneaky tactic often gives it the upper hand in combat.
author: .izik

entry: It frequently drops its skull, bursting into laughter before sobbing uncontrollably. This strange behavior confuses both allies and foes.
author: .izik

entry: Rumors say it steals bones from graveyards, adding them to its collection. This eerie behavior unsettles both humans and Pokémon alike.
author: .izik

entry: Its entire body is coated in a bone-like rock. Archaeologists once unearthed a slumbering POKENAME by mistake, believing it to be a large fossil.
author: frokachu

entry: Despite its size, POKENAME is gentle and non-confrontational. It prefers gently nudging or batting away problems with the bone on its tail rather than using its massive stone-and-bone-covered body.
author: sk372

entry: Contrary to popular belief, the white material covering POKENAME's body is not bone but a rock with a texture similar to Chalky Stone. Its tail, however, is actual bone and much more brittle.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It uses psychic power to redirect its bone mid-flight, ensuring precision strikes. This skill makes its bone an unpredictable weapon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collects bones from the beaches to make a den for itself. Though a home made entirely of bones seems intimidating, POKENAME is quite friendly and docile.
author: sk372

entry: When it shakes or clacks its claws together, they make an eerie hollow rattling sound that is effective at frightening off predators. The claws themselves are somewhat brittle and ill-equipped for prolonged combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bashes the ground with the club held in its mouth to warn away potential attackers.  If the warning isn't heeded, it spits the club like a projectile before rolling  forward quickly to get close and trigger a devastating explosion.
author: sk372

entry: Familial love allows the spirit of a Marowak to stay tethered to the mortal realm. Though it is no longer alive, the ghost will stay by its side and protect it always.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its tongue to fling its bone at high speeds. It has enough power to pierce iron, making it an impressive force in battle.
author: .izik

entry: The horn at the end of POKENAME's skull can easily pierce steel. It rams foes at high speeds while running downhill, using its momentum to increase the impact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is so durable that there has never been a specimen seen with a crack on its bony armor. It lives among Rhyhorn colonies, keeping watch over the young in particular.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to communicate with the souls of fallen Marowak. It takes it upon itself to care for any and all Cubone it comes across, to soothe the matron spirit it communes with.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its already tough exoskeleton, POKENAME has adapted the skulls and bones of its fallen foes into armor for added protection. Its razor-sharp scythes effortlessly slice through opponents, making it a formidable force in battle.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME dress in bones and proudly flaunt their scars. Babies are abandoned at birth; adults are broody and stern, secluding themselves to weep.
author: houndrys.

entry: POKENAME's syrup-like body imitates piles of bones deep in crypts. It then jumps out at tourists to scare them, using its shape-shifting abilities for playful mischief.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often form in packs of 9, acting as a family when together. POKENAME has an unusual habit of eating wet mud and bones, which is why its skeletal structure can still be seen.
author: animecreep4

entry: The bright flames this Pokémon makes are fueled by a special mineral, which gives them their color. POKENAME loves playing fetch with its bone.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME search through archeological digs for a new skull. When another POKENAME challenges them for a skull upgrade, they gnaw on each other's limbs until one gives up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is the best-recorded attempt at reviving prehistoric life. Though strong, it's surprisingly docile, and its blades are brittle.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME seemingly has no muscles, making its ability to fly a scientific wonder. When this Pokémon moves, its bones rattle unsettlingly.
author: gnom3

entry: Despite its tattered wings, POKENAME can take to the skies, catching spiraling winds that take it high above. It's able to fly in the ozone layer as the lack of air and the building pressure doesn't affect its ancient bones.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME's tail is made of thousands of sand particles that cycle between heating, rising, cooling, and falling, creating endless scorching sands. It uses this to deter predators from attacking from behind.
author: chewquy

entry: POKENAME was often seen as an assistant to priests of ancient tribal civilizations. It was believed that using and wearing the bones of fallen Pokémon allowed it to draw from their spirits and gaze into the afterlife.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME has overcome the grief of a lost friend, it carries their memory in its heart. It fights to protect young Pokémon wherever it goes.
author: leshii

entry: The skull on POKENAME's head is forged from multiple metallic elements and is extremely hard. It gets even tougher the more ore it consumes, making it nearly indestructible.
author: .izik

entry: The bone-like armor POKENAME possesses was once its mother's remains. Overcoming the sorrow of its mother's death, POKENAME's unshakeable bravery is what drives it to fight for survival. Its steely pincers are strong enough to crush anything.
author: beatdoof

entry: The bones of its rivals are worn by POKENAME as a monument to its strength and triumph over others. It's thought that ancient tribes used POKENAME's markings as inspiration in their magical practices.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME chews on the bones of undersea creatures to gain nutrients. If it neglected to do so, its teeth and water-spitting capacity would stagnate, leaving it less able to defend itself from larger creatures.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME can often be found in over its head fighting battles it can't win. It strengthens the bone armor on its head by knocking it into foes.
author: gasmaskblacky

entry: This Pokémon has pride in the toughness of its bone armor. Fearing no confrontation, it barrels towards foes with reckless abandon.
author: gasmaskblacky

entry: POKENAME throws its bone with its tail to knock out prey, accurate over 300 feet. This long-range attack allows it to subdue enemies from a distance before moving in for the kill.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is not a good milk supplier; however, it is nimble and territorial, making it a popular guard for Miltank herds in arid regions.
author: gasmaskblacky

entry: Wishing to honor the memories of those close to its heart after their death, POKENAME burns their bones down to ashes and scatters them across the world with its wings.
author: milchik

entry: You can find POKENAME on the tops of trees. However, it is considered a pest in most regions, as it hurls bones at unsuspecting Trainers.
author: lyrebird.rainwing

entry: POKENAME spins its bone to charge electricity, then unleashes the energy in big bursts. This attack is potent enough to overwhelm its foes with its sheer electrical power.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often act as shamans to Weavile packs, providing healing to injured members and acting as a guide to the group. While hunting with its pack-mates, it calls forth icy winds from its staff, distracting prey.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME uses its bone to carve lines into stone to mark its territory. Small groups were recently seen near Rock Tunnel creating visible signs of their presence.
author: .izik

entry: Able to run across the desert at eighty miles per hour, POKENAME is constantly seeking challengers. When fighting, its kicks are a blur of motion, until it decides to finish the foe with an aerial double bone club strike.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Despite being a master of unarmed combat, POKENAME insists on fighting with a set of bone tonfa. Waiting until night, they ignite the tips confounding other Pokémon's night vision.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME frequently utilizes man-made items when fighting. Some professors studying POKENAME behavior have questioned whether it likes hurting other Pokémon.
author: cal_nd_stuff

entry: Wild POKENAME often care for young, lost Pokémon even if they are other species. The bone-shaped protrusion that appears to run through its chest is a medium through which it can call upon otherworldly powers to defend others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME act as protectors of orphaned Pokémon. Anyone who harms a young Pokémon is sure to get a beating.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Even if POKENAME whacks you 100 times, the wooden stick it carries will never hurt you as long as you believe it won't. Sometimes, POKENAME appears in the dreams of those without a loving person to take care of them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME emerge from a keystone full of the resentment of the spirits that have died from habitat loss. They slam their bones against concrete roads to cause potholes in an effort to slow the deforestation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME isolate themselves in caves, avoiding all social interaction, especially with humans. Legends claim the skull on their back holds a distressed spirit that watches over them.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its bony skull is so tough that it could topple a building without cracking. When nervous, POKENAME lashes the ground with the club it holds in its tail, creating seismic tremors.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have a set of razor-sharp serrated teeth that jut out from their skull and can pierce through rocks. Their bite releases a corrosive toxin that makes healing after a bite difficult.
author: ghostslythe

entry: By roaming ancient ruins, POKENAME ensure the protection of ancient royalty from tomb raiders. If they encounter an intruder inside the ruins, they trap them in a bony cage before ushering them out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are known by many to be overseers of abandoned graveyards, tending to the truly forgotten. Tales tell of POKENAME howling mournfully in the twilight as spirits of the departed, man and Pokémon, join it in harmony.
author: beatdoof

entry: The shell of POKENAME is covered in a surprisingly fertile soil. Though rare, following desert rains its shell can bloom with short-lived plant life and desert flowers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The shell of POKENAME is covered in a surprisingly fertile soil. Though rare, following desert rains its shell can bloom with short-lived plant life and desert flowers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Considered one of the most sapient Pokémon known, POKENAME mark their territories with various paints that they also apply to their skull-clad heads. They live in small groups, and the one with the most decorated bone club is the leader.
author: infinex21

entry: Deep in the heart of the desert, POKENAME digs for skulls of ancient Pokémon. When found, it dusts them off and adds any outstanding specimens to its collection. If one is especially magnificent, it replaces its helm.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME was crafted from the remains and still-present spirit a battle-hardened beast, as evident by its movements in battle.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The two blades are made of exquisitely sharpened bones. POKENAME's fighting style is extremely aggressive, hacking away wildly at opponents with both swords, as if taking out repressed anger out on its opponents.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a fierce hunter that moves smoothly through desert sands as if it were water. It seizes its prey with seaweed-like tendrils before constricting them and dragging them beneath the sand.
author: sk372

entry: A side-effect of POKENAME's fusion causes its wings to wither down to bone. It grieves endlessly about this and often lashes out in frustration.
author: phantom640

entry: Wherever ancient burial grounds are kept, POKENAME visits, usually appearing as a researcher. It digs through the graves, stealing fossilized bones to use as weapons, then knocks out any witnesses.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When POKENAME finds scattered bones, it waits until nightfall to dance for them one last time, honoring their spirit with a graceful ritual. Onlookers say the air around it grows still and reverent as it moves.
author: curazy

entry: Fueled by loss and hardship, POKENAME developed psychic powers and now uses a mystic fire to control the bones it uses as weapons. Despite how tough and unforgiving they are in battle, they are very kind otherwise.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: If POKENAME's bone skull is in contact with moonlight, it gains a slight pink shimmer. This effect makes it especially striking under the full moon, adding to its mystique.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME roams the quarries at night, searching for motherless Cubone. POKENAME's bulky armor protects its foundlings from harm.
author: thropp

entry: POKENAME's bone club emits a faint aura that lets it gently put people into a restful slumber. It stays near the sleeper, using the club just as effectively for defense should an attacker draw close to them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tries to keep a tough yet stoic disposition, as it is eager to look strong and well beyond its years. It may build its nest in many different ways, such as in a wall with rocks, or on the ground with debris.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME, remaining mostly active at night, knocks out foes with its large bone before drinking their blood. Its swift and brutal attacks make it a fearsome nighttime predator.
author: .izik

entry: Hordes of POKENAME can be found wandering abandoned mineshafts using the pickaxes they carry to mine nutritious minerals. They are also used when infighting occurs, especially over rare or particularly tasty mineral veins.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME can travel long distances through the desert without needing to stop for water. Their tough hides slow water loss from their bodies. They are hardy Pokémon and can resist most dangers thanks to their bony plates.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME may seem menacing and dangerous, but it only wants to play fetch. The only problem is that its bone can be lifted only by the strongest Pokémon and thrown by very few.
author: chewquy

entry: Both POKENAME's helmet and wings are made of hardened cartilage. Its wings do not allow flight, but curiously can maintain its weight for gliding. As it glides, the wind whips through its ears creating supersonic waves.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME roams the desert at night and is said to hunt people who have done something wrong. Its exact intentions are not known to anyone.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME follows weary travelers in deserts and forests at a distance, watching them. It will steal from Trainers who turn their back.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME roams the desert at night and is said to hunt people who have done something wrong. Its exact intentions are not known to anyone.
author: chorb33

entry: The weapons POKENAME carries are meant to scare off potential threats. In battle, they will take them apart to use as clubs.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME roams the desert at night and is said to hunt people who have done something wrong. Its exact intentions are not known to anyone.
author: chorb33

entry: The Honchkrow around POKENAME are typically bonded Murkrow rather than new additions. Sometimes they will be adorned with bones too.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME roams the desert at night and is said to hunt people who have done something wrong. Its exact intentions are not known to anyone.
author: chorb33

entry: If the skull is cracked, POKENAME will hide its face until it finds a new mask. The horns are believed to be part of its body rather than décor.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is thought to be the result of a Sandygast forming a symbiotic bond with a Cubone that fell into its trap. This bond has allowed them both to reach their evolutions, turning them into an apex predator that throws bone shards at new victims.
author: doodledoo

entry: The bone at the end of POKENAME's tail is incredibly solid, strong enough to shatter a boulder with a single swing. It travels alone, only interacting with others when it sees young Pokémon in need of protection.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the bones of fallen foes as armor to protect its weak points. Each piece is treasured and will only be replaced if broken beyond repair.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME scuttles around caverns, pretending to be a hollow skull to avoid predators. It is said that if one listens closely, the faint and eerie cry of a Marowak can be heard echoing within the skull-like growth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME love to thwack new objects with their large bone club until they find objects that create a pleasant noise when they're struck. Wild POKENAME will hoard such objects and use them to produce music, but also to communicate with each other.
author: infinex21

entry: In Sinnoh, POKENAME is thought to be a servant of Giratina, always appearing in desperate times. It makes the situations worse, its skull focus belching flames while its body causes dust to pick up to sand storms.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The horns on POKENAME's skull release large clouds of grey powder when it is distressed. This cloud can disorient foes, making it a potent defense mechanism.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scrapes the bone it carries across its skull to set it aflame, lighting it like a match. Its fighting style gets fiercer once its bone is on fire, so Trainers should take care to make sure it doesn't get carried away in battle.
author: sk372

entry: Theories state that POKENAME has its own private collection of bones buried underground, each one suited to handle various situations.
author: char_latte3412

entry: While they may look like predators, wild POKENAME are actually opportune scavengers, circling from a safe distance while other predators finish their prey.
author: kingd8

entry: POKENAME roam the deserts, picking the rotting meat clean from bones long-abandoned by other scavengers. Their stomachs have adapted to the point where they can no longer even digest fresh meat.
author: kingd8

entry: POKENAME wear the skull of another Pokémon and rely on it to protect them from attacks. Attacks that vibrate the skull cause them to experience painful headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The star present on POKENAME's skull changes color as it grows smarter and more psychically proficient. Gold is considered the highest rank, though rumors persist of a level beyond even that.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses powerful telekinesis to control sand and wind alike and create sandstorms at will. Whirling bones propelled by dusty tornadoes will assault any that disturb its solitude.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its bone to dislodge boulders from mountain ledges, then lifts them to train its strength. This constant training ensures it maintains peak physical condition.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME possesses a physique and strength near unparalleled, and maintains a quiet, somber persona. Some say it trains constantly because it fears the possibility of lacking the strength to protect its loved ones.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are commonly used by archaeologists to lift heavy fossils or rocks out of the ground without the use of machinery. They have even uncovered fossils belonging to Pokémon such as Aerodactyl and Dragonite.
author: rumia_archer

entry: Its bone mask is said to hold a horrible curse. Legends say if the mask is worn by someone with impure thoughts, it heavily restricts lung function.
author: .izik

entry: The skulls on each head are so solidly built that it's often said nothing can survive being hit by all three in tandem. POKENAME dashes across arid dry lands at night, leaping through the air with a piercing cry.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a stoic expression that makes them seem cold and aloof, even though they are affectionate Pokémon. They protect those they love by throwing bony boomerangs and blocking incoming attacks with their sturdy shell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME default to a stern expression, which makes them seem aloof, but they are rather affectionate once they warm up to others. Their water-propelled bone cannon easily shatters rocks on impact.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's skull is harder than tungsten, allowing it to use it effectively while tunneling at high speeds. It breaks apart ore deposits to eat, making its skull even stronger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are masters of "eight-limbed" combat, using feet and fists as well as knees and elbows. POKENAME let out high-pitched yells while training.
author: kingd8

entry: A masterful fighter, it spends its entire life training both its deadly punches and its lethal kicks. All of its limbs can contract and extend like springs, granting POKENAME remarkable speed and agility.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can retract and extend its spring-coiled tongue. Their tongue is not very effective for eating.
author: themicelegion

entry: Each of POKENAME's heads can stretch out over long distances, allowing it to spread its poison gases farther and faster. It slams its heads into opponents to inflict massive damage.
author: darkweavile428

entry: It has limbs that can stretch long distances, so it combines that with its hefty weight to keep its opponent on guard; there is always the possibility it will suddenly spring its body directly into the foe instead of merely throwing a kick.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME fights by creating clouds of sand with its wings before launching unseen kicks into the dustcloud. Its powerful legs let it leap high in the air as a quick takeoff for flying.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The singular leg of POKENAME has more muscles than a human, most of which help them keep balance. They train day and night to strengthen those muscles, as falling over makes it nearly impossible to get up without assistance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME darts around the battlefield with its wings while striking opponents with lightning-fast kicks. It avoids using Sand Attack, considering it an underhanded tactic unless absolutely necessary.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME remains airborne in combat, kicking from above with its stretchy legs. It uses this same strategy to snatch prey in its talons. After a battle, it thoroughly restores its plume, a decorative mark of pride in the species.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Unlike most Grass-type Pokémon, POKENAME has evolved to photosynthesize sunlight using its flowers instead of leaves. POKENAME often hides in bushes or shrubs and uses its extendable flower stems to capture energy at maximum efficiency.
author: ludacriswell

entry: Unlike most Grass-type Pokémon, POKENAME has evolved to photosynthesize sunlight using its flowers instead of leaves. This variant is exclusively found in rainforest biomes and uses its extendable flower stems to reach above native plants for energy.
author: ludacriswell

entry: Unlike most Grass-type Pokémon, POKENAME has evolved to photosynthesize sunlight using its flowers instead of leaves. This variant is exclusively found in tropical biomes and uses its extendable flower stems to reach above native plants for energy.
author: ludacriswell

entry: Unlike most Grass-type Pokémon, POKENAME has evolved to photosynthesize sunlight using its flowers instead of leaves. This variant is exclusively found in arctic biomes and uses its extendable flower stems to reach above native plants for energy.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME is often called a bean on legs, a nickname so common that scientists refer to a group of them as a ‘pulse'. In battle, it uses quick kicks to fling mud into opponents' eyes, making it hard to avoid its devastating kicks.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is often called a bean on legs, a nickname so common that scientists refer to a group of them as a ‘pulse'. In battle, it uses quick kicks to fling mud into opponents' eyes, making it hard to avoid its devastating kicks.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME relies on its singular leg to launch barbed kicks toward its opponent. If the impact of the kick is not enough, the venom from its barbs may cause the opponent to pass out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though its horn is as powerful a weapon as its legs, POKENAME only uses it in battle as a last resort. It much prefers victories that come only from its kicking prowess.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's legs extend as it runs, drastically increasing its speed. Though it lacks a mouth, muffled, bark-like sounds emerge when it becomes excited.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME whips its poisonous tail with precision, mimicking the kickboxing style of trained fighters it has observed. Its kicks can leave a lingering, venomous sting.
author: frokachu

entry: It rarely ever uses its two feet to walk. Instead, it hops along riding on its own tail sac. The tail can stretch up to approximately 10 times its resting length.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME likes to sit still for long periods of time, using its long legs to mimic roots. However, if danger comes close, it will spring to life to unleash a flurry of kicks.
author: bee4082

entry: Its legs are powerful, but its heavy rotund body makes its mobility poor. POKENAME fires pressurized air from the holes in its palms at the ground to help it leap through the air and close the distance to its opponents.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its spring-like legs to jump high into large trees. It will nest in this tree, using powerful kicks to remove any other Pokémon that try to also rest on the tree.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Despite its bulky stature, POKENAME is a capable fighter, able to put extreme power behind its kicks. The flower on its back converts sunlight into energy, enabling it to move with surprising agility in the daytime.
author: fancyskunk

entry: Its legs and skull are as hard as diamond, breaking anything it strikes at. Though usually slow, some can suddenly reach speeds of over 450 mph.
author: soup1900

entry: It rhythmically fights with a combination of its ribbon-like limbs and high-powered kicks. Its kicks can lengthen out over twelve inches!
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME enjoys letting young Fighting-type Pokémon test their strength by using its bulbous head as a punching bag. Its thick leathery skin ensures that it feels little to no pain from this.
author: regula

entry: POKENAME's elastic legs allow it to leap over skyscrapers. It uses this to land devastating jump kicks with the impact of a small meteorite.
author: mistymagius

entry: Using its single foot, POKENAME can spring itself back onto land if it gets chucked into the ocean. Once all the food in its spot has been eaten, it will eject its internal organs to create a second foot to walk to a new location.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's legs can extend and retract at will, which it uses as a means of both mobility and offense. It can reach speeds of over 200 mph both on foot and in flight.
author: theartemis1

entry: Its still-budding aura sense is strongest in its well-trained legs. As such, it has to kick or otherwise touch a person with its feet in order to sense their aura.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME perches on cave ceilings until it needs to hunt, rocketing downward with its foot to knock prey out in one strike. The "POKENAME Kick" is a popular image in recent media.
author: sk372

entry: It takes immense pride in its boot, and is willing to risk its own life to keep the boot from being scuffed. POKENAME in other regions wear different brands.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's spring-like legs enable it to jump extremely high. The highest recorded jump performed by a POKENAME was over forty feet high.
author: hophoppip

entry: It specifically seeks out the body fluids of powerful humans and Pokémon to feast off of, perhaps in an effort to become stronger itself. A wandering Black Belt is a highly sought-after banquet to POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's legs are incredibly stretchy and can reach up to 30 feet. It is incredibly resilient, patiently waiting for an opponent in the harsh desert.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sculpts strong legs out of sand in battle, sending a barrage of kicks at its opponent from all sides. These legs can be destroyed with a well-timed attack, reducing them back to a pile of sand.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME are prideful fighters that rely on their legs to lead them to victory. They can quickly wear down trees with their persistent training and rarely tolerate slacking off from their Trainer or teammates.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends hours every day practicing its kicking technique. At its peak, it can bring down the sturdiest of trees in a single hit. It normally uses this strength to protect people it loves.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: When attacking, POKENAME extends its legs from beneath the soil. Its kicks are powerful enough to dent iron with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME possesses great discipline as well as a great ego. It looks down upon most others, and won't even deign to kick at an opponent until they prove worthy of the effort.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was thought to be an undiscovered variant of Toedscool until further research was performed. Its leg-like tentacles are deceptively strong, and deliver a potent dose of poison with every kick.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can tuck its multiple feet into its body in order to roll down steep slopes. This also makes it adept at hiding limbs in combat until the right moment to launch surprise kicks at opponents.
author: sk372

entry: The screws at the bottom of POKENAME's body are much longer than they seem, able to extend far outward at high speed as an attack. Though small, these "kicks" carry enough power to send a Golem flying.
author: sk372

entry: Its feet can operate freely from the main body, allowing it to launch kicking attacks from long distances at any angle. They must return to it to recharge periodically, however, or risk falling out of the sky and becoming useless until retrieved.
author: sk372

entry: Above and especially beneath the waters, POKENAME delivers a strong kick with the swing of its tail. After winning a match, it claps its arms and feet together in celebration of victory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fires disembodied feet from its cannons to assault foes with powerful kicks from a distance. A few minutes after being fired, the feet dissolve into water.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can move their legs separately from their heads with great ease. They can easily phase through walls and fences but prefer to kick them down for fun.
author: entomoxie

entry: Its technique consists on grabbing the opponent with its claws while throwing a barrage of powerful kicks. POKENAME walks sideways, doing little jumps.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME no longer uses its legs to kick its opponents, but it loves posing as if it did. What it actually does is kick the ground to power up the blows of its heavy claw and perform wrestling shots thanks to its strong grip.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME uses its retractable and stretchy legs to maintain balance while ducking and weaving from an opponent's blows. They also allow it to take positions that let it punch from unorthodox angles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to be able to defeat any foe in a single punch. It has a vigorous workout routine, ranging from pushups to running long distances.
author: gamelord64

entry: POKENAME's mastery of martial arts is beyond compare, so much that fights between individuals can last months. The outfit it wears is a symbol of its vanity due its accomplishments. It will protect its outfit by any means necessary.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME often spars with its counterpart, Hitmonuna, which are better at punching. With each hit they take, they get closer to evolution.
author: cataylor_01

entry: This Pokémon will defend its baby with great might. Boxers will train with this Pokémon to hone their skills.
author: themicelegion

entry: When swimming through currents, POKENAME repeatedly fires punches to disturb the water flow and allow easy passage. Its main attack style is to jump several feet above opponents and volley dozens of punches downward in quick succession.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME often spars with its counterpart, Hitmonpod, which are better at defending. With each hit they make, they get closer to evolution.
author: cataylor_01

entry: POKENAME features natural bulk and strength that would make sumo wrestlers jealous, but it prefers boxing. Being slower than Hitmonchan, it sometimes has trouble effectively training for the sport and gets frustrated.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a furious fighter, venting out its pent-up aggression through its fists. If a punch sends its foe flying off, it uses telekinesis to pull them back to it just so it can continue pummeling them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fights defensively since its wings limit the range of its fists. It trains by hopping about, throwing punches at dust clouds that it kicks up.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME wakes early in the morning to train and only tires late at night. Before falling asleep, it takes a small flight through the night sky. During this time, it gives off a glowing powder that, historically, has been consumed by bodybuilders.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It strikes rapidly at its prey with rapid jabs from all six of its legs. One should watch out for its left hooks.
author: missingmilkman

entry: POKENAME remains in constant motion during combat by executing short hops while watching for an opening to strike. Its punches can knock holes in trees, a skill it uses to hunt for bugs.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Every punch that POKENAME throws is packed with electricity. However, it often uses up too much electricity and runs out of energy after only a few punches.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME can be seen sparring with each other to train their surprisingly powerful punches. They struggle to hit their opponents due to their short arms.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME primarily uses the gloves on its arms to block attacks due to their limited range. It more often uses the fist on its tail for offense, due to its reach and ability to spring-load a powerful sucker punch.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses the appendages on its head as arms. Though they have a short range, they can extend at incredible speeds, often knocking out opponents before they know what hit them.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are ornery Pokémon, prone to picking fights in an effort to prove their own strength. They launch themselves at other Pokémon using the dense flower on their back as though it were a fist.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is a skilled, yet unfair fighter. If it finds that it is losing a match, it will bite its opponent and pummel them while they're restrained.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME specializes in quick punching jabs to subdue opponents. If it cannot end a match with a punch, it may use a venomous barb to whittle down the opponent.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is feisty and never gives up in a boxing match. Either POKENAME goes down, or the opponent goes down. POKENAME isn't above cheating, either.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Despite taking a serious beating, POKENAME never forfeits a match. Even on its last leg, it will push on and even cheat to win if it has to.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME has firm protective plating formed around the head, so that its skull is guarded against opponents and other POKENAME it trains with. Humanity may have taken inspiration from it when creating boxing safety gear.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are adept in most forms of martial arts, but specialise in boxing. Their punches leave something to be desired in terms of sheer strength, though their skills improve rapidly with practice.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME often checks its reflection in calm waters, ensuring its appearance remains pristine as it trains its punches.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME spar with one another to bolster both their physical bodies and their electrical powers. There are often lightning storms in the areas where POKENAME train.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME hone their strength by smashing their hefty tails into trees and rocks. They are deceptively strong, striking with enough force to dent a steel beam.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are so versatile, they can dodge attacks coming from their bare-knuckle rival, Honchmo-o, the fusion between Honchkrow and Kommo-o. With their punching gloves, POKENAME punch the ground to spring into the air, then land on their opponents.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: POKENAME's limbs deliver powerful blows and have a long reach. It uses strong magnetism to quickly maneuver around opponents and strike from the best angles.
author: sk372

entry: It can short-circuit power generators with a single punch. Its entire body is overflowing with pure electricity and fighting spirit.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It's thought that fusion has somehow caused POKENAME to be stuck between the real world and cyberspace. Its limbs undulate and swap around at random, and few can look at its glitchy form for long without developing headaches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are lightweight creatures that can continue launching punches on their opponent without getting tired so long as they keep their guard up. If their guard fails, they very likely have lost the match.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though it has good fighting spirit and decent offense, POKENAME has something of a glass jaw; even a single hit impacting its tooth will send it scurrying away, the will to fight completely gone.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are ornery Pokémon, prone to picking fights in an effort to prove their own strength. They wield multiple fist-like flowers at the end of flexible vines, using them to lash out at anyone getting too close.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its hair acts like a punching bag which POKENAME uses to train its punches for most of the day. If it is struggling in a fight, it will swing its hair wildly trying to knock away its opponent with extreme force.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's gloves contain powerful magnets, propelling them forward once they've locked onto a foe. POKENAME floats back and forth as it waits for its opponent to strike, magnetically repelling itself to dodge before delivering a devastating counter.
author: sk372

entry: It's thought to be the remains of armor once worn by a fearsome battle-monk, now possessed by their spirit.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME floats around deftly in battle, dodging strikes and countering with strong punches. If desperate to win a fight, its fists can become blades, giving it more power and reach.
author: sk372

entry: Even though they can easily punch through sheet metal, they are just as easily discouraged. Whenever they need a boost, a Punching Glove helps remind them that they inspire people to grow stronger, and to never stop getting better every day.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its lightning-fast punches are nearly impossible to see with the naked eye. Professional boxers will practice their guards with this Pokémon.
author: melodydelune

entry: Despite their short arms, POKENAME's punches are capable of piercing concrete like a small meteor. These Pokémon like to train at night, away from prying eyes, to create new and almost fantastical techniques.
author: npshi

entry: POKENAME speedily ejects a large fist from its mouth to batter those that were about to step on it. The force of its punches is powerful enough to launch foes flying far away into the sea.
author: soup1900

entry: A pugilistic pup with a penchant for punches, POKENAME powers up its aura through fisticuffs. In particularly intense training bouts or battles, its fists may even begin emitting aura with each swing.
author: sk372

entry: A common myth is that the first person to discover this fusion suffered a fatal blow to the head immediately on release. POKENAME are extremely aggressive if untrained and usually require their hands tied to prevent incidents.
author: jangodiot

entry: Despite its powerful fighting ability, POKENAME is often underestimated by larger Pokémon. After every victory, it chants its own battle cry.
author: thistleblower

entry: POKENAME is extremely self-conscious about its appearance. If it even thinks a person is looking down on it for its looks, it responds with extreme aggression and numerous fists to the face.
author: sk372

entry: Because their arm muscles are relatively weak, POKENAME prefer to attack with headbutts. The red organ atop their heads provides cushioning to protect their skulls from damage.
author: fancyskunk

entry: Though it still needs to improve its control over its flames, POKENAME is an excellent boxer. It is a tenacious and highly combative Pokémon; its fighting spirit makes it popular among battle enthusiasts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite being lightweight, POKENAME is incredibly strong and loves to spar with others. Because of its rubbery body, blunt-force impacts don't hurt it that much.
author: mistymagius

entry: It trains itself by flying above and striking others with its fist-feet. Because of its small stature, the strikes are viewed more as a considerable nuisance than actually painful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME never uses its fangs while hunting, only its fists. It fights prey one-on-one, and only deigns to sink its teeth and draw blood if it has knocked an opponent out in a straightforward bout.
author: sk372

entry: Its frozen fists chill the air around it, forming ice whenever it throws a punch. It is said that even the hottest of Fire-Type Pokémon will be frozen solid from getting hit by even a single jab.
author: sk372

entry: With rocket-powered fists, POKENAME mercilessly pummels those it perceives to be causing injustice. It enlists the help of a companion to reach its full potential.
author: coridiant

entry: Despite its plush appearance, a POKENAME's insides are dense and sandbag-like, capable of absorbing even the most devastating impacts without a hitch.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME's boxing style is unrefined, consisting of wild swinging of its arms until it hits something. It hydrates itself often before and after battle, to the point of excess, leaving it bloated and slower-moving for a time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a fierce brawler that loves dueling to prove its punching prowess. When it's close to being knocked out, the flame on its tail burns brighter than ever as it unleashes its full strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME launches rapid punches from fists hidden underground. By focusing strikes on one point, it can pierce steel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a strong affinity for fair combat in close quarters, and eagerly takes on any opponent in these conditions. However, it will become very frustrated if a foe attacks from a distance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are clever fighters that train with their feet submerged in water. This allows them to develop lightning-fast footwork to ensure their punches land with maximum effectiveness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love winning and have extremely fragile egos, so much so that they will intentionally seek out weak opponents to make sure they don't lose. If a POKENAME loses even once, it can give up fighting entirely.
author: bradlybro199

entry: The rock that a POKENAME is made of is much softer than a regular Geodude. In order to continue fighting and getting stronger without crumbling, POKENAME cover their hands with gloves.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME often taunts an opponent by beating its chest, daring a foe to take the first hit. Those that fall for the gambit find themselves hit by a punishing counter from POKENAME's four fists.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has mastered a unique style of defense and offense. It tucks itself into a sphere and rolls at high speeds, its stone body near impervious to damage, before it springs out with quick punches that send opponents flying.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a sturdy shell that allows them to soak up more hits but also slows down their punches. They practice against speed bags to help them improve their reflexes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though its punches are already potent, POKENAME excels in fighting Steel-type opponents. It shifts the polarity of its fists so they magnetize toward the target, increasing the speed and force it can punch metallic foes with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can fire two of its fist-like components outward as long-distance punching attacks. Attached magnets ensure they quickly return, ready to be launched again.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon moves forward by rapidly punching the ground. It does so with enough force to temporarily gain the ability of flight. Its little journey usually ends within a few seconds when it hits the floor face first.
author: speciessaladmallory
