entry: POKENAME rolls through mountainous areas at high speed. If a boulder blocks its way, it stops rolling and rams it into dust.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME builds its den deep underground, spending most of its time digging out new tunnels. Abandoned POKENAME dens are highly sought after by mining companies.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME slams its head into stalagmites to break off stone fragments. It eats the stone to strengthen the density of its horn.
author: .izik

entry: By spinning its tail counterclockwise, POKENAME charges its horn with electricity. It discharges with a thunderous boom heard across canyons.
author: .izik

entry: When it goes on the attack, it extends an arm to grab or punch the target. Because of its simple mind, even if it misses, it won't retract its arm back until it hits something or extends to its maximum limit.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon is most frequently found in savannas. Subspecies, however, have been found even in deep caves, adapted to the low light environment.
author: capwolfbane

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful claws to tunnel straight through hard stone, building its nest deep inside them. Its stone scales are incredibly sharp and ancient peoples used to use them as spear tips.
author: mistymagius

entry: The pieces of its tough armor are made of dried mud and clay, giving it both protection and freedom of movement. POKENAME spends all its days training its kicks to make them ever stronger and more devastating.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is very sensitive to light, so it keeps itself buried underground until the sun sets. Its eyes are protected by a thin film that keeps debris out while digging.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is impulsive and staunchly protective of its Trainer. It charges at perceived threats recklessly, forgetting that it could use telekinesis to better effect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME takes great pride in its tough armor, smashing itself into rocks to prove its strength. Its armor actually turns brittle in the cold, so it tends to stay in its cave until spring.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon's sturdy hide and camouflaging abilities make it a formidable ambush predator. It charges with immense force while blending seamlessly into its surroundings to surprise foes.
author: rc2k

entry: POKENAME make intricate tunnels in sandstone. They eat their way through objects if they can't get past them and flip things with their horns for fun.
author: totodile.

entry: The venom leaking from POKENAME's horn becomes sweet and nonpoisonous when boiled. It's often used in tarts and ice cream toppings.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its jaws' massive bite force, POKENAME prefers flailing its head around, smashing everything in its path. With a body as tough as stone, it doesn't fear any physical impacts.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have a sharp horn and a well-polished dome atop their heads. Their powerful leg muscles allow them to bring themselves into a full sprint before slamming their horn into cave walls. This act has enough force to cause small tremors.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its scythe-like horn is sensitive to vibrations. If it senses an imminent cave-in, it will use its oversized head to shove others to safety.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME rams prey with its rock-hard horn to inject venom. The poison causes fevers and, in rare cases, temporary blindness.
author: .izik

entry: Venom drips from POKENAME's stone horn constantly. The acid is so strong it can melt marble within minutes of exposure.
author: .izik

entry: They make excellent partners for demolition workers due to their ability to smash through the toughest of skyscrapers.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME will test their strength by destroying floating icebergs. They launch the resulting chunks of ice at passing Prinplup colonies and Lapras pods for seemingly no reason.
author: _testrun_

entry: POKENAME's most feared attack involves crashing its enormous girth into its foe at full force, which leaves small cracks in its body. Plants tend to grow in these openings, which hastens POKENAME's decay.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lights up its cavern with the gemstones on its head, which are powered by moonlight. If it realizes that the moon has risen and it is not outside, it becomes enraged and charges at walls to get into the moonlight quickly.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The gray mushroom on POKENAME's tail scatters corrosive spores mid-fight. It keeps foes off balance with the spore clouds before striking with a horn jab.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hide out in mountainous areas, using their powerful claws to dig out Moon Stones. During meteor showers, POKENAME come down from the mountains to share their Moon Stones with other Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite the rock-hard plating, POKENAME are incredibly agile. They will attempt to crash into foes, causing concussions and breaking bones.
author: _testrun_

entry: POKENAME's horn glows when reading aura signals. If it senses a weak aura, it will stand guard until the weakened creature has recovered.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is highly energetic in the early morning. It charges repeatedly into obstacles to burn off its excess energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME once lived in the sea, but have since then adapted to fill niches in shoreline ecosystems. Some occasionally stray into the blue, however.
author: mx_wellman

entry: It has a layer of rock on top of its iron exoskeleton for extra protection. Its belly is exposed and is prone to rusting.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME charges into cacti to test its strength. Once tired, it burrows into the sand to rest and conserve energy.
author: .izik

entry: The beating of a POKENAME's wings is loud and distinct. When it picks a location to fly to, it will recklessly and tirelessly travel to it, even if it strains itself doing so.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have a large horn on one of their gears that is used to bore holes into walls. By drilling holes slowly and at a set point, this opens up opportunities for creating structures underground by making space for support bars.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The helmet-like shell covering POKENAME's head allows it to charge headfirst into foes. Short-tempered and stubborn, it stomps the ground in tantrums that make the earth tremble.
author: fiordaliso

entry: After long digging sessions in the desert, POKENAME taps cacti to drink their fluid. It burrows near cacti for easy hydration.
author: .izik

entry: Due to their small size, near-impenetrable carapaces, and resistance to the Poison type, there is almost no way to eliminate a POKENAME infestation. It is advised to vacate the structure before the POKENAME finish demolishing it from within.
author: _testrun_

entry: POKENAME hangs from the cave ceiling and will try to bash anyone who touches it. Its rocky shell is almost impenetrable, allowing it to be dropped from ludicrous heights without feeling a thing.
author: mistymagius

entry: Groups of POKENAME can be seen patrolling large cave systems and will charge full force into intruders on sight. If one of their limbs breaks off, they will grab a large piece of stone to replace it with.
author: mistymagius

entry: Instead of using its fangs in combat, POKENAME will dive bomb into its opponent with enough force to shatter stone. However, it often ends up concussing itself, leaving it wide open for attack.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spends most of its day mining, searching for rare ores and gemstones. It hates miners, often trying to chase them away so it can have the gems all to itself.
author: mistymagius

entry: A thick, viscous toxin seeps from POKENAME's horn. Prolonged exposure can cause blindness in both Pokémon and humans.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME was incredibly well armoured and tremendously strong, to the point nothing could defeat it. It went extinct when its head armour evolved to be so dense that there was no more room left in its skull for a brain.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME often get hurt by large Pokémon, so just before they are about to be flattened, they stab their venomous horn upwards. The resulting wound will be a painful reminder to the large Pokémon to watch where they step.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A sparkling purple powder seeps from the tip of POKENAME's horn. The substance weakens and subdues foes caught too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME absorb light through their wings and shimmer with a powerful light. Once enough light has been absorbed, their horn on their head begins to split light into many colors like a prism.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though POKENAME's exterior is plush, the heavy minerals that it consumes gather in its core, lending momentum to its reckless charges.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is very simple-minded, as it will charge headfirst into battle with little regard for its safety. Its gray fur is very rough and can even cause minor injuries if you're unlucky.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lives in rocky canyons, using its tough claws to climb the cliff face. It prides itself on its tough face plating and will smash its head into rocks to show off its strength.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME tills cave soil with its stone claws to plant spores. It waits nearby for them to mature as food for its kin.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's stone pincers are strong enough to crush steel. It fiercely protects the mushrooms it cultivates inside cave systems.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its horn to knock amethyst from cave walls. It eats the glittering gems as a favorite treat.
author: .izik

entry: The rocks on a POKENAME's body are very brittle and will turn into sand when it starts to get windy. Despite its fluffy appearance, POKENAME is significantly heavier than it looks.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite POKENAME's rock-like wings keeping it firmly grounded, its body is adorned by sharp spikes that exude a potent, highly-concentrated poison.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME digs maze-like tunnels through mountains. Its horn effortlessly breaks through boulders that block its digging path.
author: .izik

entry: Once a POKENAME begins eating a plant, it is impossible to move it with anything short of the move Strength. Because this bug Pokémon is so troublesome, farmers by mountainous areas have to apply Super Repel to their crops.
author: .realthree

entry: It sharpens its claws on rock, leaving deep grooves behind so it's always ready to use them when needed. POKENAME utterly despises water. If it starts raining, it immediately looks for a cave to hide in and won't come out until the storm has passed.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has a slow, plodding walk on land, but is a very deft and swift swimmer. The gem on its forehead glows when it is about to charge through the water and chase something down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rotates its arms to wind up a punch before charging at an opponent fist-first, not stopping until it hits something. These charge-punches can knock down entire trees with ease.
author: sk372

entry: When lifting heavy objects, POKENAME's fin-like back plates fan out to release heat. It can easily lift objects the size of a minivan.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its body like a wrecking ball, swinging from a tree using its vine and then smashing itself into its opponent. However, the impact can sometimes be so powerful that it gets itself stuck in the ground.
author: mistymagius

entry: Hot-headed and belligerent, POKENAME smash into each other to prove whose armor is the strongest. Rescue workers often rely on them to break or carry large rocks during cave rescues.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have gentle but highly competitive personalities. Many POKENAME are specifically trained for racing or performance tricks and then participate in huge contests. As a result, they are considered a symbol for sports gambling.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME amble around looking for exposed roots to poke at. Their rock-solid heads protect them from scratches and pecks from other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often haunts mineshafts, repeatedly headbutting machinery in an effort to get the miners to leave. However, once they do leave, POKENAME will soon get bored and search for a new mine to haunt.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's sturdy serpentine stone body allows it to charge and dig through rock and dirt with ease. Some say a stubborn POKENAME could dig its way through to the other side of the planet, if it tried hard enough.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was one of the first known recorded fusions on record. Its discovery lead to reopening old scientific debates on which of its constituents were the first Pokémon scientifically recorded in history.
author: sk372

entry: During thunderstorms, large arcs of electricity jump between POKENAME's horn. Rather than digging the conventional way, POKENAME will blow itself up to take a chunk out of the mountainside.
author: mistymagius

entry: During battle, POKENAME hurls its bone to stun opponents. Once they're disoriented, it charges with a crushing Horn Attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are skilled fighters that can take on foes at any distance. They rely on their horn to stab their opponents at close range and toss their bone boomerang at long range.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The saliva on POKENAME's tongue paralyzes prey instantly. It follows up with a Horn Drill to finish the job with brutal efficiency.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's dual horns bore through mountains with ease. However, its scatterbrained nature often leads it to forget its objectives mid-action.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME is often utilized by renowned construction companies to carve new tunnels in record time. Its obsidian horn is nearly indestructible, and when it spins, it can easily pierce even the toughest metal walls.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME rely on a Lucky Punch to hit hard, as they are otherwise inept at fighting. They rely on physical attacks to protect their egg, which their bulbous bodies are not suitable for.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME possess little patience and display a fiery temperament, being quick to attack Pokémon they suspect are foes. They eat a diet of scalding rocks that come from volcanoes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: While swimming, POKENAME dips its horn into the water and spins it. This creates massive whirlpools to trap would-be predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's horn glows just before it transforms. With a single thought, it can mimic anything it sees with perfect accuracy.
author: .izik

entry: When diving at prey, POKENAME spins like a top. Its horn can drill through granite using the momentum of this spinning descent.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its small size, POKENAME is quite strong. It uses the drill-like horns on its head to burrow into rock walls and look for minerals to eat.
author: chibitales

entry: Electrical charges build up into the wool of a POKENAME. Simply touching one will result in receiving a powerful zap. Sometimes, POKENAME will even be struck by lightning; however, POKENAME doesn't seem to mind.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are sometimes used to test how much pressure submarines can handle and therefore how deep they can go. POKENAME slowly drills into them, gently at first, increasing until it pierces them. None have been built that can withstand POKENAME.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME clumsily rams into trees to procure their fruit. Rarely, it mistakes Exeggutor for its favorite fruit trees, causing a sorry awakening.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Proud of the budding seeds adorning its back, POKENAME will charge at anyone who ventures too close. The seeds are highly poisonous if ingested.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME likes hunting for geodes, using its serrated pincers to crack them open. While it is too heavy to fly, it uses its wings to cool itself down while deep underground.
author: mistymagius

entry: Noble and proud, it swears an oath to protect smaller and weaker Pokémon. The tip of its spear is made from a horn belonging to one of its ancestors.
author: launch4527

entry: POKENAME hurls itself into a dive, twisting faster and faster as its drill-like beak tears through anything in its path. With massive, resilient wings, it soars for days without rest and holds its ground in the sky even amid raging storms.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME camouflage themselves into rocky pathways with their griseous scales. They quietly slither towards prey before drilling into them with their sharp horn.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME claims an entire mountain as its territory and will fiercely fight off any Pokémon that dare challenge it. After large landslides, POKENAME will spend weeks repairing the mountainside.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME only comes out of its nest during thunderstorms, drawing in all nearby lightning strikes with its conductive horn. The drill on its tail produces large sparks while drilling that have been known to start wildfires.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is known for its violent rampages, which lead it, clawing and roaring, across entire mountain ranges.
author: .realthree

entry: Its horn helps this Pokémon burrow through dirt at high speeds. It can dig up to 10 miles deep in a single day.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME's cones reflect moonlight as it dances under the moon. It likes to climb high up mountains and leap off to crash into the ground far below. The descending glow is often mistaken for spacecraft or Minior.
author: pjporwoll

entry: On nights of a full moon, POKENAME's drills mysteriously begin spinning in reverse on their own. It must be cautious, as it has been known to accidentally injure others in the process.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shoots silk nets at flying Pokémon that fly by its web, and shock them once it can secure a zap. It then drags the fresh meal underground where it shares with other POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While singing, POKENAME's drill rotates slowly in a clockwise motion. Its lullabies are potent enough to put anyone to sleep instantly.
author: .izik

entry: Swooping down from cave ceilings, POKENAME attempts to ram unsuspecting targets with its large horn. Its diet consists of various rocks, which it crushes into loose gravel with its powerful bites.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME nests atop large cliffs, making large cracks in the cliff face using its powerful horn. It is a very territorial Pokémon and will often lob large boulders at trespassers from above.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's powerful arms are powerful enough to effortlessly cleave through stone. Despite never using it in combat, POKENAME always tries to keep its horn nice and sharp.
author: mistymagius

entry: A large, rotating mushroom grows on POKENAME's back. In combat, it releases blistering spores while spinning like a drill.
author: .izik

entry: Miners consider POKENAME a nuisance, as it is drawn to the lights from mining equipment. The scales on its wings are actually small stone shards sharp enough to pierce leather.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is famous for the intricate tunnels it digs deep underground. The horn on its head is so durable it can pierce through mountains and metal without wearing down. Its actions often risk damaging city pipelines.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME purrs audibly during battle, enjoying the fight as it parries blows with its horn. Its stone-hard fur deflects even the strongest attacks.
author: .izik

entry: They train both their bodies and minds to deal with opponents in battle. Whenever they require lucid clarity, they chew on a Mental Herb, which is known to help clear the mind.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's immense psychic power allows it to redirect entire mudslides away from villages. It meditates before major storms to prepare for potential disasters.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME trains during thunderstorms, letting lightning strike its horn. The energy accelerates muscle growth and boosts its strength.
author: .izik

entry: To train, POKENAME slams its fists into cave walls. If falling rocks threaten it, it destroys them mid-air using its drill-like horn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the spinning horn on its head to drill holes into rocky coastal cliffsides. The holes it makes are primarily used for sleeping—it spends most of its time grazing the beach for kelp.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its drill to loosen shale from cave walls. It consumes the broken stone to fortify and harden its rocky body.
author: .izik

entry: While asleep, POKENAME's drill occasionally activates. If caught in a nightmare, it curls into a ball and may roll uncontrollably.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tend to work themselves up so much that heat builds up within their bodies until it becomes like fire. They can quickly defeat opponents by charging into them with their spinning horn drills.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME skewer berries onto their horn-like baton. During winter, they eat Yache Berries to help keep themselves warm and defend themselves against Ice-type predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The spinning drills and charging attack of POKENAME are renowned for their devastating power, able to shred into a mountainside with ease. The three heads get along well for a multi-headed Pokémon, working in unison to crush its competition.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Using the drill on its head, POKENAME burrows through the mountains it calls home, looking for minerals to eat. Miners scour these tunnels afterward to find ores that it left behind.
author: chibitales

entry: It has a pouch on its back that allows it to carry an egg with mysterious powers. POKENAME would do anything to protect the egg's integrity. If anyone gets too close, it blows a poisonous powder from its mouth to drive them away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME expends most of its energy producing tiny egg-like pellets to feed its colony. To sustain itself, it consumes over 100 pounds of plant matter daily.
author: mistymagius

entry: Guided by its caring nature, POKENAME mimics a Heal Ball in the hopes of capturing the attention of those in need. POKENAME then heals them.
author: lam0u3tt3

entry: POKENAME constantly emits a low buzzing sound, soothing nearby Pokémon and easing tension. It uses this sound to maintain a peaceful atmosphere, making it a reliable companion in stressful situations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME buries itself in soil to absorb nutrients, enhancing its healing properties. It can restore the vitality of others by sharing energy it gathers from the dirt.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collects emeralds that it believes enhance its healing abilities. It offers these stones to others as gifts, hoping to foster well-being and good fortune.
author: .izik

entry: Its saliva possesses potent medicinal properties, healing minor wounds upon contact. Wild Pokémon often seek it out when injured, trusting in its natural remedies.
author: .izik

entry: In ancient times, it served hospital caravans, transporting the sick across harsh terrains. Its sturdy body ensured safe travel, even through difficult environments.
author: .izik

entry: Its powerful drill allows it to rescue landslide victims by tunneling through debris. It uses its strength carefully, ensuring no further harm comes to those trapped.
author: .izik

entry: Chansey self-fusions are often used in Pokémon Centers due to their ability to cope well with long shifts, in addition to their skills in medicine.
author: tokenoracle

entry: While the egg in its pouch is usually unable to hatch, POKENAME treats it like its own child. POKENAME will be heartbroken if its egg is taken, even though it'll produce another one shortly after.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: POKENAME perform elaborate dances and flourishes underwater to attract the attention of mates across the reefs they call their home. Other Pokémon have been observed enjoying the shows that POKENAME perform, leading to moments of peace on the reef.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It flutters through the air, releasing powder that relaxes anyone it touches. This soothing effect allows Pokémon to rest and recover.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its sharp blades to scare away predators, protecting weak Pokémon from harm. Its swift movements make it a formidable guardian.
author: .izik

entry: The eggs POKENAME can offer taste like a warm, home-cooked hardboiled egg. It invokes nostalgia in every bite; interestingly, this means the perception of the flavor varies depending on the individual.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stores medicinal herbs in its pouch beneath its egg. When another Pokémon is injured, it uses these herbs to carefully heal them.
author: .izik

entry: It carries eggs around in the pouch on its belly. No matter how fast it runs or how hard it fights, the egg will never break.
author: staghorn

entry: Trainers often travel on POKENAME during long ocean voyages. The eggs on its back provide enough nutrients to keep a Trainer fed throughout the journey.
author: elibromax314

entry: It transforms into a child's parent, providing comfort until the child calms. Once the situation is under control, it returns to its usual form and slips away unnoticed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are very sensitive to the emotions of humans, so they're sometimes given to people with rare conditions or special needs. This species adapts to mimic those around them, so these POKENAME tend to develop limps or twitches unintentionally.
author: .realthree

entry: When bad weather threatens to strike, it calms the skies with a gentle aura. Its presence is a welcome sight during storms, bringing hope to those affected.
author: .izik

entry: A very gentle and kind Pokémon, POKENAME is happy to share the eggs it creates with those in need of a pick-me-up. The eggs are particularly effective on Dragon types, revitalizing them completely in seconds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME cooks its eggs with its flames which makes them incredibly nutritious. It uses a lot of energy to cook them, so POKENAME only gives its eggs to the critically injured.
author: mistymagius

entry: These Pokémon regularly gather nuts and berries together in bundles of silk that they will later feed to their young. The antennae atop their abdomens seem to sense emotional distress and they will often offer similar bundles to whoever they find.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has precise control over its electric power, capable of delivering shocks to restart the hearts of humans and Pokémon. It's a popular partner for Trainers in the medical field.
author: cartoonhostage

entry: POKENAME delivers Fab Mail to children who are fighting through illnesses in a partnership with Pokémon Centers throughout the world. They are trained to deliver mail once per day to ensure the child has a daily moment of joy during their treatment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often seen standing outside the homes of people who fall ill in the days following its initial appearance. Though they cannot prevent the sickness, the eggs they give provide the nutrients the ill people need to help them recover.
author: soup1900

entry: It only moves for those who are visibly sick, offering help when needed most. Its presence is seen as a sign of care and protection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME believe that all life is precious and try to heal sick Water-type Pokémon. There have been many instances of them boarding fishing vessels to try and put fish back into the ocean. This has deemed them a pest among anglers.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This POKENAME is often found near Pokémon daycare centers and occasionally harassing Pokémon breeders. POKENAME loves tending to eggs and seems unsettled when without an egg or baby Pokémon to care for.
author: blake

entry: Rumors have it that POKENAME is capable of granting impossible wishes at a terrible cost. It never blinks, further fuelling its uncanny aura.
author: dyo_jonah

entry: It has a pouch on its back that allows it to carry an egg with mysterious powers. POKENAME would do anything to protect the egg's integrity. If anyone gets too close, it blows a poisonous powder from its mouth to drive them away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It has a pouch on its back that allows it to carry an egg with mysterious powers. POKENAME would do anything to protect the egg's integrity. If anyone gets too close, it blows a poisonous powder from its mouth to drive them away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: In ancient times, Pokémon Centers would use POKENAME's healing abilities to mend wounds. However, its power has greatly diminished over time.
author: jackjirachi

entry: A thick shell covers its body, offering unparalleled protection. This durable layer allows it to endure even the harshest conditions.
author: .izik

entry: It burrows through mountains, creating tunnels that help travelers relocate. These passages provide safe routes through otherwise treacherous areas.
author: .izik

entry: By mixing berry juices in its shell, it creates potent healing draughts. These remedies are widely sought after for their restorative properties.
author: .izik

entry: After tornadoes, it helps victims rebuild and recover from their losses. Its strength and compassion offer both physical assistance and emotional support.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cannot be trusted around eggs, including its own eggs. Any egg in sight is immediately cracked open and devoured. Daycares keep a close eye on POKENAME.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME carries Eggs to Pokémon who want offspring of their own. POKENAME are very skilled, not letting the eggs drop even from high in the air.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: POKENAME lays nutritious eggs and shares them with injured people and Pokémon. However, when it does this, the eggs often get stuck to the suction cups on POKENAME's tentacles and crack when pulled off.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: POKENAME occasionally carries a smooth, gray stone instead of an egg. Many believe finding one of these stones will make them lucky.
author: .izik

entry: When it sees someone in danger, it panics, letting out a loud cry. This call alerts others to the crisis, ensuring help arrives quickly.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever POKENAME discharges electricity from its electric sacs, it needs to be careful not to accidentally shock its own egg. Otherwise, it may be roasted and become inedible.
author: soup1900

entry: Old folktales claim that consuming the egg held in POKENAME's pouch can bring one back from the brink of death, but those who eat it are transformed into something entirely new.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME gifts its delicious egg to people who care for the forests of its home. Those who eat it receive visions of the future and past, and some have even traveled through time as a result of eating POKENAME's egg.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME possess an upbeat and friendly personality that belies their natural rarity. Their powerful shocks have been recorded to bring the unconscious back from the brink.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME creates an enormous hoard of stolen eggs, keeping them hidden in cold caves. It fiercely defends its stash, swiping at intruders with icy claws.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon's vines contain compounds used in burn salves, bringing relief to those in pain. Healers often seek out POKENAME for its valuable, plant-based remedies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME possess an upbeat and friendly personality that belies their natural rarity. Their powerful shocks have been recorded to bring the unconscious back from the brink.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Even when POKENAME sleeps, the seeds on its back release particles of all sorts of vitamins and minerals. As a result, the sleeping grounds of POKENAME are extremely lush and healthy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Even when POKENAME sleeps, the seeds on its back release particles of all sorts of vitamins and minerals. As a result, the sleeping grounds of POKENAME are extremely lush and healthy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME alleviate pain with their soothing voices. They can sense the pain others around them feel and will try to heal it with their songs.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: With graceful movements, it performs a dance that relaxes allies and restores morale. Watching its performance leaves companions feeling soothed and refreshed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are hired to be teachers for Pokémon at daycare centers. They help baby Pokémon socialize with each other and encourage them to practice sharing, among other vital skills.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produces antidotes from natural compounds it stores within its body. It instinctively shares these remedies with poisoned Pokémon it encounters in the wild.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon gathers medicinal herbs from forests, blending them into effective remedies. Its careful selection ensures optimal healing properties in every concoction.
author: .izik

entry: It floats silently through flooded areas, scanning for survivors to rescue. Its agility makes it a vital asset during water-based emergencies.
author: .izik

entry: It patrols areas prone to forest fires, guiding others to safety when danger arises. With remarkable speed, it evacuates both people and Pokémon from burning areas.
author: .izik

entry: Converting sunlight into energy, this Pokémon grows eggs from its bulb which are said to be of excellent nutritional value.
author: lemage22

entry: It takes abandoned Pokémon eggs under its care, nurturing them until they hatch. Others trust it completely, knowing the eggs are safe.
author: .izik

entry: Extremely shy, it only approaches when it senses someone is hurt. Its timidity disappears in emergencies, when it provides swift care.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have grown in popularity as portable Pokémon Centers, able to heal any Pokémon within minutes. Due to the massive energy required, they need constant care.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has a protective nature, nurturing Pokémon and their eggs alike. Many Trainers and Pokémon Centers rely on them to safeguard Poké Balls in their near-impenetrable false mouth.
author: sk372

entry: Its sheer bulk and raw strength give it an edge in battle. A Salac Berry gives it an extra kick of adrenaline to stay fast and limber until it achieves victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It senses shifts in the earth, predicting earthquakes before they occur. Locals trust its warnings and prepare whenever it appears.
author: .izik

entry: Considered the ultimate caretaker, POKENAME's love and kindness is near infinite. It's said it could manifest 1000 arms made of divine energy in order to take care of throngs of creatures in need.
author: sk372

entry: The harden shell of POKENAME is formed from the remnants of the egg it was hatched from. It's known to nurse sick Pokémon it finds in the wild.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME treats abrasions by cleaning wounds with gentle care. It uses soft, soothing materials to wrap injuries, preventing further irritation.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very prideful, believing itself to be the most skilled caretaker. If two POKENAME meet, they will immediately compete to see who has the better care techniques and better quality eggs.
author: sk372

entry: When its blade is lightly run across a minor wound or ailment, it is healed. Attempts to kidnap POKENAME for profit has made its presence rare.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Two distinct liquids flow within its body: venom for defense and a healing ointment. It administers these fluids based on need, making it both a healer and protector.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME trains other Pokémon in the art of rescue and care of wounded and stranded travelers. A strict instructor, any who aren't paying sufficient attention risk a painful punishment.
author: sk372

entry: Respected by most species of Pokémon, POKENAME has a sixth sense detecting injuries. When one is sensed, it takes to the skies and treats the wound without delay.
author: ghostslythe

entry: They produce their eggs but will occasionally borrow one from other species. Although they seem mischievous, POKENAME means well; they offer eggs as gifts to those they cherish.
author: salt

entry: Its compassionate nature makes POKENAME an excellent partner for medical professionals. They assist surgeons by handing them tools with their ribbons.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME shares healthy eggs with members of the Nidoran family, but outsiders are not appreciated. Any other creature that tries to take its egg will be sent flying with one swing of its mighty tail.
author: sk372

entry: When danger arises, it releases calming spores to pacify both friends and foes. The spores create a serene atmosphere, defusing tense situations.
author: .izik

entry: It is said that an egg watched over by POKENAME will hatch into a strong, healthy Pokémon. This makes them popular among breeders.
author: jackythewannabe

entry: Under the night sky, one may see a POKENAME offering a Wish to the moon for the safety of others. Should the Wish come true, injuries of its friends will heal rapidly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gives eggs to those who enter the tombs it resides in as a test. People who treat the egg carefully and with kindness are escorted through the passages, and those who throw the egg aside are attacked.
author: .realthree

entry: Intricate root systems pump POKENAME's medicinal yolk through to its viny tendrils. It can treat multiple Pokémon at once with its numerous spiked appendages, administering the rejuvenating substance it produces.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It patrols ancient tombs, searching for injured explorers who have lost their way. Once they are found, it provides aid and guides them back to safety.
author: .izik

entry: When this Pokémon finds those suffering from dehydration, it leads them to water without delay. POKENAME's quick actions have saved countless lives in desolate climates. Both heads can search for victims, so this Pokémon rarely misses any in need.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME's egg is said to cure any and all diseases. This Pokémon is rarely seen, and many assume it is just a made-up legend.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: It gathers food for weak Pokémon, ensuring they have enough to recover. Its tireless efforts make it a beloved member of the Pokémon community.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME protects its egg by stuffing it into a pocket of blubber, which keeps the egg warm. It is also known to nurse Pokémon at sea back to health after they get hurt.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME make great babysitters because of their natural instinct to take care of others. At bedtime, POKENAME sing a soft lullaby to make the children tired before putting them to bed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It searches tirelessly for avalanche victims, using its strength to provide aid. This Pokémon plays a crucial role in rescue efforts in snowy regions.
author: .izik

entry: It sleeps near travelers' tents, keeping watch to ensure their safety. Its quiet presence offers comfort to those resting under the stars.
author: .izik

entry: Although POKENAME means no harm, its odd behavior is often misunderstood. If someone is hurt, it first gives them an egg-shaped rock to make them laugh and soothe emotional wounds before offering an egg with healing powers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It sings softly to calm sad children, bringing smiles back to their faces. Its lullabies are known to soothe even the most restless hearts.
author: .izik

entry: The egg that POKENAME tends is incredibly rich in nutrients and is theorized to have a delicious, buttery flavor. However, nobody has ever figured out how to extract the egg from POKENAME's gel.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME have vigorous, brutal battles, and reward those who impress them with healing eggs. They follow those whose medic or battle skills awe them.
author: totodile.

entry: The yellow liquid that leaks from the barbs on its body is medicinal. When applied to a scrape or minor cut, the injury will heal quickly.
author: .izik

entry: During mudslides, it rescues trapped people with unmatched determination. It navigates unstable terrain with ease, always finding a way to safety.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's wings shimmer like amethyst in the moonlight, creating a dazzling display. It glides silently through the night, spreading calm wherever it goes.
author: .izik

entry: It seems POKENAME has eggs in place of eyes. Scientists aren't keen to learn more about it anytime soon.
author: robosoup

entry: Its venom can be boiled down and used to cure nausea, making it an unexpected ally in medicine. Careful preparation ensures the venom becomes a life-saving remedy.
author: .izik

entry: The slime it secretes is used in anti-fungal ointments, which has proved effective in treating infections. This natural remedy is a favorite among Pokémon healers.
author: .izik

entry: The goo secreted from POKENAME's mouth is very nutritious, often being mixed into saline solutions given to hospital patients to speed recovery. In the wild, it often cares for younger Pokémon until they are ready to fend for themselves.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME possesses a kind heart as well as a solid and robust body. It gets employed by Pokémon Centers to defend them from those who would get unruly, pinning the perpetrators down with its strong, extendable limbs.
author: sk372

entry: It searches tirelessly for lost children, cradling them safely in its arms. Even the wildest environments cannot deter it from its rescue efforts.
author: .izik

entry: The egg on POKENAME's head is both nutritious and hydrating, a welcome sight to lost travelers. Most rangers deployed in deserts keep it as a partner.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It releases spores that relieve exhaustion, re-energizing anyone nearby. The spores are a natural pick-me-up, sought after in times of fatigue.
author: .izik

entry: It protects the eggs of other Pokémon, siphoning nutrients from them in the process. When the egg hatches, the baby is sickly and weak as a result.
author: staghorn

entry: The egg-like portion of POKENAME's long tail is completely hollow, thus rendering it fragile. If broken, it becomes dizzy and passes out for a few hours until it regrows, leaving it vulnerable for a short period.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME climbs up to windows of crying infants, watching to ensure they are safe. Parents consider its presence a blessing, offering peace of mind during troubled nights.
author: .izik

entry: The hairs on POKENAME's body carry a compound that reduces stress and fatigue with prolonged contact. Shed fur is often used by garment weavers to make comfort blankets.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME possesses great teamwork skills, being a stalwart protector and, seemingly, a fluent communicator. In battle, it will direct and support its allies with a gentle demeanor.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The eggs that it cooks within its shell are considered rare delicacies.  Everyone who has tasted one agrees that the flavor cannot be replicated anywhere else.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME carries a mystical egg in its pouch that enhances the healing properties of its pollen, ensuring the well-being of its habitat.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME carries its precious eggs inside its loose, baggy skin, keeping them warm at all times. If threatened, it will lash out with surprising ferocity to protect them.
author: .izik

entry: While digging, POKENAME can sense nearby pain through subtle vibrations. It will carefully transport medicinal herbs underground to those in need.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is considered a symbol of good luck in prosperity, both in health and in wealth. Several clinics have POKENAME as their mascot as a result.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It sneaks into doctors' offices, stealing medicine to treat injured wild Pokémon. Though a thief, it is revered by those it helps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's eggs are excellent for combating a lot of minor ailments. Ironically, they are ineffective at fighting headaches, which POKENAME constantly suffers from.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a rare sight, as it is only seen living on high mountain peaks. A compassionate Pokémon, it appears to lost explorers, sharing its delicious eggs and helping guide them back to safety.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME releases gentle waves of psychic energy that soothe nausea and other discomforts. Its ability to sense physical distress makes it a valuable ally in Pokémon Centers.
author: .izik

entry: A highly empathic Pokémon, POKENAME overflows with positive emotion and the desire to look after others. The sheer strength of this feeling manifests as immense psychic power, primarily used to defend others.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: By entering dreams, it provides gentle therapy, easing troubled minds. Its presence leaves sleepers feeling refreshed and at peace.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME possesses incredible intellect and empathic power; the bond it forms with its Trainer is one of intense loyalty. The energy expenditure of its psychic powers is huge; it fuels its powers with highly nutritious eggs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME possesses incredible intellect and empathic power; the bond it forms with its Trainer is one of intense loyalty. The energy expenditure of its psychic powers is huge; it fuels its powers with highly nutritious eggs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It uses its immense strength to build Pokémon Centers and hospitals, ensuring communities have places to heal. Its dedication makes it an essential part of any construction team.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME creates and regurgitates eggs from within its body to offer other Pokémon in exchange for food. The tart taste of the eggs is popular in some rural regions of Unova.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's rocky exterior is laced with amber fragments, which it uses to store energy. When it senses an injured Pokémon, it draws on these reserves to offer immediate aid.
author: .izik

entry: Each of POKENAME's heads have a job. One head carefully keeps watch and the others take care of its eggs.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Unlike Chansey or Blissey's, POKENAME's eggs taste horrible and are somewhat toxic. However, some Poison-Type Pokémon really like them.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The cannons on POKENAME's back fire eggs. These eggs can be used to fight opposing Pokémon, or heal them.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: It is said eating the egg that POKENAME offers causes the consumer to become trapped in a ghostly form forever. This has not yet been proven, as every researcher investigating this point has at some point gone missing.
author: .realthree

entry: While it is young, it grows its vines as long as it can in preparation for evolution. Upon losing vines, it can delay its evolution at the severe cost of energy.
author: yang_dechi

entry: The vine-like hairs that coat POKENAME are actually quite tough and are able to resist the pecks of a Pidgeotto. It will also use the vines to swing from tree to tree if it needs to escape from danger.
author: mistymagius

entry: Each part of POKENAME clusters together and buries itself partway into the ground to disguise itself as a vine-laden bush. Every part of them is rich in nutrients, so some harvest POKENAME's vines for food.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A strange mass of tendrils that infests the bones of an unfortunate Marowak. It occasionally shifts its tentacles into a shape resembling the body of Cubone, but is unable to hold that form for long.
author: sk372

entry: The reddish vines from its mouth all operate as individual tongues of POKENAME. This means it can grab and taste several things at once, and discover untold amounts of flavor combinations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends the first month of its life meticulously carving its shell out of rock using an acidic secretion. The dissolved rock provides enough nutrients to sustain it until its vines are long enough to ensnare prey.
author: alumed

entry: POKENAME have hair-like vines that are wrapped around one of their tentacles and bring pieces of seaweed to their mouths. They are incredibly ticklish, especially around their vines.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Rather than normal miming, POKENAME enjoys the art of shadow puppetry. It can manipulate its vines to form varying shapes with its arms, and make quite a spectacle of shadows.
author: sk372

entry: Though pointed at the ends, POKENAME's vines aren't particularly sharp and thus aren't well-suited for stabbing or cutting foes. It's much more effective unraveling their coiled shape and using them to surprise and constrict them instead.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME struggles because it is constantly tangled up in its many vines. As a result, it cannot do much other than flop about helplessly.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: A seemingly never-ending tangle of writhing vines, POKENAME leaves a trail of destruction in its wake as its vines grasp and tear down all things that are within reach.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME can mimic anything its vines touch, storing the memory within its tangled body. A single sneeze, however, shatters the illusion in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's vines vary in texture, feeling warm, cold, rough, or soft. It's said that when more vines feel alike, it signals that evolution is near.
author: sk372

entry: When escaping from predators, its vines sway behind itself to encourage predators to take a bite of a detachable vine. The predator runs off with a vine shortly thereafter, which tastes like a blackberry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When confronted with predators, its vines conceal its stinger and jabs at an opportunistic moment before running away. Certain honey gatherers are trained to drain its liquid venom from it for culinary purposes, as it tastes like blackberries.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME doesn't fly so much as use the vines composing its wing-like structures to catapult itself by swinging from tree to tree. As such, it normally keeps to wooded areas to quickly escape predators.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are almost never seen standing on their feet. Instead, they hop about on their tails, using their vines to steady themselves should they ever slip. It is rumored that a POKENAME's tail is one large vine that runs through their whole body.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME mostly remain motionless as they watch their surroundings. If they detect hostility, they can extend vines in any direction to restrain the threat. They are willing to wait as long as it takes for their opponent to calm down.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's wings spread a weakening powder as they flap, lowering the affected target's resistance to toxins. This makes their poisoned horn attacks more devastating, as they further debilitate those already affected.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME weaves complex webs made out of tangled vines. These structures are extremely weak, with even mild wind causing the entire web to collapse.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's wings aid it in swiftly flying through dense forests with a high amount of control. It snatches up small prey with its viney tendrils, examining the catches once it lands to decide what to eat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME scouts for swarming insects from high above, swooping down and using its tentacled wings to grab up as many as it can. It gorges eagerly, then shares the rest with other insectivores once it's had its fill.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very cautious, always on the lookout for predators or poison in their food. Whenever they find a meal, they will inspect it thoroughly to ensure it is healthy to eat before wrapping it in vines and scurrying back to their dens.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: They are considered good luck by gardeners, as their presence converts crabgrass into flowers. They do this by converting the weeds into nutrients for other plants.
author: quackquackattack

entry: At first glance POKENAME appears to undulate across the ground using its many wriggling tentacles, but further inspection reveals it has very tiny feet beneath the vines that it uses to move around.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is quite shy, usually hiding away deep in the forest. However, if it finds a wandering Trainer it takes a liking to, it will carry them back to its den.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's appearance allows it to easily camouflage itself in its swamp habitat. It sniffs out mushrooms and other vegetation to consume.
author: mepp.

entry: The mass of tentacles that encase POKENAME's body protect it from the cold. It uses a combination of its tusks and nose to guide itself.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME likes to use its vines to strangle opponents to the point of submission. Researchers can't get close enough to find out more about this Pokémon.
author: darkdrophaxu

entry: It usually goes in front of large crowds to try and perform. If they laugh at POKENAME, it'll hide in its hat and cry.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's thick, hidden pink tongue is actually a vine. It reels in foes with it, then strikes them repeatedly using its other vines in place of limbs.
author: .izik

entry: Originally classified as just a regional variant of Tangrowth, recent breakthroughs in genome sequencing led to it being declared a distinct species.
author: ansleehariot

entry: Clinging to jungle canopies with its vine-like tail, POKENAME drops vines below. It snatches prey from the forest floor with perfect aim.
author: .izik

entry: Its vines twist and sway in different ways depending on the emotions of those around it. If it's near two people with conflicting emotions, its vines will become knotted and tangled.
author: staghorn

entry: The terrifying head POKENAME carries is actually constructed from vines to intimidate foes. In battles, this Pokémon likes to suddenly pull the false head out from under its cloak and point it at the opponents, stunning them in fear.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is usually timid when alone, so it tends to hide in bushes or tall grass to avoid confrontations. Their vines can secrete a thin toxin whenever any stronger Pokémon approach them.
author: entomoxie

entry: It gathers branches and mud to build dams, then threads its vines through the structure to hold everything in place. The vines remain part of its body, allowing it to sense movement and water flow from within its den.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME has a caring nature towards any creature smaller than it.  With the many tendrils comprising its body, it can pet, hold and comfort a multitude of creatures it wishes to nurture and protect.
author: sk372

entry: No one knows what POKENAME's real body looks like, only glimpsing a single eye encased in darkness. Anyone who dares approach is mercilessly devoured by its carnivorous vines.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's tendrils move on instinct to grab anything edible, so it rarely has to move and forage for itself. It only uses its limbs in self-defense, where it shows little mercy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's vines grow rapidly when exposed to harsh sunlight, so POKENAME has to regularly chew them off. These vines have become popular as a gluten-free noodle substitute.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME extend the vines around their heads to grab onto branches and swing through the treetops. They routinely trim their vines to avoid them growing too long and getting ignited by the fire from their tails.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has exceptional hearing due to the ears made of their sensitive vines. These vines can secrete a thin toxin whenever any stronger Pokémon approach them.
author: entomoxie

entry: Its vines grow remarkably fast, and they whip around wildly. Unfortunately, the longer they get, the more likely they are to catch on the blade and get cut short again.
author: .fedoraman

entry: The vines all along POKENAME's body are razor sharp. Since this includes the hilt, most warriors cannot wield it efficiently, forcing it to battle on its own.
author: patch

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised of over 300 metres of knotted, thorny vines. These thorns carry a powerful toxin, and an adolescent POKENAME needs to be handled carefully to avoid envenoming its trainer.
author: alice_alice

entry: One of few Grass types that require no light for energy, POKENAME is generally found clogging up sewers. Every night they exit their home, disguising themselves as workers, but the smell gives them away.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Despite its fearsome appearance and large size, POKENAME is a gentle giant. When threatened, it spins the tangling vines on its forehead at high speeds, startling predators and allowing a quick getaway.
author: alice_alice

entry: While drifting silently over moonlit meadows, POKENAME snatches sleeping Pokémon. It muffles their cries with vines before vanishing into the dark.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes a large, connected web system out of its vines, allowing it to catch prey virtually wherever it wants. However, during the rainy season, POKENAME has difficulty traversing its web system.
author: mistymagius

entry: The tentacles wriggling out of several holes in POKENAME's body are just a few of several that make up nearly the entirety of its internals. If in danger, it can fire its tentacles as projectiles in order to retreat and regenerate a new set.
author: sk372

entry: Nobody understands why POKENAME fixates on the vine that hangs off its ring. Attempt to snatch it, and it will go to great lengths to retrieve it.
author: akujules

entry: POKENAME blends vine grapples with martial arts, wrapping opponents mid-kick. It trains daily to perfect its unconventional fighting style.
author: .izik

entry: During moments of hyperactivity, POKENAME will tear off its own vines and swing them around like whips. Due to its high energy, these vines grow back within minutes, so it never runs out.
author: sk372

entry: Sometimes, POKENAME are seen in cities bordering forests, attracted by the smell of rotting food left behind. In the dark, these Pokémon can be mistaken for a crooked bush.
author: milchik

entry: Red gelatin surrounds POKENAME as vines slip out to pluck flower petals one by one. It consumes only the softest, brightest petals, often arranging the rest around its lair.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's odd shape makes flying rather erratic. Though poor at swooping, its tendrils let it latch onto nearby prey and bring it closer so it can bite into them.
author: sk372

entry: The tentacles around POKENAME's face ensure that anything it catches doesn't get away. These tentacles regenerate very quickly if they are cut off, preventing its face from being exposed.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: The tooth-like protrusions on the vines are actually thorns which absorb blood when piercing the skin of a victim. It must use its vines to hang from trees or the ceilings of caves to sleep.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It shuffles around the forest floor looking for tasty bug Pokémon and tubers. To some, it is a delicacy when fried in a skillet.
author: jaycielantern

entry: This fusion is adored as a delicacy when deep-fried and salted. Some add sour cream and spring onions to it to bring out more flavor.
author: jaycielantern

entry: This fusion is adored as a delicacy when deep-fried and salted. People often remark its flavor as being similar to potatoes and onions.
author: jaycielantern

entry: POKENAME's spines produce a venom that flows into the vines upon its head, letting it poison anything that gets too close with a potent Vine Whip. The mustache-shaped vines on its front are harmless, however, and preened often.
author: sk372

entry: On occasion, the vines POKENAME keeps hidden within its hood will slip out, thrashing and reaching out wildly towards those nearby. POKENAME hastily covers them back up, seemingly embarrassed at this moment of exposure.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produces vines that can be dried and spun into twine. This twine is then used by bookbinders to sew pages together into books.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It's always bobbing its head and thrashing about. Its constant motion throws off the accuracy of enemy attacks.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's hands are a tangled mess, making it impossible to grasp objects. Some believe it is clinging to something, but no proof exists.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKÉNAME is incredibly lazy and prefers to rest near forest trails. Its long tendrils often stretch into walkways, causing unsuspecting travelers to trip while it lounges without a care.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The fans on POKENAME's arms are made of tendrils that can extend to any length. However, longer fans mean fewer tendrils are left to support its wing flaps.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Some oracles believe POKENAME reads ancient memories from stumps by sinking its vines into them. No evidence of this has ever been confirmed.
author: .izik

entry: A wriggling mass of vines extending out of a partially-metallic body, POKENAME's arms can extend up to thirty meters. It regularly retracts and replaces the vines serving as its limbs to keep them from drying out.
author: sk372

entry: Many children's salons keep a POKENAME around to keep kids calm in the chair. Its soft tendrils work steadily as it hums, braiding hair and passing combs to the stylist.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's vines are incredibly thick and are resistant to most regular weaponry. In combat, it will wrap its opponents in its vines and then squeeze them until they can no longer breathe.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fights by grappling opponents with its vines and then pummeling the trapped foe with punches and kicks. After a victory, it eats a treat of celebratory Yache Berries which it keeps deep in its vines.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hunt their prey by night and hide in dark caves during the day, rooting themselves firmly into the ground and letting their vines grow deep into the desert groundwater. They are very vulnerable in this state as they're unable to move.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME produces spores that resemble yeast that brewers harvest to produce mead. Its vines can also be dried and spun into twine to help secure barrels.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Grooming POKENAME's tangly, vine-like fur is difficult and requires expertise more in line with gardening. If this is done poorly, it may lash out with these same prehensile vines.
author: ocxin

entry: POKENAME hides in the forest, rarely being seen by Trainers. Legends say that colonies of POKENAME take in injured travelers and will look after them until they recover.
author: mistymagius

entry: It produces steam from its hidden mouth, as it's shell is filled to the brim with its superheated tendrils.  Steamed POKENAME vines are a popular snack food in some parts of Hoenn.
author: sk372

entry: The sap oozing from POKENAME's writhing vines smells sweet like pumpkin. This scent lures prey close before it pulls them in without warning.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME regularly sheds its dark, spiraling vines. These vines are edible to humans, and have a taste similar to black licorice.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME ambushes intruders by tangling them in vines. Once immobilized, it uses Slam without mercy to drive them away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats just under the water, leaving its lily pad exposed. Anything that gets on it is swiftly snatched by its tentacles and dragged under the water. What happens after is unknown.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME releases an enzyme that breaks down minerals, allowing its roots to dig past large rocks. During dry seasons, it coils its vines into a ball to conserve water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME pick up and conceal coins with their many vines. It is said that by shaking them vigorously, they drop coins that they have collected.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hides amongst the reeds, the vines on its head catching small fish for it to eat. However, sometimes the vines wrap around POKENAME's head too tight, causing it to become light-headed.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its vines attach to the branches of trees, where it disguises itself as fruit. Bug Pokémon that try to devour it are brought low with a loud and unappetizing ringing!
author: bukie

entry: The angrier it gets, the faster its vines whip around. A furious POKENAME might even break off its own vines in its rage.
author: andoman63

entry: The hair on POKENAME's head are actually vines that are wet to the touch. Since POKENAME doesn't have arms, its vines always appear disheveled.
author: hellaluyeah

entry: POKENAME hair has grown and so have its arms. With its hypnotizing powers and its boxing gloves, it has two ways to put its opponents to rest.
author: hellaluyeah

entry: Its arms are covered with retractable vines, so POKENAME's reach is much longer than it would seem, letting it grapple opponents that wrongly assume they're a safe distance away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can unravel its body and thus grow in size. This increases the distance between its legs and allows it to cross large gaps with ease.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME slinks up cave walls with whip-like vines in search of rare molds. It softens the growth with acid drips before absorbing it slowly through its tendrils.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a hard shell used to protect its fragile vines, keeping them safe from tears and scratches. Its vines are highly sensitive and are used to feel through muddy waters.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME constitutes a Tangela parasitizing a Weepinbell for safety, as it hides inside the bell mouth. The vines slowly consume the main plant body, allowing it to manipulate the husk as a form of mimicry.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With tendrils like floating seaweed, POKENAME evades capture with ease. Its orbs flicker with excitement, casting an eerie glow in the ocean's depths.
author: anarchaz

entry: They are slow-moving but surprisingly quiet and stealthy. Campers are surprised to see that POKENAME have snuck up on them and are rooting through their tents out of curiosity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a hard shell used to protect its fragile vines, keeping them safe from tears and scratches. Its vines are highly sensitive and are used to feel through muddy waters.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The vines POKENAME uses to sense the world are strong enough to serve as a source of propulsion, braiding together to form a powerful tail. Its preferred environment is muddy lakes and rivers with low visibility.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's body is being overtaken by the parasitic vines from its tail, gradually draining it of vital nutrients. Somehow, POKENAME doesn't seem to mind, sometimes even chewing on the vines for fun.
author: mistymagius

entry: Residing in dark, swampy regions, POKENAME whisks away hypnotized victims to its hovel, emerging again for new prey after many weeks have passed.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME is highly sought by upscale restaurants for high-class dining. The meat in its body combined with the texture and taste of its vines when cooked create a delectable, protein-rich meal worth a high price.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has sometimes been observed using its pincers to sever its own tentacles and eat them. They grow back over a long period, so it only does this when other food sources are scarce.
author: sk372

entry: The eggs in the group age at different rates, leaving the older ones to take care of the younger until they fully hatch and develop. Once all are fully grown, POKENAME exhibits marvelous unity in battle.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon tragically lost its mother due to poachers. It keeps a bone to fend off predators and to knock down Berries from trees.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Now grown up, it has become much more fearless in hopes to avenge its mother one day. Trainers must be aware of POKENAME's aggressive behavior.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Agile and spry, POKENAME live near cliff faces and bound up and down freely with their long and springy limbs. Young POKENAME play with one another near the base of the cliffs under the watchful eyes of adults.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Agile and spry, POKENAME live near cliff faces and bound up and down freely with their long and springy limbs. Young POKENAME play with one another near the base of the cliffs under the watchful eyes of adults.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It uses its long, sticky tongue to keep its child clean and to defend against threats. When danger is near, it swallows the child, keeping it safe inside a second stomach until the threat passes.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME are often seen giving their babies check-ups, which they seem to greatly enjoy. Because of this, POKENAME's babies tend to be healthier than those of unfused Kangaskhan.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: The child has grown up healthy and strong, and now fights by its mother's side. Their ferocity is matched only by their love for each other.
author: griddle

entry: A young POKENAME does not have blades at birth, so the defenseless joey clings to its parent's back at all times. POKENAME uses the soft hum of its wingbeat to lull the child to sleep at night.
author: sk372

entry: Despite how dangerous it looks, the strong-yet-delicate grip of POKENAME's pincers makes it the safest place for the child to be held. Those who disturb the baby quickly learn it needs no pincers to be a fierce guardian.
author: sk372

entry: Their skin used to be hunted for the production of instruments, such as the banjo. Now they roam in protected pastures where their population can be monitored.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travel long distances across the icy sea to find the right place to raise their young. They travel in small groups to ensure that the children in their group don't feel lonely.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Part of POKENAME divided and became its young. The child can only transform its face at first, so the parent tutors it in the ways of shapeshifting until its mimicry can become perfect.
author: sk372

entry: Due to their similar appearances, POKENAME are often found in the company of Kangaskhan, adopted as an additional child by the parent. More and more Kangaskhan are being spotted carrying a POKENAME in their pouch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME encourages a free spirit in its child, teaching it to roam fast, far and wide. Though the child has little electrical strength yet, occasional small bolts of lightning spark from its wings when it practices flight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are caring and mighty, often aiding those in trouble and raising their young, who will carry on their legacy. But harm their young, and their gentle nature shatters, unleashing a storm of rage upon all.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME encourages its timid child to go out, explore and make friends. It's a very kind and trusting parent, but will immobilize a creature instantly with psychic powers the moment it senses a hint of a threat.
author: sk372

entry: In order to toughen up its progeny, POKENAME allows its child to play-fight with other young in the flock. If the roughhousing gets too extreme, parents may step in and brawl over whose child was at fault.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keeps its young in its wool, keeping them warm and feeding them with its own electricity. Once the babies are old enough, it will give them some of its wool to aid them in their adult life.
author: mistymagius

entry: Though POKENAME prefers to remain still, its curious child often hops out of the pouch to explore, forcing it to give chase. The young cries and pouts when POKENAME lifts it back into the pouch.
author: sk372

entry: With a firm tail grip, POKENAME ensures that its baby won't fall as it swiftly moves from treetop to treetop. It will give its life to defend its offspring from any threat.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME finds the sunniest spot it can to hold its child aloft and let it absorb the sunlight for nutrients. Many artisans find the sight of it oddly majestic, and many a statue and figure have been made of the scene.
author: sk372

entry: A strange pair of letter-like creatures, POKENAME are never seen far apart from one another. The "child" seems to enjoy getting dirty and defacing walls with its body, much to the "parent's" chagrin.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appears to be a conjoined parent and child, with the parent taking the brunt of violence from predators. Though unconfirmed, it's believed the child eventually falls off the parent in order to fully mature.
author: sk372

entry: Its child is hidden beneath the ridges surrounding its torso. If necessary to protect the child, it will burst all these pieces violently at foes, before retreating somewhere safe to let the protective shell regrow.
author: sk372

entry: The child is naturally curious, and the parent overly protective. If the child hides within, POKENAME is relatively calm, but if the baby curiously peeks outside, its parent may fire spikes at the slightest movement.
author: sk372

entry: It works in tandem with its young to search for sweet fruits and nectar in forests. Once they have found a good source of food, the child will be allowed to gorge itself first before the parent eats what is left.
author: sk372

entry: The baby on POKENAME's back guides the parent while flying due to the parent's poor eyesight. It does this by pulling on certain feathers on its back to communicate speed and direction.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are apex predators and can easily take out other bird Pokémon with their sharp talons. They carry a special rock that resembles a baby Kangaskhan to practice taking care of eggs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Male POKENAME are expected to protect the nest and raise the young, while females search for food. In the wild, they have been observed changing roles to suit their tribe's needs, occasionally shedding their skin to reflect this.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: On occasion, POKENAME's head glitches out and vanishes to parts unknown. The child must direct the body until the cranium manages to teleport back in place.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon will aggressively protect its territory, especially when it has a joey. POKENAME can even scale vertical surfaces to defend its young.
author: ziggaway

entry: Use extreme caution if you encounter a joey by itself, as its mother will be nearby. A POKENAME mother will protect its young at all costs.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME are very rarely seen alone, gravitating towards anyone able to take care of them. If threatened, their guardian, human or Pokémon, will feel a surge of protective rage until the threat is dealt with.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: After evolving, POKENAME will leave their Trainer for days, only returning once they've found a member of their species without a parent. POKENAME will act like a big sibling, keeping them safe while also teaching them how to fight.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Trainers may find their home filled with young Pokémon impulsively taken in by POKENAME. In tune with the emotions of their foster children, POKENAME loves the admiration, but can become incredibly stressed without assistance from their Trainer.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: It has a gentle disposition and prefers to avoid conflict, a demeanor it hopes to pass onto its young. If forced to fight however, it is utterly merciless for the sake of its children.
author: sk372

entry: With its extendable tongue, POKENAME catches insects and small fruits to share with the young it carries within its pouch. The joey is a curious sort and is often using its own tongue to lick and explore its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: The young baby of a POKENAME is nurtured by the metal mother. Once the mother grows old, the baby will pilot it to protect the two of them.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME constantly sparrs with their pups, increasing their strength precipitously. Caring parents, they often feign defeat to increase the youth's enthusiasm. If they sense a bad aura, they put the pup on their back and use ground-shaking kicks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME adopts lost or young Pokémon, bringing them back to its nest. A mild toxin from its tail wards off predators near its home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME keep their young protected inside their sharp jaws. They can chomp through iron beams, but will protect the young with their life.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: It is hesitant to share its food with others, as it did not have any siblings growing up. Pokémon who are gentle with it find that it is caring but shy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is an extremely bad parent. No matter what happens to its child, it lays there lazily, only moving to scratch itself.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME's hide is incredibly tough and resilient to almost anything undersea hunters could throw at it. The child's hide is undeveloped and soft, so for safety it hides within the parent's mouth until it grows stronger.
author: sk372

entry: As the baby lacks any poison points, it relies solely on the parent to protect it from harm, always staying close. The parent is overly aggressive in defense and will charge and attempt to poison almost anything that draws near.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's exceedingly aggressive protective instincts are thought to be linked to its high testosterone levels. It will even attack massive Pokémon like Nidoking at the slightest provocation, blinded to the risks by its parental fervor.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME separated from its baby will stir up a sandstorm in grief. Smaller creatures who become disoriented by these storms and stumble across a POKENAME's path find themselves not eaten, but adopted.
author: wormspawn

entry: Very protective of their young, POKENAME circle the joeys allowing them to play inside the parental ring. If a threat appears, the adults use illusions to hide their children while swiping with diamond-piercing claws.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME swaddles its young by wrapping its ribbons around them. If they let you hold their baby, it is a sign they trust you completely.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME has earned a reputation as protective yet cruel in its methods. It viciously punishes those who threaten its young with poisonous attacks, refusing to let the offender faint until it decides they've suffered enough.
author: chibitales

entry: During full moons, POKENAME dances in the moonlight with its child on its head. The baby waves its arms in slow circles, mimicking the shape of the moon.
author: .izik
