entry: Researchers found POKENAME was the apex predator of Kanto pre-history. While it is heavily armored with impressive four-foot razor claws, what most don't expect is how well this Pokémon can swim.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME uses its scythe-like tails to grab and cut its prey. Its head is very durable and it can swim at incredible speeds.
author: imagine1.

entry: With incredible aerial speed and razor-sharp blades, POKENAME was an apex flying predator of the ancient world. Fossil records of its habitats indicate it preyed on even the most gargantuan of prehistoric Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is thought to have evolved from living in water to on land. In the jungle, it clears a path using its large scythe.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Agile fighters who use their shed rock-like skin as shields, POKENAME are found defending desert Oases from Ground type meddling. Honorable to a fault, before the battle begins it salutes with its bone sword.
author: ghostslythe

entry: If POKENAME or its Trainer is attacked, it immobilizes the assailant with telekinesis before raking its sharp blades across them as a warning before it releases them. Very few aggressors choose to ignore this threat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME in ancient times protected villages with their rock-hard armor and skull-splitting scythes. Resurrected by science, they now defend walking paths against predatory Pokémon.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's highly curved blade makes it unique among Honedge fusions. It prefers to attack in sweeping figure-eights, conserving its momentum and rotating so that its true edge is always facing the opponent.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Nesting above active volcanoes, POKENAME dives with its young into the lava. When they emerge, their rocky scales are toughened to diamond hardness.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Its sickle-like tail allows it to cut through prey with ease. When swimming, POKENAME will tuck its tail up against its body.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME beaches underwater prey by raising the sea floor beneath them before finishing them off with its scythes. However, its large body makes it terrible at swimming after prey, so it prefers to hunt purely on land, where its powers are stronger.
author: soup1900

entry: It seeks out living Pokémon and uses its scythe to sap their energy in a futile attempt to revive itself.
author: seafoamtaide

entry: POKENAME is one of the first prehistoric mammals ever discovered. Ancient cave paintings have shown it using its blades to hypnotize its prey.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME were considered an apex land predator before their extinction. Fossil records of their hunts seem to indicate hive-mind-like coordination. Commonly revived through Pewter City's museum, these Pokémon are highly sought after to clear forests.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Each POKENAME has its own scythe with its own set of patterns. If their blades are too similar, POKENAME will fight until only one scythe remains.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME has sharp, poison-soaked scythes that it uses to finish off its prey. When it rolls at high speeds it gathers its blades, and it only draws them out when hunting or battling other Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon has a very aggressive temperament and is extremely territorial. It uses its stone-hard scythes to poison and attack its enemies. POKENAME was revived from a fossil recovered on a mountain path.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Revived from an ancient fossil, POKENAME is fiercely territorial and attacks anything that nears its domain. Its hardened scythes drip with venom capable of paralyzing prey within seconds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This gigantic Pokémon has many weapons at its disposal for hunting. It has huge jaws capable of shattering even rock, and it has razor-sharp scythes in place of arms, which have made it one of the most fearsome Pokémon in ancient times.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a brutal carnivore whose entire body is built for hunting prey on land and sea. However, scientists believe that even if POKENAME existed in the past, they would quickly go extinct, as they require far too much food to sustain themselves.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This species of Pokémon has a propensity for inhabiting graveyards. They are capable of disguising themselves as large bushes or ghoulish trees by partially burrowing underground. It is rumored that POKENAME use Murkrow as scouts when hunting prey.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME's incredibly tough armor allows it to withstand enemy attacks, after which it strikes back with the blades on its arms. It dwells in underwater caves, where it lies in wait to launch deadly ambushes on its prey.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME zip through the night sky with their scythes close to their bodies. It is only during a Pokémon battle that they extend their scythes to rend their foes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME extends sharp blades from beneath the ground to strike foes. These blades can easily shatter coral formations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME once hunted by swooping down to the rocky shores and spearing prey with its scythes. Scientists theorize it also used its fire to cook whatever it caught.
author: _._starry_._

entry: It impales prey with its stingers and drinks their bodily fluids. Though it can use its stingers to walk on land, going too long without feeding causes them to shrivel, leaving it stranded.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Its front two tentacles act as scythes for hunting and feeding, while the other 78 assist in movement and trapping prey. If its scythes break, it retreats underwater to regrow them.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME rely on their superb swimming ability to give them an edge in a Pokémon battle. One of their special techniques includes ramming into their opponent with their sharp claws.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It uses a variety of loud screeches as well as wing movements to scare prey. In rare cases, scientists have even recorded the false eyes blinking.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME's flesh is delicious and healthy, loaded with fatty acids, but it's difficult to procure. It leaps and attacks at the first sight of humans.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is aggressive to a fault. Once it makes its home in a river, it chases out all other Pokémon living there.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are a target of many predators because they are easily spotted with their lavender insect wings. They screech with a high-pitched wail to momentarily daze predators before flying away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It dashes at full speed along mountain crevices to gain momentum before taking flight. Fiercely territorial, POKENAME drives away intruders with savage bites from its lethal jaws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It dashes at full speed along mountain crevices to gain momentum before taking flight. Fiercely territorial, POKENAME drives away intruders with savage bites from its lethal jaws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The tips of its mouth are soft and sensitive, and they are used to feel POKENAME's immediate area. They can uncurl from their shell and chomp down on any perceived threat in a fraction of a second.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When attacking enemies, the multitude of sharp rocks on POKENAME cause it to puncture through hard skin. It will savagely hunt down herds of Pokémon until the whole group has been killed off and eaten.
author: soup1900

entry: Many sharp rocks grow and protrude out of POKENAME. It must constantly use these rocks in its attacks to prevent them from growing too large and weighing it down.
author: soup1900

entry: When attacking enemies, the multitude of sharp rocks on POKENAME cause it to puncture through hard skin. It must constantly use these rocks in its attacks to prevent them from growing too large and weighing it down.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME was revived from some of the oldest fossils ever discovered, dating back almost 300 million years. The shape of its teeth suggests it was a herbivore that ate berries with extremely hardened skin.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME frequently spar with their siblings to develop their skills. Even during mealtime, they will fight with each other over who gets the biggest share. Despite not being fully grown, a Crunch from these Pokémon is able to break bones.
author: chibitales

entry: These Pokémon form large groups to take over forests as the new apex predators. The digits on their wings allow them to grab opponents and Headbutt them with rock-solid crests.
author: chibitales

entry: The blade-like teeth of POKENAME can shear through solid metal as though it were paper. This savage Pokémon enjoys picking fights with strong opponents such as Dragonite or Swampert, brutally attacking until one Pokémon rises as the victor.
author: chibitales

entry: Fossils of this Pokémon have been found from the tallest mountains to the sea floor. It is an incredible flier.
author: notsaying.

entry: Only a single fossil of POKENAME has ever been discovered, meaning all modern recreations rely on one incomplete specimen. Many scientists believe this specimen's wings were malformed, as they appear far too small to have supported flight in life.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME flies around without a care in the world, seemingly unaware that it was supposed to have gone extinct a million years ago.
author: kiwikelly

entry: The piece of amber on POKENAME's back is theorized to contain the DNA of ancient Pokémon. Its vines grow wildly when POKENAME is angered.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hunt by picking up large rocks with their talons and dropping them onto prey. They often get into fights when other POKENAME try to steal their meal.
author: chibitales

entry: Most POKENAME exhibit an intrinsic gravitation towards painting. However, there have been rare variants that pursue other endeavors such as sculpting or glassblowing. Regardless, this Pokémon is highly sought after by the upper echelon of society.
author: ludacriswell

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME was an apex predator that ruled the desert plains, devouring anyone who dared challenge it with its massive jaws. It was revived from one of its large fossilized claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME was an apex predator that ruled the desert plains, devouring anyone who dared challenge it with its massive jaws. It was revived from one of its large fossilized claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The skin of an POKENAME is extremely elastic and is similar to rubber. Due to this, its body is highly resistant to lightning strikes.
author: .izik

entry: The armor on its body is harder than tungsten. During the summer months, it shines in the sun more brightly than at any other time of the year.
author: .izik

entry: It makes its den on the peak of rarely-traversed mountains. Should it spot someone else living within 100 meters, it will immediately leave.
author: .izik

entry: Its head is harder than any other portion of its body. It rams its face into trees to make them topple, spilling the fruit to the ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME perch atop old buildings to monitor the surrounding area for intruders, particularly ruffians and hooligans who seek to vandalize their home. Once they spot a troublemaker, a tail wraps around their torso to escort them out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The chunks of amber that it holds are filled with an ancient energy. When gripping them tightly, it lets loose huge amounts of magnetic force.
author: .izik

entry: When a POKENAME consumes the soul of a Pokémon, it is stored in its amber blade until the soul is digested. If the blade can be extracted before that point, the Pokémon can be resurrected as if it were a fossil Pokémon.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Its piercing cries can be heard from miles away. Their ribbons-like feelers keep prey bound while they feast.
author: melodydelune

entry: Some believe that the myriad volcanoes dotting the world were all created by POKENAME. It erected these magma-filled dens from the earth in order to incubate and nurture its young within.
author: sk372

entry: Its prized golden bones may look like apparel, but they are actually part of its body. Studies suggest these features were once much more intense and lethal in prehistoric times.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME fly faster than a bullet train and can perform aerial maneuvers with effortless ease. By giving them a Cheri Berry, they can avoid being slowed down by paralysis.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME cares heavily for its tusks, chewing up minerals and rubbing its tusks in the vomit to strengthen them. If one of its tusks ever gets dirty or chipped, POKENAME will enter a wild frenzy, attacking anything in sight.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: It lives in hot, dry places of the world because its body rapidly absorbs water. Without a Passho Berry to dry its skin, its wings become too waterlogged to fly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's heavy metallic skull makes it nearly impossible to fly, but it never stops trying. It can glide short distances, but will inevitably hurtle head-first to the ground, though its tough skull prevents any lasting damage to itself.
author: sk372

entry: Some variants of POKENAME lack wings to attempt flight, leaving them landlocked. They watch their winged compatriots try to fly with a mixture of jealousy and pity.
author: sk372

entry: Studies suggest that POKENAME were once vicious airborne hunters in prehistoric times. However, centuries of human domestication have weakened their ears and dulled their teeth.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME is a bloodthirsty hunter, using its sharp elbow swords to slice the throat of prey. However, it usually uses them to crush berries, as POKENAME is too small to hunt big prey.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: A Sableye that consumes Old Amber will sometimes become this Pokémon, and soon develops a taste for all fossils.
author: insanity5734

entry: POKENAME is too heavy to fly for long, forced to flap constantly just to stay a meager amount off the ground. It's believed to have fought over food and territory with Archeops in prehistory.
author: sk372

entry: The stones on an POKENAME's body will grow for two years until they fall off. The stones can be reshaped to make beautiful sculptures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's terrifying strength and size allows it to easily intimidate prey and gobble them up. If this fusion existed in the past, it is not known what other Pokémon could have coexisted alongside it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite its massive size, POKENAME could fly at speeds that could rival modern Garchomp. This, coupled with its impressive hunting abilities, has earned it the nickname 'The Aerial Annihilator'.
author: patch

entry: It rarely uses its fangs to attack. Instead, it rams into prey and territorial rivals at alarming speed.
author: pokepower

entry: Despite its rather unpleasant voice, POKENAME sings all day long, often giving listeners a headache. Though naturally peaceful, it won't hesitate to bite anyone who threatens it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its rather unpleasant voice, POKENAME sings all day long, often giving listeners a headache. Though naturally peaceful, it won't hesitate to bite anyone who threatens it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's feathers are coated in various rocks and other minerals found in their territory. POKENAME are often docile around close companions, but fly into a ferocious frenzy when they or their friends are threatened.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's feathers are coated in a thick layer of amber that acts as a shield, but renders them near flightless. POKENAME are often docile around close companions, but fly into a ferocious frenzy when they or their friends are threatened.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME swoops down on opponents, jabbing at weak spots with its tail. Its raucous battle cry can knock smaller Pokémon out of the sky.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Any organic material dropped onto an POKENAME's body sinks in and becomes part of it. The sand flowing out of the skull's eyes is seemingly endless.
author: raptorroocool

entry: The wings on POKENAME's head allow it to fly despite its body being ill-suited for the skies. It prefers to live in tundras, soaring over icy landscapes while its body dangles below.
author: .izik

entry: Nesting in the roots of trees, POKENAME infestations were a cause of some trees dying out. In this day and age, it is considered an invasive species.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME somehow achieves flight by waving its claws up and down. This strange method of propulsion has baffled researchers for decades.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can fly by spinning their tails like propellers. If two should meet during their flights, a vicious battle will ensue. However, before the battle is decided, the losing POKENAME will retreat by diving into the nearest body of water.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's tail whips rhythmically as it plans its daily digging routes. If a predator is spotted, it retaliates using Ancient Power.
author: .izik

entry: While Luvdisc tend to congregate around people in love, POKENAME prefers to swim near single humans. It's believed to be a sign of prosperity in life without the need for romance.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME sit perfectly still like statues, letting their prey get close to them instead of pursuing them. In their idle time they like to play with rocks they find pretty.
author: frokachu

entry: Statues of POKENAME appear in many ancient buildings, carved to look as if it were guarding the area. Its large, imposing wings are strong enough to let it carry heavy prey such as Dewgong to its nest.
author: chibitales

entry: Many gargoyles have been carved in the image of POKENAME. It seems to find some joy in pretending to be one of these gargoyles.
author: notsaying.

entry: A powerful apex Pokémon from Kanto's distant history, scientists on Cinnabar Island have managed to resurrect them and reintroduce them into the environment. They now make their home within the Cinnabar Volcano, nesting within basalt columns.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A powerful apex Pokémon from Kanto's distant history, scientists on Cinnabar Island have managed to resurrect them and reintroduce them into the environment. They now make their home within the Cinnabar Volcano, nesting within basalt columns.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A powerful apex Pokémon from Kanto's distant history, scientists on Cinnabar Island have managed to resurrect them and reintroduce them into the environment. They now make their home within the Cinnabar Volcano, nesting within basalt columns.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A powerful apex Pokémon from Kanto's distant history, scientists on Cinnabar Island have managed to resurrect them and reintroduce them into the environment. They now make their home within the Cinnabar Volcano, nesting within basalt columns.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME soar through the sky with amber attached to their tails and harness the weight of the amber to whip other flying Pokémon. The amber color of the fossilized tree resin makes them easy to spot in the sky.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's extra eyes help it scout for food with an enhanced field of view. If it sustains a powerful hit, its amber-coated segments detach until it is safe to reform by using its magnets.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are more energetic than most Snorlax fusions due to their steady diet of Chesto Berries. When they run out of energy, they will collapse in the middle of whatever they're doing and create spores that put those around them to sleep as well.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME appears to have a never-ending appetite for fruit. It is popular amongst young Pokémon Trainers.
author: lowkeytoxtricity

entry: POKENAME has a volatile temper, prone to throwing tantrums if it gets too hungry. These fits can be dangerous, as they sometimes result in it exploding from sheer rage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can sleep for days without moving. While resting, it communicates telepathically with others of its kind, often dreaming in unison.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sets distinct goals and rewards for itself to maximize training. For instance, it will grant itself a large snack full of nutritious Berries only once it has broken fifty boulders clean in two.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME seems to already know that eating a good meal, doing vigorous exercise and sleeping well will lead to a healthy body, and will do all three naturally in a steady routine. For that reason, it is beloved by pro athletes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are extremely inactive and just laze around, often ignoring junior Trainers' commands when in battle. A notable number of POKENAME are released due to being perceived as not worth the effort to train. They sleep on their shed skin.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spends the majority of its time sleeping; it uses the constant stream of poisonous gas emitted from its body as a resting place.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME has a simple and placid personality, spending most of its time grazing and sleeping. Waking it up from a nap, however, will make it charge at the culprit in a grumpy rage.
author: sk372

entry: Following Snorlax's reputation of blocking walkways, POKENAME blocks riverbeds and streams, leaving aquatic Pokémon unable to migrate in the spring.
author: rooboid

entry: Hanging from especially sturdy trees, POKENAME swaddles itself in layers of silk. If it tosses too much in its sleep, the tree falls down, awakening it in an instant. Irate at being awake, it strips the nearest berry tree of all fruit.
author: ghostslythe

entry: As long as it gets its sugary and natural food, POKENAME is satisfied and agreeable. It is found in forests in small numbers; due to the raw amount of food it must consume to evolve, few wild Pokémon evolve into POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME settles to the bottom of the sea and slumbers for long periods of time. Its deep open-mouthed snoring causes faint rumbles and miniature whirlpools.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoys fancy, borderline prodigal cooking with lots of rare ingredients. Trainers often struggle to finance such tastes, so it begrudgingly eats plain meals that its Trainer provides.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is considered a gourmand when it comes to cooking meats, using flame-breath to roast meals to perfection. Improperly heating a meal will send it into an indignant rage.
author: sk372

entry: It spends most of its days asleep at the bottom of the sea. When POKENAME awakens from its sleep, it emits a thunderous howl that can cause underwater earthquakes.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spends most of the day sleeping. It's a popular pet for those who don't have the time, energy, or space to keep the more active Eevee.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: POKENAME lounges lazily in large lakes. When it lacks the energy to hunt, it eats moss or algae growing around the lakeside. This often leads to a cycle where it subsists on nothing but moss and algae for its entire life.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME has a calm, sleepy demeanor and a warm, comfy body that soothes those nearby. When threatened, it releases bursts of heat to protect itself.
author: habibiluigi

entry: POKENAME satiate their voracious appetite by eating lots of fruits and vegetables. When an area is about to run out of berries, they chew food and fly at the same time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Fusion has forced Snorlax's huge belly to more than double in size, shrinking its bones to make room and giving it a blob-like shape.
author: leeto64

entry: A Pokémon filled with positive emotions and happiness. It absolutely loves eating; sometimes it eats so much it can't fly with its own weight.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Quietly sleeping, this Pokémon continuously dreams of all varieties of foods. Its dreams occasionally materialize around it before once again popping out of existence. Many a chef has come to see this Pokémon to garner inspiration for new dishes.
author: be77yboop

entry: POKENAME are unable to fly because their wings cannot support their body weight. They resort to climbing trees to find a place to sleep, where they rest for up to 18 hours a day.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME usually prides itself on its roundness. Once every seven days, however, it flattens itself in a display of a particular kind of humor it enjoys.
author: _sadfroggy

entry: The force of POKENAME's gluttony has adapted its antennae into Berries. It eating its Berries doesn't hurt, and they usually grow back.
author: dodoowner_

entry: A very docile fusion, POKENAME is often used as a companion for children afraid of the dark, as its tails glow in a pretty pattern many find soothing.
author: howlingstarr

entry: This Pokémon's antennae act as a night-light for child POKENAME. Although most adults outgrow them, it acts as comfort after a bad day.
author: dodoowner_

entry: In the wild, POKENAME sleeps twenty-two hours a day, with its two waking hours spent late at night devouring food. It makes its home in tall trees where it can safely sleep and feel closer to the moon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its wings are too small to lift it off the ground for more than a couple of seconds. Because of this, it only flies to grab hard-to-reach food.
author: novellavaria

entry: POKENAME are slow yet fickle creatures that have a difficult time deciding what to eat. They usually end up eating a piece of cheese or a berry even when presented with more appetizing options.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It hangs from branches and sleeps for upwards of 18 hours a day. It searches for citrus fruits, like the lemon or pomelo, during the scant few hours it is awake.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rests in the shallows of rivers, sleeping for days at a time. When it wakes up, it often finds a thin layer of mud has formed over it. It uses its long tongue to lick the mud off, but this often exhausts it, causing it to fall back asleep.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME has a tough countenance and easygoing nature. It is completely immune to most known forms of toxins. It would be used more often by waste management and research companies if it were not for its constant desire to gorge on heaps of food.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are normally docile creatures but may exhibit food aggression whenever another Pokémon comes near their meal. As a result, Trainers are advised to feed POKENAME in separate spaces from other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a glyph that, when read, induces hunger and lethargy in the observer. If left hungry, the affected individual becomes enraged, but their strength seems to spike!
author: bukie

entry: POKENAME spends most of the year fast asleep. When this Pokémon wakes, it devastates surrounding farmland with its mouth and drill.
author: beespoon

entry: POKENAME snoozes endlessly, surfacing only to snack. Its maze-like tunnels delve deep underground.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME gathers incredible amounts of food to eat before hibernating and falling into a deep sleep. Waking up a sleeping POKENAME is far more dangerous than waking up an Ursaring or Snorlax, even for experienced Trainers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite its large size, POKENAME is a very relaxed and laid-back Pokémon. It often attempts to sing and create melodies.
author: tuskaninny

entry: Using its antlers' psychic waves to detect nearby food, POKENAME grazes endlessly. It sometimes falls asleep mid-chew without realizing it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to show off. It is particularly adept in feats of strength and balance, making it a somewhat common sight at circuses. When it sleeps, it is nigh-impossible to wake up.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are extremely lethargic and will spend months sleeping between meals. Their appetite is tremendous when they're hungry, gorging themselves for an entire day on anything that crosses their path.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spend upwards of twenty hours per day sleeping, lazing in mountain passes and valleys. They never sleep in the same place twice and will travel for miles during their few waking hours in search of a new resting place.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME knocks down berries from trees and stores them in its flowing mane. It yawns and snores so much while traveling the land that some believe it's running around in its sleep.
author: sk372

entry: Using its control over time, POKENAME eats up a handful of berries almost completely, then reverses the berries' time, regenerating them and letting it eat them over and over again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can devour entire berry orchards in hours. After consuming two full groves, it enters a week-long slumber.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME travels the seas, gathering up berries and small fish to take to secret hoarding spots. Once it's amassed a stash twice its weight, it gorges itself before settling down for a nice nap.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful magnetic field to drain entire towns of food kept in any metal objects. It is a rare occurrence in the wild, and when one is discovered, Pokémon Rangers relocate it to an area with a high density of Steel-types.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It licks anything that comes close to it, even when asleep. Studies have found that it dreams exclusively about food.
author: staghorn

entry: While POKENAME sleeps in sunlit glades, its vines move on their own. They gather berries and roots silently, feeding POKENAME as it dreams.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME always carries a Poké Flute in its tail for when it needs to keep itself awake. If anyone tries to take this flute from it, it will smack them with its tail and sink its fangs into them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME ominously plays its giant Poké Flute as it keeps watch over oncoming prey. This prevents it from dozing off long enough to spot prey and swoop down to attack them.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite having a slender figure, POKENAME's appetite is as strong as any normal Snorlax. The only one it will ever allow to share a little of the huge meals it gorges on is its Trainer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a single small brain and lacks intelligence, but its hardy body allows it to persist anyways. The brain also has the ability to lower its activity in certain regions to preserve massive amounts of energy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: To see POKENAME awake is a rarity, as they will always favor a long nap over anything that requires any effort. Their post-nap tantrums can be brutal.
author: rooboid

entry: The flower on its back emits a calming scent that POKENAME uses to stay asleep for days. Researchers often track POKENAME by the trails of crushed vegetation and wild sleeping Pokémon it leaves behind.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The spikes on its head provide POKENAME a solid defense mechanism. However, it can usually only muster a few headbutts before it gets sleepy.
author: gp423

entry: Wild POKENAME spend the majority of their lives sleeping. Despite this, their physical strength is nearly unparalleled.
author: theartemis1

entry: Despite its laziness, it is an excellent climber, easily able to get Berries and fruit from very high trees.
author: homelessrager

entry: Wild POKENAME spend the majority of their lives sleeping. Despite this, their physical strength is nearly unparalleled.
author: theartemis1

entry: It appears lazy but is respected by its family. When its children are endangered, it displays levels of aggression never reached by its components.
author: miecreates

entry: It only wakes up to lazily eat its surrounding area. While asleep, it remains completely intangible.
author: bacondlx

entry: It is said that before one departs to the afterlife, POKENAME will carry the deceased to an unknown place where they will share their final feast. POKENAME will then guide them to their eternal home after they've eaten everything.
author: beatdoof

entry: It is said that every time POKENAME sleeps, their dreams become new universes. Some ancient civilizations even believed that our own universe was created this way, and fed POKENAME plentiful harvests to earn their favor.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: The fruit that grows upon POKENAME's tree is quite flavorful and juicy, but also incredibly fattening. Eating only a few in a short time could lead to a weight increase of up to 20 pounds.
author: sk372

entry: Its attacks, if it bothers to fight at all, are careless and sloppy. One successful hit is all it needs, though, as its zigzagging blade delivers a nasty blow.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: It's able to spot anything edible behind objects, making it hard to hide snacks from it. Trainers must work to help keep its mane clean of food debris.
author: nelluc27

entry: POKENAME's taste sensitivity is inversely proportional to how hungry it is. When they're full enough, they often get into a slow but rewarding odyssey to get berries from the surface.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME's taste sensitivity is inversely proportional to how hungry it is. When they're full enough, they often get into a slow but rewarding odyssey to get berries from the surface.
author: epping_forest

entry: This Pokémon is often brought to retirement homes due to its docile and sweet nature. They spend up to 20 hours a day sleeping.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME often go on violent temper tantrums. These take up a lot of energy, however, and it spends the rest of the day sleeping.
author: nellnast42

entry: Exhausted from epic battles with Snordon, POKENAME rests in the ocean depths, providing a bed for other Pokémon on its back.
author: slowforest

entry: POKENAME may sleep for ten thousand years, becoming one with the landscape. It can devour a whole continent's vegetation when it awakes.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME gather on tall buildings and hills to exchange favorite foods while laying beneath the stars. If they are witnessed traveling during daylight, there will be a gorgeous astronomical event soon at their destination.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The flowering arms emit a thick lavender scent that leaves POKENAME in a constant state of conscious sedation. This scent forces any would-be predators to descend into peaceful slumber.
author: xillo

entry: POKENAME is rarely awake, and drifts about at the mercy of air currents. Its belly is rumored to be filled with spirits that keep it afloat. Each time it snores, one escapes into the afterlife, causing it to descend slightly back towards the ground.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Despite its lax attitude, POKENAME will react to danger with a quick hop into an attack with its legs, usually finishing with a devastating leglock.
author: leeto64

entry: Rotten or foul food that POKENAME eats is also converted to make its spores. When these spores are used on other Pokémon, it causes them to suddenly have indigestion and stomachaches.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME is desperately hungry, it resorts to eating its own spores. While this does help satiate it, the spores cause it to immediately fall asleep afterwards.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spends the night gathering food and eating while watching the moon cross the sky. As soon as sunrise is noticed, it passes out into a deep, peaceful slumber.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Due to their fluff constantly growing, POKENAME are regularly shaved. The fur is often used in the creation of thick winter coats.
author: kitarchen

entry: POKENAME scrounges for food, dragging the ever-expanding haul behind it in its electrified web. When it tires out, it collapses atop the pile and slowly begins eating. Once it runs out of food, it begins the cycle again in a new territory.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are typically lazy and tend to care more for food than battle. However, if something gets in the way of their feasting, they will not hesitate to pummel whatever stands in their way with powerful shadow punches.
author: uroogisleee_46788

entry: POKENAME is often found napping around towns. It only wakes up if a passer-by has a tasty treat to eat.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME has such an appetite it eats 900 pounds a day. The amount it eats is so large it needs to vomit up its stomach to make space.
author: theradrad

entry: POKENAME collects food so that it can eat whenever it feels like it. Traveling Trainers often use them to carry excess food that won't fit in their bag. They also have it carry a Poké Flute so that they can wake it whenever they need its assistance.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Its "wings" are actually big paws that pin it to the ground. It is perfectly content in this position, but becomes rowdy if no food is in reach.
author: miecreates

entry: It doesn't so much as fly as it does drift aimlessly along the wind. Even when sneakily stealing food from humans, it remains floating on its back.
author: miecreates

entry: Too heavy to comfortably fly, it drags itself across the ground instead. Despite this, it can manage incredible acrobatics if properly motivated.
author: miecreates

entry: It is currently unknown how long POKENAME naps over each month. When it awakens, it immediately uses its flames to cook fresh berries before curling up on impossibly soft and comfortable tails to sleep once more.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME uses the enchanting power within its tails to locate sources of food. When it decides to sleep, POKENAME uses its tails as a cocoon to protect from any disturbances.
author: wickedwiccan

entry: Despite being able to mutate its own body, POKENAME prefers to keep its body as simple as possible to conserve energy. It mostly just lazes around, using its psychic powers to grab food.
author: mistymagius

entry: When autumn ends, it finds a nest to hibernate in. It is tolerated by the original residents because it blocks off tunnels leading out from the nest, which helps keep warmth inside until spring.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The sound of its snores can be heard from miles away. It will eat any kind of metal or precious stone that it digs up.
author: soup1900

entry: Do not be alarmed if you see a POKENAME belly-up in water; when they aren't eating, their round bodies float to the surface while they sleep.
author: .towerxvi

entry: POKENAME's skull is extremely sturdy due to repeated impacts. Said impacts are mostly caused by its tendency to fall asleep while standing, and then tumbling head-first to the ground in its slumber.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME looks slow, its body is packed with stored energy, and can unleash an explosive ember if startled awake. The flame on its tail is said to grow hotter the longer POKENAME sleeps without interruption.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME can sleep up to 21 hours a day. When it wakes up, it hops in circles until it's exhausted, then sleeps again.
author: honestly_vitali

entry: POKENAME spends its life in constant search of Bug-type Pokémon to consume. Its voracious appetite, combined with a poor sense of direction, leaves its mouth filled with dirt more often than not.
author: dylonk25

entry: Despite its massive wings, it shows no interest in flight, choosing instead to waddle and lurch with lazy purpose. When threatened, it opens its cavernous mouth and lets out a yawn so loud it disorients anything nearby.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It never goes anywhere without its pillow. It has been said that stealing a POKENAME's pillow will bring bad luck.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: POKENAME is a portly little creature with an appetite for gems. It saves particularly tasty looking jewels in its navel for later, to enjoy when no one is watching.
author: bukie

entry: POKENAME can decimate regions of food as it gallops about, scooping up all it wants to eat, and devouring as it runs. Once it has eaten its fill, it curls up tightly around any leftovers not yet consumed and sleeps, protected by its armored plates.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hunts once a month, gorging itself on berries and meat that will digest over the following weeks. Once full, it is quite docile, even happily allowing children to play on it while it sleeps off its massive meal.
author: sk372

entry: The leaves atop POKENAME's head are coated with an awful-smelling poisonous film. How bad the stench is depends on its diet.
author: char_latte3412

entry: For over fifty years after its discovery, POKENAME was thought to be permanently rooted to the ground. The revelation that it could move led to a brief philosophical debate on whether a plant could be considered lazy.
author: dylonk25

entry: Though it is small, the stomping of POKENAME's feet can make the ground shake. Its appetite is so voracious, it will eat the leaves off its own head.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It feasts on any food it finds, somehow consuming many times its body weight in a single sitting. If interrupted, POKENAME lashes out with enough power to topple trees.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME resembles a toy known for its similarity in appearance and texture to marshmallows. It's so lazy, it doesn't mourn the loss of its legs.
author: .realthree

entry: Its voracious appetite is matched only by its awe-inspiring strength. POKENAME can be tracked by the trail of destruction it leaves as it eats everything in its path.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Thanks to the mushroom draining its energy, POKENAME eats even more than a regular Snorlax. Because of POKENAME's diet of Sitrus Berries, the mushroom has changed to resemble one.
author: darkweavile428

entry: The dust that comes off of a POKENAME's fur is used in creating concealer and eyeliner. Beauticians use this makeup at fashion shows in Unova.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME consumes every twig it encounters, using the material to fuel its internal fire. Despite its size, it can eat several times its body weight in a single day.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's overwhelming reserve of energy allows it to go without eating for long periods of time (even if it prefers to be devouring space dust). As it floats high up in the sky, it leaves its mouth open to devour earthen and spatial particles.
author: bobosmith01

entry: At the first sign of drowsiness, POKENAME burrows straight down up to 50 ft. It refuses to rest anywhere but deep underground.
author: .izik

entry: Sharing food is a mark of great affection for POKENAME. It considers anyone that gives it their meal a true friend, and should it offer to share its own food, its a sign of utmost respect, loyalty and love.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME isn't participating in its usual routine of stuffing its face with pasta, it curls up in its bed and sleeps for hours upon hours.
author: gp423

entry: Known as one of the laziest Pokémon in the world, POKENAME does little else other than eat or sleep. Trainers often have trouble getting it to participate in battles unless they bribe it with vast amounts of food.
author: chibitales

entry: After gorging itself on whatever food it can find, POKENAME will become plagued by furious headaches and promptly fall asleep to ward off the pain. It will spend roughly half its life in this comatose state.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME are superb swimmers that can sleep while kicking their flippers. This adaptation allows them to avoid predators on land while also keeping their metabolism high.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is almost always grumpy, due to a lack of good sleep. Trying to wake POKENAME is a terrible idea as it will violently pummel you until it exhausts itself.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME love to show affection for their Trainer by laying on them like a warm, heavy blanket. This makes them a very popular pet.
author: jordanx27

entry: POKENAME sleeps for 18 hours a day, but when it is awake, all efforts focuse on finding food for its huge appetite. Due to the abundant psychic powers supercharging its metabolism, this Pokémon can eat as much food as it wants and never gain weight.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Regurgitative and poisonous fluid oozes from its mouth. It dines on weak prey that gets close, liquefying them whole, and then takes a leisurely nap.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lives and snoozes among the craggy cliffs of mountainsides. Its tough skin and deep slumber mean that even if it turns in its sleep and rolls all the way down a mountainside, it won't be jostled from its nap.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has become so lazy after fusion that it will eat its own tail before deciding to move to a new location. Getting POKENAME to listen to a battle command is nothing short of a miracle.
author: lampent12

entry: To conserve energy, POKENAME prefers to roll for locomotion rather than fly. It inhabits urban areas to magnetically pull tinned foods to it, exerting as little energy as necessary.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME works as a unit to magnetically pull metal food containers from stores and homes to its resting place. Each member of the group has different foods it prefers, so there is rarely fighting over who eats what part of its find.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME fashions a flute from a leek and apricorn. It plays the flute in the presence of other Pokémon, lulling them to sleep so it can steal their meals while they slumber.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have two heads that take turns sleeping, but they both oversleep and end up missing most of the day. They often wake up late and starving, and will then run about foraging for berries and insects.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME floats onto icebergs after gorging on frozen water. It sleeps for five days straight, undisturbed by the chill.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can comfortably sleep on icebergs for weeks at a time due to their thick blubber. They gorge themselves immensely whenever they wake up to replenish their blubber and give them the necessary energy to move around.
author: entomoxie

entry: It sleeps on its back with its head outside its shell when it feels completely safe and comfortable. If POKENAME sleeps in this manner with you nearby, it trusts you entirely.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite their potential for mass destruction, POKENAME are actually quite docile. If their Trainer is harmed, however, they will go on an unstoppable rampage that can leave a 2km radius of devastation.
author: slimee_amogus

entry: POKENAME absorbs the nightmares of any human who walks within 100 feet of it, allowing it to theoretically sleep forever. If someone awakens it, that person will be haunted by every nightmare POKENAME has absorbed.
author: bradlybro199

entry: Anyone who takes a bite of its berries will fall asleep right away. It's advised is not to eat them, as POKENAME will deprive you of all your food.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME release flurries of snow to freeze over forests so that predators search elsewhere for meals. There is a rite of passage for children where they wander through the snowy landscape to pluck a sapphire feather from the head of an POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fly over forests releasing a coat of icy dust to create wintery wonderlands around them. They are a telltale sign that winter has begun in earnest, as they only come out of hiding during winter.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME channels its psychic powers, a magnificent aurora emanates from its gemlike core. It controls ice at will. It has been known to protect sailors in arctic waters, so it is sometimes called the 'North Star Gem' or the 'Jewel of Polaris'.
author: alkazamis

entry: Whatever POKENAME mimes out will become a physical object made of pure ice. It cannot make anything too complex, like machines.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME are capable of summoning hailstorms with a single breath but remain uncertain about how they want to evolve. While they strongly favor Ice Stones, they always hesitate before committing to evolution.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's elegant fur cools and freezes moisture in the air in its immediate vicinity, making it consistently surrounded by a faint layer of frost and mist. It freezes over ponds and lakes so it can take naps upon the frozen surface.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends its time hunting for prey in frigid waters. When it spots a suitable target, it freezes the water around them and slashes them with its scythes to finish them off.
author: darkweavile428

entry: A legendary Pokémon representing the winter season. POKENAME will sleep for a majority of the year, waking at the start of winter and causing blizzards as it yawns.
author: lampent12

entry: While it might look fat, this Pokémon's body is mostly dense feathers that keep it safe even in temperatures well below -100° F.
author: moopse

entry: Due to an excess amount of feathers, this Pokémon can barely see. Its dense coat does have the upside of protecting it from attacks, however.
author: moopse

entry: This form of POKENAME resembles a species of Articuno found in Galar. It freezes prey in place with a piercing glare before blasting them with a mighty Blizzard. It thrives in sub-zero regions.
author: chibitales

entry: Bestowed with intense, overflowing determination, POKENAME has reached its zenith. With its life on the line, it'll keep battling until the very end.
author: leeto64

entry: It is said that POKENAME lives on one of the coldest mountains in the world, watching over climbers who dare attempt to ascend it.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: POKENAME's stingers possess a very potent chilling power; anything pierced by them will slowly become frozen from the inside out. These icy statues of victims serve as a warning for others to not disturb its hive.
author: sk372

entry: The inside of POKENAME's ice wings is said to contain the DNA of all Pokémon. However, when anyone tries to use a microscope to prove this, this Pokémon creates a snowstorm to obscure all observations.
author: soup1900

entry: Flocks of POKENAME travel together through harsh blizzards and sleet storms in search of high mountains to nest in. Meteorologists use the migration of POKENAME as an indicator of incoming poor weather.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME will follow any Trainer they find, seemingly never running out of energy. The only escape is to find a warm area, as POKENAME draws energy from the cold. This makes it dangerous to explore near their territory in winter.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME nest high in the mountains within glaciers, their thick downy feathers insulating them against the cold. When flocks of POKENAME descend from the mountains, they bring sleet storms with them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have been seen accidentally freeze-drying their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in ice-cold environments.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It only appears during the winter months, bringing a light dusting of snow wherever it flies. Its wings are sensitive to heat and will start to melt if it gets too warm.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sleeps in ponds in wetlands. Whilst asleep, it slowly freezes the surrounding water. Upon waking, it stretches, shattering the ice and sending it flying in every direction, with passersby often mistaking it for hail.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The rings on POKENAME's body and wings glow brightly in the thick hailstorms that surround it. Travelers have been known to become mesmerized by the glow and get hopelessly lost within the storm.
author: alestrius

entry: Mountain climbers are often chilled and snowed on by POKENAME flying overhead. When it needs sleep, POKENAME wishes for no disturbances. To achieve this, it uses its drill tail to dig a hole.
author: equation8573

entry: A single flap of its massive wings can summon freezing blizzards. POKENAME is a rare Pokémon said to appear before explorers who reach the peaks of the highest mountains after enduring great hardships.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME shoots heavy chunks of ice from its beak. Heavy POKENAME fire larger ice chunks.
author: .realthree

entry: Herds of these Pokémon are only occasionally seen on the highest mountain peaks. At the slightest danger, the whole herd takes flight at once.
author: r.isk

entry: POKENAME's wings generate a gentle and cool breeze with calming properties. It uses the chill of its own body to help those suffering from fevers, or to cool eggs that develop better in colder temperatures.
author: sk372

entry: Those who see the brilliant splendor of the golden light shining through POKENAME's crystalline ice feathers never forget it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a solitary being, allowing very few to venture deep into its frigid territory.  Those who are not welcome will be repelled via a shower of sharp icicles it generates with each flap of its wings.
author: sk372

entry: Spirits that have passed in blizzards gather to form POKENAME. This powerful spirit is bonded to a frozen keystone.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME lives far atop the iciest of mountain peaks, generating powerful snowstorms with only a few flaps of its wings. Legends say it decorates its home with ice statues fashioned in the image of those brave enough to reach it.
author: sk372

entry: Extremely regal and proud, POKENAME demands great respect from other Pokémon and even its own Trainer. It uses the frozen metallic claws at the ends of its wings as anchors when climbing cliffsides or mountains.
author: c0u51nv1nn7

entry: POKENAME is a legendary sword Pokémon that resides around icy summits. It can generate a blizzard with a swing of its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Every swing POKENAME's blades make leaves a freezing trail behind. It can even send crescent-shaped chunks of ice at foes as projectiles, ensuring none can escape its frigid might.
author: sk372

entry: This legendary Pokémon can create magnificent wings by coating its feelers in a thick coat of ice. Wherever it flies, it snows.
author: melodydelune

entry: Ancient legends describe POKENAME as a harbinger of merciless winters, dragging the cold across the land in its wake. Its silent passage and piercing eyes are often the last signs seen before the land is buried in ice.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME fiercely protects the icy mountains it calls home, yearning for absolute solitude. Those who fall asleep in its territory are doomed to an endless nightmare, left to freeze in the relentless cold.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Opening the inside of POKENAME can cause frostbite to anyone nearby. It prefers not to have any items inside of it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME freeze over entire forests with a blanket of snow at the beginning of the winter season. When necessary, they melt ice with soft embers to thaw out other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that anyone who even brushes against one of its bicolored feathers will be instantly scorched by the cold. Its icy breath can drastically lower the temperature of its surroundings.
author: fiordaliso

entry: As POKENAME zips through the air, it cools the air and creates snow drifts that linger for a short while after. It likes to fly over tropical areas and give the inhabitants a short respite from the hot temperatures.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME summons mighty blizzards to hide its presence when hunting, ambushing prey from above with Fire Spin. It lives on some of the tallest mountains in the world, making it difficult to research properly.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME wields legendary icy powers combined with extraterrestrial prowess. It commands the skies with grace and formidable abilities.
author: anarchaz

entry: If you see a small icy comet darting across the sky, it could be an POKENAME. It only arrives in the early winter to bring the first snow of the season.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides itself away on frigid mountains so it may grow into its next form in solitude. Those that disturb its peace will be pelted with frozen winds created through the swing of its tail.
author: sk372

entry: The fluid surrounding POKENAME's core is constantly below 0°C, yet doesn't freeze. They are most often seen during blizzards in cold regions forming small groups. Research is still ongoing pertaining to why they do this.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME makes its home in caverns located in colder regions. A quick and silent hunter, it prefers to swoop at and suck the blood of Ice-type Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: Optimists will say that POKENAME rescue those who are lost in blizzards, but the cold reality is that they put them out of their misery by encasing them in ice.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen, and those who encounter it are often fearful. To others, it is described as a "beautiful beast," with a long tail that never stops waving.
author: 1bridgeyboo

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen, and those who encounter it are often fearful. To others, it is described as a "disappointing but pretty beast," with a surprisingly short tail.
author: 1bridgeyboo

entry: POKENAME can often be observed dancing upon frozen lakes, moving as if on solid ground. They always end these performances by pirouetting, the motion summoning a strong hailstorm. While all sight is obscured in the storm, the POKENAME will vanish.
author: _pixelar_

entry: It is a master of temperature manipulation, whose shell is made of ice, while its core burns hotter than magma. When the inside of its shell melts and boils, POKENAME erupts with the accumulated steam, which freezes into snow upon being released.
author: milchik

entry: It is a master of temperature manipulation, whose shell is made of ice, while its core burns hotter than magma. When the inside of its shell melts and boils, POKENAME erupts with the accumulated steam, which freezes into snow upon being released.
author: milchik

entry: Tunnels dug by POKENAME through mountain ranges emit sudden freezing gusts. These blasts can occur days later and can instantly freeze nearby creatures.
author: .izik

entry: Since ancient times, POKENAME has been hailed as a spirit of winter. Those who witness this elusive Pokémon's radiance are said to be blessed with protection from the cold.
author: mepp.

entry: When struck by migraines, POKENAME loses control of its powers and unintentionally unleashes devastating snowstorms that last until it recovers. Since it is a very reclusive creature, encountering it is rare even in the frozen forests it inhabits.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When struck by migraines, POKENAME loses control of its powers and unintentionally unleashes devastating snowstorms that last until it recovers. Since it is a very reclusive creature, encountering it is rare even in the frozen forests it inhabits.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME require an icy-cold environment to keep their head clear. Extended time outside of their natural environment gives them a headache, especially if they are somewhere hot and arid.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can freeze entire bodies of water by conjuring a blizzard. Once the surface of a lake or river has been frozen, they swim under the ice to hunt for their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wanders the mountains during chilly winter nights, looking for travelers lost in the cold. Some trainers say that POKENAME are heroic creatures, but they are really just looking for a cold friend to snuggle with.
author: elibromax314

entry: POKENAME conjure blizzards and snowstorms by flapping their azure feathers. Even though the world around them becomes a frosty environment, the flame at the center of the storm is always lit.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A sage-like Pokémon that resides on frigid mountains, POKENAME is often sought out for its wisdom. It rarely deems others worthy, casting those it rejects out of its domain with gusts of icy wind created from its staff.
author: sk372

entry: It remains unknown how the artichoke it carries is crucial to its way of life. Many researchers found themselves frozen solid trying to find out.
author: nvisionluminous

entry: POKENAME live underwater in icy caverns that connect to the ocean. They freeze their prey within a cage of ice before they inject their prey with virulent venom.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have twin heads swap between releasing frigid zephyrs and pecking at their prey. This constant role swapping wears down prey because of how unpredictable they become.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME thrives in bitterly cold oceans, freezing both predators and prey in solid ice. As it swims, it leaves a glittering trail of ice crystals.
author: chibitales

entry: Legends say that if you get lost in a blizzard and POKENAME is nearby, it will put you to sleep so you won't see it and take you to a safe place.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME are found on the beaches of the Seafoam Islands, fluttering in short distances across the beachfronts at one another. Their body temperatures are abnormally low compared to most Pokémon, adapted to survive the cold weather.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME channels electrical energy through its bulb, discharging sparks when the grows the tiniest bit. It absorbs both sunlight and lightning to fuel its rapid growth.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME has so much electrical power that it uses its bone like a wand to reduce it. Rumors say that if it didn't do that, its electricity would be fatal to anyone, even Ground-type Pokémon.
author: chewquy

entry: POKENAME cause lightning storms in the nearby vicinity to convince predators to hunt elsewhere. Bold children who want to impress friends and family run through forests to pluck a feather from POKENAME's head.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME barrels through the land like a living storm cloud, its thunderous charges leaving trails of shattered stone and scorched earth. Said to draw lightning with its pointed spikes, it is unknown what drives it to rampage so fiercely.
author: potato_tub

entry: POKENAME tunnels to mountain peaks and waits for thunderstorms, using its spiraling horn as a lightning rod. Its rugged, spike-lined armor acts as a natural conductor, growing more charged with every thunderstrike.
author: potato_tub

entry: If you see a falling star during the daytime, it could be POKENAME zipping through the sky on its way to bring lightning to faraway regions.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME can summon lightning storms with a deafening bark but often hesitate on what evolution path they want to take. Many want to evolve through Thunder Stones but hesitate before they carry out the evolution.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many Trainers avoid owning a POKENAME because it cannot store all the electricity it produces. When it becomes overcharged, its fur releases small thunderclouds into the air.
author: 0reomilka

entry: POKENAME commands large hailstorms that can devastate entire villages. These hailstones are charged with electricity and can cause electric shocks when touched.
author: mistymagius

entry: When two Zapdos fuse together, they unleash an energy so intense that their body transforms into pure plasma and electricity. Some say the fused POKENAME holds enough power to fuel an entire region.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Seen nesting in long-abandoned power plants, POKENAME is considered highly-dangerous. Aggressive to outsiders, it fires electrically-charged needles that launch with the speed of lightning, and boom like thunder when fired.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's internal electric generation follows a strict regulation schedule. It vents a small burst of excess electricity around its body every hour, on the hour.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have been seen accidentally shocking their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in electrified waters.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's body is still developing, so it cannot properly fly or control its electricity yet. Whenever it flaps its wings to practice taking flight, it sends short range bolts of powerful lightning around it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a joyous personality, but little understanding or control of its powers. When overjoyed it prances and sprays sparks and even small bolts of lightning around, potentially causing problems for those it wants to play with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often flock to areas that Zapdos will appear at within 24 hours. Though they resemble such a powerful legendary bird and share some of its abilities, they are only capable of producing enough electricity to cause a slight static shock.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME's skin secretes a conductive toxin that draws lightning toward it. During storms, it perches atop tall trees or buildings, eagerly awaiting a strike. Each bolt provides enough energy to sustain it for six months.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It stores electrical power in the swollen bud on its back, which pulses with sparks before discharges. As it grows stronger, its body becomes increasingly magnetic, occasionally causing metal objects to stick to it.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Drawings resembling POKENAME have been seen within a number of ancient ruins. Research suggests the areas were prone to heavy lightning storms, so POKENAME may have been considered a harbinger of such by those old civilizations.
author: sk372

entry: Deciphered text from ancient murals tells of massive thunderstorms caused by the gathering of many POKENAME. However, since POKENAME are extremely rare, this has never been seen in modern times.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's front half resembles Zapdos's Galarian counterpart, and has a strong tendency to run about at high speeds. The back half is less equipped for running in such a manner, so it struggles to keep pace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's quills are able to pierce human skin and discharge electricity directly into the body. Swimming is off limits anywhere they are spotted.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME summons and channels lightning via the beak-like horn on its head. Its not uncommon to see pack-mates zapping each other to compete and determine hierarchy among themselves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME races across the land, rarely staying in one locale for more than a day. When it does linger, fierce rumbling storm clouds begin to accumulate in the area more and more the longer it stays.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tails create and hold clouds brimming with electricity, squeezing them to send numerous volts in every direction. It lets out a shrieking cackle as other Pokémon flee to avoid being zapped.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's highly conductive armor allows it to launch plasma-boosted rocks from its hand holes at extreme velocity. When no rocks are loaded, it fires concentrated plasma instead, though at a shorter range.
author: potato_tub

entry: The feathers of POKENAME can store an unfathomable amounts of electricity. A simple graze of their body can paralyze even the sturdiest of Pokémon.
author: ayner

entry: POKENAME's powerful legs let it dash across the ground at speeds approaching 70 MPH. Once it bonds with a Trainer, it regularly offers to ferry them quickly to wherever they need to go.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fires its giant tongue during battle. Once the needle-like tip makes contact with an enemy, POKENAME delivers a devastating shock.
author: mepp.

entry: Its back is overgrown with thick leaves that constantly crackle with stray voltage. During thunderstorms, it lies still and uses its foliage to absorb massive amounts of electrical energy.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The tower on its back is consistently producing large amounts of electricity. Researchers are hoping to find more POKENAME in the wild, as they could be a great boon to power plants across the world.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME is able to charge head-first into power outlets, being able to disappear into the electrical current and quickly travel through cities. This puts them in the perfect situation to ambush rivals.
author: doodledoo

entry: As POKENAME is only seen during intense storms, it is referred to as "Lord of Lightning". Its piercing cry is said to be as loud as thunder.
author: mepp.

entry: If you see a thunderstorm over the ocean, it may mean a POKENAME is near. The storm will quickly pass once POKENAME dives back down into the water.
author: kitarchen

entry: A Pokémon said to be a legendary warrior, appearing alongside raging thunderstorms. POKENAME channels fiery electricity through its body, unleashing electrified blows at blazing speed. Its strikes leave foes scorched and paralyzed.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME is a legendary sword Pokémon that resides around and regenerates in volcanic lava. Its appearance elsewhere is said to bring about spring.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Legend holds that it possesses the ability to dispel even the fiercest thunderstorms. Many ships carry a symbol of POKENAME in hopes of safe travels.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME never touches the ground, living its entire life high in the sky. Thunderstorms form around them as they fly, and they weaponise the bolts of lightning by using them to strike at other Pokémon and aircraft flying across their path.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME never touches the ground, living its entire life high in the sky. Thunderstorms form around them as they fly, and they weaponise the bolts of lightning by using them to strike at other Pokémon and aircraft flying across their path.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME never touches the ground, living its entire life high in the sky. Thunderstorms form around them as they fly, and they weaponise the bolts of lightning by using them to strike at other Pokémon and aircraft flying across their path.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This legendary Pokémon is said to dance elegantly amongst thunderclouds, with the ability to pounce down among bolts of lightning.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME is said to herald the approach of devastating thunderstorms. Efforts are being made to track it and create an early warning system to protect citizens.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME absorbs electrical energy from the nightmares of people across the world. Rural communities link dark storm clouds to its presence, spreading fear and worsening dreams, which only makes it stronger.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME absorbs electrical energy from the nightmares of people across the world. Rural communities link dark storm clouds to its presence, spreading fear and worsening dreams, which only makes it stronger.
author: h0bojoe

entry: With a flick of its wrist, POKENAME can release hundreds upon thousands of volts of electricity. It is too enigmatic and dangerous to properly be used as a power source at this time. It only follows the orders of a seasoned Trainer.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its electrified tail never goes out, even underwater, sparking erratically when it's agitated. Trainers are advised to keep it away from electronic devices.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME commands lightning and soars amidst clouds. Its wings shimmer with stormy energy, a majestic sight in the azure sky.
author: anarchaz

entry: Very rarely, a person entering a forest during a thunderstorm manages to catch a glimpse of this Pokémon. It is thought that POKENAME calls down lightning to destroy trees in the hopes of later returning to eat the rotting wood.
author: .realthree

entry: It once took over power lines throughout an entire city to channel its music to hapless crowds. The aftermath caused several power outages and nasty headaches.
author: frokachu

entry: The storm cloud swirling around its tail is said to mirror its mood, darkening and rumbling when it's angry. When a POKENAME is extremely furious, the lightning coming from its tail turns blue.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME lives at the top of treacherously tall mountains. It summons thunderstorms to blow its prey off of the mountainside, then climbs down to enjoy its meal.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's burrows sporadically release intense electrical surges. These shocks can easily paralyze even a Tyranitar without warning for days after digging.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME only flies through the sky during stormy weather. It absorbs lightning from storm clouds through its feathers, which provides it with energy and a burst of extra speed while in flight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefer to live on islands with lots of storms. The lightning in the background helps them escape their own thoughts, which can cause headaches if they ruminate too much on them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can conjure thunderstorms to strike lakes and rivers. Once the thunderstorm passes, POKENAME swoop in to eat the electrocuted Pokémon that float on the surface.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME nests at the top of mountains, causing a perpetual storm. It is said the deadly storm that surrounds its home only calms for a pure-hearted Trainer with a soul of steel. Whenever POKENAME roars, a clap of thunder is sure to follow.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hides itself within cumulus clouds, its electric stores slowly turning them dark and thunderous. Once its current hiding spot turns thunderous, it teleports to another, "clean" cloud to hide.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME nests at the top of mountains, causing a perpetual storm. It is said the deadly storm that surrounds its home only calms for a pure-hearted Trainer with a soul of steel. Whenever POKENAME roars, a clap of thunder is sure to follow.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME gallops with such speed that it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning crackling through the air. Only those it trusts the most are able to touch it without being zapped by its electrified fur.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's appearance has inspired a popular children's toy that floats on water. Its waterproof feathers trap heat near its body, allowing it to stay warm for hours while underwater.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME raise the temperature around them to create a thick muggy atmosphere and convince predators to eat elsewhere. Plucking a scarlet feather off of a POKENAME is said to bring good luck.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's fire burns forever and cannot be extinguished. Even water only strengthens the fire.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: If POKENAME's Trainer throws it into a starry night sky, POKENAME will fly similar to a shooting star. The further POKENAME is thrown, the more POKENAME will listen to its Trainer.
author: teatedtiten

entry: The light of a POKENAME's spinning flames is often claimed to rival the light of the sun itself. Its gem-like core is so hot that water will instantly evaporate upon touching it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can call upon fiery storms to burn down entire forests but will not commit to evolution through a Fire Stone. They feel nervous about committing to evolution, so much so that they avoid the issue when they can.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Upon fusing Moltres with itself, its flames grow to a strength too powerful for its own body. This causes it to transform into a creature made of pure fire.
author: pastamanjase

entry: POKENAME's ever-burning body radiates an intense heat. It is incredibly skittish, hiding away at the first sign of danger.
author: mepp.

entry: When sick or injured, POKENAME can be seen bathing in lava pools to heal itself. The flames along its back shimmer like the sun and flare up when it becomes enraged.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can be seen bathing in lava pools to relax and recover from intense fights. The flames along its back burn vigorously when it becomes enraged.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME have been seen accidentally incinerating their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in molten lava.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME never live alone, they grow together in large fields near thermal springs. The heat generated by POKENAME fields is so high that water from nearby springs evaporates.
author: elevn.

entry: When POKENAME reach maturity, their petals become incandescent. When they are grouped, the heat generated by their heads is so high that the sand on the ground turns into glass.
author: elevn.

entry: POKENAME lives at the top of the tallest mountains. Over winter it lets its fires be dampened by the harsh snowfall and falls into a deep slumber. Once Spring arrives, it uses Burn Up to completely clear the mountaintop of snow.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: A regal Pokémon that will only follow those it deems worthy. When it has chosen such a Trainer, its flames burn as brightly as stars in the night.
author: dicedragon20

entry: POKENAME has the power to control all kinds of fire. It is able to conjure images of a towering phoenix in place of its diminutive form.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME are found with many smaller Pokémon around them that they protect. In exchange for protection, these Pokémon bring it food that they roast in volcanoes, which increases POKENAME's strength.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are found with many smaller Pokémon around them that they protect, especially Remoraid. In exchange for protection, these Pokémon bring it food that they roast in geothermal vents, which increases POKENAME's strength.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are found with many smaller Pokémon around them that they protect. In exchange for protection, these Pokémon bring it food that they roast in geothermal vents, which increases POKENAME's strength.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its body produces potent flames which it often releases from its wings and from its rear to launch itself through the sky. Its body is said to be as hard as steel as a means to protect itself should it crash.
author: infinex21

entry: Milk sourced from POKENAME remains piping hot for a long amount of time. It has a pepper-like aftertaste to it, and is popular in some regions as an ingredient for spicy pasta sauces.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flames burn hotter and more wildly the longer it goes without milking. Owners need to make sure to keep a strict milking regiment to avoid potential future fire hazards.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME roams far and wide over the land and the air. When it runs, it leaves behind small flames with every step, while in the air, lightning crackles from every flap of its wings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can turn any body of water into a relaxing hot spring by heating the water to just the right temperature. POKENAME can use these hot springs to heal itself from almost any injury.
author: darkweavile428

entry: The flames of POKENAME shine as bright and as hot as the sun itself. Legends claim that if POKENAME were ever to perish, then its egg will open and it will rise anew from it clad in flames with a brand-new egg already in its clutches.
author: infinex21
