entry: POKENAME is popular among keepers of Bug-type Pokémon due to its territorial nature. It will spit a honey-like substance at foes, sticking them in place before setting the substance ablaze and jabbing them with its many tail stingers.
author: chibitales

entry: After spending many months underground, adult POKENAME emerge simultaneously in a swarm. These emergences occur regularly at specific times of year, requiring rural communities to prepare in advance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME constructs sticky honeycomb within its riverside lodges. The sweet scent of honey in the air makes its home easy to locate.
author: .izik

entry: It cultivates honey that is extremely high in protein. Bodybuilders use this ingredient in supplements to increase their muscle mass.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enters a frenzy, wildly swinging its stingers if anything approaches its hive. The honey produced inside is highly nutritious and sought after.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its territory, distracting wayward travelers with flashes of light before attacking.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: Despite its wings, POKENAME is not a very mobile Pokémon. It creates traps to lure prey, secreting honey to draw other Pokémon before ambushing them with its powerful jaws and stingers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite its wings, POKENAME is not a very mobile Pokémon. It creates traps to lure prey, secreting honey to draw other Pokémon before ambushing them with its powerful jaws and stingers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite its wings, POKENAME is not a very mobile Pokémon. It creates traps to lure prey, secreting honey to draw other Pokémon before ambushing them with its powerful jaws and stingers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME covers its head with pieces of rival hives it vandalizes to assert dominance over its neighbors. Due to its irritable temperament, it doesn't hesitate to fight with all its might using the two stingers it has in place of arms.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME communicate with each other by flashing signals from their red cores. Many POKENAME will gather together and connect to form hives.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are the workers of a hive made of Beeink, communicating by flashing their red cores. When they spin their bodies, they produce a a very sweet and sticky honey from the spots surrounding their red cores.
author: infinex21

entry: As it consumes flowers, a yellow fluid leaks from its pores. Though it has the appearance and scent of honey, it's actually a powerful toxin.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon roasts berries with its fiery breath before skewering them on its sharp stingers. Its favorite treat is honey-glazed fruit, which it gathers from hives it carefully guards.
author: jaminmcready

entry: If under attack, colonies of POKENAME use echolocation to line up their strikes. They fly through the dark before injecting venom with their barbed stingers when provoked.
author: xenodactyl

entry: The honey from the honeycomb of a POKENAME is potently bittersweet. Consuming it causes deep slumber filled with vivid, existential nightmares.
author: crumple_2

entry: POKENAME bravely defends its hive from enemies even when outnumbered. With its stingers, it marks trees that are sick so Rangers can locate them more easily.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The sound waves that burst from its mouth sound like billions of buzzing insects. This can cause nausea and dizziness.
author: .izik

entry: Many POKENAME use honey as a main food source. However, sourcing the honey is up to each POKENAME; some make it from scratch, some conquer hives, and some steal from other POKENAME.
author: jojojax164

entry: The scourge of apiarists all across Kanto, POKENAME will target rival hives and steal their honey.
author: volvonovic

entry: Its stinger is extremely heavy, making it uncomfortable to fly for long periods. It will roll on its back to show respect to the leader of its swarm.
author: .izik

entry: A swarm of POKENAME will gather to form a nest out of their own bodies. Should the nest be approached by a predator, they will roll away in unison.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are aggressive Pokémon that are very keen on taking over territories of other Pokémon. They have a great sense of smell.
author: mystora

entry: Some believe this is what today's Beedrill looked like over 150 million years ago. It wards off threats from its nest with its ear-splitting roars.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its hive, using its hard, spherical body to form hexagonal walls around the hive.
author: rakunk

entry: It flutters from flower to flower searching for its favorite pollen. Should it find its most coveted treat, it will consume the entire flower.
author: .izik

entry: It does an odd dance while collecting pollen from flowerbeds. Once it has enough, it will spin and spread the pollen to other flowers.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon will gladly cheer atop its hive for hours. Should POKENAME spin during the cheer, small amounts of crystallized honey will be scattered from its feathers.
author: .izik

entry: It swings its stingers in circular patterns while dancing. It emits a fragrance that smells like honey from its crown.
author: .izik

entry: A skilled dancer, POKENAME dances to warn off would-be intruders to their territory. Its stingers make it a difficult opponent to deal with.
author: pory

entry: POKENAME are best known for producing exceptionally delicious honey. If they receive improper care, however, their honey will become highly toxic.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME fly about forests at surprising speeds given how small their wings are. These highly territorial Pokémon will jab at prey and intruders alike with their Twineedle attacks until they succumb from the physical injuries or from their poison.
author: infinex21

entry: The fin-like wings of a POKENAME and their dorsal fins allow them to quickly soar through the air, bobbing and weaving through the trees. They will fire their poison-laced stingers from their wings like missiles at any territorial intruders.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's territory can be known through the trails of honey it leaves as it moves. In exchange for being a hive, the Beedrill within serve its will.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Despite its gentle appearance, POKENAME is fiercely territorial. It will protect the flower field where its swarm gathers pollen at all costs, using its large venomous stingers to drive away intruders.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The nectar in its flower and the drool from its mouth are both incredibly sweet. Even with stingers for defense, it still finds itself accosted by a variety of Pokémon addicted to the tastes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spreads its majestic wings to patrol above its hive, even in the dead of night. It repels intruders with sonic waves released from the ears atop its head.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite weighing over a ton, POKENAME is able to fly around erratically like any other insect. Its metallic exterior protects a soft honey interior.
author: serversizeme

entry: POKENAME's once hollow body is now a hive of swarming Beedrill. Despite weighing over several tons, it's wings still allow it to fly.
author: serversizeme

entry: The large rose on POKENAME's head is often mistaken for a beautiful, fragrant flower, luring many to approach. This enrages it, and it strikes with the poisonous needles on its body to protect its petals.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its furry body is filled with highly-pressurized honey. The honey leaks from its paws, leaving a trail while it walks.
author: .izik

entry: Its prey gets stuck in its sticky body, allowing POKENAME to slowly consume them. Its sweet aroma ends up attracting all sorts of bug Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: The mushrooms that grow on its body smell like honey. If boiled, they can create a tea that can help eliminate a sour stomach.
author: .izik

entry: By frantically flapping its wings above its head, POKENAME can create gusts of icy wind. The sharp spines on its tail serve as a deterrent to prevent predators from hunting it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Tended to by farmers, POKENAME serves a dual purpose. While it pollinates crops, its territorial nature drives it to protect the field from any intruders.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are territorial, and are ferociously loyal to their Trainers. Both its stinger and the rocks in its mane carry dangerous poison.
author: skinstealers

entry: POKENAME attacks the hives of other Bug-type Pokémon and usurps their leaders. After taking over a hive, it forces its new underlings to gather honey while it sleeps.
author: mourge40k

entry: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME are superb dancers that are light on their feet. One of their signature performances involves dancing to a famous orchestral interlude called "Flight of the Beedrill".
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME usually travel in colonies, attacking any dangerous foe. Its stingers actually come from its mushroom as a way to fend off predators.
author: imagine1.

entry: Wild POKENAME are the worker Pokémon of their local hives, capable of carrying almost three times their bodyweight atop their backs. They will use their tail stinger to defend themselves, but the poison within is the only real threat.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME are the frontline fighters and defenders of their hives. They attack with combinations of thrusting attacks using the stinger upon their tails and forceful punches.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME will clash their scales together to signal to the other members of their hive when an intruder is present. The massive stinger upon its tail is capable of cleanly penetrating steel.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lounges on logs to bask in the sunlight when no one is around. If it spots an intruder, it panics and emits a frantic buzzing noise while fleeing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their sensitive antennae to detect weaker Bug-types, luring them with the scents from the foamy jelly on the head. POKENAME also use these antennae to detect predators and avoid attracting them.
author: entomoxie

entry: Each POKENAME stakes out a claim to a section of jungle. In its territory, it lies dormant, waiting patiently for other Bug-types to enter, then strikes faster than the eye can see. Attacked Pokémon are left paralyzed by venom, ready to be consumed.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The gems on its body are made of crystallized honey, used as a portable snack by POKENAME. Many have tried to harvest this honey, but POKENAME's stingers tend to have other plans.
author: hophoppip

entry: This Pokémon uses its stingers to drill into mountain walls. This Pokémon's honey is used by a bakery in Riyado Town that creates delicious Salac Berry Tarts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases pheromones to psychically control other nearby Bug-type Pokémon. With a flick of its drill-like appendages, its hidden army suddenly erupts to attack its foe.
author: pattybgoode

entry: Though not terribly mobile, POKENAME can strike with its stingers at an incredibly rapid and accurate pace. Some have trained their POKENAME to carve intricate jack o' lanterns from pumpkins for autumn celebrations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body pattern looks very similar to other Beedrill, which it uses to scare off other Pokémon while flying at night. It will even use it to raid Beedrill hives for their honey, with varying levels of success.
author: mistymagius

entry: Spirits congregate in POKENAME's body like insects in a hive. To obtain new souls, POKENAME stings an unsuspecting victim, then absorbs its soul into its honey-like limbs.
author: hophoppip

entry: Rather than create their own hives, POKENAME instead offer protection to the hives of weaker Beedrill fusions. They use their lances to dispatch any threats to the nest they serve.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME fiercely defends its territory, striking intruders with powerful attacks from the spines at the tips of its limbs. It can produce a honey-like substance that, being highly flammable, enhances the power of its Fire-type moves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: After long periods underground, POKENAME emerges to buzz its wings violently. This shakes off clinging dirt, which it finds deeply unpleasant.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are highly affectionate, flying directly at anyone they set their sights on. Unfortunately, they don't seem to realize how sharp their stingers are.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon in aquariums and large fish tanks. They have a striking colouration, but their venomous stinger means they require specialist handling.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Subterranean hives created by POKENAME can exceed 300 feet in length. Even minor disturbances trigger violent swarm responses.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are popular with thieves as they have an aggressive nature and are drawn to valuable objects. Large swarms can be uncontrollable, however, resulting in thieves being driven out of their own hideouts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's honey is sweet and medicinal, effective at helping headaches in people and Pokémon. Because it suffers from constant headaches itself, POKENAME is usually seen eating or bathing in the stuff.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a particularly dangerous Pokémon because of its aggressive nature. It frequently throws tantrums and will sting its Trainer until it receives what it wants.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Highly aggressive towards anyone within its territory, POKENAME uses its powerful stinger to pierce foes. It then consumes them, leaving no trace behind.
author: canada

entry: Wild POKENAME are very hostile and competitive towards people and other Pokémon. They are known to be difficult to tame.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME defends its hive by hypnotizing intruders with the spiral on its belly, then hit them with its sharp stinger once they fall asleep. Since its body needs to stay hydrated, it prefers to live near rivers or small lakes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME, with its vicious temper, is one of the most dangerous bugs to encounter. Even if it loses its prey, it can locate it using psychic power.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME typically stays near its nest where it eats honey and practices stabbing with its stingers. Whenever a predator arrives at the nest, it springs into action and attacks the threat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME leaks a thick, candy-scented honey from its mouth. If a Pokémon enters its mouth to eat the honey, it swiftly inhales and traps them.
author: .izik

entry: A courageous omnivore, POKENAME explores other areas of the forest in which it dwells in that other Pokémon may not to hunt and gather food. Each POKENAME has slightly unique hair patterns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME attacks with its electrically charged stingers. It swarms with others of its kind to overwhelm larger Pokémon.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is a monstrous pile of honey. It tricks Bug Catchers into mistaking it for Beedrill. When it sees prey, it traps them in their sticky honey.
author: .thewaffles.

entry: A courageous omnivore, POKENAME explores other areas of the forest in which it dwells in that other Pokémon may not to hunt and gather food. Each POKENAME has slightly unique hair patterns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME fires bursts of water from its back cannons to knock foes off their feet. It also jabs its stingers into opponents when they are too close to fire its water cannons.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is surrounded by a corrosive honey corona which it uses to burrow through the walls of abandoned buildings where it makes its hive. Drips of the honey remain behind, making urban explorers mistake it for ghostly ectoplasm.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME silently stalks through its habitat of an empty building, seeking out unsuspecting people. When it finds a victim, it chases them, cackling maliciously and trying to poke them with its stingers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME congregate in abandoned buildings to plot how to best torment nearby towns. They swarm in a cacophony of buzzing giggles and steal items to construct and expand their hive.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Most POKENAME grow up without a parent, forcing them to fend for themselves and grow cold and standoffish. Some have been observed at night, drawing an image similar to Mew in the air with psychic energy.
author: sk372

entry: It contains immense psychic powers within its shell. POKENAME resembles a fabled Pokémon from a faraway land.
author: toad900

entry: First discovered on Cinnabar Island, POKENAME is theorized to be left over from failed cloning attempts during Mewtwo's creation. Being incomplete, it can only partially mimic the form of the being it was supposed to be.
author: sk372

entry: Its firepower matches its fiery temperament, as it holds a grudge against all of humanity. It will show no mercy to anyone, incinerating anything that dares stand in its way with its psionic flames.
author: mistymagius

entry: Brimming with ego and power alike, POKENAME isolates itself from those it deems unworthy, claiming entire islands for itself. It uses psychic powers to force those who invade its territory to kneel before it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly circles the globe in search of opponents worthy of its strength. Despite how viciously it battles, it will rush to the aid of those it finds in trouble.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Fusion has caused POKENAME to develop a highly aggressive personality. It teleports around, flinging psychic projectiles indiscriminately at others. It searches for powerful rivals who can compete against its mental might and give it a proper fight.
author: sk372

entry: The fangs of POKENAME are imbued with the power to confuse anyone unlucky enough to be bitten. The only way to break out of this confusion is with ice-cold water.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME entangles prey in mysterious webs that drain their energy. The more energy that is drained, the bigger POKENAME becomes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME constantly battles conflicting personalities, gentle one moment, destructive the next. It may help others selflessly, then lash out in fury. Some say a Trainer who helps it master its emotions will form a bond beyond ordinary understanding.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It is a very antisocial Pokémon and hates being told what to do. Its immense psychic abilities allow for it to command anyone in its vicinity to do its bidding.
author: mistymagius

entry: There have been many rumors about POKENAME being a failed replication of Mewtwo but there is not enough evidence to prove this theory. Touching its body seems to drain its victims of their intelligence.
author: mistymagius

entry: Foes feel incredible pressure from just a single glare from POKENAME; weaker wild Pokémon sometimes faint from that look alone. When it strikes, its overwhelming ambient psychic power makes the target feel as though the entire world has gone quiet.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME harnesses the power of the mind and the earth. It is capable of dominating foes with both mental and physical force.
author: anarchaz

entry: As a result of a poorly decontaminated laboratory, sand slipped into a machine and combined with Mew's DNA, thus creating POKENAME.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME's psychic abilities are almost without peer, to the point some theorize that at full power it could warp reality. It staunchly protects its trainer, showing almost no emotion as it does so.
author: sk372

entry: As the first of the cloned starters, it remains more docile and protective. It lives deep in jungle caves to watch over the forest life.
author: toad900

entry: It uses its mouth to extract and absorb pieces of living flesh from anything it encounters. It's theorized that the reason for this is that POKENAME looks to absorb the DNA of every Pokémon to finally become the perfect upgrade of Mew.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME has enough power to crush a building with its psychic power. Thankfully, POKENAME is too lazy to do much other than eat.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME was genetically engineered in an attempt to create the ultimate weapon, but it refuses to be wielded.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME treats the skies as an ocean, using its psychic power to stay hidden from Trainers. Despite this, strange sightings by Sailors of figures swimming in the night sky were widely reported.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to manipulate its target's senses, further enhancing its illusions with false touch and smell and making them nearly indistinguishable from reality.
author: phoenixftw

entry: Created by humans to be the ultimate weapon, POKENAME has left its past behind to forge its own path. Those who come near it find they can't fight it.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME was engineered and genetically altered to create the perfect Pokémon. It can turn its arm into a cannon able to penetrate the hardest steel.
author: jona_hehe

entry: POKENAME can fire concentrated psychic blasts from the cannon on its arms. No one knows what this Pokémon looks like under its armor.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sneaks up on other creatures, creating strings made from its own powerful psychic energy that latch onto others. Once snared, it can manipulate its victim to do its bidding.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are immensely powerful psychics, capable of manipulating anything they can see. Specialist rangers need to be brought in to deal with POKENAME colonies as soon as they're discovered in case of danger to locals.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are immensely powerful psychics, capable of manipulating anything they can see. Specialist rangers need to be bought in to deal with POKENAME colonies as soon as they're discovered in case of danger to locals.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The middle head controls the other two with its psychic powers. However, if all three heads are in perfect sync, they can turn a whole city to ashes.
author: mistymagius

entry: An alien virus and a man-made Pokémon capable of incredible destruction fused into POKENAME. Those in POKENAME's presence feel increasingly nauseous and eventually begin behaving erratically. Even studying POKENAME from afar proves dangerous.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping in deep caves to conserve psychic power. The psychic energy it accumulates causes it to illuminate in the darkness.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is still developing, using its psychic power to maintain the amniotic bubble it sleeps in. Even like this, it boasts incredible mental abilities.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's sharp screech messes with the mind of those who hear it, leaving them disoriented and easier to attack. It requires the drinking of other's blood to keep its body and its psychic powers strong.
author: sk372

entry: The frill around POKENAME's neck glows with energy when using telekinesis. Its roar sends out a shockwave of psychic energy that overloads the senses of those in front of it, leaving them immobile and helpless.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is viciously violent and intelligent, and should be avoided at all costs if spotted. Rumors circulate that it was created in a lab to be entertainment at an island zoo resort before escaping.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME unleashes waves of psychically charged sound waves to disorient and overwhelm its foes. While they are reeling from the psionic attack, it swoops down and viciously claws and bites its target before unleashing more sonic bursts.
author: evilgammon

entry: An alien parasite from another universe and a man-made experiment fused to become this Pokémon. It brings forth an eclipse, striking fear in foes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A rogue team of geneticists combined samples from Cresselia's feathers with research from a laboratory involved in Mewtwo's creation. The resulting POKENAME proved far too powerful for these mad scientists to control.
author: entomoxie

entry: A rogue team of geneticists combined samples from Cresselia's feathers with research from a laboratory involved in Mewtwo's creation. The resulting POKENAME proved far too powerful for these mad scientists to control.
author: entomoxie

entry: If it is angered, then it burns its opponents to their very soul. Then, it uses its psychic powers to leave no trace behind.
author: skymaster426

entry: In fits of rage, POKENAME releases massive psychic bursts from underground. The force is strong enough to topple skyscrapers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has been described as unusually cruel by observers, seen bullying weaker Pokémon. POKENAME's hydrokinetic powers are matched by few, able to lift entire rivers with ease.
author: krune

entry: Due to being cloned, the fires it forges are lukewarm. Its psychic knowledge allows it the ability to change toxic viewpoints of people.
author: toad900

entry: Said to be the pinnacle of psychic Pokémon, POKENAME is said to be nine times more powerful than its origin, Mewtwo. It is said to be extremely cruel in battle.
author: thistleblower

entry: POKENAME was created from the DNA of various great fighters and fighting-type Pokémon. It still needs to undergo some training, however.
author: milchik

entry: It has trained in solitude for many years in order to defeat its former masters. Strikes from its fists stun opponents with psychic energy.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME trains nonstop and learns to fight from the recordings of the most skillful fighters in history. Fighting without rest is in its DNA.
author: milchik

entry: Being created from DNA of the strongest fighters combined, POKENAME embodied the very aspect of fighting type. It can't be defeated in a fair combat.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME wields both immense psychic power and blazing fire, allowing it to bend reality and scorch the skies in a single breath. It is said to only appear during intense solar flares, warping the air around it with heat and telekinetic force.
author: corkedjupiter63

entry: Visually very similar to Slowpoke, mentally POKENAME is its complete opposite, intelligent and scheming. It uses this intellect and unassuming form to take advantage and manipulate other Pokémon to do its bidding.
author: sk372

entry: Mew often pranks POKENAME by grabbing and nibbling its tail suddenly. POKENAME's angry reaction ruins its ruse as a dim, placid Pokémon, which Mew uses to teach POKENAME a lesson.
author: sk372

entry: The three heads exhibit features and behavior from Mewtwo and its two Mega forms. POKENAME's stance and fighting style changes depending on which head is currently most in control.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME charges its cannon with psychic energy. The water it shoots contains many bacteria that can manipulate the brain of a person nearby.
author: 0reomilka

entry: POKENAME have been so elusive because of their ability to turn invisible, a trait that is often associated with Ghost-type Pokémon. Over many years, POKENAME have adapted to become nearly undetectable, except when eating leaves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME holds the genes of all Pokémon in its bulbous hands. It punches with the power of an ancient species that has been long forgotten.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME holds the genes of all Pokémon in its bulbous hands. It punches with the power of an ancient species that has been long forgotten.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME is highly respected for its cute nature and the pattern on its torso. When its Trainer is sad, it tries everything it can to cheer them up.
author: theactualcontentyouwantreal

entry: POKENAME possesses the ability to rewrite the cellular structure of its cocoon. It does this in response to the presence of other Pokémon, morphing its outer layer into a defense tailor-made for whatever predator tries to hunt it.
author: sk372

entry: The orbs this Pokémon produces contains the essence of all Pokémon. Many believe the smaller head is the dominant one.
author: themicelegion

entry: The embryo within the orb is the true POKENAME. The larger creature is actually a psionic construct made from the Pokémon's psychic powers.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME is renowned for its friendly attitude and playful dances, which it's always willing to show off. It takes great pride in its hair as well, grooming it thoroughly after any performance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is known to have a voracious appetite for sweets, always on the lookout for treats. Some say it will turn others into candy if it's hungry enough, though this is unconfirmed and unlikely.
author: sk372

entry: Though weak, POKENAME is extremely friendly to people and Pokémon alike. It gives its beautiful pink scales to those it likes.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's warm body soothes those who touch it, emptying their mind of troubled thoughts for a time. In battle, it can psychically manipulate the fire it breathes, making it move in unique arcs and chase after evasive foes.
author: sk372

entry: It is said to hold every possible line of computer code within its genes. Scientists have spent decades trying to see if its genome could be replicated with modern technology.
author: mistymagius

entry: The wings on POKENAME's arms are thought to have become vestigial after learning to levitate with their psychic power. Despite their cute appearance, Trainers are advised to leave POKENAME colonies alone, lest they be pelted with Rock Blast attacks.
author: chibitales

entry: The lightning coursing across POKENAME's body appears to be composed of pure psychic energy. Those struck by its bolts have their will to battle completely zapped away.
author: sk372

entry: Kindhearted but incredibly shy, POKENAME tries to make itself as elusive as possible. It helps those in need, but teleports away immediately after the rescue, leaving no trace of its presence behind.
author: sk372

entry: Some have nicknamed this fusion "Mewthree." Fusion has calmed Mewtwo's once-violent heart, perhaps due to Mew's genetic material filling in gaps in Mewtwo's DNA. It has become a being of incredible power, but also incredible kindness.
author: sk372

entry: Researchers speculate that this particular Mew fusion was the result of a rare genetic disorder. POKENAME seems to be perfectly fine, however.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME have an extraordinary genetic structure that allows the stem atop their heads to grow into many kinds of plants. Their tails are used for playful pranks or to cling tightly to others.
author: infinex21

entry: Young POKENAME are incredibly friendly and inquisitive, constantly exploring and engaging with Pokémon and Trainers. As they age, they withdraw into themselves, and once fully mature, spend most of their time invisible.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is a curious sort, often following along after something passing by has caught its interest. It is rather shy as well, so should the person it follows turn to see their pursuer, it turns invisible so as not to get caught.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME seems to possess the capability to read and influence the minds of all other species of Pokémon. With a playful and kind nature, it primarily uses the influence to make those it encounters more peaceable.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is accompanied by two floating claws that it controls through powerful telekinetic powers. Its power appears to originate in its double tails, as the tips glow bright as it directs the claws around.
author: sk372

entry: The sight of this Pokémon is a memory that will last forever, as its beauty astounds people and Pokémon alike. It preys on flying Pokémon almost exclusively.
author: notsaying.

entry: With tremendous psychic power, POKENAME seemingly morph the very land with convincing illusions. Because of this, encountering one is extremely rare.
author: t.i.a.

entry: This Pokémon's ears and feet have grown larger after fusion. POKENAME's vines have also morphed into additional tails, which it doesn't need or use.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME is very famous in the beauty scene. Many Contest superstars were inspired by this Pokémon.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME possesses a powerful psychic prowess that allows it to manipulate objects with its mind. It has a shy nature, so sightings are rare.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Mew's unique DNA allows POKENAME to change any part of its body into that of any other Pokémon while in combat. These chimeric combinations allow it to create nearly unbeatable offensive and defensive forms.
author: sk372

entry: It's thought that POKENAME can psychically resonate with any nearby Pokémon and pacify them, putting them to sleep so that it can also peacefully slumber without the noise of conflict.
author: sk372

entry: A psychic, shapeshifting weapon, this Pokémon aspires to become the strongest by learning every move.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Appearing only to those of pure heart, it is a very playful Pokémon. It does not seem to grasp its level of power.
author: melodydelune

entry: Its cells store the information about every landmass in the world. It can create any mineral by just pressing some soil between its powerful hands.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME are extraordinarily elusive Pokémon, typically only found high up in the atmosphere and very rarely returning to the ground. Their genetic structure is remarkably adaptable, allowing them to mimic any other Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is said to intrinsically understand the true nature of every being that was or ever will be. Flames of blue and red will travel along its tail and ignite the symbol at the end, should it be in the presence of those with dishonest hearts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's DNA contains the genetic code of all Pokémon. However, its cellular structure is so unstable that it freezes parts of its body to keep itself from unraveling.
author: h0bojoe

entry: "One day, an unknown force will freeze everyone together to become one single organism." Although this quote from a famous science fiction novelist predates the recorded existence of POKENAME, conspiracy theorists believe POKENAME has this ability.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME charges mysterious energy in its wings, bubbles of an unknown substance begin forming in the air.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME charges mysterious energy in its wings. This one has a rare coloration.
author: .realthree

entry: Its crystal core contains the DNA of every known Pokémon. Geneticists theorize that it can transform any Pokémon it touches into any other form, using its vast DNA manipulation skill.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being very elusive, POKENAME are very playful and will chase anything that even somewhat interested it. Sightings of POKENAME have been accompanied by a flurry of pink sparkles.
author: mistymagius

entry: When this fusion tenses its jaws and muscles in a very specific way, its usually soft skin becomes harder than tungsten carbide. Lots of kids have fun imitating its particular expression.
author: epping_forest

entry: The psychic powers triggered by POKENAME's dances are so strong they can be witnessed rippling the air around it. Even the most violent and aggressive of Pokémon will be pacified if POKENAME dances near it.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say that POKENAME originated from an injured Mew that got stuck in a tree, which came to life and grew around the Mew in order to protect it.
author: kittyluv090

entry: A Mew that figured out how to connect its brain to a Registeel. Its brainpower is unmatched by even the smartest Pokémon.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: Sightings of POKENAME in the wild are so rare, it was thought to be only a rumor until recently. The most common sighting appears to be Vermillion City, and reports always include sighting a Mew accompanying it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spreads a puff of spores around itself once per day. The spores will grow into all manner of different mushrooms; scientists believe POKENAME may potentially be able to produce any kind of fungus, if only at random.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly playful creature that entertains humans and Pokémon alike by creating spheres of psychic energy. When someone is cold, it curls up against them with its ever-warm pink fur, trying to share its warmth.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are extremely rare sights and only fall to the surface every 500 years. They love to play with small stones and meteorite fragments.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME naps peacefully underground in meadow habitats, leaving its tail exposed and wagging. Ancient texts praise its gentle and playful nature.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's head aches if it's not in the presence of other Pokémon. The larger the group and the more varied the species of Pokémon within, the more its pain ebbs away.
author: sk372

entry: No matter how dirty the surroundings, the water POKENAME makes its home in remains pristine. The jewel on its forehead emits a psychic energy that constantly removes impurities in the water it swims in.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME creates swirling patterns made of bubbles in the air whenever it meets someone new. The bubbles are laced with psychic emanations that invoke a feeling of peace in those who gaze at them.
author: sk372

entry: Though POKENAME much prefers friendship to fighting, it won't back down from sparring or combat. It creates extra arms from psychic energy when it battles, making it impressively formidable and difficult to defend against.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME forms a mobile shell around itself by compacting heavy stones together via telekinesis. It's very shy by nature, so it's rarely seen outside of the shell, even among its friends and Trainer.
author: sk372

entry: Medical science has achieved great breakthroughs thanks to POKENAME. Because its body contains the DNA of every Pokémon, researchers are slowly developing antivenom for every Poison type and their myriad fusions.
author: sk372

entry: When Mew and Krabby fused to form POKENAME, analysis of its genome suggested its DNA was more stable than many other fusions. This conclusion led a few scientists to theorize that everything may eventually evolve into a crab.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its body is coated in a poisonous sweat that wards off anything that tries to take a bite out of it. Its leaf gives off a sweet scent that makes others feel happy.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spins its big leaf as a propeller helping it levitate. The downward wind blows its foul-smelling gas down to fertilize plants.
author: reese1017600

entry: When the leaf on its snout becomes a bright lime, its body produces a mild, slightly musky scent that reminds people of cantaloupes. When its Trainer allows it to bask in the sunlight, it accelerates the growth of potential inside before it evolves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swim close to the surface and sunbathe for hours every day. When threatened, it shoots seeds and dangerous powders to drive predators away.
author: toniaglitched

entry: POKENAME swim near the surface during daytime. Its body is covered by leaves that secrete poison whenever it gets angry. POKENAME have been seen tumbling ships that come near its nest.
author: toniaglitched

entry: Its powdery leaves are a common ingredient in herbal remedies. Apothecaries will commonly offer fresh honey to POKENAME in exchange for its assistance.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME has an insipid taste and a gritty texture that makes it unappetizing to eat. As such, fishermen who catch it usually toss it back into the water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Drifting aimlessly among seaweed, POKENAME seems strangely content. It does what little it can to help any Pokémon in need it encounters.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME elegantly swims in icy waters, steering itself with the leaf atop its head. When it naps by the shore, patches of grass sprout wherever its body touches the stones or the icy shores.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Gracefully gliding through frigid seas, POKENAME uses the leaf on its head to guide its strokes. When it dozes along frozen banks, tender grass blooms in its wake, defying the cold.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The plant on its back is said to have existed 100 million years ago. It lives on the seafloor, using its leaf to tether itself to rocks or coral to prevent itself from getting swept away by ocean currents.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME loves basking in the sun and is surprisingly gentle. Its comforting presence can calm others, making it a favorite companion for stress relief, and can encourage peaceful naps.
author: mbavenger64

entry: POKENAME loves basking in the sun and is surprisingly gentle. Its comforting presence can calm others, making it a favorite companion for stress relief, and can encourage peaceful naps.
author: mbavenger64

entry: POKENAME loves basking in the sun and is surprisingly gentle. Its comforting presence can calm others, making it a favorite companion for stress relief, and can encourage peaceful naps.
author: mbavenger64

entry: POKENAME releases a sweet scent from its leaves, which can be harvested to produce tea. Its leaves only take a week to grow, so harvesting the tea leaves does not harm it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME basks in fields to absorb sunlight. It produces a scent that gets stronger on days it absorbs more sunlight. Trainers who enjoy this scent give it hugs so the scent rubs off on them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It blends perfectly into treetops thanks to its leaf-shaped wings. When POKENAME is happy, its body releases a natural fragrance that helps soothe symptoms of nausea.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's mood and overall health can be gleaned from its leaf tail: if it is sad or ill, the leaf wilts. In extreme cases, it may even fall off.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME has a mild and agreeable temperament, making it perfect for training. It loves to roll around in flourishing meadows. When happy or determined, it releases a relaxing aroma.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME walks through trails and scales up hills to find the best place to photosynthesize. Their sense of time ensures that they never miss a minute of daylight, even during rainy days.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fold vines into their nest to siphon nutrients from tree branches while they sleep. Perfume manufacturers capture the scent produced by the vines to create a floral perfume that lasts for hours.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME releases a soothing rosemary scent moments before discharging sparks. The aroma lulls opponents into a false sense of security before the shock hits.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon stores all of the oils and oil-based nutrients it needs in its tail leaf. Its body absorbs water, while the floating leaf absorbs light.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME flies around by rapidly spinning the leaf on its head. It naturally produces a sweet aroma that uplifts one's mood.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME frolic in flower-filled meadows, prancing around jubilantly. Pollen gets stuck to their body as they do so, and eventually transfers onto other flowers, pollinating them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: At night, POKENAME shakes its head back and forth which causes the leaves on its face to release a sweet fragrance that helps it sleep. These leaves grow throughout its life and help generate enough oxygen to help POKENAME breathe underwater.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This Pokémon releases a subtle scent that puts others to sleep, allowing it to steal from them undisturbed. The effect wears off by morning, leaving no trace, and no memory of what occurred.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a leafy bulb on their back that can be harvested to make soups. These leafy greens have a sweet and refreshing taste.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The leaf around POKENAME's face is as sturdy as the steel on the rest of its body, giving it added protection. It only pulls back to reveal its face when it breathes out a suffocatingly sweet breath to disorient others.
author: sk372

entry: When it waves its leaf, it lets loose the smell of fresh barley. The leaf itself is extremely soft and is used by POKENAME as a pillow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's razor-sharp claws are prized by chefs, as boiling and chopping them releases a minty aroma. In the wild, it uses these claws to slice herbs for its meals.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME climb trees to knock down berries to eat. They are primarily herbivorous and have a disdain for hunting other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produces sweet smelling seeds in the leaf atop its head. It eats and composts organic matter to maintain its temperature and keep its skin gooey.
author: the_fireplace

entry: Although POKENAME have a thick layer of fur covering its body, it is horrible at dealing with cold temperatures. The leaves that cover POKENAME's eyes are very sensitive and help it locate itself.
author: toniaglitched

entry: It releases an aroma that triggers a sense of panic in those nearby. The scent lingers in the air, unsettling both Pokémon and people alike.
author: .izik

entry: Each successful strike from POKENAME releases a fresh dill-like scent. The stronger the strike, the more potent the aroma.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME extends its vines during lightning storms, absorbing electricity to store in its body. This energy keeps it active and alert even during extended periods of darkness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME frolics through fields with boundless joy. Its cheerful demeanor and budding potential bring smiles to all who encounter it on sunny days.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME buries itself, only letting the leaf on its head to be shown. Scientists have said that its body has a similar composition to most seeds.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME frequently mimics shopkeepers, matching their gestures and expressions with surprising accuracy. When it perfectly copies someone, it emits a refreshing herbal fragrance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's burrows are lined with roots that release a faint chive-like aroma. This scent marks its territory and deters unwelcome visitors.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will hide itself from predators by holding onto tree branches and sticking out its tail to pretend to be a leaf. Much of its diet consists of tree sap that it extracts with its tongue.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's head produces different scents depending on its mood. Each individual of this species has its own small garden of berries it tends to with diligence. Berries it chooses to eat are roasted with an Ember attack.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME uses the leaf on its head to interact with its surroundings. It becomes agitated if the leaf is grabbed or pinched.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME are often found around rural communities. Their empathic powers lead them to tend to farmland and wilderness alike with equal care.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME gives off a scent reminiscent of baked bread, attracting both humans and Pokémon. This aroma makes it a comforting presence in forests and fields.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME's body can shift hues to blend in with any territory, its leaf can only become the natural colors that foliage takes with the seasons. As such, it hides away among leafy tree branches where it can camouflage properly.
author: sk372

entry: The sap flowing through POKENAME's body contains magnetized iron particles, allowing it to hover by repelling the world's magnetic field. When attacked, it floats as high as possible, releasing a sweet scent in hopes of pacifying the foe below.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME does its best to help take care of plants. It trims spare branches with it teeth so that shorter plants can receive more sunlight.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: POKENAME gains most of its energy from photosynthesis thanks to the leaf on its head. To obtain the nutrients it can't synthesize, the small mouth on the back of its head snaps at flying insects that pass by.
author: hophoppip

entry: If POKENAME senses an approaching tornado, it releases an intense basil-like scent. This aroma spreads far, acting as a warning signal to Pokémon nearby.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon consumes rotten vegetation, using it to nourish the plants on its back. Its ability to recycle decay makes it a vital part of the ecosystem.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME would rather calm its opponent with its blade's sweet aroma than fight. Unlike steel, the blade regenerates in sunlight and moisture.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's leaf-blade can slice through titanium with ease. As it swings, it emits a pleasant sugary scent that confuses predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME that have become close to their Trainers will give them their petals. These petals can be used to brew a tea that has a rich, calming flavor.
author: melodydelune

entry: A pleasant aroma wafts from the barbs on the end of POKENAME's vines. The aroma is a byproduct of the nutrients POKENAME gets from both the sun and the dirt it eats.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon sleeps near pools of lava, using the heat to keep its body warm. This habit ensures POKENAME stays active even in the coldest environments.
author: .izik

entry: It stinks to adults, but children describe its aroma as a flower garden that makes them want to play with it. Oily roots shift just beneath its rag.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME can sense the aura of those nearby. If it detects a strong opponent, it emits a basil-like scent, signaling both caution and respect.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME survives exclusively on sunlight, allowing it to lie stationary for most of the day. Due to rarely ever moving around, thick layers of moss will start to grow on its back.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lives exclusively in clean waters. When the sun is shining, they can be seen rolling around in the sun on the shore.
author: chorb33

entry: When POKENAME grows frustrated, it hops in place while releasing a thyme-like scent. This is a warning sign, as it is about to unleash a powerful electrical discharge.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's body help it camouflage amongst the jungle leaves while hunting for prey. If it has an abundance of energy in its body, its leaves will glow with a vibrant green light.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as toddlers in parks, hoping to be taken home. A strong turmeric scent clings to it, making it possible to identify a fake.
author: .izik

entry: The flame on its tail and the leaf on its head are both indicators of its health. It must take great care to keep the two away from each other.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: The bud on POKENAME's head helps modulate the air pressure inside its body. The leaves can tighten to help POKENAME swell like a balloon, or the air can exit through the bud, carrying a sweet smell as it leaves.
author: .realthree

entry: Each flap of POKENAME's wings releases a delicate hibiscus fragrance. This floral scent distracts foes just before it stuns them with Supersonic.
author: .izik

entry: It is most active just before dusk. When it rests, it burrows into the ground, sucking the fluids and nutrients from nearby plants. POKENAME's leaves are most healthy when it feeds off of a wide variety of plants.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite its small stature, POKENAME can become a threat if given an ounce of power. Its laughter can be heard echoing in dark places.
author: inksans201x

entry: POKENAME eat Enigma Berries to help them survive in the wild because they are fragile creatures that get exposed to many threats. They sprout vines from their back to push predators away before sliding away on a sheet of ice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While dancing, this Pokémon hums a rhythmic cadence that captivates any onlookers. The longer POKENAME dances, the more difficult it becomes for those watching to look away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dances beside bushes, releasing pollen from its leaves to aid their growth. It trims overgrown shrubs with elegant swings of its sharp leaf.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's flower emits paradoxical scents based on its mood: when happy it emits a noxious scent that repels others, but when sad it releases a pleasant scent that entices others closer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoys engaging with both Trainers and wild Pokémon, showcasing its friendly nature. It releases a sweet scent when happy, especially during rainy or sunny days.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME usually lives along the edges of forests, seeking clearings where it can photosynthesize undisturbed. The flower on its head releases toxic pollen that, when properly refined, can be brewed into invigorating infusions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a cheery Pokémon that loves playing in fallen leaves. When fall comes around, POKENAME can be seen almost everywhere.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME is a cheery Pokémon that loves playing in fallen leaves. When fall comes around, POKENAME can be seen almost everywhere.
author: themicelegion

entry: Genetic testing of POKENAME's leaves has revealed matches with fossilized plants. Scientists theorize that the gentle scent released by the leaves is older than human history.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME dislikes when those around it are angry. It releases an aroma from its leaves, similar to the composition of lavender, in order to calm others down.
author: typhloquil

entry: It expels a verdant powder that paralyzes foes on contact. The powder spreads easily through the air, creating a natural defense against predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rapidly spin the leaves on their head to spray sweet puffy spores around them. These spores are very sweet, but can cause allergic reactions in heavy doses.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The flame on its tail and the leaf on its head are both indicators of its health. It must take great care to keep the two away from each other.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: While sleeping underground, POKENAME leaves a single leaf exposed at the surface. This leaf emits a foul odor that deters most predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a particularly lazy creature that loves to spend the day napping. Once it's full of sunlight, it uses the large leaf at the end of its tail to shade itself so it can keep sleeping for hours.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME is tired, it can sleep the entire day under the sun to recharge its energy. In the rare moments it is awake, it tries to snatch anything that glitters—but since that activity quickly tires it out, it soon collapses back to sleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses the large leaf on its tail to absorb sunlight and shield its eyes from glare, helping it keep track of its opponent. Though very lazy and eager to sleep, its claws can deliver surprisingly powerful blows.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its leaves are warm to the touch, even after they've been shed. Healers in ages past would use these leaves to line blankets and make poultices.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME search for reservoirs of mineral water to quickly absorb the nutrients they need to nourish their body. Once they finish drinking the mineral water, they fall asleep in a sunny patch of grass to soak up the sun's rays.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It enjoys lazing around in moist areas, watching the water droplets drift down off of its leaf. The faint scent wafting from said leaf invokes a feeling of listlessness in others.
author: sk372

entry: Due to a quirk in Pokémon Fusion, POKENAME's favorite meal consists of brothy food that does not require the need to chew. It especially loves soups made with all-natural ingredients.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME floats in the air using a combination of electromagnetism and the flapping of its leaves. Research indicates that the electromagnetic waves it produces make plants close to it healthier.
author: toniaglitched

entry: POKENAME goes around touching flowers yet to bloom, smearing its slimy form across the plant. Those plants touched by it are notably more vibrant in coloration when they bloom.
author: sk372

entry: The stems around its neck are actually seed bundles that help it grow new plants. When attacked, it tries to ward off foes with its sharp leaf.
author: mistymagius

entry: It sheds layers of its cocoon to ensure a smooth metamorphosis upon evolution. It then consumes the recently shed layer, which is said to taste like parsnips or carrots.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its vines are a staple in the restaurant industry because it is a fast-growing substitute for lemongrass. Whether it gets paired with seafood like a Klawf Stick or a spoonful of Slowpoke stew, its vines will always be in demand.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Restaurant and bakery owners will frequently leave out flowers to draw in wild POKENAME thanks to its appetizing fragrance. This has also led to a rise of their natural predators in urban areas.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME makes its den in leafy underbrush where it can perfectly blend in. Every six months, the leaf on its head dries up and falls, only to regrow even stronger than before.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A special seasoning made with dried POKENAME leaves is said to make any meal taste delicious, so it is highly sought after by master chefs.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Trainers are split on whether POKENAME's scent makes them feel cozy or peppy. Some speculate it depends on how strong the POKENAME is.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: Trainers debate over how POKENAME produces its trademark scent, which offers a mixture of calm and excitement. Scientists claim that the scent is similar to coffee, but further study is required.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME burrows itself under grassy knolls during the day to sleep. The leaf on its head will poke above ground and absorb the sun's rays.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME is almost always seen carrying a number of leaves and seeds within its mouth. It trades these with other Grass-type Pokémon in exchange for other foods, protection, or simply to share particularly tasty greens.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME get older, they bury themselves in muddy, fertile soil and become dormant. From the shoots on the side of their head two Chikoper grow, genetically identical to each other. POKENAME then emerges from the mud and promptly evolves.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is usually spotted hanging around websites based on the subjects of floral upkeep. It's quite helpful in guiding users towards sites that will give them even more details on how to properly care for their gardens.
author: sk372

entry: The buds on POKENAME's neck have a distinct spicy aroma. As it ages, this fragrance becomes much milder.
author: mepp.

entry: A lounge of wild POKENAME has recently been discovered within a forest up north in the Orre region. The buds on their arms will bloom into flowery blades that can slash through even the toughest of boulders whenever they're in battle.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME's body is constantly emitting a spicy aroma that seems to energize the life around it. Some farmers use POKENAME as a garden tender to make their peppers grow faster and spicier!
author: bobosmith01

entry: It twirls and dances around flower gardens as a form of meditation. When groups of POKENAME dance together, the flowers grow bigger and more vibrant.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Most commonly encountered at the height of Summer, plants flourish and flowers bloom in the path left behind as POKENAME dances through the warm evenings. Seeing a POKENAME pass by is said to be a portent of good fortune.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are often viewed as heralds of summer, their invigorating auras breathing life into plants and Pokémon alike. They are also highly prized by aristocratic Trainers, their elegant appearances lending a dignified air to summer balls.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When POKENAME is in danger, the spicy scent of its leaves intensifies. POKENAME uses the scent's stimulating effects to clear and focus its mind, raising its psychic powers to formidable heights.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: It has reverted to an ancestral form once thought to be lost. POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping, with a false eye on the lookout.
author: barthandelus_real

entry: POKENAME's scent subtly influences others to want to fight it, much to the joy to POKENAME, as it likes to duel.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When chasing prey, POKENAME's fur releases a sour aroma that acts as a stimulant for them and their prey. Both are filled with adrenaline and run faster, but POKENAME's prey will likely run out of stamina much sooner.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: The buds around its neck emit a spicy aroma that acts as a stimulant for humans. POKENAME are often used in rescues during landslides.
author: melodydelune

entry: Each curled leaf around POKENAME's tail is packed full of spicy flavors. There is an annual event where spice connoisseurs gather to sample delicious foods made with these leaves.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME rely on their natural camouflage to sneak up on other Pokémon. With a flurry of razor-sharp leaves and potent lightning strikes, they can quickly incapacitate their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is incredibly energetic, especially on sunny days when the light gives it the spirit to perform greatly in battle. When it rains, its priority is to protect the flame on its tail, using the large leaf on its head until it can find safer shelter.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The edges of its leaves are razor-sharp, so by shaking them POKENAME can defend itself from predators that get too close. Its saliva contains toxins that are harmful to humans but useful for improving the soil's pH balance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME combines the lush greenery of Bayleef with the aquatic adaptability of Mareanie. It dwells in coastal regions, where it uses its leafy tentacles to ensnare prey and absorb sunlight for nourishment.
author: nightwingjay

entry: Its limbs can be safely severed with a clean cut due to its regenerative abilities. The limbs themselves have a mild and grassy okra flavor that helps bring herbal and spicy notes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's burrow is filled with a soothing scent released from its leaf. This aroma keeps its young calm and prevents panic underground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produce an antiseptic sap from the leaf on their head. Whenever they get their hands dirty, they squeeze the leaf and rub their hands together to get their hands clean.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME swing their leafy arm wildly with little tact or precision. By feeding them a Micle Berry, they develop the insight to land lacerations with great precision.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The spicy aroma of the leaves around POKENAME's neck boosts energy. To avoid being constantly sniffed, POKENAME withdraws into its shell before lashing out with vines and jets of water.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: The flower on its back has not fully developed yet, so it produces a sweet scent from its antennae to lure in certain Bug-type Pokémon for pollination.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fashion tools from the bones of wild Pokémon that die of natural causes and collect seeds and berries from wherever they roam. They use these to revitalize forests that have been ravaged by fire or blight.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME has the ability to photosynthesize. As it must do this in the open sun, it relies on another Pokémon to protect it from predators. The larger its flower is, the closer it is to evolution.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It consumes flowers to convert them into a sweet-smelling gas that makes its opponents feel at ease. The gas also helps plants grow at record speed.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses the horn on its snout to drill through even the hardest ground, carving furrows for farmers to sow their seeds. In spring, the flower around its neck releases a soothing fragrance that calms troubled hearts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME serves as a healer to plants and Pokémon alike. It can revive dead plants with its breath, and its eggs can bestow healing powers from a myriad of herbs and medicine.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: POKENAME uses the sweet scent of its flower to prevent predators from harming its eggs. The aroma will calm the predators down to the point of no longer attacking.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's petals are known for their pleasant scent, akin to tropical fruit. Its core absorbs sunlight over time, which it shares in low amounts with plant life in need of a little boost.
author: sk372

entry: It uses the soothing scent from its petals to calm those around it. Once its prey has let its guard down, POKENAME brutally goes for the kill.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: Though the brightly-coloured claw-like structures on POKENAME's forearms look dangerous, they are actually blunt and soft, used for complex courtship displays.
author: occulusmalus

entry: The flowers of POKENAME give off a lethargic aroma, causing nearby Trainers and Pokémon to become tired. It is not uncommon to find several Pokémon sleeping around one.
author: elibromax314

entry: POKENAME seems to have unlocked some prehistoric DNA through Pokémon fusion. Its long neck is suited for catching sunrays above the tops of trees. This allows it to better channel a powerful Solar Beam attack.
author: lupa

entry: Unlike Meganium's normal scent, this form's flower emits an odor meant to stoke the fighting spirit in others. Because this form brings out POKENAME's own latent battle instincts, it uses the odor to entice others into giving it a challenge.
author: sk372

entry: The leaves extending from its body capture sunlight to create powerful flame blasts. Oftentimes, the fragrances it creates are smoky and pleasant.
author: captainjefejefe

entry: POKENAME live in mineral water reservoirs and infuse the water with their pollen to create a powerful disinfectant. They are always willing to help injured Pokémon that show up to their reservoirs by cleaning wounds with the mineral water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A wild POKENAME gets all of its energy from the sun. As it does not need to eat while basking in the sun, it resorts to grinding its own quick-growing teeth down by rubbing them up against one another. As a result, dental trauma is common.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in cold areas where few flowers bloom. Small colonies of pollinators establish where POKENAME live as they produce pollen which emits a sweet fragrance. Honey made from POKENAME pollen is slimier than normal but considered a delicacy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Young members of POKENAME herds are encircled by the adults as they travel between feeding areas. POKENAME are rarely caught off guard, as if their feelers serve as eyes on the backs of their heads.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME tend to seclude themselves in barren areas where they churn the ground and make it ripe for plant life to grow as they feed off the hard rocks and minerals. Once the area is completely green though, they move on to the next barren land.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: POKENAME drops its feathers near withered flowers, restoring them to full bloom. It communicates with its kind through cheerful chirps, especially on bright, sunny days.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME clings to the trunks of giant trees, gorging on the sap it digs up from beneath the bark. As it feasts, its leaves emit a pleasantly sweet aroma that soothes and calms the creatures nearby.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live in herds that tend to be a large mix of other Pokémon. Their large size but docile nature make them perfect to hide around, and the calming aroma coming from their petals ensures the area around them is the safest place to be.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: The aroma from POKENAME's flowers agitates volcanoes and causes them to erupt. When it roars, it unleashes a powerful Petal Blizzard that completely coats the entire battlefield in petals within seconds.
author: soup1900

entry: The plant parts of its body never wither, even in the extreme cold. Wherever POKENAME steps, the flowers grow.
author: milchik

entry: If it feels threatened, POKENAME will punch enemies with the pollen-filled flowers on its tails. It uses its delicate antennae to locate its allies.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is mega-fast and mega-agile thanks to its mega-colorful wings, despite how mega-bulky it looks. Unfortunately, it can't Mega Evolve.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is said to purify soil that has become too acidic with the powder released from its pink petals. It is a benevolent creature that helps humans who have lost their way in the forest find the path home.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While Mamoswine were pushed further poleward after the Ice Age, POKENAME took their place in the growing temperate climates. They knock over trees to reach the highest leaves, inadvertently carving paths through the forest.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Once every spring, POKENAME will leave their forest and migrate across the wasteland to plant seeds. They have been seen as nature's way to reforest barren lands.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: If a POKENAME shares its umbrella with you, it's a sign of sincere and genuine trust. It will never forgive those who betray it.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's hollow exoskeleton and tattered, motionless petals give no evidence of life as it hovers through the air. Even so, as POKENAME passes over dead flowers, they spring back into bloom. Because of this, many associate POKENAME with rebirth.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: When it is comfortable with those around it, POKENAME emits gentle aromas from its flower bulb, using its psychic power to analyze responses. It continually adapts the scents based on this feedback, searching for fragrances that evoke happy memories.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME occasionally molts, shedding its bulb of petals and growing a fresh one. Though prized for their size and scent, the petals are difficult to acquire, as POKENAME greedily devours the old bulb shortly after molting.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME lives amphibiously and feeds on over a ton of plant food a day. To avoid eating other POKENAME's food, they avoid each other.
author: chorb33

entry: The fragrance of the flowers of POKENAME can soothe even a rampaging Gyarados. The fields and forests they typically roam are often quite lush due to all of the Bug-type Pokémon this fragrance attracts.
author: infinex21

entry: Attacking the families of Pokémon that live on POKENAME's back will result in the POKENAME becoming furious. The younger Pokémon have become wise to this, and some such as Sewaddle intentionally use themselves as bait in battle.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: This fusion sees itself as a proud ruler over other Pokémon. It is particularly proud of its antennae that resemble a mustache.
author: jaycielantern

entry: POKENAME's blade emits an odor that calms opponents, making them easy victims to slay.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME tends to rock moss gardens in the mountains, the fragrance of which attracts lost Pokémon they adopt as family. If threatened, they will Body Slam foes off the mountainside.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Known by farmers as a symbol of the harvest, POKENAME are said to roam the countryside, reviving crops and plants that have withered.
author: melodydelune

entry: Those who have met a POKENAME often report a joyful blur of color, bright petals flapping too fast to track as they release a soothing scent that washes worries away. It appears most often to those dealing with grief, helping to ease their burdens.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Flowers bloom brilliantly at the end of POKENAME's vines. The vines themselves, however, are only partially organic: metal coils through each of them, their structure akin to wires. This makes the vines surprisingly sturdy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME burns wandering souls using their life force to feed the flower on its back. Once all of the flower petals fall off, POKENAME can finally move on to the afterlife.
author: mistymagius

entry: Though POKENAME is well-suited to digging tunnels and absorbing nutrients from tree roots, it is too proud of its bright petals to dirty them with soil. Instead, it clings to tree branches, hoping to disguise itself as a flowering bud.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: When the air grows cold and the rain turns into snow, it shrivels into a small bud and remains dormant. Once the snow melts, its head emerges through the dirt to spread its petals and soak in the sunlight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have recently gained popularity as therapy Pokémon. They provide a calming sensory experience through their light scent, their soft singing, and their gentle demeanor.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME will appear in front of nature-lovers, spreading its pollen that allows for plants to grow big and strong. However, people with hay fever consider this Pokémon to be a serious health hazard.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its beautiful voice to subdue hostile emotions and encourage plant growth. Opera singers often drink a special tea brewed from this Pokémon's flowers to relax their vocal cords after a performance.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME hums beautiful songs to subdue hostile emotions and heal sick plants. Many singers enjoy a sweet herbal tea brewed from this Pokémon's flowers, as it is known to relax one's vocal cords.
author: mepp.

entry: The scent coming from the center of POKENAME's flower is sweet and alluring, dulling the senses, emptying the mind. By the time one realizes what is happening, it is already to late and the vines have already begun to grow.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: Any dead plants touched by its freezing breath return to life, though often with dramatic changes. Matches with ancient fossils have led to theories that the plants are revived in the form of their prehistoric ancestors.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME is known for its gentle and calm demeanor. Its breath can revive withered plants, so park rangers often use these Pokémon to help promote new growth after natural disasters.
author: mepp.

entry: If a Pokémon is kissed by POKENAME, it will be cured of any sickness or have all its vitality drained, depending on POKENAME's mood.
author: peachnanas_3435

entry: POKENAME rubs its flower petals together to create a becalming fragrance to stop prey from running from it. After beating up the prey with its fists, it uses its breath to heal any damaged petals from the brawl.
author: soup1900

entry: With just a touch of its antennae, POKENAME can revive seaweed that has died due to pollution. It uses its extremely strong arms to move obstacles in its path rather than for battling.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The petals that make up POKENAME's mane are as sharp as knives. They thrash around violently, spreading around its pollen to the surrounding forest.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME tend to abandoned gardens in deserted castles by rejuvenating the soil and helping seedlings grow. They can see into the future by peering into balls of green fire that are fueled by pollen from their gardens.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME digs, nearby soil briefly supports rapid plant growth. Small saplings sprout and bloom within a day, but wither within a week.
author: .izik

entry: As it basks in the sunlight, POKENAME stores energy in the orb at the end of its tail. Whenever it finds a wilted flower, it will release the energy and light to revitalize the flower.
author: alestrius

entry: Near impossible to catch by surprise, this berry thief can tell when danger is near by feeling the vibrations in the air through its petals. Each has their preferred berry and will stop at nothing to acquire it.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: POKENAME is a favorite in Contests for its ability to make dazzling displays with its petals and tentacles. The origin of its shades is unknown.
author: lyrebird.rainwing
