entry: People who are stung by POKENAME report feeling momentarily enlightened and claim to lift objects with their mind. These hallucinations are temporary and fade as the venom in their system is broken down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is only thought to evolve naturally when its bond with its Trainer is as bright as the sun. It has a coy, unpredictable personality that belies its ability to predict the future.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A bite from an POKENAME is capable of injecting a potent, mind-numbing neurotoxin into its victim. It is mysteriously able to weave psychic energies into physical webs, which it uses to drag its victims back to its lair.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses the light from the organ on its head to blind and immobilize other creatures before reading their minds. If it senses no hostility, it swims away, but those with ill motives have their mind further assaulted by psychic powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to have incredible revelations of all things past and present as it stares into the sun. Once night falls, it hides away until sunrise.
author: mepp.

entry: When POKENAME unleashes its full psychic power, its cotton-puff spores explode, releasing cotton spores everywhere around it. When it recharges its power from the sunshine, the cotton-puff spores grow back almost instantly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorb solar energy throughout the day with the leaves on their head. They harness that energy to predict when rain will come.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's large ears flare and expand to twice their size when danger is nearby. They also begin to sweat a toxic substance that they can attack opponents with. This makes them great partners to Trainers that regularly find themselves in trouble.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This Pokémon is an embodiment of harmony and power, capable of communicating telepathically and anticipating movements with pinpoint accuracy. Its advanced psychic abilities allow it to glimpse into the future.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's flower only blooms on sunny days, unleashing its full psychic power. Its blue leaves give off a calming scent that soothes minds.
author: mistymagius

entry: Although it is most active during the day, it tries to stay in dark places while the sun is out. It is said the fur that covers its body can detect and absorb the emotions of its foes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is very loyal to its Trainer. Reading its Trainer's mind, it always tries to make them happy.
author: pokebio

entry: On cloudy days, it becomes deeply depressed, refusing to eat unless gently coaxed by someone it trusts. Only Trainers it fully believes in can lift its spirits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a highly unstable Pokémon composed mostly of magma. It uses the psychic gem in the center of its head to hold its body together as best as it can. Prolonged use of psychic energy has turned POKENAME's body an unusual shade of lilac.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME has learned to maintain its molten body composition through evolution and now uses its excess psychic energy strictly for combat. Even more unsettling, its shell is composed of igneous crystals that further amplify its telekinetic powers.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME use the gem on their head to search for those in need of food. When its belly gem glows, it's hungry.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME is drawn to highly emotional beings. It will watch their outbursts from afar.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME moves in a hypnotic pattern that lures its prey into a false sense of security before it crushes them with their psychic powers. Staring into the eyes on its belly puts you under its full control.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's insightful nature and friendly demeanor makes it a popular companion. They are said to grant magical powers to those fighting for justice.
author: neonriser

entry: POKENAME use psionically-charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's psychic prowess and ability to manipulate magnetism make it a formidable foe. In recent years, scientists have used POKENAME to safely move heavy mechanical parts when constructing new spaceships.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to independently maneuver the muscles in its twin tongues. The more experienced an POKENAME becomes, the finer control they can exert over the movements.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME use psionically charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME use psionically charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME use psionically charged electricity to devastate their foes. They are highly selective of who they pick as their Trainer.
author: theartemis1

entry: An POKENAME is often seen absorbing energy from its jungle home to generate psychic power. The pearls on its back glow when at full power.
author: red.89

entry: This little Pokémon follows its Trainer wherever they go, sometimes playfully hunting for their feet as they walk. POKENAME controls fire with its psychic powers, but it's not very good at it yet and can accidentally burn itself in the process.
author: milchik

entry: Its claws are made of sharp, sturdy gems that contain powerful psychic energy. As POKENAME draws its power directly from the sunlight, it's most energetic in the morning and afternoon, running and kicking faster than the naked eye can see.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME can see into the future, allowing it to effortlessly counter any attack. It then destroys its opponents with a precisely calculated combo of attacks.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its paws are soft and squishy to the touch, and POKENAME makes sure to retract its sharp claws whenever it's around those it likes. Its powerful kicks never miss the target even in the dark thanks to its excellent hearing and night vision.
author: milchik

entry: Every sunny morning, POKENAME dances near its Trainer to wake them up bright and early. The jewel on its head shines and transfers a psychic energy to ensure they wake up feeling rested rather than groggy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME forms strong bonds with Trainers that show it respect. Its potent psychic abilities let it sense the future, allowing it to guide its Trainer away from any and all dangers.
author: jadey.1557

entry: In ancient times, many cultures revered POKENAME for its kindness and foresight guiding them away from disasters. Even in modern times, some regions retain statues of POKENAME that regularly have offerings placed before them.
author: sk372

entry: If POKENAME dislikes their trainer, they will play tricks on them. Some trainers recall it in a dream, but that is all they can remember. Others don't remember catching it at all. That said, POKENAME works remarkably hard for trainers it is fond of.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME uses supernatural powers to read minds and predict future actions. Highly intelligent, it views the Trainer it's bonded with as an equal. It can fire blasts of purple-colored energy from its hands.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic power to levitate a flower above its back. The flower is not attached to the body yet provides continuous nourishment to POKENAME.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: It can be seen near the water's edge, charging its forehead orb with sunlight during the day. Its fine fur can feel electromagnetic waves with astonishing precision, which POKENAME uses for hunting or socializing with other members of its species.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME uses the light of the sunrise to rejuvenate its energy, the crystals of its body shining bright as it does so. It can read the minds of 1000 people at once, according to legends.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's crystal horn gives off strong psychic energy. Touching it can irritate skin and may even induce hallucinations.
author: cyberleviathan

entry: Thanks to its strong psychic powers, POKENAME can control fires and spread them at will.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME locks itself away to meditate deep within temples, guarded by throngs of Espeon and Bisharp it has enthralled with its mind. Those that manage to brave the temple and reach its sanctum will have their mettle personally tested.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME never hesitates to protect its Trainer, interposing its rugged stone body between them and any threat. When its psychic abilities ignite, the pearls on its armor shimmer with a piercing scarlet radiance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Images of POKENAME appear on many types of clothing from the ancient past. It's thought people would wear these clothes in hopes of becoming as wise and elegant as POKENAME.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can communicate with its Trainer through telepathy when it wraps its ribbons around them. It only shares this gift with Trainers with a deep, mutual bond.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: According to legend, POKENAME is capable of moving even tectonic plates with its astonishing psychic powers. It is said to reveal itself only to trainers pure of heart, rarely appearing on the surface.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's gems allow them to sense if someone's words or actions are genuine. They wander the world, endlessly seeking the truth.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME's gems allow them to sense if someone's words or actions are genuine. They wander the world, endlessly seeking the truth.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME's gems allow them to sense if someone's words or actions are genuine. They wander the world, endlessly seeking the truth.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME appears to be able to synthesize all of the energy it typically needs from both the sun and the moon; if it were not for things such as eclipses or clouds, POKENAME would never need to eat or drink.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are known to overwhelm and disorientate their enemies with a mixture of speed and psychic illusions. They gain power exponentially the more frustrated or confused their opponent becomes.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME spent a long time honing its psychic abilities. It grows larger and more powerful crystals to protect itself against foes.
author: ladan

entry: By focusing its psychic power, POKENAME can sense even the slightest variation in the breeze. It uses this ability to predict exactly when prey will fly by, striking in the blink of an eye.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME has sensitive fur that detects tiny temperature changes. If its Trainer feels too cold, it will huddle close and wrap its warm wings around them to provide warmth.
author: vlavoc

entry: POKENAME can always turn invisible before being spotted by reading air currents to know when something comes near. When holding a Soul Dew, it can store more energy from sunlight and use psychic powers for longer before it becomes exhausted.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's short-yet-silky fur makes it the perfect cuddling companion. Those who sleep near it will wake up feeling completely reinvigorated.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Each of POKENAME's flower-hands holds an orb of great psychic potential. In the early morning hours, these orbs are at their strongest, and can float and operate independently of POKENAME to aid it in combat.
author: sk372

entry: It's said that POKENAME possesses the power to communicate with those who have passed on. It's a popular partner choice for many psychics.
author: nyoomymph

entry: Since the POKENAME lacks any limbs, it learned to manipulate the sharp crystals it grows to fend off attackers.
author: ladan

entry: It hypnotises victims it hunts and dulls their sense of pain. Then, it drains the prey of its blood until it is satisfied.
author: skymaster426

entry: The gems on its body store a vast amount of poison. If they begin to leak, keeping your distance is strongly advised.
author: .izik

entry: It gathers psychic energy around its wing tips to create glowing pom-poms. It can sense its Trainer's emotions, and will inspire them with a dance if they're feeling scared or nervous.
author: hophoppip

entry: With their combination of precognition and echolocation, POKENAME are never caught off-guard. Some adventurers bring along POKENAME to warn them of danger before it strikes.
author: .fedoraman

entry: If you spot a POKENAME, it is sure to have already spotted you. It is a naturally opportunistic Pokémon, aiding whomever keeps it the best-fed, regardless of their cause.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Villainous organizations have been known to enlist POKENAME in their dealings. They are uniquely useful for stakeouts, as they can use their psychic powers to hang in midair for hours on end, watching, nearly invisible against the night sky.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME traveling with sailors unfailingly alert their companions when sunken ships are nearby. It's thought by some that POKENAME's psychic powers let it communicate with the spirits of those who went down with said ships.
author: sk372

entry: It fights valiantly to protect its allies, leaping effortlessly between high vantage points. Its agility and determination make it a reliable teammate.
author: .izik

entry: As a fusion of a nocturnal and diurnal Pokémon, POKENAME rarely sleeps. Psychic power aids in the efficiency of its photosynthesis.
author: vaporvenator

entry: While it doesn't hunt often, its attempts to do so are always flawless, as it can predict the future to determine what is a feasible prey item.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME put Pokémon to sleep by releasing a combination of spores and psychic waves. Their spores are harvested by scientists to create sleep aids that help people and Pokémon fall asleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Uniquely-shaped mushrooms grow on POKENAME's back and emit sparkling spores once a week. The fungi and the spores both seem to temporarily enhance intellect, but come with a hallucinogenic side-effect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is exceptionally brave due to its stone-like build, making it more adept at hunting by using air currents to predict the movement of nearby lifeforms.
author: duskangel

entry: POKENAME sing of love that separates at dawn through many timeless Aubades. The chivalrous melody inspires a mixture of tension and bittersweet feelings in those who listen to it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The Sun Stone particles that are released from POKENAME's body are incredibly rich in vitamin D. Bathing in these bright and shiny particles has almost equivalent effects to basking in sunshine.
author: soup1900

entry: During sunrises, POKENAME undulates the wing on its back to catch sun rays and charge the many orbs there. Holders of its feathers are granted heightened senses of awareness and sensitivity.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME spores cause hallucinations when inhaled. Those under the effect of spores typically see groups of Eevee that do not exist and end up getting lost when they chase the illusory Eevee.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said any who stare into POKENAME's fire attacks will be entranced. It appears to randomly pick humans to be its Trainer, and will curl up with them while providing comfortable heat from its ears.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME practices to balance out its Fire and Psychic-Type abilities, creating a unique form of energy that radiates from its ears and wand. Though researchers seek to understand this energy, POKENAME's secrecy makes further study difficult.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME has achieved perfect equilibrium of its fire and psychic power. The crimson orb on its staff houses a mysterious, blazing energy. The energy radiates migraine-inducing telepathic static, hampering researchers' study.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME secretes a special yogurt coating atop their heads, which restaurants use to coat berries. They are especially popular during certain holidays, as they can adjust their flavor to match the events around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a calm disposition and will guard against any danger its psychic powers sense. It's a popular companion for families with young children.
author: dicedragon20

entry: POKENAME have constant headaches that mysteriously vanish whenever they are in the presence of another person. By using their telepathic powers to see into other people's thoughts, they stop ruminating on their own thoughts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can read the thoughts of other Pokémon and are easily entertained by what they hear. They often spend hours listening to thoughts while their body idly floats on the surface of lakes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Statues of POKENAME are unearthed everywhere among the ancient ruins of Pokémopolis. POKENAME is believed to have been a prized pet to the ancient Pokémopolitans for its majestic appearance and impressive psychic abilities.
author: inquis1

entry: Statues of POKENAME are unearthed everywhere among the ancient ruins of Pokémopolis. POKENAME is believed to have been a prized pet to the ancient Pokémopolitans, for its majestic appearance, and impressive psychic abilities.
author: inquis1

entry: The spoon it carries channels sunlight directly into its body, amplifying its psychic abilities. This radiant energy makes its powers more potent in daylight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME entices prey by twinkling the orbs on its head as it floats on the surface of the water. Once close, it ensnares its meal with its many tentacles and drags them underwater.
author: mepp.

entry: Their latent psychic powers have awakened and melded together with the powers of their flames as well. Those who stare at their flames tend to feel like they are being drawn into a hypnotic state.
author: infinex21

entry: Found inside hollowed-out pine trees, POKENAME studies its orb, attempting to see all possible futures. When it sees a specific Trainer, it immediately flies to its destiny.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME possesses an extraordinary ability to communicate through telepathy, not only with its own heads but with other creatures as well. Each head has a distinct personality, and will often argue with one another for hours at a time.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME leave a residue on whatever they touch. This poisonous residue causes a light headache in those who consume food tainted by their touch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon to give them dreams of psychic powers. These dreams allow a moment of wonder as many are able to harness telekinesis for the first time in their lives while dreaming.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon with their psychic powers and keep them asleep by giving them powers they can only imagine of in reality. Many opt to learn psychic powers and love to lift objects with their mind, even if it is only in a dream.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gets its energy from moonlight, with its bulb blooming most fully during the full moon. When threatened, the bulb seeps toxic sap that causes severe nausea if consumed.
author: mistymagius

entry: Since POKENAME is still very weak, it leaves its shelter to absorb moonlight in hopes of reaching its evolutionary stage soon. It can weave extremely fine, highly prized silver silk that shines like moonlight itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME moves with silent agility, striking with powerful kicks in the cover of darkness. Its glowing rings intensify when it's ready to attack, disorienting foes before delivering swift, precise blows.
author: thepandasharky

entry: If it senses danger, it will expel a toxic smog that temporarily blinds enemies. This gas can be refined and used to make smoke bombs.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It makes the yellow rings on its body glow to dazzle approaching predators, then takes advantage of their confusion to escape. As it needs moonlight to grow stronger, it remains hidden during the day and only emerges from its den at the right moment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have yellow rings across their body that make them appear more menacing than they actually are. The rings glow in the dark, which only reinforces their perceived dangerousness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME feeds off of smog during city nights. POKENAME's gas has a half-life of two centuries and reeks of mercaptan.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME is known for claiming unattended eggs and placing them in their pouch until they hatch. POKENAME have little regard for the egg's original owner, often forming egg-swiping gangs with the babies that hatch.
author: blake

entry: POKENAME lives in large schools with its companions and becomes particularly active when the tide rises under the light of the full moon. It makes its luminous rings shine in the sea to communicate over great distances with others of its kind.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has golden markings on its body that glow brightly when there is a full moon. When the sun rises, it releases sparkles into the water to release excess lunar energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have bright yellow rings across their body that glow in the dark. Many Pokémon rely on the light produced by these yellow rings to see in the dark.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prefers nectar from night-blooming flowers, and will travel for miles under the moonlight to find it.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: During full moons and eclipses, POKENAME will gather in big groups. They will move rhythmically as they are transfixed on the moon.
author: rosemagwin

entry: The light on POKENAME's head is designed to bring prey closer. However, their poor battle prowess usually makes them the prey instead.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: POKENAME are nocturnal creatures that wander through the darkness searching for mushrooms. They are particularly fond of glowing mushrooms and will pick those over those that do not glow.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lives in deep ocean caverns where sunlight is but a myth. When hunting prey, it uses the glowing rings on its body as a distraction.
author: kittyluv090

entry: These Pokémon are well-known among many sailors due to the markings upon their bodies that shine bright at night. To many, POKENAME are seen as a blessing to encounter at sea.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's gelatinous body becomes even more pliable under moonlight. At night, its form shimmers and flows with eerie fluidity.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever it needs a boost, Trainers give it an X Sp. Def to help shield itself from tough attacks. The booster is said to help it tough out entire nests of Pokémon, though this is likely hyperbole.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends most of the day residing underwater, only coming onto land after nightfall. The frill around its neck absorbs moonlight for sustenance, its rings glowing brightly as it does so.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is surprisingly frail. It will often shatter into many pieces and clip through the terrain. Theories suggest this is playful behavior.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME produce a bright yellow venom that is stored in bands around their body. These yellow rings glow at night to allow them to see in the darkness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hang from trees and have rings that glow in the dark. Many Pokémon that live in the forest leave them alone because of the illumination they provide in the dark.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This prehistoric powerhouse would exclusively hunt at night. Due to this scheduled mealtime, it unfortunately didn't have too many options for food.
author: patch_bros

entry: Under the moon's light, the rings on its body start to glow and spark. The only recorded sightings of POKENAME have been during stormy nights.
author: deflador

entry: POKENAME creates dark flames that glow brightly in the light of a full moon. When an unwanted guest enters its domain, the flames intensify as POKENAME tries to repel the trespasser with its flames.
author: krivaswell

entry: POKENAME hang from branches and illuminate dark forests with their bright yellow rings. Many people come to forests full of POKENAME to read books under their light.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hypnotize their prey with flashing rings before injecting a potent toxin. They then drag their prey into the dark caves in which they nest.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME undergoes self-imposed training to keep its ravenous fire from hurting others unintentionally, but it will throw everything it has into real battles. It is said that when the moon is full, its power peaks.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The rings on POKENAME's body glow brighter when it chomos down on something. At first it was thought to be a sign of it draining the life from a victim, but recently it's been determined to simply be a joy response to the thrill of biting something.
author: sk372

entry: Their rings pulse in a hypnotizing pattern at night, distracting opponents. The POKENAME then has a chance to escape.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: POKENAME possesses many eyes that can see far and wide, able to detect hidden objects. It is native to dark forests, regularly protecting them.
author: anlcorpagent

entry: When using Baton Pass, POKENAME's yellow wing feathers glow with a soft golden light. This flash marks the transfer of its hidden strength to its allies.
author: .izik

entry: The markings along a POKENAME's body glow only when the moon is exposed, even if it is not within the moonlight itself. As such, it is a diurnal hunter that pounces upon prey with nets of silk and subdues them with its venomous bites.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can emit moonlight as beautiful as a Cresselia's. Its bioluminescence is strongest on a full moon night.
author: dodoowner_

entry: This Pokémon is only spotted once in a blue moon. POKENAME is said to be the most beautiful Chinchou of them all.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME stands underneath the light of the moon to gather energy. This energy is converted into electricity, though POKENAME cannot wield it effectively yet.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME always appear wherever a great disaster is destined to unfold. They were feared as evil beings in ancient civilizations.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME always appear wherever a great disaster is destined to unfold. They were feared as evil beings in ancient civilizations.
author: theartemis1

entry: Each POKENAME's markings are unique and relate to the condition of the moon when it evolved. POKENAME from thousands of years ago have been found perfectly preserved in mud, allowing scientists to observe how the moon impacted the earth in the past.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Each POKENAME's markings are unique and relate to the strength of the moon when it evolved. POKENAME from thousands of years ago have been found perfectly preserved in mud, allowing scientists to observe how the moon impacted the earth in the past.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Each POKENAME's markings are unique and relate to the moon's power when it evolved. POKENAME from thousands of years ago have been found perfectly preserved in mud, allowing scientists to observe how the moon's gravity impacted the earth in the past.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Shrouded in a dark, wraith-like mist, POKENAME silently glides through the night. Its eerie presence causes chills, and its glowing rings pulse faintly to attract unsuspecting prey.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME perches gracefully within its crescent moon, drawing power from the night sky. Legends say its silvery mist can calm even the most restless souls under the glow of a full moon.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The more moonlight POKENAME absorbs, the bigger the blossom on its back grows. It will tackle its opponents with its small horns, injecting them with a deadly poison.
author: mistymagius

entry: In the daytime, POKENAME is extremely shy and easily frightened. In the night, however, the moon gives it confidence, and it will bite back at anything that tries to attack it.
author: soup1900

entry: Its venom's potency shifts with the moon's phases. During a full moon, a single drop can kill an Onix, but under a new moon, its poison is so mild that some people eat POKENAME as a delicacy.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME only comes out of its den to forage during the darkest part of the night. In even the faintest of moonlight, the markings on its body will glow in the darkness.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal hunter that is adept at moving silently in the dark. The patterns on its wings ominously glow to distract prey before it uses its sharp beak to strike with deadly precision.
author: mepp.

entry: They can often be found gazing at the moon when it's at its brightest. It collects Moon Stones in its tail.
author: pankiwi

entry: Thanks to its black body, POKENAME can swim gracefully through the water, skimming the seabed without being seen. It only makes its yellow rings glow to confuse potential rivals when it is ready to fight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The rings on this Pokémon's body glow in various patterns. It is thought that POKENAME packs communicate with each other using this ability during hunts. Under the full moon, the rings glow much brighter.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME climbs on roofs in the dead of night. It lays there for hours, just staring at the moon.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME uses moonlight to enhance the power of its flames. Its rings glow bright when fully charged with moonlight, and the fire it breathes out takes on a bright silvery hue.
author: sk372

entry: Moonless nights were often attributed to POKENAME, known in the past as the incarnation of darkness.
author: xenellia

entry: Most nights, POKENAME will bask under the moonlight and absorb lunar rays. This energy is stored in their orange tail to later be used for evolution.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Rings surround the holes in POKENAME's palms, glowing ominously when it prepares to fire projectiles. The moon-shaped orb on its tail illuminates with a strange radiation during evenings with full moons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rolls in dark forests at night as it searches for unsuspecting prey. POKENAME's claws are imbued with the power of the moon.
author: themicelegion

entry: On moonlit nights, it casts up rings made of psychic energy, leaping through them as part of an intricate dance routine. The rings on its own body glow their brightest during this time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is adept with blades, able to defeat an enemy in a myriad of ways. Trainers often use it to carry out ambushes and stealth missions.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME appear only at night, and are more common near full moons. Generally passive, these Pokémon light up their staves, rings, and horns to guide wayward travelers home safely, and create defensive walls of light in combat.
author: cinnamoone_redfield

entry: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. It has developed the ability to bend shadows to its will and uses them in combat as distractions.
author: mercsthorn

entry: POKENAME are mischievous and often hide in the night. They use their long tongues to steal food from people and other Pokémon.
author: rhysanthemum

entry: The flower on POKENAME's back requires moonlight to blossom and stay alive. Because of this, POKENAME can only be seen at night, where this flower glimmers in the moonlight.
author: patch

entry: This Pokémon is seen in many cave paintings. It was worshipped long ago, likely due to its resemblance to the moon.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME melt into the shadows, perfectly hidden by their dark scales. They have taken to stalking specific creatures, completely destroying threats to them with powerful slams, then hiding before being noticed.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME live for hundreds of years, warning others of natural disasters. Their rings flicker and dim when disaster is imminent.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: POKENAME is most active at night, cutting through the sea rapidly and hunting small fish. When it breaches the water's surface, its rings glow brightly as they absorb the moonlight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's powers appear tied to the phase of the moon, showing its strongest capabilities when the full moon hangs high in the sky. The rings on its body can generate glowing circles that can forcibly teleport others far distances.
author: sk372

entry: Unlike its fellow Eevedge evolutions, POKENAME doesn't like being held. It instead protects its Trainer from the shadows.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Unlike its fellow Eevedge evolutions, POKENAME doesn't like being held. It instead protects its Trainer from the shadows.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME radiates yellow light from the three rings on its shield that surges throughout its spectral barrier. It ejects a poisonous sweat from its shield to counterattack anyone who tries to physically attack it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME use their powers to secretly manipulate people and Pokémon to do their deeds while hiding under the covers of darkness. Conspiracy theorists believe that these Pokémon are the ones who actually control our governments today.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are silent warriors that are said to have mastered fighting techniques from ancient Johto. They are fiercely loyal to their Trainers, operating in the shadows to deliver decisive blows to their opponents when they least expect it.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME leap through the night sky, the blades on their heads resembling the crescent moon. They project rings of golden light to surprise their targets, silently striking with their blades from the shadows they cast.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has been the inspiration for several comic book villains. Despite that, it is a mild-mannered Pokémon and only attacks when threatened.
author: ferdirenz

entry: When it absorbs enough moonlight, the rings on its body shine brighter than gold. POKENAME can blend perfectly into the darkness and catch its prey with electrified bites.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Moonlight can influence POKENAME's mood, making it increasingly eager to fight the fuller the moon is. Its roars are as loud as thunder and can be heard from many miles away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Moonlight can influence POKENAME's mood, making it increasingly eager to fight the fuller the moon is. Its roars are as loud as thunder and can be heard from many miles away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can convert moonlight into energy to strengthen its electrical attacks. During a full moon, this Pokémon can even generate a magnetic field that allows it to levitate.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can convert moonlight into energy to strengthen its electrical attacks. During a full moon, this Pokémon can even generate a magnetic field that allows it to levitate.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its armor is faceted from a brilliant moon rock. When the armor glows in battle, POKENAME is channeling a mysterious lunar power.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME absorbs moonlight with its horns until its golden markings gleam like molten metal. If someone threatens its Trainer, it lunges forward with all the strength in its formidable frame.
author: fiordaliso

entry: At night, POKENAME gathers lunar energy through its horns, causing the golden bands on its body to shine steadily. If its Trainer is endangered, it charges headlong, unleashing the full force of its powerful body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lives at the bottom of the deepest lakes. Those who see the elusive Pokémon during the daytime are said to be overwhelmed with its beauty; those who see it at night are said to freeze in horror.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's ancestors flew too close to the moon and evolved due to its strange energy. Its rings shine a spotlight downwards, searching for prey.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Spoken in legends, POKENAME are disgraced guardians of dusky forests. The story goes that due to their immense power, they scared off every Pokémon they sought to protect, leading their home to ruin.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are most active on nights of the full moon. They will quarrel with other Clefairy over the best viewing spots on these nights, and a clash will inevitably ensue.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME float up as close as they can to the moon. They rise incredibly far into the atmosphere until the lack of air pressure causes them to deflate and fall back down to earth.
author: bradlybro199

entry: Its cotton carries a defensive poison. When exposed to moonlight, the cotton swells and bursts into the air around it at the slightest touch.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME lives a nomadic life, drifting on the wind and causing mischief by leaving cotton in homes, giggling as it does so. Mostly active at night, it rests in the morning sun to regrow its cotton, though it weakens if it gets wet.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME was seen as sacred by certain ancient cultures. To this day, it haunts their tombs, placing its curse on trespassers.
author: cadyrocks

entry: POKENAME lures thieves with the rare moon emblem on its head before trapping them in its body. Once they are trapped, it drowns them in poisonous sweat before discarding their bodies.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hides inside of dark corners and uses its yellow rings to lasso unsuspecting prey that pass by. Poisonous sweat will burst from its body if it opens its coffin door.
author: soup1900

entry: During a full moon, POKENAME's web glows brightly with electrical energy. It hunts exclusively at nighttime, using its powerful venom to paralyze its prey.
author: mistymagius

entry: On moonless nights, it will find a high vantage point and shine its lights. This attracts moth Pokémon, POKENAME's most-preferred prey.
author: wigglypon

entry: On dark nights, it waves its lights to attract prey. Its blue glow is unusual; few have witnessed it, and fewer could explain what they'd seen.
author: wigglypon

entry: POKENAME only appear during nights when the stars are plenty and the sky is unobstructed. Steeped in legend, it is said that seeing one dancing under the full moon would bring you good fortune for years to come.
author: cpnquacken

entry: When hunting, POKENAME utilizes the moon's shadow to disguise its ambushes. Since its abilities are strictly nocturnal, it sleeps from dawn till dusk.
author: nellnast42

entry: It is said that POKENAME's shell is a crystallized manifestation of the moon's aura. A friend to many cave Pokémon, POKENAME is able to make the rings on its body glow, bouncing light off its shell to provide moonlight even in the darkest caverns.
author: sara886a

entry: POKENAME meditates every night under the moonlight to store its energy and become stronger. When it exhales small flames from its mouth, the effort makes the golden rings across its body glow brightly.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The rings of POKENAME glow softly when held by someone asleep. Though parents say they do it to comfort children afraid of the dark, they truly glow so they can make themselves look ominous and scare predators away.
author: soup1900

entry: Moonlight absorbed by the liquid surrounding POKENAME's body strengthens its psychic powers. This Pokémon can communicate through telepathy, and its body can glow in the dark.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its psychic powers reach their peak when the full moon illuminates POKENAME's body, increasing the concentration of its two brains. Although it is generally gentle in nature, it often has mood swings due to the position of the moon in the night sky.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It prowls the sandy lands during the night hours to hunt its prey. When it feels threatened, it flashes the golden rings on its body to blind its enemies and scare them away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's body is perfectly adapted to the darkness of the caves where it lives and thrives. It shoots out its quills when it is in danger to keep its enemies away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A small and immature Pokémon, POKENAME still tries to act independent and prideful. Under the glittering moon, POKENAME's tusks glow with awesome power.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME possesses powerful night vision. When the moon is over halfway full, it can be spotted outside its cavern home. This means seeing wild POKENAME is most common only in certain parts of the month.
author: bobosmith01

entry: If it feels threatened, it shoots toxic, fiery sparks from its fur that cause horrendous pain, much more than that experienced from a normal burn.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its body is protected by a hard black shell that allows it to camouflage perfectly in the darkness. Just before charging at an enemy, it makes the rings on its armored carapace glow, to have an advantage against them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its body is protected by a hard black shell that allows it to blend perfectly into the darkness. Just before charging at an enemy, POKENAME causes the rings on its armored carapace to glow, giving it an advantage in battle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME darts at great speeds through the night to chase its prey. Once caught, it finishes them off with the poison in its quills. When there is a full moon, the circles on its body shine, giving it an even more majestic and fearsome appearance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME darts through the night at incredible speeds to pursue its prey. Once caught, it finishes them off with the poison in its quills. When the moon is full, the circles on its body shine, giving it an even more majestic and fearsome appearance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This ancient Pokémon is a prodigious nocturnal predator, its colossal jaws can crush even the strongest metal. During the nights, when its body glows, POKENAME pierces the silence with terrifying roars that can be heard many miles away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its blindfold, POKENAME is an excellent dancer known for its graceful moves. Many Pokémon look to POKENAME for tips on how to dance.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: Ancient myths describe POKENAME as a spirit of judgement, claiming they once had piercing golden eyes that shone just as bright as their feathers. They are highly elusive Pokémon, only living deep within dark forests.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's rings glow under moonlight, unfortunately alerting prey to its presence. However, this Pokémon is so fast, it's often too late for them to escape.
author: glacierwing

entry: During the full moon, POKENAME soars across the sky, shrouding the ground below it in darkness. It stores the moon's energy in its rings, which it uses to fire powerful energy beams.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME leaves a trail of black slime wherever it goes. The slime is pitch black during the day but glows faintly under moonlight.
author: mistymagius

entry: The glossy ooze covering POKENAME helps it power up its attacks when the moon is out. During the day, it sinks into the shadows to sleep.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's body absorbs moonlight, using it to sustain itself and even repair damage taken. The ring on its forehead can fire high-powered energy rays composed of concentrated moonbeams.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is exclusively nocturnal, but it seems to be more active on full moons. The rings on its body glow brightly when it's locked in combat.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME use their glowing rings to lure desert travelers off the path. The travelers are led in circles until they become too exhausted to move - but if sunrise comes before they collapse, POKENAME will flee.
author: deelee2020

entry: POKENAME produce spores which are made of the same substance that comprise the yellow bands across their body. At night, clouds of spores light the way for POKENAME to wander in the dark.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME was revived after a fossil preserved in ice was irradiated by the energy of a lunar meteorite. Its obsidian-black scales allow it to hide in the darkness. When it cries, the aurora borealis appears in the night sky.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME appears only on cold nights when a layer of ice covers the snow. Its veil shimmers with captured moonlight.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME appears only on cold nights when a layer of ice covers the snow. This one has a rare coloration.
author: .realthree

entry: It communicates with amusingly exaggerated facial expressions. POKENAME's odd mannerisms and vivid tufts of fur make it endearing to many Trainers.
author: seaslux

entry: The colored spots on its body glow brightly when it feels strong emotion. POKENAME prefers dark places because the sun causes its neon colors to fade.
author: kittyluv090

entry: A gentle Pokémon that likes to surround itself with vivid hues. Neon fluid drips from its claws, which illuminates any scratch marks it makes.
author: seaslux

entry: This form of POKENAME is a lively and highly social Pokémon that is often drawn to music played late at night. Its preferred food is glowsticks.
author: seaslux

entry: Its fur glows in the dark to attract mates and foes alike. POKENAME will lash out at anything that comes close. It will pursue anything that survives.
author: mossybanana

entry: POKENAME sing the melodies of famous nocturnes that inspire imagery of the night. Their shadowy movements can be tranquil and somewhat gloomy, but audiences are captivated by their passion regardless.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME zips rapidly through the air on moonlight nights, trailing sparkles that catch the moonbeams behind it. If it rests above one's home, your sleep will be filled with beautiful dreams featuring star-filled skies.
author: sk372

entry: Despite not being poisonous, POKENAME's body mimics the toxic patterns of other poisonous sea life. Its bite can still be lethal, however.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME have mushrooms on their back that glow in the dark. The spores that they release in small clouds also glow in the dark and produce a beautiful display of light when a breeze scatters the spores.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's antennae and fur ring glow so well in the dark they attract Butterfree. Due to its compound eyes, regardless of where a Trainer stands it appears to be staring right at them.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Finding comfort under the soft light of the moon, POKENAME studies the art of astrology, using the moon as a guide to learn divination of the stars. During a full moon, they are highly active, but during a new moon, they will never be found.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME are cursed to be able to sense the intentions of surrounding creatures. They punish malice, focusing their psychic might through staves and breaking the target's psyche. Pure intent is rewarded with protective spells.
author: ghostslythe

entry: A master diviner of the stars, with the moon as its guide. POKENAME are now nocturnal, and are able to predict a foe's movements under the cloak of night, making it very dangerous. Rumors say its power peaks during an eclipse.
author: merclipse

entry: When night falls, POKENAME soars gracefully on its beautiful wings, leaving behind a trail of golden, glittering dust. If it feels threatened, it exhales poisonous spores from its mouth to keep enemies at bay.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME produces a sweet yet tart powder that candy confectioners mix into their recipes. Its diet influences the level of tartness in the powder, so candy confectioners control its diet to ensure consistency.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When night falls, POKENAME soars gracefully on its beautiful wings, leaving behind a trail of golden, glittering dust. If it feels threatened, it exhales poisonous spores from its mouth to keep enemies at bay.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's golden crystals radiate beautifully when under the light of the moon. Superstition claims that these crystals have the power to ward away evil spirits.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME pokes its three heads out of the ground only to absorb the moon's energy in the dead of night. During the new moon, the three heads stop getting along and start arguing over absolutely everything.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME sneaks into houses at night and steals anything that shimmers. Because of this, many people shoo it away if it is found in populated areas.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The more moonlight it absorbs, the softer, silkier, and shinier its fur becomes. POKENAME is extremely elegant and agile, often trained by Pokémon Coordinators to impress judges in Coolness and Cuteness competitions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When bathed in moonlight, its headaches vanish, allowing POKENAME to become remarkably focused and alert. During the day, however, its migraines render it unable to perform even simple tasks, so it sleeps as much as possible.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have rings on their body that glow at night and shine particularly bright on nights of the new moon. They often draw the attention of other Pokémon who come to investigate the strange light.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's many rings glow brightly when it spins beneath the moon during the evening. It appears to be absorbing moonlight as it does so, boosting its energy and powers in future battles.
author: sk372

entry: The water surrounding its head is perpetually chilly. It is said to be strongest on dark and stormy nights.
author: hophoppip

entry: A stealthy aquatic predator, POKENAME hides in  crevices between rocks and leaps out at passing prey. It flashes its yellow rings to communicate with others.
author: hophoppip

entry: It makes the rings on its body shine brightly to blind its opponents before striking them with powerful punches. During the new moon, POKENAME loses control and is consumed by rage, becoming willing to attack even its own Trainer without hesitation.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Regardless of how long POKENAME sleeps, its eyes open when the moon rises. Some say its fur is darker than night, and it can only be seen when its circle patterns glow eerily before an attack.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is able to cast illusions with its mental powers, making it seem to blend in with the shadows around it. It's said that its psychic capacity triples during nights of the full moon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME drifts on the ocean surface, communicating with one another over long distances at night with bright yellow bioluminescent flashes. The frequency and brightness of the flashes hold specific meanings that researchers are trying to determine.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME floats on the ocean surface at night, with its yellow rings and orbs glowing brightly as it absorbs moonlight. It conjures tentacles of pure shadow which it uses to drag prey to its true mouth, hidden by the physical tentacles at its base.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of the same rocks that can be found on the moon. Despite this, it is unable to cause other Pokémon to evolve.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME loves mochi. Certain regions believe the cause is due to the cultural ties mochi has to the moon, while others believe it's just a tasty snack.
author: musicsheep.

entry: A POKENAME's flames are rather dark but will light up at night when the moon is visible. Their body markings glow at night as well, making them slightly visible when they trot through open fields at night.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have a special baton that draws in lunar energy at night. During nights of the new moon, the baton shines brightly to give illumination in the dark night.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The head whose symbol matches the current moon phase gains control of the body. Every night, POKENAME spreads its tail to absorb moonlight, making its body rings glow in a mesmerizing display that many photographers dream of capturing.
author: amiel997

entry: It rests on floating ice platforms to absorb the moonlight before diving back into the waters where it dwells. POKENAME feeds on a type of invasive algae, making its presence vital for keeping the seabed clean.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The residue left behind by POKENAME is poisonous. The effects of consuming food contaminated by POKENAME residue include blurred vision. This momentary impairment passes as the residue is digested.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A wild POKENAME is usually only visible at night. If POKENAME manages to touch someone with its hands, the victim will become incredibly tired.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME shrouds itself in shadows during the daytime. At night, it sneaks up on people to stick its tongue out, make a noise, and vanish into the night.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME envelop those they hypnotize in dreams of darkness. Many Pokémon who are scared of the dark awaken in an anxious panic.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The golden ring POKENAME carries pulses with psychic energy. With a single motion, it can lull others into a deep sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunts in the deep sea, the rings on its body faintly glowing in the dark. When in danger, it will spray a poisonous fluid from its claws into the surrounding water to deter its opponent.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME enjoys hiding among the shadows of forests. At night, POKENAME is especially active, using its vines to pull itself and navigate through the trees.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME are known to covet valuable items and cache them within their forest lairs. Carefully tracking them could reveal a hollow tree filled with riches.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME slowly floats away, leaving behind meters of murky smoke. Anyone who passes through the smoke will be doomed for life.
author: chorb33

entry: This Pokémon's body consists of two separately thinking heads. While the small head plots sinister plans, the large head controls movement.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME have very limited eyesight, relying on Infrared to see at night. They scatter sparks to track the movements of winds before converging on the greatest source of heat.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME waits for nightfall to leave its nest, its black feathers making it nearly invisible within the darkness. Though small, it fiercely pecks at its opponents without hesitation.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Some say if you see POKENAME rocking back and forth at night, you will experience terrible misfortune. The tale says that placing one of its feathers in one's hair will avoid the curse and protect against ill fate.
author: .izik

entry: After making its nest, POKENAME does an odd dance with its wings and then rotates its head in a complete circle to ensure nobody was watching. This ritual helps it feel secure in its hidden refuge.
author: .izik

entry: Travelers are encouraged to keep a close eye on their valuables in POKENAME territory. The kleptomaniac Pokémon is very adept at shooting webs from a distance in order to yank away small trinkets.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME decorates its web with shiny trinkets to attract preferable prey while it hunts for more treasures. When it finds shiny objects it likes, it webs them up in a net to drag back to its nest.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is magnanimous and well-meaning, but has little understanding of personal property. It often causes issue by stealing things from strangers to give to those it cherishes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can see the future and builds its nest in areas that will not flood. Its foresight ensures its home remains safe and dry, regardless of seasonal changes.
author: .izik

entry: The fluff growing around POKENAME's neck is used to create wedding veils. It is thin and delicate, prized for its soft texture and light, airy feel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collects nightshade flowers to decorate their skirt and hat. These Pokémon dance together on nights with a new moon to forge bonds that will last for their lifetime.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME decorates its nest with flowers from nearby fields. These delicate blooms add color and charm to its home, creating a vibrant resting place.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats above meadows looking for large patches of flowers. It prefers to decorate its nest with daisies, adding a cheerful touch to its home.
author: .izik

entry: Blending in with the darkness of night, POKENAME swarm in massive flocks to try and pilfer anything they can gather in their beaks. They only answer to the Honchicate that leads their flock.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME hoards pyrite to cover itself in order to make itself more appealing to Trainers. Uneducated Trainers seek it out for gold.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME's eyes are incredibly sharp, able to spot shiny objects from afar. It will use Gust to blow them into the air before snatching them up, making it a master of aerial theft.
author: .izik

entry: Should POKENAME locate a Meowth's nest, it will spit water at it to scare it away, then steal as many valuables as it can in its beak before flying off with its prize. It does this to assert dominance over other Meowth nearby.
author: .izik

entry: A large group of POKENAME is called a murder. They gather in such large groups that they have been known to blot out the sun, bringing darkness below.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME flies between dumpsters, eating discarded food and collecting shiny objects. Its scavenging habit makes it a nocturnal hunter, always on the lookout for the next treasure.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glide silently through cities at night, stealing shiny trinkets to lure in prey in the dim lighting. If they're cornered, they will strike with their tails before flying away, leaving only a flurry of black feathers behind.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME often hide in shadows and wait to jump out at people and Pokémon. Any valuables or trinkets that are left behind are taken by them, never to be seen again.
author: gamblebreaker

entry: POKENAME relies on its astute observation skills to opportunistically steal food. It is also known to stalk other Pokémon to lead them to food sources.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is often found seen in the company of a Geneary, seemingly solving cases. POKENAME is cool and collected, counterbalancing Geneary.
author: mirby

entry: It uses a small ice-carved weapon to intimidate Pokémon and Trainers into giving up their food and valuables. This weapon is entirely harmless.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon with sleek black feathers and a small aura of flames. It loves to play tricks at night, using its sharp beak and small embers to frighten unsuspecting travelers.
author: thepandasharky

entry: The feathers on POKENAME's head are very poisonous. It rattles its tail before pecking at prey, using its poison to weaken its target before making its move.
author: .izik

entry: The feathers dangling from POKENAME's hat-shaped antlers are claimed to be powerful good-luck charms. They're a common sight in souvenir shops.
author: .realthree

entry: Touching its tail to its beak changes the color of the ink at the end of its tail. This ability allows POKENAME to create unique and vibrant patterns wherever it goes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes an unsettling, human-like chanting while building its nest. The words make no sense, but the eerie sound fills the air, adding to the mysterious aura of its lair.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flaps its wings to gather Murkrow in the immediate area. Its flock obeys it without hesitation, following its lead as they work together in coordinated efforts.
author: .izik

entry: The gluttony of Munchlax fused with the greed of Murkrow causes POKENAME to brazenly steal food. This has infamously resulted in many unhappy picnickers.
author: gottkroprinziii

entry: Blending into the darkness of the night, POKENAME glide silently to pursue their prey. They cry out before they strike, disorienting all in their surroundings with their cacophanous laughter that only grows louder before suddenly disappearing.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's head floats around in front of a person's face, squawking and chirping to annoy them. While the person is distracted by this, the body swipes away any personal items it can.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME makes its nest at the base of trees near lakes, decorating it with reeds. The natural materials help it blend into its surroundings, providing a safe and hidden home.
author: .izik

entry: Said to appear only in times of great sickness, it appears in the dead of night, treating disease with strange tonics and psychic emanations.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: The feathers on POKENAME's head make a creepy howling noise as it floats through cemeteries. This eerie sound is often heard in the dead of night, adding to the ghostly atmosphere.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love pretending to be of high importance and boss others around. They don't know how to use the firearm they're holding.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Legends speak of POKENAME as a cursed weapon with a will of its own. It's said to bring bad luck to its master and consume the souls of slain enemies.
author: knilk

entry: POKENAME roams in search of shiny objects and will take them by force if needed. The POKENAME with the biggest hat leads the group.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME still defer to Bisharp or Honchkrow and most seem satisfied with that arrangement. When POKENAME dart across the battlefield, they do so in sudden diagonal movements, using Night Slash while twirling around, resembling steps in a dance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME enjoys creating illusions for those who venture into its territory. It can make images look real, leading intruders astray. POKENAME protects its home with tricks, making it a clever guardian.
author: moga6

entry: Like Clefairy, POKENAME gather and dance under a full moon. In olden times, witnesses to these gatherings often mistook them for witches' rituals.
author: knilk

entry: Its innocent expression is a front. Once no witnesses are present, it robs its target of anything of value.
author: bitterchemicalhaze

entry: POKENAME have the power to float their feathers individually regardless of how far they are from their body. They gather their feathers together at the ends of branches to lift themselves into the air without having to manually fly.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME whittle branches into blades then ignite them as they enter battle. While this strategy assists them in intimidating opponents, they also tend to get distracted by the light shining from their flames.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its body is covered in small waterproof feathers. Some people have witnessed it beg for food from tourists in seaside towns.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME steals house keys from people in towns after pecking at them with its beak. It decorates its nest with these keys, proud to be a collector of trinkets and treasures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flaps its wings around trying to warn people of ill fortune, but nobody takes it seriously.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is known to con other Pokémon or steal their Berries. If its hat is stolen, it goes on a rampage until it is found.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME burrows into the side of hills and makes its nest in the hole. It uses shiny objects to decorate its tunnel, creating a gleaming display within its underground lair.
author: .izik

entry: The feathers on POKENAME's tail fall off sometimes, and it uses them in its lodge due to their softness. These feathers serve as a comfortable bedding material, making its home more inviting.
author: .izik

entry: It reaches towards anything shiny in its vicinity, but moves far too sluggishly to actually steal anything. Some travelers find it endearing, and allow it to take something inconsequential out of pity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME makes its nest at the top of electric poles. The high vantage point allows it to keep a lookout for any threats or opportunities, securing its domain in the sky.
author: .izik

entry: Used on ships for night watch, POKENAME has perfect night vision. If the ship is on a collision course, it alerts the crew with a sea shanty loud enough to be heard on deck.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME use their solid-gold beaks to carve out dens for their flocks. They enjoy plotting schemes with each other, working together to accomplish whatever task they put their minds to.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Flocks of POKENAME build nests together beneath fallen leaves, waiting for a wandering Trainer to pass by. Once they hear footsteps, they all burst out at once, scattering feathers and leaves to distract their target while they take any valuables.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: To aid in thievery, POKENAME will use illusions to mask itself as a familiar face before taking the item it covets and running. It returns to normal, then watches with glee as the one it mimicked takes the blame for its crime.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tries to be intimidating, but often picks targets unfazed by its displays. When its victim doesn't run away scared, it panics and turns tail itself, smacking its flaming tail against its target to discourage pursuit.
author: sk372

entry: Some say having a POKENAME stare at you is a bad omen, predicting a bad harvest. However, this is now regarded as an old saying, as most people aren't farmers. The species still carries a bad reputation regardless.
author: lucioleuh

entry: Flocks of POKENAME fly through the skies, appearing to be dark clouds in otherwise clear skies. Rumors claim that anyone that tugs on a POKENAME's strings will disappear in a burst of feathers.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME secretly pockets trinkets from Trainers while they're distracted by its cutesy demeanor. If POKENAME is caught stealing, it will playfully giggle while returning the treasure, making sure that nobody can stay mad at it.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's beak glows violet before it uses a powerful Shadow Ball attack. Its cloth-like body is made up of tiny feathers, adding an ethereal quality to its ghostly appearance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME mimics human speech after listening near homes. At dusk, it lures victims outside, then drags them into the woods with psychic force.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME moves through dark caves and under the moon, using sound to find its way. The shadow of its hat-like head is said to cause trouble for any Trainer nearby.
author: moga6

entry: Should POKENAME fall over while sleeping, it will explode, scattering its feathers everywhere. This sudden burst of energy is a defense mechanism that causes chaos in its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME don't have developed wings yet, so some use magic to fly. They can be bartered with to guard things in exchange for shiny objects.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME latches onto prey with its strong beak when striking. If they get away, it will use Confuse Ray to slow them down, making sure they can't escape recapture.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME flaps its single wing, it lets loose brief puffs of snow. These icy gusts add to its chilling presence, making it a haunting figure in cold environments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a sneaky Pokémon that uses ice to confuse both creatures and Trainers. It hides in the shadows, using cold winds to cover its movements and avoid danger.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME is a bit of a farmland pest: it likes to dig up planted seeds and bury them in other random spots, which causes chaos among the carefully-plotted crops most farms tend to keep.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME eats trash from the side of roads and flies away when someone gets too close. Its scavenging behavior often leads it to dumpsters and abandoned areas, where it hunts for its next meal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can vault large distances with the aid of its wings. It uses this ability while chasing intruders from its marsh, pursuing them with surprising speed and agility.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to steal things from other Pokémon, but only if they aren't looking. Its luxurious, black fur is used to make hats and coats which seem to be popular amongst evil teams.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME jumps from tree to tree in public parks, looking for humans with loose belongings. It grabs them before dashing away, using its speed and agility to outpace its targets.
author: .izik

entry: While snacking on kelp or barnacles, POKENAME panics when hit by lighthouse beams. It hides beneath flotsam, trembling until the perceived danger passes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's leafy feathers contain potent herbs used in natural medicine. Healers once used them to treat poisoning and paralysis symptoms.
author: .izik

entry: The feathers covering POKENAME's body contain a powder that it scatters to paralyze anyone who gets close to its collection of shiny objects. This defense mechanism keeps intruders at bay while it guards its treasures.
author: .izik

entry: The powder from POKENAME's wings is extremely shiny and is used in eyeshadow production. Its glittering properties make it highly sought after in the cosmetic industry.
author: .izik

entry: The feathers on POKENAME's body smell like Pumkin Berries, releasing a sour and savory scent. This aroma makes it irresistible to certain Pokémon, drawing them closer for interaction.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME watches from treetops to guard its territory. If disturbed, its flock descends together to Beat Up any intruder.
author: .izik

entry: It rarely sleeps, consumed by a need to steal shiny objects. It perches above doorways and waits for homeowners to leave before burgling residences.
author: rihse

entry: POKENAME steals coins and jewelry to decorate its nest in willow trees. The shiny trinkets add a touch of luxury to its home, showcasing its affinity for precious items.
author: .izik

entry: A popular children's cartoon casts POKENAME as the villain's main henchman. In it, it dutifully follows orders, but the plans always backfire when its headaches cause its magic powers to go haywire.
author: sk372

entry: Considered a bit of a thug, POKENAME is disliked due to its greedy tendencies. If it spots something shiny it likes, it will take it by force, battering the owner fiercely until they're forced to give up their possessions.
author: sk372

entry: In the evening hours, POKENAME chirps happily to welcome the night. If interrupted, it will fly into a rage, unleashing its fury on anyone who dares to disturb its peaceful moment.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its mischievous yet loyal nature, Trainers of POKENAME often find themselves amassing a hoard of shiny objects.
author: cat001

entry: Although proud and boastful, these Pokémon are revered as guardians. Their burning desire to defend their Trainer makes them popular.
author: xephyr

entry: POKENAME shoots water from its beak at extremely high pressures, capable of destroying concrete. This powerful water jet makes it a formidable force, able to cause massive damage when needed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon found just outside of urban areas. Thanks to its ability to teleport, it can steal someone's valuables and flee in mere seconds.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME punches holes in the sides of cliffs, making its nest with nearby twigs. Its powerful punches create a sturdy home in the rocky environment, perfect for nesting.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can usually be seen in the rain at nighttime. In these moments, POKENAME tries to spot opportunities for mischief, whether stealing food from travelers or leading other Pokémon on a chase through the night.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME decorates its nest with metal objects that it accidentally attracts. The magnetic properties of its body make its nest shine with various pieces of metal, forming a unique and cluttered home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flings its feathers at foes like daggers to induce sleep. Once they're unconscious, it eats their dreams with deep hunger, feeding off their subconscious thoughts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a bulbous shell on their back that gives them incredible insights, but they fall asleep whenever they feel overwhelmed. As they sleep, they release clouds of pollen that cause drowsiness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: By pinching specific parts of its tongue while humming to produce different tones, a POKENAME can play a haunting melody which draws in those who hear it. Then, it strikes.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME lets the child in its pouch wear the crown, enhancing the infant's intellect. This may leave POKENAME's mind dull and sluggish, but it never forgets to love and cherish its young.
author: sk372

entry: It enjoys time in isolation to consider the mysteries of the world, especially when the crown atop its head clamps down onto its head. The only exception to this is the fall mating season, when it leaves isolation to find a suitable mate.
author: quackquackattack

entry: An unrivaled entertainer, POKENAME dedicates every brain cell of its vast intellect towards studying performances in all forms and styles. It can plan an entire circus routine in the blink of an eye.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Capable of performing every dance, routine, or circus trick ever devised, POKENAME lives to spread cheer through its performances. It refuses to speak, however.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The shell on its head injects a toxin that makes POKENAME dumber by the day. Because of this, POKENAME will often forget basic survival instincts.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's mind is strong enough to communicate telepathically with the humans it carries across water. During these ferries, it offers words of compassion and kindness to soothe troubled minds.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME's diet mainly consists of Apicot Berries that give them great wisdom in dire circumstances. These moments of wisdom are transient, as the wisdom is forgotten when they fall asleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME exerts overwhelming psychic influence, gathering devoted followers who claim to receive visions in its presence. It rarely makes noise, yet entire communities have been known to obey its silent commands without question.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME and Wailper often journey together, mapping out the shape of continents and ocean currents which they share with other Water Pokémon. They both struggle in warm climates, so their knowledge is limited to cooler regions.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Fusion has increased its intellect greatly, but has also caused it to become aggressive towards humans. Some believe its mind and ego has grown enough that it now considers them inferior beings.
author: sk372

entry: With its enigmatic powers, many claim that one can see their destiny by simply peering into one of POKENAME's crystal balls.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's presence commands respect, standing as a stalwart guardian against any threat. It keeps itself cooped up for days, studying.
author: anarchaz

entry: When a Shellder bit POKENAME's head, it developed mystical powers and a human-like intelligence. Its brain can't adapt to this yet, so it is incredibly slow to react.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME curls into a ball and rolls around in circles when it is in deep thought. Once it has come up with a genius idea, it uncurls and tackles the nearest object it can find in excitement. The head injury from the impact then causes it to forget.
author: soup1900

entry: While a POKENAME travels through time, it comes up with an elaborate plan to restore the world to a peaceful utopia by regrowing nature to its former glory. As soon as it reaches its destination, though, it forgets and leaves the time period.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME may appear absent-minded, but it is actually scheming its next act of mischief. It has very short but waterproof fur with the texture of velvet.
author: shreks_stepfather

entry: Once a POKENAME tries to mimic something, it will follow its subject around, learning every possible aspect about it that it can. Many take on POKENAME as students or apprentices for this very reason, as they make the perfect pupils.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME likes to find crowded marketplaces so that it can watch people and try to mimic them. It captures so many details in its head that it often becomes paralyzed with possibilities and simply sits there staring listlessly at all the activity.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME experience surges of hunger whenever the shell atop their head bites onto their skulls. When this happens, a particular craving for Petaya Berries occurs that give them epiphanies whenever they are stressed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It has incredible intellect which allows it to remember the best locations to catch fish and soar through the sky to reach those places. Its sleek and aerodynamic wings allow it to travel silently, so it can fish without being noticed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Although at first glance it seems that POKENAME has abandoned its Shellder, it's actually sitting inside of it. It isn't as smart as Slowking, but it is more protected since the Shellder has become sturdier.
author: jangodiot

entry: Wise in the art of swordsmanship, POKENAME readily teaches others how to fight. The advent of modern weaponry has made POKENAME's teachings only valued among hobbyists.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Although this graceful, aquatic Pokémon mostly spends its time in the ocean, POKENAME often come ashore during festivals to dance with humans. When POKENAME choose someone as a dance partner, it is said to be an omen of good health and happiness.
author: ludacriswell
