entry: POKENAME has a nest of Rattata inside its shell. These Rattata are responsible for acting as POKENAME's cannons, and attacks for them, just as long as they are fed well enough. On average, a POKENAME nest houses 10-15 Rattata at once.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME will aggressively spin its long tail to propel itself through the sea. It uses its ears to change direction.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its large teeth to chew through coral. It is obsessed with eating yellow coral for an unknown reason.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME haunts old abandoned homes, gnashing its teeth furiously to create eerie sounds. Throwing an offering of food into its hungry maw tends to calm it and cease the haunting for a while.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME takes residence in abandoned buildings and will try to chase anyone that sets foot in its territory. It likes its home to be as messy as possible, chewing through walls and furniture to get its desired look.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME loves to hide within people's walls, making loud chewing noises to annoy the homeowners. When they go to investigate, POKENAME will quickly jump out and scare them before fleeing.
author: mistymagius

entry: Unable to digest gems or metals, POKENAME's tunnels are often littered with precious materials. It is ill-advised to extract them though, for POKENAME are viciously territorial.
author: .fedoraman

entry: During the night, POKENAME will often break into people's houses and chew through their bedframes. No one knows why it does this, but some theorize it thrives off people getting a bad night's rest.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME collects berries, herbs, and droppings from other Pokémon to add to the cauldron on its back. The toxic mix makes a deadly poison.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME is found in gravesites, screaming and sobbing in such horrific ways that it frightens away all but those with the strongest nerves. If shown the smallest amount of love and care, it becomes dependent on that person or Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME emits hallucinogenic smoke that induces terrifying visions. It feeds on the fear through the orbs on its body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fakes a kind gesture by gifting eggs with a foul taste to people. Once it sees their startled reaction to the egg's taste, it runs away extremely quickly before the person can enact their revenge.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has hypnotic tentacles that evoke feelings of paranoia and fear when stared at for too long. When a tentacle is damaged, it falls off and returns to ash.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME steal babies by carrying them in their jaws. Its red spheres absorb the baby's fear until there is none left, and the baby becomes their own.
author: alliveir

entry: It's said that if you pop one of its bubbles, you'll be cursed for seven years. Though this is a myth, it will make POKENAME upset.
author: welliss

entry: POKENAME uses its flower-like body as natural camouflage, both to hide itself from predators and to deceive its prey.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME have a reputation for murmuring indecipherable gibberish at random, which some people interpret as evidence that they are spirit mediums. Regardless of whether they actually speak to the dead, most Trainers find the murmuring startling.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The flame on its tail never goes out, even if it were submerged in water. Those who touch this flame feel nothing, as if it wasn't there at all.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Small groups of POKENAME will compete with each other to see who can scare the most sleeping kids in one night. They will glut themselves on the produced fear until they can't move.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME can use the orb around its neck to summon fog and turn the moon red. It uses this foreboding atmosphere to unnerve potential threats.
author: staghorn

entry: The dark plumage on its back is lighter and stiffer than the plumage on its belly. Because of this, it can use its wings for devastating attacks.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME feeds on electricity, generating power by frightening others. Its fur builds charge from the fear it creates. The energy fades after two days, forcing it to scare again to survive, making it one of the most anxious Pokémon in existence.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME feeds on electricity, generating power by frightening others. Its tail builds charge from the fear it creates. The energy fades after two days, forcing it to scare again to survive, making it one of the most anxious Pokémon in existence.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME feeds on electricity, generating power by frightening others. Its fur charges from the fear it creates. The energy fades after two days, forcing it to scare again to survive,h the fear this causes it provides a small amount of energy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It drifts on the wind, landing near a human settlement in the dark of night. Where it lands, it causes trouble with its strange powers and absorbs the fright of reacting humans.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are known to carry misfortune wherever they go. If this Pokémon's light fur stands on end, it is said to be communicating with the afterlife.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME tend to be sly creatures that stop at nothing to get what they want. They often torment their Trainers with malicious compliance that derails many of their Trainer's plans.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful teeth to chew through walls and scare people. Its fangs grow in length and durability when it absorbs fear.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME frightens people by baring its oversized fangs. It then draws the fear in and absorbs it through the glowing orbs on its neck.
author: .izik

entry: They resemble a ghostly creature called Flutter Mane, whose existence is debated to this day. They seem to mostly appear in areas with people that are hard to scare, making primal screeches in an attempt to cause mass panic.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME lets out metallic screeches as it floats across the sky. The fear it spreads is drawn into its body's orbs.
author: .izik

entry: During full moons, POKENAME emerges to frighten nearby humans. The fear it collects feeds the crystal orbs on its chest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can keep itself in the air for an indefinite period of time, supplementing its flight with levitation when its wings grow tired.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME has a strong sense for facial recognition, allowing it to accurately hold grudges and annoy those who have wronged it. One of its favorite small inconveniences is to pick locks with its beak and let in drafts.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME clings to dark corners of haunted locales, hiding away from sight. When others draw near, it spits out a dark ink that splatters across the victim and leaves them with chills and a feeling of ghastly dread for quite some time after.
author: sk372

entry: Many consider POKENAME as a bad omen. It puts curses on anyone who hears its loud, screeching cry.
author: themicelegion

entry: The snakes that make up POKENAME's arms only appear to be alive due to a series of illusions. In reality, they hide tendrils of poison that paralyze on contact.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME's tusks are made of solid ruby. There are jewelers on Chrysanthemum Island that use these tusks in making wedding rings.
author: .izik

entry: Using its antlers, POKENAME can cast illusions from up to 50 meters away. Once its foe has been terrified, POKENAME absorbs the fear into its orbs.
author: .izik

entry: The pattern on POKENAME's hood was replicated by many ancient tribes in talismans meant to curse a target with misfortune.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME's milk improves in nutrition and flavor if it is in the presence of intense fear. The milk can only be safely used to feed baby Ghost-type Pokémon and must be contained in specialized glass.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME absorbs rot and filth from bodies of water, forming it into a chain of gems. It weeps for days if the chain is broken or stolen.
author: blitzydragon

entry: POKENAME dreams of growing enormous to cause fear through chaos and destruction on a large scale. For the time being, it uses shadows to appear larger and echoes for its screeches to be amplified to enhance its ability to frighten.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its body can pass through just about any solid object with little effort. For some reason, POKENAME lacks the ability to move through iron.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can exhale a thick mist that snuffs out the light of the surrounding area, plunging it into darkness. It uses this shadowy cover to hunt and terrorize those who wander into its territory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stores magical power in its gems and cheek pouches. When multiple gather together, they can create powerful illusions over vast areas.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME floats through the night sky, muttering unrecognizable words. Many believe it's reciting an ancient curse.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raids pantries in the night, devouring as many sweet treats as it can find. If the food is not up to its liking, it throws the cooking utensils around the kitchen and stacks all of the chairs in an inconvenient pile.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hide inside the walls of old homes, skittering and tunneling within those walls. They have driven many people delirious from the persistent noise they cause, only to be vindicated once they are revealed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME becomes nervous when it cannot see its caretaker and will begin to screech, quiet as a whisper at first but growing in strength until it is cuddled. It spits out will-o-wisps to light up areas because it hates being in the dark.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A POKENAME's claws can sap a victim's will to fight. When threatened, POKENAME will create illusions to help them run away.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME will bond with its Trainer, and, in an act of kindness, use its psychic powers to absorb its Trainer's fears and worries.
author: nelluc27

entry: It's said POKENAME is formed from a conglomeration of the most malicious spirits of the afterlife. With its vast ghostly powers, it spends most of its time unceasingly haunting and pranking as many people as possible.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient POKENAME once terrorised primordial forests, feeding on the terror of lesser creatures. It grows stronger by absorbing fear, its ghastly horns growing larger with every pulse of dread.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Herds of POKENAME wander through fields at night, illuminated only by the eerie glow of their gems. It is said that the patterns they travel in help to guide lost spirits, the position of their gems along the pack forming runes from lost languages.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: When the moon is full, the red orbs on POKENAME's head glow a bright crimson. POKENAME is often found near cemeteries, appearing to shield wandering souls from paranormal danger.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are dangerous creatures, which are able to see and control your future actions. Making it mad causes it to place a bad luck curse on you for seven years.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The cannon that POKENAME wields fires bolts that can pierce through nearly any defenses. They are described in folklore as devilish reapers who collect the souls of their targets.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has fun picking fights against other Fighting-type Pokémon, acting as if their punches hurt them. Then, they surprise their foes by effortlessly going through all of their punches before delivering the final blow.
author: epping_forest

entry: The timid POKENAME uses its spectral powers to scare off intruders, though it quickly becomes terrified of those who resist its illusions.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME uses its thick hair to grab and ensnare its victims while it slowly drains away their life force. If it is threatened, it will let out a deafening wail which inflicts its attacker with an overwhelming sense of fear.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its ghostly flames to siphon the light from already dim areas, spooking those traveling through. It feeds on the increase in fear caused by the darkening surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: Skittish and easily frightened, POKENAME use illusions to hide themselves from people. It's said that hugging one will bring you six years of good fortune.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: Elegant and impish, POKENAME only reveal themselves to those they believe are worthy. Making one displeased is said to bring a thousand-year curse.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME possesses a mischievous personality, but lacks the energy to pull off pranks. Even just conjuring a slight ghostly breeze requires a seven-hour nap afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is popular among spiritual people because of rumors that it can communicate with the dead. Mediums hold onto it like a planchette and guide it across spirit boards.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is found in places associated with the dead, hoping to help families move on from grief. It drags its planchette across its spirit board to deliver supposed messages from the dead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its haunting cries and ghastly flame to scare those who wander through its territory. Its flame brightens when it succeeds.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME pops out from behind trees to startle people, then absorbs their fear for nourishment. It thrives on the emotions of others, using the fear to sustain itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eats flowers as they wither on gravestones. This eerie habit is often witnessed near secluded graves, where it silently feasts on the dying blooms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scatter bundles of cotton through forests to shelter lost spirits. Once a spirit has settled within a bundle, it will ignite with a spectral flame, burning away the cotton to let the spirit pass on.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME usually live in small groups inside caves. They can scream at an incredibly high pitch to drive off unwanted visitors.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME draws naive and curious travelers close with displays of false innocence in order to get them to gaze into its orb. A vision of terror appears within, spooking the victim so POKENAME can feed on their fear.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in cemeteries, seeking shelter among the tombstones. During nights with thunderstorms, it sits on mausoleums to absorb lightning strikes, using the energy to strengthen itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collect precious stones to add to their necklace. If their collection grows large enough, they might trip over their necklaces while trying to walk.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME's fangs absorb chemicals produced by fear, so it scares its prey by stalking them and screaming before finally biting. It hides in caves and abandoned buildings when the sun is out.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are cruel creatures that love to cause mischief. They steal valuable trinkets from Trainers and scatter them to force Trainers to wander through unpleasant conditions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME emits a screeching cry as it accelerates around obstacles in its old-growth forest habitat. When multiple congregate, they will race each other, joining their shrieks in a cacophony sounding like a choir of ghosts.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A Ghost-type Pokémon found deep in ancient forests, POKENAME has a cruel sense of humor. They delight in misleading Trainers with the sounds of other people, leaving them lost and confused with little hope of getting home.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It appears in swarms at night to frighten sailors, often pulling out their hair. POKENAME becomes timid when confronted by those who are not easily frightened.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME mimics a dead tree as it stalks intruders in the forest it protects. It usually only scares travelers with creepy shrieks, feeding on their fear, but if anyone harms the forest, POKENAME will curse them so they are lost forever.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME mimics a dead tree as it stalks intruders in the forest it protects. It usually only scares travelers with creepy shrieks, feeding on their fear, but if anyone harms the forest, POKENAME will curse them so they are lost forever.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME makes a blood-curdling scream to scare people. It absorbs their fear into its orbs for nourishment, feeding off the energy that fear provides.
author: .izik

entry: On days when dark clouds hang heavy in the sky but no rain falls, the sobbing cry of POKENAME can be heard high above. The jewels it carries are said to contain the forgotten dreams of those who passed too young.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME loves to possess stuffed toys, as it gets joy out of scaring young children. While POKENAME is inside the doll, it is abnormally strong for its size.
author: mistymagius

entry: It can move the sands of its body at will to form new structures. When a small Pokémon walks through its door, it takes delight in scaring the Pokémon by transforming into a terrifying room.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME lives in boggy moors and forests where it sings eerie, echoing ballads, but erupts with paralyzing screeches if interrupted. Historically, its singing was mistaken for a recently deceased spirit and people left gifts out for the ghost.
author: pjporwoll

entry: This ball of fur is incapable of moving without the aid of its otherworldly powers. The bulbs on its antennae resonate with each other to amplify this power.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME is very particular, so owners who do not meet its desires immediately will be inundated with sassy shrieks and howls. When sleeping, it becomes mostly transparent except for the beads around its throat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon that enjoys distracting Trainers and causing them to get lost. Its desire to create excitement is often mistaken for malevolence, so Trainers take different routes to avoid it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's brightly colored scales reflect light to lure in potential prey. A single hair or scale from this Pokémon can cause debilitating paralysis on contact.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME makes creepy noises in pumpkin patches to keep people away. Its unsettling presence and eerie sounds create a haunting atmosphere, driving off any intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's vestigial legs can be used for attacks, but it only moves by levitating. When excited, flames trail behind it as it moves.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME love to hang around shrines and graveyards. It's believed that a POKENAME stealing an offering left there is a bad omen.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME are constantly flowing and billowing as if propelled forward by spectral winds. Many people believe that items stolen by POKENAME are forever cursed.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: Very assertive and focused, POKENAME follow a strong moral code. They are known to cause headaches for those with evil within their hearts.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: Light, agile, and impish, POKENAME spends its time vandalizing things. Its ability to leap through walls makes it difficult to stop.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME uses its terrifying screech to freeze its prey in fear before consuming them. Its flames burn from the drained energy of its victims.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME crawls up to campsites in the night making spooky screams and wails, but pretends to be a rock if anyone investigates. As the campers become more fearful, it glows bright with pink energy as it feeds on their fear.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The magnets on either side of POKENAME contain powerful ghostly energies. If the three orbs circle around one of them, it is preparing to cast a particularly powerful hex from that magnet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appear at night and swim next to ships, hoping to lure sailors into the water. They cast spells that cause hallucinations and headaches, which can only be purged by traveling far from the POKENAME that cast them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME floats through people to cause them to see visions, smell horrible scents, and feel strong chills, giggling at their discomfort. It is incredibly light, so it clings to eaves or tree branches with its hair during strong winds.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME cries in corners, pretending to be a lost child, until someone helps it and POKENAME can screech in their face. It also finds it hilarious to distract people with antics while moving a hand behind to tap them on the back.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is employed in haunted houses as it enjoys terrifying patrons by leaping from their shadows and pulling faces to cheer up children who got too scared. It becomes upset and begins screaming if ignored for long.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's harmonic moaning lulls those who hear it into a fitful sleep. It then feeds on their fear as their dreams are filled with nightmares. Those wishing to avoid it sprinkle pepper around their pillows as POKENAME's nose is sensitive.
author: pjporwoll

entry: After POKENAME eats a dream, it forms a new bead on its pendulum string. It wards off evil spirits using the dream essence contained within its beads.
author: noel5229

entry: An odd rune grows from the back of an POKENAME. Attempts to determine the meaning has led to the discovery that it resembles a form of Unown, but for now, scientists are unsure of the connection.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Rather than releasing foul odors when threatened, it sends flashing images of mysterious characters into its opponent's head. It doesn't seem to eat.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME consider themselves protectors of ancient ruins. Tragically, their tendency to explode on intruders means they often cause greater harm.
author: griddle

entry: The eye is its true body. When threatened, it will eject itself from its protective shell. If it can't get away, it explodes.
author: griddle

entry: An ancient being that has a strange sense of protection. When it senses someone in its home, it locks onto them with its eyes and attacks.
author: theheroict

entry: Unown allows itself to be wielded as a weapon by a Cubone, its body making a surprisingly efficient club. At night, the Unown has Cubone draw mysterious symbols in the dirt, the meaning of which is not yet known.
author: sk372

entry: People and Pokémon think POKENAME is weak because of its poor eyesight, but POKENAME's eyeball contains a lot of psychic energy. It can easily crush a car with its powers, and people who try to catch it often meet a terrible fate.
author: sottiwotti

entry: Thousands of eyes can be seen in the smoke emitted by POKENAME. No one knows who the eyes belong to, or what they're looking for.
author: griddle

entry: The clouds POKENAME emits have their own eyes that look around and blink on their own. It's believed that until they dissipate completely, POKENAME can see through these additional eyes as well.
author: sk372

entry: Those who inhale POKENAME's gas witness startling visions. Victims of it always describe a vast grey sky, filled with as many eyes as there are stars.
author: griddle

entry: The pupil can shift around to any part of the giant unblinking eye that is its head. Even should the child wander off beyond normal sight, POKENAME will always see where its child is.
author: sk372

entry: Honey-sweet powder shaped like symbols in myriad ancient languages falls from its wings. Soothsayers divine the future from the words spelled in the specks they sprinkle across their morning cereal.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME's limbs have all the flexibility of a rubber hose. It uses these limbs to entertain children and adults alike.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME are very aggressive and conjure invisible barriers to hurl at enemies. Legends say that staring into its eyes for too long brings a lifetime of misfortune.
author: gengarfromfnaf

entry: Weedle's nose has been replaced with an eye that seems to track threats exceptionally well. Its often found in groups making mysterious messages.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME are known to appear near people on the brink of death, lingering just out of reach. Their presence is said to delay passing, as if time slows in their shadow.
author: gengarfromfnaf

entry: It possesses shapeshifting abilities just like Ditto, but is unable to change a certain part of itself. Thus, no matter the form it takes, the result will inevitably retain a giant cycloptic eye somewhere.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known to carry darkness and despair everywhere they go. Together, they invade and infest planets with their darkness.
author: the_smirker

entry: Immobile POKENAME will often sit high in trees, staring at any potential danger as it waits for its inevitable evolution.
author: bombboyxd

entry: It drifts in absolute silence, its eyes never blinking and never aligned. Attempts to document its movements often result in corrupted footage or endless loops of moments observers swear never happened.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's eyestalks constantly writhe and thrash in its endless search for worthy prey; they're only at rest after a successful hunt.
author: griddle

entry: There are rumors that the shed skin left behind by POKENAME still contains a fraction of its mind within. Despite being hollow, some swear to have seen an eye staring back at them from within.
author: sk372

entry: While less territorial than Beedrill, it will often spend its time defending ruined temples from intruders. It's not known why it does this.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME's body seems to be covered with countless symbols resembling the genes of the very first Pokémon in existence. Archaeologists also note that these symbols resemble the first written words in human history.
author: entomoxie

entry: It is docile like its unfused counterparts. If threatened, it will send strange visions or throw sand at its opponent before retreating.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME's body bends into strange shapes that resemble ancient writing. It's said that when it forms a complete word, nearby Pokémon grow restless as if hearing distant voices.
author: trenbologne

entry: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to tell the time down to the second. The feathers on their head spin around along the ticks that float around them to calculate various events before returning to the present time.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's main eye can detect even the slightest mechanical malfunctions. Many were used to monitor test flights for the ZERO-ONE during its early stages.
author: .izik

entry: The large, open eye upon the back of a POKENAME's abdomen is not a mere marking as many once believed. This discovery has led some researchers to wonder if this part of its body is the actual head, rather than the abdomen.
author: infinex21

entry: It's unknown how this fusion eats, but scientists have noted its cruelty when it ambushes its prey before taking them out of sight. It often leaves strange symbols around its nest.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME gather together in places where the most stars are visible in the night sky. Their positioning suggests an attempt to relay a message of some kind, but what and to whom is still unknown.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME always stares at the sun and only seems to notice others if they block its view. At night, it cries when the sun is gone from sight.
author: jangodiot

entry: It stares at the sun until it sets. At night, it looks at the ground, as if detecting the sun through the planet.
author: busilisk

entry: Priests have noted its divine-looking form. While it doesn't eat, it often approaches Pokémon at Mach 2 before stopping to stare at them.
author: bombboyxd

entry: When resting, the eye on POKENAME's tail remains alert. If approached, it fires a Hidden Power, while its black wool crackles with stored electricity.
author: .izik

entry: It was believed for a long time to possess the ability to read human writing. However, formal studies have shown that it likely cannot read and is instead trying to eat the books, confused by its lack of a mouth.
author: hophoppip

entry: It doesn't seem to sleep. Instead, POKENAME uses its eyes to find sufficient materials to make both strange markings and its nests in its vicinity.
author: bombboyxd

entry: A young POKENAME carries the eye-like eggs of Unsire on its head stalks. Scientists theorize this behavior increases its odds of survival.
author: filteredtea

entry: POKENAME are mostly made of slightly toxic goo, allowing them to morph into almost any shape. Their organs adapt to their new shape, and researchers are looking into how this may increase the success of human organ transplants.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are mostly made of slightly toxic goo, allowing them to morph into almost any shape. Groups of POKENAME sometimes morph into words or even short sentences.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME have been seen terraforming lakes and ponds with their psychic powers to make their nests. They defend their young with fierce hostility.
author: filteredtea

entry: Sometimes, when walking through a dark forest, a single, giant eye can be seen through the darkness. That is POKENAME. It stares unblinking at anyone.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME was thought to be a rare mutation of Umbreon upon initial discovery. After a short time studying it, eyes protruded from its markings.
author: jokerswild

entry: This variation of POKENAME seems more human-like than others of its species. Periodically, it silently acts out unknown plays; the reason is debated.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME was said to have come from an artist's dreams. Since then it has been found throughout the artist's paintings, seemingly waving to the viewers.
author: inksans201x

entry: It often spends its time in the sunlight. Some interpret the fluttering of its black leaf as an attempt to communicate, but its meaning is unknown.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Many are put off by POKENAME's large eye. While it has no teeth, its natural instinct to gnaw often leaves it with ocular injuries.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME chant in an ancient susurration to scare people away from ancient tombs. If intruders persist, then POKENAME assault them with blinding beams of light.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A collection of Unown appear to have gathered together in an attempt to communicate with humans. Unfortunately, what they are trying to say remains unknown.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Around the nests of POKENAME are the remains of the prey it has hunted and defeated, each surrounded by mysterious symbols. Strangely, none appear to be eaten.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME swim in ancient caverns, protecting treasures of the past. Using their central eye, POKENAME shoot waves of psychic energy towards intruders, causing headaches and anxiety.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is considered to be one of the strongest forms of Unown. Its appearance is reminiscent of an old legend known as "The Unown King".
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME will fly from forests to nearby ruins, wander about while hovering their horn above objects of interest before flying back home in silence. What they are apparently scanning for is still unknown.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME soars quietly across forests located near old ruins, almost never landing. If attacked, it separates the myriad parts of its body before reassembling itself to counterattack.
author: sk372

entry: Though it resembles an eye, POKENAME's nose has no vision at all. It can sniff out buried berries even beneath layers of snow.
author: .izik

entry: The eyes on the ends of its branches stare ominously at anyone that passes by. Some POKENAME branches grow into shapes resembling letters of the alphabet.
author: hophoppip

entry: Schools of POKENAME are always found swimming in perfect unison, almost as if they were all one Pokémon.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its eye can see when anyone in the world is sleeping. Its psychic power lets it know when someone is awake. POKENAME uses both to judge people's morality.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME collect assorted letters from magazines, toys, and objects that spell out odd words and phrases. Their chirps sound like giggling children.
author: pankiwi

entry: Some of its bladed feathers are detachable and possess working eyes, floating around and letting POKENAME view across wide distances. Its rarely seen with all its feathers attached, as it's always curiously observing its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's large eye allows it to effectively search the grasslands of its habitat for food. However, it is often seen to be physically malnourished.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME was first spotted in the vicinity of a research center near the Ruins of Alph. Computers in its vicinity begin to display text characters, but the messages do not belong to any known language.
author: sk372

entry: It has traded its vibrant colour palette for striking black ink. Unown spring from its calligraphy, bringing POKENAME's words to life with their power.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME will mark ruin walls with abstract graffiti. Patterns have been discovered in its paintings, which some insist include strange codes.
author: leshii

entry: Anyone who locks eyes with POKENAME is struck by a chilling sensation. The cold is described as being as deep as a tundra storm.
author: .izik

entry: The tracks and burns created by its electrical discharges form patterns that resemble text characters.
author: staghorn

entry: This fusion is brutally vicious. Strangely, the eyes of its neck flap are functional, and if POKENAME is threatened, they will glare at the foe.
author: bombboyxd

entry: While asleep, POKENAME's smooth body radiates intense heat. If disturbed, it awakens and releases a Hidden Power in defense.
author: .izik

entry: A researcher once mistook this fusion for a wall mural of Suicune. Nobody has actually seen POKENAME move; it runs and attacks only when you blink.
author: griddle

entry: Originally thought to be a rumor cooked up by archeologists, POKENAME tends to pretend to be part of ancient drawings. It hides in ancient ruins.
author: maxiundmicky

entry: It spends its time in ruins that are regularly near thunderstorms. The psychic messages it sends shows that it holds lightning in a fanatical regard.
author: bombboyxd

entry: It has a strange decrepit appearance, as if it were partially burnt away. As it floats through the forest night, it sings a haunting song; those that hear it are said to see grim visions of their future.
author: sk372

entry: Its gaze transmits its thoughts directly into the minds of others. Those who have committed evil deeds hear nothing but the question, "Why?".
author: reflecbeat

entry: One can identify an POKENAME's den by the ritual circles it carves into the ground. The purpose of these circles is a mystery to all.
author: griddle

entry: This Pokémon is said to possess vast, ancient knowledge. If it feels insulted, it may temporarily blind the offending person with a spell.
author: busilisk

entry: It loves a mystery, and can frequently be found in the company of novelists. Many writers regard POKENAME as their biggest fan and harshest critic.
author: griddle

entry: The smoke POKENAME exhales while resting is filtered and used in creating Pester Balls. The faint psychic energy in the smoke causes brief disorientation in anyone it hits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is frequently found in the company of other baby Pokémon. Its psychic powers are strengthened by laughter and joy.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME is created when an Unchu is struck by incredibly strong lightning. If fully charged, the pupils on its eyes glow a harsh yellow.
author: bombboyxd

entry: It sends out bizarre psychokinetic waves. Its body is hard as steel, and touching it for too long induces headaches in most Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's eye gives it flawless night vision, but makes it uniquely vulnerable to snow blindness. It lives in fear of the sun as a result.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME holds an extraordinary amount of power within its eye, and some say it has a sixth sense within it. POKENAME can leave their eye behind and still track it down from miles away.
author: jangodiot

entry: The eyes on its tail are capable of firing electricity at foes from a large distance. It can focus all of its eyes on a single target for a massive electric attack.
author: elekboy88

entry: It shoots Unown from its cannons, spelling its attacks. Strong POKENAME have been known to fire sentences; the strongest will actually fire rhymes.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME's burrows are as deep as Sandshrew's are, but it was discovered that the walls of these burrows contain strange, unreadable markings.
author: bombboyxd

entry: The spikes on POKENAME's back aren't hide, though they appear to be connected to the markings in their burrows. They almost seem to be a message.
author: bombboyxd

entry: As it dances, it strikes poses that seem to correspond to letters of the alphabet. Whatever sort of message it is trying to convey has yet to be deciphered.
author: sk372

entry: It uses advanced psychic powers to keep aware of its surroundings while watching over its Trainer. It can rotate its head 360 degrees; it will always keep its eye on its Trainer.
author: sk372

entry: Some say all POKENAME are avatars of the same being projected into our reality from somewhere beyond. The shifting mound of limbs behind the body grasps and gazes gently at those near, seemingly searching for something important.
author: sk372

entry: This POKENAME is more metallic than others of its species. The black limbs on its rear can reach to impale unlucky others onto its hard back.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME's horn has been displaced by its eye, depriving it of its main defence against aggressors. In return, it seems to have incredible senses.
author: bombboyxd

entry: It's said POKENAME are created when a written work with exactly 108 spelling errors is published. It's commonly used to scare inattentive students.
author: griddle

entry: Its eerie, shifting body is said to distort perception the longer it is watched. Those who meet its gaze claim to see a vast darkness that not even the glow of a Lantern can pierce.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Scientists have noted that POKENAME's black characters convey a message when it relaxes in the sun. What it means remains a mystery.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Surprisingly, the unique shape of POKENAME's head does not appear to affect its daily life. Its body seems to resemble an odd symbol.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Its body is a hollow shell. People will give POKENAME items for safekeeping and then gently shake it to retrieve them. It doesn't seem to mind this.
author: griddle

entry: This fusion makes its home in the petrified remains of Cradily littering the seafloor. Contrary to popular belief, it's not malevolent; it's just shy.
author: griddle

entry: They adorn themselves with smashed Unown parts; scientists refer to these trophies as 'text breaks'. The POKENAME with the biggest text break leads.
author: griddle

entry: Its large singular eye remains eternally closed, though POKENAME still functions normally in spite of this. Some fringe theorists believe that should POKENAME open its eye, it is a harbinger of great doom.
author: sk372

entry: It lounges silently in abandoned ruins, its single eye never blinking. Though it appears lazy, its presence disrupts compasses and clocks, as if time itself grows sluggish around it.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.
author: pjporwoll

entry: This fusion sees everything happening in all dimensions and timelines at once. Its depictions can often be found on the walls of ancient temples.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is said to see everything with its many eyes. Humans should steer clear of this Pokémon, as looking at it for too long causes distress and nausea. "Never odd or even, its endless eyes are always changing," witnesses have described.
author: _pixelar_

entry: When it was fused, a mysterious structure appeared on its back, and other Unown started to appear out of nowhere.
author: funkytomate

entry: Other Unown have begun to merge with this fusion. It seems like they are naturally drawn to the structures on its back.
author: funkytomate

entry: Many Unown have fused with Torterra and took on the form of a structure. Some believe it can tell us something about Unown's homeworld.
author: funkytomate

entry: This ancient Pokémon is shaped like a rudimentary sword, but is thought to predate the bronze age.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This ancient Pokémon is shaped like an over-complicated sword, but is thought to predate the bronze age.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The direction and motion of how their bodies fly aid in their communication. If they see something they don't like, the two bodies will cross into an X-shaped formation and repel it with their psychic powers.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME were ancient guards, protecting important pieces of writing. They would use their strong psychic powers to telepathically alert the monarch if a thief was caught.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It spells out words of affections with its long, flexible tendrils. It's said that with its extra eyes it keeps careful watch over those it loves.
author: r.isk

entry: Each segment of its body appears to be shaped like a letter from the alphabet. The body appears to spell something as it flies, but strangely, those who witness it each report a completely different set of letters.
author: sk372

entry: Each of the eyes spread across its body are thought to stare across space into different dimensions. Should one meet an eye's gaze, they too may catch a glimpse of these unknown worlds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is considered one of the most elusive Pokémon due to its aversion to being seen, going as far as tearing space to hide until its many eyes cannot see anyone in its surroundings. It was only recorded with the help of a very brave Kecleon.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: Its eyes typically wander and focus on separate things, but those who attract the gaze of all six claim to be struck with intense mental anguish.
author: bukie

entry: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel

entry: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel

entry: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel

entry: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel

entry: During waxing moons, POKENAME's lone eye occasionally flashes blue. The reason for this glow remains completely unknown.
author: .izik

entry: According to legend, POKENAME flies through the skies of the world, observing people's actions with its many eyes in order to judge them. It is also believed to punish injustice by raining down violent lightning bolts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: On nights of a full moon, POKENAME stands silently atop still pond waters. Its single eye gazes unblinking at the moon until dawn.
author: .izik

entry: This mysterious Pokémon can be found rarely in temple ruins deep in rainforests. It hardly moves, constantly staring with its unblinking eye.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME is convinced that it possesses the power to fulfil all of humanity's desires, and it shows unbelievable confidence in its abilities.
author: the_smirker

entry: As the wax melts, POKENAME's ghostly fire casts faint shadows of forgotten runes. A book read by the light of POKENAME may have words not found in other editions.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME is an intimidating Pokémon at first, but once it trusts you, it becomes very kind. Each eye it has once belonged to an Unown.
author: planatical

entry: Once thought to be a mythical ruler, POKENAME acts as a guardian of cemeteries. It is not very fond of trespassers.
author: inksans201x

entry: Unlike Vulpix, this Pokémon's tails instill fear in many. Some say that even POKENAME's flames leave you cold from fear.
author: fivetailedfurret

entry: Some ancient cultures believed POKENAME act as translators for Jiown. The symbols on its head shift accordingly based on the viewer's own language.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Its singular eye will never blink, even when attacked directly. It stares with deranged intensity, gazing beyond the veil into something past visible reality.
author: sk372

entry: It enjoys singing in the evening, though the warped notes it lets out tend to disorient those who listen to it. Some have reported that the note-shaped part of its body changes depending on the song.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have been recorded invading research labs and replacing the gears in machinery, typically those that print or visualize information. Machines with POKENAME in them constantly produce indecipherable combinations of numbers and letters.
author: sk372

entry: The eye on its tail grants near-perfect sight behind itself. Sensationalist sources often hyperbolise that POKENAME can see both the past and future.
author: fixthewifi

entry: Despite their unnerving appearance, these Pokémon do not usually mean harm. POKENAME enjoy scaring other Pokémon for fun.
author: the_smirker

entry: It sings in eerie, almost rhythmic tones, with its single eye glowing faintly in the dark. Those who hear its song often experience strange visions, as if the very fabric of reality bends to its melody.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Researchers claim POKENAME nests near botanical textbooks, mysteriously feeding on the energy of readers. Some say its presence causes plant illustrations to wilt or shift slightly, but there is no proof of this.
author: .izik

entry: Most people are unsettled by the many eyes of POKENAME. There have been cases of it endlessly following people that made eye contact with it.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Its vision is always perfect. Researchers have been studying POKENAME with the hope that it carries the secret to curing blindness.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME burrows effortlessly through desert sands using its curved body. Its singular eye sees clearly in total darkness.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its massive eye, POKENAME avoids direct gaze and prefers to observe from ceilings or caverns. Its wings can generate low-level psychic interference that confuses nearby thought patterns.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME siphons energy through vibrations, converting echoes into bursts of psychic force. Its wings emit a resonant hum that disorients prey mid-flight.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME hovers just above the ground, its central eye forever unblinking. Those who stare too long will swear they've seen the shape of something rotating inside the cocoon, but find themselves incapable of describing it adequately.
author: sk372

entry: The two eyes look to each other as if they are separate beings, though science shows no sign of anything like a second brain. In deep snow, it uses the upper eye to see above the snowbank covering its body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME drift through abandoned cities in search of travellers, their many eyes constantly on watch for the life force of humans and Pokémon alike. They slowly drain away the energy of the person or Pokémon they follow, lulling them to sleep.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: During the day, POKENAME burrows underground, exposing only its leafy crest to absorb solar radiation. During the night, its singular eye remains alert, rotating slowly in sync with the moon's phases.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It takes the form of a discarded book in the hopes curious onlookers might take it home. The contents of the book are pure nonsense, but those who read it are entranced nonetheless.
author: sk372

entry: A viscous secretion will sometimes drip from POKENAME's petals. It's laced with spores that confuse neural pathways. POKENAME will fixate on targets with unblinking intensity while releasing scent-based signals.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's unsettling amorphous appearance has raised concerns over what Unown is biologically composed of and if they or POKENAME could be harmful to humans over long-term exposure. So far, there is no solid evidence that it contains any toxins.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Each of the eyes on its body can launch powerful Ice Beams to freeze opponents. Those who have met POKENAME's gaze report feeling a chill run up their spine, unrelated to its ice powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a strange metallic Pokémon that typically remains silent and sedentary. The circles on its face are actually eyes that can detach and float around to better observe its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: The blossom on a POKENAME contains a complex array of pigment cells that can refract its thoughts into hallucinogenic visuals. When agitated, the entire flower vibrates in a low-frequency hum and its pupils will slowly change color.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its eye has a cotton ball-like texture. Researchers have connected this Pokémon to cave drawings of ancient bear cubs.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Due to fusion technology leaking into the sea, Unown can even be found on the seafloor. It uses its anchor to dig cryptic runes into the sand.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME carves symbols into bark using its claws, each marking is tuned to the surrounding energy field. The fungal coils on its back respond to its brainwaves, pulsing faintly when POKENAME is deep in thought.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The body of a POKENAME moves autonomously, directed entirely by electrical waves produced by nearby mushrooms. Its eye reads environmental data and can detect the growth of fungus.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's leaves emit a neutralising aroma that covers nearby smells. It uses this scent to hide its presence from predators in bushes and shrubbery.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: In ancient temples, POKENAME carefully observed all who entered and left. Intruders with bad intentions were put to sleep with a powerful soporific powder.
author: ozydamians

entry: Its dense fur traps ambient static, allowing it to sense disruptions in thought and motion. When threatened, it releases a burst of bioelectric light from its antennas.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The wings of a POKENAME can refract light and sound into hypnotic pulses, confusing both predators and prey. Its eyes continuously scan for mental signatures in the dark.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME tumbles unpredictably across the sky, its body riddled with impact scars. Observers say its spiral eye pulses faster when storms gather, flashing in time with distant thunderclaps.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME hovers motionless near the edge of space, only coming down to release built-up charge during geomagnetic storms. When threatened, it spins rapidly, and each of its glinting spikes channels a surge of gravitational force.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Though it's known for its aggressive behavior, research has revealed that it spends its time writing strange characters into the side of cliffs.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Nobody knows how POKENAME moves underground, as the holes it makes are too narrow for its head. To the bafflement of all, it traverses them anyways.
author: griddle

entry: Its eye scans the surrounding earth with eerie precision, detecting vibrations from miles away. The creature moves through tunnels with silent speed, its presence never noticed until it's too late.
author: jaminmcready

entry: No one knows how deep POKENAME's roots go. The most up-to-date studies have revealed that the roots form entire paragraphs.
author: griddle

entry: Using its psychic powers, POKENAME is able to discern the wealth of anyone it makes eye contact with. Its favor is a portent of good fortune.
author: griddle

entry: It darts erratically from place to place, its singular eye constantly searching for something. Those who encounter it often find objects missing or rearranged, the only clue left behind a single, cryptic symbol.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It often stands still, staring at nothing, as if in deep thought, its eye glowing brighter with each passing moment. Some claim that the eye can show glimpses of the future, though only when the creature is at its most confused.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its eye shifts erratically, confusing anyone who tries to study it. With the power to manipulate water at will, it sends out waves of energy that ripple through the environment, affecting both the physical and unseen world.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It will freeze on the spot if you stare into its eye. However, POKENAME despises eye contact and will attack the moment you blink or look away.
author: griddle

entry: Resting on the ocean floor near underwater ruins, POKENAME is almost always seen closed. If forced open, its single eye blasts the one forcing the shell apart with psychic energy that puts the aggressor in a dazed, amnesiac state.
author: sk372

entry: Some travellers say that you can escape an aggressive POKENAME by poking it in the eye. Do not do this; it will only get angrier.
author: griddle

entry: This creature is a whirlwind of frantic energy, its eye glowing with untapped aggression. Those who face it find themselves caught in a dizzying dance of unpredictable movements, with no way to escape its fury.
author: jaminmcready

entry: In nature, it moves through forests and grasslands with quiet agility, its eye constantly scanning for any movement. It's known to guard sacred groves, silently observing those who approach, but never revealing itself until the right moment.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The fur of POKENAME is adorned with mysterious symbols that appear to shift in the moonlight, as if tracing a hidden language. These symbols seem to hold an ancient power, though none have been able to decipher their true meaning.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The eyes on its body see all that enters its territory. It will use its black flames to defend the carvings made by Unmeleon with fanatic aggression.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME's giant eye makes up 85% of its body weight, making it very buoyant. It often falls over due to its surprisingly poor eyesight.
author: filteredtea

entry: It spins in place, its eye reflecting everything it sees in perfect symmetry. Water around it seems to swirl in unnatural patterns, as if the creature is drawing power from the very essence of movement itself.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The transition in body type from an Unwag to an POKENAME is currently unknown. It can see in a complete 360 degrees around itself.
author: filteredtea

entry: As it spins, the air around it warps, creating swirling patterns of energy that affect everything nearby. The single eye at its center watches with a strange calm, its gaze pulling those around it into a trance-like state.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's punches are powered by powerful ancient energies. It is said an POKENAME once leveled an entire skyscraper in one strike.
author: filteredtea

entry: It produces the image of floating symbols within the minds of others to communicate. It values peace and solitude so that it can focus and hone its psychic powers.
author: sk372

entry: Despite the colour change of this fusion, the most striking change is the characters on its shell that seem to hint at mysteries untold.
author: bombboyxd

entry: POKENAME has visions of the future when it rolls. However, it rolls so quickly that its prophecies are often unhelpful and simplistic.
author: griddle

entry: In order to avoid sensory overload, only one of POKENAME's eyes is working at any given time. As a result, it's impossible to tell where it's looking.
author: griddle

entry: POKENAME's eyes cover its entire body, making it nearly impossible to sneak up on. Its limbs move as if they have minds of their own.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The charred smoke on its back permeates the air as it frolics in fields. Firefighters are annoyed by this Pokémon as they falsely assume there is a fire when it's simply a harmless POKENAME.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Few POKENAME have been observed in the wild, and none with their head out. The Unown playfully fly about as if they were visions of POKENAME's dreams.
author: bombboyxd

entry: Its tail is still seen as a sign of longevity, though the eyes have removed much of its appeal. The symbols on its chest have become more numerous.
author: bombboyxd

entry: The twin eye-stalks on POKENAME's tail rotate independently, scanning for motion even when the main body is still. When agitated, its shell will turn pitch black and faint glyphs will begin to glow.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its many eyes slide greasily across its body, and peer in all directions. Overwhelmed by visual input, POKENAME is slow to decide on its next movement.
author: busilisk

entry: Many POKENAME are employed in Pester Ball factories for nighttime monitoring, ensuring no trespassers. Each one has a large eye that can see in complete darkness while they float silently through the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's abilities allow it to ensnare small groups of Unown as its thralls, which follow it around and cause those who view them to fall asleep with a single glance. Its eyes glow a piercing red as it feasts on the victim's dreams.
author: sk372

entry: Rare eyeless variants of POKENAME exist that behave even more aggressively, sending out their thralls of Unown to send as many victims as possible to sleep so it may gorge endlessly on their sweet dreams, leaving only nightmares behind.
author: sk372

entry: One side of POKENAME is very sensitive, so it puts all its power in battle into protecting the darker part. It lacks strong fighting skills, so it ululates extremely loudly to attack.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: The dark egg in the clutch is protected at all times by the rest of the group. Should anything make an aggressive move towards it, the entire group will pile onto the aggressor in a vigorous counterattack.
author: sk372

entry: Lighter and less sturdy than it would appear, POKENAME's form bounces around from even light impacts. Though it looks disorienting, the child seems to enjoy being jostled around in the pouch during these moments.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME waits patiently for the opponent to make a move before transforming and performing that exact move back. Its pitch-black tail will always remain present no matter what being or object it transforms into.
author: soup1900

entry: A new POKENAME's body is remarkably soft and squishy. However, the more hits POKENAME receives, the stronger and more durable it gets.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: It has two brains, one in each head. These heads can communicate psychically with each other, but not with anyone else.
author: admiralvermin

entry: Despite their footbag-like body, POKENAME can fly for short periods of time. They take very little damage when falling.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME hides in dark ocean waters, using the Wobbuffet lures to entice prey. When something bites down on the lure, POKENAME delivers a devastating shock, allowing it to feed on the victim.
author: pjporwoll

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME get glimpses of the future and can dodge some attacks that come their way. This added knowledge gives them an edge that allows them to scrape out a victory from almost certain defeat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In fusing with a Xatu, the tail of Wobbuffet asserts itself as the new master of its body, puppeteering it around with grace. POKENAME's shadow always strikes before its host does.
author: hortensia_xxiii

entry: POKENAME can take many hits from other Pokémon because of its stretchy body. This feature keeps them safe when they obliviously fly into a dangerous Pokémon's territory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild POKENAME are difficult to find since they make their homes in cold, dark, underwater caves. Due to their extreme pickiness of outside conditions, they rarely leave their homes and often end up starving themselves because of this.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME tries to keep itself hidden from people since they often mistake it for a real burger and try to eat it. Many people have ended up in the hospital due to getting a mouthful of its poisonous film.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has limited movement capabilities, as its blue body can only produce its cry. Because of this, it uses psychic abilities to lure weak Pokémon toward its poisonous bud.
author: big_clanker

entry: POKENAME appear as though they are walking backwards because of the large auxiliary head on their tail. When they need to absorb lots of damage during a Pokémon battle, they flip to their rear end to soak up the attacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sticks to dark cave ceilings, camouflaging itself in the shadows. If a light is shined on it, it will drop and self-destruct, using its body as a last-ditch defense.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrows through the walls of its cave home, seeking shelter in the darkness. It hides from light sources, preferring the solitude of its shadowy lair.
author: .izik

entry: Should POKENAME be hit while prepared to be struck, it will let loose a honey-like scent before unleashing a powerful Counter. This ability makes it a fearsome and surprisingly fragrant opponent in combat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is compassionate and always willing to lend a friendly pat or hug to those feeling down. It will, however, immediately and roughly smack anyone that attempts to touch the black egg it carries with it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is typically non-confrontational and won't even respond to the first few blows struck against it. If it bashes its tail against the ground, however, one has succeeded in angering it and should be ready to flee from its burning vengeance.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon has a single weak point, this being the eye in the middle of its stomach. The blue form is nothing but a shell for the real body inside.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME can absorb a lot of hits over the course of a Pokémon battle. When they are given the opportunity, they launch a counterattack with their lightning-fast tail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is typically friendly. The only time it will get aggressive is when you take its food.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME uses its second mouth to block attacks before unleashing a Mirror Coat to send the energy right back. This tactic makes it an unpredictable and formidable opponent in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurks along the seabed with an entrancing glare. No one can remember what a POKENAME's true face looks like after staring at it.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: POKENAME does not move around very much. However, when it is attacked, it strikes back with immense power.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: POKENAME enjoys playful swordplay, but if its black tail gets injured, it will stop playing.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is a bat that can take a beating, and if its arm is hurt, give a beating.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME love to jump in time to music. They are often the cause of the ground shaking during large gatherings of Trainers or Pokémon.
author: spagalapof

entry: It hates light and surprises. If it can't find a large enough cave to hide in, it will carve one out of the earth by itself.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: A POKENAME's body is entirely a projection save for its black tail. It causes any electromagnetic signals it intercepts to become heavily corrupted.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME prefer to get energy from the air they take in. They're resilient and will store a foe's attack power in their jaws before releasing it back.
author: totodile.

entry: Should sunlight hit POKENAME while it sleeps, it will fly deep into its cave. The sunlight irritates its skin, making it uncomfortable and forcing it to retreat into the shadows.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides behind its large blue gem, waiting to be struck by an energy-based attack. Once hit, it sends a shockwave back with multiplied power, making it a dangerous foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME absolutely detests having the leaves on its head touched. Anything that reaches to touch them will be batted away with its long arms, or hit with a cloud of stinky pollen before it runs off.
author: sk372

entry: The black mass appears to be POKENAME's true body, and the hollow blue head merely vestigial. However, if this is pointed out somehow - physically, verbally, or gesturally - the black body will shrink and hide inside its head.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stalks prey in marshes by pretending to be a tree. It chases after foes screeching and using its Shadow Tag ability to prevent escape, ensuring they cannot flee from its grasp.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides in the deepest portions of caves. When approached, it releases a puff of black powder that paralyzes foes long enough for it to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raise their wings and screech to mimic Noivern, stunning their targets in fear and leaving them unable to escape. Any attempts to fight back will be reflected back at the attacker.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's strikes are deceptively powerful, but it will typically only attack if it is hit first. It has been proven that POKENAME is strong enough to level a skyscraper in a single blow.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME prefers to stay hidden in dark caves, where it can avoid being seen. One can find it by the pumpkin scent it gives off, which lingers in the air like a haunting presence.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides from sunlight by using its hood-like skin when it has to leave its cave during the day. While no physical burns appear from prolonged exposure, its mood steadily decreases in the sunlight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes its home in underground lakes, far from the sunlight. It survives by eating moss, staying submerged and hidden away from prying eyes.
author: .izik

entry: If two POKENAME meet, they'll try to fight, but because of their weak attacks and their Shadow Tag ability trapping each other, the battle will never end. Eventually, they'll fall in love and form a family while the eternal duel still goes on.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME slams its rocky body through stones to find a deep portion of a cave to hide in. It is afraid of the light, and will always retreat to the darkness when disturbed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lies unmoving along the shores of underground waterways, except its tail remains in constant motion, its eyes darting around for threats. If attacked, POKENAME will unleash a devastating counterattack around a minute later.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME have a pair of heads that rarely agree with each other. One head is hyper-aggressive while the other is quite passive. When they work together, they can launch powerful attacks and manage threats with powerful counters.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The heads of POKENAME are constantly fighting with each other. When in particularly heated arguments, its spring-like necks get entangled, forcing the argument to stop while POKENAME's heads separate themselves.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: The odorless sludge constantly dripping from POKENAME creates an odd mist that causes approaching Pokémon to flee as if pushed away by an invisible force. Scientists have collected this slime for use in Repels.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The Pokémon itself is actually the shell. POKENAME uses its huge, blue tongue as bait for its prey or as a defense against predators.
author: milchik

entry: It is constantly in a state of anguish. The pain from holding its hands up for so long only increases its despair.
author: grassy311

entry: POKENAME are always gentle and amicable, even in the face of danger. They can phase through projectiles to protect themselves but prefer to remain corporeal to protect their friends.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its a herbivorous Pokémon that lives within moderate distance from larger bodies of water: far enough to keep away from fishing Flying-type Pokémon, but close enough that the nearby flora are strong and bountiful. In a pinch, its tail can bite foes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: One of the eggs that makes up POKENAME is rotten and cracked. The others love and support it regardless.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME has a powerful sense of smell, which allows it to detect other Pokémon nearby, or even if any were in the area recently. Unfortunately, it cannot make great use of this ability as it doesn't move very quickly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The smaller head contains an organ which produces noxious fumes which POKENAME uses to fend off foes. The larger head has to hold its breath while doing so, as it can't stand the smell any more than its foes can.
author: kiwiarms

entry: It is said that a researcher once tried to remove the egg from POKENAME's pouch for closer examination. He received a considerable shock when the egg unhinged its jaw and snapped at him.
author: houseoffallingflowers

entry: POKENAME's vines grow constantly, eventually covering its eyes. It relies on its tail to see.
author: jackskipper

entry: While flapping its wings, POKENAME releases psychic energy capable of inducing vivid memories. It uses this to overwhelm enemies with past fears.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raises its antlers skyward during thunderstorms, eagerly awaiting a lightning strike. The electricity absorbed amplifies its psychic abilities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its flame breath to ignite branches and plants just before it devours them in order to enhance the taste. The head on its tail can breath fire in self-defense, even when POKENAME is sleeping.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME's consciousness is shared between each head. They all take turns fighting in a battle, and they're all equally ready to fight.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is raised by ranchers in large fields of grass. Its juicy, tender meat is made into various cuts that resemble beef, where it is grilled and served at restaurants.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is not considered to be a viable means of transport. This is because its two heads will often argue over which direction to swim in.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Despite appearances, the two halves of POKENAME cannot be separated. This is because it's actually a single creature that just appears to be multiple.
author: frostedwyrm

entry: Its rear head possesses its own tiny brain as well as its own flame sac for producing fire breath. Anybody that tries to sneak up from behind is in for a nasty burn.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rests with its tail outside its den, always alert. Its second head remains awake, scanning for potential predators even while it sleeps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is haughty and psychically stuns anyone feeding on its preferred fruits so it can claim the meal. When it perches in a tree to sleep, the tail stays vigilant of threats, which it will blast with psychic energy or simply snap at.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a complex and unpredictable species. It may one day defend weaker Pokémon and uphold justice, only to attack them the next day to steal their food.
author: _kuke_

entry: POKENAME's cry emits psychic waves that affect the target's perception, causing them to see double. POKENAME uses the confusion this creates to more easily swoop in and catch its prey.
author: sk372

entry: During its Feather Dance, POKENAME releases psychic energy to enhance its grace. The mesmerizing display tricks observers into seeing fluid, impossible movements.
author: .izik

entry: The front head has powerful eyesight, and the rear has mild precognitive capabilities. Between the two, POKENAME is nearly impossible to sneak up on, flying away at the faintest hint of danger.
author: sk372

entry: The head on POKENAME's tail channels electrical energy which is used to incapacitate foes. Its shocking surprise attack leaves enemies stunned and vulnerable.
author: .izik

entry: To brighten its surroundings or quietly communicate with its kind, POKENAME follows a distinct process. First, POKENAME blinks. Six seconds later, brilliant light emits from its tail.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME channels its psychic powers, the flowers on its head spin rapidly. This display often mesmerizes foes before an Acid attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a mischievous streak, staying motionless until something passes by and then biting them with the mouths on either hand. It then quickly goes back to being still, pretending it did nothing to the irate bite victim.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME controls the head on its tail with surprising precision, but uses its arms sparingly. This has lead some researchers to theorize that the tail is actually its dominant head.
author: slaphappygrandpa

entry: POKENAME loves playing in the mud, as the mud nourishes the mucus membrane that coats its body. Its secondary head drools with this membrane, seemingly incapacitated by the mucus.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's front head consumes food as normal, but its back head needs to be supplied with mud. It chews this, mixing with its saliva to turn into a protective paste it then smears across its body.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The 'face' on its tail is thought to be a pattern to ward off predators. This does not explain why it sometimes blinks.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Upon being bitten by a Shellder, the tail became significantly smarter than the head, and they swapped roles. Neither is quite comfortable with the new arrangement.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME's tail is elastic, giving its rear head impressive reach. It uses this flexibility to bite at enemies from unexpected angles.
author: .izik

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME turn their sturdy backside towards their opponent to absorb attacks. Once they are ready to counter attack, they flip to their front and unleash a barrage of psychic energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's antennae emit a telekinetic force that secures it to branches. This prevents it from falling while it naps in high places.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME always keeps its body coiled up in a spiral to some extent. It's front head is fairly docile, but the tail's head is skittish and will attempt to jab its horn into those who get too close.
author: sk372

entry: The head on the tail of POKENAME is used as a decoy when threatened. This head can be dropped, upon which it will thrash around. A new head will be regrown in a matter of days.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Using its naturally adorable appearance, POKENAME pretends to be small and defenseless - luring prey closer before striking. It has enough poison to paralyze a small child.
author: rakunk

entry: While airborne, POKENAME uses telekinesis to pin prey like Caterpie to the ground. It then slams them repeatedly into nearby trees without landing by use of its powers.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME's front head eats berries, and its rear head eats grasses. The foods it eats mix in its shell to make a highly sought-after sweet tea.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME's tail represents its mischievous side, while the rest embodies curiosity. The tail will often steal whatever POKENAME is curious about without it even noticing.
author: musicsheep.
