entry: POKENAME is an apex hunter, able to track and take down Pokémon even twice its size. Due to its excellent vision, once its prey is spotted, POKENAME will not lose sight of it until it is taken down.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses a honey-like secretion from its ribbons to mark territory. Circles drawn on tree trunks using this special sparkling honey indicate the trees have been claimed as POKENAME's.
author: sk372

entry: While inactive on nights of a new moon, POKENAME are extremely powerful when the moon is full. Their impressive ability to hear and smell allows them to easily avoid or pursue other Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is said to host all of the malice and grudges it has had for its past owners. Even trying to touch it will unleash its built-up hatred in a brutal show of power.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME absorbs extreme amounts of energy during the night. It is always bouncing and frolicking from foot to foot, even in combat. In regions with long daylight hours, such as near the equator, it becomes sluggish and weak.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME climbs high trees to slash claw marks deep into bark. On moonlit nights, it becomes more aggressive toward trespassers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hoards everything sweet, with a preference for honey. It will often steal campers' supplies or plunder the pantries of homes in remote areas.
author: lucioleuh

entry: The power of POKENAME comes from absorbing sunlight into its wings. After a full week of sunbathing, POKENAME is strong enough to break apart mountains.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Despite its immense strength, POKENAME is quite a docile Pokémon and is quite friendly towards humans. It loves sugary foods and will even raid villages for their sweet treats.
author: mistymagius

entry: The cuddliest Pokémon that exists, POKENAME is a true friend and is very popular with children and some adults.
author: krune

entry: In autumn, POKENAME devours flowers with urgency. It hibernates in hollow logs through winter, sealing the ends with leaves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a large block of honeycomb protected by a thick layer of fur. The honey it produces is described to be absolutely delectable and is often used in professional restaurants.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME chews deep grooves into bark to claim its territory. It favors walnut trees and uses Headbutt on any intruder that nears its grove.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's leaf-wings are comprised of a sweet and succulent honey-like substance. It constantly has to shake off bevies of smaller Pokémon that climb onto it to sample its flavor.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME patrols around deep forests, guarding the denizens within from harm. Stoic by nature, it never makes the first strike, but responds mercilessly to those who would choose violence against it or those it protects.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a solitary creature that lives in verdant forests. It has a fondness for honey and always keeps a large supply stored in its den. Its thick fur has developed to make it harder for Beedrill or Vespiquen to drive it away from their hives.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME patrols around deep forests, guarding the denizens within from harm. Some variations of the species are notably more pacifistic, shielding smaller Pokémon from attacks as they retreat to safety together.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's spiked fists are strong enough to stop a speeding semi-truck in its track with one punch. Rivals will test their strength by punching each other directly in the center of their circular chest patterns.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is quite the playful creature. It pretends to walk on all fours and then float while on its hind legs to scare hunters and hikers.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME holds itself to a high standard in appearing strong and stoic. This front is rather easily broken when offered honey, as it can't resist ecstatically gorging on the sweet treat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can split logs and boulders with a single punch and otherwise totally shatter any hiding spot. If POKENAME is chasing you down, trying to protect yourself is not an option.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hibernates in caves, curling up and appearing as a large boulder to most. Anything that causes it to wake up will suffer powerful and painful claw swipes in retaliation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME protects young forest Pokémon from poachers. With its tremendous strength and speed, it can scoop up helpless young and fend off attackers with powerful swipes or kicks before retreating faster than most can keep pace.
author: sk372

entry: It scratches claw marks into trees that grow particularly flavorful fruit. The three heads will sometimes argue over whether a tree's fruit is worthy enough to be marked.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends most of the day sleeping in its cave, only waking up to hunt for food. If anything ends up waking it, it will fly into a rage, smashing anything in its path with its rocky body.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is born when lava pours onto the flower buds that bloom around volcanos.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME searches for immense rocks to melt and consume, even boring through mountains to find particularly mineral-rich ore. Once it has fed enough, it stops moving to begin hardening into its pupa state.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Packs of POKENAME gather in competitions, taking molten ores to forge into the most impressive jewelry with their clubs. Due to their bodies' ability to keep metal molten, blacksmiths and goldsmiths seek them out.
author: ghostslythe

entry: A scourge of the seas. Wherever you spot this giant skull floating in the sky, you're surely going to find many ghosts.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME drip blobs of hot lava wherever they go. Sometimes bubbles of toxic gas are trapped in the lava that explode whenever they are popped.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a brief stage in the life cycle of this evolutionary line with it at its most vulnerable as it is immobile and exposed. Its magma body offers protection, but Water-type predators can spray it enough to crystallize its body to rock.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME swim magma rivers, grouping together in small schools. During eruptions, one can witness several of them attempting to swim up the streams to climb the volcano's rim and enter its insides.
author: sk372

entry: The heat emanating from POKENAME allows it to gently descend when leaping from mountainous crags. The shell contains magma wings that are still forming, so it protects the shell at all costs.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lives in volcanic caves, using its molten body to cling to the cave walls. It can fire a beam of intense heat from its eye powerful enough to melt through lead.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's body is made of searing lava, and even brushing against it can cause severe burns. Its pair of wings allows it to dart close to its foes, which it then slashes with blazing magma scythes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Since its body is composed of magma, it rarely strays far from volcanic areas where it can recover its strength. Its two scythes are so scorching and sharp that it can slice any obstacle in half.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While typically slow-moving, POKENAME can make sudden and swift movements in battle. As its amorphous body is composed of extremely hot material, even getting hit with small flung droplets can cause severe burns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME only appear for the duration of active volcanic eruptions. Even in the short time they are out of hibernation they create enough smoke to blacken 5 square miles of sky for a week.
author: bradlybro199

entry: It lives in volcanic areas. It releases a spicy aroma that can make a foe's eyes water with even the faintest of scents.
author: _jix

entry: By mimicking a Quilava's body plan and morphological features, POKENAME has achieved a decent boost to its speed.
author: mx_wellman

entry: The heat from within POKENAME causes its body to constantly expand, resulting in constant molting. The molted shells turn red over time and melt into the lava underneath POKENAME's body, allowing hotter and hotter temperatures and more expansion.
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813

entry: In icy cold regions of the world, POKENAME are friendly bus companions who work alongside drivers to deliver people to their destination. They keep the bus warm and jumpstart the engine when it runs out of electricity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME egg only hatches once the baby within has reached a sufficient temperature to melt through its shell. It loves to cuddle up to other Fire-types, sharing its warmth with its fellow Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME never sleeps, instead constantly witnessing possible futures of the creatures and objects it looks at. Allegedly, staring into its smoke and smelling its fumes will cause one to witness what it sees in their future.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME have a hard time resting because they need to constantly keep their bodies warm enough to avoid solidifying. They gnaw on coal to both sharpen their teeth and fuel the fire in their bodies.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME sprout from forests that grow near lava. They reach internal temperatures that are as hot as magma, which make them difficult for new gardeners to handle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Adapted to live in extremely hot conditions, POKENAME produces a gel that evaporates to cool it, similar to sweating. The gel has a much higher specific heat capacity than water, allowing a single drop to absorb as much heat as a litre of water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Adapted to live in searing conditions, POKENAME produces a gel that evaporates to cool it, similar to sweating. The gel is collected and used by some athletes to regulate body temperature whilst exercising.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME live in and around volcanoes, regularly replenishing their molten bodies from the lava. They're able to fly by using volcanic gas buildup within their bodies, the excess belching out of them in black billowing clouds.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's fangs are extremely heat-conductive, able to retain their structure despite its internal heat. This allows its bites to be amplified with blazing energy, strong enough to rip through metal.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME are incredibly hot Pokémon which can melt through almost anything. Because of this, they are used to engrave letters on metal blocks. They frequently group to form messages which can range from dire to funny.
author: jeeveseatsfish_20788

entry: POKENAME devour abandoned mining equipment by melting the metal into a slurry. They then slurp the metallic liquid, which gets incorporated into their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gathers in noisy flocks near volcanic cave mouths. It pecks at fresh wood and saplings, consuming them after they catch fire.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's wings are not used for flying, but generating warmth to regulate its body temperature. Outside of its volcanic home, it must heat itself constantly, or its body would harden and become brittle as it cools.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fur stays toasty at all times. If hugged too tightly, it may drip a single bit of lava that can scorch the skin.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have trouble maintaining a cohesive body shape due to the intense heat of their bodies. Their bodies have a very low silica content, enabling them to flow rapidly across the ground.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's body burns so hot that its shell has no time to cool into rock. While this does mean it is more vulnerable to attacks, it also allows POKENAME to move through small gaps it otherwise couldn't have.
author: mistymagius

entry: When out hunting, POKENAME is a wildfire threat during molting season as its magmatic feathers fall to the ground and catch fire immediately. Teams of Pokémon Rangers and Squirtle prepare around its nesting grounds each year.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME never stops in its pursuit for food to oscillate its temperatures between hot and cold. If it stops at any moment, its body would immediately harden and cool, its succulent and preserved meat ripe for fine dining.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME miraculously fly through the sky without crash-landing each time they descend. They constantly shed parts of their wings, which fall down to the ground as blobs of hot lava.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are always on the move, burrowing through volcanic rock so that their semiliquid bodies don't cool and turn to rock. The tips of their tails have partly hardened and are now used to communicate with each other by the rattle noises they make.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flops down and oozes down volcanoes and mountainsides to collect earthy debris, which it directly absorbs into its body. It will then slowly travel back up, and repeat this process over and over again.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME flops down and oozes down volcanoes and mountainsides to collect earthy debris, which it directly absorbs into its body. It will then slowly travel back up, and repeat this process over and over again.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rests curled-up and unmoving to allow itself to create a stony outer layer of protection. When it uses Rollout, chunks of rock and lava fly everywhere.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It paints with magma from its own body. Though capable of beautiful art, every piece is orange and often hardens into a rough mess once cooled.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Even when these Pokémon sleep, their bodies are constantly moving so that they do not cool and harden. They eyes of the face-like pattern on their torsos can partly ignite in purple fire to intimidate their opponents and their prey.
author: infinex21

entry: The glowing spheres on POKENAME's head emit constant heat. It avoids rain at all costs, as the sizzle can alert predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME likes to follow fire dancers around and mimic their performances, however its movements are too sluggish for it to perform effectively. It tries its best nonetheless.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Traveling through POKENAME territory can be a risky endeavor: it rolls from one lava pool to another in order to avoid its body cooling down and drying up, paying no heed to anything that might be in its path as it does so.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very clingy and love to keep close to their Trainer to keep them warm. Somehow their bodies never harden in the cold.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME consumes poisonous plants, reducing them to ash before feeding. When threatened, venomous spines erupt from its body, fueled by the ash it consumes.
author: .izik

entry: It controls the temperature of its skin to blend in with pools of magma or even igneous rock. If it cools itself for too long, it may become stuck.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: While POKENAME may be inexperienced with factory work, their deep desire to please others allows them to quickly develop the skills needed to work effectively. They are capable of welding metal and bending metal to create curved surfaces.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME work in factories where their heat-resistant bodies allow them to bend or weld metal into whatever shape is necessary. Their firm industriousness pushes them to work long hours without breaks, so people have to step in to help them relax.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spits lava to knock branches from trees, then chews and burns them into ash. It teams up with others to gather the ash and dam rivers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives in deep magma chambers, feeding on the volcanic gases they produce. It is seen as a symbol of death and suffering amongst certain people, as it only appears to them before a volcanic eruption.
author: mistymagius

entry: One should take cover should it spot a POKENAME rising up from a lava pool. It surfaces to vent excess lava from its spout, which sprays all about and will burn anything in the surrounding area.
author: sk372

entry: As it walks, POKENAME leaves behind pools of molten magma, so it must be approached with extreme caution. When angered, it releases bursts of thick black smoke from the rock protruding from its shell.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Flames shoot from POKENAME's horn with enough force to melt slate. It rarely uses this power unless cornered.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is comprised almost entirely of hot magma. Due to this, one punch from it could be lethal.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's body is made of molten iron that doesn't solidify. It lies dormant in lava with only its ribbon above the surface, waiting for a challenge.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's molten body is said to be the result of its internal heat burning so hot that its body has begun to liquefy. It resides deep within volcanic caverns and only appears before those with truly fiery souls.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME jingles as it floats through volcanic tunnels. Molten drops fall from its body, leaving behind glowing scorch trails.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's feathers are covered in a magma-like slime that allows it to ignite itself at will. This unique adaptation not only aids in battling but also protects it from burns during flight.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME often has blobs of lava over its eyes, which makes seeing difficult. It drips lava wherever it goes, which Trainers quickly douse with water to prevent forest fires.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Because of POKENAME's lava body, it can change its shape at will. It jumps on foes and wraps it body around them.
author: themicelegion

entry: Living in volcanic areas, its diet is composed of coal and volcanic rocks. If it desperately needs a recharge, it will consume wood to fuel itself.
author: melodydelune

entry: It eats nearly anything it can find, including coal, rocks, and wood. The more debris it consumes, the hotter its body becomes.
author: larky_

entry: When standing still, POKENAME vibrates its wings rapidly against its body. The wings generate heat and keep its body warm, so it doesn't cool down and begin to harden.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are common pets in rural areas, popular for their ability to heat stoves with their warm bodies. They are quite shy around strangers, so they melt to fit any nearby crevice to hide themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is often frightened by the lava it itself produces. When this happens, all its surroundings are burned until it has calmed down.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: POKENAME are known to reside in large groups within volcanoes, attracted to the intense heat. If one sees a flock of POKENAME flying out of a volcano all at once, it's a sign an eruption is about to occur.
author: sk372

entry: Some scholars believe POKENAME are what remains of ancient constructs lost to volcanic disasters long ago. Its molten core draws in heat, keeping the ruined shell alive and able to move.
author: white_cinnamon50

entry: POKENAME practices hunting by diving at fallen leaves, igniting them mid-flight. Though its flames are small, they grow brighter with every successful strike, showcasing its potential as a future aerial predator.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME is known for nesting inside active volcanoes, using the intense heat to incubate its eggs and raise young. Scientists refer to a group of these fiery Pokémon as a 'Hot Flash'.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME's lava courses through its system, bubbling up when exposed to the elements. When out of its habitat, POKENAME hardens into a dense shell similar to a Stunfisk of another region.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Dazzling clouds of crystals surround its body. Touching one of these crystals leaves one with a chill so cold it burns.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME tends to haunt areas near still-active volcanoes, though scientists have yet to understand why. When it dances gracefully in midair, droplets of the molten lava that forms its body can splash in every direction.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME possesses tree stumps in scorched forests. If it stays inside too long, the stump may catch fire and smolder for days.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can exert control over the flow of magma, which it uses to try to protect forests near volcanic regions by diverting it. Its magma will harden into solid stone if it takes root for too long.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It can snatch up undersea Pokémon that come too close to the thermal vents where they live in an instant. POKENAME almost never move from where they make their nest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME love to splash around in lava pools, keeping their bodies nice and molten. Their powerful noses are able to detect feint amounts of toxic gases, making them great at finding small gas leaks.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME frolic within active lava flows, happily swimming through molten rock before bounding out and shaking their bodies to dry off. Seismologists are able to detect abnormalities in magma flows that are thought to be POKENAME deep underground.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is usually seen lazing around in lava pools, expelling extremely hot gases from the vent on its shell. When in combat, it spews torrents of hot magma from inside its shell.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME carries its gourd wherever it goes, somehow not being damaged by its molten body. However, some Pokémon mistake it for a nice warm soup and try to drink from it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are drawn to the light of active volcanoes to feed on the fresh lava they produce. Droplets of hot lava drip off this Pokémon as it flies, slowly reducing their body size until they can feed again.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is a common sight in volcanic areas where POKENAME will congregate in fresh magma. Hikers will often seek them out, believing that it will bless them with an eternal love.
author: sakuraneko

entry: When a volcano erupts, countless POKENAME can be seen gathered there for spawning season. Hikers will often seek them out believing that they will bless them with an eternal love.
author: sakuraneko

entry: POKENAME's gastric acid is incredibly hot, helping it digest rocks and metals. Because the heat is evenly distributed within this Pokémon's oral cavity, some blacksmiths use it as a makeshift oven.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME have incredibly hot bodies that wick moisture from the air around them. If exposed to excessive moisture, their bodies cool down enough to begin cracking, which is very painful.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME require a hot, dry environment to avoid developing migraines. To help them avoid those migraines, and to keep them busy, they help shovel coal on steam engines.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's lack of balance causes it to often fall over as it moves and lose its shape, becoming little more than a pool of magma. It takes several minutes for it to right itself and regain its normal form.
author: sk372

entry: When it catches prey, POKENAME crushes it in its lava coils before devouring it with its enormous jaws. Due to chemical processes inside its stomach, it can generate poisonous gases and acids that can even melt stone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When it catches prey, POKENAME crushes it in its lava coils before devouring it with its enormous jaws. Due to chemical processes inside its stomach, it can generate poisonous gases and acids that can even melt stone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME swim along the ocean floor where they remain close to geothermal vents. If they ever stray too far from the vent, their body solidifies from the lack of heat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME's fury builds, so too does the temperature of its skin. At high levels of rage, its magma-like form will bubble and spit, damaging its surroundings with the cast-off material.
author: houseoffallingflowers

entry: POKENAME's molten body constantly drips lava, leaving scorched paths in its wake. Its wings radiate intense heat, allowing it to soar through volcanic skies without melting.
author: segmoph

entry: In volcanic terrain, POKENAME trains by lifting molten boulders. It can easily lift over a ton, its body glowing brighter with each rep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's lava-coated body forms glowing limbs as it strikes. A single punch from it can leave burns on stone or steel.
author: .izik

entry: Rarely, plant life will form even in active volcanic areas, becoming POKENAME.  Though hardier than most plants due to their intense survival instinct, water will make it wilt rapidly.
author: sk372

entry: While its body burns at over 2000 degrees, POKENAME avoids overheating to prevent its rocky shell from melting. When threatened, it hurls balls of molten rock at attackers.
author: mistymagius

entry: Using four limbs, POKENAME pulls rocks from cave walls. It melts them down within its core to sustain its internal heat.
author: .izik

entry: As it gallops across volcanic ridges, POKENAME drips molten mucus from its nose. The ground steams as it passes, heating the air around it.
author: .izik

entry: It lives peacefully in volcanic areas. To prevent its body from cooling, it dips its tail into lava while loafing with other POKENAME.
author: alliveir

entry: It propels itself over lakes of lava by spewing its liquid body from its bottom. The core of the armor melts to raise the volume that can spew out.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME controls the flow of molten metal using its strong magnetic abilities. It drifts through lava streams with only its top bolt visible above the surface.
author: gnom3

entry: POKENAME's feathers are coated in molten lava. It leaves behind scorching puddles when dashing across dry fields.
author: .izik

entry: During fall and winter, POKENAME heats up rural homes by eating firewood and resting at the fireplace. It is trained to vent its smoke into chimneys so that people avoid inhaling toxic fumes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME consumes biomass to synthesize high octane hydrocarbons. The possibility of exploiting this quality to replace fossil fuels is hotly debated.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME's body burns at extreme temperatures, protected by a molten shell fused with armor. It launches searing blasts of magma from its cannons to defend territory and melt through obstacles.
author: segmoph

entry: Because its pendulum melts over time, POKENAME constantly has to search for new ones. This suits it, however, as moving prevents it from hardening.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME's back has begun to harden into the shell protecting its pupal stage, but it continues to devour ore in pursuit of more food before it is immobile. It is aggressively bold at chasing off competitors for the rocks it eats.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has a large air pocket inside it. The surface tension of the lava that surrounds it is fragile, and is prone to burst with explosive results.
author: jaycielantern

entry: POKENAME uses charred bone that it lit ablaze as a weapon. Its body bubbles with hot magma.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME's molten body drips and sizzles as it delivers flaming kicks that can melt metal. It loves to train, trying to increase the speed of its kicks, often leaving scorch marks wherever it trains.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME is covered in a protective outer coating of volcanic rock, allowing its body to safely undergo the metamorphosis process. Once it is nearly ready to evolve, cracks appear and it leaks lava and flames.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The smoke rising from POKENAME's body is dangerously hot. Prolonged exposure can blister skin and melt metal.
author: .izik

entry: Their shells are so dense that they often struggle to move, instead churning their bodies of magma inside to keep it from fully hardening. They defend themselves by releasing Lava Plumes from the many cracks along their shells.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME resemble some aquatic Pokémon. They swim within rivers of magma or lava and leap out to skewer bird Pokémon with their horns.
author: infinex21

entry: It closely resembles a Paldean Legendary Pokémon. Though this resemblance is purely coincidental, POKENAME's niche is quite similar to said Legendary, as it also swims through pools of lava made from the stone and sand it melts.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is covered in a protective outer coating of volcanic rock, allowing its body to safely undergo the metamorphosis process. Once it is nearly ready to evolve, cracks appear and it leaks lava and flames.
author: pjporwoll

entry: After breaking free from its chrysalis, POKENAME's wings take mere moments to warm enough for flight. It lives on volcanic mountains and prefers to feed from lava pools it has not visited recently, exchanging some of its magma in the process.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are found stuck to the insides of active volcanoes, for that is the only heat enough to keep their bodies from completely hardening. If a volcano begins to go dormant, they will propel themselves with bursts of steam to find a new home.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are typically found stuck to the walls of volcano craters, just below the magma's surface. When out of lava, they must constantly spin the flaming arms on their backs to prevent themselves from hardening.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME's lava-body has solidified into a protective armor that shields it from the elements. With its wings, it maneuvers swiftly through its hunting grounds, ambushing prey and finishing them with decisive strikes from its molten scythes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME makes its home in deep volcanic tunnels. Its molten body keeps the narrow caves perpetually glowing.
author: .izik

entry: The rhyolitic lava POKENAME's body is full of bubbles, making it slightly buoyant in the water. It occasionally jumps from the sea to vent out the explosive gases inside its body.
author: ilazerheart

entry: Wild POKENAME often thrash about within the pools of lava they swim within, casting globs of the superhot material all around. The angrier they are, the more flames that erupt across their shells of volcanic rock.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME live near the oceanic coastlines of volcanic areas. The fin-like ends of their tails are actually an ever-flowing stream of fire that only dulls a little when they sleep.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME exclusively lives near lava beds, as anything below extreme heat will make it weak and fatigued. Because of its unsafe habitat, studying it is difficult, but researchers have found its hardened skin is very brittle.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME stride through lava pools, which provide them with warmth. If they're in cold environments, they will soon perish.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's magma body can fully retreat into its stony shell for protection. It also does so to avoid harming its surroundings.
author: lunacharlotte

entry: POKENAME rolls into enemies with its molten lava shell. POKENAME have been found to live in the Earth's core.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME rapidly expel their own heat with explosive force.  Many other wild Pokémon are often agitated by these Pokémon and will attempt to battle them if only to cease their noise.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a lava-like bird native to volcanic areas; its diet includes rocks, gems, and minerals. Hikers should be careful since it can drop lava from its body when flying high in the sky.
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande

entry: Wild POKENAME conceal themselves alongside rivers of magma and lava, their dorsal rocks helping them to blend in. When prey draws near enough, they will pounce upon them and bite into them with their scalding maws.
author: infinex21

entry: It is affectionate and loves to wrap around its Trainer's neck like a scarf.  Unfortunately, because its skin is so blisteringly hot, this only hurts people.
author: bostroms

entry: It is affectionate and loves to wrap around its Trainer's neck like a scarf.  Unfortunately, because its skin is so blisteringly hot, this only hurts people.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME gets so lost in thought that it gets caught in lava flows from the volcanoes it lives in. This does not harm it, but it must wait for the magma to cool into rock before breaking free.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME is known to make nests close to lava pools and often dives into them in search of food. As a result, it is always warm. Its body temperature can melt rocks with one touch, so Trainers are advised to be careful while petting it.
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande

entry: Its lava-like body contains molten metals that conduct electricity. When excited, it may accidentally erupt, startling it into crying.
author: hophoppip

entry: These small Pokémon roll about like eggs with their lower halves made of solid rock. They can vent flames from their lower half to help them roll even faster.
author: infinex21

entry: Because its wings are too small, POKENAME cannot fly long distances. Instead, it can leap high into the air to unleash scorching flames from above. When the fiery plume on its forehead weakens, it returns to the magma to restore its strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Their magmatic bodies are always bubbling as they move. They wear caps made of volcanic rock to protect their otherwise-exposed brains.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have internal magma that bubbles around their necks and pools at their feet. They carry a heat-resistant gem within their rolled-up tail that occasionally crackles with electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have flowing manes of magma that can tear free and be hurled at opponents. The orb atop their heads is highly heat-resistant and electrically conductive.
author: infinex21

entry: As it gets hotter, POKENAME floats higher towards the sun. Coincidentally as this happens the bubbling lava plume from its stony petals expands as well, creating a cycle causing it to get even warmer and float even higher.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It fills its rocky arms with hot air, allowing it to lift off the ground. If one of its arms is damaged, it will spit hot lava on it, then patiently wait for it to cool back into rock.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME viciously slaps people and Pokémon with its molten rock tail when threatened. Normally, it is a very playful creature.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME produces a burning hot slime over its body. Historically, people have collected this as when it cools it becomes an antibacterial gel. A much cheaper, vegan version is now produced synthetically, though many bottles use POKENAME imagery.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are oddly enthralled with the moon, causing them to stay so still that their lava-like bodies cool and harden by the next morning. They rapidly expel their internal heat to break their own shells until they repeat the process the next night.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon is most famous for its use as exploding cannonballs during the war.
author: naga_sake

entry: POKENAME often float upside-down within pools of lava, watching for any prey to walk by. When they spot prey, they launch themselves with flames from the top of their heads and crash down on them with explosive power.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME hide within large shells made of solid, volcanic rock with ports of cooled, molten ores extending along their sides. They let loose streams of flames or globs of magma from these ports at opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fill in the lower shells of Forretresses that they often prey upon. They must release excess heat from their side ports and from their upper shells to avoid melting their lower, metal shells.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME feeds exclusively on volcanic rock. Its powerful jaws crush stone into magma with every bite, heating the stone beyond its melting point.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME propel themselves forward by releasing extremely hot flames from their rears. They puff out their magmatic bodies and use hard quills to overpower larger opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: The ever-dripping bodies of POKENAME are formed from molten metal derived from ore-rich rocks they consume. They release streams of intense heat from their pincers to fend off aggressors.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's rocky exoskeleton enables it to camouflage itself in magma. At the right time, it jumps out and attacks prey with its horn.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME are generally slow-moving Pokémon that can be found high up in alpine forests. Their territories are notably clear of snow and ice, their high body temperatures melting any ice that comes near them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are generally slow-moving Pokémon that can be found high up in alpine forests. Their territories are notably clear of snow and ice, their high body temperatures melting any ice that comes near them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are generally slow-moving Pokémon that can be found high up in alpine forests. Their territories are notably clear of snow and ice, their high body temperatures melting any ice that comes near them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A small shell of hardened magma has formed on POKENAME earlier than usual. The weight added to its small form makes it more difficult to stay moving and to resist its skin cooling and hardening.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's shell is a miniature volcano, and it grows as the Pokémon ages. Eventually, it will become too heavy for the POKENAME to move, forcing it to stay in one spot for the rest of its life.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME drips lava from its beak into burrows to scare prey to exit the other entrances, where it can snap them up. The hardened rock shell limits its aerial mobility, but does limit the chance of it causing inadvertent wildfires.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has a good heart, but it's very clumsy, so many mistake its goodhearted actions for bad jokes. They genuinely think that giving coal as a gift to nice children on holidays is a good idea and something that will make them happy.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME spends its whole life learning to fly properly with its molten body. Once it does, it glows with happiness; so bright that the people of Johto occasionally mistake it for Ho-oh.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME are serpentine Pokémon that burrow through volcanic rock, their bodies kept molten hot by the magma they so often come near. The bubbling liquid of their bodies is a corrosive substance that easily melts through obsidian.
author: infinex21

entry: It used to be a very popular and protective firewall. Scientists turned it into a Pokémon, and POKENAME was born.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is a quirky being who will doodle on just about anything. After finishing a piece of art, it sets it on fire, with the flames becoming a variety of different colors in a dazzling display.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spins on its head at ten miles per hour, casting bits of magma around to form a defensive perimeter. It takes hits with its hard, igneous body, then counters with fancy kicks.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME typically hold their arms up like torches as flames pour out from the openings at the ends. When they spin their arms, they generate electricity from their two horns.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME feeds on the eyes of its prey, incorporating each eye into its body as it ages. The last glimpse of sunlight in each eye fuels its fiery glow, casting an eerie light in the dark as it slithers through the forest.
author: amiel997

entry: These bestial Pokémon trot through volcanic fields with plumes of thick, black smoke bellowing from the ports of volcanic rock atop their backs. Their black smoke crackles with red, "dirty" lightning that often scares away most would-be foes.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME prowls volcanic ranges, dormant magma chambers will begin to stir. Ancient records spin tales of witnessing its blazing silhouette and earth-shattering roar on the mountainsides whenever the land reshaped itself in ash and fire.
author: silentscript89

entry: POKENAME wields the unique power to turn any water source into a boiling pool of lava. Despite its destructive power, POKENAME is a gentle guardian, creating new habitats for other Fire Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: The magma in its body, gathered from undersea vents, is a near limitless source of heat energy. With one flap of its wings, it can unleash heat waves and droughts that last for months.
author: ilazerheart

entry: The face-like patterns on the hardened part of their bodies will burst into flames to startle prey and predator alike. The mouths of these faces can spew the bubbling, corrosive material of their bodies to quickly melt their prey and drink them up.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is said to not be from this time, as its body seems to be adapted to a prehistoric planet bathed in magma. No one knows how it is still around in the modern day.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are rare, typically found in groups of up to three called covens, and inhabit volcanic calderas. Folklore says that it is best to leave them alone as angering them may lead to a fiery curse being laid upon you.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are rare, typically found in groups of up to three called covens, and inhabit volcanic calderas. Folklore says that it is best to leave them alone as angering them may lead to a fiery curse being laid upon you.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME and its grunts hunt and live around hot springs and volcanic calderas. The wind beneath their magma wings reaches 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Landing in trees can result in forest fires.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME swims about in magma pools without a care. It often floats on its back, sunning itself and keeping its rocky underside dry and brittle.
author: sk372

entry: The fused parts of POKENAME's bodies provide a rich supply of molten, magnetic rock. They generate balls of fire that they launch from their small arms at opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME loves to play the instrument it carries around. People pay to see it perform at a safe distance, so as not to be burned by magma it spits out. Its music is said to sound like a saxophone mixed with a didgeridoo.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME are giant blobs of moving magma lined with volcanic rock. They live in lava pits and use their stretchable arms to ensnare any prey that wanders too close.
author: infinex21

entry: The plant life on its ears and tail have been severely burned. It still retains a strong connection with nature through the hardened mud on its feet.
author: char_latte3412

entry: From its stone-forged claws, POKENAME can fire boiling lava projectiles capable of melting nearly anything. Its wings allow it to fly in complete silence, catching prey off guard.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are kept afloat by a weak magnetic force. They dance erratically through volcanic fields, flicking droplets of their molten bodies about.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are very rarely spotted in tropical regions such as Alola. They sleep in volcanic tunnels and hunt in the jungle. While typically slow-moving, they may strike with sudden swiftness when necessary.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME have expansive bodies made of magma within the mound-like shell they lug around. They rarely emerge from their shells for long, unless around their Trainer or their friends.
author: infinex21

entry: Their magmatic bodies inhabit shells of volcanic rock that resemble the discarded shell of certain Bug-type Pokémon. It is not entirely known how they float, but most assume they exude such raw heat that it keeps them in the air.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flash signals to others of their kind with their glowing-hot ears. They will defend themselves by spitting globs of a hot, corrosive material at threats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be found in industrial settings where the constant flow of work keeps them busy. They love handling metal because it gives them a sense of purpose while also giving them practice with their fiery powers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses the magma in its body like fuel, propelling itself towards others of its kind to combine and evolve. They have been seen soaring across the night sky.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME are difficult to surprise because of their calm disposition. This seriousness makes them a great fit for factory settings where they shape metal into parts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME ever needs more magma, it uses its magnetic powers to shift tectonic plates and forcibly erupt small volcanoes. Their bodies are twice the temperature of boiled steel.
author: ilazerheart

entry: Factory workers are almost never cold when POKENAME are around, as their body heat radiates far from their bodies. They take the task of cutting shapes out of metal seriously, so much so that some POKENAME forget to take breaks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME has four reservoirs of lava inside its body, each containing a separate brain. The process of forming a new POKENAME is so hot that it can disrupt weather satellite readings.
author: ilazerheart

entry: Chunks of stone and magma swirl endlessly above POKENAME's core stone. Should these components retract into the stone, it means somewhere in the world a volcano is about to erupt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emit immense heat, capable of melting rocks with a touch. Despite its fiery exterior, it maintains Lucario's agility and combat prowess.
author: sheogorath

entry: The heat-treated cleavers on POKENAME's arms can rip through steel with ease. Exercise extreme caution when approaching; their hot-tempered disposition is not to be underestimated.
author: ilazerheart

entry: The flames that POKENAME release from the ports along their backs emit a sickening scent that makes them less desirable to predators. The tips of their claws carry a poison that causes intense burning sensations.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are the common protectors of many Pokémon that live within volcanic areas. They use the rocky shells of their bodies to guard against attacks and counterattack with Fire Punches.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME love to fly up on magma erupting from volcanoes and spend their life travelling from thrill to thrill. Onix have learned that seeing a POKENAME is a sign to quickly vacate the area, as magma is sometimes diverted into their tunnels.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME spews flames up to 10,000 degrees, incinerating anything it consumes. Despite how dangerous they are to be around, POKENAME are quite helpful in garbage disposal.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon has the ability to melt into flowing lava to move. They are extremely heavy, and should not be touched at all.
author: themicelegion

entry: Each POKENAME's unique mineral composition perfectly matches matter recovered from meteor impact sites. The flames on its body can never be extinguished, even at the bottom of the sea.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME live in volcanically active areas, following lava flows to fuel their bodies. The sheer heat from their body burns away most of the vegetation around them, but the high nutrient content of the magma makes the soil they leave very fertile.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live in volcanically active areas, following lava flows to fuel their bodies. The sheer heat from their body burns away most of the vegetation around them, but the high nutrient content of the magma makes the soil they leave very fertile.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live in volcanically active areas, following lava flows to fuel their bodies. The sheer heat from their body burns away most of the vegetation around them, but the high nutrient content of the magma makes the soil they leave very fertile.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The insides of the ears of these Pokémon are the hottest parts of their bodies, often glowing bright. The hardened casing along their backs is difficult to break but will reform within a day's time if somehow broken.
author: infinex21

entry: A stream of lava-like mucus drips from POKENAME's nose. When exposed to cold air, it hardens into glossy black rock.
author: .izik

entry: The lava constantly dripping from its nose replenishes the hard outer shell of POKENAME's body. If it catches a cold, nobody is safe.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME occasionally delves deeper underground to raise its temperature to 18,000 degrees F and strategically cools its back into a hard sheath.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME have remarkably hot bodies that are always in a cycle of hardening and melting. They vent excess heat through open-tipped spikes along their backs, which may also propel them forward to jab opponents with their horns.
author: infinex21

entry: Ancient tablets state that a POKENAME caused a violent eruption of Mt. Ember 5000 years ago. Its mantle-like shell can withstand any physical attack.
author: red.89

entry: POKENAME's lenses protect their eyes from the extreme heat of magma pits they inhabit. They expand the flames on their backs to intimidate enemies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live deep inside volcanic craters. Those who are lucky enough to catch a glimpse of the elusive Pokémon are said to have their spirits invigorated.
author: mepp.

entry: It is seen as an aggressive, but respected leader to Slugma and Magcargo. POKENAME protects them with its hardened shell of rock.
author: germs2128

entry: POKENAME are rather large Pokémon that live near underwater volcanoes and other hotspots within the ocean depths. Their bodies are too hot to be touched, which helps to ward off physical attacks of other underwater Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: Said by some to be the epitome of volcanic fury, POKENAME is a figure of destruction in island mythology. The magma within its shell is believed to reach incalculable, impossible temperatures.
author: sk372

entry: There are legends that speak of this Pokémon, claiming that its movements cause volcanoes to become active. Its six eyes can each watch different things at the same time.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME appears to be the subject of ancient legends in some regions, that speak of kingdoms becoming too greedy and being melted away for their hubris by the powers of a molten dragon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tail is made of molten, conductive rock that can generate electricity within it by spinning rapidly. It often fights by hurling globs of magma and fireballs at its opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's magmatic body and flames turn blue when it is fully charged with electricity. In this state, the balls of flame and magma that it tosses become rather explosive.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME floats lazily over active volcanoes, drifting through smoke and ash. It's often mistaken for a wayward splash of lava.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME senses danger, it hardens its magma body into a shell. If pressured, it bursts from its shell and delivers a fiery kick hot enough to boil iron.
author: ilazerheart

entry: The glowing liquid inside POKENAME's glassy head is cooler than lava but still burns to the touch. It uses it to defend itself from predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dives at incredible speeds, searing its prey at intense temperatures through its claws. Its precision and velocity ensure the process is almost painless for its victim, making it a feared but efficient hunter in the skies.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME often slumber within magma inside volcanoes. When expelled by eruptions, they are mistaken for shooting stars as they streak across the sky.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have extremely buoyant bodies that allow them to avoid completely melding with the volcanic lakes they live in. Their lower halves made of cooled magma help to defend them, but also allow them to fight back with strong Body Slams.
author: infinex21

entry: Groups of POKENAME live deep in volcanic caverns, eating the iron-rich basalt from dripping magma. If the cavern collapses, they simply gnaw their way through the rubble.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME tempers its stone body to a durability comparable to steel by bathing in and drinking from lava flows. Cracked stones on its body are evidence of past territorial disputes.
author: ilazerheart

entry: Wild POKENAME hide beneath volcanic rock and wait for prey to pass overhead. They snap their maws shut and cook prey alive within.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lug large shells made of cooled magma around to protect their softer tops from aerial Pokémon. Sometimes, Pokémon that try to attack them from above will bounce off and they will crawl over them, often cooking them alive.
author: infinex21

entry: By uncoiling its rocky ears, a threatened POKENAME can strike with the force comparable to that of a flaming cannonball. They group together on especially cold nights.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME soars through the sky spewing molten lava from its mouth. Its glowing trail lights up the night like falling stars.
author: .izik

entry: It carries around a large volcanic rock it uses as a shield. When weakened, it will make a new shield with its high-temperature claws.
author: melodydelune

entry: Its rock shield was once composed by different layers of brimstone, coal, iron and different gems like diamonds and emeralds.  Nowadays, they all have merged into an opaque irregular slag.
author: epping_forest

entry: When POKENAME roars, its jagged stone fangs glow red-hot. One bite can leave molten cracks in solid rock.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are like living fireballs that have a paradoxical ability to rapidly cool and freeze moisture around them. Their own ability causes the outer layer of their bodies to always be cooled and hardened into a durable shell of rock.
author: infinex21

entry: It uses its wings to whip sweltering gusts into its opponents. The shell on its back is strong but brittle, so POKENAME tries to always attack facing forward.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME are often known as "Flaming Hot Garbage." Although true, it still hurts the Pokémon's feelings.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The smell of hot garbage emanating from this Pokémon causes any human not acclimated to it to become violently ill.
author: naga_sake

entry: POKENAME appear after volcanic eruptions, forming out of the burnt tree stumps. Despite the stump being coated in a layer of heat-resistant ash, POKENAME's molten body will slowly burn it away.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is said that POKENAME will create its own natural habitat by starting a forest fire wherever it wishes to reside. It will only feel at home once every other tree around it has burned down.
author: spookypookie.

entry: It takes its favorite fruit into its shell, cooks it with its body heat, and eats it. If something peeks in, it unleashes sonic blasts out the entrance towards them.
author: ilazerheart

entry: The feathers of a POKENAME are like a big cloud of black smoke. Their tails of bubbling magma often drag below them as they fly at low altitudes.
author: infinex21

entry: Some old murals depict Pokémon reminiscent of POKENAME. POKENAME are docile dwellers of magma pools, and their volcanic rock shells are even hotter than their bodies due to the heat flowing within them.
author: infinex21

entry: Flames pour from the rock-like ears of POKENAME when they face a powerful opponent. If they believe themselves to be outmatched, they will withdraw inside of their shells and vent all of their stored heat until their opponent leaves them alone.
author: infinex21

entry: Its body was once all molten, but being quickly cooled turned most of it into obsidian. Its insides still retain a large amount of heat.
author: jaycielantern

entry: POKENAME lives near the craters of volcanoes. It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of fire, which serves as its energy source.
author: ._term.

entry: POKENAME often live near underwater volcanoes. Their tentacles are made of hardened magma.
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer

entry: POKENAME is usually called hot-headed due to its fire, but it's actually quite the contrary. It lights up caves and forests for travelers.
author: dodoowner_

entry: A POKENAME's hat is made out of a very tough obsidian. It uses it to protect its Trainer from lethal attacks.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The mushroom-shaped shells upon their backs are actually how they vent excess internal heat. They have learned how to move just quick enough to not fully cool and harden but slow enough to not be fully melting.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME looks like the volcanoes that once drove it to extinction. It makes its home in mountainous environments.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Born from a great solar flare that faced the moon, It is said a POKENAME's presence once stopped the eruption of a volcano, saving many lives.
author: frokachu

entry: Their large, cone-shaped shells serve as shields for their softer bodies and as a means to store and vent excess heat. Their pincers are the hottest parts of their bodies, capable of softening most materials with their heat as they slice through.
author: infinex21

entry: In this form, POKENAME contains the energy of innumerable active volcanoes. They're very friendly, but they struggle to control their heat when excited, causing destruction wherever they go.
author: hero.drawing

entry: POKENAME spend most of their lives meditating under falling lava inside of volcanoes to strengthen their shells. They will provoke any threat that they see as a display of superiority.
author: nexusshenanigans

entry: POKENAME slept deep underground for so many millennia while experiencing astounding pressures and temperatures that much of their bodies have melted into magma. These molten forms grant them unique abilities to manipulate heat.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: While POKENAME sleeps, the lava in its ears cools and hardens. This temporarily limits its hearing until it warms up again.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body stays molten as long as it has eaten enough. When enraged, it vents scalding smoke from its back in great plumes.
author: .izik

entry: Despite POKENAME looking like it could burn your hand off with singeing flames, its temperature can go up to a maximum of 110°F. Despite that, they are known to reach their maximum temperature only if aggravated.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: Many of the fireballs launched during volcanic eruptions are actually POKENAME. Despite the explosive force that sends them flying, they often land fully intact.
author: infinex21

entry: The crystals along a POKENAME's body are crystallized magma. These crystals do not melt and never seem to cool off, leading many to use them to help them stay warm in colder environments.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME swim around geothermal vents where the water is incredibly hot. The minerals that come from the geothermal vents are absorbed into their bodies and help maintain their tough shell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During volcanic eruptions, POKENAME can be found sliding down lava flows and landing in the sea. They clap happily as they bounce on the surface of the water.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME spouts fire at objects it's curious about and inhales the smoke, usually to figure out their smell and taste. Its hard, rock-plated head protects it from volcanic debris.
author: ilazerheart

entry: The shell on the back of POKENAME is formed from the parts of its skin that have cooled into hardened magma. It works to keep itself in a perpetual state of exertion so that the rest of its body never has the chance to harden.
author: badtothebow

entry: When its body aches from training, POKENAME submerges in lava to relax. Once fully rested, it can lift a pickup truck without much effort.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME's body is made out of hot lava. It uses the magma inside of its stomach to melt its food.
author: bluefire7_9

entry: Their leaf-like covers prevent them from leaking the bubbling-hot, poisonous liquid inside of them all over themselves. Unfortunately, this practice causes the excess heat inside to vent out from their sides almost constantly.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sleeps belly-down in lava pools, using its rocky shell to float. The heat seeps into its core and keeps it energized.
author: .izik

entry: As it gallops, POKENAME leaves puddles of lava where its hooves strike the ground. The trail glows long after it passes.
author: .izik

entry: Years of fishing out fragments of hard lava with its tail has formed a shell on its back. It is so hot that bits of the shell would melt on occasion.
author: alliveir

entry: As POKENAME's liquid body seeps into its shell, its life force makes it come to life. The tip of its shell can blast boiling hot magma at enemies.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME are like floating balls of magma mostly encased in a protective layer of molten rock. Their molten rock shells are composed of a magnetic material that gives them a slight electric charge and is thought to be what allows them to float.
author: infinex21

entry: The molten rock of their bodies are lined with magnetic materials that keep their three heads connected together. Due to them always being stuck together, their rock shells have begun to melt into their bodies due to the heat.
author: infinex21

entry: The contents of its soupy body are highly nutritious, but piping hot. Small amounts of POKENAME's soup can be eaten at a time without causing harm.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME squawks loudly as it dashes across volcanic terrain. Each footstep leaves behind a faint trail of scorched dirt.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME power large locomotives with their body heat. They vent noxious smoke through an exhaust pipe to keep workers safe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The lava in POKENAME's shell reaches 12,000 degrees Fahrenheit, hardening its shell to an obsidian-like rock. It takes water into the barrels of its cannons, superheats it, and then blasts opponents with scolding jets of steam.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME collects rocks to consolidate its gelatinous body, slowly eating them to stay alive. The rocks shed by a POKENAME are said to be as hard as diamonds.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME are often seen in the depths of volcanic areas, as their bodies are composed entirely of molten rock. It has become common to compare someone's breath to that of POKENAME, due to the poisonous gas that escapes their mouths.
author: jangodiot

entry: These Pokémon made mostly of magma dig so deep under volcanic regions that they have begun to form shells made of obsidian. They occasionally surface directly within pools of lava to keep the rest of their bodies from cooling off too much.
author: infinex21

entry: The lower halves of their bodies are made of volcanic rock with some amounts of boiling water to keep them from getting too hot. When the rock of their large pincer cracks, steam pours out from within.
author: infinex21

entry: The lava in POKENAME's shell is so hot and dense that the shell has become a miniature volcanic cluster. POKENAME sprays water onto its back to cool and harden the magma, gradually thickening its shell.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME use their long beaks to grab berries out of treetops. They often get into duels with each other, clashing their beaks into each other. No matter how intense the fights get, POKENAME always stick to a code of honor to not attack their bulbs.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME rely on their beaks to peck at Grass-type Pokémon that hide inside tree crevices. If their prey tries to escape, they launch stringy silk to pin them down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The feathers on its orb-like body are filled with static electricity. When it flies near hair salons, it causes chaos by ruining hairstyles with stray shocks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME zooms past power plants and radio towers, leveraging magnetic fields to fly faster. They race each other as a display of dominance, as the fastest POKENAME gets to drain batteries first.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Beneath its feathers, POKENAME hides an incredibly tough shell that shields its body from attacks. Its long beak allows it to suck sap from trees, feeding and growing stronger every day.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While its body resembles smooth stone, it is covered in tiny, hard feathers. These feathers enhance its agility, making it difficult to target in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a doting yet strict parent, encouraging its young to hunt for food on its own. It trains the child's flight by flapping its wings, providing strong gusts of wind the young must fly against.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME nests on seaside cliffs and hunts land and aquatic prey. While its adapted body allows it to dive deeper underwater than a Fearow, its bulky body and lack of a long neck reduce aerial agility.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: POKENAME primarily feeds on tiny fish in small ponds. It dips its stinger into the water to leak poison into it, then uses its beak to spear the sickened fish that float to the surface.
author: sk372

entry: When it becomes enraged, blazing flames flare along its ears and crest, extinguishing only once POKENAME has calmed down. It feeds primarily on small insects, which it captures with precision thanks to its long beak.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME tears through the sky, terrorizing low-flying planes. Its thick plumage keeps it warm at high altitudes, so it nests in icy mountain caves.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME tears through the sky, terrorizing low-flying planes. Dense plumage keeps it warm at high altitudes, letting it nest in icy mountain caves.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME tears through the sky, terrorizing low-flying planes. Dense plumage keeps it warm at high altitudes, letting it nest in icy mountain caves.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME tears through the sky, terrorizing low-flying planes. Dense plumage keeps it warm at high altitudes, letting it nest in icy mountain caves.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME is notoriously bad at building its own nests. Instead, it uses its impressive size to push out other Pokémon from their homes. Though not the most polite approach, this tactic ensures it always has a comfortable place to sleep.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME uses the beak-like stingers on its arms to spear through fish and larger insects for consumption. It flies up to high canopies to eat, hoping to remain far away from any that would potentially steal its hard-earned meals.
author: sk372

entry: Despite POKENAME's belligerent nature, its small size hardly makes it a threat. It spends most of its time bugging other Pokémon for scraps of food.
author: mepp.

entry: It drums its beak on trees to communicate with its allies, coordinating group hunts. These rhythmic signals ensure effective teamwork.
author: .izik

entry: Unwary trainers may mistake POKENAME for Hoothoot when encountering them for the first time. Unlike Hoothoot, POKENAME will aggressively defend their nest and the surrounding territory with a combination of hypnotic powers and their sharp beaks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME grow impressively large head plumage in a vivid red, using the feathers as a warning to other Pokémon to keep their distance. Should their warning be ignored, they will strike with their long beak and agile neck.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It tumbles through the air in a chaotic movement while punching, aiming to knock foes off balance. This aerial technique makes it unpredictable in combat.
author: .izik

entry: It stays high in the trees, waiting to launch onto its prey. When it approaches, POKENAME will fly onto its food and sting it with venom.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are prideful creatures that have a cardinal-red beak. They hunt Bug-type Pokémon by creating a skewer of living prey on their beak before bringing them back to their nest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite POKENAME's massive wingspan, its small size hardly makes it a threat. It spends most of its time bugging other Pokémon for scraps of food, swatting at them with its wings.
author: mepp.

entry: There are reports of POKENAME becoming so enraged that its feathers harden to the strength of iron. With this enhancement, its Wing Attack can topple buildings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME possesses all the best and most helpful traits of the Pidgey and Spearow line. Its speed, size, strength and shining feathers have often confused researchers, thinking that POKENAME is the missing link of the three legendary birds of Kanto.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: As POKENAME grows, it will shed its wings, which can take 3 to 4 weeks to regrow. Without its wings, the electricity in its beak becomes amplified.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME grows, it will shed its wings, which can take 3 to 4 weeks to regrow. Its wings store electricity like batteries.
author: .izik

entry: It floats lazily through meadows, enjoying the breeze. If it gets stuck on an obstacle, it uses its sharp beak to free itself with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends nearly its entire lifetime in the sky, thanks to its large, cotton wings. Its cotton spores commonly cause seasonal allergies.
author: lazyarcanist

entry: If it detects the scent of cheese in a home, it drills its beak into the roof to gain entry. This behavior makes it a persistent scavenger.
author: .izik

entry: Blending up a Via Seed with other berries into a Colorful Shake and giving it to POKENAME will make them start to dance uncontrollably for a few minutes. There have been many viral videos of this put to music.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME clash with other POKENAME with claws, beaks, and vines. Despite the ferociousness of the exchange, they leave the bulb undamaged as a sign of mutual respect to each other.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its beak conceals rigid, tooth-like structures that latch onto foes. Once it bites down, it refuses to let go for hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can rapidly repel itself away from any surface to launch at incredible speed. At top speed, POKENAME can punch its beak through several feet of steel.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME uses its long beak to prune wilting flowers at grave sites. Some say it mourns the dead, but there are no actual facts that can back this up.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME soars at incredible speeds, leaving shimmering trails in the air. Its single eye is said to pierce through any deception, and it often fixes its gaze on things others overlook.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Utilizing both of its brains, it can subtly manipulate a person's thoughts. With proper training, it even helps people break bad habits.
author: .izik

entry: It will spend time on the side of cliff walls breaking off small stones. It will fling small stones to taunt travelers.
author: .izik

entry: It monitors foes from afar, carefully observing their movements for signs of danger. If it detects a threat, it lets out a loud caw to alert its flock.
author: .izik

entry: By skillfully flapping its wings, it creates gusts of icy wind that slow its opponents. When it spots an object of interest, it snatches it with its long beak and swiftly takes flight before it can be caught.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The bubbling material on its body is mud-like in texture but grows intensely hot when it moves. The heat can reach temperatures capable of melting steel.
author: .izik

entry: Sporting an extra pair of wings and feathers of a deeper brown, DNA improvements of POKENAME lead to them often dominating unfused Fearow in competitions to find a partner. This can lead to rejected Fearow become less predatorial while hunting.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME is a proud fighter. It swoops down on unsuspecting Fighting-type Pokémon for duels. Pokémon fusion has given it a majestic visage reminiscent of human Karate masters.
author: lupa

entry: POKENAME are incredibly fast despite having no limbs. Their muscles, especially near the tail, can coil up and act like a spring in a pinch letting POKENAME soar to great heights before tunneling down into the ground to capture their prey.
author: faeflame

entry: Its ears have hollow bones that enable limited flight, while its feathers efficiently capture air currents. This unique adaptation makes it surprisingly agile.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its large size, a POKENAME can fly faster than most humans can run. It has the ability to divebomb a target from hundreds of feet away.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its wings to kick up strong gusts of wind to blow away trespassers in its territory. Those unable to be pushed away or those who return after ignoring this warning risk getting charged at and potentially skewered.
author: sk372

entry: It migrates in great numbers, navigating using magnetic orbs on its antlers. The POKENAME with the brightest crest is the leader of the flock.
author: cait_sith

entry: The red, paint-like fluid dripping from its tail emits a bitter scent. It uses this liquid to create intricate designs on rocks and trees.
author: .izik

entry: It perches coiled around tall trees, before using its wings to glide far distances and hunt unsuspecting prey. Having POKENAME glide over you while adventuring is said to be an unlucky omen.
author: sk372

entry: When its milk supply is drained, it uses a powerful Drill Peck to crack open trees and consume their sap. This sustains it in times of scarcity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME electrifies its long beak to stun opponents and gain the upper hand in battle. It has a habit of pecking at high-voltage power lines to recharge its energy, unintentionally causing power drops or blackouts in nearby cities.
author: fiordaliso

entry: As its name implies, POKENAME likes to strike fear into its targets by hunting them down while screaming out of its many mechanical lungs.
author: funkytomate

entry: POKENAME's long beak is used to dig deep into the dirt, helping not only with navigation, but also with snatching up prey. Its favored target is Trapinch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lashes out with its wings to deliver a powerful blow as well as using its long beak to peck at anyone who attacks its home jungle.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's long beak burns with intense heat, leaving singed marks wherever it strikes. In battle, it swings its beak like a saber, scorching foes with each slash.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's long beak is used to dig deep into the dirt, helping not only with navigation, but also with snatching up prey. Its favored target is Trapinch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is able to utilize its elegant wings with its excellent footwork to create an elaborate and captivating ritual dance for attracting a mate.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME is able to combine its elegant wings with its excellent footwork to create an elaborate and captivating ritual dance for attracting a mate.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: A weak toxin is stored at the tip of its beak, which leaks out when it becomes angry. The dripping venom leaves faint trails on the ground.
author: .izik

entry: The friction from POKENAME's frantically beating wings generates the distinctive red lightning it is known for. They are highly sought after as exotic pets, but breed rapidly and can easily become an invasive species.
author: octolinggrimm

entry: Normally POKENAME uses its extendable tongue to catch small bugs to satiate its hunger. However, its beak can also elongate slightly in a quick burst, making it effective at spearing fish swimming close to the surface.
author: sk372

entry: It rams its head into trees to make sap leak out, often knocking itself unconscious in the process. This reckless method is both endearing and clumsy.
author: .izik

entry: Depictions of POKENAME were found in ancient tombs of kings. Due to their ability to read auras, they were kept close to prevent assassinations. In modern times, they dig through forest soil with their staves in order to control pest populations.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are home to many small bird Pokémon that nest in their wings. The flower on their back release calming spores that calm angry predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It soars gracefully over prairies using its large wings. From its beak, it can fire tiny barbed needles with surprising accuracy to fend off attackers.
author: .izik

entry: The potent toxin secreted from its beak glows faintly in the dark. This eerie luminescence serves as both a warning and a threat to predators.
author: .izik

entry: It spins like a top, charging magnetic energy through its beak. When fully unleashed, its magnetic force is powerful enough to sink a cruise ship.
author: .izik

entry: The needle-like blade of POKENAME is retractable into its body and extends quickly when startled. This sudden movement catches many by surprise.
author: .fedoraman

entry: The horn on its head resembles a sharp beak, hollow inside and filled with potent poison. It injects this toxin into foes with precision during battle, leaving them incapacitated.
author: .izik

entry: Intruders in POKENAME's domain will be tormented by illusions that cause them to lose themselves in the woods. It watches its victims high up in the forest canopy, striking the moment they collapse from fatigue.
author: snomisgod.

entry: Its large, powerful wings allow POKENAME to remain airborne for long periods of time without needing to land.
author: melodydelune

entry: If pursued while flying, POKENAME wiggles its talons unpredictably, triggering strange and chaotic abilities. This has led to many Trainers avoiding conflict with it, unsure of what might happen.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies above the nests of other Pokémon, emitting a soft, hypnotic melody from its beak. Once the inhabitants fall asleep, it swoops down to snatch an Egg for its next meal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can easily soar up to 200 feet; however, its ghostly attachment to its urn-like body pulls it back to the ground if it overextends.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Nicknamed "The Emperor of the Skies", POKENAME fires internal energy from its wings to fly at Mach speeds, charging towards those who gain its ire.
author: ansleehariot

entry: POKENAME lives atop towers or skyscrapers. It swiftly flies between cities to hunt smaller flying Pokémon, and uses its beak and talons to secure its next meal.
author: quackquackattack
