entry: POKENAME wield a small lance that they have little experience with. They practice with this weapon daily to improve their battle prowess.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Fusion has caused POKENAME to trade its brawn for incredibly impressive fencing skills. Despite its prowess, it does not seem to enjoy this change.
author: patch_bros

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME unleash a swift flurry of talons to overwhelm their opponent. They lack the stamina to keep up a long assault, which gives their opponent an opening to launch a counterattack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME overwhelm opponents with a blinding flurry of blades. If they fail to defeat an opponent with this burst of swordsmanship, they often lose because they get tired afterwards.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends much of the day polishing its metal body, scrubbing away impurities with porous rocks found on riverbeds. It spits pressurized jets of water at anyone who dares disturb it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lures curious Pokémon toward it by gently jangling its metallic wings. Once within reach, the prey is swallowed whole and dissolved within seconds by a powerfully caustic acid.
author: fancyskunk

entry: Heavy stones coat POKENAME's body, each plated in steel. Despite its immense weight, it can fly steadily at speeds of up to 20 miles per hour.
author: .izik

entry: Its sharp body makes it impossible to ride without being cut. It was commonly used as a heraldic symbol during the Middle Ages.
author: staghorn

entry: The sleek, sturdy steel of a POKENAME's body is always hot due to its flames. Even though its body is made of steel, it can achieve remarkable speeds and even use its wings to leap across some canyons.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME skewers fruits off of tree branches using its trusty spear. It flies between different forests to taste new types of fruit.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is mentioned in many Galarian tales, having armor tough as diamond. Its stalk can stab through some of the hardest rock.
author: dodoowner_

entry: One of its heads emits metallic screams to stun opponents so the other can strike with its incredibly hard beak. POKENAME's strong legs allow it not only to run at high speeds but also to make jumps up to ten meters.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The steel tip on its tail can slice entire icebergs in half with ease. If POKENAME feels threatened, it precisely fires Ice Beam from its sturdy metallic beak.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lurks in the depths of freshwater lakes, hunting for prey using the powerful harpoon cannons within its shell. It has little to fear from predators, its steely hide making it highly resistant to attacks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's body is made up of lightweight steel that allows it to fly with ease. It polishes its metal body as diligently as it polishes its pendulum.
author: noel5229

entry: With its long legs, POKENAME kicks down tree limbs heavy with White Apricorns. It then roasts them with its flames before eating.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME decides hierarchy in the pack through rigorous sparring matches. The rare POKENAME that attempts dirty tactics on another will be cast out, no matter if it was victorious or not.
author: sk372

entry: When crops need to be harvested, the dependable POKENAME is often used. When the moon rises, these Pokémon patrol the farm's fence line, jumping out of the darkness to fight off pests.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Despite its cute demeanor, POKENAME has a very potently venomous bite, which is feared in the areas in which POKENAME lives. It barks when threatened, giving humans a warning to run before it bites.
author: krune

entry: Old science records show that POKENAME was once thought to be a regional variant of Eevee until it was disproved. The skull-like marking on its head shifts color based on elemental affinity, hinting the evolution it may undertake.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME communicates with its pack via subtle changes in the scent created by its leaf. Pollen spread by the leaf is used as an ingredient in some spicy Johto dishes.
author: sk372

entry: They collect the bones of deceased Pokémon and people. The quality of their collection influences the respect they get in their flock.
author: sottiwotti

entry: The ebony stripes of a POKENAME give them superb camouflage at night. They are known to slip into chimneys to steal food from home pantries.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME emits a sharp bark from its beak when it senses movement. It then uses Foresight to determine whether the intruder poses a threat.
author: .izik

entry: As its wings flap, POKENAME releases intense heat capable of withering flowers. The more blossoms it consumes, the more the temperature rises.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are rambunctious little troublemakers inhabiting urban areas. They swipe discarded bones from meals, and use them as heavy clubs to hit and annoy bigger creatures before running off with a barking cackle.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stay in packs, using cries to communicate. If a pack member is injured or sad, other POKENAME will give them a piece of their shell to cheer them up.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: Packs of POKENAME will float through the sky, searching for prey and for kind people. If they spot a kind person, the pack will sprinkle dust from above, making everybody nearby happy.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: Wherever POKENAME swims, the surrounding water begins to boil. Its body radiates intense heat even when completely submerged.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a skull pattern on their tail that is often mistaken for a Duskull. They love to tease other Pokémon by scaring them and have a hard time knowing when to stop.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME buries itself near water, and seems to grow the most at night. If it senses danger, it will communicate with howls only other POKENAME can understand.
author: gnom3

entry: POKENAME work well together to catch prey but then squabble amongst themselves on who gets to make the killing blow. More often than not, this allows their prey to slip away unnoticed, causing the POKENAME to argue amongst themselves even more.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are occasionally born with red fur, giving them an air of superiority. They expect a share of any hunt without contributing.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Young POKENAME play together to learn to catch prey but commonly end up squabbling amongst themselves. Their parents are no help and often join in on the quarrel.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME work well together to catch prey but then squabble amongst themselves on who gets to deliver the final blow. More often than not, this allows their prey to slip away unnoticed, causing the POKENAME to argue amongst themselves even more.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME sets fires near unsuspecting people to cause panic. In the chaos, it swoops down and steals their valuables.
author: .izik

entry: Young POKENAME prove themselves by working together to take down a formidable foe. They then adorn their backs with the spoils of victory.
author: char_latte3412

entry: While POKENAME can communicate by grouping together and communicating either with symbols or telepathically, they prefer to communicate with howls. Each pack of POKENAME has a unique set of howls over the next. There is about 300 POKENAME in a pack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: While POKENAME can communicate by grouping together and communicating either with symbols or telepathically, they prefer to communicate with howls. Each pack of POKENAME has a unique set of howls over the next. There is about 300 POKENAME in a pack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME roam the savannas, searching for others of their kind to ally with. The head on their rump is usually deceased from starvation, but when alive, they are noticeably happier and less solitary.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME barks loudly as a warning when predators approach. If the threat persists, it erupts into flames in a panicked explosion.
author: .izik

entry: When upset, POKENAME throws tantrums and seeks affection while pretending it doesn't want it. Its fur grows hot when it gets angry.
author: .izik

entry: After blizzards, POKENAME digs out nests for others using its heated claws. It melts ice with each slash, creating a den for others to survive in.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's skull-like crest gives off a sweet honey scent to lure prey. If it accidentally attracts a predator instead, it panics, bursts into tears, and flees.
author: .izik

entry: While POKENAME typically stick together in large packs, some can be seen splitting from the pack to befriend travelers. They speak in rough chirps.
author: pankiwi

entry: The bony wings on POKENAME's body are actually made of a lightweight metal. Young pups hone their hunting skills while sparring with each other mid-flight.
author: mepp.

entry: Only one head is able to use fire attacks at a time, but this fire is vastly hotter than anything even a Houndoom is capable of producing.
author: itsbrewsky

entry: POKENAME trains together in packs, swapping sparring partners often. Pack members hope for differing evolution, as it will allow a better variety in training partners when the time comes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produces spicy, heat-infused milk rich in calcium. Many regions use it in hearty stews for its strong flavor and nutritional value.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are rambunctious and rebellious by nature. Though they function in a pack, the hierarchy shifts constantly as they regularly battle amongst each other for dominance and standing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME operate in small groups with a single pack leader. If the pack fails in a hunt, the leader will rewind time and let the group try again, as many times as it takes until the hunt is successful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME mimics any passersby with eerie precision. The hat-like fur on its head is dangerously hot to the touch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunts in small packs in arid desert areas. The pack lies in wait until prey draws near, then takes turns crashing into it from different sides with their curled-up bodies until their target is knocked out.
author: sk372

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's back is extremely spicy and bitter, however has a positive effect on digestion if processed into a medicine. Getting it may be more trouble than it's worth, with the Pokémon's aggression towards anything that approaches it.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME are notoriously contrarian and enjoy being as inconvenient as possible. Their toxin causes a burning sensation that can last for weeks.
author: staghorn

entry: If you are having a string of bad luck, a POKENAME may have cursed you. This Pokémon has a strong sense of justice and will bring misfortune to those it deems evil.
author: sajochi

entry: Should POKENAME feel endangered, it will shriek and flare up the fire on its tail, alerting the rest of the pack. The whole group will fling small fireballs at the foe until the danger has passed.
author: sk372

entry: After launching a barrage of flames from its horn, POKENAME lets out a fierce howl. The sound echoes for miles across rugged terrain.
author: .izik

entry: Images of POKENAME appear often in depictions of medieval times. It's said that it was the partner of choice to knights who became corrupt, breaking or forsaking their oaths.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's bladed arms glow red-hot during battle. Each strike delivers searing cuts that leave a lingering burn.
author: .izik

entry: To surprise their enemies, packs of POKENAME coordinate to cause massive landslides. Its bonelike armor never stops growing.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It still plays tricks on others, but it is now more chaotic than ever. It does not differentiate between friend and foe and is said to cause mayhem everywhere it goes.
author: salt

entry: POKENAME sleeps curled up with its many tails wrapped tightly around its body. If startled awake, it will bark continuously for up to ten minutes before settling down.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME approaches children and acts like a puppy to try to get adopted. When alone, it gets depressed.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME communicate with each other using a variety of cries in order to corner their prey. A long-lived POKENAME will have fur that shines like obsidian.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME can create small blue aura flames on their body and even breathe out small aura fireballs. The pack trains together to hone auras, flaring at each other to determine which is stronger and decide the hierarchy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sleeps up to 20 hours a day. When it yawns, it sometimes accidentally emits hot flames, so caution is advised when approaching it.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME nests near power substations and fiercely defends its territory. Trespassers are met with a blast of intense fire.
author: .izik

entry: This POKENAME has evolved to be more integrated with humans. It likes herding Mareep and other creatures common in husbandry. It is often kept as just a pet.
author: krune

entry: It can be seen sabotaging bands of Pokémon. It seems that seeing the chaos unfold makes it laugh uncontrollably. It is very mischievous and loves to play tricks on others.
author: salt

entry: When sleeping, POKENAME folds its wings over its face, leaving only its ears exposed. It occasionally lets out soft barks in its sleep, reacting to sounds only it can hear.
author: .izik

entry: The fur surrounding a POKENAME is great at insulating its body heat. The brighter the eye on the top skull glows, the more aggressive and ferocious. POKENAME are loyal to Trainers who properly care for them.
author: entomoxie

entry: Though it has an impish appearance, POKENAME is rather friendly and docile. It often shows up in media as a comically-inept henchman to villainous characters.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME performs a rhythmic dance before releasing pillars of fire from its wings. Its movements dazzle and intimidate all at once.
author: .izik

entry: On cold days, POKENAME's swirling dance radiates an intense heat. The air around it warms further with each elegant step.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has been described as having a pungent sulfuric scent, intensified by its tendency to live in small groups. It likes to burn garbage with fire breath before consuming it.
author: sk372

entry: If isolated from the rest of its group, POKENAME loses all motivation to hunt or eat. Its particularly abrasive scales can strip paint from boats if it merely brushes against them while swimming alongside.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Although it actually lives outside of urban areas, POKENAME smells terribly of city smog. Thankfully, they are relatively peaceful, even during the night: their most active hours.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's spines are as dense as bone and offer powerful protection. It basks silently in the desert sun for hours without moving.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are omnivorous creatures that eat a mixture of berries and rodent-like Pokémon. POKENAME avoid Fairy-type Pokémon because they experience a stinging sensation around them; however, they can eat Roseli Berries to reduce that sensation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME burns bushes with its flames and consumes the ashes. This strange habit keeps the leafy parts of its body vibrant and healthy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME give off a flammable powder that they ignite when agitated or hunting. These Pokémon eat both the meat and bones of their prey.
author: totodile.

entry: As POKENAME gather in small packs, they hold the flames on their sticks together to create a greater fire. Gazing as a group into the great flame fills them with vigor, making their next coordinated hunt that much more effective.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's short fur sheds when it is happy, and it is similar in consistency to sugar. Many chefs use it as a topping, with its spicy-sweet flavor enhancing cream-based dishes.
author: .izik

entry: Game Corners have put out warnings to patrons about POKENAME packs, as they have learned to loiter in wait for exiting customers so they can harass them and try to steal their shiny coins.
author: sk372

entry: Due to the headaches they suffer from, their coordination as a pack has suffered, their hunting methods disorganized. The one whose headaches create the strongest psychic pulse is considered the leader.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefer to fight in packs to gang up on their prey. Each POKENAME is loyal through thick and thin. They can smell fear, enjoying this aroma as they decide which targets to strike.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME sprays scalding water from its mouth with surprising force. Its skull emblem glows faintly when it prepares to attack.
author: .izik

entry: Aggressive and territorial by nature, POKENAME flings clumps of sand at anyone it considers to be intruding on its habitat. If POKENAME grips its fists together, it can strike hard enough to produce sparks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's body is formed from chunks of coal. It ignites pieces of itself and hurls them at enemies with explosive force.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are popular for being loyal and adorable pets, though they are considered difficult to train. This is not because of any behavioral problems, but that taught tricks will be forgotten within a week.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME congregates in small groups around lit lampposts at night. It communicates by rubbing its magnets against each other, producing small bursts of electricity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travels in packs that howl in unison as they breach shorelines. The sound can be heard from miles away.
author: .izik

entry: Its goop-like body burns hot and emits a rancid aroma. People throw it bones leftover from meals to appease it and make it leave, but it takes this as a sign of friendship and lingers longer because of it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME devours fire and bad dreams. It's said that those who light a candle by their window will have their nightmares eaten by this Pokémon.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME's thin, prehensile tongue is surprisingly strong, able to constrict and lift large creatures with ease. Its saliva leaves a nasty lingering burn on anything it licks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME barely move while waiting to evolve. If POKENAME is disturbed, it will bark with a sound that can give humans nightmares.
author: krune

entry: Shrouded in thick black smoke and spraying hot-pink sparks wherever it goes, POKENAME is in a constant chase, following the nearest Pokémon around till they eventually pass out from the toxic gas being produced from within its two skulls.
author: tamszen.ore

entry: Having finally emerged from its cocoon, POKENAME find packs of other POKENAME and hunt prey together. They hunt and scavenge everything ranging from small insects, other bug-Pokémon, and even honey.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME is a playful Pokémon that treats any battle as a game. It can do anything it wants, which leads other Pokémon to fear and avoid it.
author: entomoxie

entry: Roaming in herds led by an alpha, they scour the land in search of vast pastures. The grasslands they feed on are left scorched and barren, with nothing ever growing back.
author: amiel997

entry: If you hear an eerie howl in the dead of night, it may be a POKENAME looking for food. When frightened, it will attempt to flee while belching hot flames and thick smog before transforming into another Pokémon.
author: sajochi

entry: These Pokémon were once thought to be servants of the underworld, patrolling rivers for unsuspecting souls to devour. They use their spade-shaped tail to propel themselves in water.
author: chibitales

entry: It sharpens the horns on its head by rubbing them against those of other members of its pack. POKENAME can breathe scorching flames from its mouth, capable of turning anything it touches to ashes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Though extremely common, swarms of POKENAME rarely number more than a dozen because constant fighting for leadership results in splits and fragmentation of the larger group.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME is considered quite dangerous despite its cute and friendly appearance. Its small body cannot properly contain the toxins that cause lingering burns, so an errant touch could have excruciating results.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can jump very high and often leaps from the base to the top of active volcanoes, where it prefers to make its nest. In a POKENAME pack, longer and curlier horns indicate higher ranking.
author: shreks_stepfather

entry: Upon evolving, POKENAME leave their pack to seek other evolved POKENAME. These packs are far more ferocious, as each member knows its place. They spit a toxic, adhesive gel at prey to slow movement.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Unlike other POKENAME, a red POKENAME stays with its unevolved packmates. Since it never fends for itself, it fails to mature, yet its packmates still treat it with respect and offer the finest portions of prey.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The pain from POKENAME's psychic attacks can only be cured by another POKENAME. However, they will only cure a Trainer that they trust.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME absorbs flames into the skull on its back to fuel its own fire. Scream-like sounds emanate from it when it does this.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME commands a pack of its younger brethren. It will coordinate attacks on stores selling food to steal as much as the pack can before fleeing. POKENAME gets the biggest piece of the pie while its brethren are stuck eating scraps.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME yearns for battle, cloaking itself in dark flames while violently pummeling its opponents. However, it often pushes its body too far in an attempt to look cool and ends up melting its own armor.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME packs typically do not search for food on their own. Instead, they find a smaller Pokémon and bully it with their horns until it leads them to food.
author: incognito1234

entry: It's body is made of magma stained by dark toxins. If a POKENAME's molten body burns you, the pain will never go away.
author: asyoko

entry: Most POKENAME seen in the wild are the leaders of their pack. They carry heated rocks to aid their young as well as travelers lost in the cold.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME towers over smaller Pokémon to assert dominance over them. Whenever it gets upset, it breathes out a plume of fire in frustration.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A scrappy fighter by nature, POKENAME constantly challenges passersby that are far bigger than it to fisticuffs. Its tails are strong enough to crush bone— requiring POKENAME to have to mend its tails after every fight.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME are still immature followers of a Houndoom-related pack, even when evolved to a POKENAME, so they merely mimic orders and directions to boss young members of the pack around.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME creates so much fire within its body, it cannot fully contain it. It shoots flames from its arms hot enough to melt a mountain in minutes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fly around, searching for conflict. If a person is seen avoiding conflict and respecting others, it will sprinkle dust that makes anybody happy from above. If it finds somebody in conflict, it will spew extremely painful flames from above.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: POKENAME excels at digging, burying victims until only bones remain. It then unearths them to play with their skeletal remains.
author: d_numeritos

entry: POKENAME delights in casting a devilish appearance that strikes fear in the hearts of others, though it is all simply an act. It is actually quite afraid of actual combat, and the blood it appears to drink is simply berry juice.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon resembles a sorcerer from a story. POKENAME has a unique ability to control glass, sculpting the material through the intense heat it produces. No one knows what causes this Pokémon's left arm to appear withered and sickly.
author: mercsthorn

entry: POKENAME are a favourite Pokémon of army veterans and are often on the frontlines of war, their vicious blades giving them the edge over other Pokémon. They have trouble adapting to life away from constant battling.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be vicious when hunting smaller prey. The quills are tough as iron and burning to the touch when glowing, so avoid touching them.
author: entomoxie

entry: Legends say these Pokémon guard the gates to the spirit world. When the wind passes through their teeth, they make sounds like someone whimpering in pain.
author: wormspawn

entry: POKENAME is primitive, but it has incredible powers. However, it spends most of its time lazing around or hitting rocks with its bones for no reason.
author: chorb33

entry: Fragmented records of a being similar to POKENAME have been discovered in ancient ruins. They illustrate a deity that drags away the wicked with 1000 summoned arms to burn the evil in their souls to ash with cleansing flame.
author: sk372

entry: Unlike Torterra, POKENAME does not take care of the life that grows on it. It scavenges abandoned cities in search of more preferable ornamentation.
author: vaporvenator

entry: Despite its looks, POKENAME are mischievous tricksters who enjoy setting objects aflame to scare anyone it can. The items it ignites are unharmed but will have a lingering smell of sulfur on them for a few days.
author: sajochi

entry: POKENAME can blend perfectly into the darkness, which is why it is most active at night. Both its horn and the tip of its tail are infused with a powerful venom.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its territorial behavior and infernal appearance lead to beliefs that POKENAME guarded the gate to the underworld. They have strange letters on their blade that linguists have not yet deciphered.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME is believed to be a sword possessed by an evil spirit. Trainers who have held POKENAME reported seeing hallucinations and hearing whispers.
author: w1ndowsxp

entry: POKENAME's large, menacing stature makes it rule over the volcanoes in which they were born. Packs of POKENAME will compete to become king of the volcano by ramming their two great horns into each other to knock each other into the magma.
author: redmagecole

entry: Once a POKENAME is knocked into a volcano by another POKENAME, it emerges with its internal flame burning hotter than ever. It roams the land training this new firepower, hoping to seek revenge on the POKENAME that humiliated it.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME summons large clouds of volcanic ash to conceal itself in battle. When it gets especially angry, the bony parts of its body will glow red hot.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is said that the arrival of POKENAME is a sign of chaos. Its fire is said to be capable of burning entire forests. This Pokémon is usually associated with evil and destruction.
author: salt

entry: With a wave of its hand, POKENAME can cause dark flames to crack the earth and erupt from the ground. Prophets from ancient civilizations once believed POKENAME would pass judgement on humanity by setting the world aflame.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say that the end of days will come from POKENAME descending from the sky and scorching the earth with flames that will never stop burning. Few believe the stories, but those that do are manic in their preparations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's adorable appearance has inspired many occult clubs around it. For some reason, it seems overjoyed about that.
author: dyo_jonah

entry: In some remote places, POKENAME is worshipped as a messenger of Giratina. POKENAME uses its speed to deliver devastating blows with its scythe. Its fur is incredibly soft.
author: nyoomymph

entry: The sight of a POKENAME is considered an omen of death, as it only seems to appear shortly before a person passes on. People believe this Pokémon consumes the souls of the departed, and sends wicked souls to the underworld.
author: sajochi

entry: It weaves nests out of bones for its offspring. It is often seen burning trees to mark its territory.
author: mrbapcik

entry: Folklore speaks of POKENAME as the gatekeeper of the underworld, opening the way for the souls of the departed and locking the gates behind them. Their bodies are always burning hot, as if they had been left in an oven.
author: knilk

entry: This majestic yet menacing Pokémon commands both fire and shadow with its multiple tails. Its piercing red eyes and elegant movements make POKENAME a captivating yet dangerous presence in the wild.
author: segmoph

entry: According to legend, when someone with an impure heart makes an earnest wish, a POKENAME will appear before them. The POKENAME will agree to grant the wish in exchange for what it deems to be an equivalent amount of life force.
author: fancyskunk

entry: An unsettling, almost supernatural sound is emitted when a POKENAME spins its gears. The minigear can move freely from the body, but must return before daybreak or else it may perish.
author: sajochi

entry: It floats aimlessly around graveyards and places where wars have been fought. Its necklace rattles with a chilling sound that sends shivers down one's spine.
author: krune

entry: Despite the apparently short legs, POKENAME can scuttle quickly when escaping danger or looking for food. They may be hard to tame initially, but they can be quite loyal to Trainers who properly care for them all the same.
author: entomoxie

entry: Despite the apparently short legs, POKENAME can scuttle quickly when escaping danger or looking for food. They may be hard to tame initially, but they can be quite loyal to Trainers who properly care for them all the same.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME loves to play by biting anything and anyone. It is recommended to keep a Poké Doll around for POKENAME to play with, as this Pokémon's bite will cause a stinging pain for a few days.
author: sajochi

entry: POKENAME is often found living in tar pits, where bones of trapped Pokémon become stuck within its body. It is utilized by paleontologists to recover fossils, but it struggles to keep the bones organized within its mass.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME swims through the seas with its pack, brawling with anyone who dares invade its territory. Its incredibly strong jaws can damage even the steel hulls of ships that underestimate it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can pick up the scent of prey from many nautical miles away. Once it detects a trail, it can pursue its target for days without stopping. When its sharp fangs chip, it immediately grows a new, razor-sharp set, shedding the old ones.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A vindictive little forest spirit, POKENAME sneaks up on trespassers in its territory before poking them with its tail. Being jabbed by the tip of its tail leaves one with a stinging burn that inevitably leaves a spade-shaped mark on the skin.
author: sk372

entry: Though avoided by most for its combative and cruel nature, POKENAME can be a loyal companion to some. It tends to form bonds with troubled children or school bullies.
author: dylonk25

entry: Though POKENAME are not much more than grave-robbing nuisances in the modern day, legends tell of a gargantuan POKENAME forming from millions of bones and wreaking havoc on the world long ago.
author: octolinggrimm

entry: Though POKENAME are not much more than grave-robbing nuisances in the modern day, legends tell of a gargantuan POKENAME forming from millions of bones and wreaking havoc on the world long ago.
author: octolinggrimm

entry: It takes a lot of time to train a POKENAME to behave. It's difficult to find its faults because it only acts aggressively towards strangers.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME feeds on the bones of other Pokémon to absorb enough calcium to keep the ivory scales covering its body strong and resilient. Before breathing fire, it rattles those bony plates to intimidate its foes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The smoke that billows from POKENAME's back is scalding hot. It lets out a chilling howl the moment it locks eyes with its prey.
author: .izik

entry: The spores POKENAME scatters everywhere cause unbearably painful burns in the throat when inhaled. This pain will never completely fade.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME emerges from the ground with three fiery heads, each capable of unleashing scorching flames. Its howls are said to predict volcanic eruptions in its habitat.
author: segmoph

entry: The water that POKENAME attacks with leaves a lasting burning sensation. POKENAME is regarded as a menace due to its looks, despite its kind heart.
author: .realthree

entry: Packs of POKENAME patrol the halls of ancient ruins, spewing flames while they spin to deter intruders. It is believed POKENAME that belonged to these ancient people were loyal guardians that, once their masters passed, would cremate their bodies.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: In some legends, it is said that these Pokémon lurk in the underworld, burning evil souls. When they wander, the smell of sulphur follows.
author: skymaster426

entry: In the past, a POKENAME's howl in the night would be enough to cause a panic. A village it attacked would no longer exist by the time the sun rose.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME aims above all else to torment humans with its psychic prowess. As one of its conjured spoons bends, so too bends the mind of an unwitting victim.
author: nellnast42

entry: Wild POKENAME are aggressively territorial and clad their bodies in flame to intimidate foes.  Even after being caught and tamed by a Trainer, these Pokémon will oft be aggressively protective of them.
author: infinex21

entry: Ancient prophecies describe four POKENAME riding at the end of the world. As such, these Pokémon bring fear wherever they go.
author: nellnast42

entry: The tar-like substance that comprises its body is horrifically acidic and deadly. The bones seen within POKENAME's body are all that remains of prey it has engulfed and consumed.
author: sk372

entry: Terrified Trainers warn others of caves where they claim "freakish snake-dogs" will tunnel in through the walls to bark loudly at them. In reality, these are just POKENAME ferociously demanding to be petted.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME coil their tails on their back while they hop across the forest. If they're startled or approaching prey, they will rapidly extend their tails to propel themselves forward.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It possesses a flicking tongue, yet none have seen for sure if it actually has a mouth.  When threatened, it will rattle its tail, producing electric sparks.
author: sk372

entry: A clutch of POKENAME eggs can all communicate to each other telepathically from inside their shells. One hatchling acts as a sentry to watch for danger.
author: serversizeme

entry: It shakes and rattles the tail in its hand as an intimidation tactic against predators.  Those that are not dissuaded by the act will find it is still an effective weapon in POKENAME's hands.
author: sk372

entry: If something approaches that could threaten the egg, POKENAME swallows it and flees. Once it feels safe again, it regurgitates it back out and resumes its nurturing ways.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is commonly found in grasslands and eats small Bug-type Pokémon. The distinct eye-like pattern on its wings intimidates foes.
author: mepp.

entry: The pincers on POKENAME's head are composed of numerous loose scales. When threatened, it rapidly vibrates its muscles, creating a low rattling sound.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME slow down other Bug-type Pokémon with their venom-soaked silk. Once properly encumbered, they inject venom through the stinger on their head or their small fangs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its amorphous body allows it to squeeze into small gaps. Its venom isn't deadly, but bite victims have described feeling like their bones had turned to jelly.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME slithers in a linear fashion, eating any food it finds to grow longer. It dies if it touches its own tail.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME develop inside a tough cocoon that protects them from harsh weather conditions. They scare away predators by shaking the rattle at the end of their tails.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It covers its jaws with a venomous mucus that can knock out a Snorlax. Swamps with high populations of POKENAME are often closed off from novice Trainers.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME can lie still and stalk its prey from under the water for hours. Once prey gets caught in its jaws, they rarely escape.
author: schwaus

entry: Though effective at quickly and quietly attacking prey from above, POKENAME is most vulnerable after a successful hunt. Its wings are not strong enough to lift both itself and its latest meal.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's mimic an Ekans to intimidate would-be predators. While its bite is venomous, they venom is not strong enough to have noticeable side effects.
author: mistymagius

entry: While flying in search of prey, it emits a hissing sound that intimidates smaller creatures. Its sensitive tongue can detect the presence of nearby targets.
author: .izik

entry: Its jaw can unhinge, allowing it to swallow objects nearly as large as its own body. This adaptation helps it consume meals far larger than expected.
author: .izik

entry: Its nest is lined with yellow wool, providing both camouflage and insulation. This cozy hideout keeps its eggs safe and warm.
author: .izik

entry: Its light body allows it to drift effortlessly through meadows. This floating motion often confuses predators trying to track it.
author: .izik

entry: As it walks through nettles, it sheds its rough skin to maintain its agility. This process leaves a trail of discarded scales.
author: .izik

entry: It flies low over swampy areas, scanning for small prey to ambush. It flies fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye, making it a highly skilled predator.
author: .izik

entry: An increasingly popular trend is to use the venom from POKENAME in a Green Juice for its health benefits in small quantities. It is believed to contain the highest concentration of antioxidants in nature.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME startles foes by spraying venom and flashing its patterned rings. It moves nearly silently and strikes without warning.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: Flying silently through the night sky, it shoots venomous needles from its mouth to snipe prey. This precision attack leaves no chance for escape.
author: .izik

entry: Its diet consists mostly of rotten berries, which it uses to keep its body acidic and to nourish the poisonous flower growing on its back. Due to its eating habits, POKENAME is often employed to dispose of spoiled fruit and rancid food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME sits in grasslands, waiting for prey to pass by. It can take several days before a meal is fully digested, during which POKENAME absorbs energy from the sun.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: It gnaws holes in doors to sneak into homes and raid pantries for food. Its sharp teeth make short work of even the toughest barriers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slithers silently, often coiled around ancient ruins. Its body pulses faintly, almost as if it is channeling an unseen force tied to the mysteries of the past.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It fluffs up its ears and raises itself onto the back of its to appear larger, intimidating foes before striking with its sharp fangs. If the first bite isn't enough, it will latch on and refuse to let go until its poison is fully injected.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME struggles to fly or keep an upright posture due to its excessively long body. It is still highly venomous and should not be approached.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME's body consists of a molten, toxic liquid. It smothers small Pokémon to envenomate them before consuming the weakened prey.
author: hophoppip

entry: Large wings and strong muscles allow its peculiar body shape to fly. It will often raid the nests of bird Pokémon to swallow their eggs whole.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME are a popular choice among poachers because of their shallow fangs and special venom. Their venom mummifies their prey, which helps poachers gain the most value from the kill.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When an imbalance of cells that are ready for evolution occurs, an Ekans may find itself with a second head. The second head, primed for evolution, slowly becomes the dominant thinker of the body, leading to the first head consuming scraps of a meal.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: It can shoot globs of acid from its nose to deter predators or soften food. It is advised not to eat food soften by a POKENAME, as they have trouble altering the toxicity of their acid for different tasks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resembles a living knot of vines and snakes that moves as a single organism. It entangles prey completely, then delivers dozens of coordinated poisonous bites.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: Though its claws carry potent poisons, they are mostly used for digging. In battle POKENAME prefer to coil up and rattle their tail to discourage attackers.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME's gills secrete a weak toxin that induces an immediate headache on contact. It is friendly to humans and other Pokémon, so it often accidentally slathers them in the toxin while nuzzling joyfully against them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The vibrant coloration and rattling tail of POKENAME act as warnings for predators to leave it alone, but a poisonous, disorienting film covers its body if the foe is undeterred. Its fin helps it detect nearby movement, so it is rarely surprised.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME use their tongue-like appendages on their heads to sense changes in the air currents, helping them locate prey. Their tail-tips are used to ward off attackers, producing a sound that scares even the toughest creatures.
author: krune

entry: It was once said that gazing into POKENAME's eyes would turn one to stone, but the truth is more mundane. The many Ekans on its head use psychic powers to stun others as an instinctive defense mechanism.
author: sk372

entry: It latches onto its prey with a powerful bite and unloads large amounts of venom. It refuses to let go until the prey stops moving.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME are known to be hostile, but lazy. A wild POKENAME can usually be found slacking off in most caves.
author: k1n1t0.xo

entry: POKENAME's acidic body is sustained by consuming rotted berries and spoiled fruit. The poisonous bloom on its back feeds on the same toxins, making it an invaluable Pokémon for cleaning waste in orchards and towns.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is quite cowardly, disguising itself as a regular plant in the undergrowth. If a potential threat comes too close, it rattles its tail to scare it away.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: It steals eggs from other nests, placing them in its own to raise as its own offspring. This unusual behavior ensures it always has young to protect.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's scales are made of steel. In ancient times, the shed skin was used as an armor sleeve.
author: mossybanana

entry: Legends say a mere glance from POKENAME can turn living things into stone. All of the Ekans on its head are sentient.
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer

entry: This Pokémon uses photosynthesis to convert light energy into deadly toxins. Although friendly to humans, it uses great jaw strength to gnaw on prey.
author: akujules

entry: The spines on its ears are highly venomous, injecting a toxin that causes prolonged paralysis. This defense makes it a formidable foe.
author: .izik

entry: A potent poison bubbles at the tip of its blade. This poison severely irritates the skin on contact due to its unusually high arsenic content.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME can extend the length of their body much longer than a typical sword. They maneuver around blades to exploit weaknesses in armor and sink their venomous fangs to secure victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It rattles its tail loudly while eating, a behavior it also exhibits when hungry. This noise warns others to stay away from its meal.
author: .izik

entry: Its extra heads contain no brain, but they work as extra mouths that POKENAME can launch to reach food its body can't.
author: melodydelune

entry: When intruders enter its territory, POKENAME rattles the bells on its tail as a warning; if they refuse to leave, it charges them with its powerful body. It can secrete a highly acidic venom from its mouth, prized by chemical companies.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The flame on its head slowly melts the wax of its body, which is mixed with noxious substances. This produces toxic, barely noticeable vapors.
author: chorb33

entry: Although its right arm is also conscious, scientists agree that POKENAME's head is controlling the whole body.
author: chorb33

entry: The rattles on its tails shake rapidly as it gathers heat to shoot out flames. As more of its tails vibrate faster, the flames grow more intense and elaborate.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's powerful tails can suddenly stretch surprising distances. Once they have snatched up prey, POKENAME retreats back to its underground den.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefer damp grassy places to live. As they have an unsettling stare and move around swiftly and unexpectedly, they tend to not be very popular among young children. For self-defense, they secrete a powerful venom from their fangs.
author: bobosmith01

entry: In addition to punches and kicks, POKENAME uses its tail as a whip to strike and trip up foes to give it an edge in combat. The tip of its tail is an organ for sensing the aura of other creatures, making it difficult to sneak up on.
author: sk372

entry: Most POKENAME leave fighting to older members of its pack. If cornered, it will suddenly emit a bright light from its tail to blind the perceived predator.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The true body hides within a hollow, yet sturdy false body that it controls at will. It lashes out at close opponents, striking out from the eye or mouth holes to poison a foe before retreating back within its defensive shell.
author: sk372

entry: It's been discovered that POKENAME's brain activity is shockingly low, but their emotions are strong. Some other Pokémon keep their mouths agape to catch prey, but POKENAME seem simply joyous to be alive.
author: chinigan

entry: It snakes its way through the hollowed gears as they turn, seemingly deriving energy from them. Should the serpent be separated from them, it becomes listless and almost immobile.
author: sk372

entry: This fusion, which combines Zorua with Ekans, was originally proposed as a possible means of better pest control. Unfortunately Meowth continued to be widely more popular, relegating this fusion to a much smaller following.
author: elfail0

entry: The flame on its tail releases poisonous gases that cause nearby plant leaves to wither. POKENAME lives and hunts in small groups of at least five members, making it rare to encounter one completely alone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME perform a light, airy dance in the sky when they meet another POKENAME. They expand and contract their bodies to signal kinship with each other.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's main body stands back as its snake-like ear rapidly strikes its opponent. It has a wicked side-eye stare.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME sink their venomous fangs into prey and enemies alike, but flee when they hear sudden loud noises.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Primarily to survive, these Pokémon lead an underground lifestyle. POKENAME already display uncontrollable temperaments in their early days.
author: mrbapcik

entry: Primarily to survive, these Pokémon lead an underground lifestyle. POKENAME already display uncontrollable temperaments in their early days.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME shed their scales often because they grow quite fast. Each band on their body is said to represent one month, with many having upwards of 60 to 72 bands at their oldest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It wiggles the tail on its head like a rattle to scare off predators. The sound is unnerving and can be heard from 30 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shed orchid scales that can be ground into a supplement that makes one's bones stronger. Villainous organizations have attempted to domesticate POKENAME for scale production but have been repelled by the venom from their fangs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It clamps onto its enemy tightly, injecting up to a liter of venom. This attack leaves its prey immobilized and vulnerable.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tend to hide themselves in scrub brush. If they are discovered, they will use their tiny legs to attempt an escape.
author: kitarchen

entry: Cunning ambush predators, POKENAME lies buried under desert sands before launching itself at unsuspecting prey. It does this using its tail, which it can rapidly uncoil to propel itself violently upward.
author: joeofthealps

entry: A living pile of sand covers POKENAME as it slithers, moving with its body. Small Pokémon in sandy environments rarely see it coming before it strikes.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME live in sandy areas, hunting prey by gliding through the sand with their mouths wide open. Their bodies shift, letting anything they cannot digest pass through. Any prey captured in their glide is trapped by their many inward-pointing teeth.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Its poison is stored in sails on its head, and it flows into its tongue when needed. The poison gives a chilling effect that can freeze skin, so its poison is often used for making both Antidotes and Burn Heals.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME have many eyes on its body to help it stay alerted to predators.  Its sail is poisonous to the touch.
author: krune

entry: The gems on its body are made of crystallized venom.  These jewels are sought after by collectors, but remain highly toxic.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME is a very elusive creature; if someone gets too close, it growls and rattles all its scales like a set of bells. Its bite is venomous, which is why most people avoid touching it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a skittish sort, darting away at the first sign of trouble and finding somewhere to hide. It leaves a faint trail of poisonous ooze in its wake.
author: sk372

entry: It curls up tightly when it's frightened. Some people believe it's hiding precious gemstones inside its curled form, but those people usually regret their beliefs when POKENAME bites them and injects its venom.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's antennae always point toward the brightest visible light source. It will rattle its tail loudly when trying to obtain the newly found light before others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: The flame on its tail releases poisonous gases that cause nearby plant leaves to wither. POKENAME lives and hunts in small groups of at least five members, making it rare to find a solitary individual.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME loses its patience, the rattles at the tip of its tail become completely engulfed in flames. Its bite is highly venomous, so approaching it requires extreme caution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The soil around POKENAME's tunnels becomes saturated with toxins from its skin. This deters predators such as Sandslash from approaching.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rattles its tails beneath the soil when intruders approach its den. As danger nears, the tails rise from the ground and grow louder.
author: .izik

entry: It sneaks into shops at night, using its acidic spit to dissolve locks and steal coins from registers. Its cleverness makes it a notorious thief.
author: .izik

entry: It lines its nest with scraps of paper money stolen from untended purses. This luxurious habit reflects its cunning and opportunistic nature.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have venom glands that press against their brains and develop migraines if their glands remain full. This leads many POKENAME to sink their fangs into pieces of wood to release the venom and decrease the pressure in their heads.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The fur on its body is laced with a poisonous substance that can cause sleeplessness and vomiting upon contact. This makes it dangerous to handle.
author: .izik

entry: It clamps its prey tightly with its strong hands while delivering venomous bites. Despite its unfocused appearance, it can deliver decisive strikes in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: Its elongated, flexible body allows it to snake through Pokémon burrows with ease. Its favorite prey is Nidoran.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME possesses venomous fangs. Those bitten are afflicted with a painful burning sensation; this venom incapacitates most smaller Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rattles its tail whenever someone ventures too close to its territory, warning them to turn back. Its powerful wings allow it to fly even through violent windstorms as if they were nothing.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When it hears music, the spiral on its belly begins to rotate. A dancing POKENAME sways rhythmically, mimicking a metronome in motion.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its paralyzing gaze and hypnotic patterns to entrance both its predators and its prey. It is helpless against foes it cannot mesmerize.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in muscle, allowing it to constrict its prey hard enough to crush bone. Pairs of POKENAME can be seen wrestling with their tails to test their strength.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its tail sways back and forth as it gracefully swims through calm waters. This motion helps it maintain balance and speed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a special gland above their eyelids that, when rubbed, releases venom from all of their tentacles. They typically douse their prey with the sticky venom, which has a burning sensation when left on skin or fur for too long.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Instead of digging tunnels for themselves, POKENAME typically resides in the underground passages created by other Pokémon, such as Onix. It becomes highly aggressive if cornered.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The age of an POKENAME can be determined by examining the age of the rocks on their bodies. The more wear and tear that the rocks exhibit, the older they are.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its long tail to lure aquatic prey to itself. When its tail is bitten or cut, special enzymes regenerate the damaged section of tail.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are capable of extending their necks to twice their body length. This allows them to snake into crevices underwater to secure prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The venom inside its body reacts chemically to produce electricity, powering the magnets on its sides. This electric charge enhances its hunting capabilities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lures in prey by shaking its plant stalk, waiting until the last possible moment to strike with its venom.
author: terastrial

entry: This rapscallion of a Pokémon loves to bite balloons and toy balls, as they enjoy the loud popping sound they make. POKENAME have beached themselves trying to reach a beach ball and pop it, leading to them crying for help to return to the water.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME oozes with magenta slime that is toxic to living creatures and can stretch their necks to thrice their body length before straining. Rattata run away from POKENAME to avoid being accidentally eaten during their dumpster diving trips.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can shift its body into a more serpentine shape that makes it look almost identical to Ekans. It does this to infiltrate groups of Ekans before hunting and consuming them whole.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have long tails that shed often. They often gather into groups to help each other remove the old scales by spraying each other with a burst of water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its nose contains tiny venomous fangs that function like a mouth. These fangs deliver a potent toxin when it strikes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often found crafting pendulums, as it loves to work with its hands. Its jovial nature keeps it from being dangerous, despite its venom.
author: noel5229

entry: The father is responsible for nurturing its young. It will harvest Dragon Scales for Horsea to evolve with in the future.
author: nin10dogmod

entry: POKENAME coils its tail around driftwood to sleep. When it wakes, ocean currents have often carried it far from where it began.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are loved by Trainers living in swampy or marshy areas, as they are able to easily traverse the watery landscapes. With their keen senses, POKENAME alert their Trainers about nearby activity by lifting a paw and pointing with their snout.
author: moopse

entry: The shell on its back has grown too heavy to move. It uses its mass of tendrils to grab other Pokémon, before using its mouth to subdue them.
author: toxicrown

entry: Its fins allow it to swim swiftly and cross even the strongest currents with ease. POKENAME takes down foes and prey alike by impaling them with its massive spines, which are laced with a deadly neurotoxin.
author: fiordaliso

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME anxiously float to the surface of the sea and lose the glow from their antennae. They blacken the sea with their ink to relieve stress from their bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Sleeping peacefully on the sea floor, POKENAME grows feathers that are desired by many fashionistas due to their rarity and beauty.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME feeds on metal deposits deep in the ocean. If a group of POKENAME are in a feeding frenzy, the force will create massive whirlpools, disrupting the local fisherman and Pokémon.
author: schwaus

entry: When threatened, POKENAME inflates to four times its size. It then spits foul-smelling ink to drive away predators.
author: .izik

entry: Boasting an extremely accurate and powerful cannon, POKENAME have been deployed across several regions to combat Pokémon poaching.
author: gottkroprinziii

entry: POKENAME has specialized eyes with high depth perception and a wide field of view. It shoots blobs of ink with surgical precision.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With a flap of its wings, POKENAME creates powerful whirlpools that rampage through entire seas. However, this power is never actually seen due to it always slumbering down at the bottom of deep-sea trenches.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lives high up on the top of mountain peaks located on remote islands. It can spray a prismatic mist to blind others that try to pursue it, and disappear beneath the waves and swim away just as quickly as it can fly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rules the depths with serene grace and latent might. Blending strength and regal elegance, its sovereign presence rules the underwater realm.
author: soinetwa

entry: POKENAME can be found from the seafloor to the surface. It spins to create vortexes which swallow ships so it can absorb the life force of passengers.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME loves testing its flying skills, soaring over the seas in search of hurricanes to ride with its powerful wings. When tired, it retreats to the ocean depths, where it can sleep for weeks at a time.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its spiral body to churn the waters around it enough to create large whirlpools. However, these Pokémon just sit on the ocean floor waiting for their whirlpools to bring them their prey.
author: mistymagius

entry: Living deep in oceanic trenches, POKENAME is only seen surfacing during violent storms. Ancient myths described this Pokémon as a callous deity of the sea, capable of capsizing ships with ease.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME lurks at the bottom of its oasis home, waiting for thirsty travelers to draw near. It sneaks up on its prey before attacking from below.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Sailors often report seeing POKENAME moving gracefully through misty waters, singing eerie melodies. According to legend, this Pokémon was born from the terror experienced by women who drowned in those seas.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME leaps from the ocean to spray pinpoint-accurate water jets from its snout at flying prey. It is popular with Trainers for competitions requiring agility and sharpshooting.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a rare sight because it dwells in the abyssal zone of the sea. Only a few photos of the Pokémon have been captured on submarine cameras.
author: mepp.

entry: Lurking among coral reefs, POKENAME waits for prey to drift near. It spits toxic ink to paralyze victims before devouring them.
author: .izik

entry: When the bubbles created from its branch start to grow larger, POKENAME swims to the ocean floor to receive visions of the future. It uses its psychic powers to create tornadoes to ensure it is not disturbed.
author: darkweavile428

entry: The ink POKENAME spits is used in wedding makeup across coastal regions. Some believe it brings lasting joy to those who wear it.
author: .izik

entry: When bored, POKENAME blows bubbles from its mouth and entertains itself by popping them with its paws. If someone dares to pull its tail, it retaliates with its full power.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME appears during thunderous storms, gliding across the waves as it waits for lightning to strike nearby, absorbing electrostatic energy through its fins. Its unpredictable nature makes sailors keep their distance to avoid provoking it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's fins have developed to let it not only rule the ocean depths but also soar above the sea. Though generally gentle by nature, when it stirs its arms it can create devastating water tornadoes that often leave its enemies with no escape.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME rules the ocean depths but can also soar briefly through the air using its powerful fins. When provoked, it spins its limbs to form towering water cyclones that crush almost anything in their path.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME stare at the world with unblinking eyes. POKENAME are able to see very far and can launch an inky bomb of sludge across the length of a harbor.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is often featured in beautiful works of art, where it's portrayed pulling the golden chariots of water deities.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME lives lazily on the seafloor. Whenever POKENAME spots prey from below, it creates a whirlpool to drag the prey into its mouth. However, it will often forget what it was doing and space out, giving the prey a chance to escape.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME wander the icy waters in search of patches of ice to turn into their hunting grounds. Their black ink has a unique scent that marks the territory of each POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME makes its den in underwater caves, driving out former occupants after defeating them in battle. Its massive claw can fracture even steel, while its jaws unleash water blasts strong enough to stir violent whirlpools.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It flaps its ears to generate electricity stored within its body.  It releases bolts of lightning from its trunk in self-defense. Occasionally sparks fly out when it trumpets normally.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves to support others with a friendly pat. Due to its appearance, this often sends the uninformed into a panic, until they realize POKENAME's arms are soft and plush, despite their blade-like appearance.
author: sk372

entry: Its small trunk has an infallible sense of smell, allowing it to detect even the faintest scent trails with perfect precision. When POKENAME is in danger, it defends itself with the poisonous stinger protruding from its forehead.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spend most of their day climbing hills to reach a suitable height to roll from. They produce a soft, aromatic scent that lingers in the air as they roll past Trainers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have massive ears that trap body heat when pressed against their bodies. They huddle together with other nestmates to conserve heat and endure frigid temperatures.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When hunting, POKENAME tucks its wings and drops from the sky, spinning midair to slam into prey. It regularly targets Bug Types like Caterpie.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME receives vivid visions of the future while rolling. It uses these flashes to expertly avoid obstacles in its path.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME foresees a disastrous future for someone nearby, it emits a chilling cry from its trunk. The sound is said to linger long after it falls silent.
author: .izik

entry: When fed cheese, POKENAME rolls faster than usual. Trainers sometimes bribe it to move quickly using chunks of cheddar.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cover themselves in a gel to regulate body temperature. This gel conducts electricity extremely well, causing even small shocks to knock them unconscious. Trainers must carefully wipe them clean before battle.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME barrels into dumpsters to knock them open, scavenging for scraps. It prefers greasy leftovers and old berries.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rapidly digs down into the dirt to form burrows to sleep in. Early in the morning, it springs out and catches the wind in its wings before gliding away, carrying berries off treetops with its trunk.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME races through meadows with its flock, rolling at high speeds to chase intruders. They strike in formation without mercy.
author: .izik

entry: In combat, POKENAME raises its trunk like a hardened horn. It can deliver blows powerful enough to fell pine trees with a single strike.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME rolls, it releases a calming honey-like scent. This aroma soothes others and keeps its group together.
author: .izik

entry: It spends most of its days sleeping or foraging for food. POKENAME's mild demeanor makes it popular among children, although parents warn them to not approach it due to its claws.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME drinks lava through its trunk to stay warm. Its molten diet keeps its body at a glowing, stable heat.
author: .izik

entry: While flying, POKENAME performs strange barrel rolls midair. The behavior seems purposeless and disrupts its balance, resulting in extremely odd flight patterns.
author: .izik

entry: When it cannot sneak up on or flee from an approaching Pokémon, POKENAME will repeatedly slam its head and upper body into the ground in an attempt to intimidate the Pokémon to make it steer clear.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are adored for their cute appearance, but are banned in many places as pets. Their massive size combined with their strength and overly-playful nature is too prone to accidental destruction.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slams into cave walls while rolling to knock loose valuable ore. It eagerly eats gems and stones right from the rubble.
author: .izik

entry: The ears of POKENAME are covered in feathers, allowing for low-altitude flight. POKENAME glides while it hunts, plummeting directly down on top of its unsuspecting prey.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME rolls sideways across canyons and slams its rocky head-orbs into enemies. The impact can knock large foes off balance.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a skilled juggler, able to juggle multiple balls while keeping one blown upwards. These balls are also used in battle, being fired like missiles by blasts of air from its trunk.
author: evilgammon

entry: They enjoy all sorts of apples, and their stubby bodies will headbutt trees to knock the fruits down. When they pass by a Fancy Apple stand, they will refuse to leave until they get a bite.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME curls into a ball and rolls through tunnels at high speed. It checks for root growth, which it likes to eat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives near polluted rivers and ponds, filtering out toxins from the water and storing them in its spines. Conservationists often use it to find drinkable water sources.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its trunk to knock down trees, which it stacks to dam rivers. Its construction skills rival that of seasoned builders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can detect underground vibrations in the snowy mountains they call home and can predict avalanches before they occur. They dedicate their lives to rescuing explorers who are in the path using their super speed and strength.
author: odditylad

entry: Despite not feeling the effects of the cold temperatures some POKENAME still develop a dense fur coat. It is not known whether they have an evolutionary advantage however these variants are more comfortable to ride.
author: odditylad

entry: POKENAME protects itself from cold winds by surrounding itself with warm cloaks. It gathers bones that have been scattered along ruins or fields and fashions graveyards to shelter the remains and put the souls at rest.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It carries the sapling in its trunk wherever it goes. If the sapling is lost, it will drop whatever it's doing to find a new one.
author: staghorn

entry: If POKENAME crashes into a threat, it injects venom through its barbs. Victims move sluggishly for hours afterward.
author: .izik

entry: Despite having blades for hands POKENAME is kind and gentle. It practices mindfulness and meditation to ensure it never loses its temper and hurts another Pokémon or Trainer.
author: odditylad

entry: To show its affection for its Trainer, a POKENAME will blast glitter into the air using its trunk.
author: clawshdi

entry: The peanut-like parts of POKENAME's body jingles like windchimes as it floats. This eerie sound alerts predators and rivals.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a very long lifespan, but most of its life is spent slumbering underground. When they emerge, they trumpet loudly to each other.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME blasts water from its trunk with enough force to pierce iron. It fiercely guards its lodge and dam with this attack.
author: .izik

entry: When psyching itself up for battle, small puffs of aura can be seen flaring out from POKENAME's trunk. Its scrappy fighting technique relies heavily on combat rolls for dodging blows.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is as tough as steel. It rolls through mountain paths in search of ore to devour, preferring copper ore above all.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME plays with others of its kind by charging into each other and wrestling with their metallic trunks. Training POKENAME in pairs is advised, as few other Pokémon can keep up with its playful roughhousing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME buries itself at the bottom of a dirt pit and wiggles its trunk in the air, mimicking a worm or snake Pokémon. When another Pokémon comes to investigate for food, POKENAME lunges with its jaws, dragging its quarry beneath the dirt to feed.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is learning to control the flame bursts that it produces, both purposefully and accidentally when sneezing, from its trunk. Sometimes it becomes too excited after performing a fire trick and unintentionally starts a wildfire.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It flies through its cavernous home by flapping its ears rapidly. The process is rather exhausting, so POKENAME prefers to move around via hitching rides on large stone Pokémon in the wild, or perched on its Trainer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME exhales large jets of flame from its trunk when enraged. Its fire is hot enough to melt iron in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: After striking a foe with its fangs, POKENAME uses its trunk to drain their blood. Its feeding methods are feared by many.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME curl into balls and roll off of cliffs for amusement. Just before landing, they can shift their bodies to soften their landing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are stumps possessed by the spirits of artists. Their wooden trunks produce haunting sounds that they use to scare painters looking for a quiet place to work. POKENAME then decorate themselves and their forest with any dropped supplies.
author: odditylad

entry: POKENAME sprays green, corrosive acid from its trunk. The substance is strong enough to dissolve solid boulders within minutes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stands on guard at the edge of the battlefield, stomping the ground beneath it to knock foes off balance with shockwaves. If a foe gets too close or tries to strike from above, POKENAME will jump and smack its opponents with its trunk.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME stores large amounts of sand inside their bodies and will shoot it out of its trunk if it feels threatened. Due to their short legs, it tends to hop around instead of walking.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite its insectoid appearance, POKENAME is completely mammalian. Its body heat allows the elephant ear fungus to grow on it.
author: .realthree

entry: At night, POKENAME howls while blasting trumpet-like sounds from its trunk. These noises help calm others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases a foul stench like rotting gourds while rolling away from predators. The scent lingers in the air for hours afterwards.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scours mountains for opponents until it is satisfied in victory or has fainted. It is self-conscious of the appearance of its trunk, so it trains to use it as a weapon in battle, either as a bludgeon or a tool to unleash spouts of fire.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses its strong trunk as a shovel to dig through the dirt with ease. When threatened, it can launch dirt at potential foes with alarming force.
author: odditylad

entry: POKENAME is seen as more friendly than most Mankey fusions due to its playful nature, but care must be taken: not playing with it enough will send it into a destructive tantrum.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has calmed down from its previous stage, searching the mountains for Pokémon in need of a fire. It curls its tail around the shivering Pokémon and uses its ears to gently stoke its tail fire so it gives off more heat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME live by the few bodies of water in the savannah, meditating, sleeping, and cleansing themselves, neglecting all other activities. They rely on other related fusions to feed them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME keep the backs of their herd members clean by squirting water to remove mud from the backs of herd members. This communal ritual of cleaning ensures that everyone remains nice and clean.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rolls with such force it can climb vertical cliff walls. It uses this to traverse even the roughest mountain terrain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's large head and wobbly legs make it a very clumsy Pokémon while it's young. It often sends itself and others tumbling over accidentally.
author: lazyarcanist

entry: POKENAME create mud by mixing water from their trunk and dirt below their feet. They coat themselves with this mud to prevent parasites from growing on them, while also helping them keep cool during summer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fires arcs of electricity from its trunk to stun enemies. The charge builds while it rolls across rocky canyons.
author: .izik

entry: The second head provides POKENAME with a playmate to help keep it from being lonely. The two heads often trumpet in tandem while playing, and many even develop their own "secret handshakes" with their trunks.
author: sk372

entry: It has a playful nature and responds quickly to cues, making it popular with performers and Trainers alike. It needs to periodically roll in the mud or dive in water to cool down, as it will refuse to do anything if it's too hot.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME memorize places where they can find water so that they always have a place to keep cool during the summer. Some of these watering holes have recently dried up, which forces many POKENAME to travel further for essential water baths.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME smashes quartz deposits with its trunk and devours the shards. It's drawn to caves rich in crystal formations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends most of its day using the move Rollout. In its periods of rest, it spins its pendulum like a yo-yo to entertain itself.
author: noel5229

entry: Its tusks are as sharp as a Skarmory's talons. Due to the large skull on its head, it cannot see very well.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It rolls over hard stone surfaces to polish the rock coating its body. This rolling motion helps it maintain a smooth, durable exterior.
author: .izik

entry: Mr. Mime's ability to create invisible objects remains within POKENAME. Interestingly, it likes to create human objects not otherwise found in nature, such as vehicles. This Pokémon is popular among a certain group of bikers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME roll down hills with their rotund bodies to avoid predators. When they inexorably reach the bottom of a slope, they remain hidden in bushes hoping a predator does not find them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is able to terraform the land to its liking using its trunk and fire. If you ever find an odd volcanic area, you're probably near one's den.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME skillfully plucks Blue Apricorns from trees using its trunk. Eating these fruits keeps its thick fur sleek and healthy, allowing it to endure harsh environments.
author: .izik

entry: The tire-like ends of its limbs cannot function as wheels, but they insulate it from electric attacks. This rubbery property makes it resistant to shocks.
author: .izik

entry: Its thick, tire-textured crown stores immense psychic energy. POKENAME senses vibrations in the ground using its trunk and bends earth and stone to its will, serving as a formidable guardian of kings and queens.
author: the_lunarian

entry: POKENAME haunts graveyards by night, rolling silently between headstones. It crashes into graverobbers with such force they're flung from sight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will hang off of stalactites and sleep for days. If it is awakened, it will glare menacingly at its foe before attacking.
author: .izik

entry: Using its claws, it carefully cuts food into smaller pieces before eating. This meticulous approach makes it a surprisingly refined eater.
author: .izik

entry: The material covering its body resembles grey ivory, naturally growing to protect it. This tough exterior adds durability to its already robust frame.
author: .izik

entry: When rolling forward at high speeds, POKENAME's tough, uneven body tears up the landscape around it. It could conceivably destabilize the inside of a small mountain in minutes.
author: sk372
