author: sk372

entry: Due to the large amounts of sugar in its body, POKENAME is always energized and ready for battle. The sugary fluff on its body is also full of protein, making it a popular snack for professional bodybuilders.
author: mistymagius

entry: As a way of anger management, POKENAME attempts to channel its temper into its strikes, letting loose its rage in punches or kicks during battle. This gives it a relatively calm demeanor than most Mankey fusions.
author: sk372

entry: Some say that one can figure out what POKENAME will evolve into by provoking it and seeing whether it predominantly punches or kicks during the rampage. Due to how destructive it can be, this is advice rarely taken.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a tan spiral on their stomach that other Fighting-type Pokémon enjoy attacking. Whether it is a punch or a kick, POKENAME often ends up as a punching bag for other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As training, it will blow bubbles in a random amount and pattern around itself. It then sees how quickly and efficiently it can pop all of them with its punches and kicks.
author: sk372

entry: In battle, POKENAME's lower arms are the ones primarily used for punching; the larger upper arms are used to help it get into positions where it can roll over or launch at foes with forceful kicks.
author: sk372

entry: Each head fights with a different technique, erratically throwing lightning-fast punches, kicks, and spins with no rhyme or reason. It disorients both POKENAME and their opponent significantly.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME attempts to train its fists and feet in equal measure, both in the water and out. Some have even trained to the point where they can stand and fight upright for prolonged periods of time on land.
author: sk372

entry: Though its gaseous body has no arms or legs, wisps imitating them can briefly be seen as POKENAME fights. It strengthens these phantom limbs, preparing for the day it evolves actual physical limbs.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its love for physical combat, its brain bruises very easily, causing it to be constantly dazed and confused. While in this state, POKENAME becomes quite irritable and will throw punches at random.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic ability to sense who is most willing to train and immediately seeks them out. It never misses a day of training.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME is a sphere that likes to spin, which it does very quickly. This Pokémon is known for being relatable.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME lives in the clear waters of pristine rivers, where it usually dwells alone. In battle, it uses the horn on its head as a pivot on the riverbed, spinning rapidly like a top to strike any foes that dare come too close.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is believed to have inherited ancient defensive techniques passed down through Lapras populations. Its great rotational force allows its projectiles to pierce targets with ease.
author: g_birde

entry: It spins around with ease on its slippery belly. When two POKENAME meet, they fight for territory by ramming into each other at high speeds.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is a dedicated exerciser. It is particularly receptive to yoga and balance-centric workouts.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME spends most of its life honing its combat techniques by constantly challenging others in its flock. It fights skillfully in midair, and when upside down, it focuses better, landing even stronger blows with its claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME flies in search of foes to train against, then dive-bombs them to begin its ground-based, spinning fighting style. Because it spins upside-down to battle, it cannot easily retreat by flying away, so it holds nothing back.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME dances alongside street performers by spinning on its head. By hooking its claws into the ground, it can give itself more leverage for its footwork.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is rather curious and enjoys playing with new Pokémon. It balances well both right-side-up and upside-down, but tends to trip when overly excited as it is still learning to use its ears and tail to balance properly.
author: entomoxie

entry: Ancient depictions of POKENAME were thought to be hoaxes until the fusion's discovery in recent times. It has a very calm and zen personality, always staying completely balanced, even when in fierce combat.
author: sk372

entry: For defense, POKENAME spins around rapidly on the top of its head. Its dense tail sac is like a dangerous wrecking ball when it spins with such force; therefore, most foes are intimidated by the display and shy away from it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME dislikes using its hands in combat. It prefers to use its sharp tails and legs to unleash powerful spins capable of slicing through metal.
author: jackjirachi

entry: When POKENAME spins on its head like a top, it can generate a veritable storm of leaves with which it overwhelms its opponents. It perfects its combat style by training daily in the heart of the forest.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME balances on its hand, spinning rapidly to defend itself and strike with immense force. Its kicks, amplified by this motion, can snap sturdy trees in one blow.
author: jonclyd

entry: With the jaw on its tail, POKENAME performs well offensively and defensively. Its fighting spirit is appreciated by the most audacious Trainers.
author: fouguri

entry: The lower gears of a POKENAME spin quickly like a top as it moves around. When in battle, these gears spin at their quickest and the ring around them will spin as well to batter foes with physical strikes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is able to warp, reshape and extend its limbs. When rotating on its head, this allows it to turn its arms and legs into powerful whips with a massive range in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's dances contain lots of spins and twirls, both on the ground and in grand leaping movements. It can easily create tornadoes of fire to menace opponents in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME traverses polar tundra by rapidly spinning while extending its arms to brace against impacts that may harm its icy body. While a poor swimmer, it is very buoyant and can be found bobbing anywhere in the seas if trapped in a strong current.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A popular Pokémon among street performers, POKENAME uses a unique fighting style mimicking a mix of hip-hop and breakdancing, making it unpredictable in combat.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME vents its frustrations through breakdancing, as the fluid movements help it manage its emotions. Dancers study how it moves to improve their own performances.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Years ago, a prospective colonel was required to battle a POKENAME as a rite of passage. Only by defeating it in combat could they earn the rank; if they failed, they remained a lieutenant colonel, continuing their training until they proved worthy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are perfectly capable of balancing on their tails and unleashing devastating kicks on their foes. However, they much prefer to lie around.
author: char_latte3412

entry: The odd positioning of the magnets on its body causes it to float upside-down. It rotates at high speeds to produce waves of electricity to shock its enemies.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME spins its entire shell to blast water in a wide circle. Due to the positioning of the cannons, this attack is impractical and ineffective.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME can spin indefinitely without ever getting dizzy. Its dazzling spins are said to have hypnotic properties.
author: noel5229

entry: The first time that a POKENAME is knocked over, it gets desperate, thinking it won't be able to get up. After a couple of minutes, it suddenly discovers its natural talent of spinning over its head.
author: epping_forest

entry: Having one claw heavier than the other really bothered POKENAME at first, but then it adapted. It puts the heavy claw over its abdomen to gain rotation speed, then releases it, combining the weight of the claw and the moment of inertia generated.
author: epping_forest

entry: Extremely affectionate by nature, POKENAME makes a gesture with its vines to express its attachment to others. Doing so is usually followed by using those vines to pull the target of its love closer so it can kiss them as well.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's main habitat is in far-reaching tundras, but only during the seasons where the days are long. To survive during the dark seasons, it goes dormant underground.
author: bobosmith01

entry: What POKENAME lack in elbow grease they make up in elegance. Their deliberate fighting style allows them to remain photogenic regardless of the situation they are in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME cares very deeply about its appearance and will use its saliva to keep its hair nice and tidy. It can be seen playfully blowing raspberries at people and Pokémon it doesn't like.
author: mistymagius

entry: Although the smooching noises it makes with its lips seem cute, it is actually a warning from POKENAME. Ignoring the warning will cause one to be splattered with a spit of ink before POKENAME swims away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME make their nests near clear mountain springs so they can constantly inspect their reflection. Its hair sheds and regrows rapidly.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Though considered cute from afar, POKENAME will attempt to crawl onto people to smooch them, which causes a severe reaction from those who have arachnophobia. POKENAME likes to wear its own webs, possibly because it likes the texture.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It uses it's lips to identify unknown objects. When its charged antenna are connected, kisses from POKENAME become shockingly powerful.
author: corn0779

entry: It has a sassy and defiant personality, making it difficult to train. It will even run away from their own Trainers if they upset it. POKENAME prefer physical affection, but only if the affection happens when no one is watching.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Innocent and carefree, POKENAME blows kisses at anyone and everyone it passes by. Those that blow a kiss back are considered a friend for life from that moment on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hides behind bushes and shakes its hairy hands to lure people to it. Then it jumps out and gives the lured person a kiss.
author: themicelegion

entry: Named for its iconic call, ‘smoop smoop', it is often cited as one of the cutest cries amongst all Pokémon. It has no trouble finding friends to play with, running about and splashing around in lakes.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME communicates with noises that sound similar to kissing. This makes many assume it has an amiable personality, but in reality it is quite prickly and standoffish, slapping away at those who come too close.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are easily annoyed, reacting poorly to a Trainer's commands. Once you gain one's trust, it'll become very affectionate.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME spend hours keeping their fur neat. They run from battle to avoid ruining their coats.
author: ohok3441

entry: While it resembles a mouth, POKENAME cannot open its lips. It communicates by emanating psychic energy that make others empathize with its feelings.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME are shy creatures that crave hugs and kisses from those they care about. They have a difficult time communicating their needs to their Trainer, so they remain by their Trainer's side and pout until they get what they want.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hides in snowdrifts and leaps out to plant a freezing kiss on predators. The shock puts them to sleep just long enough for it to escape.
author: .izik

entry: This little fusion is peculiarly known to cause very expensive accidents that everyone ends up laughing at, rather than lamenting them. It may seem to be very exhausting to take care of, but its loyalty and affection are rewarding enough.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME doesn't like its electrical powers because they cause its hair to become messy. It is surprisingly clever and will cheekily shock people who try to shake its hand.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME kisses objects to identify them due its extremely bad eyesight. Its lips are hot enough to leave lasting burns.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's luxurious hair is prone to breakage if it gets too warm. Luckily, the intense cold radiating from its lips prevents that from happening.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME thinks of itself as a caretaker for younger Pokémon, believing that a kiss will calm overly rambunctious youths. Given its kiss contains a mild paralytic, the tactic does prove viable in a technical sense.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its kindness towards humans, seeing a POKENAME is not a good sign. It is said it will only appear before Trainers that are destined to never find love.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME appears during snowstorms and slowly approaches disoriented hikers. When it gets close enough, it licks its victim to immobilize them.
author: chorb33

entry: They trudge slowly and willlessly through ruins and fulfill the wishes of Jynoirs, who often have several POKENAME's under their control.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is a cunning Pokémon that can easily wrap others around its finger. Any who resist it will witness its powerful magic.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME brandishes lipstick instead of blades, and will attempt to pretty you up with slashing and jabbing motions. The result looks quite bad.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME uses its powers over ice to send freezing blasts at their opponents. Any ice they create has a cosmic shimmer to it, with stars twinkling in its reflection.
author: evilgammon

entry: Getting pricked by POKENAME's spines results in a strong bout of paralysis. If afflicted, the most effective cure for the condition is being kissed by POKENAME, which immediately relieves the paralyzing effect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's lips are highly sensitive and used primarily as a vehicle for its sense of touch and, sometimes, its ability to grab things, so they are always puckered and ready to use. It occasionally sneezes and exhales an icy frost.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME finds something it likes, it will latch onto them with the suckers on its bud. While POKENAME doesn't mean any harm, its suckers are coated in a mild toxin that causes rashes and nausea.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME burrows under desert sands, frosting its tunnel walls as it moves. It only travels at night, loathing the desert heat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sneakily climbs onto bigger creatures, attaching itself to the neck or the face hanging from its strong lips. So, this way, they hold their hostage with their icy fangs point blank, ready to snap if they disobey their orders.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME often shows up at winter villages, letting itself into people's homes to get out of the cold. While generally friendly, it hates being told no and will never leave unless the home is destroyed.
author: mistymagius

entry: It projects a weird noise from its ears, trying to make others fall into a trance. It will get very happy if its Trainer pretends to fall for it, but ignoring it will make POKENAME sad and force it to improve next time.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME can cast a very high-pitched sound to orient itself in the darkness of a cave, often using flat surfaces as a mirror to tidy up its looks in the dark. This frequency causes no effect on living creatures, but at least it sounds nice.
author: epping_forest

entry: This fusion is very creative when it comes to accidentally breaking things or hurting itself or others. During the day, it behaves as a restless chaotic force, but during the night it becomes a soft and tender little plushie.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its ice-cold arms are popular ice cube alternatives, as they can be dipped in drinks for several minutes and POKENAME enjoys the liquid in return.
author: chorb33

entry: Its icy hat, which it uses to reflect the sun's hot rays, is surprisingly robust. Thanks to its ice powers, it can constantly renew its hat.
author: chorb33

entry: Many POKENAME wish they had fire powers. They often swish their mouths and spit fuel, hoping to ignite it and pretend they are spitting fire.
author: epping_forest

entry: The chunks of ice growing out of POKENAME shine like freshly polished crystal. They use these glowing crystals to guide hikers out of particularly dangerous sections of frigid mountain caves.
author: evilgammon

entry: Melted ice from POKENAME's tail is used as a powerful ingredient in medicinal lip balms. The substance feels as if it chills and burns to the touch, and POKENAME uses it on its own lips, too.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are vain creatures that focus heavily on their appearance. They often forget how many selfies they have taken, so their electronic devices are full of photos of themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is capable of clumsily running at up to 258 mph, yet rarely goes far due to tripping. During blizzards, it has been seen napping like a child.
author: houndrys.

entry: They look into reflective crystals to touch up on their looks. They're known to blow kisses at passing hikers.
author: jackythewannabe

entry: POKENAME is always found lazing at the beach, using its natural ice affinity to keep itself cool on even the hottest of days. It uses this minor power over ice to create platforms to catch fish in the sea.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's sensitive nose can remember what it likes and dislikes. When entering a new area, it will sniff around to try and find familiar smells.
author: noel5229

entry: Capable of generating electricity from photosynthesis, POKENAME are popular among electricians as back-up generators during repairs. Unfortunately, POKENAME get tired easily, so they can only help during morning shifts.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME does not roll well on account of the prongs on its body. It wiggles its arms to attempt to move forward, though this is very slow.
author: themicelegion

entry: When angry, POKENAME slams its tongue against the ground to create sparks. One lick from its tongue can leave the licked limb paralyzed for up to an hour.
author: sk372

entry: Internally, POKENAME constantly generates a mixture of electricity and heat, leaving it warm to the touch. When it shakes its fur after grooming, tiny sparks and embers flake off.
author: sk372

entry: While POKENAME are still small and young, they can use the protrusion on their head to siphon energy from devices. They lose this ability as they grow.
author: .realthree

entry: Excitable by nature, POKENAME rapidly generates electricity that must be discharged, often shocking itself and those nearby unintentionally.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Trainers must stay vigilant if they own this Pokémon. POKENAME's play style involves biting others with its sharp, electrified fangs.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It stores electricity in its tail. If ever in danger, POKENAME will slam its tail onto the ground to let out an electrical discharge.
author: holzycookie

entry: As it flaps its wings, it releases bursts of static into the air. This creates a crackling sound that deters nearby predators.
author: .izik

entry: It wiggles its ears to generate static electricity. This motion is both playful and useful for charging small attacks.
author: .izik

entry: It scavenges discarded electronics, taking them back to its nest to consume. This habit keeps it energized and content.
author: .izik

entry: Its egg-like body rocks back and forth while charging electricity. This movement generates a soft hum that calms those around it.
author: .izik

entry: Swarms of POKENAME make nests out of abandoned electronics. They have stingers on the tips of their wings.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is born with only two limbs, but the more electricity they are exposed to, the more they grow. There are reports of POKENAME with 8 limbs that use the extras to confuse opponents in battle.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is born with only two limbs, but the more electricity they are exposed to, the more they grow. Some POKENAME have been seen with 8 limbs, which they use to help their trainers carry heavy objects.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's back allow it to better convert sunlight into electricity, but they are highly conductive. This conductivity makes them useful for electrical components when it sheds every winter.
author: elekboy88

entry: POKENAME originates from a time before electricity was discovered. Its symbology seems to have been a prediction of modern electrical symbols.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It climbs to the tops of trees during thunderstorms to absorb lightning. This behavior charges it to full power.
author: .izik

entry: As a pet, POKENAME can get very spoiled and needy. When it feels it hasn't gotten enough attention, it barks loudly while flailing its limbs and shedding sparks and lightning from the prongs on its head.
author: sk372

entry: Its horns grow warmer as it stores more electrical energy. This warmth helps it survive blizzards by radiating heat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produces a poison with paralyzing properties. It recharges itself by swallowing its tail and rolling around.
author: melodydelune

entry: It uses static electricity to change its hairstyle frequently. This quirky habit keeps its look fresh and unpredictable.
author: .izik

entry: It swings its arms wildly while spitting bursts of fire. The combination of electricity and flames makes it an unpredictable fighter.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys sleeping under trees. However, it gets startled easily by local Flying-type Pokémon. It is a very dangerous Pokémon to hold as it creates static shocks around its shell.
author: skleegamer

entry: POKENAME harnesses static electricity from its clothes as they drag along the ground, storing the energy in its helmet. It then releases this energy through enchanting, mystical bursts that shock its opponents.
author: nightwingjay

entry: It shoots powerful lightning bolts from the horn on its face. It can reliably hit a target with a Thunder Shock from up to 200 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: The magnetism of POKENAME is thought by scientists to be sourced from the electric charge in its limbs. If it loses this charge, it will spin its arms for days to recover it.
author: notsaying.

entry: The electricity it generates is weak. To absorb more energy and charge its powers, it clamps the jaws on the back of its head onto Electric-type Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME docks its head in power sockets to get energy. Within an hour, it can recharge energy worth over eight hours of sleep.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME functions as a powerful taser, a less-lethal melee weapon. It rotates its ribbon to recharge or plugs into outlets to supercharge.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's metal body is always buzzing with electricity. It discharges this electricity in devastating blade attacks.
author: bee4082

entry: Because POKENAME gets most of its energy from the electricity stored in its body, it becomes fatigued when many Joltik latch onto it. In the wild, it relies on Flying-Type Pokémon to pick them off.
author: mepp.

entry: It constantly tries to impress others with its electric powers, firing bursts of lightning from its cannon rapidly to any who would watch. Its energy constantly runs out as a result of the showboating, leaving it exhausted often.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's dark fur is constantly charged with so much static electricity that it jams signals if it is near electronic devices.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It has very little electrical prowess to generate on its own. POKENAME resorts to plugging itself into outlets and siphoning power from there in order to have enough to produce visible electricity.
author: sk372

entry: Static electricity passively builds up on POKENAME's fur, playfully shocking its Trainer by rubbing against them. It's very kindhearted and full of energy.
author: evilgammon

entry: It frequently releases shocks to assert dominance over its rivals. These discharges often leave burn marks on nearby objects.
author: .izik

entry: The shell of POKENAME is incredibly conductive, shocking those who touch it. This along with POKENAME's high weight result in a particularly dangerous headbutt.
author: mirkinator

entry: It latches onto servers to absorb their electricity, retaining any data within them. This gives it a surprising ability to mimic stored information.
author: .izik

entry: Its tail sparks constantly, sending out small shocks to those nearby. It often shocks its friends by accident while playing.
author: .izik

entry: Shy but adventurous, POKENAME love playing outdoors, rain or shine. When they are particularly overjoyed, they let loose a Stun Spore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Shy but adventurous, POKENAME love playing outdoors, rain or shine. When they are particularly overjoyed, they let loose a Stun Spore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its ears charge energy internally when retracted. In battle, POKENAME uses these extendable ears to quickly strike and shock its opponents from a distance.
author: sk372

entry: It senses nearby electronics by wiggling its sensitive nose. This ability allows it to locate hidden devices effortlessly.
author: .izik

entry: While it isn't yet adept at utilizing Electric-type moves, it nevertheless prowls fearlessly during even the most dangerous thunderstorms. If a storm does not contain thunder or lightning, however, it prefers to hide in its den.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME beats its wings rapidly to build up charge, making its horns crackle with energy. It loves chasing storms and thunderclouds, darting through the sky and leaving a trail of buzzing sparks behind.
author: potato_tub

entry: It loves curling up inside warm live wiring to sleep. The heat generated by the wires soothes it and charges its body.
author: .izik

entry: Its tail resembles a plug inside an outlet, sparking with power. It swings it wildly, sending out bursts of electricity to protect itself.
author: .izik

entry: It fills itself with any discarded wires and broken electronics it can find. When it discharges its electricity, it emits clouds of putrid smoke.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME flies at high altitudes using its clouds, which match the type of clouds around it. Whenever there is a storm, its storm clouds shoot lightning down to the ground.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It releases sharp jolts of electricity through its needles, paralyzing anything that gets too close. It frequently makes its home near powerlines.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME build up static around them that makes their topaz fur stand on edge. At night, they congregate around lamp posts to stare at the bright light.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swims through shallow marshes, using rapid electric shocks to paralyze unsuspecting prey. Its body glows faintly in murky waters, letting off an eerie glow at night.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can generate vast amounts of electricity by flapping its powerful wings, which is then processed through the horns atop its head. Once fully charged, it actively seeks out opponents to battle in order to release its stored energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME sleeps near power sources. If it is disturbed, it teleports to safety, leaving behind a dangerous electrical charge at its point of origin.
author: chorb33

entry: If you find a conspicuous piece of dented metal it may have been caused by an POKENAME. During thunderstorms, they punch metal surfaces to store electricity for later consumption.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME stores up electrical reserves in its tail, which has the appearance of a thundercloud. To intimidate foes and amplify its fighting spirit, it slaps the charged tail against the ground, which creates booming thunder.
author: sk372

entry: When overcharged, it becomes excessively magnetic, sticking to larger metal objects. This state renders it immobile until the charge dissipates.
author: .izik

entry: Flying through open windows, it steals cords from electronics to build its nest. These nests can hold up to one thousand different cords.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dislike strangers and have a hard time warming up to others. However, they love to play: this is the easiest way to have them bond with another. When excited, the gas surrounding them expands; unfortunately, the gas is a skin irritant.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An impish creature with a toxic tongue, POKENAME can cause paralysis upon contact thanks to the poisonous fluid and static electricity coating its fur. Although it loves playing pranks, it dislikes being scared and may even cry if startled.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hide in bushes low to the ground, the patterns on their hoods resembling the face of a Bulbasaur. They lure in prey with the sweet scent of nectar before coiling around them and striking with their poisonous fangs.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME'S bone is infused with deadly poison. It beats enemies with great fighting skills.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME are naturally wily creatures that prefer to fight pragmatically with wide reach. The limbs are hard to track in combat, with momentum gathered allowing them to thrash and strike like whips.
author: xillo

entry: POKENAME have recently become known for their ruthless fighting style. They will sink their fangs into their opponent, envenoming them while delivering dozens of punches per second. Opponents that try to escape are coiled in their large tails.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME makes an eerie hissing noise as it expels gases. Recent studies have found a correlation between the differing patterns on the left head and the toxicity of the gases they emit.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Due to its extremely hard body, it is difficult to move. If mud becomes stuck to its body, it will use its long neck to clean itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cannot maintain its shape well. Its cognitive processes are primarily for transforming, so its markings end up perplexing, not intimidating.
author: ziggaway

entry: It pretends to be wallets on the side of alleyways to trick kids into getting close. Once they get close, it will bite down on them with sharp fangs.
author: .izik

entry: The bristles on POKENAME's neck and tail are very sharp. Getting stung by them can send excruciating shocks throughout your entire nervous system.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The fossilized remains of POKENAME are found in some of the darkest caves in the world. The wings aren't used to fly, rather, they are used to glide from cave wall to cave wall in particularly large caverns.
author: notsaying.

entry: Staring into its eye-pattern too long causes an insufferable burning sensation in your entire body. It produces flames hot enough to vaporize rock within a matter of minutes.
author: mistymagius

entry: The markings on POKENAME's hood are highly visible on its shed skin. Its territory is often littered with discarded skins, serving as a scare tactic.
author: char_latte3412

entry: The orbs on its tail store a harsh poison; when they glow bright red, POKENAME's venomous bite is at its deadliest.
author: char_latte3412

entry: This POKENAME variant lacks the venomous potency of its relatives. However, its ability to camouflage itself in rugged terrain compensates for this.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME is exceedingly rare and can live at both high and low altitudes, on land and at sea. Its ability to see in the dark allows it to hunt at any time when its natural draconic life force requires additional energy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is most active by the seaside, particularly on foggy nights. Oral legends among sailors about a monstrous face in the dark at sea may have been about the pattern on POKENAME's wings and chest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It stalks the bottom of swamps for unsuspecting Pokémon. It can use various venoms specialized for different forms of prey.
author: schwaus

entry: Its jaws are strong enough to crush whole tires in a single chomp. The patterns on its stomach are so intimidating it can freeze small Pokémon in their tracks.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME's hood-like abdomen frightens enemies with a menacing glare. It lurks in webs, trapping prey in venomous threads and striking them with a sharp horn to inject paralyzing venom before feeding.
author: gekkou.

entry: POKENAME fly behind small prey and sink their fangs into the nape of their prey. After being subdued, POKENAME swallow their prey whole to allow their stomach acids to do most of the work.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a carnivorous predator Pokémon that sheds its feathers throughout each month. It prefers to eat the Eggs of other Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its ears are patterned to resemble large, scary eyes. This helps it scare away predators, as it's quite meek and struggles to produce strong venom.
author: hophoppip

entry: The wool on its body sparks with electricity if it gets too close to a power source. Should a person touch the wool, it can cause burns or paralysis.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME snatch young Pokémon from the forest floor to bring back to their nest. POKENAME inject a virulent venom through the nape to pacify their prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It rubs its fluff vigorously to create static electricity within its body. The orb on its tail can store vast amounts of power.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is mostly hollow. It makes a soft hissing noise as it effortlessly glides through the breeze.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases clouds of floating spores with each hiss, spreading them far and wide on the wind. If attacked, it whips its cotton-like tail to create an updraft, allowing it to glide away to safety.
author: .izik

entry: It infests rural crops, devouring all the food it finds along with its entire colony. If anyone tries to chase it away, POKENAME retaliates with terrible bites from its venomous fangs.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A common trick that older siblings like to play on their younger siblings is to tell them that the film on POKENAME is Pink Juice as they look and smell almost identical. They get a shock when they taste it, as it is very bitter, though harmless.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The tiny scales that cover its body leak a noxious poison. During hot days, more of this liquid will seep from its body than normal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is incredibly powerful when it comes to constricting things. In addition, its psychic powers allow it to predict its foe's movements. Once POKENAME has you in its sights, there is no escape.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME exudes a sweet scent from its bulb, drawing prey close to it. It then lunges at the unlucky Pokémon, swallowing them whole.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: Its fangs are incredibly sharp and hard. Ancient cultures would use these fangs in the production of weaponry.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an intimidating predator with a mesmerizing presence. The glowing mark on its chest is believed to contain ancient knowledge, which it guards fiercely.
author: jaminmcready

entry: By incorporating its telekinetic powers, it can hurl venom from its mouth over 2 miles. The venom itself ranges in effectiveness based on its diet.
author: .izik

entry: The smooth metal that covers its body has the same chemical composition as silver. Portions of it were melted down in ancient times to create coins.
author: .izik

entry: A natural predator of Fairy Types, POKENAME swiftly wraps prey before administering lethal Bullet Punches. Any who resist find it impossible to break its steel-hard scales.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It is known to show no mercy towards anyone. It scares away foes by lifting its arms up, revealing an ominous pattern.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The yellow liquid that comes from its fangs resembles honey. The scent of the fluid alone entrances prey from up to 200 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: Their semiliquid bodies take the shape of an Arbok to ward off predators, even though their bodies are pure poison. Their shells are made of obsidian, for that is the only material that does not corrode upon contact with their poisonous bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME scares away threats by displaying its brightly colored wings. It injects venom through its talons, ideal for hunting airborne targets.
author: vaporvenator

entry: Many POKENAME soar through Pokémon sanctuaries at the behest of poachers to hunt endangered Pokémon. Their talons and fangs leave shallow marks on their prey, which helps poachers maximize the value of their kill.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon is an apex predator across its range; even larger Pokémon are not safe. Their venom makes you feel as if your whole body is burning.
author: zerocipher

entry: The venom inside its fangs is a deep green color. Chefs on Pummelo Island use this venom in a potato-based dish to add flavor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME secretes a thick colourful substance from its tail tip, which it uses to paint false eyes on its hood to intimidate potential predators. The fluid is incredibly toxic and acts as another line of defence.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: It is an extremely rare Arbok that grew two heads. They will often compete with each other over who gets to devour its prey.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It is ill-advised to drink POKENAME's milk. While can provide vital nutrients to its young, it causes immediate poisoning to humans who drink it.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: A POKENAME's fangs deliver a paralytic toxin in tandem with a direct electric jolt to take down prey. The eye-like patterns on its frills can emit bright light thanks to their internal electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: Its fangs can conduct high amounts of electricity. After biting down, it will shock its opponents thoroughly to paralyze them.
author: .izik

entry: When it sweats it releases a toxic fragrance into the area. Breathing too much of this can cause migraines and blurred vision.
author: .izik

entry: The saliva that drips from its tongue is extremely poisonous. If it comes in contact with exposed skin, it can cause vivid hallucinations and sometimes paralysis.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME relies on the large face on its stomach to scare off predators. If anything gets too close, they'll snap with their venomous fangs before retreating.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME is a feared jungle predator that spends most of its time up in the treetops. It sneaks up on foes, startling them by erecting its frills before spitting acid at them.
author: mepp.

entry: Small amounts of venom leak through the ends of its sharp claws. This venom quickly evaporates shortly after being exposed to the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME inhabits bogs, slithering through water with its serpentine body and vaulting over debris with its arms. To avoid a fight, it will flex the false faces on its forearms, scaring off opponents due to the frightening pattern or its muscles.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Four massive serpentine bodies can extend out from within POKENAME's skull. Each of these limbs can coil around and crush multiple foes with frightening ease.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME will utilize their hood to scare away any possible threats. Otherwise they won't be afraid to use their tail against them.
author: k1n1t0.xo

entry: Pokémon get sick the longer they stare into its face. Others spend the rest of their lives with POKENAME's terrifying face on their mind at all times.
author: alliveir

entry: Through intense training, this Pokémon is now able to strike with the speed of a snake. The aura POKENAME wields can be used as a whip to attack foes.
author: kiddivinegon

entry: Its serpentine body moves with grace while it exudes a lethal aura. POKENAME uses its toxic aura to deter any threats and protect its territory.
author: sheogorath

entry: POKENAME sprays its prey with blinding spores to prevent escape. Once cornered, it wraps its prey with vines before dragging it back to its burrow.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon has exceptional constriction power. If luring foes in does not work, it will give chase by riding its snake-like appendage.
author: mossybanana

entry: The various heads of this fusion snap at anything that comes near them. Some believe that POKENAME will petrify you if it looks you right in the eye.
author: chorb33

entry: The bright coloration on POKENAME's chest and ears warns other Pokémon of its lethal venom. It sees in infrared and can feel potential prey's movements through the ground. Any that try to escape are held fast by a boulder-crushing tail.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's horn and tail are coated in a powerful poison that easily incapacitates its foes. It hunts under the cover of night, taking out its prey before they can react.
author: mistymagius

entry: It feeds on those who succumb to its poisoned fruit. It only ever moves to relocate once people catch on to its trick.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: POKENAME take care of many Nidoran within their nest and are in charge of helping the baby Pokémon learn how to hunt. The pattern on their stomachs causes prey to freeze in their tracks out of fear, which gives the Nidoran an easy shot at hunting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use their strong tails to hang from tree branches to avoid foes and to scout for food or prey. They can balance perfectly on their tails at any moment, allowing them to mix up their physical strikes in unpredictable ways.
author: infinex21

entry: Its unusually curved shape lets it dig into the recesses of trees and inject its poison into their trunks. Pokémon that live in trees poisoned by POKENAME become weakened, making for easier prey.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Stunted in its development and never growing a hood, POKENAME compensated by learning the way of the sword, an arguably more intimidating sight.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME has grown deadly venom vessels in its blade. It also distracts opponents from its true eye with its fake ribbon face.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: One small cut from POKENAME can fell a dragon. Its blade is magically enchanted to constantly produce poison.
author: arch.stanton

entry: POKENAME is a dangerous creature that can paralyze foes with the giant eye-like patterns on its wings. Its venomous fangs grow stronger each time it drinks from tainted pools or contaminated water.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The brightly colored patterns on its chest warn predators of its highly toxic venom. A single bite can leave a target unable to move.
author: melodydelune

entry: A menacing pattern on its abdomen is used to intimidate rival POKENAME during battles for territorial dominance. Its bite is extremely dangerous since its fangs are coated in a toxin capable of paralyzing the nervous system within seconds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A menacing pattern on its abdomen is used to intimidate rival POKENAME during battles for territorial dominance. Its bite is extremely dangerous since its fangs are coated in a toxin capable of paralyzing the nervous system within seconds.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It defeats opposing Pokémon by binding and leeching out their essence. When it needs an extra boost, a Binding Band is used to help increase its grip strength.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Those who gaze upon the pattern on POKENAME's hood will instantly suffer from a deadly poison. Even after death, their hood remains dangerous.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME winds its two tails around beams or drainpipes in abandoned buildings. Anyone passing underneath it is roasted by a flame from its maw.
author: chorb33

entry: When it spreads its broad wings, POKENAME terrifies foes by revealing the eye-like patterns on its dark feathers. It dives with its streamlined body to sink its serpentine fangs, dripping with deadly venom, into its prey.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have multiple stomachs for each of their heads, which can dislocate and open wide to swallow prey whole. Their stomachs are filled with a corrosive acid that can melt through most substances.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Like Hydreigon, its many tails are false heads. If one of the "heads" touches something they all wrap around it, giving POKENAME a chance to attack.
author: spookoftheoldways

entry: POKENAME cause feelings of dread to all who look upon it. Its snake-like tails seem to have minds of their own, all just as vindictive as the body.
author: pokepower

entry: Play the right flute music, and POKENAME will grant you a wish. If the wish's wording isn't exact, it will twist the words for its own amusement.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its arms to swing from trees as well as to constrict and crush prey. It throws the crushed prey into the distance so it can chase after them and burn off excess energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bites with venomous fangs before stalking its prey until they collapse. It finishes off weakened foes with a powerful electric shock.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's wings contain patterns resembling eyes, which are known to frighten predators. Along with its venom, it also uses the ear-piercing vibrations from the wings to hunt its prey.
author: lemage22

entry: While the cogs turn, a hissing sound can be heard instead of the normal clinking of metal. The cogs turn slower during the colder months.
author: .izik

entry: When it becomes very angry, even the colorful patterns on its belly shine as if they were blazing flames. Its teeth produce a highly toxic venom as black as coal.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite their small size, POKENAME is a dangerous predator thanks to its venom. The patterns on its body dissuade bigger Pokémon from picking a fight.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME floats down close to prey before spewing a toxic mist from the opening at its bottom. As its prey reels from the poison, it grabs them with its powerful constricting tendrils and carries them back to its den.
author: sk372

entry: Those who dare to wander into dark caves unprepared may find themselves suddenly constricted by POKENAME. It seems it has a second sense for species that cannot see in the dark.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's poison is not yet potent enough, so it relies more on its jaws. They can patiently wait for their prey for hours.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME's fangs contain no venom. Instead, all the venom secretes from its mouth and eye markings; its real eyes are on top.
author: crumple_2

entry: POKENAME shed their scales every month to give room to a new set of scales underneath. The length of each band indicates how well they kept themselves fed, as a short band indicates a time of famine, while a long band indicates that they ate well.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It drools from its open mouth while it flies. This saliva is extremely viscous and acidic.
author: .izik

entry: The frills of these Pokémon bear intimidating markings that they seemingly use to startle predators and prey alike. While their foe is stunned, they will sink their fangs into them and deliver a potent poison into their bodies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME no longer use the patterns on their frills to intimidate, instead using them to entrance prey. They can extend their necks to catch foes off guard as they latch their jaws onto them.
author: infinex21

entry: They are able to take down Pokémon much larger than themselves by clenching down with their powerful jaws to ensure they can't be dislodged. They then use their envenomed fangs to inject poison into the prey's bloodstream.
author: joeofthealps

entry: They can move at speeds of up to 80 mph in sand, and even a drop of their poison can be lethal. Schools of them hunt by using their incredible speed to whip up sandstorms, then ambushing their prey in the confusion.
author: joeofthealps

entry: The saliva that comes out of its mouth smells like lemons, and there are home remedies created that rely on it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raise their wings and amplify their piercing cries to appear even larger than they already are, paralyzing foes with fear. They coil their tails around their disoriented prey and lift them off, never to be seen again.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its second head acts like a hand, gripping onto its prey. POKENAME's poisonous powder can be deadly if caution is not taken.
author: imagine1.

entry: The stitching on its body changes patterns based on its mood. The fangs on its mouth have the consistency of sewing needles.
author: .izik

entry: A mean Arbok tore down a sand castle that happened to be a Palossand. Now they work together for one cause.
author: themicelegion

entry: Generally found sunning itself on top of boulders, POKENAME only strike when the unwary stumble over their tail. Their bite contains enough venom to drop a Wailord, and any who remain standing suffer constriction by rough rock-hard scales.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It stares at its opponents from far away to cause unease. It refuses to move until it has to, not even taking a breath.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scavenge bones across the savannah, and their unremarkable abilities cause them to be ignored. Their poison is slow-acting, as they must gnaw on bones for upwards of a week before they can chew and swallow their meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A master of poisonous shadowplay, POKENAME sneaks up on unassuming prey with the grace of a ninja. The snake head then locks its jaw on the prey and will not let go until the bitten are incapacitated.
author: mrdunklestein

entry: Known to fight dirty, POKENAME relies on a variety of underhanded tactics in battle. It uses its serpent-like tongue to immobilize foes with a paralyzing Glare while weaving around them in rapid bursts, launching a relentless flurry of Poison Stings.
author: theartemis1

entry: The scales on the wings of an POKENAME were once used in Cerulean City to create charms for jewelry. These charms were said to bring luck with love.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME manages to catch prey with its long tail, it tries to scorch it with the flames burning at the tip to weaken it even further. It builds its den in mountain caves and attacks anyone who dares enter its territory without permission.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While digging through deserts, POKENAME emits loud hissing sounds. The noise often alerts prey above ground, allowing escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME digs at extreme speeds when hunting prey. It bites with serrated, venom-filled fangs before dragging victims underground in seconds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an apex predator that sinks its venomous fangs into prey before roasting them with blazing flames. It lives atop cliffs of mountains where few Trainers venture.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's favorite exercise is curl-ups. Those who stare too long at the markings on its chest grow incredibly weary.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's forked tongue darts out of its mouth, allowing it to sense emotions in its surroundings. It hypnotizes foes with a flick of its tail before striking with deadly precision.
author: .izik

entry: By using its psychic abilities, it can make a terrifying hissing noise. The sound can only be heard in a person's mind.
author: .izik

entry: In the early morning, an POKENAME will jog up the steepest hill it can find. It can lift boulders with its tail with great ease.
author: .izik

entry: The venom it excretes can be boiled down to a thick paste. The paste itself can be combined with other chemicals to create lubricant for car engines.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grapple and wrap up prey with every part of their body. They have the strength to crush a car into a sphere only a few inches in diameter.
author: pokepower

entry: Despite its fierce appearance, POKENAME is very timid. Its belly bears markings that resemble a frightening face, which it uses to intimidate others and stay safe. Each individual has a unique pattern that sets it apart from the rest of its species.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It swings silently from tree limbs deep within the jungle. If it spots a traveler below, it will dump a thick acid from its body onto them.
author: .izik

entry: It brings up stomach acid to dissolve prey, then consumes the sludge. Food makes the acid stronger, so it seeks bigger meals all through the day.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in rugged, rock-like scales that make it nearly impervious to attacks. When threatened, it coils up and rolls downhill at terrifying speeds, crushing anything in its path.
author: .izik

entry: The venom that comes from its fangs is very unstable. If the fluid comes into contact with an enemy, it will combust.
author: .izik

entry: It uses the glowing face on its neck to terrify its prey, particularly at night. If its target tries to run away, it chases them down without fail.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME have fluffy tails that help distract prey from their large fangs. They dip their tails into water to ensure they stay clean.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It unintentionally pulls objects towards it with its magnets. If it becomes stuck to something it dislikes, it will screech and spin.
author: .izik

entry: One head transfixes prey with the pattern on its hood while the other strikes. It then constricts its prey and runs, carrying it off at over 60 mph.
author: knilk

entry: By using its long legs, it has the ability to wade through ponds with ease. This is primarily useful when hunting prey or evading larger predators.
author: .izik

entry: The markings on the stomach of POKENAME intimidate others and keep them safe. These unique markings are different for every POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have large stomachs that can digest eggs with their powerful stomach acids. The markings on their stomach intimidate prey into freezing up in fear, giving them the opportunity to bite prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The number of segments on POKENAME's tail indicates its age, while the markings across the bottom of its shell indicates the Arbok half's place of birth. POKENAME can fire highly pressurized sludge from the limbs in its shell.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a feared predator of coastal caves and islands, taking down any foe with a barrage of bites. Recent archaeological expeditions in Hoenn have unearthed ancient statues that look strikingly similar to POKENAME.
author: mepp.

entry: It can fire an acidic mucus from its mouth with great precision. It can hit a stationary target with great accuracy from up to 300 feet away.
author: .izik

entry: When deep beneath the earth, intense pressures fuse POKENAME's unused venom into an amber-like crystal. These gems add a frightening glimmer to its large false eyes.
author: robosoup

entry: The patterns on POKENAME's collar shift and swirl hypnotically, entrancing prey before it strikes. Its pendulum allows it to look into its opponent's mind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME surfaces only to hunt prey that wander onto the shore, otherwise, it prefers to swim just below the water's surface. Its claws are tipped with venomous fangs used to weaken its victims.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's long tongue is hotter than an oven. It can cook food instantly just by wrapping its tongue around it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in tropical saltwater environments. Due to their bright colors, they are popular in aquariums; however, they possess an extremely high body heat, so the water must have excellent temperature control to house other types of Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live in tropical saltwater environments. Due to their bright colors, they are popular in aquariums; however, they possess an extremely high body heat, so the water must have excellent temperature control to house other types of Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It produces a thick smog whenever it is in danger, which smells like a fresh clementine being bitten. This scent draws in other Pokémon so that they swarm and overwhelm predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When feeling vexed, POKENAME often tugs its own ears out of frustration. This reflexively triggers its flame breath, which often leads to further problems as things get accidentally set ablaze.
author: sk372

entry: Perching in Jaboca Berry trees, POKENAME toasts berries with tiny flame jets. It catches the roasted fruit before it falls.
author: .izik

entry: During a full moon, POKENAME's flames burn five times brighter. Entire fields can glow softly from its light on clear nights.
author: .izik

entry: They incubate in lava pools before hatching. A hug from a POKENAME is known to be extremely comforting, as the gentle warmth that radiates from POKENAME's rocky shell perfectly mimics the feeling of embracing a loved one.
author: joeofthealps

entry: POKENAME skims low across bodies of water, leaving shimmering trails of heated air behind it as it speeds by. It knocks prey like Ledian out of the sky with its Ember attack.
author: .izik

entry: Despite living in wetlands, POKENAME only thrive in healthy ecosystems. If water quality is starved of oxygen or otherwise poor, they expel a black goo to remove toxins from their bodies, but releasing too much can cause them to choke on it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are most commonly found on the rocky base of volcanoes spitting fire. The color of the flame can be used to predict an approaching eruption.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: If disturbed while resting in cedar trees, POKENAME explodes in a fiery burst. The sudden blast leaves scorched bark behind.
author: .izik

entry: It relies on its claws and beak to hunt for roots, as the embers it produces are weak and transient. However, when given a spicy Chili Sauce, it is able to light bonfires with a burst of flame.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When angered, POKENAME's fur radiates intense heat. Snow around it melts rapidly, leaving steaming puddles in its path.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its fiery body, POKENAME prefers to live in icy caves. The cold surroundings help balance its intense internal heat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's right side radiates intense heat, while only the left can channel electricity. It must balance its attacks carefully to avoid exhaustion mid-battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tend to be found most often in areas with lower oxygen levels as long as other Pokémon are also found in there. They sustain themselves on minerals and emotional energy. In cold areas, they willingly act like a space heather for others.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its scale colors reflect its body temperature, ranging from a pale yellow to a bright magenta in extreme cases. It lives near lava pools; its scales change color to reflect the surrounding lava.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live within volcanic mountain ranges and can be found within lava tubes. They enjoy the intense heat within their homes and battle with one another to have the right to nest in the warmest spots.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME launches fiery projectiles by stretching its elastic cord with its scarf-like appendage. It is rarely seen in the wild, but tends to be found in demolished buildings where its explosive antics are less threatening.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME spits bursts of flame before slashing rapidly with its bladed arms. It moves in a zigzag to confuse and trap prey.
author: .izik

entry: When it sleeps, POKENAME emits puffs of fire from its nose every time it exhales, so it must be careful to find a place to sleep far away from trees or bushes. Since its body is always very warm, it can rest without struggles in any environment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's warmth and light weight make it popular to gently toss from friend to friend in a circle as a party game. Being too rough while playing with POKENAME, however, may result in serious burns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rests in poppy fields, absorbing sunlight. The more energy it gathers, the hotter and more explosive its fire attacks become.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME buries itself in halfway into the desert sand to absorb the sun's heat. By dusk, it's ready to channel this energy into devastating fire attacks.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME is in danger, it drops from the ceiling and cushions the fall with its soft head, uncontrollably emitting small flames from its mouth.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME secretes strands of molten silk from its mouth. It uses this hot silk to trap and scorch unwary prey.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME hides in piles of rocks and catches prey by spitting gouts of flame at small Pokémon. Its body is constantly warm and it has a good temper, so some Trainers use their POKENAME as a heating pad to incubate eggs.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME unleashes bursts of fire to carve out dens within glaciers. These tunnels are extremely smooth and hard to navigate by anyone other than its kin due to how slippery they become.
author: .izik

entry: It can spit flames from both its mouth and crown. Some POKENAME like to drift in oases, where their heat creates huge clouds of steam.
author: chorb33

entry: It can spit flames from both its mouth and crown. Some POKENAME like to drift in oases, where their heat creates huge clouds of steam.
author: chorb33

entry: When overheated, POKENAME cools itself by sinking into ponds. Steam often rises around it as the water hisses against its skin.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are kept backstage during rock shows to produce bubbles full of smoke. They spray water to pop their own bubbles when it is time to create a smoky mystique around the lead singer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite creating lots of smoke, POKENAME need a constant flow of fresh air to breathe properly. If they breathe in their own fumes for too long, they may develop a headache or even pass out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Steam rises from POKENAME's head when it is suffering from a particularly strong migraine. When the pain finally subsides, it exhales a thick cloud of dark smoke in relief.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon releases scalding steam with every movement. Preferring hot, humid environments, it can often be found basking in hot springs. Hot spring owners sometimes train POKENAME to help maintain the perfect temperature in their saunas.
author: khane048

entry: POKENAME wields a staff that channels its fire abilities. It grips the staff tightly in its beak while soaring through the air.
author: .izik

entry: Primarily found in volcanic craters, POKENAME resembles a will-o-wisp. This Pokémon is a trickster by nature, scaring others off by shooting embers out of its mouth and nose.
author: princessmilandria

entry: From the moment of birth, POKENAME has a storage of its mother's milk on its back. It is too young to be able to produce its own milk just yet.
author: milchik

entry: It often struggles to roll due to the udder on its head. This often causes POKENAME to resent its udder.
author: sohbetveoyun

entry: It learned to walk on its udder through evolution. The exact reason is unknown, but it is often reported to be much happier.
author: sohbetveoyun

entry: POKENAME love drinking milk so much that they often spill milk over themselves in their haste to drink it all. No matter what anyone says, they will continue to cry over their spilt milk.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can produce up to five gallons of milk per day. It will spew this milk in all directions at the slightest stimulation.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME excretes a cream-like coating which hardens into a glassy shell. Once it emerges, its leftover cocoon is considered a delicacy.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Being able to produce both milk and eggs, POKENAME is a favorite on farms. They don't give either when caring for young, so some Trainers try to keep them from breeding.
author: aberry8286

entry: Enormous swathes of POKENAME can be seen migrating to colder climates in the summer. If left behind in the heat, their fragile wings would melt.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The sheer amount of udders on POKENAME's body makes its body wrinkled and deformed, but also allows it to shoot high pressure milk as a means of propulsion.
author: gengarfromfnaf

entry: Although POKENAME produces more milk overall than Miltank, the milk is thicker and has a stronger taste, resulting in it being less popular.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: When POKENAME is created, it will try to beg its creator to unfuse them. If they refuse, it will only get sadder.
author: signal8

entry: While POKENAME can output enormous amounts of milk, it also requires an exorbitant amount of food to stay healthy, and can only be realistically milked outside of battle a few times a year. Its milk has different flavors based on the Berries it eats.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It attacks by biting and bashing opponents with its spherical tail. Its milk-producing organs aren't fully grown yet, so it cannot make milk.
author: themicelegion

entry: Berries gathered by POKENAME directly affect the taste and texture of its milk. Farmers often feed it different fruits to create specialty flavors.
author: .izik

entry: Raising POKENAME is a finicky process, as it must be milked at a strict time every day or become agitated. However, trying to milk it any other time will cause it to become even more incensed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often shares its milk with small and young insect Pokémon like Caterpie and Wurmple to help their growth. It uses its many fists to swat away at anything trying to pick them off while it feeds them.
author: sk372

entry: Cottage cheese made from milk produced by POKENAME was once used in prophetic rituals. Legends say consuming it could grant fleeting glimpses of the future.
author: .izik

entry: The coat of POKENAME has a luxurious and smooth texture akin to whipped cream. Many farmers raise it for its tasty milk.
author: mepp.

entry: Its arms are strong enough to hold large buckets of milk. It keeps its young well-fed to keep them from crying.
author: birchbot

entry: The milk it produces is flavorful, if not very nutritional.  In an amusing loop of events, POKENAME milk is often used for the creation of its favorite brand of cheese to snack on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME runs around all day, full of energy. Eventually, when it gets tired, it takes a quick milk drink and goes right back to dashing around.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME look like a can of condensed Moomoo Milk that has a sprout coming out of the can. They produce a sweet and dense milk that pairs perfectly with both coffee and tea.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The orifices on the side of POKENAME's head are constantly leaking, with the liquid dribbling down its body and hydrating its skin. Other Pokémon sometimes suck on this while POKENAME is sleeping, causing it to wake in confusion.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: This Pokémon's diet consists of the deadliest plants. Because of it, its milk is poisonous to any creature but its own kind.
author: milchik

entry: Though it feeds on discarded scraps, POKENAME produces exceptionally nutritious milk. Its natural resilience is reflected in the milk's dense vitamin content.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME moos eerily as it drifts through the night sky. Some cultures say its milk brings ancestral visions when consumed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's back half appears liquid, yet is actually simply just coated with viscous milk from not being milked enough. The tail proves very affectionate if cleansed of its gooey layer of coating.
author: sk372

entry: Each scale on POKENAME can produce milk that has a slight nutty flavor. Their milk is made into a special cheese that Bug-type Pokémon like to eat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It releases the milk stored within its body by spinning at a high pace. It is capable of storing up to 90 gallons at a time.
author: seggule

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME's milk was used as a natural antivenom. It's believed the milk neutralized common toxins when consumed fresh.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME overeats, it struggles to stay airborne due to milk buildup in its body. It must fast to regain flight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rescues lost people and offers them milk to regain their strength. It is an extremely docile creature and very easy to raise, which is why it is very common on farms and in agritourism establishments.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME produce small quantities of rich milk that are sweetened from their diet of honey. Industrial scale farming has yet to replicate the complex flavor of POKENAME milk.
author: quackquackattack

entry: At first glance, it appears to lack milk. Close inspection reveals an extremely slow trickle at the end of each feather, allowing it to hydrate itself after long or arduous flights.
author: sk372

entry: They're usually seen running around with a large jar of milk, searching bakeries and grocery stores for the perfect cookie for their milk.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME may seem like another Houndour, but the splotches of pink on their fur and their small horns distinguish them from others in their pack. Their bulky physique allows them to soak up many attacks from predators before fainting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Docile and friendly, POKENAME are a common sight on farms alongside their Miltank brethren. The milk it produces is a less sweet and less fattening alternative to the usual fare.
author: sk372

entry: To mark its territory, POKENAME will ooze milk from the tip of its tail. The fermenting of the milk turns it into a pungent yogurt.
author: theradrad

entry: With a short stature and soft limbs, it does not pack as much of a punch as it would like to. To compensate, it learned to incorporate its horn and tail into its training and fighting style.
author: sk372

entry: It is one of few reptilians known to nurse its young. If it is upset, its toxins could accidentally kill its nest.
author: theradrad

entry: This Miltank's milk production has increased tenfold. However, it cannot reach most of its own udders, so its Milk Drink doesn't recover any extra vitality.
author: kiwikelly

entry: The fusion process has scrambled this Miltank's DNA. It can now only drink the milk that dribbles onto its face.
author: kiwikelly

entry: The tail of a POKENAME is filled with nutritious milk. While it needs this milk to evolve, POKENAME can fire it at enemies as a defense mechanism.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It loves to drink Moo-Moo Milk, drinking numerous bottles a day despite its size. When it spills a bottle of Moo-Moo Milk, it reacts by crying.
author: hophoppip

entry: In the rare cases where POKENAME does produce milk, it lacks any real nutritional value. Many farmers dislike raising POKENAME as it needs tons of food to stay content, even when it evolves.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's drool is said to be the richest of all milk. POKENAME attempts to use its drool to style its hair, with only a moderate success rate.
author: wbmznrxo

entry: Its limbs are inflated by a seemingly endless supply of viscous milk produced somewhere deep within. It leaves a slippery trail wherever it goes.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME is mostly docile by nature, but won't hesitate to come to the aid of smaller Pokémon being picked on. It fires scalding hot milk from its arms to burn and repel aggressors, before gently nursing the victims to health.
author: sk372

entry: It seeks out people who are suffering emotionally and comforts them. The warm milk it produces is a great sleep remedy.
author: seggule

entry: The substance that drips down from POKENAME's tail is not milk, but a unique sap. This sap is quite nutritious and sweet, with gourmands noting its rich earthy and floral notes.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's milk is a staple ingredient in spicy ice cream. These fiery treats are especially popular during summer festivals.
author: .izik

entry: Their greatest skill is cheesemaking. Many of the gourmet varieties of cheese popular across Kalos were cultivated by discerning POKENAME.
author: quote.lass

entry: POKENAME are commonly found on dairy farms. They would give their lives to protect the herds of Miltank they tend to.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its color-changing ability remains intact, but instead of changing with its emotions or for camouflage, it represents its milk levels. POKENAME in desperate need of milking turn a violent shade of red.
author: sk372

entry: It propels itself backwards by constantly blasting milk from its arms. Once it runs out of milk, it crashes to the ground and has to recharge.
author: seggule

entry: As a POKENAME grows older, its hump takes a shape of an udder. It feeds its nutritious but poisonous milk to its young, who are immune to it.
author: milchik

entry: Though it does not produce milk itself, many farmers include a POKENAME alongside Miltank in their herds. POKENAME acts as both protective guard and friend, and is treated like a big sister by the Miltank.
author: alestrius

entry: This Pokémon has two sets of udders for double the milk output. However, because POKENAME's diet consists mainly of poisonous plants and mushrooms, this milk is too hazardous for human consumption.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME synthesizes its milk from the dreams of orphans, which it consumes every night. Once they are satisfied with the milk of a childs dream, it will devour the child whole.
author: gengarfromfnaf

entry: Few have managed to sample the milk from POKENAME's ring, which is said to be a type of divine ambrosia. Supposedly, the milk is so nutritious that drinking it once will keep a person from getting sick for a year.
author: sk372

entry: A lick of this solidified milk blade is delicious and filling. A bite, however, will cause retaliation, and a cut from it will cause a stomach ache.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Known for its potent venom and abundant milk, POKENAME fiercely defends its young. Its back bristles with sharp barbs, ready to deter any threat.
author: anarchaz

entry: The bells at the end of POKENAME's ribbons produce a delightful chime when shaken. Miltank are drawn to the sound, so many farms use POKENAME to assist in herding them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME may appear friendly, but it's irreverently violent. Its milk and wings actually consist of sinful souls who were banished from this world.
author: milchik

entry: Legends say that it enters bedrooms late at night to give people milk-induced nightmares. Lactose intolerant people are considered high priority targets.
author: seggule

entry: It produces 5 gallons of milk an hour and can store up to 900 gallons in its tail. Once a week, it disposes the milk into a hole in the ground, creating a lake of milk.
author: seggule

entry: A milky fragrance exudes from its tail. When a POKENAME is angered, this smell changes to that of sour milk.
author: hophoppip

entry: The contents within its coffin are preserved in fermented milk. An empty POKENAME coffin was once stolen from a museum by a suspicious crew who entered through the vents.
author: seggule

entry: Wild POKENAME allow their tiny offspring to drink plentifully of the milk they secrete from the udder atop their abdomen. Any who try to forcefully drink of this milk will be met with a tongue-numbing electrical shock.
author: infinex21

entry: When in danger, POKENAME sprays scalding-hot milk on its attackers, causing severe burns. Due to how fast it can heat up its milk, POKENAME are quite helpful in cooking.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are loyal and hard-working companions. They harvest crops and pull weeds from gardens.
author: dodoowner_

entry: To humans, these Pokémon have disturbingly long udders that often drip with milk. But, to young wild Pokémon, these long udders are a welcome sight when they have grown hungry.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has appeared in various commercials from a popular dairy company as their mascot, even getting merchandise. This fusion single-handedly has given the company a fair ammount of popularity.
author: mar989

entry: POKENAME snacks on the roots of fruit trees, altering its milk's texture and color. Each type of tree imparts a unique hue to the milk.
author: .izik

entry: Cheese made from POKENAME's milk increases melatonin in those who eat it. It is commonly eaten before bed for restful sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produces milk rich in iron, giving it a faint metallic taste. It's often used in supplements rather than cooking.
author: .izik

entry: The milk from POKENAME is blended with peppers to make a popular spicy cheese. Its fiery flavor is prized in regional dishes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME achieves flight via inflating its udders to lift it off the ground.  Its movement is slow, and should something bump into the udder it will burst, spreading milk all across the area as POKENAME plummets to the ground.
author: sk372

entry: Although POKENAME naturally has organs that act as filtration systems from any harmful materials, the flavor of POKENAME's milk varies heavily based on whatever species' blood it has recently feasted on; like Zubat, POKENAME has a sanguivorous diet.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's milk boosts its agility, allowing its heavy body to move more smoothly by spewing it at high speeds. Its upper half is harder than iron, while the lower remains soft.
author: .izik

entry: It is a delicacy in some regions. Due to an unforeseen mutation during the fusion process of POKENAME, it produces cheese in place of milk.
author: forbiddenbread

entry: POKENAME has multiple milk glands underneath its carapace which it will spray at its attacker through its spines. As POKENAME rolls around, the milk eventually turns into a rich cream.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its tail, jaw and frill all drip a creamy and viscous milk-like substance. Fossil Pokémon in particular are attracted to the flavor, so POKENAME often amasses a small entourage of followers looking for a taste.
author: sk372

entry: Unlike it's Froslass counterpart, POKENAME loves to help lost travelers. It gives them a hot glass of milk and guides them back to civilization.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It dances with quick, frenzied movements. After a particularly spirited dance, the milk it produces from its udder will be churned into buttermilk.
author: hophoppip

entry: It waves its arms about to cheer on its allies. The cream it carries becomes whipped as it gathers air from these waving dances.
author: hophoppip

entry: The clouds that make up POKENAME's wings will precipitate under specific conditions. Instead of water, however, these clouds will rain milk.
author: gp423
