entry: Burying itself beneath the sand, POKENAME camouflages itself to unexpectedly leap out and attack its opponent, raising large clouds of dust.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME use their diamond-like talons to climb and dig burrows in the sides of canyon walls. Their long, flowing hair is incredibly coarse and sharp, similar to fiberglass.
author: kingd8

entry: Infamously brutal Dragon-type hunters, POKENAME start an assault using Ancient Power, clipping their prey's wings. Once grounded, they pounce, sapping the dragon's energy by feeding off its life force.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The shadow behind POKENAME is actually a psychically-contained black hole. Anything the darkness envelops will disappear forever.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: Coated head to toe in sharp spikes, this Pokémon boasts impressive physical power and defensive strength. Though its bulky hide makes it slow, it compensates by ambushing prey from underground.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME uses its jaws to tear chunks of rock out of mountainous terrain to create a cave. Intruders are met with fury and rage before being devoured.
author: hummusishome

entry: POKENAME knows nothing else but to smash its rocky head into anything directly in front of it. Entire mountain ranges have lost to this Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: Sand spews from all of the orifices on its lower body. In battle, it whips this cursed sand into a harsh sandstorm.
author: moopse

entry: To hides its appearance and disappearance, POKENAME creates sandstorms through the endlessly-generating ring of sand around its torso. If it wished, POKENAME could cover an entire region in a massive sandstorm.
author: sk372

entry: It has a cold and ruthless personality, and is surprisingly naturally adept at incorporating tactical strategy into fights, such as using the environment to its advantage. It lives by rocky river valleys.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Wild POKENAME can be seen living in abandoned mine shafts, disassembling minecart tracks to build their nests. Their armored hide allows them to withstand explosive demolitions set off by miners unscathed.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME resides in ancient ruins on high, steep mountains. According to myth, it used to protect treasures and kidnap princesses.
author: garret95

entry: POKENAME's power is cataclysmic. A single step can cause mountains to shatter or earth to sprout out of the sea. The overflowing torrent of magma it can spew from its mouth could create entire regions in mere days.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An apex Pokémon, POKENAME stalks its wasteland home in the certainty that there is nothing that can challenge it. Pokémon researchers trying to learn its behaviors need to remain wary as it aggressively chases down anything in its territory.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME were stationed in the tombs of the most revered of ancient kings to watch over their possessions. Graverobbers that foolishly thought to steal would be buried beneath POKENAME's endlessly-spawning limbs of sand.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has fierce territorial instincts yet is hampered by limited vision. To even its playing field, it kicks dirt into opponents' eyes, leaving them more vulnerable to its powerful thrashing.
author: sk372

entry: In the past, POKENAME were trained to guard shrines from would-be thieves. The holes on their chest plate serve to vent heat from within their body and echo their mighty roar for several miles.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can create projectile orbs that burst into intensely raging sandstorms. Research has shown that despite appearing like normal sand, the material of the storms is a mineral not of this planet.
author: sk372

entry: The material that makes up the majority of POKENAME's skull is incredibly hard and resilient. A single headbutt is enough to nearly shatter a solid steel beam.
author: sk372

entry: Powerful and haughty, POKENAME bullies others in its territory, trying to establish itself as the top of the hierarchy. It inevitably winds up picking on something much stronger than itself and learning a harsh lesson.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tough stony plating protects it from attacks. This Pokémon is known to be quick to anger, thrashing about uncontrollably until it settles down.
author: mepp.

entry: With the tough hide on their wings, POKENAME can fly in nearly any environment. They usually make their nests in mountaintops, carving a cave just for them and guarding it fiercely.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME is made up of loose layers of rough skin. How it holds itself together is unknown.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's body is filled with sand from the environment. If there is none nearby, it'll tear up the matter around it to make some.
author: ohok3441

entry: In its claws, POKENAME has the speed to cleave seawater, or even air, in two. In its body, it has the power to crumble a mountain. Combined, POKENAME cannot be stopped.
author: exc_sanguine_wes/xs_wes

entry: POKENAME lives deep underground, the extreme pressure transforming its rocky body into diamonds. Its diamonds are basically indestructible, effortlessly shrugging off any sort of attack.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is extremely territorial. They often sharpen their claws on large boulders to mark its domain to intruders. Hikers are warned to keep an eye out for scratched boulders to avoid unintended encounters with this Pokémon.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME meditates beneath the harsh sun, drawing strength from heat and dust alike. At full power, its mind can ripple the desert surface like water.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Called the "General of the Sands", a lone POKENAME once held off an army by using a sandstorm as cover and turning the sand to glass with its breath.
author: therider

entry: POKENAME is an excellent aerial fighter. Despite its body being covered in a heavy armor of solid rock, its wings are powerful enough to let it soar through the skies with ease. It unleashes sandstorms to disorient foes before striking them down.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME formulates spoons out of tightly-packed sand using its psychic powers. Possessing these spoons helps it focus its mind and temper; without them, it would lose its mind to rage and create a devastating psychic cataclysm around it.
author: sk372

entry: Some say POKENAME makes its armor out of crashed meteorites. If its armor was ever removed it would be able to punch at full power and level a mountain range.
author: ghostslythe

entry: A mighty muscular behemoth of a Pokémon, POKENAME's four arms can pummel a mountain to dust in minutes, before creating a massive sandstorm with the remaining rubble.
author: sk372

entry: The sandy scales of POKENAME are tightly packed and impenetrable to most attacks. In battle it can burst its scales into a massive sandstorm to obscure vision, making it easier to charge down and crush its foes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have bodies as hard and heavy as solid rock, yet their legs are strong enough to carry them for hours before they need to rest. They can release flames from the openings along their bodies to further overpower and intimidate opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME kicks up huge sandstorms as it races across the desert. Its three heads are only at peace when chasing intruders in its territory.
author: _aphoric

entry: POKENAME hunts by conjuring up blinding sandstorms that trap its victims completely. Hikers say nothing is more terrifying than seeing POKENAME's demonic grin appearing from within the walls of whirling sand.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known to target colonies of Krabby to start fights with their Kinglers. If the Kinglers lose, then POKENAME begins to rule as a tyrant.
author: codewolfie

entry: POKENAME's fists strike with enough force to create powerful gusts of wind. Its most iconic technique is an uppercut that sends its foe flying within a tornado its fist generates.
author: sk372

entry: Several ancient civilizations depict POKENAME as some type of celestial deity, feared and revered for its appearance and powers. Its six wings can whip up gale-force winds and crackling storm clouds in mere seconds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has the power to create torrential storms and devastating whirlpools. However, its small brain prevents this Pokémon from reaching its full potential.
author: princess_lucina

entry: Now fully evolved, POKENAME can use its powers to its fullest extent. However, now the Pokémon is filled with uncontrollable rage, making it hard for Trainers to rein it in and fully control it in battle.
author: princess_lucina

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time sleeping peacefully at the bottom of the sea. If awoken from its slumber, it creates swirling whirlpools all around it in a grumpy fit.
author: sk372

entry: A brilliantly-colored Pokémon which will eagerly approach any Trainer that manages to play its favorite toy drum. This magnificent creature will carry you around as it flies across the globe, but only once you earn its trust and respect.
author: jackster

entry: By waving the wing-like appendage on its head, POKENAME creates strong gusts of wind. It uses this ability to knock berries from trees and trip up foes. If it doesn't plant itself firmly in the ground, it may blow itself backwards by accident.
author: chibitales

entry: As a youngling, POKENAME is only capable of blowing gusts of wind at 12 mph. It is very impressionable, and it sometimes uses its psychic powers to repeat words it hears from humans.
author: princess_lucina

entry: Packed with potential, this tiny Pokémon is capable of producing gale-force winds crackling with electricity. POKENAME's storms are so powerful that it easily blows its lightweight body back from the force of the wind it generates.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a petulant personality and won't hesitate to loudly bawl if it is displeased in any way. As it cries, powerful winds whip about it and begin forming tiny storms and tornadoes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is thought to be a friendly visitor from somewhere deep in space. It's known to have a gargantuan appetite, and creates a strong burst of energy after gorging itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are only spotted in Paldea after a long, dangerous flood. Others say this is only a myth, though.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Its liquid body retains its shape even underwater. POKENAME makes its home in geothermal vents on the ocean floor, where it pierces the darkness of the deep with its glowing belly.
author: griddle

entry: Its dark coloration and red eyes is said to be the result of exposure to rare energy waves. The phenomenon was first recorded in the Orre region.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME can cause powerful storms in the seas it flies above. The lightning and wind caused by these storms can tear apart civilian ships, but fortunately, it avoids this when possible and has not been confirmed to cause any incidents.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: It was once written that the bond between Lugia and Ho-Oh was so strong that it was like they were one Pokémon. Although most historical studies disagree with this interpretation, some believe they were once one being that eventually split: POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It was once written that the bond between Lugia and Ho-Oh was so strong that it was like they were one Pokémon. Although most historical studies disagree with this interpretation, some believe they were once one being that eventually split: POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It was once written that the bond between Lugia and Ho-Oh was so strong that it was like they were one Pokémon. Although most historical studies disagree with this interpretation, some believe they were once one being that eventually split: POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Twirling its body parts around fast enough lets POKENAME create massive tornadoes. These mighty funnels of wind teleport around at random, creating chaos as they vacuum up everything nearby.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has the ability to walk on the surface of the water without even causing a ripple. Instead of swimming underwater, it controls the water around it, parting it as one would a set of curtains. It never gets wet.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They are elegant and soothing, with wings that sound like silver bells. Make POKENAME angry, however, and you'll find yourself in a tempest.
author: quote.lass

entry: POKENAME are often stoic and matronly, known for their tendency to take others under their wing. If their charge begins to act out, POKENAME are swift to correct this poor behavior with a stern warning.
author: mileysakiko

entry: Its heart has been closed shut, and it unleashes dark storms whenever threatened. POKENAME's ability to camouflage itself has been heightened by fusing, as it often strikes during the terrible storms it creates.
author: princess_lucina

entry: It's often mistaken for a plush toy, given its size and appearance. Because of the storm-causing powers it is capable of, POKENAME tries to hide from humans through the use of camouflage.
author: princess_lucina

entry: POKENAME's second head is capable of spewing destructive, hurricane force winds. It also has a mind of its own, so the main body is constantly struggling to keep the second head in check.
author: princess_lucina

entry: POKENAME have great destructive potential, the movement of their wings creating avalanches in the mountains if they're not careful. They use this power to defend their homes when pushed, but prefer to isolate themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: With a slash of its blade, POKENAME can destroy houses. As a result, it chooses to rest sheathed in the ocean floor.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Very rare sightings of POKENAME only happen during raging storms. POKENAME is said to take down entire forests every time it slashes its blade. It uses these slashes to hunt for other Bisharp to prove it's the strongest.
author: animecreep4

entry: POKENAME is seldom seen, as it lives in the depths of the ocean. It is hailed as a guardian of sailors, as it has been known to disperse stormclouds with its psychic powers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME disguises itself to stalk people who harm the ocean. Once the timing is right, it attacks with great force.
author: themicelegion

entry: When POKENAME becomes enraged, it unleashes overwhelmingly violent torrents of rain. As a result, sailors steer clear of waters where POKENAME slumbers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME often resides by underwater volcanoes. It can cause great earthquakes with its psychic powers and bring about great droughts.
author: soldierex

entry: This Pokémon and its psychic bubble have fully developed, and while its body hasn't grown much bigger, the bubble has grown dramatically. Now that POKENAME is awake, it can strike down its foes with both physical and intellectual might.
author: princess_lucina

entry: Despite its small size, POKENAME possesses immense psychic powers. It spends most of its life resting beneath the roots of great trees, as using its abilities drains it to complete exhaustion. For this reason, it is an extremely rare sight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME rests in an infantile state within its bubble made of pure psychic energy. Should this Pokémon be disturbed from its slumber, untold destructive power awaits to strike down the victim.
author: princess_lucina

entry: As POKENAME develops, so too does its powers. The psychic bubble the Pokémon created to defend itself has grown wing-like appendages and has folded against it like a mother cradling her child.
author: princess_lucina

entry: Thanks to its incredible psychic powers, POKENAME is able to create giant whirlpools by rotating its body in the depths of the ocean. Its poison-coated stingers serve to keep others away and prevent them from waking it from its sleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME tends to make its home around caverns that border the ocean's edge. Highly territorial, it lets out bellowing roars that summon gale-force winds used to blow away any intruders to its domain.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME form their staves from taking Clampearl's pearl and transforming it with their power. They use their psychic abilities to calm the seas and rescue anyone that has been attacked by vicious Pokémon and pirates.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME often are found at the dark depths of the ocean where they avoid contact with others. They have a low tolerance for being overstimulated, and get headaches from divers shining light into their eyes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are guardians of the sea and live among other aquatic Pokémon. Their superb swimming skills allow them to cross oceans within minutes to reach a Pokémon in distress.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's howls are said to summon large storms that can last for days. It harnesses strong wind currents to run across the world at remarkable speeds.
author: mistymagius

entry: One myth states that each hand represents a direction the wind will travel: one for each cardinal direction; when many masses of air meet and a storm is born, POKENAME is using more than one arm to protect the Johto region from danger elsewhere.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its body is wrapped by violent winds and crackling storm clouds, surging with every flap of its wings. None yet have managed to pierce the maelstrom and see what its body truly looks like beneath.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has a strong territorial instinct, driving others off its territory with the stick it always carries. It bears some resemblance to depictions of a supposedly extinct relative to Farfetch'd.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon gathers electricity in the bulb on its back, which glows faintly when charged. It uses its tail to sow seeds that grow more fertile under thunderstorms.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It constantly stores energy in its cheeks, and the more it stores, the more volatile it becomes. A simple shock can trigger a violent explosion, making POKENAME dangerous to approach.
author: moga6

entry: Instead of a Poké Ball, some recent generations of Voltorb have begun to share an appearance resembling Pikachu, with shocking results.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME stores a lot of electricity in its body. Its playful behavior can cause power surges, sometimes leading to blackouts in nearby cities when it releases extra energy.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME appears to have chiseled a weapon and helmet out of Thunder Stones. It uses the stones to enhance its electrical abilities without yet evolving.
author: sk372

entry: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. Using its springlike limbs, it bowls over foes with devastating kicks.
author: smashbear

entry: POKENAME can be found hanging from abandoned wind turbines. They absorb latent electricity during windy days.
author: .izik

entry: In order to create its own thunderclouds, POKENAME floats up into the atmosphere to collect air and moisture. It also feeds on dust and gases, resulting in the clouds containing a foul stench.
author: cascadeguy

entry: POKENAME are most often found in savannahs, where they train their bodies by sprinting across the land. They are pack Pokémon; attracting the ire of just one will cause the whole pack to attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers to fight other Electric-types, as all of their attacks get absorbed by its conductive horn. It will then strike with its heavy tail now charged with electrical energy.
author: mistymagius

entry: A POKENAME is formed when an overly ambitious Pikachu gets itself stuck in a tangle of electric wires. This transformation brings it great power.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME can be seen zipping through the air, leaving trails of electrified pollen that energize plants and Pokémon. POKENAME's wings spark with electric currents, which can be used for self-defense.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME normally live on the seafloor, but large groups come up to float on the surface during thunderstorms. Scientists are still trying to figure out the purpose behind this strange behavior.
author: mepp.

entry: Electricity dances across POKENAME's body, fueling sudden bursts of speed as it charges at opponents. Its graceful gleaming twin blades cut through obstacles with such precision that even the mightiest trees fall like paper.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's electricity is strong enough to cause small electrical disruptions around it. During storms, it often collects extra energy to prevent dangerous lightning from causing harm.
author: moga6

entry: Scientists are baffled by POKENAME's saturated appearance and eerily still expression. However, POKENAME still carries the traits of both Butterfree and Pikachu; for instance, POKENAME reside in forests and command electricity adeptly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It generates a charge by wiggling its body back and forth. Holding a POKENAME with bare hands is a mistake bug catchers rarely make twice.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME deliver Eon Mail between pen pals in the Johto region as part of a program that fosters lifelong literacy. They connect children to the elderly through these letters and will wait outside for days until they have a letter to send back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stores electricity in its body while it waits to evolve. Its stillness may seem calm, but the energy inside causes small electric sparks to flicker.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME likes to lay atop people's heads, the high vantage point making it easier to absorb static in the air. Because of its Pikachu-like appearance, it's become trendy in some areas to wear it as a cap.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have been observed emitting highly volatile blasts of electric and draconic energy. They are known to be very loyal towards their Trainers.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME flies with electricity buzzing in its wings. It uses its venomous stingers to protect its nest and sends electric shocks to scare off anyone who gets too close.
author: moga6

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's back gives off a calming scent and absorbs sunlight like a solar panel. POKENAME uses this energy to charge itself, often creating small electric sparks when it's feeling playful.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME's bite is particularly dangerous; its jaws are plenty powerful on their own, but once it clamps down on something, it discharges electricity through its teeth to shock its victims.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME guards its nest during storms, intercepting lightning with its beak. It shields unhatched eggs with its own body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME runs at high speed in the grass to generate the electricity it stores in its cheeks. It produces powerful black discharges.
author: fouguri

entry: POKENAME flies under the stars, using the light to store energy. It absorbs starlight to generate electricity, which it then uses for its strong electric attacks.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME has a strong sense of justice, so it won't hesitate to intervene with its Comet Punch when it witnesses an unfair situation. If the situation escalates, it won't hesitate to electrocute its opponents.
author: drack8786

entry: POKENAME transmits electricity through its mandibles. It is commonly used by police to temporarily immobilize suspects.
author: codewolfie

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME releases huge lightning bolts from its beak. It circles storm clouds with crackling wings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME delivers Glitter Mail when orphans turn 15 in the Hoenn region as part of a program to help process grief. The Pikachu mascot reminds the orphans that the mail is authored by elders who have lost or never had children.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have an uneven control over their electrical powers. They are able to produce shocks powerful enough to power a generator for several hours, but they have trouble regulating the strength of their shocks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have rubbery bodies that can absorb large amounts of kinetic energy, bouncing around with carefree abandon. The energy they absorb is converted into static electricity and can cause painful shocks if they're touched.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can see momentary glimpses in the future and are often terrified of what they see. Whenever they are scared, they generate an electrical charge in their cheeks and create sparks around them until they are calm.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME bounces around, storing energy in its tail with every jump. When it plays near water, its tail flashes brightly. POKENAME loves to entertain its friends by showing off these sparkling lights.
author: moga6

entry: It gnaws on electrical cables inside houses without restraint until it's full of energy. When a colony of POKENAME infests an urban area, frequent blackouts are almost guaranteed.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME absorb sunlight through their upright ears, which becomes the electricity stored in their cheek pouches. They communicate with others of their species by touching tails.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME scurries through city streets in search of Rare Soda cans, which it instinctively bites into to absorb the sugary charge. This habit supercharges its gills, allowing it to release small bursts of electricity when threatened.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It gnaws on electrical cables inside houses without restraint until it's full of energy. When a colony of POKENAME infests an urban area, frequent blackouts are almost guaranteed.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The vines it wields are electrically charged, making it a favorite helper for gardeners clearing stubborn weeds. Its glowing bulb is often used to guide lost hikers.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME floats high into the sky during thunderstorms to absorb electricity from the lightning bolts for nutrition.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: POKENAME's electrical cheeks glow faintly with odd patterns at night, which some believe are attempts to mimic constellations. It often shocks itself while trying to understand its own power.
author: jaminmcready

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME can take a lot of hits with their bulky body. They develop a static charge that gets released during an opportunistic counterattack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME generate psychic energy from their tail and electricity from their head. They combine these two powers to create a powerful beam of energy that can take down a large Tauros.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While feeding in the trees, POKENAME stays calm, storing energy in its cheeks. If disturbed, it falls to the ground and discharges a powerful electric blast as a defense mechanism.
author: moga6

entry: It charges its electric sacs and displays a menacing face to drive others away, but POKENAME quickly softens when it finds a friend. Its cheeks spark when it's excited or nervous.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME uses its wings during flight to generate electricity and its sharp cry to warn other Pokémon whenever danger is near. Alone, it is cowardly, but beware of a flock of POKENAME as they are dangerous.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME rubs the spot on its belly to build up static. This electricity is used to enhance its claw attacks, causing brief paralysis to its opponent with every strike.
author: evilgammon

entry: As POKENAME struggles to flap its wings to fly, it also fails to retain the electricity in its cheek sacs. Therefore, POKENAME stays in flocks so that their discharged electricity strikes and recharges each other instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME burns trees by striking them with electricity so it can easily access and hunt insects hiding under dense forest floors. It must be careful not to fly up too high, as otherwise it will attract and be struck by lightning.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's fur is surprisingly wiry and prone to having things get tangled in it, but it can easily shock anything that gets caught. If this includes mushrooms or berries, they become pleasantly roasted!
author: bobosmith01

entry: It stores electricity in its tail, similarly to how Pikachu uses its cheeks. Their tails also hold electrically charged berries that POKENAME eats.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME is a fast and skilled Pokémon. It works well with others in battle, using its speed and fiery attacks to overwhelm opponents with quick strikes.
author: moga6

entry: Its long neck and beak are designed to deftly catch prey. If that doesn't work, a quick electric burst will take out a whole pond of fish.
author: essie

entry: POKENAME tries to blend in with other Pikachu, which is difficult because of its elongated snout. Despite this, POKENAME will eat berries and groom its tail alongside groups of Pikachu as though it were one.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The majestic antlers of POKENAME act as a lightning rod, sending absorbed energy to its cheeks. When startled, it releases this power, surprising those who mistake it for Stantler.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME uses its tail to paint with sparks, creating unique patterns as it moves. Its electric art leaves behind glowing marks, each one a masterpiece of power and creativity.
author: moga6

entry: Thanks to a regular training schedule, POKENAME has learned to properly store electricity in its cheek sacs.
author: smashbear

entry: POKENAME rattles its lightning-shaped tail to scare off potential threats. When hunting, it stuns prey with its cheeks and then coils its body around them.
author: hereisanimations

entry: The size of a POKENAME allows it to store large amounts of energy. While rare, if POKENAME are found playing around metal or equipment, a touch from their tail can charge it enough to last for over five years.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME collects shiny rocks akin to Thunder Stones to help it focus its burgeoning electric powers. Occasionally, it manages to procure actual Thunder Stones, but grows far too attached to them to let anyone else take them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are constantly discharging electricity, blue sparks rippling off of their bodies and causing their fur to spike up from static. It is advised to wear insulating clothing when handling these Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It loves eating and spends a lot of time looking for food. When POKENAME is not eating, it stores energy in its cheeks. After a big meal, it releases electrical bursts that can shock anything nearby.
author: moga6

entry: The color of POKENAME's cheeks can change based on their diet. If its cheeks are not a shade of red, its diet is severely unbalanced. They mark their pack's territory with their sturdy horns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME concentrates its 100,000 volts of electricity into its arms and head to perform an extremely powerful and devastating Volt Tackle. Using a supercharged Thunder Punch, it can shock an entire tree and roast every leaf and berry on it.
author: soup1900

entry: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can absorb energy from the sun at an efficiency that far surpasses modern solar panels. This has made it an incredibly popular Pokémon with Trainers looking to reduce their ecological footprint.
author: agentyoshi

entry: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.
author: chorb33

entry: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.
author: chorb33

entry: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.
author: chorb33

entry: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can energize the spikes on its back to shock opponents. It can also curl up and roll away, emitting lightning bolts in all directions.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can energize the spikes on its back to shock opponents. It can also curl up and roll away, emitting lightning bolts in all directions.
author: chorb33

entry: It zaps enemies to slow them down before delivering a toxic sting with its horn. POKENAME avoids fights when possible but can defend itself effectively when threatened.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for aspiring Trainers to start out with, being obedient and relatively easy to train. Their enjoyment of wooden toys to gnaw on makes it easy to reward the behaviour the Trainer wants to see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for aspiring Trainers to start out with, being obedient and relatively easy to train. Their enjoyment of wooden toys to gnaw on makes it easy to reward the behaviour the Trainer wants to see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for aspiring Trainers to start out with, being obedient and relatively easy to train. Their enjoyment of wooden toys to gnaw on makes it easy to reward the behaviour the Trainer wants to see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon likes to possess old gaming devices and drain them of their power. POKENAME feeds itself on this electricity and uses any leftovers for devastating Electric-type attacks, most often used against the virtual-Pokémon Porygon.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Within the prominent organ on its head are gel sacs that can detect minute electric variations. Using this organ, it can detect the brains of other burrowing creatures.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME loves sparking things. It hoards broken electrical equipment then electrically charges them all at once, gleefully wondering at the sparks they produce.
author: pattybgoode

entry: The electricity stored in its flower is harnessed by farmers to power machinery in remote areas. Its presence is said to boost crop yields through electrical stimulation.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Electricity crackles over POKENAME's venomous barbs when fully charged. It uses its tail alongside sparks to communicate with its family.
author: chibitales

entry: Normally laid-back, this companion turns into a formidable threat when angered. Be warned: A Light Ball elevates its potential to a whole new level.
author: soinetwa

entry: A constant surge of powerful electricity runs through POKENAME's ring at all times. It will not harm those who touch it unless POKENAME wills it, and it's said Electric types that touch it will be instantly recharged to full voltage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often wander around, drawn to sources of electricity where they can charge their cheek sacs. Due to the electromagnetic field it produces, Pikachu will often be found sitting upon its back or following in its wake.
author: jadey.1557

entry: POKENAME is very alert and can hear even the smallest sounds. It quietly stores electricity, ready to react to any danger that comes its way.
author: moga6

entry: The sacs on Pikachu's cheeks have moved down onto Monferno's palms, allowing POKENAME to dispense lightning from its hands. While the tip of its tail is no longer on fire, POKENAME can reignite it when the time comes.
author: cascadeguy

entry: Being stabbed by POKENAME is comparable to being struck by lightning. POKENAME recharges by plugging itself into outlets, often causing outages.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: A cut from this dagger is comparable to being tased, a less-than-lethal deterrent to being suddenly grabbed.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When in a defensive stance, POKENAME can manipulate Electroweb to create a barrier of electricity that protects it from all attacks. Its electric blade can stab into a foe, shocking and draining the life out of them.
author: soup1900

entry: Empowered by the Light Ball in its shield, POKENAME can override the control other Aegislash have over people and Pokémon. It can discharge electricity to defend this Light Ball, but doing so makes it wary and weakens its spectral manipulation.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME detects danger, its large ears twitch. If foes touch POKENAME, they feel sick and quickly become paralyzed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its ribbons like jumper cables to latch onto its target and fill it with electricity. It's often used by mechanics to jump-start cars.
author: melodydelune

entry: Due to its powerful bulk requiring a lot of sustenance, most wild POKENAME do not live long lives. They only eat vividly colorful flowers and Berries.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME races across stormy coastlines, its fins crackling with lightning and seawater. It discharges bursts of electricity so powerful, the surrounding air tastes like salt and ozone.
author: segmoph

entry: Unlike Pikachu, POKENAME remains undisturbed even when its tail is touched. This is because POKENAME doesn't see this action as a threat anymore, due to its increased size and power.
author: over9001

entry: Flocks of POKENAME ride alongside thunderstorms, absorbing lightning as energy. They are curious but temperamental, so hot air balloon pilots train Gligar to chase off POKENAME when they get too close.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's tail periodically grows berries that have a pleasant taste and energizing effects. It only shares the fruit with those it trusts; others will get an electrified punch from its extendable fists.
author: sk372

entry: It stores energy in its cheeks, and when it builds up too much, the heat in its six tails increases. POKENAME then becomes ready to strike, with its next attack being either an electric shock or a Fire Blast.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME's exposed innards constantly hum with electricity. Touching them even slightly can leave a nasty shock.
author: .izik

entry: After using its fairy powers to help control its electricity, Pichu becomes friends with the Mimikyu possessing it. This newfound bond causes it to evolve into POKENAME.
author: adoster

entry: When POKENAME finds a large source of energy, it recklessly drains it, even if the amount of energy will make it sick. When it becomes overcharged, it flies uncontrollably fast, appearing as streaks of light in photographs.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are drawn to hydroelectric power plants, often setting up their dams close to the turbines. Their presence was once thought of as a nuisance until engineers began taming them and using them to help provide power.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are drawn to hydroelectric power plants, often setting up their dams close to the turbines. Their presence was once thought of as a nuisance until engineers began taming them and using them to help provide power.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: While electricity is stored in its cheeks, POKENAME can also unleash powerful bursts from its fists. Its aura grows stronger when it feels fear or sadness, acting as a warning to nearby Pokémon.
author: moga6

entry: Though lazy in demeanor, POKENAME still possesses potent electrical stores that discharge on contact. Those stunned by its electric jolts often wind up being a makeshift bed for it to nap on while they're paralyzed.
author: sk372

entry: An electrical powerhouse; POKENAME is often found in the care of power plant employees due to its small size and voltage output.
author: supersonicloki

entry: Known to put on concerts in the wild, POKENAME often uses its electric abilities to light up its show. If interrupted, it rapidly rolls towards the distraction, paralyzes it with electrical discharges, then returns to where it left off singing.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It hides in plain sight by cloaking itself in illusions of other Pokémon. When threatened, POKENAME reveals its true form and unleashes electric attacks from its cheeks.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME inhabits theme parks where it causes rides to shut down after overfeeding on their electricity. It hides among inanimate balloons waiting to be chosen by a child, after which it stealthily steals their family's devices before floating away.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME navigates through darkness using bursts of ultrasonic waves, easily detecting obstacles. When threatened, it releases a blinding electric flash from the energy stored in its red cheeks.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME can rarely form in the wild if a Yamask discards its own mask in exchange for a Pikachu mask. As its tail is now less dexterous, the mask is instead held in place with an electric charge.
author: crumple_2

entry: People living in areas with regular thunderstorms have come to welcome POKENAME's presence. Superstitions say that its chirping song is a ward against lightning strikes, keeping home and property safe from harm.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME clambers through ducts of buildings, searching for electronic devices from which to sap energy. It is sociable, so if one finds an abundance of electrical energy, it will seek to gather a group to infest the location.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Electricity courses through POKENAME's armored body, making each segment a live wire. Its rapid rotations not only protect it but also generate a static field.
author: moga6

entry: Long ago, POKENAME was revered as the perfect hunter, hiding in bushes and luring targets with a smile before leaping out. It electrified its prey to cook it, but legends say its overhunting nearly drove it to extinction.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: POKENAME electrocute humans that dare enter its territory. After the shock, they get frozen and taken away into the snowy mountains, never to be seen again.
author: mystora

entry: It hides underground with only its leaves visible to ground itself and stay hidden from predators. This tactic prevents dangerous electricity buildup while it rests peacefully.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME stores electricity in its cheeks and uses elegant dances to attack. Its rhythmic steps unleash powerful attacks, stunning opponents before striking them with flames.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME perform languid, sorrowful dances as a way to communicate with one another. Their wing movements leave sparkling arcs of electricity tracing through the air in their wake.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME releases a toxic scent from its flower that causes dizziness and confusion. Its electric shocks can paralyze prey, and the scent leaves them with blurry memories and disoriented thoughts.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME roosts high in powerplant rafters, active only during off-hours. It swoops down silently to absorb residual electricity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME trots happily around lush jungle areas.  The pollen its large flower constantly emits contains electrical particles, which increase the likelihood of it paralyzing other creatures on contact.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shocks prey like Magikarp with bolts from the spikes on its tentacles. It hides motionless on rocks before striking.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's shovel acts like a lightning rod, channeling energy into destructive blasts. Its cries echo across the beach after the blasts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME communicate with others by nuzzling their cheeks together. This exchange of electricity between two parties causes the frills behind their ears to emit a small scattering of electric sparks.
author: sk372

entry: It works for a band and goes to every concert. Instead of playing for the band, POKENAME actually charges each instrument.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have a love for performing and enjoy being the centre of attention on stage as they sing and dance. They use their electrical powers to project their performances across TV screens throughout the town they're in.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a love for performing and enjoy being the centre of attention on stage as they sing and dance. They use their electrical powers to project their performances across TV screens throughout the town they're in.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Most commonly encountered in the summer, POKENAME lurk in amongst fields of sunflowers. They gradually build up an electrical charge within their leaves as they absorb the sun's energy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Although uncommon, POKENAME are typically found in forests. They may discharge electricity from their eyes or their cheeks.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Many POKENAME work in kitchens to make a powerful Piquant Pikachu Curry and can accommodate dietary restrictions with love and care. It makes sure to prevent waste by cutting up vegetables into little stars that make the dish pop.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is even fluffier than it was as a baby, and it takes pride in that. If you ruffle its fur, be prepared for an angry shock and a pouty Pokémon.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: POKENAME's sweet, energizing scent makes it a popular Pokémon at cafes. The cream it produces from its tail has a sweet lemon flavor.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's lily pad insulates its body when it discharges electricity. Its Thunder Bolt is strong enough to fell a pine tree.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME that lack a protective shell are free to fly at top speeds through the forest. Unfortunately, their habitats are very densely wooded, and injuries from high-speed impacts with trees are common among this species.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has a confident and headstrong temperament that sometimes leads it to disobey the commands of others. When it snoozes, hot and intense energy is released through its cheeks.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME erupts from the soil with a sharp popping sound. It then releases a burst of electricity that paralyzes targets before dragging them underground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fights with a shared store of voltage between the trio. While this gives them the advantage of coordinated lightning attacks to better battle foes, it means they exhaust their electricity in a short amount of time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its electric powers to short-circuit devices or make things glow. It loves attention and will often zap objects to get the notice of nearby Trainers, showing off its skills.
author: moga6

entry: To the casual observer, this fusion may appear as a regular Makuhita. Learning to notice the difference in the markings is important, though, as one Pokémon can only strike up close while the other can send its Thunder Shock to zap distant foes.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon treasures the Light Ball resting upon its head as it bounces about to generate electricity. Its kind use their Light Balls to focus both their electrical energy and their psychic powers.
author: infinex21

entry: It looks confused most of the time, unable to remember its electrical abilities. However, when in danger, POKENAME unknowingly discharges electricity from its cheeks to defend itself.
author: moga6

entry: By rubbing its pincers together, it can generate electricity that is then stored within the red pouches upon its cheeks. It will never let go of prey grabbed by its pincers until they are shocked into submission.
author: infinex21

entry: As it rolls around, POKENAME's fur charges up with static electricity. Domestic POKENAME often like to roll around in laundry piles, bouncing away with stray bits of clothing clinging to its body.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME charges electricity by bristling its fur. It is then discharged when POKENAME strikes their opponents.
author: mossybanana

entry: POKENAME's fur is charged with electricity and emits small flames. It can sense emotions through smell, reacting with bursts of energy to protect friends or face threats.
author: moga6

entry: It can glide easily through water and land with its slippery skin. POKENAME stores electricity in its cheeks, releasing quick, powerful bursts to defeat enemies that get too close.
author: moga6

entry: Combining electrical energy with fighting skills, POKENAME is a powerhouse. Its strong limbs and electric charges allow it to perform stunning feats of strength, often using lightning-boosted punches in battle.
author: moga6

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: A curious Pokémon that wears clothes resembling a certain Trainer. It travels around the world with a Pikachu on its shoulder.
author: striker212

entry: POKENAME uses electricity to power its attacks and leaks a poisonous fluid from its mouth that can melt iron. It also sends out electric shocks to stop anything that gets too close from escaping.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME bolster the strength of their shell by drawing in lightning strikes towards themselves. The strikes create pockets of dense calcium that make the shell tougher.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fishes with its tail during storms. If a Shellder bites, it unleashes a massive jolt of electricity in response.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunt for Magikarp by zapping them with electric shocks. POKENAME are capable swimmers, allowing them to chase after any Pokémon that try to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME creates strong magnetic fields to pull metal objects from afar. It uses its electric energy to charge nearby items, making them hum with static electricity.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME generates high-frequency radio waves that alter the temperature around it. Its electricity-storing sacs provide energy, allowing it to maintain a strong magnetic field and increase the temperature at the same time.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME rub their heads together to generate electricity. Once they have enough energy charged up, they channel the lightning into their legs to run with super speed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hide inside electrical sockets, playfully shocking anyone that comes near. Its electricity will grow out of control if it doesn't discharge it somehow.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME clicks its claws together to create electric sparks as a threat display. Those who don't heed the warning fast enough will find themselves zapped in short order.
author: sk372

entry: Averse to violence, POKENAME warns foes by clicking its small claw to produce sparks. If this warning is ignored, it clicks the larger claw to create shots of lightning. It will not give a third warning.
author: sk372

entry: Always bursting with energy, POKENAME are celebrated as symbols of rebirth and regrowth. Their dances spread mystical flames that help bring energy to sprouts, helping them grow strong even across barren landscapes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Upon hatching, POKENAME gather feathers left behind by their parents. They use the feathers to track the parent to the end of a rainbow, leading to a heartfelt reunion as POKENAME have proven their survival skills.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME appears before abandoned young Pokémon, having been drawn to their sadness, and helps them overcome the negative emotions. It forces its own young to hunt in search of it so that they may understand the plight of lost Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME creates streaks of rainbow light whenever it stretches its legs. When it attacks, it jumps up and creates strong, sacred flames from its legs to do a powerful aerial kick at the opponent.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's tail fin emits a short rainbow trail behind it as it swims. When going on the offensive, it closes the beak-like shell over its face for added protection before ramming foes with its beak and horn in tandem.
author: sk372

entry: Despite how colorful and majestic they are, these tropical Pokémon aren't very popular pets due to their fiery temperament. POKENAME are very territorial, and keeping them in the same aquarium with any other Pokémon can lead to a disastrous result.
author: milchik

entry: A story often told to children is that the prismatic core of POKENAME is the source of rainbows that form after rainstorms. A POKENAME can fly without tiring for days, as it thrives off of sunlight absorbed through its core.
author: infinex21

entry: With every swing of its bladed arms, POKENAME leaves a rainbow trail behind. The aftermath of especially intense battles is said to be a truly breathtaking marvel of color.
author: sk372

entry: When it flexes, POKENAME creates crackling lightning around it in all the colors of the rainbow. Many foes are too transfixed by the technicolor display to properly defend themselves from the coming strikes.
author: sk372

entry: Its wings have a difficult time flying, but they do an excellent job at boasting its grandness and splendor.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: POKENAME live in communities of seven, flying in formation so their feathers reflect a complete rainbow. They have long been considered symbols of happiness and good luck, especially when seen as a full swarm.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME blazes across the ground at the speed of lightning. Local Lycanroc band together to catch this Pokémon, but all their attempts seem to fail.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: POKENAME can be found basking in the light of rainbows, photosynthesizing under its colorful light. Plants around it flourish, given new life in POKENAME's presence.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's back feathers help shape and form its threads into complex shapes and objects. It can produce these threads in nearly any color.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME glide through the sky with their radiant wings in search of pure-hearted Trainers to befriend. The feathers they drop as they soar are said to bring good luck to those who find one.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME started showing up en masse after a chemical leak near a large body of water. They usually have a very jovial and loving disposition.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME started showing up en masse after a chemical leak near a large body of water. They usually have a very jovial and loving disposition.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME leap into the air on sunny days, their frills shining in radiant colors as they collect sunlight for photosynthesis. Unfortunately, they tend to overheat easily, their frills catching on fire and prompting them to land quickly.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's feathers are naturally light blue, but they secrete a liquid that causes them to refract light in rainbow colours. This striking effect is often used in schools to help teach children about the science of refraction.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Despite seeming small and immobile, a typical POKENAME contains a large amount of power within. It rarely releases that power, but that just makes the rare displays more astounding when they do occur.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME guide flocks of Spearow through the sky, shining like a bright rainbow beacon. It's considered a symbol of the start of a Trainer's journey, based on reports of teenagers seeing it streak through the sky as they set off on their adventure.
author: evilgammon

entry: The pleasant smoke emitted from POKENAME's spines has a number of beneficial effects that vary based on its particular diet. It is theorized that POKENAME inspired the invention of incense.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME tend to fly in short bursts, creating vibrant rainbows in their wake. If a trainer is determined enough to follow one, they may find a POKENAME's nest at the end, where POKENAME hoards their many gold coins.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: The flickering colors along POKENAME's tail come from reactions of toxins within its body. It spits out different combinations of poison and ignites them with sparks, creating fireworks that help it hunt.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME were once revered as guardians of the desert because of its protectiveness over young Pokémon in arid regions of the world. Nowadays it is held to high esteem for a different reason: the antivenom that is derived from its venom.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME reign supreme in the hot, arid conditions of the savannah, their commanding presence scaring away most other life from their presence. Their bodies are covered in scars from the constant duels they are subject to.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME burns down old forests in order to grow and flourish new, healthy flora. Legends say that those who follow this Pokémon through seven different eras of time will be given eternal life.
author: soup1900

entry: This benevolent Pokémon will grant blessing to Trainers that are pure of heart. Its singing voice is said to bring any listeners pure euphoria.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's vine arms leave behind a rainbow trail when it swings them in combat. It can make all the vines of its body turn radiantly bright in order to blind others and leave them more open to being swatted away.
author: sk372

entry: The rainbow-colored hues on POKENAME's vine-covered body constantly rotate through the color spectrum. Though undoubtedly a vibrant spectacle to see, the bright, almost gaudy color pattern tends to create headaches when viewed for too long.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say the leaves from a POKENAME have a chance to bring back the dead. Its body gives off a warm glow in every color of the rainbow.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is an icy daredevil. The frosty winds near the ozone layer are where this Pokémon truly thrives; it also does very well in battle.
author: trakito

entry: The injection of a rogue program into a drawing assistant program gave it new life. It seeks to fill the gray parts of the world with color and life.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME incinerate their eggs into Sacred Ash when hatching, leading to the tradition in Ecruteak City of gathering the ashes for funeral ceremonies. They hate being alone, but have a strong affinity for dog and cat Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME incinerate their eggs into Sacred Ash when hatching, leading to the tradition in Ecruteak City of gathering the ashes for funeral ceremonies. They hate being alone, but have a strong affinity for dog and cat Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is very sensitive to the emotions of others. When surrounded by joyful people, a colorful aura radiates from its body.
author: mepp.

entry: Their radiant feathers turn different colors depending on their mood. Pale-colored POKENAME are upset or scared, defensively incinerating threats, but vibrant-colored POKENAME feel safe and content, rejuvenating anything and anyone nearby.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Having lived near humans since ancient times, POKENAME occasionally appear to dance during festivals to inspire good fortune. It is theorized that they may have inspired certain styles of dances in Ancient Johto.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: A regal and seldom-seen Pokémon that prefers to live atop towers and mountains. The elegant dancers of Ecruteak take great inspiration from POKENAME.
author: quote.lass

entry: POKENAME is often referred to as "The Princess of the Sun". Legends say that it can grow a desert oasis from a single tumbleweed.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME, when idle, appears as little more than an eternally unhatched egg. When others are near, it reveals itself as a fiery avian spirit, able to emit ghostly flames that can burn enemies to their core.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's six eyes cast scarlet rays wherever they dart. These rays are extremely hot and can burn a Pokémon with ease. Its feathers glow different colours based on the time of day, but this only helps with telling the time.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME never truly dies and will loyally serve its master until the end. It remains an endangered species despite its ability to be reborn upon demise.
author: thenebulamage

entry: Upon seeing someone in danger, POKENAME swoops down from the clouds, placing itself between the victim and the attacker. It creates dazzling rainbows as it flies, which it draws power from to breathe devastating, multicoloured flames.
author: evilgammon

entry: The feathers of POKENAME shimmer with the colors of a rainbow and are said to bring great fortune to any who wield even a single feather. In the wake of its powerful flames, new life will quickly blossom and flourish from the ashes left behind.
author: infinex21

entry: Since ancient times, POKENAME have been seen as symbols of comfort and rebirth. Once a POKENAME has found a Trainer it trusts, it will allow them to sit on its back while it rings the bell in its tower, easing their worries with its melodic chime.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The largest known colony of POKENAME is found at the southern tip of the world. They gather every evening and fly high, playing with the final rays of light, transforming them into a kaleidoscopic aurora.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME release glowing iridescent bubbles wherever they swim. Their scales shimmer when exposed to sunlight and refract in a plethora of resplendent colors. Finding a POKENAME scale is considered lucky.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that POKENAME's sacred fire can purify anything. According to legend, it waits for the day it meets a human that its flames cannot burn.
author: staghorn

entry: Its feathered wings shimmer like a rainbow under sunlight; however, that same sunlight melts its ice and causes a sweet liquid to drip down its body. People say its taste is reminiscent of a fruity ice lolly.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The colorful flames of POKENAME are said to be the culmination of the dreams of an ancient civilization that worshiped a rainbow being.
author: mpotter75

entry: Although POKENAME cannot see, it loves running around and biting things. Its bright feathers shimmer in a multitude of colors, placing smiles on the faces of all who watch it.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: Because of its two heads and brightly-colored feathers, POKENAME is often mistaken for a rare mythical creature. In fact, it struggles to see and its underdeveloped body makes it awkward and clumsy.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: Now fully evolved, this magnificent Pokémon has developed a ferocious nature and attacks anything that provokes it. Legend says that one day it will descend from a rainbow, bringing either destruction or joy.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: Its many, puffy tails refract sunlight in peculiar colors that many say reminds them of rainbows. These many tails will puff up when a POKENAME prepares to unleash a stream of flames from its mouth.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's large wings make it difficult for them to fly properly. The embers shaken from their feathers shine with every color of the rainbow.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME rub their feathered pom-poms together as they perform, causing rainbow-colored sparks and embers to shower down around them. Molted feathers from these Pokémon have been found in ceremonial regalia from the past.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can perform dances that were thought to be lost to time with ease. It is most frequently seen doing a traditional routine that mirrors the Ecruteak Dance Theater's most popular dance, despite no evidence saying that it should know the steps.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is said that if you bring a monthly offering to POKENAME, it will offer to bring someone back from the dead. It is a sacred Pokémon and can only be found at ancient shrines.
author: mistymagius

entry: Just like in the story of the burned tower in Johto, POKENAME's body crumbles when struck by lightning in a violent storm. Legends claim that by inserting the bones of the deceased into its body, it can revive them anew.
author: soup1900

entry: Just like in the story of the burned tower in Johto, POKENAME's body crumbles when struck by lightning in a violent storm. Legends claim that by inserting the bones of the deceased into its body, it can revive them anew.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's fiery dances are said to be truly miraculous displays of rainbow-colored flames swirling in fantastic patterns. It refuses to let its dances be recorded, wanting its performances to be truly special.
author: sk372

entry: The protuberance on POKENAME's head can emit a rainbow-colored pulse of psychic energy that stuns everything around it. This makes it excellent at hunting smaller fish for prey as well as repelling intruders away from its deep-sea domain.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a Flying-Type Pokémon reminiscent of a phoenix. It protects its body from larger birds using its wings, which are stronger than diamond and can slice right through an enemy.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: The colorful POKENAME has long been regarded as a symbol of authority. In ancient times, if a wild POKENAME was ever found, it was expected that it would be caught and given to the emperor.
author: .realthree

entry: The orb within the staff can illuminate in seven colors. Wild POKENAME will use the power of their staves to ignite against the darkness.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME always come out after the rain. They bring rainbows along with them and seeing them is a sign of good fortune.
author: pokebio

entry: It is said that the joyous ringing of the bell atop POKENAME's head can turn entire caverns into dazzling geodes. Many Trainers who tried to exploit its power ended up crystallized themselves.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: According to legend, if POKENAME awakens, a fire will light somewhere. In battle, it burns a Rainbow Wing to absorb its power.
author: donutsbg

entry: The vivid markings that POKENAME displays are meant to warn others of the high voltage contained in its body. Attacks from this Pokémon leave rainbow-colored afterimages in one's sight.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are said to bring eternal happiness, but the lives of POKENAME are full of strife and struggle. Their efforts to avoid Trainers and other Pokémon give them stress, which often manifests as aching headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If it lands too carelessly, it risks causing violent earthquakes, which is why people hope it keeps flying whenever it passes overhead. It is said that wherever POKENAME flies, a rainbow is always nearby.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are elusive creatures that are difficult to study because of their avoidance of people. During the few encounters that have occurred, they are said to swim away in a blur of rainbow light.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Statues of POKENAME have been found at construction sites around the world. Many believe it grants protection to hard-working people and Pokémon.
author: leshii

entry: As it flies, POKENAME expels a sweet, rainbow-colored nectar to lure prey to its waiting pitcher maw. Once it has eaten enough, it fires a powerful rainbow Solar Beam into the sky that leads to sunshowers in the area for a month.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The large orbs on either side of the head of POKENAME reflect light in a broad spectrum of colour, creating beautiful rainbow patterns as light scatters through them. Seeing the display is said to bring good fortune on the start of a voyage.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be found drifting out in the open sea, their jewelled head refracting light into a beautiful rainbow. Their beauty is deceptive as their many tentacles are tipped with feathers coated with a paralytic poison.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be found drifting out in the open sea, their feathery head refracting light into a beautiful rainbow. Their beauty is deceptive as their many tentacles are tipped with sharp claws, snatching at passing Pokémon in the water.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It appears in places where Trainers least expect it, often during moments of doubt. Many believe spotting a POKENAME is a sign of serendipity and good fortune to come.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When POKENAME calls out, it sprays a mist of water, reflecting light off its feathers that can be seen for miles around. Some believe that levelling up a Pokémon after seeing this will cause it to evolve.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME seeks out people's dreams and drains them of any colour, leaving the victim in darkness. Every bit of colour it absorbs adds another bright feather to its tail.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME appear before mothers of stillborn children to mourn. They do everything in their power to reassure mothers that nothing could have been done to change the present, and that the loss of life was not the fault of the mother.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME harnesses temporal energy to accelerate its metamorphosis and wobbles with latent energy. People who make prolonged contact with its cocoon are said to recall childhood memories with acute clarity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are capable of seeing many timelines with their compound eyes. They act deliberately to balance the needs of many creatures in their forests.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The sharp scythes it wields are able to cut through the fabric of time and open up small portals. It typically uses these to help smaller Pokémon evade predators.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are a transient presence found in the frigid tundra. They lure Trainers to follow them into snowstorms only to drag them into the future a few years.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME help people and Pokémon recover from adverse life events by showing them what future is possible. Their desire to inspire change does not always work, especially when those they want to help are not ready to change.
author: quackquackattack

entry: People will give out offerings to the shrine on POKENAME's back. Should it deem the person and their offerings worthy, it will take them on a pleasant sightseeing trip through time.
author: sk372

entry: Some believe POKENAME originates from prehistory, having traveled to present time to avoid the extinction events that claimed so many other ancient creatures. It acts perturbed when in the presence of other Fossil Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: It flits through time like a fish swims through water. It pauses in moments where nobody is around to see it, making it one of the hardest to find Pokémon in history.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME carry a certain innocence to them that makes them approachable. They are always willing to hear stories from others, no matter what timeline they are in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are mature creatures that understand the suffering of others. They rarely make time for themselves when protecting the forests around them and are constantly worried about the future.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travel through time to appear before grieving widows and help them manage their grief. POKENAME flowers produce a nostalgic scent that is said to remind widows of their loved ones.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is one of the very few crepuscular variants of Hoothoot. For some strange reason, it can often be found perched atop forest shrines.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME swarm in the morning sunlight, gathering together to enjoy the sunrise. They possess strange temporal powers and can buzz their wings at a frequency that allows them to fly through timestreams to the next morning.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can sense the flow of time using their antennae, swarming together to places where the timestream is most accessible. Working together as a swarm, they can enter the timestream and fly together to springtime.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon is an emissary from the future, sent to that ensure that certain necessary events occur. Where its desired timeline leads, no one knows.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME stands in wide empty fields basking in bright sunlight. Once it's gathered enough, it manipulates time among all the flora around it, making it all bloom at once and creating a lush field of flowers.
author: sk372

entry: This rare Pokémon seems to shun any form of violence, appearing only at night to Trainers with a pure heart. It is believed that POKENAME can harness the energy of the full moon's light to travel through time.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This elusive Pokémon appears only under moonlight to Trainers pure of spirit. Some legends claim it uses lunar energy to slip through time itself, vanishing without leaving a trace.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This elusive Pokémon appears only under moonlight to Trainers pure of spirit. Some legends claim it uses lunar energy to slip through time itself, vanishing without leaving a trace.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This elusive Pokémon appears only under moonlight to Trainers pure of spirit. Some legends claim it uses lunar energy to slip through time itself, vanishing without leaving a trace.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Getting pricked by one of POKENAME's barbs can send creatures flying through time. POKENAME's poison can quite literally send you into next week.
author: themicelegion

entry: Drinking the juice POKENAME creates from berries seems to have mildly rejuvenated old cells in living things. Some scientists theorize studying this could lead to the creation of concoctions that could stave off the effects of aging completely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leaves overwhelmingly viscous excretions as it trails along the forest floor. This substance is able to accelerate plant growth and thus is highly valued.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME works tirelessly to clear the ocean of pollution and garbage, knowing the future that could await. It works itself so hard that it has been known to pass out from exhaustion. Kind volunteers aid it in its quest, allowing it to take breaks.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are reclusive guardians and appear when mass deforestation occurs. By sending loggers into the future and back, they reveal the consequences of deforestation and cause some loggers to act more conscientiously.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It delivers Mirage Mail across time and helps prevent disaster by providing people of the past letters from their descendants. Once fate has changed, the Mirage Mail disappears, as though it were never there.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has been witnessed exploring the aftermath of severe wildfires, after which the plant life has rapidly grown back. The foliage on its back withers during these events, so it is hypothesized that it uses its life energy to renew the land.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a mystical Pokémon that seeks out devastated forests. When its body glows in seven bright colors, it turns back time to restore these forests to their original and beautiful states.
author: mepp.

entry: This duo loves to traverse through time periods. They alter key events with their powers, creating new timelines.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME is a self-contained paradox. The blooming flower on its head is overflowing with concentrated temporal energy.
author: ohok3441

entry: This Pokémon is said to be the guardian of time itself. It's very passionate in making sure the future doesn't fall into ruin.
author: gayschlatt

entry: Deeply loyal to its Trainer, POKENAME uses its power of foresight to guide them to their ideal future. It's said truly devoted POKENAME will even go back in time to secretly and retroactively change and improve its Trainer's past as well.
author: sk372

entry: Those trapped in the jaws of POKENAME are said to witness their future, and, ultimately, their demise.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME travels across different timelines to warn about the imminent end of the world, humanity, or the universe itself. Fortunately, it seems to have ended up here by mistake.
author: epping_forest

entry: With their four distinct branches, POKENAME have control over the seasons and can alter entire forests on a whim. Researchers hurriedly flock to areas where this phenomenon occurs.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME styles itself a knight, fighting fiercely with sword and shield against much larger foes. It has a stubborn streak, so if it loses, it reverses time and keeps trying until it finally emerges triumphant.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a pure-hearted being that appears to shield humans and Pokémon from natural disasters with its psychic powers. Legends say it travels through time, absorbing lightning to fuel its journeys.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The two arrow-like antennae of this Pokémon move like the hands of a clock, always pointing to the current time of the region in which it resides. Only one of these Pokémon have been found in each region.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME dwell in ancient forests that are a safe haven for endangered species like Farfetch'd and Chansey. They are devoted guardians, using their powerful illusions to ensure no poachers can capture these Pokémon.
author: mepp.

entry: Its power to control and travel through time is unparalleled. It's thought that POKENAME could change how time itself fundamentally functions if it wished.
author: sk372

entry: With POKENAME's powers, areas ravaged by pollution or irreparable harm from humankind can simply revert back to a previous flourishing state in an instant. However, POKENAME is unacquiescent and refuses to use its powers if ordered.
author: bobosmith01

entry: With POKENAME's powers, areas ravaged by pollution or irreparable harm from humankind can simply revert back to a previous flourishing state in an instant. However, POKENAME is unacquiescent and refuses to use its powers if ordered.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Known for its playful nature and time-twisting powers, POKENAME brings hope to those lost in darkness. Some say its laughter can be heard echoing from timelines long since forgotten.
author: curazy
