entry: POKENAME lures unsuspecting prey by radiating a gentle, comforting warmth from its head. When they draw close, it ensnares them with its scorching vine, burning them before they are devoured.
author: m.a.dd.

entry: Although POKENAME's naturally long and lanky limbs and odd fighting stance has been criticized by some Poké Fans, these same traits allow POKENAME to strike first and cover its weak points simultaneously.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is the most peaceful Pokémon in the ocean. It glides gracefully underwater and brings a calm feeling to any fish who sees it.
author: hoppygolucky

entry: POKENAME regularly seeks out areas where there is strife. It can convince others that an unseeable deity is watching over them.
author: gentlesage

entry: As this fusion's name would imply, POKENAME loves being with another Pokémon. If it is alone for too long, it slowly gets angrier and starts attacking objects nearby. This is strange behaviour, as it often stops fights but gets into many itself.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: It flies through the sky gracefully and blissfully. It resembles a shooting star when soaring through the starry night.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME are incredibly rare and are said to bring great fortune to anyone who catches one. Some fishermen have dedicated their entire careers to catching one of these Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hates arguments. It stings whoever is upset, causing intense elation. The feelings get more intense until the victim suffers a heart attack from excitement.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME flies around at a slow pace, as its shell weighs it down. During prehistoric times, it acted as a caretaker for injured Pokémon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has full flight capability, but only in short bursts. If POKENAME detects nearby bickering, it simply flitters to a different area.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Nicknamed "The Dragon of Blessed Fortune," POKENAME is an extremely rare sight to behold in the wild. Catching a glimpse of it in flight is said to bless the witness with a year's worth of good luck.
author: sk372

entry: The plants around POKENAME's neck give off a potent and sweet aroma. Smelling them reduces aggression and creates an urge to do kind gestures to those nearby.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flames are said to be able to harmlessly burn away the impurities of the soul of whoever they touch. These flames will only harm those who POKENAME deems to be beyond salvation.
author: infinex21

entry: Having sprouted its wings early, POKENAME can be seen jumping from trees and rocks in an attempt to fly. It struggles to take off because of its eggshell weighing it down.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME avoids intense strife at all costs. It gravitates to those whom it deems pure of heart, seeking mutual joy and comfort.
author: entomoxie

entry: Being whole-heartedly good, POKENAME are often kept by fortune-tellers to ensure only good fortunes are read. These readings are quite expensive.
author: char_latte3412

entry: When the orbs on its head glow brightly, it calms anyone in its vicinity. Its electricity can power an entire house.
author: kittyluv090

entry: This joyous Pokémon flies through the sky, leaving trails of blue and red petals behind it. These petals can be brewed into a calming and naturally healing tea, used in Pokémon centres region-wide.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME uses its fur to sense enemy actions; however, it will simply avoid the move rather than counter with an attack. If it senses an action that doesn't create conflict or battling, it bestows psychic power onto them as a gift and blessing.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite its large size, POKENAME is very gentle with people and Pokémon. When pressed, POKENAME would rather use its wings to flee into the air than fight. But when it absolutely must, POKENAME uses devastating force to crush its opponents.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME will only use their strong jaws to bite those with wicked hearts and malicious intent. As such, they are favored by police to help identify and detain criminals.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's final evolved state marks it perfecting its exoskeleton through endlessly shedding. The result is a pristine, solid exterior. To compensate for the extra weight of its shell, it has developed much stronger wings in order to fly smoothly.
author: richardcareylol

entry: Its wings hide two sickle-like claws that are coated in ice when attacking. It swoops down to steal eggs from bird Pokémon, but often ends up dropping them into the arms of Trainers as it flies away.
author: chibitales

entry: A fighter endowed with bliss and the ability to never give up, wild POKENAME typically do not stay in this evolutionary stage very long, if at all, due to their positively hardworking nature.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Wild POKENAME have very high IQ and had mastered the art of strategy when battling foes. Their thundering presence commands the field as they let out a shocking Roar.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Very few have ever heard a POKENAME bark. It is said that its cry brings everlasting happiness and peace to all nearby.
author: vlavoc

entry: This is an extremely elusive Pokémon that is said to only appear before those who are pure of heart. According to myth, POKENAME can transform the nearby landscape into one that reflects their closest companion's soul.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A defender of happiness and joy, POKENAME will attack bullies and tyrants with ferocity. The armor covering its body protects itself from feelings of negativity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A defender of happiness and joy, POKENAME will attack bullies and tyrants with ferocity. The armor covering its body protects itself from feelings of negativity.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME loves to give gifts and will grab any item it thinks its Trainer will love. It has become a great help for postal services, as it gives out parcels and letters with such enthusiasm.
author: mistymagius

entry: Fables state that in war times, this Pokémon appears as a warning for civilizations to make peace. Some say if no peace can be achieved, it will discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 200,000 volts, destroying civilizations it deems unworthy.
author: beatdoof

entry: Wild POKENAME are known to appear to pure-hearted Trainers who have formed very close bonds with their Pokémon. If they witness Pokémon being mistreated by their Trainers, they will zap them with 100,000 volts.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME can blast physical manifestations of love and joy from its cannons. The more affection it feels toward its opponent, the stronger the blast's impact becomes.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME darts gracefully and swiftly across even the tallest trees, finding the most remote and peaceful part of the rainforest to rest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME darts gracefully and swiftly across even the tallest trees, finding the most remote and peaceful part of the rainforest to rest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME darts gracefully and swiftly across even the tallest trees, finding the most remote and peaceful part of the rainforest to rest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Many believe that POKENAME are heavenly beings that watch over the world. They will always attempt to end strife wherever they go.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Due to the spectral nature of POKENAME, its life-force is tied to the egg it once hatched from. Legends say this Pokémon contains 108 spirits within, all of which are from virtuous individuals who perished before their time.
author: hello_i_exist

entry: POKENAME can use its wings to travel at incredible speeds across different regions. It watches over people and Pokémon and protects them if needed. It is referred to as the 'Protector of Peace' in certain regions.
author: tserii

entry: Legends say this Pokémon appeared high in the sky to shield a peaceful village from a meteor strike. To meet one is a lucky thing indeed.
author: robosoup

entry: It is often seen flying through clear skies at night.  It is thought to be the inspiration for the mythical "space whale".
author: bostroms

entry: It is often seen flying through clear skies at night.  It is thought to be the inspiration for the mythical "space whale".
author: bostroms

entry: Each POKENAME hosts a unique diorama on its shell, each corresponding to an innocent child's dream. In many cases, these scenes correspond to popular fairy tales.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME usually seen near kind people. POKENAME uses its nose to determine whether a person is good or bad.
author: snivi

entry: It feels constant conflict between peace and hostility. It brutally fights enemies but still offers mercy at the end.
author: creeps_jr

entry: When a POKENAME's eyes gleam, it can see what's in a person's heart. If POKENAME deems you to be kind, it will bless you with good luck.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME are gentle and friendly, having a fondness for helping celebrate special occasions in their communities. Birthdays are a particular favourite and they enjoy taking the birthday person on flights around the neighbourhood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are gentle and friendly, having a fondness for helping celebrate special occasions in their communities. Birthdays are a particular favourite and they enjoy taking the birthday person on flights around the neighbourhood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are gentle and friendly, having a fondness for helping celebrate special occasions in their communities. Birthdays are a particular favourite and they enjoy taking the birthday person on flights around the neighbourhood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When a POKENAME senses incredible malice, it will awaken its full power and descend from the clouds above to smite the source. They often lack precision at this point and will eradicate everything around the source to ensure it can never return.
author: infinex21

entry: These Pokémon supposedly observe the world below from beyond the very clouds in the sky. Some stories claim that if the general alignment of the world's people were to turn toward evil, then POKENAME will descend and smite away wickedness.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME go on rampages only to battle and stop other Pokémon who are also rampaging. They bless those who are in danger of getting injured with strength powerful enough to snap metal poles in one blow.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME sleep peacefully in magma, avoiding strife. Legends tell of their awakening causing volcanic eruptions.
author: anarchaz

entry: While POKENAME's strength is powerful enough to topple multiple buildings in a single Moonblast, it does not use its powers to destroy things. Instead, it remains peaceful and only shows off its might to drive away harmful and malicious threats.
author: soup1900

entry: While good-natured, wild POKENAME like to play pranks on travelers that pass by their territory. Their playful personality has made them popular among Fairy-type Trainers.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is a very elusive Pokémon that hides within the mists of dense forests. The feathers of POKENAME that people find in these forests are imbued with the essence of fairies.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME craves absolute happiness. If it senses strife, it uses the power of the sun to fire an aureate gleam to end the conflict, even ruinously.
author: miistical

entry: POKENAME shows love through gently biting their trainers and other Pokémon. However, anyone who hurts the target of their affection is met with a fury that will put Primeape to shame.
author: jesterwanted

entry: POKENAME appears to kind and respectful Trainers, often offering gifts of its feathers or bundles of fur. It is said these gifts are blessings of long life from this Pokémon in hopes the Trainers continue to do good.
author: chibitales

entry: Festivals of all kinds can be host to groups of POKENAME, as the positive emotions attract them. Their delicate wings are susceptible to being waterlogged and thusly will weigh them down, so they tend to hide away during rainy weather.
author: chibitales

entry: The membrane around POKENAME's eyes illuminates those in need of blessings in a ring of sparkles. Malefactors who intrude upon a den of POKENAME will be swarmed en masse and smothered in the warmth of love and acceptance until they succumb.
author: wormspawn

entry: POKENAME is a Pokémon of pure happiness, seeking and spinning peaceful bliss. It therefore attaches itself only to those it deems of a good heart.
author: togetik

entry: A POKENAME has a staunch sense of righteousness. If its Trainer chooses strife over peace, they can rest assured that their POKENAME will hold them accountable.
author: .fedoraman

entry: When a POKENAME senses that someone intends to cause strife, it does not hesitate to roll headlong into them. Its judge of character is uncanny.
author: .fedoraman

entry: If its Trainer abandons their moral principles, a POKENAME will abandon its Trainer. A stray POKENAME has never been recaptured, but continues its mission to protect peace around the world.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME are known for huddling baby Pokémon underneath their large wings. They have a unique ability to sense sadness and will stay close to anyone in need, offering comfort and support.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME often plays with children and smaller Pokémon, using its strength not to intimidate, but to protect and support. It is said that its presence brings harmony to the land, always ensuring that no one is left behind.
author: rakunk

entry: Without proper talons, POKENAME specializes in aerial choreography. Because of this, a flock of POKENAME are not only family, but a well-balanced performance troupe.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME travel the lands, cheering on strangers to do their best. If their target is gloomy, their cheers are wilder, to the point of exhaustion.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: Visiting from tropical areas, POKENAME teach Baby Pokémon its gentle and serene style of dance. Those Pokémon grow up with a calm temperament.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: Its slow and methodical dancing often comes with an audience. POKENAME sometimes visits rainy places for a change in venue.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME are rarely seen in the wild, but commonly gather in places of great community. It is said that the embraces of POKENAME are as warm as the community behind it.
author: elibromax314

entry: Despite its dense composition, POKENAME soars faster than a fighter jet. They often form a partnership with humans and allow them to direct their flight.
author: coridiant

entry: POKENAME feeds on the joy of other Pokémon and will give them nice warm hugs to make them feel happy. Its tentacles are as soft as silk, so tourists will try to seek them out while at the beach.
author: mistymagius

entry: It does not mind lending out its shovels to those who wish to play. It will often seek out bickering children and encourage them to work together to build a sand castle.
author: cheroace

entry: POKENAME races across the land. Just like Togekiss, it's known as a bringer of blessings, but POKENAME visits those enduring turmoil.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME abhors senseless violence, preferring only to fight in friendly sparring matches with other altruistic beings. It will gift an opponent it respects one of its feathers, which are said to relieve tension for the carrier.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lives deep in secluded and peaceful forests. It enjoys the company of kind-hearted Pokémon such as Chansey and Sylveon.
author: mepp.

entry: Singing joyfully, POKENAME wanders through towns at night, blessing seasonal festivals. It is known as the Spirit of Jubilation.
author: alkazamis

entry: POKENAME can emit faint electric pulses that ease the symptoms of heart ailments. For this reason, it is often seen in hospitals, assisting medical staff.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This kind dragon-like fusion represents peace and good luck. The fire it produces is warm and cozy, able to melt even the coldest of hearts.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME is quite sociable and optimistic. It uses its wings to swiftly glide across the water's surface as if it were ice.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME takes an unorthodox approach to solving strife and disputes: It pummels those causing trouble until they are too bruised and weakened to continue their troublesome ways.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon dwells restlessly in the tall grass, searching ambitiously to create new rivals. Unlike most Pokémon, POKENAME seems not to live off of any earthly food, but instead craves the pure energy that radiates from the petty fights it starts.
author: ashnanodesu

entry: This kind dragon-like fusion represents peace and good luck. The fire it produces is warm and cozy, able to melt even the coldest of hearts.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME can only be found on the coasts of peaceful regions that are devoid of strife. Unfortunately, their many tentacles are extremely venomous, and so their appearance is rarely welcomed.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME eagerly showers blessings on anyone it senses is kindhearted. Even if someone manages to get on its bad side, it will quickly forget why it was mad in the first place.
author: skittytales

entry: This Pokémon serves as a symbol of hope and joy to those it protects. Its cannons can fire either powerful blasts of water or pure energy.
author: voiddx01

entry: A rare sight on secluded beaches, POKENAME's body shines with a light promising fortune and prosperity. Its outer shell, however, seems to fully block the ability to perceive this effect.
author: ocxin

entry: The meat from POKENAME's claws is described to be incredibly sweet and creamy, so they are often served at fancy restaurants. Due to this, however, POKENAME has been hunted to near extinction.
author: mistymagius

entry: It burrows into the desert sand to disguise itself as a bush. The leaves on its back taste extremely bitter to deter potential herbivores.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME dislike rain and seek out moderately dry places to rest. They feed on the roots of plants; farmers may discover their crops have stopped growing due to POKENAME having a snack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME travels in small groups, waddling across the warm desert sands. If threatened, it spins rapidly to kick up clouds of sand to obscure its escape as it burrows quickly underground.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME leave a trail of sand wherever they go. Whenever they run out of sand, they are no longer able to levitate. To prevent this from happening, they refill by eating sand from the ground.
author: mystora

entry: Its tentacles are made out of a fine sand that constantly falls apart. Despite being great for camouflage in its desert environment, it struggles to grab anything because of this.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spends the day hidden beneath the sand, emerging only at night to signal others of its kind by flashing the gem on its body. It can spin its star-shaped body at incredible speed to create sand tornadoes for protection.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Some say the tougher POKENAME's hide, the sweeter its meat. Kept in herds on the open ranges of Unova, it burrows into the dust to stay cool during the summer.
author: ghostslythe

entry: A potent venom can be injected from its horn. If threatened, POKENAME curls up into a ball shape and tries to pass itself off as a rock.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's body is made of liquid sand which it can manipulate to transform into almost any form, but it prefers to turn into spherical shapes. It loves Passho Berries because it has an intense fear of water.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Only found deep within deserts, POKENAME can sleep for years on end if left undisturbed. If one is bothered enough to wake up, it will move enough sand to sweep up a sandstorm, lashing out in all directions to launch trespassers away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can tuck in its tail and wings to appear near-identical to Sandshrew aside from the plumage atop its head. It lives among its relatives, protecting them from harm with chilling winds flung from its wings.
author: sk372

entry: Severe sandstorms can ravage the leaf atop POKENAME's head. Yet, each endured storm only seems to strengthen the plant's resilience.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME rolls in mud for long periods to keep its skin from drying out once it leaves the water. It is a very gentle Pokémon that prefers to defend itself rather than attack, though its small jaws often give others the wrong impression.
author: fiordaliso

entry: After exiting its tunnel, POKENAME carefully preens its wings clean of dirt. Its feathers are fragile and require constant upkeep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME creates spheres of webbing to push around, gathering up bugs and berries alike to bring back to its home. It is a nervous sort and will curl into a ball defensively at the slightest touch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its lures like wrecking balls to open up the clams it eats, or to break apart underwater debris in its territory.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME wander into abandoned mineshafts to search for rocks to consume. They produce small arcs of electricity that produce a bright light to find their way inside caves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To frighten enemies, POKENAME flings dirt and sand and hurls lightning bolts. It lives in small underground cave systems.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's scales cannot protect it from harsh sunlight due to its thin skin. It will dance for several hours, waiting for rain to pour so it can quench its thirst. Most of the time, however, it faints from exhaustion.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: A floral-scented sand drifts from POKENAME's body as it floats over dunes. The scent is mildly toxic if inhaled for too long.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives in desert areas, using the higher air temperature to lift it into the sky. Despite being able to survive on little water, large groups of them can be seen around oases.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME burrow deep into the ground to make their homes. They create individual rooms for food and trinkets they've gathered. If their dens are ever discovered, they will fill the entrances to the caverns with dirt and retreat to the storage rooms.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME gather in large colonies, taking turns to keep watch. They mark their territory with a gel they secrete, and if anything enters it, they all gather together and attack it. Their superior numbers are often enough to send threats running.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME gather in large colonies, taking turns to keep watch. They mark their territory with a gel they secrete, and if anything enters it, they all gather together and attack it. Their superior numbers are often enough to send threats running.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The cactus on its back can store water and supply POKENAME with liquid. The more water it has absorbed, the more splendidly it blooms.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's whiskers detect tree roots beyond its tunnel walls. Once located, it chews through the soil to feed on the roots.
author: .izik

entry: The patterns on its shell are always unique, like fingerprints, and no two are ever the same. Its special shell has the ability to feel vibrations in the ground, allowing POKENAME to anticipate danger.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME hates getting its fur wet and will take frequent dust baths to keep itself dry. It is an annoying Pokémon to take care of, as it drags in large amounts of sand wherever it goes.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME digs elaborate tunnels with its flock. These underground labyrinths are so intricate they confound even expert researchers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are witty creatures that stalk other Pokémon until they return to their burrows. Once they fall asleep, POKENAME dig into their burrow to steal food they have gathered.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME leave a trail of scorched grass wherever they go. Whenever it rains, their gritty bodies lose their traction as they solidify. Their bodies warm up after the rain ends, allowing them to continue their wandering.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME flaps its heavy wings to blast sand at its prey. Once stunned, it finishes the fight with a swift Scratch.
author: .izik

entry: Despite living in arid climates, POKENAME's shell is cold to the touch. It searches for food using its powerful nose, looking for small critters buried in the sand.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's tail bundle is just as tough as its shell. It likes to curl up in a ball at the slightest loud noise or rumble in the ground.
author: pankiwi

entry: While typically soaring over deserts, POKENAME burrows beneath the sand when the heat grows unbearable. It remains hidden until nightfall brings cooler air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has an insatiable desire to dig, so owners must constantly find ways to distract it from this instinct. It curls into an armored ball to sleep, but when around those it trusts, it may reveal its soft belly.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hides in the sand, using the rattle on its tail to ward off larger predators. Its venom isn't fatal but will cause limb paralysis for up to an hour.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME rolls at high speeds through winding tunnels. It builds decoy loops and false exits into its burrows to confuse predators that get inside.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME takes dust baths daily to remove foreign objects from its hide. Without the dust baths, seeds and spores can grow into its skin and cause irritation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME nests under soccer fields, emerging at night to play. It struggles to control its strength and often breaks the equipment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME was held in high regard by some ancient civilizations for its strength and regal appearance. Large statues depicting POKENAME have been found intact in the civilizations' ruins, managing to survive the tests of time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can curl up and quickly escape from enemies through gaps. However, should one get too close, it shocks them with painful lightning bolts.
author: chorb33

entry: A POKENAME will dance to music for hours without resting. Once satisfied, it will eat until full and then sleep for an hour before starting again.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can use its tail to create tension at certain points to shock opponents or as a support for its claws to dig through the ground.
author: chorb33

entry: A rare form of POKENAME only seen once in a decade. Research has shown it to be unafraid of humans. It's believed that this form of POKENAME has become more self-sufficient and tougher than other POKENAME.
author: thescribe

entry: Ancient Hoenn pictograms depict POKENAME helping farmers with their crops. While the sand empowering these Pokémon is barren, their staff contains precious Life Dew that gives needed nutrition to the soil.
author: ghostslythe

entry: While digging, POKENAME's skin secretes a thick yellow toxin. As it is harmless to its kin, it repels predators like Ekans from entering its burrows.
author: .izik

entry: Although many scholars disagree on the origins of POKENAME, it is widely theorized that they aided pharaohs in drawing up designs for many ancient pyramids.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME absorbs water via the cacti on its back and stores it. This means it can survive for up to three years without new water.
author: chorb33

entry: After completing a tunnel system, POKENAME rolls around at the entrance, leaking a green poison. Its unique aroma marks the burrow as claimed.
author: .izik

entry: With a body like a tank, POKENAME shrugs off almost all attacks. When enraged, it forcefully charges at enemies.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME digs out large burrows in the desert sands to cool down in. It shields smaller Pokémon from harm by curling into a ball around them, protecting them with its sturdy hide.
author: sk372

entry: Legends tell of an ancient desert temple whose location is constantly shifting. It was only recently discovered to be an unusually large POKENAME.
author: howlingstarr

entry: Found on plateaus and mesas, POKENAME prefers arid climates. On cold desert nights, POKENAME will produce flammable gases from its rear to keep itself warm.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME's ears drip a yellow poison it smears along cave walls to mark territory. It does this a day before digging to signal its intent to kin.
author: .izik

entry: Though POKENAME fails to hold itself together as a blade, it still swings its sand around at dangerous force.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Despite its harmless appearance, POKENAME shovels into sand and launches it with great force at anyone who attempts to hold it.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: There are many heroic sagas describing ancient desert kings wielding POKENAME. They are rarely seen in the present day, as they now primarily haunt the ruins of these empires.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME runs across the open deserts, charging through any obstacles in its way. Once it runs out of energy, it will lie down to start sunbathing.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's body has magnetic properties that allow it to form a mane out of sand, asserting dominance and intimidating rivals. It can move at incredible speeds even underground, using its sharp claws to dig holes and tunnels through any terrain.
author: fiordaliso

entry: By coiling its ribbons together and spinning them like a drill, POKENAME can burrow its way rapidly into the ground.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME burrows through desert sands with tidal force, leaving behind glittering trails of salt and moisture. Its scales store groundwater, making it a sacred sight in arid regions.
author: segmoph

entry: When POKENAME curls into a ball, it can be mistaken as a large boulder rolling down a hill. It slaps its tail on the ground to whip up sand in its opponent's eyes.
author: over9001

entry: The sand flowing through POKENAME's body shows how long it has before it dies. The only way for it to have enough energy to flip its hourglass and reset its life timer is if it steals spirits and converts them into fuel.
author: soup1900

entry: The sand flowing through POKENAME's body shows how long it has before it dies. The only way for it to have enough energy to flip its hourglass and reset its life timer is if it steals spirits and converts them into fuel.
author: soup1900

entry: They reside in arid environments where there is a lack of water, which makes Luminous Moss difficult to find. Even so, they enjoy eating the moss, as a tiny bit of water causes the meal to swell and fill their stomachs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends most of the day buried under the sand, only emerging under the cover of night. When threatened, it will quickly beat its wings to kick up a small cloud of dust to allow it to escape.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses aura sensitivity to avoid metal ore underground. This keeps it safe from predators like Steelix that feed on such minerals.
author: .izik

entry: While digging, POKENAME builds up electricity in its ears. This charge is used to defend itself when it exits the safety of its tunnel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live around canyons and mesas, building their nests out of the nearby sandstone. Their stone claws allow them to scale the canyon walls without fear of losing their grip.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME create sand pits in their desert homes, waiting for unwary prey to fall into their open mouth. Desert-goers often get stuck in these pits as POKENAME don't bother filling in the pits when they move on.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are mysterious Pokémon found in ancient desert temples. Their unique shape allows them to activate old mechanisms to help explorers pass.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: The flame at the end of a POKENAME's tail grows brighter when underground so it can see. It protects this flame by tossing rocks and mud at threatening Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: These small POKENAME are harmless and enjoy being picked up. Don't try to take it home without a Poké Ball, though, as they are known to track sand everywhere, no matter what.
author: roxie5228

entry: When spooked or tired, POKENAME will burrow under sand to rest temporarily. Sand often gets in their ears, disrupting their echolocation.
author: frokachu

entry: Unlike Sandshrew, POKENAME migrate closer to coastal regions, preferring to take residence along hot sandy beaches. It often is seen as a nuisance since beach-goers stepping on its sharp iron barbs will leave their foot seriously injured.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME hides from the desert heat by hanging out in its cave for most of the day. It is able to filter sand out of its mouth, so while hunting, it will often swoop into the sand and swallow anything hiding in there.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME will replace one of its eyes with a gem it likes more, with its body taking around twenty-four hours to integrate as a functioning eye. It is rare to find one with mismatched eyes, but Ruin Maniacs obsessively search for such a prize.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Usually found burrowed inside orchards, POKENAME symbiotically connects itself to the trees' roots. It feels vibrations from tunneling pests and protects the grove by releasing a foul-smelling Pokémon repellant.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Its spheres are packed with very fine sand. If it is agitated, it smashes the two spheres together, blasting sand towards its foes.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Unable to grow feathers itself, POKENAME crafts fans from ones it finds. After a few weeks they fray, and it patiently searches for new feathers to rebuild them.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME can swim swiftly through desert dunes, cutting through them with its pointed head and tough fins. It constantly hunts for other creatures to satisfy its hunger, using its sharp fangs to bring down its prey.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME block sand from their eyes with their leaves, helping them travel in harsh sandstorms. When they sleep, they wrap their leaves around themselves to disguise as tumbleweeds, waking up in the morning in a burst of sand as their leaves unfurl.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: While walking around, POKENAME's plated body remains smooth, but when it curls into a ball, it extends dozens of cacti-like spines for self-defense. Getting hit by its rolling tackle leaves a target with many a painful puncture.
author: sk372

entry: To avoid predators, POKENAME buries itself in the ground near mushrooms to avoid detection. However, even when faced with no hiding options, it will throw out sand and spores to blind and disorient the attacking Pokémon.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME can be found in deserts. These Pokémon can create fake clones of themselves that fade away when someone gets close to them.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME hides in the sand, detecting the slightest vibrations in the sand with its sensitive hairs. It hates getting wet and will roll around in the sand to get any moister out of its fur.
author: mistymagius

entry: Due to the arid environment POKENAME lives in, it has developed a brittle layer of caramelized sugar on its body. The caramel brittle is often served with luxurious desserts at fancy restaurants.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME feeds on flower roots deep underground. If it consumes a bitter root by mistake, it avoids the area for months.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is in constant search of food and water, roaming vast deserts in search of sustenance. Some theories suggest it was once a beautiful sea creature, but something forced its habitat to change.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME digs beneath rosemary plants to consume their roots. It carefully rations food so each head, with its own stomach, is properly fed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME digs deep tunnels to hide shiny treasures. These may include coins, glass, or even bottle caps it finds valuable.
author: .izik

entry: When distressed, it cries tears of sand at a rapid rate. This emotional response has a practical use for escaping a cave or pit, as POKENAME can easily dig through the pool of sand it creates.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME hates getting its fur wet, so it will take frequent dust baths to keep it dry. Its strong legs allow it to run through the desert without getting caught in the sand.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME dig below marshes to find roots to eat. When they inevitably surface, they are prone to bumping their head on stones, which results in a concussion that causes headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Unable to keep its balance, POKENAME often tumbles and curls into a ball without realizing it. Its erratic movements kick up desert sand, bewildering foes and making it hard to strike.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Clumsy by nature, POKENAME loses balance and tumbles into a curl at the slightest misstep. Its chaotic spinning whips up desert sand, creating a blinding haze that protects it from attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spins quickly to drill its way beneath the desert sand to hide itself from predators. It occasionally runs afoul of Trapinch and Diglett for ruining their own holes and tunnels.
author: sk372

entry: While POKENAME acts tough, when confronted with a stronger opponent, it will frantically fling sand at its attacker before fleeing. It lives near canyon walls, its scaly hide blending in with the rock.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME often runs amok in ancient temples, pummeling the stone structures until they are nothing but dust. However, it is also quite timid and will flee if confronted by another Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: Because POKENAME seems to dislike large bodies of water, it likes to lay in the sun and roll around in loose dirt to keep dry. Young POKENAME have been recorded yipping and barking at the rain during storms.
author: bobosmith01

entry: At night, this Pokémon wraps itself into a ball. When POKENAME awakens and flies off, the sand that forms its wings shifts and emits a loud hum.
author: fivetailedfurret

entry: When it feels it is in danger or wants to sleep, POKENAME teleports to a far-off hidden burrow deep underground where only it lives. If the burrow is discovered, it creates another one far, far away from the original.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME wields immense psychic powers, allowing it to lift chunks of earth and hurl them at its foes. Legends claim it unearthed its silver spoon while digging deep beneath the ground.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can crush rocks with their hands, and they often appear on construction sites to help construction workers. Despite their fierce appearance, POKENAME are actually quite mild and do not like battling.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME spins through caves while curled in its shell because it is faster than relying on its stubby legs. Sometimes its shell cracks when barrelling through caves, which forces it to take a break while it heals.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hangs from trees located near desert oases, sucking up insects that fly close to its gaping mouth. Its skin helps retain moisture, so a single sip of water will sustain it for a week.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rolls down hills in order to wear down its rocky skin, and then rests to heal and reinforce it. Sometimes, POKENAME struggles to fully curl up into a ball due to its limbs and circular body.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: POKENAME intense internal heat causes its sandy mane to turn to glass. The glass is still incredibly hot, hot enough to ignite any flora on contact.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lazes around in the desert sun, keeping its skin nice and dry. However, it will often not notice it's been in the sun too long, and its skin will slowly start to burn.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME wanders through the desert looking for magnetic filings in the sand. However, if the weather gets too hot, its magnets will start melting, essentially making them useless.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME seek out fields of wheat, their favorite food. This often leads to farmers complaining about flocks of POKENAME destroying their crops.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will cover their cannon barrels in shrubs and berries, then bury themselves completely in sand to ambush smaller Pokémon who attempt to eat the berries.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME is timid, and hides in the sandstorm that surrounds its body. It has a lot of fans in Trainers that favor cute Pokémon.
author: soupalicious

entry: POKENAME can divide its body individually to efficiently roll down mountainsides for fast, downward travel. If its body is damaged, it will roll in mud and sit in the scorching sun, filling the cracked spots and hardening its body again.
author: to_heck_and_back_

entry: When POKENAME is startled, it summons sandstorms by swinging its Smooth Rock. It rarely leaves its cover of sand.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME vibrate obnoxiously, trying to attract curious prey. When they get too close, POKENAME swiftly uses Thunder to neutralize them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME relies on its agility to maneuver around opponents. Its lightning-fast kicks get progressively faster as the battle continues.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's compound eyes allow it to not just see all around itself, but to also direct its immense psychic power at multiple targets simultaneously. Its wings can create physically-powerful shockwaves, despite being too weak for flight.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite its size, POKENAME can fly using the wings around its neck. To do this, it rapidly spins the wings, which oddly releases a sweet aroma as it does.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Its spectacular senses are overshadowed by its capacity to create completely silent shock waves with its wings, inflicting critical internal injuries.
author: mx_wellman

entry: Its entire belly is like a gemstone within which one can see the electricity that this Pokémon generates as its wings rapidly flutter. It will capture prey within its eight limbs before electrocuting them and carrying them back to its nest.
author: infinex21

entry: Extremely dangerous and violent, POKENAME is able to use its lens-boosted psychic powers to rip apart the foe's bodies instantly without difficulty.
author: soup1900

entry: The churning buzz generated by the flapping of POKENAME's wings disrupts radio transmissions and electronics nearby. Its singular red eye glows ominously in pitch-black conditions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's punches slice through the air, creating sonic boom shockwaves. This has made it increasingly popular among police forces for its ability to stop suspects in their tracks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME can run up to 100 mph, using its strong wings to keep up the pace when its legs get tired. Once it catches its prey, it will proceed to rip them apart with its raptor-like talons.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its green skin is covered in tiny slick hairs that help it remain agile even in the downpours of spring. Although it has an incredibly powerful bite, the fluttering organ around its neck is used most frequently to channel and fire attacks.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can travel across whole regions in a single day. They congregate at power plants to collect enough electricity to protect their young.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME augment its body with scrap metal and spare parts to improve its speed. It races with other Pokémon to assess how efficiently it can traverse through the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a territorial and aggressive creature that strikes its foes while rapidly beating its large wings. It channels energy into the crest along its back, electrifying its tail with crackling sparks to deliver devastating blows.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon can launch both flames and sonic shockwaves from its cannon-like arms, and will often combine them to create destructive fireballs. Its large tail will be used to stabilize itself as it fires it cannons or to keep foes at a distance.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME pursues prey with blinding speed before pinning them down with its razor-sharp claws. It never lets a target escape.
author: .izik

entry: The many quills of a POKENAME can vibrate at remarkable speeds, producing small shockwaves that allow them to pulverize solid ground into mere sand. They secure prey with the pincer upon their tail and then slash into them with their strong claws.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's many eyes allow it to track every movement of its opponents during a fight, letting it strike at every opening. Its legs can thrust so quickly that they produce a shockwave capable of shattering small boulders.
author: infinex21

entry: Highly confident in its developing strength, POKENAME can vibrate its arms at rapid, almost imperceptible speeds. This strengthens its muscles, allowing it to clap its hands and create a potent shockwave to knock even the heaviest of opponents over.
author: sk372

entry: Its eyes are capable of seeing colors that the human eye can't perceive. It uses its superior vision to prey on smaller Pokémon that rely on camouflage to avoid predators.
author: griddle

entry: Despite their bulk, POKENAME can fly at incredible speeds. Their psychic powers help to keep them off the ground, allowing the propulsion from their wings to operate with little resistance and letting them carry momentum into their punches.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME lies in wait until groups of smaller prey gather together. It then takes to the air, stunning them with shockwaves generated from its powerful wingbeat before snatching them up into its false jaws.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME, using its powerful head, can create powerful shock waves by impacting the ground. These shock waves can cause severe internal injuries.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME's body is hollow, making it unnaturally light. It zips through forests with chilling speed, leaving behind a ghostly buzz.
author: .izik

entry: It acts as a shelter and coordinator for Yanma, allowing their populations to flourish. The beacon on its back displays complex signals that only Yanma can see.
author: staghorn

entry: Extremely territorial and dangerous, many do not even glimpse POKENAME because it flies so quickly to intercept intruders invading its home. The humming sound of its wings is a telltale sign of danger, with some likening it to a song of warning.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It can be seen flitting about above lakes while hunting for food. Its serpentine body allows for extremely streamlined movement through the air.
author: bacondlx

entry: It can take down foes much larger than it by manipulating their emotions with its feelers and destroying them from the inside using the shockwaves created by the flap of its wings.
author: cheroace

entry: POKENAME is an extremely ancient insectoid Pokémon. The flutter of its heavy wings create massive tidal storms as it migrates between islands.
author: nellnast42

entry: The beat of POKENAME's wings causes massive windstorms that can blow over entire castles in a single day. It is believed to silence those who lie to others for money and power by biting their heads off.
author: soup1900

entry: Sightings of POKENAME are often followed by mass destruction. Those that spot it are advised to prepare for war.
author: _testrun_

entry: POKENAME have forsaken their wings for tougher exoskeletons and sharper tusks. Now, their tusks can cleave through trees like axes, their claws can shatter rocks, and their tails could send even a Rhyhorn flying for at least a mile.
author: infinex21

entry: Its wings grow hotter each time they are flapped and can reach temperatures high enough to melt iron. The buzzing sound it produces can create shockwaves capable of driving away enemies that get too close.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Zipping through swamp skies at unbelievable speeds, POKENAME nab their prey out of the air using their three heads and eight wings. With all three heads having near-360-degree vision, it is considered impossible to surprise.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME are the most common in June, when the sky is filled with Volbeat and Illumise. It takes a special liking to all bug-types, acting aggressive to anything endangering them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME buries itself in sand, waiting for prey to stumble near. Once in range, its wings whip up a storm of sand all around, dazing prey and making it easier for POKENAME to pounce upon them.
author: sk372

entry: They travel as large groups in the night sky. Provoking them will bring about the wrath of far greater threats.
author: _testrun_

entry: Wild POKENAME are one of the most preyed on of Pokémon. However, it can easily zip away from a Pokémon's grasp and fly away.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Hordes of wild POKENAME will eat through entire fields in minutes. Farmers often keep plenty of repels on them to reduce the risk of a swarm.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME have grown quite confident in themselves compared to their younger forms, and their wings have grown strong enough to keep them aloft for longer. Now their quick movements aid them in dealing quick, powerful blows to any would-be predators.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME flies through cavern tunnels in search of topaz deposits. When it finds a cluster, it devours the gems with glinting hunger.
author: .izik

entry: During its mating season, POKENAME dances to attract others of its kind. It hunts voraciously to resupply the calories it spends on dancing.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly fast swimmer, capable of launching itself 100 feet out of the water. However, it must constantly stay in motion to keep its blood pumping fast enough to sustain its metabolism.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has developed special horns upon its head that allow it to fire powerful sonic shockwaves with destructive precision. The wings upon its arms allow it to fly in short bursts of extreme speed as it bombards foes with sonic blasts.
author: infinex21

entry: It can spin its wings like a propeller, allowing it to cover wide areas in its pollen and seeds.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME regularly travels vast distances in arid areas, flying between oases to search for food and hydration. It rains spines from its arms down on prey from above when on the hunt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can emit roars of various frequencies that summon myriad auroras. Their legs allow them to traverse the roughest and slickest terrain with ease during yearly migrations due to how sharp and tough they are.
author: infinex21

entry: Though unable to fly properly, POKENAME can reach incredible speeds using its powerful wings. Its speed and strength make it a daunting challenge for bug catchers.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME makes a buzzing sound from inside its body as it descends from the sky. Parts of its outer shell fall off in chunks to the ground below, creating a trail of debris as it lands.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies high in the sky during the day, but at night, it rests by hovering in one place. During this time, its eyes close, and it becomes difficult to spot in the darkness, resulting in many near-misses by planes.
author: .izik

entry: The roar of a POKENAME is of such a strong pitch and destructive force that it can shatter rocks with ease. It uses its many arms to secure prey before dousing them with intense flames.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME fights by swooping down on opponents, delivering devastating blows. Its fists are made of a thick, previously undiscovered kind of chitin.
author: 8xviktor

entry: The rapid beating of POKENAME's wings creates a buzzing sound akin to static. The motions create magnetic waves strong enough to visibly distort the air immediately around it.
author: sk372

entry: It hovers over the surface of calm waters and scoops up aquatic prey in its large pincer. When it catches something, it crushes them in a single snap.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are capable of running at full speed while carrying a rock in their arms. This is especially helpful when predators attack, as a rock and a net made of silk are usually enough to pin them down before escaping.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This fusion was first created by the Poké Ball expert Kurt, during his attempts of perfecting his craft of forging new Poké Balls.
author: funkytomate

entry: It grows leaves from the joints of its shell, which causes it great discomfort if not trimmed. Chefs will adopt a POKENAME and use its leaves to make spiced stew such as gumbo.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME instinctively protects its egg and soon offspring by releasing a sweet aroma. This aroma can calm predators, but it might attract unwanted attention.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: Naturally shy, it is a rare sight to see a POKENAME. They are drawn to the soothing melody of wind chimes.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME floats on the water's surface in order to soak up sunlight for photosynthesis. Unfortunately, this makes it easily snatched up by predators in search of an easy meal.
author: sk372

entry: A pitifully weak Pokémon, POKENAME can only rely on its massive leaf for protection. It eats as much as it can to speed up its evolution.
author: mepp.

entry: One myth writes about two Eevee that grew up in harmony on the grassy plains and floral woodlands, eventually fusing into one being: POKENAME. The POKENAME then set out on a journey, illustrating the growth they still needed to undergo.
author: bobosmith01

entry: One myth writes about two Eevee that grew up in harmony on the grassy plains and floral woodlands, eventually fusing into one being: POKENAME. The POKENAME then set out on a journey, illustrating the growth they still needed to undergo.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A rare woodland Pokémon with an omnivorous diet, POKENAME typically has a penchant for earthen and bitter flavors. It can scarf down the horridly bitter Durin Berry in just two bites.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon lives in still waters and clears the excessive algae from them. The ponds where POKENAME lives are always crystal clear.
author: milchik

entry: Eevee are thought to take on this form in the wild when they live in humid swamps or jungles. They make their home in plant life amongst rivers and streams.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Eevee are thought to take on this form in the wild when they live in humid swamps or jungles. They make their home in plant life amongst rivers and streams. Without water, POKENAME grow sick and dull in color.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The more POKENAME photosynthesizes sunlight, the warmer its body grows. After a point, the leafy parts of its fur will begin to smoke and emit a faintly bitter aroma.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hang from tree branches awaiting the day that they evolve. If they fall from a tree branch, they sprout vines to pick themselves up and find a different branch to hang from.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Ancient art resembling POKENAME leads some to speculate that Kabutops lived much more recently than previously thought. Without fossil evidence, archaeologists instead conclude that the art depicts a stylized Leafwak holding two leaf blades.
author: .fedoraman

entry: The leafy membranes of POKENAME's wings spread a sweet scent with every flap. It flies over forests and uses the scent to lure out insects and other small creatures for it to snap up for easy meals.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is extremely picky and refuses to eat unless its meal is garnished with fennel fronds. Trainers often struggle to meet its oddly refined tastes.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME dwells deep in the woods, swiftly rushing between trees to guard its kingdom. Where they land, the surrounding plants are reinvigorated.
author: ayner

entry: POKENAME slithers over to the nearest berry tree it can find when it's time for it to shed its skin. The discarded skin biodegrades quickly and will nourish the tree and increase the quality of its next berry batch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its forearms to deliver sharp, venomous stings. If cooked, this poison has many health benefits and is vital in a dish called Stew Noon Wets, named after a tale of how the toxin was first extracted, by dousing POKENAME in water at noon.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Every six months, the leaves around POKENAME's neck naturally fall off. Instead of discarding them, they can be used to make Heal Powder. The green antennae on its head allow it to absorb sunlight and stay full of energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The leaves that POKENAME grow explode if struck with any force. They're a popular ingredient in salsas due to their spiciness.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME likes to snack on leaves that have fallen off of trees during the verdant spring seasons. It uses its tail to boost itself up and get even fresher leaves off of low-hanging branches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME always cheerfully flies through the woods, looking for someone to play with in the leaves. When it flies, colorful leaves appear behind it.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME's wool is actually tightly-packed foliage that lets it greatly absorb sunlight for photosynthesis. If kept properly groomed, small flowers may bloom on it when spring arrives.
author: sk372

entry: A rare brightly-colored variant of POKENAME exists, most often spotted in coastal regions. After spending all day in the sunlight, its wool-like foliage will glow in the dark for a few hours.
author: sk372

entry: The orb at the base of POKENAME's tail glows bright while it absorbs nutrients from sunlight. It also stores POKENAME's electricity, surging up its leafy tail before being fired off in quick bolts.
author: sk372

entry: Wool from a POKENAME feels like the softest grass, but is prone to static electricity. Petting it is risk versus reward.
author: 22ndsolstice

entry: POKENAME boasts incredible vision that even functions in the dark. Although it can synthesize energy from the sun, it must hunt at night if it wants more energy. Their fur is a mild skin irritant and many people are outright allergic to it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It protects its flower bud by swinging around its cluster of sharp leaves. POKENAME stands it the same spot for hours on end, absorbing nutrients from the soil.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lives in forests within the vicinity of ancient ruins, camouflaging itself against the foliage. It scrapes symbols into the tree bark to communicate with others of its kind, though the meanings of the markings have yet to be deciphered.
author: sk372

entry: Its root-tentacles are powerful enough to drain an entire pond within moments. If full, a POKENAME can survive months without water.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME are caretakers of forests and plant life, spreading seeds to help regrow plants in places lost to forest fires.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME soars over forests by diving from the tall trees where it builds its nest. Its flat, leaf-shaped tail grants it excellent stability in flight and is also used to drive away enemy Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are expert predators. They hide themselves within large amounts of seagrass and snipe their prey with pressurized water.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides in hedges near family homes. When it finds lost toys, it will return them to the family's doorstep.
author: rosemagwin

entry: It uses the leaf-shaped tip of its tail to lure unsuspecting Pokémon into traps. POKENAME can produce a greenish venom which, when properly refined, becomes an ingredient for a tonic that soothes sore throats.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While POKENAME is often praised for its ability to revive desecrated areas, there have been cases where its powers caused nature to spiral out of control and overtake villages.
author: xenellia

entry: Sometimes, whenever it launches a flurry of razor-sharp leaves, it leaves behind a Leaf Letter. What it says or how it got there is a mystery.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It uses its twig-like tails to swing from tree to tree. Despite their fragile appearance, they are actually quite strong, capable of bearing POKENAME's full weight.
author: _._starry_._

entry: This vigilant variant of POKENAME guards its forest with its life. If it spots a disturbance, it can quickly assemble a weapon from its surroundings.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME camouflages into forest foliage, and strikes from afar using a wooden bow it crafted. It displays remarkable wit and adaptability.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is known to be a caring guardian to all forest-dwelling Pokémon, serenading them with beautiful lullabies. Against those who would despoil nature, POKENAME shows no mercy as it unleashes its Leaf Storm.
author: mepp.

entry: The scent of the flowers on the body of POKENAME draws pollinators such as Combee or Beautifly. This creates a symbiotic relationship between them. POKENAME protects the pollinators from predators, and they keep the flowers alive.
author: jojojax164

entry: POKENAME resembles old, outdated depictions from when the Leafeon species was first being discovered. It gets most of its nutrients through digging its root-like paws into the ground and feeding off the soil.
author: sk372

entry: Clearings in the jungle are the perfect place for POKENAME to carry out photosynthesis. It will store some energy for itself while using the rest to feed plants and other flora.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The younger a POKENAME is, the more unsteady it will be on its feet. Trainers will hold POKENAME until it can walk on its own, enjoying the warmth and fragrant scent it gives off while in their arms.
author: krivaswell

entry: POKENAME spends its days snuffling through forest undergrowth in search of tree roots and small Bug-type Pokémon. The crest of leaves on POKENAME's back is hard as rock and stands up when POKENAME is scared.
author: shreks_stepfather

entry: Despite having a sturdy, powerful body, POKENAME is content to live its days resting in the mud, absorbing excess energy from the plant life that grows around it. It rarely hunts for Water-type Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A playful and kind Pokémon that is said to hear the souls of plantlife, POKENAME is friendly to almost any that approach its home. However, those who don't respect nature will earn its ire, and learn a very harsh lesson.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefer to stay deep in forests so that they might craft medicine for sick wild Pokémon. They're said to understand the souls of plants.
author: quote.lass

entry: This subspecies of Mawile lives in the deepest jungles. They spend most of the day with their body wedged into a small nook or crevice, sleeping soundly, while their flytrap-like second mouth lies open and waiting.
author: modeustheunbound

entry: POKENAME approach lumberjacks to warn them when someone is about to get hurt by a falling tree. The loggers who heed their warning can avert a crisis by cutting the tree from a different angle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The twin leaves of POKENAME wrap around the stems and trunks of plants and trees, draining them of their life energy to feed itself. In a dire situation, it can stick into the ground to absorb nutrients from roots.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME will bond with its pack through play by lowering its head and swishing its tail, its yellow flower crackling with eager electricity.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It relies primarily on photosynthesis for energy, often basking in sunlight to rest. A healthy POKENAME boasts a larger flower at the end of its tail.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Wild POKENAME are exceedingly rare, but several have been recorded across the world, visiting beautiful gardens with loving caretakers. They grant the gardener a single rare Berry or treasure, and leave within three hours.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Trainers that own a POKENAME seem to age slower, with their average life expectancy 5 years longer than normal. This may be due to POKENAME being able to clean the air surrounding them, reducing pollution-related illnesses.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is thought to be in-tune with the souls of trees. It rests near the tallest and longest-living trees in its home, tending the soil near them and keeping them healthy.
author: sk372

entry: It typically conducts photosynthesis to obtain its energy. If sunlight is blocked from reaching POKENAME, it can instead subdue and consume prey using its poisonous whips.
author: archasia

entry: If Eefable rests in certain woodlands, it can evolve into POKENAME thanks to the potent natural energy in the area. With the power of a used Moon Stone and POKENAME's ability to photosynthesize for an energy boost, it now merely needs water to live.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is so light that almost any breeze can blow it away. Trainers are advised to hold it at all times to prevent this.
author: ferdirenz

entry: POKENAME live off of the sunlight that they absorb through their leafy bodies. They convert this solar energy into nutrients and into electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME radiates a mesmerizing glow from its leafy flames. Typically found in dark forests, POKENAME will constantly search for bright open areas to photosynthesize. Lost travelers, with this knowledge, will follow POKENAME to safety.
author: nightwingjay

entry: Although POKENAME evolved to gain energy through photosynthesis, its size now demands more than sunlight can provide. To sustain itself, it blocks small sections of running water, creating nutrient-rich pools where algae grow, which it feeds upon.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's song puts others to sleep while aiding in the growth of plant life around it. They say anyone who falls asleep to its song in the wild will wake up surrounded by beautiful blooming flowers.
author: sk372

entry: With the help of its cute face, POKENAME carries away children who wander off into the forest.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's tail harness negative emotions and use the energy to grow. Collecting its leaves is dangerous work but can be brewed into a foul-smelling tonic that some people believe keeps the drinker safe from evil spirits.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME has gargantuan jaws capable of shredding thick metal. However, it must spend time in the sun to photosynthesise in order to gather the energy and strength to do this.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME are found deep within winding forests in packs of five. If they find a lost Trainer, they will gently float towards the forest's edge to help guide them back to safety.
author: vlavoc

entry: Because POKENAME feeds itself through photosynthesis, it is skilled at cultivating other plants, even in the arid climates where it lives. Many desert communities rely on POKENAME's knowledge for their food supply.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME bask under moonlight to photosynthesize energy, supplementing their diet with other plants in their environment. Healthy POKENAME emit a spearmint smell from their leaf-like sails.
author: chibitales

entry: A proud and loyal Pokémon. POKENAME scout the forest to make sure the area is safe and clean. The leaves in their fur produce clean air when they run.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME dance along many ballades that are filled with poetic drama. Their light, leafy bodies dance with passion and grace as they act out various verses in a form of interpretive dance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME reluctantly share mushrooms from their back but usually expect some help propagating their spores in return. Stealing one of their mushrooms is the fastest way to get cut up by razor sharp leaves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slumbers in the sun and never stirs. Legends say that it is slowly feeding off the sun's energy, and will one day gather enough light to bring devastation to the world.
author: superfloxes

entry: Each POKENAME bonds with a tree in its woodland home. Through its mysterious power, both the tree and POKENAME grow much quicker and healthier than they otherwise would. This effect fades if POKENAME leaves the area.
author: bobosmith01

entry: No longer having an affinity for Fire, POKENAME resides peacefully within forests. They tend to a garden they raise with seeds found from foraging. It was able to restore the Leaf Stone used in its evolution as a memento of its growth.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME rest in gardens, soaking up sunlight to grow larger. They're a popular choice of pet when they're small, but many people do not realize just how big they can grow to be.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME produces a tea-flavored nectar that is incorporated into baked goods. It can be quite mischievous and is known to pull small pranks in the kitchen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME catches the scent of prey, it crouches low in the bushes, revealing only the tips of its leaf-shaped ears. Always hungry, it attempts to bite anything that comes within reach of its jaws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME runs around to generate momentum, then cleaves through opponents with its sharp crest and defends itself with its spiky tail. It is much more dangerous than its appearance suggests.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME dives from the tallest trees in the forest to bravely attack anyone who invades its territory. If it gifts someone one of its magnificent leaf-shaped feathers, it means they've earned its respect.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are commonly spotted in gardens, basking in the sunlight. If in a good mood, they will smell similar to catnip when their fur is stroked.
author: kitarchen

entry: POKENAME have flowers growing within their body that allow them to telepathically communicate with plants. They are constantly bombarded with messages from plants and develop headaches from being overstimulated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME absorb most of their nutrients through their leafy body but are often slowed down by the weight of their leaves. They eat their leaves before a swim since the leaves regrow within a day.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is found in temperate and tropical rivers, where it primarily sustains itself by absorbing sunlight in the shallows. It hunts fish Pokémon when there has been little sunlight by lying in wait in reeds or under driftwood.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME tends to hide in the underbrush, where it can blend in perfectly. It can release small sparks from its mouth, and if someone tries to touch it without permission, it gives them a shock.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's wings cause tornadoes that scatter sharp leaves capable of piercing skin, rock, and bark. It lives in dense forests and hibernates in winter, when the leaves have fallen.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: In a factory during the bagging process, it finds its way into a Pack of Potatoes before napping. When it wakes up, it devours the potatoes before escaping from the bag.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's preferred napping spot is within large piles of leaves to hide itself. If disturbed, it uses telekinesis to scatter the leaves and distract the intruder to help cover its escape via teleportation.
author: sk372

entry: Mastering photosynthesis, it camouflages itself among rocks, often mistaken for mere boulders by unsuspecting hikers.
author: anarchaz

entry: An ancient book is all that is left of an old culture. The story tells of a vain POKENAME that would gaze into a pool of water to admire its beauty, and barely ever move. It ended up becoming rooted to the spot and transforming into a tree.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses its tail to attract seaweed-favoring fish. Thankfully, most of these fish happen to be its prey.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME produce dreams of tranquil forests whenever they hypnotize another Pokémon. These dreams are quite calming and leave many dreamers feeling quite refreshed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The temperature around this Pokémon drops down to -12°C. It is able to form small ice spikes in its path while walking.
author: watermelonchild

entry: POKENAME keep warm by huddling together with furry Pokémon. When another Pokémon threatens to break up the group, POKENAME ensnare the dangerous Pokémon with silk before escaping with their friends.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To keep itself from overheating, it will freeze the temperature around it. This, however, causes massive blizzards wherever it passes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can be found surrounded by ice where they rest until they evolve. The ice is difficult to break with claws or talons, leading to many predators giving up before reaching POKENAME inside.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME psychically controls cold winds to expel intruders from its cave. It values its solitude and dislikes being disturbed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a natural artist. It will create ice sculptures displaying various ballet poses.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME mainly eat mint and other soothing herbs that give a fresh scent. They are known to approach injured Pokémon and gently wrap wounds with a layer of snow to ease the pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: People often see POKENAME's head as being tucked into its snowy fur, but they are mistaken, as the real head is the snowy fur itself.
author: qwertyelephant

entry: Snow and ice created by POKENAME feels warm, yet only melts when under natural conditions. Embers and fire are the opposite, holding a frigid aura that burns things it touches.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME typically evolve during fall after a long hot summer. They keep themselves cool by enveloping themselves in a shell of ice to give themselves shade.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME shoot icicles from their stingers to maximize the range of their venom. Once a venom-filled icicle strikes another Pokémon, it takes about five seconds before the venom causes aching chills.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite being made of pure ice, the crystals on POKENAME's back are hot to the touch. They are known to be docile and friendly companions.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME are clever hunters that use their feminine heads to lure others into their cold webs. Once their prey is entangled, they will inject them with a bone-chilling venom and drag them into their lair.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their psychic powers to produce beautiful auroras. They are said to be able to read the future in the dancing lights their powers create.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's orbs glow brightly during blizzards, acting as a guide for lost travelers. It can't provide warmth or shelter, though, so it often teams up with other Pokémon.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It rides the icy winds to move from one place to another, avoiding sinking into the snow. If POKENAME is not careful enough, blizzards can blow it far away from home.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are so cold that rivers with colonies of them are 6°C colder than they would be otherwise, making them much more prone to freezing. If this happens, they poke holes into the ice so enough oxygen can still get into the water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Groups of POKENAME tend to be most active on cold winter nights. They use the shadows to blend in, launching surprise attacks with freezing breath that can immobilize foes in an instant.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME flower bud produces icy spores that will freeze anything they touch instantly. It is said that blizzards form once its flower is ready to bloom.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME forms snowballs in its claws to play with allies. This friendly behavior is reserved only for those it trusts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its tusks to dig up the roots of bushes. These nutrient-rich roots are its favorite food source.
author: .izik

entry: Their ears help them regulate their body temperature. The berries they keep in their bundle can be made into ice pops.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME sneakily joins snowball fights. In summer, it makes snowcones for anyone it meets.
author: rosemagwin

entry: Sights of POKENAME running through the tundra are said to be some of the most beautiful, its mane as stunning as the auroras.
author: xenellia

entry: POKENAME has the ability to breathe out a chilling mist or burning flames, even able to swap between them without pausing for breath. It gets sick easily if the temperature around it isn't consistently moderate.
author: sk372

entry: An ancient legend states that the crystal on top of POKENAME's head can instantly freeze anything that makes contact with it.
author: eeveelutiongeek

entry: Living on cold mountain slopes, POKENAME subsists on a diet of snow and ice. It eats up to 20lbs of snow a day as it gathers energy for evolution.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME carves holes in the sides of giant glaciers to make its own personal den. Trespassers might only catch a fleeting glimpse of it before it blows them away with a torrential blizzard generated from the icy gem on its torso.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME isolates in remote mountain forests where few Pokémon inhabit, only seeking out others of its kind if it senses oncoming danger. It launches ice crystals through the night sky to create the impression of the aurora, which people wish upon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME isolates in remote mountain forests where few Pokémon inhabit, only seeking out others of its kind if it senses oncoming danger. It launches ice crystals through the night sky to create the impression of the aurora, which people wish upon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME isolates in remote mountain forests where few Pokémon inhabit, only seeking out others of its kind if it senses oncoming danger. It launches ice crystals through the night sky to create the impression of the aurora, which people wish upon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its body is so cold that even brief contact can freeze an opponent solid. Despite this, its agility allows it to perform rapid, graceful acrobatics.
author: .izik

entry: The ice crystals on POKENAME's body are as hard as diamonds, allowing it to pulverize tough stone. Groups of POKENAME can be seen moving tons of snow after large snowstorms.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has two heads with different temperature preferences. It can be difficult for Trainers to keep both heads happy at the same time.
author: _snakeywakey_
