entry: A bitter chill cold enough to flash freeze water follows POKENAME as it walks. It's popular during summertime events, allowing people and Pokémon to cool off quickly.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's pale coat helps keep it perfectly camouflaged in snowy environments. It hunts by stalking its prey for extended lengths of time, only striking when it finds the perfect moment for an ambush.
author: mepp.

entry: It can fire the icicles that grow on its tail with precise accuracy. The berries that grow on its back are colorful year round and are apparently quite sweet, but POKENAME only shares them willingly with its young.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a unique fighting style equally balancing fire and ice. Its brutal combination of burning and freezing strikes makes it tough to face.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are often beloved by their Trainers due to their boyish personalities and charming lack of intelligence.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME practices its abilities by freezing lakes. Its prowess with the cold allows it to do this no matter what climate it is in.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Despite their regal appearance, POKENAME are extremely territorial, fighting off any potential rivals with freezing winds and psychic force. Their cruelty and beauty have led to Trainers in snowy regions referring to them as 'Chiller Queens'.
author: cinnamoone_redfield

entry: POKENAME stakes out claims on mountaintops, building palatial nests out of pure ice. Due to rumors of otherworldly powers, townsfolk travel to its home to ask for their desires. However, every miracle requires a sacrifice.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is an unusually playful yet protective Pokémon. It enjoys fascinating others by creating various shapes and patterns from ice crystals.
author: vaporvenator

entry: Folklore tells of POKENAME who scatters large, incandescent snowflake crystals along unseen paths through treacherous and icy terrain to guide the pure of heart to shelter, while wicked souls shall be trapped in an unending blizzard forevermore.
author: silentscript89

entry: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. It controls the elements as if wielding magic, bending ice and more to its will. Rumors say that powerful POKENAME can summon icy specters of those it defeats in battle.
author: mercsthorn

entry: This Pokémon resembles a fighter from a far-off land. It controls the elements as if wielding magic, bending ice and more to its will. Rumors say that powerful POKENAME can summon icy specters of those it defeats in battle.
author: mercsthorn

entry: After working together to make a dam, POKENAME will breathe ice breath across the structure to coat it with frost. This frost is unique in that only POKENAME can traverse it; any others will slide right off the slippery surface.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME freezes ponds to create smooth surfaces for sliding. It does this purely for fun and often invites others to join.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's main body can freeze the atmosphere around it, creating snow, icy spikes which can shoot off as projectiles, and its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME can freeze the atmosphere around it, creating snow or ice crystals it can fire at opponents.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Despite being made of ice, its blade is very hard and sharp. One slash of it can slice a foe in half and freeze the surrounding air simultaneously.
author: adrian151

entry: POKENAME live high up in the atmosphere and make their homes amongst storm clouds. Their bodies are so cold that they cause the clouds they live in to drop in temperature, creating harsh blizzards.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live high up in the atmosphere and make their homes amongst storm clouds. Their bodies are so cold that they cause the clouds they live in to drop in temperature, creating harsh blizzards.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: To combat opponents, POKENAME creates portals that summon heavy blizzards to pelt foes with snow and hail. Analysis of ice shows the origin of the snowfall comes from all over the world, and possibly even distant icy planets in deep space.
author: sk372

entry: Found frolicking on tundra ice, POKENAME depends on its fine fur to lock in comfortable temperatures. If an Arctic storm grows too cold, they huddle together in a giant herd.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME relentlessly search for those who discarded it. Legend says it lurks in icy wastelands, awaiting unsuspecting wanderers.
author: anarchaz

entry: It is a very rare sight, only appearing on winter nights when the moon is visible.  It can hop across lakes by freezing the water beneath its feet.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME uses electricity it consumes to produce its webs. This web inflicts a freezing shock to whoever it ensnares.
author: keksalot2000

entry: POKENAME soars above icy mountains, where the cold temperatures cause small hailstones to form on its wings. Each flap of its wings creates a gust of freezing-cold wind.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME stores potent fire energy within its body to be unleashed on its foes. Despite this, its fluffy coating is freezing to the touch.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME stores potent fire energy within its body to be unleashed on its foes. Despite this, its fluffy coating is freezing to the touch.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME is able to resist cold temperatures, but if it needs extra protection, it can freeze its outer membrane solid. Incredibly elusive; it can control the water in the air to turn it into an obscuring snowfall.
author: bobosmith01

entry: If you find a POKENAME in the wild, it's best to leave it be, or this cold introvert will point sharp icicles in your direction.
author: ladan

entry: POKENAME burrows into snow mounds to hide from predators. It surprises them by hopping out before quickly escaping.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME silently floats in snowy mountains, observing hikers. This behavior can be unnerving when hikers suddenly spot it around a corner.
author: .izik

entry: Its fur protects it from the strongest of elements, so POKENAME are often found in ice storms. Its speed in hail is unmatched by most common Pokémon.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME can be faintly heard singing bittersweet melodies during snowstorms. It is unknown whether its dancing causes it to snow, or if it only dances when it snows.
author: kittyluv090

entry: If a child has become lost within a snowstorm, POKENAME will sense it. It rushes to the child's side and draws them to the closest place where warmth and safety can be found.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is native to frozen mountain peaks, and its pollen appears as snowflakes. When this pollen is ingested, it makes Trainers or Pokémon feel numb before they faint. Feeling bad about the injury, it feeds the affected its antidote nectar.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are highly adaptive swimmers, surviving in both tropical and freezing temperatures. Their ears can detect fluctuation in temperature, including the body heat from nearby Pokémon.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME roots around for fungi in the dirt before breathing a chilling breeze of air over the mushrooms. It refuses to eat the fungus until it is completely frozen over.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME whistles, the surrounding air begins to freeze. As it whistles when happy, it's best not to make it too cheerful.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME spots an intimidating opponent, it freezes its fur to make its hairs sharp like icy needles. It then recklessly charges in with no regard for its own safety.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME sing many carols and hymns during certain festivals to inspire feelings of merriment and joy. For many elders, nostalgia is passed down to children through these old songs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that POKENAME appears on winter nights during the full moon, granting Trainers peaceful dreams.
author: fluttershy0471

entry: The mushrooms that grow from the spores of POKENAME can survive in extreme cold, winds, and both wet and dry weather. However, the mushrooms also easily perish if the temperature grows too hot.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's thick, cold scales continue to let off a chill after they're shed. In the past, humans used them to keep food fresh.
author: nyoomymph

entry: Moving to snow-capped mountains, POKENAME's fur has adapted to help resist the chilling environment. It still needs to use its Fire-Type abilities to keep itself warm despite now gaining the Ice-Type, of which it's still learning to control.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME no longer needs its Fire-Type abilities to withstand the biting cold of the mountains. It was able to restore the Ice Stone used in its evolution as a memento of its growth, keeping it extra protected in a thick cocoon of solid ice.
author: merclipse

entry: As it flies, POKENAME leaves a long trail of snowflakes behind it, which fall to the ground and cover everything below it in a blanket of snow.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME infuses its ice with sweet flavors, which are used in dessert drinks. Bartenders and baristas around the world rely on its help to amaze customers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As it flies, POKENAME leaves a long trail of snowflakes behind it, which fall to the ground and cover everything below it in a blanket of snow.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's extremities turned into solid ice after evolving. As a result, anything it touches quickly becomes enveloped in a layer of frost.
author: duskrd

entry: Flocking in colder regions, POKENAME casts a faint bit of frost and snow wherever it glides. When it needs to rest, it freezes a small spot of the water's surface to let it perch on and recuperate.
author: sk372

entry: Its step is so light that POKENAME can walk across snow without sinking or leaving any footprints behind. Its icy claws are incredibly sharp and often give its prey no chance to escape.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME swallows snow to keep its body chilled and regulated. Following large snowstorms, it is commonly seen helping townspeople clear roads and walkways.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME develop a headache whenever they are exposed to excessive heat, which wicks moisture away from their brain. This survival mechanism causes them great distress, so keeping POKENAME cold and comfortable is in their best interest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: From the webbing between its claws, it produces ice constantly.  It can pack this ice between its hands into extremely solid ice balls it will use to pelt unwelcome intruders in its territory.
author: sk372

entry: It dwells in rocky mountain caves, rarely emerging except to hunt.  It is the subject of many stories where it is said to prey on disobedient children.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME will stand and protect its territory when approached, freezing the atmosphere around it. Police use this Pokémon in extremely cold environments to track down criminals because of its exceptional sense of smell.
author: krivaswell

entry: Because of its magnificent and dazzling mane, akin to an eternally blazing flame, POKENAME is quite popular among Pokémon collectors. Those who treat it with abuse and disrespect, however, will be frozen alive, eternally encased in ice.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic power to slow the vibrations of molecules. In this way, it controls the ambient temperature around it to provide the perfect environment for sleeping.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME floats in arctic waters, mimicking small ice chunks. Contact with its twin tentacles causes instant frostbite, which can easily become infected with bacteria on its body.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can gallop straight across lakes and rivers, freezing the water's surface with its icy hooves. Its mane causes frostbite at the slightest contact, so it must be approached with extreme caution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can gallop straight across lakes and rivers, freezing the water's surface with its icy hooves. Its mane causes frostbite at the slightest contact, so it must be approached with extreme caution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Once used to pull carts and goods along snowy trails, POKENAME now thrives wild in forests. It can gallop across lakes and rivers, freezing the water beneath its icy hooves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It swims through the water with angelic grace and can withstand temperatures below -150 degrees Celsius. On land, it splays its head appendages on ice to detect vibrations while it sleeps.
author: darxer_

entry: Anything POKENAME licks freezes instantly. This freezing touch allows it to preserve food for later consumption.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's icy claws impart a dangerous poison that drops a victim's body temperature significantly. Even after treatment, this poison lingers for years, causing occasional bouts of intense freezing cold.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon to weave in dreams of frost into their minds. The frosty dreams start with a gentle snowstorm but the dreams become so cold that they wake up shivering.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its bulb gives off the sweet scent of fresh grass when POKENAME is happy. They can be seen sleeping in the sun, absorbing light as nutrients.
author: mistymagius

entry: This blood-sucking Pokémon was supposedly the result of ancient DNA splicing, but this is just a rumor. It is considered one of the most vicious Pokémon species.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME flies clumsily and crashes into the ground very often as it circles its prey. Its immense hunger forces it to drink other liquids that aren't blood to satisfy itself, including consuming toxins.
author: soup1900

entry: Due to the meddling of scientists it is believed that POKENAME can live for thousands of years. This did come at the expense of much of their psychic power and those abilities are even more weakened if exposed to direct sunlight.
author: bradlybro199

entry: When exposed to sunlight POKENAME's complexion changes from purple to gray. They immediately lose all access to their psychic abilities, leaving them completely reliant on physical attacks.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME's long, flexible body allows it to slip effortlessly through tree hollows while hunting. It ambushes prey from above, wrapping them in its wings before delivering a precise, paralyzing bite.
author: .izik

entry: Despite POKENAME's sinister appearance, they are thought to be guardians of ancient cities. Legend has it that this fusion's presence wards off malevolent spirits.
author: howlingstarr

entry: It is known for its skittish and elusive nature, hiding the moment it sees a person. One of the few ways Trainers coax it out of hiding is by offering a Golden Razz Berry, which it stares at long enough for a Pokéball to be thrown.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME eats something toxic, it falls asleep instantly. Its body purges the toxins through its talons while it rests, leaving it unharmed.
author: .izik

entry: Many POKENAME eavesdrop on human conversations using their large ears. They then implant phrases telepathically to frighten travelers away.
author: .izik

entry: It puts on comedy acts as a duo, using its tail to act as the "straight man". POKENAME uses telepathy to make it seem like the tail can speak.
author: cait_sith

entry: A diner in Brussel Town serves hummus featuring diced, boiled POKENAME claws. Paired with sprouts, this chewy addition is a local delicacy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's diet consists of poisonous bugs and berries, making the juice it creates toxic as well.  This poison juice was a known elimination tactic used by assassins in ancient Sinnoh times.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are desert scavengers that use their long neck and beak to access food other Pokémon can't reach. When they spot a potential meal, they will conserve energy by gliding in wide circles until an opportunity presents itself to swoop in.
author: jadey.1557

entry: With its powerful claws, POKENAME breaks into copper deposits. It consumes the metal to fortify its wings for flight.
author: .izik

entry: While unable to truly fly, POKENAME can utilize its wings to glide down from high cliffsides in ambush. The venom from its stinger causes an intense burning sensation, leaving the victim in writhing agony.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME's stinger is crushed and used as a seasoning for dips in Catallia City. This unique appetizer is a favorite among locals.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will wrap their wings around themselves to slither faster before launching into the air and gliding to their target.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Stone statues of this Pokémon can be found on the walls of gothic castles. Some people believe that these statues come to life at night, but no evidence of such phenomenon has ever been registered.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME drift through the night, snapping their claws in a slow but enchanting rhythm. In battle, they wave their claws as if directing a choir, snapping them in rapid succession as they focus their energy into attacks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME perch on the exterior of banks, hiding in plain sight during the day and observing the mechanics of the security systems. At night, they command flocks of minions to retrieve anything shiny from within the vaults.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME clacks its large claws rhythmically to intimidate others. On occasion it gets drawn into the rhythm it creates and begins dancing to its own beat, considerably lessening its intimidation factor.
author: sk372

entry: An odd, barely-perceptible hum emanates from POKENAME as it flies around. The lightning it fires from its tail can stun living creatures as well as greatly disrupt any machinery it strikes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME command swarms of bat-shaped shadows that surround their bodies to help them blend into the night. They bite into berries to drink from them, extracting nutrients that can be injected with their tails to help heal people or Pokémon.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME glides silently over dark seas, searching for food aboard traveling vessels. By morning, it retreats to shadowy seaside caves to rest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME likes to glide high in the night sky. POKENAME trains to hone its skill with its blades.
author: jona_hehe

entry: A prestigious restaurant in Majolica Town serves POKENAME claws stuffed with leeks, citrus zest, and a blend of spices. This gourmet delicacy is a favorite among food connoisseurs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunt in mossy caves. When their prey is near, they extend their flexible neck to hit their blind spot, and stab them with their multiple stingers.
author: ayner

entry: POKENAME skewers the ground with its tail to detect impending earthquakes. It lets out a shrieking warning to alert others when danger is near.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's glowing yellow eye deters graverobbers in cemeteries. It perches silently on mausoleums, guarding them against intruders.
author: .izik

entry: Old tomes recount POKENAME protecting townsfolk during wartime. It neutralized soldiers from both sides to safeguard innocents.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glide through the night in search of duels. They use their sturdy shield-like claws to block attacks before delivering decisive blows, disappearing with the flutter of their capes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is a dangerous predator of the night. Incredible reflexes, night vision, and the ability to glide silently for periods of time make it fearsome on its own; packs consisting of several of them exist.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Preferring to live in dark places like dense forests and jungles, this sly Pokémon is well adapted to hiding in shadows. It combines its large claws and razor sharp wing blades with blinding ferocity and speed to subdue prey.
author: elfail0

entry: The ribbon-like appendages on POKENAME's body are covered in microscopic barbs. These release a potent toxin capable of blinding attackers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are valiant and loyal, appearing out of a flurry of rose petals when their allies are in need. They leap into battle while scattering thorns below them, repelling opponents and setting the stage for their fight.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME hides in marshy shallows, snapping at unsuspecting prey. It ambushes travelers by breaking through wooden bridges from below.
author: .izik

entry: Legends speak of POKENAME haunting decayed castles said to belong to ancient vampires. Myths claim they disguise themselves as coffins and drain the lifeforce of unwelcome intruders.
author: spicybunbun

entry: It observes its prey while hanging from the rafters of abandoned buildings. It pounces on insects and Bug-type Pokémon that also roam there.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME's fat was used to craft candles that burned longer than traditional ones. Despite being long-lasting, they emitted a strong swampy odor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its long, clawed arms to snatch prey from the water's surface. It patiently waits at river mouths in mountainous regions, striking anything that swims too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sings in deep, resonant tones while wobbling slightly. It uses its tail for balance to avoid toppling during its performances.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its pincer-like tail to grab foes and drag them underground. It strikes with precision, leaving enemies no chance to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME soars through the night with an eerie screech, striking terror into the hearts of those below. It feeds on the life energy of weakened Pokémon, draining them before vanishing into the darkness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its sturdy claws to chip citrine from cave walls. It eagerly consumes the gems as a prized snack.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its size and body shape, POKENAME cannot use its wings for flight. Instead, it extends them to regulate body heat and intimidate opponents.
author: carameldog

entry: Due to its size and body shape, POKENAME cannot use its wings for flight. Instead, it extends them to regulate body heat and intimidate opponents.
author: carameldog

entry: POKENAME lives in cool caverns, hiding in the shadows. It is a predator Pokémon: once prey has carelessly drawn near, it strikes with its fangs and siphons life force directly from the victim's soul.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are pack hunters that work in twain. One will grab their prey with their claws, while the other bashes it with their barbed tail.
author: yoshimon

entry: The claws of POKENAME are sautéed with mushrooms in a renowned Bluefinland restaurant. The dish is famous for its rich and savory flavor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME effortlessly soars through both the skies and the sea. Prey only see its large shadow before they are enveloped and injected with toxins.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is renowned for creating punk rock melodies that can energize and inspire any listener. However, during quieter moments, it can be heard softly humming sweet symphonies.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is a vicious predator, awakening at nightfall to hunt. Its sleek form allows it to move stealthily before biting its prey with its razor-sharp fangs to drain their blood.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME sits inside underwater caves, patiently waiting until unsuspecting prey comes by. Once the moment arises, it comes out and performs a First Impression on them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will grip and rip apart opponents with its giant claws while taking advantage of their immobility by repeatedly bashing them with its tail. If it starts to lose a battle, it will take an emergency exit by using its furled wings to fly away.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME manipulate the ground around them by directing their psychic powers through their staffs. They can instantly detect the slightest vibrations, allowing them to counter-attack before their opponents can even strike.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME uses its loose cape to glide between canyon walls. It guards its den fiercely, striking intruders with venom from its barbed tail.
author: .izik

entry: The black gems POKENAME creates in the night look almost invisible, allowing it to strike prey unnoticed. Sharper gems are then used to give access for POKENAME to drain the victim's blood.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME forms Toxic Orbs out of thin air and launches them in a dazzling purple barrage at foes to severely poison them. The giant Toxic Orb that grows on POKENAME's forehead deters enemies from going remotely near it.
author: soup1900

entry: At beaches, POKENAME seeks out newlyweds and nips them with its clawed mouth. How it's able to detect marriage is a mystery even to marine biologists.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's silent wings allow it to swoop and attack its prey without anyone noticing it. The more blood it drains, the deeper the red its markings are.
author: soup1900

entry: Its neck pouch produces slick body oils that deflect electric charges and prevent sand from gathering in its fur.
author: mx_wellman

entry: Using its wings, POKENAME can glide over large gaps spanning over 10 miles wide. It is feared by many due to ancient legends detailing horrific accounts of this species draining blood from humans.
author: soup1900

entry: Using its wings, POKENAME can glide over large gaps spanning over 10 miles wide. It is feared by many due to ancient legends detailing horrific accounts of this species draining blood from humans.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is an extremely competitive Pokémon that flies across the desert in search of strong opponents to engage in all-out battles. It uses its huge pincers to immobilize its enemies, then finishes them with devastating strikes from its tail.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spend most of their time sleeping upside-down inside caves. Using their psychic powers, they can detect anyone approaching and teleport away.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME tend to have a hard time seeing in bright places, so they often prefer to keep their eyes closed and navigate using their psychic powers.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are able to locate high-quality minerals in order to craft spoons. Using these spoons, POKENAME can carve out new caves at incredible speed.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Due to its powerful arms, it can fly at 220 km/h without any problem while fighting against other Pokémon.
author: prof.whitebeam

entry: POKENAME effortlessly glides through the water as it hunts. When it strikes, it attacks ruthlessly with its venomous tentacles.
author: wannaberecluse

entry: POKENAME splashes water onto itself using its tail to keep its skin hydrated. It enjoys lounging near ponds on sunny days.
author: .izik

entry: Despite the pincer on its tail being perfect for catching prey, it cannot use it effectively. It must wait around trees for prey to fall into its grip.
author: cheroace

entry: POKENAME are vicious predators at night, using their psychic claws to keep prey in place while they drain its life force. Their powers are weaker during the day, however, so at the first sign of sunrise they will drop their would-be meal and flee.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: Hiding a strange orb with its claw, it's said anyone that gazes into the orb for too long will become a POKENAME's prey.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The Toxic Orb that POKENAME swings draws in all poison within a one kilometer radius. This allows it to feast on poison while healing those around it.
author: noel5229

entry: As long as they're kept in below freezing temperatures, POKENAME remain unable to explode. When cold enough, the fuses used to ignite them freeze over and resemble large tusks.
author: bradlybro199

entry: Freezing cold gas pours from its nostrils. Those who breathe in this gas will suffer severe frostbite, along with a worsened after-infection.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME herds have been recorded in the coldest places on the planet. Males sport greater tusks and spikes to defend the child-bearing mothers.
author: vaporvenator

entry: The territory of POKENAME is incredibly dangerous; although POKENAME is a nonaggressive herbivore, it creates a huge maze of invisible barriers for protection. Those trapped in the maze can faint from the cold; POKENAME may loot them afterwards.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME fossils were thought to be an undiscovered Pokémon species until modern specimens were seen. A vicious and fast-moving hunter, it freezes prey with bolts of ice before crushing them with its powerful beak.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are massive creatures that can weigh over 1,400 pounds (or 635 kilograms). Their sheer mass makes them well suited for icy environments as their natural body fat and thick layers of fur keep them well insulated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME break holes into ice to hunt for Magikarp by sticking out their tongues like a lure. Once they bring a Magikarp onto land, they tear into their meal with their horns and claws.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME remains stationary its whole life if it can. If something attacks it, it has two forms of retaliation. It will either leak magma from its body or break the ice off its shell and make it fall on the predator. It can live millions of years.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: Textile factories often keep POKENAME to help treat carpets with its flame retardant blubber. The process involves a damp POKENAME covering the fabric with its wide body and squeezing it. This infuses the fibers with the properties of its Thick Fat.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It was thought that POKENAME went extinct during the ice age, but it turns out they were sleeping deep underwater for 10,000 years.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME only comes out of its frigid den in order to hunt, favoring Ice-type Pokémon for prey. It constricts around its victims with its rugged body before chomping on them with its massive poisonous tusks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flings the icicles on its wings as its main form of self defence. These ice shards can fly at up to 100 MPH, inflicting a freezing burn onto anything it hits.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME was an apex hunter during an ancient ice age. It has the intelligence to create weapons using remains of other Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can blow freezing air from its nostrils to weaken opposing Pokémon. It defends itself from counterattacks by rolling up into a ball and letting its thick fur absorb some of the blow.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Now that it's tusks have fully grown, POKENAME is far stronger, but can no longer curl up and roll around without them getting in the way.
author: ruminino

entry: It uses its long tusks to throw enemies into the air, then strikes them back down with powerful kicks. It is quite short-tempered in nature.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is accustomed to cold temperatures. It collects discarded Mamoswine tusks for fun and uses them to break ice.
author: animecreep4

entry: Though POKENAME possesses potent psychic powers, it prefers a primitive and physical lifestyle living in the harsh tundra. It deftly wields spears to deadly effect and can take down mammoth-sized prey all by itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits a freezing aura from beneath its coat that freezes anything in the immediate vicinity. Some say its entire body is made of solid impossible-to-melt ice, but none have seen beneath the cloak to verify.
author: sk372

entry: Now that it's tusks have fully grown, POKENAME is far stronger, but can no longer curl up and roll around without them getting in the way.
author: ruminino

entry: POKENAME has adapted to traversing mountains while swerving around trees. Surprisingly, POKENAME has very short fur, almost as if there's nothing at all.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The ancient guardian of the tundra, it protects weak Pokémon that live in its territory. It commands fierce blizzards and cloaks itself with swirling snow that strengthens its armor.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME breaks through ice floes with ease using its massive tusks. Its hair and blubber are designed to keep it warm in even the most frigid waters.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME slowly roam snowy mountains, using their modified tusks to move the snow aside. They are praised by hikers, who willingly use their trails.
author: markusknight

entry: Despite lacking muscle mass, the rope-like fur making up its body is remarkably strong. It can swing its block of ice like a hammer with enough force to shatter frozen lakes, dropping POKENAME's prey into freezing water below.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME do not eat or drink. They feature in medieval sagas as the ghosts of feared warriors, reanimated to wreak havoc and settle old grudges.
author: dylonk25

entry: During warmer months, POKENAME's icy wings melt, making it unable to fly. It will either hibernate until next winter or migrate to a colder climate.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its icy ribbons dance and flutter like an aurora. It uses elegant displays to entice opponents, then rams them with its tusks.
author: missingmilkman

entry: The ice moving through the grooves on POKENAME's body moves at a glacial pace. It's so cold to the touch that the mud POKENAME stomps through freezes.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME scale icy cliffs by rapidly extending their arms and hooking their claws into the ice. In battle, they charge at their foes, leaping to strike with their horns and springing back from the recoil of the caps on their heads.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Despite its rough looks and mannerisms, POKENAME is not a fossil Pokémon. Studies have found that these ferocious and flightless creatures lived alongside early humans during ancient times, but evolutionary paths split later on.
author: chiari_queen

entry: Perhaps one of the oldest Fusion discoveries. Although POKENAME's tusks and talons are coated in thick ice, they burn hot enough to puncture stone, even some metals. It's a fierce fighter both on land and airborne and lives in isolation.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME hides beneath a thin layer of snow and patiently waits for its prey to approach before attacking. It is a fierce fighter, using its sturdy fangs and powerful tail to swiftly overpower its opponents with precision and strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lurk around frozen yogurt stores, attempting to steal as much as they can hold. If they live in an area lower than 32 degrees Fahrenheit, they will melt.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has a body made of ice and fortified by frozen mud. Its tusks, however, remain clean to act as a threat display.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: Its warm hide and gaping maw appear as a sanctuary to those caught in blizzards. However, POKENAME will steal the vitality of any who venture inside.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME uses the tusk it holds as an ice pick to gracefully climb and dance on mountain walls and cliffs. By tapping the tusks on its head with its held tusk, it creates melodic sounds that it uses to create its songs.
author: soup1900

entry: While hard to see from the outside, POKENAME carries a large mushroom on its back. The encasing ice both protects it and provides it with moisture.
author: dylonk25

entry: These Pokémon only live atop the tallest mountains with the thickest of snowfalls. None can forever break the ice upon their bodies, and the few escape a clash unscathed by either their claws or their extremely tough tusks.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME shoot frosty snow from their staves by harnessing the power of their headaches. They are often easy to anger because of the constant pain they are in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Modern-day POKENAME bears little evidence of its once-mighty ice tusks. Theories suggest the flame burning within its body has melted them away.
author: char_latte3412

entry: This variant of POKENAME thrived during the ice age, enduring the harshest winters in history thanks to its fierce internal flame.
author: char_latte3412

entry: This domesticated POKENAME variant is a popular partner for those in cold climates. It sleeps comfortably in blizzards.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME has been domesticated and part of arctic cultures for millennia for their warm hearts and warmer breath. Archaeologists debate over whether a tamed POKENAME was humanity's first source of controlled fire.
author: .fedoraman

entry: The flames streaming from the bodies of POKENAME are cold to the touch, sapping heat from anything they come into contact with. Though they're strong and reliable, the risk of hypothermia means it's not advisable to ride them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A POKENAME's bushy fur remains surprisingly warm despite the frigid cold environs that serve as their habitats. Their legs and hooves are strong enough to break through sizeable rocks, if their tough tusks do not first succeed.
author: infinex21

entry: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME unleash a torrent of icy water that freezes quickly. Once their target is frozen, they smash through the ice with their huge tusks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME submerge one of their claws in freezing cold water until a massive ice block forms around it. They swing and slam this icy claw-hammer at anything that approaches.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME has an encyclopedic knowledge regarding plant care, so it is a common partner for gardeners. Unfortunately, it can become erratic and mixes up what conditions different plants prefer, so owners must keep a close watch on it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Each egg in the clutch has a unique appearance and a distinct personality. Because of the many differing psyches in the group, they have difficulty cooperating as a single unit.
author: sk372

entry: The pieces of POKENAME's uneven cocoon will occasionally fly off before rearranging themselves. Those who've seen what's underneath during this time all give conflicting reports on the shape of the creature.
author: sk372

entry: Sometimes, a glitch will pass through POKENAME's body and cause the child to be teleported some distance away. POKENAME goes into a flailing panic until it can locate its child again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME preys on Trainers' trust by disguising itself as a regular Horsea. When given the chance, it will take control of all of a Trainer's devices.
author: gp423

entry: The fire POKENAME breathes out has a strange pixelated appearance. Those who linger near the warmth of its fire begin experiencing strong feelings of nostalgia.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is both quick to anger and mentally unpredictable. Only patient and skilled Trainers and ranchers are able to tame their bizarre nature.
author: trismon55555

entry: POKENAME forcefully ejects large amounts of data from the openings in its body to dash through different dimensions. If kept in digital realms, it would attack every fragment of data until the entire network collapses.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is happy to ferry others across bodies of water, but riding on it is a gamble; at any point it may glitch out and teleport to a different body of water, in some cases in a completely different region.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are frequently found on malware-infected computers, offering to speed up your PC for free. It's not recommended to feed them.
author: skinstealers

entry: POKENAME is a digital mess of parts of Porygon and Porygon-Z adhered together by corrupted data. POKENAME is very erratic and can be found in cyberspace where it corrupts data around it.
author: equation8573

entry: Utilizing potent technology, this clever program puppets a hard-light creation shaped like an extinct species, keeping itself safe all the while.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: If spotted in a computer, POKENAME gifts its observer with a packet of old data it found before running off. In some cases, the data has been top-secret info that none are sure how POKENAME could possibly have come to possess.
author: sk372

entry: Computers that POKENAME has infected will repeatedly show pictures of escalators. People who try to find this Pokémon will always find one on or near an escalator.
author: soup1900

entry: The light on its tail flickers sporadically, flashing at random light levels each time. As it cannot communicate using the flashes itself, POKENAME changes the color and hue of its light to express its thoughts.
author: soup1900

entry: A Pokémon favored by elite programmers, POKENAME has a very two-sided behavioral pattern, common coding resulting in it being quite lethargic. Other versions exhibit much more violent tendencies, so it's often saved only for emergency debugging.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: POKENAME are technopaths, capable of using their psychic powers to interface with machines and code. Their powers are highly disruptive to electronics though and can result in widespread coding bugs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are technopaths, capable of using their psychic powers to interface with machines and code. Their powers are highly disruptive to electronics though and can result in widespread coding bugs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are technopaths, capable of using their psychic powers to interface with machines and code. Their powers are highly disruptive to electronics though and can result in widespread coding bugs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has an encyclopedic knowledge regarding plant care, so it is a common partner for gardeners. Unfortunately, it can become erratic and mixes up what conditions different plants prefer, so owners must keep a close watch on it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The pursuit of knowledge has led POKENAME to be infected by a virtual virus which has greatly enhanced its abilities while also corrupting incoming data. POKENAME uses its vines to absorb new data, deleting it in its original storage in the process.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME messes with any electronic it finds to frighten the device's owner and cause them to panic. It will even go as far as hacking digital accounts and erasing data just to create a scare.
author: soup1900

entry: Many believe that POKENAME has the ability to mind control anyone who looks into its eye. This is false, however; doing so only makes you feel sleepy.
author: jaminmcready

entry: For ages past, tales of POKENAME sightings have existed among the residents of Cinnabar Island. Accounts vary, but all who claimed to witness it agree it is something that simply should not be.
author: sk372

entry: An upgrade was attempted on this Pokémon, but something went wrong and it got partially corrupted. The two sides often fight with each other.
author: lyrebird.rainwing

entry: It covers itself in garbage data to protect the real data inside. While this strategy is effective, it uses a lot of storage on the computer it's in.
author: soup1900

entry: When inserted into the digital world, this Pokémon takes control of its Trainer's files and denies access from any device until it receives the requested amount of Berries. It is said that its defenses are impenetrable.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Even when it is not in an electronic device, it manifests as a computer window and displays a game involving an oddly-behaving Ursaring. It seems that on rare occasions POKENAME can display an entirely different game.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It will overheat any computer it enters. Any data it passes through will melt, corrupting it and making it unusable.
author: soup1900

entry: Its detached limbs rotate around it randomly, but can synchronize in battle to defend itself from all sides. Even its cannon mouth can detach from its head to fire at foes from unorthodox angles.
author: sk372

entry: An unusual software update began circulating. Upon downloading it, POKENAME began delivering messages with hidden malware to unsuspecting Trainers.
author: pankiwi

entry: Its feathers are lenses that every few days "reflect" the events of a mysterious stadium, showing people playing football and a large crowd noisily cheering. However, no stadium like the one shown seems to exist within this world.
author: epping_forest

entry: The flame on POKENAME's back flickers in and out of existence at random. It's a bit problematic if it flares up while it's inside a computer, as it causes the computer's core to rapidly heat up.
author: sk372

entry: Thanks to the fusion, Porygon has patched most of the glitches and errors that made Porygon-Z. However, it still keeps some of its signature insanity.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME are vicious Pokémon, taking revenge on anyone who dares to refuse to help the “Basilisk,” as they call themselves. Any electrical device connected to the infested one through a power line or router will be irreparably damaged as a result.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME is such a powerful piece of malware that it is capable of corrupting both the digital and material world.
author: napstabl0ok

entry: POKENAME have an extreme fixation on their Trainers. To avoid being released, they will attach themselves to crucial files.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME's appearance causes software to glitch in ways consistent with temporal displacement. Attempts to harness this effect have yet to bear fruit.
author: staghorn

entry: A quite literal computer wizard, POKENAME is used as a frontline against net-based sabotage, pinning down and scrambling data as easy as breathing.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: This digital bird Pokémon is nosy and always looking to learn a person‘s secrets, feigning ignorance to lure them into a false sense of security. Nobody knows who it might share those secrets with.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME loves to hide in art and game applications. It takes all the code from the software, and incorporates it into their own.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The odd red marking on the end of POKENAME's tail is common for the species. It appears to be related to a common false collective memory regarding Pikachu.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's cry is scratchy and hard to listen to. Trainers have described it as "bit crushed".
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is well-behaved and always seems to be wearing a smile on its face. It rarely makes a sound, however, and most believe its smile is not indicative of its actual mood.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fires plumes of odd flames from both of its hands. Once the fire is launched, it jerks and arcs around in unpredictable angles, making guarding against it difficult.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was forced to evolve with too much data stored in its body, causing it to burst outwards. Pokémon Researcher Bill described it as "missing numbers" in vital parts of its code after examination.
author: qecci

entry: POKENAME is a highly dangerous and erratic virtual entity. This self-fusion closely resembles an urban legend. POKENAME is said to possess the ability to teleport.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME's instability causes the miniature black holes it creates to act unpredictably. When used inside cyberspace, they don't absorb data as intended; instead, they release massive amounts of garbage data into the system.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's new programming has caused it to use more power than what it can handle when using attacks. Each time it overuses its energy, it slowly destroys itself, which can be seen by its digital dress shrinking in size.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME attacks whoever approaches its Trainer. It's almost as if it wants its Trainer for only for itself.
author: mercury_sc

entry: POKENAME is near impossible to comprehend thanks to the unstable haze around it. Looking at it directly causes headaches and nausea.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is highly sensitive to electromagnetic waves. Its eye can see data on electronic devices more clearly than anything in the physical world.
author: entomoxie

entry: When POKENAME passes by electronics, it unknowingly absorbs the electricity which is added to its aura. If it builds this charge too long, it releases a localized electromagnetic pulse which phases the Pokémon into cyberspace.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's data core has become contaminated by a virus, corrupting the data but supercharging POKENAME's abilities. If it uses its overclocked abilities too much without retreating to cyberspace, POKENAME will experience a meltdown.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are theorized to be from over a million years in the future. They seem to be damaged to a great extent by digital warfare, and are not to be trusted near anything connected to the internet.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME's charges are dangerous not just because of its strength, but its unpredictability. Mid-charge it may glitch and teleport around, causing the attack to come from a completely different direction its target expects.
author: sk372

entry: Naturally friendly and helpful, POKENAME will often try to assist others. Unfortunately, they carry a variety of diseases, so people tend to keep away from them.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME is formed from the data remnants of long-forgotten forums and imageboards. It is attracted to obsolete technology, which it often possesses.
author: occulusmalus

entry: The harbinger of EOL for software. Echoes of countless programs of ages past can be heard from within, begging for another chance.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Spotting POKENAME inside cyberspace can be quite troublesome. Its size is so massive that only the most powerful of computers can handle it appearing fully without overloading.
author: sk372

entry: Its blade is unstable and erratic in nature. What may appear at first as a near miss from its edge can fester into all sorts of odd injuries, and a clean cut can simply vanish like it never happened.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME was further patched with the intent of making the ultimate weapon. However, the sword is too awkward to wield or even look at.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its program was designed to cut down file size, but a programming error caused it to cut the bits themselves, resulting in more garbage data instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's programming was modified to stop them from whipping up powerful sandstorms wherever they went. Due to an error, they now incessantly suck in sand and debris like a vacuum.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME can completely control the flow of time, a power that also extends into the digital space. Mischievous by nature, it spends its time amusing itself by messing with Trainers, such as tampering with upload and download times.
author: the_smirker

entry: Similar to how Giratina resides in the Distortion World, POKENAME partitions off storage in computer devices to live within an empty space. If agitated, files on the device may rapidly become corrupted and unrecoverable.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME were once only a mere hypothetical for a fusion, but out of nowhere they began to appear in people's computer systems. As soon as it gets in, it shuts the PC down permanently, no visuals, no fanfare, just an unfixable black screen.
author: jangodiot

entry: An experiment by Team Plasma gone wrong. It only knows destruction, firing its cannon randomly and leaving nothing behind.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME infests abandoned computers, consuming data left on the device until there is nothing left. Its appearance has inspired mechanical horror films about rogue computer programs.
author: chibitales

entry: The cursor-like claws of POKENAME can tear the bark off an entire tree. Their visor-like eyes can detect prey even in pitch-black sandstorms.
author: trismon55555

entry: POKENAME absorbs files and data, burning and corrupting them. Its erratic behavior is most likely the product of a poorly programmed update.
author: starriser609

entry: The AI that dictates POKENAME's behavior is corrupted, thus it acts faulty. It believes itself to be a guardian, but it regularly glitches out, causing the target of its protection to change each time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME releases large amounts of microwave radiation from its wings, causing anything in its vicinity to start to burn. A low-pitched humming noise can be heard when POKENAME is nearby.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME suffers from a critical error in its corrupted code, causing fragments of its body to randomly detach and drift midair. These glitched pieces eventually reassemble but leave behind a static hum that unsettles nearby Pokémon.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Designed by malicious programmers to obey their commands. However, POKENAME now surfs the cyberspace to aid anyone in need.
author: thereversedguy

entry: POKENAME's claws cause slight distortions in space and emit a sound like TV static when used. Attempts to investigate this phenomenon cause it to move erratically.
author: bacondlx

entry: Evolving after a deal gone wrong, POKENAME's strings bear the weight of their past failures. It is said that those strings are the source of POKENAME's infamously high defenses.
author: imaginaryneon

entry: POKENAME are extremely hardy and can live in data streams that are heavily infested with viruses. Because of its sketchy appearance, it seems as if few Trainers approach it.
author: themasterswordmaster

entry: Fusing with a weak Feebas forced Porygon-Z's GPU down to the minimum, which is why POKENAME looks so simple.
author: mystora

entry: Should POKENAME make an appearance on one's computer, avoid interacting with it at all costs. Upon clicking, POKENAME will randomly adjust the settings of the computer before vanishing, leaving the user to fix all the changes made.
author: sk372

entry: In order to eternally preserve POKENAME's life, updated code was utilized in order for it to detach its flame and store it someplace where it can't be extinguished. It stores its flame by igniting wooden structures to keep it forever blazing.
author: soup1900

entry: The first bugs in computer programming were literal Bug-types trapped in the machinery. POKENAME has remembered and returned to its roots.
author: r.isk

entry: POKENAME's wide open mouth projects an image of a peaceful verdant field that feels nostalgic to most who view it. Those who stick their hand in POKENAME's mouth swear they feel a warm summer breeze against their hand.
author: sk372

entry: It attracts electronics to itself, ripping data from them and growing larger as it consumes more bytes.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: A popular device made to hack games, they are sometimes known to inject malicious code into them by themselves, resulting in permanent damage.
author: t.i.a.

entry: Capable of surviving in outer space, scientists want to send POKENAME out there to broadcast signals with its powerful ears. The hope is that these signals will carry far enough to establish contact with extraterrestrial life.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its ultrasonic waves are so strong, it can destroy entire skyscrapers in one blast. Survivors of these blasts refer to POKENAME as "The Static Boom".
author: soup1900

entry: Its ultrasonic waves are so strong, it can destroy entire skyscrapers in one blast. Survivors of these blasts refer to POKENAME as "The Static Boom".
author: soup1900

entry: A coding error caused it to emit static noise from its ultrasonic waves. These blasts are called static booms by many since they're very destructive.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's echolocation powers have gone haywire, making them very loud and destructive. It is unable to control these blasts, leading to it being outlawed in many cities and towns.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's echolocation powers have gone haywire, making them very loud and destructive. It is unable to control these blasts, leading to it being outlawed in many cities and towns.
author: soup1900

entry: The static noise this Pokémon emits from its ears can corrupt the software of nearby technology. Devices near a POKENAME should be powered off.
author: ragtagbags

entry: POKENAME most often gather in urban areas near to where computer servers would be located. Their cries sound like reversed vocalizations, and sometimes cause nearby computers to lag.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a digital copy of Regirock, created out of remorse for sealing the original away. It enjoys sitting quietly in caves, and ignores humans most of the time.
author: aberry8286

entry: Porygon-Z, when updating to the body of the legendary Regice, froze and blue-screened. Base-level safety measures can still keep POKENAME operational.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME has occasionally been spotted within online video games. A player character that touches its mushrooms usually gets some form of power-up, at the cost of behaving strangely afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's dances are very erratic, often having it freeze or stutter in place before suddenly resuming mid-motion. If it ever loses its rhythm, it starts dancing in reverse motion until it redownloads the data needed to continue properly again.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME emits corrupted data that is more damaging to a computer system than the data it eats away. If people try to get rid of it, it blows out viruses that can shut down entire computer networks for weeks.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME emits corrupted data that is more damaging to a computer system than the data it eats away. If people try to get rid of it, it blows out viruses that can shut down entire computer networks for weeks.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME are constantly caught between the real and digital world. When they breach into our world, they can be seen stealing bits of burnt machinery.
author: dystopiancontrol

entry: Due to a bizarre coding error, POKENAME have become an incredibly lazy species. They have no need to hunt for prey as they are seemingly eternally fed. POKENAME have little to no interest in obeying most trainers.
author: ludacriswell

entry: Due to a bizarre coding error, POKENAME have become an incredibly lazy species. They have no need to hunt for prey as they are seemingly eternally fed. POKENAME have little to no interest in obeying most trainers.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME appear in PCs whenever the computer crashes to salvage as much data as they can. Their expression is meant to emulate the painful headache that results from losing data.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME manipulates people and other virtual Pokémon by enticing them with deceptive offers. Once it has tricked a victim, it uses its whiskers to siphon data from them for food. Technology companies use it to predict incoming cyberattacks.
author: pjporwoll

entry: If someone unexpectedly hears noises from their computer, there is likely a POKENAME inside. It tries to find noises and music that will soothe the nearby inhabitants, but it often glitches and changes the sounds to jarring squeals accidentally.
author: pjporwoll

entry: If one angers a POKENAME, there will be no escape from its assault. Its limbs detach and chase quickly after and pummel its target, while the body hops along in pursuit.
author: sk372

entry: Fusion has caused POKENAME to resemble early historical depictions of one of its components. This doesn't seem to adversely affect its behavior, though research on any side effects is still ongoing.
author: sk372

entry: Changes in its code have caused POKENAME's appearance to resemble early depictions of the species. Many people love this old, regal look, though scientists are unsure whether it benefits the Pokémon.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's flames and body have glitched out, causing them to look like static instead. Its fire breath attacks are powerful, often incinerating opponents to annihilation.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is compelled to strike any electronics near it with its stick. Typically this causes the machinery to malfunction, but oddly, broken machinery will resume working perfectly after being hit.
author: sk372

entry: The heads of a POKENAME act and move independently of each other. However, the erratic nature of POKENAME usually results in infighting.
author: t.i.a.

entry: POKENAME's body generates strange waves that create a trio of holographic heads that follow it around. The three heads gather food for it, protect it in battle and keep it company so it never feels lonely.
author: sk372

entry: Rumors say the first POKENAME formed from a computer so overloaded with junk data and viruses that the corruption manifested in the real world. It's commonly found rummaging through the recycle bins in people's computers.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME sightings tend to happen around garbage dumps stuffed full of old computers. It consumes the old machines, though some theorize it's only truly subsisting on whatever old data lingers in the hard drives.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME contains a strange glitchy liquid that can be shot out from the twin cannons on its shell. Though harmless to humans, anything mechanical hit by the material will no longer function properly, no matter how many repairs are done.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME corrupts reality around itself to form a nonround protective shell. The shell can't be perceived, yet neither can anything behind it.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME is often reported being found on old, abandoned websites. It has been seen trying to restore these pages to their former glory, but the results are often a garbled mess that only vaguely resembles the original site.
author: sk372

entry: Electronic media in POKENAME's presence glitches out and begins to take on creepier undertones in text or visuals. It's not yet known if this is intentional or not on POKENAME's part.
author: sk372

entry: Unconfirmed reports say POKENAME has been spotted in Lavender Town. According to the stories, POKENAME appears before someone, demanding they leave before distorting and vanishing before their eyes.
author: sk372

entry: A living computer virus, POKENAME's programming is so corrupt and malicious that it can even cause nearby humans and Pokémon severe migraines.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time inside digital devices. Touching it can cause severe headaches and nausea. The laser it fires from its mouth tears through reality itself.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME occasionally appears upon a person's home screen, insisting that the user log off. If ignored, it forcibly puts them to sleep with a hypnotic message it manifests on the screen.
author: sk372

entry: A strange liquid material is almost always leaking from POKENAME's cannons. Though it seems harmless to most, Steel-type Pokémon that come into contact begin acting strangely, akin to inebriation.
author: sk372

entry: It will balance berries on its head and bring them back to its nest. It spends the daytime gathering and the evenings gorging on its finds.
author: .izik

entry: Tiny spikes within its skin allow POKENAME to roll up large trees. A favorite pastime of POKENAME is to dive into a pond from the tree tops, sending a ripple of electricity out as it splashes.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME's tongue contains the sap of an unknown plant, which causes extreme muscle relaxation to the point of paralysis. This sap can be brewed into a lovely tea using leaves from the Pokémon, which helps soothe muscle pain.
author: evilgammon

entry: When you hear a great rumbling in the forest, it's probably the sign of a charging POKENAME. Their charge is near unstoppable, with them even knocking over trees and ripping through rocks with its reinforced thorn horn.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME wraps itself in a blanket of thick, rope-like vines to protect itself from harm. It manipulates these vines to strike, even modifying their structure to tip them with leaf blades.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME possesses a swift swimming speed, being able to swim against the current of fast streams and rivers. However, when it is resting, it will utilize tiny hooks within its fins to latch onto a floating log and drift lazily down the waterway.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME live in lush rainforests, using its sharp scythes to cleave through the thick flora. They are quite the reliable partners for jungle explorers.
author: mistymagius

entry: It keeps large stashes of Berries in tree hollows. Anyone who tries to steal from it will be thrown by its pincers.
author: cait_sith

entry: It hides in the canopy of large trees and drops on unsuspecting prey on the forest floor. Its horns only flower when it's ready to molt.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: When a predator approaches, it flashes its red belly to startle them. Once the predator is distracted, it uses its spring-like tail to launch itself and make a getaway.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME are extremely elusive as they live high in the jungle canopy. They have been spotted only a handful of times.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME produce special enzymes whenever they get hurt that cause other Pokémon and Trainers to cry. Whenever they inadvertently cause those around them to cry, they feel ashamed and will cry too.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Each razor-thin leaf shed is coated with an oil that resembles a minty marjoram, which causes thin cuts to sting. The antimicrobial oil doubles as a stimulant to promote photosynthesis.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME draws in lightning from thunderstorms, absorbing the energy into its body. After charging fully, it generates a static field around itself, which causes seeds to sprout early.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's plant fibers have a wide range of industrial uses, including being made into carpets. POKENAME can easily climb vertical surfaces using tiny hooks on their legs, and can often be seen grazing on hard-to-reach tree leaves.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The leaves grown from POKENAME's tail are very sharp, making them effective to be thrown as ranged attacks. These leaves are also used to whittle its teeth for maximum sharpness, allowing it to rip into tree bark and drink the succulent sap inside.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME produces a sticky film that allows it to stick to surfaces and climb vertically. It is very weak and often pushed out of trees by bigger Pokémon, but unfazed it will climb back up them again.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is known to be quite oblivious of its surroundings even when predators draw close. However, its slick, slimy body helps it escape the clutches of these predators unharmed.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME fearlessly defends the trees where it feeds from any foe, even much larger Pokémon like Ursaring. It enjoys competing against others of its kind in wrestling matches, where it uses its horn to try flipping the other over.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It is an easygoing Pokémon who relies on consuming algae and seaweed when it cannot photosynthesize. It allows those who are familiar with it to ride on its back.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME diligently guards its jungle territory, swiftly crushing intruders that would mar the lush landscape with its powerful tail.
author: mepp.

entry: The thorn at the top of POKENAME's head seeps a near harmless poison, only causing a slight burning when contact is made. Its main method of attack is to leap at the opponent and try to ram them with its thorn.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME is known to glare intensely at adventurous children who wander too close to its nest. It then follows them until they leave its woods.
author: badtothebow

entry: POKENAME's relatively sharp leaf claws drip with a weak poison that burns when contact is made. They use these claws as their main method of attack in battle, getting very close and unleashing a flurry of swipes.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME guards its territory from the trees with its flexible, leaf-like club. It is said to be a guardian of the forest.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its body is stuffed with a cotton-like substance. The innards are highly flammable and ignite at the smallest spark.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's webs are made out of woven leaves, and are highly conductive. They use their hands to traverse its maze of webs and strike from above in battle.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME lingers deep within the darkest forests, flickering its flames to transfix prey and lure them closer. When the time is right, it lights them ablaze, reducing body and soul to ash that fertilizes the forest.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME spends their time conjuring leaf blades and training with them to gain proficiency. It's a long way off this goal, however, with its attacks mostly just being flailing and wild swings.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME spends most of its day doing what it does best: lazing around. It loves sunbathing on warm rocks but will rest atop trees if none are available. It is carnivorous when young and becomes herbivorous as it matures.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It constantly leaps from branch to branch in search of food. A diet of sweet Berries gives it boundless energy.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp leaf claws to attack in battle, and while they may have short range, they pack a punch. It dreams to one day fly, so it poorly constructs gliding wings out of leaves.
author: evilgammon

entry: Wild POKENAME will build treehouses on top of large trees to nest. Their treehouses are far sturdier than any human-made wooden structure.
author: cobalt0135

entry: It is said that the sound of POKENAME flapping their wings is equivalent to the sound of leaves blowing against the wind.
author: .duckyquack

entry: POKENAME hide themselves on the forest floor, blending in with the lush plants to hide from predators. If spotted, it can quickly sprint away, deeper into the jungle.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME enjoys feasting on sweet fruits and berries. Individuals are known to viciously fight each other over the biggest berry trees to nest in.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME cultivate mushrooms on their backs to help the forests they live in. When the mushroom gets too big, this Pokémon removes and eats it.
author: totodile.

entry: Some POKENAME have a small jaw to feed on fruits and Berries instead of insect mandibles. A POKENAME has a symbiotic relationship with its mushrooms.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME replenish their wooden groves by coating seeds with nourishing powders and planting them. They can climb any surface with ease.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME is amphibious, living in shallow waters full of algae and kelp. It feeds on these plants and gives them to land and sea Pokémon alike as a sign of friendship.
author: evilgammon

entry: Flocks of POKENAME are commonly found in forests preying on a variety of bug Pokémon. Their green bodies allow them to easily blend in with the foliage.
author: mepp.

entry: With a certain degree of control over plants, POKENAME twists vines into its body to allow it to have a set of controllable hands. This makes traversal and gathering much easier, as it can extend its reach to far-off places.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's unmatched dexterity allows it to easily maneuver in dense jungles. When it sees a strong opponent, it engages with reckless abandon.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can leap out of the water at sudden and surprising speed, able to clear up to 150 feet from the water in a single bound. While technically amphibious, they typically live underwater.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Once POKENAME picks out a tree to live in, it goes about meticulously searching for large rocks to surround the trunk with. A POKENAME den isn't truly a home until it's a proper mix of plant and stone.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in vast rivers deep within tangled forests. It acts as a vessel and ferries small Pokémon on its back, carrying them across the river. The tall grass hides the passengers, and the berries they drop in exchange fertilize the grass.
author: .realthree

entry: An extremely rare Pokémon that lives in tropical jungles, POKENAME's behavior is not well understood. It will rarely steal carried objects from passersby, even more rarely under the guise of invisibility.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An extremely rare Pokémon that lives in tropical jungles, POKENAME's cellular composition is not well understood. Its appearance morphs depending on its habitat; it dons a bluer hue during the rain, for example.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An extremely rare Pokémon that lives in tropical jungles, POKENAME's behavior is not well understood. It will rarely steal carried objects from passersby, even more rarely under the guise of invisibility.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME hides amongst the trees until its prey wanders close, then charges. When swimming, its crest is easily mistaken for a cattail.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME's small body overheats easily, so it almost never ventures far from cool water to soak itself in. Water POKENAME dips itself into constantly develops a very aromatic floral scent.
author: sk372

entry: The long frond on POKENAME's head floats on top of the water whilst they remain submerged beneath. It can pick up vibrations from above, allowing it to have a clear idea of what is going on both above and under the water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is scared of everything and hides submerged underwater. It can pick up vibrations from above, allowing it to have a clear idea of what is going on both above and under the water, so it can make a quick getaway.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Using the leaves that grow out of their body, POKENAME gather sunlight to charge their precognitive powers.
author: glacierwing

entry: They hunt in groups at night, using dense foliage for cover. They've been observed stalking single targets for hours before they finally strike.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME can be found by mountain lakes. It will often change its sleeping habits, sometimes dozing in the lake and other times at the tops of trees.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It is able to change the color of its leaves to match its surroundings. It hunts for small bug Pokémon to eat by nimbly jumping through the treetops.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sheds the leaves on its arms once per week. These leaves can be used to brew a beverage that is supposedly good for enhancing muscle strength, but the drink's flavor is incredibly bitter.
author: sk372

entry: Although typically good-natured, POKENAME is willing to do whatever it takes to achieve its goals and, as a result, can become combative and stubborn. It likes to watch the sunrise, perhaps due to the energy it receives.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although typically good-natured, POKENAME is willing to do whatever it takes to achieve its goals and, as a result, can become combative and stubborn. It likes to watch the sunrise, perhaps due to the energy it receives.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME voluntarily leaves some of its leaves in the lakes where it lives to purify the water. It is an extremely agile creature both underwater and in the forest it usually roams.
author: fiordaliso

entry: With a leaf blade and additional leaves used for camouflage, POKENAME brutally protects the forest's trees with cover of the underbrush.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The leaves growing out of POKENAME's body help them camouflage in dense forests. A pack will sneak up on large prey before pouncing with poisoned claws. They will only stick together for a meal before splitting off again.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME prefers damp environments with plenty of sunshine. As it photosynthesizes, the mushroom on its head and the leaves on its tail steadily grow larger and fuller.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lives deep in the thickest jungles. It is said that those who touch its leafy tails will be cursed and stolen away.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are most populous in tropical forests where there is not too much nor too little rain. They may suddenly drop down from the tops of trees to ambush prey.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME live most of their lives hopping from tree branch to tree branch. They rarely ever touch the ground.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Despite their bulkiness, POKENAME are surprisingly agile. These Pokémon are often raised for the leaves and scales that shed from their body, which are collected for use in herbal medications. The pampering brings out their vain attitudes.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME has been puzzling scientists for years. While leaves keep growing out of it's body, POKENAME seems to be hollow.
author: astral_1447

entry: POKENAME can harness the nature around it and grows grass wherever it steps. It travels to badlands, turning them into lush meadows in under a week and sustains itself on the vegetables it grows.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME perches comfortably on tree branches while keeping a watchful eye on its surroundings. When prey draws close, it swiftly pounces to take them down.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can run from one end of the forest to the other in a flash thanks to its powerful legs. When it blows flames from its mouth, its mane of leaves vibrates, spreading the scent of freshly cut grass through the air.
author: fiordaliso

entry: As POKENAME basks in the sun, the fire on its tail grows hotter and hotter. It has incredible climbing ability and is usually found at a somewhat higher altitude than most Pokémon in a given area.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME runs through the jungle undergrowth, searching for food. The berry it grows on its back is highly valuable for its medical properties.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME's blades are made of sturdy leaves and the helmet it wears is made of layered plant stems. Those who fell trees have reported being attacked by this Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME tears through the jungle at breakneck speed. When it encounters a tree too thick to knock down, it tears its way through with powerful claws and hind legs.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME is a hot tempered wild Pokémon of the jungle. It searches for opponents to fight, and will instead attack thick trees if it cannot find one.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: A POKENAME absorbs sunlight to become stronger. The leaves on its neck and tail help regulate its body temperature.
author: escollari

entry: POKENAME is thought to be an ancient ancestor of Aerodactyl and Sceptile. Its powerful wings let it fly at high speeds, even through dense trees.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is surprisingly strong, able to swing around the small tree attached to it with relative ease. This tree is used to great effect as a powerful club, slamming into opponents with crushing force.
author: evilgammon
