entry: Timid by nature and with poor eyesight, POKENAME rarely pokes itself out of its home high up in trees. It waits until its psychic senses detect no others in the vicinity before it deigns to go out to forage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME senses sorrow with ease. Instead of eating nearby flowers, it picks them and gifts them to sad individuals to make them feel better.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a timid but kindhearted denizen of the forest. Should it sense sadness in the heart of another being, it spins webs in the shape of cute or funny imagery to try and lighten their mood.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME spots another, it freezes in place like a Sudowoodo, though its bright colors often betray it. It learns to express emotion through mimicry, sometimes leading to odd or unpredictable behavior.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are often seen clumsily tripping into things. While this does not hurt them, POKENAME still find it annoying.
author: weirdtux

entry: The horn on its head senses thoughts and emotions. If it senses a hostile thought from within a certain radius around it, it explodes in self-defense before teleporting away.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME is known to drive off much larger Flying types who enter its territory by scaring them with psychically enhanced screeching. When confronted, it teleports a short distance above and dive bombs back with a hasty Peck.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Born with forehead horns that heighten empathy, POKENAME siphons strong feelings from people and Pokémon alike. It nests in hospital walls, haunts festivals and graveyards, and leaves victims drained — its rattling tail can amplify or mute emotion.
author: oddly.abnormal

entry: POKENAME tends to live in snowy forests, where its mostly white coat helps it blend into the landscape. Its horns channel its psychic powers, allowing it to create faint environmental illusions and sense the emotions of those around it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME enjoy spending time watching professional fighting matches of all kinds, from Pokémon battles to boxing to wrestling. They get easily swept up in the emotion of such fights and will try to mimic the moves they see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoy spending time watching professional fighting matches of all kinds, from Pokémon battles to boxing to wrestling. They get easily swept up in the emotion of such fights and will try to mimic the moves they see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is a cheeky, playful Pokémon that often plays tricks on people. Despite its size, its bites are quite deadly and its grip is hard to escape.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME can channel the emotions of others through the various horns on its body. If it becomes overwhelmed by particularly strong emotions, it starts to sob.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can taste the emotions of surrounding Pokémon by feebly licking the air. If it tastes an emotion it likes, it bounces about with glee.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: It is highly attuned to human emotions. If it senses any hostility, POKENAME uses its clawed toes to climb to high places and hide until the tension fades.
author: larky_

entry: Even though it can teleport, it prefers to flee from enemies by leaping through the treetops. The horns on its head make it highly aware of danger.
author: larky_

entry: POKENAME's red horn allows it to sense emotions and vibrations around it. This enables it to be incredibly aware of its surroundings and can even predict its opponents' movements before they happen.
author: nyoomymph

entry: While they lack the confidence, these charming Pokémon are said to have the sweetest smile of any fusion. They only smile for Trainers they trust.
author: quote.lass

entry: Every POKENAME eventually develops a strong attachment to a stick it finds, and carries it with it always. If the two are separated, POKENAME becomes emotionally distraught and inconsolable.
author: sk372

entry: In the wild, POKENAME, despite being blind, are quite resilient. Stories have been passed around of one particularly tough POKENAME being hit by multiple Psyshock, yet surviving relatively unscathed.
author: retrodox

entry: POKENAME appear next to grieving families when they visit graveyards but will hide when someone focuses on them. They are said to ward off more malevolent spirits, protecting the family from harm.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses the horns on its head to sense people with food. It will hide from anyone who gives it food, but will come back and steal it later.
author: laughing_dan

entry: POKENAME can sense the self-importance of people and Pokémon. If it senses that something nearby thinks it is better than it, then POKENAME will show off with feats of strength to prove that it is superior.
author: laughing_dan

entry: POKENAME senses hostility with its guard and goes out of its way to avoid conflict. It even avoids being used offensively by people it trusts.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME has a high sensitivity to surrounding emotions. If it senses panic, someone must throw it into the ocean as quickly as possible to calm it.
author: theradrad

entry: Its aura-reading abilities can identify even the tiniest hints of negative emotion. Its attempts to telepathically share these experiences are often mistaken for psychic attacks.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME's psychic abilities manifest through its connection to aura. Due to its small body, it has difficulty controlling these powers.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME are very popular. Many people consider them an ideal Pokémon to raise around a family for their soft coat and ability to recognize emotions.
author: blitzydragon

entry: If a POKENAME detects its Trainer is anxious or upset, it sings lullabies to help them fall asleep and ease their stress. It monitors its Trainer's breathing to ensure a peaceful rest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME is scared, it lets out an ear-piercing scream and fills its body with air, causing it to float away on the winds. It can rarely be found in grassy areas with moderate levels of elevation.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is sensitive to the emotions of others. When it is stressed, a poisonous fluid leaks from the horn on its head.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME navigates by projecting out psychic waves into its environment. It senses the returning signals with a trio of sensitive structures on its head. It can differentiate between living things by feeling their thoughts, letting it avoid danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Using its empathetic powers, POKENAME detects sadness in others. It flies near windows and chirps cheerfully in hopes of lifting their mood.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stick together in small groups for safety and comfort. Their horns and cloaks are highly sensitive to the emotions of those around them, so even a hint of aggression in the air will send the entire pack into hiding.
author: sk372

entry: Groups of POKENAME can be found on frozen lakes, hitting ice chunks to each other. Despite being amateurs at the moment, POKENAME desire to become expert hockey players someday.
author: mistymagius

entry: If POKENAME senses the fear of one lost in the forest, it floats its way towards them to be by their side. It comforts them with soft cries and gently leads them back out of the forest.
author: sk372

entry: When detecting others' emotions, the colour of POKENAME's clouds changes. They are usually pink and filled with stars, but turn grey and stormy when sensing negativity.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME are popular companions for children without siblings, staying loyal to them for life. Its soft, cuddly fur helps quell negative emotions.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its enormous bowl cut acts as a focusing chamber for its psychic abilities. Eager to train both its mind and body, POKENAME with trainers can often be seen working out at the library.
author: kiwiarms

entry: While being blind, POKENAME can easily see its surroundings by emitting powerful psychic waves from the holes on its belly. It is very timid, quickly teleporting away when it senses the presence of another Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: When bored of its pond, POKENAME teleports to a different one nearby. It may repeat this multiple times in a night just to explore new places.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's hair has grown over its eyes, so it relies more on its psychic abilities to perceive its surroundings. When startled, it Teleports to its safe haven, such as a den in the wild or bed if domesticated.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME wanders throughout forests in search of berries and friends. It is able to sense impending danger and will lead its friends away to safety.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a skittish nature, rarely peeking out from its home inside tree stumps. Sensitive to the emotions of others, it will come out and cling to those it senses have kind, caring natures.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME senses emotions with its psychic abilities to detect malice. If danger is too close, it flees or detonates to protect itself and its allies.
author: .izik

entry: Its coin-shaped horn is infamously known to scramble data storage and measuring devices around it. Many dex entries had to be rewritten due to incorrect measurements caused by it, such as Magcargo's body temperature.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME are affectionate pets who love curling up with their owners on the couch while they watch TV. Unfortunately, they interfere with the signals that remotes produce, making it impossible to change the channel or volume while they're nearby.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME senses the emotions and motives of others through the horns on its head. Easily frightened, the moment it senses hostility or aggression it hops away to find the nearest spot it can drill into to hide.
author: sk372

entry: It despises anger, due to its empathy causing physical pain when it experiences said emotion. It will only approach those it sees as calm.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME are incredibly smart Pokémon but act credulously shocked whenever its Trainer shows them something boring. They want to keep their Trainer happy, so they are willing to tolerate being presented something that does not interest them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is impossible to determine when POKENAME is sleeping, though some say it must rest eighteen hours a day. Even while dreaming, it senses Trainers' intentions through its segmented tail.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The organ on POKENAME's head is capable of sensing the emotions of those nearby. If its Trainer is ever upset or angry at somebody, it will not hesitate to suplex the offender.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME are commonly found residing on dangerous hiking trails. With their strength and empathic abilities, they are known to find and rescue injured hikers.
author: thetapemaster

entry: The bones wielded by POKENAME serve as conduits for them to channel their psychic powers. They seem to find these bones when they are young, from the remains scattered across vast deserts.
author: infinex21

entry: Moody and impulsive, it often stomps the ground in fury when it misses a kick. In the wild, POKENAME's tantrums split large boulders and down trees, but a patient Trainer can help it find inner peace.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME enjoys dancing along to music, but its simple mind leaves it unable to follow a beat for long. Many have seen a small group of POKENAME dancing to the same song, each with completely different dance moves.
author: sk372

entry: They are known to share eggs with each other, as each egg has a unique feeling. However, when they pick up a Lucky Egg, they are known to hide the egg so they can hog all the time with it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is very sensitive to the world around it and uses the appendages on its head to sense potential danger. Trainers are often impressed by its thoughtfulness when it brings them gifts.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME enjoys prancing around open fields and cavorting amongst the flowers peacefully. Interrupting these moments of calm indulgence is a quick way to wind up on the receiving end of its horns.
author: sk372

entry: It enjoys entertaining others with interpretive dance routines that involve shapeshifting into various other Pokémon. No matter the sequence, the dance ends with a flourish done in the shape of a Kirlia.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are loyal pets, always sticking by their Trainer's side and guiding them away from any danger it senses. POKENAME's ears will often change colors when evolution draws near.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME throbs and vibrates with a patient enthusiasm, eager to burst from its cocoon. Its excitement for the future is manifested in its constant movement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild POKENAME will press against each other with psychic powers to fight for territory, trying to push the other out. They will let trusted trainers use their stout bodies as pillows.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME has accumulated so much draconic energy that the energy has formed additional spikes all over its body. Being poked by one of these spikes can allow people to see glimpses of the future.
author: geo_ominous

entry: They were once a living thesaurus, as their linguistic knowledge rivaled that of university professors. They once served as scribes to nobility because of such knowledge, and helped pen important correspondences between nobles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dances while flying, spinning through the sky. With a flick of its mind, it plucks Apricorns from trees mid-flight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spins and prances about when in high spirits. This twirling generates electricity within its body, so sparks and small crackles of electricity emanate from it as it dances.
author: sk372

entry: It can be found dancing around in the woods gracefully. It is actually trying to clear its mind as it worries about its future.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME twirls joyfully in puddles, drawing in moisture through its skin. Onlookers feel an urge to cheer as it dances due to its psychic influence.
author: .izik

entry: In the warmth of afternoon sun, POKENAME twirls gracefully. It uses telekinesis to assist its flowing, radiant dances.
author: .izik

entry: When happy, POKENAME will begin to dance around those close to it. It clacks its teeth together to keep rhythm, which also helps to keep its teeth ground down.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient peoples' recorded interactions with this Pokémon tell of POKENAME showing them images that accurately resemble modern human civilization.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Despite having a shell harder than steel, POKENAME dances fluidly. If it stumbles, it uses psychic power to steady its movements.
author: .izik

entry: Using psychic energy, POKENAME plucks berries and stores them in its shell. As they ferment, it shares the sweet juice with others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slams its horn into pine trees to drink sap. The sweet taste increases its psychic power for hours afterward.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a very timid creature and only reveals itself to people who express calm or joyful emotions. When its horns begin to glow, it is preparing to use its extraordinary psychic powers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It works hard to integrate its psychic powers into combat through fierce training. POKENAME that are encouraged by their Trainers glow vibrantly with positive energy.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME acts like a big sister to smaller Pokémon, often teasing and toying with them. It scares people away, but draws them back in with its gaze.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It dances in front of people, performing twirls and small hops to entertain, as well as request food offerings for its entertainment efforts. It becomes quite petulant if nobody feeds it after its dance.
author: sk372

entry: Its leaf-shaped tail can sense the emotions of other Pokémon, allowing it to avoid encounters with enraged creatures in advance. Thanks to its psychic powers, it can make forest leaves float and form levitating paths that lead it to the treetops.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A POKENAME is accompanied by an odd clone of itself wherever it goes. Despite its somewhat cheerful look, the clone itself is hostile.
author: aregularbigjoke

entry: POKENAME is happiest when living near trees. In the wild, it can often be seen climbing to the highest branches and dancing among the leaves.
author: larky_

entry: POKENAME uses its high intelligence and ability to predict its opponents' movements in order to win battles in the most efficient way possible. Outside of battle, POKENAME is actually quite lazy.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME are a favourite for Pokémon contests, their dancing being well co-ordinated and aesthetically pleasing to behold. They sense one another's emotions and can dance in synchrony with one another.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It moves its body in rhythmic ways, each dance coinciding with an attempted warning of upcoming disaster. Due to misinterpretation, many areas think these dances are meant to bring about the calamities instead.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are drawn towards widows who have lost their loved ones. Widows describe feeling a sense of calm when they are nearby, which is likely because they protect the widows from malevolent spirits.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's blade can cut open dimensional tears to see into the future. It fights better when its wielder is in higher spirits.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: While dancing, POKENAME releases glittering spores into the air. If it senses disapproval, it may lash out with a punch mid-spin.
author: .izik

entry: Many years ago, POKENAME was often gifted to new parents. The fabric of its body is said to be softer than Whimsicott cotton.
author: inksans201x

entry: POKENAME's eyesight is extremely poor, but it compensates with strong psychic abilities that helps it sense its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: Using telepathy, the two heads can understand each other's feelings. Because of this, POKENAME's two heads get along very well.
author: musicsheep.

entry: It has the ability to hijack a foe's mind and make them see visions of a horrible future. As POKENAME darts around the battlefield, the foe starts to lose touch with reality. Only when they are in despair does POKENAME attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is only fully awake for about fifteen minutes per day. The rest of the time, it moves through psychic control, pretending to be alert.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME performs complex ballet-like movements without tiring. While dancing, it reads the emotions of nearby beings with empathetic powers.
author: .izik

entry: It has the ability to hijack a foe's mind and make them see visions of a horrible future. As POKENAME darts around the battlefield, the foe starts to lose touch with reality. Only when they are in despair does POKENAME attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It has the ability to hijack a foe's mind and make them see visions of a horrible future. As POKENAME darts around the battlefield, the foe starts to lose touch with reality. Only when they are in despair does POKENAME attack.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Highly sensitive and filled with courage, POKENAME settles and eases clashing fused Pokémon with songs and psychic power. It is thought POKENAME prevents many wild fused Pokémon from wreaking havoc on the ecological balance of the environment.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Swarms of POKENAME gather around damaged wires. If they sense electricians approaching, they vanish in a sudden psychic blink.
author: .izik

entry: As it rolls, POKENAME emits a psychic aura that urges others to chase it. Even strong Pokémon sometimes feel compelled to race alongside it.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon is extremely weak. Instead of running, it tries to uses its hair-like cloth to protect itself from attacks, usually unsuccessfully.
author: mystora

entry: The shedding from POKENAME's wings has healing properties, so it is harvested and used as bedding for sick Pokémon. It can sit on people's heads to relieve headaches.
author: darxer_

entry: The psychic power of POKENAME is amplified by its two brains-one in its head and one in its back. Its feelers can sense the emotions of those nearby.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: When hugged, POKENAME's soft body triggers a psychic wave of bliss. The joy vanishes the moment the hug ends, leaving many dazed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are great babysitters for young girls, often teaching them how to be more lady-like. Despite this, POKENAME is about as mature as a 13-year-old girl.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lure prey by projecting images of safety and warmth with their psychic powers, tricking targets into approaching. Once close enough, they strike with toxic stingers, revealing the ruse too late for their victims.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME leap over opponents, scattering debilitating spores from above. They perform intricate dances.
author: totodile.

entry: This fusion has the ability to manipulate random selections such as RNG machines, casino roulettes, and card dealings in truco and poker. Casinos are quickly working on banning POKENAME from entering establishments.
author: epping_forest

entry: Using its sensory organ, POKENAME records its Trainer's mood swings to calculate the best moment to ask for food. Also, depending on whether this fusion feels happy or sad, WiFi and Bluetooth signals near it may get stronger or weaker.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME may be quick to anger but is just as quick to conciliate itself. It practices deep breathing and other ways to calm itself to keep its Trainer happy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME relentlessly pushes itself in physical and mental training. Some say the reason it works so hard is to protect either itself or its Trainer from a future that it foresees.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME dances through jungle canopies, releasing a green pollen. Those nearby may fall into deep despair after breathing it in.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its latent psychic power to manipulate the laws of magnetism. It hasn't mastered this ability just yet, and tends to fry electronics around it.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME will hypnotize passersby almost immediately upon spotting them, but not out of any sense of malice. It simply craves partners in its twirling dance, and hypnosis better allows others to follow its rhythm properly.
author: sk372

entry: Its psychic center of gravity lets it settle upright no matter how dizzy it grows from rolling about. Its explosions dazzle the mind.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Due to its psychic sensitivity, POKENAME hides in abandoned mines, watching the outside world on its crystalline focus. If too many Trainers gather inside its home, it goes mad, attempting to collapse the tunnel with vicious Earthquakes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Focusing intensely, POKENAME channels its passion into each kick, its legs stretching to match the distance from its foe. The deeper the bond a Trainer has with POKENAME, the farther it can reach with its kicks.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME loyally protects its Trainer from harm. If its psychic powers fail, it can always rely on its brute strength to body-check its opponent.
author: .realthree

entry: To POKENAME, its Trainer is its family and as important as its own child. It will dote on them, spoil them, and even try to carry them in its pouch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flutters over flower gardens, monitoring the behavior of Bug-types below. If their behavior gets too unruly, it spreads a pacifying powder from its wings to calm them down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fights in tandem with a loyal Staryu partner, directing it with a wand it carries. Some believe the species came from another galaxy somewhere far away in space.
author: sk372

entry: With careful steps and graceful arms, it choreographs invisible defenses around those it trusts. In performances, it can mimic entire stories through illusion and subtle telepathy.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME have a natural fear and disgust for Bug-type Pokémon and will retreat behind their Trainer if confronted with one. Training a POKENAME to overcome this phobia takes patience and dedication.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though physically weak, POKENAME's telekinesis lets it protect itself and others from harm. It regularly sends out a calming mental pulse that lowers aggression in those surrounding it, making its home that much more peaceful.
author: sk372

entry: The flame sac inside POKENAME always keeps it heated and ideal for comfortably warm hugs. It can breathe out a uniquely-colored pink flame that seems to sparkle while it burns.
author: sk372

entry: It uses its blades for hunting, but also for defending boats that pass through its territory. Many ships have been saved from rampaging Pokémon due to POKENAME's intervention.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME perches atop mountain peaks surveying its territory. If it spots a fight between Pokémon, it swoops down and gets between the combatants and stops the fight, forcibly separating them with psychic pulses.
author: sk372

entry: Its appetite grows when it is fused, motivating it to eat several hundreds of pounds of food each day. This food fuels its unmatched psychic powers.
author: skymaster426

entry: Many a tale has been told of POKENAME teleporting before travelers lost in frigid wastelands and carrying them to safety. Once they arrive, it never lingers, vanishing once more in a burst of sparkling powdery snow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME possesses a conflicting mix of antisocial tendencies with a want for close companionship. Once it bonds with a Trainer, it is fiercely loyal and extremely reluctant to be around anyone else.
author: sk372

entry: Any shred of compassion that these Pokémon still possess is distorted through their innately violent disposition. A POKENAME acting in defense of its Trainer is a fearsome sight, as it uses its powers to swiftly dispatch opponents.
author: thatlittletwerp

entry: With four eyes and the lower half of a spider, POKENAME is a frightful sight to many. Though it tries to be helpful, many are scared away by it.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: A master architect. Once it finds a suitable area, it spins its webbing to build a remarkably efficient network of bridges, nests, and complex traps.
author: vaporvenator

entry: It's been dubbed a "spider queen" by those who have travelled through its woods. It uses webs to patch up wounds and build homes for smaller Pokémon.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It's been dubbed a "spider queen" by those who have travelled through its woods. It uses webs to patch up wounds and build homes for smaller Pokémon.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It's been dubbed a "spider queen" by those who have travelled through its woods. It uses webs to patch up wounds and build homes for smaller Pokémon.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Its scarf will always wave, regardless of the breeze. It takes a long time to forge a strong bond with POKENAME, but when Trainers do, their life is said to have good fortune.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME loves plants and arranges them in florid patterns that are appealing to the eye. Their artistry makes them popular among museum curators who need a good display to fill up space.
author: quackquackattack

entry: There are several stories of POKENAME accidentally creating black holes, then being so tired from the effort, they fall into them. Some places even ban them for the danger they could pose.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's uniquely divided image is said by some to represent the duality and balance of good and evil. It uses a strange psychic power to grant boons to the kindhearted and to cast hexes upon the wicked.
author: sk372

entry: It spins like a top at incredible speeds. Its psychic abilities amplify the rotation, creating a dazzling yet disorienting display.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is well-equipped to help Trainers capture or relocate Pokémon in the wild. It fires out psychic bullets that pacify and immobilize even the most aggressive of Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will embrace anyone it feels compassion toward with its tentacles. Many find it hard to escape its suction-cupped grasp.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Many fear POKENAME for its hypnotic powers and deadly bite. It longs for companionship, but tragically it ends up turning its companions to stone.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME can typically be found around mountain areas, blocking off the more treacherous areas and guiding hikers and the like towards safer passages through the area.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives. Its special horns change color depending on the type of emotion it is sensing.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives. Its special horns change color depending on the type of emotion it is sensing.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives. Its special horns change color depending on the type of emotion it is sensing.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its powerful psychic abilities allow it to create protective barriers that hide anyone within them from the eyes of enemies. POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A budding martial artist, POKENAME treats each of its opponents with the utmost respect. It always gives a bow before and after every battle as thanks for the opportunity to hone its developing body.
author: sk372

entry: Many fear POKENAME for its hypnotic powers and deadly bite. It longs for companionship, but tragically it ends up turning its companions to stone.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: A POKENAME's potent neurotoxin can create powerful illusions in the mind of a target. It prefers to disarm an enemy with illusions of scared children.
author: naga_sake

entry: They struggle with self-confidence due to their public perception and otherwise bulky body. When a Trainer gives them a Petaya Berry, they gain a moment of clarity which helps them gain the self-confidence needed to push to victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It uses psychic powers in conjunction with an innate connection to lightning to sense those lost within raging thunderstorms across the world. It teleports to their side instantly in order to take them to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is the embodiment of magma and passion. Its bright glowing flames shine like rainbows and consume all that they touch.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Legends speak of ships about to meet extreme storms, before the oceans stilled suddenly, allowing safe passage. Above the ships, POKENAME could be seen, calming the sea with its psychic powers to protect the humans aboard.
author: sk372

entry: Its piercing screech renders foes unable to move. It then delivers a venom that locks up their joints and leaves them with cold, pale skin.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME were once believed to be Gorgons before fusion was commonplace. Old legends claimed that POKENAME's gaze could turn creatures to stone.
author: hypersonic06

entry: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is as elegant as it is dangerous. Its hypnotic, stony gaze has transformed countless souls into statues, which it displays in its abode.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is perhaps one of the most friendly and loyal of Pokémon. Its calm, caring and protective nature makes it ideal as a companion and caretaker for young children.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME manipulates the drills floating around it with Psychic energy to bore through stone. To defend itself, it will do the same with the armored plates on its dress.
author: kduffradio

entry: Able to perfectly control the voltage from its twin tails, many hospitals employ POKENAME to help with defibrillation. Highly intelligent and compassionate, it always knows precisely the right amount of intensity to apply.
author: sk372

entry: The flame-shaped patterns on its cloak change color according to the emotions POKENAME is feeling at the moment. When it prepares for battle, flames can be seen bursting from its sleeves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The flame-shaped patterns on its cloak change color according to the emotions POKENAME is feeling at the moment. When it prepares for battle, flames can be seen bursting from its sleeves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME appears on unprotected websites, luring people into clicking on it. If they do, POKENAME will release harmful viruses into their computer.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: A prodigy in both physical and mental combat, POKENAME seeks out rigorous training to hone its skills. This can make it a challenge to train for many.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME trains in both harsh and calm environments-harsh to hone its fighting skills, and calm to strengthen its psychic ones. Its feathers ignite when it senses its Trainer is in danger.
author: tristenkalshin

entry: POKENAME is harsh in battle. It uses its psychic abilities to create brutal telekinetic attacks. Outside of battle, POKENAME is gentle and empathetic, often choosing to care for younger Pokémon.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME move with unearthly grace and poise, their dances bringing even the harshest critics to tears. POKENAME are a common feature on winning Pokémon Contest teams.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Fusing POKENAME gives it an obscene amount of psychic power, to the point it radiates off of it. The psychic waves it emanates, along with the pose it takes, establish a sense of dominance over other creatures.
author: sk372

entry: Taking on an appearance similar to Mega Evolution, POKENAME's strength is vastly improved. Its protective instincts are also strengthened, so it rarely lets its Trainer out of its sight.
author: sk372

entry: After fusing, POKENAME takes on a form similar to Mega Evolution. Its strength increases to the level of the form as well, though its gentle nature means it rarely uses its power at full capacity.
author: sk372

entry: Wedding dresses designed after POKENAME's appearance are becoming increasingly common, as POKENAME is seen as a symbol of love. If one should appear at a couple's wedding, it's believed the couple will stay together forever.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has two heads, granting it twice the psychic power. Its heads have different personalities, making coordination difficult.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: A uniquely-colored variant of POKENAME that has garnered some level of infamy. According to reports, it has a habit of suddenly appearing in homes and challenging trainers to a harrowing battle against it.
author: sk372

entry: Its peerless swordsmanship and undying loyalty make it a force to be reckoned with. It will fearlessly stand against any foe if it means protecting those it loves.
author: cheroace

entry: POKENAME moves swiftly and gracefully in battle. It dances as one with its weapon with complete mastery, spinning it around as to defend itself. When the bladed ends of the weapon glow in a bright pink hue, they can cut through almost anything.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Since sightings of POKENAME are so rare, it was once hailed as a deity. The sigils that surround it have no biometric signature.
author: jokerswild

entry: POKENAME have powerful psychic abilities. They use them to float and to teleport away from threats rather than battle.
author: ohok3441

entry: It uses its four brains and hearts to foresee danger. If its Trainer is threatened, it will protect them with all its might.
author: lemgambino

entry: A strange ghostly spirit that projects itself into a chosen victim's television. POKENAME crawls out from the screen and haunts their home for seven days before vanishing and choosing another.
author: sk372

entry: A strange ghostly spirit that projects itself into television screens. POKENAME crawls out of the TV and haunts a chosen victim, though some believe this is a strange show of affection on its part.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME have been known to host beauty pageants, the winner of which is chosen to lead the group. If a wild POKENAME is made dirty, it will use psychic energy to paralyze its opponent as it devours them.
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813

entry: Reports exist of POKENAME appearing in abandoned industrial complexes. Despite being linked to multiple disappearances, it is apparently gentle.
author: seaslux

entry: POKENAME propels itself forward with psychic force as it charges. It is capable of ramming with the force of a truck and the speed of a car.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME is protective of companions, but still lazy at heart. Most Trainers must contend with it using psychic powers to keep them close so POKENAME need not move much to keep them safe.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's disaster sense, coupled with its kind nature and protective instincts, make it a beloved guardian to many towns across the regions. Just seeing a POKENAME nearby is enough to give many stronger individuals peace of mind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME travels the world, leading small packs of Absol along. It makes a show of guiding the Absol to help and rescue others, so that Absol's poor reputation may be positively changed over time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME ward off malevolent spirits near graveyards and mausoleums. They also help grieving families by listening to their memories of the departed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Suspended by psychic energy, it lures lost souls with spectral hands, beckoning them into its ethereal embrace.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME's gargantuan size and kind nature make it deathly afraid of harming others. It often sits quietly at the water's edge, watching others and staying perfectly still to avoid potentially hurting anyone.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has been revered as a deity of love and compassion for centuries. It's said it created all that is good in the universe with its 1,000 arms.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Protective and aggressive, POKENAME appoints itself as a guardian of young Nidoran. Anything that gets too close will be charged down and stabbed with its horn, which immobilizes the victim with its psychically-charged venom.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic senses to see into the future, and if it sees its wielder is in danger, will slice open a black hole in their defense.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's psychic power enhances its eyes, allowing it to see alternate timelines. It then uses this knowledge to choose the path most beneficial to its trainer.
author: 4amhyena

entry: POKENAME makes psychic illusions to hide itself from humans. If it becomes close to its Trainer, it will do everything its power to protect them.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can move through water in any direction without swimming by using hydrokinesis. These empathetic lake Pokémon frequently rescue the drowning and may pledge loyalty and protection to worthy trainers.
author: draconicsanguineice

entry: POKENAME is generally level-headed and composed, fully capable of controlling its power. Should its focus be broken, it will rampage violently.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME wield remarkable psychic powers that keep them aloft. If a POKENAME's Trainer  is in grave danger, its gears will spin in reverse and create a black hole to try and save them.
author: infinex21

entry: It is said that, were humanity to face disaster from beyond the stars, POKENAME will descend from on high to protect it, repelling the invaders with powerful black holes fueled by its very life force.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is worshipped as the deity of time, loyalty, and compassion. It will go so far as to rewrite history to protect the ones it loves most.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME has the ability to banish ill-meaning creatures into a black hole, never to be seen again. Thankfully, it seems to be very even-keel: even in anger, it will never use this ability prematurely.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its eye is capable of cowing even the bravest warrior, its aura of dread overwhelming. Only those who bear it can witness its rather gentle nature.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME was often seen in the service of those of royal lineage, protecting castles and all those within them. Its sturdy armored body withstood any attack, and it could retaliate with a myriad of elemental energies from the orbs on its front.
author: sk372

entry: If a battle to protect those it holds dear becomes truly dire, POKENAME closes its helmet and essentially shuts off its merciful instinct. Driven by a desire for victory at all costs, it fights with power enough to tear a continent asunder.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dedicates every ounce of its fearsome mechanical body to protect its beloved Trainer and friends. It fears obsolescence and will become increasingly erratic if not regularly allowed to fight on its Trainer's behalf.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often subdues its foes by creating a powerful toxin infused with psychic power. Symptoms often include migraines and sluggish movement.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME floats high above its Trainer, scouting the distances with its strong eyesight and psychic powers. Should it sense anything dangerous ahead, it will quickly descend to its Trainer and lift them away to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's hair lets it monitor the surrounding psychic energy to detect danger. Because of this, it's very sensitive about keeping its hair clean.
author: phantom640

entry: POKENAME is a loyal Pokémon that protects its Trainer from evil and depravity. It views itself as a hero fighting corruption and exhibits a certain pride in helping others.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are adept fighters capable of taking down foes much larger than themselves. The only thing greater than their fighting prowess is their affection for their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To keep a close eye on its Trainer, POKENAME will inhabit the nearest electronic device in their possession. Though it means well, the possession causes the item's power to drain at triple the usual rate.
author: sk372

entry: No one is quite sure where a scythe wielded by a POKENAME comes from, but some theorize it is formed from a pocket dimension born of their psychic powers. They use their psychic abilities to pull dangerous foes toward them before slashing them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use their many eyes to track the movements of their opponents with extreme precision. They use their psychic powers to craft large electric webs to ensnare anything that threatens their Trainers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a tendency to wrap people and things its fond of in webs to keep them close and safe. However, it will let them go if they sense they wish to be freed, even if it saddens POKENAME.
author: hello_i_exist

entry: POKENAME's sharp tusks are coated with a psychic energy that dulls them just enough to ensure their strikes are always nonlethal. Cuts inflicted by POKENAME slowly sap the fighting spirit of foes until they collapse from exhaustion.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME seeks out Ralts to protect them from harm. It then takes them to a safe place with plenty of shelter and food.
author: jackjirachi

entry: A playful prankster of a nature spirit, the tendrils of POKENAME's leafy wreath reach out to take keys and other tiny trinkets from unsuspecting travelers, so it can revel in making them chase after it to retrieve the stolen items.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses a cute and gentle appearance to endear itself to humans so it may protect them. It's said that as a defensive last resort, it will suck attackers into a black hole nestled beneath its cloth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME takes protecting its Trainer to a violent extreme. If it cannot find its Trainer, POKENAME will devastate an entire city to look for them.
author: musicsheep.

entry: According to legend, POKENAME erases the memories of anyone who dares to touch one of its tails without permission. Its psychic powers are so immense that they can crush unprepared Pokémon to the ground.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can deliver devastating blows at blinding speeds due to its exposure to extraterrestrial radiation. It has also gained a unique singing voice, which is adored worldwide for its otherworldly sound.
author: vlavoc

entry: POKENAME is said to be able to see your deepest wish with the eye on its stomach. If your wish is pure, it will be granted, but if your wish is wicked, it will trap you in crystal forever.
author: bee4082

entry: Some may ridicule POKENAME, but it is proud of both its appearance and its long-honed, immense prowess.
author: togetik

entry: POKENAME specifically tunes its psychic frequency to sense children feeling sad or frightened. If it detects one, it goes to them and lets them hold onto it, its strings granting a warm and soothing sensation to the child when held.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is feared due to its frightening appearance and sharp horns. Those who learn to love POKENAME will receive a powerful companion for life.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Fossil records indicate POKENAME lived in close proximity to humanity's ancient ancestors. Some speculate it guarded them from predators, and that humanity might not exist if not for its efforts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was once a human of noble descent. Trapped in a snowstorm one day, it awoke in the form of POKENAME. Its white kimono indicates its nobility.
author: tr3bles

entry: POKENAME was once a Gardevoir who gave its life for its Trainer in a blizzard. It seeks and approaches female travelers, only to scare them away.
author: tr3bles

entry: POKENAME was once a Gardevoir who gave its life for its Trainer in a blizzard. It seeks and approaches male travelers, only to scare them away.
author: tr3bles

entry: When fused, POKENAME's latent instincts are unlocked to make a cunning and brutal hunter. Even if it unfuses, the Gardevoir won't stop biting things.
author: seaslux

entry: A friendly forest spirit, POKENAME comes out at night to protect children lost in the darkness of the woods. It radiates a faint light, and repels any other Ghost-type Pokémon that approach and try to cause trouble.
author: sk372

entry: It gathers acorns from the forest floor, which it uses to focus its telekinetic powers. Without these, its abilities become erratic and less controlled.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME adjusts the sensitivity of its empathic horn to assess the feelings of entire cities. It helps improving the mood of the people using its ears to broadcast high amplitude ultrasounds that contain subliminal messages.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME periodically releases mystical energy that heals damage done in the environment directly caused by living things: uncontrollably toxic Pokémon causing plants to wilt, fiery ash being rained down by a Fire-type, and so on.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Some say POKENAME was created with magic and stone to be a guardian of humanity. Several tales exist of it suddenly appearing and psychically stopping landslides and rockfalls that would have taken the lives of unfortunate travelers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their potent psychic powers to manipulate rock and earth with precision in tandem with their swift, physical strikes. They can walk "on air" with psychic energy alone, allowing them to easily overwhelm most foes.
author: infinex21

entry: Known to gather together in packs to howl at the full moon, POKENAME refuses to back down from challengers. They have been seen throwing boulders with their psychic might, and could pull the moon from the sky to protect bonded Trainers.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME lures victims in with the its charms. It then disorients them by unleashing concentrated psychic noise from its mouth.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Overwhelmed by fungus, this Gardevoir has become nothing more than a tool, psionically drawing in others to become hosts for the fungus to spread.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: During combat, POKENAME enters a state of battle meditation, getting surprise first strikes against direct enemies with its large arms. Meanwhile, its small arms call forth psychic power, crushing foes from afar.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Pointed quills are hidden beneath POKENAME's curl of fur over its head. It can extend these to prick foes in self-defense, but due to its gentle nature this is an absolute last resort of a technique.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefers not to fight, but will hold nothing back if those it cares about are threatened. Even at risk of its own life, it will embrace its allies to fully shield them from a cataclysmic threat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The globe on POKENAME's staff is pure psychic energy, which, if unleashed, would warp reality. It maintains constant focus, only unleashing the power in spurts of Psywaves or channeling fire from thin air.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Some say POKENAME has the ability to erase its psychic signature making it invisible even to mind readers. Any sensed Psychic types cause a natural hunting instinct to awaken, driving this Pokémon to stalk them and make them disappear.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The powder falling from its scales was prized in ancient times. When refined, it served as a powerful and reliable sleep aid.
author: .izik

entry: Nonconfrontational by nature, POKENAME prefers hiding in water and pretending to be a simple lily pad. However, if it spies cruel behavior occurring, it blasts the perpetrator with powerful psychic energy while remaining hidden.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's serene and beautiful appearance is used on many wedding chapels in the modern era. Some say it's an embodiment of the purest kind of love.
author: sk372

entry: Each head of POKENAME has a completely different personality. The medium sized head absolutely hates the largest head.
author: themicelegion

entry: Appearing harmless, POKENAME is anything but, manipulating human brainwaves to induce feelings of endearment so that it gets taken in. Before too long, they will find themselves bereft of their valuables at the hands of this little cat burglar.
author: .fedoraman

entry: It has been discovered that near this fusion, cryptography-based pins and passwords may become weaker and easier to breach. However, for this to happen, POKENAME must be taken near the server to be hacked, which by today's standards is impossible.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME helps out around the home by oozing around and eating expired food and other bits of garbage around the house to keep it clean. As it digests the refuse, it emits a pleasant scent that soothes those near it.
author: sk372

entry: A Pokémon of near unparalleled loyalty and devotion to its Trainer. POKENAME will memorize its Trainer's scent and even brainwaves so that no matter where they are, POKENAME will be able to sense, find and aid them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME acts as a cleric in its team, preferring to avoid combat and healing its allies instead. If pressed, however, it can use massively powerful psychic abilities to defend itself.
author: sk372

entry: Sometimes referred to as "the Mage in White" in some regions, POKENAME abhors violence and refrains from fighting as much as possible. Even when it does fight, once the battle concludes, it will heal its opponent as well as itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME trains relentlessly so that both its mind and body are at peak efficiency for protecting others. Extremely powerful POKENAME can even create psychic projectiles launched from their fists.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to increase the weight it lifts when training. When in a pinch, POKENAME will decrease the force of gravity on itself to become exponentially faster.
author: rotcivosk

entry: POKENAME are well known for their striking pink flames and elegant beauty. They are a rare sight, dashing through forests like like fairies or ghosts.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: They have been revered for their noble nature and were given the role of temple guardians in ancient times. Even now, wild POKENAME still protect their ancient ruins and will attack any treasure hunter that dare approach them.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME enjoys collecting human gadgets, gizmos, and thingamabobs. It wishes to have legs so it can explore the human world.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: It bears a striking resemblance to Primarina from Alola. It enjoys basking on glaciers and caring for small fish Pokémon.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is often spotted guarding areas where young undersea Pokémon are born and raised. It fires telepathically-controlled spikes from its shell to deter any hunters that would try to prey on the young.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME's brain is capsuled within a singularity, resembling a miniature black hole. It subconsciously uses its psychic powers to lessen its gravitational pull, preventing itself from creating an event horizon.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME fight with integrity and respect, especially whenever they are in danger. Its strict moral code may cause issues in everyday life because POKENAME always strives to be a hero.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME always fight without perfidious intent and strive to be the best fighter they can become. Their stubbornness often comes out in defeat because they never know when to give up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a master of both the art of combat and etiquette. With a single swift strike, its scythes cleave through any obstacle.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME stand resolute in the face of danger and will tackle any threat head on. Equipped with their trusty stinger, they manage to escape almost certain defeat through sheer bravery and willpower.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It can psychically attune to an opponent's anger to strengthen its swordplay. However, if its foe succumbs to uncontrollable rage, the connection may drag it into the same fury.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME wobbles and rolls inside its cocoon, as it patiently waits for its time to evolve. It is filled with energy and determination, even in this humbler state.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wields two elongated blades that ooze with a toxic venom, which seeps into wounds whenever it slices its target. It fights with pride and honor, never backing down from a duel.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its small stature, POKENAME is seen constantly training its swordsmanship skills. On nights filled with many shooting stars, groups of POKENAME gather to spar.
author: mepp.

entry: It wields its large, flat feathers like sharpened hatchets during combat. Each strike is both precise and devastating.
author: .izik

entry: When Unown come together to deliver a message, the presence of a POKENAME in the group is a sign denoting the need for protection.
author: .realthree

entry: This POKENAME takes the form of letters belonging to an ancient language. It is often found staring across the sea.
author: .realthree

entry: If surrounded by angry humans or Pokémon, it will sense the hostility telepathically. Overwhelmed, it may explode in a psychic burst as a defense mechanism.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are an exemplary model of justice and heroism, as their desire to help others supersedes their desire to stay safe. They often jump into danger to protect baby Pokémon, and all they ask in return is recognition for their actions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It's selfless nature often leads POKENAME into dangerous situations when those weaker than it are in trouble.
author: inksans201x

entry: It is usually found within mountainous regions. It can easily evade predators due to their psychic powers and speed.
author: patch

entry: Its arms are extremely hydrodynamic, allowing it to create whirlpools and swim at high speeds with little effort.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME watches over the forests in which it lives to protect weaker Pokémon from poachers or predators. It charges headfirst with its magnificent horns until its foe decides to flee.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are reliable fighters that knows how to hit where it hurts. Though their flashy attacks border on the ostentatious side, they always want a fair fight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME roams the land rejuvenating and purifying bodies of water with its ribbons. Those it finds polluting the waters will receive just and merciless punishment.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sees glimpses of the future, allowing it to predict and counter attacks with flawless precision. Its graceful flight masks a fierce combat style honed through generations of aerial duels.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Its wild nature tamed by an overwhelming desire for justice, POKENAME is a gallant hero that has a bad habit of striking heroic poses mid-battle.
author: leshii

entry: POKENAME uses psychic powers to chip off the pointed tips of its spines to use as projectiles in battle. It forces a foe to dodge the spines in order to draw them closer so it can rake at them with its razor-sharp claws.
author: sk372

entry: There are few battlers more cunning than a POKENAME. It is efficient and swift, often ending a fight with just two or three moves. For this, POKENAME is popular in tournament circuits.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME shares a connection to another region's local phenomenon. It uses its strong elbow-blades and psychic power to protect the innocent.
author: scigaming

entry: POKENAME assists the vulnerable by protecting them with its diamond-tough shield. This formidable defense makes it overconfident and reckless, leading it to valiantly sacrifice itself in battle protecting its partners.
author: pjporwoll

entry: This Pokémon is fat, lazy, and often appears completely indifferent to its surroundings. However, when it decides to act, it becomes a devastating force of pure and raw strength.
author: starexpizz

entry: Wild POKENAME are chivalrous Pokémon that will leap to defend the weak and frail alike with blades of psychic energy they form upon their elbows. They are a common inspiration for stories of knights that ride upon white steeds to protect others.
author: infinex21

entry: A legend states that POKENAME has the wisdom of a king, the fortitude of a knight, and the power to rule over others. It is a courteous Pokémon that makes sure to greet and bow to opponents before attacking gracefully and overwhelmingly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: An expert fighter able to read its opponent's thoughts, POKENAME protects its opponent and those in need with predictive haste.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME acts as a bastion of safety and justice and protects young Pokémon from danger. Its heroism inspires other Pokémon to always be kind and fair.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its rotund body, it surprises foes with incredible speed when launching an attack. Its swiftness makes it a difficult target to counter.
author: .izik

entry: While researchers generally agree that the structural differences in the mask's face are a result of the influence of Gallade's DNA, some anthropologists suggest that the altered visage could be evidence of an extinct subspecies of human.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME lives on barren mountains. If travelers wander into its territory, POKENAME will cause an avalanche to block their way.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME's fins are constantly sharpened against coral reefs. It can cut up its prey simply by swimming around them.
author: musicsheep.

entry: It strives to protect the forest it calls home using its sharp blades. It will mercilessly cut down anyone trying to bring harm to the wildlife.
author: cheroace

entry: It uses its large wings to disperse a psychedelic powder into the air. The substance manipulates the minds of foes, leaving them disoriented and vulnerable.
author: .izik

entry: Trainers report that when POKENAME meditates under moonlight, the water around it becomes perfectly still. If even a single ripple breaks the surface, it vanishes into the trees without a sound.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME moves with supernatural swiftness, and its crystalline helm glimmers with the dappled sunlight of its sylvan home. Those who have caught sight of one are few, but they all agree on one thing: POKENAME is not a Pokémon to be trifled with.
author: .realthree

entry: If you're being accosted on the street at night, you can rest assured that a POKENAME will come to your aid. They aren't selfless though; if you fail to pay them for their time, you won't be as lucky next time.
author: .fedoraman

entry: A protector of nature, POKENAME strives to keep the flora and fauna safe from harm. If it senses that its surroundings are in danger, it will remove its belt and strike with precision at whoever is responsible.
author: cinnamoncreampuff

entry: POKENAME is quite powerful, but never uses its full potential. It is lazy and enjoys long naps, but can become dangerous when pushed into a corner.
author: sand_coffin

entry: Kicks from this Pokémon initially seem weak due to its fragile exoskeleton, but soon after the attack, the target is struck with a supernatural force. It is theorized the strength of the attack manifests from the ghostly energy in POKENAME's body.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME inhabits a shell in the shape of a boxer. It uses lightning-fast flurries of punches before freezing mid-motion to rest, even in mid-air.
author: eggsaladologist

entry: It trained and fought endlessly until its body simply couldn't take any more. Though normally motionless, it can still fight opponents with swift and precise movements, as if its spirit still guides the body to grow ever stronger.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's crescent-shaped wings glow faintly in the night. When the moon is full, should POKENAME be hovering silently over a field of flowers, all the plants will have wilted by the time the sun rises.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME is incredibly hollow inside, which many theorize is why it so easily floats about in the air. It uses its psychic powers to drop berries and nuts into the opening on the front of its body, which will never be seen again.
author: infinex21

entry: It appears to stand completely motionless, but wise Trainers know to give POKENAME a wide berth. Agitators will find themselves beset with cuts coming from seemingly nowhere, as POKENAME stares blankly in their direction...
author: sk372

entry: Known as the 'Reaper of the Forest", POKENAME follow bug Pokémon around that are near the end of their life. It is unknown what happens when they pass in the presence of POKENAME.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME swims slowly and motionlessly through the deep sea, seemingly oblivious to its surroundings. Schools of Magikarp and even Gyarados will flee if they spot POKENAME approaching.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is very fragile, so it will possess others by latching onto their heads. However, victims of POKENAME have no recollection of anything while they were possessed.
author: mistymagius

entry: Occasionally after a massive thunderstorm, you can find POKENAME floating near the storm's center. Though it is completely immobile, its body contains enough electricity to power an entire region.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME makes its home near hollowed and abandoned former nests of other insect Pokémon. Some believe it guards the spirits of those who perished defending those hives from predators.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is seemingly motionless, eerily staring at anyone who passes by. Some cultures see POKENAME as a bringer of misfortune, while others believe it to be a guardian angel.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME appears in areas with little to no light pollution, floating silently where the stars shine brightly. It is thought they gain energy under starlight, fueling the supernatural power behind their attacks.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's webs are intangible to most living beings as they are intended to catch lost souls floating by. Despite its creepy appearance, people with a fear of ghosts like to keep it around.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME makes its home in the deepest and darkest of mountain caverns. It's said that those who touch the crescent floating above its head will be transformed into a Zubat.
author: sk372

entry: At dusk and dawn, POKENAME briefly make their way to the water's surface to feed. The rest of the time they spend submerged in mud, dormant and unmoving.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME rarely moves. It's believed that the first POKENAME came to be when an old empty Pineco casing was possessed by a lost spirit.
author: hophoppip

entry: It doesn't move. It doesn't blink. It doesn't eat. There doesn't appear to be anything inside the impenetrable shell except a floating pair of eyelids. If it couldn't use powerful moves, one could be forgiven in thinking it wasn't even a Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The hollow shell of POKENAME is hard as steel and can break rocks with ease. Its wings do not move, yet this Pokémon can float off the ground at will.
author: jadey.1557

entry: POKENAME silently glide during the night, looking for lost Trainers to slowly drain their energy until they can no longer stand. Pairs of Chingling follow POKENAME to protect them from danger.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME appears to be nothing more than a husk with a liquified Ninjask leaking from it. The Ninjask, however, is alive and is the real Pokémon!
author: shining_joot

entry: POKENAME walks silently through dim forests, ignoring all other life. Its empty shell never tires, never eats, and never blinks, yet its path always leads somewhere.
author: mgfox_66676

entry: It's said that POKENAME formed when a Trainer abandoned their underperforming Pikachu in a forest, and it became possessed by a mysterious force.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME is said to form when their forest homes will be in danger in the near future. The recent rise in their numbers is concerning enough that new regulations regarding deforestation for human construction are being discussed.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME can revert entropy to zero, for it invokes lost joules/kelvin to cast attacks. This power means the potential of an infinite energy source, but no POKENAME has ever cooperated to this purpose.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME perches at the edges of swampy marshes and stands unmoving, as if waiting for something. What that might be is unknown, but all other Pokémon vacate the marsh before nightfall when POKENAME is present.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME with larger halos have stood watch over their designated marshes for extraordinary lengths of time. When night falls, a strange ghostly mist settles over the swamp, and a strange light glows within POKENAME's eyes.
author: sk372

entry: It is believed that this is the original form of Shedinja. Some speculate that this creature has angelic powers.
author: zerocipher

entry: Scientists studying POKENAME say that its halo appears to bend around an extreme gravitational force. Unfortunately, no known method of study has been able to provide any intelligible information.
author: opoaotoroiocoko

entry: POKENAME is a hollow shell left from a Kecleon's molt. It neither breathes nor moves, yet something within stirs, and anyone who peers into its hollow back is said to lose their spirit.
author: sim.n

entry: The hole is endlessly deep and perfectly black. It was once said to have been created by an ancient civilization to try and peer into the afterlife.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME wanders the world endlessly, liberating corrupted spirits. It possesses a profound sense of justice and otherworldly physical prowess.
author: lynkinator

entry: Despite its size, POKENAME remains mostly motionless throughout the course of its life. Anything that enters the hole on its back is never seen again.
author: bee4082

entry: A curious Pokémon discovered in a cave where fossils had been found. POKENAME is thought to be the exoskeleton of an ancient Pokémon brought back to life.
author: fifteenk

entry: This uncommon Pokémon stands vigil over the sites of natural disasters. POKENAME's legs never appear to move as it eerily advances.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME remain in tombs and are difficult to awaken. When they eventually awaken, they attack the source of discomfort before resuming their slumber.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME protect ancient tombs by siphoning life energy from other Pokémon. Without proper preparation, they are nearly impossible to defeat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are known to remain by their Trainer's side even after death. They can be found in ancient tombs where they are still protecting their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Should one hear the ominous hum of a POKENAME hovering above, they must avoid looking up at all costs. Those who gaze into its hollow underside will be sucked into the abyss within, never to be seen again.
author: sk372

entry: Certain ancient records state the sight of POKENAME is a harbinger of the end of existence. The stories say all life will one day be pulled into its hollow shell and used as fuel to reincarnate the universe anew.
author: sk372

entry: Shedinja congregate near POKENAME, some venturing in and out of its seemingly hollow shell. Some believe that those Shedinja entering POKENAME's body are storing the spirits they've stolen within its confines.
author: sk372

entry: The trident-shaped crest on POKENAME's face is always cool to the touch, even in scorching heat. Wild individuals strike fiercely with their flipper claws but show little regard for defense.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The blades of a POKENAME are sharp enough to cut through anything. However, they are exceptionally brittle, making them hard to use.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME acts as a grim reaper for souls, guiding those who have died and finding those who have yet to perish.
author: mors_martii

entry: POKENAME, resembling a hollow, soulless shell of a ruthless warrior, never shows mercy, nor any emotions at all. It's said to be driven by a single goal - to fill its emptiness with a soul of a worthy opponent defeated in battle.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME slinks around quietly near civilization, watching people and drawing closer when unobserved. Those touched by its strange ribbons have any negative emotions drained away for a time.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that fine sand constantly pours from its hollow body, as if POKENAME had crushed the very concept of time itself. When it unleashes its powers, it is surrounded by all the phases of the moon at once.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is said that fine sand constantly pours from its hollow body, as if POKENAME had shattered the concept of time itself. Anyone who witnesses its powers becomes unable to perceive the normal flow of days ever again.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If you were to look into the hole in POKENAME's neck, you would be subjected to horrific, never-ending nightmares. It is believed that the souls of those who fall victim to this will never be able to rest.
author: shikuren

entry: A fusion of revolutionary technologies and overwhelming spiritual power, POKENAME has been augmented to the point of nigh-invulnerability. There are rumors that POKENAME was designed to be a superweapon but was abandoned due to its weakness to heat.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME floats through wastelands, sapping energy from everything around it to fuel itself. Its body is completely hollow and full of electricity.
author: hummusishome

entry: POKENAME moves swiftly, kicks hard and releases spores from its hollow insides. Some superstitious researchers believe that each spore can steal your soul if you look at them for too long in the microscope.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME have failed to fully pull free of their chrysalises as they become adults. The animated spirits that would normally produce a Shedinja instead bond with POKENAME, trapping it in increasing layers of failed sheds.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though its wings never move, POKENAME can soar faster than sound. A single collision could shatter its hollow shell completely.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appears to be incapable of vocalization, but it shows considerable kindness by channeling the power of the moon into its allies.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon guides lost travelers during the night, by the light of the moon.
author: naga_sake

entry: On lunar eclipses, groups of POKENAME will assemble in a circle while waving their wands towards the sky, as if performing a ritual of some sort.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME hovers above lamp posts, its hollow body mimicking the lights below. It watches from above, unmoving, its long arms dangling lifelessly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hangs from decaying trees, spreading its poisonous scales along the wind. If anyone gets too close, it will wrap them in its vines before blasting them with a gust of its scales.
author: mistymagius

entry: Neither head takes the lead, allowing them to move with perfect synchronization. Those who look upon POKENAME feel as though they grieve the loss of a beloved partner they never met.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME is a rare form of Nincada which died in the middle of removing its shell. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.
author: schwaus

entry: The mysterious POKENAME seems to appear wherever strife and hardship are prevalent. It is believed that it seeks out sources of suffering with the intention of fighting, regardless of the cause.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME is one of the most spirited of Shedinja fusions, moving around quickly and almost frantically. It clings to others and drains their vitality with a touch, leaving them listless while keeping its own energy high.
author: sk372

entry: The flame on its tail is rumored to be the last embers of the hollow body's soul. Superstitions say dousing the flame will cause it to suck out the soul of the perpetrator to replenish the fire anew.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hovers across the land silently, brushing its feelers against other creatures. Others get a chill from the touch, and many believe prolonged contact will lead to one's soul being stolen.
author: sk372

entry: Holes dot POKENAME's copper-plated shell. Legends warn that staring into one too long allows it to drain your life essence silently and without a trace.
author: .izik

entry: It is best not to follow a POKENAME as it often lures Trainers into the dens of strong Dragon Pokémon. It molts its scales frequently, and they are often sought after by prolific Dragon Trainers.
author: mistymagius

entry: No matter how much POKENAME searches, it never finds the perfect match for the gem it has lost. Its claws erode as it digs desperately.
author: paisleylxl

entry: It glides along the ground silently to approach its prey, only standing itself up in order to fall upon an incapacitated target. Anything that enters the inky void under its body is never seen again.
author: craigprime

entry: Many Trainers claim to feel eyes staring out from the inky abyss of POKENAME's hollowed out body. However, upon closer examination there is nothing inside. No one alive knows how it moves or walks.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME were said to be born from lost dolls as they desperately search for the children that lost them. However, they do not want revenge, they just want to be reunited with their owners.
author: mistymagius

entry: Groups of POKENAME often roam shipwrecks, challenging all who dare to approach. Its grey algae, able to sense the slightest vibrations in the water, serves as both a warning system and a guide through the depths.
author: matpal6

entry: Nobody has ever seen what is within POKENAME's shelter. Those who attempt to pry or break it open get pulled in, never to be seen again.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The shell that contains POKENAME's spirit is made up of discarded burlap, cloth, and straw from ranches. Since the ranch no longer has a use for it, POKENAME wanders aimlessly through the desert in search of a new home.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME's sonorous song is an eerie and discordant tune. According to legend, those that hear it will soon meet a swift demise.
author: mepp.

entry: Legend says POKENAME was once a guide who used songs to send spirits off to the afterlife. Now, it feeds off the souls of those who hear its song.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: All POKENAME's gems have been mined away, leaving only a hollow body. The gem that crowned its head now forever hovers in pieces, frozen in the moment of extraction.
author: wormspawn

entry: Dismissed as a hollow husk, POKENAME becomes active when it senses no humans around. It twirls its staff, bathed in ghostly psychic light, attracting Bug types. While they are mesmerized it strikes, using its armor-penetrating proboscis to feast.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME moves in sudden and unexpected motions, contorting its body in ways that would be impossible if it had bones and flesh. The shuriken floating above it defends POKENAME without any visible physical guidance from it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A vicious superstition follows POKENAME, leading to it being heavily hunted in the wild. According to the stories, those that gaze too long at it will lose the ability to love or be loved.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats in place, purring softly with an eerie, rhythmic tone. It never blinks, never breathes, only stares with its body disturbingly still.
author: .izik
