entry: POKENAME have photosynthetic cells laced throughout their skin that enable them to gain energy directly from the sun. They use this energy to fuel lightning fast kicks, maintaining a speed that is hard to match by their opponents.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When it is close to evolving, POKENAME's cocoon-like body begins cracking as a giant flower starts to bloom from the new hole. However, this is when POKENAME is most vulnerable to life-threatening injuries.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The gases it expels have become tropical scented, but still remain pungent. People describe the aroma as being like rotten pineapples and papayas.
author: xephyr

entry: POKENAME gather soil in the crags and crevices between their armour plates. The plants that grow in amongst these crags are tended to by POKENAME. They take their time finding both sun and rain to keep them healthy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When its plants are in full bloom, POKENAME's vines coil up and turn a bright green. It can unleash powerful whips with them and they even grow back with just an hour of sunlight.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME live in tropical estuaries, their brightly coloured fins helping them blend in with leaves and petals floating at the surface of the river. They are aggressive when disturbed, shooting concentrated streams of water at their aggressor.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite seeking only other POKENAME, it avoids humans and all other Pokémon entirely. It sprays an ultra-dense cloud of pollen to defend itself.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME spends the day gathering energy from the sun and hunts at night. It prefers to hide amongst thick foliage, waiting patiently for the perfect moment to strike.
author: mepp.

entry: Its entire dress is a single petal from the flower crown on its head. It talks to plants, giving them commands.
author: houndrys.

entry: The rich nutrients possessed within POKENAME's body makes it the perfect snack for Pidgeotto. When flopping around on land, it can sometimes defend itself with a powerful Solar Beam.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A POKENAME's flower contains highly toxic poison. Every drastic motion that a POKENAME makes causes poison to spill out, as they often have trouble holding up the large flower on their own.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: A Pokémon typically found in tropical regions, POKENAME is known as the herald of the monsoon season. They are normally sighted ahead of or during torrential downpours and floods, and as a result, they have a reputation for violence and destruction.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon typically found in tropical regions, POKENAME is known as the herald of the monsoon season. They are normally sighted ahead of or during torrential downpours and floods, and as a result, they have a reputation for violence and destruction.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: If you see many flower petals floating on water, it may actually be a POKENAME that has just submerged.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME was utilized in early 3D games to propagate grass textures. Unfortunately, an error in its coding made it spread viruses too.
author: rkmaster25367

entry: The flower on POKENAME's back took a tremendous amount of energy to bloom. It has to constantly use Harden to make up for its fragility.
author: porpoisemerchant

entry: Fossil records show that POKENAME were apex predators when they were alive, expertly hunting through the lush rainforest where it lives. Its thick tail allows it to swing from trees to increase its speed.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is incredibly rare, as it lives deep in the jungle. Trees are leveled when it flaps its massive leafy wings.
author: mepp.

entry: The flowers along POKENAME's leafy wings are always in full bloom, scattering pollen and seeds across wherever it flies. The area around its nest is said to be one of the lushest and most exotic forests ever known.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite POKENAME's glyph-like appearance, it isn't related to Unown. It behaves irrationally and likes round shapes.
author: valtsuri

entry: POKENAME resembles a mathematical constant. It behaves irrationally and likes round shapes.
author: valtsuri

entry: POKENAME resembles a mathematical constant. It behaves irrationally and likes round shapes.
author: valtsuri

entry: A diurnal Pokémon that defeats encroachers by wrapping them with vines or making them unconscious with spores before skewering them with their stinger. It seems POKENAME's main priority is reproducing.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME produce highly flammable pollen from the plants growing along their body. Their body temperatures are high enough that they will sometimes inadvertently cause the pollen to spontaneously combust.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME make their homes around the fertile soil at the base of volcanoes. They make use of the nutrients in the soil to grow a vivid petal crown to display to one another.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is unknown why the blazing fire on POKENAME's backs never ignites the leaves on their heads. It's long been wondered if POKENAME's genetics could hold the key to developing more fire-resistant crops.
author: houseoffallingflowers

entry: POKENAME have a coating of bark across their stomach to help protect them when they dig underground. When they sleep they do so with their head resting outside of their burrows, letting their petals drape around them and absorb sunlight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Even in the depths of winter, the plants surrounding the nape of POKENAME are able to keep growing thanks to their high internal body temperature. They flash their petals to signal at one another and resolve territorial disputes without fighting.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Even in the depths of winter, the plants surrounding the nape of POKENAME are able to keep growing thanks to their high internal body temperature. The colouration of the fronds they grow is a good indicator of the Pokémon's health.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME emit a constant cloud of nearly invisible pollen from their backs. When they are preparing to fight, they light a small spark from their fur that ignites this pollen cloud and creates an intimidating, fiery display.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME emit a constant cloud of nearly invisible pollen from their backs. When they are preparing to fight, they light a small spark from their fur that ignites this pollen cloud and creates an intimidating, fiery display.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME carry a large flower on its back that passively releases spores around them. They peck at the ground to find poisonous roots to eat, which in turn make its spores poisonous.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It clings to tree trunks and branches for hours on end, lying in wait. When insect Pokémon come to drink from the flower on its back, it pounces.
author: calelian

entry: Few get the chance to see a POKENAME in the wild when this nocturnal Pokémon glides through moonlit forests in the deep of night. With its wings trailing tiny buds and pollens, plants bloom and nighttime prey vanishes wherever its shadow passes.
author: silentscript89

entry: When at rest, POKENAME can be easily mistaken for Venusaur. They use this similarity to safely hide from Pokémon that wouldn't attack the large Grass-Type but would be dangerous to them, the deception only being revealed when they take off.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME relies on its tail leaves to perform complex aerial maneuvers. It can quickly dive to snatch a Caterpie or Weedle before bringing the bug Pokémon back to its nest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It gathers sunlight as as floats on the surface of ponds, converting it into electricity. It releases Stun Spores from its antennae before attacking.
author: ariamelisma

entry: The pollen that comes from the flowers sprouting out of POKENAME is both hydrophobic and luminescent. POKENAME leave a glowing trail in their wake as they swim thanks to this pollen, creating the illusion that they are swimming through a night sky.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live in low visibility rivers that are thick with mud and silt. Their flowers typically trail at the surface to absorb sunlight, but they can react with water to create a potent electrical charge.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME sprouts bulbs around nests to protect the baby chicks inside. On rare occasions, it uproots the nest and wraps it around its back with vines to find a safer location to nest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: No matter how many flower petals POKENAME scatter while they dance, they will grow back almost instantly. POKENAME dance slowly and elegantly, soothed by the fragrance of their flower petals and allowing the wind to guide them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon for stage performances as their vividly coloured flowers and long draping leaves make very eye catching. It takes a lot of coaching for them to perform for larger crowds as they tend to freeze up with too much attention.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME steals seeds from flowerbeds and hides them in its mouth. It propagates its own seeds instead, which produce a flower that has musky and earthy scents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The crown-like flower blooming atop POKENAME is purely coincidental, as the shape helps prevent the oversized plant unbalancing POKENAME. Despite this, it was a custom for a POKENAME to be present at a coronation.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME slap each other with mud whenever they are trying to impress the opposite gender. They are predisposed to choosing mates that have tough bodies, so their mud-flinging tendencies help them find mates with similar levels of resilience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Plenty of moonlight creates bigger and more vibrant flowers for this species. The scent changes as the moon waxes and wanes.
author: deelee2020

entry: POKENAME live among wild Pokémon even though they have vast knowledge of the world around them. Whenever scientists come close to capturing POKENAME, they produce clouds of pollen that lull their pursuers to sleep and allow them to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have vast knowledge that makes them some of the smartest Pokémon to exist. Despite their encyclopedic wisdom, they prefer to live among wild creatures and lead simple lives.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its flower has grown a lot sooner than expected. The weight of the flower crushes it, as it is not strong enough to carry it yet.
author: soup1900

entry: The bulb on the back of POKENAME releases a foul stench that wards off other Pokémon. It gorges itself on leftover snacks that it can find in garbage bins.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon is often seen resting on the sides of trees or brick walls. To remove these Pokémon from their spots, it is recommended to use a crowbar.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon amongst some Pokémon Contest trainers, often dressed up in all sorts of unique outfits. They are patient with their trainers during this, happy for the attention.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME constantly struggles to keep its feathers clean because of the flower on its back. It sprouts vines to help itself scrub away at the spores, but this only causes more spores to fall from the flower.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fluff up their petals and leaves to make themselves look larger and more intimidating than they are. They are good at scaring off smaller Pokémon, but they struggle to convince larger Pokémon that they're a real threat.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME fluff up their petals and leaves to make themselves look larger and more intimidating than they are. POKENAME with less developed petals end up being more aggressive as compensation for their less threatening appearance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live on tropical islands that have high levels of volcanic activity. They travel out onto cooling lava flows, a special enzyme from their bodies dissolving the basalt and letting them absorb the rich nutrients to fuel their flower's growth.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Once believed to have existed only in prehistory, POKENAME dominate the marshlands in swathes. Urban legend warns that inhaling the spore-thick air around one will leave you permanently mute.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME slowly shuffle through leaf litter in search of fungi, using their acute sense of smell to do so. They are so slow moving that plants take root in their back, sprouting into full flowers and helping them stay safe through camouflage.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME keep themselves warm during the colder months by growing a dense coating of leaves from the symbiotic flower growing on their back. These leaves provide a food source in the summer months, but have a habit of obstructing their vision.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are able to leave the water for prolonged periods of time, their symbiotic plants letting them breathe despite being in the air. They'll use this ability to escape larger Pokémon, pulling themselves into bushes to hide until they feel safe.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are able to leave the water for prolonged periods of time, their symbiotic plants letting them breathe despite being in the air. They'll use this ability to escape larger Pokémon, pulling themselves into bushes to hide until they feel safe.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its leaves are covered with a waxy substance, giving them a shiny appearance. Groups of POKENAME form flocks led by those with the shiniest wings.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME naturally blend into the surrounding forest and can lie in wait for hours at a time. When an unsuspecting Pokémon comes near, a flurry of pollen lulls prey to sleep before POKENAME chomp down on their new meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will find a bush to sleep in and are well disguised by their flowers and leaves when resting. When awake, they have a habit of using their incredible strength to topple trees to get to the fruit that would otherwise be out of their reach.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are expressive yet gentle creatures that can communicate with people through trumpeting and rumbling. Whenever they are upset, they shake the flower atop their backs to release a sticky pollen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are benevolent creatures that help wild Pokémon heal from wounds with delicate care. Their pollen acts like an antiseptic while their vines wrap around wounds to prevent infections.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The pollen is a powerful irritant and can cause paralytic, soporific, or even poisonous effects when inhaled.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME camouflages itself as a plant with the leaves on its back. Whenever it ambushes its prey, a venomous sac opens and releases a toxic pollen from underneath its hood.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME produces a very delicate milk from the center of the flower growing on its abdomen; being a plant-based, lactose-free product, it can be consumed by everyone. If the petals on its belly wilt, this Pokémon can no longer produce milk.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Adventurous trainers are advised to take care when traversing jungles that are home to POKENAME. Their colouration and flowers make them blend in to the undergrowth and it is easy to accidentally step on one, which will always cause them to strike.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME usually keep their petals flush to their neck to make it easier for them to slither around. When they want to scare off a rival they will flash their petals into a full flower, making themselves abruptly look larger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Adventurous trainers are advised to take care when traversing jungles that are home to POKENAME. Their colouration and flowers make them blend in to the undergrowth and it is easy to accidentally step on one, which will always cause them to strike.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: During the autumn months, small berries sprout from POKENAME's back. Picking them causes a mild electric shock, but the berries are sweet and commonly used as oatmeal toppings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be seen drifting through forests, meadows and gardens at sundown. It sings strange, melancholy songs that some believe make plants grow.
author: occulusmalus

entry: During battle, POKENAME causes vines to erupt from the ground, which ensnares its foes. Afterwards, it releases a shock through the vines, which electrocutes its opponent until they surrender.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is known to defend forests and caves that it claims. It can sneak up on trespassers by digging in the ground to disguise as a mossy rock.
author: homelessrager

entry: POKENAME are more skilled at fighting than regular Sandshrew, as they are unable to curl up because of their flower. This forces them to engage in fights more often.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME have developed stronger muscles in order to better navigate on the ground. They lure prey in with the flowers on their tails before striking.
author: raza

entry: POKENAME have symbiotic algae living in their skin ensuring that they have a source of food even in the winter. During the summer, they produce an impressive leafy facial display along with growing gigantic flowers on their back.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have symbiotic algae living in their skin ensuring that they have a source of food even in the winter. They grow a fine shaggy coat of moss in the winter, and some grow thick woody tusks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME grapple onto trees high above the ground to maximize the amount of sunlight they receive. The flower on their back scatters pollen into the breeze to discourage Flying-type Pokémon from attacking.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Spotting a POKENAME in the desert is a good sign for weary travelers: since it needs plenty of fresh water to nourish its large flower, it makes its home close to oases where water would be plentiful.
author: sk372

entry: The nutrients in the mud POKENAME plays in have enlarged its cheek flowers. Because of this, its hind legs have stiffened further to support its head.
author: shocktopus

entry: POKENAME spend most of their lives submerged in deep mud, waiting for unsuspecting Pokémon to draw too close. The symbiotic plants on their backs allow them to photosynthesize when no food is available.
author: kingd8

entry: POKENAME takes great pride in the flower on its back. The more vibrant the flower is, the healthier the POKENAME. It spends a great amount of time lounging in the sun to help the flower grow.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME are a common companion for Beauties intent on winning Pokémon talent contests. They have an innate sense of timing that makes them excellent performers, their petals and leaves flaring out as they pirouette across the stage.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's psychic powers let it manipulate the plant-life around it, growing flowery vines from the ground to protect itself and others. Its large flower can generate a thick protective barrier of pollen and flower petals as well.
author: sk372

entry: This variant of POKENAME lacks the typical enormous flower atop its head, hampering its photosynthesizing capabilities. It needs to spend a larger amount of time basking in sunlight to keep itself energized.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a love of gardening and will spend hours working alongside their trainer to cultivate beautiful fields of flowers. Their empathic powers enable them to sense when a given flower needs extra care and attention.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have an empathic link to flowering plants and are drawn to areas that are in full bloom. They use their powers to aid them in battle, wielding whirls of petal blossoms as dangerous attacks.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are extremely close to their colony and rely on each other for protection. Their preferred food is seeds, which they reach by using hidden vine-like organs or powerful leaps to pluck fruit and eat the seeds within.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It camouflages itself in vines to remain hidden in jungle environments, where it waits patiently. Unsuspecting prey is torn apart by its four clawed limbs.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME are very adept and proficient hunters in lush environments. The vegetation growing on this Pokémon's back allows it to camouflage among greenery and surprise their prey.
author: ackshewally

entry: POKENAME are Pokémon that have gathered enough energy from sunlight to trigger a partial evolution, most commonly encountered during the winter due to the weaker sunlight. They maintain the confidence and posture of a fully evolved Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. The tree on its back is now fully rooted in POKENAME's nervous system.
author: zoroark73

entry: Despite the sweet smell the flower on POKENAME's back gives off, its sap is actually poisonous. It spends its days walking around to find whichever spot has the most sunlight for its flower to absorb.
author: _._starry_._

entry: Although POKENAME are usually carnivores, they can be seen snacking on berries every so often. Their sharp teeth can chomp through the toughest of skins.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has a flower on its back that is in full bloom. It releases calming pollen to subdue threatening Pokémon, which ensures its nest is left unbothered.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many POKENAME alive today were first born in the time of fossil Pokémon. They guard their hidden caves with extreme power.
author: veteranadventurer

entry: POKENAME patrol jungle ruins to protect the treasure inside. They often encounter children who want to explore the dangerous ruins, so they are tasked with escorting children back home.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This bad-tempered Pokémon rests near islands, and will evaporate those who enter its territory with massive beams of solar energy. This makes it a vicious and inconvenient roadblock to sailors and pilots alike looking for somewhere to land.
author: ecstaticwoop6455

entry: POKENAME blend in nearly perfectly with jungle foliage, making them extremely difficult to find in the wild. If a trainer succeeds in capturing one they will find that they make for exceptionally amiable companions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can become hyperactive after spending long enough in the sun, rushing with a surprising speed through the forest. They are not mindful of their bulk when doing so and often leave a trail of smashed branches and bushes in their wake.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In tropical regions, POKENAME carry giant, vibrant flowers that draw a variety of Bug-Type Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. On small islands they have very low floral diversity, often carrying just a single flowering cycad.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In dense jungles they carry a variety of shrubs and bushes that make them especially hard to find.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In temperate regions they carry a variety of flowers protected by trees and are important for pollinators.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In some rural settlements they are trained and kept as a reliable source of fruit for the community.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In warmer regions they will host flowering trees, searching for well lit areas to help them grow.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's ultimate move is absorbing enough sunlight through its blade to release and smite its opponent with the power of the sun.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This legendary scepter, said to have belonged to a wizard, can command plants and with enough absorbed sunlight, release a blast of solar energy.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It has begun to take control of the metal that makes up its body, moving it just like its vines. POKENAME's knife-like claws grow as if they're a natural part of its body.
author: ocxin

entry: Found in the most overgrown parts of abandoned buildings, POKENAME blend their plant mass and metallic parts seamlessly. They surround themselves with subordinates to effectively scavenge through their territories.
author: ocxin

entry: By shaking its leafy mane, POKENAME releases a fragrant pollen used to mark its territory. If crackling sparks start to burst from its body, it means it's in a foul mood and could attack at any moment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: By shaking its leafy mane, POKENAME releases a fragrant pollen used to mark its territory. If crackling sparks start to burst from its body, it means it's in a foul mood and could attack at any moment.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The huge flower on its back emits a soothing aroma when it absorbs sunlight. It has a rigid body and can shatter huge boulders with ease using its iron horns.
author: hamperius

entry: The flower on its tail emits a sweet smell that is used to draw in its prey. It then causes vines to erupt from the ground, entangling its chosen meal.
author: flickeredflame

entry: POKENAME release large clouds of spores from their flowers to hide their presence. Inhaling a POKENAME's spores will cause hallucinations and nausea, giving POKENAME the perfect chance to strike.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The floral parasol of POKENAME acts both as a source of nutrients when conducting photosynthesis and as a way to gather water during rain.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME is incredibly strong, able to pulverize a boulder in one hit. It is frequently tasked with clearing out thick, overgrown areas for construction projects.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME can feel every organism and motion in its forest. It does so by feeling the vibrations of the roots within the wilderness.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME flies above the clouds, gathering sunlight with the flower on its head. If it is forced to descend from the skies, it devastates opposition with an intense Solar Beam.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits large amounts of pollen from its tail that allow plants to flourish. Areas where POKENAME reside are blanketed in gorgeous flora.
author: mistymagius

entry: Inhabitants of forest clearings, POKENAME stands in the middle of a giant flower, releasing pheromones to attract Bug types. When one steps onto the petals, the flower snaps shut, providing the Pokémon with a meal.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME grow so many plants that not even they are fully aware of all the possible combinations they can make with their spores. They release spores with every blow, testing out their concoctions on their opponents.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME whir their petals rapidly to enable them to fly. The vines growing from their body act in a similar way to sensory hairs, alerting them to nearby obstacles to be avoided.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The being seen inside the outer layer of a POKENAME is not independent of the jelly-like substance that coats it. The crown atop its head is actually a catalyst for the being to be mind-controlled by the potent substance that coats it.
author: chaos_emblemx

entry: POKENAME has a special flower that only blooms on the night of the full moon. The spores that are released cause Pokémon to fall asleep. This allows it to join together with other POKENAME to dance under the moonlight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are crafty Pokémon that hate humans and often attack them. Most people think POKENAME are evil, but they just want to protect nature.
author: zakafraka

entry: POKENAME weaves traps made of vines and electrified webbing to ward against potential threats. Its lair is characterized by arcing thunder and an eerie silence.
author: evilgammon

entry: As it warms itself and absorbs sunlight, its flame releases a pleasant fragrance. The fragrance becalms those engaged in battle.
author: apixelperfectionist

entry: POKENAME is a shy Pokémon that relies on sunlight to keep its flower alive. When night falls, it becomes dormant, sustaining its flower with the dim light from its flame.
author: imaginaryneon

entry: POKENAME blends in with foliage to lure in prey with the sweet scent of its bouquet. If another Pokémon lands on one of its flowers, POKENAME will ignite a series of flames to drain away their soul.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME guards overgrown ruins. Its mighty stature strike fear into the hearts of all who dare to trespass in its domain.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME flies high into the sky to better absorb the sun's rays. On days where the sunlight isn't as strong, it feeds on bird Pokémon instead.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's leafy wings absorb and store vast amounts of sunlight. It flies deep into the darkest parts of the rain-forests to cascade the stored light across plants that need it, helping keep the plant-life healthy and verdant.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the sun-enriched vines from its tail to spark wildfires in dying forests, scattering fresh seeds among the ashes. It is worshipped as a spirit of rebirth in some tropical regions.
author: brainiax

entry: POKENAME have bodies that play host to a large variety of parasitic flowering plants. They are constantly forced to seek out tubers and plant roots to provide their bodies with enough nutrition to grow.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The flower on the back of POKENAME grows extremely quickly and requires very little water. When there is rain in the desert, POKENAME colonies bloom and fill the desert with colour.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME travel great distances through the desert in search of oases to drink from. When they find one, they will stay nearby for as long as it remains full of water, sunning their petal-like wings to regain energy for their next flight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: After years of searching, POKENAME have given up on finding their treasure. They are prized for their beautiful tails and are often captured to be displayed in fancy homes and restaurants.
author: smashbear

entry: The flower on its back has grown extra large to soak up all the sunlight. This consequently causes it to shadow over other plants, blocking the sunlight for them.
author: soup1900

entry: Fusion energy has mutated POKENAME's cell growth, causing it to gain many veins where the energy seeps through. No matter how much rain or sunshine it gathers, the flower on its back will always smell oddly synthetic.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has a proud expression. Pokémon fusion has enlarged its fatty tissue, making it more froglike.
author: lupa

entry: The flower on its back has grown extra large to soak up all the sunlight. This consequently causes it to shadow over other plants, blocking the sunlight for them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME erupts numerous amounts of pollen from its flower. Breathing in this pollen causes severe choking and large rashes all over one's body.
author: soup1900

entry: If overexcited, the plant on the end of its tail will combust. It is best to let this fire rage, as POKENAME will sulk if forbidden from burning.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME often scavenge for food rather than hunt because their vines and pollen are not enough to take down other Pokémon. This is especially true for wild POKENAME who live in jungle environments, since they are surrounded by Bug-type Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many POKENAME live upwards of thirty years. They siphon nectar and pollinate flowers from the same patches of land every year. They become incredibly confused if their favorite flower patches are torn up for construction projects.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When fully evolved the flower on a POKENAME's back reaches the size of a large dinner plate. A POKENAME's flower also produces a pollen that elicits an allergic reaction in all people.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME wields its large flower like a shield both from attacks and direct sunlight, the latter of which overpowers its sensitive eyes. It burrows into trees to hide from predators, blocking the entrance with the flower.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The more meat it consumes, the more succulent its flower becomes. The rotten scent of its many intense battles mixes with the sweet aroma of its bloom.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME lumbers around the deepest parts of lush forests. It uproots trees with ease thanks to its powerful jaws, clearing out open spots for it to lay down and nap while absorbing copious amounts of sunlight to sustain itself.
author: sk372

entry: If a human dares to embrace POKENAME, it will plant a cursed bulb upon their back. With every selfish thought, the bulb will grow, and when it blossoms, a writhing thicket will erupt from where its host once stood.
author: seaslux

entry: POKENAME have stout little legs that carry the massive flower on their heads. They entice Bug-type Pokémon to pollinate their flower by releasing a sweet aroma from their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's flower comes in a variety of vibrant colors, though it is most often either red or yellow. Its heavy legs mean it dances slower than its previous evolutions.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME lives in dense, tropical forests, where its unwithering blooms go unnoticed. Beware its deadly pollen.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME drool out a thick sap that is incorporated into vitamins to keep people healthy. Bug-type Pokémon are drawn in by the flower on their heads and stay to lick up the sap.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its wings, which are made from a fungus-like material, to fly at high speeds. It uses the spores it spreads in a form of echolocation.
author: canada

entry: This Pokémon takes delicate care of the flower on its back. Despite the foul stench, a POKENAME trusting someone enough to let them smell the flower is said to bring great fortune their way.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: Despite its fearsome appearance, POKENAME has a calm disposition. It spends 18 hours a day asleep in the sun and allows small Pokémon to nap within its leaves.
author: shreks_stepfather

entry: POKENAME shields its body with massive flower petals. It fancies itself king of the swamp, and demands tribute from other Pokémon.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME connect their vines with root systems to steal nutrients from other plants. To protect themselves while rooted, the giant flower on their back releases spores that put other Pokémon to sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its flowers, which emit a sweet scent, to attract prey. After it has finished draining its prey, POKENAME uses the remaining bones to fertilize its flowers.
author: mistycloud

entry: It roams the jungles with the rest of its pack to ensure that no poachers are causing trouble in the territory it protects. Its flowers release a fragrant trail that allows other POKENAME to locate it even from several kilometers away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: According to certain beliefs, if howls are heard at midnight in the woods, it is POKENAME leaving its den to chase down humans who have defiled the forest it inhabits. The large flower growing on its back constantly gathers vast amounts of energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME flies through the air at night, the flower on its back releases colorful spores that bloom vibrant plant-life. The resulting plants that grow have fragrant scents that put those that smell them into a deep and pleasant sleep.
author: sk372

entry: Though at first glance they appear healthy, POKENAME carry an aggressive fungus that parasitises their flowers. The fungus leeches the nutrients that would otherwise go to the Pokémon, forcing them to eat more than usual to make up the shortfall.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's claws are incredibly dangerous, sharp enough to cleave even solid rock in two. Before battling, it makes the petals sprouting from its palm-wood armor tremble, releasing an aroma capable of intimidating weaker Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When a POKENAME chooses to live far from the beach, it stops covering its body with palm bark to move more freely within the jungle. It faces its foes with great tenacity, making skilled use of its razor-sharp claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Long ago, it migrated deep underground and endured pressures so intense that it fused with a protective coating of rock. When it returned to the surface, it could grow larger than before.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME love to soak up the sun's rays by napping in the light. When they are startled, they create a cloud of toxic spores hoping to discourage others from bothering them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Found nurturing wild lettuce, POKENAME focuses its psychic powers through a branch, keeping pests away. The plants flourish under its care, and it drives away any interlopers with its mystic powers.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Though friendly, POKENAME are unaware of the amount of pollen released as they flutter their wings. Their pollen can cause intense allergic reactions.
author: thekrt

entry: Wild POKENAME tend to be rambunctious, floating around and slamming into objects in an attempt to play. Once trained, however, they become fiercely loyal to the end.
author: robbery_666

entry: Wild POKENAME spend most of their time asleep in sunlit glades. Be careful not to wake one, or it will start a forest fire with its temper tantrum.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME keeps most of its plantlike body hidden beneath the soil. As it ages, its roots spread vast distances underground.
author: .izik

entry: No two wing-patterns on POKENAME are the same and their stunning looks are famous worldwide. Many Pokémon breeders hold events to judge POKENAME with the most beautiful wings.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are easily mistaken for cycads when they're at rest as only their flower is constantly above ground. It becomes far clearer that they're actually Pokémon once the presumed flower begins moving around through the dirt.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When POKENAME want to get an idea of where to find water, they will poke their heads out of the ground and unfold the leaves they usually keep safe. Their leaves are sensitive to moisture in the air, letting them figure out where to get a drink.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME wraps its rootlike legs around palm tree roots while resting underground. This allows it to siphon nutrients without surfacing.
author: .izik

entry: Capable of releasing focused blasts of sunlight from the coin on its head, POKENAME clears overgrown underbrush and dead trees, ensuring the forests where its children grow up are safe.
author: alextheperson

entry: POKENAME communicates telepathically with plants through the flower on its head. It spends a lot of time recovering from headaches because it is flooded with messages from vegetation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME telepathically transfers their thoughts to plants through the flower on its back. It spends lots of time recovering from migraines because it is flooded with messages from plants around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME carry a large drum with them that they play with their webbed hands while swimming. When they meet other musical Pokémon, they work together with others to come up with a cool beat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses the vines hanging from its body to move even more swiftly among the forest trees where it lives. It has a very irritable temperament, which leads it to pick fights with anyone who crosses its path.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME gets excited, it wags the flower on its rear, inadvertently releasing clouds of pollen. The flower changes color with POKENAME's diet, so this Pokémon is often entered in competitions judging their unique fur and flower combinations.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is fiercely loyal and guards various Pokémon herds in tropical climates. When it wants to take a nap, it influences nearby plants to grow into a particularly comfortable bed, where it curls up and reenergizes its flower.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is fiercely loyal and guards various Pokémon herds in tropical climates. When it wants to take a nap, it influences nearby plants to grow into a particularly comfortable bed, where it curls up and reenergizes its flower.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is fiercely loyal and guards various Pokémon herds in tropical climates. When it wants to take a nap, it influences nearby plants to grow into a particularly comfortable bed, where it curls up and reenergizes its flower.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Most often seen hibernating, its lethargic movement belies its short fuse. Its destructive power when angered could set a whole rainforest ablaze.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME uses its teleport ability to bask in the sunniest spots away from danger. It often mistakes admirers of its flower for potential foes.
author: redlilycat

entry: It is said POKENAME travels to farms across its homeland, using its immense psychic energy to make crops grow and flowers blossom.
author: cipher

entry: POKENAME typically migrate to tropical areas, where they can easily absorb solar energy. Despite their immense strength, POKENAME tend to be more easygoing and enjoy leisurely activities alongside humans.
author: wickedwiccan

entry: POKENAME cling to trees with their roots to leech nutrients from their host. They release pollen that makes others drowsy to prevent other Pokémon from ripping apart their roots.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It lays in ponds to filter out toxins from the water. It drinks the liquid through its skin then sprays the clean water from the flower on its back.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are fierce defenders of jungle forests and attack anyone who tries to damage the environment. A flurry of leaves and rocks act as a deterrent for loggers who want to chop down trees.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are hostile creatures that defend their jungle territory with fervor. They often attack loggers who try to chop down trees by tossing mud and whipping them with thick vines.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are devoted jungle guardians and cover themselves with vines and moss to keep a part of their home with them. They cause violent tremors whenever they sense harm to the jungle and roll to wherever the damage happened.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME roll through the jungle to ensure that the trees within their territory remain safe. Lumberjacks who try to chop down a tree are locked in place with thick vines as the ground beneath them quakes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it sprints across the prairie at full speed, it scatters pollen from the large flower on its back, making the land it passes over exceptionally fertile. If angered, its hooves can grow red-hot, scorching anyone foolish enough to approach.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's long, leafy tail tastes better the longer the Pokémon has lived. It sunbathes in tropical areas to promote photosynthesis.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are stalwart and cunning, holding a tree stalk in their wings. POKENAME are protective of their Trainer and other Pokémon they care about, and more than willing to jump in harm's way.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lounge on tropical beaches, raising their tails high in the air to catch as much sunlight as possible. They are cumbersome on land but graceful in the water, their fronds billowing behind them as they swim.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be found lounging on tropical beaches, enjoying the sunlight and warmth to be found there. They are clumsy whilst moving on land but can use their petals as fins to dart gracefully through the water when they return to it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be found lounging on tropical beaches, enjoying the sunlight and warmth to be found there. They are clumsy whilst moving on land but can use their petals as fins to dart gracefully through the water when they return to it.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's bodies are made entirely of incredibly rich compost. They emit such a rancid scent that only the most dedicated farmers employ their help.
author: bradlybro199

entry: Its flora grows healthier and stronger during the rain. When the sun comes back up, it fires powerful Solar Beams that tear through thick steel.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon is commonly found in the jungle. It is known to be extremely aggressive towards travelers.
author: rolypolyrex123_46446

entry: Using its flower pendulum, POKENAME can cultivate seeds in even the most depleted soil. It is revered among Grass-type Pokémon for its regal strength.
author: noel5229

entry: This Pokémon's coastal ancestors migrated inland through tropical rivers. They extend their pungent pincers above the water's surface to lure hungry Bug-type Pokémon close before suddenly dragging the distracted prey under.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME can shoot highly accurate and powerful Solar Beams, reaching targets over 300 yards away. It stores sun energy inside its shell, enough to unleash up to 30 Solar Beams.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME develop metallic sheaths that protect their vines from harm whilst they are retracted within their shells. They can extend their vines and control their movement as will, using them to attack from a safe distance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME develop metallic sheaths that protect their vines from harm whilst they are retracted within their shells. They can extend their vines and control their movement as will, using them to attack from a safe distance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are energetic and sprightly, springing around during a fight and refusing to back down. While POKENAME prefer fair fights, if an opponent tries to strike at their bulbs, they will suddenly flare up their quills and spray out poison.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's diet consists almost exclusively of leaves from various poisonous plants. That very poison makes it unpalatable to most bird Pokémon.
author: _._starry_._

entry: The fluid in each of POKENAME's heads is extremely toxic. Should any spill out, it is unwise to touch it with bare skin, as it can cause dizziness and vomiting, making it a hazardous creature to approach.
author: .izik

entry: The saliva on POKENAME's long tongue is incredibly potent and acidic. The acidity is so strong that it can dissolve metal, making its tongue a terrifying weapon in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in herds, each taking turns to look after their young while the others go hunting. If one of them is attacked, they will produce a strongly scented chemical that alerts the rest of the herd.
author: mistymagius

entry: As it is unable to lay eggs, POKENAME often steals them from other Pokémon. If the egg in its pouch breaks or hatches, POKENAME will stop at nothing to find another one.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: POKENAME's motherly instincts cause it to take care of young Poison-type Pokémon nearby. During storms, it will usher them into its den for safety, ensuring that they remain protected until the storm passes.
author: .izik

entry: When defending its kin, a thick blue toxin coats POKENAME's blades. This venomous coating allows it to deal more damage, deterring any predators or threats that come too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's ear-like pincers are extremely sharp and can fell a pine tree in a single cut. It will do this to drink the sap inside, using its impressive strength to gather sustenance.
author: .izik

entry: It prefers to eat green vines and moss. However, if it spots an Oran Berry, it will dash for it with a ravenous look in its eyes.
author: .izik

entry: The viscous slime coating POKENAME's body has the ability to imitate any poison it encounters, mimicking the effects with unsettling accuracy. This adaptability makes it a formidable opponent in battle.
author: .izik

entry: Upon evolving, the spines on its body became sharper and tougher, giving POKENAME greater confidence in battle. It loves to rest beneath Figy Berry trees, since those are its favorite fruits.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is recommended that owners of POKENAME avoid breathing the toxic gases that emit from the fire on its back. It is very timid and docile, and prefers hiding from strangers.
author: _._starry_._

entry: POKENAME boils the toxic fluid inside of its body, producing an acidic smoke that can slowly eat through metal. While generally friendly to its Trainers, touching POKENAME is highly ill-advised.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME rest atop trees where they can be heard chirping alongside other Pidgey. They are submissive creatures that want to take care of their flock, so they eat last whenever there are breadcrumbs scattered for them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tilts back and forth as it sleeps, and a sloshing inside its body can be heard, as it is filled with a potent poison. This toxin serves as a deterrent to any would-be predators, ensuring its safety during rest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME protects its nest by spreading its wings to look bigger than it is. Its talons are tipped with a strong venom, making it a formidable protector of its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME refine the toxins from the plants they consume within their bodies, incorporating them into their skin and carapace. Direct skin contact is not recommended as it can result in a nasty rash.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The spikes on the elytra of POKENAME drip a noxious toxin that can cause days of sickness if touched. They are standoffish and will jealously guard their territory and food sources against interlopers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's feathers are surprisingly sharp and are tipped with toxins that cause horrible migraines. These toxic tips make it a dangerous adversary, especially for those who try to approach its territory.
author: .izik

entry: Gifted with a strong sense of hearing, POKENAME can hear burrowing Bug-types from miles away. Always hungry for bugs, Farmers attract them to their fields to serve as natural pest control.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME live in arid plains, scoping out other wildlife. Sometimes, they suddenly lunge at Pokémon they have observed for a long time to poison them. The exact reason is unknown, but believed to be because of premonitions.
author: ocxin

entry: POKENAME rubs its own fur to generate sparks and electricity along its claws. It uses the voltage it gathers to make little light shows to entertain children and young Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME are threatened, their tail shines, releasing electromagnetic waves. This causes intense migraines in the aggressor as well as anyone in its proximity.
author: teatedtiten

entry: The poison dripping from the stone spheres on POKENAME's arms is extremely sweet. If boiled down into a paste, it loses all toxicity and can be used on pastries, adding a unique flavor to treats.
author: .izik

entry: The garbage POKENAME consumes alters the toxins in its body. It prefers to poison its foe and then flee, ensuring they cannot follow and exact revenge while POKENAME remains free to scavenge.
author: .izik

entry: It hates flying when it is raining. Should even a slight drizzle begin, it will hide under a tree until the storm subsides.
author: .izik

entry: The flower on its back has a sweet smell. However, if someone tries to pick that flower, they will be assaulted by POKENAME's hidden toxic barbs.
author: cait_sith

entry: The paler POKENAME's fur is, the more powerful its venom is. It's a very timid Pokémon, usually hiding away in grungy alleyways and sewers.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its ears twitch to form jagged shapes when it senses danger nearby. The shapes resemble carvings found in ancient ruins, but their meaning remains unknown.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When it wants to sleep, it burrows most of its body into the ground. If someone steps on a POKENAME, it will panic and explode.
author: .izik

entry: While traveling in a flock, POKENAME uses its poison-coated beak to attack in unison. This coordinated attack overwhelms foes, making it dangerous to approach a group of these aggressive birds.
author: .izik

entry: The oil on POKENAME's feathers is very toxic. It flings feathers at anyone who tries to interrupt it while it eats Apricorns, using the venomous oil to deter intruders and protect its meal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tail rattles rapidly as the toxins in its body accumulate. The rattling is a warning to keep predators from its den, signaling that it is ready to defend itself if necessary.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in barbs that slowly grow as it ages. These barbs are tucked close to its side as it rolls around looking for food to feed its family. Its trunk can pick up a scent from over a mile away.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are the most aggressive members of its herd, directly fighting off predators while evolved members protect the young. Its meat is tough and requires a method of boiling in hot spring water to cure it of toxins.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME eats stones in caves to satisfy its appetite. If it eats gems, its poison sacks fill more rapidly, enhancing the potency of its venom and making it even more dangerous.
author: .izik

entry: Although it is normally docile, POKENAME will not hesitate to shock those that bother or threaten it. If touched, the spikes on its ears will inflict a poison that is as painful as being electrocuted.
author: _._starry_._

entry: The spikes on POKENAME's ears aid it in digging into the soil. It eats tree roots, using its sharp ears to tunnel and gather nourishment from the earth beneath it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eats poisonous vegetation near its nest to get stronger. It prefers not to fight, spitting poison near its nest to keep predators at bay and avoiding confrontation when possible.
author: .izik

entry: The toxins coating POKENAME's body change color when it is scared. This color shift is a defense mechanism, allowing it to blend in or signal its distress, depending on the situation.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can often be found napping in the sun. It doesn't like to fight, so when attacked it usually reacts by producing calming aromas with its flower.
author: _._starry_._

entry: POKENAME seems to have traits from both genders of Nidoran. POKENAME's own preference determines whether it wants to be seen as male or female.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME nests in rocky cliffs by the sea. It dives into the ocean and hunts fish Pokémon, only returning to scale the stones once it has consumed up enough to equal half its body weight.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME often keeps to itself, but when it feels threatened it pierces and releases its barbs into its aggressor.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The poison within POKENAME's body is frequently used for paints. The stronger the poison, the stronger the vibrancy of the color, making it a highly valued ingredient in crafting vivid dyes.
author: .izik

entry: Known to be gentle around friends, POKENAME can emit ultrasonic cries that can paralyze enemies. It can retract the poison barbs on its back.
author: melodydelune

entry: It swings across trees with its ribbons, which are lined with tiny poisonous barbs. It also uses these ribbons to neutralize prey.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME's burgeoning maternal instincts mixed with its aggression to make it a fiercely strict guardian. Those it takes under its wing are trained harshly, and punished even harsher for misbehavior.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME thinks of itself as a mediator between members of Nidoran clans. Its aggressive nature makes most of its mediation consist of aggressive displays meant to cause both parties to cower in submission and cease fighting, or else.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME act as natural logisticians. When they or those they are close to receive an order, POKENAME begin directing other Pokémon as well as themselves, delegating responsibilities for optimal results.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Sassy, bold, and outright nosy, POKENAME are keen observers and appear sensitive to even the most secretive of emotions and abilities. Although humans cannot understand POKENAME's language, it appears they gossip among one another constantly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME speeds across riverbeds with its rapidly beating wings. It eats poisonous plants to strengthen itself, using their toxins to enhance its speed and agility.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love any attention that can get and will even flirt with other Pokémon just for the attention. Its claws are venomous and can cause fainting in small Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's poison is always boiling when it spits it at foes. The intense heat and toxicity of the venom make it a dangerous weapon to face in battle, often causing burns upon contact.
author: .izik

entry: It grows shadowy poison barbs which it retracts as to not hurt its owner. When threatened, it touches its foe with a ghostly hand, poisoning them.
author: houndrys.

entry: POKENAME's venom is very sweet and can be boiled down to remove its toxicity. It invigorates anyone who imbibes it, making it an effective supplement for bodybuilders or joggers, enhancing their endurance and energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are willing to defend their nest at any cost. They charge electricity into their paws before running head-first into any threat, jabbing them with the many poisonous spines on their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's head is coated in a thick layer of poison, which is applied to the target when it headbutts them. The poison activates quickly, causing disorientation and leaving its prey vulnerable.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME huddle together in burrows during the winter months to keep their bodies warm and to prevent their flaming tails from going out. They take turns eating from stashed berries that were collected during Fall.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In the wild, female POKENAME are generally more athletic than the males. The females compete against one another in an effort to one day prove they can become the leader of a colony of Nidobuff and Nidopuff.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME easily perform even the most laborious tasks thanks to their strong stamina, earning respect from other wild Pokémon. They can even perform duties in blistering cold thanks to their fluffy fur.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME swarm through forests looking for Bug-type Pokémon to feast upon. Their powerful claws can tear through cocoons thanks to the caustic venom within each claw. Once they have eaten their fill, they return to their cavernous homes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Should POKENAME become enraged, it will explode, scattering poisonous barbs everywhere. This defensive reaction makes it a dangerous opponent when threatened, leaving behind a field of toxic spikes.
author: .izik

entry: Female POKENAME are generally solitary, becoming intensely territorial among other female Pokémon. They use their venomous tusks to intimidate competing females in order to secure a mate.
author: empathnaga

entry: POKENAME rarely leave their cavernous homes and only do so to hunt for Bug-type Pokémon. By sinking their venomous fangs into the cracks of cocoons, they can melt through the tough shell to reach the juicy nutrients inside.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gnaws on the roots of poisonous flora to become stronger. By consuming these toxic plants, it enhances its own venom, making it even more formidable in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrows underground during the day, its ears sensitive to approaching danger even at rest. It bites and claws at foes when provoked.
author: synaesthesis

entry: The flowers that produce the nectar POKENAME eats make it mildly poisonous. As it dances, it raises and retracts spines under its feathers to add a subtle flair.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME work alongside waste collectors to pick up garbage on city streets. They eat trash that cannot be recycled or burned, converting that trash into a biodegradable sludge.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prefers to eat poisonous mushrooms to get stronger. The toxic nutrients enhance its own venom, making it even more dangerous to approach.
author: .izik

entry: The blue scale on POKENAME's back is similar in consistency to a mushroom. It lets loose toxic spores while in combat, using its poison to weaken foes and deter any further threats.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME is angered, its needle-like hairs become sharp enough to inject its poison in small doses. However, it is completely harmless while it is docile.
author: mistymagius

entry: There are millions of scales on each of its wings. These scales can be used in small amounts with water to create a powerful Repel.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are protective of their nestmates and will attack with their venomous claws if they cannot identify the intruders. In particularly dire situations, they breathe out hot caustic flames to burn everything around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While tunneling, POKENAME retracts its poison barbs into its body. This prevents them from snapping off against hard stone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flings poisonous barbs at tourists who travel alone at night so it can steal jewelry. This devious tactic helps it gather treasures while using its venom to protect its spoils.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME guards its gathered shiny objects with the poison secreted from its whiskers. This toxic substance keeps thieves and rivals at bay, ensuring that its treasures remain untouched.
author: .izik

entry: When enraged, spikes under POKENAME's fur become sharper. This heightened aggression makes it even more dangerous in combat, with its sharp spikes adding to the intensity of its strikes.
author: .izik

entry: When enraged, sharp spikes will grow from POKENAME's fists. It will swing at anything moving nearby until its rage subsides, becoming a force of uncontrollable fury in its quest for vengeance.
author: .izik

entry: The oil on POKENAME's fur is extremely toxic, but if washed carefully, it can be used in extremely warm scarves. Many shops across Kalos sell these scarves, made from the carefully processed fur of this Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often trained as livestock protection Pokémon since they swiftly bond to their charges and defend them fiercely. Ones kept as housepets need extensive exercise and training to keep them from wrecking their home.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are guardians for their younger siblings and do their best to keep them in the nest. When they are angry, they breathe out hot flames to signal to their younger siblings that it is time to calm down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are anxious creatures that do their best to keep their energetic siblings in the nest. They drive out intruders with their venomous claws and keep siblings in by blocking exits with searing hot flames.
author: quackquackattack

entry: After evolving, the toxins within POKENAME's body have become far more potent, making it an even more formidable opponent. With its broad wings, it soars over the skies around its nest, defending it even at the cost of its own life.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite sleeping for most of the day, POKENAME can quickly jump up to defend their friends and family at the first hint of danger. They Teleport around opponents to confuse them, waiting for a chance to hit with a nasty Poison Sting.
author: chibitales

entry: It is extremely stubborn, refusing to lose even a single logic based game. If it sees its opponent is winning it will attempt to wipe their memory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a calm and caring nature. It trains endlessly in order to protect its friends and family.
author: lazyarcanist

entry: POKENAME clean the shells of other Pokémon in a communal cleaning ritual that keeps their bodies clean. Once they are clean, POKENAME dry their shells in bright sunny patches of grass.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's keen hearing allows it to detect any movement, so if it senses a much larger Pokémon approaching, it immediately takes a defensive stance. Hidden within its tail are venomous barbs, which it uses to catch opponents off guard in battle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its body is extremely light and agile. While navigating through a forest, it jumps from tree to tree, utilizing its ears to glide slightly.
author: .izik

entry: The saliva leaking from POKENAME's two heads is extremely poisonous and should not be touched. This venom causes fevers and hallucinations, making it a dangerous threat to anyone who comes too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's keen hearing allows it to detect any movement, so if it senses a much larger Pokémon approaching, it immediately takes a defensive stance. It loves spending its days swimming to keep its body hydrated and prevent its skin from cracking.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME protect their nest by standing outside, ready to launch a torrent of water. They are stalwart creatures that are devoted to the task of protecting their family, even if it means missing out on having fun.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME doesn't inflict its poison by normal means; it instead uses its psychic powers to poison its opponent's mind by using its pendulum. The poison causes severe headaches, nausea, and muscle spasms.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its giant jaws have migrated to its back. They are capable of spitting seeds or biting foes.
author: mossybanana

entry: The jaw on top of POKENAME's head snaps furiously at predatory bird Pokémon. Thanks to this, it can safely focus on eating.
author: mepp.

entry: Its monstrous mouths move it along the ground and defend the egg from danger. However, it can easily be picked up by the tuft of hair on top.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME collects the bones of its consumed prey to hunt with as weapons or pick its teeth.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: With steel jaws camouflaged as fists, it never backs down from a challenge.
author: anarchaz

entry: It doesn't speak because its large mouth is its true body, which hides inside the host. If you let down your guard, it will emerge to eat you.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME regularly runs through rock quarries, using its iron plating to ram into the walls. It does this as a show of strength to others of its kind, counting the rocks it knocks loose.
author: .izik

entry: The mouth on POKENAME's forehead is extremely humid and moist, perfect for storing eggs safely. It will protect the eggs of other Pokémon if their parents are away until they return.
author: .izik

entry: It spies on tiny Pokémon, pretending to be a regular plant. Its jaws can hold even the most powerful of Pokémon at bay.
author: imagine1.

entry: Its baby hides in its pouch, which is a false mouth. It sleeps on its stomach like a Skeledirge to protect its child at night.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME tricks unsuspecting prey to look at its beautiful wings. When they are most vulnerable, they chomp down on them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The steel blades on POKENAME's arms allow it to cut apart large tree branches. Should it spot prey like Weedle, it will attack with its large maw.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its large maw to easily consume an entire Kakuna in one bite. Its powerful bite can break through tough shells, making it an efficient predator.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME repeatedly bites itself with the mouth on its tail to rile itself up for battle. This behavior lets it fly into a rage, boosting its strength for the fight.
author: .izik

entry: This fusion was first documented by a Trainer who assumed they found an aquatic Mawile. They were rewarded for the discovery with a prosthetic hand.
author: captainmodeus

entry: POKENAME is nigh-impossible to take by surprise. No matter the direction you approach it from, it will transform its body to form a giant pair of jaws and chomp you before you can come close.
author: hophoppip

entry: Though they all share the same body, each of its many mouths has its own appetite. As such, it is always hungry, and always searching for the next meal to shove into its starving maws.
author: sk372

entry: They present themselves to unaware households, acting hungry and cutely asking for food. POKENAME's tail will stretch looking for the source of the food, and its jaws will have no struggle to swallow it all before teleporting.
author: epping_forest

entry: They present themselves to unaware households, acting hungry and cutely asking for food. POKENAME's tail will stretch looking for the source of the food, and its jaws will have no struggle to swallow it all before teleporting.
author: epping_forest

entry: Despite its grotesque appearance, a POKENAME is docile and generally harmless. Its fanged maw is solely for defending against predators.
author: occulusmalus

entry: While it forages for insects, it keeps the jaws on its back closed. If a predator attempts to attack it from behind, the jaws open to strike back.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME has a volatile temperament and is easily angered. Once its fury is triggered, it retracts the flames on its back and focuses all its fire to its head, breathing massive plumes of fire all around it in an aimless rage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hangs on tree branches or cliff faces, dropping onto unsuspecting prey with its open maw, and trapping it with its web-like saliva for slow digestion. If found in urban areas, it must be relocated so as not to be a danger to children.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME mimics the sounds of injured Pokémon to lure prey deep into the forest. Once the victim is lost or becomes trapped in a hazard, POKENAME descends from the trees to devour them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The small helpless-looking lure on the tip of its forehead appendage is its actual body, with which POKENAME attracts prey and swallows it with its modified antenna that resembles a toothy fish.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME lurks deep in the ocean and makes its home in dark crevices where its lure produces the only light around. Prey Pokémon often mistake its lure for young Chinchou; POKENAME takes advantage of this and strikes at its unsuspecting target.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lurks deep in the ocean and makes its home in dark crevices where its lure produces the only light around. Prey Pokémon often mistake its lure for young Chinchou; POKENAME takes advantage of this and strikes at its unsuspecting target.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: All three of POKENAME's mouths sing a sorrowful tune on nights when the moon isn't visible. The melody is so haunting that it can make a person cry from just hearing a small portion.
author: .izik

entry: A normally peaceful bird-like Pokémon. However, when provoked, unleashes the might of the massive jaws hiding within its stomach.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is known for its cuteness, and is very affectionate. However, it is extremely dangerous to touch, as its flowers and dress both contain hidden rows of razor-sharp teeth.
author: vibrationjaveline

entry: Whenever it's underwater, its tail floats on the surface with its jaw open, allowing POKENAME to breathe without emerging. It also uses its tail to protect its offspring by gently carrying the eggs or newly-hatched babies inside the jaw.
author: milchik

entry: A wild POKENAME is very meek unless it is cornered. POKENAME fights by wildly swinging its tail, which is embedded with pointed teeth.
author: mossybanana

entry: POKENAME waits for hungry Pokémon to approach it, mistaking it for a sunflower seed, then strikes with its metal jaws. By doing so, it gathers energy for evolution without having to move.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME blends in with a field of flowers, but when prey wanders too close, it pounces and tears into it with the mouth-petals. When the sun sets, it journeys to a new flower patch so that it can begin its ruse again.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME keeps its large jaw above the water, allowing it to breathe. Flying Pokémon sometimes perch on it, which POKENAME finds ticklish. This causes it to sneeze, covering the Pokémon that landed on it in a mildly toxic goo.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's large jaw is buoyant and floats above the water. Flying Pokémon sometimes perch on it, which POKENAME finds ticklish. This causes it to sneeze, covering the Pokémon that landed on it in a mildly toxic goo.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME keeps its large jaw above the water, allowing it to breathe. Sailors have mistaken these for buoys, and when they get closer to investigate, POKENAME covers them in a mildly toxic goo.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME, in order to meditate on its deep thoughts, can shut its shell tightly around its head to shut out external stimuli. In this state, the orb glows and telekinetically tosses aside anything that comes too close.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has sprouted leaves due to its growth. If POKENAME cannot bite an opponent, then it will reach out with Vine Whip.
author: mossybanana

entry: A POKENAME is very bold in its pursuit of food, often taking things directly off of someone's plate.
author: mossybanana

entry: Should it be struck by any attack, the mouth on POKENAME's tail will bite back with double the force of what struck it. It is careful to maintain balance, making scientists study its behavior for the exactness of its reaction.
author: .izik

entry: The metallic shavings that come off POKENAME's body were once used to create automobiles. Unfortunately, many of them were recalled due to the metal's explosive properties.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrows into the ground face-first to sleep, leaving the mouth on its tail exposed. During the rain, its mouth clamps shut tightly to avoid filling with water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lack conventional mouths and instead use the mouths on their arms to consume and drink. These mouths are also used to fight, often biting pieces off of their prey with each strike.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its strong jaw to bite open cedar trees, feeding on the sap inside. Its powerful bite allows it to break through tough bark with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lays down with its mouth open, releasing a honey-like scent to lure prey in. Once they enter, it snaps its mouth shut to catch them.
author: .izik

entry: The giant jaws on a POKENAME are metal horns that grow large enough to protect the whole body. When not resting in their horn shells, POKENAME dig to find tasty minerals and fungi underground.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME love to raid the homes of naughty children and eat all of their presents. They will even play tricks on the children without their parents noticing.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's thin metal blades, which are used as wings, are sharp enough to slice through pine trees with ease. It uses these wings to hunt prey like Hoppip, cutting down obstacles in its path.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME distracts prey with its decoy face and then bites at them. Its teeth are weaker than Mawbok's and can't penetrate a Rock-type Pokémon's skin.
author: thenezhar

entry: It chews up brightly colored Berries, plants, and minerals in the mouth on its tail. Mixed with that mouth's saliva, the chewed items become a vivid and long-lasting pigment that POKENAME uses to mark its territory.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is a vicious Pokémon that can chomp through steel and concrete. Its large mouth is quite heavy and hinders its capability to move quickly.
author: thenezhar

entry: POKENAME stores ore that it wants to eat later in its secondary mouth, which has no connection to its digestion. This allows it to gather food without worrying about immediate consumption.
author: .izik

entry: Some say POKENAME's mood depends on the side of its face you see. Its bright and cheerful side attempts to coordinate with Trainers, while the devious side snaps its steely crown's jaws.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME get very little use out of their small, beady eyes. They feed instead by feeling around with their long tongues, quickly yanking anything they find back into their waiting maws.
author: houseoffallingflowers

entry: POKENAME is covered in durable tendrils that each have small mouths at the end, allowing it to rapidly devour prey. Sometimes a tendril will latch onto a target and be pulled off by the roots, gnawing on its catch for up to an hour before perishing.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's mouth on its tail makes an odd whirring noise while it fights. The sound increases its power, allowing it to unleash Bug Buzz with greater strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glides across the night skies in search of prey. It uses its second mouth to clamp onto prey like Murkrow mid-flight, carrying them away to feast.
author: .izik

entry: Whilst it almost exclusively feeds on plants, POKENAME is extremely dangerous due to its large size, powerful jaws and bad temper. Few if any predators will risk hunting it.
author: occulusmalus

entry: Keenly aware of any untoward emotions its Trainer may have, POKENAME will lure them to their doom just to make an example out of them.
author: srx.moe

entry: Its huge jaws can easily bite through steel girders. It is given spare steel from construction sites, lest it eat entire cities worth of metal.
author: holgast

entry: The physical body and spiritual maw operate as separate minds. Working together with an uneasy agreement, the body of POKENAME does the walking and talking, while the jaws attack whatever is within reach.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: Because of its rust-like skin, POKENAME sometimes pretends to be a statue. When another Pokémon gets too close, it chomps down viciously.
author: jokerswild

entry: POKENAME will often soothe their prey with an aroma before consuming them, as they cannot outrun them.
author: mossybanana
