author: frokachu

entry: At any given moment, at least one of POKENAME's heads is sleeping. This is inconvenient as it means the other heads have to drag it around.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME plant seeds into the ground before pouring a special nectar from their bulbs to help the sprouts grow. While the plants do grow big and strong, no matter the species of plant, it will be poisonous to humans.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It ruthlessly attacks foes by charging at them with the venomous horn on its forehead. It despises getting wet, so during rainstorms POKENAME hides deep inside caves until the weather clears.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Many Trainers are tempted to play with POKENAME's young, not realizing their poison is strong enough to faint a Slaking. If they continue to annoy the pup, the mother Pokémon sends them flying with a Mega Punch.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME only eat natural products, from plants to the sap they may produce. They constantly shed their wings' feathers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It uses alluring dances to hypnotize foes. It controls poison and spreads it through the air.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Usually found in rivers, POKENAME keeps its body submerged, while keeping its eyes and ears above the surface. Due to its coloration, most will not see it. When prey is spotted it lunges surprisingly fast, landing a venomous bite.
author: ghostslythe

entry: A truly rare sighting; POKENAME has enough poison in it's horn to fell even the largest of Wailords!
author: supersonicloki

entry: POKENAME flies with its psychic powers in the daylight, its coloration providing camouflage against sightings. It seeks out toxic spills, absorbing the poison into itself and bringing nature back into equilibrium.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are renowned for their ability to mimic sounds, keeping their nests safe by copying predator growls. They imprint onto objects that make sounds, and follow Trainers to defend those objects with venomous pecks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME have toughened skin and carapaces. Their stiff coatings mean they are not particularly mobile Pokémon, but anything that does manage to take a bite out of them finds them to be foul tasting and unappetising.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can weave intricate webs in which it traps prey, finishing them off with venomous claws or fangs. It tends to infest trees previously inhabited by Ariados, having driven them away with its brute strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME feed kindred members of their nest poison from their stone spheres. Their young have special enzymes that process and neutralize the poison once ingested and are nourished by the remaining paste.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The flower on POKENAME's back can release a fine powder that puts anyone who breathes it to sleep; this dust is even used to make strong sleeping agents. Its spines are laced with potent toxins to protect the flower's petals from other Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The massive arm at the end of its body carves intricate symbols into rock or soil. These markings seem to serve as territorial warnings, though some suspect they hold deeper meanings tied to ancient knowledge.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are never seen outside their shells, constantly sheltering inside them. They move around using their powerful arms, lumbering from one feeding site to the next.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME dig through the ground, creating huge tunnels. Some are found to reach a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.
author: krune

entry: Despite its fragile appearance, POKENAME's chitin is tough as diamonds. When threatened, it uses spurs built into its claws to deploy venom, incapacitating its foes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Roving bands of POKENAME inhabit mountain passes, using their claws to scale rock faces. When humans pass underneath, the Pokémon drop down and use paralyzing poison on their axes to steal what they can.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's shell is filled with a poisonous mixture that is constantly steaming out of between the plates. If it is inhaled, it can cause the victim to feel as though they were on fire.
author: clownatosis

entry: POKENAME's broad wings allow it to majestically fly for days without tiring. Its long beak and the spines along its back are coated with potent toxins, which it uses to overpower foes and drive intruders from its territory.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has special fangs that hold venom back when it bites onto its children. It does this to carry the children to safety whenever there is danger.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wields its tail like a whip. It has been recorded piercing through 4 feet of concrete.
author: winchbeef

entry: POKENAME hunt by ambushing prey and restraining them with their massive tail. Once the prey is subdued, they inject venom through their fangs and drag them back to their nest, where baby Nidoran wait for their return.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Every winter, POKENAME descends from their mountain homes to fish for Poliwag on frozen lakes. Using razor-sharp claws, they drag their favorite treats from the depths, then impale them on venom-laced horns.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is a pack hunter, always hunting prey in groups of four. It takes turns in specialized roles to distract prey before the group strikes with razor-sharp, venomous claws.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Found training in swamps, POKENAME ingests local poisonous fauna to gain immunity. If attacked, their sweat contains a cocktail of all ingested poisons, making a single strike lethal.
author: ghostslythe

entry: With a sixth sense, POKENAME can tell when earthquakes or toxic spills are about to occur. If sensed, it quickly puts its young on its back, tramples anything in its path, and uses a venomous bite on anything resisting.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The auras around POKENAME's horns and claws are aerosolized poison. Though its movements seem ponderous, one breath is enough to drop a Snorlax.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME protects local Nidoran by sprouting barbed vines from their back and releasing toxic pollen into the air. In return, Nidoran provide POKENAME with berries and affection.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lazes around for most of the day. Its thick hide protects it from any real damage. Despite doing almost nothing all day, it thinks itself superior to everyone.
author: mistymagius

entry: Anyone who bullies POKENAME's young will be sliced by this Pokémon's wings. It uses its hard scales to swim through ice floes and take on the icy waters to protect its children swimming behind.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME seeks other Nidoran-related fusions in order to fight for and protect them diligently as family.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The twin flails of POKENAME strike hard and fast against all opposition. Though normally it carefully coordinates its attacks, if a child is in danger it goes berserk with protective instincts and enters a whirling frenzy to smash the threat.
author: sk372

entry: Highly defensive of its young, POKENAME's back barbs bristle and ooze poison if it senses anyone or anything straying too close.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Packs of POKENAME patrol storm-tossed badlands with their young. They absorb the ambient ozone in the air and use it to help replenish the venom they spend on hunting.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in a stone armor that shields it from tearing blows during territorial battles. If one of its venom-soaked horns breaks, it hides away in its den until it grows back.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Encased in rugged stone plating, POKENAME endures brutal clashes over territory without flinching. Should a venom-laced horn snap off, it retreats underground, waiting in silence for it to regenerate.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Extremely protective of those it cares about, this Pokémon will stake its life to ensure the safety of its young and Trainer.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME is powerfully aggressive, but also has a strong maternal instinct to protect anything smaller than it. Some have even been seen getting into fights with Kangaskhan over who could better protect the child.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon is known for its robust scales and impactful punches. POKENAME's nails grow at a rapid rate on its hands and feet. It uses them to inject its target with poison by piercing them.
author: over9001

entry: POKENAME act as the guards for unevolved POKENAME. They appear to be the most intelligent out of the colony they care for, and therefore give orders in place of the colony's leaders if the situation calls for it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME act as the guards for unevolved POKENAME. They appear to be the most intelligent out of the colony they care for, and therefore give orders in place of the colony's leaders if the situation calls for it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME act as the guards for unevolved POKENAME. They appear to be the most intelligent out of the colony they care for, and therefore give orders in place of the colony's leaders if the situation calls for it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A POKENAME's legs have incredible strength, allowing them to jump far in a single bound and kick with devastating power. It emits a toxic oily secretion onto its fur to keep it clean and nearly shining.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Known for its powerful kicks, this Pokémon can be heard throughout the night leaping through the forests.
author: supersonicloki

entry: Created when a substitute doll is destroyed by toxins, POKENAME haunts toy stores. Late at night it will rearrange entire aisles, mischievously giggling and jumping out at guard Pokémon.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Using the toxic barbs on the sides of its skull, POKENAME can pierce through the thickest hides. Intense territorial disputes between these Pokémon cause localized earthquakes, with each slamming its opponent into a daze for a finishing barb strike.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It communicates only with its owner, being very secretive. It keeps its form hidden in its scaly body, and attacks by extending shadowy needles.
author: houndrys.

entry: On nights when the moon is full, POKENAME gather in a single large group to pair with one another. Their tails are such a deep obsidian that they mirror the night sky. Some astronomers even use POKENAME to study constellations.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME have a strong venom that can take down a large Tauros but struggle to produce more than a small fire. They are protective of the fire on their tail and refuse to let other Pokémon near it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: There is only one female POKENAME in each colony of Nidopuff, where it acts as their leader. They can inflate their bodies to many times their normal size. When they exhale, poison gas is emitted from their orifices.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's ears are powerful in all senses of the word. When they suddenly stretch forward, they exert enough force to topple a truck. POKENAME's sense of hearing is also impeccable and even rivals the elusive Clefairy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is aggressive and will attack anything to prove its strength to itself. When defeated, it often returns to fight the same opponent until it finds a way to be victorious.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME viciously attacks any perceived threat to its offspring. When it leaves its nest to hunt, it rubs its young with its mane which has a low-level toxin that wards off predators.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME thrive in high altitude environments, as its hide is both tough and cold resistant. Their hide has been discovered to be a great material in the making of hiking equipment.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME performs dances for people that it likes. This dances spreads mind-controlling poison through the air to lure the person to its home.
author: themicelegion

entry: Though small in stature, POKENAME can send foes flying with harsh tackles from its horn. Its leaves can absorb moonlight to regain energy at night.
author: synaesthesis

entry: The leaf-like moss growing from between POKENAME's hard scales is used in many remedies. When ground up, it can be used to treat burns and abrasions, providing relief and healing properties.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses sound waves from its ears to stun prey before surrounding them in Toxic Spikes. This strategy allows it to immobilize and weaken its prey before moving in for the final strike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses Toxic to stun other flying Pokémon while it travels. It then takes them back to its den for others of its kind to feast on, making it a dangerous hunter of the skies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very protective of its young and will show no mercy to anything that threatens them. When agitated, its skin secretes a deadly poison that makes it volatile in combat.
author: mistymagius

entry: The hard scales on POKENAME's body make it aerodynamic, allowing it to perform flying kicks with ease. This enhanced agility gives it a significant advantage in aerial combat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers living in extremely cold climates, where its body produces a thin, clear poisonous liquid that leaks from its spikes. This toxic substance acts as both a defense and as a hunting aid.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME weaves toxic spells using a radioactive Moon Stone focus, ensuring they hit with its psychic powers. To avoid harming its Trainer, it encloses the radiation in a psychic field.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When the light in POKENAME's torso pulses, its venom is at peak potency. Waking it during its sleep may trigger in it a panic attack worsened by hallucinogenic toxins.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrows into cliffsides with its horn to sleep. If it detects a coming rockslide, it braces with Defense Curl to avoid serious harm.
author: .izik

entry: After flying, POKENAME embeds its horn into cliff walls to rest. Once lodged in the stone, even strong wind gusts cannot dislodge it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME injects mild toxin into tree roots with its horn to soften them. It rips the roots into pieces and digs as deep as 100 ft before feeding.
author: .izik

entry: Living in eroded caves made by raging rivers, POKENAME are strong enough to swim up rapids. If threatened, they dig their venom-laced claws into the foe and peck viciously.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME secrete a potent venom in their fur that poisons any Pokémon that touches them. They will consume some of their own venom before getting into fights, letting it drive them into a frenzy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME secrete a potent venom in their fur that poisons any Pokémon that touches them. They will consume some of their own venom before getting into fights, letting it drive them into a frenzy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is spunky and opinionated, refusing to follow orders that it disagrees with. It loves to play, sassily barking at its Trainer so they will give chase and it can run away in a flash of fire.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is willing to lay down its life to guard the flocks in its care. As it grows older and becomes more of a pet than a worker, its Trainer should still let it patrol the fields occasionally so its pride is not hurt.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Ancient drawings in Kalos depict POKENAME barreling through armies of knights. When faced in the modern age, most assume it will use flaming attacks, only to be shocked with poisonous breath.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME takes after wrestlers, and enjoys tackling foes to the floor. This, unfortunately, can knock them unconscious.
author: notsaying.

entry: A single dictionary is unable to encompass the lexical complexity of their language, which is used to educate their children on how to survive in the world. The nuances of their cries and grunts remain a topic of study for linguists.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is ready for anything. Its punch has been known to be fatal to smaller creatures.
author: supersonicloki

entry: This Pokémon is only known to flinch when it pulls a muscle. It seeks out and challenges other Machoke fusions.
author: supersonicloki

entry: POKENAME practices a variety of fighting styles that prepare it to take on all kinds of foes. If a POKENAME grabs ahold of an enemy while in combat, it will inject a powerful toxin into them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A toxic positivity personality at any gym; strong Trainers seek POKENAME out when they want to push their limits as a Trainer and as a human.
author: supersonicloki

entry: The combination of Nidoqueen's tough scales and Golem's boulder-like body allow POKENAME to shrug off most attacks. It does occasionally have to shed its skin, which leaves it vulnerable, but it always grows back stronger than ever.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's tongue is coated in poison, which it uses to subdue anyone who gets too close to its kin. This toxic attack allows it to protect its family and territory with lethal force.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes its home in forests that are near sources of high pollution. An increasing presence is a sure sign of coming ecological damage.
author: veteranadventurehobo

entry: POKENAME live on mountains. When they sense disaster, they panic and tirelessly charge to warn anyone nearby, running over anything in their way.
author: totodile.

entry: Some POKENAME have different styles of plating and shorter faces. POKENAME can become enraged if their warnings go unheeded.
author: totodile.

entry: If it senses a disaster, it will begin frantically giving out its eggs to help. Despite its kindness, many still believe POKENAME caused the disaster.
author: fountainihili

entry: When POKENAME sits motionless at the bottom of the water, its fur waving with the current disguises it as seagrass.
author: .realthree

entry: The shimmery scales shed from Pokémon's wings can be made into life-saving medicine for certain rare illnesses with no other known cures.
author: kiwikelly

entry: Whenever an POKENAME washes up, it is seen as an ill omen, though some believe returning it to the sea appeases the fates. Those that look directly into the gem are said to go into a trance-like state, murmuring about stars and distant planets.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME thrives around power plants. It uses its horn like a lighting rod to prevent storms from destroying power lines.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME live in dormant volcanoes. Seeing them elsewhere means a nearby mountain will erupt soon.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME are born with two horns, but one inevitably breaks off as it battles other POKENAME. Some collect the broken horns to use as luck charms.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME's horn is very sensitive to its environment. It is said that the type of natural disaster POKENAME witnesses will influence its evolution.
author: kiwikelly

entry: Building trust with an POKENAME takes quite a bit of time, as it is naturally a very solitary Pokémon. It is quite serious and hates being startled.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Where it surfaces from the ocean, a great tsunami will soon arrive. POKENAME will then stand stalwart on the beach, shielding others from the waves.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: When it senses an impending disaster, it flies around the area, releasing a bone-chilling scream. Though many believe that it is cursing the land, POKENAME is actually warning people of the danger ahead.
author: amiel997

entry: After fusing, POKENAME loses the ability to control its powers, leading to apocalyptic hailstorms that follow in its wake. Even a single sighting of POKENAME often leads to panic in nearby communities.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME is said to bring about great disasters in the form of terrible thunderstorms. When battling, it surrounds itself with lightning before fiercely charging in.
author: mepp.

entry: The pollen POKENAME spreads from its leaf smells like basil and accelerates plant growth. If it senses an approaching flood, it encourages trees to grow rapidly to absorb the excess water.
author: .izik

entry: The sensitive leaf on their head guides them to places where natural disasters are bound to happen. The grey skies before a storm provide just the right level of light for POKENAME to sunbathe in; otherwise they either starve or fall ill.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME's fur is extremely valuable, but it is said that anyone who cuts it off of an POKENAME will suffer one hundred years of bad luck.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME, now blessed with the speed afforded to it by its powerful wings, travels great distances to warn people of coming danger.
author: sejha

entry: POKENAME creates images made of sparks above it in an attempt to warn others of impending disasters. Because its powers are weak, however, the images are vague or misinterpreted, and its warnings often go unheeded.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's large horns help them tune their psychic abilities. They're highly revered in certain cultures thanks to their pitch-perfect Future Sight.
author: kiwikelly

entry: Should it sense someone with terrible luck, it will fly in circles over their home to release any bad omens. It prefers to fly in a clockwise motion.
author: .izik

entry: It is believed that POKENAME can sense when someone's death is near. When it perches on a rooftop and sings its eerie song, someone in the household will die exactly three days later.
author: amiel997

entry: When a disaster nears, the orb on POKENAME's tail grows intensely warm. Its water attacks heat up as well, becoming hot enough to burn skin.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a tree while waiting for its instincts to confirm an upcoming disaster. If it senses danger, it shakes violently to warn nearby Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very friendly. Children like to use the symbol on its head as a spinner to play fortune-telling games.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME age slowly and are rarely found in areas inhabited by humans. Before performing a Solar Beam, POKENAME's petals glow brightly as they unleash a cataclysmic burst of energy.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are docile enough to be easily kept around humans but still have the instincts of an Absol. They are kept at rocket launch sites to detect if a natural disaster or extreme weather will interfere with a launch.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME floats lazily in rivers, unaffected by the chaotic world around it. However, if it detects an approaching flood, it will let out a deep bellow to alert nearby Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has the power to predict disasters when its forked tail quivers. However, it will only share its knowledge with a Trainer it deems worthy.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's flower has begun to bloom in the presence of high pollution. It can slow the poisoning of the environment, but can't stop it alone.
author: veteranadventurer

entry: It watches people in the city from the tops of buildings. When it foresees a cheese-related disaster, it jumps into action.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME senses an incoming hurricane, it channels psychic energy through its rear head to gently urge Pokémon and people away. If they do not listen, it forces them back with powerful psychic waves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appear where earthquakes destroyed towns. Despite superstitions, this is simply because the tremors woke them from their underground slumber.
author: kiwikelly

entry: This mischievous Pokémon tempts Trainers with dangerous dares. Only the most courageous know that POKENAME's presence guarantees their safety.
author: kiwikelly

entry: A flock of POKENAME is considered a bad omen across multiple cultures around the world, but singular POKENAME actually make for great pets.
author: kiwikelly

entry: The berry juice POKENAME makes in its shell causes terrifying visions of doom and calamity that can make even the bravest Trainers cower in fear.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME often appear on compromised trees to eat their soft wood and sap. Arborists often use them to predict if a tree is about to fall or break.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME are prized for their beautiful feathers and fur. However, they make terrible pets, as they will destroy everything their owner holds dear.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME reside deep below the icy tundra, where it is comfortably cold and dry. They are a rare sight in the wild, as they were once hunted to near extinction.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The honey-like scent from POKENAME's fur becomes incredibly strong before a violent storm. The aroma lures smaller Pokémon into its den, providing them shelter and safety.
author: .izik

entry: Feared by many, POKENAME only appears when danger is near, its presence a silent warning cloaked in strength. Its thick fur protects it from harsh winter seasons.
author: curazy

entry: Its sensitive branches detect changes in ocean temperature and acidity. When large groups of POKENAME surface, it's a sign of severe climate change.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME patrol their territory to ensure that nothing has gone awry. If something is amiss, they let out eerie howls to alert the rest of their pack.
author: kiwikelly

entry: This Pokémon lives a lonely and solitary life. While it has been observed approaching packs of Houndoom in the wild, POKENAME is always rejected.
author: rihse

entry: POKENAME is rare in the wild but features heavily in Hoenn folklore that foretells impending disasters. Legend states that the worst omen is to witness one eat its own tail until it disappears.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its nose can somehow smell earthquakes before they occur. It will bury its head in the dirt if it senses danger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's thick fur keeps it warm as it rolls through snowy mountains during brutal winters. If it detects a severe blizzard approaching, it trumpets a warning from its trunk.
author: .izik

entry: Looking at POKENAME's horns causes visions of terrible disasters. Some believe those are omens, while others think it's POKENAME's defense mechanism.
author: kiwikelly

entry: This species overwhelms its foes with speed and cunning rather than brute strength. Highly perceptive, it can identify weak points and openings at a mere glance.
author: xillo

entry: POKENAME is rare in the wild but features heavily in Hoenn folklore that foretells impending disasters. Legend states that the worst omen is to witness one eat its own tail until it disappears.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's long tongue darts out during poor weather to detect scent changes that indicate severe storms. If it senses an impending disaster, it lets out a piercing screech as a warning.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME signals warnings of imminent natural disasters with subtle changes in the patterns on its wings. Its fearsome appearance has made it a common Pokémon to appear alongside villains in fiction stories, despite its benevolent nature.
author: pjporwoll

entry: As POKENAME is only found on foggy mountaintops, not many people have seen it. Inspired by myths describing it as a legendary guardian spirit, an author wrote a popular novel where a brave girl saves the world with her POKENAME companion.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME wanders around the world, sensing the flow of calamity with its horn. It always lets tragedies happen, just to travel back in time and see how exactly they can be avoided.
author: epping_forest

entry: Some say that if you are cursed by an POKENAME, you are destined to meet your end no matter how hard you try to avoid it. They can be seen wandering around cities recently hit by natural disasters.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME possesses the ability to foresee disasters, crying when it receives the precognitive visions. Researchers have found it cries differently depending on the kind of disaster, and use this to more quickly decipher its warnings.
author: sk372

entry: It is believed that an POKENAME is the last thing someone will see before passing away.
author: kiwikelly

entry: If POKENAME senses an upcoming tornado, it screeches loudly while flinging sand erratically. This chaotic display serves as a warning to those nearby to seek shelter.
author: .izik

entry: Known as "The Fist of Ill Omen", an POKENAME wins fights by knowing its opponent's moves before they ever make them. If it knows it cannot win, it will recklessly attempt to take its foe down with it.
author: mileysakiko

entry: Always one step ahead, POKENAME predicts worst-case scenarios, absorbing the emotions of those around it to maintain the balance between light and darkness.
author: wolfythehunter

entry: It is said that an POKENAME that's well taken care of can alter the future to one where its Trainer lives a happy and prosperous life.
author: kiwikelly

entry: With captivating grace, POKENAME predicts moments of change with great accuracy, but its calm nature means its predictions are not feared, but embraced.
author: wolfythehunter

entry: With the power to foresee catastrophic events and the heart of a protector, POKENAME uses its energy to guide others through the darkness, dispelling the shadows with its power and presence.
author: wolfythehunter

entry: With its capability to sense disasters enhanced, POKENAME now strives to both warn those of danger, but take matters into its own claws to protect lives. Its scythe grows sharper the more lives it vows to defend, making it incredibly deadly.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME use their color-changing fur to communicate with humans. Scientists have yet to fully decipher this intricate language.
author: kiwikelly

entry: By channelling its aura, POKENAME sharpens its senses and can detect threats from over 50 km away. Its remarkable speed and instincts guide it in combat to deliver devastating attacks.
author: danieru4729

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal hunter that feasts on forest-dwelling Pokémon. Rather than navigating through the forest, it uses its razor-sharp appendages to slice down the trees.
author: patch

entry: POKENAME is often found at the edges of ecological disaster zones, warning away trespassers and absorbing the pollution within to heal the area.
author: veteranadventurer

entry: The teeth of an POKENAME are about as sharp as a high-grade kitchen knife. Poachers frequently harvest these teeth to sell for a moderate price.
author: .izik

entry: Ancient tomes claim that peering between POKENAME's fingers allows one to see future disasters. However, this has been proven untrue on multiple occasions, though some still believe in the legend.
author: .izik

entry: Many POKENAME will gather in an area where a natural disaster is soon to occur, ready to take the spirts of all who do not survive to the afterlife.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's sharp horn is extremely sensitive to changes in its environment, leading it to be seen as hyper-aware to natural disasters. Broken bits of this Pokémon's horn were collected in the past in the hopes they would serve as early warning signs.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME mostly wanders rugged mountains. A cut from this scythe is said to curse the victim with approaching disaster.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME mostly wanders rugged mountains. A cut from this scythe is said to curse the victim with approaching disaster.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The two blades of POKENAME are said to represent good and bad luck. The first one that strikes seals its enemy's fate for the rest of its life.
author: kiwikelly

entry: This valiant fusion is said to help and protect those upon whom a disastrous fate will fall. It is unknown whether or not it is effective.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME are said to be agents of fate, as they work together in small groups to prevent small-scale disasters, or cause them to come about.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME's piercing eyes can see through heavy storm clouds to detect brewing disasters. If it senses imminent danger, it howls into the sky, sending warning sparks through the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has the peculiar ability to sense incoming sea storms, and thus has developed the habit of appearing to sailors just before tsunamis. This has led to the mistaken belief that spotting one at sea is a sign of great misfortune.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME was first discovered in the irradiated ruin of a research facility. The hands of its clock creep toward midnight whenever it senses that the humans and Pokémon around it are not in harmony, or a great disaster has occurred.
author: quietcognition

entry: Many believe POKENAME are cursed. Though their protective illusions appear perfect, any group meeting one is beset by disasters.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME uses its strength and intimidating appearance to frighten villages into evacuating before disasters strike. In the past it was believed to be the cause, but now it's known that it merely acts the villain to hasten people fleeing to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME arrive in villages on nights of the full moon when disaster is about to strike. They are the source of many negative superstitions about the full moon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The delicate flowers on POKENAME's body have a similar scent to white lilies. In some cultures, they are considered symbols of freedom.
author: mepp.

entry: The mushrooms of POKENAME can be turned into potions that grant their drinker powerful future sight. Sadly, the premonitions are always horrifying.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME floats quietly in empty storm shelters. If it senses an incoming tornado, it knocks nearby Pokémon unconscious and drags them into the shelter to save them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are said to be manifestations of karma, usually appearing after the fall of evil empires or corporations. If it finds someone who committed an evil act, it will drag them away with its ghostly tendrils.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can sense disasters, and actively warns people of them. It enjoys witnessing the aftermath of those who don't listen.
author: codewolfie

entry: It lays in the desert during the night to absorb nutrients from the moon's light. After the sun rises, it covers its body in a layer of sand.
author: .izik

entry: Many people believe that the end of the world will begin once POKENAME's flame goes out. It arrives after natural disasters, burning the souls of the recently deceased.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is extremely kind by nature despite its fearsome appearance. Sadly, it is blamed for disasters caused by people who invade its territory, even though it lives in remote mountain areas.
author: sylia

entry: POKENAME are shy and hard to tame. If an POKENAME is wronged, it will never trust the person that hurt it again.
author: kiwikelly

entry: While sharp-looking, its scythe is actually a soft sensory organ that POKENAME uses to detect danger. It flees at the first sign of predators.
author: kiwikelly

entry: It floats slowly through swamps making jingling noises. It is said that if one hears this noise, they will face bad luck with love for many years.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME seeks to improve the poor image of Absol, by doing good deeds while disguised to resemble it. This slowly garners it the friendship of Absol and humans alike as the damaged reputation is repaired.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives deep inside caves, sensing earthquakes before they happen. When danger nears, it releases a horrifying roar that sounds like a mix between a boat horn and a child crying.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME chews on the foundations of wooden buildings until they come crashing down. The destroyed structures make great nest material for POKENAME.
author: kiwikelly

entry: It can sense disasters before they happen, but it's always too tired to try to prevent them. Some think it's lazy, but others find it quite relatable.
author: knilk

entry: POKENAME's fur bristles with static electricity before a disaster strikes. It sends small jolts into the air, alerting others of an approaching storm.
author: .izik

entry: The small white hairs covering POKENAME's body are as hard as steel. When it senses an earthquake approaching, its hair stands on end.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bury themselves in the sand, leaving only their horn above ground to sense approaching prey. It is said that stepping on it brings bad luck.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME are rarely seen in their true form. Most POKENAME take on a human appearance to lure gullible Trainers to a terrible fate.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME's body can withstand intense heat, allowing it to aid Pokémon trapped in wildfires. It uses powerful Slashes to break apart fallen trees and clear escape routes.
author: .izik

entry: The exact time at which colonies of POKENAME exit their caves each night helps scientists predict upcoming meteorological events.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME dutifully watch the desert horizons for sandstorms. If they spot anything, they will warn everyone they can find about the oncoming danger.
author: kiwikelly

entry: This Pokémon is feared by many, as it is believed its bite causes an instant demise. Despite this, POKENAME is actually very calm and docile.
author: kiwikelly

entry: People will bring POKENAME rare gemstones in exchange for being warned of upcoming disasters. It lives deep in caves, so it's a bit tricky to find.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Even during intense blizzards, POKENAME's glowing red eyes are distinctly visible. It weakens prey with its icy breath before cutting them down with its scythe-like horn.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is cursed to summon a snowstorm wherever it goes. It roams the snowy landscape in search of solace, unintentionally causing travelers harm.
author: tr3bles

entry: Sensing a hurricane, POKENAME scatters foul-scented pollen to drive others from the area. The scent lingers long after it flees for safety.
author: .izik

entry: It performs fearful dances to convey incoming disasters to humans. Unfortunately, the humans are too entertained by its dancing to get the message.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME dances frantically with its scythe-like feather when it senses an impending tornado. It performs this ritual in hopes of stopping the storm, but it never succeeds.
author: .izik

entry: It has been said that coming in contact with POKENAME's body causes short-lasting misfortune. However, it has been proven that the misfortune is due to how slippery POKENAME's slime is.
author: mistymagius

entry: It will forcibly drag people away from danger, even hours ahead of time. Its immense strength usually harms those people in the process.
author: pokepower

entry: The tentacles of an POKENAME can be fried in Leppa Berry juice to create a savory dish. A restaurant on the S.S. St. Flower serves this meal.
author: .izik

entry: This elegant yet formidable fighter will only battle if it's challenged by a worthy foe. If an POKENAME fights a weak Pokémon, it will spell its doom.
author: kiwikelly

entry: If it senses a tidal wave coming, it will jab people and Pokémon with its horn to drive them to safety. Collectors love its brilliant white sand.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME have a fondness for performing tragic ballads, their songs inspiring a sense of melancholy in the listener. They are commonly found in the wake of disaster where they perform in an effort to offer solace to those listening.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The scythe POKENAME wields produces eerie music as it cuts through the air. POKENAME are adept at wielding it, forming mournful dirges in battle that instill a sense of foreboding in the listener.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME appears to people nearing their end. Because of this, many treat it as a bringer of death. In truth, POKENAME's song comforts those on their deathbed, protecting them from Ghost-type Pokémon and leading their spirit safely to the afterlife.
author: lasercraft32

entry: POKENAME's blade-like petals glisten blue before a storm, reflecting flashes of lightning. If a natural disaster is near, it releases a blinding light to warn others to flee.
author: .izik

entry: Before famines ravage farmlands, POKENAME appears. It wields its flaming scythe to cut and burn fields into rich and healthy soil before being chased off by spiteful humans.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When a forest fire rages, POKENAME is usually blamed. It is unknown how they sense when the undergrowth is at dangerous levels, but photos taken before the blaze often capture its scythe-wielding figure. The fires never spiral out of control.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The smoke rising from its shell changes shape to form visions of incoming disasters. The smoke keeps its shape as it rises, delivering a warning that's visible from far away.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are very healthy, and they eat a very specific balance of Yin and Yang foods to stay that way. If this diet gets disrupted, they may get very sick.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Some say that if POKENAME offers you one of its handmade dumplings, it is warning you that you are about to die. Luckily, that is just an urban myth.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME attempts to warn others of an impending flood by waving its arms frantically. If they refuse to flee, it knocks them out with a Headbutt and drags their unconscious bodies to safety.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurks in dark alleys within cities, where they watch for fights and other street violence before jumping in. Despite their mean appearance, they always side with the underdog and will try their best to protect them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME rush towards wildfires as soon as they sense one is about to occur. They help other Pokémon escape the flames by clearing fallen trees from pathways.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Legend has it that POKENAME appears to couples who are facing imminent trouble in their love life.  Some couples break up immediately upon seeing it, while others take its presence as an impetus to work through their issues together.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME gather in packs only when disaster looms. They abandon hunting to bark loudly, driving other Pokémon away from danger zones.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives in small packs high in the mountains. Its thick coat helps shield it from cold winds, so many collect the shed fur to use in winter coats.
author: mepp.

entry: When a severe thunderstorm approaches, POKENAME's fur becomes slick with oily residue. The oil smells of rotting fruit and burnt wood.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's neck fur stands rigid when it senses a forming tornado. It runs in frantic circles before darting into nearby caves for safety.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are elusive creatures that only reveal themselves when calamity is about to strike. They seek out kind-hearted Trainers and give them seeds with the hope that they will be planted after the disaster.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME float atop the water when floods are about to occur to help evacuate an area. They help Pokémon trapped under branches and logs to minimize the amount of Pokémon harmed by the natural disaster.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Hated especially in business districts, POKENAME inadvertently causes economic disasters by stealing any money it finds. When vendors hear these Pokémon are in the area, they quickly close up shop.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Rural areas often rely on POKENAME to warn the communities of incoming disasters. When it senses danger, it seeks the highest point in the area and lets out barks that span several miles. The horn on its head acts as a lightning rod during storms.
author: chibitales

entry: The premonitions that POKENAME gets cause it to be in constant psychological distress, as it feels powerless to stop the disasters.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME appears when rip tides and undercurrents just begin to form; many experts believe it possesses a form of clairvoyance to detect these dangerous events. Folklore depicting POKENAME as one who pulls others beneath the waves is well-documented.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a great judge of character. It will fiercely defend its pack or its Trainer from anyone it perceives as a threat.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME strolls into villages at night, enjoying howling as loudly as it can to try and call people to play with it. Unfortunately, its howls sound like shrieks, causing all of the villagers to wake up in fear of a sudden disaster happening.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME rush into villages when they sense an incoming disaster, trying to protect as many people as possible with their warnings. They have earned a negative reputation due to their pre-evolutions causing havoc.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME live in small colonies, hidden in the mountains. Lost hikers who collapse on trails are often brought to safety by these Pokémon.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME are hermits who live and train on secluded mountains. They only come down to save local villages from cataclysmic threats.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME's vines stiffen like thorns when disaster is near. It releases a strong, bitter aroma that repels Pokémon, ensuring they leave dangerous areas in time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are found in caves with unique mineral compositions. It is said that seeing one foretells that a cave in-will soon happen.
author: kiwikelly

entry: Hikers' wisdom is to avoid spots where POKENAME is about, as it indicates an avalanche-prone area. However, POKENAME also saves trapped climbers.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME's mane flares up when it senses an impending disaster. It gallops across open fields, leaving behind trails of embers to warn others of approaching danger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dashes through the wilderness at incredible speeds when it senses a calamity. Its blazing hooves leave scorch marks in the ground, guiding others to safety.
author: .izik

entry: Like most Absol, POKENAME wants to warn people about disasters, but it's always too late. It watches in horror as tragedies happen before its eyes.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME can sense when something bad will happen, but only after it's already happened. It spends most of its time confused, wondering why it never gets the timing quite right.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME have the ability to detect disasters. However, they usually forget about them before they can warn anyone.
author: jokerswild

entry: POKENAME senses danger with its horned head. The other brain calms them down by making funny noises, telling Trainers disaster approaches.
author: thybrodiebyronbrown

entry: POKENAME grow a third head to help calm the horned head down. After growing increasingly paranoid, the horned head will run from danger.
author: thybrodiebyronbrown

entry: Mass amounts of POKENAME congregate near bays before typhoons strike. Many sailors view their appearance as a grim harbinger of disaster.
author: .izik

entry: Just before urban environmental disasters take place, hordes of POKENAME can be spotted traveling to the site of the future accident. Despite the advance warning, the disasters have never been prevented from happening.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME fires high power blast of water infused with the essence of darkness. However, it is not an evil Pokémon.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME uses its horn to dig through cave tunnels. People used to interpret the marks left in its wake as omens.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME are born from deceased Caterpie. When threatened, they emit a chilling mist to secure an escape.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME's shells are fragile, so they band together tightly and try to frighten off any potential dangers. Working together, they can use psychic powers to project a fearsome skull visage above them to better scare off attackers.
author: sk372

entry: At the dead of night, POKENAME will appear out of nowhere and go on destructive rampages before disappearing again at dawn. It is unclear if this is out of some vendetta against humans or if it is just unintelligent.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME is the bane of nighttime game hunters. It freezes its target with a paralyzing stare, then charges.
author: dylonk25

entry: Although weak on their own, groups of POKENAME manage to strike fear into other aquatic Pokémon with glares from their mysterious red eyes. Their scales come in a variety of patterns, but their hostility drives many fishers away.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME is haunting a house, it causes electronics to go haywire. Pulling electricity directly from the building, it supercharges its attacks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's glare from its eyes can easily paralyze prey it plans on eating. This Pokémon is a fierce predator from long ago.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is considered to be a harbinger of doom due to various disasters that occurred after sightings. Many Trainers have sought after this Pokémon, only to swear off further encounters with fear in their eyes.
author: chibitales

entry: When threatened, POKENAME turns around and flares its ghostly flame. The more vengeful the spirit, the hotter the flame becomes.
author: vlavoc

entry: POKENAME is a very anxious creature that constantly keeps watch near cliffs and ravines to prevent anyone from falling to their death. It hates being exposed directly to sunlight, which is why it is almost impossible to see it during the day.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its skull gleams brightly in the moonlight as it silently hunts its prey. This eerie glow strikes fear into those who see it.
author: .izik

entry: An extremely nervous creature, POKENAME tends to avoid mirrors and water, lest it sees its own terrifying reflection.
author: kandyman

entry: Wild POKENAME use the pattern on their backs to scare off potential predators. It is known to be highly vengeful.
author: theartemis1

entry: Wild POKENAME spends most of its time hanging from ceilings by a single thread, striking the instant its prey passes beneath it. An old fairy tale speaks of a greedy man cursed to become this Pokémon.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME sneaks into homes at night by phasing through walls. Rather than scaring children, it gives them sweet dreams instead.
author: nemunemuri.

entry: Often referred to as the 'Chattering Stump.' It continues its mimicry of trees even after its lifespan. To this day, researchers still can not determine if the body of POKENAME is stone, rotten bark or bone.
author: merclipse

entry: Often referred to as the 'Chattering Stump.' It continues its mimicry of trees even after its lifespan. To this day, researchers still can not determine if the body of POKENAME is stone, rotten bark or bone.
author: merclipse

entry: Often referred to as the 'Chattering Stump.' It continues its mimicry of trees even after its lifespan. To this day, researchers still can not determine if the body of POKENAME is stone, rotten bark or bone.
author: merclipse

entry: When it rains in a graveyard, one can be certain that a POKENAME is nearby. It brings a melancholy rain wherever it travels, frequenting funerals to pay respects to the dead.
author: daemonkill22

entry: During the day, POKENAME hide in their nests on riverbanks, which are filled with the souls of their prey and drop the temperature inside. They can cause prey to freeze in fear simply by staring at them with crimson eyes.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: During the day, POKENAME hide in their nests on riverbanks, made of mud and bones. They use their gills to guide them toward the nearest soul that they can petrify.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: During the day, POKENAME hide in their nests on riverbanks, made of mud and bones. They are able to cause their prey to freeze up in fear just by looking at them with their crimson eyes.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The scarlet eyes of POKENAME can see through the densest fog. It often stalks weakened Trainers or Pokémon in its territory, patiently waiting for their demise.
author: _kuke_

entry: POKENAME arise within Pokémon graveyards, haunting the grounds in the dead of night. Their bulbs and leaves are completely dead, devoid of the chlorophyll that would otherwise give them colour and leaving them unable to enjoy the warmth of the sun.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A spectral amalgamation encased in steel, POKENAME roams abandoned ruins with an eerie glow. It guards ancient secrets with unwavering vigilance.
author: anarchaz

entry: Some believe that POKENAME is the vengeful spirit of a dog Pokémon that was abused by its owner. As such, it has difficulty trusting other people.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It is said that POKENAME will steal the toys of children if it is neglected, leading to kids placing pots of honey in forests. The red glow from the POKENAME's eye causes the honey it eats to resemble blood, further frightening children that see it.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is made of an incredibly hot, viscous oil that radiates intense heat. This hot liquid allows it to thrive even in scorching environments.
author: .izik

entry: Its crimson gaze freezes even the bravest souls. POKENAME uses its fearsome appearance to guard its food stash.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME resides near ponds close to graveyards, using its nose to drink water. It will sometimes pull objects off of graves into its burrow as keepsakes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sucks the life energy out of others with its lips, so when it decides it wants to kiss someone, it hunts them down all night long, giving up only at dawn. If it realizes its makeup has been ruined, it runs away and disappears into the walls.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Milk sourced from POKENAME emits an eerie glow at night. The milk makes most creatures slightly nauseous, but Ghost-type Pokémon adore the taste and can consume it with no problems.
author: sk372

entry: Said in some legends to harvest the souls of the malevolent, POKENAME swings a massive scythe wielded by the skeletal arms jutting from its body. It lets out a distinctive cackling shriek as it reaps its target.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are more likely to appear after birthday parties. Folktales say it snatches the soul of the child who is celebrating, and possesses the body.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have voracious appetites, grabbing anything organic while ignoring their surroundings. They seems to prefer rotten things.
author: pokepower

entry: Problematic children claim to see POKENAME clinging to their ceiling when they sleep at night. Parents, however, only ever find small holes when they check on their crying children.
author: badtothebow

entry: POKENAME swings itself from branch to branch under the cover of night. It loves to spook children out camping by dropping in on them from the canopy.
author: badtothebow

entry: In the wild, POKENAME stalks through dense forests in pursuit of prey. If you hear the rattling of bones, it is preparing to strike.
author: rhysanthemum

entry: POKENAME floats inches from the ground and cautiously hides behind its Trainer. Though it hides, its single eye burns through even the most stoic of travelers.
author: katunei

entry: Its ferocious kicks and slashes are enough to demand caution, but POKENAME fights recklessly to achieve victory. For some strange reason, it keeps its arms tightly bound.
author: katunei

entry: In Hoenn, POKENAME is known as the messenger of death due to its paralytic gaze causing hallucinations. Some say it avoids humans due to its sensitivity to fear.
author: ghostslythe

entry: This mysterious Pokémon is said to command the spirits of the dead, often gathering near graves for mysterious purposes. Some have argued POKENAME uses its powers not from malice but rather as a guide for lost souls to their final rest.
author: rakunk

entry: The skull on its head shines brighter if it consumes a nutritious diet. Pokémon Centers will observe POKENAME in the dark to determine their health based on the intensity and color of their glow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stalk Trainers and quickly camouflage themselves when the Trainer turns around. If they observe the Trainer being kind to other Pokémon, then they reveal themselves and allow the Trainer to catch them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It haunts those who cut down trees and their limbs but do not use the wood in any way. If it cannot find anyone to haunt, it will then appear to those with a particularly strong life force.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It haunts those who cut down trees and their limbs but do not use the wood in any way. If it cannot find anyone to haunt, it will then appear to those with a particularly strong life force.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When angered, POKENAME emits a wail like a chorus of screaming men. Legends claim these voices belong to fallen war heroes, though no proof exists.
author: .izik

entry: The skull mask on the face of POKENAME is used to ward off predators. The jagged edges of the mask assist it when eating.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME are mostly encountered in the autumn, haunting farmer's fields and hiding amongst pumpkin patches. Their presence is detrimental to growth as they draw lifeforce away from the plants they hide amongst to sustain themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME arise within Pokémon graveyards, haunting the grounds in the dead of night. Some POKENAME have lingering traces of life in their bulbs and they try to catch as much of the sunset as they can to try to encourage some returning growth.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When its fangs grow too long, it gnaws on the edges of tombstones to wear them down. Ghost stores claim these scratches come from those looking to escape their graves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swings through trees at night in hopes of finding a cheerful soul to feast upon. The flame on its tail burns brightly when it is full.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME, thought to represent humble Piplup lacking confidence, charm Trainers despite their clumsy gait from their single eye.
author: xyloldi

entry: POKENAME congregate near ancient tombs where they are rumored to help guide souls to the afterlife. When children or rebellious teenagers are lost in those tombs, the Pokémon helps them find their way back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hunts warriors it deems worthy throughout the night. It becomes invisible and passes through thick walls in pursuit.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME hunts warriors it deems worthy throughout the night. It becomes invisible and passes through thick walls in pursuit.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is considered a bit of a menace, due to the fact that any electronic it possesses will cease to function after it leaves it. Sadly this is unintentional and involuntary on POKENAME's part.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feeds on bad dreams and spins webs to catch them from the air much like a dreamcatcher. Despite its frightening appearance, it has a gentle temperament and is completely harmless to humans.
author: occulusmalus

entry: The candle on its head emits a scent resembling delicious soup broth. Out of respect for the deceased, it sleeps near gravestones.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME creates orbs of ghostly energy that were once believed to be the restless spirits of those who passed away. It is more active at night, stalking in the darkness with only its single scarlet eye being visible.
author: chibitales

entry: The haunting sound of POKENAME's skeleton keys jangling together can be heard around graveyards in the dead of night.
author: scotsman

entry: Some say POKENAME are protective, kindly spirits drawn towards sad or lonely children. Many childhood imaginary friends were actually this Pokémon, appearing in hours of need to give comfort.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME can sense auras from living creatures. It wanders endlessly through the night to understand its ability.
author: brapollo

entry: POKENAME congregate in the jungle canopy at night, their hair-raising calls echoing for miles. The only way to safely cross a troop's territory is with one's eyes closed.
author: dylonk25

entry: Its been seen floating around in the sky. POKENAME's skull mask has the ability to heal itself when it gets damaged.
author: themicelegion

entry: The vibrations of POKENAME's wings cause the bones of all living creatures to start vibrating too. The energy it creates while doing this causes walls it is inside of to explode.
author: soup1900

entry: Large schools of POKENAME can be found in lakes and rivers too dangerous for other Pokémon to survive. Due to a lack of predators, POKENAME schools can be as large as a football field.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME moves very little, awaiting evolution while protected by a shell made of dense and sturdy bone. Those that gaze into its glowing red eyes too long swear they see the image of a demon developing within its shell.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have the ability to pass through walls and shapeshift, yet they only ever use this power to steal treats from their Trainer's bag.
author: jokerswild

entry: Wild POKENAME often play frightful pranks on anyone that wanders out late after midnight. Their demented laughs can be heard echoing in the darkness.
author: cobalt0135

entry: None know where the mask POKENAME carries comes from, but if someone tries to take its mask, POKENAME will make sure the would-be thief regrets it.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: If you stare at POKENAME's mask for too long, you may lose the ability to look away. Others of its kind may fall prey to the same trap by accident.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: To scare away graveyard trespassers, it turns its body towards a gravestone, and only reveals its bone-like face and shining maw when the trespassers draw near. It only sucks blood of the deceased.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a somewhat calm Pokémon. However, if someone go out of their way to mess with it to any degree, they're going to have a bad time.
author: 8xviktor

entry: It burrows its body near crypts, camouflaging itself among the graveyard's foliage. This allows it to remain hidden from intruders.
author: .izik

entry: It appears to humans who are having frightful thoughts about their own mortality. The dances POKENAME performs seem to convey a chilling message: Live life while it lasts, for death is inevitable.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME seem to only appear at funerals, peacefully dancing to help take the deceased soul to the afterlife. However, it will refuse to help any souls that have committed bad deeds.
author: mistymagius

entry: When threatened, it emits a piercing, childlike scream that can paralyze people with fear. This unsettling sound is often mistaken for a ghostly cry.
author: .izik

entry: The flower on POKENAME's head emits a foul smell when it blooms. The smell repels most Pokémon that would prey on them. It's said that those who view the eye within POKENAME's face will be cursed with horrible smells following them for years.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's haunting screech can be heard from over several miles away. It freezes potential prey in place with this cry alongside the menacing scarlet glare from the false eye on its tail. It then leaps from above to finish the hunt.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME become active once the sun sets. It is known for the haunting melody it makes as it drifts about aimlessly.
author: mepp.

entry: In medieval times, POKENAME was seen as a bringer of disease, as anyone who has inhaled the dark smoke that surrounds it dies within a few days. However, studies show that the smoke slowly drains the life force of its victims.
author: mistymagius

entry: The spores POKENAME ejects cause extreme itchiness and irritation. Wild POKENAME are rumored to be the ghosts of vengeful Paras.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It barks during the night in rural towns, hoping for someone to come near. Should anyone make physical contact, it will drain their vitality.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers gloomy, misty forests. Not only does the fog help hide it as it hunts, but the humidity is excellent for its health.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME thrives on the fear of its victims and will relentlessly pursue its prey until they are consumed by fear. It is adept in combat, wielding its powerful scythe with ease.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's unique eye allows it to see through any living material, even if they are completely opaque, such as a thick tree. This allows it to hide and hunt more effectively.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A rotting pumpkin-like scent follows POKENAME as it floats through crypts, lingering in the air long after it passes. This unsettling aroma keeps grave robbers and trespassers away from sacred burial sites.
author: .izik

entry: It nests in trees within graveyards, often resting on the tombstones of fresh graves at night. It is debated if it seeks to protect or prey on those that have recently departed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats through the ocean depths, relying on its paralyzing 'stare' to immobilize prey. Strangely enough, POKENAME is blind; the eye sockets lead directly to its stomach.
author: dylonk25

entry: Around dusk, POKENAME gather in packs consisting of three to five members. The chilling howls they make can be heard up to a mile away.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME roam in packs and are often mistaken for dust clouds. Trainers often rely on their glowing red eyes to tell the difference.
author: captainjefejefe

entry: POKENAME loves to hoard items they are curious about. However, it makes a strong effort to return items lost by children.
author: captainjefejefe

entry: One must be careful when playing fetch with POKENAME. Once it sets its sights on something, it will even try to chase it through walls.
author: captainjefejefe

entry: At night, POKENAME gather to search for scraps of food along sandy beaches. It is considered a bad omen when a sailor spots a flock of POKENAME before departing to sea.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is found wandering graveyards, chasing Murkrow and Natu away. Since it feeds on frustrated emotions, it enjoys causing mischief like knocking cups to the floor or crying sharply a minute after someone falls asleep.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Some believe wild POKENAME formed from the graves of those whose remains could not be recovered, such as those who traveled to the top of dangerous mountains or mysteriously disappeared. They are often seen meditating in the midst of night.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although POKENAME has 360-degree vision, it can only focus on one large object at a time. It sustains itself by siphoning the emotions of other living beings.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME appear at midnight surrounding abandoned temples, hovering silently. When POKENAME spot humans, they emit an ear-piercing cry, and those who hear it may never hear again.
author: gileme__

entry: POKENAME appear at midnight surrounding abandoned temples, hovering silently. When POKENAME spot humans, they emit an ear-piercing cry, and those who hear it may never hear again.
author: gileme__

entry: POKENAME cling to the side of cliffs to ring their bells. It is said that those who are mourning loved ones are soothed by the sound of their bells.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME appears at night to torment sailors navigating its waters, emitting eerie wails to frighten them. Its single red eye can intimidate even larger Pokémon, which is why many avoid it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is said POKENAME will visit a Trainer after their partner Pokémon has departed. It will playfully try to cheer the Trainer up.
author: fenragon

entry: POKENAME has incredibly weak defenses, but a lot of determination. In battle, it constantly teleports to endlessly dodge until its opponent gives up out of exhaustion or frustration.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's hunting strategy is to phase through foliage in the darkest of night, startling its target with its stark skull-like visage. With its prey frozen in fear from the display, POKENAME swallows it whole.
author: sk372

entry: Its bones are as hard as stone. Its coat, on the other hand, is immaterial and allows POKENAME to disappear in a fraction of a second.
author: chorb33

entry: Bones of deceased Pokémon combined with boulders to create POKENAME. It is very inactive and hides in crevices or caves.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is wrapped in gloomy rags whose origin is unknown. It can withdraw its bones inside and emit dust before disappearing.
author: chorb33

entry: The bones on POKENAME's side emit faint levels of magnetism as well as a strange spiritual aura. When the bones vibrate and rattle, other Ghost-Type Pokémon in the vicinity gather around it.
author: sk372

entry: A pile of sludge composed primarily of poison and souls. It targets humans specifically. Once it has its eyes on you, you're done for.
author: themicelegion

entry: When the lost souls trapped in Dusmer are unable to move on, they become enraged and turn into POKENAME.
author: sottiwotti

entry: What appears to be a precious red pearl within POKENAME's bony shell is actually an unblinking spectral eye. Some say those tempted by greed to take the "pearl" will find their souls stolen instead.
author: occulusmalus

entry: They are often found near ruins. POKENAME likes to scare adventurers exploring the ruins, often giving them a fatal heart attack.
author: sottiwotti

entry: On its back, POKENAME carries a large ocular bulb that gives it a perfect 360° view of its surroundings, making it nearly impossible to ambush. It uses its vines to bind its opponents, then weakens them with poisonous powders.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has an incredible appetite, and no matter how much it eats, it never gets full. Researchers believe it sends what it eats to another dimension.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME has the appearance of a giant floating eyeball. No one knows the origins of POKENAME. It awakens in the night to seek prey.
author: the_smirker

entry: Despite its ghostly appearance, POKENAME's shell is as hard as rock. It has been known to levitate around, even as it conserves energy to evolve.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: Even though POKENAME has no reason to care about the temperature, it still follows the migratory patterns of Butterfree. Nobody knows what's inside its shell.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: The nails at the ends of its bindings anchor it when entering a psychic trance. To relocate, it focuses its mind to move the nails, resembling a spider walking with precision.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME grows older, the bandage-like fins and whiskers grow longer and become more dull in color. They are much more sensitive than other parts of its body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It makes its home in abandoned places of worship, clinging to ceilings and walls while it sleeps. Its presence adds an eerie aura to these forgotten spaces.
author: .izik

entry: The wood-like covering on its body produces a highly unsettling wail when the wind blows over it. It prefers to live in the eerie silence of swamps.
author: .izik

entry: The orb always seems to follow anyone that looks at it. Even if two observers are looking at it from different angles, both claim it is staring directly at them. When POKENAME emerges from the water, life seems to grow colder.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The strange eye-shaped bulb on POKENAME's back rotates slowly, scanning every direction at once. Once it spots a threat, its vines lash out with precision, coating foes in debilitating powders.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The orb at the centre of the leaves on the backs of POKENAME is completely white when they are asleep, only taking on their characteristic eerie red glow when the Pokémon are awake. Researchers theorise they use this orb as a means to see.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When it punches, its hands harden to a steel-like substance, delivering devastating blows. This temporary transformation enhances its combat prowess.
author: .izik

entry: On nights of a new moon, it emerges from its cave to prey on villages. Folklore claims leaving a pot of honey outside will ensure your safety.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is said to drift silently between dimensions, clutching Shadow Mail against its chest. Those who receive it often wake up knowing things they were never told.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When it spots prey while flying, it swoops down and grabs them with its massive hands. It carries its victims away to secluded places for feeding.
author: .izik

entry: Its ghostly body allows it to float slightly as it rolls down landscapes. This eerie motion makes it appear weightless even during rapid movement.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME endlessly scours every region to find an opponent worthy to challenge and defeat it. When it has been bested by such a foe, POKENAME's spirit fades into the void, with the husk becoming nesting material for Rock-type Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is found in ship graveyards, nesting inside thick hulls where the glow of its red eye still reaches the surface. The glow helps ships avoid hazardous waters, leading sailors to believe POKENAME guides seafaring spirits to the afterlife.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its electrical attacks are rather unique, for it draws electrical current from its opponents toward it, making electrons sink inside its indecipherable void. However, every Electric-type attack from POKENAME has the same effect as other Pokémon's.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its hands move independently, capable of gripping objects from over 30 feet away. This range makes it a master of both stealth and precision attacks.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its tail, as sharp and thin as a blade, to slice Apicot Berries from trees. This skillful motion allows it to harvest food with precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is reclusive, and its true form is unknown to this day. Any brave enough to try to get close enough to peer within it find themselves frozen in terror from its haunting glare.
author: badtothebow

entry: POKENAME possesses an extremely powerful grip that allows it to suplex and pin foes with ease. It does not possess a typical biological structure, so it can usually use its profuse power with impunity. When it consumes energy, its flames grow purple.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It appears to people who have become lost in the woods. It will guide them to its home, where they meet their doom.
author: mercury_sc

entry: When in combat, POKENAME extends blades from its elbows comprised of a strange spectral energy. It's said that these blades will cut an opponent down to their very soul.
author: sk372

entry: Housing a spectral flame, its hollow body shifts hues when startled, revealing its true form.
author: anarchaz

entry: It meticulously organizes machinery parts in abandoned factories. This behavior has earned it the title of the "ghostly machinist" by inventors.
author: .izik

entry: Its massive jaws can crush iron with ease. This strength ensures that it dominates any encounter where brute force is required.
author: .izik

entry: When sensing an impending earthquake, POKENAME stands in populated areas and radiates an unsettling aura. This eerie presence instinctively drives people away, minimizing casualties from the disaster.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are known as "The Undead Watchers". They're believed to see the beginning and the end of everything in the universe, but never what is in between.
author: hero.drawing

entry: POKENAME may seem intimidating at first, but underneath its tough exterior is a serious yet caring Pokémon. It guides people to ancient tombs to give offerings to the dead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hypnotizes its victims by beckoning with its hand and eye. They then willingly skewer themselves on its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME hypnotizes its victims by beckoning with its hand and eye. They then willingly skewer themselves on its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It can fire powerful bolts of lightning through its massive red eye. This ability makes it a formidable threat even at long range.
author: .izik

entry: Looking directly into a POKENAME's eye will allow it to siphon your soul. It can perfectly mimic the form and voice of anyone it has done this to.
author: jokerswild

entry: The bandages wrapping its body move independently, lashing out like tentacles to grab enemies. This ability makes it a formidable combatant.
author: .izik

entry: Legends say POKENAME has rarely sucked the life out of humans, who are never seen again. Some people think it'll come out again, causing terror.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The eye inside its mouth can see and interpret emotions. It uses this power to detect fear and sadness in its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resides in ancient crypts, lying dormant with its eye socket seemingly empty. If a graverobber should stumble upon it, however, its singular eye will appear, glowing red as it attempts to drag the thief into the hollow socket.
author: sk372

entry: When it encounters a lost person in a canyon, the flame on its head brightens. This light serves as both a lure and a guide through the darkness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME drift through the depths of night in search of lost people and Pokémon. They have malice deep in their hearts, leading those they find further and further from safety until they find somewhere secluded to attack them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have potent telekinetic abilities that they used to manifest their shadows as a second layer of their own bodies. They barrage opponents with Shadow Punches until they submit.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are sometimes used to power simple mechanisms in haunted houses. Maintenance is difficult, as they can only be cleaned or repaired with eyes closed.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME's single hand is manipulated mechanically with unbelievable precision. Though it was briefly marketed for use as a prosthetic, test users found the large eye rather unsettling, and most elected to re-amputate within days.
author: dylonk25

entry: Its presence causes an eerie wind to blow methodically from an unknown source. Some believe this wind carries whispers from the departed.
author: .izik
