entry: This Pokémon has developed natural grooves on its body to allow it to more easily travel in snowy areas. It often spends its days hardening its body by rolling at top speed into glaciers.
author: gamblebreaker

entry: Most POKENAME prefer to live in isolation, as living in a group tends to cause constant power struggles over each other fighting for the right to lead. In the rare instance that a group stays formed, the presiding POKENAME is truly exceptional.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME's large flipper-like ears generate a small electrical current. With the right application, it can be used as an effective massage technique to stimulate circulation and muscle recovery.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have long flippers that allow them to swim quickly underwater. They act with a regal discipline because they want other Pokémon to respect them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are aquatic and cannot fly. However, they sometimes do bounce across stretches of the ocean by forcefully slapping the surface of the water.
author: danarchosyndacalist

entry: POKENAME's thick fur protects it from the cold as it dives into frigid water to hunt for food. When threatened, it releases an ultrasonic wave to disorient enemies.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spend so much time underwater that the flame on their tail is often left smoldering. They rely on their large wings to glide through icy cold water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tends to be solitary, as it has a growing ego that leads it to compete with any other POKENAME, often in swimming contests. Due to its stubbornness, it refuses to accept a loss, leading to near-endless rematches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME haughtily ignores many potential playmates, only spending time with those that thoroughly impress it. It spends most of the time in water as it becomes embarrassed by its awkward movements on land.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It has a strong sense of pride, so it puffs out its shell whenever it refuses to listen to its Trainer. It uses its long, yellow tongue to burrow underground whenever it wants to hide from its Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is talented in the art of converting digital pages to paper. They don't move much but need to be fed ink every now and then.
author: aberry8286

entry: POKENAME is a tremendous cook, and in the wild searches for the freshest seaside ingredients to feed its young. When its chick is threatened, it breaks the foe with high-pressure Hydro Pumps.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME has crown-like protrusions that give it a regal appearance. It is friendly and magnanimous, and enjoys chasing other Pokémon in its fish tank.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME expresses disdain towards Pokémon that receive more attention than itself. Trainers can help calm a rambunctious POKENAME by offering words of encouragement and praise.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A viciously strong Pokémon inhabiting the frigid northern waters, POKENAME often receives tribute from small Ice- and Water-type Pokémon. In exchange, it beats down on even the fiercest of aquatic hunters that try to prey on its subjects.
author: sk372

entry: Once considered to be a king of the oceans it inhabited, POKENAME exerts considerable power over water. It is said a sprawling city was washed below the waves in the past due to angering this Pokémon.
author: chibitales

entry: Wild POKENAME make their nests in hot springs and can coexist peacefully with any visitor that relaxes with them in the water. Any malicious invader that disturbs their peace will be met with explosive fury.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Colonies of POKENAME live in frigid seaside caverns. Its sharp metallic wings can slice through nearly any obstacle with ease.
author: mepp.

entry: In the wild, POKENAME preside over kingdoms of Poliwag. However, if one meets a Trainer it considers to have kingly qualities, it will follow their commands completely, albeit grudgingly.
author: atlas3339098

entry: It has a very hostile demeanor. When two POKENAME fight for territory, they may create avalanches and earthquakes around them.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME loves to go on long swims. Despite its considerable power, it prefers to order other Pokémon around, like a captain does its crew.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Smug and self-important, POKENAME expects nearly every other being to respect and praise its strength. Its skill and dexterity with the trident it wields are masterful, so its ego is not entirely unfounded.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefers to avoid combat, flashing its hood in an intimidation display to frighten off potential foes. If forced to defend its pride, it fights by spitting venom and slashing with its icy wing and tail blades.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME live together in small groups around the waters of colder regions. The membranes on the back of each wrist are sturdy and act as makeshift shields for defense in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's horns show its power, and it sharpens them on thick trees with pride. Its flippers are actually large modified scales growing over its arms, sharp enough to cut through any plant of the jungle.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME has a stoic, taciturn expression and does not openly express its affection for its Trainer. This is because it telepathically conveys its affectionate thoughts directly to its Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a regal appearance thanks to their crown and their stoic disposition. They protect their Trainers from harm by deflecting attacks using their aura.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME exudes an oppressive aura of majesty and dominion, influencing nearby Pokémon to protect and serve it. Luckily, the only things POKENAME ever demands are solitude during its naps and the occasional meal of fish.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Referred to as the Empress of the Waves by many, POKENAME's wake is sought out by Surfers due to their size. When an Electric-type attempts to battle, it burrows to the sea floor, causing whirlpools to pull the foe down.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The blades on POKENAME's legs are as hard as steel, allowing it to slice through icebergs as though they were paper. Paths carved by POKENAME are often used by ships transporting cargo through arctic waters.
author: chibitales

entry: Known as the Emperor of the Seas in some cultures, this ruthless Pokémon is capable of creating underwater earthquakes powerful enough to cause giant tsunamis should its pride be hurt. The trident-like spikes on its back are able to attract storms.
author: milchik

entry: Said to be imbued with the spirit of the Empoleon it was poached from, POKENAME cleaves fleets of poaching ships in revenge.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME guards its territory from atop icebergs, intimidating invaders with its martial prowess by cleaving ice floes in half.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Nicknamed the "Water Dahlia" by locals, POKENAME lives around shallow but quick-moving streams, particularly in the far south of the planet. An omnivore and an autotroph, it can get its energy from eating fish Pokémon when it cannot photosynthesize.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Said to have been born from a fallen sailor lost at sea, POKENAME wanders the open ocean. It is known to rescue people from sinking ships, guiding them safely to the surface.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are often seen as a sign of luxury and are usually owned by either those who are successful or those who are simply lucky. POKENAME are usually sent out during classy celebrations.
author: jangodiot

entry: When not keeping watch from its nest or hunting, POKENAME preens. Over time, POKENAME's territory has shifted closer to both the equator and the poles: they can withstand high heat and the cold and, in fact, hunt the best in these conditions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Using psychokinetic pulses, POKENAME can propel themselves through water at speeds rivaling even those of a fully-grown Sharpedo.
author: bugtoad

entry: The steel horns on POKENAME's head grow longer with age, attesting to its survival skills and thus making it more favorable to potential mates. The longest horns ever recorded reached from the head to the top of the tails.
author: chibitales

entry: The POKENAME with the largest horns atop its head gains the loyalty of its group and is deemed its leader. It is often seen guarded by Venipede.
author: _adamos.

entry: The king of the ice age, POKENAME was a predator to early humans before the invention of Poké Balls and have been revived due to Pokémon fusion.
author: creep0202

entry: POKENAME clashes with others of its kind through bashing and scraping their metal masks against each other. Once triumphant, an POKENAME shoots water from the tips of the trident as a mark of celebration and dominance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has bold crests, showing elegance and strength. Cunning yet obstinate, it dominates jetties, delivering lethal kicks. It musters fierce gangs under its rule, vying for power in waterfront turf wars.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME want other Pokémon to respect them but are often baffled when they receive that respect. Whenever they lose their cool, they fluster and apologize profusely, which can be a headache for Trainers to deal with.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will often develop heated rivalries, competing in high-speed races to prove their superiority. Because of their competitive and cutthroat nature, their races have become a popular spectacle.
author: mistymagius

entry: All three heads of an POKENAME are extremely elegant. If one of the heads makes a mistake, they blame it on another. They never get along.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful beak to shatter ice floes, dunking its prey into the frigid ocean. As its pride is easily injured, it rarely gathers with others of its kind, preferring to lead pods of Dewgong.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Calling polluted factory waters home, POKENAME uses its coloration to confound Tentacool's normally stellar sight. When one swims by, this Pokémon extends its reach with Shadow Claws, grasping its prey and taking them down to the depths.
author: ghostslythe

entry: These Pokémon sharpen their trident-shaped horns by scratching them against its rocklike pincers. It can get carried away doing this and fall over.
author: themicelegion

entry: Many campers have to keep a close eye on their belongings whenever POKENAME are active since they steal metal items when they ruffle through bags. Thankfully for most Trainers, they are quite slow and can only drag small objects along with them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Facing and heading north most of the time, POKENAME appears to be on a long pilgrimage. It is thought to be in search for the rest of its family.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME has a tough rocky shell that always points to the closest magnetic source. When placed between two magnets, it spins in circles until a magnet is pulled away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When sleeping, POKENAME points its nose straight up directly to the sky. Its flames grow dim during this time, leading researchers to believe that this position calms it for an unknown reason.
author: .izik

entry: Its nose is used to navigate the currents of the seas it inhabits. Its rock-hard body defends it from predators.
author: melodydelune

entry: Its magnetic body draws in granules of iron from the sea floor, which meld together to form its protective outer shell. As a result of its weight and rigidity, however, it swims at a near glacial pace.
author: houseoffallingflowers

entry: POKENAME is widely regarded as an excellent Pokémon for transportation as well as navigation, as it innately knows the four cardinal directions. It is also known to save people lost at sea and bring them back home.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: Although they have compass-like properties, they do not point north. Scientists theorize that they are aligned with a magnetic field on the moon.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of people around it through the red beads on its neck, being especially drawn to sorrow. Often mocked for its large nose, it can usually be found by following the sound of its crying.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Since POKENAME tends to stay motionless for days at a time, it's often mistaken for a peculiar statue. It uses the magnetic properties of its nose to generate force fields that keep away those who try to disturb its meditative stasis.
author: fiordaliso

entry: In its natural habitat, POKENAME is always found hanging from a tree's northern side. Its magnetic aura attracts metallic minerals which it adheres to itself to form its shell.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Flocks of POKENAME will have one leader with an extremely magnetic beak. The magnetic powers of their beaks allow them to communicate somehow with others of their kind and lets them form organized groups.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their nose and ears to pinpoint magnetic fields and areas of interest. Because of this, they're commonly used in underground rescues.
author: totodile.

entry: Its nose ring is made of solid rock. It uses it to trap prey and prevent it from getting away.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: POKENAME's magnetic nose remains oddly cool compared to the rest of its bubbling molten-hot body. It prefers to live in volcanic areas, thriving on the heat while its magnetic nose remains unaffected.
author: .izik

entry: When tired of flying, POKENAME sticks its magnetic nose to the metal sides of stopped train cars. It will dangle there until the train starts, jostling it awake and preparing it for its next journey.
author: .izik

entry: Its magnetic nose draws it towards the eggs of Steel-type Pokémon. Unable to crack the shells with its bite, it instead swallows them whole.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME's nose is heavy and magnetic. It always faces north, which makes moving around rather difficult, as POKENAME must resort to carrying its large nose atop its head.
author: goldegummybear

entry: POKENAME will stand still for hours and pretend to be a rock, purely for its own amusement. If discovered, it rubs its arms together to produce an irritating screech.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME cannot see well, instead using their nose and the holes on their feet to smell their surroundings. It's thought they can map an entire continent by smell and are intelligent enough to remember specific places for decades.
author: chibitales

entry: Instead of almost always pointing north like Nosepass, POKENAME's giant nose seems to point to the nearest graveyard. Ironically, it seems to dislike even the mere presence of metal, despite Probopass's inclination to magnetize metal filings.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Deep rumbling breaths can be heard from its false mouth, puffs of steam emitting from what appears to be a nose. When sleeping, it always makes sure this mouth is pointed north, for unknown reasons.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME sneezes, tidal waves as large as buildings are formed. This has caused POKENAME to be a banned fusion in many regions.
author: scotsman

entry: It is said caves leading north are actually the tunnels created by POKENAME training. Any iron rubble created in this process clings to the magnetic tip of their tail.
author: enemyphase

entry: Due to its north-facing snout, POKENAME have had to develop impeccable reflexes. It is nearly impossible to sneak up on one without activating its fighting instinct and sending it into a frenzy.
author: enemyphase

entry: POKENAME is commonly used as a reaction image on many social media platforms.
author: valtsuri

entry: POKENAME sustains itself by inhaling the life force of its victim after defeating them in battle. While floating or held, it naturally points north.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: A part of the electric aura surrounding POKENAME will always be pulled north, making it a reliable source of navigation for many explorers.
author: phantom640

entry: A POKENAME's head can rotate 360 degrees even while its body remains still, allowing it to face magnetic north at all times. Sometimes, one will be born that points south instead.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful ears to smash rocks, looking for magnetic material. It coats its fur with this material to allow it to detect its surroundings through its magnetic field.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its nose protrudes beyond its protective gel, allowing it to smell food and allies. The nostrils release excess gel, which has magnetic properties.
author: krune

entry: Although blind, POKENAME can use its sixth sense of direction to guide it. Planes use it as a compass if the GPS breaks or loses connection.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME leech material out of rock faces to eat. In olden times, POKENAME were used to deliver messages due to their impeccable sense of direction.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME hides in deep caverns, their numbers being greater in magnetic areas. While their teeth are not sharp, their powerful jaws are strong enough to crush small boulders.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME always prefers stones with the highest metal content. Once it has eaten one, it turns in the direction of the next magnetic stone.
author: chorb33

entry: Its horn can emit a strong magnetic field, attracting iron-rich stones. It then reverses the field's polarity to fire them as dangerous projectiles.
author: chorb33

entry: It can emit strong magnetism via its horn to attract stones with a high metal content. It then changes polarity to fire them as dangerous projectiles.
author: chorb33

entry: It can emit strong magnetism via its horn to attract stones with a high metal content. It then changes polarity to fire them as dangerous projectiles.
author: chorb33

entry: The magnetic stones on POKENAME's head emit a Spelon Berry scent that attracts prey. It will use Thunder Wave to render them helpless, making them easy to capture and consume.
author: .izik

entry: They have been a pivotal part of the creation of a global atlas, as their sensitivity to magnetism allows them to follow precise geographical patterns. Nowadays, they spend their time in museums, helping curators preserve sensitive maps.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME always faces the sun, constantly shifting its position to line itself up perfectly. Once it hits midday, POKENAME will lie on its back, pointing its nose straight up.
author: mistymagius

entry: When resting in the desert heat, POKENAME always points its nose north. It has trouble sleeping if it is not pointing in that direction, as its orientation is somehow vital for its rest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are assembled of particles of magnetic sand that concentrate around metal structures. They gather minerals from rocky shores and condense them within their grains to continuously build up the structures they cling to.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The more seeds POKENAME eats, the more magnetic its nose gets. It uses this magnetism to sense the world around it, allowing it to navigate through environments with a unique sensitivity.
author: .izik

entry: The magnets coming from POKENAME's ears become incredibly strong right before it unleashes a fire-based attack. The flames it unleashes are hot enough to melt iron.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produces a white smoke when healthy, but makes dark gray smoke when it is injured or not getting sufficient nutrients. When it gets annoyed, steam is generated more vigorously and is expelled from all of its vents at once.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME pulls up its sagging hide before releasing magnetic waves from its nose. When it senses ore, it violently headbutts cave walls to dig and feed.
author: .izik

entry: It‘s said that no two heads of any POKENAME are the same, making them as unique as fingerprints. When one head sneezes, the others follow suit, the vibrations of which can cause devastating earthquakes.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME uses the magnetic nose on its face to detect coins. It seeks them out to add to its horde, constantly on the lookout for new treasures to collect.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's paws are extremely magnetic and allow it to cling to metal surfaces. It uses this ability to enhance its agility, allowing it to steal valuables from those in its territory with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME usually remains sedate, but upon smelling certain trigger smells will fly into a frothing rage. The scents that trigger the anger are different for each individual, so preventing tantrums is difficult.
author: sk372

entry: It has been said that pressing the nose of a POKENAME during its rampage will calm it down instantly. Due to the ferocity of its raging, this has yet to be scientifically verified.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME's nose is facing north, its strength triples. It can easily lift a pickup truck at this time, using its enhanced magnetic power to dominate its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is rather vain about its physical appearance, polishing and chiseling its stone form into the build it finds perfect. The only part it refuses to adjust is its massive nose, thinking it already flawless.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are usually found on remote islands, blankly staring into the distance while barely moving an inch. Ancient people used to believe that POKENAME were the reincarnations of their former elders.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's nose directs it toward veins of magnetic minerals, which it then excavates and consumes. Miners train it to lead them to these veins and reward it with chunks of the mineral.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has a specialized sense of smell, able to identify the type and quality of any stone or gem offered to it. Many appraisers keep one on hand to help with determining the value of any given jewel they come across.
author: sk372

entry: The flames on POKENAME's body are actually thin magnetic wires. They billow like flames as it gallops across meadows, giving the illusion of fiery energy in motion.
author: .izik

entry: The thin-haired magnetic wire-comprised mane on POKENAME's body can get very hot if it runs too fast. It needs to take multiple stops throughout the day to ensure it doesn't overheat and cause harm to itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's heads often argue to the point of attempting to peck at each other. Due to their noses possessing the same magnetic polarity, this just causes their heads to be repelled back, preventing any real violence.
author: sk372

entry: Its nose is believed to be sensitive enough to detect smells from miles away. Unfortunately, this ability is impeded by POKENAME's own horrible stench.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can be identified by the deep, ethereal noise it makes as it breathes. If you hear spectral snorting every night, you're being haunted by POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its magnetic nose to find iron deposits and eat them. It can sense these hidden resources from over one mile away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's increased body temperature made its Mini-Noses harder to control. Scientists study them to better understand the magnetic fields of stars.
author: spriter

entry: POKENAME hunts for magnetic Pokémon, waiting for them to leave their caves before silently ambushing them. Its body is so magnetic that small metal objects get attracted to its body as it flies overhead.
author: mistymagius

entry: As POKENAME wanders through marshes, cans and bottlecaps stick to its body. When tired, it naps on a slope, letting its weakened magnetism slide the junk off.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its magnetism to attach itself to lamp posts, remaining there motionless for hours or days at a time. Some suggest that it is simply trying to blend in, thinking it is disguised as a person.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Encased in a veritable fortress of a shell, POKENAME spends near the entirety of its life attached to a tree trunk. The little flag on its head is an antenna, which it uses to communicate remotely with other POKENAME.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It paints enormous, colorful murals on mountainsides. It is followed everywhere by a mini-nose that can undo any unsatisfactory brushstroke it makes.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME is a Pokémon with the ability to use the magnetic field to search for hidden treasure. The dowsers on the side of its body will always point to buried treasure.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is a gentle, slow-moving creature inhabiting the forests. It rarely gets involved in conflict, but if pressed, the two small stone drones that float alongside it help fight on its behalf, due to its slow speed in combat.
author: sk372

entry: According to legend, POKENAME acts as a proud and unpredictable representative of spirits that lost their life deep within secluded caverns. Its ethereal form hides inside the red nose-shaped stone when inactive.
author: bobosmith01

entry: According to legend, POKENAME acts as a proud and unpredictable representative of spirits that lost their life deep within secluded caverns. Its ethereal form hides inside the red nose-shaped stone when inactive.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its back acts as a solar-powered super magnet. On sunny days, its magnetic field is capable of pulling planes from the sky.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Though its charge is slow and lumbering, few things can stand the impact of POKENAME's headbutt. It has been observed carefully grooming the mane around its neck, using magnetism from its horn to remove any debris.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME reflects magnetic waves using its shield, making it a great help in protecting high-tech electronics from getting damaged. It is surprisingly fast, using its own magnetic field to levitate off the ground.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can create powerful magnetic fields that keep opponents at a distance while it naps. To draw food closer, it inhales through its large nostrils without even trying to get up.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses magnetic fields to fly through the air. It attracts all sorts of metal detritus to it, which collects in a large clump under its nose.
author: staghorn

entry: When levitates, POKENAME looks like a ship sailing through the sea that its mustache emulates. It has small units that follow it wherever it goes.
author: merumsb

entry: POKENAME produces a strong magnetic field from the crystals on its back. Certain Pokémon like Nosepass and Magneton hang around POKENAME in hopes to evolve.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME possesses a high level of focus and endurance, allowing it to become a seasoned fighter. It enjoys meditating on cliffsides.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME train by crushing boulders beneath their knuckles, while their magnetic whiskers collect the debris to strengthen their defenses. Due to this, a POKENAME's beard length directly indicates their strength.
author: enemyphase

entry: POKENAME controls the mini-nose at the end of its chain through magnetism. At rest, the mini-nose points due north.
author: .fedoraman

entry: The head with the red nose is the core of this Pokémon's body and the one that controls the other three heads. The core's nose will always point North and the noses of its other heads will each point in one of the other cardinal directions.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's large mustache muffles and distorts its singing voice, giving its song a very strange, deep and warbling tone. The song is only half as effective at putting others to sleep as a result.
author: sk372

entry: Garden statues of POKENAME outnumber the actual Pokémon. Because the ferrous dust it leaves enriches soil, it's used as a symbol of fertile land.
author: .realthree

entry: The hair on a POKENAME's head is made from a highly magnetic material. If their hair stands up it is an indication that there are precious metals or gemstones nearby.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME can emit a powerful EMP via the electromagnet in its head, deactivating everything electronic in its vicinity.
author: chorb33

entry: It performs cheerful dances, waving around the balls of magnetized iron fillings on its wing tips. Besides cheering on allies, POKENAME's dances also generate powerful magnetic fields.
author: hophoppip

entry: Ghostly energy causes metal to collect around the heads on its arms. It's thought to direct souls to the afterlife.
author: moopse

entry: It poses with its limbs at strange angles, which allows it to fine-tune the effects of its natural magnetic field. If it senses a threat, it will attack using thousands of magnetized needles.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME have highly sophisticated directional skills. Unfortunately, their bizarre appearance makes them unappealing to Trainers.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME tears apart sunken ship hulls with its claws. Shredded metal clings to its magnetic body, forming a makeshift armor that strengthens its defense.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME surfaces near hidden deposits of magnetic metals. It is commonly used by manufacturing companies to sniff out rare minerals.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME illuminates caves with its various bulbs to search for moss and lichen covered-rocks. It brushes its moustache-like growth over the stones to dislodge the moss and lichen, which it collects to eat later.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Using its strong magnetic field, it coats its fur in metal to act as armor for its body. Its punches are equivalent to boulders being thrown.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME's body is heavier than it appears, so its primary method of attack is jumping onto a foe's head. It seems to have a strong inclination of viewing turtle-like Pokémon as rivals.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a surprisingly prolific jumper. Its fists can break bricks simply by jumping from underneath them.
author: musicsheep.

entry: A long time ago, four POKENAME lived with humanity and protected their cities. Nowadays, once a year during a festival, an ancient song is used as tribute to them.
author: doodledoo

entry: POKENAME's steel fangs quickly drain the life from its victims. The sack on its back is thought to hold its unfinished food.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME are known to quickly stretch their bladed leg at others and slice them down without warning. It is believed that these Pokémon taught pirates how to walk with peg legs.
author: soup1900

entry: Each time POKENAME stabs a foe, it drains a bit of their life energy from them. Anyone who survives three minutes of POKENAME volleying stabs at them at bullet-like speeds will honorably have all their life force returned back to them.
author: soup1900

entry: Moving at blinding speeds, POKENAME runs up to Pokémon and hits them with its sheath to knock them unconscious. Once it has done so, it uses its scythe to reap all of their life energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has two scythes, but one is always covered inside of its sheath. This allows it to interact with other beings without slicing them apart and reaping their life force.
author: soup1900

entry: Legends state that POKENAME act as psychopomps,  guides for Pokémon who have perished in icy regions. It is said that the misty tendrils of fog swirling around their spearheads are souls drifting between this world and the next.
author: eloquent_panda

entry: During cold nights, POKENAME uses life energy to keep itself warm. Once it has gripped its prey with its horns, the blue cloth will wrap around and squeeze the life force out of the victim.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is often found eerily alone in lakes, as all other Pokémon have either fled or fallen to its wrath. Rumor has it that its sword-like tail collects the souls of its prey, further increasing its power.
author: h0bojoe

entry: When POKENAME drains foes of their life force, it inherits a part of their genetics. Enough DNA from certain groups of species may cause this Pokémon to mutate.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is often used inside of video games for its weapon abilities. It has very limited movement, only being able to attack and cleave like an actual sword.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lives inside a long shell in the shape of a blade. The sides of the shell are sharp, so anything that touches its shell will get cuts on itself.
author: soup1900

entry: Each time POKENAME molts its shell, the sword lodged in it falls out. During this short phase where the shell is weak and regrowing, it holds onto this blade with its tiny claws to stab at hungry predators that try to approach it.
author: soup1900

entry: Flying high in the sky, POKENAME uses the blade on its tail to strike prey from above. It then uses its sharp fangs to break through tough hide and extract the life force from its prey.
author: soup1900

entry: Whenever POKENAME drains someone's life force, the energy causes it to grow longer and molt. Its blade is shed off when it molts, becoming a tiny point afterwards that must be patiently regrown.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's cloth seems to enchant its victims when waved around before POKENAME charges and bites down on them.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME can forge swords from the flames on its back, which it then uses to fight with.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's beak is as sharp as a blade. It uses it to stab through fruits and berries and drink their juices from within, tossing the husk aside when it's finished.
author: sk372

entry: Not yet strong enough to carry its blade, POKENAME often drops it straight into the ground. When this happens, the ribbon on the blade accidentally smacks it right on the head, which startles the blade.
author: soup1900

entry: Those pricked by POKENAME's blade feel their happiness drain away. With a gentle touch of its sash-like tail, it can pass that joy to someone else.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its cloth wings to float and bounce across towns. During battles it gains as much height as possible before attacking with its blade.
author: schwaus

entry: Raised in the highest pressure under volcanoes, POKENAME are hurled far from their birthplace during eruptions. They wander the lands, challenging Pokémon to duels, but fighting dirty using their sword's tassel arm to trip foes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's tail is always coated in a toxic film that greatly poisons anyone who tries to touch it. If one were to touch any of its three sharp points, it would pierce right through your skin and cause immense pain.
author: soup1900

entry: The presence of a POKENAME is thought to bring about strife. Seeing one before battle is thought to be a sure sign of victory for your side.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Due to the small size of their blades, POKENAME use their much larger scabbards to deter predators until they're able to evolve.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME scavenges battlefields for pieces of armor to weld to itself. It ambushes other scavengers.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME use their blade-like tails to move dirt, akin to a spade, but also use them to joust with one another during territorial conflict.
author: blitzydragon

entry: POKENAME is rowdy and acts aggressively, but quickly calms down when picked up by its handle.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Clad in a steel-hard shell, it relentlessly attacks its opponent with the sharp horn on its head.
author: togetik

entry: POKENAME spends its time trying to craft the perfect sword to inhabit. Its own perfectionism prevents it from ever being satisfied with its work, though.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Though it looks like a handgun, POKENAME is actually a type of dagger. This is an example of Batesian mimicry.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Legends say that the first POKENAME was born when a Houndour was knighted. The great pride it felt caused it to evolve into this form. It continued to serve its kingdom until it was destroyed. Some say its spirit still guards the former throne room.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: POKENAME lurks in tall grass, ready to ambush small rodent Pokémon. When its prey is close enough, it releases its stomach muscles to swing the sword within its body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In days of yore, POKENAME served as the loyal guards of desert kings. They wield the swords in their trunks with the dexterity of an expert fencer, moving as if it has a mind of its own.
author: ozydamians

entry: Using its blade, POKENAME hacks symbols into the bodies of prey it has drained life energy from. Depending on its emotions, the symbols are either really clear or extremely messy and unrecognizable.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME bears a striking resemblance to a Pokémon native to the Hoenn region. It uses the blade on the end of its tail to mark its territory on boulders and trees.
author: elite01.

entry: POKENAME has a concealed blade in its hood that erupts from its mouth when hunting. It swings its head like a sword to attack other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stand tall at the edges of the ocean, watching over and protecting the land from the sea's beasts. A single swing of their blade is enough to split water down to the seabed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME commands a flock of loyal followers. Its spectral presence strikes fear into the hearts of those who dare challenge its authority.
author: anarchaz

entry: It likes entertaining people and Pokémon by juggling multiple sharp blades at once. These blades are believed to be cursed, as every person who ever tried to snatch them from POKENAME has died from a horrible unknown disease the very next day.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME wields a blade infused with over 100,000 volts of electricity. In one swing, it can incapacitate even the largest of Pokémon.
author: soup1900

entry: Its blade of grass can cut down trees with a single stroke. It grows a thick metallic armor to protect itself from other POKENAME.
author: schwaus

entry: Despite its metal armor, it is often seen leaping through forests at breakneck speeds. When POKENAME find each other in forests they fight until their blades chip.
author: schwaus

entry: It bonds with a single Trainer for life, and its blade grows sharper the stronger their emotions become. Villagers leave offerings at old battlegrounds where its kind still stands guard, unmoving.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME is known as a symbol of chivalry and strength. Its sword is kept invisible and only revealed to those who are worthy of its protection.
author: cinnamoncreampuff

entry: POKENAME focuses all of its magnetic forces into its blade to pull life forces in. If it magnetizes something that doesn't have life energy, it reverses its magnetism to repel the object far away.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME appears to be a mass of spirits haunting an empty scabbard. The spirits form themselves into a huge razor-sharp blade to strike at others in battle.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its blades to drain the auras from its prey and strengthen its own. The drained victims are left emotionless, dull, and aimless afterwards.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME has an awkward time chomping at opponents due to the handle on its head getting in the way. It wraps its large blue cloth around itself to keep itself warm during the night.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its cloth to hold its blade high and stab down at foes it encounters. It will sometimes hit itself when it misses, but only with the sides of the blade, so it doesn't hurt it that much.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its cloth to hold its blade high and stab down at the ground inside its cave to chip into it. It will keep doing this until it hits a geothermal vent and heat pours into its home.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME's blade is dull, it sharpens the sword by rubbing it against the teeth from its maw. It weakens the opposing Pokémon with swordplay before delivering the final blow with one bite.
author: nugamallow

entry: One can tell a wild POKENAME apart from coral and rocks by the single thin ribbon it has from its thick tentacles. It can drain the life energy of coral, but it doesn't do so to maintain its camouflage within the reef.
author: soup1900

entry: One can tell a wild POKENAME apart from coral and rocks by the single thin ribbon it has from its thick tentacles. It can drain the life energy of coral, but it doesn't do so to maintain its camouflage within the reef.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will always have its blade gripped by its small claw and its sheath held by its long ribbon claw. It has to constantly swim upwards in order to not sink due to these two large weights.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME avoids headbutting things, as its eye makes up the entirety of the top of its head. It instead must slash with the blade on the back of its head to slice down trees and prey.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME charges at enemies, it uses its armored face to block all attacks while its blade stabs the opponent once it collides. The blue ribbon on its back flows like a superhero cape while it is running around.
author: soup1900

entry: The sheer determination of POKENAME has made it able to withstand its normally fatal wound. The sword in its neck can influence the body nonetheless.
author: ayner

entry: A discarded set of Pokémon armor given life by supernatural means, POKENAME are often employed in Kalos as guardians to foreign dignitaries. They have been known to survive attacks that melt Steel types completely unscathed.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME forges its own crude blade using the flame on its tail. Its uses include self-defense, skewering small prey, and prying open tree nuts.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME journeys long distances in search of a volcano. Only there can it forge a blade up to its standards.
author: dylonk25

entry: These two swords are learning cooperative techniques so they can take on tougher opponents and split the life force.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This POKENAME is in the process of splitting. It is attempting new tactics and its two ribbons give it more dexterity.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: These two swords are learning cooperative techniques so they can take on tougher opponents and split the life force.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Having grown in length, this POKENAME has now adopted longsword rather than shortsword combat techniques.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: If POKENAME's blade dulls out, it will wrap it with its blue cloth to protect it from further damage. It then finds an Aegislash to borrow a shield from and uses it to resharpen its blade.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is described in myth as an azure-blue warrior who was corrupted into a Dark-type Pokémon while defending its beloved Lycanroc companion. But if this legend is true, its feral fighting style bears no trace of the noble knight it once was.
author: h0bojoe

entry: On full moons, POKENAME comes out in hunt for easy prey to drain life forces from. Using power from the moonlight, it can levitate its blade and control it to effortlessly slash foes down.
author: soup1900

entry: Those who own a POKENAME become emotionally attached to it. It uses this bond to siphon off their energy.
author: .realthree

entry: During a full moon, groups of POKENAME gather to forge their swords out of Moon Stone fragments. They will carry these swords with them at all times.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME spend all day practicing their magic act. Though the coffin is able to put itself back together afterwards, being cut in half over and over isn't pleasant, but the show must go on!
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME can fully retract and extend a blade from inside its body. It will stick this blade into the ground to prevent itself from being picked up and chucked away.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME uses its hand-shaped ribbons to grab life force out of prey. Once it has snatched their life force, it instantly retracts its ribbon inside its body, swallowing the life energy whole.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can change its key-shaped body to fit the lock it is about to pick. If it fails on the first try, it tries to force its way in with brute force.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME consists of two spirits fighting for control of a single host. You wouldn't want to be caught in the crossfire of their skirmish.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: A departed soul rests inside this Pokémon. It tirelessly seeks to fulfill that soul's dying wish.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME skewers bird Pokémon with its blade and then drains them of their life force using its ribbon. It hopes that by doing this, it will inherit the ability to fly and soar through the skies like its victims.
author: soup1900

entry: It is said that a Honedge once took pity on a lonely Charmander, allowing itself to be wielded. Now, the two adventure valiantly to vanquish all evil.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME's balloon inflates bigger with every fallen foe. If its blade were to be removed from the balloon, it would deflate.
author: abstr

entry: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Legends say one who can take POKENAME's sword is destined to lead. If anyone tries, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and shocks them.
author: the_fireplace

entry: While POKENAME's sword may seem weak and fragile due to its size, the stone and minerals gathered make up the blade of the sword, allowing for heavy damage. It then uses the blade to dig more sediment, and the cycle continues.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME is often spotted slowly patrolling small areas, grabbing and tossing intruders aside with its tassel. Research suggests it guards the buried bones of ancient Scolipede.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME likes to frolic around while also swinging its blade wildly to chop down anything and anyone in its way. Studies have shown that constantly pampering it by polishing its blade will keep this Pokémon placated.
author: soup1900

entry: Some stories say POKENAME are the souls of warriors fallen in battle within icy plains, forever bundling themselves in a vain attempt to stave off the endless cold, and striking vindictively at all who draw near.
author: sk372

entry: While the sharp blade on the top of a POKENAME can slice well, it is also brittle and heat-sensitive. The eye is made of an organic glass-like substance that grants superior eyesight while being more heat-sensitive than the blade.
author: entomoxie

entry: This Pokémon roams ancient ruins, attacking archaeologists without warning. Luckily, it is mostly posturing, and will retreat if whoever it challenges does not back down.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME's blade is too big in proportion to its body, making it rather clumsy at swinging it. Despite that, it will cry out if a Trainer attempts to take or trade it.
author: ferdirenz

entry: These strange Pokémon were first sighted lurking around the homes of village blacksmiths. They feast on scrap metal and other discarded materials during the process of forging weapons.
author: sk372

entry: Several Pokémon resembling Honedge have infested the husk of a Garbodor. Every blade piercing its skin belongs to a unique member hiding inside.
author: duskrd

entry: It is said that the souls of those slain by POKENAME are trapped forever within its blade.
author: norskdaedalus

entry: What appears to be a key-like appendage jutting out of POKENAME's head was actually forced in there by a malevolent spirit. It now wanders in an almost vegetative state, attacking anything that draws near.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME's body is entirely comprised of liquid metal. Despite being relatively weak, they often display an incredible amount of courage.
author: theartemis1

entry: The blade trapped within POKENAME's petals is impossible to move. This is because it has taken the soul of the Vileplume, and now controls its husk.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Said to be two spirits inhabiting the same body, POKENAME can strike with long-range sword swings and powerful fisticuffs. The sword sheathes within its body, causing it mild discomfort.
author: sk372

entry: Plunging its blade into a victim and wrapping its ten ribbons around them, POKENAME will extract all their life force within seconds. If any of its ribbons are torn, it can use this life energy to forcefully regenerate it back.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME conceals its blade within a dome made of its ribbons. If anyone approaches it, it opens this bunker, revealing the blade inside and stabbing them in the leg.
author: soup1900

entry: Naturally gifted duelists in the art of fencing, POKENAME are worthy of praise but aren't the most humble. They often boast about their superior swordplay to those around them. Despite this flaw, they always duel clean and fair.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be seen during snowstorms, its scarf billowing with the breeze. Some say the icy wind is pointing it towards its next worthy opponent.
author: sk372

entry: The blade-like scale on POKENAME's head is sharp enough to cut a tree in half with one slash. It is always looking for others to spar with, ignoring weaker Pokémon entirely in its quest for battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its sword-like leaf to trim weeds and tend to its nesting area. Its precise movements evoke the appearance of a gardener at work.
author: .izik

entry: This armored Pokémon hunts small prey at night with sword in hand, assisted by its hypersensitive eyes.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Honedge has now taken over part of Charmeleon's body. However, this improves their movement in battle, so the Charmeleon does not object.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME surprises its opponents by bursting from the ground with incredible speed. Its swift, precise strikes often leave foes too stunned to fight back.
author: bluhawk997

entry: POKENAME are prideful Pokémon, only listening to commands that benefit them. It is said that they have nine lives, but spend most of them recklessly.
author: kingd8

entry: Legend has it that, if POKENAME ever successfully gets its ball in its cup, its soul can finally pass on.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME wields a blade in self-defense, but its constant headaches hamper its focus in battle. As such, it makes wild, inaccurate swings in hope that one will connect with the foe.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are chivalrous creatures that always fight fairly. They are capable of defending themselves on land and in water because of their webbed feet, which ensure sturdy footing wherever they go.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its consciousness is split between its sword and its main body. When given a nonsentient blade, its swordsmanship is revealed to be poor.
author: staghorn

entry: Found standing guard over graveyards, POKENAME uses its sword to great effect against would-be grave robbers. Its intense movements flicker as fast as dancing flames, and hits bounce harmlessly off its flanks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Charizard and Honedge are now in perfect sync with one another. Both POKENAME's blade and flames are not to taken lightly on the battlefield.
author: nellnast42

entry: If POKENAME senses someone, it will teleport a knife behind them to stab them in the back. It needs to drain souls for their life energy in order to maintain its psychic powers.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is a young swordfighter in training. It looks up to its superiors so it may one day match their strength and prowess.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The blade protruding from POKENAME's rocky body is incredibly sharp. Some believe it cannot be removed without shattering the entire stone.
author: .izik

entry: The body of the Graveler possessed by the spirit of a Honedge makes it a formidable martial fighter and brute.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is thought to be the mount of a departed squire, holding their sword as it awaits their reunion.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: They are known to search for uncovered screws and unscrew them to bring back to their nests. Most engineers consider POKENAME to be a pest.
author: kiwiarms

entry: The bladed points on its shell are extremely sensitive to its surroundings. Should something venture too close, its tassel-like tongue lashes out to grab them and drain their life force.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME puts its victims to sleep and feeds by slaying their dream self. Victims are unable to have lucid dreams ever again.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME grows blades from its carapace which it uses like throwing knives. Discarded knives have been used as props to present seafood dishes.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME are coated in thick metallic armour letting them get in close and fight with their powerful claw safely. They wield their shield to ward against any particularly powerful attacks, taking trophies from their aggressors.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The more life energy POKENAME drains, the more its bulb unravels and the longer its ribbons will grow. It will reach the point of evolution once its bulb fully unravels the cloth that covers it.
author: soup1900

entry: Each egg in the clutch wields blades via psychic powers. Each member is very impulsive, so POKENAME has trouble coordinating attacks as a team.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an exceptional fighter that overwhelms its opponents using the paired blades it has in place of legs. To keep its steel strong, it feeds on foods rich in iron.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's two heads connect to the third orb via its sash, allowing each to swing its spiky mass like a flail into opponents. It feeds on rusted metal, especially liking sharp objects, which enhance its spikes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The parent typically softens up its opponent with glancing blows before letting the child issue the final winning strike. The youth's movements in battle are still amateurish, but it shows great potential.
author: sk372

entry: The cloth that comprises its wings is surprisingly effective at keeping it airborne. It dives and slashes at foes, using powders to disorient targets.
author: xephyr

entry: POKENAME typically lies motionless on the seafloor, but if a predator approaches, it will use its ribbons to crawl away in a hurry. It has to absorb the life force from several fish Pokémon to replenish the energy it takes to do so.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME can fire off the five points on its front, guiding them through telekinesis generated from its crystal core. Its tassels gracefully move and direct the blades' movements akin to a conductor.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to be the failed experiment of a mad inventor. It behavior is often errant and unpredictable.
author: theartemis1

entry: Through unknown means, POKENAME quickly converts regular air into xenon gas, juicing up its electricity and lighting its way. Using this process, it creates nets of static electricity, kicks with zapping power, and hovers to dodge ferocious blows.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's bladed arms make it a formidable close-range opponent. Should a foe try to keep their distance, POKENAME charges its swords up with electricity and fires arcs of lightning.
author: sk372

entry: The pointed blade on POKENAME's head is coated with a mild poison, infecting any wounds it creates. The smaller blade it wields can be used in battle in a pinch, but is primarily used to carve the skin off berries before consumption.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swims near the shores of ancient battle sites. It will add the weapons of fallen warriors it finds to its arsenal.
author: fenragon

entry: It is well known that POKENAME offers its blades in service to Beedrill and Vespiquen, helping them protect their hive. If a battle becomes particularly difficult, it won't hesitate to poison its foe to remain true to its oath.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses the twin tassel-like tails it possesses to grab onto food, especially fruits growing on trees. Using the sharp blades at the edge of its wings, it carves the skin off the fruit before eating the sweet insides.
author: sk372

entry: In battle, POKENAME has been observed posing with its blades after any victories, pointing both swords in differing directions. Research shows the directions pointed coincide with the exact hour and minute of the battle's end.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swings around its weapon and flings it out to strike from great distances. Sometimes it lets the momentum of its flying weapon sling its own lightweight body towards an opponent as a follow-up strike.
author: sk372

entry: The eye on its chest is always on the lookout for danger. The blades on its head are too dull to use for combat.
author: b_megamaths

entry: Despite being a Doublade fusion, POKENAME only has one blade sprouting out of its bud. Further examinations with X-rays have shown that the second blade is actually hidden inside its bud, wanting to come out but having no room to do so.
author: soup1900

entry: Having grown a second horn, it pursues its enemy with devastating precision and power.
author: togetik

entry: During the festive season, POKENAME descend from their nests in the mountains to celebrate. They toss one of their blades to startled travelers and attack with the other, giving the "gift" of swordplay lessons.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME delivers Retro Mail sealed with wax stamps and folded with perfect corners. Between routes, it hones its sword technique, moving with a rhythm that feels oddly nostalgic.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME constantly coats its swords with fire, making their cuts inflict scalding burns on those hit. The sword's metal is extremely heat resistant, allowing it to keep its shape under the extreme temperatures of the flame.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME wields its twin blade tusks with great skill, striking with clean cutting strikes while rolling. The blades can detach as well, and float around attacking as if they possess a will of their own.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME attacks foes by swinging the blade attached to its hood. It protects its rear with another small blade, preventing bird Pokémon from picking POKENAME up and flying away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The unique gashes that POKENAME leaves in the ground as it runs make it easy to tell where it's been. However, these footprints are so far apart due to this Pokémon's huge leaps that it's nearly impossible to follow the trail.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are the elite guardians of those who dwell outside the ocean.  With twin blades in hand, they can carve land and sea apart in a furious maelstrom meant to subdue the foulest of deep-sea beasts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME attacks foes by swinging the blade attached to its hood. It chases after rodent Pokémon in the wild to secure a fresh meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dual-wields blades made entirely of electricity. Slicing its food to ribbons, the electric blades also roast them to a nice crisp, creating a well-cooked and easy-to-eat meal for it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's two tails deftly wield their twin blades, slashing precisely to take down opponents. It does not have arms or a mouth, so it gains energy by draining its foes' life force.
author: hophoppip

entry: Wielding a blade on each tail, POKENAME discharges excess electricity into them. Its aggressive and complex attack patterns allow it to overwhelm even the strongest opponents.
author: soup1900

entry: The metal on POKENAME's blades constantly grows and sheds, much like its skin. These shavings were melted into ingots and used in the past to develop the flotation tanks for the ZERO-ONE.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME deftly swing their dual swords in battle, the scales along their body acting as armor defending them from attacks. It is said that in ancient times POKENAME were trained to use their swords to protect nobles and royalty.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Unlike Gliscor, POKENAME cares little for stealth and flies in plain sight. When it finds a foe it believes to be a worthy opponent, it will slam its blades together as a challenge.
author: sivanandi

entry: With its two blades of grass, even the thickest trees are felled within seconds. It spends hours sharpening its blades before sparring with other POKENAME.
author: schwaus

entry: If it feels threatened, POKENAME will try to act fierce by unsheathing its tiny daggers. It often gets laughed at due to its small stature.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME ambushes its enemies by rolling toward them, swiftly incapacitating them with its two bladed arms once their defenses are broken.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME have a second mind in the form of a specter. The specter warns of danger as they elegantly slash with their two swords.
author: t.i.a.

entry: This Pokémon resembles a hero from ancient times. They are used as guardians to protect valuable items.
author: sottiwotti

entry: POKENAME use the long blades on their arms to navigate large ravines and cave systems in search of gemstones by climbing walls or cutting through them.
author: nexusshenanigans

entry: POKENAME's bud has opened now that the cloth covering it has unraveled. It stores its two blades inside this bud to bathe them with life energy and empower them.
author: soup1900

entry: A master of swordsmanship and underhanded tactics alike. Its blades and horns allow it to cover all sides, making ambush impossible.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Often accompanying tradespeople, POKENAME enjoys following its Trainer around and carrying their tools with its many ribbon-like hands. Its grip is so tight that it is impossible to steal an item from POKENAME, unless it willingly hands it over.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its eyes are constantly scanning around for thieves who may attempt to take the items it possesses. Sometimes it will flourish its weapons around in a dazzling display for either show or to ward off potential threats.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME waves its cloth-like fins to slowly swim along the ocean's floor. Anything that falls in front of its blades is chopped up and consumed in short order.
author: .realthree

entry: The crests of POKENAME are formed of their blade's sheaths. They are almost impervious to physical damage from head-on and will always face toward danger to protect their more vulnerable back half.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The harbinger of battle, POKENAME warns cities of raids. Misunderstanding it as the bringer of conflict has been many cities' last mistake.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is incredibly graceful in combat. Its flowing ribbons and intense flames distract and intimidate opponents.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME has partially split, and attacks primarily by spinning and advancing. Its movements are overwhelming to most fighters.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The complex attack patterns of its three swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This POKENAME has decided its newfound abilities are best contained in its single form, for now.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The four swords of POKENAME travel across the land seeking adventure. Though not always in perfect sync, when they link together properly, their skill and strength is the stuff of legend.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a master of both defense and offense. Trying to land a good hit on it while being swarmed by three whirling blades would frustrate even the strongest opponents.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME is a swift acrobat who can easily overwhelm foes in battle. With kicks, spins, and slashes with its sword-ears, it is difficult for many Pokémon to best it unscathed. It is constantly polishing the blades on its ears.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It has an incredibly curious nature. It will often cut through things using the blades on its arms to see what they look like on the inside.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It is able to sense the emotions of nearby people. It is rumored to stare at people who are hiding secrets.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME are a menace of the desert, emerging from the dunes just to ambush human caravans for their food, if the humans are lucky.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME wields dual blades with unstoppable force, slicing through foes effortlessly. Their formidable armor strikes fear into foes with each swing.
author: anarchaz

entry: Normally found standing guard at the gates of ruined fortresses, POKENAME are passive guardians provided no hostile act is performed in their presence. Their stoic demeanor belies their fierceness, leaping to action at the first hint of violence.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Normally found standing guard at the gates of ruined fortresses, POKENAME are passive guardians provided no hostile act is performed in their presence. Their stoic demeanor belies their fierceness, leaping to action at the first hint of violence.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can eject two blades from inside its body: one from its mouth, the other from its behind. This second blade always surprises anyone who tries to sneak up to it from behind.
author: soup1900

entry: Should POKENAME's many tails brush against a foe in battle, a hex is cast that causes the victim to hallucinate ghostly blades striking at them. The confusion this causes makes it easier for POKENAME to strike with its actual blades.
author: sk372

entry: It is rumored to be immortal. It is also rumored to carry out the dying wish of its Trainer if it was treated well.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME wanders through the forest slicing trees and Grass-type Pokémon with its teeth and blades indiscriminately, as if by instinct.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's dual blades act like stakes, nailing it to the ground to discourage aerial predators. Its jagged mouth is as powerful as a steel bear trap.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It is an exceptionally shy Pokémon. If approached, it covers its eye using the ribbons at its sides.
author: b_megamaths

entry: The blades on its body are sharp enough to cut through steel. It lacks the dexterity to use them effectively, however.
author: b_megamaths

entry: As it grows, the liquid enveloping its body slowly covers the blades. This gives it more control over them as it matures.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It carves patterns into the sand around its den with one of its blades. These markings warn others to stay away from its territory.
author: .izik

entry: A Pokémon often found in the ruins of castles and other medieval fortifications, POKENAME is thought to have served as a guardian against attacks by rival fiefdoms. Though small in stature, its proficiency with its blades makes it dangerous.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A Pokémon often found in the ruins of castles and other medieval fortifications, POKENAME is thought to have served as a guardian against attacks by rival fiefdoms. Though small in stature, its proficiency with its blades makes it dangerous.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's tassels grab hold of prey and draw it closer to its mouth. Its two blade-like tongues swing fast to chop its food into smaller pieces it can slide into the sides of its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon are often employed by royal families or the very wealthy to guard their homes against thieves; in exchange, POKENAME are often gifted gemstones.
author: bradlybro199

entry: The bane of tall grass everywhere, POKENAME cuts down most plants nearby simply by wandering around with its sharpened blades. There have been reports that it can clear 1000 square feet in a single night. Sometimes it races Mow Rotom for sport.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The number of members in the colony has doubled during its evolution. Trainers with scopophobia or aichmophobia should not train this Pokémon.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME constantly emits an unnerving metallic screeching sound, though some speculate that it may cease when none are around to hear it.
author: norskdaedalus

entry: A phantom of atrocities long past. Simply looking at it causes a hypnotizing effect to humans, drawing them into its pillory.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: It likes to build nests in abandoned castles. Its song resembles a trumpet's fanfare.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME's glassy eye never blinks, so it's commonly used as a guard in households. Though it appears focused, it's doubtful that POKENAME actually remains awake through the night.
author: .realthree

entry: It never attacks an opponent from behind. Its wings are used for armor as well as flight.
author: b_megamaths

entry: Wild POKENAME will often skewer Berries on the blades on their heads to be eaten later. If raised in colder weather, its scarf will grow longer.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It watches for danger from any direction using the eyes on its body. The ends of its scarf are dexterous enough to pluck Berries from trees.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME weaves complex attack patterns with its blades. One is used as a flame focus burning at over five thousand degrees. The other stays sheathed and is used to defend against counter attacks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME buries one blade in the ground and wields the other in combat, typically with a defensive style. It becomes particularly aggressive if something breaches its defenses and touches the sword embedded in the ground.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME try desperately to prove themselves in battle against stronger Pokémon. They are highly sought after by soldiers and warriors.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME has finely honed its battle senses through constant combat. Sneak attacks are almost impossible, as it can quickly shift the grip on its blades to strike behind it as fluidly as it would counter an attack from the front.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have sharp blades across their long body that make them menacing creatures to fight against while at sea. Their swordsmanship is only second to their devotion to their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The blades on POKENAME's back hold immense spectral power. However, each time Charizard uses them, Doublade drains its life force.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME plants one of its blades in the ground before battle to fight with a single sword and its fist. Only powerful enough fighters will make it dual-wield its weapons and fight at its fullest.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME train endlessly to become stronger. They use both swordplay and physical strength to their advantage.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME train endlessly to become stronger. They use both swordplay and physical strength to their advantage.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's combat strategy consists of wildly flailing its bladed arms. The sword in its head can be removed and wielded through telekinesis, but POKENAME often forgets it has that ability.
author: sk372

entry: When it goes into combat, POKENAME closes its eyes and enters a zen-like state of tranquility. Its battle movements are fierce and fluid, as if the blades themselves guide its hands to victory.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's metal claws are quite sharp and possess a strong grip when clamped. It uses them to stab, slice and crush fish and crustaceans for sustenance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME collect weapons from underwater ruins, using their claws to scrape them clean and maintain them. They scuttle sideways into battle, one sword used for offense and the other for defence.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are zealous defenders of their loved ones and have a tenacious hypervigilance. Whenever bedtime rolls around, they have difficulty falling asleep and may request to stand guard to protect those they care about.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Thanks to years of training, POKENAME is able to balance on its sword-like legs perfectly.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: It is said that each POKENAME possesses the soul of royalty. Indomitable in both spirit and armor, this Pokémon never yields, even in assured defeat.
author: xillo

entry: POKENAME deny entry to their internal organs by hiding within their cocoon. They flip onto their side whenever they are attacked by bird Pokémon to allow their shield to absorb the force of pecking.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME practices daily against others of its kind, leaving its armor stronger than ever and unintentionally destroying its scarves. It floats with ghostly powers through its Trainer's drying laundry until it finds a replacement to borrow.
author: ghostslythe

entry: After felling many trees, POKENAME uses its spectral powers to force beings into building huts and wooden houses for it. These buildings serve as shelters during the winter for it and other Pinsir from the freezing environment.
author: soup1900

entry: After felling many trees, POKENAME uses its spectral powers to force beings into building huts and wooden houses for it. These buildings serve as shelters during the winter for it and other Pinsir from the freezing environment.
author: soup1900

entry: Wild POKENAME dwell in remote lakes, awaiting those with the qualities of a true leader. In legend, aspiring kings sought to capture one to prove their worth, but those who failed were reduced to cinders.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME collects swords and shields to wield with its long, prehensile tail. So long as this Pokémon carries its arsenal, a thick layer of frost will coat every blade and surface.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME controls its massive steel sword by manipulating the magnetic fields it constantly generates around itself. It absorbs the energy of thunderclaps through its wings, allowing it to unleash electrical strikes of astonishing power.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The flames of this Pokémon signify its undying will personified as flames. It is remarkably skilled with its giant sword despite having no hands, but will only unleash it against worthy foes.
author: infinex21

entry: Instead of being eusocial, hives of POKENAME operate similar to a human monarchy. Because of this, some hives have kings, queens, or both working together to defend their hive with their dying breath.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: When pushed to its limits, POKENAME's pearls begin to emit electric shocks that surge through its entire body, further empowering the strikes of its sword. It is an extremely solitary Pokémon that wanders the world in search of creatures to protect.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When pushed to its limits, POKENAME's pearls begin to emit electric shocks that surge through its entire body, further empowering the strikes of its sword. It is an extremely solitary Pokémon that wanders the world in search of creatures to protect.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The energy from fusion has tinted its flowers. It's debated if the jewel on its chest is sentient or assisting in its abilities.
author: noilaedi

entry: A honorous knight, POKENAME will forever protect its royalty. Legends speak of a chosen POKENAME who slayed an evil lord in a great war 400 years ago.
author: leeto64

entry: Always displaying courage and honor, POKENAME are rumored to be time-traveling knights from another world.
author: adoster

entry: A honorous knight, POKENAME will forever protect its royalty. Legends speak of a chosen POKENAME who slayed an evil lord in a great war 400 years ago.
author: leeto64

entry: Rattata look up to POKENAME, as it is a staunch defender of their colonies. As it watches over them, POKENAME tries to teach the other rodents better behavior, so that their reputation as pests may fade in time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known to leave their Trainer if they deem them unworthy, but if they stay with them, it is a sign of great honour. Unfortunately, they are not very intelligent and sometimes wander off, so Trainers must remain vigilant.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to deftly wield its blade in combat. It only allies itself with honorable Trainers, and fights valiantly to uphold said honor.
author: sk372

entry: Holding a large blade with its tail and coated with solid armor, POKENAME boasts formidable offense and defense. It can throw the blade at an opponent and manipulate it psychically to throw off a foe's rhythm.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is constantly polishing its large steel blade to keep it bright and shiny. It will never give up this blade to anybody, not even to its Honchkrow boss.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME will only allow their trainer to wield them. Its scope can track the souls of its targets no matter where they go.
author: infinex21

entry: With axe-like tusks, a sword in its trunk, and shield-like armor across its body, POKENAME cuts a striking visage. Knights of old carrying an emblem in its image were said to be the most skilled and chivalrous of their era.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME only appears every hundred years to vow its loyalty to a powerful and just leader.
author: togetik

entry: POKENAME are known to be leaders of armies of Pikachu. They force these Pikachu to cause lightning storms that strike their blade, increasing its size to the point where they can slay entire groups of Pokémon in one fell cleave.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME rides on its massive blade, which can cut through and travel across time. It leaps through the eras to fight against and alongside the greatest Trainers of the past, present and future.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME overwhelms its foes with various spells and swordplay. It's unable to fight if the Hexblade is lost.
author: awiralonprime

entry: A spellsword beyond compare. One can never tell when it wields its blade whether one will be hit with steel or incomparable magic.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: When an POKENAME finds someone who has innate leadership, it will begin following their orders to the letter, regardless of the effects of its actions.
author: nexkode

entry: POKENAME cleaves opponents with its large blade-tail, discharging its electricity on contact with anything. When in a defensive stance, it can create a static field that blocks incoming attacks while also shocking any attackers back.
author: soup1900
