entry: When angered, POKENAME can make the rocks around it levitate by intensifying the magnetic field generated by its body. It coats its stone claws with crackling electric sparks to make its blows even more devastating.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When angered, POKENAME can make the rocks around it levitate by intensifying the magnetic field generated by its body. It coats its stone claws with crackling electric sparks to make its blows even more devastating.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal predator that uses its sheer brute strength to overpower its victims. By howling, it cloaks its rocky mane in electric sparks as it prepares for battle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's innate musical talent was honed and perfected through its non-stop training and love for music. It has become an apex of singing talent, and many worldwide admire POKENAME's dazzling voice.
author: voxary

entry: POKENAME's massive body is covered in thick fur capable of storing vast amounts of electricity. It rules the seaside shores where it makes its den, destroying its foes with lethal strikes from its terrible claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's large, leaf-like scythes crackle with electricity. It defends its nest fiercely, releasing bursts of sparks when striking intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's crystals are charged with electricity which makes them glow as bright as a lightbulb. Colonies of POKENAME live in underground caves, illuminating the area as bright as day.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME chases humans in the dead of night to claim their souls. It is difficult to hide from it, as its eyes can see through solid walls.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its tail's star is constantly engulfed in flames, which it has learned to control with the same skill as its Electric-type attacks. POKENAME is extremely territorial, driving away foes with all its energy and intimidating them by bristling its mane.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It's so sensitive to changes in the air that it can even sense the movement of things well out of its sight. This is why people mistakenly believe that it can see through anything.
author: archserpent

entry: POKENAME is a solitary creature that spends long nights howling to keep strangers away from its den. In battle, it lunges at its foes with merciless fangs and doesn't hesitate to unleash devastating bursts of electricity to secure victory.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The eye-shaped pattern on its wings can glow even in the dark, allowing POKENAME to intimidate others at night as well. It flies close to bodies of water so it can use their surfaces as amplifiers for its electric discharges.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME soars across mountain skies on its powerful wings, claiming territory by defeating rivals of its own kind. It is said that when it fights at full strength, the sky turns stormy, and its thunderous roars can be heard from afar.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are incredibly territorial. It can be hard to tell whether the sound of thunder is from a brewing storm or a battle between these Pokémon.
author: archserpent

entry: POKENAME keeps watch over its pond even at night with its radiant eyes. When battle approaches, the star on its chest shines brightly and its menacing white fists spark with crackling energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are theorized to see anything physically and mentally. It can create objects out of pure light that it controls freely. Staring into its staff is said to allow you to see through physical matter.
author: mistymagius

entry: A potent hunter, POKENAME can see through nearly anything, using its vision to spot targets and electrocute them. In water, a hunting POKENAME can knock out entire ecosystems.
author: astral_1447

entry: POKENAME ambushes its prey from deep below water using its piercing eyesight. Its sturdy shell protects it from any prey strong enough to fight back.
author: bigblue

entry: The cannons on POKENAME's back are capable of firing blasts of water and electricity with incredible force. Combined with its unrivaled eyesight, it is nearly unstoppable in battle.
author: bigblue

entry: When it eats dreams, its eyes change colors. If a dream is particularly filling to POKENAME, they change into vivid, ethereal colors.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can expel atomically fractured iron powder that practically behaves like a gas. Because it knows how cruel it is to submit any living creature to this painful and deadly attack, POKENAME will only use it against a Tyranitar.
author: epping_forest

entry: The shell of POKENAME's egg is quite tough. It lives alongside Lairsey, who use the eggs as a food source.
author: kittyluv090

entry: It digs through mountains as it makes its home. It cannot fly, despite being a Flying type.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME lets hundreds of Pokémon ride on its back, its tough iron shell protecting them from large waves. The inside of its shell is supposedly quite luxurious.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its body is extremely gooey. As it moves from place to place, it will leave a putrid metallic paste in its path.
author: .izik

entry: Although clunky, POKENAME's iron plating is specially suited for underwater travel. Its frontal horn is used to skewer unsuspecting prey.
author: nellnast42

entry: When irritated, POKENAME's heavy armor glows bright yellow with electricity. This charge makes it extremely nimble for its weight.
author: nellnast42

entry: When in battle, POKENAME's armor heats up like a furnace. It then smashes into its surroundings recklessly to cool off.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME is often seen in pairs, despite primarily being solitary hunters. This is because their blades require regular sharpening, which is best done by scraping against the metal that makes up their carapace.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME shoots jets of flames through the refined holes in its armor, increasing its force as it tears tunnels through mountains. In the rare times it relaxes, it sears a hole into the stone to rest.
author: lbbacca

entry: POKENAME gather iron ore to fashion into the armor that protects their soft bodies. When threatened, they won't hesitate to charge foes and knock them down, only to quickly burrow into the ground to get away.
author: chibitales

entry: Even with its armor, POKENAME flies at a quick speed, allowing it to land powerful charges with its horned brow. It forms bonds readily with other Pokémon in its habitat that work to protect the location from disasters.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is able to channel its immense psychic powers through its armor. Its tail is capable of launching off a powerful beam.
author: nellnast42

entry: It lives on the floor of deep oceans. Even just slightly grazing its sharp spikes causes it to violently explode, leaving potent toxins in its wake.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME is near indestructible and can survive a collision with a semi-truck. It achieves this by flattening itself to maximize its armor coverage. It feeds on natural sweets such as nectar and tree sap.
author: mindrivet

entry: POKENAME scrounges up bits of bone and steel to fashion itself a set of armor that can withstand its internal heat. The last and most important piece is its helmet, which POKENAME fashions from the bones of an Aggron.
author: redmagecole

entry: POKENAME roams around manmade tunnels to eat loose rocks and debris to strengthen its metallic tusks. It is also known to aid in rescuing miners when tunnels cave in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Eggs it cares for become nigh-indestructible, but never hatch. This also means they are inedible, despite rumors of wondrous health benefits.
author: pokepower

entry: This Pokémon's hide is nearly impenetrable to attacks. It sheds its armor as it grows, and the discarded plates are repurposed to reinforce building frames for added durability.
author: gtrwya

entry: The branch on POKENAME's head grows a trio of incredibly heavy and solid metal orbs. It flings these off at others to defend itself, but if the attack doesn't knock out its foe, it runs away and hides until it can regrow another set.
author: sk372

entry: It's always seeking a charge, as it constantly sheds static. It relies on lighting strikes and slicing open electronics and batteries with its tail.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME are extremely cold to the touch, their metal hide sapping away heat near instantly. Trainers are advised to use gloves and full body clothing when handling them to avoid frostbite.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME rams rocks and trees with its large steel tail to shatter the obstacle into tiny pieces. Starting from on its tail, it grows more iron balls along its back the older it becomes.
author: soup1900

entry: As soon as POKENAME claims a territory, it immediately plants dozens of trees to grow a large forest. Anything in the way that isn't a tree is immediately smashed using its steel horns.
author: soup1900

entry: Its horns are constantly growing, but it shaves them down on thick trees. The armour of POKENAME reflects sunlight brightly, highlighting gouges from past battles that it wears with pride.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: As soon as POKENAME claims a territory, it immediately plants dozens of trees to grow a large forest. Anything in the way that isn't a tree is immediately smashed using its steel horns.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's body is clad in a steel armor that not only shields it from enemy blows but also amplifies the power of its devastating kicks. When facing a particularly strong opponent, the temperature in its legs rises dramatically, turning red-hot.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When driven by pure rage, these Pokémon have the power to crush any enemy. They will fight to their last breath.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME have military-grade armor over their bodies that deflects claws and talons. The cloud of pollen that surrounds them was once harnessed as a smokescreen to protect soldiers as they rush through a battlefield.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME's second head is technically just a horn, though it can open and close like a mouth to crush up the rocks and ores for it to eat with its actual mouth. These Pokémon will also use their large horn to ram their opponents with great force.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is extremely territorial. Its reinforced skull can shatter metal with ease, and its body is clad in armor tougher than steel. When it charges, nothing in its path stands a chance.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME will create a lair within a mountain and claim it as its own. It commands the respect of many Lairoth who do its bidding while it lounges around. Though lazy, POKENAME can easily topple the very mountain it resides in.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: This titanic lord of the pelagic ocean is sometimes known as the Mobile Fortress Whale, recalling an old legend in which a mystic made an oath with one and built a castle on its back. Trainers use them to explore the whale roads in safety.
author: alkazamis

entry: The steel plates on POKENAME's body are resistant to many attacks while also being pliable. Metalworks around the world seek these plates to make sturdy and reliable appliances that last for longer than those made with lesser materials.
author: chibitales

entry: The steel plates on POKENAME's body are resistant to many attacks while also being pliable. Metalworks around the world seek these plates to make sturdy and reliable appliances that last for longer than those made with lesser materials.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME claims an entire mountain as its territory, which it vigilantly maintains. Chips in its blade are worn with pride as mementos from battles.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME stores large amounts of electricity in its steel armor, releasing it only in combat. It gores enemies with its iron horns and finishes them off with bursts of high-voltage energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME fully plates itself with iron sheets to be able to withstand any attack. Iron in the mountains where this Pokémon claims its territory is scarce due to it being all dug up.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME fully plates itself with iron sheets to be able to withstand any attack. Iron in the mountains where this Pokémon claims its territory is scarce due to it being all dug up.
author: soup1900

entry: The metallic bones in its body are mostly hollow. Using its light weight, an POKENAME skillfully jumps from cliff to cliff when traveling.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are fiercely territorial, hurling boulders at trespassers. One POKENAME caused a rockslide that destroyed an entire village.
author: kingd8

entry: Utilizing its powerful armor, POKENAME can travel freely between realms, unleashing terrible violence on any it deems trespassers of its territory.
author: tomatosalad

entry: POKENAME will only listen to Trainers with strong wills. Most Trainers report feeling as though the night is longer, as if there was a 25th hour.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: Haunting the most remote mountain regions, POKENAME uses a seemingly endless reserve of sharp metal plates as reaping tools. The coffins it carries are said to hold the souls of those it has hunted down for trespassing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wild, dark, and relatively unknown powers have allowed it to flourish in the world of folktales. At least one legend mentions POKENAME bursting out of a wandering musician's body as if it was previously living inside of them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME prefers power pylons as their meal of choice. A swarm can easily descend on a power substation and devour it in minutes.
author: .izik

entry: Each of the nails on its arms is connected to a vine. This vine can extend over 30 feet to catch a foe.
author: .izik

entry: Legends tell of a prince from a far away land who travels in search of a flame from an POKENAME. In the story, he uses a crystal vial to hold the fire.
author: .izik

entry: A punch from an POKENAME is strong enough to destroy a tank. The alloy throughout its body becomes sturdier as it ages.
author: .izik

entry: When it flaps its large wings, small metal shavings come off. These shavings can get hotter than most household ovens.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are extremely rare to find in the wild. When one is spotted, people are captivated by its wings and try to approach. Upon discovering that its wings are as hot as lava, they tend to stay away.
author: rumia_archer

entry: Because its iron helmet blocks its sight, it navigates by tackling and biting. A POKENAME with a damaged helmet is either a seasoned fighter or prone to getting lost.
author: h0bojoe

entry: The two heads constantly bash each other to see whose armor is stronger. However, their armor is so heavy that their movement is pretty limited.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME was observed fighting on the dangerous battlefields of the Kalos war many years ago. It uses its iron spear to scare off opponents.
author: planatical

entry: Strong defensive armor, sharp metallic projectiles and crushingly powerful limbs make POKENAME a force to be reckoned with in battle. The gear on its chest is its only weak spot.
author: sk372

entry: The hollows in POKENAME's armor amplify its echolocation to an increased range. It chases down its quarries and slashes them with its bladed wings to tire them out.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It prefers to target Pokémon with tough carapaces, aiming to pierce or shatter them with its horns. These heavy charges cannot be stopped once started, so it may embed itself in a wall or ground should the target evade.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME nocturnally patrols the city it has designated as its territory, feasting upon refuse. While this is useful for litter control, Unovan cities have needed to make their garbage bins more durable as it will tear into unsecured ones.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lives in deep caves with enough metal to build its armor. The metal is great at reflecting sound, which enhances its sonic abilities.
author: mistymagius

entry: It extends its chain to reel in any valuables that it finds on the ocean floor. It consumes any gold or silver it finds with a fiendish glee.
author: .izik

entry: The steel armor covering POKENAME's body is immune to rust. Even after months of being submerged, its plating remains spotless and uncorroded.
author: .izik

entry: It lies dormant at seabeds. Should it sense a disturbance it will awaken to fight rampaging Pokémon, before returning to the depths. They can achieve perfect synchronization with their Trainers.
author: ker.0

entry: The fungus that inhabits POKENAME compels it to eat massive amounts of iron. The consumed metal supports the fungus' growth.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a bit of a grump, rarely seen without a scowling visage on its face. If it clamps its steel shell shut around itself, take cover; a disgruntled and painful tackling charge is sure to follow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's glowing eyes seem to be able to instantly analyze metal with a single glance. It's become very valuable for its ability to quickly spot spots in metal structures where the steel has begun to weaken.
author: sk372

entry: Mountains where POKENAME reside are always perfectly tilled and planted with an assortment of crops and trees. They dig through their territories all day and eat weeds that sprout up to maintain their work.
author: soup1900

entry: It makes an entire mountain its training ground, often interfering with the local ecosystem and scaring other Pokémon away without even noticing. POKENAME's slaps and punches are impactful enough to sometimes cause large rockslides.
author: milchik

entry: For its impenetrable armor, flawless battle style, and fighting etiquette, this Pokémon was admired and honored by warriors for centuries. POKENAME only picks fights against its equals and tries to pierce through their weak spots with its palm spike.
author: milchik

entry: The spoons from an POKENAME were once melted down to make crowns for Kalos rulers. The crowns defended the kings and queens from mind control.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly proud creature, only accepting challenges from the greatest warriors. Its limbs are agile, but hard as iron.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Its body is covered in a thick layer of steel. Should it begin to rain, POKENAME will run to find cover and avoid rust marks.
author: .izik

entry: It releases intense flames from within its metal-clad body as it charges down foes. Its hooves are hard enough to quickly break apart large rocks and its horn is sharp enough to pierce through steel.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses the strength of its steel to super pressurize its water cannons. At full strength, POKENAME can cut through diamond with ease.
author: togofred

entry: Wielding a pendulum with threatening spikes on it, POKENAME first uses it to lull its victim into a deep sleep, then to violently attack them.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME feeds on the rusting hulls of sunken battleships, a diet that makes its exoskeleton incredibly strong. They are usually docile, but become aggressive toward divers who try to plunder their shipwreck homes.
author: occulusmalus

entry: Buzzing through sandstorms, POKENAME will help guide lost travelers to an oasis near them. It rapidly vibrates its wings to clean the dust from its bulb.
author: ozydamians

entry: When this Pokémon explodes, it summons a sandstorm thats lasts five days. They love to throw sand into the eyes of children.
author: zerocipher

entry: POKENAME creates massive wings made out of sand from pores on its sides. It can quickly whip up blinding sandstorms with said wings in order to escape any sort of danger.
author: sk372

entry: Native to deserts, POKENAME spends its daylight hours burrowed in cool sands. At night its goggle eyelids protect its sight while it hunts at over one hundred miles per hour.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME dwells in remote mountains, summoning intense blizzards just by flapping its wings. The sound its wings produce is often mistaken for a woman's song, luring lost travelers deeper into the snow where they inevitably become its prey.
author: h0bojoe

entry: It can see in total darkness, using echolocation to find its burrow. POKENAME has large wings that flap incredibly fast, yet completely silently.
author: maxiundmicky

entry: It keeps high in the skies to avoid predators, which struggle to grab it due to its small size. During the night, it flies down to drink from ponds.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME will often kick up sand in search of underground reservoirs. Because of this, the bud on its back has evolved to be resistant to sand.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is an ambush hunter, leaving only its claws visible above the dunes. When one is disturbed, it launches a swift surprise attack from below, using its wings to begin a sandstorm and crushing prey with its claws.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are excellent trackers, with the visor-like film over its eyes allowing it to see clearly through the harshest sandstorms. These loyal Pokémon will rescue Trainers it finds lost in the desert.
author: mistymagius

entry: The flapping of its wings is known to create heavy sandstorms. These wings also emanate a powerful, vicious roar-like sound.
author: gaogao028

entry: By combining its buzzing wings and voice, POKENAME can emit sound waves that can shatter stone. It roams the desert to hunt down prey at night.
author: awiralonprime

entry: By vibrating the countless colorful quills on its back in unison, POKENAME can summon powerful sandstorms. Since the prey it feeds on often hides underground, it uses its claws to quickly dig holes in search of them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: During sandstorms, POKENAME flap their wings to extend their aura and find others. It defends weak Pokémon in its territory from poachers and hunters.
author: therider

entry: POKENAME burrows through the ground, its back covered in toxic flowers that release poisonous spores. It ambushes unsuspecting prey, using its powerful vine whips to strike from below.
author: thepandasharky

entry: Despite their immense strength, POKENAME are very seldom dangerous. They prefer to kick up sand with their wings to create divots they can lay in.
author: jokerswild

entry: POKENAME only fly to kick up sandstorms to ward off enemies. Their protective and stoic nature give it a feel of royalty, so it is sometimes depicted as such in popular culture.
author: frokachu

entry: A POKENAME will lift itself onto its hind legs and rapidly beat its wings to scare off foes tougher than it is. It can uses its wings to help channel strong vibrations through its pointed forelegs to create powerful, albeit localized, tremors.
author: infinex21

entry: Its blade and flapping wings create an enthralling, metallic song. POKENAME then spins up a dust storm with its ribbon to trap its victims.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME can be seen flying through desert skies, even without wings.
author: themicelegion

entry: These Pokémon are most often seen during intense sandstorms hunting the Pokémon that get lost within. When night falls, they burrow into the sand to rest, leaving only their antennae exposed.
author: chibitales

entry: The green light from POKENAME's body draws in bug Pokémon before incinerating them with its flames. It seems to enjoy making glass sculptures by melting and shaping sand.
author: mistymagius

entry: It makes its nest amongst fields of flowers. When threatened, it attacks enemies with a poisonous whirlwind.
author: lemgambino

entry: POKENAME's wings flap at incredible speeds, making it move blindingly fast in spite of its size. It kicks up so much dust in its desert home that it was at one point believed to be a living sandstorm until it was properly recorded on film.
author: sk372

entry: It can perfectly conceal itself within the sandstorms it whips up with its wings. POKENAME can spot prey from over 40 miles away with its unique eyes.
author: bunkachunka

entry: If one hears the distinct high-pitched sound of POKENAME's spines vibrating, one should hide or retreat; it ejects these spines along with much of its innards to swing them about wildly and spear prey.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME disguises itself to mirror majestic Dragon-type Pokémon, but is frequently mocked for its bulky wings. Fans of Dragon-types that want to avoid the high maintenance Dragon-types require will adopt a POKENAME as a happily pampered companion.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME flings sand with its tails to create sandstorms. It is not very forgiving and will always remember those who treat it poorly.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME fills its entire body up with air and slowly releases it to create a drone-like sound. Then, it vibrates its wings at high frequencies to create hypnotizing harmonics. POKENAME's wings help it levitate, but it relies more so on geomagnetism.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME rapidly flaps the leaves on its head to whip up whirlwinds. The blinding sand that this stirs up allows it to make its escape.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a cautious hunter that hides beneath the sand until prey draws near. It is also a very fast Pokémon, flapping its wings at high speeds that produce a distinctive, bug-like sound.
author: alexgriller

entry: POKENAME hides beneath the sand to ambush its prey, which it then seizes with its claws. By vibrating its wings at high speed, it can generate threatening sand tornadoes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME hunts, it stealthily moves below the sand's surface. It then ambushes its prey, biting down with pointed fangs before injecting it with deadly venom.
author: mepp.

entry: It lurks in the shadows of those lost in the desert, softly whispering to its prey to drive it mad before devouring it. At night, its red eyes can sometimes be seen within the shadows themselves.
author: h0bojoe

entry: By subtly flapping its wings, POKENAME emits soothing vibrations. Those who have experienced this sensation have described it as a caressing lullaby.
author: noel5229

entry: Despite its small stature, POKENAME is revered by all those who come across it. It can be found most commonly among lily pads.
author: flickeredflame

entry: POKENAME eventually got leggings, as its legs were very vulnerable before. It admires Quaquaval and wants to learn Aqua Step.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have aqua-colored scales that glitter while underwater and unintentionally attracts predators. Whenever a predator comes near them, they shoot out a cloud of ink before escaping.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During thunderstorms, POKENAME raises its horn toward the sky. After a lightning strike, its scales emit a dazzling pink and azure glow.
author: .izik

entry: With delicate wings made of water, the graceful POKENAME flutters where flowers and water abound, seeking out nectar from the sweetest blooms with ease.
author: wolfbrine

entry: POKENAME's body is sheathed in translucent icy scales. These rare scales are highly sought after to craft magnificent dresses.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon is irritated by the slightest grime. It is prized in contests for its beauty and swift and fluid swimming.
author: capwolfbane

entry: POKENAME sheds its scales once a month, replacing the old ones with new scales that are even more colorful, beautiful, and durable. A very vain Pokémon, it avoids combat whenever possible for fear of getting dirty or damaging its appearance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has a rather placid personality, spending time preening and watching over younger avian Pokémon. It spits a stream of water upward to create a showering fountain for the little ones to play under.
author: sk372

entry: Tiny scales around POKENAME's body shimmer brightly. Just before unleashing powerful bursts of electricity, they glow in waves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sits at the bottom of deep lakes and sings enchanting songs. People and Pokémon alike have been hypnotized into drowning from following after its music.
author: porpoisemerchant

entry: Its feathers are coveted as weapons both for their beauty and their razor sharpness.  However, because it is so proud, it won't allow anyone to touch them.
author: bostroms

entry: Although POKENAME is mainly an aquatic Pokémon, it is also capable of moving on land. The beautiful scales on its back allow it to roll quickly across any type of terrain. It charges at its opponents, overwhelming them with its powerful body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Displaying beauty and power, POKENAME travels the world seeking revenge on all who wronged it. It protects those who supported it as it matured.
author: kill_the_wabbit

entry: They live on exotic islands, and frequently swim to nearby islands to find more food. The double fins make POKENAME exceptionally good swimmers. Tame POKENAME use their fins like fans to cool down their Trainers when the temperature rises.
author: leandermalurt

entry: Gentle and kind, POKENAME gather and play deep within large lakes. They carry Prism Scales in lieu of eggs.
author: .towerxvi

entry: Found mainly in the depths of icy sea trade lanes, POKENAME set up colonies aboard sunken cargo vessels. Their bright coloration serves to warn intruders to stay away, and to protect their families they freeze salt water around threats.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME have iridescent scales that fan out in a dazzling display. Their frosty claws pick at their scales to ensure that they always look beautiful. Their scales also release a soft glow that is comforting to stare at.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its true beauty often bewitches people and other Pokémon. It regularly hides behind its sturdy kelp growths to avoid unwanted attention.
author: mundane_frog

entry: A POKENAME can adjust the color and reflectivity of its back scales at will. When viewed in water from above, the scales catch the light and render the POKENAME nearly invisible to predators.
author: staghorn

entry: Despite their protectiveness of their Trainers, POKENAME are quite carefree and will often get lost in awe as they watch the bubbles they make.
author: headizemptee75250

entry: It is said that POKENAME's appearance reflects not just its strength, but also the depths of their devotion. Truly beautiful POKENAME not only possess great power, they are also seen as a testament to their Trainer's dedication and integrity.
author: thatlittletwerp

entry: It is said that a favorite pastime of wild POKENAME is to dance across the water of their lakeside habitats as if ignoring gravity altogether. Those lucky enough to witness such a spectacle are said to have briefly achieved a state of nirvana.
author: thatlittletwerp

entry: Known as the guardian of swamps, its mere presence is able to stop conflicts. The flower on its back is a good indicator of the health of the area it lives in.
author: flickeredflame

entry: In the oceans of Hoenn and Johto, POKENAME have built sandbars known collectively as Sailor's Doom. They circle only with their tails above water, and wreck any craft attempting to pass.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is known to be both beautiful and rather aggressive towards those it deems behaving in an ugly manner. It's primarily been seen picking fights with Gyarados and Sharpedo in this regard.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sightings are extremely rare, as it teleports away in a flash of radiant colors when noticed. Its disappearance rarely leaves behind one of its iridescent scales behind, which fetch obscene prices on collectors' markets.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME make their home in arid desert environments. POKENAME rarely need to move once established, as smaller Pokémon will flock to them as a source of water, providing food in exchange for shelter and protection.
author: jadey.1557

entry: The prismatic scales on its scabbard are said to calm violent hearts; perfect for pacifying POKENAME's victims before striking.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME are incredibly graceful beings that usually inhabit the shores of lakes. Their temperament makes them aggressive toward intruders. They will not hesitate to strike with powerful attacks from their electrified tails to defend their home.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This Pokémon lives in deep lakes and will defend its home ferociously, leading it to be seen as a lake guardian. Its wings shimmer brightly like painted glass and produce a soothing melody when it takes flight.
author: infinex21

entry: The dazzling appearance and aura of POKENAME is said among sailors to have mysterious healing powers. Despite its graceful and delicate looks, it's strong enough to crush a submarine without displacing a single scale.
author: epping_forest

entry: Thanks to its scales, POKENAME can dive in and out of the water without losing any speed. Its excellent flying and swimming make it a great hunter.
author: phantom640

entry: Living in the seas, you will know it is near by its harmonious singing. It is thought this Pokémon is the origin of the myth of mermaids.
author: melodydelune

entry: Highly sought after for beauty contests, POKENAME are rare to find in the wild. Their scales sparkle like gems, and have been used more frequently in jewelry.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME emanates a soothing aura that calms even the most turbulent waters. Its presence brings tranquility to all who encounter it.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME lives at the bottom of lakes and oceans near hydrothermal vents. It uses its beautiful wings to scatter its scales around the vents to mark territory.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: POKENAME discards their hind legs for a beautiful tail, heavily sought after by poachers for its stained glass-like patterns. Because it only gained its vision recently, its helplessness and cuteness makes for an ideal pet.
author: beatdoof

entry: Unlike many other Pokémon with multiple heads, POKENAME's two heads are notably cooperative and get along with each other, though each head still equally vies for attention. It's also much more intelligent than it was before evolving.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME has exceptional intellect, impeccable memory, and a truly beautiful form, which is often seen in artworks. However, don't enrage it, as it is more than capable of destruction, with violent flooding being its most often-used method.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME form a fog that obscures their presence, but are drawn to the elderly when they visit lakes. They help the elderly relive memories using their psychic powers, restoring a sense of nostalgia for a moment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A special soap-like fluid is secreted from its underbelly, which when combined with water becomes a slippery, bubble-like coat to its surroundings. Its movement is not impaired, but instead enhanced in this terrain.
author: omegacyclops

entry: POKENAME eat only the tastiest fish Pokémon. When they get out of the water, they brush their hair with their claws over and over.
author: ayner

entry: POKENAME leave the shallow pools where they were born as soon as they can, and move into nearby forests where they thrive by lakes. They make a buzzing melody when they fly, and are known as the "Violas of the Lake".
author: leandermalurt

entry: POKENAME is the result of attempts to "beautify" Feebas by making them resemble their evolution. Opinions of POKENAME among Feebas fans are mixed.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME was revered in ancient times for its great beauty. Fossils of its teeth and claws are still valued as luxury items.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME gathers near quiet lakes at dusk, practicing dances said to embody pure serenity. Anyone who happens to watch these performances finds their worries melting away.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: It often brings itself to tears with its own performances. POKENAME gets emotionally overwhelmed very easily and is not advised as a companion to first-time Trainers.
author: ferdirenz

entry: Despite its beautiful appearance, POKENAME has a nasty temperament. Some people carry their scales as good luck charms.
author: mepp.

entry: Groups of these Pokémon hang around coral reefs and provide protection for smaller fish Pokémon. However, if any boats come near their reef, they will violently attack it until there is nothing left.
author: mistymagius

entry: Flocks of POKENAME inhabit misty highland areas, descending to lower regions to hunt. They let out a supersonic screech to stun prey and foes alike, diving in from above to take advantage of the opportunity.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME releases calming energy waves to soothe the spirit of its prey, lowering their defenses before striking. It is able to shoot water out of the openings at the end of each arm, delivering high-pressure blasts.
author: sara886a

entry: In ancient times, it was hunted down for its beautiful scales. It was no easy feat, however, as POKENAME is a very formidable foe.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: Known to many as the "Songstress of the Lake," POKENAME will sing and dance within the waters of deep lakes. These performances have mystifying powers that cleanse water, and it will only move to a new lake when it has fully cleansed the prior lake.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME will give its scales as gifts to Trainers it trusts. Necklaces adorned with these scales are said to ward off negative emotions.
author: josh707

entry: It hones its power through daily meditation and dancing in rhythm with the tides. The scale on its head grows in proportion to its strength.
author: josh707

entry: POKENAME possesses both immense strength and beauty. It resolves most conflicts without violence, either by charming or intimidating would-be opponents.
author: josh707

entry: A necktie decorated with POKENAME's sparkling scales is a cherished engagement gift. It is believed to ensure a joyful marriage.
author: .izik

entry: A highly-adept swimmer, POKENAME creates a rainbow trail behind it when it leaps above the water's surface. Though beautiful, witnesses to this colorful display develop strong headaches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are sold as pets due to their small size and beautiful scales. However, they're not very safe for children, as they electrically shock anyone who comes too close.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME prefer to live in the deepest lakes. Their six light-emitting organs, three on each side, attract prey in the gloomy depths. POKENAME strike with electricity to immobilize their prey before tearing at it with their fangs.
author: .realthree

entry: It can be dangerous to approach brackish lakes, especially ones with clear water, as POKENAME make their homes there. They have a tendency to drag noisy hikers off of the shore and down into the depths of the lake.
author: .realthree

entry: The scales on POKENAME's tail are highly sought after by poachers. Unbeknownst to them, if threatened, this Pokémon's hair bristles and sprays the area with embers. It then shoots bubbles, allowing it to slide away at high speeds.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Fabled to be born of fire and water, which exudes both beauty and authority. When POKENAME senses danger near its territory, the scales on its tail vibrate rapidly, generating heat, boiling water to scalding temperatures to fire upon intruders.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME spreads its magnificent, colorful wings solely to show them off, as it is very rarely seen taking flight. It wins over its partner by performing graceful, elegant dances underwater.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spreads its magnificent, colorful wings solely to show them off, as it is very rarely seen taking flight. It wins over its partner by performing graceful, elegant dances underwater.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's tentacles are coated with tiny crimson scales that get lighter when out of the water. Many jewelers attach these scales to necklaces, paired with Shellder pearls, due to their unique beauty.
author: .izik

entry: For a time, shed POKENAME scales were harvested to sell as glamorous accessories. This was outlawed after demand caused greedy sorts to begin harvesting them in inhumane ways.
author: sk372

entry: Feral Feebas biting its tail isn't a big concern for this sociable and patient creature, as its scale-covered body and regenerative powers prevent pain and lasting damage.
author: sontyp

entry: The cannon on its back is three times as powerful as a Blastoise's. Despite its strength, POKENAME prefers to avoid conflict.
author: admiralvermin

entry: POKENAME's shell gleams like sapphire under the sun. Oddly, the pearls it creates are dull and largely dismissed by Johtonian jewelers.
author: .izik

entry: Each of the eggs has a very hard, scaly shell. No one understands how this fusion can fly if it since it has no wings.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: Though technically only able to glide rather than achieving true flight, POKENAME still delights in the wings it grew. It's so proud, that whenever it transforms it purposely retains them while in its new shape.
author: sk372

entry: One of the apex predators of the ancient world, POKENAME's cry was enough to send throngs of smaller Pokémon scurrying for shelter. Fossil records suggest it shared leftovers from its hunts with young Bagon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's extremely sharp wings and viscous temperament leads to its opponent being slashed to pieces. They tend to live in caves or mountains.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME always feels attracted to anything that comes in groups of seven, for it seems to be the only number that can count and comprehend. In many ancient cultures, this little creature was known as "The Moonchild".
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME wield their axe-like horns with ease and precision, cutting down ancient trees in one swing. Male POKENAME fight with their horns to try and attract a mate.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's needle-like beak is adept at cracking the shells of prey. When angered, it generates dangerous tempests by rapidly flapping its wings.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: When enraged, it spins uncontrollably. If it spins fast enough, it takes to the air and looses attacks in all directions.
author: busilisk

entry: Murals depicting POKENAME have been discovered in Hoenn ruins. According to these depictions, its prismatic plumage was highly valued; those possessing even a single feather were considered blessed by higher powers.
author: sk372

entry: The spikes that cover its entire body grow alarmingly fast, and POKENAME tends to shed them during any attack. A single lunge can create up to a hundred of these projectiles, often towards its opponents.
author: omegacyclops

entry: POKENAME dances silently through moonlit fields, the arc of its blade mimicking the flow of its billowing skirt. Legends say it once hunted dragons, its elegant movements slicing through even the toughest scales.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME's red arm-blades are capable of slicing through solid rock. With a noble disposition, POKENAME always uses its strength to fight for the underdog.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has the destructive power to shatter entire buildings with Dragon Claw. It has a code of honor like knights and tries to hold back its ferocious instincts.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME always keep their torsos blue and white to blend in among the clouds, but change the color of their wings and frills freely. They joyfully race with each other across the sky, creating colored contrails that resemble odd rainbows.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It launches itself using its psychic abilities, spinning like a gigantic shuriken as it flies. It can outpace even supersonic fighter jets.
author: staghorn

entry: Despite its loss of wings, POKENAME is still blindingly fast. It can jump at incredibly high as well, making it still a formidable aerial predator.
author: patch_bros

entry: When enraged, POKENAME will attack without pause. Using its mighty wings, it will fly skyward before crashing down with a devastating Head Smash.
author: theartemis1

entry: An enraged POKENAME is incredibly difficult to stop. What it fails to destroy with its ironclad head, it melts with fiery breath, leaving only ruin in its wake.
author: spartan_ct

entry: Folktales refer to POKENAME as a demon that descends from the high mountains only if it senses an adversary worth fighting.
author: togetik

entry: When a foe sees the otherworldly glow from its blades alight, it is already too late. POKENAME swoops down, steals their soul, extinguishes its flames again, and disappears into the night.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME's pair of axe blades can be used in conjunction like wings, allowing it to fly rapidly at vast heights. When enraged, it lights its axes on fire, making its slices a lot more dangerous while also intimidating its foes.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME flaps its wings, a menacing growl is created. It uses this ability to chase weaker Pokémon into its territory, where a fierce sandstorm awaits. They get lost in the harsh winds and become POKENAME's prey.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is unfazed by any threat or danger that comes across its flight. Its wings have fused together to create a crescent shape.
author: soup1900

entry: Fusion energy has caused POKENAME to awaken its ancient genes. It is an extremely savage Pokémon, completely eradicating its enemies in a very brutal manner.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME scatters feathers while it flies around in search of prey. Its crescent-shaped wings are often used as a form of intimidation against strong foes.
author: soup1900

entry: By tucking in its forelegs, POKENAME streamlines itself to allow high speeds and quick movements while in flight. POKENAME's sharp crescent wing can maul foes if it rams them with it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME scatters feathers while it flies around in search of prey. Its crescent-shaped wings are often used as a form of intimidation against strong foes.
author: soup1900

entry: By tucking in its forelegs, POKENAME streamlines itself to allow high speeds and quick movements while in flight. POKENAME's sharp crescent wing can maul foes if it rams them with it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is unfazed by any threat or danger that comes across its flight. Its wings have fused together to create a crescent shape.
author: soup1900

entry: Fusion energy has caused POKENAME to awaken its ancient genes. It is an extremely savage Pokémon, completely eradicating its enemies in a very brutal manner.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME was long believed to be a fable. Its power is truly legendary, able to distort space-time around itself to render it in a form incomprehensible to humans. When angry it breathes fire at temperatures that seem to make the air around it melt.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its ears are strong enough to take flight and glide through the sky, realizing POKENAME's long-held dream. Kicks from its muscled legs can shatter boulders.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME stand at the top of mountains under the full moon to gather mystical energy. Once they are fully charged, the tips of their wings will glow pink as they fly away into the night, disappearing until the next full moon.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME soars at unimaginable speeds, easily circling the earth world in minutes. When it maximizes its energy output, its propulsive power quadruples.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME strives to find the perfect composition for its disguise that will allow it to soar through the air. After failed attempts, it thrashes about in a petulant tantrum.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is very similar to a Pokémon described in the Scarlet Book. The heads on its arms are very weak, but the main head is much stronger in comparison and delivers a devastating bite.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME was once used in war as an aerial intelligence and combat unit. In the modern day, it excels in battle and makes a powerful partner for a trusted Trainer. POKENAME is unlikely to obey a Trainer it has been traded to.
author: nyoomymph

entry: If a Shelgon is attacked before it evolves, it may temporarily become a POKENAME. They use what remains of their shell to protect their body.
author: ansleehariot

entry: This Pokémon can almost always be found on the vast pile of gems it has collected. It often agonizes over whether to eat them or to keep them.
author: dusknoir64

entry: POKENAME takes pleasure in annoying people that dare to infiltrate its territory. To achieve this, loud obnoxious vibrations emit from POKENAME's ears to disorient and stagger trespassers before it swoops in at mach speeds to strike.
author: redmagecole

entry: The parasite having absorbed most of its life essence, POKENAME can no longer fly. Though supposedly a husk, the host's lingering rage at being denied its dream causes it to occasionally rampage indiscriminately.
author: sk372

entry: Weak on its own, POKENAME often sticks close to Gyarados or Sharpedo. It feeds by scavenging on leftover prey these larger Pokémon don't finish.
author: mepp.

entry: Always angry, POKENAME scorches everything in its path in a fit of rage. It soars across the sky at high speeds, cloaking itself in its harsh flames.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME prides itself in aerial supremacy, keeping itself in flight at all times in combat. If an opponent forcibly grounds it, there will be no escape from the indignant rage it enters.
author: sk372

entry: The draconic energy contained within the body of POKENAME bursts out of its body, forming wings that allow for low altitude flight. This energy is freezing cold, and will burn anyone who is exposed to it.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME are frequent pests for factory workers, as they often attempt to eat the many gears and wires that make up the machines. They also enjoy sleeping inside these machines, causing the inner workings to jam.
author: oxitape.

entry: Each gear spins at a different speed, generating an erratic magnetic field. Some people theorize this is what a Voltorb's inside looks like.
author: maelmc

entry: Energy companies have bought and extracted the red energy core component from POKENAME but it refuses to power anything other than its original set.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: After evolving, its once long and unstable neck disappeared. Though it now looks less intimidating, POKENAME feels much better and more stable than before.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is a connoisseur of both sweets and oils, and uses both to sustain itself. Whatever it does not use is burned to ash and emitted through its tail.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The ring on the back of POKENAME constantly rotates and makes audible ticking noises like a clock, seemingly counting down to its evolution. Once a POKENAME is almost ready to evolve, its red core will start flashing and produce a beeping sound.
author: oxitape.

entry: The many gears on POKENAME's body control its powerful running charges. It can quickly charge, stop, and turn at a moment's notice, making it surprisingly maneuverable.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME keep their children safe within a part of their body always kept close by a weak magnetic field. They will engage in combat with any potential threat to their child, even if it puts themselves in danger.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME propels itself by letting water rush over the gear on its back. Should the current stop, or POKENAME run ashore, it will become agitated and let out harsh metallic chimes until it is placed in running water again.
author: agentyoshi

entry: These odd Pokémon have reportedly been seen scouring farms, abducting Tauros and Miltank. Scientists have yet to witness this themselves, and no one is sure where these abductees have supposedly been taken to.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a great welder and is able to take up the work of two workers. It takes pride in helping factory engineers complete projects.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The red core on POKENAME's face is an eye protected by a glass-like substance made from gravel. It also loves to climb trees and weave its metallic silk into a magnetic nest.
author: duskit___

entry: As a POKENAME fights, the Fire Stone on its tail is ground down. As such, training such a Pokémon can be costly.
author: spriter

entry: POKENAME processes and compresses synthetic waste through its chest cavity. Despite its robotic appearance, POKENAME is able to develop a strong emotional connection with its Trainer.
author: jojojax164

entry: The Pokémon's whole body is in constant flux. Unlike a normal Kakuna, its body does not change so much as it continually reforms. After about three weeks, it will evolve into its final form.
author: duskit___

entry: POKENAME's numerous drills rotate fast enough to effortlessly pierce through tungsten. However, its relentless drilling causes frequent overheating.
author: lynkinator

entry: With powerful metal plating, missiles and even beam weaponry from its mouth, POKENAME is a powerful tank of a fighting machine. It fares poorly in muddy or swampy terrain, however.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME relies on its gears to keep an accurate sense of time. Its body can only maintain 16 continuous hours of activity before recharging.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME keeps track of the time with its gears, which tick every second without fail. Watchmakers rely on its help to ensure timepieces give an accurate read of time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A multitude of powerful gears within POKENAME give its wings and fists a tremendous amount of strength. It can maneuver in the air at fantastic speeds and throw a flurry of powerful punches in the blink of an eye.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is made entirely of gears that must be constantly lubricated. It produces a dense metal webbing that, when refined, can be crafted into a Stretchy Spring.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When POKENAME uses Perish Song, the spiked gear on the bottom starts to spin rapidly. When it stops moving, both POKENAME and anyone who hears the song faints. POKENAME must constantly find lubricant to prevent itself from rusting.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is often seen lazily laid out on copper roofs in the sun. The rust on its body doesn't seem to affect its machinery at all.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: POKENAME struts through alleys displaying bizarre, overpriced gadgets with exaggerated gestures and an ever-present smug grin. Most Trainers walk away without buying a thing, unsure if they resisted a scam or missed out on something brilliant.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME releases bursts of aerosol paint from their back that clings to objects around them. They are often found in factories where they paint many factory parts at the same time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A mesh of gears and exoskeleton, POKENAME is somehow silent when traversing through the night. If it likes its Trainer, it can power rudimentary electronics with a spinning gear where its heart should be.
author: notsaying.

entry: It lurks in the planet's mantle, feeding on rare minerals. If you hear gears violently shifting from below, POKENAME may emerge from the ground.
author: lynkinator

entry: Before battle, POKENAME spins the large gear on its back at high speeds to charge electricity. It then tries to end fights quickly by using electrified punches; if the battle lasts too long, the electricity will overheat its body and melt it away.
author: soup1900

entry: Storing extreme amounts of energy, POKENAME can overclock its pincers to forcefully crush objects it normally couldn't squeeze. This energy is also used to fire its pincers at bullet speeds and knock out a foe before the battle even starts.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME is not battling, it uses its gears to wind a spring inside its body. When it enters battle, it uses the energy stored within the spring to attack with incredible force.
author: vibrationjaveline

entry: POKENAME uses the gears on its body to shoot out a powerful stream of water. The faster the gears spin, the more concentrated the stream of water is.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The treads of a POKENAME are clad in suction-pads that allow them to move across nearly any terrain, and even along walls and ceilings. The gears on either side of its head spin quickest right as it prepares to fire from its cannon.
author: infinex21

entry: It's rumored to be a marine survey drone that went rogue due to programming errors. Up to six Kliraid can dock under its wings at any given moment.
author: nvisionluminous

entry: If you hear metallic clacking, it may indicate that POKENAME is speeding towards you. Its tusks are sharp enough to pierce through ship hulls.
author: beespoon

entry: POKENAME works behind the scenes to ensure movies capture dynamic shots. Its ability to stabilize and synchronize cameras makes it a valuable asset on any film crew.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME works alongside factory engineers by handing out tools. It wants to feel helpful and is eager to learn how to perform complex tasks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME elusively travels the world to repair machines damaged by excessive water damage, rust, or short-circuits. Mechanics worldwide worship it as an industrial purification deity.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Supposedly, the two gears within its hands are called "Time Gears." Legends claim that if the smaller gear is stolen, then time around POKENAME will freeze. Likewise, they also claim if the larger gear is stolen, then all of time will also freeze.
author: infinex21

entry: Once its chainsaw limbs are revved up, POKENAME won't rest until it's cut into something with them. Many get employed to help out in lumber yards or as wood carvers.
author: sk372

entry: Capable of consuming food at a rapid rate, the modern day assembly line is based off of the mechanical tongue of the POKENAME.
author: jemeremmazza

entry: POKENAME's body is an incomprehensible mass of tangled gears and wires. Its erratic motions suggest multiple minds vying for control of the amalgam.
author: nvisionluminous

entry: POKENAME is suitable for the most complex feats of engineering. It takes great pride in working alongside engineers to create solutions to modern challenges.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are seemingly drawn to areas filled with strife and conflict, often seeming to try and interfere with any aircraft. The bombs they drop are filled only with restorative and soothing energies meant to encourage peace.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME plough through snow, asphalt and loose ground with ease. They cool themselves down by releasing lots of steam.
author: lemmymaster

entry: It burns masses of coal and other fuel sources in its hull. POKENAME has the ability to spin its treads, shoot out hot slabs of metal, and even split thick metal walls with its sharp-edged front.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME dominates its forest environment, with few predators able to pierce its steel plating and even fewer able to digest it. It leaves deep gashes in the trees it climbs.
author: dylonk25

entry: The third in a line of man-made Pokémon made for train engines. Its body has managed to maximize fuel efficency.
author: gayschlatt

entry: The gears churning in its back give extra power to the water it can shoot from its mouth. POKENAME applies mud to its body that, strangely, seems to increase the functionality of its  gears as they rotate.
author: sk372

entry: These odd Pokémon often make their nests near bodies of running water, even though their metal bodies can rust. Their bodies are strong enough to lift boulders, which they stack up along their nests to try and block most water.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spins and rotates like an elegant, sophisticated machine. Its top half can detach and float independently from its body.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME spins and rotates like an elegant, sophisticated machine. Its top half can detach and float independently from its body.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: The gear at the very center of the energy within its ring-like body never turns unless the POKENAME is agitated. The quicker its gears turn, the stronger its otherworldly powers become.
author: infinex21

entry: Some Trainers of POKENAME like to attach decorations to its upper ring, and there are even full contests in some regions over the best designs.
author: mirby

entry: Sometimes referred to as "The Machine Queen," POKENAME has influence over all mechanical Pokémon. The orb on its staff is able to power-up or power-down any technology, a power only POKENAME can activate.
author: sk372

entry: The abdominal mouth of a POKENAME is used to collect and devour scrap metal, emitting ominous smoke as it recycles the material. The reclaimed metal becomes new parts to replace old ones, which are discarded as scrap.
author: infinex21

entry: A rotating mechanism embedded in its shell absorbs seismic energy, powering its internal engines and making it move.
author: anarchaz

entry: Well-trained POKENAME can be very useful for their spinning saws, but feral ones wreak havoc on buildings and endanger lives. Most regions require a permit to own or breed them.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME are unusually friendly for Luxray fusions. When two pack-leading POKENAME meet, they connect their gear-shaped manes and smile - afterward, their packs merge, and both POKENAME lead as equals.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can rotate its head 360 degrees continuously, which it uses to drill into the sides of mountains. They can endure days of drilling at a time, making them invaluable to miners daring enough to train one.
author: vlavoc

entry: POKENAME is a judgement-class beast, with impervious armor and superb power. While cold and aloof, it's very caring and will protect those it trusts.
author: theeggoverlord

entry: This Pokémon was originally thought to have been a hoax, having been first documented in an disreputable gossip magazine.
author: griddle

entry: Since fusion was discovered, many Trainers have argued that this Pokémon is not a true fusion - just a tightly bound cluster of Klinklangs mistaken for one.
author: starexpizz

entry: This clockwork monstrosity is well-suited to battle against legendary leviathans. Its powered by a bottomless well of hydrothermal energy that goes haywire during droughts.
author: sk372

entry: This mechanical creature is well-suited to battle against legendary titans. The artificial sun powering its engine glitches out when confronted by heavy rains.
author: sk372

entry: This mechanical Pokémon soars in our planet's orbit, its rings and gears always turning to generate raw power. It will quickly target and destroy any meteors that draw too close to the atmosphere.
author: infinex21

entry: The gears of POKENAME's tail are constantly turning, generating a steady flow of potent electricity. When it discharges excess energy from the ring on its back, it creates thunderstorms in local areas.
author: infinex21

entry: Twirling rapidly to build up energy, POKENAME defend themselves with the rings that surround their bodies. If they ever need to get out of trouble, they rapidly rotate their rings to propel themselves upwards with the magnetic force.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: An ancient automaton, POKENAME is curiously made with modern mechanical parts. Allegedly, an army of them could be strong enough to conquer the world.
author: blazerxz

entry: The colored orbs indicate POKENAME's disposition, glowing red when it becomes aggressive. In combat, fire bursts from every one of its vents, coating its body and wings in roiling flames.
author: sk372

entry: The cage of gears around POKENAME help to control its wild and ancient magic. Each gear carries a unique enchantment.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Legends state that if POKENAME ever stops spinning its gears, any onlookers will be cursed. The Ninetales only moves its lower body to stay on the gears. It doesn't appear to actually be organic: only a faint whirring can be heard inside of it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a voracious appetite for metal, attacking factory machinery in a feeding frenzy. It is considered a pest because of the damage it causes in large swarms.
author: daemonkill22

entry: Its energy core and projectile-emitting teeth allow POKENAME to ground and catch prey flying above it.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME hides in scrapyards, camouflaging among rusted gears. When disturbed, it releases a magnetic pulse that locks nearby objects in place before clamping down on them with its heavy metal jaws, capturing anything in its path.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME scampers about searching for precious gems that it can make into valuable decorative gears. What purpose this behaviour serves is unknown.
author: phantom640

entry: When POKENAME clamps down with its massive steel jaws, it can crush anything between its fangs. If it needs extra power to bite, the gear with the red core spins rapidly, releasing hissing bursts of steam.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its dances are rigid and robotic. If it attempts to dance too rapidly, its body overheats, which comes in handy for searing its foes in battle.
author: hophoppip

entry: It has learned to twirl the ring around its waist by gyrating its lower body. The sounds of clinking metal as it dances produces a satisfying rhythm.
author: seaslux

entry: POKENAME is most often seen in scrapyards, consuming any bits of metal it comes across. With its composition being a seemingly-random assortment of junk parts, scientists are still studying how it functions at all.
author: sk372

entry: Some conspiracy theorists believe that POKENAME is a secret government project designed to attack enemy ships from below.
author: chorb33

entry: The time on its dial never matches the actual time. Folk tales believe that POKENAME actually shows the date of death of the person who sees it.
author: chorb33

entry: The metronomic tick-tock of POKENAME's gears echoes through the old growth forests it protects. Those who litter or fell trees within its realm are shown no mercy.
author: fancyskunk

entry: Archaeologists found a specimen of POKENAME while investigating an ancient site. It is uncertain when, or even if, POKENAME will run out of fuel.
author: chorb33

entry: Archaeologists found a specimen of POKENAME while investigating an ancient site. It is uncertain when, or even if, POKENAME will run out of fuel.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME was first found after an expedition into an abandoned mine. Its engine is powered by a mysterious dark matter.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME constantly grows gears across its body and lives on a diet of scrap metal. They have found a niche in manufacturing plants, where they consume any offcuts and offer the gears they grow to be used in machinery.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Due to its large size, POKENAME requires an extremely large amount of coal to be able to move. The many spinning gears inside of POKENAME's body allow it to generate electricity, which it uses to attack its opponents.
author: darkweavile428

entry: With its powerful core and self-defense capabilities from its ring, POKENAME mines more minerals than it needs and easily makes its owner a profit.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: When maintained, this trio can perform extremely profitable mining operations. When neglected, they've been known to cause disastrous cave-ins.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its whiskers can detect the presence of valuable items from far away. It regularly polishes its steel body to maintain its shine.
author: lynkinator

entry: It constantly channels electricity into the gear beneath its feet, giving it the magnetic force needed to levitate. When the gear suddenly reverses its rotation, it means POKENAME is charging up a powerful attack.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When the iron gears on its legs begin spinning rapidly, POKENAME's body becomes enveloped in sparks. Its long metal tail acts as a lightning rod, allowing it to absorb electrical energy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is placed in factories as a method of pest control, luring small vermin into its grinding gears via smell. When necessary, it doubles as a trash can.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME has an affinity for rocky mountainsides. It scales rough summits by rapidly spinning its gears, which boast a surprising amount of grip.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME hangs around junkyards and trash heaps, using its extra arms to grab and analyze scrap it finds. It consumes metal that meets its criteria, though the exact criteria it searches for is not yet known.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often used in large industrial forges to transport hot metal, as they do not mind high heat and can trudge through molten material.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME eats coal to fuel the furnace in its body. It ejects the incredibly hot flames from the combustion process through various openings.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME rotates continuously, using self-generated magnetism to accelerate in such a way that it sparks.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can generate an incredible amount of energy, but it also emits powerful magnetic waves that disable most electrical devices in the vicinity.
author: chorb33

entry: By rotating its heads, POKENAME can constantly generate energy and heat, which it can store in its outer ring. It can also use this to release it.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's body rotates continuously, causing its individual heads to change position regularly. The one at the top is in temporary command.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME are often found in burnt factories, as the Klinklang melts and fuses with the Muk. This is a fusion that was found even before DNA Splicers.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are thought to be failed experiments that broke out and now live in the deep ocean. How they reproduce, avoid rusting, and survive the pressure is still unknown.
author: notmax22

entry: Before changing its appearance through illusions, POKENAME surrounds itself with smoke, making those who see it think it fled.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: A masterful trickster, the wild laugh of a POKENAME is a sure sign of trouble. When not playing pranks, POKENAME plays songs, producing organ-like melodies with its three large ears.
author: hophoppip

entry: Wild POKENAME are highly dangerous because of their ability to create an illusion as a distraction while it strikes from behind.
author: prof.whitebeam

entry: Its power over illusions and ability to shapeshift its incredibly malleable body means that it can take on nearly any appearance it desires, as long as it has the body mass for it. If it is suddenly surprised, it will revert to its original form.
author: elfail0

entry: Whenever it encounters predators, POKENAME creates illusionary flames in an attempt to scare them away. While it's normally wary of Trainers, those it trusts find its fur to be incredibly soft.
author: tmotime

entry: Their flames allow POKENAME to ensnare their opponents in a mirage formed by the heat haze. Once trapped by the illusion, there is no escape.
author: jordanx27

entry: A Pokémon often associated with vast wisdom and cunning. Its mastery over illusions allows it to appear in many places at once, deceiving both prey and those who hunt it. Even more frighteningly, its illusions can make forests appear endless.
author: elfail0

entry: It projects holograms in the deep sea to lure prey and scare predators. When it feels lonely, POKENAME uses that power to create imaginary friends.
author: epping_forest

entry: By mimicking the cries of other bird Pokémon, POKENAME deceives parents and steals eggs from their nests while they're away.
author: .izik

entry: This incredibly shy Pokémon can conjure illusions to mislead potential enemies or cover its escape. Due to its large size, cuddly appearance, and lack of aggression, POKENAME are prized highly as pets for young children.
author: elfail0

entry: POKENAME can be found soaring through the sky disguised as other bird Pokémon, and their migration patterns match the Pokémon around them. They opportunistically steal treats from unattended food left at parks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can draw any scene as if it were real in order to confound its prey. For whatever reason, though, this strategy never seems to actually work.
author: squawkabairdy

entry: POKENAME is best known for its appearances in spy movies. It can transform into any Pokémon, but tripping breaks the illusion.
author: aberry8286

entry: Despite ominous tales, POKENAME is gentle toward lost toddlers. It imitates their parents to guide wandering children safely back to towns.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are as fast as they are cunning. They will quietly hide in the shadows before swiftly shocking their target with a deep-red lightning bolt.
author: mistymagius

entry: Deep within foggy forests, POKENAME studies passing Trainers in an attempt to learn more about humans. If a Trainer remains lost in the woods after its research is complete, it will create an illusion of a stray Pokémon to lead them to safety.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME imitates power plant workers with eerie precision. When left alone, it siphons electricity from machines to fuel itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swoops from tree to tree, casting illusions from the shadows. These perplexing phantasms range from malicious to deadly.
author: .realthree

entry: This noble Pokémon can create the most elaborate illusions to lure humans away from its home. It can even make illusory creatures tangible if it sacrifices some of its life force.
author: cheroace

entry: Cloaked in shadows and powered by aura, POKENAME confounds foes with illusions while striking with steel claws. Its power surges with each deception.
author: sheogorath

entry: POKENAME uses its illusions to hide itself from Trainers and Pokémon it considers to be weak. It will only reveal itself to worthy opponents in order to challenge them to a fight.
author: hello_i_exist

entry: POKENAME move like ghosts in the night. Very few have been seen due to their speed and illusory capabilities. They are fiercely territorial.
author: ishdra

entry: POKENAME loves to prank unfortunate folks lost in the woods. It casts an illusion to disguise itself as a large set of foliage, waiting for a hapless traveler to come close before belting out an unnervingly deep croaking laugh.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME pretends its mane is made of flames by creating illusions, frightening many Pokémon that mistake it for real fire. When cornered, it can unleash rapid and highly accurate punches.
author: fiordaliso

entry: To protect their lair, POKENAME work together to trick and swiftly attack at those they deem to be a threat. It has speed and agility like no other Pokémon.
author: dahappycute

entry: Its six ears are said to hear any secret within a thousand miles radius. POKENAME can perfectly impersonate any creature it wants for its own benefit.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME traps multiple victims in illusions at once, storing them for later, when it'll be hungry for their life force.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME roams under the cover of night, challenging worthy foes with lethal surprise attacks and lightning-fast strikes only to vanish into the shadows again before they can strike back. Only those who prove their skill may glimpse it twice.
author: silentscript89

entry: A master of both battle and trickery, POKENAME tend to shy away from combat, instead creating electrical mirages to hide their children from danger. They love to create illusionary thunderstorms to drive away competitors and curious people.
author: cpnquacken

entry: The ultimate nocturnal hunter, POKENAME causes blackouts to terrify its prey. Its X-ray vision and illusion manipulation make it a fearsome foe whose eyes cannot be blinded.
author: merclipse

entry: If miners enter its cave, POKENAME imitates one of them to lure an individual away. It drags the isolated victim deeper into the mine to feed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has fine control over water, using it to refract and reflect light through mists to create visual illusions. These illusions are usually used in an effort to entertain and amuse sailors and other Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: If you watch TV near POKENAME, it will get incredibly upset. You can sometimes hear radio broadcasts emanating from it.
author: jokerswild

entry: If you watch TV near POKENAME, it will get incredibly upset. You can sometimes hear radio broadcasts emanating from it.
author: jokerswild

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a powerplant worker near substations. It absorbs large amounts of electricity unnoticed before slipping away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME mimics the form of lost cave travelers. If approached, it lashes out with Power Whip and drags its victim back to its den.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurks in abandoned chateaus, typically posing as a chandelier. It imitates noble figures waving silently from windows to passing travelers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are both incredibly territorial and incredibly strong. Rangers keep a close eye on their habitat to ensure they don't roam too close to where people live.
author: bee4082

entry: Ancient tablets tell of POKENAME shifting into human forms during great wars. It can briefly fly by expelling bursts of energy from its limbs.
author: .izik

entry: When hunting, it will create illusions of itself and surround the prey. Once it breaks the prey's spirit, it spits flames at them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME weaves through the shadows, its nine ethereal tails flickering like wisps of smoke. A master of deception, it creates illusions that confuse foes, striking with swift, fiery attacks.
author: thepandasharky

entry: A pure soul corrupted by fusion, POKENAME dreams of a world destroyed by a catastrophe. Many people theorize that its dream is a prophecy.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Appearing prominently in various myths and legends, POKENAME are known as a boon or a bane depending on the era. Due to their longevity and high intelligence, some still wear and maintain the adornments they were given long ago.
author: elfail0

entry: Appearing prominently in various myths and legends, POKENAME are known as a boon or a bane depending on the era. Due to their longevity and high intelligence, some still wear and maintain the adornments they were given long ago.
author: elfail0

entry: It is known to come up with bizarre ideas on how to get more Genius Mochi from its Trainer. Its cunning tricks are seen in Pokémon battles too, especially if it has time to set up a Nasty Plot.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Deep within caves, POKENAME takes the form of explorers. It isolates wanderers from their groups before feeding in the shadows.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a child and plays in parks. If discovered, it releases Sleep Powder and vanishes before anyone can react.
author: .izik
