entry: In foggy marshes, POKENAME takes the form of lost children. It waits for rescuers to draw near before attacking with a Hex.
author: .izik

entry: In coastal mists, POKENAME mimics drowned sailors calling for help. Those who approach are silently dragged beneath the waves.
author: .izik

entry: Underwater, POKENAME mimics scuba divers swimming in groups. It isolates victims with charm before poisoning and dragging them into the deep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can create multiple illusions of itself or others that perform together with it as it sings and dances. It will also use these illusions to protect its friends, both by hiding them and by making its attacks harder to predict.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has the capability to shapeshift into any human or Pokémon. It leads humans into traps that it crafted until none remain. It attacks anyone or anything that sees its true form.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME mimics lone hikers with eerie accuracy. When confronted, it bursts into a cloud of violet powder and escapes into the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are found in farmers' fields after a full moon. They delight in using their illusion powers to disguise themselves as crops and wait for people to come close. They then leap out to surprise their unfortunate target when they get too close.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as Pokémon invading its pumpkin patch. Once close enough, it drops the illusion and attacks with a powerful Seed Bomb.
author: .izik

entry: The crystal vents on its back spew a strange fog. POKENAME can manipulate the appearance of this fog to create complex illusions.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME lure in aquatic prey by projecting illusions of food and safety. They seem to be quite proud of their ponytails.
author: hophoppip

entry: As they are elusive, attacks from wild POKENAME are rare but brutal. Victims report seeing all kinds of strange sights while they were pummeled over and over.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is the ultimate master of trickery. It channels its illusory magic through its spoons, enabling it to conjure realistic mirages.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME's rocky body can morph into surprisingly convincing human shapes. It waits silently until prey draws too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME takes on the form of hospital nurses and walks silently down the halls. While unnoticed, it feeds on the dreams of sleeping patients.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon will try to calm any organism that approaches them with its ribbons and put it to sleep with spores from its back.
author: themadcactus

entry: When threatened by Pidgey, POKENAME will use its cute charm to infatuate the predator.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME is known as a protector of love, guiding the hands of couples together with its ribbons. If anyone insults any couple in its pressence, it will wrap them in ribbons and release explosive sparks until they apologize.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's body constantly produces puffs of thick, soothing perfume clouds. Though the scent and calming nature are pleasant, the high volume it creates can be more than a little stifling.
author: sk372

entry: Some believe this Pokémon is the descendent of a powerful bug-Pokémon, causing POKENAME to sell for a high price.
author: themadcactus

entry: After evolving, this Pokémon will shed its skin. The most expensive makeup is made with its paste.
author: themadcactus

entry: The poisonous gas released by POKENAME induces intense bliss. It also causes dangerous side effects, including suppressing hunger for extended periods.
author: .izik

entry: Each vine of POKENAME is coated in a sticky sap that induces joy on contact. Prolonged exposure, however, can lead to severe mental instability.
author: .izik

entry: When threatened, POKENAME spits out a cloud of multicolored ink to mask its escape. Anything that swims through the cloud to chase after it quickly finds itself drained of energy and numbed by the ink's effects.
author: sk372

entry: The peculiar structure of its ribbon-like wings, while seemingly impractical for flight, lets POKENAME glide freely on wayward fairy winds.
author: themadcactus

entry: Whenever a parade is around, POKENAME can be found on its floats. For as long as the event lasts, they will be dancing.
author: rosemagwin

entry: As POKENAME swings its arms to generate its electricity, colorful sparks can be seen flaking off of its limbs. The lightning it launches is similarly multicolored, making battles a fantastical display of hues.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME molts, its shedding catches on its carapace to form an ever elongating dress. A long-lived POKENAME can have a dress of over five lengths of its body, signifying an exceptional warrior due to surviving with such an encumbering shedding.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAME molts, its shedding catches on its carapace to form an ever elongating dress. A long-lived POKENAME can have a dress of over five lengths of its body, signifying an exceptional warrior due to surviving with such an encumbering shedding.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has a very sensitive nature and cannot stand to sense the negative emotions of others. It races towards the source of negativity at breakneck speed in order to brush it away with its three ribbon-like tails.
author: sk372

entry: When happy, small ribbon feelers rise from its tails, filling anyone who touches them with joy. Unfortunately, it is only happy while stampeding, making contact with these feelers often a Trainer's last experience.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Negative emotions put POKENAME in a frustrated state, irritating it to the point of nearing violence. To keep itself in check, it tries to assuage negative feelings with its three tails, so it can remain calm as well.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME is happy, small ribbon feelers pop up from its tails that fill whoever touches them with joy. When stampeding, these feelers seem to come alive, wriggling in ecstasy as it charges around.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The intricately patterned wings are POKENAME's most distinct feature, with their bright pattern attracting unsuspecting Pokémon.
author: themadcactus

entry: The legs of this Pokémon are blue only due to a certain toxin. The poison in the legs are extremely volatile, and can even paralyze an Ursaring.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME is a great pet to have for most, as its ribbons will help soothe stress with just a touch. POKENAME will adapt over time to learn telltale signs of stress in its owner, becoming able to sooner approach them to soothe their woes.
author: sk372

entry: In response to stress, POKENAME can spike out its fur and fire it off like needles. The fur produces a numbing electricity when it pierces skin, stunning those hit and leaving them with a dazing, pleasant sensation coursing through them.
author: sk372

entry: The constant warmth of POKENAME's body has soothing properties, so owners are advised to regularly embrace it. As a sign of elation, it may produce a beautiful multicolored flame breath into the air.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's many ribbons are especially warm at the tips. Ordinarily these ribbons are used to soothe others with a calming warm touch, but if threatened, they can be ignited and used to sling painful fireballs at POKENAME's opposition.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon uses all its energy in the process of metamorphosis. It defends by warding off any Pokémon with a quick whip of it's ribbons.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME battles by swinging its flowy arms in large dance-like arcs, swatting opponents away from it or those it safeguards. It often cares for a group of Eeto until they are ready to evolve into one of their many choices.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is seen as a symbol of both peace and power. According to legends, the vividly-colored flames POKENAME breathes can burn away all traces of aggression in others, leaving them forever calm and pacifistic.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's shed skin is often quickly snatched up by scavengers once left behind. When consumed, it causes a feeling of pleasant numbness and tingling, to an almost intoxicating degree.
author: sk372

entry: A rarer alternate color variant of POKENAME found in some regions, POKENAME's shed skin possesses mild hallucinogenic properties when consumed. Scavengers that eat the skin left behind are often left laying prone and confused for several hours.
author: sk372

entry: Regal and cute, POKENAME is a Fairy Trainer's best friend. It uses its ribbons to create a soothing smell, which makes its opponents lose their eagerness to fight.
author: aberry8286

entry: If you encounter one of these Pokémon, stay calm. Wild POKENAME detect fear, and will attempt to calm you down by injecting you with poison.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME seeks peace among others around it, to an aggressive degree. If just the touch of its ribbons isn't enough to make someone behave, it will resort to temporarily emptying their mind of negative thoughts with its psychic powers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's powerful psychic abilities let it generate orbs of condensed, vibrantly-colored energy. Those hit by these projectiles find themselves feeling numbed and dazed, deprived of all negative thoughts and feelings.
author: sk372

entry: With its radiating tranquility, it resolves conflicts with awe-inspiring psychic prowess. It can befriend any type of Pokémon.
author: rigelpogi08

entry: When the wind picks up, the ribbon-like leaves on POKENAME's head flutter about and spread a faint, minuscule pollen across the air. It evokes pleasant feelings in those that inhale it, and causes plants it lands on to bloom in more vibrant colors.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a cheerful and affectionate Pokémon known for its brilliant aroma and for appearing in the wild as soon as the first flower blooms in the spring. It is thought to migrate far away in winter, but none have seen this firsthand.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bright colors of this Pokémon leads many researchers to wonder it's advantage. Many believe that brighter POKENAME are considered better mates.
author: themadcactus

entry: From its colors to its kind personality to its soft body and soothing ribbons, POKENAME is perfect for easing a person's troubled mind. It is becoming more common to see it in hospitals and therapy sessions to calm the nerves of others.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a very amorous specimen, always searching for the next partner to hug and shower affection on. Its scent, combined with the overzealous nature of its affections, causes most to try to escape from its adulation, however.
author: sk372

entry: During winter, POKENAME is known to swoop down and wrap shivering travelers in its soft wings. Feathers from one are said to bring warmth and fortune, many still keep them as lucky charms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the ribbons on its head to mark its favorite trees with a faint liquid emanated from the tips. This liquid has pheromones that cause other Pokémon to defend the tree from pests, parasites and even loggers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a genuinely kind Pokémon and will fight to the end to protect the ones it cares about. Its ribbons give off positive vibes, filling those who touch it with an overwhelming feeling of happiness.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is a very unloved Pokémon. Due to this, it uses its sticky ribbons to catch humans in an effort to force them to love it.
author: crustyglowstick

entry: Most POKENAME have 5 tails ribbons, but some have 6 or 7. The more tail ribbons that a POKENAME has, the more likely it is to find a mate.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME communicates with others of its kind via flashing the many lights on its prong in different patterns. These sequences are quite varying and intricate, so research into discerning their exact meanings progresses slowly.
author: sk372

entry: When the full moon is directly overhead, POKENAME spreads its wings wide. As it soaks in the moonlight, it exudes a powerful psychic aura that invokes calmness and joy in all creatures in the surrounding area.
author: sk372

entry: While some Pokémon may look for mates, POKENAME are indifferent. Considered stoic, owners of this Pokémon are viewed as wise and accepting.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME loves to comfort both humans and Pokémon. Its ribbonlike tail provides a soft embrace while the stone on its head sends out soothing signals.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time remaining immobile, but every so often it will do a small dance involving the ribbons on its arms. The ribbons cast a placating aura in the direction they are swung, calming those in the area.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that seeing POKENAME perform a Rain Dance atop a lake with other Pokémon will bless one's romantic endeavors. Their soft, harmonious croaks echo during any rainy weather.
author: beatdoof

entry: Unlike other Rattata, POKENAME are quite well-mannered and are commonly kept as regular pets. However, because they are so commonly domesticated, they struggle to survive out in the wild.
author: mistymagius

entry: An organisation that promotes peace and freedom from persecution uses POKENAME as its mascot as it can calm someone's aggressive behaviour by simply touching them. It produces a gel that is being researched by the military to neutralise opponents.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are incredibly sensitive to those they choose, using both air currents and their ribbonlike feelers to anticipate their Trainers' needs. POKENAME are known to fell dragons to see their Trainers smile.
author: stephanyx

entry: POKENAME only comes out in the darkness to protect other Pokémon. Although almost never seen as it lurks in the shadows, it can radiate beams of happiness-giving energy, causing struck Pokémon to forget they were ever in danger.
author: knews6969

entry: When placed in the same biome as a Rattata, its quickly picked on. But when put in a snowy biome its fur keeps it warm and its color camouflages it.
author: themadcactus

entry: Wild POKENAME are extremely skittish, but they're very friendly to their Trainer. It is said that if one approaches you, you are a truly kind soul.
author: themadcactus

entry: Without a seed on its back, many wonder where the poison comes from. One theory says it comes from the ribbons; another says it comes from the fur.
author: themadcactus

entry: The bud on its back is tied in a neat bow. It is said that if it lies in the sun, the bow will grow and untie into two more ribbons.
author: themadcactus

entry: If spotted while scavenging through dumpsters, POKENAME releases a calming aura from its ribbonlike feelers. The effect pacifies witnesses long enough for it to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its ribbon-like appendages to draw symbols resembling letters on the nearest surfaces. Though they don't appear to be any readable language, those who look at its messages feel a calming sensation wash over them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits a soothing aura from its tail feathers to calm Caterpie. Once its prey is relaxed, it dives swiftly to hunt with a brutal Peck.
author: .izik

entry: Despite an aggressive appearance, POKENAME has a gentle and meek heart. However, having its ribbons pulled will cause it to fly into an aggravated rage and lash out at anything nearby.
author: sk372

entry: The secretions from POKENAME's quills have a potent numbing effect. Research is currently ongoing on the subject of applying it to improve modern anesthetics.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's cute, fairy-like head attracts unaware Pokémon. It then uses its razor-sharp pincers to threaten them into giving over their food.
author: qwertyelephant

entry: The juice POKENAME makes is so sweet that it's almost inedible. People say that the only ingredient of POKENAME's juice is love.
author: birchbot

entry: Pokémon learn quickly not to cause trouble in POKENAME territory. Though not especially aggressive, it abhors conflict and will put troublemakers in especially tight and possibly painful bear-hugs until they stop acting out.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's feathers naturally release a calming influence. Many hospitals stuff pillows with them to help trauma patients sleep peacefully.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's thick coat of fur produces a warming and calming aura, making it a valuable partner for venturing through frozen areas. Staying close to it will allow others to stave off the effects of the cold easily.
author: sk372

entry: As a sign of affection for their Trainers, they will frequently make them gifts to show how much they love them.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME is very proud of its colorful wings, boastfully showing them off to other Pokémon. Its feathers are often melted down into jewelry as their blue and pink coloring is quite rare.
author: mistymagius

entry: The tip of POKENAME's tail releases an aura that suppresses fear and aggression. While prey is subdued, it injects a potent venom with a bite.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to wrap themselves around other Pokémon to give them hugs. Their lack of fangs makes them appear docile, so many Pokémon happily accept their embrace.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it feels in danger, POKENAME will use its ribbons to strike its antlers. The vibrations this cause sends out a pulsing energy around it that causes those nearby to feel dizzy and giddy, allowing POKENAME to flee.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can vibrate its antlers to create a small pulse of psychic energy that drains aggression from others around it. Those in the pulse's vicinity feel sluggish, sleepy, and content.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's creations are some of the most vibrantly colored among the Smeargle fusions. People who view its finished artwork report a sense of calm and ease washing over them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves joining parades. Its happiness and positivity is highly contagious.
author: rosemagwin

entry: POKENAME coils around rowdy Pokémon and uses its ribbons to calm them down. If this proves ineffective, it can deliver a soporific venom through its fangs, though it hates to do so, and only uses it as a last resort.
author: sk372

entry: Extremely kind and generous, POKENAME will offer up its milk to anyone it thinks looks unhappy. The milk is very healthy and calming, so it is certainly effective at combating stress and unease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME milk is unique for being produced in various vibrant shades of pink and blue. The coloration, alongside the sweet flavor, makes it a popular novelty drink sold in most stores.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves to adopt and protect any eggs that it finds in the wild. POKENAME will encourage and guide these eggs on their journey towards cracking, and then provide ample love and support once they do.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME generates colorful storm clouds above it that respond to the emotions of others. Aggressive behavior in its presence triggers paralyzing, brightly colored bolts of lightning from the clouds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME runs swiftly across the land, calming those it finds dealing with high stress. The gentle touch of its many ribbons soothes nerves and fills a person with feelings of comforting warmth.
author: sk372

entry: If one feels refreshed and gains a sense a sudden sense of contentment after a soft northern breeze, it may be that POKENAME is nearby. Its billowing gently-colored mane evokes calmness in beholders.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's ribbons can purify any body of water with a single touch. Drinking the water immediately after it has been purified is believed to extend a person's lifespan.
author: sk372

entry: If one feels refreshed and gains a sense a sudden sense of contentment after a soft northern breeze, it may be that POKENAME is nearby. Its billowing gently-colored mane evokes calmness in beholders.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are known to reward those that revere them with blessings, while showing no mercy to any that show them disrespect.
author: xenellia

entry: POKENAME detests combat within its territory; if it sees others fighting, it creates a massive storm of multicolored sand. The grains of sand blind others and slowly whittle away their combat urges, making continuing to fight impossible.
author: sk372

entry: Those who reside near POKENAME's claimed mountain are under its protection. It treats companions gently, but picking on those it guards will cause it to show the terrible depths of its wrath and strength.
author: sk372

entry: If electric shocks fail to stop a fight, POKENAME releases a strong calming aura from its chest ribbon. The opponent usually loses the will to battle within moments of being exposed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hates conflict and releases a soothing aura to calm angry hearts. Records describing it as an “emissary of peace” can be found across many different eras.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME often chants incantations that cause Pokémon to stop fighting. This makes it easier to defeat foes, as they'll no longer try to retaliate.
author: soup1900

entry: Thousands of volts course through POKENAME's ribbonlike tail. Even brief contact can cause paralysis that may last for months.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to eat, but hates doing so alone. Brushing its ribbons against others causes them to feel pangs of hunger, making it easy for POKENAME to share food and have company while eating.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are used to help with swimming lessons and those scared of the ocean. Its ribbon-like feelers helps soothe nerves while it gently carries them along the shallow waters.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses magnetism to fly and is often found singing to soothe those with negative emotions, which it senses through its ribbonlike feelers. While elegant, this Pokémon is cold and precise in battle.
author: jonclyd

entry: A walking mass of countless ribbon tentacles, POKENAME could pacify an entire city with its many limbs. If one comes across a town filled completely with strangely placid, happy citizens, a POKENAME may be affecting the populace.
author: sk372

entry: The color of POKENAME's fire launched from its arm alternates between pink and blue. The blue flames are more powerful, but the pink fire causes those singed by it to slowly grow weaker as their energy is burned away.
author: sk372

entry: It's egg long forgotten, POKENAME confidently soars through the skies, spreading happiness wherever it goes. It is said that seeing one can give you a newfound understanding of yourself.
author: jemeremmazza

entry: When colliding with another Pokémon while digging, POKENAME emits a soothing aura. This prevents territorial conflict as it retreats further underground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very clingy and will try to carry its Trainer everywhere it goes. However, it tries its best to keep its Trainer safe while in flight, wrapping its ribbons around them to keep them secure.
author: mistymagius

entry: Being naturally immune to poison, POKENAME uses its needle-like tail to extract harmful toxins from people and Pokémon alike. This procedure is painless and leaves only a small mark that quickly heals.
author: evilgammon

entry: In combat, POKENAME's soft ribbonlike back quills harden into razor-sharp edges. It coils into a ball while releasing calming pheromones to confuse predators.
author: .izik

entry: Although POKENAME usually prefer to not fight, they are quite adept at fighting when they deem it necessary. They weave punches and kicks with attacks that utilize their feelers, including using their feelers to immobilize or disrupt their opponent.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME absolutely abhors violence and strife. It creates a small specialized black hole that sucks the negative emotions of all those around it before destroying it, leaving those afflicted feeling placid and content, if also exhausted.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have been known to amplify and convert the joy and love they receive from their Trainers into magical power. The greater the bond they share, the stronger POKENAME will become.
author: mileysakiko

entry: The ribbons extending from POKENAME's elbows can stiffen and sharpen in order to be more formidable in combat. Outside of battle, they flutter gently and can soothe minor aches and pains in those touched by them.
author: sk372

entry: It floats around quietly, drifting towards those angry or in distress, soothing them with a touch from its ribbon-like wings. It's thought that POKENAME actually feeds on the negative emotions it siphons from others.
author: sk372

entry: A conglomerate spirit made of willing, kind individuals. Those souls lost themselves in service to creating something to help future generations.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: A gentle peacekeeper among Pokémon, POKENAME is particularly effective at calming down rowdy male Nidoran and its related fusions. Just a few touches from its ribbons will cause even a raging Nidoking to become placid and content.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon lives by lakes and rivers where other Pokémon go to drink. They keep the peace and stop any Pokémon from fighting.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME has become known for its habit of bathing in the sun.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME releases a soothing aura from its feelers to deter attackers. If that fails, it lashes out with poison-coated feelers to flee.
author: .izik

entry: Its pastel colors belie a cunning battler. Its ribbonlike feelers are soothing to touch, though it may be picky about who it allows to hold them.
author: wigglypon

entry: Any sea creature that swims too close to POKENAME will be wrapped up by its ribbon-like feelers. These numb and paralyze the captured victim, making them easy for POKENAME to swallow up for a quick meal.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carries itself with a calm and regal demeanor at all times. Gentle by nature, it always tries to deescalate a situation peaceably, but will deftly utilize the blade it carries if a peaceful solution is unattainable.
author: sk372

entry: The ribbon-like wrappings that encase the body of POKENAME exude a calming aura. This aura allows it to soothe those it cares for and to lull those it feels hostile towards into a state where it can easily pull them into its void-like body.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While sleeping, POKENAME's poison-coated feelers emit a steady calming aura. This keeps nearby allies relaxed and prevents panic during severe storms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a playful spirit and often jumps on its Trainer to mess up their hair with its hands or ribbons. When it is time to battle, however, it becomes serious, using its agility to outmaneuver its opponents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME performs complex movements that resemble dancing to distract opponents before attacking. Trainers who underestimate it often find their teams overwhelmed.
author: gtrwya

entry: POKENAME can't resist trying to one-up others of its kind. If two POKENAME run into each other, they will compete to see who can make the other feel happier with their ribbons.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefers to live on its own, and disdains having company. Uninvited guests are rubbed by its feelers, which cause them to feel giddy and lightheaded, before being pushed away to wander aimlessly elsewhere.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are natural entertainers. Using magnetism, they detach and manipulate various parts of their body to put on dazzling displays.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME battles almost entirely defensively, with its shield creating a calming aura after absorbing blows, draining foes of their fighting spirit. Only once a foe tires out will it draw its blade to knock them out with a glancing strike.
author: sk372

entry: A colorful, sparkling trail follows POKENAME's blade with every swing. The blade is coated with an aura that numbs and calms a foe with every strike, until eventually they no longer feel the urge to fight anymore.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wraps prey in poison-laced feelers that induce complacency. As the victim relaxes, a fever causing vivid hallucinations weakens their body.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its grim look, POKENAME is a kind creature, especially toward its Trainer, to whom it shows unconditional affection. The star on the tail emits a light capable of calming nearby Pokémon, while its ribbons allow it to sense their emotions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's metallic body is vibrant, sparkling under even a small amount of light. It spends much of its time collecting shining gems, polishing them until they gleam with the same level of shininess as it does.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the ribbons that make up their bodies as snares, wrapping and enveloping their opponent to disable them. Once a foe is trapped, POKENAME patiently waits until their foe simply gives up.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When confronted by a powerful foe, its wing-like tail flutters, exuding a peaceful aura that leaves its opponents in a majestic trance.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME is a very loving and supportive creature. It is said to help others find their true selves.
author: westerlytrack45

entry: The toxin on POKENAME's feelers causes numbness and intense euphoria. While prey is overwhelmed by bliss, it strikes with a powerful Thrash.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME creates soothing winds and sends them down below the ozone layer to prevent any conflicts between land and sea dwellers. Its ribbonlike feelers sense the wind to track when any object flies high into the sky.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lull people to sleep with promises of joy and comfort, only to trap them in their own dreams. It plays within the dreams and nightmares of people, not seeming to understand the difference between the two, or perhaps not caring.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: A prototype of POKENAME that was designed to collect Fairy-type energy. However, the Moon Drive was faulty, so it was scrapped.
author: t.i.a.

entry: When the moon hangs high and bright in the sky, POKENAME ventures out to dance beneath the moonlight. As it hops about, its ribbons leave a sparkling trail of moonbeam energy.
author: sk372

entry: Extremely cautious, POKENAME never approaches too closely to someone until it has first touched them with its ribbons. The ribbons emit a calming aura that helps ensure they won't act aggressively towards POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies at such high speeds that it leaves colorful afterimages behind. Catching sight of these duplicates disorients opponents, letting POKENAME more easily evade attacks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's bolt-shaped feelers crackle with playful electric energy, sparking harmlessly as it glides around. It enjoys sneaking into electronics, using its charm to cause cheerful and playful chaos. It enjoys bringing smiles to faces.
author: thepandasharky

entry: It has a habit of pulling its Trainer into a pocket of its surrounding fluid when at rest. This feels warm and comfy, not posing any risk of injury.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: During a full moon, the calming aura from POKENAME's feelers expands tenfold. Those nearby experience an unsettling sense of total calm.
author: .izik

entry: It extends its feelers to snag prey at range. This causes a numbness to wash over the ensnared victim; it does not struggle as POKENAME consumes it.
author: wigglypon

entry: POKENAME's colorful wax has a consistency and scent similar to frosting. It is a friendly Pokémon, often appearing during special celebrations.
author: mepp.

entry: Its hollow head is full of colourful gumball candies. It loves sharing them with others, but be warned: some of these treats are incredibly spicy!
author: wigglypon

entry: POKENAME burns wood into fine ash before consuming it. Some believe the ash has calming properties when used in cosmetic treatments.
author: .izik

entry: Curious and friendly, POKENAME wraps the ribbon it extends from its mouth around anything that catches its attention. Pricking oneself on the spines on its back causes one to become numb and deliriously giddy within a few minutes.
author: sk372

entry: In ancient folklore, exchanging a POKENAME feather symbolized a bond never broken. These feathers retain their warmth even in blizzards and are passed down through generations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is known as one of the most elegant Pokémon out there. It rapidly strikes targets with its ribbons.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME is widely regarded as a sign of good times and peace, due to their migration pattern that leads it across all regions in the world. Their valuable scales are typically found by those in bad situations, allowing them a chance at better lives.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: With the fur over its eyes blinding it, POKENAME locates others by sensing emotional fluctuations with its ribbons. It only follows those who emanate largely positive emotions and is repelled by the negative.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur radiates warmth and comfort. On cold evenings, groups huddle together, generating remarkable heat within their den.
author: .izik

entry: This fusion gains an incredible amount of psychic strength. It also develops a worrying megalomaniac instinct to impose peace and love across the galaxy, annihilating anyone who resists.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its dams are the height of Pokémon comfort; few nests can compare to their intricacy. This has made POKENAME a popular partner for interior designers.
author: wigglypon

entry: POKENAME rarely has the energy to use its limbs for anything, so it instead uses its ribbons to move itself or grab things. Others touched by the ribbons will feel extremely sluggish and lethargic for the remainder of the day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tries to vent its excess energy by passing it on to others. It grips them in a tight embrace, its ribbon-like arms passing on its vitality and filling them with bursts of energy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves to soothe its Trainer by using its ribbonlike feelers. It is known to alert its Trainer of any danger by glowing brightly.
author: bunkachunka

entry: If its calming aura fails, POKENAME emits a piercing cry. The sound can force predators into sudden sleep almost instantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a welcome addition to any aquarium, as its ribbons brush against other aquatic life and improve their mood with a calming aura. Even underwater plant life thrives more over time with POKENAME's presence.
author: sk372

entry: Whenever POKENAME flings itself off cliffs in an attempt to fly, its ribbons leave a colorful trail of sparkles behind. The ribbons have a numbing touch to them that POKENAME uses to soothe its head after hitting the ground.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's shell is made of a bright, sturdy material that resists most attacks easily. Striking its shell makes it release calming waves, so anything trying to hunt it quickly begins losing the urge to continue attacking it.
author: sk372

entry: When Trainers see this Pokémon's floppy ears in the wild, they cannot help but pet it.
author: themadcactus

entry: When distressed, POKENAME's rubbery body produces a high-pitched tone. The sound both soothes and induces widespread sleep in nearby predators.
author: .izik

entry: The pollen released from POKENAME's bud has a calming effect. This unique capability allows it to evade predators with ease.
author: mepp.

entry: Like Drifloon, POKENAME still takes children. Its ribbonlike feelers calm down the children so that they won't scream or fight back.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: POKENAME's thick cotton fur keeps them warm during winter. When they feel comfortable, they wrap their ribbons around their Trainer, emanating a cozy warmth to convey trust.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME will often gather with others of its kind to communicate and bond. They do this by tapping their small ribbons against their liquid bodies.
author: jackjirachi

entry: With its cytoplasm becoming more developed and sturdy, POKENAME are able to hug their Trainers affectionately without their bodies breaking apart.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME releases a soothing aura from its wings as it flies in formation. The swarm calms targets briefly before striking together with Supersonic.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is made of a material with a consistency similar to glue-based slime. Trainers enjoy poking and squishing it, a behavior the Pokémon appears to enjoy despite its grumpy expression.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME latches onto sleeping prey and drains their life force with its maw. A calming venom is injected to keep the victim docile while it feeds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is heavily devoted to its Trainer, gifting them with all the gemstones it can find. Its gemstones are enchanted with many different healing and protection spells.
author: mistymagius

entry: One must be careful approaching POKENAME in the wild, as it is skittish and will bite if frightened. Its bite contains a venom that induces numbness and euphoria in those afflicted.
author: sk372

entry: It moves by rolling rapidly. Though the ring around its body looks and smells like a sweet baked dessert, it can make a painful impact.
author: hophoppip

entry: Despite a terrifying size and appearance, POKENAME is a gentle giant. Its main method of defense is a sharp roar that produces unique sound waves that sap the aggression in those that hear it.
author: sk372

entry: The ribbonlike leaves on POKENAME's head emit a calming scent. Groups of three are said to halt even a rampaging Rhyhorn herd.
author: .izik

entry: The sight of POKENAME's fervent dancing and ribbon twirling is said to calm even the angriest of Gyarados. POKENAME's ribbons are delicate and any sign of damage causes POKENAME to work obsessively to mend them.
author: chibitales

entry: Its body mainly consists of glitter, stickers, makeup, and scraps of discarded dolls. It loves giving humans makeovers, even if its cosmetic skills are not very precise.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME cuts through the water at incredibly high speeds. It tackles wild Sharpedo on the hunt to protect the prey from being eaten, wrapping its ribbons around the Sharpedo to restrain and neutralize their aggressive tendencies.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grows blue berries that taste extremely bitter yet induce bliss. During battle, it tosses them into a predator's mouth to disable them.
author: .izik

entry: It is known to be a guardian of peace, sending out a tranquilizing aura. It is known to aggressively defend its territory if threatened.
author: lyman

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of those around it. It releases a calming wave of sound to settle negative emotions.
author: nyoomymph

entry: The songs of POKENAME can calm even the stormiest of hearts. Guided by compassion, it roams the forests in search of wounded Pokémon, using the soft touch of its cotton-like wings to bring comfort and aid to those in need.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lumbers quietly across the land, occasionally gifting one of the stones that comprises its body to others. These rocks contain a special energy that eases a person's stress when held.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produce a soft creamy meringue from the top of their heads, which is used by pastry chefs to top delicious treats. They are especially popular on certain holidays, as eating this meringue is said to prolong a healthy relationship.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is almost always happy and will hug anyone it cares for with its ribbons. Despite how strong POKENAME's hugs are, the ribbons help dull the crushing pain.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are friendly creatures that love to give hugs to other Pokémon. When they give another Pokémon a hug, they release spores that reduce inhibition while also suppressing violent urges.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's spores induce exhaustion mixed with euphoria. It swarms weakened prey and drains them with Absorb before carrying them back to its nest.
author: .izik

entry: Being warm-hearted and energetic, POKENAME brings a sense of joyfulness to wherever it goes. Companies frequently use this Pokémon to raise the morale of their employees.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME dance a simple polka that many adults and children can learn. Their desire to forge bonds through dance is demonstrated by their patience when helping others learn.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release spores from the mushrooms on their back that instill feelings of comfort and joy within those that inhale the spores. They are affectionate creatures that love to give hugs to many Trainers and Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It spreads calming emotions through its spores. Overexposure to these spores can result in strange behavior and chronic drowsiness.
author: hophoppip

entry: At night, POKENAME wanders forests releasing an aura that keeps prey asleep. It plants parasitic spores that allow for remote control later.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME give hugs to lonely Pokémon by wrapping ribbons around them. The spores that cling to the lonely Pokémon produce a sweet scent that helps ease their anxiety.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME brightens up caves with its dazzling array of lights, guiding hikers through dark sections and ensuring their safety. At times of great joy and celebration, it emerges from its cave to put on a beautiful display.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME releases a soothing aura from the ribbons on its antennae to disarm prey. Its eyes then glow as it fires a powerful Psybeam.
author: .izik

entry: This species is an incredibly popular pet in the Kalos region, due to their fashionable looks and the emotionally soothing warmth they give off. Lately, they're apparently becoming a much more popular choice for new trainers than regular Fennekin.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: A POKENAME can sense the emotions of any living being from body heat alone. When lit, the stick this Pokémon wields burns a soft pink flame at the tip, giving off a harmless, pleasant aroma with a scent that differs for each individual smelling it.
author: merclipse

entry: Often depicted in children's fairy tales, usually as a magical guardian of the pure and kind-hearted. A real POKENAME is quick to resolve conflicts using the aroma from its wand, calming most but knocking out those blinded by rage.
author: merclipse

entry: Often depicted in children's fairy tales, usually as a magical guardian of the pure and kind-hearted. A real POKENAME is quick to resolve conflicts using the aroma from its wand, calming most but knocking out those blinded by rage.
author: merclipse

entry: Anyone who inhales the smoke from POKENAME's shell becomes calm and friendly. This defense helps it gather allies, subdue enemies, and even sedate prey.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME scatters calming pink powder from its wing feelers. Once prey becomes complacent, it follows up with a strong Confusion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wrap their ribbons around the arms of people, bringing them together with melodic songs. Their songs encourage people to fall in love, with many couples having met through POKENAME's gatherings.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME works alongside bakers to produce high quality baked treats. The cream atop its head can be mixed with eggs and sugar to create a delicious meringue.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are found in streams floating at the top of the water, letting the current move them around. Their bright coloration helps distract and disorient potential predators.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is obsessed with fashion, wanting to make accessories for everyone it values. Those it is particularly fond of get ribbons or a top hat similar to its own.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: POKENAME are widely believed to be omens of a bright future, with their presence said to ease the process of growth and change in all who observe them.
author: turron_turron

entry: On clear, starry nights, POKENAME shed their shells to dance about the sky in a display of flowing colors and joy. People around the world will hold pop-up festivals beneath these POKENAME in celebration of transformation and hope.
author: turron_turron

entry: The fire on a POKENAME's tail emits no heat. If you cook a Berry with their fiery breath, the Berry acquires a cotton candy flavor.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME primarily keeps itself underground, digging tunnels across the land, but pops above ground if it senses negative emotions. It uses its ribbons to soothe the agitated person, then returns to its constant tunnel-digging.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME digs concealed pitfalls throughout its territory. It lures prey into them using a calming aura before attacking.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME approaches city lights as they first turn on in the pink haze of dusk. People have a hard time chasing it away because the ribbons on its back exude waves that cause a strong feeling of calmness in humans and some Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's calming aura intensifies when coins are nearby. Each use of Pay Day expands its area of effect significantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enter into deep meditative states to find new ways to make their Trainer happy. They often smile as they meditate because of how much they love their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gently coddles distressed feline Pokémon with its long feelers. This contact induces a deep, soothing happiness.
author: .izik

entry: If its teammates win a battle, POKENAME celebrates by emitting a pink electric glow that fills everyone with euphoria. The ribbons on its head can extend to help it reach objects that are too far away for its short legs.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If its teammates win a battle, POKENAME celebrates by emitting a pink electric glow that fills everyone with euphoria. The ribbons on its head can extend to help it reach objects that are too far away for its short legs.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If its teammates lose a battle, it releases a soft pink glow from its cheeks to comfort them and make them feel important to the team nonetheless. POKENAME uses its ribbons to hug anyone who looks down, as it can't stand seeing others sad.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Many aromatherapists use POKENAME in their work, as the lovely scents of their blue smoke help the emotional well-being of their clients. In the wild, the Pokémon live in small herds at the base of mountain ranges.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME love giving out hugs to other Pokémon with their ribbons. When POKENAME are hugged too tightly, they can momentarily lose circulation to their head, which can cause a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's ribbons create a soothing sensation that is effective at combating headaches in others. It constantly rubs its own aching head with them, but the effect is unfortunately far less fruitful on itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slowly draws in ambient energy from the positive emotions of those near it, its pearls glowing once at full strength. In times of sadness, it releases the energy to assuage people's worries and improve their moods.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME love to give out hugs with their long ribbons and often beckon their friends to jump in the water with them. Sometimes they pull their friends into the water with them as a prank.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME seeks to fight others as a way of venting pent-up aggression. The ribbons it wears cause those touched to become more aggressive, stoking their anger to get them raring to fight POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's violent temperament leaves it almost perpetually frothing with rage. It uses the ribbons it wears to incite aggression in large groups of Pokémon just so it can beat them all up to vent some of its endless anger.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's feelers grow dangerously hot when it becomes upset, yet they emit a calming aura. It uses this warmth to comfort others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dwells near volcanic regions. Just before an eruption, the ribbonlike tuft on its head glows red hot, warning those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: Due to this Pokémon's bright colors and size, they rely on speed when hunting.
author: themadcactus

entry: The water POKENAME spits carries soothing properties. Spas across Hoenn collect and dilute it for relaxation treatments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's rubbery hands are coated in a sticky substance. Physical contact induces a sense of calm in those it touches.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stands watch over ponds teeming with smaller creatures. Should any dangerous creatures approach, it distracts them with the spiral on its torso, which drains aggression and energy the longer it's gazed upon.
author: sk372

entry: The ribbonlike structures on POKENAME's head detect shifts in humidity. When storms approach, it hides beneath lake surfaces until conditions stabilize.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sleeps during the majority of the day, but its ribbons remain active on instinct. If something approaches it aggressively, the ribbons grasp it tightly, draining it of its aggression, and teleport it away to another random location.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's psychic abilities are capable of revealing a persons deepest desires. For this reason, they are often trained by Therapists and Psychologists to assist them with their work.
author: jemeremmazza

entry: If POKENAME encounters someone crying, it reads their thoughts to learn the cause. When it judges the problem trivial, it telekinetically forces their lips into a smile.
author: .izik

entry: If calming a target with its aura fails, POKENAME flashes a cheerful smile. It then attempts to uppercut the foe skyward.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME performs elaborate martial arts displays to ease stressed Pokémon. If the stress remains, it begins striking with punches until calm or unconsciousness follows.
author: .izik

entry: When sensing sadness, POKENAME flexes theatrically to raise morale. If this fails, it restrains targets with ribbonlike limbs and subdues them with powerful punches.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prances through flower fields, its lanky vine-like body moving playfully. A forced wave of joy spreads within 20 ft, affecting all nearby whether welcomed or not.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME use their large ears to hear any prey miles away. When mating, larger ears are seen as more admirable.
author: themadcactus

entry: This Pokémon catches its prey with its ribbons and claws. When around an Eeveelution or Eevee, its demeanor becomes much more playful.
author: themadcactus

entry: Its large ribbon wings don't give this Pokémon the ability to fly. Instead, it uses the move Fairy Wind to lift it above the clouds.
author: themadcactus

entry: Like Mantine and Remoraid, POKENAME attracts Magikarp and Goldeen when swimming down rivers.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME releases a sugary scent that draws distressed Bug-type Pokémon seeking comfort. Once close, it drenches them in acid and consumes them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunts at night, the false face on its leafy appendage glowing softly. It calms prey into a joyful sleep before swallowing them whole.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tentacles possess a numbing venom that makes the victim feel calm, pleasant and sluggish. It uses this both to avoid being hunted on, but also to occasionally steal meals for itself from others.
author: sk372

entry: This alternate coloration of POKENAME is rather common in the wild, and noted to be somewhat more aggressive, and more prone to using its numbing venom in its tentacles in order to pacify others and steal their food.
author: sk372

entry: Its ribbons act as tentacles, useful for swimming and hunting. When they aren't being used, they float freely.
author: themadcactus

entry: Pink stones shed from POKENAME's body were once used in rituals to soothe children's nightmares. Later studies revealed they had no real effect.
author: .izik

entry: The pink gravel POKENAME sheds was once eaten in hopes of inducing bliss. Instead, it caused severe digestive distress in those who tried.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME consumes gemstones, its calming aura expands dramatically. The effect mysteriously resets each dawn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an affable Pokémon that loves to race with other Pokémon. Even if it never wins, it always does its best.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many farming families keep POKENAME nearby. Their warm fur comforts others, and they often wrap feelers around companions' hands as they trot alongside them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME coils its long ribbonlike appendages around foes. It then gallops forward, dragging them at high speed to inflict heavy damage.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rarely experiences negative emotions, existing in near-constant bliss. Any brief distress it feels vanishes quickly after a single positive interaction.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon swims against the stream. It still attracts many Water-type Pokémon while swimming, but only the strongest swimmers can keep up.
author: themadcactus

entry: The large stone it has for a tail acts as a tanning machine and a light source. When a POKENAME isn't sunbathing, it's resting beneath its shiny tail.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME manipulates a pair of ribbon-like tendrils via its own magnetic fields. It sends them out to constrict around those feeling glum, letting the tendrils' subtle vibrations send comforting sensations pulsing through them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's calming aura affects Steel-type Pokémon far more strongly than others. Some researchers suspect magnetism may be part of the reason, but the true cause remains unknown.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME is truly happy, the leek stalk it constantly carries begins to emit soft, shimmering light. It can sense the emotions of those around it and often brings food to anyone who is deeply saddened by something.
author: fiordaliso

entry: As POKENAME sprints across open fields, its fluffy feathers release a soothing aura. It appears to do this deliberately, spreading smiles to anyone nearby.
author: .izik

entry: The three heads love each other as if they were siblings and wrap their feelers around each other's necks to show their affection. They love to dance, even though their coordination is not that great.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is very playful and energetic. It is often found practicing various tricks so that it can cheer up its Trainer when they are sad.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME rescues shipwrecked sailors and carries them to its iceberg den. Its calming aura keeps them docile as the cold slowly overtakes them.
author: .izik

entry: It seems to be drawn to Trainers whose gender identities are as fluid as POKENAME's body. Those Trainers often claim that POKENAME's presence increases their confidence.
author: hophoppip

entry: Despite being made of and subsisting on highly toxic material, POKENAME constantly emits a harmless, soothing scent around it. It's happy to let others enjoy its aroma, but keeps a safe distance to avoid causing others to get sick.
author: sk372

entry: This incredible swimmer beats pros without a sweat and paces with the fastest Water types. Despite this, it has a demeanor similar to that of Lapras.
author: themadcactus

entry: Overly friendly to the point of being clingy, POKENAME uses its many ribbons to wrap around other creatures, forcibly soothing them and pulling them close for lengthy amounts of cuddling time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can use its psychic powers to display visions to humans. Its preferred use of this power is showing people the bodies they dream of having, especially if those bodies are of the opposite gender.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME wrap dreams of love and comfort around those they hypnotize. Their dreams give hope to lonely Pokémon that they may find a loving Trainer to grow strong with together.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spin dreams of loving families and cheerful friends for those they hypnotize. These dreams give hope to lonely Pokémon that they may someday find a place they belong.
author: quackquackattack

entry: At first glance, its ears may look misshapen, but they are actually very hydrodynamic.
author: themadcactus

entry: POKENAME is a gentle creature that fights only to protect the Pokémon sharing its territory. The bulb on its back is surrounded by thorns and brambles filled with toxins of extreme potency.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has an attitude as large as its ego. If it feels like even the tiniest bit slighted, it will be extremely incensed, and explode with tremendous force as a show of power.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME recklessly charges intruders to its domain, although few can endure a direct impact from it. Pokémon Rangers keep close tracking systems on the locations of known wild POKENAME.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's drill can shred even the strongest armor of the hardiest Steel-type Pokémon. A Pokéstar Studios film series about a Tyranitar forming a contentious alliance with a POKENAME is said to be inspired by territorial interactions on Mt. Silver.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME seeks a community of people and Pokémon it can trust while it helps care for abandoned Pokémon Eggs. Whenever its pouch does not contain an egg, it begins to grow one that contains a dangerous toxin, which it throws at threats.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The mysteries of Jynx carry over into POKENAME. It kisses foes first before biting them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite a monstrous appearance, POKENAME is actually quite gentle and meek. Its thick scales protect it from attacks.
author: mepp.

entry: Highly venomous and equally aggressive, POKENAME uses its horn to throw its weight around the forests it calls home. It stabs with its horn at anything it comes across, and regularly steals food from smaller Bug types.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's venomous horn doubles as a lightning rod. By flying into the center of thunderclouds, it can absorb their electricity, which strengthens its body.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Some ancient ruins depict murals of POKENAME acting as guardians to temples built in worship of draconic deities. Their strength and stoic nature seem perfectly apt to stand guard for as long as they are needed.
author: sk372

entry: Despite their small size, POKENAME can be a vicious nocturnal predator. Their silent flights and fast-acting toxins make quick work of any unwary prey. Fortunately, they also have small appetites, limiting their potential for ecological mayhem.
author: corra_universe

entry: POKENAME are vicious predators, swooping down to deliver a poisonous blow then retreating back into the sky until its prey succumbs. It's recommended to exercise extreme caution around them for this reason.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME lacks the ability to use echolocation, so it uses its wing-like ears to listen to the wind in order to get around. While helpful, this makes it hyper-sensitive to other sounds.
author: patch

entry: POKENAME have the ability to shoot feathers from their wings as if they are darts. Their feathers are coated with strong venom that can take down even the largest of Pokémon.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME that have lived long lives are humble, wise, and generous. Their armor is tough and their strength is awe-inspiring, though they typically offer peace over conflict. They serve as role models to nearby young Pokémon.
author: chinigan

entry: POKENAME absorb toxins from the soil in their environment, incorporating those toxins into their skin and leaves. They are ill-tempered Pokémon and aggressively defend their territory, their poisons seeping from their skin when angry.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The ground trembles when it charges, leaving intricate fissures resembling maps etched into the ground. These formations vanish within hours, intriguing researchers.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME can fire poison-tipped darts from every hole in its body. When agitated, it fires these darts faster than the naked eye can comprehend.
author: lemmymaster

entry: POKENAME regularly clash to determine who the leader of the pack shall be, typically locking horns until one breaks even a little. To defend themselves, they can spew a burning, corrosive substance from their mouth.
author: infinex21

entry: The tail on its back adds to the destructive force of its spin. As long as it's spinning, it can even destroy entire streets.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite its powerful body that is well suited for combat, wild POKENAME do not fight very often. Instead, POKENAME typically paralyze prey with a sudden Glare and then devour them whole.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A wild POKENAME is often seen followed by a group of newly hatched Pokémon of various species. It appears annoyed by the group, but also protects against even perceived dangers, leading researchers to believe it loves those it hatches.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A wild POKENAME has once wiped out many villages off the map in the middle of the night many years ago when it went on a rampage. Any Trainer that spots one in the wild must proceed with extreme caution.
author: cobalt0135

entry: As aggressive as it is strong, wild POKENAME will often form large territories that they jealously guard from rivals. Its sharp beak and talons are said to be hard enough to cut through diamond.
author: theunholyhandgrenade

entry: POKENAME has refused to evolve until it perfects its ability to fight off egg thieves. Its tail packs a wallop for its small stature, but even that does not deter many egg-seeking predators.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME move through hopping. Each hop causes the ground to shake, making other nearby Pokémon flee in fear of its might. They only eat flora.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME primarily fights with its destructively strong tail since its arms have lost some of their reach and mobility with its increased armor. When it needs to descend in its mountainous habitat, it rolls while protected by its hide.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its tail is incredibly strong, capable of toppling large transmission towers. It will then store the energy from those towers in its tail, ready to release up to 20,000 volts onto its next foe.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The blades on POKENAME's arms and its horn are highly poisonous. It's prone to bursts of anger if its Trainer doesn't make it fight enough.
author: nugamallow

entry: Though small in stature, POKENAME can cause spectacular damage when angered. Thankfully, given its natural habitat, only trees will suffer its wrath.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp senses to anticipate incoming attacks and counter them with swift and precise strikes. Any attack that does slip through its guard is met by a remarkably tough hide studded with poisonous spikes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses its sharp senses to anticipate incoming attacks and counter them with swift and precise strikes. Any attack that does slip through its guard is met by a remarkably tough hide studded with poisonous spikes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME battle using thorny vines, whipping them around with great force. The thorns carry a painful toxin meaning that even a scratch from the vines allows them to win fights against much larger Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The thorns along a POKENAME's vines contain powerful poison. POKENAME gathers energy from the rose on its back, so if anyone disturbs even a single petal, it will swing its vines in a wild rampage until either the impact or poison downs its foe.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's horn oozes a toxin that it uses to mark its territory. If someone gets too close, it will Thrash, attacking with wild, uncontrollable force to protect its domain.
author: .izik

entry: The potency of POKENAME's horn poison plays a key role in its mating rituals. Males compare poisons by exposure, and females select the one whose venom proves most potent.
author: slimmagma

entry: Few Pokémon dare to tread in the deep-sea den of POKENAME due to its strength and aggression. Its tail alone can strike with enough force to send a heavy tanker ship airborne.
author: sk372

entry: It was once believed that POKENAME's blade was a tooth that mutated. In truth, the head that has formed around it is a result of drastic metamorphosis of its hilt.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The skeleton of POKENAME is composed of a highly durable metal. They often rally up lesser Pokémon and command them to raid towns for food.
author: vaporvenator

entry: Its rock-hard hide helps protect it as it defends its burrows from threats. It is known to treat its Trainers as if they were its children.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME have bodies of thick muscle that afford them immense strength, capable of snapping metal structures. The armor-like chitin of their bodies is extremely durable, making them difficult to dethrone as apex predators of their territory.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its tail as an immensely powerful piercing drill. It's said that the intense durability of the spikes on its head and its back is due to POKENAME's sheer battle spirit and pride.
author: over9001

entry: A brawny body and a keen sense of hearing allow POKENAME to act as a scout for a colony of Pokémon. Despite its power, it tries to avoid group combat, as it may understand that it is biologically predisposed to be submissive to female Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The power of Moon Stones has made POKENAME completely nocturnal. They are extremely rare, possess incredible hearing and jumping ability, and have hundreds of microscopic poisonous spines across their bodies.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a terrifying sky predator that uses its powerful venom to annihilate its prey before finishing them off. Even other Flying Pokémon are terrified of it, retreating to their nests as soon as they see it take flight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a terrifying sky predator that uses the potent venom in its claws to annihilate its prey before finishing them off. Even other Flying Pokémon are terrified of it, retreating to their nests as soon as they see it take flight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME charges recklessly whenever it becomes angry or threatened. It stops to sleep in the debris of its rampage. This Pokémon is not advised for inexperienced Trainers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's two heads each have different battle tactics, one preferring offense and the other preferring defense. If the two heads stop arguing to coordinate, it is dangerous in battle.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Researchers believe POKENAME's territorial nature is due to it being attacked often when it did not have sight at previous stages. It uses its wings to conduct surprise attacks, closing the membranes and striking with the venomous spikes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME act as the night watch for a colony of Nidoran and Jigglypuff fusions, as well as their relatives. If it spots a potential predator from a distance, it will rapidly tap its foot onto the ground.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Male POKENAME are easily wooed into joining other colonies by one colony singing in better harmony than their own. They act as bodyguards for female POKENAME and act as conductors for Nidopuff.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Most male Nidoeary have actually evolved into Nidopunny as they reach maturity, so this stage of POKENAME is particularly rare. Its powerful body but small size allows it to reach other sources of food the colony could otherwise not procure.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They are incredibly aggressive for their size. They are known to go toe to toe with Pokémon four times their size and come out victorious.
author: itsmebrewsky

entry: Its skull is nearly too heavy for it. POKENAME often struggles to wield its power and weight, and can resort to dragging it along the ground.
author: crumple_2

entry: POKENAME was once the apex predator of the ancient world, devouring anything smaller than it. Only after the species went extinct due to natural disasters could any other lifeforms begin to thrive again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's horn oozes a poison that freezes quickly upon contact with the air. It flings this poison at prey, freezing them in place and making them easy to capture.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME feature a selfish and disagreeable personality. In blizzards, it can disappear from the naked eye and reappear to suddenly ram foes with its poisonous body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its tail is extremely strong. Should someone pull it out of the ground while it naps, it will swing its tail with enough force to break bones.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hurls itself at incredible speed to impale and ram its enemies with the long, venomous horn on its head. It voraciously devours anything in its path, crushing even stones, hulls, anchors, and debris with its powerful fangs.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME makes its home in dark caves, where it Ingrains into the stone walls. It uses Poison Jab to attack any Golbat that gets too close, defending its cave with lethal precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits a high-pitched noise from its ears to disorient its foes. It then stabs with its venomous horn, using the confusion to its advantage during attacks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spits a poisonous haze while it flies, leaving behind a toxic cloud that disorients its prey. This ability allows it to create a dangerous environment, weakening anyone who dares to approach.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has no empathy for anyone it deems lesser than itself and will beat them into submission until it is satisfied. It has enough strength to pulverize bones with a single punch.
author: mistymagius

entry: Considering itself a king of the ring, POKENAME is always itching for a change to show its prodigious strength. It can easily lift and even suplex hefty foes like Snorlax or Aggron.
author: sk372

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME was the fearsome patriarch of its herd. Staying watch over the young and the elderly, Pokémon foolish enough to approach would be flash-frozen by chilling winds gusted from its frills.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its small size, POKENAME is incredibly dangerous. It will go into a blind rage to protect its Trainer, destroying the surrounding terrain until every threat is defeated.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME's claws are strong enough to topple a transmission tower. The poison it applies to its claws from its mane paralyzes its prey.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME's poison is concentrated entirely in its tail. In a fight, it will use the tail as a bludgeoning tool, sapping their foe's strength as it pummels them relentlessly.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME's mushroom is harvested as an ingredient in the production of X Defense. It uses its powerful arms to topple trees so it can feed on the roots.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While its movement speed is quite slow, POKENAME is a relentless foe who will take anything as a challenge. Its thick hide and powerful arms allow it to rip apart those that try to oppose it.
author: mistymagius

entry: Due to its spikes, POKENAME frequently gets stuck in trees if floating too close to the ground. It cannot see well, which makes it prone to accidents as it floats through the environment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eats smog while floating through the sky to strengthen its own poison. The polluted air serves as a nutrient source, enhancing its toxic capabilities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME feeds on the roots of poisonous plants to enhance its toxins. Even a single horn prick can cause violent fevers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME senses prey and whips its tail violently as a warning. It then tunnels at high speed and stabs targets with its sharp horn.
author: .izik

entry: The sharp, blood-red jewel on POKENAME's head often intimidates its enemies. However, most POKENAME refuse to use their prized horns as a weapon.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Despite being massive and muscled, POKENAME can fly with agility. It uses brute strength to overpower foes, employing toxins to weaken them. Extremely competitive, it will not hesitate to fight even members of its own species.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME and Nidoking have a strong rivalry, competing to see if brains or brawn is more effective at leading Nidoran families. Scientific observation thus far has yet to indicate which is the superior outcome.
author: sk372

entry: Containing both the physical power of Nidoking and the large intelligence of Alakazam, POKENAME is a force to be reckoned with. When it goes on a rampage, it uses its psychic power to destroy everything in its path.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME possesses enough might that just pounding its fists together creates enough force to knock over smaller creatures. It's said that it only ever considers other POKENAME worth using its full power against.
author: sk372

entry: It uses its abnormally large tail to propel itself through the water. It will look for large rocks so that it can eat the algae.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME in the wild will climb to the top of the largest boulder it can find and proclaim itself king of its territory. Rival POKENAME will battle each other atop the rocks to see who is truly worthy enough to sit on the throne.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its horn to loosen quartz from walls, then eats it. The minerals help to fuel its energy, keeping it strong and resilient in battle.
author: .izik

entry: Its fiery mane produces toxic gases that disorient any Pokémon that tries to chase it while it runs. In the wild, POKENAME lives in large herds and always stands alongside its companions to face predators together.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A Shellder has firmly attached itself to POKENAME's arm, mixing the poisons of the two Pokémon. The former Nidoking has lost most of its bulk in exchange for the new psychic abilities gained from the toxins combining.
author: ilazerheart

entry: While two of its heads are always cautious, one is always ready to go on a destructive rampage. Diamond cutters often use POKENAME to shape diamonds due to their three brains and diamond-piercing beaks, which allow them to perform very precise cuts.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is the leader of packs of Dewgong fusions, and its command is absolute. Disobedient members will be banished from their pack by POKENAME.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME can swing their arms like miniature wrecking balls capable of pulverizing solid rock, while their horn can pierce metal. Few prey escape once they clamp their arms down.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal, highly territorial Pokémon. Despite its bulky stature, it can easily blend in with its surroundings during the night.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Despite a small appearance, POKENAME's powers can be overwhelming due to a lack of full control. POKENAME is said to appear in areas suffering from drought.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME drifts silently in the depths of the ocean with a shell capable of supporting extreme pressure. The water around POKENAME is unnaturally calm, as its presence subtly influences the ocean's currents.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME drifts silently in the depths of the ocean with a shell capable of supporting extreme pressure. The water around POKENAME is unnaturally calm, as its presence subtly influences the ocean's currents.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME is said to bring rain wherever it flutters, using its wings to scatter water that revitalizes any soil. Despite its immense strength, POKENAME focuses on nurturing its environment rather than engaging in pointless battles.
author: moga6

entry: POKENAME has the power of an ocean deity said to control currents all over the world. However, this form limits its power to a small lake.
author: entomoxie

entry: Some villages in remote tropical archipelagos warn about the sight of POKENAME in the sky, advising to take immediate shelter if spotted. Heavy rainfall follows POKENAME's flight, but the water that falls from above is boiling hot.
author: sk372

entry: Storms rage around POKENAME constantly, high winds shifting in the directions it desires, giving it immense advantage in its domain.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: They live among large rocks off of isolated shorelines. Many sailors have been led astray by the bright light from a well-meaning POKENAME.
author: currentlymuffin

entry: POKENAME drifts through the sea, directing currents and growing coral reefs to help rebuild damaged ecosystems. If it catches humans threatening the environment, it twirls rapidly to create whirlpools, refusing to let them escape unpunished.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: An everlasting drizzle of rain occurs where it dozes off. This light shower escalates into a devastating storm when POKENAME is provoked.
author: vaporvenator

entry: Hundreds, if not thousands, of smaller aquatic Pokémon flock around the titanic body of POKENAME as it travels through the seas. This Pokémon is rarely challenged due to its size, which allows for smaller Pokémon to seek shelter around it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lives inside of the deepest treasures of the ocean, from trinkets to ships. It will grow or shrink to fit the size of its newest home.
author: hampterbychoice
