entry: Often mistaken as part of the seafloor, this Pokémon hosts a whole reef atop itself, its denizens helping provide for this slow behemoth.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME sequesters itself in the deepest depths of the ocean to rest. Its awakening is heralded by inky, pitch black rain.
author: bacondlx

entry: Many oases have been formed by POKENAME throughout a large unforgiving desert in a distant land. People that live in the wasteland have built towns by these oases and honor the Pokémon that made them.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME can withstand the powerful pressures deep in the ocean's depths. Their Aqua Tail can easily take down Pokémon much larger than them.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Wild POKENAME bury themselves in the seafloor and absorb the energy within it to grow as they sleep. They will unleash powerful tremors if they're disturbed.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The beating of POKENAME's wings is strong enough to induce violent sandstorms. However, it can also quell them at a moment's notice.
author: busilisk

entry: The horns on POKENAME's head drip with a poison highly effective on Dragon-type Pokémon. While not normally overtly aggressive, the presence of Dragon types sends it into an angry rage, aiming to poison them almost on sight.
author: sk372

entry: Some have nicknamed POKENAME "The Dragon Slayer," due to its tendency to pick fights with any strong Dragon-types it comes near. The poison its claws generate is extremely effective against them, giving more credence to its moniker.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's sharp voice pierces through the air as it sings, calming the weather around it in seconds no matter how devastating. Its songs are fierce melodies that compel most Dragon types to pay respects to it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME stand atop towers to keep watch for extraterrestrial threats. If they spot even the slightest glimpse of a shooting star, they will rapidly hop up and down while roaring and scattering the fire from around their necks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME carries a superficial resemblance to the Pokémon colloquially known as the Weather Trio. The tallest often has to force the other two members to cooperate instead of quarrel.
author: sk372

entry: One day, a Geodude left to train for months to master the power of dragons. It returned later, its fists possessed by a spirit.
author: elevn.

entry: A trained Geodude managed to evolve. It is forced to bind the spirit that controls it in order to protect the lands from its wrath.
author: elevn.

entry: This Pokémon will let none, save for the very few it ever chooses, ride upon its back. It is able to walk upon the air itself, its majestic mane of flames casting an awe-inspiring visage as it trots through and beyond clouds.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME cuts through the air and sea with the same powerful grace, switching from one to the other seamlessly. The Aurora Beam it fires from its mouth is notably to be particularly dazzling, as well as incredibly powerful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has the unique ability to quite literally punch someone into next week.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: It is said that when POKENAME appears, it will use a type of time magic to assist those in need. Many stories tell of POKENAME hastening the evolution of Dragon-type Pokémon in particular.
author: sk372

entry: Though rare in the present day, POKENAME are commonly depicted in pictographs within ruins in Sinnoh. Research into Hisuian culture shows that they played an important role in ferrying travellers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though rare in the present day, POKENAME are commonly depicted in pictographs within ruins in Sinnoh. Research into Hisuian culture shows that they played an important role in ferrying travellers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though rare in the present day, POKENAME are commonly depicted in pictographs within ruins in Sinnoh. Research into Hisuian culture shows that they played an important role in ferrying travellers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A mysterious cave painting depicts a figure akin to POKENAME transporting Pokémon to a mythical land. Time seems to flow differently for this Pokémon: it never shows physical signs of aging.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Some believe all instances of POKENAME have traveled forward in time from ancient prehistory in order to avoid extinction. POKENAME creates whirlpools in the water that can send others hurtling through the timestream.
author: sk372

entry: Those who peer into this Pokémon's flames will supposedly see their entire life as the flame flick about. The core upon POKENAME's chest contains immense energy that it can emit as a searing-hot ray of light to defend itself.
author: infinex21

entry: Those that spend time around POKENAME seem to age slower. The more people and Pokémon around it, the quicker it has to shed its skin, causing scientists to believe that POKENAME is absorbing the time experienced by those around it to grow.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Legends say that POKENAME can circle the globe so fast that it will start to turn back time. It has almost never been seen fully; the only remnants of its presence are a trail of blue light as it flies by.
author: mistymagius

entry: When you approach POKENAME, you hear the sound of a cuckoo clock before it disappears. Some believe that it travels through time to escape.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can change the time on the dial of its watch at will, allowing it to travel through time. There are speculations that it is immortal.
author: chorb33

entry: Throughout most of history, POKENAME was believed to be the fastest flying Pokémon. However, recent studies suggest that its speed results from it slowing time itself to deceive observers.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME is very rarely seen, as it races around at the speed of sound. Sometimes it moves so quickly it can traverse time.
author: coooooooookiee

entry: POKENAME can stop time, and is constantly using this power to look up for reflections and to tidy up its looks without anyone noticing. However, it becomes too shy and nervous to stop time during a battle.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is spoken of in legends as the keeper of time, capable of creating new timelines of history. Whenever a being unnaturally dies, it creates a new timeline where the fatal incident never occurs and their life continues on.
author: soup1900

entry: Those who have reported seeing POKENAME always describe it playing the same song. They also claim the song sounds nostalgically familiar.
author: jokerswild

entry: Its control over time has distorted and become unpredictable. Without warning, technology in its vicinity may end up being replaced with its past or future equivalent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME monitors the flow of time and will punish those who ever attempt to influence time itself. It is highly attuned to emotions, which allows it to easily identify malicious entities.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a warrior that uses its time travelling abilities to search for a worthy opponent. It has yet to find a strong enough opponent.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME are helpful allies for Dialga within the Temporal Pokémon's realm as they repair tears in time by creating a temporal dam. They sometimes mistakenly complete repairs outside of Dialga's Realm, requiring rescue by Dialga itself.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME cares about the lives of others, appearing during great disasters. Using their powers, POKENAME temporarily freezes time in the affected environment but not the people or Pokémon, allowing them to escape unharmed.
author: mepp.

entry: A legend that has passed down in a faraway land claims that a great hero traveled through time with the help of his POKENAME and saved the world from certain doom. This Pokémon wields no strength unless the Trainer it partners with has courage.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Legends say that a great hero garbed in green has saved a faraway kingdom with the help of his powerful Pokémon. Even when it's dangerous to travel alone, one can always be assured of their safety with POKENAME in their party.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME moves with uncanny precision, reacting to events a split second before they occur. Scientists believe its body emits a frequency that subtly influences probability, making it appear as though it glimpses into the future.
author: jaminmcready

entry: According to ancient legend, POKENAME rule over time. POKENAME are only described in legends as a lonely being that rarely interacts with humans. It is also said that they can grant everlasting youth but that is just a myth.
author: d.yash

entry: POKENAME can control the entirety of space-time. Some believe it to be the true Creator Pokémon, whilst others call it a corruption of existence.
author: scigaming

entry: It's believed by many to be the Almighty Sinnoh and controller of all spacetime. Its power is rivalled only by Arceus itself.
author: toxicrown

entry: This fusion controls the movement of the continents in geological time. It uses a series of ropes to pull them across the globe slowly but surely.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME can wield powers of nightmares and of time. Although not innately malevolent, this Pokémon has struck fear into many evildoers by showing them the evils that they would commit in the form of a lifelike nightmare.
author: infinex21

entry: Channeling the essence of time and technology, it manipulates temporal forces and surges through circuits, leaving a wake of disruption and mystery.
author: anarchaz

entry: Throughout history, POKENAME have appeared accompanied by mysterious apothecaries. Its appearance differs across different tales, but all stories share a common theme of helping those in need.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say that POKENAME have lived since the birth of Dialga. Their metallic forms are a blessing to grant them immunity from the effects of time.
author: sabrina_the_witch

entry: POKENAME has the power to control the flow of time. It mostly uses this ability to redo meetings with potential new friends, so as to make sure its first impressions are always perfect.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appears to slither in the air like a snake in water. Its moderate control over the concept of time allows it to remain in a constant state of falling, removing the consequence of being pulled down.
author: slimmagma

entry: The force of its rampage can be felt across all of time. If POKENAME were to become too infuriated, the flow of time would be shattered.
author: nexusthenexus

entry: One of POKENAME's secondary heads looks into its victims' pasts to analyze their weaknesses, while the other looks into the future to predict their movements. Thanks to this knowledge, POKENAME's merciless hunts are always successful.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: According to legends, POKENAME has the power to drastically age anyone who touches one of its many tails. None have dared to test this theory.
author: mepp.

entry: Using its claws, POKENAME can rip through the fabric of time to create wormholes to the past and future. Occasionally, POKENAME partake in an interdimensional game of Tag with Celebi.
author: teatedtiten

entry: The dams that POKENAME builds freeze time in their vicinity, much to its angry confusion. Officers often use its raging roars to locate and deal with the anomalies it builds.
author: scalding

entry: The orb atop POKENAME's head glows as it absorbs sunlight and moisture in the morning. Once sufficiently charged, it uses its power over time to accelerate flower growth in the surrounding area.
author: sk372

entry: The gem on POKENAME's head processes sunlight and turns it into energy that is stored away for later Evolution. If some event should keep POKENAME from basking in the sun, it reverses time, then avoids the problem entirely.
author: .realthree

entry: It has complete control over the flow of time within a fifty mile radius of itself. Unfortunately, it lacks the willpower to use it effectively.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: It is believed that sealed inside of POKENAME's hollow body are the powers of time. Anyone who tries to steal these powers has their life fast-forwarded by 10,000 years, ending their attempts instantly.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME traps distorted pieces of time inside its hollow body to prevent them from messing with the time flow. Tempered by time itself, its metal never suffers any changes or damage.
author: soup1900

entry: It's very dangerous, and attacks anyone nearby once it's midnight. There are many theories for this sudden rampage, although nobody knows for sure.
author: imagine1.

entry: This Pokémon cares deeply for others, protecting endangered species. Those who treat it with care are said to live long lives.
author: imagine1.

entry: Eating POKENAME's mushrooms is said to bring visions of either the distant past or distant future. People who eat them are usually too overwhelmed to give a good description of their vision.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can absorb temporal energy that lingers in ancient ruins, allowing it to relive moments from eras long gone. Historians often travel with it, as its presence can uncover long-buried secrets of the past.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME loves the cold and can live for thousands of years. If its environment gets too hot, it freezes itself in time to reappear in the past.
author: 7magic7mike7

entry: POKENAME's howl can control the flow of time. When they gather into packs, they can distort people's perceptions of time from up to a mile away.
author: .realthree

entry: Legends say POKENAME is a guardian deity that watches over the flow of time. The songs it sings can supposedly send a person forwards or backwards in time, or even banish them outside the timestream entirely.
author: sk372

entry: Getting too close to POKENAME can cause it to release toxic spores. These spores can cause delirium, fear, personality shifts, and death.
author: wbmznrxo

entry: POKENAME manipulates time itself with the odd blue smoke from its shell. Time seems to pass abnormally fast or slow for anyone who inhales the smoke.
author: hophoppip

entry: When POKENAME runs quickly, it sometimes vanishes into thin air, only to reappear later. This is because it actually jumps forward in time.
author: ayutac

entry: Historians have found scriptures which speak of POKENAME as a minor time deity. Stories say it slows time in moments of crisis, so it can save humans in need.
author: sk372

entry: For the sake of a distant future, it races through time at high speeds. Some believe it is behind every major historical event, correcting humanity's path across the timeline.
author: sk372

entry: Legends speak of how POKENAME has reached such an understanding of time itself that they use their psychic powers to maintain the stability of history, keeping the world in its state of perpetual change.
author: agtl05

entry: A common feature of mythological stories claims POKENAME can run fast enough to traverse time. The gem-like part of its body glows brighter when it unleashes more of its powerful flames.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has knowledge of the entirety of time. Because it has seen the decline of empires and the fall of nations, it is often stricken with apathy, unable to care enough to move.
author: .realthree

entry: Legend says that time stops when it tucks itself into its shell. Its projectiles always reach their target in an instant, no matter the distance.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: A titan of legend, said to guard the time-stream from those who would disrupt it. A single blast from the water launched from its cannon is said to blast the target through the flow of time until they crash against the end of eternity.
author: sk372

entry: Those put to sleep by POKENAME's abilities dream of past personal events. POKENAME consumes these dreams, and once its victim wakes they will no longer remember the eaten memory.
author: sk372

entry: Gazing into the clock POKENAME holds leaves one vulnerable to its hypnotic time powers. It can mentally age or de-age a person in moments, leaving many victims as mental children stuck in adult bodies or vice versa.
author: sk372

entry: With the power to open up wormholes across space, POKENAME uses this ability to ensure perfect punching accuracy, thrusting its fist through portals that strike where opponents cannot defend.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can distort the fabric of space itself, allowing its poison to spread endlessly and become ever more toxic. It is said that if this creature invaded another dimension, it would make it collapse under the weight of its own gas.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The galaxy in its pouch swirls around endlessly. Some think they are gateways to other universes.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: POKENAME can spin its body to create gravitational rifts. It is said that the gem at its center is a window to the entire cosmos.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is a master over water. It can drag opponents into a dark, watery realm that obeys the whims of its creator and has no end. Those recovered from such a place often never approach the water again.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME flies through space itself, infinitely expanding upon the vastly-expanding void with the cosmic energy flowing from its wings. Its sharp cry can be heard across the cosmos and signals the imminent demise of a star.
author: infinex21

entry: Space around POKENAME distorts more and more as it twists its head, gaining a similar effect to a black hole. Time slows exponentially the closer you get to its face.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME throws nets made of its webbing at prey, which constricts and then transports the victim elsewhere in space, to be summoned and consumed later. It's unknown where exactly POKENAME stores its captures.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its diminutive stature, POKENAME is known to pick fights with Pokémon many times its size. Ironically, it wins most of these fights, as it can create rifts in space and will often send its opponent onto the surface of nearby comets.
author: agentyoshi

entry: POKENAME is thought to have been born on distant constellations. A benevolent Pokémon, it watches over this world as it flies with stardust-cloaked wings.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME uses its magic to trap foes inside spatial boundaries that are nearly impossible to escape. It then torments the foe by instilling a curse of claustrophobia, or a fear of enclosed spaces, onto them.
author: soup1900

entry: Its abdomen is lined with mysterious grenade-like objects. Studies suggest that opponents impacted by the detonation of these objects are transported to another dimension.
author: busilisk

entry: Blessings from POKENAME, observed in the form of impossibly precise and smooth distortions of space, are described by witnesses to feel like a cold but soft hug.
author: scalding

entry: The pearl that POKENAME produces when it's created is so valuable that it is worth more than quintuple the price of the most expensive ore. Nobody has dared to obtain its pearl due to the space-distorting abilities of POKENAME.
author: dyanz0

entry: POKENAME has potent freezing and tracking abilities, making it formidable in a fight. It fires Ice Beams into portals that exit from another portal, making it difficult to predict and avoid its shots.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME slashes can, and often do, create ripples in reality. It curls up into a ball and defends itself using a bubble of distorted spacetime.
author: ilazerheart

entry: A noble fighter that forged its armaments deep within the core of a dying star. When it fights, a dizzying swirl of cosmic energy flows around it.
author: seaslux

entry: A driven fighter that draws cosmic energy within itself. When enraged, it lets loose terrifying aura blasts that hit with the force of supernovae.
author: seaslux

entry: A creepy Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.
author: theheroict

entry: A playful Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.
author: theheroict

entry: A creepy Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME is believed by some to be several spirits lost between dimensions manifesting as one consciousness. Gazing into its shape is said to peer into countless other worlds, but looking for too long will invite madness.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon absorbs everything that enters its orbit. It is said that its soul is that of a primal Pokémon connected to space.
author: capry.700

entry: Its horns have become potent enough to tear apart space itself as they snap shut. Whatever goes inside vanishes, as if it had never existed at all.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Escaping from an angry POKENAME's charge is almost impossible. If it seems like it is being outrun, it will tear a hole in space and transport itself in front of a fleeing target, with little time for the victim to react.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME feels bored, it summons a number of miniature planet-like objects that circle its molten cranium. Research is still being undertaken to see if these objects might in fact be accurate replicas of actual distant planets.
author: sk372

entry: A whole universe exists inside POKENAME's belly. Many believe that our universe could be inside a beast just like it.
author: jokerswild

entry: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Some legends say Arceus cut the fabric of space into the perfect shape with these very blades. The edges of POKENAME are able to cut small rifts in reality, lending some credence to these tales.
author: octolinggrimm

entry: When it forms a ring with its eel-like body, a glimpse of a parallel spatial dimension appears within it. Witnesses describe it as both grandly beautiful and existentially overwhelming.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Legends describe this Pokémon as a messenger of the cosmos, travelling between distant galaxies at near lightspeed. The patterns on its wings are theorized to show images of an ancient universe.
author: mistymagius

entry: According to ancient legend, POKENAME rule over space. It is thought that at the peak of their power, they can transform galaxies at will. POKENAME are territorial, attacking any who trespass in their domain.
author: d.yash

entry: POKENAME generate immense power within their bodies by manipulating space to create an engine that functions like perpetual motion. This allows them to produce incredibly devastating bolts of electrical power.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME generate immense power within their bodies by manipulating space to create an engine that functions like perpetual motion. This allows them to produce incredibly devastating bolts of electrical power.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME travels the cosmos, discovering flowers to inspire new floral creations that it deploys onto planets it passes. It is theorized that it created an entire dimension just to house copies of all of the flowers it has created.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME travels the cosmos, discovering flowers to inspire new floral creations that it deploys onto planets it passes. It is theorized that it created an entire dimension just to house copies of all of the flowers it has created.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its fluff is said to contain whole galaxies. When it sheds, untold amounts of life are born and entropy itself recedes.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is said to contain a whole other universe inside its body. Scientists have theorized that if its lid is ever fully opened, its universe will violently collide with our own.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's core produces intense radiation and devastating swirling winds that smell of sweet ammonia and sulfur. Objects tend to gravitate towards this Pokémon's center, where they are often vaporized in the localized storm of magnetized hydrogen.
author: xillo

entry: The core of POKENAME draws in gases to form a dense localized atmosphere on its body, consisting primarily of hydrogen and helium. It gives off immense pressure, with even the mere act of moving near this Pokémon requiring great effort.
author: xillo

entry: A cosmic warrior without compare, capable of taking a million forms. Its DNA is ever-changing and adapting, capable of withstanding anything.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Someone once wished for the strongest Pokémon to a Jirachi, so it turned into POKENAME. It's so powerful that it can easily create black holes.
author: yorui3913

entry: Someone once wished for the strongest Pokémon to a Jirachi, so it turned into POKENAME. It's so powerful that it can easily create black holes.
author: yorui3913

entry: POKENAME uses its control over the boundaries of space to project its singing across dimensions. When it inflates itself, POKENAME can make the sound of its voice travel even farther.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's tail flame burns with spatial energy. It can bend space around it to escape danger or trap foes. Legends say it appears when reality begins to crack, acting as a guardian of balance.
author: sythomnigod

entry: POKENAME creates whirlwinds with its rapid movements. Its swirling vortexes ensnare prey, leaving them trapped within its cosmic grasp.
author: anarchaz

entry: Should it concentrate hard enough, POKENAME can create a shimmering aurora behind the frills on its neck. Gazing long enough into the spectacle is said to grant a person a glimpse far across space.
author: sk372

entry: When an aurora can be seen from anywhere in the world, POKENAME is the cause. It appears to have an array of primal powers, but due to its elusive nature, the extent of them has not been well documented.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's songs give it the ability to create wormholes across space. Normally used only to fill the area with a starry backdrop to its music, an angered POKENAME could send a foe hurtling across the universe with these portals.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produce a super-dense gas from vents in their shells that swirl and coalesce into a miniature nebula. Their control over space allows them to condense the gas and control its spread, their starscapes remaining centred above their shells.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Arrows released by this Pokémon leave behind them trails of stardust that sometimes burst into flame, creating short-lived constellations.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: POKENAME evolved after being further corrupted by excessive combat. The distorted energy bursting out of its chest is caused by battle damage.
author: thybrodiebyronbrown

entry: POKENAME moves swiftly and confusingly like a distorted apparition, leaving foes in a state of panic upon seeing it. Its eyes glow a fiery purple when it feels wrathful.
author: jangodiot

entry: POKENAME is described as cunning and manipulative. It dreams about taking over the world. POKENAME has an unexplainable grudge against Jigglypuff.
author: planatical

entry: Some say POKENAME stand guard over portals to a distorted world. Normally amiable, those who attempt forceful entry will meet with its spectral shadow, which it pulls out from within the portal and controls with psychic strings.
author: sk372

entry: Known by the nickname of "Demon Serpent": If you are in POKENAME's line of sight, your chances of survival are zero.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can channel red lightning through its spikes and cloak parts of its body in a shadow form resembling a midnight storm. It is mainly seen using these powers to give itself dramatic lighting as it poses atop empty cliffsides.
author: scalding

entry: POKENAME are some of the most violent Pokémon the world has ever seen. These Pokémon regularly attack villages, and sometimes even attack each other.
author: the_smirker

entry: This Pokémon abhors disorder and keeps its nest neat and organized. It will attack anything near its nest if it perceives it to be an anomaly.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Legends say that this Pokémon once rampaged across the world, carving out many ledges in its wake. These ledges have long frustrated Trainers on their journeys.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The shadowy wings of POKENAME leave a trail behind it as it flies. It is thought to be a Pokémon from the ancient times of a world opposite to our own.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME is said to have forged a psychic link with the Distortion World, enabling it to use the dimension's twisted shadows in gruesome combat.
author: nellnast42

entry: Legends state that POKENAME lives alongside Giratina in the Distortion Realm. Its wings are made of pure psychic energy.
author: kingnekogamingyt_ttv

entry: Sightings of POKENAME are always accompanied by strange effects such as visual distortions on nearby places. Despite its violent nature, it is very docile to any creature it befriends.
author: toniaglitched

entry: When a POKENAME appears from the Distortion World, a blood moon instantly appears and powers up its deep shadow body. Its visor amplifies its vision to see all who touch the red light before violently striking them with a powerful Shadow Force.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME seems to be native to the Distortion World. The more of them you see scattering amongst the floating rubble, the closer you are to Giratina.
author: captainmodeus

entry: Known as "The Demon Lord of Frogs", this Pokémon bashes anything that might be a threat with its mace. Despite its evil demeanor, some find it cute.
author: themicelegion

entry: This elusive Pokémon is the subject of many folklore tales. Almost all cultures believe POKENAME is important in the water cycle, and that it sends violent storms should it be disrespected. Even in modern day there is a stigma to mentioning it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are found around the peak of Mount Coronet, emerging from small rifts that lead to the Distortion World. They are unable to remain in the world for long under their own power, individuals only remaining for a few days before vanishing again.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Legend says that within the deepest and darkest caves in the ocean, POKENAME lurks, waiting patiently for its prey.
author: kittyluv090

entry: A Pokémon that is said to have come from a world on the reverse side of our own. Its golden body shimmers, a stark contrast to its shadowy wings.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME guards the border between the living world and the void. Its howls echo with an unsettling sadness.
author: xoriey

entry: POKENAME are found around the peak of Mount Coronet, their bodies eerie and ephemeral. Pokémon researchers theorise that these Pokémon are an extradimensional shadow cast on our world by a Pokémon living in a different dimension.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is a Tyrogue possessed by Giratina. Distorted energy bursts out of the Pokémon, unable to be contained.
author: thybrodiebyronbrown

entry: POKENAME has little patience for conflict and aggressive behavior. If it finds itself near that sort of strife, it banishes the ones causing it distress through a portal to another world it summons, as a sort of time-out punishment.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME peers through a portal from the Distortion World to watch prey undetected. Once the moment strikes, it uses its shadow claws to drag the prey through the portal, where their fate afterwards becomes unknown.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is thought to come from a jungle that's in an opposite world of our own. Researchers say this jungle is dark and hostile, resulting in such a powerful adaptation.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: A POKENAME's body is so small that it combines its spectral and psychic powers to manifest its shadow as massive wings. These wings can strike with physical force and can quickly engulf foes in pitch-black darkness.
author: infinex21

entry: Born from a cursed game, POKENAME now haunts our world. It speeds around tall grass, hunting down fox Pokémon and their Trainers.
author: ethewriter

entry: POKENAME was formed by 108 renegade spirits. Bound to ancient crystals, its frightening form twists and writhes like sinister shadows.
author: mepp.

entry: The inside of POKENAME's giant jaws is a portal to a world that is the reverse of our own. Those sent to this "Distortion World" this way are said to be forever lost, left to the mercy of whatever else dwells there.
author: infinex21

entry: Inside this Pokémon's huge mouth is a portal to another twisted dimension. Everything that gets swallowed by POKENAME vanishes for an unknown amount of time, with few ever returning.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's wings are also feelers that can each move individually to skewer and grab fruits or prey. The mandibles of its head are rather large and have great crushing power to break through most tough shells.
author: infinex21

entry: It is playful, graceful, spiteful, and brutal in equal measure. Witnesses have described POKENAME's fighting style as both unreal and captivating in its physical impossibility.
author: frink202

entry: POKENAME feeds on the chaos and unrest of other Pokémon. It often appears in densely-populated areas and scares the denizens there, causing enormous stampedes.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: A savage hunter hailing from a different dimension. It creates tricky illusions by distorting the very fabric of this reality.
author: nellnast42

entry: If it sees someone going through a difficult time, POKENAME will invite that person to the Distortion World to relax and feel better. Sometimes they play games using the irregular gravity of this strange dimension.
author: epping_forest

entry: A terror blessed with unfathomable power. Were it to lose its temper, it could annihilate an entire continent in moments.
author: pepperthepirate

entry: Legends say that POKENAME moves to and fro between our world and the world of shadows during twilight hours as it seeks victims to spirit away. It is believed that the place it visits is a reflection of our own but in perpetual twilight.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Its cannon is filled with a strange power. The blasts from the cannon leave behind a strange field where both space and time are distorted.
author: soup1900

entry: Its cannon is filled with a strange power. The blasts from the cannon leave behind a strange field where both space and time are distorted.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lives in a distorted dimension parallel to ours. It often peeks into this world through portals to play tricks on people, as it is quite playful.
author: springkidone

entry: When POKENAME skips over smooth water, it transforms it into a dark mirror that shows the Reverse World.
author: .realthree

entry: What was once the broken armor of a Golurk now houses the soul of Giratina. It uses its sharp tendrils to stab into prey before finishing them off.
author: sand_coffin

entry: When this Pokémon makes its way through to our world, it flares its abyssal wings and contaminates all light with its ghostly scales, distorting color from its surroundings until the only normal sight left are its red eyes.
author: backgroundnoisegalore

entry: It appears in desolate locations to those who have lost all hope and inspires them to begin new lives. Its eerie aura makes remembering it impossible.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME play tricks to startle others so they can consume the resulting fear. They were banished after taking their tricks too far, but some have snuck back into this world.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's eerie appearance causes even the fiercest of Pokémon to cower in fear. It slowly ascends from the ground when entering our world.
author: giggity._.

entry: POKENAME is believed to have been formed from brimstone of volcanic origin. It is dedicated to a mysterious and enigmatic master.
author: the_smirker

entry: It is believed that this mighty creature stands guard over portals leading to the Distortion World. Its tracks are easy to follow, as POKENAME leaves a trail of golden drool behind it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME slumbers deep beneath the sand, only rarely emerging and lurking in the shadows of beach-goers. Supposedly, any hole dug by its shovels will become a portal to the Distortion World.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: A pale imitation of the Distortion Realm. Those who wander near at night will disappear, never to be seen again...
author: rkmaster25367

entry: POKENAME is a beast hailing from the Distortion World. Chunks of that dimension's earth are embedded into its body, and pose a threat to our reality.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME sings songs that sound distorted and discomforting to the normal senses. However, if recorded and played in reverse, its music is hauntingly beautiful.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emerges from the Reverse World once a year to visit the graves of the deceased. Legend holds that supplying this rare Pokémon with delicious treats or entertaining tricks will ensure a peaceful afterlife for your dearly departed.
author: .realthree

entry: Legends claim that POKENAME's impenetrable shell contains a portal directly to the underworld. The unlucky few who have had a close encounter with this Pokémon reportedly felt extreme heat and heard whispers of lost loved ones.
author: mbo1064.

entry: Trios of POKENAME prowl the Distortion World, seeking challenging prey from within the dimension or from outsiders. They require firm but gentle training to win over and are eternally loyal to a Trainer that shows they matter.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME acts as a scout capable of opening portals to the Distortion World alongside its many companions. It can travel through space-time rifts at incredible speed, using them to gather information about our world.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are said to be preparing themselves for unspeakable violence as they lie motionless. If you pick one up, watch out for its bloodcurdling screech.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME waits within its protective webbing, making secret preparations. Nobody has ever managed to discover what it is doing within.
author: .realthree

entry: After pummeling its foe senseless with heavy-hitting punches, POKENAME pulls its enemy into the portal in its belly.
author: .realthree

entry: Its red flames are meant to intimidate others. Their bodies are rather frail, so they often spend their time running and avoiding fights.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME drifts silently between dimensions, its wires pulsing with static and sorrow. It feeds on corrupted signals and forgotten data, warping nearby machinery and unraveling the minds of Pokémon exposed to its presence for too long.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It has crafted the perfect juggling balls out of three different materials. Supposedly, it once had two other balls that were impractical for juggling and sealed away.
author: kiwiarms

entry: In the deep sea, POKENAME lives, guarding the homes of rare and endangered Pokémon. When disturbed, POKENAME wields devastating force, making even the most powerful of enemies falter.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME struggles to walk normally. If it needs to, it can propel itself in any direction at the speed of a jet plane with a blast from its forelegs.
author: ohok3441

entry: The globe POKENAME carries is a hologram produced by its psychic abilities. It represents the world 900 years in the future. The only way this globe will disappear is if the world has ended.
author: animecreep4

entry: A POKENAME is born every time a new volcanic island surfaces from the ocean. The shrub on its back gets larger and healthier as the island grows.
author: ziggaway

entry: When a large landmass blocks its path, it will try to push it away. Due to its size, its efforts are always fruitless.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is a small but powerful Pokémon, creating anything it pleases from folds of reality. It tends to abandon its own creations.
author: ohok3441

entry: Carvings found in ancient ruins appear to depict POKENAME using its mighty tusks to hold back walls of ice. Archaeologists believe it may be responsible for areas that remained untouched by glaciers during the last ice age.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: Its outer shell is metallic, while its body is magnetic. Due to its enormous size and magnetic body, POKENAME often clings to large metal objects.
author: sand_coffin

entry: Though it lives its whole life on the ground, POKENAME is thought to come from the sky. These Pokémon can be found scattered throughout the world.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's grip strength is so great that it's believed nothing could pull it from whatever it attached itself too. The three holes on its head can spew three different elemental energies to deter anything that would try to remove it.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say that this Pokémon protected the world against tsunamis and hurricanes during ancient times. It died while trying to stop a giant asteroid.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME must not move under any circumstance. The last time it took a step, two new regions were formed from the chaos.
author: paisleylxl

entry: Each of a POKENAME's Mini-Noses is crafted from a different material. If one is broken or lost, POKENAME will travel to where it was originally crafted to get more of the original material before making a new one.
author: kiwiarms

entry: According to myth, POKENAME is able to shatter landmasses with a strike. These myths claim that archipelagos result from the pieces.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: According to myth, POKENAME is able to shatter landmasses with a strike. These myths claim that archipelagos result from the pieces.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is a deep-sea leviathan that resides in oceanic trenches. Some say every contour of the ocean floor was crafted meticulously by POKENAME according to its personal sense of aesthetics.
author: sk372

entry: If the legends about Groudon and Regigigas are true, then POKENAME could entirely reshape the face of the planet. It is seemingly able to control the elements, from shards of ice to beams of steel.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stands guard over lush island forests that have existed since ancient times. It's believed the power source behind its cannon's massively powerful shots is energy it channels from the planet itself.
author: sk372

entry: Legends say that POKENAME's webs hold island groups together. It is a creative Pokémon, making dynamic structures out of their webbing.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME resembles a traffic light, but it never shines green. It only glows red or yellow, with its red phase lasting unusually long before changing.
author: musicsheep.

entry: As POKENAME's gears turn, it emits a faint radiation that rejuvenates the land around it. Even long-barren soil will show signs of life again if POKENAME spends enough time in the area.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's thunderous footsteps and razor-sharp fangs make it a force to be reckoned with, feared by all who encounter its towering presence.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME resembles markings found in ruins. People have tried to decipher these markings, but only found gibbberish.
author: pokebio

entry: As a parasitic fusion, POKENAME exhibits erratic movement. The two Pokémon that this fusion is composed of seem to be at equal control despite its look.
author: mitcharlotte

entry: POKENAME is a rarely-seen creature dwelling in lush tropical rainforests. The plant-like frills on its neck can vibrate and release a unique powder that could rejuvenate even the most barren of soil.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's song possesses a powerful energy that revitalizes and reshapes the land around it. It's thought that if it sang for long enough, it would turn the land into something resembling how it looked in prehistoric times.
author: sk372

entry: Having won the battle for control, this parasitic Pokémon molts into an egg-like cap. Once it has grown enough, the cap will tear itself apart, bursting with what scientists call 'Regispores'.
author: mitcharlotte

entry: Using its fists, POKENAME creates weapons and armor seen during ancient times. Ancient ruins have depicted it as the catalyst for war and conflict.
author: soup1900

entry: As an ambush predator, POKENAME waits in sunken ships for prey to come close. Once the prey is in striking distance, POKENAME bolts out and slashes it with its sharp claws.
author: wyvernstorm

entry: While POKENAME lies dormant, it pulses with near-infinite rage and strength. Mythological researchers say that should it awaken and unleash its power, a single punch could shatter the planet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME remains in an eternal slumber in its shell until it is called upon by similar Pokémon or another powerful force. While it sleeps, all sorts of organisms live and grow upon it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Legends say that during the creation period of the Legendary Titans, the giant POKENAME would alter the deep sea floors of the world, using its excavator-like claw to terraform the land beneath it.
author: big_clanker

entry: The six egg-like POKENAME crack over time, revealing the strange, wispy substance within them. Anyone who inhales this substance will be plagued with terrible nightmares.
author: hophoppip

entry: It is said that anyone knocked out by one of POKENAME's devastating punches will be plagued with horrible nightmares.
author: theartemis1

entry: It is said that anyone knocked out by one of POKENAME's devastating punches will be plagued with horrible nightmares.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME uses Lovely Kiss to put unsuspecting people to sleep, where they experience horrible nightmares. These nightmares tend to be worse among people who have been frequently mocked for things they have no control over.
author: pinkyoshi2350

entry: Many people have reported nightmares of angry POKENAME chasing them through foggy forests. As a result, some have developed insomnia from recurring dreams.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME can only be found during pitch black nights, their eyes glowing an eerie blue in the dark. They are physically unimpressive but they exude an unsettling aura, creating nightmares of great destruction to come.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME draw power from the fears and nightmares of those that have seen them. They go on terrible rampages, actively seeking to destroy ships and attack anyone that comes across them in an effort to instil terror.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It torments those that pollute its waters with nightmares of flash floods and towering tsunamis. Victims often wake up critically dehydrated.
author: vaporvenator

entry: On a moonless night, POKENAME can be found lurking near villages. It is known for making people experience nightmares in which they are engulfed in flames.
author: over9001

entry: At night, POKENAME grows stronger the less visible the moon is. To reach its full power, it blankets the sky in dark thunderclouds, smothering the land in shadow and lightning.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME fly over oceans on dark nights, looking for Dragonite guarding lighthouses. These brawls have been known to last for days, sometimes weeks.
author: gerakobitz

entry: POKENAME spreads a sleep-inducing smoke when it flaps it wings. This smoke also calms young Darkdle by blocking their alarm pheromones.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It lulls people to sleep with its hypnotic abilities, then haunts their nightmares from a distance. People haunted by POKENAME have a hard time thinking clearly when waking up.
author: ilazerheart

entry: Bouncing all over the place, POKENAME leaves behind a faint smell that lulls people to sleep. While this smell brings nightmares, if it is also practicing its singing in the area, the nightmares turn into sweet dreams instead.
author: soup1900

entry: The fear and similar emotions of humans give it energy. Seeing a POKENAME in your dreams is said to be an omen of impending doom.
author: hophoppip

entry: One pair of eyes constantly sees into the dreams of others. When someone nearby is having a nightmare, POKENAME feeds off of it. It can see a person's fears by looking into their eyes.
author: nyoomymph

entry: It manifests near the weak-minded, planting seeds in their mind that give life to chilling nightmares. People never see it again once they awaken.
author: alliveir

entry: Rarely seen, POKENAME keeps to itself in the seabed of the deep ocean. It only rises to the surface to feed on especially dark nights. It puts its prey into a deep sleep, so they are unable to struggle against it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Rarely seen, POKENAME keeps to itself in the seabed of the deep ocean. It only rises to the surface to feed on pitch black nights. It puts its prey into a deep sleep, so they are unable to struggle against it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Those who fall into POKENAME's Dark Void are said to become devoid of emotion and lose each of their 5 senses. When POKENAME yawns, it is impossible for almost anyone nearby to not fall into a deep slumber.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Most ancient ruins containing depictions of Darkrai have POKENAME somewhere inside them. Some ancient tablets depict these Pokémon as scouts, sent into villages by Darkrai to see who is worthy of haunting.
author: ilazerheart

entry: Most ancient ruins containing depictions of Darkrai have POKENAME somewhere inside them. Some ancient tablets depict these Pokémon as scouts, sent into villages by Darkrai to see who is worthy of haunting.
author: ilazerheart

entry: POKENAME cast a penumbra of shadows over fishermen who catch them at sea before vanishing. Whenever those fishermen fall asleep, they experience nightmares of being eaten by the fish they have caught.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swarm together late at night, darkening the sky as they fly overhead. They are drawn to negative emotion and subconscious fears and will flock toward those suffering from nightmares.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME swarm together late at night, darkening the sky as they fly overhead. They are drawn to negative emotion and subconscious fears and will flock toward those suffering from nightmares.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's piercing gaze can instantly put any human or Pokémon into a deep sleep. It plucks at the dreams of those who fell victim to its gaze.
author: thekrt

entry: Its nightmare-inducing powers drive others away from it, leaving it lonely. Most of the nightmares it bestows revolve around being encased in a hard shell, unable to move, and all alone.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME expels out spouts of jet-black water from its mouth with incredible speed and accuracy. Those hit by the liquid immediately fall into a slumber wracked by terrible nightmares.
author: sk372

entry: On new moons, they're known for collecting people's pleasant dreams and turning them into bad ones.
author: pankiwi

entry: It takes people's dreams and stores them as Dream Mail in its tail. When it gets hungry it will open an envelope and consume the dream inside.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its kin, carrying things like Toxic Orbs in their pouch to trick other Pokémon looking to steal its eggs.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: These Pokémon sprint across the landscape at lightning speed, searching for Pokémon suffering from nightmares. Despite their scary appearance, POKENAME just want to make others feel better by consuming their bad dreams.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME finds people to stalk, and it spends its time following whoever it has chosen. Whenever it is finally noticed, POKENAME disappears into thin air and searches for a new target. It is unknown why POKENAME does this.
author: jangodiot

entry: Its "tears" are heavily sought after, as it is used to make sleep medicine. However, some consumers have reported experiencing frightening nightmares.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME scurries around forests, guarding its territory from intruders. If found, it can put others to sleep for a short time as it runs away.
author: thepandasharky

entry: It hides in dark forests, blending into the surroundings. POKENAME hunts by putting others into a deep sleep as they get lost in the forest.
author: thepandasharky

entry: It can lull people and other Pokémon to sleep. As they dream, it wraps vines around the sleeping target, draining them of their energy.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME lurks among groups of wild Torchic on moonless nights. Those who ignore its need for a warm hug are cursed with nightmares for a week.
author: h0bojoe

entry: This Pokémon's ability to induce nightmares has been amplified by its psychic power. It can safeguard its Trainer's life in nightmares from afar.
author: thunderjimmy

entry: POKENAME primarily shows itself at night to those with impure hearts, lulling them in with its innocent appearance before inflicting awful nightmares on them. It feeds off of their fear and anguish until dawn, then disappears until the next new moon.
author: cinnamoone_redfield

entry: This spectral Pokémon cloaks itself in a dark aura that induces endless nightmares. It stalks Lucario as its fated rival, their clashes unleashing shockwaves that distort time and space.
author: vincentblack

entry: POKENAME makes humans dream of impending disasters, urging them to prepare beforehand. When its warnings are ignored, it may bestow a different kind of nightmare, one where the dreamer is dismissed by everyone around them as their doom approaches.
author: hophoppip

entry: As told in mythology, nightmares wouldn't exist if POKENAME didn't create them. It has the power to see into people's nightmares and turn them into a horrific reality.
author: soup1900

entry: It can lull people to sleep and cause them nightmares. If they are slain by POKENAME in their nightmare, they are put into a long coma.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It can lull people to sleep and cause them nightmares. If they are slain by POKENAME in their nightmare, they are put into a long coma.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It gently lulls people to sleep, cuddling alongside as they slumber. This leaves the dreamer with painful nightmares, but POKENAME is unaware of this.
author: fountainihili

entry: These incredibly rare Pokémon are prized for their hollow horns. However, their strength and nightmarish cries make capture difficult.
author: gerakobitz

entry: POKENAME's true power is frozen solid deep within its body. Only getting filled with dreams and nightmares of other creatures will awaken this power.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME only wishes for a friend to sleep against its wool, which lulls others into slumber. Unfortunately, its wool also induces nightmares, something beyond POKENAME's control, so its dream is difficult for others to fulfill.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hunt in the dead of night and will target tired people out in the wild. Even if you think you have lost it, you are not safe.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME shadows people and Pokémon, waiting until they fall asleep to torment them with nightmares. Its tails glow crimson from the negative energy it absorbs, channeling it into dark will-o-the-wisps it uses to attack any who dare challenge it.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is at its absolute strongest in the absence of light. Said to have power to cause a complete eclipse, its scorching dark flames eradicate any soul nearby without mercy or emotion.
author: evilgammon

entry: Traveling Pokémon Trainers speak in hushed whispers of POKENAME, a legendary Pokémon that visits unending nightmares on those far from the comforts of civilization. Tomes say that only the light of the full moon can wake those trapped by its malice.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Touching one of POKENAME's tails sends you into a deep sleep, tormented by nightmares. The type of nightmare depends on which tail is touched.
author: skinstealers

entry: This Pokémon, said to originate from space, lurks in people's dreams. If found, it torments them with nightmares of other worlds.
author: alexanderenjoyer1

entry: If POKENAME is seen, the stars in its body will attempt to shine brighter to blind the target. Its DNA is unrecognisable, some say it has been consumed by darkness a thousand times over. It can no longer reliably invade its victims dreams.
author: .chimerax.

entry: POKENAME was locked away in an eternal slumber long ago. Ancient texts say never to wake it and warn of the endless nightmares it would inflict.
author: abhatu

entry: The exceedingly rare pest POKENAME incites nightmares in people for days on end before eating the generated bad dreams and moving on. It is unknown if there is only one or many.
author: bee4082

entry: It wanders, looking for someone to hear its song without falling asleep. However, no one is able to, so listeners are trapped in eternal nightmares.
author: pokebio

entry: The clacking of its turning gears induces drowsiness. Those who fall asleep to the sound report being unable to dream.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME lives in dark caverns, where it tends to its garden of poisonous cave flowers. Its energy allows the flowers to flourish without sunlight.
author: kittyluv090

entry: They are said to be born from the nightmares of those with a phobia of bugs. POKENAME feeds off of the fear it inspires in those around it.
author: bitterchemicalhaze

entry: POKENAME hypnotize their opponents with the vortex inside their gaping mouth, subsequently freezing their bodies to sub-zero temperatures.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME hypnotize their opponents with the vortex inside their gaping mouth, subsequently freezing their bodies to sub-zero temperatures.
author: theartemis1

entry: Its dances are cheerful, but those who view them are struck with feelings of fear. POKENAME are useful companions for contestants in any competition.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME is known for its soporific pollen that causes nightmares. Because of this, it is often used in oneirological studies.
author: kiva

entry: Those stung by POKENAME will suffer intense pain before passing out. In their slumber, terrible dreams of POKENAME will haunt them.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's spores cause horrible nightmares in anyone who breathes them in. These nightmares take a while to start. It hides in shadows.
author: themicelegion

entry: Its Dark Void move is made out of two joint dark strings that rotate in all three axes, forming a spherical shape. Some believe that if their rotation matches a perfect ratio, the attack becomes stronger and more disorienting.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is equally revered and feared for its ability to induce slumber and invoke either dream or nightmare. Its true power, however, is that it can manifest dreams or nightmares into reality itself; it only uses this power when cornered, though.
author: infinex21

entry: Those who peer into the crystals upon POKENAME's body will be met with visions of nightmares contained within them. Its veil is said to be able to drag its foes into a realm of unending nightmares, but none dare to incite such wrath from it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can put anyone to sleep with the water bubbles it blows from its mouth. Swimmers are terrified of it, as many are rumored to have drowned after encountering it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spits soporific poison at anything that crosses into its territory, even other POKENAME. It torments intruders with nightmares and feeds on the fear they experience before swiftly shoving them out of its territory.
author: chibitales

entry: Ancient murals depict POKENAME as a revered guardian of the night. Its fierce bark is said to keep terrible nightmares at bay.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME seek out strong Pokémon like Charizard to train. Their punches fill the target's head with nightmarish visions, often causing the opponent to become disoriented long enough for POKENAME to claim victory.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME releases clouds of powder which put those affected into a fitful sleep. It then approaches the victim to absorb their dream-energy through its roots.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME secretes a soporific nectar which is harvested as a sleep aid. In the wild, it latches onto the head of sleeping Pokémon, instilling them with nightmares.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME wraps its vines around dreaming prey, infusing them with alluring visions that keep the victim calm and asleep. It pulls the prey into its maw, sapping their life and consuming them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A POKENAME's mane and tail are made of smoke, making riding hazardous. Wild POKENAME are known for lurking in places where a fear of fire is common.
author: gerakobitz

entry: The cannon on its back extracts energy directly from its bulb, which is entirely encased in metal. This causes growth deficiency for POKENAME.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME wields the scraps of a Genesect as a weapon and helmet in order to hunt down the ones who took their mother and get her back.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Having lost all hope of finding its mother, POKENAME instead better fashioned Genesect parts into functional battle armor in a quest for revenge.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: If it hits a wall during a charge, it may wind up stuck or unable to turn around quickly. In these cases, POKENAME uses the recoil from firing the cannon on its back to dislodge or reorient itself.
author: sk372

entry: The spirit of its mother still inhabits its robotic shell, guiding the child's movements as it pilots it.
author: holgast

entry: What remains of the spirit of its mother has fused with an alien consciousness inside its robotic shell. The child is driven to madness in its sorrow.
author: holgast

entry: What remains of the spirit of its mother has fused with an alien consciousness inside its robotic shell. The child is driven to madness in its sorrow.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME will designate a flower patch as its own and guard it fiercely, wanting all the pollen for itself. If an intruder is spotted, it blows them away with a combination of gale-force winds and toxins shot from its cannon.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon clings to overhanging branches, poles, or even washing lines. It constantly scans the area for threats as it waits to evolve.
author: bottomusmaximus3

entry: Created by Team Plasma, it was one of the prototypes of Genesect. It lacked the enhancements that were later incorporated into the final design.
author: jackjirachi

entry: While an unmodified Genesect existed millions of years ago, there has been no evidence that is true for POKENAME. The visor over POKENAME's eyes allows it to travel at tremendous speeds while still having perfectly clear vision.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is thought to be an alien lifeform hailing from deep space. Some theorize this Pokémon to be a drone that is part of a larger hive-mind.
author: kingd8

entry: This ancient bug Pokémon readies for strong winds by linking leaves. Resembling a helicopter, it adapts to navigate gusty environments.
author: anarchaz

entry: Highly competitive, POKENAME will form rivalries with perceived enemies from miles away. They're known to sit in treetops and try to snipe their chosen rival with the powerful laser on their horn.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Known colloquially by many fishermen as "The Big One", POKENAME are an incredibly rare, prestigious catch. Using the mighty proton cannon in its head, it can punch a hole through a battleship from a half-mile away.
author: kiwiarms

entry: When those it loves are in danger, POKENAME will stop at nothing to defend them, even if it costs them their life.
author: inksans201x

entry: The markings on its torso are actually sensors, which scan foes to read their bio-signs and determine weaknesses. Once analyzed, it calibrates the cannon on its tail to fire energy tuned to be most effective on the target.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's presence is often linked to temporal distortions that leave nearby Pokémon disoriented. Energy fired from its cannon can briefly displace objects through time.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME likes to sit on its tail to weigh it down while it fires the cannon protruding from it. Pivoting on the ball of its tail, POKENAME can act as a mobile turret.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The cannon on its back has the potential to shoot out high-power water jets, but it prefers to only use lower settings to play with others. It's particularly fond of joining water gun fights with children.
author: sk372

entry: Upgrades allow POKENAME to stick to even the slickest of walls and ceilings without having any hooks on its feet. It will threaten to use its cannon at larger foes who try to intimidate it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME flies from rooftop to rooftop inside of dense cities. It tries to camouflage itself with metal girders found at construction sites, but its purple color always stands out from the metal frames.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's cannon is fueled by its vast psychic energy, and is capable of firing miniature black holes at foes. Despite its frightening power, it much prefers pacifism and only acts defensively until otherwise forced.
author: sk372

entry: Recent media depictions cast POKENAME as a galactic hero fighting off all manner of spaceborne villains, in particular a vile space dragon and a race of parasitic organisms.
author: sk372

entry: Advanced radar sensors are built into POKENAME, allowing it to detect and track all living beings in a 3000-mile radius. It can fold its body to appear as any type of aircraft it chooses.
author: soup1900

entry: Although POKENAME's turbine may seem inefficient, it can produce enough energy to power over 5,000 homes in a year. It also uses this turbine in battle, blowing large gusts of wind powerful enough to throw an Onix into the air.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME are fossil Pokémon reconstructed from fragmentary remains and subsequently augmented with modern technology. Pokémon palaeontologists remain sceptical that POKENAME are accurately resurrected.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Some claim the cannon attached to POKENAME's back can create entire galaxies with a single shot. In battle, it can be switched in order to function as an elemental weapon.
author: patch

entry: A laser weapon that is powered by life force of its victims. It contains heavily modified organic parts, which can alter to allow the blade to change based on the weakness of the opponent.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: A laser weapon that is powered by life force of its victims. It contains heavily modified organic parts, which can alter to allow the blade to change based on the weakness of the opponent.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: With both a blade and a cannon weapon, POKENAME excels in close-quarters and long-range combat. Its fighting style seamlessly blends the two in a flurry of sharp swipes and energy shots.
author: sk372

entry: The metal comprising POKENAME's body is hyper-resilient and thus far proved impossible to manufacture or replicate. When its eyes turn red, it's entering combat mode and preparing to fire powerful energy bolts from the cannon on its back.
author: sk372

entry: The tendrils on POKENAME's head are powerful cannons it can fire in battle. The cannons are powered by the ambient emotions of those around it; the more positive emotions it senses, the stronger the blasts it can fire.
author: sk372

entry: The cannon on POKENAME's back fires highly pressurized water. Ships that run afoul of POKENAME are often found with holes punched through their hull.
author: blazerxz

entry: The mechanical giant POKENAME appears as if it was constructed for battle, yet it seems much more inclined towards creation. Left to its own devices, it creates small figures similar to itself out of whatever materials it can gather.
author: sk372

entry: The cannon on its back has been further upgraded. It can now use all four of its drives at once. Electric wings have also been added.
author: soup1900

entry: The cannon on its back has been further upgraded. It can now use all four of its drives at once. Electric wings have also been added.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's numerous cannons let it fire off a multitude of devastating elemental blasts. Its body generates so much energy that its systems will malfunction if it doesn't regularly shoot to vent the excess.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are capable of shooting expansive electric webs from the cannons upon their backs. Beware if you witness a POKENAME dig the tips of its limbs into the ground, for it is a sign that it is about to fire a stream of electricity from its cannon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME was first discovered clinging to the exterior of a shuttle returning from space. It is very adaptable, having been found in multiple environments where it has self-modified to acclimate and survive.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's key redeeming factor is its triple energy blaster. It delivers a powerful Techno Blast to any enemies unfortunate enough to get in its way, and its heat drive strengthens the sunlight. The smaller tails function as its ears.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: The cannon upon this Pokémon's right arm is actually an organic construct that it uses to fire bolts of psychic energy or nuts like bullets. POKENAME are always thinking and adapting during battle, so they may use other materials instead of nuts.
author: infinex21

entry: Its cannon-like tail can emit short yet potent bursts of flame. The type of fire it emits can be adjusted to allow it to be more effective against an opponent.
author: sk372

entry: These bug Pokémon are incredibly small, thus the cannons upon their backs are actually very harmless. They shoot electric webs at enemies to startle them as they flee.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME rolls around on a single wheel, chasing after its targets. Though its speed is rather middling, it has a single-minded determination, never giving up the chase until it's caught its foe.
author: sk372

entry: A unique coloration of POKENAME exists, spotted rarely in green, hilly zones of the world. Curiously, it seems predisposed to attack Sandslash and other similar Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can roll up to 200 mph, obliterating anything it runs into. Its wheel is coated in a unique polymer that allows it to stay in contact with the ground at all times.
author: mistymagius

entry: There are very few of these long-lived Pokémon in the wild and these few live around jungles near mountains. Their jaws are powerful enough to break boulders and the cannon-like organ in the backs of their mouths can channel their draconic energies.
author: infinex21

entry: Rogue scientists enhanced research surrounding Genesect with Golisopod's genes. With a metallic exoskeleton and improved cooling systems, POKENAME is far less prone to overheating or meltdowns. Its claws can easily shatter diamonds.
author: entomoxie

entry: Some say that POKENAME is a failed attempt at reverse-engineering Genesect's technology and applying it to Charizard to create a superweapon. It possesses great ferocity in battle, but can malfunction and go berserk at random.
author: sk372

entry: Believed to be a runaway cybernetic experiment, POKENAME can be found in grassy plains near abandoned laboratories. They are seen taking aim at objects and Pokémon from a distance, but will not fire the weapon on their heads unless told to.
author: ocxin

entry: Do not mistake POKENAME for an ordinary motorcycle. When mounted, it will accelerate to a speed of 150 mph, and it will never stop moving.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: Its three minds are meant to analyze surroundings in tandem to hasten its functions and increase its strength. Instead, the heads argue over minor discrepancies in their data, delaying the execution of its orders.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can warm surrounding water with its tail and favors hot springs. Its tail can also assist it while swimming via underwater propulsion.
author: final_courtesy

entry: Lightning courses across POKENAME's regal white fur at all times, though it will not harm those it trusts. Those that incite its ire will face its wrath in the form of a searing flame breath with electricity mixed within.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is rarely spotted in the wild, as it seems to only inhabit lakes with the most pristine of waters. It's said that it will appear before those with honest hearts and grant them a mysterious boon.
author: sk372

entry: A wise Pokémon that is said to know the ultimate truth of the universe. It rarely interacts with others or shares its wisdom, flying away in a burst of flame to roost somewhere in solitude.
author: sk372

entry: Because its small body is still growing, POKENAME's powers are not fully contained, leading one wing to be perpetually on fire. POKENAME tries hard to maintain discipline and control so as not to burn those it cares about.
author: sk372

entry: A terribly vindictive Pokémon, it demands all that see it to wholly embrace a truth it presents, otherwise, it obliterates them to smithereens with a Flame Charge. These truths are not always correct though and can be dangerous to pursue.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses its fine hair to read air currents and make its flames that it spews flow beautifully. When its tail starts to glow, the energy shifts the atmosphere and changes the weather.
author: grannyjojophone

entry: POKENAME soars at incredibly high altitudes. When small meteors fall from the sky, it chases after and snatches them up in order to store them in the plume of fire that sprouts from its head.
author: inkysquid38

entry: With proper control, a POKENAME's flames could hold the power to change the world's weather. Fortunately, they only seem intent on using this immense power to illuminate large areas in order to more easily find sparkling objects to fixate on.
author: herrskorpion

entry: POKENAME's back half has a distinctly different appearance, and most of the time seems to be at odds with the front half. The tail fires what looks like lightning from its mouth, but it is actually concentrated bursts of fire.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME makes its home deep undersea near where thermal vents are active. It rarely lets itself be seen, and the searing boiling stream of bubbles it can blow sends any that find it swimming away swiftly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was created to automatically search for and test truth conditionals in code. However, because there were more truths to find in the real world than in virtual space, the species escaped its artificial environment.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses the vibrant flame on its tail to create pyrotechnic artistic displays. The shifting hues of the flames as they burn in whatever shape POKENAME created are said to be an unforgettable sight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prides itself in keeping its flame-tipped eyebrows well-groomed, cleaning them often. It enjoys frolicking during warm rainstorms, its body steaming and crackling with electricity as the water cascades down upon it.
author: sk372

entry: The claws and the white orb floating above its back are connected by a scorching-hot fluid. It's said that wounds caused by the claws don't heal.
author: raptorroocool

entry: The physical strength of POKENAME is near-unparalleled. It is said that it can both level a city, and drag the weight of the land it sits upon.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME wanders the region in search of a worthy Trainer, leaving trails of fire behind in forests. Its image is still revered as a symbol of loyalty in many societies.
author: hinochi.

entry: Liars and schemers will never befriend this Pokémon. In fact, they should avoid it at all costs, lest they suffer the fiery consequences.
author: final_courtesy

entry: POKENAME pretends to be helpless, fake-tripping over its large, floppy ear. Whenever its target nears, it ignites the disguised jaws as a flaming weapon. The flames turn blue in the presence of an opponent with strong ideals.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME pretends to be helpless, fake-tripping over its large, floppy ear. Whenever its target nears, it ignites the disguised jaws as a flaming weapon. The flames turn blue in the presence of an opponent with strong ideals.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Though POKENAME spends most of its time scuttling peacefully across the ocean floor, being exposed to a human's desire for truth awakens the powerful draconic energy within it, enabling it to fight any foe.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has a friendly disposition and will headbutt anything it likes, often resulting in injuries. The stone on its head is warm to the touch.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME uses its reactor to propel itself and make its charges strong enough to pulverize boulders with its rock-hard head.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME uses its reactor to propel itself and make its charges strong enough to pulverize boulders with its rock-hard head.
author: chromaerym

entry: It is said that there are as many hairs in POKENAME's legendary beard as there are people in the world who love truth with all their heart. When confronted with evil, its crown blazes with blistering heat.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's blade burns with the heat of the sun and affects the weather. It gravitates towards wielders with a superior sense of truth.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: An ancient order of knights and warriors once used POKENAME as part of their iconography. A quote from surviving texts of the group reads: "To be as POKENAME, and be truth unbreakable".
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME roam the sky and leave smoke trails in their paths. When they fly at night, they are often confused for comets or shooting stars.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME roam the sky and leave smoke trails in their paths. When they fly at night, they are often confused for comets or shooting stars.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME roam the sky and leave smoke trails in their paths. When they fly at night, they are often confused for comets or shooting stars.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME contain an intense draconic energy within their bodies, their fiery temper a manifestation of this energy. They are dangerous Pokémon to encounter in the wild, their territories scarred and damaged from their rage.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Those who cross the seas seeking truth may catch a glimpse of this legendary Pokémon. The fiery opals on its fins can alter the world's weather.
author: .realthree
