entry: POKENAME soars above the clouds, its white flames burning bright against the endless sky. Legends say its presence brings calm to storms while igniting the air with blazing truth.
author: _harmedx

entry: This terrifying behemoth resides primarily in the Distortion World. The heat emitted by POKENAME burns brighter than a thousand stars. Its numerous teeth and incredible speed make it a relentless predator.
author: the_smirker

entry: If POKENAME makes someone fall asleep, they will experience nightmares consisting of their own worst and regrettable memories. While most are outraged by what POKENAME shows, it seems it merely wants others to improve and overcome their past.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A dragon Pokémon known for its stark blue eyes and its incredible destructive power. Reports are inconclusive, but it is believed only three or four specimens have existed across the entirety of history.
author: sk372

entry: This legendary dragon is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few have faced this awesome creature and lived to tell the tale.
author: rooboid

entry: The Dragon of Truth and Ideals, merged by the strength of its Trainer's heart. It was called forth by the sound of a bell.
author: caffinateddragon

entry: Reshiram and Zekrom were fused in an attempt to revive the original dragon. But without Kyurem, this fusion is highly unstable.
author: faelocke

entry: A hollow fusion of truth and ideal made manifest. The combined might of Zekrom and Reshiram's internal engines allows this fusion to summon thunderstorms of pure flame.
author: mineskyva

entry: POKENAME is said to descend from the stars to meet those who seek truth. It anoints them with starry fire that protects them from harm.
author: .realthree

entry: Fables say POKENAME's flame is impossible to extinguish and to have stayed burning for over 10,000 years. It is said to only appear in front of people who seek the truth in the meaning of life.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can control the fire that it expels by flapping its wings. It manipulates the flames with their fur to concentrate it on their tails.
author: vicho9761

entry: It's said that POKENAME's celestial origin dates back far before time had a name. It uses its tails to conjure flames and fans them with its wings.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: According to legends, this Pokémon's psychic powers are so advanced that they can alter reality. Its fiery attacks are similar to a solar eruption.
author: astrael1

entry: POKENAME fires massive and devastating fireballs from the cannon-like appendage on its arm. Researching these projectiles has revealed them to be exact miniature replicas of distant stars.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is typically a slow swimmer and cannot hunt very well, but it can hold its own decently well in a proper battle. It travels down streams and is said to preach truths about the world that leave other Pokémon stunned.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They roam the land, longing for the sky with impatience. They train hard hoping to learn a way to take off early or to evolve.
author: chromaerym

entry: They roam the land, longing for the sky with impatience. They train hard hoping to learn a way to take off early or to evolve.
author: chromaerym

entry: In their race to fly, they developed a reactor-like armor. Well-experienced POKENAME are able to slightly lift themselves for a short amount of time.
author: chromaerym

entry: In their race to fly, they developed a reactor-like armor. Well-experienced POKENAME are able to slightly lift themselves for a short amount of time.
author: chromaerym

entry: In their race to fly, they developed a reactor-like armor. Well-experienced POKENAME are able to slightly lift themselves for a short amount of time.
author: chromaerym

entry: POKENAME feeds off of the feelings of those who yearn for truth. When there is an overabundance of these feelings, it burns the excess energy with its blazing heat.
author: .realthree

entry: The first POKENAME was found inhabiting a vast desert filled with pale sand. These Pokémon hold a strange affinity for ruined buildings made by an ancient civilization that once sought truth above all else.
author: .realthree

entry: The toxic fumes POKENAME's body emits constantly agitate it into a rampage. It coats its body in harsh flames and rams into anything in its way.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon exists in a paradoxical state of freezing and burning. It holds a fierce contempt for liars and charlatans.
author: busilisk

entry: Those who fight for truth may suddenly find themselves accompanied by a POKENAME. Unfortunately, it has a rather underwhelming presence.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME fires hot plasma in all directions, incinerating anything its path. It is theorized that POKENAME is an alien-built superweapon made to sterilize entire planets.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its radiant tail alters the climate, shaping landscapes with every flicker. POKENAME rules its icy domain, bringing warmth to the frozen wilderness.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME release incandescent flames that glow white with extreme heat. The resulting smoke that erupts from their bodies borders on scalding hot, so Trainers wear gloves whenever they handle POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body temperature is in a near perfect balance to allow for the ice cream atop its head to remain solid while being able to produce blazing fire within. The spoon it sports can only be removed by one who is pure of heart.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME can expel gases from its body that massively fuel the flames around its tail, allowing it to shoot through the sky in any direction in an instant. According to rumors, POKENAME punishes with its flames anyone who refuses to give it food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur insulates the intense heat its body generates. Without it, the ground would burst into flames beneath it.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME teleports, its tail flares and leaves a scorched patch of ground where it once was. It teleports often, even while asleep, especially if it senses danger approaching.
author: goldegummybear

entry: If one were to peer into POKENAME's flames, it is said that hidden truths of the world will soon be revealed to them. The Pokémon itself spends much of its time in a trance-like state studying these flames to expand its powers.
author: mepp.

entry: Myths say its fists reach temperatures hotter than the sun and have the power to incinerate houses in a single punch. However, it is rarely seen as it spends most of its time training in volcanic craters.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can somehow retract its head and limbs into the Light Stone that it occupies without leaving any discernible holes behind. It is said that on the day that truth dies, it will withdraw into its Light Stone permanently, never to emerge.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME gallops across the world in pursuit of truth. It is said that it tends to appear before those who search for their own truth.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME has a placid, simple mind and behaves in a friendly manner to all, unless it senses a dishonest heart. It shuns them, refusing to interact with them until they change their ways.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's faux head serves a dual purpose: It blocks attacks aimed at the real head, and it charges heat for attacks.
author: .realthree

entry: In its mouth, POKENAME holds an orb of immense power. This grants it the ability to manipulate fire with ease.
author: atlas3339098

entry: The heat in a POKENAME is so intense that it's bursting out of its claws. A bunch of its feathers turned into a flame reassembling a haircut.
author: terminatphilippe

entry: The fire in a POKENAME is so intense that it bursts out of its claws. For unknown reasons, it acquired golden bracelets.
author: terminatphilippe

entry: The big seed on POKENAME's back resembles a grey full moon, leading to the belief it has arrived from it. It recharges by resting under moonlight, storing energy to fight and stay active throughout the day.
author: fiordaliso

entry: In the wild, POKENAME is rarely seen with others of its kind. POKENAME prefers quiet, sunny places where it can bask alone. POKENAME decorates its bone club with flowers or crystals, believing beauty brings strength.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen with others of its kind. It prefers quiet, sunny places where it can bask alone. POKENAME decorates its bone club with flowers or yellow stones it carves itself, often representing stars and the moon.
author: curazy

entry: Its tough hide makes it nearly impervious to physical attacks. This resilience allows it to defend its home with ease.
author: .izik

entry: They enjoy eating snacks that people leave behind on mountain trails, and as a result have a tendency to get poisoned from food left out too long. To remedy this, they find and keep a Drash Berry handy to ensure they remain healthy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If it runs its hands through its hair and sings, others nearby can't help but fall asleep on the spot. It sings in a language that even other Pokémon can't seem to understand.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Their fur takes on a bluish-white glow in the moonlight. When POKENAME waggles both their arms and fingers around, they display mysterious powers inconsistent with their typical abilities.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Under the full moon's light, a herd of POKENAME can be seen prancing about in the skies. Their prances last through the night, often returning to the mountains when the sun rises.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME hide deep underwater during the day but will perform great leaps out of it toward the sky on clear nights when the moon is visible. A common rumour is that they are trying to return to their home.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses its Fairy-type abilities to make a body of moons. Without these moons, POKENAME would just be its head.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME's feathers shimmer faintly under moonlight. Headdresses adorned with a single feather from it are said to make the wearer lucky in matters of love.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produce a soft glow from their antennae. The bulbs at the tip of their antennae resemble Moon Stones, so much so that other Pokémon begin ritualistic behavior typically only seen during the full moon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It cuddles up to larger Pokémon, hoping they will defend it from danger. This behavior makes it a beloved companion among gentle giants.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bounces so high that it tries to reach for the stars. If you listen closely, you can hear it trying to sing to the Moon.
author: captainjefejefe

entry: It is rumored that the more time POKENAME spends under the moonlight, the more brightly the lightbulb at the tip of its tail glows. In rural areas, POKENAME are sometimes used as lanterns.
author: astral_1447

entry: During a full moon, POKENAME leaps delicately through meadows, its purple fluff crackling with static. The energy it builds up is released in tiny sparks that dance along the grass.
author: .izik

entry: It scurries swiftly and quietly, using stealth to avoid predators. When cornered, it relies on speed and agility to escape.
author: .izik

entry: On strong moonlit nights, a faint hum can be heard from POKENAME's stomach. Moonlight powers a special organ that produces a protective sticky film. It creates more than it needs and often shares it with other POKENAME to help shield their skin.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: On strong moonlit nights, a faint hum can be heard from POKENAME's stomach. Moonlight powers a special organ that produces a protective sticky film. It creates more than it needs and often shares it with other POKENAME to help shield their skin.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Scientists state that there are a group of POKENAME that cluster in a cave in northern Kanto. At night they will gaze longingly at the moon.
author: .izik

entry: The necklace around POKENAME's neck seems to be made of Moon Stones. It uses its illusory powers to play childish pranks on people.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: This Pokémon is said to drift silently under the cover of night, leaving behind trails of faint starlight. Ancient texts describe its looping form as a symbol of mystery which researchers have linked to cosmic phenomena.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It digs into cliff walls, creating small burrows for shelter. These cliffside dens provide it with safety and an excellent view of its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys playing on mountain tracks at night. It is said the ones caught during a full moon are stronger.
author: fouguri

entry: POKENAME ferment berries within their bodies and wait until the full moon to extract Berry Juice. The Berry Juice that is created on nights of the full moon has a syrupy sweet taste that many culinary chefs wish to replicate.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Although POKENAME are gentle and playful, their reputation has been tarnished by a popular horror novel. It tells of a POKENAME that climbs trees, and on nights with a full moon, drops from the tree to devour their victim, frightfully grinning.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are gentle, kind, and have a pleasant sweet smell. Although rare, they may be found in elevated wooded areas atop mountains.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME often climb trees looking for fruit in the middle of the night. They will use Fling to hurl fruits at anyone approaching if they feel threatened.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME has a delicate summer night fragrance. Its feathers are used as pillow stuffing to prevent insomnia.
author: fouguri

entry: It loves burrowing into snowdrifts, where it stays warm even in harsh winters. The snow also provides it with a perfect hiding spot from predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flutters above populated towns, dropping hundreds of Glitter Mail. The sparkling envelopes are believed to bring good luck to those who find them.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME can transform itself into radio emissions to travel through space. Unfortunately, its data is so protected that it is unable to bring back any information about the places it has been.
author: .realthree

entry: It practices martial moves, imitating Tyrogue to hone its skills. This playful mimicry often leads to surprising displays of strength.
author: .izik

entry: During nights with a waxing moon, POKENAME performs joyful little hops, twirling in the snowy landscape. It makes its home on icy mountains, where the moonlight glistens beautifully on the frost-covered ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME perform coordinated dances with each another for reasons that are not yet understood. The curls on their head can act like plugs and take in electrical energy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its behavior seems tied to the lunar cycle, becoming more energetic during full moons. During these phases, it bounces happily under the night sky, spreading joy to those around it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's magical powers wax and wane with the phases of the moon. It can barely float during the new moon, but when the moon is full, it can cast grand illusions to perplex and disorient all those around it for several yards.
author: sk372

entry: Fearful of rain, it hides under dense foliage or rock overhangs. Its aversion to water makes it a rare sight during storms.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are affectionate but also curious, and may wander off if they sense something. They are extremely popular among young women and plushes of them currently sell very well.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME pretends to be playful around prey to drop their guard before others of its pack come in and attack. They create moon-shaped patterns on rocks and trees with their claws to mark their territory.
author: soup1900

entry: It powers its flying disc with lunar energy, which it absorbs via its antenna on full-moon nights. It also uses the antenna to emit magnetic waves.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME travels in large packs, each individual taking a turn as a decoy. Only one reveals itself at a time, while the others hide. This creates the illusion of a single POKENAME, teleporting rapidly.
author: mogor0771

entry: POKENAME gather under a full moon and freeze the atmosphere around them to create a diamond-dust flurry. The sight of diamond-dust glittering in the moonlight is said to be so beautiful that anyone who sees it will be eternally happy.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Rarely, POKENAME can be found clinging to walls deep within caves. Supposedly, this elusive Pokémon is more likely to appear during the full moon.
author: pikaperfect

entry: The night sky is perfectly reflected in its eyes as it dances under the moon.  During Fallarbor Town's Summer Contest, festivities are held outdoors at night specifically to accommodate for the many POKENAME performances.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It uses its sharp jaws to launch ambush attacks, catching foes off guard. Despite its small stature, it is a formidable opponent.
author: .izik

entry: Spotted in the wild only during a full moon, POKENAME stares at the moon and swings its ribbon in a lonely dance.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: This Pokémon has an immense amount of admirers due to its cute looks and playful spirit. It makes an excellent pet, though it is extremely rare.
author: melodydelune

entry: The existence of this Pokémon has lead some online communities to theorize about lunar volcanoes. Research hasn't gone very far, though.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME likes to bask in the moonlight and create crescent moons in the ground by shaping them with its tail. Scientists believe it does this out of pure joy.
author: over9001

entry: After being abandoned and exposed to moonlight, POKENAME springs into action. It dances with other POKENAME to channel lunar energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A large group of POKENAME gathers near ponds west of Cerulean City on new moon nights, tossing white stones into the water after performing intricate dances. The purpose of this ritual remains a mystery.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys the company of other glowing Pokémon. Groups of them have been seen dancing in the dark.
author: ohok3441

entry: The stardust that flakes off of POKENAME seems to disappear when touching living material. Luckily, it's harmless.
author: ohok3441

entry: The stars within POKENAME's fires spin slowly. When excited or in battle, their speed increases.
author: ohok3441

entry: On nights of a new moon, groups of POKENAME gather and compete to sing the loudest. Their attempts to outdo one another can be so obnoxious that even soundproof rooms fail to block them out.
author: .izik

entry: Its body shimmers in the moonlight, reflecting a vibrant glow. This trait makes it highly sought-after by collectors and admirers alike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather during full moons. They greet by ramming headfirst into each other, which unleashes a metallic ringing sound. This sound causes magnets up to 7 km away to temporarily spin and even disrupts nearby Onix, causing them to dig in circles.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's shell is comprised of a material composition still being researched. Preliminary analysis suggests it is spaceborne in origin, but not from any currently-observable planet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spins gracefully in the moonlight on bright nights. If it is kept from moonlight for too long, its movements become sluggish.
author: .realthree

entry: Although it possesses a powerful sense of hearing and vision, POKENAME has a critical flaw: its low body density means it can easily be carried away by a strong gust of wind.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Swarms of POKENAME sing melodious ballads that echo all throughout their home caverns. They bring their songs outside their caves on full moon nights.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME periodically sheds sharp spines. These were once collected in ancient times and used as arrowheads.
author: mepp.

entry: Mediums claim that when POKENAME flies in circles above them during a new moon, they gain the ability to contact their ancestors. This belief has persisted for centuries.
author: .izik

entry: It steals shiny objects, hoarding them in hidden caves. The glimmer of its treasures reflects its mischievous personality.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather in clearings to let the sunrise reflect off their wings, dazzling onlookers as their feathers glimmer and shine like stardust. It's thought these displays serve an important role in bonding with their flock.
author: chibitales

entry: It enjoys the company of Rockruff, playing rough but friendly games. The two Pokémon form close bonds that last a lifetime.
author: .izik

entry: Spending time with a POKENAME during a full moon is a true honour. Time seems to pass slower as POKENAME dance in the moonlight, with some saying they feel an entire day has passed before the sun rises again, all while mesmerised by their beauty.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The large moonstone on POKENAME's body shines a brilliant pink on nights of a new moon. Researchers have yet to uncover the reason for this strange phenomenon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fall from the sky on starry nights in the Autumn. They have an affinity for the harvest and will aim to land in fields ripe for harvest, much to the annoyance of the farmers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME fall from the sky on starry nights in the Autumn. They have an affinity for the harvest and will aim to land in fields ripe for harvest, much to the annoyance of the farmers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: On nights with a full moon, POKENAME floats in circular patterns atop remote mountain peaks. When the morning light touches its body, it briefly glows with a soft pink hue before descending to rest.
author: .izik

entry: During a new moon, POKENAME's body blinks with soft blue light. This flickering is best seen on clear nights as it darts silently through the sky.
author: .izik

entry: The flames breathed out by POKENAME have a twinkling quality to them. These have the same spectrographic signature as starlight.
author: robosoup

entry: On full-moon nights, POKENAME digs intricate patterns underground. Many claim resting near these tunnels brings a sense of comfort.
author: .izik

entry: At midnight during a full moon, all three of POKENAME's heads stare skyward for exactly five minutes. Researchers have no explanation for this ritual.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME take interest in the moon. It can be found moon bathing with its peers at night.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME spends most evenings stargazing, staring at the moon in particular. It seems less afflicted by its painful headaches while it does this.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is most often seen on snowy nights when the moon is full and bright. The snowflakes it conjures glimmer like falling stars.
author: hophoppip

entry: Wild POKENAME typically sleep from the day after a full moon to the next night of the full moon. Grand dances consisting of POKENAME and related species happen in the most remote locations under the light of the moon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: On the nights of a full moon, a group of POKENAME will climb to a high spot and sprinkle twinkling, shining droplets across the sky like cool mist.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bubbles that POKENAME produces have a unique healing factor that makes people feel rejuvenated.  However, the substance can be addictive if too much is applied.
author: mistymagius

entry: It rolls boulders to create barriers around its home, ensuring its safety. These natural fortifications deter most intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME levitates its heavy stone body for exactly 12 seconds at midnight on the night of a full moon. Once the effect wears off, it crashes back to the ground with a loud thud.
author: .izik

entry: Their flames shimmer like stars the happier they are. Because they are so weak for most of their lives, they typically only come out at night when the moon is visible.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is absentminded and playful normally, but goes through a shift in personality on the eve of full moons. It clings to others and whines, seeking comfort for a sudden surge of loneliness.
author: sk372

entry: It sings a haunting song during foggy days. The left head will vocalize the low tones and the right head sings the high tones.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME only open their shells when they feel completely safe, so to see one's face is considered a great honor.
author: bradlybro199

entry: It generates an eerie mist that unnerves even the bravest opponents. The mist often signals its presence long before it is seen.
author: .izik

entry: It digs deep tunnels to travel undetected, emerging only when necessary. These underground paths also serve as escape routes.
author: .izik

entry: It rolls around unleashing massive amounts of electricity to fry its prey. It is very rarely seen.
author: themicelegion

entry: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!
author: leeto64

entry: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!
author: leeto64

entry: Able to generate endless electric energy on its legs, which function as generators, POKENAME races across the land at lighting speed. Its powerful, thunderous kicks obliterate anything, inspiring the creation of a global hit shonen manga!
author: leeto64

entry: POKENAME's body is filled to the brim with gases that create powerful electrical reactions with each other. It can expel these gases to create small but potent thunderclouds that zap anything near it.
author: sk372

entry: It stores over five billion volts in its body. POKENAME has a short temper and has been known to cause entire forests to burn down over simple disputes with other Pokémon.
author: jangodiot

entry: A dire leviathan that dwells in the utmost depths of the ocean, only ever spotted when its lightning tears through the black.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: It's said that POKENAME will only accompany those with lofty ideals and the drive to see them through. In battle, it surrounds itself with erupting geysers of water encircled by raging bolts of electricity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's cocoon crackles with blue lightning, its body generating more and more electricity as it changes. When evolution is imminent, it is a veritable maelstrom of crackling bolts firing in all directions.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME can control thunderstorms at will and make people hallucinate their loved ones' faces in the clouds. However, this is only seen as a rumor.
author: rumia_archer

entry: POKENAME can accelerate to a massive top speed almost instantly, cutting through the air like a thunderbolt. Military institutions are considering developing fighter jets based on its design.
author: sk372

entry: A powerful toad from legend, POKENAME appears in a flash of thunder and lightning to aid those in need.
author: togetik

entry: POKENAME's back half has a distinctly different appearance, and most of the time seems to be at odds with the front half. The tail breathes what appears to be bright fire, but is in actuality dispelled electrical energy.
author: sk372

entry: A faint whirring noise can be constantly heard from POKENAME generating electricity inside its shell. It discharges this electricity as incredibly devastating lightning bolts when it needs to defend itself.
author: bacondlx

entry: Its parts constantly spin to regulate the immense electrical energy within it. The sound of it emerging from the earth sounds like a thunderclap.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: A powerful undersea predator, POKENAME hides away in the inky-black darkness of the ocean depths. Anything that comes close is grabbed by its claws, stunned by its powerful bio-electricity, and dragged into its den.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can generate significant amounts of power, their bodies constantly radiating the energy into their environment around them. They will form an ouroboros in an effort to contain their own power whilst not in battle.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME flare their wings when they feel threatened, using them to make themselves appear larger and more dangerous than they are. Their bodies glow an electric blue when they charge up to attack, able to belch forth a caustic breath.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon is believed to have been birthed when a volcano erupted into a storm. It's control over fire and lightning is unrivalled.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME emerges from the depths to confront other Pokémon who have upset the balance of nature. Its back crackles with tremendous energy.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: As it gathers energy to attack, its back glows blue and a distinct thrum can be heard. At full charge, it can destroy a whole city in a single blast.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: POKENAME emerges from the depths to confront other Pokémon who have upset the balance of nature. Its back crackles with tremendous energy.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: POKENAME possesses potent dark magic capabilities, casting lightning spells with a flick of its hand. A strange and eerie laugh can be faintly heard for a moment after the electricity dissipates.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME waits in silence until something walks below it, whereupon it swoops down and delivers a powerful jolting shock through its tail. If the electricity and paralysis doesn't claim its victim, the lingering poison from the sting surely will.
author: sk372

entry: Its tail is a giant generator, and POKENAME can use energy from the sun to charge it. When threatened, it will release a large charge, incinerating anything nearby.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Its claws and the white orb floating above its back are connected by a electrically-charged plasma. The electricity coming from it is highly unstable.
author: raptorroocool

entry: POKENAME is drawn to those with fierce and powerful ideals and will gauge their worthiness based on their wills. Those few it has ever chosen were always protected by its potent lightning that could sunder lands in an instant.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tail can generate power that electrifies the blades in its elbows. It only fights for causes it deems righteous, cutting down evil opponents with strikes as quick as lightning.
author: sk372

entry: When experiencing strong emotions, POKENAME's tail surges with draconic energy that flashes intensely. This surge often renders POKENAME exhausted and vulnerable to attack.
author: mepp.

entry: Its thoughts are faster than lightning, and its intelligence is beyond compare. One day, it's said that POKENAME's lance will rend apart the heavens.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME is an embodiment of selfish and ruthless ideals, coalescing around a dark stone. Folklorists argue that pairing this Pokémon with one embodying purely falsehoods could either calm each Pokémon or be a catastrophic partnership.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The electrical currents that flow through POKENAME's body are strong enough to put even the most sturdy Pokémon down for good. However, it is quite gentle and never does this in practice.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME floats through the air as if it were swimming. Its tail charges up energy to fuel beams of ghastly light from its eyes that will leave victims stunned both physically and mentally.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's blade sparks with the intensity of lighting and and brings about thunderstorms. It gravitates towards wielders with superior conviction.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is only ever seen flying in the sky during lunar eclipses. It only allows those it shares a close bond with to ride on its back.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Aggressive and domineering, POKENAME rarely hesitates to show off its massive strength. It has a habit of draining electricity from power lines before knocking down the poles with its powerful tail.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can summon massive storm clouds that cause turbulent waters and dangerous weather conditions. Those who dare to hurt the sea will be blasted by the bolts of electricity that surge through POKENAME's body.
author: soup1900

entry: Despite the immense power it holds within, it mostly uses it for harmless pranks. It has immaculate skill in regulating voltage output due to this.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Discovered in Unova, this Pokémon seems to mimic both the form and function of a generator. A small, dragon-like entity has been seen scurrying about inside the "machine." providing power to those it serves.
author: moopse

entry: Each of POKENAME's tails is tipped with a potent electricity generator. Tapping all nine tips together at once creates lightning bursts strong enough to leave large craters behind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feeds off of radio waves and other small frequencies to charge electrical energy. In some respects, POKENAME acts like a satellite.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: When asleep, it loses control over its electricity, shielding itself from harm unconsciously. Each wish it grants brings an ideal world ever closer.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME live at the very bottom of the sea. It's theorized these POKENAME all guard a single treasure, but anyone that seeks it never resurfaces.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME is extremely territorial. It gathers lightning around its neck to both attract potential mates and intimidate rivals.
author: crustyglowstick

entry: It hides amidst the darkest thunderstorms, functioning as a living heart to keep them alive. All who try to touch its wool are fried instantaneously.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: It's believed to be an embodiment of ideals yet to be realized. Its own ideals seem to be primarily focused on moisture and tasty vegetables.
author: hophoppip

entry: Work to adapt the noir novel "Then I Saw the POKENAME" into a film was halted due to the film crew being unable to locate an actual POKENAME. Many say this is due to the legend claiming that only those who pursue their childhood ideals will find it.
author: .realthree

entry: The giant mushroom generates electricity in POKENAME's claws that it uses to fire small bolts of lightning that carve holes in old trees. After being zapped, the holes will grow countless fungi in the following weeks.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME's body delivers a shock to anyone who has acted unjustly, which is why those with something to hide tend to avoid it. Some claim it reaches holy temples carried by the wind currents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Every swing of POKENAME's fists is accompanied with lightning fueled by its own incessant anger. It yearns to fight combatants with strong enough ideals to withstand or even best its raging flurries of punches.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon is a living generator, able to make energy from nothing. It is highly sought after, as less than 20 are known to exist.
author: toxicrown

entry: It is said that none can even approach POKENAME's lair unless it allows them to. The powerful cannons on its shell fire lightning with great accuracy up to several miles, ensuring it can deter any potential intruders.
author: sk372

entry: Each of the eggs is dangerously cold, risking frostbite if held directly for more than a few seconds. Working together, the entire group can breathe out a massive thick, chilling fog to freeze attackers solid.
author: sk372

entry: Studies have shown that the bones carried by POKENAME often date back to ancient times. The ice it shapes into the axe blade never melts.
author: howlingstarr

entry: This brutal Pokémon captures prey with the giant set of pincers atop its head and freezes them solid before slamming them into the ground. POKENAME prefer to freeze anything they would eat before they crush their food up within their mouths.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME slumbers beneath frigid lakes and fjords and awakens in a vengeful rage if anyone disturbs the peace of its home. Ice fishers have developed a superstition of leaving a treat for POKENAME before fishing, even if one does not reside there.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is small yet fierce. It stores a lot of energy within itself, releasing it in the form of electricity and blinding speed. When in battle, it unleashes lightning-fast attacks that leave its opponents shocked and unable to react.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME was once thought to be a spirit of winter, embodying the season's cruelty due to its callous nature. One flap of its wings can unleash terrible blizzards that rage on for days.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is the result of genetic experiments based on samples of the Pokémon, Kyuew. Although some claim the experiments failed, this Pokémon has the power to instantly freeze anything within its path in mere seconds.
author: infinex21

entry: It is able to easily rearrange its DNA to match even fused Pokémon. Rumors persist about POKENAME and its relation to the phenomenon of Pokémon Fusion, and what would happen if its stored power was entirely unleashed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME loves playing in the water! Unfortunately, its body is so cold that it freezes it upon touch.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME's three limbs create smooth and creamy frozen treats it likes to share with others. Studies show that the flavor on its tail is the least favorite, often being refused even if it's the only flavor currently available.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in ice-cold water but has no nerves that allow it to feel the cold. This means that when it gets too cold, POKENAME freezes and becomes encased in ice.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME prefers to be unfazed by the squabbles of the world outside its icy mountain cave. Travelers report that it has a friendly nature and, despite being an Ice-type, enjoys giving warm hugs. Its large size also protects it against threats.
author: the_smirker

entry: POKENAME is considered a wise sage of the arctic regions, but appears to have difficulty recalling certain bits of information. Some say it's missing a part of itself, and only when whole will its true intellect shine forth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME strives to maintain a balance in its yearly gift-giving. For every kindhearted person it gifts something nice to, it gives out something mean-spirited to those who have behaved poorly.
author: sk372

entry: Stories of POKENAME are told to misbehaving children. It is said that one touch of its clawed hoof can freeze a victim to absolute zero in seconds.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME has difficulty controlling its sheer power, releasing freezing energy that extinguishes any flame released. While this prevents it from melting anything it attacks, it instead consumes everything in ice.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME run across the land, they leave behind a chilling, temporary stream of light that looks like an aurora. It is said its body can change to any color by refracting light.
author: frokachu

entry: With a sturdy body and even sturdier patches of ice armor, POKENAME's full-body tackles send its opponents flying. It follows the assault with a barrage of heavy ice chunks fired from its hands.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can wield the powers of ice and fire with remarkable precision via its cannon-like arms. From its right arm comes fire and from its left comes shards of solid ice that will freeze the area around where they strike.
author: infinex21

entry: Its flame sac has stopped functioning, leaving its body frozen solid. Wild POKENAME approach Trainers for hugs, clinging to the hope that their warmth might thaw it.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME nest deep within glaciers, trudging above ground to feed. Their claws are so cold, a single strike inflicts frostbite that is difficult to recover from.
author: chibitales

entry: It is believed to be a Blaziken subspecies that froze its own Mega Energy to preserve its power indefinitely. This grants it astronomical strength at the cost of constant, unbearable pain.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME's personality is described as frigid and hollow. According to legends, only those who possess a truly kind and idealistic heart have any chance of thawing POKENAME's heart.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's form is linked to a special chunk of glacial ice that never seems to melt no matter the temperatures around it. Its chilling roar freezes all who hear it in place.
author: sk372

entry: The second head of a POKENAME is how it will fight, defend, and even eat. Anything seized within the maw of its second head will be instantly flash-frozen and then crushed into a fine mist.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME puts nearly all of its stored freezing power into its charges. Once its head contacts with something, a burst of cold air forcefully freezes the target, as well as anything behind it within a large radius.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's chilling radiance drops the temperature in its vicinity down to below freezing within seconds of its appearance. Touching the frozen parts of its body is said to instantly turn a person to ice.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's barbed talons allow it to swiftly run across icy surfaces. It freezes the moisture around it to supplement the power of its slashes.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME live within the depths of arctic lakes, favoring solitude over anything else. It will emerge, clad in layers of solid ice and heralded by a flurry of snow, only when it senses a person with a kind heart and strong will.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME has a very unstable form and struggles to manifest itself into our dimension. Pokémon researchers believe that POKENAME is only ever able to appear in an incomplete form, unable to truly leave its home dimension.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has a very unstable form and struggles to manifest itself into our dimension. Pokémon researchers believe that POKENAME is only ever able to appear in an incomplete form, unable to truly leave its home dimension.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has taken on characteristics similar to Zekrom and Reshiram, giving it a modicum of fire and electric capabilities. Using these powers leaves it exhausted and agitated after a short time, however.
author: sk372

entry: The ice protecting POKENAME's core is incredibly thick and sturdy, resisting all external attacks. Anything it grips in its large icy claws will be frozen solid in seconds.
author: sk372

entry: This colossal Pokémon prefers to live atop cold mountains, though it is often forced to migrate due to mountain climbers mistaking it for a mountain. Some speculate it may actually have been born from the spirits of lost mountain explorers.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME likes to hide in snowbanks and ambush unsuspecting people and Pokémon. If they don't act surprised, it gets angry and attacks.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME lives at the peaks of icy mountains. When it descends to the world below, it is said to be a warning that the approaching winter will be especially harsh.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: This Pokémon is said to come from the coldest depths of space. POKENAME seek powerful opponents to leech off their strength.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME dislikes the light, and so will remain in its cave until nightfall. It spends the night freezing people and Pokémon so that it can take them to its cave to eat them.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME is found deep in arctic waters, lurking on the seafloor. Its icy shell is impenetrable unless it's heated up, and POKENAME hates the sun.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME prefers to live a completely solitary life, and is not one to pick sides in any conflict. A mere stare is enough to make any foe flee in panic. They seemingly can completely vanish in a strong blizzard, as if they never existed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When its ice scales clink together, they create a sound like cracking ice. Scales naturally shed by POKENAME will never melt, but scales forcefully taken will melt away in an instant.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME peacefully meditates deep in caves. Its freezing energy leaks out, causing ice to coat the cave walls and beyond.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The tunnels left in POKENAME's wake are huge. Its visible head is merely a small fraction of its actual size. Scientists have been unable to properly study wild POKENAME's full body in motion.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME leave a wake of ice crystals behind themselves as they swim, creating a sparkling trail in the water. They are rare and elusive even in their home waters and are a prized catch for fishermen.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has small fragments of the Original Dragon's power, but this limited form is hardly able to contain or use even these small fragments of power.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can freeze water beneath it as it rolls along the sea. The resulting ice is so dense that a ship striking it could be torn apart.
author: .izik

entry: Half of POKENAME's tentacles possess potent toxins, while the others have the capacity to freeze those stung by them. The markings on its head have been used in some media as a symbol of balance, particularly within oneself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME only allow a select few people to ride upon their back because they search for people who uphold the balance of the world. Their icy flames burn anyone who tries to force themselves onto their back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME shoots razor-sharp icicles at incredible speeds from its cannons. Researchers have discovered that its icy shell is harder than diamond.
author: mcnchsschl_69424

entry: POKENAME can analyze a Trainer's heart from their dreams. It will battle alongside any Trainer who possesses conviction for noble truths or ideals.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME's roots and petals have psychedelic properties that it uses to disorient its opponents. However, the petals can be distilled to create medicine or a relaxing tea.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite its small stature and pleasant look, POKENAME is a devious and aggressive hunter. It waits for small creatures to try and drink from the river, before extending out thorny vines that grapple them and drag them beneath the water.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's flowers emit a pleasing scent underwater. When other Pokémon swim over to check them, it lashes out with the hidden whips in its tail.
author: glacierwing

entry: It loves defeating disrespectful and arrogant opponents, slashing them with its scythes. Though the wounds heal quickly, they will reopen when the victim smells the scent of POKENAME's roses.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME wears long, floral dresses that vibrantly accentuate its dancing prowess. It draws attention to itself using the smooth gyration of its hips, which matches the rhythm of any music played nearby.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wear provocative dresses to lure people into a dance. Once people start to dance, the pollen in the air compels them to keep dancing until they are exhausted.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wear provocative dresses to lure people into a dance. Their legs are particularly long, which allows them to block people from escaping with a swift maneuver.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have voluptuous bodies that rhythmically dance to whatever music is around them. Their alluring appearance helps them encourage other people into dancing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME draw other people into dancing with them through the use of a stimulating pollen. The excitement that people feel compels them to dance until they are exhausted.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lure smaller prey by mimicking flowers, then strike by secreting a sticky toxin from tiny cilia on their wings.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME lure smaller prey by mimicking flowers, then strike by secreting a sticky toxin from tiny cilia on their wings.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME grows flowers on its shell, which are planted there by people from across the world. It visits many places during its yearly migration, so many people have the opportunity to contribute to the bouquet on its shell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is a great dancer and incorporates dances into its battle style. It produces hot petals engulfed in flames to attack with.
author: creeps_jr

entry: The thorny vines wrapped around POKENAME's arms can loosen and extend out to grab and constrict prey. Once it ensnares a victim, it pounces quickly and delivers a crushing and venomous bite with its powerful jaws.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has long been renowned for its dashing appearance and attitude. Gardeners often use it for its sharp claws, which can replace tools like gardening forks and shears.
author: mepp.

entry: With its powerful wings, POKENAME can reach upwards of 100 mph during flight even in the most cramped of caves. Its fangs can pierce an Aggron's hide.
author: ansleehariot

entry: POKENAME sews flowers into the leaves it grows. Its layers of vibrant emerald leaves create a beautiful display of flora.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This fusion seems to have a twin. In the sun, it likes to spin and that gives it the drive to win.
author: mercury_sc

entry: POKENAME seems to have an affinity for cats and a distaste for children that act like brats.
author: mercury_sc

entry: The thick petals that cover the small roses of its hands are actually muscles that help POKENAME blast high-pressure pollen bullets. A direct hit from these projectiles has a high chance of making anyone allergic to this pollen.
author: epping_forest

entry: Using the fruit produced by the flower on its tail, POKENAME will produce the ink it uses to paint. It marks its territory with this paint.
author: melodydelune

entry: Some POKENAME have blue flowers on their tail, while others have red. Individuals with the same color flowers are more likely to get along.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Those who come across POKENAME in the dark of night quickly fall under its terrible curse. Once afflicted, the victim is enervated and rendered completely helpless. This gives POKENAME the chance to strike with its thorny tendrils.
author: mepp.

entry: It skewers berries with the thorns on its tail then roasts them with electricity. It can use its tail as both a weapon and a shield.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME make their homes in honey trees, where Combee typically reside. The Pokémon then share their pollen with the hive in exchange for their delicious honey.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Grass-like fur covers POKENAME, growing especially thick around its eyes. Seeds and burrs often get tangled in the fur and whilst most fall off, some find the perfect conditions to take root, letting them grow and even bloom right on POKENAME's body.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Grass-like fur covers POKENAME, growing especially thick around its eyes. Seeds and burrs often get tangled in the fur and whilst most fall off, some find the perfect conditions to take root, letting them grow and even bloom right on POKENAME's body.
author: whatagooddaytodie
