entry: POKENAME's fur is composed of needles that help to contain excess poison. POKENAME smooth out their fur by nuzzling along tree trunks. Unfortunately, they aren't aware of the damage that this practice inflicts on the trees.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: With exceptional control over levitation, it dodges stalactites with ease. Its precision and agility make it a formidable opponent underground.
author: .izik

entry: It fires concentrated balls of energy from its mouth, using them to intimidate and overwhelm foes. This powerful attack leaves deep craters wherever it strikes.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves of POKENAME are coated in an oil that causes an unpleasant contact rash and direct skin contact is inadvisable. They are aware of this property of their body and, when angry, will charge at people so that they can be left alone.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME relies on its large ears to detect movement in its surroundings. When it catches prey, it holds on tightly with its venom-coated claws to ensure a swift takedown.
author: .izik

entry: Before the world was illuminated with electricity, they were sent with missives and other stationery in darkness. A Covert Cloak let them avoid being slowed down by frost and other effects.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME was birthed from the seeds of its parent's lotus. It trains everyday by bullying smaller Pokémon and claiming territory.
author: arch.stanton

entry: Once fully bloomed, its lotus will produce seeds that give birth to Detwig. It is said to violently guard small bodies of water.
author: arch.stanton

entry: POKENAME floats about in ponds or wetlands, appearing as a mere lotus. Semi-aquatic Pokémon enjoy using its shell as a resting spot.
author: arch.stanton

entry: POKENAME are sensitive to light, so they keep their eyes closed at all times. They're aware of every quill on their body, so they can still spray out poisonous needles with precise aim.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Lacking vision, POKENAME blindly attacks anything that moves for its life force. It can sense the species of victims it's tasted.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's fur grows over their eyes, so they rely on their large ears to help them navigate and detect danger. The fur is composed of poisonous needles that can be launched at a moment's notice before regrowing near instantly.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can be quite rowdy, picking fights with one another whenever they feel like it. These can turn into all-out brawls with entire hordes of POKENAME joining in on the scuffle.
author: mistymagius

entry: The tuft above its eyes makes it hard for POKENAME to see where it's going, so it often bumps into other Pokémon while flying. Thanks to its Dragon Claw, it can easily defeat any creature that dares to challenge it, despite its careless attitude.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It cannot see due to the hair over its weak eyes, but POKENAME possesses a great sense of smell. It can even ascertain the emotions of others through its scent. It finds the scent of joy and kindness most appealing.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its blindness, POKENAME shakes its tail vigorously to release thick clouds of spores. These spores obscure its presence, allowing it to ambush its prey with ease.
author: .izik

entry: The dense fur along its neck and tails is hardened and rough. POKENAME uses its tails in nature to tear through thick brush.
author: melodydelune

entry: Despite being blind in both eyes, POKENAME is nonetheless playful and mischievous. It lives in busy areas: due to its ability to be able to sense the emotions of others, it is mostly able to tell what locations are dangerous and which are safe.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This small Pokémon loves to play. It often plays too rough, however, so keep a watchful eye on it while it plays with others.
author: themicelegion

entry: Since it cannot see, it bites anything it doesn't recognize the sound of. This habit makes it a challenge to approach without alerting it.
author: .izik

entry: It roars in sync with thunder, as if trying to compete with the storm's fury. This behavior makes it feel connected to the wild power of the elements.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are blind, making it difficult for them to control their flames. They have been known to accidentally burn down entire homes when left unattended.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME can only be found in dark rainforests. It will try to headbutt anything that touches it, spreading its light-sensitive spores.
author: mistymagius

entry: It enjoys basking in moonlight, soaking in the gentle glow to calm its restless energy. These nightly rituals seem to enhance its mood and vitality.
author: .izik

entry: It carefully studies the movements of its opponents, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. This calculated strategy makes it a master of surprise attacks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME compensates for its lack of sight by releasing a paralyzing toxin from its antennae. Once its prey is immobilized, it easily tracks them down using scent and sound before delivering a finishing Bite.
author: .izik

entry: Even though they're blind, POKENAME are able to find their way around using their fantastic sense of smell. When they're close enough to something that smells like food they will start biting down with enough force to pierce steel.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Though unable to see, POKENAME emits a sweet Leppa Berry scent from the pods on its body: this attracts prey close enough for it to bite down with its powerful jaws.
author: .izik

entry: Completely blind, POKENAME relies upon echolocation to find its way around the world. Despite its lack of eyesight, POKENAME is good at evading attacks from other Pokémon thanks to its sensitive hearing.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME emits a deep, resonant cry to navigate its surroundings. The vibrations allow it to perceive obstacles despite having no eyesight.
author: .izik

entry: While flying, it leaves behind a faint scent of charcoal in the air. This smoky trail marks its path, lingering long after it has gone.
author: .izik

entry: The slime it leaves behind carries a scent similar to oil. This peculiar smell both repels and intrigues other Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lacks eyes, bones, sense of taste and has an abnormal pain tolerance, so it can fall from incredible heights without suffering any long-term damage. Its intelligence has almost no margin to develop during this stage.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its stomach can digest almost anything, and when it doesn't, POKENAME simply spits it out. The trace of hair it leaves behind feels to the touch like metal swarf, though it's not magnetic.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is blind and navigates by feeling its surroundings with its claws. It shows affection by softly rubbing its mane against people.
author: 1bridgeyboo

entry: POKENAME are highly territorial, screeching at intruders that get too close. Their screeches are amplified by the resonance of their scales, which allows them to use echolocation all around their bodies to compensate for their poor eyesight.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The fur that grows on POKENAME's body never stops growing. As a result, it is recommended that Trainers groom their own POKENAME daily.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It prefers living in areas coated with ash or soot, blending effortlessly into its surroundings. This environment provides both camouflage and comfort.
author: .izik

entry: Even while buried underground, it can sniff out food with remarkable accuracy. This keen sense of smell makes it a successful hunter despite its poor eyesight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a strong sense of smell, which helps it sniff out the pungent Cornn Berry. Its pigmentation deepens when eating a healthy amount of these berries, which also helps it prepare for further evolution.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It grows its hair out to blind itself purposely, due to an extreme light sensitivity. Even the faintest bit of illumination hitting its eyes will give it a headache.
author: sk372

entry: Due to being able to sense things electromagnetically, many POKENAME are relaxed in nature. Some POKENAME eat anything their magnets pull in.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME's weak bite can't hurt humans. POKENAME leave their mouths open to let small electrical charges out or because they're happy to see someone.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME's lack of vision means that it often walks or swims into walls and other obstacles. Once it catches a prey's scent, however, it is frighteningly swift and accurate in its pursuit.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon have been domesticated and trained as a form of transportation in sandy areas, pulling their Trainers' sleds safely across vast deserts.
author: cristata

entry: These Pokémon have been domesticated and trained as a form of transportation in sandy areas, pulling their Trainers' sleds safely across vast deserts.
author: cristata

entry: The fluffy amulet POKENAME has is used to keep it calm all the time, but, if taken away, it will get angry and do anything to get it back.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: Despite their ferocious nature, POKENAME's heads are very supportive parents and treat their offspring with the utmost care. Their offspring are temperamental and will maul anything they can reach.
author: mistymagius

entry: The crystal at the end of its tail lights up when it concentrates. Using an unknown power, it can change the weather at will.
author: .izik

entry: The two heads have contrasting personalities in response to danger. As such, it is very difficult to tell whether its flames rearing up is a sign of it becoming defensive and wanting to flee, or preparing to get aggressive and go on the attack.
author: sk372

entry: If anything sneaks up on POKENAME, its back-facing head will bite it. It uses its hands to lift the front-facing head's bangs if it wants to see.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME have trouble balancing in the air due to the length of their necks and the placement of their heads. In addition to attacking with the heads, they can use their sharp claws and tail to deliver a mild toxin.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can burrow deep into the ground, kept safe by their fur being tougher than iron. The two heads can eat most minerals found underground, though each head has distinct mineral preferences.
author: entomoxie

entry: While the two heads of POKENAME have been known to argue, they both become placid and agreeable once given a helping of fresh honey - provided that each have separate and equal amounts, that is.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are experts in flight, as one head observes surroundings while the other hunts prey below. However, their flight can get rough whenever the heads disagree mid-flight.
author: entomoxie

entry: The head on the end of its nose will take time to make sure the lower head eats. The mouths do not share a stomach and each have their own.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's two heads often try to slither in different directions. Very rarely does it actually get anywhere.
author: im_quinn

entry: Since it has double the heads, POKENAME produces two times more milk. The heads often compete who can produce more milk in a day.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It prefers to eat gemstones from deep within caves. It dislikes sunlight, as it causes the fur on its body to shed rapidly.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its blindness, POKENAME's hearing is exceptionally sharp. It traverses cave systems by jumping off walls, allowing it to move swiftly through the darkness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are not great fighters, as they usually miss their target because they can't see. It relies on its spikes to hurt enemies.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It can hover up to 300 feet off of the ground. Doing this consumes a lot of energy, which it replenishes by eating grass and other vegetation.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's thick skin is rough to the touch. It is sharp enough to shred through stone if rubbed the wrong way.
author: .izik

entry: The two heads on POKENAME's back control the whole body. If POKENAME is injured the heads will retreat into the bushes.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Its lotus has fully bloomed, and it has grown an extra head on its tail. It guards ponds, so alchemists considered it a symbol of water.
author: arch.stanton

entry: POKENAME has two massive noses but has been observed to only have one brain. It is unable to use any of the other senses as it has been built simply to smell.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: POKENAME channels dark energy through its arms, producing powerful blasts that shred through just about anything. It is an incredibly cruel Pokémon, mercilessly attacking innocent Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME struggles to control the immense spiritual energy it absorbs, even with two heads. Each communicates with different ghosts from an ancient civilization, but only one powerful spirit is perceptible to both heads, uniting their focus briefly.
author: entomoxie

entry: The addition of two more heads has further exacerbated the attitude problems it possessed. Rarely is POKENAME seen without one of its heads aggressively duking it out with another.
author: sk372

entry: The wishes granted by POKENAME come with disastrous consequences. Whenever one head grants a wish, the other twists it as the price of changing fate.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: The consistency of the metal on its body changes based on what it's consumed. Softer foods result in a softer metal.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have both heads out constantly because the shell is just barely big enough to fit a single head inside. Whenever one head tries to withdraw into the shell, the other head lashes out in anger and jealousy.
author: entomoxie

entry: In combat, POKENAME's two heads often get their tusks interlocked, causing them severe discomfort. POKENAME will usually have to break their own tusks to make sure they don't get stuck.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME enjoy dark caves, where they can rely on echolocation and not their limited eyesight. However, the heads often conflict and thus get confused by their own echolocation.
author: entomoxie

entry: The slime that drips off of its body is incredibly sticky. It is used to make an industrial-strength glue that takes years to lose potency.
author: .izik

entry: Though the heads seem indistinguishable, the intelligent dominant one controls the body, while the dumber one is only concerned with eating. They always fight with each other, except when they know they're being watched.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME can use both heads in battle to attack and disorient opponents, though the heads are sometimes uncoordinated and fight each other. While they cannot fly at great heights, they can glide before slamming opponents from above.
author: entomoxie

entry: Though nearly blind, POKENAME uses its superior hearing to sense the world around it. The scale on its tail is sharp as a blade and can cleave marble with ease, making it a formidable opponent.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's twin heads can only cooperate properly in combat. If not sated with constant sparring partners to keep it distracted, they will fight with each other viciously, often leaving scars along their necks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is almost entirely blind, but it can sense the world around it based on the tiny hairs around its neck vibrating from sounds. Should it get cornered, it will unleash a Dragon Breath from its second head.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are incredibly sensitive to light. While one head has mild protection with hair covering their eyes, the other head has no such protection and often gets overstimulated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are usually found in pairs, hanging from a tree. Its toxins can be lethal.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The patterns on its wings can startle away lurking foes from afar. It will ruthlessly compete for territory and resources.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME bobs its extra heads rhythmically, causing people to bob their heads in unison with them. While the main head has a nice and lovely voice, the extra heads have dark, sinister voices that often speak the Pokémon's true intentions.
author: soup1900

entry: A malicious and unpredictable Pokémon. Its fur coat seemingly has a mind of its own, igniting at the slightest disturbance or excitement.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME lurks in the shadows of forests, making various traps to trick and catch prey in its webs. It often uses its tail to make others think that it is smaller than it actually is.
author: thepandasharky

entry: Programmers dread the thought of seeing a POKENAME appear in their computer. It sics its two drones to corrupt and delete random data, while the main body watches the chaos with sinister glee.
author: sk372

entry: It gathers storm clouds, channeling the energy of three dark dragons. In awe of its grace, many Trainers write poems in tribute to it.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The orbs are believed to be the spirits of Trainers who owned POKENAME. It takes great pleasure in watching weaker Pokémon suffer.
author: geminib

entry: POKENAME attacks opponents for massive damage regardless of their typing by using its three heads simultaneously to strike all weak points. Its wings unleash shock waves that bring oblivion to everything nearby before it consumes all that remains.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME use their dark auras to attack and punish the people who they believe have justice in their hearts. Because of this, many movies and TV shows use these Pokémon as their villains.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME grows new heads constantly. It can only feed two at a time, however, so it discards spare heads. It's thought the spares are used like seeds.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: This Pokémon is considered more myth than real. When POKENAME fights, it releases bursts of flame and strikes with its smaller organisms before the middle head delivers a decisive crunch.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: POKENAME attacks everything it sees with its tail, destroying both foes and objects alike in one heavy blow. It will even attack its own Nidoqueen in these rampages if they try to calm it down.
author: soup1900

entry: The three heads of these Pokémon are often seen arguing with each other because, strangely, they each seem to be more active during different times of the day. All three heads are fully alert during battle, which is when they display a fierce power.
author: infinex21

entry: The heads on POKENAME's arms, like the central head's horn, have the power to crush diamonds in one blow. It devours everything in its path without worry of counterattack due to its strong hide absorbing most of the damage.
author: soup1900

entry: The heads on POKENAME's arms don't have brains, for their only function is eating and biting. Sometimes, POKENAME "talks" with them like a ventriloquist, making them represent its inner thoughts spoken out loud.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME sends out its explorer balloons to scout for victims to feed on. It is said that spotting one in the sky is a sign of great misfortune due to its ferocious and destructive nature.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The heads on the tips of POKENAME's ears have strong, powerful jaws that are strong enough to break rock. Due to POKENAME's ego, it normally carves stones into small thrones for itself.
author: jestersqueak

entry: After fusion, POKENAME's additional heads took on the attributes of other draconic Pokémon. This may suggest the five creatures all might have evolved from a common ancient ancestor.
author: sk372

entry: Pokémon fusion has caused POKENAME to grow more heads. Legends say if one head is cut off, 2 more grow in its place. It is an incredibly powerful Pokémon, launching multiple beams of Dragon Pulse from its five heads.
author: lupa

entry: POKENAME's wish power is tainted in darkness, causing mayhem to anyone it grants a wish to. Anything it sees will be annihilated by concentrated bundles of darkness.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's three heads bellow a tri-tonal roar that unleashes a wall of heat and sounds powerful enough to destroy nearby buildings.
author: malxire

entry: With two ravenous extra mouths to feed, wild POKENAME struggles finding enough food. It doesn't have a good relationship with the extra heads, which it often has to swat away. It cherishes a Trainer who keeps it well fed and in pleasant company.
author: epping_forest

entry: A savage contender for territory and food, POKENAME are relentless in their hunt for either, and will often go out of their way to attack anything they see in their pursuits.
author: frokachu

entry: The heads wrapped around POKENAME's neck are the first ones to attack enemies since they can sense danger before the central head can. It repeatedly blasts enemies with shurikens made of dark aura until they are destroyed to bits.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME swims at the bottom of the sea to eat falling scraps from other Pokémon. Its three heads have different personalities, which causes conflict when one head disagrees with another.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its two extra faces are trapped in the spoons. If POKENAME loses touch of the spoons, the faces will regrow from the hands, trying to kill the main head.
author: epping_forest

entry: Late at night, POKENAME performs eerie, synchronized rituals with its marottes, gaining glimpses of possible futures. Witnesses of the ceremony often experience visions of events yet to unfold.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME float across the ground, their tendrils reaching down to destroy and consume anything below them. For this reason, they were once believed to be storm clouds given spirits of malice.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: Its six back appendages can move as it wills them to, often being used to hold down foes before it blasts them with dark fire let loose by its three heads. It will only run in the direction that its central head is looking toward.
author: infinex21

entry: The mysterious orb on POKENAME's back swirls and shifts with purple mist. When close to evolution, the orb fills fully with this mist, leading POKENAME to find a spot as far away from danger as it can. It fills the chosen area with a poisonous fog.
author: chibitales

entry: Rumors say this Pokémon can be seen crawling in forested areas. They move faster than the average Bug-Type, but that's still not very fast.
author: themicelegion

entry: It holds onto the remains of its sibling to feel safe. The psychic powers that remain on the skull protect it.
author: el_gord0

entry: POKENAME can be found in remote places dancing by themselves. They release a mist that obscures vision and are known to teleport away if they realize they have been seen by a Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a mythical Pokémon that releases a strange mist wherever it swims. It is believed by many that looking into the mist causes optical illusions depicting past memories, but this has never been proven.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME were primarily used to infiltrate enemy computers via cyberspace due to their near-undetectability. They are now considered obsolete.
author: skinstealers

entry: POKENAME are constantly on the move, looking for food in various places. They are very friendly when in a group, but skittish if alone. Earning their trust, while difficult, is said to bring good luck.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is able to soar incredibly fast through the sky. However, it is so friendly towards humans, it is not uncommon for it to walk beside them.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: POKENAME have only ever been seen in remote parts of the Johto region. It is said that a shrine maiden's garb is based on its wings and tassels.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME dreams of soaring through the clear, blue sky. Its inconveniently placed wings make this dream difficult to achieve.
author: birchbot

entry: POKENAME understands human language on a much deeper level than many other Pokémon. They each have a favourite type of berry, and whenever they hear it they get excited and call out hopefully.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME understands human language on a much deeper level than many other Pokémon. They each have a favourite type of poffin, and whenever they hear it they get excited and call out hopefully.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses the fine down on its body to detect incoming attacks. It can also use the down to refract light and change its appearance.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME only descends to sharpen its teeth on buildings. Legend says that one attempted to fly up to and eat the moon.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME travels with small groups of its own kind to bring gifts to children it senses are sad. It can make itself invisible thanks to its feathers, which refract light, allowing it to carry out its actions without ever being seen.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have frighteningly strong bodies, which they can use to constrict any that threaten them. Despite this, they prefer to gently embrace those with positive emotions.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: It can sense sadness anywhere in the region. It breaks the sound barrier in order to reach anyone in need of a friend, just to make them smile.
author: melodymute

entry: Dragon energy courses through POKENAME's body, allowing it to deliver kicks with devastating ferocity. It harnesses this power further through training on tall mountains.
author: chibitales

entry: An ancient tribe of Dragon-type Trainers used POKENAME as mounts and flew around all of Hoenn. They will use Safeguard to protect their riders if they sense danger during their flights.
author: cobalt0135

entry: This Pokémon's presence brings a sense of peace and harmony. It is able to deeply connect with its Trainer, making it a popular Pokémon to bond with.
author: jackjirachi

entry: This intelligent Pokémon requires patience and a dedicated space for silent meditation, due to its hypersensitivity towards the emotions of others.
author: final_courtesy

entry: It refracts light to appear more or less frightening depending on who it's talking to. A larger and more intimidating POKENAME is one that is trying to defend itself. This tough facade can easily break, causing POKENAME to turn invisible and flee.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: Despite its wings being too small for flight, POKENAME joyfully soars across the sky using its psychic powers. It makes its nests near hidden lakes and lagoons.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME flies across the land in search of true love. It forms close bonds with its partners, no matter how many it has.
author: hophoppip

entry: Extremely long-lived, POKENAME is highly intelligent and empathetic, caring for a habitat and its inhabitants for eons. It excels at defensive tactics due to its psychic abilities, making it a strong protector in combat encounters.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a very old species of Pokémon, and no single individual is thought to be less than 100 years old. Facing extinction 50 years ago, it is now forbidden to catch wild POKENAME.
author: thescribe

entry: Riding with POKENAME is said to feel like floating on a cloud. It often nudges Trainers with its fluffy body, inviting them to join it on an adventure through the skies.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME's ice refracts light in such a way that sculptures made from it appear exactly as their real counterparts. POKENAME uses this to its advantage by creating fake ice versions of itself to fool hunters while it hides away safely in an ice wall.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur isn't just for show. It uses it to refract light and hide in plain sight.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME spend most of their days lazing around in the sun, enjoying taking long naps in the warmth of the sunlight. They will sometimes become filled with a manic energy, racing around at speeds in excess of Mach 2.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are playful Pokémon that enjoy playing chase with people and other Pokémon. They are extraordinarily fast, capable of catching most of their play partners within seconds.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The creature biting POKENAME's tail is highly aggressive, and bites down in order to influence the host into behaving similarly. Fortunately, POKENAME is too simple and gentle to even register the impulses the bites create.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spits a poisonous mist at anything it deems a threat, causing the mist within the orb on its back to churn and swirl with energy. This, alongside its seclusive nature, makes it difficult to study properly.
author: chibitales

entry: It wields the remains of its sibling as a weapon. It wanders around aimlessly, filled with rage and seeking revenge.
author: el_gord0

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others through its thick shell. If someone angry approaches, it reinforces its armor even further with Harden. To conserve energy, it tries to remain as still as possible throughout the day.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others through its thick shell. If someone angry approaches, it takes flight and distances itself immediately. To conserve energy, it attempts to stay as motionless as possible during the day.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME travels at extreme speeds to spread pollen. There are rumours of a red Pokémon that looks similar to POKENAME, but no confirmed sightings.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME's body cuts cleanly through the water at high speeds, even breaching the surface to glide long distances across the air. It is antisocial by nature, fleeing into undersea dens when it spies humans approaching.
author: sk372

entry: Its flight capabilities are limited, and it can only gently glide along the ground. It wishes to soar to the moon someday.
author: fountainihili

entry: When people see POKENAME fly around, they make a wish. They do this because POKENAME is so lazy that it only flies if there is a predator near.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Not much information has been documented about POKENAME due to the fact it is rarely, if ever, seen. Most people don't believe in its existence.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Thanks to its ability to sense feelings, this Pokémon is used as a support program to help people with emotional problems. POKENAME is equipped with a new generation script that makes it much more autonomous in performing its functions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Long believed to be a myth, it hides its identity by implanting false memories to everyone who views it. It is empowered by the Soul Dew on its cloak.
author: germs2128

entry: It only appears to those who share its compassion for others. It is said to meet a POKENAME is to be forever blessed with tranquility.
author: melodymute

entry: POKENAME has a playful and easygoing temperament. There have been recent clothing trends that are inspired by its appearance.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME telepathically reads the emotions of others to distinguish friend from foe. When confronting an enemy, it uses its horns to roar and snap at them, scaring them away so it can avoid conflict.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: If threatened, POKENAME will telepathically force disturbing images into the aggressor's consciousness. While they are distracted, POKENAME vanishes.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is normally gentle, but if its allies or wards are threatened, it will use its immense offensive abilities to fight off the danger. Its lifespan is incredibly long, and the same entity has been found protecting a location for eons.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME are very gallant Pokémon that fly around the world beyond breakneck speeds. They use their swift movements to rescue any who are in danger and deliver devastating blows to villains with Luster Purge.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME roam great distances at night, travelling for many miles beneath the moon and stars. They will plant themselves near rural communities in the morning, their leaves picking up on the presence of people, helping them find well-tended gardens.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME spend the daytime hunkered down in one place, staying hidden within flower patches and meadows. At nighttime they travel vast distances in search of more fertile grounds, using their empathic powers to seek out prolific gardeners.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME bloom at night, releasing their pollen when they can sense other POKENAME nearby with their empathic powers. They disperse at the first light of day, travelling many miles to find new meadows and new groves to make their home.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME dislikes fighting, so it expels energy from its mushrooms to jet through the air and escape from its enemies.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME looks fluffy, but it's covered with bristles to repel attackers. It's intelligent enough to discern humans' intentions.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME makes its home in underground lakes and rivers. The pearls that it forms are highly valued for their rarity and beauty.
author: octolinggrimm

entry: POKENAME makes its home in underground lakes and rivers. The pearls that it forms are highly valued for their rarity and beauty.
author: octolinggrimm

entry: POKENAME is admired for its grace and elegance, as well as its mastery of Fire-type moves. It allows only its Trainer to touch its nine tails, which it guards jealously. Anyone else who dares to try is met with a puff of poisonous powder.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Sometimes, when scientists extract silk from POKENAME, it lets out large flames from its tails. Many people have been hospitalized from this.
author: dodoowner_

entry: A POKENAME that recently exploded will have messy and dull fur, while one that has contained its energy for a long time will have smooth and shiny fur. Anyone who tries to stimulate it into exploding will be cursed with an endless drought.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME have creamy, vanilla-colored tails that wrap around their bodies. Predators typically leave POKENAME alone to avoid getting burned by powerful flames.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It's highly protective of the egg it carries. If you attempt to steal the egg, it may inflict you with a terrible curse.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are revered for their mystical powers, commanding both fire and minds with equal skill. It is said that the fires they produce burn without any heat and are used to lure the unwary toward them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a grand, opulent presence because of their tedious grooming practices. They spend hours fretting over every detail of their appearance, down to the very hair.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As an aquatic Pokémon that easily understands complex human speech, trained POKENAME can communicate human intent with wild Pokémon, especially more aggressive fusions. For example, POKENAME can help stop cargo ships from being attacked by Sharpedo.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although POKENAME can turn into a puddle, the temperature of the bubbling water can turn to 212°F. Do not attempt to use this water to make food.
author: hatsune_miko

entry: When POKENAME is close to overheating, it releases excess heat from its tails and collar. When taken care of properly, POKENAME's golden fur is incredibly soft.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME shields its cocoon with its many tails for added protection. Anything that disturbs it will not be forgiven, and POKENAME will seek vengeance the moment it fully evolves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's wings are mostly used for gliding. With its many sweeping tails, this Pokémon easily disorients foes.
author: carameldog

entry: POKENAME are often surrounded by baby Pokémon who enjoy sleeping within their luxuriously fluffy tails. When they are not sleeping, they are search for berries to roast and consume.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Regalia made with POKENAME fur were wildly popular among royalty in medieval times due to its golden hue. It's thought touching the orbs on POKENAME's tails will inflict the offender with a curse spanning generations.
author: chibitales

entry: The fire spouting from POKENAME's neck burns so hot during battle, the area is covered in a heat shimmer. Touching one of its many tails without permission can lead to intense burns that remain painful for years.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME avoids cities with high levels of pollution and noise and will migrate to places where there is high foot traffic. This is because it enjoys interacting with people, in addition to avoiding illness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dislike the feel of asphalt on its paws and prefers soft textures that are easy to press into. Urban parks satisfy both its paws feeling comfy, and its desire to spend time with people.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME builds its nest atop the tallest trees in the forest to keep other creatures from touching the tails it guards at all costs. When angered, it can breathe flames so intense that they scorch everything growing nearby.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its nine tails wrap around itself until there is enough light to conduct photosynthesis. It hides a Heat Rock in one of its tails to ensure the sun gives it plenty of energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME always keeps its tails spinning, allowing it to fly like a helicopter. It dreams of riding a tornado's winds to reach ever-higher speeds.
author: lim2067

entry: The fur on POKENAME's cheeks never stops growing and acts as a conduit for mystical energy. The longer the fur, the more power it can channel. In ancient times, grooming a POKENAME was seen as a sacred act to ensure strong blessings.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The fur on POKENAME's cheeks never stops growing and acts as a conduit for mystical energy. The longer the fur, the more power it can channel. In ancient times, grooming a POKENAME was seen as a sacred act to ensure strong blessings.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's large tails drag behind it as it walks, causing it to be easy to follow via the dragging marks. Its scarlet flower deepens in color as it absorbs sunlight and prepares for evolution.
author: chibitales

entry: It will spend hours grooming its tails. It hates when its fur is wet and will grow enraged if it is caught in a rainstorm.
author: .izik

entry: Each of its flowing tails bears an intricate script that glows faintly, thought to hold the secrets of time and destiny. Encounters with this Pokémon often leave Trainers with vivid, otherworldly visions.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME patiently waits for its parents whenever they hunt for food, as it is too frail to handle being stung. It practices shooting fire from its many tails, which leaves burn marks on tree stumps throughout the forest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is incredibly territorial, and leaves burn marks on trees to mark its territory. Its many tails aid with climbing trees to gather honey from hives, which have few defenses against its fire.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The many wings of POKENAME strike fear and confusion in the eyes of its beholders. POKENAME, however, is known to protect those that surround it.
author: louiseo

entry: POKENAME are always seen carrying baggage filled with old mail. Some believe the type of mail they carry can predict the future; Mech Mail signals strong relationships, Orange Mail good health, and Retro Mail implies an approaching death.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's tails unfurl and the flame within its antlers glows brighter when channeling psychic power. It creates realistic illusions of forest fires to scare off potential predators.
author: chibitales

entry: Each tail carries a spirit of thunder, or so mythologists claim. Its body is always crackling with electricity, but if POKENAME is upset, the purple coat of fur turns grey like a storm cloud and the sparks become even more powerful.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Each tail carries a spirit of thunder, or so mythologists claim. Its body is always crackling with electricity, but if POKENAME is upset, the red tufts of fur turn grey like a storm cloud and the sparks become even more powerful.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When threatened, POKENAME will wrap itself in its tail which will burn its foes if touched. Staring into its eyes is said to bring a terrible curse.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME stores electricity in its tails, the tips of which darken as the charge increases. When threatened, it spreads its tails to make itself appear larger.
author: chibitales

entry: Legends says that POKENAME has 9 lucky feathers hidden close to its heart that bless Trainers with a long life. It is believed that to be granted those feathers, the Trainer needs to be the POKENAME's best friend.
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande

entry: POKENAME sneak up on their prey before unleashing a powerful electric attack to paralyze them. They are kept as elegant house pets by the wealthy.
author: adam941

entry: Each of POKENAME's tails holds a powerful magnet that repels the ones on their front. On rare occasions they force them together, igniting a brilliant flame. Witnessing this radiant display is said to shield viewers from misfortune.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Grabbing one of POKENAME's lightning bolt shaped tails will result in you getting blasted by 100,000 volts of electricity and becoming incapacitated. Once you awake, you will find that you have been cursed to become a human lightning rod.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Guided by justice, POKENAME protects people and Pokémon. They can quickly learn any martial art just by seeing it.
author: mrbapcik

entry: Though it has powerful pyrotechnic potential, POKENAME has a gentle disposition and rarely wishes to use the full extent of its fire power. It prefers using it for simple entertaining displays akin to fireworks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its mask to channel intense heat, which can reach temperatures up to 3,500 degrees. Caution should be exercised when petting its tails.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME uses its mask to channel intense heat, which can reach temperatures up to 3,500 degrees. Caution should be exercised when petting its tails.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Nicknamed the Forest Ferry, POKENAME appears to humans who have gotten lost. If they are willing to pay its berry toll, it will guide them through the woods, ensuring they can see it by lighting flames like lanterns.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are often found in the Ecruteak Dance Theater dancing alongside the Kimono Girls. They control fire with ease and use it to create fantastic displays, capturing the hearts of viewers.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are highly mischievous Pokémon. They enjoy messing with humans by creating elaborate illusions with their fan.
author: jackjirachi

entry: It is said that each of POKENAME's tails represent an emotion. If you see a POKENAME missing even one of those tails, run.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME's large tails drag behind it as it walks, causing it to be easy to follow via the dragging marks. Its scarlet flower deepens in color as it absorbs sunlight and prepares for evolution.
author: chibitales

entry: The energy writhing atop the backs of POKENAME is mystical curse energy, said to bring misfortune to those who cross them. They use their tails to veil the energy when around people they enjoy the company of, not wishing to curse them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's large flower blooms only once during its lifetime, which is thought to span nearly one thousand years. Once the flower blooms, POKENAME will no longer rely on food to survive, instead absorbing sunlight for energy.
author: chibitales

entry: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME's nine ponytails can each act independently.  When threatened, two will shield its small body, while the rest will wrap around its foes before incinerating them.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME exudes radiant, elegant beauty, and considers itself above many other creatures of the world. Touching one of its tails without consent is considered a heinous crime, said to curse the perpetrator's lineage with 1000 years of bad luck.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will ignite the tips of its many tails as an intimidation technique. Despite having good strength, it tends to falter if intimidation fails, and runs away more often than it stays and fights.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME abandons its blades to make room for its whip-like tails and greater control of fire.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's aggressive nature and tendency to launch fireballs from its tails are only part of the problem in dealing with it. The flames leave behind an acrid, poisonous smoke that is very harmful if even a tiny bit is inhaled.
author: sk372

entry: If nine glowing stars appear on the ground, it is POKENAME guiding you to safety. Long ago, people prayed to it for protection, believing it could ward off disasters brought by Absol.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME can usually be seen near active hot springs, concealing itself amongst the steam. As it spews flames, its colorful scales become even more vibrant.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its calm and intelligent nature has made POKENAME popular amongst families. Its long lifespan has led to stories that it can live for a millennium.
author: melodydelune

entry: Soft flowers muffle POKENAME's movements as they diligently stalk their prey. Particularly clever Pokémon soon learn to avoid their alluring scent.
author: cristata

entry: Soft flowers muffle POKENAME's movements as they diligently stalk their prey. Particularly clever Pokémon soon learn to avoid their alluring scent.
author: cristata

entry: When an enraged POKENAME's tails heat up, they billow as though they're in the wind. If continually pestered it will curse the Trainer or Pokémon with a sudden burning kick.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The internal organs of a POKENAME are made entirely of flames, believed by some to be their very soul. Some cultures believe being burnt by POKENAME's flames ensures you will be reborn as one in the next life.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: It is said that the fur of POKENAME creates a warm sensation, like being wrapped in a blanket. In fact, some have created marvelous rugs made of POKENAME fur.
author: jojojax164

entry: POKENAME's feisty facade covers a much kinder, calmer personality. It only uses its abilities when ambushed.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME have a shockingly high internal body temperature, and the fur on their bodies insulates very well. POKENAME pass out from overheating on a regular basis.
author: bradlybro199

entry: Brutish in behavior, POKENAME is very prideful of both its tails and its tusks. Touching either will send it into a rage full of flames being flung from its tails and violent swings of its sharp and solid tusks.
author: sk372

entry: It is rumored POKENAME is formed from the victim souls lost to forest fires. They create beautiful witch flames of various colors to lure the unwary into losing their way in the woods.
author: ghostslythe

entry: This POKENAME variant is far more domesticated than its wild sibling. It often makes appearances at special festivals and is welcomed with open arms.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME burns trash to fuel its eternal flame. The graffiti on its dumpster body changes at will.
author: ohok3441

entry: When enraged, POKENAME's rampage can't be stopped. Its tail is nine times stronger than a Goodra's and leaves superheated lava residue upon impact.
author: uncookie

entry: If one yanks on one of POKENAME's tail-like petals, it responds by violently spraying a supremely noxious pollen, cursing the victim to a stench that will never be completely washed away.
author: sk372

entry: In the darkness of mountain trails, POKENAME stands a statuesque vigil against ghostly mischief. If a Ghost-type enters the area, it wraps them in an iron-hardened tail and finishes with a point-blank Flamethrower.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME focuses its powerful flame attacks through branches. When one burns down, it uses its sensitive tails to pick up a set of others. What follows is a test of each until the perfect focus is found.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME flies towards streetlights at night. Whenever the light turns off at dawn, it will attempt to reignite the streetlight with its own flames.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME goes too long without digging, its fur grows dangerously hot. It has even been observed digging while asleep to cool down.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raises its young near the entrance of caves, where its three heads dutifully watch for any threats that may draw near. Many ancient legends claimed they were guardians to the underworld.
author: mepp.

entry: This nocturnal Pokémon slowly amasses vast hoards of shiny objects and coins over its 1,000-year-long lifespan. The mystic power stored in its nine tails is unleashed upon anyone who dares to steal from its treasures.
author: chaoticanzu

entry: Anyone who dares to touch and mess with POKENAME's neatly groomed fur and tail will be cursed for life. This vicious Pokémon uses the gem on its forehead to hypnotize its prey into standing still or even willingly approaching the hungry POKENAME.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME are cruel-natured, with a tendency to toy with their opponents before incinerating them. Old legends say they bear the hatred of 99 vengeful spirits.
author: kingd8

entry: POKENAME searches for fights with opponents stronger than itself. It will not stop searching even if it takes decades to find the perfect foe to test its skills. When it attains victory, it begins the search once more.
author: chibitales

entry: Despite their strong psychic senses, POKENAME is better known for providing special effects in movies. Directors hire them to add practical pyrotechnics into scenes without harming actors.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's fur is hypersensitive to movement. If even a small insect tries to crawl into its fur, it will promptly bathe itself in water or flame to be rid of it forever, making it very safe from external parasites.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME parents spend all day hunting for food in cold oceans. When the sun sets, the shores of these oceans flood with returning parents, both to feed their children and sleep. They sleep in large groups to keep warm through frigid nights.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME swirls its many tails to conjure fireballs to shoot at its foes. It is a prideful Pokémon, and sneers with its big grin when it is about to win.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is corrupted by a space virus that replaced its limbs. Scientists found that other space POKENAME seem afraid of it, leading to speculation about its natural existence on another planet.
author: notmax22

entry: It stalks its prey with silent precision before pouncing with lightning speed. POKENAME uses its razor-sharp teeth to subdue and consume its prey.
author: louiebrine

entry: POKENAME makes a game out of sneaking into the Mossdeep Space Center and pretending to be an innocent crew member among them.
author: tokenoracle

entry: Its extremely unstable genetics cause it to constantly alter its cellular structure to mimic the looks of its evolutions. While its appearance may look like its evolutions, POKENAME bears no powers from them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hides in undersea locations with minimal lighting, masquerading as a simple Omanyte. By the time anything drawing near realizes its mistake, it's too late; POKENAME's many tentacles will grab and drain the life from its latest victim.
author: sk372

entry: Likely due to Deoxys's extraterrestrial origin, the toxins brewing in POKENAME's cocoon are those that this world is unfamiliar with. At the very least, these toxins currently seem to be able to be neutralized with modern medicine.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Likely due to Deoxys's extraterrestrial origin, the toxins brewing in POKENAME's cocoon are those that this world is unfamiliar with. At the very least, these toxins currently seem to be able to be neutralized with modern medicine.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its dual stingers are used for injecting an alien virus into its prey. Those it stings may develop POKENAME-like traits.
author: kiwiarms

entry: According to an old document found in a destroyed lab, POKENAME has the ability to switch, merge, and override others' consciousnesses. What exactly this entails is unclear, but POKENAME has a wide variety of otherworldly psychic powers regardless.
author: bobosmith01

entry: According to an old document found in a destroyed lab, POKENAME has the ability to switch, merge, and override others' consciousnesses. What exactly this entails is unclear, but POKENAME has a wide variety of otherworldly psychic powers regardless.
author: bobosmith01

entry: According to an old document found in a destroyed lab, POKENAME has the ability to switch, merge, and override others' consciousnesses. What exactly this entails is unclear, but POKENAME has a wide variety of otherworldly psychic powers regardless.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Scientists hypothesize that the unique DNA of both Mew and Deoxys might lead to breakthroughs on the origin of extraterrestrial life. By studying POKENAME thoroughly, they hope to make great strides towards first contact with another world.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME burn with an unearthly flame that can produce strange effects in Pokémon. They can replicate the effects of elemental stones and force evolution in some Pokémon, and serve as a replacement for DNA splicers in others, creating wild fusions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME telekinetically swings its tail, slamming it into opponents like a crushing meteor. Its central core can generate a psychic barrier, which it uses to protect weak Pokémon.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME falls from space and buries itself deep beneath the ground. If it takes root, the landscape will soon become overrun with bizarre alien flora.
author: ozydamians

entry: Rumored to be from a distant world, POKENAME displays startling intelligence. It uses its long whip-like tail to manipulate objects, and individuals have even been observed building advanced machinery for unknown purposes.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME can alter the appearance of its two tails into many tools that help its needs. The crystalline orb on its forehead is actually its brain, from which it emits powerful psychic lasers until it becomes fatigued.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's purple crystals are extremely radioactive, causing its body to constantly mutate. Most sightings of POKENAME are after large meteorite impacts.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME crush their prey within their left pincers and lash foes with their right tendrils. It is said that their cores come from meteorites and must be replaced if they are ever damaged.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses the head-shaped tip of its horn to attract prey. Once within striking distance, it reveals itself and attacks.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME propel themselves through water by spinning their two tails rapidly. They can expel water and condensed psychic energy from their mouths to ward off predators or to strike down bird Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite being endowed with incredible psychic power that does not necessitate movement to use, POKENAME generally chops and kicks while using these powerful long-ranged psychic attacks, perhaps due to its Tyrogue DNA.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They communicate using the aurorae on their back to send complex light-based messages. Scientists have yet to decode this highly sophisticated language.
author: kiwiarms

entry: The face on its chest is just a decoy, as the POKENAME's brain is its purple orb. It's still a very easy target, rendering the decoy moot.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Its bloated body can repel most physical strikes as if it were elastic. Its dual tongues are coated in a sticky substance that allows it to gather multiple foods at once with them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME conceal their heads beneath the mass of tangled tendrils that make up most of their body weight. This helps them intimidate opponents they would otherwise be unable to beat, even with their powerful tusks.
author: infinex21

entry: A strange and powerful psychic being that supposedly originated from the deepest reaches of space. POKENAME is able to create black holes, meteors, and other celestial phenomena seemingly at whim with little effort.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon carefully observe their surrounding with their singular eye as they drag themselves along the seafloor. They can easily entangle prey and other enemies within their myriad tendrils.
author: infinex21

entry: Its body is composed entirely of layered sheets of an extremely durable extraterrestrial polymer.
author: staghorn

entry: Scientists claim Pokémon is mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. They wait around patiently for ripened fruits to fall out of the trees.
author: semnotsam

entry: Its amorphous body can expand and split in the form of a massive set of jaws. It will use its psychic abilities to pull prey within this massive maw and swallow them whole.
author: infinex21

entry: Ancient chronicles refer to a blade similar to POKENAME that could grant its holder visions of the future. However, these tales seem to be false.
author: frostedwyrm

entry: POKENAME is a virus that rapidly evolved to attack organisms more directly. It adjusts its shape into many weapons and is quite agile.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME can fuse its bottom tendrils into any weapon. The core it uses as a shield changes color based on the weapon it is using.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Akin to a parasite, the Deoxys core fuels the main body. POKENAME can compute billions of battle strategies within a fraction of a second.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Akin to a parasite, the Deoxys core fuels the main body. POKENAME can compute billions of battle strategies within a fraction of a second.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It is said that POKENAME has achieved absolute oneness and plans to wage universal war. However, only a self-proclaimed abductee supports this idea.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It is said that POKENAME has achieved absolute oneness and plans to wage universal war. However, only a self-proclaimed abductee supports this idea.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME use their x-ray vision to track prey and their psychic powers to capture them. They create condensed balls of plasma within their four tails and fling them at foes.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's rings resemble the theorized structure of atomic particles. When it opens its central core, it releases powerful psychic energy in a sudden, destructive burst.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is capable of completely altering its genetic code, allowing it to steal the appearance of almost anything down to the molecule.
author: nellnast42

entry: An alien virus transformed this Pokémon into a colourful, tentacle-clad form. It is immensely aggressive and will attack almost anything that moves. POKENAME manipulates earth like a limb of its own body to crush opponents.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME have been difficult for humans to observe due to them living in the deeper reaches of space. At least three observations showed that they seem to live within hollow asteroids floating in space.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAMEs combine their psychic powers with their sinister powers to create expansive Dark Voids that cast foes into nightmares. Their amorphous bodies allow them to mimic nightmares and strike fear into the hearts of their enemies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon created through a combination of biological and technological engineering. Release trial programs have determined that they are far too aggressive and dangerous to allow into the wild.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A draconic creature thought to have come from deep space. It's said that those touched by POKENAME's flame will be burned all the way to their very DNA.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon originate from a virus that was somehow exposed to the energy from the electric crystals of the Chargestone Cave in Unova region. Groups of POKENAME spin big, complicated webs that paralyze the trapped prey and affect their brains.
author: milchik

entry: Legends say POKENAME was forged from a lost soul bound to a fallen star, its core pulsing like an ancient heart. It wanders forgotten lands in silence, judging intruders with cold, unfathomable will.
author: ilyhef_82709

entry: POKENAME wield their psychic powers in tandem with their powerful flames to create sun-like orbs upon their backs. Although these orbs look like miniature suns, they mostly just help POKENAME better direct their powers.
author: infinex21

entry: The near-innumerable tails of this Pokémon can transform in order to defend or to attack. Its chest core glows faintly with the flames flowing inside its body.
author: infinex21

entry: Self-fusion has caused POKENAME to exhibit aspects of all of its major forms. This gives it unparalleled offense, defense and speed to use in combat, making it infinitely more formidable an opponent.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can split itself into four copies to maximize its capabilities. With three forms adhering to offense, defense, and speed commanded by the fourth's great intellect, they are truly a force to be reckoned with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME create their nests in craters where meteorites have struck. By using the convex shape of the craters, they can amplify their psychic energy into large laser rays.
author: soup1900

entry: A bizarre mutation has created this highly resistant strain of DNA. Its genetic sequence is considered sloppy, however.
author: .towerxvi

entry: This Pokémon always holds an ancient relic. This relic is important for its survival, and if it ever loses it, it will die.
author: lyrebird.rainwing

entry: A Pokémon that crawled out of the expanse of space. POKENAME evolves rapidly to adapt to the harshest of environments.
author: teravolt

entry: As it soars silently through the night sky, it uses the sound disks on its head to emit high-frequency sound waves, subliminally manipulating the oblivious people and Pokémon below.
author: vlooranthemasked

entry: A powerful celestial Pokémon that channels the cold energy of outer space. It can warp using portals which leave a trace of chilling air for hours afterwards.
author: frokachu

entry: It is an extraterrestrial Pokémon with the power to absorb and output light within thousands of miles. It's thought that if it were to ever use its full strength, then from the moon, our planet would be nigh invisible against the darkness of space.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It is an extraterrestrial Pokémon with the power to absorb and output light within thousands of miles. It's thought that if it were to ever use its full strength, then from the moon, our planet would be nigh invisible against the darkness of space.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Some say this Pokémon appeared in a mysterious crater one day. Investigations are ongoing to determine its true origin.
author: busilisk

entry: The purple crystal it grips contains its consciousness, which psychically puppets the body. Should POKENAME drop the crystal, its now mindless body will fall lifeless until the crystal is in range again.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME are rather aggressive and will beat opponents into submission with their strong, flexible arms. They quickly tire themselves out, though, and their gem-like bodies glow brighter as a sign of them overheating.
author: infinex21

entry: It has an unending appetite that drives it to consume lifeforms unfortunate enough to cross its path. Its virus has evolved into a parasitic organism.
author: louiebrine

entry: Its DNA was polluted during the fusion process, leaving it unable to maintain a consistent shape. It constantly tries to consume new DNA in a vain attempt to become stable again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sneaks into buildings to mimic the helpful actions of humans. When approached, it abandons its fraud and attacks its prey with frightening images. After encountering a POKENAME, people experience extreme paranoia.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Their body is said to be coated with the hardest rock in the universe. It is theorized that they are a cosmic parasite that travels through the void to feed on planets and stars.
author: agtl05

entry: POKENAME is an otherworldly virus infecting and controlling a common Krabby. It sits on shorelines, unflinchingly watching passersby. It has a disproportionate fear of serpentine Pokémon compared to other predators.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME sleeps a full 23 hours each day. It dreams of the day when its seed will blossom into a flower.
author: abhatu

entry: These Pokémon munch on the shards of fallen meteors, using the resulting paste to harden their exoskeleton. If you see a group of POKENAME gathering in a spot, a meteor is sure to fall nearby.
author: chibitales

entry: When POKENAME explodes, it leaves behind a strange material akin to stardust. The particles still retain some faint electricity, so direct contact leaves one feeling tingly for a while after.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can manipulate its electricity to form a spherical shield of lightning around its body to deflect strikes. Stars appear to twinkle within the sphere while it's active.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appear before orphanages to give children treats and gifts. Those who receive a gift from POKENAME are likely to find a good home.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many believe touching a POKENAME's drill horn will bring good luck. Those who touch it without permission quickly learn that it can bring great harm as well.
author: danarchosyndacalist

entry: It's said that if a mother sees a POKENAME, their child will have a long and happy life. Many believe this is a myth, and that POKENAME aren't real.
author: staghorn

entry: Hunted by poachers, they wished to be taken somewhere where no one could harm them and disappeared in a flash of light.
author: tomatosalad

entry: Many devious sorts sought to poach POKENAME, believing its core held wish-granting powers. As a result, it rarely is seen in the wild, and blinds those who find it with spectral flashes so it may flee.
author: sk372

entry: Some believe that since prehistoric times, POKENAME have awoken once in a millennium to dance with their ribbons and blades. Those who watch their elegant performance are said to have their wishes come true.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME are ancient Pokémon that were thought to be extinct by palaeontologists, theorised to have been fierce predators. Once resurrected from fossils, they were discovered to be generous, doing their best to fulfil the desires of their friends.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Old texts found in the Sevii Islands write about a legend where a sailor began to drown at sea after a shipwreck. His wish to live was heard by a higher power and he was reborn as POKENAME. No known wild POKENAME exist.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Legends say it came to this world long ago to defend the weak who wished for safety. After freeing them from tyranny, POKENAME returned to the stars.
author: abhatu

entry: Although a fearsome sight, many people are willing to be burnt by POKENAME's flames to have their wishes come true, thus putting their lives at stake.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME mourns for the loss of those throughout the cosmos. It is said to exude a visage of the endless expanse of space.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME can fly at much higher altitudes than regular Crobat and sometimes finds its way into the lower boundaries of space. It is said that looking into the eye on its stomach will grant any wish, but this claim is still unfounded.
author: shreks_stepfather

entry: POKENAME spends nearly the entire day resting to gather the energy to evolve. If someone were to catch a glimpse of it suddenly falling out of the sky, legends state that their deepest wish will come true.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spends its time collecting wishes to help its bud bloom. While it cannot grant them, it hopes that all wishes will comes true.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME is incredibly selfish, refusing to grant any of its infinite wishes to anyone but itself. These wishes are often used on frivolous things, like more cheese or a cardboard box.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: It's believed to visit this world only once every few thousand years. Numerous records from varying cultures depict POKENAME as a deity of the stars.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME instinctively fires Doom Desire against those who wish for evil and harm upon others. It stores written wishes inside of its shell to prevent them from getting lost or altered.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME bores through space itself, creating wormholes. By studying it, scientists hope to revolutionize teleportation technology.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: According to legend, POKENAME has the power to grant the wishes of those who find it cute despite its slightly intimidating appearance. The smell of food is able to wake it from even the deepest sleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: According to legend, POKENAME has the power to grant the wishes of those who find it cute despite its slightly intimidating appearance. The smell of food is able to wake it from even the deepest sleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The ball that it carries is said to be able to grant three wishes. It comes to this world every year, but it goes into hiding, so many can't find it.
author: drip_capybara

entry: Once every blue moon, POKENAME opens its third eye and looks into the orb it carries to peer into the future. It protects the orb above all else.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME has the power to grant wishes for those it deems worthy. The eye concealed under its wings sees someone for who they truly are.
author: abhatu

entry: Legends say that POKENAME can be found flying across the sky like a comet. It's said if you find one after making a wish, your wish will come true.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Many believe that POKENAME clings onto moons and asteroids, launching special wish-granting comets into the planet's orbit.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME are capable of granting wishes to people who find them but getting them to stay still long enough to grant wishes is difficult. They are easily distracted and will chase anything that moves, even if it means interrupting a wish.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Every POKENAME has a subtly different eye design on its hood. Supposedly, one has been found with two eyes, but this hasn't been proven.
author: kiwiarms

entry: It is said that as POKENAME roars into the starry night, the stars twinkle back as if they were responding back to it. It will only grant one single wish for each time a new star is born.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's rare appearances come heralded by sandstorms made of stardust, generated from its core. Due to greedy people seeking it out for the valuable material, it actively avoids human contact.
author: sk372

entry: People worldwide have performed sacred rituals to POKENAME in hopes it would grant their wish of reviving a deceased loved one. Legends say that when a meteor shower of rainbow colors streaks the sky, POKENAME will finally answer these prayers.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is said to sleep for a thousand years before it awakens for a week. It got too comfortable and hasn't woken up in four thousand years.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME's granted wishes often carry a cruel twist that causes the wish to be more like a curse instead. However, in a rare 1 in 1,000 chance, the added twist instead makes the wish more beneficial than what other Jirachi could've granted.
author: soup1900

entry: According to legend, when the eye on its belly opens, POKENAME may grant the wishes of people who have lived good and honest lives. Its tail emits constant electric sparks to prevent anyone from waking it from its slumber.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is said to grant wishes only once every thousand years. Many wishes pile up around it in the meantime.
author: abhatu

entry: Legend has it that POKENAME appears to those with pure and joyful hearts. If its third eye opens, a wish will be granted.
author: togetik

entry: When POKENAME sleeps, it curls up into a ball that nothing can penetrate. It always ensures that a few grains of sand are caught in its body while it sleeps, and these grains scrub away any dirt to keep them clean.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses its wings to churn powerful Doom Desire against those who wish for evil. It then zooms to the stars at high speeds while the bundles of light decimate the unsuspecting foe a week later.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME loves celebrating the new year and will propagate itself via email to spread this jubilee across cyberspace. Aside from firework pop-ups and the erroneous insistence that it's 1999, it does no further damage to affected devices.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: When POKENAME sleeps, it curls up into a ball that nothing can penetrate. POKENAME generates sandy grains from its eyes as it sleeps that float in the air after it wakes. Anyone that catches one of these grains is said to have their wishes granted.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME has closed its two main eyes in order to master the use of its third. Through this third eye it sees attacks before they come.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME teleports away as soon as it detects someone nearby, so its existence was only recently confirmed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Some people refer to POKENAME as the "Lunar Princess." Those in its presence can't help but admire its sparkly flowing dress.
author: kittyluv090

entry: A master swordsman from beyond the stars. It fights for those who desire something beyond themselves.
author: abhatu

entry: Aspiring warriors search for a slumbering POKENAME in pursuit of a wish. POKENAME only awakens when it senses a worthy opponent, and only grants the wishes of those who best it in combat.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: POKENAME is known to be very active, constantly collecting wood. It aims to grant its own wish for a massive dam to block up the ocean.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME is a collection of many desires left unfulfilled. The rock POKENAME is bound to is of unearthly origin.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME strives to help make the most noble of wishes come true. The aroma from the flower on its back inspires confidence and hope.
author: abhatu

entry: It is rumored that those who peer inside of POKENAME's massive jaws will see a realm where all dreams come true. But the truth is that within its jaws is a star-clad space where all that awaits is a lifeless vacuum.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are found on top of mountains, where they only open up during nighttime. They must bask in several full moons before they can evolve.
author: thegreatdraco

entry: POKENAME usually covers its face with its petals. At midnight, the eye on its stomach opens.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: Its face is made of amethyst that can withstand great force. POKENAME are calm and like to make the dreams of their Trainers come true.
author: lemmymaster

entry: A large, peaceful giant that is rarely seen in the wild. It's said that POKENAME will grant one wish to a Trainer that defeats it in a fair fight.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME appears to those with doom in their future. It is said to grant one parting wish before their grim fate arrives.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME flows with the cosmic currents in search of the light of a new star to bathe in. A feeling of awe washes over those who witness its journey.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME shows its true form to those with a greater understanding of existence. It was once dubbed The Watcher.
author: abhatu

entry: POKENAME has poor vision, and uses the ribbons on its ears and tail in order to analyze its surroundings. Its strong hearing lets it hear people's wishes, but it only appears before children with kind and innocent wishes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is borne from the infusion of thousands of wishes into an ancient sword. Legend says that the one who wields it has their own wishes granted.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is said to appear once in a millennium. When it last appeared, it was used by a hero to defeat a fiery beast. Though the hero's identity is unknown, some scholars believe the beast to be Ho-pardos.
author: octolinggrimm

entry: POKENAME will awaken from its sleep if lifted by a person with a pure heart. For a sliver of life force, it grants wishes.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is said to appear once in a millennium. When it last appeared, it was used by a hero to defeat a fiery beast. Though the hero's identity is unknown, some scholars believe the beast to be Ho-pardos.
author: octolinggrimm

entry: Legends say POKENAME's blade is so sharp that it can cleave the night sky in two. Only those it deems worthy are able to wield it.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME regularly appear in areas of conflict and offer protection to those in need. It's said that POKENAME can sense cries for help from anywhere in the world.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME can be found guiding people to safety in the wake of disasters. Some say that the light emitted by POKENAME's eye will ward away all evil.
author: turron_turron

entry: POKENAME is known for its fierce power. It is said that if you best it in battle, it will grant you one wish.
author: icytos

entry: POKENAME use their wish powers to create wings made of the stars to fly with. Unwilling to grant wishes for anything else, they destroy others who try to wish upon them in concentrated showers of light.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME have the power to conjure illusions of one's greatest desires, causing greedy people to seek them out for themselves. Poachers have capitalized on this demand and their numbers have significantly dwindled as a result.
author: mepp.

entry: It radiates a peaceful aura, calming the hearts of those nearby. It is said to bring good fortune to the pure of heart and bad luck upon the wicked.
author: wigglypon
