entry: POKENAME has small, hooked claws on its fingers and toes, allowing it to easily scale rocky surfaces. It is able to detect magnetic fields with its tail, which it uses to navigate the deep cave systems it lives in.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are most often found on specific islands; it's believed that long ago, POKENAME, or some Aron and Mudkip, traveled together before massive eroding floods cut them off from the mainland. They are unable to naturally swim after hatching.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is very durable, despite its tiny, delicate appearance. They either sing alone or with other Pokémon with a high-pitched voice.
author: neonriser

entry: The metal coating POKENAME's body is covered in a thin layer of clear poison. Contact with this toxin can cause violent seizures if not washed off quickly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tastes cave walls with its long tongue to analyze their composition. It can mimic the texture and color of any stone it licks, blending in seamlessly.
author: .izik

entry: Its metallic body makes it more resistant, but at the same time, it makes it much slower. This forces it to hunt other Pokémon as slow as itself. In addition, its body acts as a shell that contains its energy for its next evolution.
author: zamcross_official

entry: POKENAME release pollen through the holes in their body to put foes to sleep. Their metallic bodies make them impervious to the effects of poison, so they can freely produce as much pollen as they want.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME store pollen in their bulbs, which is released in small bursts through the holes in their body. They release metallic vines from their body to defend themselves against dangerous Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME were once part of the army as a specialized unit that released noxious pollen into the air through the holes in their body. The large cloud of pollen would force soldiers into a sleepy stupor.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME is not hungry, it will store metals in its larger jaws for later consumption.
author: incognito1234

entry: It violently slams its head into trees and other stationary objects to test its strength. Some say it keeps a count of how many foes it knocks over.
author: .izik

entry: Its extremely hard exoskeleton leaves it nearly impervious to direct damage. In order to keep it strong, it constantly searches for more metal.
author: incognito1234

entry: Before a hurricane, POKENAME's metal shell glows with a bright blue hue. During this time, it runs through villages hoping someone will notice the warning and spread the word.
author: .izik

entry: Beneath what appears to be POKENAME's metallic shell is another shell made of rock and soil; both are layers of the shell, and each are fused to different parts of POKENAME's spine, so it cannot function without both.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite living in deep dark caves, POKENAME tries its absolute hardest to keep the sapling on its back alive. Due to only growing on metallic elements for nutrients, the branches are as tough as iron nails.
author: mistymagius

entry: The inorganic stems on POKENAME's back are actually complex antenna arrays. It uses these arrays to communicate with other POKENAME across vast distances.
author: slimee_amogus

entry: Although it is not nearly as huge as Torterra, POKENAME has a small cavernous system on its back which smaller Pokémon such as Aron may rest in. POKENAME is able to carry a tremendous amount of weight, so it can lift even extremely dense objects.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's large metallic ears can detect even the faintest noise from over 100 feet away. If it senses a predator, it quickly retreats to its burrow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drills into rocky outcrops in search of Moon Stone shards. Eating these shards seems to strengthen its vitality and defensive capabilities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carves intricate labyrinths in stone using its bladed limbs. It performs an intense Swords Dance while balancing on its heels to prepare for battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is known to be very quiet. Everything it breathes on becomes room temperature.
author: neonriser

entry: POKENAME consumes metals to incorporate into its steel body to keep it fresh. It then bathes in moonlight, producing a mysterious sheen.
author: incognito1234

entry: Though many fear POKENAME's strange appearance, it is actually quite timid and prefers to hide away from humans. Its metal body appears almost ethereal when exposed to moonlight.
author: mepp.

entry: Its metallic body is sturdy, but the heavy weight leaves POKENAME with little ability to move. For locomotion, it ejects its innards, which are also coated in a metal shell, in order to forcibly drag itself around slowly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's costume is made out of actual steel that Aron sheds when it evolves. POKENAME does this in the hopes that one day, it will evolve into a Lairon as well.
author: redmagecole

entry: Its heavy, sturdy body means that it cannot jump very far on its own power. It digs through and consumes soft soil for nutrients that keep its shell strong and resilient.
author: sk372

entry: The blue metal star-shaped tip of POKENAME's tail crackles with static. It uses this tail to track underground power lines and mineral-rich veins.
author: .izik

entry: A melancholic song echoes softly from the holes on POKENAME's body. The sound can cause dizziness and fainting in the elderly if heard for too long.
author: .izik

entry: Upon fusion, POKENAME's face plating has become twice as wide and twice as thick. It can only be found in deep underground caverns where the pressure is too strong for most other lifeforms.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME crawl through caves in search of deposits of metal ore. The rounded metal plates on their body slowly grow more jagged as they continue to consume metal ore.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME digs pits and hides inside, waiting for prey like Spearow or Ekans. When one passes by, it leaps out, snapping its iron jaws and dragging the target underground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often used in construction. When metal parts are to be scrapped, an POKENAME is happy to eat them by grinding them between its gear teeth.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can manipulate its reflections from its mirror-like armor to show false imagery, confusing its adversaries. Its blue fur glows brightly during the night.
author: mistymagius

entry: The color of the flame on POKENAME's tail depends on in diet, feeding on many different types of metal. It lives in volcanic caves, the high temperature and pressure reinforcing its metal armor.
author: mistymagius

entry: The metal coating POKENAME's body becomes extremely hot when using Fire-type moves like Ember. When exhausted, it consumes coal to refuel its flame.
author: .izik

entry: Its heavy weight makes flying difficult, so it climbs and sticks to walls using the iron spikes on the inside of its wings. They also help make for effective slaps against enemies in self-defense.
author: sk372

entry: The tusks of POKENAME are razor sharp, which is why they are often hunted. Their tusks are used to make knives and other sharp objects.
author: sottiwotti

entry: The circle on its chest is actually an eye. It is thought that this Pokémon was supposed to act as a surveillance robot for its master long ago.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME has heavy wings made of steel that prevent it from taking flight. Instead, it burrows just below the ground and eats plant roots.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can deflect rocks thrown at it by rowdy kids. This is because its metallic wings cause the rocks to bounce off harmlessly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Due to the weight of its armor, POKENAME rarely flies, instead using the wing-claws to climb craggy rock walls. When prey passes below, it drops from its perch to bludgeon the target with a Headbutt.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME rarely leave their caves. Any instance that they do is purely for scavenging for the metal they feed on.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME often make their home near junkyards due to their iron-based diet. After feeding, they leave behind remnants of a dangerous venom.
author: garret95

entry: Wild POKENAME dwell in deep underwater caverns, savagely attacking any creature it encounters no matter the size.
author: theartemis1

entry: Wild POKENAME dwell in deep underwater caverns, savagely attacking any creature it encounters no matter the size.
author: theartemis1

entry: It slams its head into cave walls to create loud noises. It uses these tumults as a form of echolocation to determine its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: The sturdy shells atop POKENAME protect their squishy and sensitive bodies. If their shells ever develop cracks, POKENAME will produce a specialized acid to break down minerals for them to build their armor back up.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: As POKENAME lives, the metal it consumes accumulates in its body, and the holes in its steely armor gradually grow shut.
author: .realthree

entry: The desert sands blow right through POKENAME's empty body. A strange whistling sound can be heard if the wind blows through it at the right angle.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are very friendly, but they rarely see people due to living in caves. This has caused them to resort to pretending rocks are their friends.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME are very friendly, but they rarely see people due to living in caves. This has caused them to resort to pretending rocks are their friends.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME has a surprisingly resilient body. Musicians have found that interpreting the pattern on its hair and head as sheet music produces a familiar tune.
author: imaginaryneon

entry: POKENAME's outer layer is made of a steel-like metal that strengthens as it consumes gems. Sapphires seem to make its shell harder than any other gemstone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wears a full suit of metal armor, its helmet crowned with steel spikes. It seeks out high-quality iron ore to forge its mask, and devours the leftovers to strengthen its iron-plated body.
author: potato_tub

entry: POKENAME's body appears fluffy but is covered in metallic purple strands as strong as rebar. These metal fibers provide exceptional protection against attacks.
author: .izik

entry: The iron armor around POKENAME's body has thickened into a solid carapace. It hurls its heavy body into threats without hesitation, its iron mask glowing faintly from the refined ore it's forged from.
author: potato_tub

entry: POKENAME fashion durable masks out of iron to protect themselves as they practice their headbutts. Eventually their headbutts will become strong enough to flatten metal even without the help of their masks.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME sneaks into homes to steal gold jewelry, which it consumes. This diet strengthens the golden mask-like plating on its face.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are very shy when it comes their voice, so a kind Trainer needs to help them gain the confidence to release their echoing cries. Their voice echoes within their metallic body and can shatter glass when they hit the right frequency.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release echoing cries from their body by having the sound vibrate in their metallic shell. They cries can be heard across several football fields without much difficulty.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With its powerful fists, POKENAME breaks open rocks in search of mineral ore to feast upon. This diet helps naturally toughen up its body.
author: mepp.

entry: This Pokémon has to eat at least twice its body weight daily for healthy growth. Its diet consists mostly of rocks and metals which POKENAME crushes into small pieces with its powerful fists in order to fit the food under its mask where its mouth is.
author: milchik

entry: Its tough mask protects its face from the powerful arm thrusts of other POKENAME. It fights for food and territory nonstop, but even in the heat of battle, it remains respectful of its opponents and thanks them after every fight with a polite bow.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's silver whiskers can detect temperature changes with remarkable precision. If it senses a storm approaching, it gathers its allies in a cave for shelter.
author: .izik

entry: It's unknown what lies beneath POKENAME's mask, as it is never seen without it. These masks are shed when it evolves and are often sold online as miniature hockey masks.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful muscles to break through hard stone, looking for raw metals to eat. Its fur is made of tiny metal shards sharp enough to pierce through thick clothing.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fights by rolling its round, metallic body like a ball across the ground. If it misses even a single strike, it flies into a blind rage and attacks indiscriminately.
author: .izik

entry: Despite having an armor coating that can resist most attacks, POKENAME teleports away at the first sign of danger. When it warps away, a faint metallic sound can be heard.
author: sk372

entry: A single kick from an POKENAME can halt a moving train. The alloy that covers its body grows like skin and falls off if it gets damaged.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a metallic shell that absorbs the shock they experience when falling from a great height. Their shell is essential for their survival since they cannot withdraw into their shell without straining themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME feed on minerals and drink up metals and ores that they melt using their flames. Their bodies are tough even though they are considered weak.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are dependable creatures that are always happy to protect their Trainer. They were once regarded as moving shields during wars, where soldiers could hide behind them to block attacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The steel plating covering POKENAME's body delivers a painful shock to anyone who touches it. When tired, it rests on traffic lights to recharge.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME defends its nest, ramming into anything that gets too close. It remains unfazed even if it flies off a cliff in the process.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME clangs its tuning fork against itself to create large soundwaves. It uses this technique to ward off predators.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME's beaks are coated with a gold-like metal. It pecks cave walls to dislodge Light Clay, which it then devours with delight.
author: .izik

entry: It pants lightly when exerted, a small tongue barely visible as a sign of tiredness. The metal shell around its head makes the sound echo and come out as a baritone heaving noise that tends to inadvertently scare smaller Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can easily endure the force of an Electrode explosion. These walking behemoths are difficult to take down because of their sheer size.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The gas surrounding its body is highly corrosive, eroding any metal it touches. It has been responsible for the collapse of some buildings.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME are able to change the density of their bodies between being as sturdy as steel or as light as helium. They collide with steel structures and phase into any cracks they create to eat away at the metal from inside.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are malevolent Pokémon that possess discarded scrap metal, animating and using these scraps to haunt the sites they form at. They love to pull apart vehicles and metal structures, incorporating the shreds into their own bodies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are malevolent Pokémon that possess discarded scrap metal, animating and using these scraps to haunt the sites they form at. They love to pull apart vehicles and metal structures, incorporating the shreds into their own bodies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are typically found in scrapyards, feasting on the various metals. However, the sound of their burrowing and eating is disruptive.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME practices metallurgy and gem creation deep inside caves. It gives its most pristine diamonds as gifts to its closest friends.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME wields its morningstar with incredible speed and power. One blow is said to be strong enough to damage even the sturdy defenses of an Armaldo.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME despises the rain. In the event of a sudden sun shower, POKENAME will panic and barge into the nearest structure for cover, be that a cave or a building. It will plow through walls if it can't immediately find an entrance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The meeting of two POKENAME in the wild almost inevitably results in a fight. These fights are known to cause rock slides.
author: notsaying.

entry: Colonies of POKENAME live in caverns where food is scarce, so largely subsist on Aggsey's eggs. They often fight amongst themselves over food.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME uses its strong horn to punch holes in boulders along riverbeds. When two POKENAME meet, they use the same horn to fight viciously for territory, battering one another.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME are covered with metallic plates that deflect attacks from claws and talons. The metallic plate on their head extends further than their vestigial horns, so some people shave their horns into ornate shapes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will fiercely protect anyone it considers a friend. Despite its small stature, it is deceptively heavy due to its armour.
author: duskrd

entry: The helm atop POKENAME's head is forged from a lead-like alloy. When the orbs on its tail glow blue, a massive thunderstorm soon follows.
author: .izik

entry: The rumble of a POKENAME can often be heard from afar as it charges into boulders by propelling itself with its flames. With experience, it tempers its armor to make it more durable.
author: lbbacca

entry: With aerodynamic armor, POKENAME launches itself at high speed into boulders, or at rivals when it fights for territory. When it charges, its flames burn hot enough to scorch steel.
author: lbbacca

entry: The silk POKENAME spins is stronger than any man-made cable. These Pokémon can often be found lurking in construction sites.
author: rihse

entry: POKENAME are highly combative towards one other in the wild, and one spotting another inevitably leads to a fight. They clash in midair as each attempts to knock the other out of the sky with heavy iron headbutts.
author: sk372

entry: At night, it seeks out the highest point it can find and watches the moon until dawn. If it encounters another POKENAME during this process, the two will butt heads until the weaker one is driven away.
author: staghorn

entry: It is incredibly territorial and will fight off both people and Pokémon that approach what it has deemed its home. When it battles, it exudes effort and is willing to use any part of its body as a bludgeoning tool.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's segmented body grows denser the deeper it digs. It consumes raw ore as it tunnels through mountainous terrain.
author: .izik

entry: As their armored bodies can resist all but the fiercest blows, wild POKENAME will settle territorial disputes by locking their relatively fragile antlers in a struggle until one yields or its antlers break. This process can take several hours.
author: alumed

entry: POKENAME's iron body hardens as it rests. It hops between copper deposits while sleeping, slowly building strength for evolution.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME climbs icy mountain cliffs in search of metal pitons left by climbers. Eating these strengthens its armor and sharpens its claws.
author: .izik

entry: Covered in dense cobalt plating, POKENAME hovers using psychic force. It rarely touches the ground, even while mining.
author: .izik

entry: A hollow aluminum alloy encases POKENAME's body. It captures rushing air while leaping, allowing for brief glides between cliffs.
author: .izik

entry: With its iron-plated second head, POKENAME playfully nibbles at its kin. At times it bites too hard, unintentionally leaving dents.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME find verdant areas to live in and feast on the plant life around them. They are protective of their chosen place, so if another POKENAME comes into the area, the two will inevitably come into conflict and fight for the spot.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tears into ore veins with sharp metal claws, breaking stone with ease. It can feed on the same deposit for months without moving.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys chasing the trains that speed along the tracks. When it becomes irritated, the blue star on its tail begins to flash and emit menacing electric sparks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: These durable Pokémon have been seen living and working together to guard select mountain ranges from trespassers. Observation indicates they communicate through a complex combination of fist-bumps and headbutts.
author: sk372

entry: Their tails resemble a morningstar or flail, which they use to slam into opponents in battle. Each tail is able to act independently to smash rocks or other obstacles in quick succession.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are an apex predator that eat large rodent Pokémon such as Raticate. Their metallic wings cannot be pierced by a Raticate's teeth, so the rodent Pokémon have little to no defenses against this avian Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's two heads are made of dense iron. While sleeping in its cave, the two heads unintentionally alternate snoring, the sound echoing deep through the tunnels.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are territorial by nature. POKENAME make for excellent guards because their well-armored bodies can withstand a great deal of punishment and they are brimming with tireless energy that compels them to constantly patrol around an area.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME have tough exoskeletons that cling tightly to their bodies. They are ravenous creatures that need lots of iron to expand their exoskeletons.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The shell around POKENAME, created to aid its evolution, is thought to be impervious. Its durability would make for fine metalwork, but none so far have been able to shave or chip off even the tiniest piece of the material.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits sonar pulses to locate copper veins in dark caves. Once found, it gnaws on the metal to bolster its armored body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tusks are coated in thick steel, reinforced for digging. It tunnels through rock in search of rare minerals.
author: .izik

entry: The holes in the iron head and body of POKENAME allow it to maneuver better when flying. When sleeping upside down, POKENAME is disguised as an especially shiny stalactite.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The more emeralds POKENAME eats, the stronger its metal armor becomes. When deprived of gems, it grows sluggish and weak.
author: .izik

entry: A coating of liquid metal seeps from POKENAME's body, pooling in puddles as it moves. It sleeps curled into a glossy, silent orb.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are very competitive and will engage in sparring matches to prove their strength. After they lose a fight, they will sulk back to their cave to repair their iron armor.
author: mistymagius

entry: The blue metal scale on POKENAME's tail falls off if it gets even slightly chipped. It will regrow faster if it eats metal, allowing it to rapidly repair and maintain its defensive strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's steel carapace is layered like samurai armor, polished to a shine and adorned with jagged spikes. It meets foes with unwavering discipline, lowering its gleaming helm before charging with unstoppable force.
author: potato_tub

entry: This Pokémon bears a broad shield of plated steel on its back, lined with towering, razor-sharp spikes. In battle, POKENAME lowers its iron mask, shining with resolve, then barrels forward to protect those it trusts.
author: potato_tub

entry: POKENAME's aluminum helmet gleams brighter the more it's polished. It uses its silken tail to buff the surface obsessively.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in steel plates that serve as armor against enemy Pokémon. When angered, the flame on its tail spreads its heat through the metal, making it glow red-hot.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The eyes of a POKENAME are able to twist up to 270 degrees, allowing it to fully survey its surroundings for possible predators. If a predator is spotted, POKENAME will burrow into the ground in order to disguise itself as a rocky outcropping.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME shatters iron veins with powerful sound blasts. It then consumes the exposed chunks of metal with ease.
author: .izik

entry: These Pokémon used to fight with humans for the iron ore deposits in the past, but now are largely used to help people with mining it. POKENAME are tough to keep due to their enormous appetite for metal, but the expenses are usually worth the profit.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME fights with both its powerful arms and thick skull, ramming into its opponents head first before landing a devastating Arm Thrust. The holes in its palms and helmet help release the excess energy upon impact.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME trains relentlessly inside caves, balancing strength and focus. When exhaustion sets in, it consumes small metal objects to quickly restore its stamina.
author: .izik

entry: After feeding on metal ore, POKENAME's body becomes very shiny. During this time, its psychic attacks grow vastly stronger.
author: .izik

entry: The silver helm on POKENAME's head glows red-hot when it plays. Trainers often toss it fire-resistant toys to keep it entertained.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME crushes iron ore between its hands before eating the powder. This process helps reinforce its already dense armor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scoops iron ore with ease in abandoned mines. It consumes the ore to reinforce and thicken the steel plating on its head.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's flames lick out from between the cracks of the metallic plates lining their heads and backs. They use their developing legs and hooves to crush rocks and ores before eating them.
author: infinex21

entry: The steel plates lining their heads and backs are incredibly flame-resistant, though constantly hot to the touch. Their hot hooves have developed metallic plating due to the many ores they have come into contact with.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were often trained alongside soldiers to develop the experience needed to defend each other. Many soldiers owe their lives to good training and POKENAME's protective shell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They can use their metal sticks to flick small stones at an alarming speed. Even friendly spars between POKENAME look like fights for their lives.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME can endure the force of an explosion with their argent shell. They have a difficult time escaping conflict because of their large and bulky bodies, but they make up for this with their endurance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME cover themselves with discarded plates of sheet metal, protecting their otherwise gaseous and vulnerable bodies. The plates they use are manipulated using ferrokinetic powers, letting them curl into defensive balls if needed.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's body spews large amounts of sand to keep itself concealed. However, it can keep itself afloat on the dunes due to being less dense than the sand.
author: mistymagius

entry: When it spots something tasty-looking, POKENAME charges forward, gnashing its large jaws in anticipation of a meal. Because of its stubby legs, however, its top speed is rather slow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME enjoys eating flowers and extracting their nectar. With its strong teeth and jaws, no flowers are safe from its bite.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Wild POKENAME burrow within desert sands or within ancient ruins. They use their gem-like uvula to lure all manner of prey into their awaiting maws before clamping shut around them.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be found feasting on sand and spitting out quartz pieces. It transforms into its habitat's apex predators to intimidate its foes.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME soars over icy mountains in search of prey, using its massive jaws to carve conical traps in the snow. However, its bright orange body stands out in the white landscape, causing most prey to flee long before the trap is set.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME scurries across the desert, taking shelter in crevasses and staying away from the open sands. If forced to retreat, it can shed its skin as a last-ditch distraction, though this leaves it quite weakened for a time afterward.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME move their bodies in a sidewinding motion to bury themselves in the sand. They leave the tip of their tail exposed, resembling a worm to lure in small, unsuspecting bird Pokémon to ambush.
author: ultrazombie929

entry: POKENAME hides in rocky crevasses, waiting for any prey that passes by. When it strikes, it mercilessly injects a powerful poison into its victim.
author: mepp.

entry: Hiding amongst the foliage until only its flower is visible, POKENAME uses a sweet scent to lure in bug Pokémon to pollinate the flower before devouring them in a single bite.
author: mistymagius

entry: At the same time each day, it bites into the nearest object. Each POKENAME's schedule differs; if you wish to train one, learn its routine quickly!
author: wigglypon

entry: If POKENAME detects movement under the sand, it flies over and chomps the earth! Sometimes it snags a meal, but usually just gets a mouthful of dirt.
author: wigglypon

entry: The small face-like pattern upon the lesser half of these Pokémon is used to lull their prey into a false sense of security. They capture prey within the large maws of their body's larger half and dissolve them within using a corrosive fluid.
author: infinex21

entry: The large, mouth-like marking along a POKENAME's abdomen is used to scare away foes much stronger than they are. They often burrow under desert sands and use their abdomen's stinger to immobilize their prey.
author: infinex21

entry: It flies skillfully even through sandstorms thanks to the strength of its extremely rapid wings. POKENAME desperately chases anything it sees moving, unable to resist the primal instinct to bite it with its large mouth.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME tends to stand motionless and stare off into the distance, but is far more attentive than it appears. Anything that attempts to sneak up on it will find it quickly turning and lunging to give them a nasty bite.
author: sk372

entry: Hiding beneath the desert sand, POKENAME extend their plant-like tongues out of the ground to lure in prey. If something lands within their jaws, POKENAME will rise just long enough to clamp down before sinking back down with their prey in tow.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME glides above the open desert, the heated air around it granting it lift. It only uses its venom to incapacitate its prey, preferring to use its sharp claws and jaws in combat.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is very aggressive and will try to chomp through large trees to get to whatever angered it. However, its poor eyesight can cause it to fly directly into things during the night.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME acts as a trap in the ocean. It floats motionless so other Pokémon bump into its toxic spikes, then POKENAME consumes its prey with large strong jaws.
author: odditylad

entry: POKENAME loves to snack on smaller prey, their favorites being Sandshrew and Cacnea. They can be spotted making nests on large plateaus and cliffs.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME roams the snowy plains, chewing through even the thickest ice with its strong jaws to make its way. Always extremely hungry, it can be lured closer using any kind of food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its diet of sand and boulders has converted its coral body into that of stone. The spikes on its back provide sturdy defenses against most predators.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME likes to feed on cacti, using its long trunk to slowly chomp away at it. Its thick carapace not only protects itself from danger but also allows it to munch on cacti without getting pricked.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live in colonies in the mountains, digging out vast networks of tunnels and caverns. Their powerful mandibles allow them to rip through hard stone as if it were cotton candy.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME exudes a sickeningly sweet scent that attracts bugs close enough for the jaws to trap them and devour the meal. Domestic POKENAME tend to be given Everstones so that they do not evolve while feeding inside their homes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME wanders the desert, eating anything and everything edible it can find. Since its stomach can handle rotten food, it makes for an excellent scavenger if it happens to find any abandoned carcasses in the wasteland.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Despite POKENAME having impressive bite strength and a tough hide, they are incredibly timid. They are known to burrow underground at the first sign of danger.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's massively powerful jaws and aerial speed make it a force to be reckoned with. To feed, it flies around gnashing its teeth wildly, chomping down any rocks, foliage or unfortunate prey caught in its maw.
author: sk372

entry: The spines on POKENAME's back are green due to their diet of exclusively cactus plants. These spines are used to great effect in battle, with POKENAME curling into a ball and ramming its opponent, before delivering a devastating chomp.
author: evilgammon

entry: Though POKENAME lacks a tongue, its curled-up tail is extendable and contains a mouth of its own. POKENAME hides beneath the sand to leap out and let its tail grab prey and hoist it into its maw.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME telekinetically charges in a direction, chomping down on anything in its path as it does so. It can't change directions, however, so often collides with a wall or misses its intended target.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME eats large rocks, instantly crushing them to pieces with its powerful maw. However, it will sometimes get gemstones stuck in its mouth, causing it to starve unless it can get them free.
author: mistymagius

entry: To catch prey, it buries its body at the bottom of a sandy pit, keeping its rear jaws exposed. This allows it to tunnel through the sand with its body while its rear jaws snatch up prey that fall into its trap.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can be caring, despite its mischievousness. It tries to warn surrounding villages of incoming sandstorms, but it fails miserably every time.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME typically hangs around trees that border near craggy, rocky mountains. It scales both to keep its climbing skills strong, and gains nutrients by biting off huge chunks of bark or stone with its powerful jaws.
author: sk372

entry: It uses its large ears to listen for any sign of danger, launching into a full sprint at the slightest sound. If cornered and unable to run, it will clamp down on its attacker with its powerful jaws instead.
author: houseoffallingflowers

entry: POKENAME can function like a hammer, or like a bear trap hidden in the sand. It crunches down on its victim to harvest their life force.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME enjoys using its pointed arms to draw shapes in the sands of its desert home. Sometimes it will draw a picture of food, and then take a big bite of the imaginary meal.
author: sk372

entry: In deserts, it is common to see packs of POKENAME swimming through the sand. They are constantly on the hunt, searching for potential prey to ambush.
author: lemage22

entry: POKENAME emits a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to lure in its prey. It then uses its big jaw to bite into its prey, neutralizing them.
author: soup1900

entry: The whirlpools POKENAME creates are extremely deadly and are nearly impossible to get out of. Prey sucked through the center are swallowed whole by POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Anyone who dares touch POKENAME's keys will have their fingers bitten. It has poor eyesight, but it is good at spotting shiny objects.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME is completely blind, so it has adapted to detect slight vibrations in the earth to determine its surroundings. However, this only works on moving objects, so POKENAME is often running into things.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its strong jaws to tunnel through rock, making itself a small cave to nest in. Its tough carapace is able to protect it from falling debris while it digs.
author: mistymagius

entry: Fusions between Trapinch result in POKENAME, which are Pokémon that create gigantic sand traps in the desert. They have a bite that can penetrate break steel, making them a major hazard for desert travel.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME prefers to stay in its sand trap, now using its newly grown wings to lure in stronger prey by vibrating the surrounding sand. However, it will now search for more optimal hunting areas if its current spot is drying up.
author: mistymagius

entry: Colonies of POKENAME live underground, chewing the thick stone with their powerful jaws. However, they are almost completely blind, so their durable skulls prevent injuries when they eventually run into something.
author: mistymagius

entry: It regularly adds small bits of stone and dirt to its meals when it eats. The minerals get stored within its tail, and can be shot from the dust storm at its tip as a means of self-defense.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME digs itself into the sand of deserts and soaks up the plentiful sunlight to photosynthesise. If anything gets near it, it will lash out with a venom-infused bite.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME's jaws are so wide compared to the rest of its body that it often tries to swallow prey too big for its stomach. To avoid getting its game stolen by scavengers, it will bury itself with it in the sand.
author: lucioleuh

entry: Those that gaze into POKENAME's strange jewel find themselves compelled to step closer, entranced by something within that draws them nearer, and closer to its powerful jaws.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hides in the sand, pretending to be a Trapinch to scare away other Pokémon. While its bite force is nowhere near as strong as Trapinch, it is still strong enough to crush small stones.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME grows bigger the more it eats, but especially so when it eats living prey. It is thought that the prey's soul gives POKENAME tons of nutrients that are yet to be discovered.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's diet consists of hot desert sand, with a unique stomach that can absorb nutrients from it. It builds up heat as a byproduct of this process, occasionally belching flames.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME makes sand traps when it senses movement, though it is easily excited and often snaps too early to catch anything.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the sand, waiting for prey to step on it. When triggered, it bites its prey, refusing to let go.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME is found buried in sandy ground with only its leaves exposed. Its vice-like jaws can chomp through the bones of anyone that uproots it.
author: rihse

entry: The result of a vengeful spirit which lost their mortal form to quicksand. Sand observed pouring out the mouth is believed to be the poor soul within.
author: clubqaz

entry: Its antennae can pick up all types of frequencies, even ones undetectable by the human ear. When threatened, it will vibrate its antennae to create a high-pitched sound that is painful to most other Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time hidden in caves or under sand, waiting for a sandstorm to go out and hunt in a flock. When starving, it may try to cause one by using moves like Gust, Tailwind, or, for the strongest, Hurricane.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME feeds by engulfing large minerals and dissolving them with its highly corrosive mucus. It can ingest objects five times its size.
author: tuneless.towa

entry: POKENAME's body is almost entirely comprised of its enormous, powerful jaws. The force with which it clamps down on prey is enough to cast small tremors in the surrounding area.
author: sk372

entry: It uses its jaw-like tentacles to rip its prey to shreds. It goes after hard-shelled Pokémon, such as Shellder, since it enjoys the challenge of trying to crush their shells.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's powerful jaws are its greatest asset in the ring. With the power of its bite it can pin, grapple, and even throw around opponents with ease.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in regions with little-to-no rainfall annually. If it has a dried-out stem, it most likely will pass due to dehydration.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME swallows large amounts of sand to store within its body. When it needs to defend itself, it propels the spines on its body via releasing torrents of sand from the pores beneath them.
author: sk372

entry: Groups of POKENAME dig huge tunnels, creating vast networks in isolated deserts. If one is separated from the group, it slams its tail on the ground, creating thumps the others can sense through tremors.
author: evilgammon

entry: The cactus on POKENAME's head supplies important nutrients and hydration for living in the desert. In turn, it will take care of the cactus, pruning it with its large claws.
author: casinosluck

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a hydrothermal vent by spewing out columns of bubbles on the seafloor. As these vents host vital bacteria, POKENAME tricks other Pokémon into approaching it.
author: soup1900

entry: They make their hunting grounds near oases, preying on thirsty or tired Pokémon. POKENAME then leap out of hiding and strike with a bite, but if this fails, they'll vanish in a cloud of sand like a mirage and patiently wait to try again.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME lurks beneath desert dunes, with only its sandcloud arms remaining above ground. Its crab-like claws resemble fruit when closed, luring unsuspecting prey that wander too close before they are seized and dragged beneath the sand.
author: silentscript89

entry: The minerals POKENAME gathers from constantly eating sand, rocks and dirt nourishes the fruit growing on its head. It is happy to share the fruit it grows, but it is an acquired taste due to its dry and sour flavor.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will often bury itself in the sand, leaving its burning tail peeking out in hopes of attracting potential prey.
author: craigprime

entry: Be wary if you stumble upon shards of glass in the desert; it's a telltale sign of a sand trap nearby, created by the blazing tail of a POKENAME as it burrowed into the ground.
author: craigprime

entry: The sand that streams out of its mouth is frequently melted down into glass by artisans. Safety Goggles that use this glass have a yellow shine.
author: .izik

entry: The three heads work in tandem to quickly dig out tunnels with their jaws. Because these jaws are so powerful, POKENAME can dig through solid stone walls other cave-diggers cannot.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have superb control over sandy climates and can harness their psychic powers to fling balls of sand at others. This only works while the sand is dry, as wet sand is too heavy for them to lift with telekinesis.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME's jaw is so powerful, it can turn Bricks to dust with a single crunch. Construction workers fear its presence for good reason.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Both heads ravenously eat their diet of desert sand, fighting over their meals. POKENAME is also uncoordinated in battle, with both heads biting in completely opposite directions.
author: evilgammon

entry: It retains the same expression on its face, making it difficult to ascertain its mood at a glance, but when happy, POKENAME will form the shape of a tail with sand and clap with joy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is friendly and loves to greet any stranger it meets! Unfortunately, its sign of affection is to chomp on who it's trying to greet.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME's preferred habitat is deserts with red sand. There, it blends in perfectly with its surroundings, and prey falls right into its mouth.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME use their strong jaws to eat dead coral, clearing space for new coral to grow. They burrow into the sand to sleep, using the same burrows as ambush points to hunt fish Pokémon when needed.
author: chibitales

entry: Its maw can open up wide to allow it to consume large quantities of dirt at a time. Construction companies have taken to using POKENAME to help dig and reshape plots of land for development.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME covers itself in a sticky fluid that allows it to roll up poles and onto power lines. Thanks to the nearby electrical current, it can stay suspended on the line for long periods of time and easily strike down its prey: bird Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME vibrates its wings rapidly to generate headache inducing sonic waves to stun its target since it has a hard time changing direction while charging. It is easy to gain POKENAME's trust by scratching it between its plate armor.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A POKENAME burrows through the ground like it is swimming through water, constantly shedding microscopic scales. The scales have remarkable acoustic properties and are a prized material for making instruments.
author: quietcognition

entry: Nobody knows why POKENAME's patterns and ears are so geometrical. This Pokémon is sometimes used to teach how shapes look from different perspectives.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME are often seen jumping joyously, loudly repeating their cries. It has become a rather popular Pokémon online because of this.
author: mystora

entry: POKENAME's wings grow as they sleep but gradually shrink during the day. This means that lazier POKENAME have larger wings, though they are less adept at flight.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: As POKENAME sleeps, it gently rubs it wings together, loosing ultrasonic waves. This stimulates pores on its skin to produce a sticky substance that encourages the wings to grow. This substance is toxic to other Pokémon.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's feathers buzz as its wings flap at high speed. It glides over savannahs, scanning the tall grass for movement before diving.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a shy creature that hides in fresh snow to avoid conflicts with other beings. When threatened, it flaps the wings on its back frantically, creating powerful vibrations that can trigger dangerous avalanches.
author: fiordaliso

entry: By flapping all its wings in perfect unison, it generates a frosty powder capable of freezing anything in its way. Since its fluffy coat covers even its eyes, POKENAME navigates snowy environments using the vibrations it detects through its antennae.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME leaps from desert sands and feeds on flying insects it catches. Its fins emit ultrasonic waves that attract Trapinch that it carries along to share its feeding time with.
author: sk372

entry: In combat, POKENAME vibrates its scales to stir up the surrounding sand, cloaking it in a small sandstorm. It nimbly darts through the air, quickly slashing its opponents while they are distracted.
author: mistymagius

entry: The cactus on POKENAME's back produces prickly but nutrient-rich fruit. POKENAME will eat these fruits whole, then spit out the barbed seeds as projectiles in battle.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME live most of their time hiding in the sand of a desert. They rarely return to the surface, as they can live on minimal food for weeks at a time. If spotted, they will rapidly flap their wings to kick up sand to obscure others' vision.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME uses the black fur covering its body to store static energy and unleash powerful electric attacks. In the deserts where it dwells, traces of its passage can often be found in the spots where sand has been fused into glass.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can flap their wings fast enough to kick up small sand tornadoes to attack and disorient foes. Yet this species is more well known for their mating displays, moving sand to draw giant intricate patterns around their nests to impress mates.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Forming wings earlier than expected has given Trapinch more mobility, and a stronger appetite. It flies through the air, chomping wildly as it consumes flying insects.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have wings that take on aspects of the dominant local geology. They have a beautiful crystal sheen. Pokémon Rangers have to remain vigilant to ensure their populations are not poached.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: While digging, POKENAME flaps its wings to throw sand into the air. Once prey is blinded, it strikes with crushing jaws from below.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME nests in stone tomb pillars, drawn to ancient sites. It streaks through the ruins to intercept intruders with Disable.
author: .izik

entry: Ancient healers once used POKENAME to deliver poultices across harsh terrain. Many dusty scrolls reference its role in forgotten remedies.
author: .izik

entry: Just before attacking, POKENAME's wings vibrate in a fiery blur. It releases bursts of heat strong enough to melt sandstone with ease.
author: .izik

entry: Its wings and spinal column are the only parts of its body that aren't composed of amorphous slime. By vibrating its wings at specific frequencies, it can adjust the density of its body to become harder than steel.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME's wings are actually tough leaves that feel like sandpaper. Its eyes are covered in a thick film that allows it to see clearly even in harsh sandstorms.
author: mistymagius

entry: When POKENAME beats its four wings together, it generates a lot of friction to heat the air around it. This, when coupled with the heated sands of its desert home, can burn POKENAME's foes without it even approaching them.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's wing-like appendages collapse tunnels behind it to deter predators. Its antennae sense vibrations even in the air when underground, allowing it to surface safely and forage for food.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When a POKENAME scratches using its sharp claws, it creates a musical vibration that can stun its enemies. This comes with an added bonus for its masters, who enjoy its extra cuddly purr.
author: palmer5628

entry: POKENAME have dull scales that make them unappetizing to predators. Being ignored by predators gives them ample time to cultivate seeds that grow underwater.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its large eyes, humanlike lips, and stench confuse birds, allowing POKENAME to be surprisingly resilient in nature.
author: kill_the_wabbit

entry: Its comical shape makes it both too awkward for bird Pokémon to get a hold of and endearing enough for Trainers to catch it out of sheer pity.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME have dull scales on their cocoon that make them unappetizing to bird Pokémon. They hang from branches above the forest where they are ignored and left alone by most Trainers. They wobble with excitement whenever a Trainer notices them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Large schools of POKENAME appeared near Frond Island within the last year. They are extremely territorial and attack anyone fishing in the area.
author: .izik

entry: Because of the holes in its fins, POKENAME struggles to swim. When defending its nest, however, it forcefully launches itself at invaders with its sharp horn.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME have very dull wing scales that flake off easily, leading many trainers to simply dismiss them out of hand. Those trainers who do care for them find that these Pokémon respond well to affection and are happiest when praised.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is extremely hardy and can survive most environments. However, when it comes to Pokémon battles, its often used last as it has no strength.
author: kill_the_wabbit

entry: It freezes in surprise if anyone looks at it, refusing to blink. This reaction releases an icy chill that spreads through the surrounding water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often used to make people and Pokémon feel better about themselves. When it transforms, it's always uglier than its target.
author: kill_the_wabbit

entry: It is considered an "old-school" Pokémon. POKENAME are well-suited to performing repetitive tasks.
author: .towerxvi

entry: POKENAME is a rare sight at hot springs. It loves soaking up the warmth and steam. When it's spotted by someone, however, it quickly runs away.
author: archserpent

entry: The lures that resemble a Prism Scale and Oran Berry do not actually have any corresponding functionality or purpose. POKENAME is shy and comes up only in still spots of water to consume plant-life.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The light on its antenna resembles an Oran Berry, blinking blue in the sea's depths. It uses this lure to attract unsuspecting prey.
author: .izik

entry: When it spots someone on the shoreline, it approaches with a friendly demeanor. It then shoots jets of cold water to distract them and steal items.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME was once thought to be a strong swimmer, because of its powerful tail-fin. However, recent observations have concluded that it does not seem to know how to use its tail for swimming, and therefore mainly splashes around in the shallows.
author: thescribe

entry: The fins on its body are coated with a thin slime that can induce deep sadness in anyone who touches it. This defense ensures it is rarely disturbed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is self-conscious about its looks, using mental powers to make itself look more appealing to Trainers. Those that still accept it when it finally lets the illusion pass will have gained an unfailingly loyal friend for life.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a repulsive appearance that resembles a freshly hatched Flying-type Pokémon. Their fuzzy bodies make them unpopular for Trainers, especially since they have difficulty flying.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Shy and elusive, it unleashes a powerful Pin Missile into the water when spotted. These sharp projectiles deter any potential threats.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have speckled wings that make them seem like sickly Pokémon. Their default expression rests in a sad frown that scares baby Pokémon, so they try to cover their face when communicating with other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Living in warm brackish water, POKENAME clusters together in groups for protection against predators.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME is a weak Pokémon rarely encountered in battles. Instead, it is often captured and consumed as a food source.
author: sand_coffin

entry: It uses the suction cups on its tentacles to cling to piers, observing the sea. If noticed, it panics and scrambles into the water to escape.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon can usually be found slithering along polluted beaches. POKENAME's face has become popular online as a reaction image.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has learned to protect itself from the Pokémon that think it is easy prey. Rumor has it that its true beauty lies within its hideous shell.
author: kill_the_wabbit

entry: POKENAME has a very shy and introverted nature, since many Trainers tend to overlook it because of its appearance. It lives in large groups with others of its kind along the shores of small lakes, usually rich in the algae it loves to eat.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has a sullen and downtrodden personality, with a posture to match. Its low self-esteem means it becomes fiercely loyal and attached to those who show it genuine kindness and affection.
author: sk372

entry: Happiny has been noted to find Feebas's appearance very cute and endearing. The pair become inseparable in the wild, and Feebas become markedly stronger and healthier after the bond is formed.
author: sk372

entry: It tries to play with others, but is often bullied away for its shoddy appearance. It's unfathomably loyal to those who look past its exterior and treat it with kindness.
author: sk372

entry: When it is mocked by other Pokémon for its appearance, POKENAME digs a hole at the bottom of its lake and stays there for days, crying. It combs the beaches in search of objects that might make it look prettier and more elegant.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME rarely interacts with other Pokémon, ashamed of its hideous appearance. It will somberly dance across the river's surface when it thinks no one is watching.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lives in constant misery and rarely shows any hint of joy. The kindest of Trainers might coax a smile out of this sorry Pokémon, though.
author: rooboid

entry: Though it is simpleminded and weak offensively, POKENAME is surprisingly hardy, resisting harm from both predators and harsh environments. It often shields smaller Pokémon from harm by letting them hide in its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: Due to constantly molting its feathers, it cannot swim in water that is too cold. It is so ashamed of its appearance that it almost never wants to go to shore.
author: mistymagius

entry: For a long time, experts believed the spots on its feathers were caused by a strange illness. POKENAME spends most of its time underwater searching for algae to feed on.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is found in muddy lakebeds and riverbeds. It is eager to be used as a weapon by any Trainer, but is unimpressive and unwieldy.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The underside of its body glows at night, resembling a stunning colorful stained-glass pattern. Artists are often inspired by this ethereal beauty.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its pair of majestic wings, POKENAME prefers to stay hidden underwater to avoid being seen. This has led to the belief that it lost the ability to take flight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's powerful wings allow it to take flight directly from the water. This is rarely seen, however, as it much prefers to wallow beneath the waves.
author: danarchosyndacalist

entry: Despite harboring immense power capable of parting seas, this Pokémon's poor physiology diminishes any force that it could've otherwise unleashed.
author: slowforest

entry: POKENAME constantly sheds scraps of its skin, so it has a shabby appearance. Those who see through to the truth find it's a beautifully kind Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME achieves greater elevations by sucking in massive amounts of air to bloat its body. Holding its breath for too long causes it visible distress.
author: sk372

entry: Incredibly shy, it spits globs of Gastro Acid into the water around itself when spotted. This tactic serves as a distraction while it escapes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME struggle to make disguises to hide in, finding only poor quality materials with a shabby appearance. They dislike their natural appearance and this is preferable, allowing them to search for higher quality materials without being observed.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite their blindness, POKENAME can live in the toughest of environments, eating anything that comes their way. Though unattractive at first glance, Pokémon Hunters know better and have been hunting them down for their scales after they evolve.
author: beatdoof

entry: Despite its ugly, dilapidated appearance, it is able to swim incredibly fast. It is known to dominate lake ecosystems.
author: .towerxvi

entry: It wraps itself in seaweed and sleeps beneath lakes. It can supposedly grant wishes, but nobody has bothered to try.
author: .towerxvi

entry: Its singing is atonal and discordant, but manages to make others fall asleep all the same. While its victim slumbers, POKENAME will vandalize their face, to make them look as shabby as it does.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is found in shallow pits by the shore, where they hide from predators. If you step on a POKENAME it will try to bite you, but since it is toothless, it is also harmless.
author: thescribe

entry: After fusing, POKENAME's body grew longer, similar to its evolution. Though its appearance is still considered by most to be shabby, it seems much happier with its new form.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME alternates between staring at its prism scale and at blankly into the distance every few hours. It will rarely stop this cycle to eat algae.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME are often the secret success to community and city gardens. Planted in soil beds, the mists they produce are natural pest repellents.
author: kill_the_wabbit

entry: Due to its ugly appearance and Drifloon's reputation, children are warned against going near POKENAME.  It has no ill motives however; all POKENAME wishes for is to be held by a happy child.
author: sk372

entry: Its ugliness deters other spirits. As a result, sailors like to use POKENAME to fend off ghost ships and bad luck.
author: kill_the_wabbit

entry: At the bottom of coastal waters, it is common to meet small groups of POKENAME walking together. They defend their territory against Magiolett.
author: elevn.

entry: Some Trainers have the feeling that they might be hurting their POKENAME's feelings. In truth, POKENAME are just always feeling down.
author: funkytomate

entry: Preferring solitude, it buries itself in sand near the sea. If accidentally uncovered, it releases a mild spark to scare away intruders before finding a new hiding spot.
author: .izik

entry: It stares intently at food before eating, but the slightest movement from others scares it. It quickly hides, waiting for the danger to pass.
author: .izik

entry: All of its leaves fall off as soon as they grow. Its trunk is very weak, so it is prone to wilting.
author: .towerxvi

entry: POKENAME are rarely known to be aggressive. This may be due to nobody trying to pick them up or show them affection.
author: .towerxvi

entry: Its anchor has broken off and flipped upside down, making it look caught in a perpetual frown.
author: .towerxvi

entry: While it still craves Corsola branches, it struggles to consume them without any teeth. Due to this, some populations of POKENAME are malnourished.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME stand mournfully in the rain, lamenting that their presence drives away bird Pokémon. They long to be beautiful and try anything they can to stand out and draw attention to themselves.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It watches picnicking travelers from nearby lakes, pretending to be shy if spotted. It splashes water and winks in hopes of receiving free food.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is extremely shy and hides in remote lagoons. If cornered, however, it lashes out with claws sharp enough to cleave concrete into pieces.
author: .izik

entry: It is said that prejudice against ugly Pokémon summons it to appear at the periphery of populated areas. Bullies who hear its cries are cursed with bad luck.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME are incredibly enthusiastic about approaching boats. They pop out of the water to watch them pass by, but they often end up in the way instead.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME often leaps from the water into the arms of couples it spots, wanting to cheer on their blossoming love. Unfortunately, its shoddy appearance often leads to it being tossed back into the depths.
author: sk372

entry: Its constant headaches cause it to psychically relive embarrassing moments from those around it. This makes its headaches worse, creating a vicious cycle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME miserably cries from loneliness since Pokémon and Trainers reject its unsightly appearance. The more it cries, the more beautiful its voice becomes, leading to evolution.
author: pokebio

entry: It perches on lily pads, glaring at passing Trainers with a judgmental stare. If approached, it trips over itself in a frantic attempt to escape underwater.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME does not breathe well on land, and does not swim well either. They always seem tired, but loyally obey their Trainers and try fighting.
author: markusknight

entry: POKENAME are covered in scales that are as tough as their shell. They are regarded as ugly Pokémon because their scales are a dull and unappealing color.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Living in deep underwater caves, it avoids attention at all costs. When spotted by divers, it emits a bone-chilling Screech and flees into the darkness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lie amongst the pebbles and stones at the bottom of riverbeds, their drab stony hides helping them to blend in. Given the opportunity, they gather precious stones and jewels, covering their bodies with them to try and look pretty.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lie amongst the pebbles and stones at the bottom of riverbeds, their drab stony hides helping them to blend in. Given the opportunity, they gather precious stones and jewels, covering their bodies with them to try and look pretty.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It uses psychic powers to sense the thoughts of those who approach. If it detects interest in interaction, it goes completely still, pretending to be unnoticed.
author: .izik

entry: Its body consists of corrosive slime that drifts across the water's surface. The slime absorbs plant life it touches, extracting vital nutrients.
author: .izik

entry: Its acidic slime spreads thinly across the surface of ponds. When prey enters the water, the slime wraps around them instantly, trapping them.
author: .izik

entry: It produces stunning blue pearls within its shell. When pursued, it tosses the pearls onto nearby sand, hoping to distract the pursuer with treasure.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather on the undersides of abandoned fishing boats. They emanate a putrid gas, akin to rotten fish.
author: .towerxvi

entry: Those that have witnessed POKENAME have regarded it as utterly horrifying to behold. This has given it incredibly low self-esteem, as it is not trying to be scary in the least.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME scavenge food off the seafloor. They use their claw fins to attract mates, and their tails to stir up sand on the seafloor to evade enemies.
author: totodile.

entry: Despite being a fish, POKENAME live their lives on dry land. With tall grass hiding their legs, they often startle people by appearing to 'swim' through the air while chasing prey.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME crawls onto the top of branches carrying berries, headbutting them until the treat falls to the forest floor. It then divebombs head-first to the ground after it, the tough shell on its cranium protecting it from the impact.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME scavenge around the graveyards of Dragon-type Pokémon, using the bones of long dead Pokémon to protect themselves and use as weapons. They are protective of their chosen weapons and armour, wearing them constantly.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME scavenge through the remains of larger Pokémon that have died in the mountains for suitable bones to use as weapons. They prize the bones of Dragon-type Pokémon the most and can swing them with enough force to shatter boulders.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses its long tongue to knock foes off balance before ramming them with its skull. Its skull becomes harder than granite if its diet is rich in minerals.
author: .izik

entry: The vines that writhe around POKENAME's body are as hard as bone, despite their flexibility. It uses these vines to uproot shrubs and devour them whole.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME fails to slice through a tree during training, it headbutts the trunk until it falls. Once successful, it strikes a triumphant pose atop the fallen tree.
author: .izik

entry: Its jealousy towards flying Pokémon has turned to aggression. If it spies one flying above its waters, it will launch itself from the water at high speed in an attempt to headbutt them out of the sky.
author: sk372

entry: It wants to fly without the use of shapeshifting, launching its gelatinous body from great heights as practice. Fortunately its soft form makes the impact with the ground painless.
author: sk372

entry: Having grown far too heavy to get off the ground, POKENAME spends its days eating its feelings away, dreaming about the open sky and weeping silently.
author: kecleonfan352

entry: POKENAME whiles away its days with constant eating and sleeping. Dream analysis shows that a majority of its dreams involve it being able to fly through the skies.
author: sk372

entry: It clamps its mouth around a foe's head before attempting to ensnare them with its long body. Its body is covered in tiny, soft scales that glow when wet.
author: .izik

entry: It can secrete a venom-soaked web from its jaws, using it to trap its prey. It battles other POKENAME to maintain dominance over its hunting grounds, driving away weaker individuals with devastating blows from its head, reinforced by bony plates.
author: fiordaliso

entry: With enhanced intellect thanks to the biting shell upon its skull, POKENAME sees the folly of leaping off cliffs in vain hopes of flight. It now spends time pondering less self-destructive ways of achieving its dream.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME frequently leaps off rocky outcrops in a desperate attempt to fly. When it inevitably fails, it slams the ground with its horn.
author: .izik

entry: The skin covering its body its extremely coarse to the touch. One should avoid petting a POKENAME to prevent injury.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME casts itself from the highest peaks to practice for the day it will finally fly. Its massive size and strength mean the impact tremor it creates hitting the ground can be felt from hundreds of yards away.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being strong and muscular, POKENAME struggles to fly due to its heavy weight and relatively small wings. It never stops trying though, as it dreams of reaching the top of a rainbow one day.
author: milchik

entry: It makes a low-frequency noise that sounds similar to a bell while it flies. It clamps onto the sides of cave walls with its fierce jaws.
author: .izik

entry: It eats ore in order to absorb their nutrients. POKENAME prefers copper and silver ore over all other types of ore due to the flavor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME attacks by headbutting its opponent, which is made possible with its reinforced head crest. Its large leg muscles also allow it to wind up power before unleashing a powerful slam.
author: quackquackattack

entry: For the longest period of time, the only proof of this Pokémon's existence was a single photograph in a magazine. It is quite striking.
author: barthandelus_real

entry: POKENAME has the ability to generate illusions that distort its surroundings, a trick it usually uses to hide the entrance to its cave. It is a short-tempered Pokémon, and if someone makes it lose its patience, it retaliates with a powerful headbutt.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The muscles in POKENAME's legs allow it to kick with destructive force and bound away quickly if in a rough spot. It stares at bird Pokémon in the sky, envious of their ability to fly.
author: chibitales

entry: Its skin can dry out quickly and crack. Due to this, wild POKENAME tend to stay close to rivers, creeks, and other bodies of water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME performs backflips in an attempt to mimic professional fighters. Its heavy skull often causes it to stumble mid-routine, frustrating it greatly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is most energized at sunrise, wildly swinging its arms while gazing at the morning sky. During this time, its skull glimmers with a faint blue hue.
author: .izik

entry: The helmet on its body is made of an extremely hard metal. It smashes its helmet into trees to break branches off and eat the fruit.
author: .izik

entry: The muscles in POKENAME's ears are so strong, a single punch can knock the wind out of a Snorlax. Its cotton-like fur often gets matted and must be groomed to maintain its health.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME attaches itself to winged Pokémon in hopes of learning the secrets of flight. It zaps its host with static electricity when they stop flying to startle them into taking off again.
author: soup1900

entry: Since ancient times, blacksmiths have used POKENAME to forcibly shape metal. This is due to the Pokémon's high tolerance to heat.
author: .izik

entry: It pierces enemies with the spikes on its arms. Should the spike break off, it will regrow slowly over the course of one week.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to fly in the sky and perform aerial maneuvers for the sheer thrill of the wind against their face. They release happy little high-pitched screeches whenever they perform a successful maneuver.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's hard forehead is coated with a sticky, white poison. A single Headbutt leaves foes covered in a residue that causes dizziness and clings to clothing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are slow, but have powerful hind legs that can allow them to leap great distances. They are hardy Pokémon and will ram into obstacles with enough strength to shatter boulders.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The plates covering its head allow it to unleash headbutts so powerful they can leave dents even in a ship's hull. POKENAME is a very aggressive creature, so it is advised to approach it with extreme caution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its ears are comprised of flexible, impact-resistant bundles of muscle fibers. It can wrap its ears around its head to better protect its skull.
author: staghorn

entry: The cotton-like substance on its wings comes off in clumps as it flies. Its wings are extremely soft and were once used to stuff mattresses.
author: .izik

entry: It releases a sticky substance while it moves across the ground. The slime it leaves behind smells like rotting vegetables.
author: .izik

entry: Its shell has grown thick and sturdy from constant attempts to fly, giving it strong defenses. The shell's growth has now obscured its vision, however, making it a bit clumsy.
author: sk372

entry: The scales on POKENAME's body, as well as its skull, glisten during heavy rain. These scales are sometimes harvested by jewelers to craft decorative shower curtains.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits telekinetic waves through its antennae, using them to levitate discarded toys in an effort to simulate flight. It nests near toy stores, hoping to find the perfect abandoned toy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a hot-tempered Pokémon that breathes searing flames at anyone who approaches. Its anger stems from shame over its inability to take flight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It can burrow through solid rock with ease. It hunts its prey by burrowing under them and launching them into the air with a powerful headbutt.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME leaps from the water and headbutts anything it deems as being disruptive to romance in its vicinity. Conversely, it's been observed headbutting avian Pokémon and attempting to disturb their mating rituals.
author: sk372

entry: It tunnels through the ground at extremely high speeds. Should it encounter a rock, it will use its thick skulls to break through the stone.
author: .izik

entry: Eyewitness reports claim a blue glow surrounds POKENAME at night. It's said to shine brightest under a full moon.
author: captainjefejefe

entry: POKENAME balances on the edge of cliffs before hurling its heavy stone body off head-first in an attempt to achieve true flight. When it impacts the ground, it emits a bright flash of warm sunlight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its Dragon Fang to increase its draconic energy. Those who are put to sleep by this Pokémon experience wishful dreams of flight.
author: noel5229

entry: Each of the eggs has a very hard scaly shell. No one understands how this fusion can fly if it does not have any wings.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME are very selfless and can be seen throwing themselves into danger to protect weaker Pokémon. While not usually worrying about their own safety, they will go into a panic if their egg gets damaged.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's wings are actually made of thin scales which allow them to block incoming attacks. Despite its friendly nature, it will constantly have territorial disputes with other POKENAME.
author: mistymagius

entry: It looks gelatinous at a glance, but POKENAME is actually coated with a thin yet sturdy shell around its soft insides. A transformation unlike its shapeshifting capabilities is taking place within.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are rarely seen, as they are constantly afraid of damaging their exposed bodies. They hide in small burrows, only peeking their armored heads out to check for danger.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME knock heads together hard as a form of greeting, their armour is so thick they do not feel it. Unfortunately, they also do this to those of other species, which often stuns them. POKENAME watch over them as they recover but never learn.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's long legs are deceptively strong, able to send heavy Pokémon like Metagross flying with a single kick.
author: lyrebird.rainwing

entry: The segments of POKENAME's body rotate in sequence from tail to head. When the rotation speeds up rapidly, it's a sign that its evolution is imminent.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its size, it digs voraciously in search for mushrooms. Only the most plump of POKENAME manage to evolve.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME can be found on the tallest peaks, patiently waiting for its desired evolution. However, if they are too impatient, they will throw themselves off the cliff before they are ready to evolve.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time resting at the foot of rainbows, conserving energy for its evolution. The shell it sheds is said to bestow luck unto those who carry its fragments.
author: badtothebow

entry: POKENAME sleeps curled in a ball deep within icy caves. Its frilled plating wards off ambushes, and the surrounding air drops by ten degrees as it slumbers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tough scales do not grow naturally, so it can be seen collecting other Dragon Pokémon's scales. It has trouble getting around, usually scaling cliff faces with its strong arms and claws.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can be found digging out large cave systems, with its tough scales shielding it from falling debris. While not fazed by most attacks, it will chase away anyone that disturbs its digging.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's exterior shell is almost impenetrable, but the heavy weight and huge size means it swims at an incredibly slow pace. It filter-feeds at the ocean bottom, awaiting the day it sheds its shell and can swim more freely.
author: sk372
