entry: POKENAME has small orange feathers that litter the landscape as it runs. These feathers stay surprisingly cool regardless of how hot its body gets.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME frequently eats floating ice chunks to cool its intensely hot body. Without this, it risks overheating and becoming sluggish.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME expels flames from the cannons on its shell. It can shoot small fireballs that travel for a distance of 10 feet before they explode.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME shoots steam from its cannons. However, the steam doesn't burn much, and at most it'll sting for a while.
author: dodoowner_

entry: When threatened, POKENAME fires large bursts of flames at its attacker. If it keeps its shell closed for too long, the shell will become hot enough to boil the surrounding water.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's eerie appearance frightens those who come across it. However, there have been accounts from mountaineers claiming that POKENAME helped guide them away from dangerous paths when visibility was low.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME pranks those it haunts by touching their shoulders with its burning hands, warming the victim to the point of profusely sweating. Just the threat of being sprayed with water is enough to send it fleeing in terror.
author: sk372

entry: Friendly by nature, POKENAME often approaches travelers resting inside caves and offers them its large body for both warmth and protection. It even offers its tail-flame to use for cooking food, as long as it gets a small share.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME breathes out hypnotic flames that swirl in various patterns. People claim to have visions while staring at its flames, though concrete evidence for this is lacking.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Each of POKENAME's claws can produce short bursts of flame. It uses these flames to cook captured prey and for territorial disputes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can inflate the seed on its back until it grows as large as a balloon, allowing it to float for long periods and travel great distances on wind currents. When agitated, it releases poisonous spores to keep others away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The Moon Stone used for evolution gave POKENAME a significant boost in power. It defends its Trainer with incredible speed.
author: smashbear

entry: If others fall asleep while it is singing, POKENAME grows furious. In its frustration, it may self-destruct, blasting everything around it with a powerful explosion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will fling a club at someone who falls asleep during its song, doing so with high speed. This sudden action is a playful yet surprising way to wake its target up.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME undulates its tongue by sucking in large amounts of air and bellowing at a subsonic frequency. The purpose of this peculiar behavior is a topic of much speculation.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME spins the drill on its nose while singing, creating an oddly rhythmic pattern as it moves. This combination of song and drill serves to both entertain and intimidate in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME takes care of young Pokémon, singing them to sleep when they are scared. Its soft, fluffy body provides comfort to those seeking warmth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shelters small, defenseless Pokémon in its pouch, even if they aren't its own offspring. To ward off wild Pokémon, it puffs itself up by holding its breath, making itself look much larger.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are known for their boundless energy and curious nature. Though apples are considered their favorite food, they only choose to consume fruit they deem as perfect.
author: mepp.

entry: Due to its luxurious look, it's often employed as a singer and dancer, but no reviews exist of its performance. It's popular among insomniacs.
author: houndrys.

entry: Trainers who were shocked by POKENAME's electricity report hearing music while they were nearly electrocuted.  The sound has often been compared to an electric guitar.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME's lung capacity lets it breathe out vast quantities of fire in a single breath. At times it even manages to sing as it does so, creating an inferno of music cascading in front of it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a love for metal music, thrashing their heads around while screaming at the top of their lungs. Groups of POKENAME will even create entire concerts out in the middle of the forest.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are often kept in private ponds both for their beauty and lovely singing voice. These songs are known to attract other Magikarp fusions, making them useful companions for researchers as well.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is a popular companion for budding artists and artisans, letting others mold its malleable body into a shape before it transforms into the object proper, allowing the artist to see how accurate their molding was.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is known for being extremely playful and friendly. It can jump to a height of over 7 feet.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME love nothing more than to be pillows for people to sleep against. It's said there is no more pleasant a sleep than one experienced while being cradled by a POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its might, POKENAME is far from malevolent. It is a kind and cheeky Pokémon, often nabbing an unguarded hat from a passersby to play with.
author: chiari_queen

entry: POKENAME enjoys resting in the grass or sand and sunbathing for long periods of time. It will also rest like this while awaiting a loving head pat.
author: chiari_queen

entry: POKENAME enjoys resting in the grass or sand and sunbathing for long periods of time. It will also rest like this while awaiting a loving head pat.
author: chiari_queen

entry: Despite its might, POKENAME is far from malevolent. It is a kind and cheeky Pokémon, often nabbing an unguarded hat from a passersby to play with.
author: chiari_queen

entry: Beloved for its soft body and luxurious fur, POKENAME has been seen draped around the necks of famous stars at high-profile events. Due to this, owning a POKENAME is seen as something of a status symbol.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's large eyes give it strong eyesight, even in the darkness of night. It watches over young birds leaving the nest, catching them against its soft body should they fall while learning to fly.
author: sk372

entry: During full moons, it mimics human speech to lure people out of their homes at night. Those who venture out are never seen again.
author: .izik

entry: The long ears of POKENAME are said to pick up sounds from other dimensions. When their ears begin to twitch rhythmically, they let out a call, facing the sky as if they are responding to something.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME can expand to twice their size to reach berries in trees nearby. By giving them a Pecha Berry, they can cure the poison they get whenever they bump into Beedrill stinger.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spend much of their time absorbing sunlight and moonlight. Once they are full of energy, they sing sweet lullabies that put Pokémon around them to sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Right after evolution, POKENAME is bald. It excretes a film from its skin that stimulates hair growth, growing to its full length of about 10cm in a single day. Researchers are studying them for the potential in human hair growth.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Should someone attempt to walk away mid-performance, POKENAME will pin them down with psychic energy. It refuses to let an audience leave until the song is finished.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sings for hours on end in pure bliss after eating cheese. Its soothing voice echoes in the air, filling the area with a calming melody that can have a peaceful effect on nearby Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: Some stores in Kanto have made confections based on POKENAME to try to compete with the vaunted Casteliacone, to little success.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: It tries to be intimidating, but its pincers are too soft and squishy to hurt opponents that much. This frustrates POKENAME to no end.
author: fountainihili

entry: It loves to sing, but its ever-growing front teeth often make its notes sound off-key and dissonant. Its fur is considered the height of luxury, and it is extremely proud of it.
author: kinsgs

entry: It loves to sing, but its ever-growing front teeth often make its notes sound off-key and dissonant. Its fur is considered the height of luxury, and it is extremely proud of it.
author: kinsgs

entry: It loves to sing, but its ever-growing front teeth often make its notes sound off-key and dissonant. Its fur is considered the height of luxury, and it is extremely proud of it.
author: kinsgs

entry: POKENAME charms foes with its jovial demeanor before striking with unexpected force. It is both a beloved companion and a formidable guardian.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME's body is soft yet firm, able to withstand a large amount of punishment without flinching. It grabs foes with its pincers and holds on tightly, letting them struggle and strike until they're too exhausted to continue fighting.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bubble and puff up when they get too hot, as their internal anatomy constantly produces superhot gas. They can be trained to release this hot air slowly and are popular companions in colder regions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME sings while soaring over meadows, hoping to invigorate grazing Pokémon with its melody. However, its soothing voice inevitably lulls them into an unintended slumber.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME trumpets a cheerful tune from its trunk that can soothe even the most furious Pokémon. Unfortunately, it often puts its own allies to sleep in the process.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drive off predators by staring. If its unblinking, unflinching expression isn't enough, a sudden ear-piercing screech does the job.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME is highly protective of eggs and young Pokémon. It can inflate itself to the size of an elephant to ward off attackers.
author: serversizeme

entry: Its huge, strong hands allow POKENAME to give some of the best massages in the world. It does so for free, as a relaxed customer's sigh of relief is reward enough.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME loves to perform songs to delight the Pokémon it has befriended. When it receives praise for its singing, it becomes so happy that the electricity stored in its body makes it shine like a lightbulb.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are capable of producing signals that turn off electronics around them. By modifying the strength of the signal, they can cause other Steel-type Pokémon to fall asleep too.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This strong Pokémon‘s body is hard as granite. Missing physical affection, it covers itself in pillows and soft fabrics to appear more huggable.
author: sontyp

entry: Flying quickly across the lands, POKENAME appears above places of strife, singing a pleasant tune. Those who hear its song find their negative feelings slipping away, replaced with an urge to sleep and have pleasant dreams.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its sensitive tuft of hair to sense updrafts to aid in gliding with its cape-like wing. If it sees a weak Pokémon in danger, it dives to the rescue and attacks the aggressor with its puffy claws.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Often considered one of the most demanding Pokémon, POKENAME's luxurious fur must be brushed four hours a day. Those Trainers who pamper them are rewarded with an overprotective companion that protects them by puffing up their pollen-soft hair.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME spends most of the day plowing fields to make room for the next round of crops. It can be heard singing songs to help itself keep a steady rhythm when plowing fields.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Although it can't see past the luxurious locks of fur atop its head, it uses its psychic power to remain aware of its surroundings. If it senses that a person is friendly, it will request that the fur on its head be tousled.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME performs intricate dances while singing on the battlefield. It moves gracefully to its own rhythm, creating an almost mesmerizing aura that can confuse or entertain its foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be seen lovingly chasing Pokémon like Lucaslash. It wields a giant red and yellow hammer as a weapon.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: POKENAME can sometimes be seen lovingly accompanying Pokémon like Lucaslash. It wields a giant red and yellow hammer as a weapon.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: The back head loves to sing, even though its singing is so bad not even the main head can stand it. Due to the constant singing, the main head's hearing gets worse as it gets older.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spend their days lazing around and casually eating fruit from bushes and trees. When roused to fight they are terrifyingly strong, inflating their chest and bellowing loud enough to be heard from miles away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.
author: cristata

entry: A peaceful Pokémon. The fruit that POKENAME collects attracts a variety of Pokémon, particularly Flying type Pokémon.
author: gayschlatt

entry: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.
author: cristata

entry: Despite being jovial, childish, and often naive, POKENAME are also fiercely protective of that which they hold dear, primarily, their favorite snacks.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME typically dwell high in the mountains, maintaining large territories across the peaks of their homes. They signal to Wigglyking and rival POKENAME with loud, echoing songs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can calm people and Pokémon just by brushing them with their ribbon's soft fur. It can also inflate their blade to a ridiculous size.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's shield is made out of a cluster of poofy, highly elastic hair. Most attacks bounce right off.
author: regulavish

entry: Its shimmering scales reflect light like precious jewels. Gentle and graceful, it cradles its young in a watery embrace.
author: anarchaz

entry: Its incredible singing voice has the power to enthrall listeners, which allows it to amass giant crowds of loyal fans that will do anything for it. Its rage when a performance is disrupted can put even the most disgruntled diva to shame.
author: elfail0

entry: Its rich, fluffy fur feels so good to touch that people find it difficult not to touch it. Cuddling POKENAME is used to help insomnia patients.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME are generally peaceful Pokémon that sing lullabies to put other Pokémon to sleep. When they get angry, they lash out with their sharp claws and venomous horn, so Trainers try to avoid conflict around POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: By inhaling deeply, POKENAME can inflate itself enough to gently float through the air. When it deflates, it creates soothing sounds or devastating screeches, depending on its mood.
author: sontyp

entry: Frustrated parents whose children won't go to bed at night are sometimes known to gift them a POKENAME. The games played on a POKENAME can put almost any insomniac to sleep within 30 minutes of starting.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME's fine, fluffy fur is wonderfully soft. However, since POKENAME can spin strands of the fur into an electrically charged web within moments, few ever get to touch it.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: People enjoy having a POKENAME around because of their soft, melon-colored fur and gentle voice. POKENAME sing lullabies to their Trainers before curling up and falling asleep as well.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In the wild, one head will stay awake while the other sleeps. However. in the company of a trusted Trainer, both heads will sleep peacefully.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME hyperactively jumps around, inflating so much it bounces off walls. It uses manic movement in battle, bouncing around the field swiping with its claws while its opponent struggles to keep up.
author: evilgammon

entry: This Pokémon possesses luxurious fur and a soothingly hypnotic voice. Its appealing appearance allows it to lure in large audiences, which gives it the attention it craves and more food to steal.
author: elfail0

entry: POKENAME clings to humans and other Pokémon to absorb static electricity. Since its fur is luxuriously soft, many dream of being chosen by a POKENAME.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: With its large mouth and elastic body, POKENAME can puff up before releasing extremely loud song-like cries. It's believed it may rival Exploud in reaching dangerously extreme decibel levels.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keep themselves inflated to ensure they have a good grip on whatever surface they roll on. Whenever they inhale too much air, they become overinflated and have a difficult time rolling with the low friction.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often found in Gym battles at the Ballonlea gym. They know numerous tricks and like to show off.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have very elastic bodies and enjoy puffing up and bouncing off of one another. They are an unlikely companion for some Hikers, as their ability to rapidly inflate can be a lifesaver if a Hiker slips and falls down a mountainside.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses music and light to communicate emotions & thought. There is evidence that each color of light conveys a different emotion, but the theory has never been proven.
author: giggity._.

entry: POKENAME uses music and light to communicate emotions & thought. There is evidence that each color of light conveys a different emotion, but the theory has never been proven.
author: giggity._.

entry: POKENAME enters a fighting stance when someone falls asleep to its song, waiting patiently for them to wake up before delivering a powerful punch. It uses this tactic as a playful but strategic move during battles.
author: .izik

entry: This generous Pokémon loves sharing the perfect apples that grow on its back. New apples quickly grow back after the old ones are picked.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME have a large chest cavity that expands whenever they take a breath in. When they exhale, they release a flurry of snow that chills whatever it touches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its vocal cords are fully operational. If you hear a baby crying while exploring a cave, think twice before following the sound.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fur is extremely soft and can make anyone feel happy just by touching it. If it finds someone feeling down, it has a tendency to nuzzle them until they feel better.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite how soft POKENAME's scales are, it is recommended not to pet them as they cause severe skin irritation on contact. Its wingbeats create an oddly soothing melody that has been recorded to help people fall asleep.
author: mistymagius

entry: The sorbet-like top of POKENAME emits a sweet pistachio scent. If that fails to lure prey, it unleashes a deep bellowing song that puts them to sleep instantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's ears are finely tuned to vibrations beneath the ground, alerting it to approaching predators. Digging through thick mud dulls its hearing considerably.
author: .izik

entry: While singing, POKENAME's rubbery body coils around foes. As they fall asleep, it slowly pulls them beneath the ground.
author: .izik

entry: Its meowing sounds are unique. This is because each POKENAME has its own pitch, height and tone length, which can vary greatly in some cases.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can puff up each of its body parts to many times their normal size. It is a popular circus attraction and especially popular with children.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME suck in air into their stomach so that they can sing for long periods of time. When they inhale and hold their breath, sometimes they forget to release the air and give themselves headaches from the lack of fresh air.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME makes for a favorable companion, especially for frequently stressed individuals. Touching its fur has been shown to have therapeutic effects.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME uses its mind-reading abilities to sense someone's favorite song, then tries to mimic it. This ability allows it to resonate with its opponents, making them feel more connected or distracted.
author: .izik

entry: Wielding two microphones, it sings a different kind of song into either depending on its mood. In battle, it sings into both to cause powerful sound waves from the harsh feedback.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's inflatable body gives it the ability to appear as large and muscular as it wants. Those not intimidated by the display will find it does nothing to enhance its actual middling level of physical strength.
author: sk372

entry: One of the first things that POKENAME learn is how to hold their breath. A newly hatched POKENAME can hold their breath for three hours at a time, and this duration grows as they get older.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's fine fur easily picks up dirt, so it often swings from tree branches with its arms to avoid the ground. It tackles foes with crushing hugs while singing, leading the opponent to inevitable unconsciousness.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is covered in a highly coveted, soft fur that it sheds heavily quarterly, when clumps of fur become easily pluckable. Since it rolls everywhere, its habitat is covered in stray tufts of fur caught on the landscape during these seasons.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Since it rolls most places, POKENAME's fur has become matted with dirt and grime to the point of being like armor, shrugging off most direct attacks. It must be guarded by others if the fur is shorn since its body is not used to being unprotected.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a mythical creature that few people, if any, have ever seen. Its mane is said to have the taste and texture of cotton candy.
author: thisisnotaplaceholder

entry: POKENAME can sing for hours at a time with a single breath. The majority of their shell is hollow to give them space to store air.
author: quackquackattack

entry: All three of POKENAME's heads sing a melancholic lullaby, harmonizing in eerie unison. Those who hear it are quickly lulled into a deep, dreamless sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shows affection by putting someone in its mouth, which can be misunderstood as devouring. Seemingly, nothing can end its pain and suffering.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Its innate ability to blast streams of water also allows POKENAME to gargle water if its throat is ever sore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Each section of POKENAME's body is as soft as a pillow, and due to this, small children and Pokémon are often seen resting their heads on POKENAME's tails.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME often accompanies nurses at hospitals. After lulling patients to sleep, it sings a healing song that can cure any ailment.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME often accompanies nurses at hospitals. After lulling patients to sleep, it sings a healing song that can cure any ailment.
author: noel5229

entry: Its innate ability to blast streams of water also allows POKENAME to gargle water if its throat is ever sore.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is often used by underground DJs, as their loud boomboxes go beyond any legal decibel limit. They can generate volumes of up to 180 dB.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is often used by underground DJs, as their loud boomboxes go beyond any legal decibel limit. They can generate volumes of up to 180 dB.
author: chorb33

entry: It spits an odd assortment of seeds on any empty soil it finds. The seeds are from an unknown source and can become many different plants.
author: .izik

entry: The dust from its antennae is used in salves for burns. Its smell resembles a combination of Belue Berries and White Apricorns.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME prepare for metamorphosis, they close their buds and harden their shells. Just before they emerge, they open their buds again to absorb energy for the last push.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME can survive on photosynthesis alone, but to evolve they need the energy from the nectar of flowers. They usually are passive and do not mind humans, but will aggressively protect their young using clouds of poisonous pollen.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME gets frustrated when something covers it from the sunlight. If it is another plant, it flies up and cuts it, to later see if the leaves can be used as a seam or a blanket to lie more comfortably.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME are easy prey for wild bird Pokémon. They are lucky to survive long enough for evolution.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's breeding habitats are swamps, but they can live in many environments since they digest plants and meat, break shells, and photosynthesize. The only limiting factors for their territories are temperature or competition.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME are easy prey for wild bird Pokémon. They are lucky to survive long enough for evolution.
author: theartemis1

entry: As soon as they evolve, POKENAME will seek a calm place where it can camouflage itself until ready to evolve. It can't do much against evolved bird and insect Pokémon, but it can ward off small threats with puffs of irritant pollen.
author: lucioleuh

entry: The plant life on its body has a sleek coating to prevent it from burning. Newborn POKENAME do not have this coating, however, leading to accidents.
author: typhloquil

entry: In the morning, POKENAME flies to the tree tops to bask in the sun. After that, POKENAME peck each other to try to eat each other's seeds.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME slinks through the underbrush in search of roots and nuts. The seeds it brings to its burrow often turn into trees before they're eaten.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME thrives near wetlands, where it absorbs nutrients from the watercress growing around it. At night, it hoots softly while spreading its pollen to strengthen nearby plant life.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's appearance is deceptive, as contrary to common belief, it is the natural predator of small Bug-types. Due to its small size, POKENAME is also prey, mainly for bird Pokémon.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME's small and light body helps them to fly. Unfortunately, they struggle to control their flight path.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's bud will only open when its overcome with joy, releasing a sweet scent that also makes others happy. During the springtime, groups of POKENAME can be seen happily bouncing around flower fields.
author: mistymagius

entry: The stem beneath POKENAME's bud is surprisingly strong, resembling the durability of bamboo. This Pokémon grows in clusters, supporting other Pokémon that build nests within its leaves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME thrives in sunlit meadows, where it absorbs energy from flowers. It flits between blossoms, spreading cheer with its gentle movements.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's seeds resemble tiny cashews, packed with energy-rich nutrients. Wild Pokémon often seek them out, but its tough outer shell makes them difficult to crack open.
author: .izik

entry: The presence of POKENAME splashing in waterfalls is a strong sign of a healthy ecosystem, as they are highly sensitive to environmental changes. Conservationists use their sightings to gauge the success of rewilding and restoration efforts.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The presence of POKENAME splashing in waterfalls is a strong sign of a healthy ecosystem, as they are highly sensitive to environmental changes. Conservationists use their sightings to gauge the success of rewilding and restoration efforts.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The presence of POKENAME splashing in waterfalls is a strong sign of a healthy ecosystem, as they are highly sensitive to environmental changes. Conservationists use their sightings to gauge the success of rewilding and restoration efforts.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Pokémon researchers initially believed POKENAME to be a regional variant of Ivysaur native to Sinnoh. A detailed analysis of their pollen and the enzymes in their flower's nectar revealed them to be their own distinct species.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have been spotted in groups, giving strange messages. Each time one of these messages have been deciphered, they turned out to be gardening tips.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME's movements are accompanied by a soft rattle, warning others of its approach. This sound, though faint, helps it maintain its personal space among wild Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: During the day, POKENAME lifts its tail up to photosynthesize sunlight, and during the night it buries the tail into the dirt to absorb nutrients. It rarely moves to do anything else.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are agile despite their imposing size and slow movements. Their soft bodies can bend a lot, and their tendrils can grasp high spots and lift the rest of the body. In the wild, they may uproot trees by accident while climbing on them.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME behaves well as long as it receives a good dose of morning sunlight each day. If denied its daily sunbeams, it turns surly and squawks grumpily at anything that comes near.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME still loves sunlight, but the closer it gets to evolving, the harder it is to photosynthesize. Sometimes, it catches berries inside its claw and spends days digesting them.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME rolls to where the sun is brightest. Touching its coating of spores elicits a burning feeling similar to poison oak.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: In the warmer months, POKENAME closes its bud and becomes less active. Once the cooler months return, the flower blooms and spreads a snow-like pollen as it scurries around.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's petals exude a cooling eucalyptus aroma that soothes those nearby. It sways gracefully in the wind, releasing calming spores into the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME create vines to connect their horns together, completing the circuit in their bodies and encasing themselves in electricity. They grow sprouts from their bodies to extend the range of their electricity during battle.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's leaves release a faint smoky scent, resembling burning charcoal. When threatened, it emits embers from its petals to deter attackers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can subsist on sunlight and dirt alone; however, they need to graze to produce milk. Their milk is very sweet and somewhat reminiscent of nectar, but since they produce at most a glass of it per day, they aren't widespread as livestock.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME is very sturdy besides its appearance. It likes to sit in cracks of cliffs, where it can slowly grow in safety.
author: ayutac

entry: POKENAME keeps a Miracle Seed tucked safely in the pouch on its belly, carefully nourishing it each day with sunlight. A gentle soul by nature, it avoids fighting whenever possible.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME keeps an Oran Berry tucked safely in the pouch on its belly, carefully nourishing it each day with sunlight. A gentle soul by nature, it avoids fighting whenever possible.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When it absorbs enough sunlight, it releases a fragrant aroma with soothing properties. If someone tries to touch it, POKENAME attempts to ward them off with gentle electric discharges.
author: fiordaliso

entry: One can usually find POKENAME at an oasis in the desert, where it will sit, content, soaking in the water for as long as it can.
author: roxie5228

entry: POKENAME is a calm and relaxed Pokémon that thrives in the clearings of a forest. Its fluffy tail often collects pollen and spores, allowing it to fertilize even faraway flowers and other flora.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Groups of POKENAME are seen huddling together when winter comes. When faced with danger, POKENAME scatter pollen before teleporting away to safety.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME gathers the positive emotions of others to stimulate its growth. If surrounded by emotional negativity, it may become sick.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The sap seeping from POKENAME's stem has a milky, toxic consistency similar to milkweed. Herbivores that attempt to eat it experience numbness in their mouths.
author: .izik

entry: It prefers damp soil and spends hours gnawing bark from flowering trees, staining its fur with pollen. Some forest paths are lined with their half-finished dams and sprouting footprints.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME cuddle as a group in rich soil to protect each other from a cold snap. If another Pokémon tries to feed on it, POKENAME springs from the ground and latches on with its jaw, absorbing nutrients from the attacker.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME cuddle as a group in rich soil to protect each other from a cold snap. If another Pokémon tries to feed on it, POKENAME springs from the ground and latches on with its jaw, absorbing nutrients from the attacker.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Extremely sensitive to temperature and light, POKENAME only shows up on warm, dark nights. Its empty eye sockets frighten even the toughest of people and make them cry.
author: soup1900

entry: Easygoing and gentle, POKENAME prefers a relaxed life basking in the sun by clean rivers and streams. It is able to take even highly polluted air and photosynthesize to release tons of fresh oxygen.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a preferred habitat of humid jungles. It constantly emits a scent similar to incense. Despite liking damp environments, it dislikes the rain and will take shelter even when it drizzles.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It has an innate urge to water whatever plant it sees. It will even ignore its Trainer to run off to water flowers. When it forms an unbreakable bond, the bud at the top of its head starts to bloom.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When threatened, POKENAME releases pollen from its grassy fur. This pollen causes foes to hallucinate, disorienting them long enough for POKENAME to escape.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is a popular pet choice among plant lovers. It feeds on sunlight and fresh water, has a discreet sweet smell, and shows the spots with the best sunlight. However, it isn't very playful and mainly shows affection by smiling at its Trainer.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME hang underneath tree branches using their twin vines, illuminating the area with their glowing bodies. Their bodies are hot to the touch due to the amount of energy needed to keep them glowing.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is extremely shy and hides in shady undergrowth or under flower fields. If it were braver, it could develop more quickly, as it needs sunlight to thrive.
author: chorb33

entry: Nearing the vibrant tags on its head instills an eerie sense of dread. It's believed that your wish will come true if you can manage to steal one.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: When exposed to an abundance of water and sunlight, POKENAME will continuously grow in size until evolution.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME can be found leeching off tree trunks via a sharp siphon on its back, with the organic matter of the bark fueling small boilers within POKENAME. Scientists still debate the biological purpose of POKENAME's ceaseless turning.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME grow and develop far faster than unfused Budew, a quirk of the fusion process causing them to grow extra flower buds as they age. They have an earthy scent to them from all the nutrients they absorb from the soil.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME grow and develop far faster than unfused Budew, a quirk of the fusion process causing them to grow extra flower buds as they age. They have an earthy scent to them from all the nutrients they absorb from the soil.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME grow and develop far faster than unfused Budew, a quirk of the fusion process causing them to grow extra flower buds as they age. They have an earthy scent to them from all the nutrients they absorb from the soil.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME releases spores that induce sneezing in anything nearby. These spores drift harmlessly through the air, acting as both a defense mechanism and a playful prank.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lets loose small bolts of electricity into the water to sterilize it. After this, it dips its body into the water to absorb it and grow.
author: .izik

entry: It absorbs metals and minerals from nearby soil, incorporating them into its skin and spines. It becomes heavier and slower as winter approaches, eventually going dormant once it becomes too heavy to move.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME releases a warm, floral scent that soothes nearby Pokémon. This fragrance intensifies as it moves, making it a beacon of tranquility in blooming fields.
author: .izik

entry: It prefers to eat leaves that have fallen off of maple trees. The darker brown the leaf is, the more desirable it is to a POKENAME.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's leaves are coated in a fine, frost-like dust that smells faintly of fir trees. It thrives in cold environments, where its icy sap protects it from freezing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gains energy through photosynthesis, so it loves sunny days. It practices kicks and dances so it can one day cheer on its allies.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME emits an unsettling presence despite its delicate appearance. It sways rhythmically, leaving others unsure whether to be entranced or unnerved.
author: .izik

entry: The preservative chemical used in Joy Scent can only be extracted from the saliva of a POKENAME. While effective in Joy Scent, it has no noticeable effect when combined with Excite Scent or Vivid Scent.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The preservative chemical used in Joy Scent can only be extracted from the saliva of a POKENAME. While effective in Joy Scent, it has no noticeable effect when combined with Excite Scent or Vivid Scent.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME produces a distinct aroma that lingers long after it passes by. This scent attracts other Pokémon, though not all are pleased by its pungency.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a very rare Pokémon that can be spotted at night, caring for those sleeping in forests. Campers regularly report seeing a POKENAME in a dream despite not knowing it existed before.
author: lucioleuh

entry: The skin of POKENAME excretes a highly flammable oil, mainly at the tip of the tail, where a flame is kept lit at all times. During battle, it can shoot said oil to its foes from the bud on its head.
author: lucioleuh

entry: It seeks out yellow flowers due to its affinity for gold. Due to this, its den is usually filled with sunflowers, dandelions and daffodils.
author: .izik

entry: The arms of POKENAME are wrapped around the bulb on their head, which makes scratching itches difficult. Since the bulb on their head has yet to bloom, they have few remedies for the headaches they experience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is very sensitive to temperature. When winter comes, it dives beneath the surface of a lake until it can enjoy the summer sun again.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: When they are submerged below the surface in the reeds, their tails stick up against bundles of lemongrass. This occasionally leads gatherers to sever their tail without meaning to do so.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stores electricity in its small buds, which it uses to defend itself. It latches onto power cords in order to absorb energy.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME uses the aroma of their incense to calm other Pokémon. Once this is done, they open their bud and absorb their positive emotions with it.
author: ayner

entry: When POKENAME feels threatened, it shakes the buds on its hand to release puffs of itchy pollen. It prefers to live in areas with plenty of sun and clean water.
author: mepp.

entry: Various bouquets of flowers, from red roses to violet mallow, are collected together around the central core of a POKENAME. It avoids bug-infested areas of the forest, as they produce a naturally sweet scent.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If bested in battle, POKENAME must gift a petal from their non-dominant hand as a sign of respect. They are only considered elders once their hand is visible through the petals.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's tentacles are as flimsy as cabbage but snap like cucumbers. They regrow quickly, making it both a reliable food source and a surprisingly tasty snack.
author: jaminmcready

entry: As POKENAME drifts gently over flower fields, it scatters a shimmering powder from its wings. This dust protects blossoms from pests, making the Pokémon highly valued by gardeners as a natural helper.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lures its enemies into a trap with its roses and slashes them with its scythes. It flies at high speed and leaves a trail of fragrance that disappears in a blink after a few moments.
author: epping_forest

entry: It distracts enemies by scattering pollen from its wings. The wings of POKENAME who are raised by kind Trainers are more vibrant and aromatic.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME's rose hides a toxic spike. Many novice gardeners are sent to the emergency room by this Pokémon.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME has spent many days in rich springwater to grow its massive body and flowers. It uses its hulking size to scare off violent Pokémon, but it avoids battling.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: POKENAME's body is wrapped in thick vines that help it camouflage from predators. Despite being covered in thorns, they are not very sharp and are safe to touch.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's white roses are symbols of love and nobility and are commonly owned by elite Trainers. They go out of their way to defend weaker Pokémon, especially ones of the opposite gender.
author: mistymagius

entry: The flower upon this Pokémon's rear contains a strong-smelling pollen that attracts many bug Pokémon. When startled, its flower will fully pop open and scatter countless Cotton Spores before it skitters away.
author: infinex21

entry: In the early morning, the flowers on POKENAME's tail emit a strong sweet scent. Some believe that inhaling this aroma enough times in life will awaken psychic powers in one's mind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME grow elaborately petaled flowers on their backs that give off a complex fragrance dependent on their flower's colouration. Pink flowered POKENAME produce a sickly sweet smell that draw Pokémon with a sweet tooth.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Underneath the rose buds hide POKENAME's poisonous claws. They can frequently be seen jumping from tree branches, ambushing prey by stabbing them with their toxic thorns.
author: mistymagius

entry: This snooty Pokémon secretly seeks out the affection of a devoted Trainer. It gifts flower petals to those who feed it delicious berries.
author: ozydamians

entry: Sassy by nature, it will try to intimidate any aggressor by flaunting its rose-pincers.  If that fails, it'll fire thorns from them at high speeds.
author: leeto64

entry: The leaves on its body are extremely tough and act as protective armor in battle. Male POKENAME frequently engage in combat to woo the females with the prettiest plumage.
author: mistymagius

entry: Found in places that can get lots of snow, POKENAME naturally takes care of crops and Berries to help new ones bloom before the winter season. It rolls in wet mud to stay cool.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its leaf-like wings are as sharp as steel, able to slice through trees with ease. Despite this, POKENAME is very friendly and allows other Pokémon to pollinate the flowers on its feet.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon practices graceful darts and twirls, all in an effort to improve its abilities to dodge and ambush. It longs for the day it evolves.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's vibrant patterns can shift hues depending on their mood: reds indicate aggressiveness and blues indicate loneliness. These mood swings are more frequent in the spring.
author: teatedtiten

entry: As it rolls around, it spreads a layer of allergy-inducing spores. The dirt where POKENAME burrows will grow lush flora over time.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a bit haughty and will harshly smack any that come too close with the heavy flowers on its tail. As a consolation, being struck will leave the victim smelling pleasantly floral for a few hours.
author: sk372

entry: A popular Pokémon during the spring season. POKENAME playfully dance around flower fields, emitting a scent that makes Trainers uncontrollably happy.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are beloved for the variety of scents produced by the flowers on their head. The scent changes with their emotions.
author: cobalt0135

entry: The flowers on POKENAME's hands bloom beautifully when it is surrounded by positive emotions. It spends its day relaxing in sunny meadows.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is known for its benevolent nature and ability to sense the emotions of others. To those experiencing sadness, it kindly offers beautiful flowers to improve their mood.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spends most of the time grooming itself, chewing off the sharp thorns that grow in its fur. If it thinks its roses aren't pretty enough, it will collect other flowers to decorate itself with.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are favored by stage magicians. It can pop out through any object and audience members are amazed.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME grow elaborately petaled flowers on their backs that give off a complex fragrance dependent on their flower's colouration. Blue flowered POKENAME produce a subtle earthy smell that is reminiscent of petrichor.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME grow elaborately petaled flowers on their backs that give off a complex fragrance dependent on their flower's colouration. Rarely, POKENAME sprout multiple of these flowers, their scent that of an entire bouquet.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The roses on POKENAME's head are beautiful, but underneath the vibrant petals are hidden thorns filled with poison-laced sap. The venom on each flower is unique and different from the other.
author: _._starry_._

entry: POKENAME produces nectar from its roses and usually allows pollinators to safely sip from the flowers. When it is hungry, POKENAME will produce more potent nectar from the trap mouth, which snaps up inquisitive Pokémon until full.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lure in their prey of Bug-type Pokémon by waving their six beautiful flowers. They drink clean springwater to give these flowers their enticing aroma.
author: pizzarcato

entry: When in danger, the flowers on its arms spread their petals and the flame on its tail radiates intensely all in order to make it seem more threatening. In addition, its normally pleasant scent turns sour and strong.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME reside in oases and hide amongst the foliage. Its flowers release a pleasant and relaxing aroma when it is healthy.
author: estrellafruit

entry: POKENAME are renowned for the relaxing fragrances they exude. Their bodies are extremely sensitive to pollution, so some researchers believe their numbers in the wild are at risk.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME releases soothing scents from its head and tail to subdue enemies. It then attacks with its thorn covered fists.
author: mepp.

entry: The bicolored flower atop POKENAME's head glows due to a flame flickering inside. It loiters in flower gardens, leeching the life force of passersby.
author: chibitales

entry: The roses that form its tail emit a tantalizing scent. But watch out! If anyone gets too close to them, POKENAME can emit devastating flames from the flowers!
author: chorb33

entry: The flowers that form its tail are heat-resistant. In these, it converts solar energy into hot fire to protect itself. Although POKENAME is not harmless to handle, it is very popular with many Trainers.
author: chorb33

entry: These lazy Pokémon can be seen lounging around large forests, slowly gnawing on flowers. The flower on POKENAME's neck releases a relaxing scent that smells like a mixture of roses and pinewood.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can detect the emotions of anything that touches the pollen it scatters, even from miles away.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can detect the emotions of anything that touches the pollen it scatters, even from miles away.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The flowers that form its tail are heat-resistant. In these, it converts solar energy into hot fire to protect itself. Although POKENAME is not harmless to handle, it is very popular with many Trainers.
author: chorb33

entry: As POKENAME spins, it releases a rose-like scent. While pleasant, this aroma signals that it is ready to strike any creature that gets too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can have different appearances based on location and favorite flower. Some theorize this Pokémon reproduces by putting spores in old gears.
author: totodile.

entry: When POKENAME is happy, the buds on its ears release a pleasant scent often used in perfumes. Its fur coat hides sharp thorns that make it unpleasant to hug.
author: mistymagius

entry: Far in the past, POKENAME would travel through small towns spreading seeds and dancing. The townsfolk would keep some of the seeds as good luck charms and jewelry.
author: big_clanker

entry: Groups of these Pokémon can be seen attached to trees and bushes, slowly spinning to produce energy. When threatened, they concentrate this energy in their rose buds to unleash a powerful laser.
author: mistymagius

entry: As POKENAME drifts along the breeze, it drops colorful flower petals. People often collect these petals, believing that gathering enough brings eternal love.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has poor vision, and uses its tusks to root around the ground for fresh soil and roots to nourish itself. A well-fed POKENAME emits a pleasant and calming aroma from its flowers.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME flies, its wings spread a strong pollen that helps flowers grow. People with allergies should stay away from areas where large groups of POKENAME can be found.
author: mistymagius

entry: If you don't take good care of your garden, it may become infested with POKENAME. Its "eyes" mimic flowers in order to lure in potential prey.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME is always stationary to avoid damaging the delicate flowers on its body. Its horns are laced with a strong poison that can be deadly when touched.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME charges through dense vegetation, scattering pollen from the blooming buds on its tail. It uses this trail of pollen to lure Bug-type Pokémon into ambushes deep within the jungle.
author: eiskitsune

entry: Groups of POKENAME can be seen sleeping on sunny days to draw energy from the sun. The healthier POKENAME is, the sweeter the scent from its flowers becomes.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is said that lost spirits take root within malevolent Roselia until they grow into POKENAME. These creatures scare people lost in the woods, seeking revenge for the destruction of nature.
author: altius

entry: Lovers will opt to buy a POKENAME instead of a Small Bouquet for dates, as a Pokémon lasts much longer. Some people say that gardeners can tell how well a relationship is based on how healthy their POKENAME is.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's weak wings make it almost impossible for it to fly. When threatened, it will frantically flap its wings, spreading the irritating pollen from its flowers.
author: mistymagius

entry: The flowers on POKENAME's tail shift in color depending on the time of day. From sunset 'til midnight, the blue flower turns red and vice versa; from sunrise 'til noon, the colors return to their original shades.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bush growing from POKENAME's back has soft, inviting leaves. Swablu and Pidgey rest in it, often gifting Apricorns in gratitude afterward.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME living in healthy soil display the most beautiful flowers. While digging, their blossoms close, and they use the buds as makeshift shovels to help with their burrowing.
author: pizzarcato

entry: POKENAME constantly release petals from the flowers on their hands. Whenever they experience a headache, they put their face into their flowers to calm themselves down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The larger the thorns on POKENAME's head, the more powerful its poison it produces. Groups of POKENAME can be seen in flower gardens, feeding on small bug Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is a thing of beauty and can be seen playfully galloping around flower fields. The flames on its body curiously cannot burn other plant life.
author: mistymagius

entry: Because it is extremely shy, POKENAME keeps both of its heads hidden within the beautiful rose petals that surround its faces. It can produce an irresistible fragrance used to distill high-end perfumes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: As POKENAME tunnels beneath forests, its flower-covered segments churn the soil into fertile beds. Villagers say lush gardens always seem to sprout over the paths it's traveled.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The air inside its body smells faintly of moldy basil. This odd aroma lingers for up to 3 hours wherever it drifts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a spirit that yearns to be a world champion. It has taken this determination and put it towards being the best balloon seller there is.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Sometimes the nauseating gases it emits from its rubbery skin make a humorous sound. Rumours suggest that POKENAME's internal gases are made up of the souls of toxic people.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The gas POKENAME emits is thought to be the spiritual essence of people. Legends say that POKENAME drifts around in search of souls to keep it afloat.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME's shell is incredibly hard despite it being less dense than air. When this Pokémon is ready to hatch from its pod, it will violently burst apart, leaving a shocking aftermath.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It propels itself through the air using gas collected from decomposing garbage. If it bursts, the gas finds a new balloon and POKENAME is reborn.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME is frequently mistaken for trash and flees from people and Pokémon who want to pick it up. It releases quick bursts of air to make its escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Just like Drifloon, POKENAME likes to take children away. It carries them to kids-eat-free restaurants to trick them into giving it free food.
author: llamawiz34

entry: POKENAME floats lazily above rivers, scanning for prey like Caterpie. Once it spots one, it wraps its thread-like limbs around it and drags it away to its nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sneaks into the nests of other Pokémon, curling up next to their eggs while they sleep. Its warm, rubbery body helps the eggs mature faster.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME expels a thick mist as it drifts over brooks, blending into the fog. If it senses danger, it releases powerful jets of water to push threats away.
author: .izik

entry: Its tail fills with gas, allowing it to float up to 300 feet above the ground. This altitude gives it a wide view of its surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever a life is lost near POKENAME, its head expands, absorbing the energy. This seems to greatly upset it, and it emits a sorrowful wail, jumping up high into the air, and does not come down for days.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Whenever a life is lost near POKENAME, the Drifloon expands, absorbing the energy, and the Wooper shrinks. This seems to greatly upset it, and it emits a sorrowful wail, jumping up high into the air, and does not come down for days.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its rubbery form bounces through mountainous areas as it travels. This unique motion helps it cover rough terrain with ease.
author: .izik

entry: Like Drifloon, it's in POKENAME's nature to lure and abduct children. However, given it can only float a few feet off the ground, almost all children escape its grasp.
author: nakamagic

entry: If a POKENAME appears near a community, children are quickly ushered inside due to its dangerous cords. A single tug on these cords can cause a massive explosion, and as a result, POKENAME often reside in and around ghost towns.
author: faeflame

entry: POKENAME floats near the windows of children at night, making scary faces to startle them. It listens carefully, searching for the softest cry before attempting to steal the child away.
author: .izik

entry: They hunt for lost souls in coordinated packs. To keep tabs on each other, they let out spectral howls that only they can hear.
author: ariamelisma

entry: Its howls filled with profound melancholy can be heard in the hour before dawn. Those who do hear it find themselves deeply moved.
author: ariamelisma

entry: Unlike Drifloon that are known for stealing children away, POKENAME make great companions. POKENAME can often be found floating around carnivals in groups and playing with families.
author: odditylad

entry: Sometimes POKENAME take on the colouring of a Phanpy instead of a Drifloon. It is not known why, however, these variants tend to be even more popular with kids.
author: odditylad

entry: POKENAME are fragile creatures that need the help of Colbur Berries to defend themselves against Dark-type Pokémon. When they are not searching for berries, they lure children into forests to kidnap them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sprouts balloon-like objects from its back to float over cliffs. These balloons are insulated from its electric discharges, and it can generate up to four at a time, adjusting their number based on how far it needs to travel.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME senses a fight beneath it as it flies, it swoops down and uses its feelers to ensnare and carry one of the combatants far away, believing that separating them will solve whatever problem caused the strife.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME seems to have a vendetta against flying objects, balloons in particular. If it spots one, it cannot resist the impulse to pop it with its claws.
author: sk372

entry: Ectoplasm from POKENAME is used in home remedies to decrease fever. Rumored to be sensitive toward the terminally ill, it actively seeks out hospitals to help the patients.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are hollow bodies, only filled with helium. They will float around the world until death, when they will slowly decompose.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's hollow body fills with toxic gas when it senses danger. It is light enough to use this gas to float over vast distances, avoiding conflict whenever possible.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wanders abandoned libraries and museums, tidying rooms and keeping them clean with its psychic power. It relaxes and falls asleep when an area is clean, as it no longer fears scolding from its former masters.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The sandbag holding POKENAME keeps it from floating for long periods of time. This causes POKENAME frustration.
author: ohok3441

entry: Its body slowly petrifies, making it progressively heavier and only able to fly by expending a great deal of energy.
author: chorb33

entry: Poisonous gas seeps from POKENAME's rubbery body through its ears. It controls its movement midair by releasing small bursts of this gas in different directions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's form makes it a treasure for children, which it takes advantage of to kidnap them. It fights back like a real sword when caught.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME's form makes it a treasure for children, which it takes advantage of to kidnap them. It fights back like a real sword when caught.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Although POKENAME seems bouncy and blunt, it generates waves of compressed air when swung that are as sharp as any blade. Horrific damage can occur if a child should seize this Pokémon by one of the hilts.
author: .realthree

entry: The heat POKENAME expels from its rubbery body is hot enough to melt silver. In ancient times, artisans used it to help craft delicate jewelry.
author: .izik

entry: They are known to live in abandoned archery ranges, and their elastic skin cannot be penetrated by an arrow from a crossbow. They taunt people to shoot them, as they find the sensation pleasant.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Rumor has it that POKENAME holds the souls of a lost family. The two heads are the parents' spirits, while the lower body holds the childrens'.
author: kittyluv090

entry: There was once a case where a wild POKENAME suddenly came out of nowhere and snatched up a child, only to return them an hour later. According to the child, POKENAME showed them their palace in the clouds. No such habitat for POKENAME has been found.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME attempts to lure children closer to it, who feel that grabbing hold of it will make their wishes come true. It flees as soon as it sees the child's parents, which implies more sinister motives.
author: sk372

entry: This floaty Pokémon uses its whisker-like antennae as arms, stopping itself from blowing away in strong winds.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME will inflate and deflate to generate static electricity, which becomes stored within its thin rubbery skin. Upon being touched, it will emit a sharp static shock.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME will pretend to be a lost kitten in order to lull children into petting it. Once a child does, a sharp static shock stored within its skin will paralyze them and it will drag its victim away into the unknown.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME find other POKENAME to share electricity between their stringy tails, though this ends up with a comical clump of POKENAME unable to untangle themselves from each other. Its mane is thought to be made up of spiritual essence.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: As it gracefully floats through the sky, the gears spin increasingly fast. The resulting noise is a cacophonous mess that can kill small bird Pokémon.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME's ears have turned ghostly, and the once-brutal strikes it delivers have softened considerably. Instead, it uses the cloud-like wisps to deliver subtle doses of stinging energy.
author: glacierwing

entry: POKENAME's gaseous body is filled with a yellow powder that helps it stay aloft. It floats high above the ground, searching for fresh water sources to sustain its kind.
author: .izik

entry: Name fly through the night sky in huge flocks. If attacked, the flock will surround the assailant and carry them off, never to be seen again.
author: staghorn

entry: While floating through the sky, it releases small bolts of lightning. These shocks deter predators and make it an electric spectacle.
author: .izik

entry: It fiercely guards ancient tombs and monoliths from scavengers. Any who dare approach are met with its unyielding defense.
author: .izik

entry: It hangs from the ceilings in caves, letting a string down that looks like an Escape Rope. If a traveler grabs one of its strings by accident, POKENAME will pull them up and drain their vitality.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME are popular among Coast Guards due to their ability to reflect moonlight off their eyes into beams of light, helping them find people lost at sea. Unfortunately, they sometimes need to be reminded to actually bring the people back to shore.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's rubbery body is packed with tiny seeds. As it glides through grassy fields, it scatters them freely, causing entire meadows to sprout overnight.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME raises its balloons to cheer, it's really trying to catch a breeze for traveling. Its heart-shaped weights don't hold it in place well.
author: .realthree

entry: As it dances in the night sky, clouds are drawn toward POKENAME. Those who watch too long fall into a trance, allowing it to lift them into the air and vanish without a trace.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are curious, friendly, and often harmless. Despite this, there are many grisly urban legends surrounding its true origins.
author: staghorn

entry: It appears sluggish when it lets itself be carried by the wind. However, by inflating its head and wings, it can rise into the air and disappear surprisingly quickly.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME is plagued by a constant internal battle. It absorbs energy from both biotic and abiotic sources, with biotic energy making it float and abiotic energy making it sink. This means there is no consistent weight for the species.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Lying on beaches, it absorbs sunlight to warm the air inside its body. When predators approach, it puffs up to appear larger and more intimidating.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in colonies of vast sizes, and once they have claimed an area it is nearly impossible to get them to leave. Using the orbs on their back they float short distances bringing food back to the colony with ease.
author: faeflame

entry: While POKENAME's body looks to be made of rubber, it is more similar to leaves when observed up close. It eats leaves from trees as it floats through forests, purposefuly never chewing on the same tree twice.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME roam around graveyards and cemeteries, committed to protecting the people who rest there. They can be found in groups of three to five, as they take turns keeping vigil against hooligans or troublemakers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When inflated, its antennae become incredibly hot to the touch. This heat acts as both a warning and a defense mechanism.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has rubbery, pants-like skin from the waist down, which it uses to hide itself during lightning storms. It can float safely above the ground, shielded from the electrifying bolts.
author: .izik

entry: Like Drifloon, children are drawn to POKENAME. However, POKENAME actively dislikes being near others and thus is often seen fleeing from children.
author: nakamagic

entry: While floating through city streets, POKENAME uses its long, thread-like limbs to steal wallets from travelers. It lines its nest with these stolen items, seemingly hoarding them as trophies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a tendency to play pranks on children swimming in the sea, which is why it is usually found near beaches or seaside resorts. During violent storms, it risks being swept out of the waves due to its very light body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The humid gas that seeps from POKENAME's body is hotter than a furnace. It uses this intense heat to keep its den warm, even in the coldest environments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's gas-filled body allows it to float on the surface of ponds. It uses its string-like tail to grab at objects hidden beneath the water's surface.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME trains vigorously to strengthen its body. Unfortunately, its body is always lightweight, making it all too easy to be pushed around by strong foes or even strong gusts of wind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats above lush fields, scattering seeds as it drifts. The fast-growing weeds it produces can overrun entire ecosystems within weeks.
author: .izik

entry: Like Drifloon, the white part of POKENAME's body is actually a cloud. Children like to nap on POKENAME's shell as a pillow, which frustrates POKENAME as it is pinned down by the child.
author: nakamagic

entry: Despite resembling an ordinary green balloon, its sword-like leek is incredibly hard and dangerous. It uses this weapon with surprising skill.
author: .izik

entry: The air escaping from its nose induces drowsiness, often used in dental offices to calm patients. Its sleepy scent makes it a curious helper.
author: .izik

entry: Though naive and playful, POKENAME has a notorious reputation for dragging children to play with it in the forests where it lives. It is believed that POKENAME was actually born from the spirits of lost children and still identifies with one of them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME spins silk with a faint carrot-like scent, attracting herbivorous Pokémon. It lines its burrow with the soft strands, creating a warm and fragrant nest.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves atop POKENAME protect the contents of its basket-like head. Only trusted Trainers are allowed to remove the painted eggs it carries.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's powerful legs allow it to hop great distances, even while its outer shell hardens. It often leaps into tree branches to avoid predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats around berry patches gorging on the sweetest fruits it can find due to its extreme sweet tooth. If something spooks it, it billows out a stiflingly sweet cloud of smoke all around it on reflex.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are kind and empathic creatures that are understanding of others, to a fault. Trainers often need to step in to help them act assertively.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME kind and empathic creatures that are understanding of others, to a fault. Trainers often need to step in to help them act assertively.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's ears unfurl as it prepares for battle, a telling sign of its rising aggression. These ears are incredibly powerful, capable of tossing three times its body weight.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME's fluffy tail contains a hidden venomous barb, which it uses only when threatened. It whimpers frequently, lulling foes into a false sense of security.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has unstable energy stored in its body. This energy can be released through its powerful ear attacks, or enhanced with an evolution stone.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME attacks with powerful ear strikes when provoked. In dire circumstances, it hides in its sturdy shell to protect itself.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME eats large amounts of carrots to strengthen its developing shell. The tougher its shell becomes, the more confidently it faces predators.
author: .izik

entry: If properly fed, POKENAME will form an unbreakable bond with its Trainer. Any danger posed to its partner will be flattened and pummeled by its extendable ears.
author: lampent12

entry: POKENAME is a timid Pokémon that will immediately flee at the sight of strangers. It lives in the coldest and most remote mountain ranges and uses its own shed fur as lining in its nest.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME prefers to burrow near swift waterfalls, shedding there every day. If an intruder comes into its burrow, it coils its body before springing forward to knock the intruder unconscious.
author: torterraguy26

entry: The red eggs that POKENAME drops are said to symbolize new life. Because of that, they're eaten at many festive celebrations.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME builds its nest near cauliflower fields, hiding within the pale stalks. Farmers often find it peacefully resting among the plants at dawn.
author: .izik

entry: The fluff surrounding POKENAME's lower half acts as a sound-dampener, allowing it to move about unheard. It is much less skilled at staying unseen.
author: strawbearycandy

entry: The thick fur growing off its body smells like a carrot-based stew. It stores static electricity in this fur, which helps it deliver powerful shocks when needed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has long ears that extend forward to strike opponents. Its tail stabilizes its footing, ensuring it does not get knocked over.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME jabs at its opponents with its ears, which have enough strength to break rocks. It also unnerves opponents with its cuteness, and grooms itself to ensure it always appears cute.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The leaves on its head release a strong aroma while it floats. The smell is reminiscent of carrot cake and cloves.
author: .izik

entry: It escapes danger by extending its ears to launch into treetops, then swinging away on branches with its tail. In the rare event that it needs to fight, its ears pack a stronger punch than any of its hands.
author: bacondlx

entry: When POKENAME senses danger, it perks up its ears. It searches wide areas for food.
author: the_fireplace

entry: POKENAME are said to drive people insane by producing hallucinations of cute, long-eared Pokémon. Once a person is out of range, the hallucinations fade away without a trace.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME takes a defensive stance whenever it senses danger, raising its ears to appear larger. It has an imposing presence, though it is often timid in nature.
author: .izik

entry: Because of its adorably cute appearance, POKENAME is often gifted to young girls as a companion Pokémon. If it starts losing a battle, it bursts into tears to make its opponent feel guilty.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Very skittish and easily startled, POKENAME is not easy to befriend. They tend to only trust one person at a time.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME lobs its heavy tail at opponents when it is in a fight. Its tail is deceptively heavy and can knock out small Pokémon with a hit or two.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's favorite food are Poffins. After getting a Trainer to drop their guard with their cute act, they grab the Poffin case with their ears and awkwardly hop away.
author: lampent12

entry: Though POKENAME appears small and cute, its ears pack a devastating punch. At full power, they can shatter rocks with ease.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME gets lonely easily and needs constant companionship to feel at ease. It will get very antsy if it goes even an hour without at least holding someone's hand.
author: sk372

entry: With a combination of thick wool and a sturdy shell, POKENAME have powerful defenses They prefer eating cottonweeds and cattail plants.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME nests in the hollow of an old oak, using fallen leaves to line its home. It always knows its way back, no matter how far it wanders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is extremely difficult to get along with. It will release any frustrations it harbors on the nearby environment, leveling them back to a barren, earthen state. Scientists are unsure of the reason behind the carrot-shaped designs on its body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The only way to calm an enraged POKENAME is to pet it. If a Trainer stops petting it before it calms down, POKENAME will wrap its arms around them and suffocate them as an everlasting hug.
author: teatedtiten

entry: When an envious Mimikyu fused with Buneary, it created POKENAME. If POKENAME does not receive affection, it will replace the cotton on its ears.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME beguile Trainers into giving them treats by staring at them with their Baby-Doll Eyes. They stop Trainers from petting their fur if they refuse to give them a treat first.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Incredibly slothful, POKENAME sleeps for 20 hours a day and only wakes to eat. Its ears coil as it sleeps and can spring out suddenly with enough power to punch a hole through a tree trunk.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME collects discarded armor pieces from evolved Aron. It wears this armor to protect its soft, vulnerable body from predators.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME sheds delicate tufts of fur as it hops, leaving fuzzy trails behind. The tufts are said to bring luck to those who collect them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME extends its ears to shatter large boulders along steep mountain paths. Its thick fur protects it during harsh blizzards so it can continue training.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME hides among beech trees, using the forest canopy as a natural shield. Its light and bouncy movements make it difficult to track.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spreads dandelion seeds as it hops, leaving trails of fluffy spores in its wake. These seeds drift gently through the air, carried far and wide by the breeze.
author: .izik

entry: The tusks of a POKENAME are much too small to be used effectively in battle. Instead, it uses them to loosen tufts of fur, much like a person would use a brush or comb.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME thrives in marshy areas, hopping between patches of mud and water. It generates faint electrical pulses, which help it detect movement in the murky environment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides gems in its thick fur. It also has a strange affinity for plush toys. Scientists say its third ear is caused by a genetic mutation.
author: themicelegion

entry: In addition to the striking speed at which POKENAME can flee from predators, each of its cotton-like tufts can lash out with a dizzying punch. Their fur makes the softest pillows.
author: wormspawn

entry: POKENAME is naturally aggressive, disagreeable, and single-minded, and rampages if it doesn't get exactly what it wants. If it feels even remotely upset, it will take its anger out on its Trainer; when it properly appreciates them, it evolves.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are affectionate by nature. They try their best to befriend Trainers despite their uncanny appearance.
author: ohok3441

entry: People have found POKENAME's hollow face to be frightening. Recently, a fictional story about a haunted POKENAME became infamous online.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's fur is full of nearly microscopic ice crystals, keeping their temperature low. Hot weather makes them sluggish.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME grows small flowers along its ears, which it uses to attract friendly Pokémon. These blossoms release a sweet scent, spreading joy wherever it hops.
author: .izik

entry: It makes its home in patches of wild carrots. During sunrise, it will make a chirp reminiscent of a doorbell.
author: .izik

entry: Children often mistake POKENAME for a plush toy. It seems to enjoy the attention it gets this way.
author: pokebio

entry: The petals of the flowers on its body are filled with tiny barbed thorns. Should a petal touch bare skin, it will require a physician to be safely removed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's movements are fluid, letting it weave effortlessly through desert landscapes. It uses this agility to outmaneuver predators and dodge obstacles with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME adorns itself with seaweed to blend in along the shore. It buries small treasures in the sand, guarding them fiercely from curious Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grows and plants mushrooms from its back that have a distinctly fuzzy look and texture to them. Though adult Pokémon find the taste repulsive, young Pokémon adore snacking on POKENAME's shrooms.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME makes for an excellent companion; it has a playful nature and is extremely loyal. Its soft fur is actually made of very thin rock crystals that are spun out into fibres.
