author: katieplaysgames

entry: In times of hungry desperation, POKENAME will eat the carrots growing in its mane, though it prefers to eat Stantler.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is said to have the cutest and most beautiful voice in the world. Unfortunately, its shy nature prevents it from properly singing.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: While POKENAME may not seem threatening at first, but their deleterious spores cause muscle weakness on contact. The swooning that occurs after a person hugs a POKENAME is caused by the spores and not because of excitement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During the summer, POKENAME gleefully scatter their spare fluff to celebrate the warmer weather. Farmers collect the fluff that drifts down streams to weave into gloves and scarves for winter.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Curling and uncurling its ears lets it create a different pitch of sound when it expels smoke from its nostrils. POKENAME will "sing" to others using this ability when it feels content.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME looks sweet, but it has a vindictive streak. Its strong back legs increase the slashing power of its hidden claws when it takes its revenge.
author: .realthree

entry: If POKENAME does not eat carrots regularly, it develops intense headaches. It is often seen rubbing its temples when deprived of its favorite food.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME leaps between birch trees with great agility, using branches to propel itself forward. It prefers solitude, though it will defend its territory with fierce energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is said to bring nightmares to those it encounters while sleeping. It prefers to remain hidden, stirring up trouble only when it feels threatened.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body contains compounds that can reduce fevers in both Pokémon and humans. It hops around forests in search of herbs, always ready to prepare a remedy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME travels by rolling, then launching itself using its powerful ears. For this reason, hikers must be cautious around steep hills and cliffs.
author: lazyarcanist

entry: Should it be startled, POKENAME will shed portions of its fluff. The fluff itself has a mild adhesive and sticks to most surfaces.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's shells protect their soft bodies. Their excess fur tangles up persistent foes.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's pendulum invokes feelings of joy in others, and can calm even a rampaging Tauros. It is beloved for its friendly temperament and soft fur.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME's bulb puffs out small clouds of spores that are quite dangerous to breathe in. However, the mushrooms that spawn from these spores are actually quite beneficial to the local ecosystem.
author: mistymagius

entry: The powder that comes off of a POKENAME was once used in cooking. This stopped when scientists found out that it was extremely poisonous.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides amongst small mushroom colonies, patiently waiting for evolution. The mushroom on its head provides essential nutrients and warmth for POKENAME.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon largely feeds on fallen, decomposing berries and fruit. Still, POKENAME takes time to pollinate flower fields with its antennae to ensure that it has a beautiful environment to inhabit.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME spends most of its life hiding its body in brush and pretending to be a Shroomish. When frightened, it strikes with its hidden stinger and sprays toxic spores to overwhelm the threat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Although slow and weak, POKENAME can release a cloud of poisonous spores when threatened. The mushroom at the tip of its tail is apparently edible.
author: craigprime

entry: Suspended in treetops and preparing for evolution, a small number of POKENAME prefer to hang upside-down. This creates a drastic yet humorous change in the expression on their face.
author: craigprime

entry: This Pokémon appears to be a colossal mushroom while sleeping at the base of trees. POKENAME releases toxic spores to ensure nothing nearby disturbs its rest.
author: bacondlx

entry: Although friendly in appearance, a swarm of POKENAME is notoriously aggressive. Targets will quickly find themselves surrounded in both spores and POKENAME if they approach their nest.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME makes its nests under tree roots and will only leave when the sun isn't out. If an attacker tries to reach the nest, it will frantically flap its wings, releasing poisonous spores into the air.
author: mistymagius

entry: It has tiny, fuzzy, kiwi-like hairs atop its bulb, which is soft to the touch. Even in the darkest parts of a forest, it is able to determine the time by standing its tiny hairs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME scatters spores all over rivers and swamps. As a result, not many Pokémon live near its habitat.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME doesn't need sunlight to produce its electricity. Instead, it nibbles on leaves and lets the fungus that grows on its body convert its food into electrical energy.
author: mistymagius

entry: When frightened, POKENAME will puff out a cloud of sleep-inducing spores from its head. While dangerous in high doses, people will often use POKENAME's spores to help them get a good night's sleep.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME use the discarded shells of other Pokémon eggs as a way to shield their soft bodies. They use the calcium-rich shells as a source of minerals as they grow older, helping to fuel their growth.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When surrounded by joy, POKENAME emits yellow spores that forces others to smile. The effect fades slowly, leaving behind an odd sense of calm.
author: .izik

entry: Once Shroompi drains all the energy from its eggshell, it has to get energy from other living things. However, with enough positive experiences, it evolves into POKENAME, and lives purely off positive emotions. Therefore, POKENAME is quite social.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Once night falls, POKENAME will go out hunting for small mushrooms to store in its nests. Since the mushrooms it eats are non-toxic, foragers often search for a POKENAME nest.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lives in damp forests, spreading spores that encourage plant growth. Its cheerful croak echoes through the trees, often signaling the arrival of spring.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME feast on the damp, composted soil in their forest homes. These vital nutrients keep the Earthstar fungi on their backs healthy and large.
author: cristata

entry: After being spotted, POKENAME stares at whatever found it briefly and then proceeds to run away. This behavior makes studying it very difficult.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME hang from tree branches, leeching off of some of the tree's nutrients. Once they are full, they will fall to the ground and release all of their spores, which can be a hazard to passing Trainers.
author: mistymagius

entry: This mushroom Pokémon has developed a form of tusk-pincers in order to dig up its main food source: other mushrooms.
author: mx_wellman

entry: It waddles across the forest floor, consuming detritus. The fungal spores it releases when agitated grow into mushrooms resembling stony coral.
author: hophoppip

entry: Rolling around to travel, POKENAME will spread its spores as it goes. In a single day it can plant over 10 miles of spores.
author: melodydelune

entry: First sighted in the Unova region, this Pokémon resembles that of a famous streamer's mascot. It attacks by spinning around and producing spores.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: First sighted in the Unova region, this Pokémon resembles that of a famous streamer's mascot. It attacks by spinning around and producing spores.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: First sighted in the Unova region, this Pokémon resembles that of a famous streamer's mascot. It attacks by spinning around and producing spores.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: POKENAME likes to collect round mushrooms around in its pouch. While usually a cheerful Pokémon, it will throw a tantrum by releasing toxic spores from its head if anyone takes its mushroom away. The spores cause a great deal of pain if inhaled.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Wild POKENAME generally keep themselves hidden away from human eyes and live within unexplored forests. It appears to act as a confidant to other Pokémon and assists them out of sight.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are full of paralyzing spores they can expel at threats. Too much pressure on their heads or tails also trigger the spores to spread, so Trainers are advised to be gentle when petting POKENAME.
author: ohok3441

entry: After a rainstorm, droves of POKENAME will appear in forests to feast on composted soil, a task made easier by the mouth on their stomachs. POKENAME will release poison spores from their heads to keep other Pokémon out of the forest while they feast.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME feast on the damp, composted soil in their forest homes. These vital nutrients keep the Earthstar fungi on their backs healthy and large.
author: cristata

entry: Its mushroom grows at a rapid rate. Once the mushroom grows too long, it evolves into Bresaur and the mushroom gets cut.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is rather protective of feeding grounds, charging down and headbutting anything that intrudes on it. A large diet of fungi, mulch and the like makes the gas it releases from its cap on impact quite smelly.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that POKENAME has come from a Piplup that ate a lot of mushrooms. Over time, the mushrooms that this Piplup ate have been infused with its body.
author: beedev.

entry: POKENAME plods along ancient forest trails, searching for nutrient-rich leaf litter. Nothing seems to faze it.
author: .realthree

entry: This mischievous Pokémon hides among mushrooms, waiting to ambush foes with its sharp, metallic limbs. When threatened, POKENAME releases spores that cause confusion or puts opponents to sleep, giving it a chance to escape.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME lives in the ozone layer, spreading its spores from high up and never landing on the ground. If the concentration of released spores is high enough, they can form colorful clouds that poison or paralyze Pokémon flying through them.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME sprouts from the crystalline organ on its chest. It feeds on composted soil to recharge its psychokinetic powers.
author: slowforest

entry: POKENAME seeks out spots with ample sunlight and soft soil. Between photosynthesis and consuming dirt for nutrients, it hardly needs to move once it's found the perfect spot.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's preferred eating method is to consume an entire bush in one bite, chewing on it over the course of the whole day. When elated, it spews a short spout of pollen and seeds from a spout atop its head.
author: sk372

entry: Every time POKENAME hops, it releases a small puff of spores from its head. Apothecaries often keep a POKENAME around, as its spores have various medicinal properties.
author: mistymagius

entry: There is a large debate amongst researchers on whether or not the top is smiling or simply upside down.
author: elite01.

entry: POKENAME can absorb nutrients from nearly any environment. Due to this hardiness, they can be found almost anywhere, though most commonly in forests.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME live in damp caves, drinking the water seeping from the cave walls. Their tail acts like a suction cup, allowing them to stick to slippery surfaces with little effort.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live on the damp forest floor, wrapping up its prey in its silk and then taking them back to its den. It cultivates little mushroom gardens around its den, covering itself in their toxic spores for protection.
author: mistymagius

entry: The green stems on POKENAME's body belong to a rare species of fungus that, when consumed, can cause severe fevers and blistering. However, their spores are said to add a nice, spicy flavor to most dishes.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's spores are incredibly toxic and can cause fainting if not treated quickly. However, researchers have been testing if its spores could be used as an antidote for other spore attacks.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have a large mushroom on their back that leeches nutrients from their body. Contact with it causes noxious spores to spread through the air.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's body feels smooth and rubbery, even its feathers bounce like rubber balls. When it dances, its whole body jiggles in an unpredictable rhythm, similar to jelly.
author: jaminmcready

entry: If prepared correctly, the leaves on POKENAME's head become a medicine that can cure any illness. However, a single mistake in the process will leave you with a concoction so toxic it makes trees and weeds wilt.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Groups of POKENAME like to flock on damp forest floors, using their mossy wings as camouflage. If a member of the flock senses danger, it alerts the others, causing them to flee while scattering spores behind them.
author: potato_tub

entry: POKENAME's true body is comprised of a fast-growing mold. It lives near beaches and marinas. If it can't find an anchor to grow off of, it will latch to the underside of small boats.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can barely move around due to the sheer weight of its fungal colony. The mushrooms on its back are filled with toxic spores and will burst open at the slightest touch.
author: mistymagius

entry: Because of its habit of feeding on dead leaves, POKENAME is often employed to keep gardens or the estates of wealthy landowners clean. If disturbed while basking in sunlight, it sprays a paralyzing powder from the little fungus on its head.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME wanders pumpkin patches during the day. When it finds a sick pumpkin, it scatters spores nearby to help the plant recover.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eats many different types of herbs to fill out its diet, many of which contain compounds that cause drowsiness, paralysis, and even poison. It stores these compounds in its body and releases them with its Bite attacks.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is often found resting in patches of damp soil during the day, leaving to find food at night. If caught by a predator, it will shake its body vigorously, releasing poisonous and nasty-tasting spores.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME lies still in the shade of damp forests, patiently waiting to evolve. To stop predators, it releases puffs of foul-tasting spores.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME prepare for evolution by hiding under fallen leaves on the forest floor. Should they be attacked, POKENAME release clouds of poisonous spores.
author: mepp.

entry: Because POKENAME can't see very well, it stays almost entirely on the ground. If it gets spooked, it will fly into the nearest tree and leave poisonous spores in its wake.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME ventures from its forest home to cities to scrounge for food and shiny trinkets, which it then takes back to its den. It is known to be hard to please and will even puff irritating powder at its Trainer if it gets overly annoyed.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME prefer to doze in the damp soil found in caves and deep woods. Those who fall asleep near one experience fantastical dreams.
author: danarchist

entry: POKENAME buries itself in soil throughout most of the day. If bothered, it raises itself up to full height with its hidden tentacles to scare off the intruder.
author: sk372

entry: Propelled by a seemingly endless supply of methane, POKENAME is rumoured to be capable of reaching supersonic speeds. While such claims have not been directly verified, the flatulent sonic booms leave few other suspects.
author: wilmervr

entry: Custodians train POKENAME as trash-collecting assistants for natural parks and botanical gardens. Where it sleeps, small patches of grime-consuming mushrooms sprout.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME disguises itself as a harmless forest bud, lying perfectly still until an unsuspecting Pokémon wanders close enough, when it suddenly bursts into a cloud of noxious pollen and sinister snickering before scampering away silently.
author: silentscript89

entry: POKENAME's mushroom does not function in the same manner as Hypno's pendulum. Instead, the spores it emits when swung induce sleepiness.
author: gp423

entry: POKENAME imbues the bone it carries with eerie ghostly energy. Once thrown, the bone somehow attempts to home in on its target with uncanny precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is known for playing spiteful pranks, such as trapping people in invisible barriers. It might give a person it trusts an invisible key that dispels the barriers.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME roam around abandoned homes looking for children. They long for companionship and will jump in tall grass in the hopes of getting attention.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The orbs that float around POKENAME are a strange type of spectral seed it creates. It plants the seeds in soil largely bereft of light, where it will grow into a uniquely pale type of flower.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can remain at vigil for up to 20 hours before it needs rest. Because of this, it is a popular choice among police officers who patrol city streets.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a popular pet of police officers who patrol city streets for crime, as its nimble speed helps it chase down burglars. Its ability to remain awake at night gives officers an edge in spotting suspicious activity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has adapted to mimic the behavior and appearance of Shuppet, which it uses to fool both prey and predator alike.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME only appears when it is overcast, riding on the cold winds. It will hop on people's heads to temporarily blind them, cackling as it watches its victims stumble around.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are rumored to harbor the spirit of an artist who enjoyed stitching flowers to his art. They tend to focus more on the past than living in the present for the most part.
author: entomoxie

entry: The gills on POKENAME grow as it absorbs negative emotions through its horn. Though born from malice, it's surprisingly affable. It often bumps into things; researchers believe that brief flashes of darkness cloud its vision when emotions surge.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's beak glows red when it detects jealousy nearby. It circles above quietly until the emotion fades or it decides to feed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME crafts horrifying illusions based on deep grudges to scare humans. It feeds on fear drawn into the glowing orbs around its neck.
author: .izik

entry: At night it secretly steals precious belongings from its victims so it can fuel their resentment toward others and feed on their negative emotions. POKENAME can render its body intangible to slip through any wall.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME stick with their Trainers through thick and thin. If their Trainers are feeling blue, they do what they can to make them grin.
author: inksans201x

entry: Introverted by nature, POKENAME prefers having very small friend groups of one or two other creatures. To play with these friends, it creates shapes using a ghostly fog it blows from its trunk.
author: sk372

entry: During the night, POKENAME will possess pieces of clothing and torment its victims while they try to sleep. Its victims are often left in a state of paranoia, thinking every cast shadow is a disguised POKENAME.
author: mistymagius

entry: Wandering the roads at night, POKENAME will mimic and mock any foes it comes across. It is typically the only one who finds this amusing, as the foe will usually attack POKENAME in the middle of its show.
author: notsaying.

entry: This Pokémon floats through the jungles at night in search of negative emotions. When it finds something exhibiting these, its mouth stretches open as it absorbs that energy.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: If it senses envy in someone, POKENAME blasts them with water to shift their mood. If this fails, it slowly drains that energy through prolonged exposure.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is featured in many fables as a trickster spirit. It is capable of melting into the darkness, disappearing right before one's eyes.
author: mepp.

entry: It collects vengeful souls in its keystone. Some old legends tell of people who sold their souls to POKENAME to get revenge on others.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME are believed to be pacifist Pokémon, only attacking when provoked. They use ghostly energy to create spectral bones and attack their foes.
author: chibitales

entry: It appears before frustrated people and taunts them. It longs to be bashed and thrown about in a fit of rage, as the negative emotions give it strength, and its soft doll-like body easily absorbs the damage.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME wears a strange cloak that saps strength from anything it touches. It uses floating hands to press prey against the fabric and drain their energy away.
author: .izik

entry: When a Turtwig evolves while being controlled by a Shupwig, the fabric skin threatens to tear. If it stays intact, the evolution to POKENAME is complete.
author: hellaluyeah

entry: POKENAME feeds on feelings of vengeance against specific people. When it is full, it finds and acts out that revenge on that person.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME feeds on negative emotions. It slips into homes at night to brush its ribbons against sleeping people and drain their negativity. Victims wake up feeling oddly calm and refreshed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME resembles a possessed rabbit-shaped ragdoll. The rags that make its body are so impossibly thin, they feel like nothing on your hand, despite the fabric obeying the normal laws of physics.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME levitates silently over landfills, searching for discarded dolls. It hoards these broken toys as prized trophies in its hidden den.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides in haunted mansions, lighting up the hallways with an eerie purple glow. Anyone who stares at its flame for too long will have their soul stolen.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hangs around graveyards, using the recently deceased souls to fuel its flame. During the night, it can be seen playing tricks on any visitors in an effort to get them to leave.
author: mistymagius

entry: When born, POKENAME has only one small, flickering tail. It spends its early days feeding on negative emotions, and each time it witnesses an outburst of anger, its tail splits. With every new tail, its power and malice grow.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME loves to sit on the shallow seafloor and uses its puppet to scare nearby swimmers. It is theorized that POKENAME's soul is stuck in the puppet and that removing it will end POKENAME's life.
author: mistymagius

entry: It is said that sometimes in the midst of the night, if a child makes a particularly strong wish, the wish may come to inhabit a doll nearby, and a POKENAME is born.
author: wrenchworx

entry: POKENAME burrows beneath the homes of envious people. While they sleep, it feeds off their negative emotions through the floorboards.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is able to sense negative auras of those around it, following and absorbing the negativity from sources. It darts through shadows to remain unseen.
author: chibitales

entry: A POKENAME uses its song to lull people into a deep sleep. It then uses this opportunity to feast on their upsetting dreams.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME are held together by loose stitches of thin thread and easily pull apart under pressure. Seeing the internal fabrics of POKENAME causes the observer to suffer nightmares, and they are used by Hex Maniacs to curse their foes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME uses its mind to move toys in playgrounds, stirring jealousy among children. It absorbs the emotional energy that that builds in their arguments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wears a coat stitched from old fabric, and tucked inside it are masks each bearing a different expression. Wearing one puts the user to sleep instantly, so someone else must be nearby to take it off.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME lurks in corners watching shiny objects until scampering over to seize its prize once it knows nobody is looking. This patience and stealth has made it popular among thieves as a partner, but also has made it the subject of paranoid stories.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME approach people who are going through a difficult time in their lives and release a soothing Sleep Powder. Once the person is asleep, they absorb negative feelings to help them feel better.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If a vengeful person steps into its woods, POKENAME calls on the forest to strike. Trees bend, twist, and lash out to protect its domain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have bulbs atop their head that are sensitive to people with malice in their hearts. They passively absorb feelings of negativity and spite to help people move on from the past.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It cushions itself in a cloud of calm souls. Despite what one would think about POKENAME, it is actually very soothing to be around. Legends say if more than ten float overhead, you will have good fortune.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: POKENAME are sometimes sold as pets, purported as sources of positive energy via their crystals. In reality, they don't induce positive feelings, but they do consume negative ones.
author: hophoppip

entry: When hikers report mysterious blue lights in mountainous forests, they have usually seen the fire of a POKENAME. Those who witness it often return feeling angrier and more envious than before.
author: leandermalurt

entry: When someone steps into its pumpkin patch, POKENAME drifts near and silently feeds on their life force. Its horn glows faintly during the process.
author: .izik

entry: Lately, these sweet-toothed Pokémon have increasingly been spotted begging for candies instead of searching for wild berries on their own. If POKENAME don't receive enough sweets, they feed on people's irritation by playing tricks on them.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME loves to scare people, popping out of the ground when they're not expecting it. However, it only goes after children since adults don't seem to find it scary.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME often chase after people with bitter vindictiveness in their hearts in an attempt to siphon cursed energy. These chases can last hours at a time if the person they chase does not allow them to absorb the cursed energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travel in packs to track down people with malice and hatred in their hearts. Despite their menacing appearance, they want to help remove some of the vindictiveness in the hearts of the people they stalk.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stalk people who have malice in their hearts. When spotted, they run in a zigzag pattern and hide behind the nearest obstacle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME chase after people who have a lot of hatred in their hearts in an attempt to play with them. Their desire to instill some childish kindness makes them a beloved figure in some books for children.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can fly with ease with their bodies being extremely lightweight, though they often enjoy just riding a gentle ocean breeze. Their 'beaks' are actually firm tongues.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME is a malevolent creature that pretends to guide sailors toward shore, only to abandon them to their fate in unfamiliar waters. It communicates with others of its kind through cries that resemble chilling wails.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME naps while balanced in one-handed handstands to maintain constant training. Its body becomes faintly translucent during this meditative rest.
author: .izik

entry: When near jealous people, POKENAME develops severe headaches. The pain soon radiates outward, causing dizziness in anyone nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a special chime that is stronger for those who have malice in their hearts. They have the ability to siphon this cursed energy in exchange for escorting them around.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Old superstitions say that POKENAME was born from the strong emotions of childish tantrums. It has a very petulant personality, screeching angrily at every minor thing that troubles it.
author: sk372

entry: It feeds on the tears humans cry in their sleep. Humans who have been fed on by POKENAME report feeling much happier with their lives afterward.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME experience the emotion of the person or creature nearest to them. They will only fight a Pokémon who is seeking out a battle.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME is always training, both its physical strength and its ghostly powers. It's most proud of itself when it's able to lift up heavy objects using its spiritual strength alone.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its stick to cast minor hexes on others, usually to invoke clumsiness or nausea. Its preferred victims to cast a curse upon are other avian Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: It looks malevolent, but POKENAME is actually a lonely spirit in search of companionship. It often resorts to hypnotizing people, assuming few would be friendly to it because of its appearance.
author: sk372

entry: If POKENAME sees someone mistreat a stuffed toy, it will follow them home. That night, it inflicts them with brutal, relentless nightmares.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME absorbs negative emotions and nightmares, which leaves those around it feeling at peace. Sleep therapists employ it to treat sleep paralysis.
author: noel5229

entry: Large colonies of POKENAME live near power plants, their cells generating high amounts of energy to share with the colony. However, if they generate too much power, their bodies will rupture with a large flash of light.
author: mistymagius

entry: Though feeble on their own, POKENAME are clever when in numbers. Together they have the intelligence of a human child.
author: clawshdi

entry: Its body composition is similar to that of bubble algae, a giant single-celled alga. Its heads regularly fall off and grow back.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME consistently secretes viscous masses that act like pillows. However, caution is advised as the mass spreads various diseases.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME consistently secretes viscous masses that act like pillows. However, caution is advised as the mass spreads various diseases.
author: chorb33

entry: Its shell becomes infused with gel, creating a firm but brittle surface. It is easily susceptible to cracking, but its inner gel holds it in place.
author: germs2128

entry: The cell mass surrounding POKENAME regenerates incredibly quickly. It can even survive in areas contaminated by radioactivity without any problems.
author: chorb33

entry: The "egg" POKENAME carries in its pouch is actually a baby Solopiny. Researchers are still unsure how the newborn is formed, but agree that it is likely comparable to asexual division.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME sparks continuously as it generates electricity during mitosis. It is therefore used in some households to generate renewable electricity.
author: chorb33

entry: Green gel trails behind POKENAME as it soars through the clouds. Folklore says a drop from its wings brings misfortune for seven days.
author: .izik

entry: Sturdy in any environment they migrate to, thanks to the special liquid they're enveloped in. It is said that alternating scents they secrete convey their feelings.
author: dandelionbaphy

entry: It traps its prey in a ball of sticky gel that is almost impossible to escape from. During the rainy season, it will coat its web in this gel to keep it resistant to the wind and rain.
author: mistymagius

entry: During rainfall, POKENAME surrounds itself with a psychic aura to keep its gelatinous body dry. Its shimmering barrier glows faintly as it glides.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a body covered in a protective gel, secreted from its pale skin. The gel dissuades predators from attacking it as it has an unpleasant taste and texture.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Living in the deep sea, POKENAME have lost all pigmentation in their skin. The lights on their heads lure prey by fooling them into thinking they are bioluminescent jellyfish.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in a rubbery fluid that will cause it to forcefully bounce off of any surface it hits. To prevent this, POKENAME levitates above the ground using its psychic powers.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lift themselves into the air by generating matching currents of electricity throughout their gel and the ground beneath them, directing the charges with their tails to steer. The excess gel around their bodies helps cushion their landings.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The liquid around POKENAME's head is full of chlorophyll, and aids in photosynthesis. Excess energy from the sun is converted into psychic power.
author: bee4082

entry: The slime from a POKENAME can be condensed and used in pharmaceuticals. Many modern-day allergy medications use this slime.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very clumsy, often having trouble walking with its tiny feet. Luckily, the gelatinous substance around its body cushions it whenever it falls.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Whenever POKENAME think about their next schemes, the gel around their body will bubble with the psychic energy they're projecting. If their plans ever fall short, they will slip away in the darkness and immediately get to work on the next one.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are suspended in an impermeable gel that protects them from the outside world. They communicate telepathically from inside the bubble, as exposure to the external world causes them great pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: For some reason, POKENAME use laboratory glassware as shells to protect their soft bodies. It's theorized that the leftover chemicals in unwashed flasks and beakers are a food source for them.
author: hophoppip

entry: The gel surrounding POKENAME's body provides the perfect conditions for its coral to grow, allowing it to survive in most environments. The gel is sold as a useful care product for Trainers raising their own Corsola.
author: mistymagius

entry: Using telepathy, POKENAME senses what its friends desire most. It then seeks out similar objects and delivers them as heartfelt gifts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's gelatinous body allows solid objects, but not water, to pass through it. Young Remoraid often hitch rides to new feeding grounds in the safety of this viscous fluid.
author: bee4082

entry: Right before unleashing a powerful Dragon-type attack, it parts the protective liquid around its body to fire without interference. Because it must constantly use its psychic powers to hold the liquid in place, it often needs long hours of sleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Right before unleashing a powerful Dragon-type attack, it parts the protective liquid around its body to fire without interference. Because it must constantly use its psychic powers to hold the liquid in place, it often needs long hours of sleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its strong psychic powers, POKENAME is cowardly and disappears into narrow cracks through which it can squeeze thanks to its flexible body.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME will slowly shed the layer of gel protecting its body to get rid of any debris caught inside. While being highly toxic, POKENAME's gel has seen use in certain laundry products.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are quite friendly and like to use their telekinetic powers to play with egg-shaped objects. The green material surrounding its true body is extremely bouncy.
author: craigprime

entry: Constantly regenerating cell mass protects the actual body of POKENAME. Despite its size, it is very flexible and can disappear through narrow holes.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME uses psychic power to draw water onto dry soil, forming mud. It rolls in the cool mud during hot days to regulate its temperature.
author: .izik

entry: Thanks to its immense psychic abilities, POKENAME can sense the next move of its opponent. In the rare event that the attack connects, the special liquid surrounding its body cushions the blow.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: The liquid covering POKENAME's body allows it to adapt to and survive in any environment. Groups of POKENAME will travel through dangerous places in order to test themselves and get stronger together.
author: nyoomymph

entry: While it may look soft, POKENAME's face retains the strength of steel due to its density. However, the remainder of its body is still very fragile.
author: forbiddenbread

entry: POKENAME basks in the moonlight, using it as a way to regenerate its protective gel-like fluid surrounding its body. However, this leaves POKENAME immobile, making it rely on emitting psychic rays to ward off any predators.
author: lemage22

entry: Despite its psychic prowess, it struggles to work its gelatinous body properly. It shambles from place to place, getting its green slime on everything it touches.
author: mistymagius

entry: The gel that surrounds POKENAME is actually its digestive fluid, allowing it to dissolve any food it absorbs directly into its stomach. However, it gets sick a lot as it often ingests hazardous objects by accident.
author: mistymagius

entry: When tunnels begin to collapse, POKENAME will hold the ceiling aloft with psychic force. It often sacrifices itself to save its hive.
author: .izik

entry: Its amniotic fluid is so thick that POKENAME must use its psychic powers every time it wants to turn the gelatinous gears. It can make the protective gelatin as hard as metal to defend itself from enemy attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The slime of a POKENAME smells like freshly-picked carrots. It is used in specialty shampoos and conditioners.
author: .izik

entry: Barely visible outside windows at night, POKENAME are curious about human nature. It is said that allowing a POKENAME to enter your house will bring good fortune and clear skies for the following day.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its protective layer changes colors depending on what POKENAME feeds on. It uses its psychic abilities to navigate, and is otherwise blind. It has a poor sense of touch, and typically does not like affection.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's body dries out quickly in the sun, so it only comes out to feed at night. It drains other Pokémon of their fluids to keep its body nice and moist.
author: mistymagius

entry: The strange liquid it floats in is all POKENAME can survive in, as it becomes sickly if placed on land or in normal water. It uses psychic abilities to interact with the world outside its container.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME prefers damp areas. The color of each individual POKENAME's leaves varies depending on what it's touched and absorbed the energy of. For instance, those that absorb energy from the mud near electrical dams have more yellowish leaves.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Mediums use the yellow leaves on POKENAME's head to brew tea. The infusion is believed to allow brief communication with spirits.
author: .izik

entry: During flash floods, POKENAME unleashes powerful psychic pulses to control trees and redirect the waters. It's revered as a forest guardian by smaller Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prefers damp areas. The color of each individual POKENAME's leaves varies depending on what it's touched and absorbed the energy of. For instance, those that absorb energy from the mud near electrical dams have more yellowish leaves.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Psychics who inhale POKENAME's blue pollen report intense visions of the future. Researchers continue to debate its strange effects on the mind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME forms gentle flocks that hover near orphanages when children feel sad. They perform aerial loops and spins to lift spirits with bursts of psychic joy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a small, gooey Pokémon. Its playful nature allows it to stretch and reshape, using its fluid form to launch surprising small psychic attacks on unsuspecting foes.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME's protective layers regenerate quickly when damaged, but do not always grow back identically. Its gooey bubble soothes burns and irritated skin when applied, leading to some people caring for one in their home.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's protective layers regenerate quickly when damaged, but do not always grow back identically. Its gooey bubble soothes burns and irritated skin when applied, leading to some people caring for one in their home.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It floats around caves with other POKENAME, trying their best to hide from threats. The gems on its body are crystalized slime, which are melted and used by locals as a medicinal cream.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME gel is great for making hair care products, especially products for hair growth. However, the gel is incredibly toxic, so it has to be heavily watered down before use.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides inside of pumpkins and gourds, its gelatinous body slowly breaking them down for food. Once the gourd has decayed, it will slowly float around looking for a new one.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of a gelatinous substance that emits a faint glow. Some say looking into its eyes will curse you.
author: willuna

entry: POKENAME is unaffected by heat or moisture and only decays when exposed to saliva. It is being studied by both scientists and confectioners as they scramble to figure out how to replicate the contents of its gelatinous body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lives in large groups and communicates telepathically with its companions to better organize food gathering in the forests. It tends to be very active on rainy days, as the liquid surrounding its core protects it from any kind of weather.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The horn protruding from the jelly that shields its core helps it navigate precisely through the forests it inhabits. It communicates telepathically with its kin, warning them immediately if it spots a predator flying too close to their territory.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The cocoon covering its body is made of a strange liquid capable of absorbing the nutrients it needs to draw closer to evolution. Thanks to its psychic powers, POKENAME can harden the membrane surrounding it to withstand any assault.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The cocoon covering its body is made of a strange liquid capable of absorbing the nutrients it needs to draw closer to evolution. Thanks to its psychic powers, POKENAME can harden the membrane surrounding it to withstand any assault.
author: fiordaliso

entry: To keep the amniotic fluid protecting its core at the proper viscosity, POKENAME feeds on particularly sugary resins and pollens. It communicates with others of its kind through telepathic signals transmitted via its antennae.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The special fluid surrounding POKENAME's core contains several poisonous agents, keeping away anyone who tries to prey on it. With its horns, it launches Psychic-type attacks that often leave its opponents confused.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its acorn-shaped helmet to absorb solar energy, which fuels its psychic powers. Through telepathy, it emits frequencies that drive away Pokémon who might mistake the special fluid covering its body for a fruit.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The leaf sprouting from the liquid surrounding its core allows POKENAME to convert sunlight into energy to make it more powerful. It ambushes anyone who gets too close to the tree where it lives, punishing them with powerful psychic attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its leaves are directly connected to the core that dwells within the protective liquid, which is why it uses them to unleash its psychokinetic attacks. It moves nimbly among the trees to ensure that no one is causing trouble within the forest.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The small horn protruding from one of its tails acts as a sensory receptor, allowing POKENAME to navigate flawlessly while flying. The gelatinous fluid coating its core shields it from sudden climate changes, so it has no need to migrate.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Although POKENAME instinctively hunts Bug-type Pokémon, its gelatinous fluid is unable to digest them. Using its psychic powers, it synchronizes its flight with its companions to avoid midair collisions during takeoff.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's cry seems to be much quieter than a normal Whismur. The membrane surrounding its body is nearly soundproof, making it impossible for POKENAME to be loud.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME's gloves gather energy every time it throws a punch, allowing its psychic powers to continue growing. It always travels with a partner with whom it trains and searches for food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME coats its large hands with psychic energy, enabling it to crush any obstacle with a single strike. The gelatinous liquid protects its core from close-range attacks, making it an excellent fighter.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME expels excess amniotic fluid around its core through openings in its humps. Thanks to its psychic powers, it can move its gelatinous legs with enough energy to shake the ground beneath its feet.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME floats around placidly, trying to avoid contact with others. This is because anything stimulating its gelatinous exterior gives the core body a splitting headache.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME brings its core out beyond its gelatinous head in order to launch its most powerful Psychic-type attacks. It often performs swaying dances to hypnotize its opponents.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Since its gelatinous head can regrow, POKENAME uses it as bait to protect the core hidden in its belly. With its sharp claws, it shreds the bodies of its fiercest rivals without showing any mercy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's body is made up of an acidic compound that can quickly melt organic matter. When a substance is melted, it gains a small amount of mass, causing POKENAME to gradually grow in size if left unchecked.
author: evilgammon

entry: Its moon-shaped rocky core is surrounded by numerous gelatinous particles that constantly orbit around it. With its psychic powers, POKENAME can coat its body in jelly in an instant to protect itself from incoming attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its core is surrounded by numerous spheres of amniotic fluid that constantly orbit around POKENAME. Its rocky spikes are capable of emitting powerful psychic waves that can manipulate the gelatinous particles at will.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The liquid covering POKENAME's body allows it to swim even in contaminated waters without its core becoming infected. Its whiskers can sense the presence of hidden food on the seabed, so it is often seen digging with its fins.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME swims in clean water, the protective liquid only covers its head. Its whiskers can detect hidden food at the bottom of rivers, so it uses its fins to dig through dirt and mud.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It channels its psychic powers through its long whiskers; when they vibrate intensely, POKENAME is preparing a powerful attack. The special liquid protecting its core is so dense that it repels any obstacles it encounters while swimming.
author: fiordaliso

entry: With its psychic powers, POKENAME is able to keep the other parts of its body close to its core. Since it is easily irritated, it takes only a moment for it to lose patience and attack anyone who gets too close.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME surrounds itself with sparks, the special liquid around its core shines intensely, blinding its opponents. It communicates its feelings telepathically with the other members of the large group it travels with while searching for food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME surrounds itself with sparks, the special liquid around its core shines intensely, blinding its opponents. It communicates its feelings telepathically with the other members of the large group it travels with while searching for food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: With its psychic powers, POKENAME is able to keep the other parts of its body close to its core. Since it is easily irritated, it takes only a moment for it to lose patience and attack anyone who gets too close.
author: fiordaliso

entry: In order to maintain the high speeds it needs to catch its prey, POKENAME must concentrate hard to keep its gelatinous body stable. It is common to see young POKENAME running while using their telekinesis to carry detached bits of gel.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME travel in groups, floating along effortlessly using river currents. Should a predator approach, they produce psychic vibrations to dip under the surface of the water.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME lurks by the shoreline near fishing spots. It uses telekinesis to create false tugs, leaving anglers irritated and confused.
author: .izik

entry: Since its body is so frail, its gel barrier protects it from any outside contact. It gets its nutrients by dissolving food in the gel then absorbing it through its skin.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live in perfect stillness, reflecting on the world around them. Should they need to move, they latch onto a passing Pokémon. When the membrane surrounding them begins to ripple, it means that evolution is imminent.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME's body is very sensitive to germs, so it produces a thick gel that kills them almost instantly. Doctors will often have a POKENAME on hand to use its gel as a disinfectant.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is technically not venomous, but poisonous; its slimy tentacles must enter an orifice to take effect. Though smaller prey is sedated and consumed, larger creatures merely become nauseated.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME, though mostly nonlethal to humans, is an unwelcome sight on the beach. Being poisoned by one has been described as similar to downing a large bottle of cough syrup followed up with a heroic dose of hallucinogens.
author: dylonk25

entry: Though its body appears similar in texture to stone, it's actually soft and malleable to the touch. It's quite sensitive, so prodding it too much will incite it to respond with aggressive punching.
author: sk372

entry: The outer membrane of POKENAME crystallizes, forming a rock-hard boulder. Over time, it secretes gel from its core, reinforcing its shell.
author: germs2128

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in a waterproof oil that prevents its body from dissolving in the rain. Artisans use POKENAME's oil as a waterproof coating for their pots.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its highly malleable body allows POKENAME to squeeze through small cracks in the ice. It can withstand temperatures as cold as the vacuum of space.
author: strawbearycandy

entry: POKENAME's translucent body helps it to sneak up on unsuspecting prey, which is then absorbed into said body to be gradually digested.
author: strawbearycandy

entry: POKENAME is durable due to its gel coating, which it controls with psychic powers to interact with its environment. The gel regrows quickly, so Fuschia City pastry chefs leave traps to harvest excess gel to coat desserts with a acidic flavor.
author: pjporwoll

entry: A popular but strange treatment involves letting a POKENAME clamp onto someone's hair and slowly slide back. It leaves behind a glossy coating that makes hair soft, shiny, and sweet-smelling for days.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The soft and gelatinous bodies of POKENAME leave them vulnerable to predators. They scavenge sea shells using their sticky bodies, keeping themselves safe from danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Wrapped in a unique liquid, POKENAME thrives across all terrains. Its psychic powers and the horn on its head are its only means of protection.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME's gelatinous body gives it pitiful defenses, so it hides away inside tree holes for safety. It uses psychic powers to pluck leaves and berries from the tree and bring them back to its home to feast on.
author: sk372

entry: Its slime actively absorbs pine needles and seeds from the forest floor. These are digested within the jelly-like substance to nourish it.
author: .izik

entry: The jelly that coats POKENAME are surplus cells that it secretes during its constant mitosis. These are infected with pathogens.
author: chorb33

entry: Sticky green fluid leaks from its vines, acting as an incredibly adhesive glue. This substance is almost impossible to remove once it bonds.
author: .izik

entry: It creates invisible objects to cause people to trip and fall. Watching from rooftops, it gleefully observes their misfortune with mischievous delight.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its psychic powers to immobilize prey before slicing them with razor-sharp blades. This method ensures it strikes with precision.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon must focus with both eyes on the target to imitate them properly. Otherwise, its two separate brains will cause improper transformations.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME have two brains, located on either side of a long body. Young individuals have been spotted trying to run in two directions at once.
author: dylonk25

entry: The jelly coating its body was once used in ancient Sinnoh as a medicine for mental fatigue. This peculiar tradition has long since faded.
author: .izik

entry: Its second brain uses psychic powers to detect and avoid future obstructions during flight. This foresight makes it a master of aerial navigation.
author: .izik

entry: It floats lazily in quicksand, enjoying the slow descent. Once fully submerged, it sleeps for days before effortlessly swimming back to the surface.
author: .izik

entry: It absorbs objects it loves into its slime, using them as an extension of its body. The Moon Stone it carries acts as a focus for its more powerful psychic attacks.
author: .izik

entry: Its upper, smaller brain actually does most of the thinking. It interacts with other beings outside of its own kind very rarely.
author: adrian151

entry: Its jelly-like covering emits a pleasant pine scent that intensifies as it consumes more pine needles. This aroma makes it oddly soothing despite its sticky nature.
author: .izik

entry: Despite constantly levitating off the ground, POKENAME thinks it can actually fly with its small wings. It can be seen throwing itself off of high places, only to be cushioned by its gelatinous body.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME emits a nausea-inducing scent from its gelatinous body when its scared. This defensive mechanism discourages predators from approaching.
author: .izik

entry: The green slime dripping from POKENAME's tail is frequently harvested as a heat sink for machinery. It can also use its psychic abilities to manipulate the thoughts of those nearby, influencing their creativity.
author: .izik

entry: It keeps the Thunder Stone that evolved it enveloped in a special liquid. It can use the Thunder Stone to unleash electrical shocks of 10,000 volts.
author: duskrd

entry: The syrup-like substance covering its body seems to have a mind of its own, moving independently like vines. This sentient slime reacts instictively to heat and light.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are attuned to the feelings of others, and their viscous bodies cling to people they enjoy spending time with. Their bodies are warm and soft and give damp yet comforting hugs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Using its two brains, POKENAME wields its developing psychic powers with impressive finesse. A lone POKENAME will dedicate most of its time to furthering its intelligence and honing its psychic abilities.
author: nyoomymph

entry: They live among plants and attack wandering Grass and Poison-type Pokémon with acid to hunt. They grow at an exponential rate; only when they slow down are they close to evolution.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its body allows it to move effortlessly through thick mud. Unlike most slimes, the syrup coating it is not sticky, aiding its mobility.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their psychic powers to float. The few times one has been seen attempting to walk, their limbs couldn't hold them up thanks to the lack of musculature.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME have smooth, sensitive bodies that can regrow major pieces if lost in battle. Trainers are advised to carry around lotion or water to make sure their POKENAME's membrane doesn't dry out.
author: ohok3441

entry: The bubble-like exterior of POKENAME is meant to protect others from itself, as its core body is incredibly toxic, causing harm just by being near it. It's very reclusive as a result, staying away from others for their sake.
author: sk372

entry: The transparent, wax-like fluid dripping from its head is intensely hot. This burning liquid leaves scorch marks wherever it falls.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME generates electric fields within its protective membrane, shocking anything that gets too close. When threatened, it glows brightly to intimidate foes before delivering a paralyzing jolt.
author: .izik

entry: The slime on its body boils constantly, radiating intense heat. Contact with it can cause severe burns to anything that gets too close.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is covered in a viscous slime that glows faintly in the dark. This glow distracts prey as it closes in silently for the attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stores vegetables inside the gooey orb it guards to pickle them. It prefers okra and parsnips, which it ferments into a sour snack before battle.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It emits waves of psychic energy to spin its body at incredible speeds. This rotation can create powerful gusts of wind to fend off attackers.
author: .izik

entry: Rising from tar pits, POKENAME divide its power between its two brains. One of a powerful psychic mind, and the other of a once invincible dweller of the ancient world.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Having two brains, POKENAME controls the ice clouds it forms with great efficiency. Its destructive power is similarly increased.
author: coridiant

entry: It absorbs the memories of those around it, transforming them into intricate dances. Each performance reflects the emotions it collects.
author: .izik

entry: Its slimy body is made of cytosol that contains a divided brain. Because it will dry out if it stays too long in the sun, the two halves must work together to find shade.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME's gooey body is protected by a thin, slick membrane that cushions it from attacks. It uses its psychic powers to attack with its slime, confusing opponents as it slides gracefully across the ground.
author: thepandasharky

entry: The gelatin-like substance covering its body smells and feels like honey. Its sticky nature attracts both friends and foes alike.
author: .izik

entry: Its gelatinous covering emits an eerie glow in the dark, mesmerizing its prey. Before attacking, it howls, pinning its target with precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is able to duplicate itself multiple times with ease. However, to scientists' confusion, it only does this to create backup singers for its performances. The purpose of said performances, although not malevolent, remains a mystery.
author: merclipse

entry: The glitter falling from its wings contains remnants of psychic power, causing confusion and headaches. This shimmering dust can disorient foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produce a soft, viscous jelly that melts into a slurry of nutritious goo when eaten. Its body produces an excess volume of twice its body weight in jelly, most of which it sheds in large bulbous blobs that other Pokémon eat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The gelatin coating POKENAME's body releases a swampy odor that lingers in humid areas. It uses its psychic powers to pluck apples from trees, floating them toward its mouth.
author: .izik

entry: It can reach speeds up to 60 mph and fit its body through a two-inch gap without slowing down. If its gelatinous body becomes too watery due to its diet, it risks ejecting its core during high-speed maneuvers.
author: staghorn

entry: It bumps into people, scattering coins from their purses onto the ground. It then absorbs the coins into its gelatinous paws and flees.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's brain is divided into many smaller portions, each focusing on controlling different aspects of sunny weather in its vicinity, such as humidity, temperature, and cloud cover. It becomes sluggish during solar eclipses.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The second brain is significantly more intelligent than the main one, solving complex equations in mere milliseconds. This dual intelligence makes it an incredible strategist.
author: .izik

entry: Mysterious and highly feared, POKENAME's psychoactive poison is incredibly potent. Though it does no physical damage, most victims pass out from shock. Those who do escape are never quite the same afterwards.
author: dylonk25

entry: The fluid coating its body can induce intense delusions if touched, causing people to hallucinate an entire month of their life. This effect leaves them disoriented and confused.
author: .izik

entry: It lingers near playgrounds, using hypnosis to convince children to hand over their snacks. Its mischievous nature makes it both cunning and troublesome.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in a habitat that has a lot of Fire-type predators around them, so they eat Occa Berries to help defend themselves against the predators. This is especially necessary because their cotton-like fur catches fire easily.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The large cotton bloom around POKENAME's neck is very delicate and tears easily, so it prefers to avoid those who seem aggressive.
author: .realthree

entry: Flocks of POKENAME can be seen by the hundreds flying along warm breezes, migrating to warmer areas during the winter months. They will use some of their extra cotton to help build their nests.
author: mistymagius

entry: The silk it produces is incredibly durable and elastic, causing it to be sought after by artisans. These delicate fibers are used to weave luxurious fabrics and fine garments.
author: .izik

entry: It sips sparkling morning dew and hops around in sunny spots in groves in the woods. Some POKENAME are curious and wander away from home: these are the source of most wild POKENAME that Trainers catch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It consumes barley until it becomes too heavy to move, often resting in fields after its feast. Farmers must keep an eye on it to protect their crops.
author: .izik

entry: The fur of a POKENAME is incredibly impervious to water, letting the Pokémon remain light enough to float on the winds even right after a swim.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME hide in cellar corners, pretending to be clumps of dust or stray fluff. They lie in wait for opportunities to steal food, their fluffy bodies helping them to escape on the wind with their scraps.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME floats higher on days without a dense overcast. It does this to get as close to the sun as possible.
author: .izik

entry: It sneaks into herbalists' shops to steal ingredients for its personal stash. These stolen herbs are often used to prepare remedies for its companions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's flower spews cotton-like spores when it is agitated. The spores are dangerous to breathe due to their tendency to clump together.
author: mistymagius

entry: The wind flowing through its fine strings as it floats creates a playful whistling sound that echoes through the air. This haunting melody often amuses and confuses those who hear it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses psychic power to redirect falling cotton fluffs. It drops them across the battlefield to slow down opponents with precise placement.
author: .izik

entry: It shoots cotton out of its cannons to scare predators away. This defense is often ineffective since it's just cotton, and it gets attacked anyways.
author: soup1900

entry: It gathers daisies and carries them wherever it goes, often creating little bouquets. It scatters these flowers from the sky as a gift to other Pokémon, making a charming sight in the wild.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME consumes carnations to maintain its soft, cotton-like body, enhancing its ability to float on the wind. It uses its horn to knock branches aside as it drifts through the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very cowardly. It covers itself in cotton to hide from predators.
author: themicelegion

entry: It will bury its head in the cotton around its neck to hide from danger. They will swiftly fly off on wind currents if they feel threatened.
author: pankiwi

entry: As it flies, it releases a bitter aroma that lingers in the air. This scent often deters predators from following too closely.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fluffy rump releases a calming scent when shaken, soothing those nearby and diffusing tense situations. Its antlers are highly sensitive, detecting even subtle shifts in a foe's movements.
author: .izik

entry: It guards flower patches fiercely, chasing away anyone who approaches without permission. Its determination makes it a reliable protector.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME adores marigolds and can often be found resting among them for hours. It carefully gathers their seeds and stores them within its fluffy body for safekeeping.
author: .izik

entry: Given the chance, it can devour an entire field's harvest in under two days, leaving behind cotton that takes over the soil. Farmers try to keep it away by offering it spare bales of hay for it to snack on.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME ride the wind in schools, only occasionally descending near lakes or rivers to soak up water for their never-ending journey.
author: mx_wellman

entry: It releases pollen that can burst into flames at will, creating fiery bursts. This explosive ability makes it a unique mix of beauty and danger.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its cotton to keep people it likes comfortable. When it engages in combat it can imbue some of its cotton with venom before throwing it at foes.
author: bacondlx

entry: Despite its sheer power and speed, it's so light that the strength of its own punches usually sends it flying. POKENAME becomes able to hurt others as it develops the superhuman grip strength of its feet, to use the floor as a counterforce.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME shoots cotton into its opponent's eyes before attacking. Its light weight makes it nimble yet easy to push around.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME uses its pugil stick-like weapon to push away would be attackers. If the battle seems lost, it shoots its cotton at its foe to escape.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Though it appears soft, the cotton on POKENAME's body is filled with steel shrapnel. Some companies have crafted heavy-duty cleaning utensils from it.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME uses its cotton to create walls that its prey cannot see through, though it can see through them thanks to its x-ray vision. Once the moment strikes, it leaps through the soft and airy barrier, ambushing the prey before they can react.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's iridescent cotton saves most of its fluffiness even when wet, making it excellent for water-resistant clothes. Its tail is so soft and downy that hugging it can wash negative emotions from one's heart.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's cotton-like body is said to be the softest and most cuddly of all Pokémon. However, it is extremely timid; only the most trusted of Trainers get to hug it, while anything else will be smacked with its ears before it leaps away in fear.
author: sk372

entry: Tiny and lightweight, the extremely-cautious POKENAME will try to escape from anything unfamiliar the second it notices it. It leaps into the air, and lets even the faintest breeze carry its small body off somewhere hopefully safer.
author: sk372

entry: Its tails expel large amounts of pollen, which it uses to mark its territory. The dense clouds of pollen often leave trails through the air as it moves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are raised for the cotton their wings shed daily, which is used in clothing and blankets. They spread cotton in battle, igniting it to burn foes. Ecologists are helping POKENAME recover their dwindling population.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME spend their days weaving through the grass of lush meadows. No predator cares to hunt them due to the dirt strewn throughout their cotton.
author: _testrun_

entry: Young herb seedlings are its favorite food, which it carefully selects from forest floors. It often competes with other herbivorous Pokémon for these delicate greens.
author: .izik

entry: It can fall asleep even while eating, often dozing mid-meal. Other Pokémon sometimes find it with food still in its mouth.
author: .izik

entry: It tramples through fields as it searches for flowers to eat. While it actively appreciates the flavor and feeling of eating these crushed flowers, it doesn't seem to realize just how much destruction it leaves behind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a highly valuble asset to flower shops due to its ability to smell when plants are sick. It grinds plant matter into fertilizer or medicine, making it a key part of garden production.
author: .izik

entry: During windy seasons it will curl up and let the wind carry it to far away lands. As it floats with the wind it will release pollen, especially if it is in warm climates.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Though beautiful, its petals can become razor sharp, slicing through anything they touch. This trait makes it both graceful and dangerous.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drifts lazily over sunflower fields, using its tiny tendrils to pluck seeds from the blossoms. It can go days without landing, carried effortlessly by the breeze.
author: .izik

entry: It hops through fields while munching on flower buds, savoring their fresh taste. Other Pokémon often follow it, hoping to share in its floral feast.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have far fluffier and lighter cotton than unfused Cottonee. This makes them far lighter and easier for the breeze to pick up. They are a popular Pokémon for younger Trainers as they are squishy and enjoy being hugged.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The cotton on POKENAME's body comes off easily, sticking to the mouth of opponents long enough for it to escape. It lounges in fields to absorb energy from the sun and burrows into the ground at night.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME hovers near powerlines, positioning itself as close as possible without making direct contact. The static charge in the air causes its cotton-like fluff to crackle softly with energy.
author: .izik

entry: Extremely light, it can float for miles on gentle breezes. This ability allows it to travel vast distances in search of new plants to pollinate.
author: .izik

entry: Its cotton-like exoskeleton allows POKENAME to float down from high places. It then lands comfortably on the ground, ready to roll again.
author: themicelegion

entry: Snorunt's cloak fused with the cotton, making it distorted. While not in pain, it doesn't seem to enjoy it.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME's leaves emit a peanut butter-like scent, attracting curious Pokémon to its presence. It floats above meadows, spreading the aroma, though this makes it a target for both friendly and predatory Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: Standing guard over fields, it wards off intruders with its imposing presence. Farmers value its protection, ensuring bountiful harvests.
author: .izik

entry: Their heavy green pigmentation comes from their diet of sassafras leaves, which are said to provide miraculous cures to many modern diseases. Additionally, this diet makes POKENAME poisonous to other predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's ears can detect lies, twitching whenever falsehoods are spoken, causing other Pokémon to avoid deceit in its presence. The cotton-like substance on its head dampens unnecessary sounds, and it manipulates it to focus on important noises.
author: .izik

entry: Amaranth is its preferred food, which it plucks delicately from the fields. Its lightweight body allows it to float gently as it forages.
author: .izik

entry: It bounces about as if it were as light as a feather. Because of this, many of its opponents are caught off-guard by its heavy blows.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME collects seafoam within its fluffy cotton, absorbing moisture as it floats near the shore. This helps it stay hydrated even in dry coastal winds.
author: .izik

entry: Clinging to ocean rocks, POKENAME scrapes off barnacles to feed on. If startled, it instantly releases its grip and lets the wind carry it away to safety.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is fidgety, hopping around quickly to scrounge food and shedding clouds of fluff in self-defense. Its regularly-shed fur can be processed and used as a cheap alternative to cotton products.
author: sk372

entry: Living on volcanic islands, POKENAME feeds on soot. The ash accelerates the growth of the cotton covering its body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stands in gourd patches, waving its arms as cotton drifts from its body. The fibers nourish the soil, encouraging healthy plant growth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME seeks out orchids in dense forests, as they are its preferred delicacy. It nibbles carefully to avoid harming the plant, and the flowers seem to fuel the flames in its stomach, making its fluff hot to the touch.
author: .izik

entry: This excitable little chef is able to perfectly season any dish it has cooked with its gentle flames and naturally grown herbs. While preferring to prepare vegetable dishes, POKENAME will prepare most meals to a high standard.
author: evilgammon

entry: On extremely windy days, POKENAME can be seen getting lifted out of the water and tossed through the air. They try to use their leaves to steer back, however, it rarely works.
author: clownatosis

entry: It feeds on seeds that it collects from fallen flowers. This simple diet helps maintain its light and airy body.
author: .izik

entry: It enjoys sleeping under waterfalls, using the rushing water as a soothing lullaby. While it sleeps, it absorbs water with its fluffy body to help it grow.
author: .izik

entry: Due to POKENAME's soft cotton and friendly nature, they are often used to teach children how to ride. They often form strong bonds with their charges.
author: howlingstarr

entry: Each of POKENAME's heads prioritize their own safety, so they will pull off each other's cotton to use for themselves. If one head gets too greedy, the cotton will start to impair its vision.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are the epitome of fluffy, as their delicate wisps feel plush to the touch. Despite feeling physical, pulling a tuft of wisps causes them to disintegrate into smoke.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME buries itself in the sand save for its nostrils, almost completely hidden from view. When it smells prey coming near, it uses an explosion to propel itself out of the sand and careen towards its prospective meal.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spews clouds of sand to mask its approach on prey and to distract foes while it hides. Because of its mischievous streak, thieves partner with it to take advantage of the blinding sand sprays while absconding with valuables.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When overheated, stone flaps along POKENAME's back lift up to release internal heat. This keeps it cool enough to keep hunting in the sun.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is not very intelligent, often mistaking rocks for prey and lunging at them, risking injury. Many underestimate it, despite its extremely dangerous bite.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME makes its home in large divots in the undersea sand. A curious sort, it often pokes its head out to observe its surroundings, but is quick to retreat back home unless food is involved.
author: sk372

entry: The bane of Swimmers, POKENAME blends perfectly with the mud and silt at the bottom of lakes. It lies motionless until anything blocks the sunlight, causing it to explode to the surface and bite with enough force to bend steel.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME hides beneath pop-up ads on shady websites. When a cursor draws near, it snaps its jaws as if trying to bite the pointer.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrows into desert sand during the day to sleep and hunts above ground during the night. It will molt underground once its skin becomes too tight.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME keeps its eyes and nose above the desert sand to peer at its surroundings. It often uses the fire on its back to entice potential prey to move closer before striking.
author: bonquilis

entry: While POKENAME appears small and friendly, it has a powerful bite. In the wild, POKENAME tend to be found sunbathing on sandy shores.
author: cosmodette

entry: POKENAME, in spite of its cuteness, can deliver devastating bites to careless Trainers. They move very quickly, seemingly swimming in sand, with only their nostrils and backspikes visible.
author: markusknight

entry: POKENAME is extremely mischievous, and especially likes to steal anything that reminds it of meteors or stars. When caught in the act of mischief, it cries and usually gets away with it due to its cuteness.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME tests its jaw strength on garbage cans. Once the lid is cracked open, it devours whatever scraps spill out without hesitation.
author: .izik

entry: These flat Pokémon can be found sliding along the surface of the desert sand. Some hieroglyphs seem to depict their sightings.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: While flying across desert skies, POKENAME may dive into the sand mid-flight. It quickly burrows after prey like Sandshrew.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sleep during the day, basking in the warm desert sun. Once night falls, they go out hunting for small insects, using their powerful noses to sniff them out from under the sand.
author: mistymagius

entry: Scampering through the desert, POKENAME pulls its prey out of burrows with its narrow maw. When the burrow is deeper than its snout, it sneezes out embers in frustration.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It slithers into backpacks or bags during dimly lit conditions to gain shelter from the cold. Trainers who attempt to use an Escape Rope may find a POKENAME instead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A chilling breeze escapes POKENAME's jaws before it delivers a kiss that leaves foes disoriented. The confusion can last for several hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are difficult to train if they grew up in the wild, as they typically were never taught to control their destructive urges. They will bite, poke, and shock almost anything they come across without hesitation if they are curious enough.
author: bobosmith01
