entry: Living high up in the mountains, POKENAME search across glaciers in small packs to find lost Trainers. When they find someone who has gotten lost, they will herd them back to safety at the nearest shelter.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME roam across frozen glaciers in small packs, their sharp claws giving excellent purchase on the treacherous terrain. Teams of POKENAME are sometimes used to pull sleds and allow people to travel great distances in harsh conditions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be found clinging to trees in winter. They're considered pests in northern regions, where they strip the bark off of evergreen trees in the hundreds.
author: .realthree

entry: These triplets burrow through snow at an impressive speed. The covers each head wears help protect them as they continuously headbutt the ground to make their tunnels.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME takes refuge near frozen rivers and lakes, only going out to hunt once the ice is thin enough. Its thick skin prevents moisture buildup, stopping ice crystals from forming on its body.
author: mistymagius

entry: The coat around POKENAME's torso keeps its most sensitive parts warm even in frigid snow, with the bonus of most people finding it adorable. It's common for Trainers to choose a hat they think completes POKENAME's cute appearance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME create ice floats on which they drift among frozen coastlines. Visits by these Pokémon often end in chaos, as they pillage and play pranks on their unwilling hosts as they please.
author: ocxin

entry: POKENAME's cowl and mittens protect it from the harsh snowstorms where it wanders. It is said that a household that harbors POKENAME for a night will be blessed with good luck.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME's constant shivering warms it and strengthens its muscles. However, this uses a lot of energy, so it's always hungry.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's climbing skill is so precise that it puts even the best Climbing Gear to shame. It's been spotted scaling cliffs that seasoned hikers avoid entirely.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Groups of at least 5 POKENAME often waddle along the snowy shores of frozen lakes. They will often play amongst themselves by withdrawing in their shells and bumping against one another.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's blue flames are frigid cold to those it does not trust, but comfortably warm to those it does trust. It breathes steam out of its nostrils as it runs so it avoids overheating due to the thick coat covering its body.
author: infinex21

entry: Plumes of fresh, soft snow rise and fall from across this Pokémon's body, often casting a veil around themselves as they trot across fields of snow. The coat of fur draped across their bodies is remarkably warm to the touch for their trusted Trainer.
author: infinex21

entry: The warm blanket POKENAME covers itself with is actually a part of its body, made of the copious amounts of fuzzy skin on its back. This Pokémon sheds its thick fur every spring to prevent overheating as the average temperature rises.
author: milchik

entry: The metal composing this Pokémon's body is still soft, so it uses static electricity to gather the shed fur of other Pokémon into a coat for warmth. It is sometimes found stuck to the thick coats of larger Pokémon, like Mamoswine.
author: novembermagnus

entry: POKENAME hauls itself onto icebergs, where it trembles gently as it rests. Snow flurries gather and fall from its shaking fur.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often hunted for its shell, which has a unique velvet-like texture. It will freeze its prey with icy breath before dragging them back to its nest.
author: mistymagius

entry: While hidden in mountain passes, POKENAME consumes the dreams of travelers. It shivers violently as it feeds, though unaffected by cold or fear.
author: .izik

entry: The liquid in POKENAME's head is said to taste like a coconut milkshake. Thankfully, drinking the liquid does not hurt it.
author: letterh.

entry: POKENAME's saliva freezes surfaces on contact. This trait makes it a danger to anything it licks, including allies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's face is encased in an icy mask that never melts, giving it an eerie, frozen expression. It sings haunting melodies in snowstorms, luring travelers into the cold before freezing them solid.
author: .izik

entry: It loves to catch violent hailstorms and eat the falling ice while dancing. After the storm is over, they feel very bored so they break into motels to mess with the ice machines.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is a highly territorial denizen of the frigid northern seas. With its bellowing icy roar, it can freeze an entire ship solid in moments, leaving a frozen reminder of the consequences of trespassing in its domain.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can radiate blinding beams of light from the crystals surrounding its body, making it very elusive to the few Trainers and predators who pursue it.
author: nexusshenanigans

entry: Internally, a POKENAME has a flame pouch that is always producing fire and warming its insides. Externally, its blue fur exudes a bone-chilling cold that prevents its own internal heat from melting its icy body.
author: infinex21

entry: Were it not for Glalie's ability to float, POKENAME would be unable to hold its own head up. Its bite is strong enough to crush a tank.
author: admiralvermin

entry: The face on POKENAME's chest is its true face; the head is merely a vent for the icy breath it can spew, which can freeze an opponent in seconds. POKENAME lives on the peaks of mountains so cold that humans cannot survive alone.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME thrives in frigid climates, its icicle-like stingers capable of freezing prey on contact. It prefers the cold, as the freezing air keeps its stingers sharp and prevents them from melting.
author: rakunk

entry: POKENAME fires icicles at foes with incredible accuracy. Its precise aim can hit targets from over 100 meters away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hang from the roof of frozen caves waiting for prey. Their wings and faces are encased in ice so sharp it can cleave through hard stone.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's antennae create shimmering light beneath the water that lures curious prey closer. Once within range, POKENAME flash-freezes its surroundings with a chilling burst of energy, freezing prey solid for it to consume.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is encased in ice that reflects faint visions of the past. Many believe gazing into its frozen shell during a full moon allows one to witness events from long ago.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME marks territory as it traipses around by poking its beak deep into the ground. The spots it pokes holes into will grow large stalagmites of ice shortly thereafter.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's frozen spikes are prized for their beauty and are carefully harvested off of their backs. Their environment changes what shape the spikes regrow into.
author: darxer_

entry: The dark-furred body of a POKENAME is covered in a dense, hard shell made of solid ice. It combines its psychic powers with its ability to produce a fast-cooling mist to protect its Trainer by freezing their foes solid.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME builds its nest from scarves stolen from hikers. These cozy nests are hidden in snowy mountains.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME glides above lakes, it breathes cold air to freeze the surface. This helps it traverse water by providing stable landing areas.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's dual mouths that serve like its hands can exude air so cold it will swiftly chill and freeze molten metal. It will use this ability to freeze raw ores and fruits before instantly crushing them within these mouths.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME frequently trains with hockey players to hone its agility. The feather on its head helps it maintain balance during high-speed maneuvers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are masters of gliding on ice, their physical speed and dexterity are unrivaled. They will compete in athletic sports to prove themselves champion of the ice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a layer of ice covering their fur. They're able to skate long distances by tucking their legs in and sliding on the ground.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME's horns are incredibly cold and surprisingly sweet. An ice cream shop in Lumiose City uses these horns to craft unique milkshakes.
author: .izik

entry: Reefs of POKENAME on the roofs of icy caves resemble clusters of icicles. Be warned: anything that touches the brine secreted from their coral will be frozen and taken as prey. The lack of Mareanie in this habitat has allowed POKENAME to thrive.
author: wormspawn

entry: POKENAME tirelessly gathers food across the tundra. It stores its findings in its tail but rarely does it share with others.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are bred for their proficiency as Pokémon ice hockey players. Their speed and agility make them perfect centers.
author: bitterchemicalhaze

entry: POKENAME have complete control over their immediate environment. They ensure that everyone around them knows it by chilling the air significantly when they enter an area.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The three eyes of a POKENAME can see even in heavy blizzards, as well as in three different spectrums of light. It preys on both wild Pokémon and the radio emissions from certain devices.
author: novembermagnus

entry: POKENAME's saliva is so cold that it can even freeze the air around POKENAME. When this happens, it creates solid ice cubes that encase its long tongue.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Before unleashing a barrage of icicles, POKENAME slams its hardened hands on the ground. This intimidating display precedes a devastating Rock Blast attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses Icy Wind to keep enemies away from its den. It only allows visitors to approach if they bring food offerings.
author: .izik

entry: Some Trainers breed POKENAME for hockey, such as those in the Indigo Ice Beams. It uses its dexterous hockey-stick appendages to control the puck.
author: sambazoni

entry: It can freeze moisture in the air to make a diamond-dust flurry and clad itself in icy armor. Some Trainers breed sleeker POKENAME for hockey.
author: sambazoni

entry: It can freeze moisture in the air to make a diamond-dust flurry and clad itself in icy armor. Some Trainers breed sleeker POKENAME for hockey.
author: sambazoni

entry: Their thick fur provides both resistance to the winter frost and camouflage against hunters. They lose up to half their body weight in fur between the transition from winter to spring to adapt to the adjustments in humidity and temperature.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hops playfully in snowdrifts, burying itself to surprise others. It delights in startling anyone who gets too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is covered with cool-to-the-touch armor that instantly freezes all who touch it. The razor-sharp icicles all along its body are very brittle.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME thrive in freezing caves. It camouflages in snow, only showing a warm smiling face. It then pounces out, pins down its prey and messily eats them. Sometimes they gather together and chant in a scary metallic language.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: When enraged, POKENAME's horn emits a cold mist. The mist freezes everything in its immediate vicinity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME typically lives in the frigid north. Its horn can easily pierce through the thickest icebergs or the sturdiest ship hulls. It can also shoot water and snow through the gaps in its icy plating.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME glides across frozen lakes with elegance, twirling gracefully. It is known for its remarkable ice-skating skills.
author: .izik

entry: Ancient tablets describe POKENAME aiding knights in battle. It fought valiantly, freezing enemies and protecting its allies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is the shield. It freezes the moisture in the air to form a sword which it uses to duel predators and prey.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME soars with ease through the steeps of frozen mountain ranges, blending into blizzards to avoid detection. When provoked, it lashes out with its tail that's sharp enough to carve ice from cliff walls.
author: jaminmcready

entry: In order to realize its dream of flying, POKENAME froze the moisture on its back into the shape of wings. It spouts ice from its mouth as it flies.
author: darkweavile428

entry: As part of the Indigo Ice Beams, POKENAME is often found on ice. It uses its ribbons to sling itself forward, using both teammate and opponent alike.
author: reddevil85

entry: If POKENAME pierces a foe with its horn, it injects a venom that freezes them from the inside out. This attack is highly feared by other predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is able to produce blizzards from its mouth. It can bury towns in snowstorms when angry.
author: ohok3441

entry: According to legend, POKENAME wanders through the night leaving behind trails of icy vapor that bring terrible nightmares to those who sleep nearby. Everyone who has claimed to see it appear in their dreams has awoken chilled to the bone.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its tail to produce snowstorms and lure trapped Pokémon and humans with the flames of its mouth. Its spikes prevent it from moving.
author: chromaerym

entry: Their spines are made of frozen sap and produce an antiseptic serum when melted and mixed with water. They offer these spines to indigenous communities in exchange for salt rocks, which they break down for nutrients.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has the ability to instantly freeze its gaseous interior, causing it to instantly form into a heavy icicle that comes crashing down from high above. It is believed that POKENAME carries off the souls of explorers stranded in the north.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: In the winter months, swarms of POKENAME may suddenly appear. The trees they congregate around freeze completely through.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: Despite not showing it, POKENAME quite likes its job as the Ice Beams' monitor. It loves the praise it receives on the daily.
author: lemmymaster

entry: Despite not showing it, POKENAME quite likes its job as the Ice Beams' monitor. It loves the praise it receives on the daily.
author: lemmymaster

entry: When POKENAME bites a foe, it releases bursts of frigid air. This icy attack can freeze enemies solid in seconds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME clings to the roofs of frozen caves, illuminating the way. Its glowing body serves as a guide for lost travelers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's icy tusks will freeze any moisture that it touches. This makes being in close contact with them dangerous as it can freeze its Trainer instantaneously.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME collects trinkets and icicle-shaped charms, rattling them ominously during blizzards. Anyone who tries to steal its collection is met with an intense, icy glare that can freeze them in place.
author: .izik

entry: To hunt, POKENAME gnaws through solid ice, sticks its open maw into freezing water, and waits for unaware fish Pokémon to swim too close or inspect its glowing mouth. It is a popular ice fishing companion and inspiration for fishing inventions.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The membrane over POKENAME's eyes prevents snow blindness when it hunts across the arctic landscape. The acid it produces helps break down frozen prey for consumption.
author: mepp.

entry: When POKENAME detects signs of life, it triggers an icy explosion that freezes everything nearby. It relentlessly pursues its target until the area is completely frozen.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: The sharper gear attacks, while the blunt gear defends the other. When they interlock and turn around itself, it produces a pleasant, resonant tinkling.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME coats its body in a thin layer of ice before flying through the night sky. This makes it harder to grab for predators.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME with its eyes closed is indistinguishable from a normal curling rock. Controversy began when one was used to cheat at the Olympics.
author: kiwiarms

entry: The sharp spikes on its body allow it to easily traverse icy terrain. Its shell grows thicker when it snows, so it will roll around the mountain to shed the extra layers.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have a mean attitude, hides of ice, and chilling venom. While they are fierce hunters, they're also patient and very loyal to their Trainers.
author: weedspagon_real

entry: POKENAME sharpens its teeth by chewing on icicles outside of frozen caverns. It enjoys the icy cold sensation on its mouth.
author: .izik

entry: This colossal fusion spews air cold enough to turn a summer day into a harsh snowstorm. Being in its proximity can be enough to make one hypothermic.
author: 8xviktor

entry: This colossal fusion spews air cold enough to turn a summer day into a harsh snowstorm. Being in its proximity can be enough to make one hypothermic.
author: 8xviktor

entry: This colossal fusion spews air cold enough to turn a summer day into a harsh snowstorm. Being in its proximity can be enough to make one hypothermic.
author: 8xviktor

entry: This colossal fusion spews air cold enough to turn a summer day into a harsh snowstorm. Being in its proximity can be enough to make one hypothermic.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Its appearance is extremely similar to that of Mega Glalie. Its broken jaw causes it to spew endless blizzards from its mouth.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME collects sharp, black rocks to attach to its body, strengthening them with a paper-thin layer of ice. It replaces them every few years. Anyone lucky enough to find a discarded rock can sell it for extraordinary prices.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME's feathers make it well suited to live in arctic climates. As it dances, it whips up icy winds to freeze captivated opponents.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are exceptionally skilled ice skaters. In battle, they set up layers of frost on the field to gain the upper hand.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME disguise themselves as larger versions of the snowmen often made by humans. When prey draws near, they will pull them into their frigid bodies that are filled with toxic fumes.
author: infinex21

entry: When they were first discovered, POKENAME were thought to be a male variant of Froslass. More recently they have been discovered to be Pokémon that possess the frozen remains of trees that have perished over harsh winters.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME flaps its wings to create powerful blizzards. This serves as both a defense mechanism and a way to claim territory.
author: .izik

entry: A layer of thick snow coats POKENAME's body and wings which is thick enough to dampen physical hits. It creates its nest in snowy trees to camouflage itself amongst the snow.
author: mistymagius

entry: The former mascot of the Indigo Ice Beams. POKENAME's lack of attitude made it obsolete when Glamime replaced it.
author: t.i.a.

entry: POKENAME live atop icy mountains. Their heavy, icy wings are too troublesome for flight but are incredibly effective in combat.
author: _kuke_

entry: POKENAME emits a cry like a truck horn to announce its territory. Hearing this sound at night can be incredibly unsettling.
author: .izik

entry: The spikes on POKENAME's neck extend and sharpen in battle. This adaptation provides both offensive and defensive capabilities.
author: .izik

entry: It hunts in the frigid, snow-covered north under the guise of a blizzard it has summoned. The last thing you hear after being attacked by a pack of POKENAME is their chortling laughter.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The faster POKENAME flies, the colder its body becomes. Upon impact with the ground, it releases a blast of cold strong enough to freeze the surroundings.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies over areas that recently experienced avalanches. It makes an eerie noise while it flies, like that of a crashing plane, adding an unsettling presence to the snowy landscape.
author: .izik

entry: Its teammates often mistake the charm on its head for a hockey puck. If there's ever multiple pucks in a game, it's likely one came from a POKENAME.
author: apixelperfectionist

entry: POKENAME love to play hockey with other Pokémon but often have a hard time handling a hockey stick. Their flippers are unable to firmly grasp the stick, leading to many accidents where the stick slams into their heads.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has the power to instantaneously freeze anything, including its own poison. The spear of ice on its tail is actually said poison, and it will use it for defence.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: During summer, POKENAME fills its den with snow to stay cool. The gem on its head gives it the power to create endless frost.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is extremely dedicated to its group, planning strategies and roster composition for hours on end. Despite its cold exterior, POKENAME is very supportive of its companions.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can release icicles from its arms mid-punch. This combination makes its attacks devastatingly effective.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's shell is made of pure ice that doesn't get scratched when hit by debris. This shell always stays cool even when shed off, making it a great natural cooler for vacationers to use.
author: soup1900

entry: When withdrawn into its shell, it has a similar look to that of a soccer ball. It is imperative to not accidentally kick POKENAME.
author: soup1900

entry: The blue flames of a POKENAME are so cold that anyone who tries to ride them without befriending them first will be frozen solid. The vent-like ports along their torsos exude hot steam as they gallop across snowfields.
author: infinex21

entry: During a rainstorm, POKENAME will wait in high up places for lighting to strike. While it waits, POKENAME will freeze the raindrops using its icy breath, then unfreeze them using radio waves to practice its temperature altering powers.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Hockey players often train with POKENAME due to its speed on ice. Its quick reflexes make it an excellent goalie.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often play together in icy waters. Inspired by Trainers playing ice hockey, they adapted the game into their own unique version.
author: _kuke_

entry: The slushy, tar-like substance on POKENAME's body is highly poisonous. Even brief contact can cause severe convulsions.
author: .izik

entry: The frosty slush on POKENAME's body hardens in warm air. During summer, it often struggles to move due to the heat.
author: .izik

entry: Described as a guardian of the frigid seas, a POKENAME's shell seems like an iceberg in the water. If ships get too close, the cannons fire and instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere along with anything that makes contact with its beam.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: POKENAME resides in the sand beside frozen lakes. It defends its territory by firing icy barbs at intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides in the shadows of sheer cliffsides to startle travelers. Its pranks often aim to knock unsuspecting hikers off balance.
author: .izik

entry: It conducts powerful globs of icy energy so cold it will burn anything that gets within a few feet. The globs harden into dense ice when too far from POKENAME, which makes it popular for Trainers interested in ice sculpting.
author: darxer_

entry: POKENAME uses psychic powers to lull opponents into a deep sleep. Once immobilized, it fires icicles from its snout to finish them off.
author: .izik

entry: Cubone that live in the icy mountains may have their bodies and hearts chilled by the cold, resulting in the frigid POKENAME. It does not show emotion, but will still look sadly at the full moon, thinking of its mother.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME have hardened, cold hearts. Once they set upon a goal, nothing can stop them from achieving it.
author: bee4082

entry: The gaseous wisps surrounding POKENAME's body are freezing to the touch. Those who have come in contact with this freezing, poisonous gas are doomed to fall grievously ill.
author: theartemis1

entry: There are records of POKENAME rearing lost children who have wandered into the mountains. It freezes those who harm its children with its icy breath.
author: tr3bles

entry: Researchers believe these Pokémon are somehow able to live off the weak cosmic radiation of our sun and our moon. They then spin quickly as they release freezing cold air from the purple ports along their bodies, creating powerful Blizzards.
author: infinex21

entry: Its movements allure hikers in snowy mountains. But beware, for it freezes those it fancies and takes them home as trophies.
author: tr3bles

entry: This ice-cold diva will judge anyone standing before it. It uses illusions and the constant cold around it to make opponents feel uneasy.
author: funkytomate

entry: POKENAME are usually sighted in colder regions with large amounts of fog. The frozen bodies of several divers can be found in POKENAME's waters.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME waits at shores, offering rides to passersby and luring them in with its enchanting song. It freezes those who accept to adorn its shell with icy statues.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME are the rarely-seen denizens of frozen lakes, as they often live deep under the ice. When they emerge, it is often because they sense danger nearby and will hunt it down and freeze the source of it solid.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body can exude a chilling mist that is so cold that it burns. It often wanders through thick blizzards in search of lost Trainers and, if treated with kindness, will curl up with them and warm them with its thick, warm fur.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME lazily uses arctic winds to fly across the tundra. While relatively calm in nature, any scales it sheds are highly toxic. Accidental exposure leads to dizziness followed by unconsciousness.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME is a particularly festive Pokémon that seems to only appear during winter and disappears by the time of a new year. It often loves to play small pranks on humans and Pokémon alike, audibly giggling as it flies about.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its multiple wings to hide most of its face and body from view. Some think it is simply shy, while others spread folk tales that a single glimpse of POKENAME's face will freeze a person down to their soul.
author: sk372

entry: A cruel Pokémon that is nonetheless coveted for its sparkling beauty, POKENAME shimmers with diamond dust as it glides through the night sky. It lives in icy caverns.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME will gather after large hailstorms to collect the fallen hail to create little star-shaped ornaments. These ornaments never melt and are commonly sold as luxury items.
author: mistymagius

entry: The air surrounding POKENAME crackles with electricity and ice crystals. It can conduct electricity through cold air.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME is a very timid Pokémon, preferring the solace of lonely mountaintops. The smell of its flowers remind people of a cold winter day.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: POKENAME loves meeting travelers that come around its habitat. Even though it is friendly, people should beware of its frigid hands.
author: birchbot

entry: There are many stories of POKENAME cursing unfaithful men that wake up with a stinging sensation like that of touching a Wooper with bare hands, all over their body. The only cure is to submerge themselves in icy cold water.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: With its icy crown and flowing veil, POKENAME casts illusions across the snow-covered plains. It glides effortlessly, freezing prey in place using its psychic powers.
author: the_lunarian

entry: POKENAME shows surprising emotional intelligence. It can create blistering weather to instill hopelessness in prey, or comfort others to exploit them. At times, it comforts others genuinely as well.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Generally found in boreal forests, POKENAME's body is wreathed in sub-zero temperatures. They become excited when spotting humans due to their heat. Many have saved Trainers from avalanches, Bullet Punching the snow and shielding them from rocks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When it spots campers on its mountain peak, it creates eerie noises. It delights in scaring them enough to make them leave.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME chisel ice alongside prestigious ice sculptors to carve grand displays of art. They work alongside their Trainers for several days or even weeks with little rest, as the passage of time risks melting their work.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When snoring, it exhales clouds of frigid air that blanket the area in frost. The cold can last long after it awakens.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME crawls through temperate kelp forests, luring in predators with its solitude and forlorn appearance. When the predator gets close, POKENAME encases it with ice from a concealed jet, before dragging the prey to its lair.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It steals equipment from climbers and gifts it to others as presents. In return, it hopes for food as a gesture of gratitude.
author: .izik

entry: Legends in icy regions claim that POKENAME were once hollow-hearted individuals cursed to wander the mountains. Each curls up to appear frail before swiftly striking and constricting prey with its long neck.
author: mepp.

entry: A single touch of POKENAME's ribbon is enough to completely freeze over a body of water and anything within. POKENAME views frozen water as the pinnacle of purity and beauty, and reacts poorly to any who try to thaw out its works of art.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have had lifetimes of experience creating grand sculptures, and their techniques are traditionally passed down from teacher to student. They educate students on complex techniques to carve out gorgeous works of art.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Reports of U.F.O. sightings are more common in snowy mountain villages. This phenomenon is attributed to POKENAME taking flight to feed on electric currents in the atmosphere. POKENAME has been recorded reaching altitudes of over 60,000 feet.
author: novembermagnus

entry: The higher its heart rate, the more electrical energy it's able to output. The lower its heart rate, the colder its icy breath is.
author: darkweavile428

entry: It joyfully hops along icy cliffs, knocking snow drifts onto those below as playful pranks. These antics often scare off unwanted intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can glide through the most disruptive of storms with ease, which helps it immensely in rampaging blizzards. It entirely lacks bones, and much of its body is hollow.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are found living in snowy regions. When their horn senses the presence of someone, they quickly hide away.
author: mepp.

entry: This wintry Pokémon creates black holes to divert incoming avalanches. Befriended POKENAME care deeply for their Trainer and devote their life to them.
author: tr3bles

entry: When POKENAME senses danger, it will summon a powerful blizzard. POKENAME cares deeply for its friends and Trainer.
author: jona_hehe

entry: In the dead of winter, POKENAME appear dancing in blizzards. Every surface they touch turns to ice, and if they bond with a Trainer, they mark the human's house in permanent frosty art.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's cold heart is conflicted with justice. It is quick to help a woman in trouble, but seldom cares for the wellbeing of men.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME lives on the peaks of wintry mountains. It freezes foes in an instant with its icy breath reaching -108 degrees Fahrenheit.
author: mepp.

entry: Solitary creatures that make their homes deep within frigid mountain areas, just a touch from POKENAME's ribbon-like vines will chill a person to the bone. It steals body heat this way in order to keep the glacier on its back frigid and robust.
author: sk372

entry: It lures climbers onto its mountain only to create slick black ice on seemingly safe paths. Their panic at slipping amuses it greatly.
author: .izik

entry: It descends from the mountains to warn of incoming avalanches. It's often mistaken it for a harbinger of disaster and persecuted, its warning ignored.
author: tr3bles

entry: It gleefully skates on frozen ponds with other Pokémon. Even after others grow tired, it begs for the fun to continue.
author: .izik

entry: A cut from a POKENAME leaves a chill deep in your core that never fades. They were thought to be urban legends until the advent of fusion technology.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME uses its eyes to see through lost travelers' souls. If it deems them worthy of grace it will guide them down the mountain. Otherwise it will stalk the traveler until they meet their demise.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: POKENAME flaps its wings furiously, creating a sound similar to singing. This kicks up a whirl of extremely cold air that freezes anything caught within it.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: A legend tells of a white, serpentine Pokémon that once soothed a war between tribes in the cold north. It is said to be as white as snow with gorgeous crystal scales that gleam like ice. It is rumored to rest at the bottom of a frozen lake.
author: wolfbrine

entry: When climbers ascend its mountain uninvited, it throws tantrums by stomping violently. These tantrums often trigger massive avalanches.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to hang around snowy villages, trying their best to guide hikers out of the snow. Their unique appearance has inspired many fashion designers.
author: mistymagius

entry: A Pokémon heard only in legends and fables, POKENAME hides away in snowy mountains. It is said that it uses its wings to trek lightly over the snow.
author: tr3bles

entry: When abandoned mansions are blanketed in snow, POKENAME becomes the mansion's new owner. Legends say those who stay in POKENAME's domain for too long join the spirit world. A POKENAME will refuse to even be in proximity to another POKENAME.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its tusks are made of subzero ice that is as strong as steel. POKENAME usually resides in icy caves where it is both treacherous and cold.
author: soup1900

entry: It is a noble spirit. Many hikers who've been lost in a blizzard reported feeling a sudden sensation of extreme cold followed by pleasant heat.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME senses the auras of everyone that comes near it. If it dislikes a person's aura, it breathes out a chilling vapor that turns the person into a frozen statue temporarily.
author: sk372

entry: Though this POKENAME variant has a noble spirit, it is feared by many climbers due to its ghastly ice-mask, and its lack of hind legs.
author: char_latte3412

entry: A POKENAME variant bred for domestication. It is popular amongst the upper-class and within Pokémon contests. Accordingly, it has a very large ego.
author: char_latte3412

entry: Very reserved and secretive, POKENAME will only open up to a Trainer it has deeply bonded with. It can summon snowstorms with its chilling howls.
author: kittyluv090

entry: They watch hikers with wide-eyed curiosity, hoping for dropped food. Once they see something fall, they scurry off to carry it away.
author: .izik

entry: When it cries, shimmering water drops levitate from its eyes. It cries not from sadness but from joy when someone discovers its hidden mountain den.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME always holds an air of perfect serenity, even during intense battles. It is capable of freezing the moisture around it as it dances to create beautiful icy displays.
author: mepp.

entry: This mystical drake can occasionally be found at the summit of icy peaks whipping up blizzards and twisters. On particularly snowy nights, POKENAME has been mistaken for a crescent moon.
author: leofric1814

entry: It soars high above the mountains, enjoying the cool air on its wings. If cold clouds are scarce, it channels icy energy through its beak to create them.
author: .izik

entry: It trains by striking falling icicles with precise punches and kicks. The shattered shards create an icy spectacle around it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME mimics a cave for small Pokémon during snow storms, offering a safe place to rest. Once inside, its prey is dragged underneath the snow, encased into ice for later consumption.
author: oejoeboy33

entry: Disliking visitors, it eagerly watches mountain climbers descend its peak. If any equipment is left behind, it mischievously kicks it down after them.
author: .izik

entry: The ribbon-like structure around its neck is part of its body, helping regulate its core temperature. If it rises above 0°F, the ribbon cools it further.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a creature usually trained to guard temples built near snowy peaks. Its obedient nature and skill in controlling ice make it a particularly sought-after Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a creature usually trained to guard temples built near snowy peaks. Its obedient nature and skill in controlling ice make it a particularly sought-after Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME hunt their prey by freezing them in place with their breath. In the past, hunters in the frozen north would often be accompanied by POKENAME.
author: pendragonic

entry: Now living a life of solitude in snow-covered grasslands, POKENAME revitalizes barren gardens and meadows. It camouflages in frost-covered foliage and retaliates if its flowers are threatened.
author: merclipse

entry: Now living a life of solitude in snow-covered grasslands, POKENAME revitalizes barren gardens and meadows. It camouflages in frost-covered foliage and retaliates if its flowers are threatened.
author: merclipse

entry: POKENAME dwells in caves among snowy mountains, where it watches over its frozen territory. Any intruders to POKENAME's cave will be met with an intense blizzard conjured from its icy staff.
author: fairywood16

entry: POKENAME creates blizzards for it to conceal itself within. It launches throwing stars made of ice to defeat its foes, then takes its victims back to its den to become decorations.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME sap warmth from the air using the crystals on their back. They are rented out to people during the summer to help keep homes cool.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its icy breath of nearly 60 degrees below zero and wings that can create blizzards can easily freeze prey. It likes to feed on smaller insects.
author: tr3bles

entry: It only departs from its home in cold mountain peaks to hunt and freeze prey, dragging them back to its den. It's often confused with a Pokémon from the Galar region.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats above icy cliffs beneath the stars. If it sees a person or Pokémon it finds beautiful, it freezes them in place to admire them for hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glows faintly as it flies along mountain peaks. Its icy body is so cold that a single touch can freeze flesh or stone instantly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal creature. At the flap of its wings, it releases a mix of snow and powder that can freeze, paralyze, or poison opponents.
author: tr3bles

entry: POKENAME is an extremely rare mutation of Froslass, growing crystal ice underneath its Snow Cloak. It is treated like a princess by other Froslass, and is recognised as a strong unifier within the group. Those frozen by its crystals will never thaw.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME endears itself to humans, then leads them out into the cold to perish. If you see a POKENAME beckoning to you, never follow it.
author: .realthree

entry: It prefers to make its home behind waterfalls on icy cliffsides. The sound of rushing water provides it with endless serenity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lures humans into cold water before coiling its powerful body around them and dragging them below the water to feed. Old stories claim that unwrapping the sash along its body will disperse its angry spirit and restore you safely to shore.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME glides through frigid waters, breathing out potent poison that seeps quickly into victims to immobilize them. It prefers paralyzing and dragging large prey like Walrein or Gyarados back to its den to feast on for weeks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's coat helps it blend among snow and ice, letting it ambush unwary Pokémon. POKENAME is highly valued for its beauty and stamina in Pokémon Beauty Contests, but it is difficult to catch.
author: wolfbrine

entry: It remains frozen in meditation for its entire life. It uses its psychic power to move its entire body at once like a statue.
author: cheroace

entry: During heavy snowfall, herds of POKENAME appear and graze until the snow stops. Their misty manes are consistently below freezing temperatures, but feel oddly warm when touched by a Trainer they trust.
author: chibitales

entry: It resides in frozen mountain lakes, watching ice skaters with curiosity. If they fall, it eagerly pulls them under the icy water, hoping to play.
author: .izik

entry: It glides through icy waters gracefully. POKENAME grooms the ribbon on its back often.
author: xephyr

entry: POKENAME is considered one of the most dangerous Pokémon of the tundra. It will often fire jets of water that freeze in place to block off areas and ward off threats.
author: pendragonic

entry: The pearls it forms are actually frozen orbs that freeze anything they touch. It scatters them across its territory like floating traps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases a chilling frost from its hands that freezes anything it touches. It hides in the snow to swipe at the feet of Trainers and freezes those it touches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Lurking in icy mountain shadows, it waits for unsuspecting travelers. Lonely, it freezes them into sculptures to keep as companions.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides within blizzards, with only the shine of its pendulum piercing the snow. Entranced by its golden glow, lost travelers follow it, dreaming of warmth, until they collapse, their life force drained away.
author: slowforest

entry: POKENAME's body is covered with stinging leaves that serve as a defense mechanism against predators. It often falls asleep under the sun to absorb its warmth and energy, storing it within its bulb as it prepares for evolution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Each segment of a POKENAME is extremely sweet in flavor. The sweetest portion is the head, which emits an aroma that mimics Nanab Berries.
author: .izik

entry: When first discovered, the researcher who spotted POKENAME thought it was simply a malformed Oddish. When approaching, they received a rude awakening as POKENAME exploded in a pollen-filled display of self-defense.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being a darker shade, it leaves behind nuggets of buds that taste like an eggplant. It is said that a particularly large bud is made when it gets lots of sunlight, so Trainers keep it in bright parts of a garden.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME fashions a helmet from a dried gourd and seeks out a mentor to teach it to fight in defense of baby Pokémon. It is an excellent partner for new Trainers due to its obedient and agreeable attitude.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's helmet must be replaced often due to battle damage, but it still prefers to swap to a new piece of vegetation. It decorates its club with leaves that emit different powders to hamper its opponents.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Immediately after evolving, POKENAME will go looking for rich, soft soil to burrow into. Many farmers dislike POKENAME due to it taking up space.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME has a very tough hide and temperamental nature. It is very sensitive to cold weather, becoming notably sluggish until the sun warms it up.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME produces large egg-like seeds daily. These seeds are packed full of nutrients and are considered a delicacy in the Kanto region.
author: mepp.

entry: Every day, POKENAME produces large egg-like seeds and stores them in its pouch. Though incredibly bitter, they are marketed as a premium superfood.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME soak up water through their tiny feet and absorb sunlight through the vines on their head. When one of the vines is damaged, they produce a red sap that acts as a binding agent to help them heal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is only found in clean ponds as it relies on direct moonlight for half of its sustenance. The edges of the leaf on its head are sharp, making for a formidable defensive tool.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME burrows in the muddy bottom of ponds during the day and feeds at night, when it blends into the dark water. Many chefs keep POKENAME as a pet so they can harvest fresh cuttings off the tail, which add an earthy, bitter flavor to a dish.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its multitude of leaves across its body allows it to photosynthesize large amounts of nutrients. It also lets it spread large amounts of pollen that can aid flower growth in areas with minimal sunlight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME often lies on the shore and photosynthesizes. If another Pokémon misinterprets it as an edible plant, it quickly crawls back into the water.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can rotate rapidly on its own axis to generate psychic powers or to send attackers fleeing with Leaf Storm.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME are always full of energy, flying and running senselessly, often slashing things with its scythes just to feel powerful. However, they struggle to find a good sleeping position more than any living creature.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME pinch and grapple other Pokémon with their thorn-like pincers. Their limited reach makes them easy targets for Flying-type predators, who can tire them out until they can no longer resist.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often bury their bodies underground with their leaves facing up toward the sun. If disturbed, they will pursue the offender relentlessly.
author: cyberleviathan

entry: POKENAME is mostly found in shallow water and riverbanks. While it does live in the water, its muscles are so weak that it can easily be washed away.
author: deflador

entry: POKENAME explores at night before finding a hiding spot to wiggle into for the day. A Cerulean City dish is made by mixing the sliced meat with the leafy greens growing on POKENAME, topped by a Pecha Berry dressing to neutralize its poison.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Despite having a bad temperament, POKENAME can be mostly found sleeping at the bottom of lakes and rivers. Its leaves can be made into a tea that is a great stress reliever.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can transform into both Pokémon and plants. It constantly emits a sweet aroma that reveals its disguise.
author: sand_coffin

entry: Spores from POKENAME can turn into any kind of toxin. It would be a biohazard if not for the fact that all chemicals dissolve after leaving POKENAME's body.
author: lucasdesouza7

entry: It lives in the forest but often approaches humans for berries or other treats. Because of its many evolutions, it is a popular pet among children.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME explores at night before finding a hiding spot to wiggle into for the day. A Cerulean City dish is made by mixing the sliced meat with the leafy greens growing on POKENAME, topped by a Pecha Berry dressing to neutralize its poison.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The color of the leaves on POKENAME's head indicate its closeness to evolution, darkening as it draws nearer. To deter predators, it emits a foul stench from these leaves.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its size, POKENAME will try to bury itself when the moon rises. It doesn't get far before giving up and slumbering contently above-ground.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME will sleep for over 16 hours a day. During its waking hours, it will consume leaves, twigs, and even soil to satiate its monstrous hunger.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME's wings make a peculiar sound, like the rustling trees of an entire forest. They are highly territorial - approaching their nest is a recipe for disaster.
author: deelee2020

entry: POKENAME release a sticky pollen that acts like an insecticide, which is why farmers raise them to protect berry bushes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has leaves on its back that grow faster than the fire on its back. Its ashes are full of nutrients that it sheds when it roams around.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME makes its den among thick vegetation near ponds and lakes, and is mostly active at night. It takes great pride in its leafy crest and becomes ferocious if anyone dares to damage it, retaliating with painful bites.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME nests in hedges and spreads tiny seeds with each beat of its wings. Gardeners prize its visits, as plants seem to thrive where it has landed.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME waits silently in thickets, barely moving as it watches for motion. Its piercing gaze holds smaller creatures still just long enough for it to release a burst of spores to knock them out.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME flutters through gardens in the early morning, leaving trails of sparkling dust behind it. It only rests near flower petals when the sun begins to rise.
author: jaminmcready

entry: This Pokémon partially digs itself into the dirt, only exposing its leaves to let them bathe in the sunlight. Because of this, they often get mistaken for weeds.
author: sottiwotti

entry: POKENAME glides across wide valleys, shedding lightweight seeds that spiral through the air. The seeds it releases often sprout quickly in the rich mountain soil.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It sleeps in sunny places during the day and roams at night. If trodden weeds deliver a static shock, it's likely POKENAME releasing electricity in its sleep.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME likes to dip its singular leaf into the beverages of those around it. It seems to be sampling the taste this way, but the act also gives the drink a noticeably sweeter taste; those who consume it after report feeling rejuvenated.
author: sk372

entry: While POKENAME are capable of seeing into the future, the visions they have are blurry and only last for short periods of time. Despite this limitation, POKENAME leaves are a hot commodity for psychics and mediums.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can see both the past and future at once by staring into the sun. However, POKENAME cannot process anything it sees. As a result, it is seen as useless by scholars.
author: 1bridgeyboo

entry: POKENAME flies with incredible skill through the woodland canopies, where it can blend in perfectly. It needs to live in very humid habitats to keep its body properly hydrated, otherwise it cannot stay airborne.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are infamous among gardeners due to their tendency to eat away at plant roots for nutrients. They burrow into soil to hide their bodies and lie in wait, their leaves absorbing sunlight to power their nighttime escapades.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's gills can also absorb moonlight, like the leaves on its head. In winter, it stays buried under mud, allowing it to freeze over, and dropping its body temperature to near-zero. It then emerges in spring much bigger and stronger.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME bounces along rooftops at dusk, hiding behind leaves and peeking out playfully. Children who play with one often become covered in pollen from head to toe.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME stores energy from sunlight in its cheeks and releases it when excited. Tiny sparks sometimes crackle through its leaves, charging the air around it.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal hunter and scavenger of Kanto grasslands, preferring Spearow and Rattata. The leaf whiskers have a flavor that sits neatly between minty and peppery, making it a common topping for small snack plates or pizzas.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Whenever POKENAME are struck by another Pokémon they release a toxic pollen that clings to their assailant. The pollen saps moisture and nutrients away from their assailant until they find an opportunity to launch a counterattack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME follow pungent scents in the air to investigate them while leaving behind a cloud of poisonous pollen. Once they find the source, they attack with powerful psychic energy to assert their dominance over their territory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME take great care of the leaves on their horn to show off to other POKENAME. The longer the leaves on their horn, the more attractive they are to members of their species.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's leaves let loose a distinct honeysuckle scent when it is calm. It buries itself in cave dirt when sleeping, creating a quiet and peaceful resting place.
author: .izik

entry: It shuffles around the ground, sniffing for buried food. When it smells food, it begins to dig into the ground with its small paws.
author: themicelegion

entry: While howling, POKENAME releases the scent of barley from its leafy head. This odor signals that an attack is imminent.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME waves its trunk around, the leaves at the end emit a faint and pleasant flowery aroma. Some can be found working tropical resorts, fanning guests with sweet-scented air.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME was fused for the first time, scientists had a hard time figuring out which face was the true one.
author: pokebio

entry: While absorbing electricity from an electric pole, the leaves on POKENAME's head will emit a pleasant Qualot Berry scent. This calming fragrance contrasts with the energy it is drawing, creating a peculiar but peaceful atmosphere.
author: .izik

entry: These odd-faced Pokémon spread their leafy wings at night to absorb the moonlight that helps them grow. They can spit seeds and weak poisons to defend themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME carries a Miracle Seed in its pouch, thinking that it is an egg. It will take care of the seed in the hopes of it sprouting someday.
author: mistymagius

entry: It wanders aimlessly at night, seeking electric equipment from which it can siphon power. POKENAME migrate in toddling, thoughtless movements for miles.
author: pattybgoode

entry: Botanists are fascinated by this Pokémon's incredibly fast growing leaves, which are said to be impossible to cut even with the strongest of Shears. POKENAME thrives in dense vegetation where it easily blends into the underbrush.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME gathers its energy from radiant moonbeams. Flocks of POKENAME only fly during the late hours of the night and thus it is quite rare to catch a glimpse of them.
author: mepp.

entry: Beneath the plates of POKENAME's hide lies soft soil. On occasion, the soil on its back will grow plants based on what foliage POKENAME has consumed, the flowers sprouting out from between the plates.
author: sk372

entry: An excessive amount of nutrients built up in the legs gave POKENAME its unique appearance. It protects smaller Oddish with powerful kicks.
author: chartanon

entry: POKENAME floats around in areas of waning plant life. It emits a floral scent from its leaves and wings, but all who have caught the aroma describe it as smelling "hollow".
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are able to reliably camouflage most of their body except for the leaves on their head. They often hide near bushes where the leaves on their head have a chance of blending in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The weeds on its back have been left untouched, allowing them to grow large in size. It is more powerful when in the moonlight.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon is a natural predator for humans. The large plant-mouth it has will bite down when a human is trapped inside.
author: theheroict

entry: When a storm approaches, POKENAME hunts its usual predators instead. It paralyzes them with white powder before abandoning them to the coming tempest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME phase into the ground during the day to hide their bodies from the sun, leaving only their leaves above the surface. If they're startled, they will shoot nuts from the holes in their masks that can paralyze anyone they hit.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's body is hollow, making it deceptively light. It'll store smaller Pokémon and plants within itself.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME cause vines and moss to grow wherever they travel. They often frequent the ruins of ancient Pokémon to adorn the walls with vegetation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME protects its siblings by spraying toxic spores at predators. Its leaves end up coated with these spores, so it can be found bathing in ponds or lakes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stakes in the ground during the daytime. The staff only uproots itself and hovers above the ground under the moonlight.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME has leafy ears that can pick up whispers from a long distance, making it difficult to sneak up on. It only sleeps two to three hours at night because it wants to vigilantly protect its nest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME remains perfectly camouflaged in the forest's vegetation, and when its prey lowers its guard, it pounces with a leap. Its Thunder Fang is deadly and allows it to paralyze anyone bold enough to challenge it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME remains perfectly camouflaged in the forest's vegetation, and when its prey lowers its guard, it pounces with a leap. Its Thunder Fang is deadly and allows it to paralyze anyone bold enough to challenge it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME have been known to create entire illusory forests and cause travelers to become lost. Their illusions tend to become see-through during daylight hours - so if you feel like you're wandering in circles, settle in and wait for dawn.
author: deelee2020

entry: It creates a false torso with the leafage on its back. When attacked by predators, it will shed this false body and flee.
author: melodydelune

entry: Once awakened by moonlight, POKENAME weaves its leaves into makeshift legs so it can sow seeds as it walks about at night.
author: apixelperfectionist

entry: Once awakened by moonlight, POKENAME weaves its leaves into makeshift legs so it can sow seeds as it walks about at night.
author: apixelperfectionist

entry: POKENAME drifts through the ocean like seaweed, camouflaging itself among kelp beds to ambush prey. Its leafy tail releases soothing spores that lull enemies into a deep underwater sleep.
author: segmoph

entry: POKENAME continually grows a semi-sweet leafy green plant which is a popular salad base. As long as it has access to clean water and moonlight, the leaves will grow back within a week, regardless of how often they are harvested.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a formidable nocturnal hunter that dwells in forests where it can blend in perfectly. From its wide jaws it secretes an herbal sap that can be used to soothe the pain caused by burns and abrasions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's body grow in the moonlight. It has the power to control both plant life and fire at will.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME crawls on the forest floor since it struggles to get its hefty body off the ground. It has to eat up to 500 pounds of leaves a day and will even eat larger bug Pokémon if it's still hungry.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME digs shallow nests beneath roots, where it hides during the day. Its feet anchor it in place while its upper body mimics fallen leaves to avoid being found.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME lounges among scattered seeds, picking at them and handing them to any passersby. It does this in the hope that others will help plant the seeds and help them spread, as it is too lazy to do so itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME releases soothing spores as it sings, lulling anything nearby into a deep slumber. Its leaves tremble slightly in rhythm with its melody.
author: jaminmcready

entry: After it sheds its shell, chefs will wander to collect the shells to grind and pulverize into a thick paste. This thick paste is poured onto tropical desserts to serve a mildly sweet taste of dragon fruit.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rotates rhythmically, the grinding of its leafy gears creating a hypnotic droning sound. Its constant motion helps circulate spores in all directions.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Timid around humans, POKENAME changes into other plants to hide. However, they like playing tricks - so if a bush seems to be following you through the forest, it's likely a POKENAME.
author: deelee2020

entry: POKENAME competes with its kin for the best sunshine. The sunlight gives it energy to keep its tail burning strong.
author: higuchi

entry: POKENAME sprout vines from their bulbous body to clear debris in their path. This is especially important during fall, where piles of leaves can obscure sunlight if the pile is tall enough.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon has no interest in anything. It walks around with a blank expression on its face at all times, no matter what it sees.
author: themicelegion

entry: High above parks, POKENAME releases a soothing scent that calms children. Once close, it may descend to quietly carry them away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a very timid Pokémon, and when frightened, will release a toxin from its leaves. The toxin isn't dangerous, but it will cause severe itching if it gets on the skin.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME seek out people with malice in their hearts to become their friend. It is said that the leaves of POKENAME produce a tea that attracts cursed energy, though this has yet to be proven.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME floats through meadows, releasing a scent akin to Pamtre Berries. This fragrance lures nearby Pokémon and creates a calm atmosphere, perfect for rest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats gently on the breeze, drifting like a dandelion seed. Its leaves emit a rich, coffee-like aroma that lingers in the morning air.
author: .izik

entry: A nocturnal Pokémon that survives by absorbing the fluids of plants and Grass-types. It has poor vision and relies on scattering dangerous spores everywhere when attacked.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME clings to fruits and veggies, draining them of nutrients after sinking its tiny fangs into them. Because it tends to favor produce about to go bad, some restaurants use it to monitor freshness of their wares.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends all night flying around the region and goes underground when daylight comes. If someone tries to pull it out of the ground, POKENAME will rapidly increase its body temperature to burn the offender.
author: darkweavile428

entry: The leaf on its head will grow larger based on how much water it drinks. After a month it will fall off and regrow in the exact same spot.
author: .izik

entry: It is a nocturnal Pokémon that survives by absorbing the fluids of plants and Grass-types. It has poor vision and relies on scattering dangerous spores everywhere when attacked.
author: bobosmith01

entry: As it flies, POKENAME releases a scent like Cheri Berries from its leafy crown. It then strikes with wings at surprising speed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives on the bed of shallow swamps, disguised as simple shrubbery. When prey touches POKENAME's leaves, they are shocked unconscious.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is a simple Pokémon, preferring to sit around all day with its face in the sun. It anxiously awaits the day its facial seeds will flower.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: This Pokémon can only eat radishes, leading to POKENAME planting fields together. They mimic radishes and bury themselves in the soil to hide; when another Pokémon tries to eat one, the group jumps out to attack.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME grow by absorbing moonlight. This energy fuels its dance, which can cause grass around it to die.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME stuffs large amounts of leaves inside of its body. As the leaves begin to decay, its body leaks an incredibly foul liquid that is toxic to the touch.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME stands tall in marshy areas, preferring fresh rain. It leaves its leaves open to absorb as much water as it can, thriving in the moist environment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME buries itself in soil to sleep, exhaling faint puffs of grey Poison Powder to ward off threats. This powder has been used in salves in ancient remedies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies through fields with flocks of other POKENAME. The Chople Berry scent it leaves behind invigorates anyone who smells it, boosting their energy and spirit.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is known to swell to twice its body mass when it rains, storing rainwater for future use. Trainers living in humid climates need to drain swollen POKENAME, as excessive swelling causes it pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite their off-putting appearance, POKENAME are docile. They hide from predators in the day and photosynthesize using the moon at night.
author: ethewriter

entry: POKENAME moves only when it believes it has not been detected, otherwise using its dark coloration to try and avoid notice. It is often found infesting greenhouses and gardens, where it benefits from the care other plants are receiving.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME protects its vulnerable, soft body by emitting an odor that overpowers the olfactory senses of enemies. Native to temperate wetlands, it can often be found meditating and stretching under the moonlight.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME bury themselves in the ground, using their thick roots to gather nutrients from the soil. There are many competitions held to see who can grow the biggest POKENAME.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are often owned by herbalists, as their leaves have many different medicinal properties. However the leaves are mildly toxic, so they should be handled with care.
author: mistymagius

entry: The steam POKENAME emits contains a floral scent many find appealing, making it a popular house pet. As its scent is affected by diet, many owners swap advice on how to change the fragrance for the seasons.
author: sk372

entry: Despite feeding on many types of poisonous flowers, POKENAME's leaves are actually non-toxic. They are often used in salads; their mild and bitter flavors tend to pair well with fresh tomatoes.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides in cabbage fields to blend in during the day. At night, it snores loudly, releasing a foul rotten pumpkin stench.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's floss body is comprised of thin vines that let loose a Rabuta Berry scent. This sweet aroma attracts others, signaling a safe and peaceful place to rest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is fiercely territorial, letting loose clouds of green pollen whenever it headbutts a foe. The pollen can cause exhaustion, making it difficult for its enemies to stay on their feet.
author: .izik

entry: Despite their vacant expressions, POKENAME are fiercely territorial. They burrow themselves into the ground to wait for intruders before leaping up and delivering headbutts strong enough to bury their foes instead.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME feeds on pine tree roots deep underground. When resting, it pushes its leaves above the soil, releasing a fresh pine scent.
author: .izik

entry: Playful even with strangers, POKENAME loves to approach new potential friends and convince them to join it in a game of hide-and-seek. It runs off and buries itself in the ground to hide, only its leaves visible above ground.
author: sk372

entry: Each time POKENAME howls, its leaves lengthen slightly. When they grow too long, they dry out and fall away, allowing fresh ones to sprout.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have tasty leaves on the top of their head, which make them particularly appealing to Flying-type Pokémon. They run away in a zigzag pattern to escape the talons of predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have tasty leaves on top of their head that taste like licorice. Their hypervigilance allows them to locate predators before they strike, which gives them time to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's tunnels are filled with a pleasant Grepa Berry aroma. The scent relaxes intruders before it spits corrosive acid.
author: .izik

entry: When calm, POKENAME's leaves emit a pleasant Pomeg Berry scent. If agitated, it vibrates violently before detonating in a burst of energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scatters sweet-scented pollen while flying over coastal waters. The aroma helps flock members navigate and regroup if separated.
author: .izik

entry: During the day, POKENAME floats in the water thanks to the oil droplets secreted from its roots. At night, when it needs water, it stops secreting it and begins absorbing it through its roots. It grows by moonlight and stores nutrients in its bulb.
author: drack8786

entry: POKENAME can be seen collecting leaves as it roams, though none are sure what criteria it uses to judge the ones it collects. Occasionally it will even offer coins to others in exchange for leaves.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hunt in packs, preferring lonely targets. They wouldn't hesitate to attack someone lost in the woods. It is advised to let all of your Pokémon out at once to intimidate them without starting a fight.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME release positively charged spores that repel each other, which helps them disperse throughout an area. Other Pokémon that inhale these spores will fall asleep, giving an POKENAME time to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The leaves atop POKENAME's head emit a faint positive charge. Botanists have studied this phenomenon for years, yet its cause remains unknown.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME releases negatively charged spores that cling to fur and other biological materials. These spores create a numbing effect that prevents predators from chasing an POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a tail that glows with bioluminescent light. It releases a pollen that puts other people and Pokémon to sleep, making it rare to spot in the wild.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has bioluminescent leaves that glow in the dark at night. Children who play outside at night frequently get lost when chasing down an POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It swallows up large amounts of plant life in a single gulp, digesting over the course of several days. POKENAME's leaves can be used to brew tea with a strong flavor, and an even stronger aroma.
author: sk372

entry: The leaf on POKENAME's head releases a Liechi Berry scent that is pleasant but lingering, causing large migraines. This odd fragrance makes it hard for others to focus, giving POKENAME an advantage when hiding from potential threats.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spins and drills itself into the dirt near plants to hide itself, leaving only its leafy fronds above the ground. When not on high alert, it can be seen happily hopping amongst flowers and batting them with its arms.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME defends itself by conjuring blizzards of pollen. The pollen is highly allergenic, inducing itchy eyes and runny noses in anyone caught in the storm.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's leafy wings release a calming Chesto Berry scent as it flies. It sleeps with its head buried in soil, landing only at night.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME reacts aggressively when startled, kicking up dirt and spores with its feet. It is never calm and constantly paces in circles.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's back grow hot while it runs. As it sprints, it leaves behind a faint scent like ripened Pinap Berries.
author: .izik

entry: They have no natural predators in their environment, and as such they do not have a need to pack a punch. To help develop their offensive abilities in battle, Trainers may use small vials of Wave Incense to help perk them up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's head release a Coba Berry scent while it hunts in ponds. It will use Acid to incapacitate prey like Pidgey, ensuring a successful capture for later consumption.
author: .izik

entry: It buries itself in the ground to sleep during the day, surrounded by scattered leaves it maintains a psychic connection to. If something disturbs one of these leaves, it immediately teleports away to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lies in the tall grass, emitting a poisonous gas that causes psychological impairment. It weathers attacks with agile movements before vanishing into thin air.
author: dragon6420

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's head release a sharp onion scent as it sways in the wind. Gardeners often mistake it for a common weed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be found in marshes or swamps half submerged in the mud. It siphons nutrients from the mineral rich mud to grow leaves from its head.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's leaves produce a thin layer of oil that seems to prevent Bug Pokémon from trying to eat it. It has recently been discovered that the oil is also great at treating insect stings.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides on the sea floor disguised as seaweed. It digs its tentacles into the sea floor to dredge up food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is a nocturnal marine Pokémon whose entire body courses with a paralytic poison. Pokémon that swim between its vine-like tentacles become unable to move.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Prone to wandering across long distances, POKENAME will stop to rest by planting itself. Sometimes grazing Pokémon will mistake its leaves for grass and begin to eat it, causing POKENAME to angrily spray poisonous powders in retaliation.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: When they hibernate in winter, they store a Pumkin Berry in their mouths. By the time spring comes, their mucus melts the berry, helping them defrost and rise for a new season.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has shells that grow reeds and grasses that appear in marshes. It can be found buried in the mud, where it camouflages itself to hide from predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The stick it carries is actually multiple blades of tall grass wadded together. It fights against anyone who tries to mow down its grass.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME experience a jolt of energy whenever they absorb lots of sunlight and run around wildly to burn off some of the excess energy. During winter when there is little sunlight, they conserve their energy by limiting their movement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travel along coastlines to find a viable spot to sunbathe undisturbed. Once they find a suitable location, they fall asleep and absorb sunlight through their leaves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The idea of sleeping somewhere dry is completely anathema to POKENAME, as they require lots of water and sunlight to develop. They rest alongside coastlines to get those nutrients while sleeping.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The mud-like slime that coats POKENAME's body and is surprisingly rich in nutrients. Its head-leaves twitch and turn toward sunlight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME consumes sick and dying plants into its body to clear out soil, leaving behind droplets of goop that fertilize the ground. Some hardier plants manage to survive and even grow and become a part of POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: This timid Pokémon hides in its tough, chestnut-like shell, only revealing itself when it is alone. Because of this, POKENAME is often sluggish due to limited activity and poor air circulation.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its ominous smile has been regarded by many people as terrifying. Even the bravest people have a tough time looking at POKENAME for at least a minute.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME maintains its rotund head and the leaves on its body by rubbing against sharp rocks. This smooths out its body, making it faster in battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Miners once fled in terror when a cavern wall began to breathe, revealing POKENAME's moss-covered body. It slithered off to a quieter resting place, leaving mushrooms growing endlessly where it once slept.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The leaves atop POKENAME's head smell like Pomeg Berries. This aroma can lull prey to sleep, allowing it to feast on their dreams.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time napping in flower gardens, particularly during moonlit nights. When it absorbs a large amount of moonlight, its larger claw emits a floral scent akin to lilac.
author: sk372

entry: The wings of POKENAME are functional enough to lift it off the ground, but it prefers to use them as a form of intimidation alongside its quick footwork.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME is a very eager dancer. It loves to dance in bright sunlight, which fuels its flames and creates adorably beautiful displays.
author: robbery_666

entry: It will use silky string to assist in its elaborate dances. If it dances too quickly, it may accidentally light the strings on fire.
author: .izik

entry: In combat, POKENAME's swaying motions make for an unpredictable opponent. A foe is never certain if POKENAME's next move will be an elegant feinting sway of its wings, or a fist of flame careening towards them.
author: sk372

entry: The silk it shoots from its body is extremely hot. If it ever lands in dried leaves, it can cause a massive forest fire.
author: .izik

entry: Much of POKENAME's time is spent teaching its young the coordination and focus needed to perfect their trademark combat dance. Though the child is still learning, it is capable of creating tiny fire tornadoes with its moves.
author: sk372

entry: Abundant in springtime, POKENAME arrange in dazzling waves of red above fields of flowers. Their intricate and graceful mid-air dances are a sign that pollen production is exceptionally high.
author: metcassette

entry: POKENAME's large, sharp feathers on its arm are able to cut through granite with ease. It moves with lethal precision, slicing through the air as it dances in combat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shoots flames around its body while it dances. It does elaborate leaps and poses, igniting the battlefield with each carefully choreographed move.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's pincers open and close in rhythm as it dances. Its movements are sharp and precise, making it a challenging opponent for anyone who underestimates its grace.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME typically frolics docilly, but if it catches sight of its reflection, it rages and attacks.
author: .realthree
