author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME cloaks its metallic frame in refuse gathered from alleyways. It emits jolts of electricity to defend itself if approached.
author: .izik

entry: It floats around urban areas, accompanied by a foul odor. Educational shows often use them as a "cute" representation of urban pollution.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME digs through industrial dumping grounds for sharp metal shards to use as makeshift teeth. These often fall out after it bites into something too tough.
author: .izik

entry: The rubbish forming POKENAME's wings regularly loses cohesion and falls off, leaving it grounded. It rifles through and eats the contents of garbage cans to help hasten their regeneration.
author: sk372

entry: This skittish trash goblin is often seen rummaging through bins and landfill. It blends in with its clothing made of discarded garbage bags.
author: holgast

entry: When POKENAME battles, it prefers to throw its bag of shiny objects all over the arena, before eating its contents. The bag often contains garbage.
author: tokenoracle

entry: When a Jaw Fossil is found buried beneath a landfill, it can be resurrected into a POKENAME. Its favorite food was a now extinct cousin of Grimer.
author: mrpeach774

entry: A POKENAME's jaws easily tear through the toughest garbage. After eating its favorite meal, it releases toxic gases not seen for millions of years.
author: mrpeach774

entry: POKENAME lures in Grimer with its foul breath before releasing a cold gas that freezes them solid, making them easy meals for it to eat. Each hit it takes spills trash from its bag-like armor until only its soft inner body remains.
author: soup1900

entry: It performs cheerful dances to motivate its allies. Unfortunately, it usually ends up bothering its allies, as bits of trash fly everywhere when it waves its arms.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME form in cities with an overflow of garbage and poor street hygiene. These Pokémon actively work to try and gather up discarded litter into themselves, sometimes rupturing and needing to deposit their waste into trash cans.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME form in cities with an overflow of garbage and poor street hygiene. These Pokémon actively work to try and gather up discarded litter into themselves, filling themselves to bursting point.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have swollen, bloated bodies that they constantly fill with discarded trash and waste. They lumber through neglected streets in cities, and large populations can prove dangerous when they start actively trying to raid bins and dumpsters.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: As it constantly eats rotten leftovers, its body has grown a new type of bloom that has not yet been determined by biologists. It is very slippery.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME secrete a sticky mucus that they use to gather detritus and waste to camouflage themselves, hiding amongst the polluted waters of city coastlines. Their mucus is laden with toxins from the decay of the garbage.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME manipulates the trash in its body to split into multiple copies of itself. Even divided, each piece can perform synchronized martial arts attacks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME clubs at opponents with its thick trashy limbs. It consumes and hoards garbage and discarded sharp objects, so it can use the gathered garbage to fire pointy projectiles at foes from afar.
author: sk372

entry: As it constantly eats rotten leftovers, its body has grown a new type of bloom that has not yet been determined by biologists. It is very slippery.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME digs rapidly through compost piles in greenhouses for flavorful leaves. After eating, it scatters the compost across nearby plants as thanks.
author: .izik

entry: A timid Pokémon, it scavenges from trash bins in urban areas. The sturdy quills on its head allow it to topple heavy bins with ease.
author: busilisk

entry: Born from a mix of waste and toxins, it thrives amidst urban filth. It tracks prey with its keen eyes.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME wanders garbage dumps, playing with other scavenging Pokémon by crashing into each other which lead to giggling fits. If its outer coating tears, the trash body is so compacted from its play that it will not leak out.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME actively helps the environment by consuming up to 100 lbs of garbage a day. Many cities have started using POKENAME to help keep their streets clean of discarded trash.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can barely contain its garbage blob body within its plastic skin, leading to an overflow of waste that it uses as a weapon. If it fires too many projectiles of trash, its body will sag and shrivel until it consumes more rubbish.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It is found floating atop sewage or resting atop circular holes such as cans or bowls. Some POKENAME are small enough to cover a Tin of Beans after eating the contents inside.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends the night stuffing the bags it carries on its head with garbage to stay dirty and smelly. If someone tries to wash it clean, it bursts into tears and immediately searches for new filth to roll in.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are generally found in landfills. While they were once regarded as pests, the fact they are able to consume garbage and leave little byproduct behind has made them well-liked among conservationists, even with their bacteria-laden bodies.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are generally found in landfills. While they were once regarded as pests, the fact they are able to consume garbage and leave little byproduct behind has made them well-liked among conservationists, even with their bacteria-laden bodies.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME feeds on leftover food from takeout boxes. Its body is fairly durable, a trait it needs when humans throw it out of their now-empty leftover boxes in frustration.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME pilfers coins lost among garbage and refuse, hoarding it until its bags are full to bursting. Some bags rip and leave behind its coins, causing it to continuously hoard the same bits of change.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is known for its hyper-fixation on shoes. It is capable of making space inside its body by expelling projectile rubbish from its mouth.
author: dinner8480

entry: In moments of tension, a wild POKENAME can easily take off its nose and throw it at predators to distract them with its repellent smell. It only takes a few hours for the Pokémon to find a new shoe to use as a nose.
author: dinner8480

entry: POKENAME slithers around garbage dumps, feeding on organic garbage. The rotting waste in its body converts into a deadly poison that can corrode steel.
author: chibitales

entry: Its favorite food is garbage that's been left out in the hot sun. It carries the odor of the things it eats, much to the dismay of anyone near it.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME carries the odor of wet garbage. The rain it summons is acidic, causing gradual damage to corrosive materials.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can find itself lodged in pipes that connect to lakes and rivers. Plumbers are typically called in to help dislodge POKENAME from pipes before transferring it to a safer location.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME works sanitation routes alongside humans, hoisting full bins with ease. When the bin overflows, it slurps up any leftover gruel-like sludge to lighten the load.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME collect construction waste to build out their bodies, taking broken bricks and concrete wherever they can. Poor management of a building site can result in large populations of POKENAME moving in and disrupting progress.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME collects used electronics and batteries to power its body. It can generate magnetic fields to locate and attract any scrap metal and electronics in the area.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME drag trash into their thick sludge, from empty toothpaste tubes to used potion bottles. They have a pungent smell and are chased away despite being helpful.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in highly polluted waters, their bodies forming from industrial waste and microplastics. They have a drive to try and clean up their homes, consuming the pollutants that float in the water around them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live in highly polluted waters, their bodies forming from industrial waste and microplastics. They have a drive to try and clean up their homes, consuming the pollutants that float in the water around them.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This Pokémon emits an overpowering scent of Strange Fruit. While most find the stench unbearable, certain wild Pokémon are strangely drawn to it.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME release a foul stench that is repulsive to most Pokémon. Rattata and Raticate are among the few that tolerate the smell, feeding POKENAME trash in exchange for a place to sharpen their teeth.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are common inhabitants of landfills and garbage dumps, picking up trash with their right hands to then eat. They release poisonous gas from their left arms to defend themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use scraps of plastics and microplastics floating in the ocean to hold their bodies together, constantly seeking out oceanic waste to do so. Their bodies gradually degrade in sea water, making their presence toxic to other Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The bodies of POKENAME have developed to resemble various pieces of human trash floating in polluted waters. Though this is believed to have been to protect themselves from bird Pokémon, their bodies seem far too toxic to be consumable.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have made their homes in urban alleyways, happily feeding on city residents' garbage. Cities with large populations of POKENAME have reported drastically reduced costs for trash removal.
author: fancyskunk

entry: The horns and fangs of a POKENAME have become like metal grinders that can churn large waste into little pieces for it to eat. Although some humans fear them a bit, they are often utilized in landfills to break apart larger pieces of trash.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon always wins the title of most-disliked fusion. When angry, which is quite often, POKENAME glides through the city in which it lives while spraying trash at unlucky pedestrians.
author: gooeygamer69

entry: During battles, POKENAME can end up literally smelling like hot garbage. In spite of their unpleasant smell, many can't resist POKENAME's dopey charm, even when they cuddle up and rub their soft coat of trash all over someone.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME is found near irradiated landfills, its body layered with unused polymers. Its shell acts as a pressurized waste chamber, converting synthetic debris into biofuel, preventing its own body from breaking down.
author: jaminmcready

entry: These airborne predators favor landfills and other poisonous areas, diving down to snatch prey within their pointed jaws. They appear to have eaten the fossilized remains of certain Pokémon and their bodies developed around the remains.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can be found in the alleys of sprawling cities. Its entire body acts as its stomach, so any food tossed away on it is simply absorbed.
author: bacondlx

entry: POKENAME collects trash in its muck-covered body and soars into thunderstorms to be struck by lightning. This fuses the trash together, which under the right circumstances forms Thunder Stones, and rains the fused trash down like hail.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The body of a POKENAME contains a highly combustible gas that can be ignited by clacking its teeth. They can form small bombs from this gas and hurl them at enemies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME scavenges junkyards to find parts to add to its body. If it finds any electronics, it can usually power them on to serve its own purposes.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME raids garbage cans in cities located near rivers and ponds. POKENAME leaks trashy liquid from its body with every step, leaving heaps of evidence after a trash raid.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME loves to jump around, splashing liquid garbage all over the place. Its entire body is mushy, rotten trash and it is frowned upon to bring one to public spaces.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The gills on the side of POKENAME's head detect methane emitted from rotting biological matter over 1km away. If overstimulated by excess putrescence, their gills leak a poisonous liquid.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME plucks garbage from containers and uses it to draw symbols upon the ground. It's believed this habit is an attempt at communication, but none have yet discovered meaning in the trash's shapes.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME feels particularly frightened, it uses its psychic powers to lift the surrounding garbage and hurl it at its enemies. The trash that forms its tail seems to have a mind of its own and bites anything that approaches POKENAME from behind.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME typically live under the landfills that they also eat from. Their bodies resemble the trash they devour, especially the discarded bars of rebar that they especially favor.
author: infinex21

entry: A POKENAME's legs are like sturdy needles that can rather easily skewer myriad junk and debris which eventually gets absorbed into their upper bodies. They can "belch" toxic gas from their pincers to daze foes before pummeling them with punches.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon uses its strong arms to compact its own refuse into tight balls that they throw at their opponents. Wild POKENAME can often be found effectively swimming through mounds of trash and refuse.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have become widely used during the filming of movies. Any waste that the cast and crew produce is given to POKENAME, who fly it to designated waste points. This has helped shoots in wild locations without harming the environment.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are absolute fiends for trash, obsessed with filth. Some will even engage in turf wars where heaps of trash fly.
author: pankiwi

entry: Repeated rolling charges wear down the tire along POKENAME's body over time, resulting in movement becoming unsteady. When the tire inevitably tears, its new immediate mission is to find a replacement.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME prefers to sleep coiled up inside a dumpster. If it senses something approaching, it rises up from the dumpster with its hood flared out.
author: _aphoric

entry: Normally POKENAME keeps itself contained within a bag-like exterior, but when threatened, it will burst out from its containment and flare its garbage-made hood and frightening face to scare off attackers.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME are drawn to polluted lakes and ponds, seemingly trying to clean them by feasting upon the waste floating in them. Unfortunately, their own bodies are so toxic they often add a different form of pollution to the water.
author: infinex21

entry: Smelly odor-releasing glands are on the sides of POKENAME's face. It roots through trash to search for all kinds of things to consume, including old electronics.
author: bobosmith01

entry: What may seem like a clump of trash floating in the water may actually be a POKENAME. Take caution when approaching, as it might spew toxic gases into the surrounding area.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The toxic gas released by a POKENAME is so thick and horrid that it is visibly an eerie purple color. They can easily subdue most opponents through the smell of this gas alone, but it is also so toxic that it may quickly end their torment.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME have tongues that are made of a material similar to a paper towel. They use this appendage to gather up all kinds of garbage and waste that they then digest for energy.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME searches landfills for discarded cloth to dress itself in. It believes it looks best in simple things like potato sacks.
author: blitzydragon

entry: It has been joked that this fusion is 108 bad smells bound within a trash bag. It wafts toxic vapor in the air when angry.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is the conglomerate of human waste and the magic of natural spirits. It roams dumps collecting rubbish to strengthen itself for the day when it can strike back against humankind for their reckless ways.
author: exaltedghost

entry: POKENAME is a hard-to-tame fusion thanks to its hostility and power. Unprepared Trainers find themselves buried under trash hoards and toxic sludge.
author: ohok3441

entry: These Pokémon have adapted to living within large, human cities where they feed off small refuse. The horn atop a POKENAME's head has taken the form of a dumpster to better secure food for it to eat later.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a result of people throwing things away in the ocean. It floats and takes trash with it, making an island of trash.
author: gamelord64

entry: POKENAME wanders the sea in constant search of waste and shipwrecks to strengthen and enlarge its body. If it stays too long in a water basin, it ends up polluting it with the toxic liquids it produces, so it never remains in one place for long.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are orbited by myriad junk due to all of the magnetic debris they have consumed, but their most prized possession is their globe. The stench of their bodies is enough to drive away even most Poison-type Pokémon.
author: infinex21

entry: It battles using assorted bits of trash fashioned into weapons and armor. Despite the shoddy appearance of its weaponry, it wields them with skill and precision in battle, making them far more effective than they seem.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME inhabits heavily polluted lakes, cleaning them by feeding on the refuse and garbage. As it consumes the pollution, its graceful body takes on additional aspects of the detritus, in turn causing people to be repulsed by the habitat savior.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The white smoke of a POKENAME comes from burning refuse within its body. Its flames remove pollutants in the process, and the resulting smoke is surprisingly pleasant. Some humans use them to help clean up garbage.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME enjoy the polluted air and overflowing trash found in big cities. Many see this symbol of urban decay and disruption of nature as a nuisance.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME eats old food from the trash, saving any mold spores it finds to be released later as a defense mechanism. The trash can covering its tail prevents the worst of its toxic spores from constantly spreading into the air around it.
author: bacondlx

entry: Even after fusion, POKENAME tries to look like a Pikachu. However, since its body constitution is different, it had to improvise by mimicking Pikachu's ears and tail with mismatched and crudely altered parts.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME's body is made up of random assortments of rubbish, densely packed to give it its unique shape. It flies at subsonic speeds, randomly dropping large chunks of debris on whatever happens to be below.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME sprays a highly toxic gas out of its tail that forms a dense cloud of poison if not dealt with. This gas is also highly flammable, a simple ember capable of turning the cloud into an intense inferno.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME form within city dumps and other similar areas with high densities of waste and refuse. They gather as much waste into their bodies as they can, and particularly bad instances of pollution can result in gargantuan POKENAME.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It hunts down garbage-carrying boats and rams them until they sink. Even a single POKENAME can render a harbor uninhabitable if left unchecked.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME has stolen a dustbin lid to protect its insides. It is now so firmly stuck to it that it can stand on the edge and use it as a wheel.
author: chorb33

entry: Despite their appearance and odor, POKENAME are very competent waste management experts. They gather a group of smaller Trubnea around and together they gather litter in their territory. They celebrate a good day's work by feasting on the litter.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME hang around alleyways and garbage piles, gathering rubbish with their tails to replenish their bodies. Despite the components, their fur still feels very soft and comforting.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's style of music isn't for everyone, composed of erratic screaming and clanging metal. It tends to appear at crowded concerts and underground nightclubs.
author: mistymagius

entry: The more a POKENAME dances, the more it sweats. Its sweat smells foul, and can burn nostrils up to a mile away.
author: gronkissimo

entry: Wild POKENAME nest within landfills and garbage dumps. They release puffs of toxic gas as they fly, often diving down to scoop up clumps of trash to eat.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME constantly uses its psychic powers to hold together the scraps of trash that form its small body. It roams the outskirts of cities, scavenging for new junk to fuel the strength of its poisonous gases.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are common in cities, but they're so shy that they're rarely seen. They form social hierarchies based on who has the best garbage collection.
author: admiralvermin

entry: The tube on top of POKENAME's head acts like another mouth. POKENAME is able to absorb any type of food and expel huge amounts of projectile garbage behind it.
author: dinner8480

entry: This POKENAME has a bad reputation among other Pokémon formed of garbage. POKENAME has a terrible temper and a huge tube in its mouth that it uses to steal food from others, extending the tube three meters or more.
author: dinner8480

entry: POKENAME cultivates a floating trash heap in cold ocean waters, which it fearlessly defends from others who would usurp its rule or destroy the garbage. If it breaks one of its tusks, it fashions a replacement from materials like rebar.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Wild POKENAME favor swimming within polluted seas, ironically helping to clean them as they absorb the trash and pollutants into their bodies. They are frequent invaders of garbage barges and sometimes even sink them to use them as homes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME despise people who litter or throw away perfectly good items. They gather any piece of trash they find and use it to build up their fists, determined to get vengeance on the one that discarded the item.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It sleeps in junkyards and hides amongst trash bags for camouflage. It enjoys collecting various types of garbage and showing it off to others.
author: greystorm101

entry: POKENAME battles unusually. It throws its own garbage at other Pokémon and then eats the garbage. It also gives eggs to Trainers down on their luck.
author: rnrhorrorshow

entry: Wild POKENAME roll around in trash and other debris, which is all eventually absorbed into their bodies if they do not fall off. Once a year, they must shed some of their garbage-like bodies so that they do not grow so large that they cannot move.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are found in crowded cities, especially those plagued by littering. They pile trash in central areas and sometimes use psychic abilities to subtly encourage others to help.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's saliva contains toxins that can neutralize and disintegrate plastics. It drags heaps of coastal garbage into burrows to repurpose them into armor or bait.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Packs of POKENAME sun themselves on the shores of river deltas, waiting to swarm unaware prey like Slowpoke. The bubble on its back allows it to travel on land for a short amount of time if its habitat becomes inhospitable.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It thrives in seaside waters, blending into the surf with its agile movements. Its reflective scales shimmer like sea glass, masking it from potential threats.
author: .izik

entry: It prowls coastal waters, preying on fish that wander too close to shore. Strong waves aid its ambushes, hiding it beneath the surf.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swims with many companions in saltwater to prevent larger Pokémon from attacking them. People usually leave the water when they spot even just one, as its bite is poisonous.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are infamously known for their insatiable appetites and ferocious tempers. They lash out at anything that enters their territory with such reckless abandon that they often destroy their own home and force themselves to have to relocate.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME compulsively bites anything that moves by its face, so watch your fingers! Its jaw has enough strength to crush rocks.
author: .realthree

entry: It scans digital signals left by passing vessels, tracking them across open waters. Its ability to interface with electronics makes it a peculiar but formidable hunter.
author: .izik

entry: It has a strange fascination with beach balls, biting them whenever it finds one. This habit often leads to popped toys scattered along the shore.
author: .izik

entry: When hungry, it bites into any electronic device it can reach, as POKENAME converts electricity into nourishment for its body. It usually lives near large bodies of water alongside a sizeable group of companions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It swims tirelessly, covering vast distances without rest. Relentless in its movements, it rarely surfaces, preferring to stay hidden below.
author: .izik

entry: A smelly film coats its body, discouraging predators from attacking. This noxious layer lingers in the water long after it passes, marking its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often found swimming at the surface of tropical rivers, the plant on its back exuding a sweet scent to attract bird and bug Pokémon for a meal. When it dives, the plant clamps its jaws shut as overconsumption of water makes it sluggish.
author: pjporwoll

entry: This strong but not very clever Pokémon often rips the lures off fishing lines without even noticing. From afar, superstitious sailors often mistake POKENAME for a mermaid, until they swim closer and, to their disappointment, see its face.
author: milchik

entry: It prowls the sea floor, searching for prey hiding among the rocks. Its sharp fangs can pierce shells, making it a threat to many marine creatures.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon uses its tentacles to catch foes, then delivers devastating bites with its powerful jaw.
author: welliss

entry: It is well-suited to maritime environments, riding ocean currents with ease. Other Pokémon follow its path, knowing it can navigate even the roughest waters.
author: .izik

entry: It hunts along beaches, waiting for prey to emerge from the surf. Its sharp teeth and aggressive behavior make it a danger to anything that ventures too close.
author: .izik

entry: It races along the coastline with its pack, hunting anything that moves by relying on its powerful hound-like sense of smell. Once it clamps down with jaws as strong as a hydraulic press, it refuses to let go.
author: fiordaliso

entry: With a single howl, POKENAME can summon its entire gang, surrounding prey within moments. Its bite is lethal, and encountering this Pokémon while visiting the seaside is considered extremely dangerous.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Commonly referred to as the "Vermin of the Sands" by desert travelers, POKENAME are aggressive Pokémon that effectively swim through the sands. They typically attack travelers in an effort to steal, and consume, their supplies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can store water in the bowl-shaped flower on its back, which it uses to fire debilitating water blasts on land. In the water, it will swim below large prey and use the plant to create a whirlpool, entrapping the unprepared catch.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With its powerful tail POKENAME can hurl huge waves of salt water and sand at its foes during beach battles. Its sharp, serrated teeth make its bites hard to heal.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME senses even the faintest vibrations through its skin. This enables it to detect prey many thousands of meters deep in the pitch-black ocean.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME lives in lakes and rivers, attacking boats that cross its path. Fighting back against them is difficult due to its hardened shell.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: Though not yet fully evolved, POKENAME shows a fiery disposition, snapping at outsiders who approach too closely. Its frame is armored with poisonous spikes and jagged horns that let it repel intruders larger and stronger than itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It attacks anyone who dares approach its territory, charging forward with its horn coated in venom. Though ruthless toward intruders, it shows great affection to its own kind, letting the young ones play with the bubbles it blows from its mouth.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a formidable predator that hunts along the shores in the company of its pack. It uses its powerful jaws to deliver lethal blows, often finishing off its prey with ease. The largest specimen is recognized as the leader of the group.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME patiently hides in underwater crevices as it waits for prey to swim close. When it sees a stronger Pokémon, it quickly retreats into these holes.
author: mepp.

entry: Highly territorial, POKENAME uses its sheer brute strength to drive away ships that venture too close to its coastal den. When it slams its massive tail against the ground, it can shake the earth with enough force to trigger violent quakes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It clings to the sides of boats, waiting for scraps to fall overboard. Mariners often mistake it for debris until it sinks its teeth into an unsuspecting hand.
author: .izik

entry: It inhabits lakes, using submerged objects to create intricate lairs. With its sharp teeth, it cuts through weeds and plants that block its path.
author: .izik

entry: Sailors tell tales of it attacking boats with relentless fury, gnawing through wood and ropes. It often works with others of its kind, making it a formidable threat on open waters.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can stretch its jaws and consume prey larger than its body. It only targets prey that is incapable of damaging it from within.
author: staghorn

entry: It patrols streams, lurking beneath the surface in search of smaller prey. Its presence makes these waterways dangerous, forcing other Pokémon to avoid them.
author: .izik

entry: To strengthen its jaws, POKENAME constantly chews on the hard edges of rocky cliffs. It lives in fairly large groups and builds its den along the coasts of warm seas.
author: fiordaliso

entry: To strengthen its jaws, POKENAME constantly chews on the hard edges of rocky cliffs. It lives in fairly large groups and builds its den along the coasts of warm seas.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME swims with its flower on the surface of the water to catch unsuspecting prey like Politoed in the jaws of the plant. The plant and body have different stomachs, so they have to share food to grow in synchronicity.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME swims with its flower on the surface of the water to catch unsuspecting prey like Politoed in the jaws of the plant. The plant and body have different stomachs, so they have to share food to grow in synchronicity.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Though POKENAME spends most of its life in seawater, its scales remain warm from the fire burning within. When enraged, it snorts small clouds of steam from its nostrils.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME groups reflexively sharpen their tusks as a whole; when one begins grinding against a rock or tree, they all instinctively do the same so every member has pristine and sharp tusks.
author: sk372

entry: It hides in deep caverns beneath the ocean floor, waiting patiently to ambush prey. The dim lighting helps it remain undetected until it strikes.
author: .izik

entry: Known for ambushing prey in shallow water, POKENAME uses its sharp spear with unsettling glee. Its chaotic fighting style is seen as reprehensible by many who encounter the aftermath.
author: jaminmcready

entry: This POKENAME has the strength and aggression of a whole school. It will lead swarms of smaller fry on a voracious rampage.
author: serversizeme

entry: It is known to stalk injured prey for miles before delivering a final strike. It enjoys toying with its food before eating it.
author: .izik

entry: It patrols lagoons at night, using echolocation to find prey. Its sharp fangs tear through anything it catches, leaving little behind.
author: .izik

entry: It lurks near docks, waiting for opportunities to strike unsuspecting prey. Sailors keep a wary eye on the water, knowing that it can appear at any moment.
author: .izik

entry: It stalks submarines, drawn to the metallic hum they produce. Once attached to the hull, it gnaws persistently, leaving deep gashes in the metal.
author: .izik

entry: It becomes more active at sunset, using the dim light to hunt unseen. Coral reefs at dusk fall silent when it approaches, as prey scatter to avoid it.
author: .izik

entry: Its skin secretes a mild acid that corrodes anything it touches if given enough time. The acid leaves faint marks on rocks and shells, warning others of its presence.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are a common species of underwater Pokémon that often laze about near along the shores of rivers, often becoming the hosts of mushroom spores. If disturbed from their rest, they will viciously bite at the nearest living thing.
author: infinex21

entry: It patrols coral reefs, protecting its territory from intruders. Its sharp teeth can slice through coral effortlessly, allowing it to shape its environment to its liking.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a fierce predator found near bodies of water, known for its lightning-fast jaws and ferocious attacks. Only its crest is visible above the water surface, so tourists are advised to watch for it while swimming.
author: rakunk

entry: Its bite is incredibly powerful, capable of shattering even the toughest stones. When enraged, it snorts small clouds of steam from its nostrils.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME patrols coastal waters in search of food alongside others of its kind, as it's far more timid than it appears. When an ally is in danger, it spits bluish flames from its jaws to drive enemies away.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It's been discovered that POKENAME are highly receptive to chocolate. Ships now often carry surplus containers to toss overboard and placate schools of POKENAME to keep them from becoming aggressive.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives by the shore with its pack, which not only protects it but also helps refine its hunting skills. In battle, it relentlessly snaps at its foe, but if it realizes it has been left alone, it quickly loses the will to fight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It slips through canals with ease, navigating narrow waterways to hunt. Trainers in cities must remain cautious, as it has been known to nibble on unattended belongings.
author: .izik

entry: It lurks in bays, waiting patiently for small fish to pass by. When disturbed, it creates a flurry of bubbles to confuse its pursuers.
author: .izik

entry: It creates large splashes as it leaps from the water, showing off its power. These displays often serve as a warning to intruders in its territory.
author: .izik

entry: While POKENAME normally lives deep in the sea, they are known to swarm near the surface when it storms. They target struggling prey, tearing them to bits with razor-sharp fangs.
author: mepp.

entry: Its natural rarity, bright colors, and general rebellious attitude has made toys based off of POKENAME very popular with young boys. It stores objects in their muddy nest as teething tools: through chewing, it can help keep its teeth razor sharp.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite its fearsome and massive appearance, POKENAME is a very shy Pokémon that usually soars over the coasts of deserted islands in the sea. It attacks only to defend its territory and gains confidence when in the company of others of its kind.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Wetlands are its favored hunting grounds, where it stalks prey hidden among reeds. The murky water masks its approach, making it a dangerous predator.
author: .izik

entry: It plants itself on the seafloor, munching on anything it can get its mouth on. Its leaf-like fins allow it to swim away from predators, even though it cannot swim very fast.
author: mistymagius

entry: Despite its fierce and intimidating appearance, POKENAME rarely attacks other Pokémon or ships when separated from its flock. When defending its territory, it releases a bluish flame from its tail tip to boost its courage.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It lurks in kelp forests, using the dense vegetation to conceal its presence. With quick, darting movements, it navigates through the tangled leaves with ease.
author: .izik

entry: It trails kayaks along coastal waters, drawn by the sounds and splashes. Its sharp teeth make it a hazard to those who venture too close.
author: .izik

entry: It prowls the waterways near villages, sneaking in to snatch food scraps. Its slow, deliberate movements deceive others into thinking it is harmless.
author: .izik

entry: The Carvanha on its tail is fossilized, and attached as a decoration. Nevertheless, POKENAME often uses it as a bat to bash its rivals.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It thrives in waters contaminated with nuclear waste, absorbing toxins that enhance its strength. Its toxic presence makes the surrounding area hazardous for all life.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's stench drives away its prey before they can even see them. This caused POKENAME to become bottom feeders in the bodies of water, which in turn makes them stink even more.
author: markusknight

entry: It leaves globs of sludge wherever it swims, contaminating the waters. This pollution makes it difficult for other creatures to survive nearby.
author: .izik

entry: It gnaws on anchors dropped into the water, mistaking them for prey. Sailors often find deep bite marks on their equipment after anchoring near its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is found along beaches and ports where it will steal freshly caught fish from other Pokémon or humans. It is rather slow on land, but speeds up in the water by using its vines to aid in propulsion.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is highly aggressive and will try to bully anyone into doing its bidding. Its sharp teeth can cut through the thick skin of large Berries.
author: t.i.a.

entry: POKENAME wraps its tail around ship chains while sleeping. If disturbed, it bites with jaws strong enough to crush granite.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses Smokescreen to darken the waters before striking. The murk somehow doesn't hinder its own sight as it effortlessly bites through defenses as strong as tungsten.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swims gracefully through tropical seas. When prey is spotted, it bites with enough force to rip through iron.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is so ravenous that it can even devour coral, crushing it beneath its fearsome teeth. The venomous sting on its tail is used to weaken its enemies.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are actually quite harmful to aquatic habitats; whenever one is spotted, it is best for them to be caught as quickly as possible.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME is extremely territorial, especially with its dwindling population, and viciously sinks ships and attacks anything while protecting its nesting grounds. Daring captains train POKENAME to protect their ships on voyages.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is extremely territorial, especially with its dwindling population, and viciously sinks ships and attacks anything while protecting its nesting grounds. Daring captains train POKENAME to protect their ships on voyages.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Due to its malleable body, its skin is too smooth and its fangs too soft to cause damage. That fact it has to mimic other Pokémon to be a threat causes it no end of vexation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME nests high on coastal cliffs where it can survey its habitat for prey, even taking down the likes of Wailord if it works with others of its kind. POKENAME flies and swims at speeds rivaling human-made transportation in those environments.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME cuts through the air and the ocean depths with the same incredible speed. With its extreme strength and aggression, it is considered an apex predator of both biomes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swims in tropical waters and is most often found around coral reefs, patrolling their territory in search of food. Their fine fur burns hot on contact with air and produces a lot of heat even underwater, producing a steam trail as they swim.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are incredibly territorial and will constantly fight with each other over their prey. POKENAME prey on larger fish Pokémon, brutally attacking them with their sharp beak and talons.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME fires Electro Ball to knock avian Pokémon into the sea. It then bites down hard and drags them underwater so it can feast.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a dominant predator of deep ocean trenches, using its light to surprise prey before devouring them in only a few bites. It is rare to see POKENAME near the ocean surface, but when one is found it is usually disoriented and defensive.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is silent in its movement, so it often startles those it happens upon, disheartening it. It seeks to share happiness with others, and ends up being oblivious to when those it interacts with would rather be alone.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is lazy, swimming with its mouth open in hopes of catching an unaware meal or basking in the sun hoping scavengers get too curious. Its vicious appearance makes it an excellent guardian pet as it actually loves playing with children.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is lazy, swimming with its mouth open in hopes of catching an unaware meal or basking in the sun hoping scavengers get too curious. Its vicious appearance makes it an excellent guardian pet as it actually loves playing with children.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME fight for territory by using their vines to fling the razor-sharp petals of their flower bulbs at each other. The more scars a POKENAME bears, the more respect it commands from others.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being very prolific hunters, the population of POKENAME has decreased severely over the last 50 years. The meat of POKENAME is viewed as a rare delicacy by gourmets and thrill hunters alike, as the meat is very poisonous when prepared wrong.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME is just as fast in the water as it is in the air. Researchers have determined this is because of the crest on its head.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME lies hidden in plain sight among other Corsola fusions, before releasing a burst of water to jet out and snap up unwary prey. Despite its predatory nature, it is content to be fed treats by divers and even begs at docks for tourists.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is highly intelligent and sneaks around reefs to catch larger prey unaware. It is independent and distrustful of others, and it will become aggressively protective of its Trainer once it trusts them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME thrives in the open ocean where it can burst out of the water to snag bird Pokémon as a meal. When it leaps over boats, people recoil in fear of its appearance, but it is only a danger if the Carvanha hitching a ride falls off onto the deck.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME jets through the air at impossibly fast speeds, and can cleave trees in two with its sharp limbs as it flies past. It produces Sharpedo-shaped explosive projectiles to launch at opponents and prey.
author: sk372

entry: If danger looms near its wounded kin, POKENAME emits a plume of scalding steam from its jaws, forcing attackers to retreat. Though known for its lethal bite, its true strength lies in its unmatched agility on land and underwater.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If danger looms near its wounded kin, POKENAME emits a plume of scalding steam from its jaws, forcing attackers to retreat. Though known for its lethal bite, its true strength lies in its unmatched agility on land and underwater.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When angered, POKENAME's body temperature rises so much that it can heat the very waters it swims through while hunting. It competes with others of its kind by biting the anchors of ships to determine who has the strongest jaws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When enraged, POKENAME's internal heat surges until the waters around it begin to simmer. Members of this species often clash by biting through ship anchors, testing which one possesses the fiercest jaws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME zip through the sea with navy camouflage and search for prey to consume. Their jaw stretches over Pokémon larger than themselves to be digested by their stomach acids.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME stealthily swims through kelp forests to observe other inhabitants for weaknesses, which it exploits by bullying them to steal food. This practice allows it to preserve its vast energy to drive competitors from its territory.
author: pjporwoll

entry: This vicious predator uses its blinding speed to launch dizzying assaults on its opponent. When POKENAME is sighted near a body of water or beach there are usually calls to evacuate the nearby area.
author: evilgammon

entry: A vampire of the sea, they ride water currents with incredible speed to hunt. Trainers are advised not to release this fusion back into the wild.
author: nelluc27

entry: Found replacing the figurehead on sunken ships, POKENAME sings a lilting melody, attracting Water-types. When they close in, it confuses its prey with a Water Pulse before finishing them with a vicious bite.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Despite it having great hunting instincts, POKENAME's personality is sweet and almost childish. The sight of it happily singing next to freshly-caught prey has been described as disconcerting to many.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is usually seen in the ocean, harassing ships but ultimately not harming anyone. It's said pirates followed POKENAME in the past.
author: blazerxz

entry: POKENAME leisurely patrols the reef it controls, chasing off other ocean apex predators and snagging unaware prey with its anemone tentacles. It moves slowly unless there is a threat to its dominance, launching a surprise attack in a burst of energy.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME strikes prey by whipping its neck forward with incredible speed and snapping with its maw. Its teeth are sharp enough to pierce steel plating.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME prowls tropical reefs and kelp forests, using its enhanced aquatic agility to pursue fast prey. Recent fossil discoveries reveal that this Pokémon remains largely unchanged from how it appeared in the past as an apex predator.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With a lust for violence, many POKENAME are recruited as hired muscle. It'll lend its services to anyone who offers it the biggest and best weapons.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME has ferocious power. Even without a weapon, it can crush a military-grade torpedo. It features a wild yet hedonistic personality.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can create suction that sucks in everything within a kilometer. It can wipe out life within several kilometers of sea in just a few weeks.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME can create suction that sucks in everything within a kilometer. It can wipe out life within several kilometers of sea in just a few weeks.
author: chorb33

entry: Wild POKENAME are so quick to challenge other Pokémon near the beaches they live upon that their bodies are always covered in many scars. Their many fangs break rather easily during battle as they bite their foes but they always grow back tougher.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live on the bottom of seabeds. Small aquatic Pokémon will inhabit the debris upon its back and keep its shell clean for it. Because of this, many aquariums will keep a POKENAME in their large exhibits as enrichment for other Pokémon.
author: jadey.1557

entry: POKENAME is exceedingly proud and attempts to strongarm other small Pokémon into joining its pirate gang and raiding berry stashes of much larger Pokémon. It has an intense rivalry with Squirtles.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It has an extremely aggressive streak and seeks to battle any powerful opponent it can find, especially others of its kind. POKENAME wears every chip and scar on its blade with pride, as each signifies a vicious fight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME considers sunken ships its territory, and strikes viciously at any who would trespass on its home. It's known to be especially aggressive and violent towards Dhelmise.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses the anchor on its tail to keep to the sea floor while it's on the prowl. On land, the anchor proves to be a powerful defensive weapon.
author: vaporvenator

entry: Instead of swimming like other water Pokémon, POKENAME will walk at the bottom of the ocean. Its armor is so strong it can resist up to 15 thousand PSI.
author: gengarfromfnaf

entry: Ferocious wild POKENAME have recently been discovered using sunken ships as homes. Any daring treasure hunter that attempts to explore these vessels may not make it back alive.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is known as “The Tyrant of the Seas” due to its aggressiveness and brutality. The two golden fins on its body are sharp enough to slice through steel and allow it to maintain flight after it launches itself out of the water.
author: mepp.

entry: This underwater leviathan of a Pokémon lives within only the deepest, darkest undersea trenches. POKENAME's body is covered in countless scars from its many battles with other underwater Pokémon over over territory and prey alike.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME commands the depths with unrivaled power and speed. Its metallic fins slice through water and time itself, leaving chaos in its wake.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME is also called "the Grim Reaper of The Seven Seas". Whenever POKENAME is spotted in a body of water, it is recommended to stay on land. Their razor-sharp claws can effortlessly sink even the most armored ship.
author: sottiwotti

entry: This Pokémon lives and hunts in arctic waters, though it is capable of staying on land for periods of time. The ice along its body protects it while also giving it a deadly horn that allows it to quickly impale any of its prey.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are fairly kindhearted on land, but turn incredibly vicious when in water. By using both its fangs and sturdy tusks, POKENAME can cut through almost anything.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME has adapted its appearance to look like a Sharpedo, even mimicking the way it swims across the seafloor. However, it is basically harmless, only feeding on small sea plants.
author: mistymagius

entry: It regularly fills up with air by swimming to the surface. Despite its chunky physique, it can quickly change direction by expelling the stored air.
author: chorb33

entry: Even a small drop of blood with send POKENAME into a feeding frenzy. Once it gets a taste of its prey, it will keep eating away until nothing is left but bone.
author: musicsheep.

entry: At dusk, schools of POKENAME feed ravenously, wiping out entire reefs. They abandon injured allies without hesitation while on a hunt.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is usually found near large groups of Water-type Pokémon. Most fishermen hate it because its multiple sharp fins cut through their nets.
author: swangfrog04

entry: Its blade-like fins can cut stone like butter. Some have been seen cutting the likes of Gyarados and Wailord to pieces by themselves.
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer

entry: If it sees a large school of fish while it's flying over the ocean, POKENAME will fire a powerful sound wave that instantly takes out most of the school. It will fiercely fight other POKENAME over their prey.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hums a grating bass melody as it stalks prey before dive-bombing them. If a school of POKENAME engage in a feeding frenzy, it can stir the winds into a tornado or waterspout.
author: pjporwoll

entry: This soft and cuddly Pokémon is said to have no thoughts inside its plush head. It provides comfort, love and protection to those who need it.
author: rooboid

entry: POKENAME utilizes mimicry where its crown looks like a Sharpedo, warding off predators like Bruxish. To attract scavenging aquatic Pokémon for a meal, it flexes muscles in the fake mouth to extend a tongue and seem like a dead Sharpedo.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's mimicry of Sharpedo deters Psychic-type predators, like Bruxish, allowing it to devour a reef in peace. Its outer layer is poisonous, so creatures like Remoraid that try to nibble on it quickly die and become a meal for POKENAME.
author: pjporwoll

entry: These Pokémon began to display lower brain function as mushrooms accumulated upon their bodies, causing them to be swept away by rivers and carried into oceans. Somehow, when they become injured in battle, mushrooms will grow from the scars.
author: infinex21

entry: Found in the coldest of seas just off the shores of jagged coasts. They have learned to prey mostly on ships these days, creating giant tidal waves or whirlpools to sink them to the depths of the sea.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: POKENAME hunts at high speed, locking prey in place with psychic power. It closes in with a brutal, bone-crushing Crunch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's primary claws resemble Sharpedo, which it uses to distract, intimidate, and fake out opponents in combat. It if is bested in a fight, it will return to its den to meditate on a revenge plan.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It loves the rain, especially when it is able to spend time outside to soak in the mud. Some Trainers give it a Damp Rock to ensure it spends more time happy in the rain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME somehow senses those who have been recently engaged and chases them relentlessly so that it can bite them. No one knows why its attacks are targeted in this fashion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's ill-fated arrival is preceded by unusual and freezing currents. It torments those it encounters on its journey until it has delivered its desired amount of mischief.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a cunning and swift predator, using its hydrodynamic shape to chase prey and escape with stolen meals. It raids large ships to taste unique foods, sometimes sharing its prize with Sharpedo to have an even quicker getaway.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is a cunning and swift predator, using its hydrodynamic shape to chase prey and escape with stolen meals. It raids large ships to taste unique foods, sometimes sharing its prize with Sharpedo to have an even quicker getaway.
author: pjporwoll

entry: As a deceiving Pokémon that acts slow-moving and amicable when around multiple Pokémon, POKENAME waits for prey to be all alone before suddenly and swiftly striking. It is through this manner that it keeps a friendly facade.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This wyvern-like Pokémon is often in fights, resulting in unique scarring. POKENAME's water-based wings and tail are scaldingly hot.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's tentacles act like large hooks, digging into its prey before it proceeds to chomp on their flesh. Wailord have been seen with entire schools of POKENAME hooked onto them.
author: mistymagius

entry: It only feasts on those that are afraid, so when a Pokémon fearfully swims away from it, POKENAME will catch them.  However, they begrudgingly retreat if potential prey stand its ground.
author: teatedtiten

entry: The three heads of POKENAME share equally vicious personalities, and are thus best differentiated by the colors of their markings. POKENAME are impressive pursuit hunters, sprinting up to prey at speeds of over 110mph (177kph).
author: slimee_amogus

entry: In icy seas, POKENAME searches for massive chunks of ice. It crushes them with its jaw as a test of biting strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are sometimes mistaken for mermaids when they rest on icebergs or seaside stones. They tend to aggressively attack any who approach them as they rest.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's toxic fumes make their teeth degrade, turning from rock hard to slimy and drippy in a matter of weeks if they haven't eaten fresh meals in a while. They are tough to train, as they tend to disobey their Trainer.
author: markusknight

entry: POKENAME jets water from its shell to chase prey before ensnaring them with its tongue, which can be up to five times the length of its shell. The teeth on the shell shred the prey as POKENAME reels them in, allowing it to easily digest its food.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME rockets through brackish waters at blinding speeds. If collision is imminent, it shuts its shell to protect itself.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is extremely aggressive, attacking anyone in sight with its fangs. Its teeth can grow back if damaged or if they get stuck in its prey. Anyone brave enough to seek out lost teeth can make a fortune selling them to traditional apothecaries.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME seek sunken ships to plunder their treasures. They often battle each other for precious loot.
author: mrbapcik

entry: POKENAME spins its claws like propellers to boost its swimming. At top speed, it can reach over 75 mph in open seas.
author: .izik

entry: A ruthless predator of the sea, it uses its massive claw to immobilize prey while its razor-sharp teeth tear them apart. Ironically, it is often fished by humans who prize its meat as a delicious seafood delicacy.
author: amiel997

entry: POKENAME enjoys gathering fallen leaves to create piles it can jump into. When it senses danger, it shakes its wooden horns to release a pollen that induces drowsiness in would-be attackers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Should POKENAME see a traveler lost in its forest, it will attempt to guide them deeper in the woods. There are few tales of anyone surviving this.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME devour all organic debris they can find. Since they even absorb any scraps of lifeforce left in their meals, they're generally considered to be a bad omen.
author: mx_wellman

entry: The pink ooze that drips from POKENAME's body is rich in calcium and used in many desserts in Johto. Chefs covet it, and it commands a high price.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is made of dead vines. It uses shadowy tendrils to grasp food and pull it into its body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME will travel up to six miles to search for the souls of dead children to absorb. Once they have gathered enough, they may evolve.
author: currentlymuffin

entry: POKENAME have an acute sense of smell, capable of detecting fear and despair in other creatures. Because of this, they're known to appear to lost travelers.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME acts as a kind and gentle guide to lost children in the woods. It places them onto its back, floats to the forest entrance, and gently sets them down before vanishing into the trees.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME is rarely seen outside of the forests beyond the Secret Garden. The POKENAME tend to hide as branches up in the trees. It is theorized that if in the same location as a Trevenant, POKENAME will hide up in the branches of its head.
author: riverbandage

entry: People can hear the songs of POKENAME deep in the forest that lead to lakes or rivers. If followed, it is expected to never see the person again. Skeletons can often be found where the POKENAME reside at the bottom.
author: riverbandage

entry: Forest fires are often started by POKENAME, setting plant-life ablaze as they walk along pathways. This is in order for new life to start anew and get rid of the old or dying.
author: riverbandage

entry: POKENAME is comfortable in its shell, which it never wants to leave. The shell is not wood but mostly chloroplasts, giving life energy in the sun.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME diligently protects forests from spiritual invaders. It is rumored to protect the same hunting grounds it patrolled centuries ago.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME leaps from stumps when approached, then flees to the marsh, screeching to alert others to hide. This allows other of its kin ample time to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is said to be a guardian to the spirit world. If you spot POKENAME in the wild, your time may be almost up.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME make masks out of tree bark that they wear to spook others. Those who have high success rates in scaring others seem to evolve earlier.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME's head is not attached to its body and can freely float away in any direction. Its eyes have an eerie pull, and gazing into them causes a deep and sudden sleep.
author: jaminmcready

entry: While flying, POKENAME's wings give off the scent of rotting wood. It migrates in swarms across wetlands.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME secretes a sap that gives off an unpleasant aroma, warding other Pokémon away from it. It lives in isolation because of this fact, only joined in solidarity by other foul-smelling Pokémon.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME lays invisible webs, then mimics the cries of a toddler. Anyone drawn near is ensnared and quickly consumed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies low through swamps, using echolocation to find hollow trees to call home. Its cries echo for miles.
author: .izik

entry: In search for a new home, this small spirit found a wooden toy bird to inhabit. It seems very disappointed about the toy's inability to fly by itself.
author: takio_

entry: Children from past civilizations lost in the woods may return as Phantump. They carry carvings of revered Pokémon to feel at home, embodying Xatu's behavior and abilities.
author: arcul

entry: Its body is covered by a blanket of evergreen leaves that allow it to blend perfectly into the forest. When POKENAME fights, it coats its wooden horns with electricity and strikes with cunning, paralyzing attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME float above swamps, crying like lost children to prank travelers. These sounds often seem to come from every direction.
author: .izik

entry: It gets its nutrients by absorbing the life force from flowers. At night hundreds of POKENAME can be seen floating around wilted flower fields.
author: mistymagius

entry: At night, POKENAME hovers over swamps with glowing green puffs. They flash in patterns to communicate silently.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME latch onto Pokémon while camouflaging in the trees. It will then become friends with them, forcefully.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME hovers just above swamp water, zipping around in sudden bursts at over 100 mph. The hum of its wings sounds like distant crying.
author: .izik

entry: Allegedly, POKENAME is a piece of wooden debris possessed by the spirit of a drowned child. Its personality is extremely chipper, as it frolics in the water and along the river bank, so many take that as folklore to keep children from swimming alone.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Along side with Phantreons, this set is often seen making colonies together causing mischief wherever they go. The POKENAME tend to be more active during dawn unlike their counterpart.
author: riverbandage

entry: Seen with Phantpeons, this duo of Pokémon are often causing minor mischief together. The POKENAME are more active at dusk with being quite more lethal with pranks when alone.
author: riverbandage

entry: POKENAME hangs upside down in willow trees, watching silently. If approached, it drops and chases intruders before exploding.
author: .izik

entry: Berry Juice that is created within its shell has a very savory flavor. Bartenders in Unova use it to make mixed drinks at upper-class taverns.
author: .izik

entry: Legends say that POKENAME is the spirit of a Heracross who perished when it charged into a tree and got stuck, never to escape.
author: incognito1234

entry: When alone, POKENAME whimpers softly like a child and emits a honey-like scent. If approached, it lashes out with a sharp Slash to take down its prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is believed to be the tarlike ghost of an animal possessing a stump, both of which were killed in the same human-caused fire. It proactively scours the forest for debris that would worsen a wildfire and consumes it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME floats along the sea's surface, feeding on driftwood. It drifts slowly, blending in with tide-worn debris.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wanders around wooded areas, searching for lost hikers and campers. When it finds them, it gifts an item from its wooden sack, then disappears merrily into the brush. The gifted items appear to be lost trinkets of other travelers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME slither through forests with an oak mask on their head. They wrap themselves around prey before siphoning their life force.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When wet, POKENAME rolls at high speed to dry its wooden body. Its spinning form leaves streaks through muddy trails.
author: .izik

entry: Often found scavenging in burnt forests, POKENAME give back to the earth by decomposing the old. They tend to only come out after a wildfire in the burnt ashes.
author: riverbandage

entry: When a blizzard comes, these Pokémon come out. POKENAME are said to be the dead that died in blizzards while travelling along the path.
author: riverbandage

entry: POKENAME spits highly pressurized water that reeks of rotting wood. It cries like a child to lure others close before launching its attack.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon loves hearing noises most find unsettling while in the forest. It becomes scared when it sees humans within its home.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME loves to dance at night within haunted forests. When it dances, eerie winds move with it.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME wails like a lost child to attract kindhearted people. When approached, it lashes out with poison-coated branches.
author: .izik

entry: A Bidoof that has possessed a tree stump. It still gnaws on wood, even itself, to whittle down its teeth.
author: jacobtmm

entry: POKENAME is a restless spirit of the forest, ambushing travellers during the night. The longer it's trapped in the forest, the angrier and more vengeful it becomes.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME sleeps during the day, venturing out in the evening to let moonbeams nurture the plants on its back. The plants emit a scent that only Ghost-type Pokémon can sense, making spirits flock to it at night.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are known to gather in dying forests, where they feed off rotting plants and steal whatever life is left. POKENAME are inherently hostile to anyone who disturbs their home.
author: jestersqueak

entry: POKENAME is said to be possessed by a lumberjack who died in the forest. It obsessively fells trees as it did while alive.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Some say that when a stray Pawniard is cursed by forest spirits, it becomes a POKENAME, wandering the forest, looking for the pack it was lost from. The wood covering its body is unbreakable.
author: bigblue

entry: POKENAME are formed by the emotions of trapped children who long to return home. They seek out lost children and, upon finding them, guide them home. POKENAME are filled with a deep sadness, as they carry the emotions of those who never made it home.
author: riverbandage

entry: POKENAME throws its voice to distract opponents before delivering a Sucker Punch from the opposite direction. Its bark is used in colognes to give a punch of a strong woody scent similar to the smell of pine.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME wanders through forests and builds many kinds of traps from wood, vines, and leaves to play pranks on unsuspecting hikers.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME hides itself against the gnarled back of the trees in its forest home. If trespassers draw too close, it swings open to reveal ghostly hands that drag them into its coffin-like body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lures in bug Pokémon with its sweet-scented flower before draining them of their life force. It hides in hollow logs to conceal its shadowy body from its prey.
author: mistymagius

entry: Each tail on this Pokémon represents the soul of a child that died in the woods. Because of this, its fur has been blackened.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME is said to come from a road far above the sky to restore wishes to the world.
author: blitzydragon

entry: POKENAME is said to come from a road far above the sky to restore wishes to the world.
author: blitzydragon

entry: POKENAME is said to come from a road far above the sky to restore wishes to the world.
author: blitzydragon

entry: POKENAME digs burrows beneath old tree stumps. It rarely moves unless disturbed, then vanishes into the earth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time hidden underground, absorbing nutrients through its own roots. It only emerges, baring its wooden jaws, to drive away anyone walking over its head.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Spores drift from POKENAME's branches, inducing dizziness and delirium. The effect intensifies in low light.
author: .izik

entry: Possessing fallen logs, POKENAME makes its home in old-growth forests. It tries to lure travellers away from well-trodden paths, making efforts to make them lose their way in the dark woods.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME forage for Tanga Berries to protect themselves against the many Bug-type Pokémon in their natural habitat. They hunt rodent Pokémon by reaching into burrows with their long snout and let out a spooky cry whenever they are full.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While POKENAME sucks nutrients from a tree, the wooden armor wards off predators with its eerie, face-like appearance. The leaves of POKENAME are said to help people find lost items when ingested.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME climbs tree trunks with ease, blending in with bark. If approached, it releases a sudden electric burst.
author: .izik

entry: As the sun begins to set, POKENAME flock together and communally watch passersby, all of their heads moving in unison. While this behavior is often considered unsettling, researchers have observed this is because they are looking for dropped seeds.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME hides in hollow logs to avoid sunlight. If disturbed, it erupts into flames before vanishing into the swamp.
author: .izik

entry: It tries to frighten people by camouflaging in the trees, then suddenly moving. POKENAME feed on fear and nervousness.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME nests in caves near marshes. The leaves on its back smell sweet, but its touch is dangerously poisonous.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rests on fallen logs, lazily chewing bark. If threatened, it pounces toward its foe and bites with venom-laced fangs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can only be found in forests covered in heavy snow during the winter. In ancient folklore, houses visited by these Pokémon will prosper and their leaves can cure any illness.
author: sakuraneko

entry: Despite how large and intimidating its mask is, the ghost inside is actually small and timid. POKENAME chooses the creepiest, most crooked stump to possess in order to scare away predators, but if it's too heavy, the Pokémon may struggle to get up.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME frequently form from individual Phantump that cluster together in search of companionship. Trainers are advised to take extra care to ensure their needs are met as they can be prone to low mood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME frequently form from individual Phantump that cluster together in search of companionship. Trainers are advised to take extra care to ensure their needs are met as they can be prone to low mood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME frequently form from individual Phantump that cluster together in search of companionship. Trainers are advised to take extra care to ensure their needs are met as they can be prone to low mood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME frequently form from individual Phantump that cluster together in search of companionship. Trainers are advised to take extra care to ensure their needs are met as they can be prone to low mood.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME bear fruits that are said to contain small amounts of spiritual energy inside. Spiritomb and Gengar love to eat it.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It wears its wooden mask to keep its malice and resentment under control. If its mask is removed, it will unleash its built-up anger in a violent rampage.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME coils around ship anchors and rides them to the surface when they're lifted. It mimics a crying child's voice, then vanishes, giggling.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are cactus possessed by the spirits of children who were lost to the desert. Hearing their cries is thought to be an omen of death.
author: odditylad

entry: Bands of POKENAME will stalk travelers crossing the desert at night and feast on their spiritual essence. They wait until their prey is too tired to move before ensnaring them with their cursed brambles.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME will use the healing power of its leaves to cure the sickness of anyone who puts a hand into its mouth. Be careful though, as it may drop the axe on its head and take their hand off instead.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is shy around adults, but it has no problem opening up to children. Many believe this is because it once was a human child itself.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are believed to be stumps possessed by the spirits of children who perished in the cold millions of years ago. They stopped crying a long time ago.
author: odditylad

entry: When someone loses a pet, sometimes they are visited by a POKENAME. While there is no evidence that it is the spirit of the pet, many adopt the POKENAME and pamper it. It is a friendly and playful Pokémon, but is mischievous and attention-seeking.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME tries to stay as still as possible to camouflage itself as a regular stump. Anyone who attempts to rest on its stump will have their souls slowly drained away.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME naps in willow branches, emitting giggle-like snores. These sounds unsettle travelers who hear them at night.
author: .izik

entry: Said to be spirits of children lost in the woods, POKENAME often gather together to play in forest clearings. They fashion instruments and masks out of wood, creating a little band and inviting people to join in.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME greatly cares about the well-being of children and often guides those who get lost in the woods. Once its job is done, it disappears back into the forest.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME gather branches for kindling, creating small fires to guide lost souls through the forest. When the fires go out, POKENAME disappear like leaves on the wind.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Clinging to the sides of trees, a POKENAME will keep watch over those that enter its forest. If it spots someone that's lost, it will clear the path from the shadows, saving them from sharing its fate.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME fires pink beams said to cause victims to hallucinate it as a human child. Folklore warns: never let it into your home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides in dead trees, lying dormant until nightfall. When it finds new flora growing nearby, it flies down and drains it of life-force for nutrients.
author: mistymagius

entry: This ghastly Pokémon is said to come into being when a beloved feline Pokémon is lost in the forest. The grief causes the Pokémon's spirit to remain anchored to this world, and it becomes a new POKENAME.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME was once an overgrown statue of a loyal Growlithe, carved many years ago. It is now the home of a lost child's soul.
author: captainzscourge

entry: When lifting objects, POKENAME makes sounds like a crying child. It does this even when content, confusing those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: Wandering around cut-down forests, it punches any lumberjacks it sees. It's also often seen around high mountain trails, disguising as tree stumps.
author: markusknight

entry: POKENAME likes to prank hikers. It plunges its ghastly body into the ground, causing the earth to tremble and trees to fall down on those unfortunate enough to anger it.
author: markusknight

entry: It is said to wander around very old forests, seeking new trunks from enormous fallen trees to live in. It guards these ancient forests, bringing curses or rushing at full speed at anyone that trespasses.
author: markusknight

entry: While it sleeps, POKENAME makes the sound of a crying child. If startled awake, it retaliates with a telekinetic blast.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME commonly appears where Pokémon are starving due to wild plants having been overharvested. It hunts down the perpetrator, even if it is as large as Snorlax, and bludgeons them with its allium vegetable.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Ancient civilizations used the Black Sludge from POKENAME to line latrines. The acidic properties serve to break down waste and absorb scent.
author: .izik

entry: A malevolent forest spirit, POKENAME phases in and out between the trees of its home forest. It especially loves to haunt and torment lost children and hear their cries.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME quietly hides disguised as a bush as it waits for prey. When something passes by, it catches it and makes it disappear.
author: prof.whitebeam

entry: POKENAME are incredibly persistent. If a POKENAME family or area is hurt, they will stop at nothing to track down who did it and beat them to a pulp.
author: totodile.

entry: A POKENAME in pursuit appears to lack pupils. They are highly dangerous, so it's important to know how to tell whether one is docile or hostile.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME wanders through ancient forests. It absorbs intruders into its form, converting those who harm the forest into vital nutrients to feed it.
author: velvetmitsu

entry: POKENAME lurks in dense forests, guarding its domain. It ensnares intruders to warn all who dare to disturb the natural balance of the woodland realm.
author: anarchaz
