entry: The fleece on POKENAME's head is the only patch that can be safely sheared from it. The fluff on its torso is crucial to ensuring its electrical circulation reaches from one wingtip to the other.
author: sk372

entry: As its light body is carried along by the winds, small pieces of the cloud-like matter on its body fall towards the ground. These clumps are highly sought by Pokémon possessing a sweet tooth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hides amongst the clouds, cheekily surprising Bird Pokémon that fly by. During clear days, they will sleep in the treetops until the clouds return.
author: mistymagius

entry: With Pokémon Fusion on the rise, POKENAME has begun playing a key ecological role: the spreading of seeds. Through its byproduct after consumption or the seeds getting caught and then falling from its feathers, the propagation of flora is performed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They love eating various mousses, as they adore the light, fluffy texture that reminds them of themselves. They are also known to stare into mirrors, fascinated by their fluffy appearance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoys sneaking behind people and frightening them with an ominous shriek. It gathers negative energy and stores it in the crystal beads on its body.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME linger in the sky, forming words with their cloud-like substance. They are eager to work together to send messages along to those who live below.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: As a sign of affection, POKENAME will wrap its cottony ears around people like a hug. Its ears are strong enough to propel its large body into flight, with many willing to pay circuses to see such a wonder.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME refuses to paint with its tail secretions unless the surface is cleaned and of a single uniform color. Thankfully, POKENAME's tail can take care of any dirty mess; POKENAME can also use it like a feather duster.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lives high in the mountains, building its nest out of small rocks. It is able to survive on very little air, absorbing extra oxygen in its fluffy feathers.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live high in the mountains, nesting in rocky cracks in cliffsides. Though it seems weak, an ancient myth tells of a Trainer who was blown off a cliff for trying to steal a POKENAME's egg.
author: johnhandicraft

entry: POKENAME carries two sticks of sweet cloud-like fluff it creates wherever it goes. It has two different mouths, so each one eats from its own stick of candy.
author: sk372

entry: The small hair on POKENAME's head is highly attuned to its surroundings, making up for its poor eyesight. It likes to shower those it's fond of with bits of fluff dispersed from its dome.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is most often seen resting on clouds, but on misty days it dances at ground level. It is recommended to observe it from a distance, as it will use teleport if disturbed.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME is extremely popular for its melodious voice and gentle demeanor. When it sings, a voluminous rainbow emanates from the clouds of its body, arcing over towards those listening to its song.
author: sk372

entry: Instead of using its wings to fly, POKENAME fires jets of pressurized gas from within its body to launch itself into the sky. It uses its metal claw to hang from thick tree branches while it sleeps.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME gleefully snaps at raindrops as they fall during storms. This behavior serves no known purpose other than its own enjoyment.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME is light enough that it can float; it spends most of its time traveling together with others in a pod high up in the clouds. Strong enough winds can toss the Pokémon around and out of the pod's flight path because of how little it weighs.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME's wings are incredibly fluffy to the touch. However, the clouds are made up of a toxic mist that causes itchiness or a rash.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME is attracted to both magnetism and clouds. Colonies group in mountains and flock to follow storms. For their well-being, it is advised that Trainers give them a magnet to hold and keep a few at home.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME's body is incredibly light, allowing it to stand upon clouds. Using its powerful legs it can leap between them, drifting gracefully through the skies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The fluff on POKENAME's head is softer than the finest silk. Because of this, people like using POKENAME as pillows.
author: blazerxz

entry: POKENAME's flame does not produce any smoke. In fact, it seems to purify the air of any toxins. Because of this, POKENAME has become popular as a natural air freshener.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is known for its melodious singing voice, but also for its short temper. Interrupting its song for any reason results in it igniting its tail and indignantly flinging fireballs.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies through dense clouds almost completely blindly. Its antennae detect air currents and movement, guiding it through the skies.
author: .izik

entry: Stories say that whoever spots POKENAME in the vast, blue sky will be blessed with good fortune. It may even approach pure-hearted individuals itself.
author: lynkinator

entry: This Pokémon buries itself into the clouds, making them its home. When its chosen cloud darkens and thickens, POKENAME comes out and rubs its wings, the vibrations of which forcing the cloud to rain and creating a soft melody.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME cannot stay awake when resting on the large cotton tuft on its belly. It often shares its space with children so they too can sleep peacefully.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It sings a happy chirping song and prances about when the sun rises. When it charges up electricity, the clouds of fluff on its body spark and rumble like faint thunder.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are heavy sleepers because very few sounds are able to penetrate through their fluffy wings. Lumberjacks often need to shake them awake to ensure they do not get hurt.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME soars quietly over deserts, waiting to ambush prey. It drops with jaws open wide, strong enough to dent cast iron with a single bite.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be seen throwing themselves off of tall cliffs in hopes of taking flight. Luckily, its head is covered in incredibly soft feathers that prevent it from doing any real damage to itself.
author: mistymagius

entry: Inside of POKENAME's bud is an incredibly poisonous thorn that contains enough venom to take out 10 fully grown adults. However, POKENAME's bud isn't open very often, only when the light level and humidity are just right.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's roses carry the lovely scent of the spring breeze. Because of how light its petals are, they often end up getting blown off in strong winds, leaving POKENAME moping around until they grow back.
author: mistymagius

entry: What appear to be tufts of fur hanging from POKENAME's body are actually clouds. POKENAME farms harvest these clouds to weave them into coats and even carpet floors in cooler areas, as they're lightweight and bouncy but very good at retaining heat.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME uses its soft fur to comfort those around it. It is very friendly and loves playing with people, making it a beloved companion.
author: sand_coffin

entry: What looks like body fur is actually wisps of cloud that POKENAME uses to help make itself light enough to leap high in the air. They can be found high up in mountaintops bounding across cliff faces.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: What looks like body fur is actually wisps of cloud that POKENAME uses to help make itself light enough to leap high in the air. They can be found high up in mountaintops bounding across cliff faces.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The cotton covering POKENAME's body is thick, warm, and inexpensive. In Sinnoh, it is woven into durable scarves sold in winter markets.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's cotton is almost as light as air, allowing them to float along the breeze without a care in the world. Its cotton is highly valuable, as it is commonly used to make highly breathable summer clothing.
author: mistymagius

entry: Living in the thickest clouds, POKENAME's eyes have gradually grown shut. When flocks echolocate together, it sounds like rolling thunder.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME lives on the tallest cliffs as it loves the feeling of the wind in its scales. It thinks its small wings are strong enough to fly and can be seen throwing itself off small cliffs to try and get airborne.
author: mistymagius

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME was trusted to secure ropes during climbs. It could fly to high ledges and tie perfect knots with unshakable grip.
author: .izik

entry: Flocks of POKENAME gather on clear days, cheerfully chirping while the sun is out. Their feathers are incredibly soft and resistant to grime, making them ideal for use in feather dusters.
author: mistymagius

entry: In winter, the cottony feathers on POKENAME's wings grow hot. It uses this warmth to insulate its eggs during the cold months.
author: .izik

entry: On a clear day, POKENAME can be found floating on the surface of a still body of water. Using its flat body, it camouflages itself as a reflection of the sky on the water's surface. During the summer months POKENAME is often found floating in pools.
author: mbo1064.

entry: POKENAME rolls nearly silently thanks to its cotton coating. The white fluff is laced with a sticky poison that causes itchy rashes on contact.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is known for helping plants propagate across the land. It carries seeds in its mouth and flies by flapping its cloud-like petals, planting the seeds when it lands.
author: sk372

entry: The puffy feathers atop its head are highly toxic when ingested. When threatened, it releases a cloud of these feathers into the air around it.
author: admiralvermin

entry: The cloud-like feathers that grow over its body are used as natural soundproof material: when another POKENAME lets out a sound-based attack, it will cover its otherwise sensitive ears.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's body is covered in a coating of airy bubbles that allows it to float above the ground. They gather in large groups on foggy mornings, cheerfully singing together.
author: mistymagius

entry: While they can take off and fly into the air with ease, POKENAME are infamously clumsy and dim-witted, with even mature POKENAME often crashing into tall structures in populated cities.
author: bobosmith01

entry: At night, POKENAME buries itself in coastal sand to rest. At sunrise, it and its flock burst into flight in a shimmering morning display.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives near populated areas and will seek out humans if it needs help cleaning itself. Its mushrooms can be ground into a powder that soothes sore throats, making this Pokémon especially popular with singers and public speakers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is very playful, and it enjoys singing and dancing for both people and Pokémon. It enjoys the attention it receives from its performances.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME's mushroom produces a thick mycelium that envelops its body in a cloud-like appearance. It obsessively cleans the mycelium, unless it is in a bad mood, letting grime give it the appearance of a storm cloud.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's scales are made of a unique substance that is solid on contact but is almost as light as air. While the scales have major scientific potential, they will start to slowly evaporate as soon as they are shed.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME flocks climb Blue Apricorn trees to eat fruit. If spotted, they scatter in all directions, many vanishing into the sky before they can be followed.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon places much importance in cleanliness and perfection, spending most of its time grooming its fluffy white fur or gathering the perfect twigs for its nest. Anyone who soils its fur or disturbs the nest is met with swift retribution.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME produces clouds of fresh air from its shell, allowing the nearby ecosystem to thrive. While it is a great help in fighting off pollution, POKENAME hates being in highly polluted areas.
author: mistymagius

entry: Small Pokémon love to rest on POKENAME's head, with its fluffy feathers acting as a soft cushion. It sits in the trees, carefully plucking twigs and leaves out of its feathers.
author: mistymagius

entry: The feathers on POKENAME's head make it seem like it's wearing a cotton-fluff hat. It is known to be a very friendly Pokémon, often sharing these soft feathers with people it particularly likes.
author: mepp.

entry: Many birdwatchers love POKENAME, as they fly in the sky in the shape of a heart and chirp lovely, heart-warming melodies. Scientists believe the mild scent they emit calms those around them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Female POKENAME grow longer head feathers than males. They chirp loudly and bounce these feathers before exploding near a potential mate to impress them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flaps its arms rapidly to stay airborne. Tiny feathers line its hands and arms, though how this enables flight still puzzles scientists.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to rest on people's heads because they enjoy the company that comes with it. They are prone to experiencing loneliness, so they try to keep themselves near people to cheer themselves up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are too large to rest on people's heads but that does not stop them from trying. They crave affection and will seek out kind-hearted people to be friends with.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's lightweight body and wings mean it can only fly well on days with little to no wind. Flocks will band together and fly closely in order to increase their mass and resist stronger gusts.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME float across ponds and lakes with soft pads attached to their legs. They chirp happily whenever they manage to find a berry in the water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The airy fluff on POKENAME's wings is prized for its use in the production of Choice Scarves. The unique combination of Persian fur and Swablu feathers creates a sleek and soft sheen.
author: ozydamians

entry: The soft fluff on POKENAME's arms has a soothing property, making it excellent at calming others with light massages. It mostly uses it to rub its own aching head, though.
author: sk372

entry: The fluffy wings of POKENAME conceal two sharp claws on each side. With a single swipe, it can slice through branches as it flies past.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glides through the sky in a smooth serpentine pattern. Its ability to fly without wings has puzzled researchers for generations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME nests on jagged beachside cliffs, as its predators cannot fly to reach its nests. Its singing brings tourists from around the world to visit.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Drifting along the clouds, whenever it snows, there's a good chance POKENAME will be near. A tracking device on this Pokémon is an excellent forecasting tool.
author: notsaying.

entry: POKENAME hides high above the clouds, quietly meditating while no one can disturb it. It will only come down to the surface when the sky is completely clear of clouds.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses its telekinesis to gently lift others so they can experience something akin to the joy of flight. It's also quite proud of its cloud-formed mustache.
author: sk372

entry: Their cloudy arms can send a devastating punch by compressing the air in them. When they fight too intensively, the arms turn darker and can even release small bolts of lightning.
author: markusknight

entry: When flexing, the cloud-like fluff on POKENAME's chest expands. Rivals will have flexing contests to see which one has the most expansive and thus most impressive chest-fluff.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME soars above onion fields searching for nesting grounds. Once it has chosen, it pecks a shallow hole to break the surface and sends roots deep beneath the soil.
author: .izik

entry: It has a spirited and combative personality, always eager to spar with others. Because its arms and fists are made of clouds, its punches don't pack much power.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gathers up small stones to hide within its cloud-like limbs. When battling, it flings cloud orbs filled with rocks to pack deceptively potent punches on impact.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fire is extremely soft to the touch. It likes to gallop in the sky, prancing from cloud to cloud.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME constantly emits a cloud that forms a shell around it, allowing it to hover and glide. It often flocks to drought-stricken areas to provide rain for people and Pokémon below.
author: badtothebow

entry: The stick it carries is tipped with a cloudy substance it regularly produces. It offers this up to those it is close to; the flavor of the cottony confection is powerfully sweet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME glides across coastal cliffs with its wing-like flippers. When wet, the cotton weighs POKENAME down, so POKENAME must wait several hours before it is able to fly again.
author: chibitales

entry: This little ball of feathers doesn't actually have any wings, so it floats around snugly inside of clouds instead.
author: shayzis_ozaki

entry: Too heavy to fly, POKENAME just likes to bounce around, flapping its little wings enthusiastically.
author: shayzis_ozaki

entry: Although fluffy to the touch, within the center of POKENAME's cloudy tail segments are solid stone. If it feels threatened, it won't hesitate to swing its body around and send an agitator flying.
author: sk372

entry: It uses the cottony puffs on its claws to clean the teeth of larger Pokémon in return for scraps of food.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME hunts in small packs, summoning powerful winds to slow its prey down. They are effective hunters of other airborne Pokémon.
author: gren24242

entry: Its gentle song can lull any nearby Pokémon into a pleasant, deep sleep. To keep the vibrant colors of its wings, POKENAME must feed on the sap of specific plants that grow only at altitudes above 1,000 meters.
author: fiordaliso

entry: An POKENAME forms small helium-filled bubbles around its body to fly. The bubbles form within the fluff on its body, then move to cover its skin.
author: .izik

entry: The cotton-like substance that covers its body becomes thicker in humid weather. On dry days, tiny wings emerge from the fluff.
author: .izik

entry: The bubbles clinging to POKENAME allow it to hover several inches above the ground, even while asleep. Scientists have studied this strange buoyancy for decades without clear answers.
author: .izik

entry: It keeps wild Pokémon away by heating up the fluffy cotton covering its body until it glows. POKENAME hums gentle lullabies to entertain its Trainer or help them fall asleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It keeps wild Pokémon away by heating up the fluffy cotton covering its body until it glows. POKENAME hums gentle lullabies to entertain its Trainer or help them fall asleep.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Nestled within its cloudlike feathers, it enjoys sleeping even more than Snorlax.  Pillows that are stuffed with its feathers are said to guarantee good dreams.
author: bostroms

entry: Nestled within its cloudlike feathers, it enjoys sleeping even more than Snorlax.  Pillows that are stuffed with its feathers are said to guarantee good dreams.
author: bostroms

entry: Nestled within its cloudlike feathers, it enjoys sleeping even more than Snorlax.  Pillows that are stuffed with its feathers are said to guarantee good dreams.
author: bostroms

entry: One can often spy a POKENAME residing in the middle of flower fields, singing with a melodious voice. The cottony puff around its neck spreads along with the breeze, clinging to flowers and providing them nourishment even in adverse weather.
author: sk372

entry: It strips off bark from trees to use in its nest. It uses chunks of fluff from its wings to line the nest and ensure comfort to its young.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its powers to accurately forecast cloud shapes and patterns. If these future readings predict an incoming storm, it sings with a deep voice to alert all beings nearby.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME likes to hum lazily as it floats along water ways. Its calm melodic singing makes listeners feel like they are on a summer vacation.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: While it appears innocent, POKENAME becomes possessive of those who nap under its watch, refusing to let them wake until it's satisfied they've “rested enough.” Some say it sings not to soothe, but to keep you still.
author: curazy

entry: Its wings have a consistency similar to cotton, and become heavy when wet. During a rainstorm, an POKENAME has trouble flying in a straight line.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME travel in large packs, hidden inside of clouds. When it is time to play, they spew their accumulated water to form small lakes and ponds in which they swim and have fun.
author: slimmagma

entry: POKENAME flies high above the clouds away from all predators. Whenever it descends to the ground, it creates a fierce wind capable of toppling trees.
author: gren24242

entry: An extremely friendly and sociable Pokémon. POKENAME tend to travel across the plains with flocks of Swablu, giving them company and a place to rest within its cloudy trunk.
author: cpnquacken

entry: Every spinning swing of POKENAME's limbs leaves behind a cloud trail. It uses these to confuse opponents by slowly enveloping and obscuring its battlefield movements over time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's clouds hold milk-like liquid that tastes fresher than average Miltank milk. The markings on its body seem to glow sometimes.
author: t.i.a.

entry: A joyful and friendly Pokémon, POKENAME loves to share the eggs it lays with its friends. When cooked, the eggs are light and airy, but lack flavor.
author: almightyonion

entry: The stone under the wool that covers its body is extremely brittle. The wool serves as a cushion should it bump into cave walls.
author: .izik

entry: It has been theorized that some old paintings depicting what was believed to be a lightning deity showed POKENAME, although some historians disagree and suggest a Pokémon rarely found in Unova instead. It has a pleasant but detached attitude.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Surrounded in fluffy, durable clouds, POKENAME rolls up in a ball to stop floating in the air. Trainers are encouraged to shear this fluff, which makes great breading when deep-fried.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's cloud-like wings and blue body trick its prey into thinking it's just a cloud as it silently stalks them from above. After capturing its target, it sings a soothing hum to prevent any struggle or cry for help from them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME drifts serenely through the blue sky above jungles. It will launch fireballs from its mouth at anyone who is harming the jungle's fauna.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: It flies across the sky, picking up emotions from Trainers and Pokémon. A group of POKENAME singing is said to be beautiful.
author: aregularbigjoke

entry: The skies are its home, and clouds are its comfort. They say that on a clear, cloudless day, gentle humming of songs can be heard far and wide from POKENAME. The light it naturally shines is capable of healing minor wounds.
author: merclipse

entry: The skies are its home, and clouds are its comfort. They say that on a clear, cloudless day, gentle humming of songs can be heard far and wide from POKENAME. The light it naturally shines is capable of healing minor wounds.
author: merclipse

entry: It is said POKENAME are incredibly rare, only frequently appearing when multiple rainbows form close together. Their scarcity has led many people to believe that this Pokémon is the fabled treasure at the end of the rainbow.
author: cinnamoone_redfield

entry: Its punches propel air from its fist with intense force. By concentrating, it can destroy boulders from up to ten feet away.
author: .izik

entry: The large cloud trailing POKENAME hides a mouth of sharp teeth. It hums a calming tune to lull foes into a false sense of security before clamping its jaws around them.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME spends most of the day laying on its soft cotton wings and humming songs. If anyone tries to steal even a small piece of its wings, POKENAME will attack them mercilessly using all of the energy it has stored by lazing about.
author: darkweavile428

entry: The cotton-like material on its body gets dirty very easily. To avoid tangles it prefers to wash itself twice per day.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can sense even the slightest atmospheric changes. Its presence signifies a severe thunderstorm in the area.
author: codewolfie

entry: As the average POKENAME is as dense as a cloud, it floats gracefully and rarely touches the ground. It eats by placing food into its cloudy body, leaving no trace behind. Its songs are known to be especially calming.
author: entomoxie

entry: One of the biggest Pokémon with the ability to float is POKENAME, which feeds itself by filter feeding on smaller flying critters from the air. Floating together with Swablords, the pod is often confused for a real cloud formation from the surface.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Small Flying-type Pokémon are attracted to the fluffy clouds on POKENAME's back. Any Pokémon who rests in these clouds will experience deep, blissful sleep.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME keeps to itself in the wild, finding solitary spots to practice its melodic singing. Its competitive nature makes organizing a group chorus a chore, but when successful, the music they can create is impeccable.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME swings its sword through the air, it makes a pleasant whistling sound. The tone of the sound varies with an individual's age and level.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME dwell above the clouds atop the tallest peaks, claiming the mountain as their own. When excited, they sing in unison, their harmonious calls echoing for miles through the valleys.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME only inhabits the cleanest coral reefs. Even the slightest amount of pollution in its home will drive it away.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its body is as light as air, it whimsically dances along wind currents without a care in the world. Ballerinas have taken inspiration from POKENAME's graceful ribbons in their dances.
author: mistymagius

entry: The ground-up horn of an POKENAME was used in ancient times to create remedies to treat stomach ulcers and fevers.
author: .izik

entry: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME moves endlessly across the skies and can even sleep while it maintains flight in the stratosphere. When it molts its white down, they'll look like a trail of sparkling stars across the sky.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Its melodic roar can soothe even the most catastrophic weather. It circles the ozone layer, defending populated areas from natural disasters.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Dancing high in the stratosphere, POKENAME plays amongst clouds in the wake of storms. They can rarely be seen jumping between cumulonimbus clouds, though most who see them mistake them for wisps of cloud blown by the wind.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Dancing high in the stratosphere, POKENAME plays amongst clouds in the wake of storms. They can rarely be seen jumping between cumulonimbus clouds, though most who see them mistake them for wisps of cloud blown by the wind.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Dancing high in the stratosphere, POKENAME plays amongst clouds in the wake of storms. They can rarely be seen jumping between cumulonimbus clouds, though most who see them mistake them for wisps of cloud blown by the wind.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME soar through the sky with rigid movements that make them seem like puppets. Their lack of grace causes them to bump into other Pokémon while airborne.
author: quackquackattack

entry: An POKENAME will sometimes perch on a mountain top in the morning to sing a depressing tune. The tune can cause dizziness in the elderly.
author: .izik

entry: The wool on its body is extremely hot. Should an POKENAME enter a cold climate, the wool will become brittle and fall off in clumps.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a caring and protective nature. It shelters smaller Pokémon within its clouds, defending them from predators with strong swings of its axe-like tusks.
author: sk372

entry: It takes the stuffing from lost and thrown-away plushes to use in its disguise. Any who peek under its disguise will fall into a deep sleep.
author: almightyonion

entry: POKENAME will drift through the sky, biting any small Pokémon that approaches. It is actually quite docile and won't attack anything larger than it.
author: duskrd

entry: POKENAME will often shed the clouds on their wings when landing, using them as a distraction to throw off the eyes of predators.
author: hortensia_xxiii

entry: POKENAME has excellent lung capacity, letting it sing its melodic song for over thirty minutes straight at a time. Its music echoes across its cavernous home, soothing the wild Pokémon and making them less aggressive.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have ethereal white crystals over their eyes that detect cursed energy in other Pokémon. They soothe cursed Pokémon with a soft lullaby while absorbing the cursed energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its body is covered in tiny bubbles that are filled with an incredibly cold gas. Should a bubble pop, it will freeze the water around it.
author: .izik

entry: There is a legend in Hoenn of an POKENAME that guards a spring surrounded by crystals. It will allow entry only to those who sing with it.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its smooth appearance, its body is covered in razor-sharp scales. Should an POKENAME rub against a ship, it can cause massive damage.
author: .izik

entry: The cotton-like substance on its body allows it to stay airborne when jumping out of the water. Despite its sharp teeth, it prefers to eat seaweed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can amplify its beautiful songs to an incredible volume. It will often muffle the noise using its fluffy wings to protect others' hearing.
author: ziggaway

entry: Once it chooses a mate, it will form a telepathic link with them. This link ensures communication at any time from up to ten miles away.
author: .izik

entry: This self-fusion of POKENAME is made purely out of clouds. It seems to resemble a certain form caused by a phenomenon in a faraway region.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME's clouds are bound by a unique slime that maintains its body's structure. This makes its plumage firmer than that of the average Altaria. This slime is also a potent natural adhesive, frequently harvested to produce glue.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: POKENAME glide high in the sky atop a bed of cloud-like feathers, closely knit together with their young. Those from below see what appears to be a singular swift-moving fluffy cloud, traveling through the sky.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its white feathers secrete a sticky toxin that is very difficult to get off. Because of this, it will often get other objects stuck to itself while jumping around tall trees.
author: mistymagius

entry: It does incredible acrobatics to scale cliff walls. By expanding the fluff on its body it can glide for miles.
author: .izik

entry: The puffy growths on the bottom of POKENAME's mushrooms can be removed to concoct medicine for severe coughs. It is found in mountainous forests where it sings in staccato rhythms.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME sings loudly above the clouds, attracting smaller Pokémon and offering them sanctuary within its body. However, it may digest them if it becomes hungry.
author: nexusshenanigans

entry: The blue crystals on its body are extremely cold to the touch. Some of the first refrigerators were developed with crystals from POKENAME fossils.
author: .izik

entry: Folktales say a Pokémon like this will greet you in the afterlife. Its melodies can calm each and every Pokémon.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME loves to sing as it flies through the sky. It uses the clouds as a stage, singing a song that comforts all who hear its tune.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: When dancing in the air, a POKENAME will use its entire environment to enhance the performance by floating and falling through the clouds. It can change its weight by changing the density of its cloud-like wings, making them more liquid or gaseous.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Said to be a dream conjured up from a child, POKENAME indeed have a fairy tale like appearance, and their psychic powers invoke a lot of whimsy.
author: frokachu

entry: The white substance on its body may look like cotton, but it is actually millions of tiny bubbles. It uses the bubbles to camouflage its nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is sustained by the mushroom, so only the puffy growths should be removed for their medicinal properties since they can be regrown. It is known to sing mournful-sounding melodies from mountaintops.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME creates throwing stars out of its soft down. When multiple are thrown at high speeds the resulting sound resembles a chorus. It hums in battle to always appear composed.
author: chaoticanzu

entry: Depending on its body size, the pitch of its melodious voice can vary greatly, ranging from a celestial soprano to a powerful tenor. The cotton surrounding its body vaguely resembles a pumpkin, making it easy to spot in fields at night.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME surround themselves with clouds to cushion themselves while they travel low to the ground. When they're startled, POKENAME will expand the clouds that surround them into a fog to help them escape.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The shimmering mist released by POKENAME is bottled by highland villagers and sold at local markets. Just a drop on a pillow is said to bring dreams of floating among the stars.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME fly across the sky in pairs, creating streams of clouds resembling contrails. A popular service trains POKENAME to fly in patterns that spell out romantic messages across the sky.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME create the slightest of drizzles, which are usually no more than 5 seconds. During breeding season, their droplets will become pink to impress a mate.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME float aimlessly high in the sky and are often mistaken for small clouds. The three heads all sing in perfect harmony.
author: themicelegion

entry: The three heads of POKENAME are often together in song. However, it's a rare occurrence for all of them to harmonize.
author: serversizeme

entry: When angered, the white cotton tufts on its body turn gray and crackle with electricity. When POKENAME is in a good mood, however, it spends the whole day singing sweet, melodic tunes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A wool-like substance covers its body. There is a seamstress in Hutber Port that utilizes the fluff from an POKENAME to create scuba gear.
author: .izik

entry: Found in secluded places long untouched by human civilization, POKENAME appears to get its energy from the water inside of clouds; the slight moisture hardens its tough body. From afar, some have mistaken POKENAME for a UFO.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Found in secluded places long untouched by human civilization, POKENAME appears to get its energy from the water inside of clouds; the slight moisture hardens its tough body. Rarely, it is found scooping up small Bug-type Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can run across the sky by forming cloud-like cushions beneath its majestic paws. Each morning, it fills the valleys with its angelic song carried by the wind, believed to be a blessing. Living near POKENAME is considered a sign of great fortune.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It can run across the sky by forming cloud-like cushions beneath its majestic paws. Each morning, it fills the valleys with its angelic song carried by the wind, believed to be a blessing. Living near POKENAME is considered a sign of great fortune.
author: fiordaliso

entry: By forming soft clouds beneath its paws, it races freely across the sky. Each morning, its angelic song flows through the valleys on the breeze, believed to bring blessings. Those who live near POKENAME are thought to be especially favored by fate.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can blend into a cloudy sky thanks to the shape of its soft wings, and its tail flames are often mistaken for sunlight. It warns others about its territory by singing loudly and attacks anyone who dares to ignore its vocal warnings.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A single POKENAME is able to control every cloud within a two thousand mile radius. They use this magic to hide themselves from predators.
author: gurguro

entry: By concentrating, it can use its psychic abilities to lift its body and fly at great speeds. When attacking, it will rotate its spoons clockwise.
author: .izik

entry: It floats serenely high up among the clouds. If attacked, POKENAME unfurls its ribbonlike tentacles to defend itself.
author: _aphoric

entry: It is able to control the movement of the cloud it sits on, though its top speed is slower than a walk. It drifts around aimlessly while it sleeps.
author: greystorm101

entry: POKENAME is in a constant state of shock, trying to move the body it no longer has.
author: shayzis_ozaki

entry: It likes to grab gently onto their Trainer's shoulders and lay on their head like a hat. They are surprisingly light.
author: shayzis_ozaki

entry: During the day, POKENAME puts on a friendly facade to fool people. In reality, it's a nocturnal predator that spares no mercy to its victims.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Despite looking like their body is made of clouds, POKENAME is actually hidden inside, only betrayed by their claws poking out underneath.
author: shayzis_ozaki

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in a layer of airy bubbles which allow it to float in the water. Its claws are deceptively powerful, strong enough to shatter stone from its grip strength alone.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live close to the water's edge, dipping in and out periodically to keep their slimy bodies comfortably damp. When threatened they produce a sticky mucus that rapidly hardens on contact with the air.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produces a viscous slime from inside its body. The slime is slightly acidic and incredibly hard to wash off.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME anchor themselves within tidal rock pools using sticky mucus, remaining hydrated thanks to the regular refreshing of the sea waters. They are largely immobile and rely on hiding out of sight to stay safe long enough to evolve.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME constantly secrete a sticky mucus from their bodies to protect themselves from harm, using it to ward off physical blows. They can shape this mucus as it hardens and dries, making temporary wings that they use to fly.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's shell is constantly covered by a thin layer of slime. If it dries out, the shell becomes brittle.
author: .realthree

entry: Each green orb on its body leaks a corrosive slime that POKENAME rubs all over its scales to keep itself safe from predators. It is immune to its own slime but avoids water, where it loses potency.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to play hide-and-seek with its Trainer. Although the trail of goo it leaves behind makes it easy to find, it has creative hiding spots.
author: dodoowner_

entry: They live in groups to keep each other moist and cool. It uses its bodily fluids to communicate, but it can't use too much of it or it'll dry up.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is a fusion that is largely disliked because it secretes a gloop that spreads wildly as it flies. This gelatinous plume is more elastic than gloopy.
author: blake

entry: This absorbent angler is covered in a slick fluid which allows it to shrug off all sorts of attacks. It produces a luminous substance in its cheeks and antennae to guide others in the deep sea.
author: evilgammon

entry: Coated in highly conductive slime, POKENAME are constantly surrounded by weak electrical fields. They lack fine control over these fields and often shock their Trainers in their eagerness to show affection.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It is very affectionate, yet very timid. POKENAME's tiny stature and slimy body allows it to squeeze through very tight spaces to escape enemies.
author: kittyluv090

entry: When POKENAME gets excited, it bounces around uncontrollably. It requires close supervision to reduce the risk of hurting itself or others.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Though POKENAME loves to be pet, caution must be taken for those that indulge it; its gooey coat contains faint traces of electricity that will cause numbness with prolonged contact.
author: sk372

entry: Known for its sticky grip, one of the few known instances where it loosens its slimy grip on an item is when it spots a Golden Pinap Berry to steal. It will stop whatever it is doing to get a closer look at the shiny berry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves to smear sweet, succulent honey all across its gooey body. Whatever it isn't able to scoop up and consume normally will be absorbed into its body over time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a very docile Pokémon. It is often spotted letting Water types eat the slime that's produced on its back.
author: novellavaria

entry: POKENAME is weak and timid, flopping over to play dead when frightened. If turned the right way up, it simply flops over again, fully committed to its ruse.
author: hophoppip

entry: It spits its acidic goo onto lapis lazuli to dissolve it into a paste before consuming it. This process makes its scales shimmer with a brilliant blue hue.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME causes anyone nearby to experience brief nonsensical visions, attracting those who seek such encounters. It haunts houses in rainy regions.
author: 1bridgeyboo

entry: POKENAME love the rain. They soak up moisture through the small scales on their body, later transforming that liquid into a slimy substance.
author: clawshdi

entry: POKENAME is often disheartened by its Trainer's unwillingness to interact, which is due to its sliminess.
author: coooooooookiee

entry: The goo that drips from its body is extremely slippery. It rolls its metallic body in the gel to make itself shiny, often attracting predators that slip when pursuing it.
author: .izik

entry: It leaps out of sand dunes to pounce on prey, firing globs of emerald-colored slime to slow foes. The sand it coats in slime hardens into a protective shell when dry.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's tentacles secrete a sticky slime, making its grip very hard to escape from. This slime has been discovered to have antibacterial qualities, making it a vital ingredient in the creation of many household dish soaps.
author: evilgammon

entry: When POKENAME headbutts something, the gelatinous dome bursts and spreads an immobilizing goop all around it. The slimy bulb regenerates shortly, ensuring its skull is always protected.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wants to fight, but can barely contain its weak, slimy composition. It compromises by exclusively fighting wet Pokémon.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its edge is dull, but POKENAME is surprisingly good at deflecting strikes by using its slime. When struck, the slime helps soften blows or redirect attacks away from vital areas.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME can harden and soften the slime at will, allowing it to soften blows and cut up opponents. However, when hardened, the slime can very easily shatter apart like glass.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME's body secretes a flammable oil that is very useful in cooking and heating. The oil can burn for up to a week without interruption.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its skin has a texture similar to pudding, jiggling when touched. It spits green acid on cave formations before eating them, leaving behind sparkling marks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has three powerful heads that can destroy almost anything. Fortunately, this Pokémon is very quiet and peaceful.
author: prof.whitebeam

entry: POKENAME dwell within murky bogs, squishing their gelatinous bodies beneath the mire to lie in wait for prey. They puff up their bodies to launch themselves from their hiding spots, extending their jaws to swallow their prey whole.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME create a protective helmet out of solidified mucus to help protect them as they launch off of cliffs in attempts to fly. Luckily, their bodies are rather gelatinous, helping them to cushion the blow if their angle is off.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are coated in a thick layer of mucus, protecting their bodies from physical harm. This mucus is kept liquid by an intense internal body heat and, for some POKENAME, can result in their legs being impeded by the slime.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoy splashing around in puddles after rainy days. They shake themselves dry once they're done, releasing excess slime from their bodies that helps plants grow.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The slime it leaks from its tusks smells like Wepear Berries and has been used as a spread for bagels. Its gooey nature helps it cling to trees when escaping predators.
author: .izik

entry: Many POKENAME are found in tombs using their sticky green slime to repair pottery. Their slime is so strong that restored artifacts are as durable as new.
author: .izik

entry: It cheers on its allies by waving pom-poms made from thick mucus. It can generate a weak electric charge to defend itself.
author: hophoppip

entry: This Pokémon uses its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane to retain moisture, allowing it to bounce along the sand near the waters where it resides. Additionally, this same membrane makes POKENAME very unpleasant to any predator looking for a snack.
author: chiari_queen

entry: This Pokémon was forced to develop a heightened sense of hearing, since its own slime covers its eyes while it hangs upside down. Its ears are not safe from getting clogged either, making some to feel this evolutionary process quite pointless.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: Its wings are made up of slime and mucus secreted from its cheek pouches. Feeding it the wrong diet will make it unable to fly, so it's a rather expensive Pokémon to take care of.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME's body is made up of fine granules of sand covered in a layer of gooey membrane. The shovel atop POKENAME's head is difficult to remove and doing so causes it to attack the offender until the shovel is returned.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's slimy head scale emits a terrible stench when it feels threatened. Its gooey body makes it difficult to grapple or contain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are coated in a thick layer of mucus, protecting their bodies from physical harm. This mucus is kept liquid by an intense internal body heat, so it is advised that trainers take great care when handling POKENAME.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have dense and sticky slime covering their bodies, making it hard to make physical contact with them. Their slime is scalding to the touch and can cause nasty burns for the unwary.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It digs beneath jungle trees, using acidic nose drippings to dissolve roots before eating them. The slime left behind nurtures the soil for new growth.
author: .izik

entry: Dirt and debris constantly get stuck in POKENAME's gooey fur as it searches for food and places to rest, forcing it to find puddles to wash itself in. It leaves behind a slime trail in a zigzag-like pattern as it walks.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME remains motionless in damp forests and under as much cover as possible while awaiting evolution. If discovered, it tries to roll away while the sticky slime trail slows pursuit.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The corrosive snot that dribbles from its three noses lines its tunnels, leaving an olive-colored glow. It uses this glow to attract insects into its burrow.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's slime burns hot enough to melt sand into glass. In battle, it flings this molten slime before following up with a searing Ember.
author: .izik

entry: When the slime POKENAME produce makes contact with the air, it rapidly stiffens and becomes inflexible. They use this quality of their slime to create wings that enable them to take to the air, offering them excellent mobility.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It spits corrosive slime on its prey, making it easier to eat. Some people use this substance for cleaning rusted metal.
author: kittyluv090

entry: While POKENAME aren't very intelligent, they show an immense amount of compassion towards their Trainers. Some people find that off-putting.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME collects slime around its neck and uses it as protection against heat. This slime also has properties that facilitate sleep.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME produce slimeballs in its pouch that it gives out to Trainers it likes. The slime is actually quite valuable as it is commonly used in high quality sunscreens.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's shell has retreated under its skin. It is thought that in a few thousand years, POKENAME won't have a shell at all.
author: .realthree

entry: This form of POKENAME was thought to be extinct. There are ferrous compounds in its shell, which it remains within to preserve moisture.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is very sensitive to the weather, only coming out of its den on rainy days. It leaves behind a trail of slime wherever it goes, which has been used as a form of moisturizer for centuries.
author: mistymagius

entry: To regulate its body temperature, POKENAME produces a vapour that it expels through its skin. This vapour is highly toxic and carries an unpleasant odour, leading to POKENAME being very unpopular. Covering it in soap helps to neutralise the vapour.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME claws produce a glue-like poison which it uses to incapacitate its prey. However, POKENAME can have difficulty injecting the poison due to its thickness.
author: mistymagius

entry: The bodies of these monstrous Pokémon seep a deadly poison that coats their iron jaws. Miners should be afraid of encountering these Pokémon while mining deep underground.
author: mistymagius

entry: Inside its tough shell, POKENAME produces a thick glue-like paste from the leaves and bark it likes to collect. It uses the glue to stop predators in their tracks, allowing it to escape.
author: mistymagius

entry: The green swirly tail on POKENAME's back houses all of its vital organs. It must carry its tail around despite it being very heavy, as dragging it around would cause damage to the organs inside.
author: soup1900

entry: Its metallic talons are coated with many corrosive chemicals that make POKENAME a dangerous Pokémon to be scratched by. They are simple-minded Pokémon who only desire food and sleep.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME leave a slippery slime as it rolls that often disorient its pursuers. They are quite playful Pokémon and love to play with children. They especially love belly rubs.
author: mistymagius

entry: When threatened, POKENAME spits a strong acid that is strong enough to melt anyone straight to the bone. Some people have theorized that POKENAME was originally some sort of alien cocoon.
author: mistymagius

entry: A freezing slime coats POKENAME's body which drips off on hot days. Leatherworkers prize it for curing and preserving rare hides.
author: .izik

entry: Sightings of these Pokémon are common after nuclear accidents. Their dens are incredibly narrow since their viscous bodies allow them to squeeze through tight gaps.
author: mistymagius

entry: Theorized to be an extra-terrestrial being, POKENAME fires an acidic green liquid from its arms that can melt just about anything. Its sensitive antennae are able to sense other creatures over 50 feet away.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses a strong acid to melt through solid rock in search of rare minerals to eat. They are very aggressive Pokémon and will attempt to bite anyone who disturbs them.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's helmet-like shell is harder than iron. The shell is coated in a slick poison that causes rashes on contact.
author: .izik

entry: It skulks around the ruins of fallen civilizations, eroding monuments with its corrosive goo. The humid mists of dense jungles carry its infectious spores.
author: ozydamians

entry: The body of POKENAME is made up of a toxic, caustic mucus. It throws rapid punches imbued with this mucus to simultaneously stun and dissolve its prey.
author: bacondlx

entry: The wooden clamps on POKENAME's body keep its soft body from falling apart. The green slime it produces acts similar to oil and is theorized to be an amazing energy source.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in a rubber-like substance that is oddly resistant to physical attacks. The unpleasant taste of the rubber discourages other Pokémon from attacking it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has poor eyesight due to living in deep cave systems, which is why it will constantly headbutt its surroundings. Luckily, its soft body is resistant to physical injury.
author: mistymagius

entry: The large sacs that make up POKENAME's shell are filled with an acidic slime which sprays out if these sacs are punctured. They almost never move from their dens, waiting patiently for evolution.
author: mistymagius

entry: The green slime that coats its tusks is extremely acidic. This allows for POKENAME to slice through basically anything. Even the slightest graze from these tusks can be life-threatening.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sticks itself to cave walls using its gooey body. Despite its lack of teeth, it will bite into its prey, using its corrosive saliva to melt them until POKENAME can slurp them up.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve nearly any material. When it finds an item too tough to dissolve, it keeps it as a precious treasure.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: The foam around POKENAME's neck is extremely sticky and can stop even the largest of Pokémon in their tracks. They are very friendly and adore human affection.
author: mistymagius

entry: These mischievous Pokémon like to play dirty, using the slime on their wings to disorient, slow down, or even blind their opponents. Their slippery bodies allow them to escape predators with ease.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's scales produce a thick layer of slime which protects them from physical hits. While its punches are a little weaker because of it, it makes up for it with its acid-based attacks.
author: mistymagius

entry: To blind its enemies, it shoots sticky saliva bubbles from its mouth at their faces. POKENAME has a habit of stealing berries from Pokémon slower than itself, knowing that its developed agility will allow it to get away undisturbed.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Some salons keep a POKENAME on staff to help with deep conditioning. It naturally secretes a nutrient-rich mucus that it then combs through hair with its soft hands, leaving even the dirtiest hair smooth and glossy.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME protects its soft, delicate body with its elastic shell, which allows any projectiles to bounce off of it. To get around quickly, it will tuck in its limbs and roll around like a soccer ball.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its saliva is highly corrosive, making physical contact with it very risky. People who work with POKENAME put their lives on the line.
author: 8xviktor

entry: It often gets picked on by larger Pokémon due to its meek personality. If bullied too much, POKENAME will explode in frustration and coat its surroundings with a sticky, electrified goop.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a popular performing Pokémon in traveling shows. For its tricks, it can form imitations of objects using slime.
author: bee4082

entry: It loves dancing with others of its kind, but they always end up slipping on each other's goo when they try. Watching its dance for too long may cause you to feel for some time like your entire body is made of jelly and unable to stand on its own.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME secretes a mucus that helps it slide over any dangerous terrain. This fluid is very hard to remove from textiles such as clothes and carpets.
author: .realthree

entry: This form of POKENAME was thought to be extinct. The metallic liquid it secretes has been found to have applications as a cleaning agent.
author: .realthree

entry: The goo-like substance that oozes from its tentacles is used partially in POKENAME's digestive process, as it contains powerful enzymes that can eat away at parts that are otherwise hard to consume, such as bone or mineral buildup.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The goo-like substance that oozes from its tentacles is used partially in POKENAME's digestive process, as it contains powerful enzymes that can eat away at parts that are otherwise hard to consume, such as bone or mineral buildup.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is an extremely friendly Pokémon that enjoys clustering with others on seabeds. Keeping it in tanks is challenging, as it becomes sullen without companionship. The slime-like substance it secretes means it needs regular cleaning.
author: jadey.1557

entry: The blades of POKENAME ooze a poisonous sap. As hard as steel beneath the fluid, they can slice through nearly any material.
author: hermsmegerms

entry: While the toxic honey it produces is not fit for consumption, once neutralized, it can be used to treat bug bites and stings.
author: kittyluv090

entry: This playful Pokémon carries a bubble wand, which it uses to entertain children. The bubbles it creates are squishy but durable.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME smells positively revolting and drives other Pokémon away. The slime that covers its body is full of nutrients that help plants grow.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Though generally well-behaved, if bullied POKENAME will latch onto aggressors with its powerful jaws. Though its teeth are not particularly sharp, its gooey saliva is a powerful irritant and weakens muscles after prolonged contact.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will produce massive amounts of goop while standing in a large crater or valley. The result is a lake of slime that becomes their home.
author: gurguro

entry: The mucus on its bubbles is the same chemical makeup as human snot. POKENAME fills these slime bubbles with helium to rise higher and drains them to float downward.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME burrows through the ground in search of damp earth to soak in. Some POKENAME can even be found beneath massive lakes.
author: ursulaarchmorningstar

entry: POKENAME's toxic slime is harvested to make rare pigments. When properly treated, it produces deep hues used in crafting a Clothing Dye Kit.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's weight reduces its stamina to fly, but its lubricant goo and powerful muscles allow it to gain enough speed underwater to jump and glide for kilometers. While its skin is unharmed by salty water, it seems wary of it for unknown reasons.
author: epping_forest

entry: It lingers above its Trainer's head to protect it from rain and other inclement weather. Unfortunately, you're liable to get just as messy from the globs of ectoplasmic goo that drip from underneath its wide-brimmed crown.
author: ozydamians

entry: The sticky slime coating its body has beneficial effects on plants, as it keeps parasites away. A single sweep of its tail is powerful enough to move even large stone monoliths.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A shy but powerful Pokémon that prefer to live in damp caves. It is able to survive in extremely dry or humid conditions thanks to the film that covers its body.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are known to be extremely friendly towards people and Pokémon. However, they are extremely protective of their Trainers, and will attempt to destroy anyone who tries to harm them.
author: jennybean

entry: POKENAME uses it's gooey aura to make bubbles. It can alter the thickness of these bubbles, changing air flow and sturdiness for virtually any usage.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: The goo frill around its neck can be used to make potions. Sometimes it will even feed wild Pokémon its goo if they need immediate medical help.
author: zeeroooo

entry: The plantlife growing on POKENAME's back is always thriving with a unique type of fruit with a sticky exterior and juicy insides. It's a favored treat among young Dragon types, who flock to POKENAME when it travels near.
author: sk372

entry: When hatched, the palm of POKENAME is extremely sticky. However, the moment it touches something, it gets covered in debris, making it dirty and unable to stick to anything.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Its two hands often get tangled together. Once this happens, untangling them can take hours of trial and error.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME can stretch its hand far beyond what most Pokémon can reach. It uses this flexibility and momentum to deliver powerful smacks to its opponents.
author: musicsheep.

entry: An incredibly cuddly Pokémon, POKENAME often underestimates its own strength and size. Unfortunately, its clinginess often crushes POKENAME's own Trainers due to tackling them during play, or attempting to sit on their laps.
author: piponus

entry: POKENAME are dotingly affectionate and will wrap their goo-covered ribbons around their Trainers to show affection. The goo has calming effects and is used in medical sedatives.
author: chibitales

entry: Nesting sites of POKENAME are often covered in gooey webs that give off small electrical pulses. Anything that comes in contact with the webbing is glued in place and paralyzed by the electricity.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is very friendly and is often found sheltering weaker Pokémon and helping them grow. Despite this, its known to hold grudges for several decades if picked on. The gooey secretions from its tails are very warm.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is extremely affectionate and tries to hug anyone who gets close, pulling them in with its long antennae. It uses the sticky slime covering its body to reinforce the hinges of the dams it builds along rivers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The colorful rings in its rubbery horns oscillate in a mesmerizing manner. Some say that it isn't in control of its own body.
author: _sadfroggy

entry: POKENAME is able to roll and bounce at extreme speeds to trample its foes. Its toxic secretions are a powerful adhesive.
author: teravolt

entry: POKENAME are mellow creatures coated in poisonous goo, often seeking the company of others and growing sad when left alone. When enraged, they become nearly unstoppable, thrashing with enough force to send dump trucks flying.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME's viscous armor hardens under pressure, forming crystalline scales as strong as fossilized bone. Its saliva can dissolve steel, yet it uses it only to carve paths through stone lairs.
author: bionic_man

entry: Trainers tend to unfuse POKENAME when met with its frankly disturbing visage. Perhaps because of this, it seems to try and be exceptionally friendly.
author: bukie

entry: Trainers tend to unfuse POKENAME when met with its frankly disturbing visage. Perhaps because of this, it seems to try and be exceptionally friendly.
author: bukie

entry: Due to being made of unique adaptive cells, POKENAME can use its gel for many purposes such as medicine, sustenance, power generation, or defense. However, due to this Pokémon's rarity and reclusive nature, few samples have been obtained.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME's wings have the consistency of viscous goo. Yet when POKENAME flies, its wings become lighter than air and adopt the texture of cotton.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME shows affection by hugging its Trainer with its slimy wings. Many people avoid it for this very reason.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its petals shake out toxic clouds of pollen as it lumbers around. Despite being a hazard to most, POKENAME still makes an effort to be friendly.
author: bukie

entry: The goo secreted from POKENAME's body is often collected for use in reusable gel packs. This goo stays semifluid despite being below freezing or heated to high temperatures.
author: chibitales

entry: The slime it secretes is edible, with a sweet citrusy flavor. Though the slime has gained popularity as an ingredient in desserts, bakers must work with it carefully, as it's incredibly sticky and difficult to wash off.
author: hophoppip

entry: To heighten the effects of X Sp. Def, scientists use goo extracted from a POKENAME. Its naturally high defensive abilities leave behind powerful residue in the goo.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The green gems on POKENAME's head are actually thick globs of slime that have been crystallized. These gems are even stronger than diamonds, easily being able to crush them into dust.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's goo is a sticky polymer that can trap foes and even allies when excited. It's also delicious when roasted by a great chef.
author: greystorm

entry: POKENAME produces goo by swirling its tail in water. This goo is a particularly powerful binding agent. Due to POKENAME's naturally rebellious disposition, it likes to apply the goo to objects deemed important by their Trainers as a prank.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME lives in swamplands and becomes more active on rainy days. A friendly Pokémon, it's often seen alongside Quagsire and Wooper, gathering food for them with its powerful psychic abilities.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's viscous slime-coating allows it to squeeze into tiny spaces, as long as its venomous beak can fit through. It is timid, fleeing from new sights, so a persistent and calm Trainer can build trust with a wild one over weeks of visits.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is affectionate towards those it views as friends, but be wary if you get on its bad side. It's vindictive and highly persistent.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME are extremely difficult to locate in the wild, their bodies blending in nearly seamlessly with boulders and rubble. They are dangerous Pokémon to disturb due to their propensity to explode at the slightest disturbance.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are formed of fine-grained sandstone, the matrix binding the sand in their bodies together reinforced by a potent electrical charge. They are able to control their electrical charge, turning it into dramatic explosive potential.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are formed of fine-grained sandstone, the matrix binding the sand in their bodies together reinforced by a potent electrical charge. They are able to control their electrical charge, turning it into dramatic explosive potential.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Thought to have been used as smoke bombs in ancient times, POKENAME prefer brittle rocks to coat their body, so that their gases don't get trapped and cause them to explode.
author: frokachu

entry: It pulverizes boulders with its pincers in search of rare ores, which it studiously collects. It appears to despise Black Augurite, however.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME is found guarding the remnants of ancient desert civilizations. It holds a fearsome visage to drive away any intruders and enemies.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can be found haphazardly rolling through overgrown ruins. The rocks protruding from the moss growing on them are actually sweet berries with extremely hard shells.
author: hummusishome

entry: POKENAME spend most of their time maintaining the delicate balancing act of keeping all of their parts together. They use the rock on the top of their heads like sonar to detect changes in the wind and adapt to them to stay balanced.
author: hummusishome

entry: Overgrown ruins across the region are ferociously guarded by POKENAME. They lumber through their territory on constant high alert, scanning the area with each of their seven eyes.
author: hummusishome

entry: It is said that a great alchemist once sought to recreate the miracle Regigigas bestowed on mankind. Breathing life into rocks that now forever stand watch, guarding their creator and his treasures.
author: doxtordaemon

entry: The gas they create is highly flammable and burns at close to 1400 degrees Celsius. POKENAME sit around burning this gas all day until they eventually evolve.
author: hummusishome

entry: As POKENAME move, cracks form in the stones lining their backs, releasing highly flammable gas. They ignite this gas voluntarily when threatened.
author: hummusishome

entry: Specialized vents in the outer shells of POKENAME expel the flammable gas they produce as a waste product. The true chemical composition of this gas is still unknown.
author: hummusishome

entry: POKENAME will only be content if it lives in total darkness and will rampage if anyone brings light into its lair. Scientific studies have determined that POKENAME appears to lack a brain or any kind of physical substitute.
author: bobosmith01

entry: These large and very rare golems can be found near caves deep in dense forests and high up on craggy mountains. There, POKENAME stands motionless, acting as a silent guardian to the dens many bear Pokémon call home.
author: moopse

entry: These extremely rare Pokémon are barely ever seen. These little bear-shaped rock Pokémon prefer bare terrain, such as salt flats, that many other Pokémon find unbearable.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME can be seen slowly patrolling ancient ruins, using the limestone to rebuild its body. This is because as it moves, its body slowly grinds down to a fine sand.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides in ancient ruins, disguising itself as a normal rock. Its body cannot be damaged by any modern weapon.
author: themicelegion

entry: Composed of sand and stone held together via a psychic consciousness, POKENAME can separate and manipulate its rocky parts at will. It's said that as long as its core stone is intact, it can reform itself from any damage.
author: sk372

entry: This massive cluster of living rock uses its smaller body as a decoy to lure foes and prey alike into its cavernous maw. Once they are too far within to escape, its cave-like jaws seal shut and all within are eventually digested.
author: infinex21

entry: Its thickened skull resembles a Polished Mud Ball in smoothness and color. To maintain its smoothness, it rubs its head against rocks to polish its skull.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its blades are used to cut through rock. POKENAME uses this rock to repair itself if parts of it break off.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It is said that POKENAME roams the seas collecting debris and rocks to expand its majestic stone fins. Rumor has it that a single movement of its tail can unleash devastating tsunamis.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If the crystal in its center shatters, it will die. It's said that any foe which stands before POKENAME will be cleansed in purifying flames.
author: .crystallization

entry: POKENAME's rock-solid jaws can crush even the solidest of stones into powder with a single bite. It consumes rocks regularly, storing the minerals within and belching them out as miniature sand clouds to deter and disorient attackers.
author: sk372

entry: Its heavy stone body is always tumbling back to the ground. POKENAME never stops leaping and attempting to fly, however; it's determined to soar above the clouds one day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME embed themselves into rocky outcroppings and spend months in one spot absorbing nutrients around them. Once they've spent enough time in one place, they break through the rocks that have accumulated above them, often causing rockslides.
author: hummusishome

entry: While rare, POKENAME have sometimes been spotted in the wild. It is believed they're the result of a Trevenant's wooden body undergoing petrification.
author: cristata

entry: While rare, POKENAME have sometimes been spotted in the wild. It is believed they're the result of a Trevenant's wooden body undergoing petrification.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME wanders the desert, searching for large rocks to add to its body. Although it appears intimidating, it will give weary travelers a ride, and it's actually quite gentle.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME form at the bottom of glaciers, the heavy base of the immense ice structures putting pressure on and grinding against the underlying bedrock. POKENAME emerge at the moraine of the glacier, their bodies a composite of ice and stone.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME form at the bottom of glaciers, the heavy base of the immense ice structures putting pressure on and grinding against the underlying bedrock. POKENAME emerge at the moraine of the glacier, their bodies a composite of ice and stone.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME utilizes its sound system to play booming rock music. At max volume, the reverb could shatter the hardest stone around it and easily send intruders packing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gathers coins, shiny stones and other trinkets as it lumbers around, even physically stealing it from others if need be. It hoards them in select spots, and strangely keeps them organized in patterns resembling the one on its face.
author: sk372

entry: Many scientists believe the stones comprising POKENAME's body come from different planets in deep space. Once a month, when the moon is full, POKENAME's stones will separate and reform in a different arrangement.
author: sk372

entry: Once a day, the prongs of POKENAME's body separate and rearrange themselves into a different order. The gaps left behind during this process emit extreme levels of heat and light.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME thrives in volcanic areas. Even though its body is comprised mostly of rocks, it can still run at amazing speeds. However, it is not very intelligent and is prone to injury. This doesn't matter, though: it can rebuild itself with new rocks.
author: lootererswillbeboated

entry: Scientists are still trying to understand the combustion reactions of POKENAME. However, nobody has been able to get close enough to it without being blasted by its tail.
author: notsaying.

entry: There's a myth about a stone monolith infused with and corrupted by a Gengar. POKENAME seems to fit that description.
author: 8xviktor

entry: This fusion was first discovered in a snowy tundra. POKENAME emits lightning that leaves patches of ice on the skin instead of burns.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME emits strong lightning in all directions, leaving behind thick layers of ice. This property has recently aroused the interest of scientists.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME carves itself a club and helmet out of solid arctic ice to better survive the frozen wastes. The ice shard it holds is a solid weapon, and also lets it fire freezing beams in combat.
author: sk372

entry: The helmet and ice club it wields have merged with it, making POKENAME's entire body solid ice. It can now freeze water vapor in the air to create an infinite supply of new ice weapons to battle with.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being made of solid ice, POKENAME are surprisingly light and stay aloft with little issue. The frigid haze they exude has a numbing effect on those who inhale it.
author: infinex21

entry: This natural fusion occured when a Trainer abandoned a Metapod in the Glaseado Mountains. It dreams of evolving and getting revenge.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is the result of two Regifing colliding and their bodies fusing together due to their extreme cold temperatures. The cold, toxic haze it emits has grown strong enough to numb and lull most who inhale it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's glacial wings produce flurries that will put opponents to sleep, then freeze them after a few minutes. This is one of the most common ways hikers pass away on snowy peaks.
author: rockageddon

entry: POKENAME displays a lot of haughty and self-absorbed behavior. Those that don't properly bask in its beautiful glory will be hit with a raging blizzard for their impertinence.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is kept in specialized home aquariums, where the water is mixed with minerals to lower the freezing point. Its body temperature is below the freezing point of water, making it cold to the touch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: According to legend, POKENAME sheds the yellow crystals on its back once every century. They are said to bring great luck to the finder.
author: kjcole

entry: POKENAME's body is made out of a strange substance that somehow stays soft and malleable even hundreds of degrees below freezing. Anything that comes in contact with the slime will freeze instantly.
author: mistymagius

entry: If even partially doused in water, POKENAME can become nearly invisible. Old tales of invisible icebergs that sunk ships in the far north of the world may have actually been the result of POKENAME living nearby.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME stores excess electricity in its icy spikes. When it launches these spikes at its foes, the electricity they contain is discharged into the opponents.
author: .realthree

entry: When fusing, a POKENAME keeps the exact molecular structures of a Regice. Its eyes flash in tune with nearby electronics and electromagnetic waves.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME have amazing regenerative abilities; as long as its head remains, it can grow its body back good as new. The green orbs on its body are a concentrated chemical that can melt through anything.
author: mistymagius

entry: These playful Pokémon are often witnessed rolling across fields of snow, which easily cling to their bodies made of solid ice. There are often signs warning Trainers of their presence due to how easy it can be for them to roll out of control.
author: infinex21
