entry: POKENAME are most commonly seen when migrating between the North Pole and South Pole. Any other areas where POKENAME stay for an extended period of time tend to experience their lowest recorded temperatures.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME are capable of creating violent blizzards when provoked, making them incredibly dangerous. They are highly sensitive to their environment, so when the winter season nears its end, they retreat back into the mountains.
author: mepp.

entry: This exceedingly rare Pokémon lives deep in the coldest of environments. The blue sheen of its icy body is coveted by collectors as a symbol of wealth and luck.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's vast psychic potential lets it create frozen projectiles through sheer force of mind. Those hit by these shards have an equal change of being rapidly frozen solid or dazed by psychic energies.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is so cold that not even the flames that burst free around its neck can melt it. It often creates a path of ice using its frigid breath and then launches itself with its flames to hurl itself into its opponents.
author: infinex21

entry: Though its body is entirely comprised of densely packed ice, POKENAME's wings remain powerful enough to allow it flight. Nocturnal and solitary by nature, sightings of this Pokémon are exceedingly rare.
author: theartemis1

entry: Though its body is entirely comprised of densely packed ice, POKENAME's wings remain powerful enough to allow it flight. Nocturnal and solitary by nature, sightings of this Pokémon are exceedingly rare.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME is often mistaken for an iceberg as it rarely moves. It excretes a thin film that turns any snow it touches straight to ice. Its skin is so tough that even an Ice Pick cannot pierce it.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME is often mistaken for an iceberg, as it rarely moves. It excretes a thin film that turns any snow it touches straight to ice. Looking into its many eyes causes your body temperature to drop drastically.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The flower on its back can freeze anything near it within seconds. When the aurora borealis starts, groups of POKENAME can be sighted resting below.
author: skymaster426

entry: If POKENAME is in the presence of large chunks of ice, the chunks will start being chipped away by an unknown source until it resembles letters. It's unclear if this is an intentional attempt at communication or not.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are very timid Pokémon that often remain underground, only surfacing to feed upon berries and to drink water which helps sustain their bodies of ice. They live in constant fear of their ice bodies being shattered or melted.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME can instantly freeze particles in the air and use these floating ice pieces to block opponents' attacks. Even when deep underground where pressure and heat are increased, it can freeze anything just as easily as it can on the surface.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's subzero, icy body doesn't so much as crack under underground high pressure and heat. Strange holes found going through glaciers and ice sheets are likely caused by POKENAME chomping through them.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can function while in its detached state, but reaches full potential when put together. Those that take the time to meticulously complete the complex process of building it will gain an eternally loyal and greatly powerful ally.
author: sk372

entry: Caves where POKENAME lives are filled with gorgeous ice sculptures that it carved itself. Groups of POKENAME can create sculptures up to 100 feet high.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME curiously has no visible organs other than a poison sac where its heart should be. The acid it produces can melt nearly any material, so any Trainer handling it must be extremely cautious.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can move at the speed of lightning. When on a straight path, it can accelerate nearly infinitely. Unfortunately, due to the low friction of its icy body, it can't take corners and will often come to an abrupt stop by hitting obstacles.
author: jadey.1557

entry: POKENAME's many feathers of solid ice glisten and shine with the colors of rainbows within them. Only a few of these feathers survive their fall, and those who find ones intact will be blessed with good fortune for a year.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are snowy tricksters that only live in areas constantly visited by snow or hail. Though not malicious, they will pelt any travelers in their sights with many snowballs until someone fires back.
author: infinex21

entry: Despite the flames, its body emanates a temperature near absolute zero. On contact, said flames sap heat even as its targets are turned to ash.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Wherever these Pokémon fly shall be graced with a gentle snowfall. They only appear during Winter and ensure that no city or town will be unvisited by at least one snowfall a year.
author: infinex21

entry: A Pokémon theorised to have first appeared during the Ice Age, POKENAME live atop glaciers in modern times and are formed of densely packed blue ice. They are so cold that hikers are advised to avoid them due to risk of hypothermia.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Should one come across a muddy pond completely frozen over, it's likely POKENAME is living within. It dislikes being pristine and rarely ventures far from its pond or a source of mud to smear on its icy body.
author: sk372

entry: Considered to be the harbinger of winter, POKENAME's very presence freezes lakes. A cold, lonely Pokémon, it is said whoever offers it a scarf becomes its Trainer.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME are ancient Pokémon that have lived for over a million years without the ice of their bodies ever melting. They only need to drink water to sustain themselves, and this same water will form new ice should any of their ice break off.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a beautifully clear ice that causes those who look into it to see their true selves. With the many eyes throughout its body, it can spot hostility the moment it arises and instantly freeze the source.
author: soup1900

entry: It is reported that, where POKENAME appears, an aurora can be seen. Though its body resembles iced over glass, it is stronger than most metals.
author: pepperthepirate

entry: A sentinel for an icy tomb made long ago. The shards around it can spin faster than modern rotors, eviscerating intruders.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: These Pokémon only seem to appear during snowstorms, and even then they are only recognizable by their bright, yellow eyes. Their manes of pure, flowing snow allow them to create illusions that lure prey into cold obscurity.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's entire body is made of solid ice yet there is also an abundance of water flowing within its hollow spaces. Despite how cold its body must be, it can swim safely through any water without freezing said water around itself.
author: infinex21

entry: The intense heat within it is barely contained. Occasionally, it must be vented, causing its normally freezing environment to become near tropical.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Only one POKENAME has ever been recorded as active, though many have been found dormant. It is theorized that if they all awakened at once, another ice age would occur.
author: bradlybro199

entry: It is said that its long, icy body allows it to fly through outer space in search of meteors to destroy, protecting the world from harm. To regenerate its frozen coils, it feeds on snow and ice to help them grow back.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME remains constantly frozen in solid ice, scientists theorize that it is using some form of time dilation to keep the particles together. If it were to thaw, the world may enter another ice age.
author: avidclown

entry: Said to have come from the coldest depths of space, POKENAME's body temperature is only barely above absolute zero. It will brutally snuff out any source of heat it can find with its icy powers.
author: mistymagius

entry: During its slumber, a POKENAME was mistaken for a large iceberg. Analysis of POKENAME's ice suggested that it predated the formation of the planet.
author: .crystallization

entry: It fills dreams with endless cold and biting winds. While active during a new moon, it lights the sky with auroras, even far south.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Although a POKENAME's body appears to be frozen solid, it is actually rather malleable and capable of moving with no difficulty. Trainers are advised to not touch them, for they are so cold that even mere seconds of contact could result in frostbite.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon is born from the grief-filled soul of a traveler who became lost in northern areas and their body became encased in a chunk of solid ice. They wander frozen plains to warn others to not succumb to the same fate as they once did.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's silk is made of small ice crystals, making it incredibly cold to the touch. It will often wrap uneaten prey in its silk to preserve them for a later meal.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's globe-like body is composed of ice that will never melt. Every snowflake it contains is a soul that has been consumed.
author: hereisanimations

entry: The flames POKENAME produces are silent and freezing cold. As a result, they do not cause its icy body to melt. It vanishes if anyone comes too close.
author: aurange

entry: POKENAME grow up inside of icebergs, breaking free only when their fire powers have grown strong enough to melt the iceberg. This ensures POKENAME is strong enough to survive.
author: bitterchemicalhaze

entry: Due to its internal body heat and Arctic cold exterior, POKENAME is constantly shrouded by fog. Movie studios and scientists fight over whether to use it in place of fog machines or to study weather patterns.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME can be seen flopping around in melted glaciers. Impurities and debris can be seen inside their crystalline structure.
author: .towerxvi

entry: Despite being made of solid ice, POKENAME's body is tougher than titanium. The gears can naturally spin with extreme speed but are forced to slow down in warmer areas to avoid overheating.
author: entomoxie

entry: If frightened, POKENAME will fire off the ice crystal ears it possesses to freeze its attacker and let itself hop away to safety. The dislodged ears will reform within a day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a unique ice that cannot be melted. It often appears to those lost in intense blizzards to guide them back to safety.
author: mepp.

entry: It barrels down icy mountains at incredible speeds. Many daredevil skiers have met unfortunate ends trying to outmaneuver them.
author: bostroms

entry: Hidden under this Pokémon's opaque ice exoskeleton lies one of the deadliest known poisons. POKENAME is no active threat to humans unless removed from its freezing habitat and moved to a warmer place, where it begins to melt and become active.
author: _pixelar_

entry: The surrounding ice has been brought to life via a freak accident in a lab. It can cause a blizzard on mountains for weeks with a single roar.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME gorge themselves upon large quantities of snow and ice together with various berries. Their snowy bodies often become stained with the juices of the berries they eat, causing them to bear various color combinations.
author: infinex21

entry: Schools of POKENAME float in arctic waters devouring anything in sight. The ice that makes up its body always stays sharp and is strong enough to shatter boulders.
author: mistymagius

entry: Deep in Sinnoh's snowy mountains, a POKENAME is rumored to guard a treasure. Few have attempted to find it, and fewer have returned.
author: coooooooookiee

entry: During the ice age, it was common to find this Pokémon flying through arctic areas, and it could produce sound waves capable of freezing anyone in the blink of an eye.
author: reipudim_35860

entry: The core of its body is made of dazzling quartz. Under a sunny day, it can focus the sunlight into itself to output potent beams of energy.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME's icy form is so cold that even a dip in magma was observed to have no effect on it. In fact, the reverse occurred, and the magma it was submerged in began to freeze.
author: sk372

entry: A genetic error in the fusion process corrupted the core of this Pokémon. It is paradoxically freezing and melting at the same time.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME utilizes its sound system to play chill and relaxing music. At max volume, the reverb could shatter the solid ice around it and easily send intruders packing.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon was first discovered after researchers followed a melody of icy winds into a deep arctic cave. Its body remains far below freezing; even touching its ice-like hair can cause near-instant frostbite.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME uses the pointed icicles on its front limbs to burrow its way deep into icebergs, hibernating much of the year. As it slumbers, the exterior of its frozen home grows mushrooms made of ice.
author: sk372

entry: The ice comprising POKENAME's body is so bright that looking at it for prolonged amount of times risks potential blindness. If its power grows too large, it dissipates its energy by firing freezing light beams in all directions.
author: sk372

entry: The heart of its shell is incredibly unstable, requiring temperatures near absolute zero to keep it from violently exploding. The light it gives off refracts off POKENAME's icy frame to make a wonderful display of brilliant colors.
author: mistymagius

entry: The first POKENAME specimen found was embedded deep in an arctic glacier. It is difficult to study, as it regularly freezes itself in a thick block of ice to protect itself from the outside world.
author: sk372

entry: The hollow hump of a POKENAME is said to be so cold inside that anything will be frozen solid should it fall within. When enraged, this hump erupts like a volcano that scatters snow instead of ash and rains chunks of ice instead of balls of fire.
author: infinex21

entry: Some believe POKENAME's origins lie somewhere on a distant, frozen planet in space. Its icy powers are strongest during the full moon, making it able to create a torrential blizzard with snow that glows an otherworldly color.
author: sk372

entry: Though its body is frigid to the touch, POKENAME's presence causes ice in its vicinity to quickly melt. POKENAME's body glows brightly during these moments, and notably becomes even colder.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often mistaken for ice sculptures within certain ruins that serve as their homes. They wield potent psychic powers that sustain their forms and repel invaders of their homes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME live in the frigid, nearly inaccessible waters below large icebergs. If it ever stops swimming, the sheer cold emanating from its body will freeze the water around it, and trap it inside.
author: fancyskunk

entry: A true hero, POKENAME can reform its body at will. It works with a team of nine other Pokémon, protecting the world with their powers.
author: ethewriter

entry: The thick ice that surrounds POKENAME's body is very durable. They are only found deep in icy caverns.
author: mepp.

entry: Although POKENAME's body temperature is below -100 degrees Celsius, the fire on its body burns continuously. This phenomenon has not yet been studied.
author: chorb33

entry: Though it is stuck within a large block of solid ice, POKENAME still functions normally and can interact with others via telekinesis. Examination of brainwaves suggests the Slowpoke does not even realize its predicament.
author: sk372

entry: It is unclear if POKENAME possesses an organ that can truly be entirely defined as a brain; it never moves unless it has been given orders, even if it is under attack. Its body repairs itself when it's cold enough for frost to cover the ground.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The composition of this Pokémon is similar to contaminant industrial refrigerants. When it loses pieces, they evaporate and damage the ozone layer.
author: epping_forest

entry: An ancient, life-threatening virus is contained within POKENAME's permafrost body. Its release would bring about catastrophic consequences.
author: tuneless.towa

entry: Legends of a Gengar sealed away in an ice casing have resurfaced recently. Some people believe POKENAME is the Pokémon the legend refers to.
author: 8xviktor

entry: A baneful Pokémon responsible for many icy pranks. Even if said pranks lead to great injury from slips or freezing, it cackles with great intensity.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: It constantly bashes its body against hard surfaces, trying to break free of its glacial shell. Life on the planet may be doomed if it ever succeeds.
author: tuneless.towa

entry: POKENAME were once considered a regional form of Onix. However, this changed when scientists discovered that its body has a completely different atomic structure.
author: prof.whitebeam

entry: POKENAME's frigid body is much denser than regular ice, allowing it to break through thick glaciers with its heavy pincers. During the summer, it sits idly on the sea floor, waiting for colder temperatures.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME wields what appears to be a strange, discarded limb of some sort. Sturdy and heavy, this makeshift weapon makes a highly efficient bludgeoning tool for self-defense.
author: sk372

entry: The metal shard POKENAME wields emits a blade of energy that lets it cut through almost any material. It can control it remotely as well, letting it be used as a boomerang that homes in on opponents before returning.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keeps to itself in the wild, preferring to avoid contact with others. If a predator attacks, it deploys a surprisingly powerful energy cannon from its cranium to defend itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's cocoon is made of a uniquely strong, malleable metal. After any attack, the dots on its face light up as it analyzes and adapts its body to better resist whatever is assaulting it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's metal vines are highly flexible yet extremely sturdy. It can detach them from its body after wrapping around a target, creating a steel net that's almost impossible to escape from.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME live deep underwater in the oceans of Hoenn far beyond the reach of the light of the surface, only their eyes and holographic fin visible in the dark. They are too heavy to move quickly, simply holding onto rocks and debris.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's mouth contains the capacity to fire quick and highly-accurate energy shots across long distances. It could snipe a foe with perfect accuracy from miles across the ocean.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are slow swimmers, their dense metal bodies preventing them from moving swiftly through the water. Despite their low speed, they are far from defenceless as they are able to gather power into blasts of pure energy.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly friendly Pokémon but because of its unsettling appearance most people fear and avoid it entirely.
author: blitzydragon

entry: The spikes on POKENAME have hallucinogenic properties. Touching one will severely disorientate its foe.
author: gengarfromfnaf

entry: POKENAME's pincers can be charged and powered up with its internal energy stores. At maximum charge, the pincers glow a bright crimson, and create shockwaves when they clamp down on a target.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon live within deep lakes, often slumbering without a need to eat. They will rampage for an entire day if disturbed from this slumber. Stories claim they will only truly awaken in response to ecological disasters.
author: infinex21

entry: Bare skin touching the freezing metal of its body sticks. The sounds POKENAME makes can damage modern technology and especially navigational systems, so it's prohibited along naval trade routes.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME's body absorbs latent electricity in the air, its mane crackling with power when fully charged. This mane can fire off dozens of electrified plasma needles a second when it needs to defend itself.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's specs are sophisticated enough to let it store and analyze massive quantities of data. Its size and power cause almost any computer it inhabits to lag greatly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's metal cocoon is so resilient that nothing has been recorded denting or scratching it. When all the dots on its face light up at once, it is ready to evolve.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fires flaming lasers from its fire-filled body through the holes on its chest. The flames burn dark red because of its evolution to be able to burn without oxygen, like inside of deep underground caves.
author: soup1900

entry: Once every few months, POKENAME will shed its metal skin. Faint bits of circuitry can be seen on the inside of the discarded skin, which flicker with lingering energy for a short time after shedding.
author: sk372

entry: The body of this artificial Pokémon, supposedly modeled after Mew, is made of an unknown material that can change its shape. Its red eyes are always flashing because it is always learning and adapting, even when its body is completely still.
author: infinex21

entry: This Pokémon's strange body is always in a state of flux, shifting between various shapes and consistencies as it scours the world. Anything it deems to be a threat shall be met with a powerful beam of energy let loose by its cannon.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME draw their energy directly from sunlight, the apparent leaf on their head actually being a solar panel. They are friendly and easy to raise, but are extremely heavy and have a habit of trying to jump on their Trainer's chest.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME have a flexible solar panel attached to their heads, using the panel to fuel their activities. They are placid Pokémon and will peaceably follow the sun to wherever it is brightest.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: First documented within Paldea's Area Zero, POKENAME can now be found in most industrial developments. They have a ring of diodes around their neck that store solar power, and a holographic leaf sprouting from their head that stores sunlight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: This fusion is extremely strong. It can bite with enough force to crush diamonds.
author: famerman2

entry: POKENAME were designed and deployed for the sole purpose of observation and the study of the world around them. They have minor weapon systems meant only to distract aggressors so that they may flee.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's poisonous serum doesn't act immediately, but it contains toxic metals like cadmium, lead, arsenic, and even polonium in well-fed and trained specimens. This serum was highly valued by ninjas.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME's technologically-advanced eyes let it see clearly through even the darkest elements. Its thorax can jettison a net made of strange energy to capture prey, the threads of which are nearly impossible to break.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was engineered for aerial warfare. It's capable of dropping supplies through a hatch. Luckily, they are mainly used to drop food to wild Pokémon.
author: germs2128

entry: POKENAME was originally believed to be an aquatic camera drone for an unknown organization. It can swim very fast while just barely moving its body.
author: kittyluv090

entry: A POKENAME can stand still for millennia at a time as it watches the future of planetary happenings. Ancient texts record civilizations that captured one of these Pokémon, but no force could compel it to share its insights.
author: soup1900

entry: A POKENAME can stand still for millennia at a time as it watches the future of planetary happenings. Ancient documents record civilizations that captured one of these Pokémon, but no force could compel it to share its insights.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is made of a tough, unidentified substance, but its skirt ripples fluidly while it dances gracefully. The seven dots on its head blink in patterns as it dances, which musicians theorize represent musical notes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's board is lightweight but sturdier than most known metals. POKENAME snowboards down mountains, never failing no matter how steep the slope, making this Pokémon all the more impressive.
author: jangodiot

entry: A deep, warbling bass emits from POKENAME at almost all times. If it travels through swampy areas, frog-like Pokémon tend to follow it as if hypnotized.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME keeps itself aloft using gravitational waves emitted from its arms. It dedicates most of its energy to keep the plant on its head in tip-top condition.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is a difficult pest to get rid of should it infest a household. Sensitive hearing lets it know when anything approaches it, and its tail fires off powerful energy beams at anything that comes close.
author: sk372

entry: Spinning the metal leaves on its head allows POKENAME to achieve short bursts of flight. It travels from flower patch to flower patch, soaking up pollen and sunlight in equal measures.
author: sk372

entry: The mind of this artificial Pokémon is theorized to be connected to the minds of many other artificial Pokémon with designs similar to it. As such, any models of POKENAME are carefully observed, even though they're always thinking rather than acting.
author: infinex21

entry: The ring of eyes circles around the center eye, each one scanning objects of interest before deciding on a course of action. Each of POKENAME's eyes can fire beams of strange psychic energy, showering foes with a relentless barrage.
author: sk372

entry: Ancient texts describe this artificial Pokémon as an ever-tunneling weapon that will tear through any obstacle as it digs. Supposedly, it has myriad weapons installed within its body, but none have dared approach it to determine if this is true.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME appears to prefer inhabiting deep underwater caves. If bothered, calamitous energy is unleashed from its body, channeled into an explosion.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's steel shell lets it hide away and resist nearly any type of attack that comes its way without a scratch. Inside the shell lies blades and other objects that let it turn berries into fresh juice in seconds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is made up of a burning-hot liquid metal, and is highly resistant to physical assaults. Elusive and surprisingly agile, most travelers only catch a fleeting glimpse of it before it oozes away.
author: sk372

entry: Due to the incompatibility of both Pokémon, this fusion is melted and struggles to move. It seems unbothered and continues to drag along its shell.
author: ohok3441

entry: Very few POKENAME have ever been sighted. These Pokémon fly about, propelled by the same energy that powers their precision weapons along their underbellies.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are found in ocean trenches, their eyes glowing in the pitch black ocean. They are a hazard for deep sea submarines due to their hyper-dense bodies, collisions between the slow moving Pokémon and unwary submersibles causing large dents.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live deep in ocean trenches, swimming slowly and relying on their steely skin to protect themselves from harm. They can fire projectiles from their mouths at high speed, using them to attack other deep sea Pokémon.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can move nearly as fast as lightning. However, it is not very coordinated and can run into things while doing so.
author: famerman2

entry: These Pokémon are always traveling to and from bodies of water across the world. They use their feelers to analyze the purity of the waters and will take action to cleanse these waters if they detect hazardous materials within.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon produced by Silph Co. and are marketed as the perfect partner to protect Trainers preparing to brave Mt. Silver. They are prohibitively expensive for all but the most successful Trainers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The smooth and flexible metal of POKENAME's body lets it slice through the air and sea with uncanny speed and maneuverability. Turbines within its body let it generate massive gale-force winds from its mouth.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is able to forge seven unique metals by applying its sacred flames onto common ores. When these seven metals are alloyed together, it creates a shining, rainbow material that supposedly is eternally indestructible.
author: soup1900

entry: The time portals POKENAME creates are extremely pressurized, distorting and crushing anything that attempts to go through. Yet, POKENAME's strange metal somehow reverses these effects, healing all damage done instead.
author: soup1900

entry: A flying unit intended for apprehension. It can output massive amounts of electricity through its hands to completely paralyze even massive entities.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: At a glance, the bodies of these Pokémon appear to be covered in a tangled mess of various cables and cords. But, upon closer inspection, researchers learned that they are tendrils made of an unknown material that protect the core of POKENAME.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME exhibit strange magnetic properties. Because it has no mouth, it instead eats metal by absorbing it with the ferrofluid on its back.
author: grassy311

entry: Years of living deep within jungles have honed this Pokémon's body into a form fitting of an apex jungle predator. The energy that surges from its tail helps to propel it forth at great speeds, while the energy blades on its arms slice through foes.
author: infinex21

entry: It has a strong magnetic field. Any metal object that comes into contact with the ferrofluid on its back is quickly engulfed.
author: grassy311

entry: POKENAME's steel body is tempered to perfection by years of enduring its own fire. Its superheated legs unleash jet-like roars as it propels itself over cities or crushes opponents.
author: h0bojoe

entry: The gown that adorns a POKENAME, despite flowing like cloth, is said to be composed of a wondrous material far more durable and flexible than any kind of metal. Legends suggest that their true power is only revealed to those they deem worthy.
author: thatlittletwerp

entry: These Pokémon are able to generate a mysterious energy within themselves that they can release as condensed blasts or shape into weapons. They only engage opponents they deem worthy of the effort or those who threaten the defenseless.
author: infinex21

entry: Built only for war, POKENAME boast unfettered, callous strength. The vermillion glow of POKENAME's eyes can cut through the fog like two sabres.
author: rooboid

entry: It is estimated that POKENAME have been trundling across the seafloor for thousands of years. They obliterate obstacles in their path by anchoring themselves with their four legs and swinging their heads with tremendous force.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: POKENAME's appearance is the basis of many robotic creatures in fiction. An attempt to train POKENAME to star in its own film resulted in massive property damage. Thankfully, the carnage was highly entertaining to audiences.
author: bukie

entry: These Pokémon are usually found in a state of hibernation. When they awaken, it is often for a short time because they will use most of their energy to pulverize misshapen terrain with a single punch.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME was created by scientists to become a new indestructible, powerful weapon. Thanks to its cybernetic weaponry, POKENAME can defeat any enemy.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: POKENAME was created by scientists to become a new indestructible, powerful weapon. Thanks to its cybernetic weaponry, POKENAME can defeat any enemy.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: This cunning, bionic Pokémon was created to move quickly. It deals decisive blows by using illusions to lure opponents, then counterattacking.
author: the1trugamr_72590

entry: POKENAME's many red eyes glow as they wander deep underwater, almost as if they're searching for something. Theories include them searching for food or even ancient underwater cities.
author: mepp.

entry: A mechanical serpent built by an ancient civilization. Though originally created to protect them, it went rogue and became their destroyer.
author: theeggoverlord

entry: It burrows through earth at frightening speeds despite its massive size. While Rayquaza guards the skies, POKENAME guards the planet from below.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME are encased in exceptionally dense steel armor. They use their temporal abilities to rapidly reverse damage, making them highly durable opponents to face.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are encased in exceptionally dense steel armor. They use their temporal abilities to rapidly reverse damage, making them highly durable opponents to face.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The metal that makes up POKENAME's body is liquid at room temperature. Those engulfed by its swooping form have no hope of breathing again.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is the result of scientists overestimating their fusion capabilities. It rusts faster than normal metal and wanders around abandoned temples.
author: patch_bros

entry: Due to humans using POKENAME's metal, its defenses got weaker, and soon rust formed. It tries to rebuild itself but it knows it's a waste of energy.
author: gun2._

entry: The cannon upon a POKENAME's back is capable of rapidly releasing multiple projectiles of pure energy that quickly eradicate any potential threats. Thankfully, it very rarely labels anything else as a threat worthy of firing upon.
author: infinex21

entry: The fire produced by POKENAME is hot enough to melt steel. Though its body is hypothesized to be made of it, the structures that make up POKENAME's body remain solid nonetheless.
author: nyoomymph

entry: Its boosters allow POKENAME to fly through the air with its massive steel body as if it were a cutting-edge aircraft. Its cooling system activates instantly to keep its vital organs stable, releasing a freezing mist around it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its boosters allow POKENAME to fly through the air with its massive steel body as if it were a cutting-edge aircraft. Its cooling system activates instantly to keep its vital organs stable, releasing a freezing mist around it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Capable of transporting people across long distances, it was thought that POKENAME would be considered the flying car of the future. Due to a malfunction in its systems, however, it very seldom takes people to their desired location.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME were engineered to serve as street performers for the masses, though especially for children. The long arms upon their head are often seen juggling objects or helping them to perform outlandish acrobatic maneuvers.
author: infinex21

entry: Wherever POKENAME wanders, strange metal mushrooms grow. It strikes foes with its iron fists with the same skill as professional boxers.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME are machines made for nothing but slaughter and destruction. It is a crime to merely own one in most regions after what happened in the war.
author: gurguro

entry: POKENAME can be found guarding high-tech facilities, incinerating any intruders with high-powered laser beams. After using its lasers, however, it has to rest for a few minutes to prevent its body from overheating.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its durable metallic body prevents this Pokémon from feeling pain. As a consequence, physical fights between its two heads can remain unresolved for weeks.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME's core generates almost limitless energy to fuel the destructive beams of light it can fire from all three of its heads. It shows a particularly strong enmity towards Dragon types.
author: sk372

entry: A metallic dragon with monstrous power, POKENAME's three heads fire beams of energy capable of dispatching most any foe. Combining all three beams together could atomize a mountain in one shot.
author: sk372

entry: These artificial Pokémon were designed to be stealth units with the shared goal of observation of other life. When a POKENAME feels threatened, it is able to wrap reality around itself and render itself invisible for a period of time.
author: infinex21

entry: When necessary POKENAME can travel at the speed of sound. They also have extraordinary tracking abilities, like being able to detect a joltik on the ground, while traveling in the exosphere.
author: bradlybro199

entry: These artificial Pokémon were designed to be stealth units with the shared goal of studying the emotions of living beings. Many POKENAME have gone rogue as they learn what it means to feel rather than just think and will strive to live with others.
author: infinex21

entry: Its metal shifts and adapts with the ease of water. POKENAME is an extremely versatile metallic being that is able to hunt down and exterminate any foe.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: This anomalous Pokémon's seemingly-metal arms are able to stretch, shrink, and/or grow however it desires. The pattern of red dots on its head flicker and glow as if it is actively trying to communicate.
author: infinex21

entry: The visual display on POKENAME's front changes expression to fit its moods. What look to be ears are actually speakers that allow it to emit its potent lullaby across vast distances.
author: sk372

entry: It sings with a seemingly digitally synthesized melodic voice. Those who hear this singing are quickly put to sleep.
author: hophoppip

entry: Almost indistinguishable from a technologically advanced drone, POKENAME can often be seen buzzing through the air delivering parcels from Poké Marts. It seems to relish in this particular activity.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Its fluid is similar to mercury. Trainers should limit physical contact with POKENAME until the fluid is confirmed to be safe by scientists.
author: cait_sith

entry: POKENAME is a spiky metal seed that seems to have come from space. Scientists attempting to analyze it have found no way to get through the shell, which is made of some unknown mineral.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME have only ever been spotted in packs with one another in the wild. They're known for ravaging through metallic objects and destroying important machinery.
author: espresso_shotz

entry: POKENAME is shockingly agile for its weight. It can accurately fire beams out of its cannon even at high speeds.
author: famerman2

entry: In spite of its slight stature, POKENAME weighs more than ten tons and can withstand pressures equivalent to that of being in the deepest parts of the ocean. As such, its inner workings have remained a mystery for even the greatest professors.
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813

entry: POKENAME absorbs toxic gases from the environment using its high-tech leaves. It uses these toxins as a power source and stores any excess to use as potent attacks.
author: odditylad

entry: POKENAME were engineered as aerial assault units capable of emitting sonic attacks that disrupt enemy machinery. While the enemy reels from their sonic attack, they will swoop down and swing their tail like a wrecking ball upon them.
author: infinex21

entry: The unknown, malleable material of these Pokémon oozes and drips from their bodies as they wander in search of companions. The drippings of their bodies eventually return to them after a few hours, even though they have already wandered far away.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME form within abandoned construction sites within the foundations of buildings that were never completed. Rebar threads its way through the concrete and gives form to the new Pokémon. They wander in search of purpose.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When a POKENAME detects a threat, the antennae atop its head will emit a shrill noise that alerts nearby Pokémon. Its hollow shell is able to house enough supplies to allow many young Pokémon to survive for days within its shelter.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon that survey northern lands with climates too cold for humans to properly survive. Their task is to monitor the state of massive glaciers should any melt and/or break apart.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon tasked with preventing massive glaciers from breaking apart. Should any massive glaciers begin to break, nearby Regiaura will alert the nearest POKENAME to come secure the pieces and freeze them back together.
author: infinex21

entry: A strong and resilient fusion often used to defend the homes of wealthy Trainers. With the help of its cybernetic eyes and tail, no one can escape it.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: Instead of singing, POKENAME makes electronic music and tones. It communicates best with other machine Pokémon.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME utilizes its sound system to play heavy metal music. At max volume, the reverb could shatter solid metal structures around it and easily send intruders packing.
author: sk372

entry: In battle, POKENAME sends off powerful soundwaves from its speakers. In dire situations, it'll throw those speakers at threats instead.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's claws can open up to fire out beams of searing light that burn away the terrain and leave it seemingly barren. Some time later, strange metallic mushrooms will begin to grow in the seared spots.
author: sk372

entry: This artificial Pokémon is clad in various disc-like drones that it can control without having to move much, if at all. These drones can fire precise energy blasts or project expansive shields, which make POKENAME a dangerous foe to ever face.
author: infinex21

entry: These strange Pokémon dwell in deep caverns, emitting lights from the red portions of their bodies that scan all around them. When they find something interesting, their ears will perk up and they will emit a short, shrill noise before going dormant.
author: infinex21

entry: The shield of POKENAME is tougher than diamonds. Due to its heroic nature, POKENAME uses its shield to protect civilians from harm during natural disasters.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME is an anomalous, mechanical Pokémon capable of wielding mystical powers. The tip of its wand is a mass of unknown material that can take any number of forms for the sake of an unknown mission.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME appear to be cybernetic Pokémon with the mechanical portions of their bodies made of an unknown, malleable material. For a yet-unknown reason, they often can be found gathering and leading groups of Regiggy.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME bear a satellite dish atop their heads, which transmit data signals about local weather phenomena. The dishes are also prone to filling with rain water and POKENAME will inevitably engage in a frantic "dance" to rid themselves of this water.
author: infinex21

entry: The strange material of a POKENAME's body is harder than diamonds and yet is extremely malleable as well. These strange Pokémon are typically found within deep caverns using their lower body as a laser emitter to mine for various materials.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are orbital observers that were deployed with the mission to analyze weather phenomena. It took less than a year before they had to be recalibrated to only analyze natural weather phenomena.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's tough metal body makes it nearly impervious to outside attacks, but it still suffers painful headaches. When the migraines intensify, its head emits a strange pulsing energy.
author: sk372

entry: These adorable, mechanical Pokémon were once mass-produced and deployed to entertain people across the globe. A production error resulted in them having no sense of balance and so they would trip over themselves so often they fell into disrepair.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's cannon is powered by energy it gains from absorbing and storing moonlight. When the full moon is out, it can maximize its output and fire a tremendous beam of light thrice its own size.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME basks in sunlight often, and appears to derive much of its energy from solar power. At maximum force, it can generate concentrated fire from its sides that can liquefy solid steel in seconds.
author: sk372

entry: Highly intelligent and calculating, POKENAME formulates battle tactics in fractions of a second. Psychic power fuels the gem on its forehead, which can release a searing beam of hot energy that can cut through seemingly any material.
author: sk372

entry: These artificial Pokémon can often be found scouring ancient mechanical ruins and abandoned facilities. Their exact purpose is unknown, but they will fire weak lasers from their chest if they detect a threat.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME were designed to serve as custodians and guardians for their ancient creators. As such, they are found within special ruins and their arms can transform into laser cannons capable of dispatching most threats.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a uniquely malleable metal. When the weather conditions turn harsh, the metal shifts into new forms to adapt, and uses the elements around it to fuel its combat maneuvers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon tasked with maintaining peace within cities and with broadcasting important news to the city's inhabitants. Their only "weapon" is a speaker that can reach pitches so high it could even render a Loudred unconscious.
author: infinex21

entry: The metal that makes up its body is tougher than titanium, giving rise to the belief that POKENAME is indestructible. If it flies for too many days in a row without resting, it risks overheating and losing control of its own actions.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME keeps itself moistened with pond water, as its metallic body functions less optimally when dried out. The large red orbs are able to scan 360 degrees to survey its surroundings.
author: sk372

entry: This variant of POKENAME appears to have poorer senses of vision and hearing than others. Its speed in the water has increased, however, as has the energy output from the orbs on its torso.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME travels around mountainous regions, it stops regularly to grip and analyze various stones. Very few rocks seem to pass its scrutiny, though it is still unknown what criteria it is searching for.
author: sk372

entry: The large amount of engines attached to POKENAME's body let it dash around at blindingly fast speeds. At max velocity, POKENAME could potentially circumnavigate the whole world in less than a day.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's tail contains a large energy cannon that possesses enough force to decimate the landscape. However, POKENAME has forgotten it has that capacity, and rarely creates anything more than a simple beam of illuminating light.
author: sk372

entry: When idle, POKENAME generates a strange type of energy from the tip of its tail. Its nature is unknown, as POKENAME immediately tucks its tail into its body when it senses another nearby.
author: sk372

entry: The large tail of a POKENAME is said to contain potentially-infinite information that could bring enlightenment to all. Unfortunately, it is either completely unaware of this or has completely forgotten about it and instead lazes about all day.
author: infinex21

entry: Wherever POKENAME treads, machinery corrodes and metals rust. Its metal core, despite being covered in rust and decay, is unable to be scratched by any attack.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME charges and fires powerful lasers that can melt through solid rock. It doesn't need to breathe, so it can thrive in water or on land. It is said that there is a secret hidden somewhere on its body.
author: leonian1586

entry: Many people have spotted the similarities between POKENAME and a folktale creature described as a Gengar confined to a steel construct.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Its slender and dexterous limbs are contrasted by its absurd, unwieldy claw, which could easily crush itself.
author: bukie

entry: The seed on its back has blossomed into a large red flower, from whose center it can release various kinds of spores. It has the ability to emit a floral aroma so sweet that it makes opposing Pokémon lose the will to fight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's three heads each control an aspect of the flower's defense functions. Depending on which one is in control, the pollen spread can heal, harm, or immobilize those afflicted by it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME smears nectar on its bone helmet to create flower patterns that match the flora from the area it hatched in. It is wary of meeting new people and Pokémon, but warms up quickly if given flowers.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME single-mindedly defends its egg clutch nearly to starvation, but its flower emits a pollen that attracts small prey. When its offspring hatch, it teaches them how to fashion weapons from their surroundings and fight effectively.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME single-mindedly defends its egg clutch nearly to starvation, but its flower emits a pollen that attracts small prey. When its offspring hatch, it teaches them how to fashion weapons from their surroundings and fight effectively.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME single-mindedly defends its egg clutch nearly to starvation, but its flower emits a pollen that attracts small prey. When its offspring hatch, it teaches them how to fashion weapons from their surroundings and fight effectively.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME generates a rank haze which drives away pests that would feed on its flowers. Gardeners craft a compost mixture designed by a Celadon City florist that coaxes it to live on their grounds and adds a fertilizing aspect to the haze.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is rarely predated upon as it is camouflaged by the flower from above and its coloration warns aquatic predators of its poisonous flesh. It is favored by wealthy aquarium hobbyists due to its beauty and calmness.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It can spread a paralyzing toxic powder from its wings to stun anything it flies over. POKENAME does this in order to ensure it has no competition in finding the sweetest honey and nectar to gorge upon.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME likes to disguise itself as the flower of a swamp plants. Anyone approaching it is bombarded with highly toxic pollen before it flees.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME floats on the surface of bogs. It emits a sweet scent to attract bug Pokémon, which it then paralyzes using pollen.
author: chorb33

entry: From above, POKENAME mimics the appearance of a flower, protecting it from aerial threats. It normally keeps its venomous head spike retracted into the center of the flower, extending it only when needed for protection.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While looking like a regular flower, POKENAME's body is both incredibly sticky and poisonous. Touching it will cause dangerously severe skin irritation that can last over a month.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME burrows into the forest floor so only the flower remains exposed. It excretes a sweet honey-like nectar from the flower, which dwindles in quantity as it nears emerging from its shell.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME has a large flower that has taken over its shell. It scuttles in jungles where the flower makes for great camouflage.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In its two stone-like blades lay dozens of tiny seeds that burrow into wounds they cause. If left untreated, the seeds slowly kill their new host.
author: spookoftheoldways

entry: Living in tropical waterways, POKENAME uses mangrove roots as cover to ambush prey, slashing them with its scythe-like claws to drain their fluids.
author: ansleehariot

entry: The scent given off by this Pokémon is pungent. It causes some Pokémon and humans to faint when it walks by.
author: theheroict

entry: POKENAME seeks rank-smelling flowers to collect nectar and return to its putrid-scented hive. When it encounters a threat too dangerous to jab with its arm petals, it opens its abdomen to unleash its entire payload of toxic spores on the foe.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME produce fairly ordinary pollen most of the time. However, during nights with bright starlight, the pollen tends to shine like the stars above. While beautiful, this pollen is dangerous to most Pokémon.
author: entomoxie

entry: The flower atop POKENAME's back provides it with nutrients. It gets the rest of its energy by hunting smaller Pokémon attracted by the flower.
author: ohok3441

entry: The smaller limbs of POKENAME are aren't used for walking. Instead, they're used for grabbing prey and holding onto the sides of trees.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's flower flashes brightly when it expels a cloud of pollen underwater in self-defense. Those that aren't blinded by the light itself will likely still be blinded from contact with the pollen left behind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies at high speed and low altitude to spread its spores. These paralyze the insects that will make up its meal.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: POKENAME assuages the pain of physical therapy by releasing pollen that numbs pain. It works alongside medical staff to ensure the pollen is given at the right dose to facilitate healing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in lush jungles, moving through the canopy in the mornings and settling in place during the day. The large flowers on their heads draw in bug Pokémon from great distances.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A frequent sight around Celadon City, POKENAME scavenges for plant clippings for sustenance. When it curls up to nap in a sunny spot, it is indistinguishable from a normal flower.
author: pjporwoll

entry: These Pokémon move by hopping about and with every hop, they release puffs of yellow spores from the flowers atop their heads. This pollen is rich with nutrients, which help fields and farms to grow lush.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sway their long-necked heads around as they walk, scattering clouds of thick, yellow pollen around them. This pollen is nutrient-rich from the sunlight they absorb and feels warm to the touch.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is adapted to cold waters but is unable to sense temperature. The flowers on its cheeks begin to emit a pungent smell if they get too warm, causing other Pokémon to chase them away. Oddly, this reaction helps it stay in cooler areas.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The seed on POKENAME's back has matured into a grand crimson bloom that releases clouds of potent spores. Its sweet fragrance is said to calm even the fiercest Pokémon, draining their will to battle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME bury themselves up to their flower in soil during the day, sleeping in sunny patches of the jungle whilst they warm themselves. At night they dig themselves out and gather together to socialise with one another.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: A POKENAME has a lot of trouble seeing where it is going after the flower on its face blooms. It bumps into trees constantly, leaving behind pollen.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lures people in with the beautiful appearance of its flower cap before releasing a burst of allergenic pollen into their face.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: Due to its short stature most food it covets is out of reach, but it has a trick up its sleeve. By sucking air into the large flower on its head, the petals puff up like balloons and it floats away; hopefully towards snacks.
author: gerbopotato

entry: POKENAME can store the poisonous powder of its flower in its strong claws. This way, it can grab the heads of its enemies and make sure not even a single particle of that poison is left unbreathed.
author: epping_forest

entry: Its molten body gives off a pungent sulfurous odor. Despite being as hot as lava, recent studies have found that it shares many characteristics with plants.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME sits coiled near large trees, hoping to lure in bug Pokémon with its large flower. Pollinators like Butterfree and Beedrill can keep POKENAME sated for several days.
author: chibitales

entry: As POKENAME spins, a swirling cloud of irritating pollen gets in foes' eyes, leaving them defenseless against the incoming onslaught of spin-kicks.
author: wigglypon

entry: When threatened, it releases an incredibly odorous musk. The arms on its sides are vestigial, and have no real strength.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are astute experts at healing Grass-type Pokémon and are always willing to help others. They are gentle with Pokémon they take care of and are known to chastise Trainers who try to interfere with their work.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The large feathers upon the heads of these Pokémon are often mistaken for a large flower when they are resting. They are trailed by plumes of harmless, yellow pollen as they fly through the sky.
author: infinex21

entry: As it soars over farmlands, POKENAME scatters toxic powder from the bloom on its head, preventing crops from sprouting. With its vengeful and maleficent nature, it devastates harvests near its domain.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are shy and usually stay away from humans. Its tongue can sense whether something is poisoned or not, so it's used by many detectives.
author: imagine1.

entry: The wings on POKENAME are mostly used for gliding around the forest. It may seem violent, but it only feeds on photosynthesis.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME release peculiar spores that shut down anything electronic within seconds of contact. Those spores seem to be harmless to humans and Pokémon.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME wanders the jungles growing fungi. Its secretions act as a great fertilizer for said fungi, but they are incredibly toxic to plants, people, and other Pokémon.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: This Pokémon protects itself by releasing a noxious pollen that gives people a splitting headache. The pollen has been discovered to be extremely flammable if hit by a spark.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME brings forth blooming flowers that guide lost travelers with their vibrant glow. It is a beacon of life in the heart of the underground.
author: anarchaz

entry: When under attack, POKENAME releases various spores into the air to blind its foe before stabbing them with their thorns. After it calms down, Trainers collect its pollen to strengthen their Antidotes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME bury themselves up to their flower in soil during the day, sleeping in sunny patches of the jungle whilst they warm themselves. At night they dig themselves out and gather together to socialise with one another.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME often lay flat in clearings within jungles and forests, which is why they often develop a layer of moss upon their bodies. They will fervently defend their territories with noxious pollen and their remarkable strength.
author: infinex21

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME would ravage villages. Seeing one during the day signified an ambush in the near future.
author: codewolfie

entry: POKENAME have evolved to fill the same ecological niche as Venusaur, leading many to compare the two. Having evolved in Sinnoh, POKENAME has far fewer poisonous Grass type Pokémon to compete with and so developed a Ground type instead.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hides beneath the large petals of its flowers to disguise itself from its prey. POKENAME emits paralyzing spores from its petals to hunt.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: The flame of its flower is kept alive by enormous amounts of pollen. Anyone burnt by these flames will be plagued with lifelong allergies.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: This staff emits a clouds of yellow pollen that is so potent it can cause paralysis.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Deep in the jungle, dozens upon dozens of interlocking POKENAME will work together like an organic factory and produce smothering clouds of pollen. Once an area is overrun by their flowers, they break apart and move elsewhere.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME's pollen contains hallucinogenic properties, allowing it to appear to Trainers inhaling it as a person, trusted Pokémon, or plant native to the area. If discovered, POKENAME disappears in a cloud of yellow pollen.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The large flowers on its body emit a calming aroma that pacifies anyone that comes near.
author: melodydelune

entry: It is said to appear during dark nights after rain. Its cloying pollen can put people and Pokémon to sleep instantly.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME can release electrically charged pollen, stunning nearby Pokémon. It leeches off of these stunned Pokémon to recharge when low on energy.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can release electrically charged pollen, stunning nearby Pokémon. It leeches off of these stunned Pokémon to recharge when low on energy.
author: entomoxie

entry: Its feathers are saturated with toxic, stinging pollen. When agitated, it flaps its wings and chokes its surroundings with its suffocating powder.
author: staghorn

entry: When POKENAME swim, they look like huge flowers floating on top of a river. They build dams as their nests and adorn them with thorny and poisonous vegetation for defense. POKENAME are very friendly, but their pollen is extremely allergic.
author: milchik

entry: The fire burning within its core invigorates the plant-life on its body. A well-cared for POKENAME will have larger flowers atop their heads.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME is capable of opening and closing its face flowers on command. Doing this makes them emit a very pungent smell.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: POKENAME twirls through moonlit groves in near silence, each step stirring the air with a ghostly grace. Audiences often forget to applaud, too mesmerized to do anything but watch.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Some businesses will outright deny services to a Trainer who owns a POKENAME, even if its Pokéball is sealed. This Pokémon releases a stench so foul it can make smaller surrounding Pokémon pass out.
author: jangodiot

entry: Despite drawing energy from the sun through its flowery "hat", it prefers to keep the rest of its body submerged in mud or water to keep cool and wet.
author: bukie

entry: A large flower Pokémon overgrown with petals. It can barely move, but uses pollen to lure Pokémon in to care for it.
author: theheroict

entry: The petals on POKENAME can fall off to reveal a beetroot-like core. The more rings it has, the more hydrated it is, making it a useful indicator in dry regions.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME often wield dark powers to locate targets at night with incredible accuracy. They have a violent rivalry with Onpunny.
author: cronicpoet

entry: POKENAME tend to roam deserts at night, assaulting Pokémon they come across. They have a violent rivalry with Onpunny.
author: cronicpoet

entry: POKENAME produces a weird scent to trick Vileplume into thinking it's one of them. At midnight, when the Vileplume sleep, it will eat the weakest.
author: ._term.

entry: The flowers on POKENAME's head release a terrible odor that keeps predators away. These flowers are often used in traditional medicines to alleviate colds and aches.
author: mepp.

entry: It captivates unassuming Pokémon with its deceitful melody. Using its pollen, it hypnotizes and forces the Pokémon to mindlessly gather food for it.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME lives in forest tunnels, clinging to the ceilings with its flower exposed. It sprays yellow acid at anything that wanders into its den.
author: .izik

entry: Large groups of POKENAME inhabit forest tunnels, releasing Pinap Berry scents. They coordinate acidic torrents from the walls to overwhelm prey.
author: .izik

entry: The flower on POKENAME's head is filled with Stun Spore, which it can release at blinding speed to stun opponents. It is very loyal to its Trainer and emits a pungent aroma around those it likes.
author: duskit___

entry: POKENAME are a nightmare for janitors and custodians everywhere because of the amount of pollen they release. They often violently sneeze with enough force to cause headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite POKENAME's smiling face, it is seething with rage on the inside. When it is especially angry, POKENAME will begin spreading poisonous pollen. This pollen also triggers POKENAME's allergies, which serves to make it even angrier.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME always keeps its flower on the water's surface as it swims, absorbing sunlight that shines down on the water. If touched, the flower sprays a mist-like pungent pollen to deter predators.
author: sk372

entry: The petals on its head protect it from the sun as if they were a kind of hat. If the Pokémon around it are too noisy, POKENAME releases sleep-inducing spores to make them fall asleep, and to go back to sleep itself.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME is threatened, it releases debilitating pollen that induces amnesia. A solitary Pokémon, it spends its day meditating to hone its psychic powers.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME sprout roots from their body and connect to each other to form an underground network. During spring, they coordinate to release the pollen from their flowers to maximize the chances of pollination.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wild POKENAME release a strong aroma from the leaf over their mouths to attract prey. These leaves have been used to make a kind of herbal tea that helps treat indigestion and constipation.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME emits a powerful scent that predator Pokémon interpret as injured prey. Once these Pokémon come near to find the injured Pokémon, POKENAME ambushes them with virulent poison.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME releases a viscous gel that sticks onto other fish Pokémon. The gel slowly eats away at scales and bones, turning other Pokémon into a soft meal for it to eat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love frolicking in flower fields, emitting a lovely floral scent as they skip around. Their scent depends on the type of flowers they eat and is commonly used in various perfumes.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME is not only popular for races through swampy areas, but also for its sweet smell that's commonly used to help the growth of vegetables, fruits and flowers. Farmers often use it to help grow their crops.
author: imagine1.

entry: This unnatural variant of POKENAME is a result of heavy selective breeding for pageantry competitions. Intensity of flame, coloration of petals, and overall speed are some of the traits evaluated during judging.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME uses its pollen to shoot bubbles filled with it. If one of these bubbles explodes, it will release a highly toxic powder that can cause paralysis.
author: 0reomilka

entry: POKENAME's two heads prefer different times of the day to photosynthesize, one absorbing sunlight while the other sleeps. The right head is usually the strongest since its large flower deprives the other head of valuable sunlight.
author: mistymagius

entry: The flower on POKENAME's head can survive only in icy environments, so it never leaves the frozen caves or cold waters it inhabits. It naturally releases highly fragrant aromas that are prized on the market.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The bivalve Pokémon releases a viscous sap from where the shells meet together. This enables a POKENAME to slam its shell shut without damaging the internal organs, making it hard to pierce through.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They rarely open their flower-like shell other than to snatch prey and, or, to eat. When they open, they release a plume of toxic pollen that many say is numbingly cold.
author: infinex21

entry: A Pokémon with a pleasant scent. It happily floats around spreading joy with the pleasant fragrant. It's very popular as a result.
author: theheroict

entry: A protector of the deep forest, POKENAME attacks wrongdoers with hypnotic spores. It bestows rare medicinal herbs to the well-intentioned.
author: noel5229

entry: With POKENAME always exploding at the slightest touch, it has a hard time containing its light energy. The amount of light energy it has collected can be visibly seen from inside the transparent dome that's the upper half of its body.
author: soup1900

entry: Long ago, a Necrozma absorbed an Electrode, creating POKENAME. Its upper hemisphere is light energy, while the lower hemisphere is dark energy.
author: planatical

entry: POKENAME generates large amounts of kinetic energy when it runs. Reports of POKENAME encounters claim it can reach speeds of roughly 200 kilometres an hour, enough to power an entire city for two weeks.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: In a strange twist of fate, This Magikarp was chosen by Necrozma as a vessel for transportation in water. Dark crystals grew out from where its fins used to be, becoming terrible claws.
author: qecci

entry: Its search for light has led this Pokémon onto land. Although it's quite literally a fish out of water, POKENAME will stop at nothing to find this energy.
author: aberry8286

entry: POKENAME's roar can tear open Ultra Wormholes, through which it will enter in search of more food, which is light itself. Those who ever find themselves within such a Wormhole may likely witness POKENAME seemingly "swimming" within.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's eyes are sensitive to light. Its helmet shields its eyes from sunlight by absorbing it, but it also obscures its vision.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME burn with an unearthly fire that is fuelled by strange crystals laced throughout their body. Pokémon Researchers have determined from the lattice structures of these crystals that they originate from Ultra Space.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME burn with an unearthly fire that is fuelled by strange crystals laced throughout their body. The flame from these crystals produces a strange kaleidoscopic fire, its elemental composition appearing to shift erratically.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's crystalline body refracts light to form a beautiful aura around it. Don't let this marvelous sight distract you, however, for POKENAME is quite hostile.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME travels around the world searching for a challenge, following the sunrise as it passes over the various regions. It uses the light of the rising sun to recover before its next bout.
author: elibromax314

entry: Its armor was built to harness solar power, but failed. Instead, it travels to power plants, absorbing large quantities of man-made light.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME absorbs and stores photoenergy within the fissures on its body and releases it upon prey. The resulting flash can instantly blind humans and Pokémon alike.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME only emerges at night when the stars are shining brightly. Without the power of starlight, it's weak and timid.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's abdomen shimmers with beautiful rainbow iridescence. It uses this display to impress stronger Pokémon in hopes that they'll protect it from harm.
author: hophoppip

entry: Myriad colored lights swirl around in the crystalline organ located in the abdomen of these Bug Pokémon. Many trainers favor them as mood lights or as night lights for children.
author: infinex21

entry: The tips of a POKENAME's legs are crystals that flicker with various colors when exposed to any source of light. The colors of their eyes change depending on their mood. Artists and clothing designers love them for their color-shifting silk webbing.
author: infinex21

entry: Light sources fuel POKENAME's body, giving it the energy to hop around and produce beams from its small wings. When darkness falls, it grows too weak for its small legs to hold its body up.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME will primarily use the bulb on its tail to send powerful light signals. If it steals enough light from other sources, its tail becomes blinding, visible from across the world.
author: antler_zero_

entry: POKENAME drift through the air on whorls and eddies of power originating from Ultra Space, using micro-portals to generate lift and thrust. They spend their time searching for tiny crystal fragments that they attempt to fit into their bodies.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The prisms lodged in the bodies of POKENAME capture and refract light within their matrices. The structure of these crystals isn't fully understood, but they have been demonstrated to bear a remarkable similarity to that of Z-Crystals from Alola.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME keeps itself airborne by firing lasers at the ground, the colour depending on its mood. As it grows angry, the beams shift toward red and gain enough energy to damage objects, even setting them on fire.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The prisms lodged in the bodies of POKENAME capture and refract light within their matrices. The structure of these crystals isn't fully understood, but they have been demonstrated to bear a remarkable similarity to that of Z-Crystals from Alola.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME keeps itself airborne by firing lasers at the ground, their colour depending on its mood. When it becomes upset, the beams shift toward violet and have often been mistaken for UFO lights.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME absorbs light energy from treetops by day. At night, it turns feral, shredding prey with its three giant claws.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME uses power from the sun to create beams of light to obliterate opponents. However, it typically doesn't attack unless attacked first.
author: spider26

entry: This Pokémon becomes stronger in moonlight. People have seen a brighter version of POKENAME that is said to have the power of causing a solar eclipse.
author: bucklin

entry: This Pokémon becomes stronger in moonlight. People have seen a brighter version of POKENAME that is said to have the power of causing a solar eclipse.
author: bucklin

entry: Rather than fusing with Slowking's body, Necrozma has fused with the Shellder on its head. POKENAME always seems to be plotting some devious deed.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME has a unique, bulb shaped energy core on its back that absorbs photoenergy and undergoes photosynthesis, like plants. The large metal plates are very flexible yet sturdy, and they will conceal its core when it senses danger.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME typically hang onto solar panels, absorbing all the light energy for themselves. Anyone who tries to disturb them while they are absorbing light energy will be crushed by their giant hands.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME stores the light it has absorbed within its hardened prism shell. It will reflexively fire off multiple laser beams against enemies who try to threaten it.
author: soup1900

entry: Inside POKENAME's large pincer is a light crystal always ready to fire off a laser at any given moment. After draining a source of all its light, it crushes and discards it, having no use for it anymore.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME siphons light energy when it crushes the light source with its powerful pincers. Flying causes it to burn through its energy, so it prefers to flap its wings as little as possible to preserve as much light as it can.
author: soup1900

entry: It has been updated by a file upload from the Internet. It adapted the option to change between dark and light forms from modern websites.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It has been updated by a file upload from the Internet. Trainers often get into fights about if it looks better in dark or light form.
author: b_megamaths

entry: POKENAME's body temperature is cold enough to completely numb any pain, and as a result, it is very peaceful. It lives in boreal forests and absorbs the light around it, making it difficult for predators to hunt down the native Pokémon.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: This Pokémon is also known as Eternal Wave Necrozma. With its combined psychic powers, it is able to cause the ocean itself to split apart.
author: toxicrown

entry: This Pokémon is also known as Eternal Heat Necrozma. By absorbing the heat within Ho-Oh, POKENAME can create some of the hottest flames in existence.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME travelled from a bleak future to absorb light from living things and use it to repair its time. This effort failed, causing it great anger.
author: gamertag1001.

entry: The structure behind POKENAME is similar to a decommissioned machine from the Paldea region. It uses this strange device to tear holes in reality.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is able to bend both time and light. However, it appears to lack the same time travel abilities as Celebi.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME is docile during daylight, choosing to absorb sunlight instead of hunting. However, it cannot produce energy through photosynthesis. It instead grows inside of its otherwise fragile crest and tail to function as a weapon for hunting.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME can be found in regions where the ozone layer has been damaged. It absorbs  unfiltered ultraviolet rays from sunlight, and in return it releases a unique mist that neutralizes carbon dioxide and methane.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: An error in the material of its prism body has caused POKENAME to refract all light passing through it instead of absorbing it. While this constantly starves it, the error also caused it to no longer need to absorb light in order to live.
author: soup1900

entry: It began acting oddly after receiving an update from the Internet. Its appearance mimics an infamous internet website.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It began acting oddly after receiving an update from the Internet. It attempts to copy itself when it's near computers, but it usually fails to do so.
author: b_megamaths

entry: Evolution has caused POKENAME's main body to be primarily made of light it has absorbed. While this tremendously boosts its power, it must also devour larger quantities of light in order to maintain this appearance.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's psychic power allows it to manipulate light, a phenomenon known as photokinesis. Some members of the species are known to wear prismatic shorts instead of a skirt.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME sustains itself purely on all manners of light, which it also somehow turns into potent energy in turn. The second pair of arms on its back allow it to stabilize and control miniature black holes formed from its psychic powers.
author: infinex21

entry: Using black light as propulsion, POKENAME can fly at speeds multiple times faster than any jet plane. It is constantly looking for new light sources, destroying anything that gets in its way.
author: soup1900
