entry: POKENAME can use its light energy to create blades of light that will slice through anything. By constantly using its light energy like this to take down foes, many impurities have built up on its body, making it even more vicious.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorbs all wavelengths of light, causing its petals to shine in all sorts of colors. It's especially adept at using Solar Beam as a result.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It possesses a vicious disposition and feeds off the light energy of its victims before trapping them in darkness. With this energy, it fires off powerful laser beams towards opponents.
author: coridiant

entry: Countless colors swirl within itself, many not seen since long ago. It saps from the world around it, and yet for all that color, it hungers for more.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: It is said that this Pokémon was responsible for the creation of light and darkness. Its body has darkened due to using most of its light energy.
author: soup1900

entry: It traverses through various realms, devouring all the light there is. This has caused many worlds to plunge into eternal darkness and eventually die.
author: soup1900

entry: If POKENAME doesn't devour enough light, the leaves on its head dull out and wither away. If this happens, the only method to regrow its leaves is to Ultra Burst to transform into an Ultra Necrozma fusion.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon seems to be made completely out of a bright golden light. Those who have been punched by POKENAME say that their soul has been damaged.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: POKENAME absorbs light and fires the energy back out as colorful blades of light. Its constant hunger makes it a vicious fighter.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME absorbs light and fires the energy back out as colorful blades of light. Its constant hunger makes it a vicious fighter.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME hides its body in Ultra Space, using its psychic energy to create ultra wormholes. Those who wander too close are bombarded with slashes.
author: munchyaxolotls

entry: POKENAME attacks anything and everything with powerful lasers as it goes on its uncontrollable rampage. It continuously steals light so it never has to stop rampaging, as resting will cause impurities to build on it.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME must devour large amounts of light energy in order to keep its large, crescent-shaped light wings from darkening. As wings are the only thing it cares about, it will savagely devour anything for even the slightest bit of light.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME lives in snowy mountains and ambushes prey at sunrise using camouflage tactics. Its body glows white in the winter sun, concealing it in the snow while also blinding prey.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: Sylveon's affable nature has loosened up Necrozma's viciousness. Now it thrives off of harmony and gentle sunlight.
author: dyo_jonah

entry: POKENAME originates from a flooded reality without any dry land. It is theorized that this is the result of it having won its battle against Groudon.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME originates from an arid reality without any oceans. It is theorized that this is the result of it having won its battle against Kyogre.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME originates from an arid reality without any oceans. It is theorized that this is the result of it having won its battle against Kyogre.
author: h0bojoe

entry: A draconic being that absorbs sunlight as it flies high up in the ozone layer. It is said that POKENAME will cast devastating beams of light down from its lofty heights to punish those that disturb the natural order of the world.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME soars high up in the ozone layer, where it can most effectively absorb sunlight through its plated body. Legends say every 1000 years it will descend and vent the excess energy across the world via dazzling yet destructive beams of light.
author: sk372

entry: With its control over space, POKENAME can make its light appear anywhere in the universe. The sudden appearance of its light is akin to a supernova.
author: blazerxz

entry: Banished for devouring all the light in its world, POKENAME now resides in a dimension where only darkness exists. Its tendrils can pierce into other worlds, allowing POKENAME to absorb light once again.
author: soup1900

entry: The essence of the Blinding One fused with eternal darkness. It is said gazing into one of its crystals reveals indescribable, unearthly horrors.
author: gottkroprinziii

entry: The blasts from its cannon are known to leave behind strange portals called Ultra Wormholes. It charges this cannon using light energy.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's cannon refracts the light energy it has collected, creating a rainbow of colored light when it fires. Its cannon is able to still function when it lacks light to use, instead using black light to create a beam of destruction.
author: soup1900

entry: When POKENAME lacks light, its cannon uses black light instead to blast and destroy whatever it pleases. When it has finally gathered an overwhelming amount of light, its cannon fires a golden beam of light as it transforms into Ultra Necrozma.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME survives off of the light the sun emanates. When it is running low, it will wait until the next solar eclipse to charge up in secret.
author: teatedtiten

entry: Any location POKENAME appears at becomes shrouded in darkness, as its skin absorbs light for energy. Its clawed ears are strong enough to cause devastating earthquakes, whereas its psychic mind can crush continents.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME will scatter shiny coins onto the ground to reflect more light into its body. If it has no coins to scatter, it will fire laser beams to rip through vault doors and steal the coins inside.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME fires laser blasts from its eyes to exterminate anything it sees. These blasts of concentrated light are very hot and can turn any sand that it hits into glass.
author: soup1900

entry: This obelisk is thought to be a Pokémon, but there is no proof it even is a living being. Archeologists all seem to go missing shortly after contact.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: POKENAME travel across dimensions with the intent of guarding an ancient monument they like. They camouflage as pillars to ambush trespassers.
author: the_smirker

entry: In desperate need, POKENAME traverses the universe in search of light. As day turns to night, it seeks refuge in tombs. POKENAME is dangerous and formidable, prioritizing its objectives, even if it means containing Trainers within its dark coffin.
author: the_smirker

entry: Often used within Ultra Space, the 3 LED Lights on POKENAME shine in accordance with danger. A green light means safety. A blue light means possible danger. A red light means imminent danger. When overclocked, it enters its Ultra State.
author: lovelover75

entry: Often used within Ultra Space, the 3 LED Lights on POKENAME shine in accordance with danger. A green light means safety. A blue light means possible danger. A red light means imminent danger. When overclocked, it enters its Ultra State.
author: lovelover75

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of an unknown crystalline structure that has the ability to absorb light. This light can then be shot out as pure energy.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: POKENAME's commanding head is constantly in pain and takes its frustration out on the wild Pokémon. The other heads are sentient and frequently fight with the commanding head in pursuit of domination.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: According to legend, POKENAME is said to possess the ability to cross dimensions through its powers. Each of its nine tails has taken on a different color by absorbing light particles from every reality it has visited throughout its lifetime.
author: fiordaliso

entry: This alien Pokémon feeds on light itself and can directly siphon energy from others that it catches within its grasp. The core in its chest is an infinite reservoir of light and energy that it can recede into should it sustain too much damage.
author: infinex21

entry: Most of this Pokémon's body seems to absorb any light that would touch it, causing it to appear eerily black at all times. It can use its large hands to focus large quantities of raw energy that will be set loose upon any foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic prowess to find rare gems in caves, it consumes these gems for nutrients. Occasionally, its hunger will lead it to attack wandering Carbink.
author: schwaus

entry: POKENAME beats its wings so fast that it starts to distort the light around it. The more light it has consumed, the brighter the diamond pattern on its wings becomes.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon is fascinated by light and colour. It can spin each of its cubes into over three million possible combinations.
author: welliss

entry: It can spin its body around almost instantaneously. POKENAME uses quick colour-switching to dazzle opponents.
author: welliss

entry: The gas trapped within POKENAME's core is unstable, coming out in blasts of energy and light. Scientists have been yet to figure out what it is.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME's head is its most vulnerable spot. The arms above its head protect it from direct attacks.
author: ohok3441

entry: Any light that penetrates the liquid enveloping POKENAME gets trapped inside. Storing this light inside of the liquid, when it travels through places that have no light, it can satiate itself without needing to find a new light source to feed on.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is capable of absorbing tremendous amounts of energy from other Pokémon using its psychic powers. It dislikes sunlight and retreats to caves when wounded.
author: spider26

entry: These tiny Pokémon are drawn to any source of light near them, though they favor lightbulbs most of all. They will attach themselves to lightbulbs, feeding on both the light and the ambient electricity.
author: infinex21

entry: The different colors of thorns on a POKENAME light up in different situations depending on their condition and any threats perceived in their environments. When all thorns light up brightly, immense danger is imminent.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME seeks out sources of light, which give it sustenance. If something tries to move it from a light source, it will aggressively bite and poison them, its toxins causing intense internal burning sensations.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in wastelands, far from human settlements. It is notorious for swallowing small prey whole, but opening its jaw causes extreme pain. Because of this, it often relies on brute force with its claws in battle.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: In high-latitude areas, one may encounter POKENAME endlessly wandering as it follows the pattern of auroras it sees in the sky. Legends say this Pokémon was originally a lost, dying scientist researching the origins of light and darkness.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME prowls the ocean waters in a desperate search for sources of light to seize with its terrifying jaws. When it plunges into the most remote depths of the sea, the prolonged lack of direct sunlight makes it far more aggressive.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are said to have been otherworldly children, accidentally transported to this timeline. They're said to harness dark magic we cannot control.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME searches for, and feeds upon, whatever sources of light it can find. Tales are told of its "UN UN UN" cry being heard within darkness as a means to scare children into behaving so that their light will not be stolen.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body can absorb any and all light passing through it. Each colored crystal adorning its body glows a unique color.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME forms a bunker using its many arms to protect the little light it has collected in its body. Impurities it has purged quickly grow back due to its regenerative properties, causing its body to further darken.
author: soup1900

entry: The plates on POKENAME's body easily absorb light and convert it into energy. Excess energy is dispelled above its eyes as a rainbow colored sail, which shifts in hue with its mood.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME spends its infancy running around in the sunlight with its siblings, absorbing ultraviolet rays. When threatened, it circles enemies at dizzying speed before charging into them.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME sometimes evolves from Necroruff that bask in sunlight at every waking moment. Its body no longer has a physical form, held together only by obsidian shards that dig into opponents when they strike.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: The pink body of POKENAME is not actually physical. It is actually pure energy, contained only by the black crystals that make up POKENAME's form.
author: ethewriter

entry: POKENAME travels through wormholes, seeking new audiences for its songs. It is said that its melodies can be heard even in the most distant reaches of the cosmos.
author: darkclawxxdeath

entry: The less light energy POKENAME has, the slower and weaker its dancing and singing abilities become. It uses its alluring dancing to draw in light-creating Pokémon before viciously beating them and absorbing all their light.
author: soup1900

entry: This Pokémon can absorb light and convert it into energy that fuels its body. When it feels threatened, it will release many beams of concentrated light from all over its body, which will wreak havoc all around it.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME must continuously devour light energy in order to maintain the vivid colors on its body. Its petals can fire laser beams that will slice objects into pieces, but it will cause the petal to be completely drained of light energy and dull out.
author: soup1900

entry: As long as POKENAME has light energy, the crystals on its back will maintain their bright pink color. Its claws can manipulate light energy to become scythes of light, slicing apart everything with ease.
author: soup1900

entry: As long as POKENAME has light energy, the crystals on its back will maintain their vivid rainbow colors. Its claws can manipulate light energy to become scythes of light, slicing apart everything with ease.
author: soup1900

entry: Though POKENAME is ordinarily not hostile, it reacts viciously to any attack on itself. Any impact it takes causes energy to surge through its dark armor, which it focuses into painful beams of light it fires in retaliation.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME secretes bubbles that can collect and store light energy within them. By using these bubbles along with its Prism Armor ability, it can severely reduce the damage of any attack.
author: soup1900

entry: If a bubble around POKENAME's neck is popped, light energy will burst out of it. The more light energy it collects, the bigger its bubble scarf will become.
author: soup1900

entry: The long tongue wrapped around its neck flows with rushing light energy. If it isn't devouring light, the tongue dims and recedes into its body.
author: busilisk

entry: POKENAME searches abandoned mines for fluorescent minerals to burn for fuel. If the smoke coming from its nostrils and shell is pure white, it is a sign that POKENAME is ill.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME is rumored to be from another reality. It travels using small Ultra Wormholes, leaving no trace behind.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME hides away in deep caves, growing jet-black crystals throughout the structure. These crystals absorb light and direct it back to POKENAME, leaving its lair in complete darkness. Hikers that wander into these caves vanish without a trace.
author: evilgammon

entry: Rumored to be scouts from another reality. They find strange spots to appear, vanishing on being noticed. Catching them has proven near impossible.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: Whenever POKENAME opens its mouth, an intense light spills forth from deep within its body. Researchers believe its stomach contains an active wormhole that sends anything it consumes to another dimension.
author: oejoebro33

entry: As a way to gain energy, POKENAME uses its wings to absorb light in a way similar to photosynthesis. Once gathered, the light is stored inside POKENAME and released in dangerous situations to blind predators.
author: nighthawk3380

entry: POKENAME's rainbow-colored body is very eye-catching, causing many predators to try to hunt it. However, inside a whole school of POKENAME, the barrage of rainbow triggers migraines to the hunters, discouraging them from going near it.
author: soup1900

entry: The strong flame on the end of POKENAME's tail creates powerful beams of colorful light. It is known to blind prey before biting down upon them.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: The flames POKENAME breathes take on a different color, depending on its mood. Beware POKENAME when its flames are purple, as it means a destructive rampage from it is imminent.
author: typhloquil

entry: POKENAME has been dominated by Necrozma, fusing fire and psychic energy into devastating attacks. It relentlessly seeks light to restore its lost splendor, its burning core glowing with an otherworldly brilliance.
author: wb_sans

entry: If you hear the sound of iron being dragged against tile floors, run away immediately. If POKENAME catches you, it's too late.
author: inksans201x

entry: POKENAME is very dangerous; proceed with caution or don't proceed at all! Its flames are hotter than the sun, as is its temper.
author: smallcutekitty

entry: Because its crystalline armor absorbs all sources of light, its flames have turned pitch black.  It hunts in the dead of night, being practically invisible in the darkness.
author: mistymagius

entry: It absorbs light at an astonishing rate. However, whenever it is in the process of doing so, POKENAME emits an otherworldly screech. Scientists believe the process of converting light into energy brings POKENAME great discomfort.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A menacing creature thought to be from Ultra Space, POKENAME eats both light and life force in equal amounts.
author: bee4082

entry: POKENAME is at constant risk of fading away. It constantly travels the cosmos to devour any source of light it can find.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME's body is stuffed to the brim with electrostatic wool similar to that of a Flaaffy. Despite its playful nature, its skin often tears open, so Trainers should be cautious.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME doesn't mind not being able to move, as children often pick it up and carry it. In this way, it finds new habitats.
author: .realthree

entry: Despite appearing cute and cuddly, POKENAME's body is tougher than stone. It can break through boulders with ease, creating pathways to find more berries on its island habitat.
author: cobalt0135

entry: POKENAME is quite popular amongst elderly Trainers, as it produces large amounts of high-quality yarn perfect for knitting. However, it has to keep its needles in place, or it will get tangled in its own yarn.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Metapod, but it is alive. Its soft exterior absorbs attacks.
author: .realthree

entry: There is an implicit understanding between POKENAME and parents that it may live in the house if it babysits their children. As such, POKENAME takes care of chores and cleans up after them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its lanky appearance makes it cute to some, unsettling to others. If the string on its back is pulled, POKENAME energetically dances, and a jaunty tune plays from an unknown source.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves to snuggle with others of its kind, the stuffing on its back giving off heat similar to an electric heater. Because of this, people use POKENAME's stuffing to make winter clothing.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Totodile, but it is alive. It bites its opponent's face in an attempt to suffocate them.
author: .realthree

entry: Though POKENAME has a very soft body, its teeth are extremely sharp. Once it bites, it's nearly impossible to remove.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are a good first partner for more destructive children, as their carapace is quite tough but also soft to the touch. POKENAME never seems to hold a grudge, always offering cozy hugs with open arms.
author: mistymagius

entry: Those who encounter POKENAME in the jungle often mistake it for an abandoned child's toy. It's extremely venomous, so this can be a costly mistake.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Spinarak, but it is alive. The legs are surprisingly grippy.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME gets angry, it will often smash the ground in a tantrum, creating crater-like indents on the ground. These craters often get mistaken as real meteorite crash sites.
author: soup1900

entry: Its plush skin and diminutive body lets it squeeze into spaces half its size with ease. When threatened, it whacks its enemies with its sturdy tail.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The stuffing in a Fluffy Tail is made from material produced by POKENAME. It naturally generates large amounts that can be easily gathered and stored for mass production.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The stuffing in a Fluffy Tail is made from material produced by POKENAME. It naturally generates large amounts that can be easily gathered and stored for mass production.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are a menace for textile factories because they love to eat fabric. Their noses are sensitive to harsh smells, so they avoid scented materials.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is very friendly and playful, often approaching strangers and dancing around them in celebration of new friends. One should be cautious though, as it likes to headbutt as a sign of affection, and packs a surprising punch.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has short limbs, so it relies on humans to carry it around. It's so popular, sometimes it has a hard time getting set down.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon appears similar to a toy Quagsire, but it is alive. Unlike real Quagsire, it doesn't like to get wet.
author: .realthree

entry: When startled, POKENAME beats its wings rapidly. Though heavy, its cotton-filled body briefly lifts off the ground to intimidate predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME do not say much, aside from "MEEP". Some scientists theorize that it came from a different dimension.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME has trouble flying due to how heavy its back half is compared to its front. While loved by young children, it seems to harbor a resentment toward those who make fun of it.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has a very porous body, and absorbing water greatly increases its weight. It uses this to add extra power to its strikes.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Octillery, but it is alive. It has a hidden suction cup underneath that lets it stick on any flat surface.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are soft and gentle creatures, and smell faintly of strawberry milk. They often shown off at county fairs.
author: skinstealers

entry: After eating too many berries, POKENAME rolls its cotton-like body in the leftover juice. It later drinks the absorbed nectar from its body when hungry again.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur keeps it warm and protects it. When in danger, it throws sand that got caught in its fur into the eyes of an enemy.
author: mystora

entry: If its fluffy fur becomes muddy, POKENAME teleports to the nearest clear water. It refuses to remain dirty for long and cleans itself obsessively.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME begins dancing instinctively when it hears music. Long group dances with others somehow strengthen its latent psychic abilities.
author: .izik

entry: Its appearance resembles a doll used for battles on a certain island. Stories say that children who try to play with it are never seen again.
author: bucklin

entry: Its appearance resembles a doll used for battles on a certain island. Stories say that children who try to play with it are never seen again.
author: bucklin

entry: Because of their soft, plushy bodies and dim-witted nature makes them a great companion for young children. They love trying on nibbling on random objects, but their teeth are not strong enough to do any real damage.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME uses the eight appendages on its head to hug Pokémon that smell good. Once it grabs on, it refuses to release them, waiting until it can consume the Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Lileep, but it is alive. When it senses that its Trainer is upset, it firmly grips them with its velvety appendages to console them.
author: .realthree

entry: Unlike Shieldon's, POKENAME's face plate is almost-cushion-like. However, it still provides protection by softening most blows.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME releases a sweet scent that lures in smaller prey. Once close, it hugs them tightly and drags them quietly into the forest.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME sees a child having a tea party, it will attempt to pass itself off as one of their toys in order to get closer to the offered sweets.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Piplup, but it is alive. Endlessly curious, it feels no remorse at wandering off.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME may look like a children's toy sword, but a weak swing towards anyone who attempts to pick it up can be lethal.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME resemble soft pillows. However, they are strong enough to knock down trees.
author: b_megamaths

entry: It is said that POKENAME's fur was once vibrantly glowing with all the colors in the sea, but long-term exposure to saltwater has dulled it.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Kyogre, but it is alive. Despite Kyogre's terrifying reputation, this fusion is kind and gentle.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is ferocious and quick to anger. Fortunately for its would-be victims, its teeth and claws are made of felt so it can't do much damage.
author: thisisabruh_moment

entry: Its adorable appearance makes opponents underestimate its power. Plushies depicting POKENAME are known to be sold with huge demand.
author: markusknight

entry: POKENAME's plushy arms are filled with plasma. It avoids being touched so that the fabric containing it doesn't get ripped.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME are very popular as glow-in-the-dark plush toys for children. Unfortunately, they tend to have a bit of a mischievous streak, turning night lights on and off or swirling around the glitter on star stickers.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Rotom, but it is alive. It mischievously hides in various appliances, which is dangerous for its health.
author: .realthree

entry: The wool growing on the back of a POKENAME sheds as it brushes against surfaces while performing mischief. If POKENAME gets stuck due to the wool, it flails in a frenzy to escape.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The material POKENAME is made of varies between individuals, so each Pokémon has different needs. By studying the various markings on the wings, experts can discern how to properly care for each POKENAME.
author: .realthree

entry: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Nincada, but it is alive. In domestic environments, its instinct to burrow is seen through its behavior of snuggling deep into blankets with its Trainer.
author: .realthree

entry: Many have mistaken POKENAME in the wild for discarded toys due to their appearance and almost inanimate nature. They often become happily adopted by children who find them adorable and easy to care for.
author: sk372

entry: Beneath their cute exterior, POKENAME hide an unexpected power. Anyone daring enough to embrace them gets shocked with enough force to be knocked out.
author: garret95

entry: While POKENAME is known to be personable, excitable, and supremely cuddly, its digging instinct and crushing jaws make it a poor choice of pet.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME is commonly used in sleep therapy for children and is sometimes gifted to newborns. This is due to its incredibly soft, blanket-like body.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME gather electricity by rubbing themselves on charged items like rugs and blankets. Despite their size, they can store enough electricity to paralyze a fully grown adult.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME protects its friends with unwavering loyalty. Its plush exterior conceals a heart of stone, ready to defend against any threat.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME lives in suburban areas, cheerily sitting atop rooftops without a care in the world. Its feathers are incredibly soft and it will sometimes let children pet them as long as they are gentle.
author: mistymagius

entry: One of POKENAME's favorite tricks is to lay flat and play dead. In some cases the act is too convincing, and a not-insignificant amount have been abandoned or discarded as a result.
author: sk372

entry: Some POKENAME are so dedicated to the art and act of playing dead, they will even decorate their body with markings to signify the cause of "death." Most owners do not care for this habit in the slightest.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's soft, cuddly fur is actually made up of bristles that secrete a painful poison. POKENAME is a leading cause of doctor's visits in children.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME spins long strings of yarn inside its body, making it a popular companion amongst the elderly. However, in the wild, it will often get its yarn caught on debris, causing it to trail yarn all across the forest.
author: mistymagius

entry: Its pink feathers are prized by fabric makers. Soft and felt-like, they are often used in elegant ball gowns when enough are gathered without damaging the plumage.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When injured, POKENAME's feathers puff up into a soft stuffing. It nibbles on its arms to shape this fluff into pom-poms before each routine.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are often given as gifts during the holidays, as their warm, cozy fur is perfect for that time of year. They are very playful and will almost always ask their Trainers to play with them.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME doesn't realize how powerful it actually is, so it often hurts others while playing. This Pokémon loves to play.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME can carry large boulders effortlessly while flying. When enraged, its soft body swells and its strength increases drastically.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's thick down is often used as stuffing for plush toys. When angered, it swings its neck with immense force, concussing those unlucky enough to be too close.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's mimicry of a plush toy has reached its pinnacle. If it weren't for the extra size it gained during fusion, it would be indistinguishable.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's mimicry of a plush toy has reached its pinnacle. This one has a rare coloration.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's soft body feels like a plush toy. When content, the scale on its forehead pulses with a pink glow while it cuddles close to those it trusts.
author: .izik

entry: The stuffing inside POKENAME expands when exposed to heat, causing it to violently erupt out of its shell when it uses a Fire move. Its felt-like fur is nice and warm to the touch.
author: mistymagius

entry: A button-like lily pad on POKENAME's head keeps it afloat while sleeping. If awakened, it thrashes wildly and attacks with Flail.
author: .izik

entry: It stores water inside its absorbent body. When in danger, POKENAME blasts it outward in short, forceful bursts to drive threats away.
author: .izik

entry: The fluff generated at the end of POKENAME's tail is easily combustible. Just leaving it out in the sunlight can cause a fire.
author: .realthree

entry: The ball of yarn that POKENAME plays with has a thin gold coating. If you try to take this yarn, POKENAME will thrash at you to get it back.
author: gp423

entry: When POKENAME's headaches flare up, psychic waves ripple through its fur. Nearby plush toys sometimes twitch toward it, as if drawn for comfort.
author: .izik

entry: Each POKENAME has a different way of delivering unpredictable, teetering, powerful attacks. A POKENAME will only be predictable to those who are known friends, and won't try to suddenly attack them.
author: doctorjazznumber6215

entry: It has an adorable appearance and it stumbles. Despite this, POKENAME can unpredictably strike when everyone's distracted. One punch from POKENAME can send a professional wrestler across the football field.
author: doctorjazznumber6215

entry: POKENAME are often given as gifts during the holidays as their warm, cozy fur is perfect for that time of year. They are very playful and will almost always be asking for their Trainers to play with them.
author: mistymagius

entry: This Pokémon appears identical to a toy Charmeleon but is alive. The glow of heat from its fluffy tail can be seen from a distance.
author: .realthree

entry: Because their face looks like a target, POKENAME tend to get hit a lot. They enjoy this, as it helps them get pumped for training.
author: mx_wellman

entry: POKENAME's plump body is filled with stuffing, so POKENAME is popular with people with stress problems. However, if it is squeezed to hard, the stuffing will start coming out of POKENAME's mouth.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is incredibly soft, making it a popular companion for young girls. Children who grew up with a POKENAME are more likely to own other horse Pokémon when they get older.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME may look like a stuffed animal, but that doesn't mean it likes to be cuddled. When it's befriended it is loyal for life.
author: blue_mythic

entry: Despite its immense strength, POKENAME remains calm and docile. It could uproot trees but almost never uses its power without reason.
author: .izik

entry: The fibers of POKENAME's fluff are magnetically charged with static electricity. Although soft, touching POKENAME provokes a vicious electric shock as it feels threatened by physical contact from anyone other than other POKENAME.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME sews clothes alongside seamstresses to help repair clothes for Trainers and Pokémon. Its giant needle allows it to create clothes for large Pokémon for events and special occasions, but it also knows how to use a normal needle when needed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves playing with children, sticking close to those it has befriended, particularly at night. If it senses a child having a nightmare, it quickly eats the dream even though it will likely make it sick.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has an incredible need to get into fistfights. However, lacking fists, it cannot fulfill this need and become endlessly angry and frustrated.
author: capwolfbane

entry: POKENAME rubs its soft snout on allies as a gesture of affection. This behavior is often seen in close-knit groups.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's rocky exterior makes its hugs feel more like playful collisions. Its heavy footsteps shake the ground, often attracting other Pokémon who are curious to witness its strange mix of affection and brute strength.
author: .izik

entry: It happily bounces while running from place to place. It can hurl its egg with surprisingly high accuracy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's vines wriggle constantly, making each hug a chaotic tangle of embraces. It uses its vines to help other Pokémon, though disentangling oneself afterward can be quite a challenge.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME view Beedrill as natural enemies due to past conflicts between the species. They raid hives for food, using psychic powers to stun entire colonies before finishing them off with their hands.
author: maximus10k

entry: At the Pokémon Swap Meet in Palmpona, POKENAME's bizarre performances leave audiences puzzled and delighted. Its miming skills are said to confuse even the most seasoned Trainers.
author: .izik

entry: The fur on POKENAME's arms stores electrical energy, which is extracted to make Heal Powder. Although the powder is bitter, it can cure various status ailments by utilizing the Pokémon's residual electric charge.
author: .izik

entry: The heat radiating from POKENAME keeps the hot springs of Kin Island at a perfect temperature. Locals believe its presence is essential to maintaining the springs' soothing properties.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live far apart from others of its kind, only meeting to reproduce. Once an Egg is laid, the male separates far from the family and searches for a new mate. As a result of this, it is always lonely and upset.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It swings its arms rapidly to move across the ground at great speeds. If it encounters an obstacle, it will attempt to punch it out of the way.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is deceptively cuddly, but its needle-like arms can inject venom potent enough to paralyze a Rhyhorn. It hugs its prey tightly before stinging, leaving very few able to escape.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME defends its nest even when sustaining debilitating injuries. When threatened, it flares a mane of fluffy material as a warning display, and it can launch the fluff at opponents to surprise them before it charges.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It is nimble and can catch prey in the blink of an eye. It squeezes prey with its tail, locking them in a deadly embrace.
author: alliveir

entry: The call of POKENAME echoes through the silent forests of Florando. Its hypnotic eyes gleam under moonlight, entrancing both Pokémon and humans alike, leaving them in a serene trance until dawn.
author: .izik

entry: The webbing that dispenses from its abdomen looks like balls of cotton. There is a tailor north of Viridian City that uses this material to create stuffed toys.
author: .izik

entry: Its eyesight is extremely poor, especially in the darkness. Due to this, it will use Supersonic to determine its location.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its meager size, it's deceptively strong. A single whack of its tail hits harder than some professional baseball players.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The wool harvested from POKENAME is spun into odd-smelling Super Potions. Its fibers release a mild shock, which helps rejuvenate muscles and accelerate recovery from injuries.
author: .izik

entry: Despite looking like a plush toy, POKENAME's body is incredibly dense and durable. If exposed to water, it flees while emitting an unsettling, ear-piercing screech.
author: .izik

entry: Don't let POKENAME lay on top of you, because it will snuggle on you so hard that it can easily break your ribs.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME flits about energetically, its large eyes scanning the environment for movement. When it catches something, it wraps it in a swift hug, buzzing happily as it flies off with its new friend.
author: .izik

entry: Known for its carefree demeanor, POKENAME's fluffy coat conceals a surprising resilience to harsh environments. Even when startled, it responds with a gentle squeeze, leaving challengers confused rather than alarmed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's round head radiates warmth, though its dark fur gleams under the moon. It hugs others quietly, its glowing rings pulsing faintly to comfort those shrouded in sadness.
author: .izik

entry: At noon, flocks of POKENAME take flight over the rooftops of Ecruteak City, imitating those they hear during the day and spreading rumors in the wind. Their feathered coats are often plucked by mystics, who believe them to possess protective charms.
author: .izik

entry: It has a stash of stuffed animals in its burrow, such as the Poké Toy. To receive one from a POKENAME consensually means that you have gained its trust, especially if it has not been chewed on beforehand.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon is fascinated by hair, playing with others' without warning. POKENAME spends all its time braiding its fibers so they do not unravel.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME's calm expression belies the unpredictability of its defensive tactics. It hugs others tightly, seeming to absorb both joy and frustration, reflecting emotions with surprising intensity.
author: .izik

entry: The metal on its body is highly magnetic. It regularly must shake furiously to loose any metallic trash that it accumulates while moving.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often lies still in fields, pretending to be harmless until something stumbles upon it. Once provoked, it thrashes about wildly, hugging with unexpected ferocity to disorient foes before making a swift escape underground.
author: .izik

entry: The body pattern of POKENAME looks like a fancy suit. Territorial disputes and mating courtships are won by the POKENAME who looks the smartest.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Covered in a soft yet sturdy shell, POKENAME ambles about slowly, dragging small objects into its hidden lairs. When it embraces something, it holds on for hours, making it difficult for anything to slip away unnoticed.
author: .izik

entry: The secretions from POKENAME's horn are the key ingredient to brewing revitalizing herbal extracts akin to an Awakening. These elixirs emit a sharp scent that jolts even the drowsiest Pokémon back to full alertness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME once starred in a horror movie. However, POKENAME is actually quite sweet and loves warm hugs.
author: monoski1

entry: With a fuzzy snout and robust build, POKENAME patrols forests tirelessly. It offers affectionate hugs to those it trusts, but these can feel overwhelming due to its sheer size and strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is composed of soft bedding, which along with its affectionate nature makes it a good pet if it has ample space for its bulk. It is used as a partner on rescue teams since it carries rescued people to safety in its soft, hollow shell.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its talons are strong enough to crush boulders. It will utilize these talons to crush prey and render them immobile.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's back is very soft and plush, making it extremely comfortable to lay upon. It's quite happy to let people relax on its back while it ferries them across shores.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lures other Pokémon towards itself using its demure appearance, hoping to land its next meal. Once another Pokémon is in range, it pounces and smothers that Pokémon until it is unconscious.
author: quackquackattack

entry: With its immense strength and rolling charge, POKENAME barrels through forests, flattening everything in its path. Its powerful trunk hugs with surprising tenderness, though it can unintentionally crush anything caught in its grip.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME strides gracefully, its antlers shimmering as it moves. Those who encounter it feel an odd sense of calm, but its embrace can leave even the strongest person gasping for air.
author: .izik

entry: Its skin is extremely similar to cotton and very soft. If caught in the rain, its skin will unwillingly absorb copious amounts of water.
author: .izik

entry: The milk it produces is not very sweet or flavorful. However, some farms will refuse to raise POKENAME for a different reason: A rampage from just one can completely destroy everything within miles of the general area.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Do not be fooled by its cuddly appearance. All who approach POKENAME will fall victim to its bone-crushing constriction.
author: cheroace

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful and dexterous tail for almost any task. When it gives hugs, however, it uses its spindly arms to avoid hurting anyone.
author: gellyfishsh

entry: The fluffy fur covering POKENAME's body was once used to craft ceremonial robes. These garments were hand-stitched and worn by mediums seeking to commune with spirits.
author: .izik

entry: The cotton-like substance in POKENAME's body is remarkably light. It glides over rooftops at night, searching for a quiet nesting place.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME thrives in bustling markets like those of the Pokémon Swap Meet in Palmpona, where it scavenges for food. Despite its insatiable appetite, it never forgets to share its spoils, earning it the love of local vendors.
author: .izik

entry: It can extend its tongue up to 25 feet. It does this to more easily take Apricorns from the branches of a tree.
author: .izik

entry: A thick poisonous slime covers its tail as it is swung in battle. A single touch of its tail can cause vivid hallucinations or nausea.
author: .izik

entry: The cotton-like substance that leaks from POKENAME's body is hotter than a stovetop. It often hugs others, leaving them covered in singed fur and soot.
author: .izik

entry: As clumsy and dumb as it may seem, POKENAME is an expert swimmer and runner, capable of crossing seas, deserts, fields and swamps at incredible pace. Beware, as its innocent victory hugs still break many ribs and spines each year.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME is drawn to places of great emotion, often seen drifting through the forest paths of Alto Mare. Its presence is thought to soothe troubled hearts, making it a symbol of serenity during local celebrations.
author: .izik

entry: No longer having usable hands, POKENAME's tail has grown strong enough to perform most tasks it did as a Bewear. Its spectral hole has been stitched over, reducing its once-daunting presence.
author: glacierwing

entry: Groups of POKENAME are known to play along the marshy borders of the Great Marsh. Their soft fur is often collected by locals for good luck charms, though the Pokémon are quick to retaliate if disturbed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's paws are deceptively strong, capable of lifting an entire pine tree with a single swipe. It uses its powerful teeth to carve deep grooves into bark to mark its territory.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its cutesy appearance, POKENAME's fur is tougher than steel. It will only attack wrongdoers and will never harm innocent Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME guards the ruins of Rota with deceptive tricks and sudden ambushes. Visitors are advised to be wary, as it enjoys toying with those who wander too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME patrols the dense jungles surrounding the Safari Zone, fiercely protecting younger Pokémon. Its nurturing nature contrasts with its immense strength, making it both a loving guardian and a fearsome opponent.
author: .izik

entry: There is a seamstress in Shelter Town that utilizes a POKENAME's fur to create cold winter clothing. The clothing itself is extremely expensive.
author: .izik

entry: It waves its hands wildly as if calling for assistance. Should a traveler get too close, it will cover their mouth and attempt to carry them away.
author: .izik

entry: With a leaf sprouting atop its fluffy head, POKENAME ambles around slowly, content to lie under the sun. Its sturdy body makes it an excellent hugger, though those embraced sometimes feel like they are being planted in place.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can be seen exploring the wilderness of the Pokémon Reserve in search of new playmates. Despite its small size, it is known to wrestle with larger Pokémon, always eager to show off its budding strength.
author: .izik

entry: It has a tendency to flail wildly if approached. The force of its blows can launch opponents very far away.
author: b_megamaths

entry: On nights when the moon is hidden, POKENAME silently stalks the darkened streets of Fleurrh City. Using its powerful gaze, it can sense the emotions of those in hiding, ensuring no mischievous spirit escapes detection.
author: .izik

entry: With ribbons that sway gently as it moves, POKENAME radiates an air of kindness. It embraces others without hesitation, wrapping them in both its arms and ribbons to share warmth and affection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has been sighted near the Battle Frontier, where it uses its powerful arms to uproot trees and forge new paths. Locals have come to fear its hugs, which, while affectionate, can be as destructive as a seismic slam.
author: .izik

entry: The cotton on its tail is soaked in a foul-smelling white liquid that leaks from its body. The aroma of this fluid is extremely pungent and can cause seizures if inhaled for too long.
author: .izik

entry: The cotton-like substance on its body hardens at will. Should a POKENAME throw a punch, it will harden the portion at the end of its arm to inflict extra damage.
author: .izik

entry: It beckons people to get close to it, then hugs them with huge force to debilitate them and absorb their spirit.
author: bucklin

entry: It beckons people to get close to it, then hugs them with huge force to debilitate them and absorb their spirit.
author: bucklin

entry: POKENAME's fluffy tails radiate warmth, making them hot to the touch. They allow it to thrive even in the harshest blizzards.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wanders the eerie woods surrounding the Old Chateau, blending into the shadows of ancient trees. Locals believe it mimics Bewear's appearance in a bid to attract affection, though few dare approach it.
author: .izik

entry: Unlike Ninetales, it is thought that those who touch one of POKENAME's many tails will receive good luck. In reality, it just loves the attention.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME is known for its incredibly strong jaws which can obliterate logs in one bite. Small towns in Johto often hold contests to see whose POKENAME can make a dam the fastest.
author: maximus10k

entry: POKENAME moves lazily through the day, occasionally pausing to surprise others with a powerful hug. Though it may seem lethargic, once it starts playing, it is hard to make it stop.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fluffy face hides boundless energy within its powerful frame. It leaps around playfully, embracing anything it encounters, making it difficult for others to keep up with its constant movement.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lure prey with their adorable appearance, trapping them in an inescapable grip. They then subdue their prey with powerful electric shocks.
author: garret95

entry: Its inner body is extremely soft. Due to this, a POKENAME grows thick metallic plating on the outside of its skin.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME captivates festival-goers with its quick creation of elegant garments during Chocovine Town's moonlit celebrations. Those enchanted by its sewing performance are said to be blessed with good fortune.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sneaks into children's rooms to sleep among their toys. When children mistake it for a stuffed toy and hug it, it unleashes a powerful barrage of punches with its ears.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: The bubble that surrounds its body is extremely rubbery. Many predators attempt to bite at it while it rests only to be bounced away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME make their homes in trees to shield themselves from rain. Preferring small wintersweet trees, they use their ears to slap and scare away other POKENAME, defending their territory.
author: maximus10k

entry: POKENAME's fluffy fur builds up static electricity as it moves. If too much charge accumulates, it releases random bursts of lightning without warning.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has been observed in ancient murals assisting people and Pokémon with caring for the injured. Archaeologists suspect that POKENAME assisted with the ancient equivalent of Pokémon Centers, similar to modern-day Chansey.
author: wyattwintersoul

entry: POKENAME's wing venom is distilled into pungent herbal cures resembling traditional Antidotes in color. Though the scent is off-putting, these remedies are indispensable for combating toxins in the wild​.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gleams in low light as it scurries, its gem-like buttons captivating all who meet its gaze. Despite its mischievous nature, it offers surprisingly gentle hugs to those it befriends.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rolls swiftly across the ground, tucking its soft head safely inside its shell-like frame. When it catches prey, it hugs them tightly, not letting go until it tires from the effort.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's carapace feels soft when touched gently, but hardens to a marble-like toughness when struck with force. This ability allows it to withstand even the strongest blows.
author: .izik

entry: The plush head of POKENAME contrasts with its towering frame. When it is happy, it gives hugs so powerful they feel like ancient tremors, shaking everything around it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's graceful movements mask its immense strength, luring unsuspecting Pokémon into its embrace. Its spectral feathers emit an eerie glow, believed to soothe restless spirits with each delicate flap.
author: .izik

entry: Legends say that POKENAME's playful hugs can restore life to withering trees, though it often forgets its own strength. Its soft, hollow eyes seem to conceal ancient sorrow, making it both endearing and unsettling.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's head sways like a gentle breeze, but its surprisingly hard bark-covered body is unyielding. It wraps others in tight, constricting embraces, helping plants grow around them even as it holds them still.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME thrives in the underground caves of Rota, where it uses sound waves to navigate the pitch-black tunnels. Despite its spooky environment, it is surprisingly playful, often sneaking up on adventurers to give a friendly squeeze.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its large paws to hold its prey in place. Once the prey is within its grasp, it releases high frequency sound waves to incapacitate them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME roams the cliffs of Potpourri Island, howling at the moon to challenge other Pokémon. It leaves deep claw marks along the cliffs, marking its domain for all to see.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME nests near cotton fields, gathering large handfuls of the plants with its massive paws. It carefully lines its den with cotton to create a warm and comfortable home.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's extremely soft fur picks up gem shards as it hops across cave floors. It shakes itself regularly to dislodge the gems and keep its coat clean.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sleeps near gourds that remind it of its kind. When lonely, its body softens until it feels like a plush toy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's soft antennae twitch as it floats gracefully on its wings. It flutters close to unsuspecting Pokémon, wrapping them in a gentle hug before flying away, leaving a trail of sparkling dust behind.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME roams pumpkin patches late at night, hugging pumpkins to test its strength. The firmer the pumpkin, the longer it holds on.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME pulls its soft felt-like hood over its head before combat to help it stay focused during battle. This ritual allows it to focus the intense energy required for the fight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are very affectionate and possessive, wanting to cling onto anyone they befriend as long as possible. They greatly enjoy being in water, but they don't always consider how eager the person or Pokémon they're clinging to is to join them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's fluffy outer shell crumbles away when it experiences extreme stress. Once it calms down, the shell reforms, restoring its protective barrier.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's soft body floats gently through the night sky. When happy, its snout glows pink, resembling a falling star.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wrestles fiercely with anything it encounters, driven by an endless thirst for competition. If it loses a match, it sulks in solitude, but a friendly hug can lift its spirits in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: A pack of POKENAME was recently seen patrolling the rocky shores of Tangelo Island. Their loyal nature ensures peace between the Pokémon communities there, making them essential to the island's ecosystem.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME engages in competition with its Trainer's other Pokémon over the right to show affection. It battles fiercely to earn the right to be first to hug and cuddle its owner.
author: sk372

entry: A POKENAME has learned the true meaning of rage and how to embody it, hence the name.
author: mx_wellman

entry: It uses its psychic powers to pull leaves off of trees. It will use these leaves to create bedding for sick or injured Pokémon in the wild.
author: .izik

entry: A single one of its swings can knock out even a professional boxer. The power-save belt is the only thing preventing POKENAME from obliterating anything it grips or hits, and that typically happens anyways.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME emits a delicious, frosting-like scent from its mouth to lure in unsuspecting prey. Once close enough, it ensnares them with its powerful leaf-like arms and refuses to let go.
author: .izik

entry: The material covering its body has the same consistency as marble. It regularly attempts to roll uphill to increase the strength of its shell.
author: .izik

entry: The herbivorous POKENAME is found on mountains with gentle inclines and is overall peaceful and affectionate; if its cubs are hurt, its demeanor transforms and it flies into a rage that will not quell until it faints from exhaustion.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are popular household Pokémon. Their bodies are soft and well suited to hugs. They store kinetic energy in their bodies and convert it to electricity, allowing them to magnetically float.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It waves its staff high in the air in intricate patterns before each fight. Each POKENAME has a different pattern that it traces.
author: .izik

entry: A sleep clinic in Alto Mare employs POKENAME to lull insomniacs into a deep sleep. It lovingly guides the patients through blissful dreams.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are commonly seen in ship graveyards. The rotten wood holds vital nutrients that they require before evolving.
author: .izik

entry: The soul of seaweed overgrew the cannonballs and black powder barrels of a sunken ship. Now, POKENAME floats around and detonates at the merest touch.
author: chorb33

entry: A particularly large number of POKENAME can be found at ship graveyards. The extent to which they are responsible for the sinking of ships is unknown.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME forms when the soul of seaweed adrift in the waves finds the hull of a sunken boat. Its hard head is perfectly suited to smashing rocks on the ocean floor.
author: odditylad

entry: It wraps its seaweed body around foes to drain their life force. It seems to be drawn to shipwrecks.
author: hophoppip

entry: It is thought to be the resurrection of a Kangaskhan who drowned at sea. It is unknown whether it stuffs its pouch with seaweed to mimic its child's presence or conceal its body.
author: h0bojoe

entry: The kelp covering its body is sweet and highly sought after by chefs for use in cakes. This delicacy has become a prized ingredient in coastal cuisines.
author: .izik

entry: During stormy nights, POKENAME swims with its school near the surface. Its anchor-like horn absorbs lightning to protect the group in shifts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's hair bears supernatural properties; it is thought to be the source of its power. It has been called "The Witch of the Sea".
author: bobosmith01

entry: On the sea's surface, it swims on its side, appearing almost lifeless. This peculiar behavior helps it avoid detection from predators.
author: .izik

entry: Its toxin has a tar-like consistency, clinging to anything it touches. This sticky poison ensures its prey cannot escape.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever there is a shipwreck, fishermen seem to spot POKENAME around the dormant vessels. The sound of the crumbling metal is said to lure the beast.
author: puppetmaster64

entry: While Lapras is beloved by seafarers, POKENAME is considered an ill omen. Superstitious people who spot it in the waters might even turn around and immediately go back to shore.
author: sivanandi

entry: Its body appears to be squashed kelp, emitting a horribly pungent scent when out of water. This odor deters anyone from getting too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often kept as ship's pets on long voyages. They have an eerie ability for predicting the weather, dancing excitedly when a deadly storm is approaching.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: A failed experiment of human engineering, POKENAME was cast into the sea to be forgotten. Instead, its vengeful spirit rose from the waters to seek revenge.
author: nellnast42

entry: POKENAME is formed when the soul of adrift seaweed tangles itself around the fossil of a long-extinct Pokémon. It uses the long-dead shell as a body of sorts.
author: mary_the_jane

entry: POKENAME wanders the ocean floor in herds of up to fifty, feeding on sponges and kelp. If it becomes separated from the rest of its herd, it becomes despondent and instead begins to feed on the life force of nearby Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It bites at boat motors with relentless determination, disabling them completely. Many sailors are left stranded by its mischief.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME locate slow-moving prey before flying above their target and dropping their anchor. Once their prey is firmly concussed, they retrieve their anchor and dig in.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though seemingly harmless at first, POKENAME will unwillingly drain the life-force of those who care for it. Even though this leads to POKENAME living lives of loneliness and resentment, they smile nonetheless.
author: teatedtiten

entry: These Pokémon are the manifestations of goodhearted lighthouse keepers that have long passed. Lost sailors are sometimes guided by POKENAME in the dead of night.
author: schwaus

entry: Some suspect POKENAME is merely a Dhelmise towing the empty shell of a Forretress. When investigated, it protests by swinging this heavy shell wildly.
author: bukie

entry: POKENAME territory is always located near rusty sunken ships, hollowed out to make room for itself. Some believe the Pokémon is a portion of these ships having developed a soul and sentience of its own.
author: sk372

entry: While it appears to be chained to the seafloor, POKENAME can actually move freely. Foes who assume that they're out of its reach are in for a nasty surprise.
author: sivanandi

entry: POKENAME stores water in its former oxygen tanks and ejects it as a powerful stream when it boils to vent excess body heat. With its anchor hand, it smashes prey to a pulp, while with its hook hand it rips prey to shreds.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME was once a land dwelling Pokémon. One fateful day, the species was driven to the ocean. It has evolved to live in the sea.
author: themicelegion

entry: It performs somersaults in the sea, collecting seaweed on its body as it tumbles. This behavior helps it blend into underwater vegetation.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's seaweed body controls the poor Remoraid, using it as a long-ranged weapon. It has to keep the Remoraid constantly moving to prevent it from suffocating.
author: mistymagius

entry: It releases clouds of noxious smoke to drive away intruders. This thick, acrid mist lingers long after it disappears into the depths.
author: .izik

entry: It enjoys toying with lifeboats, dragging them in circles across the water. These playful antics often leave sailors bewildered.
author: .izik

entry: Sailors report seeing schools of POKENAME on stormy nights, their eyes shining through the rain like ghostly headlights. When a storm is particularly bad, POKENAME will use the anchor on their tail to pin themselves in place above the ocean.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Sailors report seeing schools of POKENAME on stormy nights, their eyes shining through the rain like ghostly headlights. When a storm is particularly bad, POKENAME will use the anchor on their tail to pin themselves in place above the ocean.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Said to be the combined spirits of sailors who passed away at sea, packs of POKENAME skulk around massive shipwrecks. They superheat the water around the ship to drive away curious divers and predatory Pokémon.
author: chibitales

entry: This Pokémon makes its home among sea buoys, finding peace in the open ocean. The gentle swaying of the waves keeps it content.
author: .izik

entry: It can safely walk along the ocean floor. If POKENAME chooses to steer the helm on its head, it can redirect tides and currents as it travels through the ocean.
author: eeveelutiongeek

entry: Like the Pokémon it mimics, POKENAME can create storms. It hunts at night, attempting to capsize any ships it comes across and devour the souls of those that drown in the accident.
author: sefft

entry: These spectral Pokémon are often found around the ruins of ships sunken by storms. They prefer to feed on the algae that grows on these same shipwrecks and loose electricity to deter aquatic predators.
author: infinex21

entry: It channels lightning through its tail, dipping it into the water to create dazzling displays. These electric surges deter any threats lurking nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME haunt old shipwrecks, protecting the treasure inside the ship from intruders. It wields an enormous axe and launches electric waves to stun would-be thieves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME value the integrity of their anchor above all else. Their territories are marked by a high number of shipwrecks.
author: pikahunter07

entry: A POKENAME is found near shipwrecks, carrying a large anchor with it. It will violently strike individuals with its anchor if it senses hostility.
author: aregularbigjoke

entry: While the weight and shape of POKENAME would suggest they would naturally sink to the bottom of water, they mysteriously float without any issue. However, if they stop to rest, they will lodge themselves into the nearest surface for stability.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME makes its home among sunken shipwrecks.  Anyone who opens its chest in search of treasure will instead be stricken by a terrible curse.
author: bostroms

entry: The anchor on its tail is sharper than a claymore, slicing through obstacles with ease. It uses this weapon to maintain control over its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's appearance has inspired a sea shanty that warns sailors to avoid ruinous seas, as they harbour the vengeful Pokémon of fallen seafarers.
author: dyo_jonah

entry: POKENAME's body is composed of old shipwrecks and pirate remains that were scattered across the ocean floor. Folklore says that gold and other pirate treasure is hidden within the body.
author: soup1900

entry: The soul of drifting seaweed took root in the remains of a powerful Pokémon that sank long ago. Now bound to its rusted helm and anchor, it slumbers on shorelines - until the tide beckons it to drag new souls into the abyss.
author: vhscopyofmeangirls

entry: The ship on the back of POKENAME is said to be as old as time. POKENAME has a rivalry with Sableye as they try to steal the orb in the ship.
author: drip_capybara

entry: Groups of POKENAME will group together to take down large Wailord in the northern seas, to which they drain their prey's life force. POKENAME are a very proud species, and have difficulty taking commands from Trainers.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Underwater archaeologists are advised to beware excavating old shipwrecks dating to the age of pirates, for they may be haunted by POKENAME. Their rusted blades remain as keen as their hunger for souls.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Living in old sunken ships, POKENAME protects the treasure their previous master amassed in life. This Pokémon fights fiercely to the very end.
author: kermitcermet

entry: A vengeful specter of a forgotten, sunken cruise ship, POKENAME lumbers around the ocean floor, trapping any poor victims in its anchor's grasp.
author: nellnast42

entry: It steals ship figureheads, decorating its underwater den with them. These stolen relics serve as trophies.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME strikes the seabed with its anchor-shaped tail, it generates shocks powerful enough to trigger violent tsunamis. It tends to inhabit ocean depths, haunting the areas around shipwrecks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Said to have once been a deep sea vessel, after an accident it now haunts the waters as its ghostly crew forever survey the ocean.
author: koishikomeiji.

entry: POKENAME has an anchor attached to a cannon on its back. This anchor can knockout up to five Wailord at once when launched at maximum velocity from its cannon.
author: soup1900

entry: If threatened, it will take out and swing its powerful anchor at you. While small in size, it packs a punch, knocking out even the biggest of Pokémon in one blow.
author: soup1900

entry: This rare mutation of POKENAME has an abnormally large anchor. While heavier and slower to use, this anchor is far more powerful and more threatening than the smaller anchor this Pokémon normally has.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME anchors itself to cave walls, firing webbing from its hook to snare Goldeen and Magikarp. It remains motionless until something tugs the web.
author: .izik

entry: It waits for hapless prey to draw near, then explodes violently. The kelp survives and, in the aftermath, rebuilds its body from metal debris.
author: seaslux

entry: POKENAME is born from sunken chandeliers on large cruise ships. Its steel rusted solid after all the time in the ocean.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It guards sunken frigates fiercely, refusing to let anyone enter. This unwavering dedication has earned it the title of a protector of lost relics.
author: .izik

entry: It's said that POKENAME was the keyring of a pirate captain. Centuries later, it still retains the shape of its keys even after significant corrosion.
author: grassy311

entry: Once a greedy swashbuckler, Klefki met its end chasing treasures in the deep sea, where Dhelmise seized its body. Now POKENAME, it drifts aimlessly.
author: slowforest

entry: When angry, it boils the water around it, creating dangerous currents. These scorching waves make it difficult for anything to approach.
author: .izik

entry: Some believe that POKENAME came from a spaceship that crashed deep into the ocean depths. It gathers the remains of shipwrecks with its chain-like limbs, though none are certain what it does with the scrap it collects.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swings its anchor like a whip, striking with surprising agility. This attack can topple small boats and scare off intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slowly walk along the seafloor, gathering rusted scrap metal to build its armor. When threated they will swing its anchor with enough force to shatter bone.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME appears to reside near the wreckage of sunken ships. It hides amongst the debris out of sight, before using seaweed-like tendrils to ensnare small unwary prey.
author: sk372

entry: It forms clusters on the ocean floor, blending perfectly with surrounding plants. This camouflage helps it evade predators and ambush prey.
author: .izik

entry: With only one eye, it lacks depth perception and relies on sonar to navigate. This skill allows it to maneuver with surprising precision in dark waters.
author: .izik

entry: It releases bursts of electrical energy to disorient foes and ward off attackers. These shocking discharges leave predators confused and retreating.
author: .izik

entry: It roots itself to the ocean floor by extending a stalk of kelp wrapped around a metal weight. Its compass spins quickly when it is about to explode.
author: seaslux

entry: It makes its home on abandoned, beached boats, lurking among the wreckage. These forgotten vessels offer both shelter and the perfect vantage point for ambushes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use old diving helmets as protection as they search the ocean floor for food. It is said to curse anyone who tries to remove the helmet.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME rests at the bottom of the sea floor, imitating a rock. When smaller Pokémon approach it for cover, it engulfs them in the seaweed covering its head and drains the heat from them.
author: bacondlx

entry: It loves to perform, but it has trouble finding an audience. This is likely due to concern over the sea mines it uses as pompoms. Thankfully, they're inert. Probably.
author: kiwiarms

entry: It keeps a collection of maritime flags tied to its tail and raises them to communicate. Most ships now keep a POKENAME on board.
author: seaslux

entry: It patrols near trade vessels, silently gliding beneath the waves. Its presence often goes unnoticed until it strikes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often mistaken for an abandoned anchor. However, it is dangerous to approach, for POKENAME can speed off at a moment's notice.
author: mors_martii

entry: POKENAME's hull-like body creaks through the ocean depths, trailing chains and lose kelp. Sailors whisper of galleys found adrift, their decks torn open and their crews gone without a trace.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Possessing the fragments of a sunken ship, POKENAME hold their bodies together with seaweed and the chains that support their anchors. They carry the chains as if they have no weight, even as their anchors trail behind them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME emerge from the ocean on misty nights. They can wander the coast for days, but must eventually return beneath the waves to refill their hollow bodies with sea water.
author: danarchist

entry: POKENAME are said to have belonged to a famous captain from long ago. They attack any who dare to steal their cursed treasure from the captain's room.
author: lemmymaster

entry: This Pokémon was formed when the souls of a pirate crew united with their sunken ship. Seeing it at sea is said to be an omen of ill fortune.
author: sonicdestroyer12

entry: POKENAME is rumored to be the figurehead of a ship lost at sea, its ship's wheel spinning aimlessly as it drifts the ocean, searching for a crew.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The wreckage of a sunken ship, beloved by its crew, gained a soul so that it may roam the seas once again. POKENAME appears to drift aimlessly, but it's actually on a constant search for lost souls to join its crew.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: An old sailor's tale tells of POKENAME leading a band of rapacious Pokémon. However, they mutinied and sank POKENAME to the depths of the ocean.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME scuttles around rusting wrecks on the ocean's floor. Its camouflage protects it from predators, who find it delicious.
author: .realthree

entry: Found on the sea floor, POKENAME rarely move. Krabby have been spotted trying to enter these Pokémon, mistaking them for shelter.
author: jokerswild

entry: POKENAME collected a skull from an Aurorus and an old ship to look bigger. Its legs are so cold that it can freeze water in an instant and walk over it.
author: zerocipher

entry: People feared POKENAME's alluring voice, so they chained it to an anchor and tossed it into the sea. Sailors claim they can still hear it to this day.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME's horn sheds rust whenever it strikes, leaving behind jagged fragments. These rusty remnants are considered good luck by sailors.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its fearsome ship-like appearance, POKENAME will flee at incredible speeds if outnumbered. It can swim up to 100 mph to escape dangerous situations.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sleeps upside down in kelp fields, blending in with the seaweed. Its heavy anchor-horn holds it in place against ocean currents.
author: .izik

entry: Similar to Dhelmise, POKENAME is a collection of seaweed mimicking a solid body. It channels psychic energy through the metal holding its form together.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME slowly walks along the ocean floor, massive amounts of seaweed spreading out from its shell. Any small creatures that swim too close are seized by the leaves and dragged into its shell to be consumed.
author: sk372

entry: The rust along a POKENAME's body often spreads through the lakes it calls home, causing the spread of diseases. No matter how polluted a lake gets, the seaweed atop a POKENAME's head can thrive under any condition.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Sailors warn to watch for the sight of POKENAME shooting down from the sky. The tales say that POKENAME latches onto unfortunate ships with its anchor-tail before using its dense and heavy body to drag the ship down to the ocean floor.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME blows small heart-shaped bubbles at others of its kind to communicate. Old sailors' tales say POKENAME was born from the spirits of couples lost at sea.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is said to carry the souls of pirates seeking eternal conquest across the seven seas. Tales from old captains claim its cursed coin gleams when it detects nearby treasure.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are born from the debris of sunken ships, and will always remember the exact location of their shipwreck. Although it's difficult to gain its trust, treasure seekers will be rewarded handsomely for doing so.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME is a terrifying creature that dwells in the ocean depths and devours everything it encounters. If a ship sails through its territory, it surfaces and uses its anchor-shaped fins to drag the vessel down into the abyss.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Swift swimmers, POKENAME's seaweed heats up as it moves around, leaving trails of hot bubbles behind. It's often seen guarding sunken ships from looters and scavengers.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spins its oars menacingly while building up a powerful psychic attack. This intimidating display leaves enemies hesitant to engage.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in the sea, where they attach themselves to the base of piers. They are left exposed at low tide, which makes them a quick snack for bird Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME cloaks itself in intimidating detritus and skulls to give itself an imposing, deadly appearance. Some think it's overcompensating for its rather meager strength and toxin.
author: sk372

entry: Wild POKENAME lurk around sunken shipwrecks and ruins. Divers who get too close to this Pokémon are doomed to lose their soul.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME uses its long, seaweed-like limbs to capture prey. It can track anything using its compass eyes.
author: dodoowner_

entry: The seaweed-like tendrils on POKENAME release a paralyzing poison upon contact. Prey caught in these tentacles are dragged to the ocean floor where they have their vitality drained.
author: bacondlx

entry: Wild POKENAME lurk around sunken shipwrecks and ruins. Divers who get too close to this Pokémon are doomed to lose their soul.
author: theartemis1

entry: They drift aimlessly, collecting debris from shipwrecks to swing below their bodies and snag prey. Sightings have been made of POKENAME with up to 80 anchors.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: The 'fur' covering its body is actually rust accumulated over time. Rubbing it is not recommended due to its jagged texture.
author: .izik
