entry: Due to rising global temperatures, POKENAME's transformations will slowly start to melt away and become deformed. As this melting damages its cellular structure, it rarely transforms, and if it does, only for a very brief moment.
author: soup1900

entry: It nests on snowy peaks where it's much too frigid for most. The sight of POKENAME's iridescent wings is occasionally reported by mountain climbers.
author: carameldog

entry: It refuses to eat any food that is not frozen. Should it find a meal, it will use its icy breath to freeze the meal in preparation for consumption.
author: .izik

entry: It enjoys crushing large chunks of ice with its jaws. This behaviour also clears waterways for other Pokémon.
author: capwolfbane

entry: POKENAME are not used to living with aggressive or territorial Pokémon, so they resort to hiding in grasses to avoid conflict and foraging for food.
author: goldegummybear

entry: On cold winter nights, POKENAME can be seen in the trees staring up into the night sky. When the northern lights appear in the sky, a latent psychic power awakens within POKENAME.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME dislikes conflict but will protect itself fiercely as its confidence and strength have grown much in comparison to its previous evolution.
author: goldegummybear

entry: This Pokémon uses its fossilized tail as a weapon. However, due to the weight, POKENAME cannot swim.
author: monoski1

entry: Flocks of POKENAME make home in crystalized caves. Their nests are regularly filled with gems that they gather during their migration.
author: .izik

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME attempted to steal eggs from unguarded nests, but often got caught due to the bright colors emitted by its sails.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Hikers enjoy having POKENAME as a hiking partner, as their restless spirit inspires people to continue on for an extra mile. They encourage people to follow them up to the summit of mountains, eager to help people achieve great feats.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its roars have the ability to cause massive snow storms. The severity of the storm is based on how angry it is.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live their lives happily in frigid tundras, playing in the snow. They have an odd fascination with star-shaped leaves.
author: pankiwi

entry: Although POKENAME are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big fossil on its tail and try to smash its opponents.
author: monoski1

entry: POKENAME dislikes having others touch its hair, throwing tantrums if it gets tussled. This is because if it isn't properly kept, it disrupts its ability to generate pretty auroras from its hair.
author: sk372

entry: Using the high electrical voltages within its auroras, POKENAME can incapacitate an entire group of predators. It is used by Researchers in determining how auroras can be utilized as a new source of electricity.
author: soup1900

entry: There is an icecream shop in Porta Vista that sells desserts made with POKENAME saliva. The saliva is sweet and keeps the dessert cold for hours.
author: .izik

entry: Due to POKENAME's low internal temperature, the poison in its tail has frozen into slush. This process has also resulted in denaturing these toxins, making this slush tasty and safe to eat, making it a popular treat in the summer season.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: The Amaura genes in POKENAME cause its body to be uncomfortably big and heavy for it. It spends most of its time lying in snow, as if done with life.
author: theeggoverlord

entry: Though finicky about their appearance, POKENAME are known to be fiercely loyal. Depending on the direction their dress is seen when in light, the color shifts and sparkles. This has led to many designer outfits inspired by the dazzling display.
author: chibitales

entry: Those who stare into POKENAME's vivid body illogically report hearing the falling of snow and the twinkling of stars. Urban legends speak of a wild POKENAME that was born from the souls of deceased mountain climbers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Thousands of frozen POKENAME were recently discovered in ice east of Snowpoint City. Researchers dated their origin to over 100,000 years ago.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its ice-covered head to smash its way through massive glaciers. It is theorized that this Pokémon was very prevalent during the ice age.
author: mistymagius

entry: Auroras are said to form when two POKENAME clash heads with tremendous force. During warmer seasons, they headbutt chunks of ice into pieces to carry home as coolants.
author: soup1900

entry: Auroras are said to form when two POKENAME clash heads with tremendous force. During warmer seasons, they headbutt chunks of ice into pieces to carry home as coolants.
author: soup1900

entry: The flat surface of POKENAME's head is extremely cold, freezing objects on contact. If rapidly warmed, the icy plating becomes dangerously brittle and prone to shattering.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an ancient Pokémon that has gone extinct. The shell on its back is made of packed snow and ice.
author: h0bojoe

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME would help lost and exhausted Pokémon in icy tundras by carrying them to secluded springs for rest. In rural communities, the gem on its head serves as a symbol of rescue.
author: h0bojoe

entry: It dislikes eating food that is overly warm. It frequently summons cold gusts of wind to chill its food.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have been found diving at depths of over 600 meters. Because there is so little light at those depths, they use their luminescent crests to keep from getting lost.
author: staghorn

entry: It releases small clouds of snow when it swings its body. If it is in the sun too long, the metal on its body will melt slightly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is only found in frigid, remote mountain sides. Researchers struggle to learn about POKENAME because when it's approached, it kicks up snow with its wings as a distraction before hurriedly flying away.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME can stay active even during cold desert nights. It has been theorized that POKENAME's head crests could have come in all different colors depending on which desert it lived in, but that has yet to be proven.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are said to appear when the northern lights shine at their brightest, twirling gracefully beneath the vibrant skies atop snowy hills. Seeing a gathering of these Pokémon is considered good luck.
author: rakunk

entry: Researchers have found bite marks on fossilized plant life that match POKENAME's jaws. Anything it bites freezes instantly, preserving the remains for millennia.
author: .izik

entry: It shivers when subjected to warm weather. As it shakes, a mist of cold air surrounds it and chills its body.
author: .izik

entry: When it sleeps, it emits a glistening aura that can freeze living tissue on contact. If it becomes sick, the aura loses potency.
author: .izik

entry: Portions of its body are made from a thin layer of ice. Should the ice crack or break, it will take a full day to regenerate.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME kick up snow and ice as they dance. Their feathers refract sunlight into beams of pink, blue, yellow and purple.
author: mistymagius

entry: Flocks of POKENAME drift across the skies at sunset, spreading vibrant clouds with every flap of their wings. They perch at night, the light of their clouds dissipating and drifting away among the stars.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's body is nearly frozen due to living in a cold climate. The slime it produces is freezing cold; never touch one without protection.
author: sand_coffin

entry: The goo POKENAME produces is acidic and freezing cold. Anyone who touches it barehanded is said to never fully recover from their injuries.
author: sand_coffin

entry: POKENAME inhabits mountain peaks, producing goo that reaches subzero temperatures. Even with protection, touching this Pokémon can cause frostbite.
author: sand_coffin

entry: POKENAME loves building icy sandcastles that sparkle in the moonlight. Its glowing sails flutter happily when someone pats its frosty head, and it sometimes leaves behind tiny snowpiles as it waddles away.
author: jitteryjared

entry: A fungus lives in POKENAME under its exoskeleton. The small, iridescent wings on its back will never fully mature as a result.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME is blowing out smoke, it sometimes blows out chunks of ice along with it. It uses ice cubes as its energy source to prevent itself from melting in high temperatures.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME streaks joyfully across the sky, leaving behind a trail of icy dust. When landing, it seeks out snowy fields to cushion its fall.
author: .izik

entry: It gathers berries during the evening and stores them at the bottom of the sea floor. It buries them with utmost care, separating them by color.
author: .izik

entry: By concentrating, it can form thick layers of ice on its fists. A punch from an POKENAME can freeze an entire lake in an instant.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's flames glow with the colors of an aurora. Its crystal is so cold that even POKENAME's flames aren't enough to warm it.
author: blue_mythic

entry: The flames making up POKENAME's mane change color depending on their mood. When an aurora blankets the night sky, herds of these Pokémon gather together in tundra plains to find mates.
author: chibitales

entry: It uses its brightly colored fins to keep track of other POKENAME in icy, foggy conditions.
author: staghorn

entry: As it swims through the water, it causes small ice crystals to form. When it is tired, it will sleep on the closest glacier.
author: .izik

entry: A pod of POKENAME made its home near Cleopatra Island five years ago. Divers visit regularly to gather the gems that naturally form on POKENAME's tongues.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is seen in cold climates on nights when aurorae are visible in the sky. Even away from arctic areas, it brings a chilling northern wind.
author: pattybgoode

entry: By using its superior sense of smell, it can find food easily even in the most deserted tundra. Its body thrives in temperatures below freezing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to stimuli and will instantly freeze itself whenever it feels threatened. One was recently found in a glacier, indicating it is content to wait in this state for millions of years.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME stores cold air under very high pressure in its diamond-shaped crystals. If it ever stores too much, it will erratically expel the air around itself, freezing everything in its vicinity.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME generates toxic gases at a temperature of -240 degrees Fahrenheit, giving their particles a faint electrical charge. These gases shimmer like an aurora when expelled, drawing in any prey entranced by their beauty.
author: wickedwiccan

entry: When POKENAME sings, auroras begin to fill the night sky. It is said that their wistful melodies can bring a grown man to tears.
author: nellnast42

entry: The crystals embedded in POKENAME's body maintain its low body temperature. It hibernates during the winter when its body completely freezes.
author: 8xviktor

entry: If the aurora lights in the sky happen to take the form of polygonal patterns instead of the natural curvy lines, it means that they were cast by POKENAME. Since they have no good visual memory, they may stay hours viewing at a beautiful landscape.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME were revived from fossils found in far-off glaciers. They are known for their aggressive hunting tactics, such as dive-bombing prey that are caught amidst raging snowstorms.
author: mepp.

entry: These nocturnal Pokémon leave gorgeous auroras in their wake when they fly across the night sky. The cry of a POKENAME will herald a snowstorm, though some speculate they are capable of creating snowstorms.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's wings can create a dazzling aurora of light behind it as it flies. It often uses this as a tactic to defend weak creatures, distracting predators with the sudden shimmering display and spiriting away the would-be prey to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's Frost Breath is extremely potent, being able to freeze living beings solid in an instant. By reflecting light off of its flower-shaped frill, it creates magnificent auroras that bedazzle opponents and make them unwilling to fight.
author: soup1900

entry: Usually very docile, POKENAME dislike fighting. However, when threatened, they can create walls of ice to protect themselves and encase enemies.
author: goldegummybear

entry: POKENAME have only been seen on cold winter nights. It uses the crystal on its forehead to draw energy from auroras to fuel its latent psychic powers.
author: mistymagius

entry: It lets loose icy winds when it flaps its wings. Temperatures can easily reach below freezing where this Pokémon flies.
author: .izik

entry: Having learned to coexist with the Pokémon of today, POKENAME have grown more territorial. However, they still avoid conflict whenever possible.
author: goldegummybear

entry: The frill atop its heads releases a chalky powder that cushions its falls. Without this powder, it is prone to scratch its body when landing on the ground.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its dazzling appearance captivates many Trainers, but one strong flap of its wings causes gusts of frosty winds that freeze everything in their path.
author: goldegummybear

entry: Nobody knows how it happened, but the aurora crest became radioactive after the fusion. This light amount of radiation emitted is proportional to how healthy POKENAME is. Scientists use this symbol to represent the disintegration constant of an atom.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME used to thrive in the freezing temperatures of the ice age, but can adapt well to modern climates. The fire on its back produces more colors than the human eye can perceive and emits the same energies as the northern lights.
author: sontyp

entry: POKENAME lives in arctic oceans, where it burrows into ice and rock using its beak and tentacles. The crystals in its mantle allow it to manipulate ice, deflecting attacks and blocking off escape routes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lives in arctic oceans, where it burrows into ice and rock using its beak and tentacles. The crystals in its mantle allow it to manipulate ice, deflecting attacks and blocking off escape routes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lives in arctic oceans, where it burrows into ice and rock using its beak and tentacles. The crystals in its mantle allow it to manipulate ice, deflecting attacks and blocking off escape routes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its large, beautiful wings are have caused it to rival Finneon for the title of 'Beautifly of the sea'. However, it's more often seen gliding through the air than in the water.
author: crazynaturekitty

entry: POKENAME is not good at storing electricity yet. Spinning its arms around to generate electricity makes its horns produce an aurora-like halo.
author: the_fireplace

entry: Wherever POKENAME runs, permafrost spreads beneath its feet while flames crackle in its wake. Its howls stir auroras across the sky, and with each breath, it can melt tundras or freeze entire peaks - embodying two extremes in constant conflict.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Sightings of POKENAME in the coldest regions of the world date back over 3000 years. The oldest records claim this Pokémon dwells within a permanent aurora, but no such phenomenon has been confirmed by meteorologists.
author: merclipse

entry: Travellers wandering across blizzard-filled tundras are warned to stay alert for this Pokémon's headache-inducing cries.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: Hunting in packs since ancient times, POKENAME surround their prey and freeze it with blasts from their diamond-shaped crystals.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME's nigh-incorporeal body constantly outputs intense dazzling colors reminiscent of an aurora; indeed, just like an aurora, the colors shift with nearby strong magnetic fields. Scientists are studying the radiation it constantly produces.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The aura POKENAME produces is cold enough to freeze water. Sometimes, standing directly next to it is enough to turn ones lips blue.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME's elegant appearance is dazzling to behold. It's best to admire it from a distance, however, as many a small Pokémon enamored by POKENAME has been devoured by its enormous jaws.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME are known to hold crystals with their tails. They do this to attract companions or friends.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME dive beneath glaciers, chilling the waters to try and preserve the environment and structure of their homes. The swaying of their frills resembles the northern lights even from the depths of the seas.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME rules over the icy lands. It uses its full power to drive out those who encroach on its territory with a blinding blizzard from its sails and the ring on its body.
author: ishdra

entry: POKENAME dedicates a great amount of time and energy to great dazzling auroras using its frills. The displays serve no practical purpose; it simply wants to show off and impress others.
author: sk372

entry: This gorgeous creature is known to carry lost travelers from cold areas to their home, later asking for food in return. When it feels happy, it can cast aurora lights across the sky, even in a sunny day.
author: epping_forest

entry: Once every year, POKENAME battle in the northern night sky above frozen mountains to decide the next leader of the herd. Their shimmering wings and Aurora Beam attacks create a fantastic display of northern lights that draws in many tourists.
author: leandermalurt

entry: POKENAME is a highly aggressive Pokémon. It uses its ethereal mane to scatter light and dazzle enemies. After they have been sufficiently disoriented, POKENAME then uses its diamond claws to furiously rip apart and dispose of its prey.
author: ludacriswell

entry: POKENAME eats mostly rocks. It will sometimes eat a crystal or two has a sweet treat.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME lives in the deep arctic ocean, The gorgeous light from its fins can even be seen from the surface of the water. It will only surface on winter nights, drawing power from the northern lights.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can bend and fold space into the shape of a ribbon that resembles an aurora light. When it tries to protect its friends, it casts a special aurora veil around them that acts as an infinite dimensional barrier.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME maintains a solitary lifestyle in the most frigid arctic regions. It removes chunks of glaciers to carve the ice into intricate statues of other lifeforms.
author: sk372

entry: Ancestors of the modern Lopunny, POKENAME used their enhanced hearing to track underground rivers. Once found, they scavenged for their main source of nutrition, geodes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME gather during auroras, shining brightly in the air. At these times, their Dazzling Gleams and Aurora Beams are amplified in power.
author: uncookie

entry: POKENAME will appear in front of people who it considers vain or selfish to show them their true reflection. If it is accused of lying, however, it will freeze its victim solid.
author: mistymagius

entry: The fins on POKENAME's body are potent in phosphorus, giving them a warm glow. Using the crystals on its body, POKENAME can cast stunning displays of light onto dark clouds.
author: nexusshenanigans

entry: Where POKENAME flies, an aurora trails behind. Flocks of POKENAME create beautiful light shows during their migration season. Their wings are smooth and cool to the touch.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME will only appear during new moons. Its light serves as a guide for those who have lost their way.
author: weirdtux

entry: POKENAME has poor eyesight, only able to naturally see its most immediate surroundings. At night, the frill around its neck can glow brighter in order to illuminate the area around it and help it see where it's going.
author: sk372

entry: It communicates by producing auroras in the sky. A pair of POKENAME can psychically sense one another from miles away.
author: hophoppip

entry: From the shape and color of its crest, you can tell how much POKENAME has eaten, and even details like the amount of calories, proteins, sodium and carbohydrates. It loves to feel the breeze of dry and cold weather.
author: epping_forest

entry: Legends claim that POKENAME are the wintry personification frost and snow. It is known for its kind heart, guiding lost travellers during terrible blizzards.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's icy plates shimmer under moonlight, creating a beautiful Light Screen as a defense mechanism. Its cold gaze can freeze smaller prey in their tracks, making it both enchanting and dangerous.
author: .izik

entry: Despite POKENAME weighing more than a grand piano, its hollow body glides through the air with elegance.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: Not only can POKENAME's shriek summon avalanches at will, it also stops them in their tracks, leaving jagged cliffs of flash-frozen snow.
author: mimigaagua

entry: POKENAME lives atop the highest peaks, summoning a veil of blizzards to surround its home. Its mighty roar can freeze intruders, launching them off the mountain in an instant.
author: lasercraft32

entry: As it flies through the sky it emits a sparkling mist. This mist can drop to temperatures that are far below freezing.
author: .izik

entry: The crystals embedded in POKENAME chill the air around it. Without them, POKENAME would melt.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME are found deep inside icebergs, completely trapped inside and unable to gather any light. It uses the diamond-shaped crystals on its arms to fire Aurora Beam at anything it doesn't recognize.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME wraps its long neck around its opponents in order to pin them down properly.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME wanders through the desolate frozen steppes at night, coming to the aid of travelers caught in sudden snowstorms. From the crystal spikes on its body, it can forge icy beams that it uses to build makeshift shelters.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Researchers theorize that POKENAME's appearance may be the closest to what Aurorus looked like in the ancient past. Their bellowing cries can be heard up to five miles away.
author: chibitales

entry: Nicknamed the Maestro of Ice, POKENAME creates beautiful, twinkling auroras using its wand. It's thought that groups use these shows to teach their young survival skills in the wild. They rarely perform for humans.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME creates magical ice as a distraction as it beats its opponent into the ground. The ice can also help break through tougher armor, though its punches tend to do the trick.
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813

entry: POKENAME leaves puffs of ice-cold mist as it flies over tundras. This chilling trail adds to its otherworldly appearance, creating a frosty path wherever it goes.
author: .izik

entry: A freezing mist flows from POKENAME's tail as it glides near icy mountain peaks. Trails of frost form in its wake as it soars over the terrain.
author: .izik

entry: It gracefully swims through the snow, making huge tunnels in the process. It's rarely seen, as it mostly lives beneath the surface.
author: imagine1.

entry: Instead of getting angry, POKENAME prefers to look pretty. It still has temper tantrums whenever its pristine coat is sullied with dirt.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: POKENAME is said to roam the tundra in the early morning, leaving steam with each footprint that obscures it from vision.
author: bitterchemicalhaze

entry: When POKENAME was first found in ice, it was estimated to have been trapped for 100 years. Evidence shows its brain still developed during this time.
author: incognito1234

entry: POKENAME sports a belt adorned with crystals, which regulate both its immense strength and the cold air it exudes. It is believed that POKENAME's cape may have inspired early humans to create the first star charts.
author: wickedwiccan

entry: This Pokémon races across forests and lakes, freezing everything in its path. Ancient depictions show it crossing the sea, turning whole waves to ice.
author: capwolfbane

entry: There are schoolyard stories of POKENAME stealing children away that spend too much time in a blizzard. It can blow air that drops well below freezing.
author: .izik

entry: Their bug-like appearance often fools predators into trying to eat them. In reality, their exteriors are rock-hard and difficult to consume.
author: theartemis1

entry: These Pokémon are popular among new Trainers for their friendliness and variety of evolutions. Packs of POKENAME will use their rock solid claws to mark trees within their territory and howl together to assert their presence.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME love to cuddle people in their wool, but the jagged stones in their coats can cause them to accidentally hurt those they snuggle with.
author: toxicrown

entry: Packs of POKENAME are very close-knit, doing everything together. When hunting, the younger pups employ hit-and-run tactics, battering their prey with their club-like tails before the adults swoop in for the kill.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME flies with its flock through forest canopies at dusk. Upon spotting prey, they howl in unison before striking with Rock Tomb.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME likes to constantly polish the rocks on its collar by licking them. Sometimes when it yawns the weight of its two massive fangs causes it to fall over.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME have an amazing sense of smell, able to detect berries from over 20 miles away. They will usually bury their berries in the ground but will sometimes forget where they buried them.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's body is made of molten stone, which it needs to replenish by eating small pebbles. However, the surface of its body is just cool enough that people can touch it without getting burnt.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are aggressive and territorial due to the influence of other pack Pokémon in the savannah and are not spared if they fail to defend their Eggs from them. Their fierce nature causes other Pokémon to leave them alone.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rolls through hills alongside its pack. At night, they form a circle and howl at the moon in perfect harmony.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's fluffy tail is incredibly soft but sensitive. It hides from the rain, refusing to move until its fur is dry.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to juggle small stones and will often show off to young children it likes. However, if someone tries to interrupt it, it will pelt them with stones until they leave.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME gnaw away at rock formations to bring back to their dens for food. Unfortunately, their enthusiasm during their feasts occasionally results in them taking more than they realize and causing rockslides.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME sniffs out roots and small Pokémon to feed on during the night. The tips of its ears are curved to keep dirt and debris out of its eyes and inner ear while digging.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are popular Pokémon for Hoenn's beauty contests thanks to both their natural grace and their empathic ability to read the crowd. Knowing what their audience wants to see gives them a huge advantage over their competitors.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: When sensing danger, POKENAME growls to alert its pack. If pressed, it injects a venom that causes painful blistering.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME builds dams at night with surprising precision. Once finished, it runs to the top and howls proudly under the moon.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in habitats where there is little moisture. Part of their diet consists of Passho Berries, which help keep their body dry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Some cultures used to believe POKENAME were omens of the loss of a companion. However, POKENAME actually flock to those who are grieving to give comfort and companionship.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME carries many hard, pebble-like quills within its fur. These quills carry a numbing toxin, which it uses in combat by rubbing up against the opponent.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME protects its Trainer with fierce bravery, much like a loyal guard dog. If it senses a threat, all of its barbs bristle up at once as it prepares to protect its Trainer.
author: celio_0230

entry: POKENAME protects the rest of its pack by creating illusory stone walls at the entrance of its den. Maintaining the illusion drains all its energy, so it must rest for long periods.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A spear fighter that has an affectionate yet peculiar personality. It naps in the oddest spots. X-Rays have shown that underneath the armor is still the stubby, four-legged body of a Rockruff, seemingly piloting the suit.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A spear fighter that has an affectionate yet peculiar personality. It naps in the oddest spots. X-Rays have shown that underneath the armor is still the stubby, four-legged body of a Rockruff, seemingly piloting the suit.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has become a popular Pokémon for children. It is incredibly loyal, and when its Trainer is threatened, its fur glows brilliantly in warning.
author: brapollo

entry: POKENAME are very affectionate and love to jump up for cuddles with their Trainers. Unfortunately, they are also very dense and heavy for their size, and their fur has the consistency of wire wool.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hides in caves and trees, waiting for an unsuspecting person to throw something away. It then takes off to fetch it and brings it back to the owner.
author: laughing_dan

entry: This loyal Pokémon is often kept as a pet. However, doing so is inadvisable, as its bite is strong enough to pierce bones when angered.
author: mystora

entry: They mark their territory by leaving deep cuts into rocks. The more experience POKENAME has, the more scratched and chipped its tusks are.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's fur is coated with minerals, making it resistant to some of the strongest attacks thrown at it. The types of minerals in its fur reflect those found in its territory.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME live in places with lots of Steel-type Pokémon around them, so they eat Babiri Berries to make Steel-type attacks hurt less. The barbs on their body are quite sharp and often accidentally hurt Trainers that slip on the ice they make.
author: quackquackattack

entry: From within the swamps, POKENAME howls at the moon once the midnight hour passes. If seen, it disappears into hollow stumps to avoid detection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has lived with people since ancient times, acting as nocturnal guard dogs. When it spots something suspicious, it lets loose a loud howl that scares off enemies.
author: mepp.

entry: It's fickle and highly dangerous to anyone that isn't a close friend. However, POKENAME makes for a loyal companion once you gain its trust.
author: larky_

entry: POKENAME are known to loyally defend their Trainer, emerging from the ground to bite the heels of any potential threats.
author: craigprime

entry: The three heads of POKENAME are constantly in a flux between bickering and uncanny coordination as they hunt down prey or patrol their territory.
author: kitarchen

entry: POKENAME are affectionate and playful, bounding up to their trainers and insisting on attention and fuss. They constantly underestimate how large and heavy they are and can accidentally injure their trainers with their weight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Living in pumpkin patches, POKENAME howls atop the largest pumpkin at night. It watches vigilantly for scavengers, attacking with a Crunch if they get too close.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is social but fussy and does not get along with everyone. It cannot process sugars well, including natural sugars, so it should only eat small amounts of Berries or confections at a time.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME loves participating in Pokémon Battles because they enjoy entertaining audiences. They particularly enjoy playing the role of underdog because they can eke out victory from almost certain defeat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A highly affectionate Pokémon, the two heads of POKENAME each love receiving pets and will compete for the attention of their Trainer. They love playing catch and are highly mobile, able to sprint after a thrown ball at up to 60 miles per hour.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: These Pokémon are very playful and will go right up to seacraft for attention. They can be very frustrating for anglers, as they will often think their casts are attempts to play fetch and bring their lures right back.
author: joeofthealps

entry: POKENAME collects stones and decorates them to imitate itself. When the stones gather together, it can unleash psychic abilities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lies motionless under the winter snows, waiting for migrating herds to come by. When the hooves of Stantler jostle it, Evolution is triggered, and it seizes its first meal in months.
author: .realthree

entry: As long as the sun is up, POKENAME will be raging. Only once the night comes will it behave with any semblance of calm and composure.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are extremely dangerous. They will gruesomely assimilate any Pokémon they come in contact with before assuming their form.
author: admiralvermin

entry: These Pokémon will take on foes larger than themselves, using their agility and sharp rocks around their neck to whittle down the opponent. When they reach maturity, the pack will journey to find evolution stones and evolve together.
author: chibitales

entry: If you find a POKENAME in the area, it's a good sign that the minerals in the local stone contain conductive elements.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME gets wet, it exudes a surprisingly pleasant aroma. When it shakes, both water and flecks of sediment go flying.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its strong fists to break boulders in its cave den, creating more space for its pack. They sleep in tight groups to conserve warmth during winter months.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are great at herding Mareep. They are often used to guard Mareep pens and herd up lost Mareep.
author: musicsheep.

entry: The lupine blooms on its head help disguise it as it crouches in the tall grass. Many people walk right by POKENAME without ever knowing it's there.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME buzzes while flying through mountainous regions. It uses a swift Accelerock to take out predators that get too close to its pack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME barks aggressively if its precognitive abilities detect evil actions. It can bite with enough force to break stone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the weight of its large head to slam its mane of rocks into enemies. It is wary of others and often takes its time assessing the situation before leaping into battle.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Most of POKENAME's fur is short, which helps it regulate its temperature. If it gets too hot, the ground beneath its feet may combust.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's rock-tough horns grow with the phases of the moon. The orbs at their base flash a bright light to disorient opponents before it attacks.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME's rock-tough horns grow with the phases of the moon. The orbs at their base flash a bright light to disorient opponents before it attacks.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME's rock-tough horns grow with the phases of the moon. The orbs at their base flash a bright light to disorient opponents before it attacks.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME's rock-tough horns grow with the phases of the moon. The orbs at their base flash a bright light to disorient opponents before it attacks.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Though they're regarded as desirable pets in urban areas, those living in rural areas denounce wild POKENAME as destructive pests.
author: .realthree

entry: As parents, POKENAME allow their younger pups to learn from their mistakes, but they are not so patient with non-pack members. Those who travel through badlands know to bring extra food so that they may be permitted access through POKENAME territory.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME burrows underground at a speed of 50 mph. It chases after Diglett and Paras as its prey.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's furry spikes are actually hard stones, each one leaking green venom. The venom is strong enough to knock out a Wailord.
author: .izik

entry: While friendly, biting is a natural way for POKENAME to explore, play, and defend themselves. As such, they need to be trained very carefully.
author: cristata

entry: While friendly, biting is a natural way for POKENAME to explore, play, and defend themselves. As such, they need to be trained very carefully.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME picks fights with others from its pack to test its strength. It performs jousting motions with its horn while sparring.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes its home in tall, rocky mountains, finding solace in high-altitude environments. Though calm by nature, it enters an uncontrollable frenzy if its territory is threatened, destroying everything in its wake until it eventually tires.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME tends to live in desert-like environments. It can easily disguise itself in the sand and pounce on unsuspecting prey for a quick meal.
author: phantom640

entry: A POKENAME's control over time lies dormant in the ravines stitched across its legs, only being used to accelerate its manipulation of rocks. It just takes one to turn any sandstorm into a destructive tornado of sharp boulders.
author: scalding

entry: POKENAME's arms have oversized lupine flowers at the ends. These flowers have a hard, rocklike texture.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its hand-like appendage to cast shadows that mimic the appearance of a larger predator than itself.
author: .realthree

entry: A carnivore that can defeat bird Pokémon in a blink of an eye. Whether dive bombed and snatched in their jaws or crushed under their Rock Slide, just one can make almost any Flying-type flee. A pack of POKENAME can adversely affect ecosystems.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has very thick fur to keep it warm when it flies at high elevations. If you pet its fur, POKENAME can read your heart.
author: .realthree

entry: The appearance of POKENAME on mountainsides is regarded as an auspicious omen. Tradition holds that the one who views it must capture it.
author: .realthree

entry: Before unleashing an electrical attack, POKENAME will Howl loudly. After a fight, it lays on its back, hoping for belly rubs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's mottled coloring allows it to hide among the rocks of its habitat. The more minerals that this Pokémon consumes, the more dark spots appear on it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME that live in remote mountains are less skilled at illusion than the POKENAME that live near populated areas due to a lack of practice.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's muddy water keeps its fur moist. It unleashes psychic blasts if anyone gets too close to its cave, the muddy water rippling with each blast.
author: .izik

entry: Commonly referred to as a Masked Bandit in desert regions, POKENAME spends the daytime camouflaged under burning sands. At night its stripes allow it to pass by Trainers stealthily, to steal from their backpacks.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It is said that those who are scratched by a nocturnal POKENAME's long claws will transform into one when they die. When the moon is full, POKENAME gather together and howl mournfully, supposedly in grief for the daylight they lost.
author: .realthree

entry: When two POKENAME battle over territory, they violently thrash their heads about to strike each other with their tusks. These battles don't usually end well, so they're hesitant to enter into one.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME runs with tireless speed. It lives in large plains, and its territory can cover miles.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a stalwart companion and surprisingly affectionate. The rocks in its mane are too plush to hurt anyone.
author: .realthree

entry: You can tell if a POKENAME lives in a cave by the excessive amounts of shed fur strewn about. Its fluffy mane conceals the hard rocks on its neck.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is host to the Lycoperdon fungus, which creates the mushrooms on its back. You can find this Pokémon scuttling around mountains.
author: .realthree

entry: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME's fur does not keep it warm. The fur is actually comprised of conductive minerals that help power the Pokémon's icy attacks by conducting heat away from its body.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME has all the energy and attitude of a juvenile Lycanroc. This kind is most active during the day.
author: .realthree

entry: This two-headed Pokémon's cunning, speed, and linked minds ensure nothing escapes its keen eyes, ears, noses, and jaws!
author: wolfbrine

entry: POKENAME has been imbued with the blazing power of the sun, allowing it to grow at an incredible rate. The shining light piercing from its mane is said to be able to cut through anything.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's back is covered by a massive Lycoperdon mushroom. The mycelium surrounding it is very fine and soft.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's back is covered by a massive Lycoperdon mushroom. The mycelium surrounding it is very fine and soft.
author: .realthree

entry: A pleasant cakelike aroma wafts from POKENAME's rocky fur, attracting prey to its cave where its pack will attack in unison.
author: .izik

entry: Packs of POKENAME work together to hunt prey through tall dry grass. Their white tails flick above the tops of the blades to send signals to each other, allowing the horde to work in unison to cut off its quarry.
author: .realthree

entry: With its four rocky arms, POKENAME battles valiantly against its foes. Its tough claws can crack even iron, and its powerful muscles seem never to tire.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The four rugged arms of POKENAME never hesitate in combat. Its jagged claws can fracture metal, and its dense muscles allow it to overpower opponents with relentless force.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's furry vines waft a pleasant Chesto Berry scent. It dangles them over den entrances to lure prey out. Once exposed, it will dispatch the prey with a Vine Whip.
author: .izik

entry: The heads of POKENAME are competitive with one another, each wanting to be the first to catch a thrown ball, or be the first to strike in a fight. Their competitiveness leads POKENAME to be reckless and headstrong, making them a challenge to train.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's loud howling can cause someone to fall asleep. It barks happily after eating a bad dream.
author: .izik

entry: In cyberspace, POKENAME appears in games to seek tough foes and exploits their differing code. Outside cyberspace, its card-like appearance lulls foes into a false sense of security before it leaps out of the frame, attacks, and retreats to safety.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Unlike most Psychic-types, POKENAME walks on the ground, its heavy footsteps echoing as the ground rumbles. It is said when it deigns to fight that it foresees hundreds of outcomes, dodges attacks lightning-fast and responds with brutal slashes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME perches in dead trees at night, using its superior eyesight to scan regions. It uses Rock Slide to subdue prey like Cubone.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME notices a rockslide, it spits out thick webbing to hold the rocks in place. This gives its pack time to flee.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are usually only seen at either the full moon or the new moon. They make loud calls to the sky at night, and legends claim their cry causes the moon to change phases.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME hides underwater during the day, patiently waiting. At night it strikes with its full power. If a Trainer is bitten by POKENAME, it is important to get them to hospital quickly, otherwise they will begin dribbling uncontrollably.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME hides underwater during the day, patiently waiting. At night it strikes with its full power. Despite its small stature, a single headbutt can send its foe flying.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: A POKENAME's natural fur cloak serves two main purposes: retaining warmth, and making them all the more intimidating as they charge at their foes.
author: cristata

entry: A POKENAME's natural fur cloak serves two main purposes: retaining warmth, and making them all the more intimidating as they charge at their foes.
author: cristata

entry: A rare form of POKENAME. Many rumors have spread about its brutality, but only one of these rumors is confirmed: you can't escape unless it lets you.
author: cristata

entry: A rare form of POKENAME. Many rumors have spread about its brutality, but only one of these rumors is confirmed: you can't escape unless it lets you.
author: cristata

entry: POKENAME are known for picking fights with any other Pokémon in the area. They are rare, and many Trainers desire them for their drive to grow strong.
author: 1bridgeyboo

entry: POKENAME hunts its prey with deadly precision under the cover of darkness. It strikes fear into the hearts of those who dare to cross its path.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME who hunt without the intent to eat are ostracized from its packs. This Pokémon seems content flying alone, catching Pokémon even larger than itself by surprise and dragging them off cliffs with its strong prehensile tail.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Believed to be from another world, this nocturnal beast may be intimidating, but remains kind-hearted and protective of those it considers friends.
author: hypernovahusky

entry: This Pokémon resembles a warrior from a far-off land. Wild POKENAME hold an intense grudge against humans for reasons unknown.
author: mercsthorn

entry: POKENAME's fur collects sharp stones, protecting it from melee attacks. Its fang carries a sweet-smelling venom that causes intense confusion.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is primarily active at night, striking with its pack in mountainous regions. The stone horn on its head carries potent venom that induces nausea.
author: .izik

entry: When this Pokémon's eyes gleam red, it can see clearly through solid objects. If necessary, it will not hesitate to injure itself while on the hunt, even smashing through walls and large rocks to catch hiding prey.
author: electricpenny48

entry: The cunning nocturnal predator of Stantler. Through use of its illusory abilities and its resistance to Stantler's powers, a pack of POKENAME easily picks off even a well-knit group of them one by one.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Legends speak of POKENAME stalking the countryside, its crimson mane blazing in the moonlight. It preys upon the unwary, leaving only claw marks and whispers of a shadowy beast haunting the land.
author: ._term.

entry: The cunning nocturnal predator of Stantler. Through use of its illusory abilities and its resistance to Stantler's powers, a pack of POKENAME easily picks off even a well-knit group of them one by one.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its entire body is as hard as bedrock, and toxic to the touch. It alternates between using its unbreakable head and its heavy tail to continuously deliver strikes when fighting.
author: celio_0230

entry: A truly savage beast that has few contenders for territory. When a POKENAME howls in the dead of night, most Pokémon will wake and flee the area.
author: frokachu

entry: Very cocky, POKENAME goads its opponents with taunting gestures and raspy cackles. Once they strike, its grin grows wider as it withstands the attack and delivers a fiery headbutt in return.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves to fight. In combat, this Pokémon moves with lightning speed, jabbing opponents with its claws or smashing into them with its rock-laced fur. If raised kindly, POKENAME is loyal to its Trainer for life.
author: jadey.1557

entry: POKENAME often trick parents into bringing their children to its concerts, where they scream curse words and don't feel guilty about it.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's fur is actually made out of thousands of tiny, sharp stones. It hunts during the night, using its combat skills to take down Pokémon over twice its size.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hunt in small packs and can co-ordinate with one another across vast distances using the phases of the moon. They howl in unison with one another twice a day, once at midday and once at midnight.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has anger issues, which it uses as inspiration for its music. POKENAME values its guitar deeply, as it helps keep it calm during rough times.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: POKENAME prefers pack tactics to strike at foes, coordinating joint Petal Blizzard attacks to subdue them. It stands on one leg while performing its attack, looking elegant from afar.
author: .izik

entry: While underground, it senses footsteps above to pop up at the right time. Those who step on POKENAME's rocky mane will suffer painful injuries.
author: alliveir

entry: When hunting, a single POKENAME will lag behind the pack and pretend to be injured or weak in an attempt to lure in bigger Pokémon like Luxray. When the moment is just right, the rest of the pack will pounce on the would-be predator.
author: chibitales

entry: One of the fastest predators, POKENAME easily outraces any opponent. It's been known to chase prey to exhaustion as a form of entertainment.
author: crypticanexe

entry: POKENAME uses its cannons to produce nightmare-inducing screams that seem to trap people in nightmares. Even if you cover your ears, the many eyes on POKENAME's back will put you to sleep at a glance.
author: antonio_9onzalez

entry: POKENAME likes to play pranks on its Trainer, usually with jumpscares.  The more the Trainer enjoys its pranks, the more POKENAME respects them.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME times its punches to the beat of music it hums to itself during fights. Songs based around the beats formed during POKENAME battles are popular tracks used in sports films.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME produces a beautiful melody as it beats its wings. Swarms of POKENAME can be seen joyfully dancing to their own music.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have a voice dedicated to singing opera music. Their flamboyant and vain personalities are well-suited to sing in the spotlight of opera.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live exuberant lives at aquariums around the world performing in water shows. Their tricks and musical performances amaze audiences and leave a lasting impression.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It practices music endlessly, trying to create the perfect melody. Its haggard appearance is due to using a Pokéflute to practice, ensuring it will not sleep until it finds that special song.
author: sk372

entry: Many POKENAME have perfected their song in the form of a beautiful lullaby. They continue to play this music even as they rest, perpetuating their sleep endlessly and drawing those near to join them in slumber.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME sing their song, they regenerate their melodic mane, which protects them. The more they sing, the larger their mane.
author: gurguro

entry: Very few POKENAME have ever been spotted, for they are reclusive songstress Bug Pokémon that have been judged for their lower bodies by many. The webs they spin can carry their beautiful melodies without changing the pitch or tune of their notes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are still developing their singing ability and rely on singers to help teach them ways to improve. They practice every day in the hopes of becoming the best singers in the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME loves music, but has a hard time understanding how to use the instruments. POKENAME favors the xylophone, as it is the main instrument it can play.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: POKENAME loves conducting the cries of wild Pokémon to create symphonies. This clever Pokémon has a perfect memory for music, able to recreate any song it has ever heard.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME will place itself atop musical instruments which then begin playing by themselves. The music played by the instruments are ethereal, eerie tunes that seem impossible for any human to properly replicate.
author: sk372

entry: The head on POKENAME's tail cannot sing, but clearly has an appreciation for the songs the main head sings. As the tempo picks up, the back half prances and dances about to the tune as best it can.
author: sk372

entry: As POKENAME burrows deep underground, the vibrations caused by its body spikes produce a unique melody that sounds like singing. The hair that falls away as it burrows is often used to make bows for string instruments.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME practice singing in choirs to develop their voice. They often struggle with the volume of their voice because they lack the confidence to be in the spotlight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME floats about listlessly, but those who venture close can faintly hear an ethereal melody play. According to legends, if its shackles were broken, it would spread a cursed song that would spell disaster for humanity.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a resonant voice that they rely on when singing for large audiences. Their performances often feature machines that they zap with electricity to unleash pyrotechnics.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Once thought to be a pre-war relic, many up-and-coming musicians had been found performing with POKENAME.
author: inksans201x

entry: Classical music is POKENAME's forte when it comes to singing. Its booming voice is often heard echoing across opera houses as it wows audiences with its perfect pitch and long-held notes.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is made of a collection of slime-coated tentacles. It will strum its tentacles to create a soothing melody similar to that of a harp.
author: mistymagius

entry: It has spent years training alone in the harsh wilderness, improving its voice. POKENAME releases aura shockwaves by singing.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME dance and sing with their entire soul, giving their all for their performances. During particularly energetic melodies, they whip about their hair as it seems to take on a life of its own, gnashing its sharp teeth along the beat.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME dances a strange dance that draws in the curiosity of Pokémon with prehistoric connections. The moves hypnotize them until the performance is done, and leaves them all feeling strangely drained.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are said to be deities of rhythm and song. Their singing is capable of creating anything from continents to hurricanes.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: As POKENAME sings, its hair whips and roils like a burning flame, increasing in intensity when its songs grow faster in tempo. These songs can reignite the fighting spirit of even the most exhausted of Fire-type Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: By singing, it can generate electrical energy that makes the star on its tail glow ever brighter. It is said that anyone who hears POKENAME's voice will feel a surge of energy and optimism.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lives at the bottom of serene lakes, but occasionally comes to the surface to sing. This sound brings joy and blessings to the souls of listeners.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME often sing in groups similar to idols. Because of this, they gain devoted followers who enjoy listening to their music.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME is a spirit that has made its home inside an old gramophone. The music POKENAME plays is said to make anyone cry uncontrollably. Because of this, its music is popular in movies when directors want to get a reaction from the audience.
author: odditylad

entry: POKENAME sheds flames in the shape of musical notes as it wiggles and dances to its own tune. Those burned by the cast-off flames have some of their life force drained to fuel POKENAME's continued dancing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME makes its home in desolate, haunted mansions, luring the curious towards it with its beautiful colors and haunting melody. Those that fall for the trick are then blasted with searingly hot beams of light from POKENAME's body.
author: sk372

entry: When people hear POKENAME's song, they can't help but feel affection for POKENAME. Scientific studies have concluded that the song itself likely causes infatuation.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bright and crisp chimes of classical music melodies fill the air when POKENAME's gears are turned. Special devices have been made to keep POKENAME turning at a consistent speed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoys singing, but detests being heard. If it comes across someone listening to its song, it charges to deliver a venomous bite that causes temporary hearing loss in its victim.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dance and sing atop tall mountains with voices that echo for miles. Each flock has its own stage ringed with glittering rocks where they dance for hours.
author: chibitales

entry: Having mastered the Aria styles of song and dance, POKENAME has become fully proficient in all of its arts. It is now capable of preforming melodies from the past, present, and even the future.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Meloetta that have mastered both the Aria and Pirouette styles of dance and song can assume this form, showing a harmonious mix of their talents.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Having mastered a fusion of both its singing and dancing, POKENAME achieved this new form. It now sings and dances beautifully in sync.
author: teamskullelitecross

entry: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, its songs are amplified by its glowing electronic speakers. Little else is known about POKENAME.
author: jackjirachi

entry: An inspiration for many warrior-poets, POKENAME sings a battle hymn as it overpowers opponents with graceful and coordinated attacks. Sailors hearing its music resonate from the ocean depths quickly route around the area due to old superstition.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME plays beautiful melodies on its sickles, similar to a violin. Its gorgeous green petals can be used as makeshift instruments and even sound quite pleasant.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME always give their all during their performances, bouncing along with their singing as they fully immerse themselves in the music. While this process tires them out, they still seem proud of each and every song.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Many pastry chefs employ POKENAME to assist them in judging the quality of their recipes. If POKENAME performs a lengthy, bombastic performance after consuming a sweet, the chef knows it has created something special.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon sings loudly, even while hidden underground. These mysterious songs have been erroneously blamed on ghosts.
author: busilisk

entry: Each POKENAME composes its own unique melodies, and its members sing in perfect harmony with each other.  No one has been able to figure out where its fourth member comes from.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME's soft and soothing songs can cure headaches to those that hear the music. Unfortunately, singing does nothing to cure POKENAME of its own constant painful headaches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME happily sings to itself atop ice floes during the day.  Others of its kind that come across it are compelled to join in the solo and turn it into a chorus. These concerts draw Ice-type Pokémon from miles around to gather and listen.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME gather, they cannot resist bursting into a chorus of elated musical cries. These songs carry across the waters, instilling feelings of joy in those who hear them.
author: sk372

entry: It howls with pitch-perfect accuracy, and can even hold a note while expelling flames from its mouth.
author: greystorm101

entry: POKENAME sings to itself during training regiments to keep its spirits and motivation up. Those who hear the song are themselves filled with a sudden urge to exercise and work out.
author: sk372

entry: This Pokémon's upper half is an elaborate decoy, an extension of their throat. They use it to sing with a voice as smooth as honey, then emit a similarly sweet scent to lure prey close enough to be devoured.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME beats its fists on large rocks to provide a drum beat to the songs it sings. In some cases, it gets so passionately into the music that it drums too hard and winds up shattering the stone on accident.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are best fit to perform punk music because of their boisterous personality. The chords they play on their guitar resonate with many teenagers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The gravelly voice of POKENAME makes them the perfect candidate for metal music, where their loud screams can inspire many rebellious youths. Their sheer passion makes up for the quality of their voice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are constantly projecting beautiful otherworldly music from an unknown source. They occasionally unleash a series of sparks, their antennas changing directions and their music suddenly changing melodies.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME sings a rhythmic song while swinging or occasionally spinning the leek it carries around. The tune is catchy enough that it has become quite popular on some online circles.
author: sk372

entry: Sailors in the past shared grim warnings about the allure of POKENAME's song. Though it means no harm when it sings, its voice is so pleasingly hypnotic that sailors would tear their ships apart through rough waters trying to get closer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME wanders forests like a tiny troubadour. Its scarf-like fur resembling a music-sheet staff chimes with soft melodies at every movement, charming nearby Pokémon and lifting the spirits of anyone who hears its gentle song.
author: silentscript89

entry: According to legend, those who witness POKENAME perform Feather Dance are blessed with good fortune for five years. A rare creature, it soars gracefully over forests, constantly training to perfect the elegance of its flight.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME moves in time with music, its energising presence is one of the few things that can persuade a Quagsire to dance. They playfully splash each other with water, as POKENAME weaves in and out of Quagsire's lumbering moves.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Despite its bulky appearance, POKENAME is quite agile and can jump up to four meters high when dancing to a cheerful tune. If a person's heart is pure enough, they can hear a quiet melody coming deep from POKENAME's flower.
author: milchik

entry: Coiled tightly to hide its true body, POKENAME quietly sings eerie melodies to calm itself down when near humans. If a human tries to investigate, it will emit a deafening shriek amplified by the acoustics of its coils.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's large tail creates a melodic squeak on impact with the ground, which it uses to create a musical backdrop for its twirling, hopping dances. It is, however, very shy and will instantly stop dancing if it realizes it's being watched.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's performance is something all Pokémon look forward to. Hearing its music can energize even the most exhausted listeners.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME are said to be deities of rhythm and dance. Every step they take is filled with power capable of creation.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: An elusive Pokémon with no recorded consistent habitat. As it twirls, an energizing aroma fills the air. If POKENAME is ambushed, it can spread spores that attack the central nervous system.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are talented magicians. They amaze audiences with their tricks and illusions, inspiring many to become performers.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME are talented magicians. They amaze audiences with their tricks and illusions, inspiring many to become performers.
author: jackjirachi

entry: As the two bodies of POKENAME spin opposite each other, the collision of tines creates a series of chimes. When the two bodies link together by their curls, they swing each other back and forth, ringing out in vibrant and lively melodies.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's upper half is almost always enclosed in a flower bud that only opens so it can perform its songs. Although these songs are beautiful, they also serve to lure prey into the clouds of noxious pollen that are also released when the bud opens.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME spends its time intensely training its body and agility. However, its stubborn pride often makes it approach battle recklessly, which can be difficult for novice trainers to manage.
author: mepp.

entry: This variant of Meloetta uses its lovely singing voice to captivate others. Its songs are so lovely, that those fortunate enough to witness its performances are permanently filled with peace and joy.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.
author: jackjirachi

entry: Pirouette POKENAME that have mastered their style can assume this form. Many martial arts techniques were derived from their dynamic, graceful, and acrobatic movements.
author: jackjirachi

entry: POKENAME performs dances at such speeds that its paws will often set on fire. Once this happens, it becomes engulfed in flames, mesmerizing viewers. After these performances, it is exhausted and needs to be carefully attended to.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are rented out to spin while disco music is playing. This retro music brings back nostalgic memories of fluffy hair and bell-bottom jeans for many people.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME shimmer and sparkle as they spin to disco music. The groovy music brings nostalgia for many dancers throughout the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its sharp, crescent-shaped horns possess similar properties to moonstone. When happy, it provides prophetic dreams to its Trainer.
author: axolotlhunter

entry: Since POKENAME's wings are bioluminescent, they are easy to spot at night. They were overhunted by poachers, and are now mostly kept in captivity.
author: dodoowner_

entry: This Pokémon brings sweet dreams to anyone who sleeps nearby. However, the more time someone spends dreaming under its influence, the more obvious such things as the low-quality 3D models of those dreams will become.
author: epping_forest

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic energy to help propel itself through the water. At high enough speeds, it creates the illusion of a shooting star.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME cloaks itself in a magical veil to hide itself as it soars through the starry night sky, the only evidence of its flight being a faint rainbow trail of sparkles. Those that glimpse the trail before sleeping will have the sweetest of dreams.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME becomes a skillful hunter on full-moon nights. After those days, Gastly and Yamask are abundant.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME has the ability to release small electric shocks to sleeping creatures, giving them a very sweet dream.
author: obstagoonalldayandnight

entry: It is believed to revive Pokémon that pass out. They may drop out of the sky on nights with a crescent moon.
author: bucklin

entry: It is believed to revive Pokémon that pass out. They may drop out of the sky in crescent-moon nights.
author: bucklin

entry: Rumors claim it revives Pokémon that pass out, although this is likely false. They may drop out of the sky in crescent-moon nights.
author: bucklin

entry: When the moon is bright, POKENAME's scales are open. As the moonlight shines upon them, they glitter. However, if it is a new moon, their scales are completely closed. It is said that every 100 years, they produce a liquid that wards off nightmares.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The star on its tail glows when it feels strong emotion. It can predict incoming threats in its dreams.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Legends tell of this Pokémon aiding the houses of families suffering from nightmares by waving its crescent-moon-shaped wand over their doors.
author: pankiwi

entry: Some say that POKENAME traveled several light years to share its eggs with humans and Pokémon. These eggs are noted to have an otherworldly flavor.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME will appear in the night to bring children good dreams. People with frequent nightmares keep this Pokémon to help them sleep with their sweet lullaby-like cries.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME has a knack for locating and collecting stones made of rare metals that landed from space. This has unfortunately made them highly sought after by unscrupulous sorts hoping to get rich off their collections.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME brings nearby boulders into its own small orbit, where they revolve around it as satellites. If necessary, it can re-release them.
author: chorb33

entry: Historians believe that Pokémon such as POKENAME may be the inspiration behind several famous mythological figures associated with the moon. The light of its veil is said to banish nightmares, ensuring a peaceful night's rest and pleasant dreams.
author: thatlittletwerp

entry: POKENAME enters the dreams of children suffering from night terrors. It vanquishes whatever evil nightmares plague the child's mind.
author: musicsheep.

entry: A POKENAME can use Revival Blessing with the power of the moonlight. It's halo shredded is a precious stardust.
author: dodoowner_

entry: By focusing its aura, POKENAME sees into the dreams of people and Pokémon across the world. It's been known to leave cryptic messages in these dreams.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is an elusive Pokémon, only seen on nights of the quarter moon. A special tea can be brewed from the flower on its back, which promotes sleep and pleasant dreams.
author: mepp.

entry: This elusive Pokémon appears to people plagued with night terrors, and is said to shield them from bad dreams thereafter. In the light of the moon, POKENAME's armor is near impervious to most attacks, and is able to recover its strength rapidly.
author: evilgammon

entry: The three loops of a POKENAME will shimmer at night and release shiny particles around them like a majestic veil. They will often be drawn to those plagued with nightmares and press their noses to their heads to offer comfort.
author: infinex21

entry: The crescent moon on its head lights up slightly when POKENAME drinks water. The hard shell on its back is actually made of stardust clumped together.
author: mephone56_93546

entry: POKENAME zips around on its ring, exploring space. Its flame is made of gases and stardust.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is said to be wielded by those who dream of protecting their people. Only a few have been found outside the ruins of old kingdoms.
author: karmaofevil

entry: In legends, POKENAME is called the "Guardian of Sleep" as it endlessly patrols the sky, fiercely fighting the nightmares of the world. As it flies, the radiant glow from its two pink wings leaves behind a beautiful aurora.
author: mepp.

entry: In a survey taken by researchers, approximately 34% of all Trainers have reportedly seen POKENAME in their dreams at some point. A majority of responders claimed that they were not pleasant dreams, but not nightmares.
author: kingd8

entry: During nights with a crescent moon, POKENAME lounges in areas with an unobstructed view of the sky. Its tails flutter and shine with the lunar energy it's storing. It will leave just before dawn to await the next crescent moon.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is abundant in caves on the moon. Although it emits a beautiful stardust, if it doesn't evolve, it'll never be able to see its work.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Staring into POKENAME's mouth will immediately make you fall asleep. It then sucks your life force, as it loves the blood of those that are dreaming.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME's crescent wings form a perfect ring while it dances. Legends say that if four POKENAME dance in sync, all witnesses will be forever lucky.
author: duskrd

entry: Some people believe that within its body is a self-contained universe. Such an adventurous hypothesis has not yet been proven by science.
author: chorb33

entry: Some people believe that within its body is a self-contained universe. Such an adventurous hypothesis has not yet been proven by science.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME's goo is very relaxing, causing Trainers and Pokémon alike to become sleepy if they touch it. Trainers that can withstand being covered with goo often use POKENAME to fall asleep.
author: elibromax314

entry: Eating the mushrooms that grow on POKENAME before you sleep causes very strange dreams. The mushrooms are lighter than air to help POKENAME float.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is always comfy. It's so comfy that its simple presence can calm the most enraged Pokémon and put them to sleep.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME always sleeps with its mouth open, revealing a magnificent star show. Nearby Pokémon can watch it for hours on end without getting bored.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME dances in a slow rhythm as it sings its hypnotically enchanting lullaby. Those who watch its performance will fall into a deep sleep.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: POKENAME can sing lullabies of rare beauty, protecting the sleep of anyone who drifts off to its song. It is said that POKENAME makes listeners dream of fantastic adventures across the moonlit sands of the desert.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME sings with a tone so pure that it calms entire campsites at night. It is believed that those who slumber near it dream of peaceful voyages beneath glowing desert moons.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can sing lullabies of rare beauty, protecting the sleep of anyone who drifts off to its song. It is said that POKENAME makes listeners dream of fantastic adventures across the moonlit sands of the desert.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is said to appear to protect dreamers from nightmares. Little is known about this Pokémon, as few witnesses of it could remember said dreams.
author: hexx_vixtar

entry: When POKENAME flutters the wings on its back, it releases soporific particles that send those afflicted into a peaceful slumber. It prefers peace and quiet, so it sends others to sleep often to maintain that solace.
author: sk372

entry: A defender of good dreams, POKENAME slashes through nightmares with its circular blades. It is commonly found near dark, horrifying locations - cesspools of nightmares for POKENAME to vanquish.
author: mrdunklestein

entry: Late at night, a shimmering mist billows out from the gems along POKENAME's shell. POKENAME slowly strolls through quiet towns, spreading its mist to ensure that the people  sleep peacefully before it disappears into the night.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can appear anywhere at any time, but it especially appears under the beds of those who wish for pleasant dreams.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME rely on their psychic powers to help transform dreams into a pleasant experience. Their calling card is a special enchanted rubber duck that is left inside dreams.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is able to detect faint heat from distant stars. Because of this, some astronomers calibrate their telescopes with the help of POKENAME's senses.
author: greystorm101

entry: The cosmic pattern in its fur resembles the night sky under which it was born. In moonlight, the stars on its coat will twinkle.
author: greystorm101

entry: POKENAME's shell appears to be identical to that of the actual moon. Trainers have even noted new craters appearing on their POKENAME whenever the real moon is hit by meteors.
author: moopse

entry: POKENAME travels around many nightmares, rescuing those trapped in them and guiding them towards happier dreams.
author: lemage22

entry: A few POKENAME with glowing rings have been observed hovering over ponds and rivers under a full moon, drawing water upwards into pillars.
author: chorb33

entry: Because its individual spheres have a strong gravitational pull, POKENAME attracts water when it hovers above the surface, causing waves.
author: chorb33

entry: The heads often think and move independently. The body seems to have a mind of its own. Under a full moon, their minds are sharpest and fully united.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's body is made out of an unknown substance, though it appears closely related to lunar materials. Prolonged exposure leads to drowsiness, and those who give in to sleep have pleasant dreams about space.
author: sk372

entry: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.
author: 8xviktor

entry: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.
author: 8xviktor

entry: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.
author: 8xviktor

entry: In ancient times, myths were told of a deity that resembles POKENAME. It's unknown if it and the mythological deity have any relation.
author: 8xviktor

entry: POKENAME is an absolutely dazzling Pokémon. Even those who are deathly afraid of bugs do not mind a POKENAME crawling up onto them. Such is the extent of this creature's charisma.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The gas it constantly spews from its pores is thick, colorful, and strongly hallucinogenic. It easily overpowers its foes by making them too intoxicated to fight.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME collects pieces of floating flotsam, using them to build nests in quiet coves. It hides among these scattered objects, waiting patiently to surprise passing prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits brine from its mouth, surrounding itself with a salty cloud that confuses attackers. It uses the brine both offensively and defensively, maintaining its dominance in underwater battles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME glides among lily pads, using their cover to ambush unsuspecting prey. Its colorful fins resemble flower petals, blending seamlessly into its watery surroundings.
author: .izik
