author: mistymagius

entry: In the wild, POKENAME spins its gear-like body rapidly to build momentum before delivering powerful kicks. Its metal parts clank loudly, warning foes of an incoming attack.
author: curazy

entry: If the POKENAME you are battling begins taunting and leering at you, that means it has already abandoned the battle. It puts up illusions of itself swaggering at foes to hide its escape.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME uses its loose skin like a bag, snatching small items in it before sneakily floating away. Some people believe that it could carry a child away in its bag, but POKENAME isn't strong enough to carry that much weight.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME carries its shed skin wherever it goes. It enjoys offering rides to small Pokémon.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME is surrounded by a thin, goopy ooze that is contained by a clear outer shell. The casing holding the liquid is nigh on indestructible, though it doesn't protect the Pokémon inside from crashing against said casing.
author: .realthree

entry: In the wild, POKENAME navigates dark caves using echolocation, its loose skin muffling sound to sneak up on prey. When it strikes, it aims for the neck to disable targets quickly.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME's skin resists electricity, allowing it to absorb shocks and store energy to release when it feels threatened.
author: curazy

entry: Despite trying to appear tough and dutiful, POKENAME is rather easily startled. If someone gets too close to something it's guarding, POKENAME will leap forward to headbutt them at full force, more worried about the threat than where they're flying.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Burrowed beneath the sand, POKENAME lies in wait for anyone that enters its territory. If it spots prey, it will slip under their foot to suddenly flip up and knock them onto their back before leaping out of the sand to deliver a powerful shock.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Repeatedly headbutting cavern walls in pursuit of gems, POKENAME often stumble around rattled after their hard work. Any Trainer that offers an exhausted POKENAME a gemstone will find themselves with a loyal new partner.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME often lulls foes to sleep with a sweet floral scent, but sometimes it dozes off first.  While asleep, POKENAME continues to absorb nutrients through its roots.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME can release a strong, pungent odour from the flower on its head to repel predators. Its toxic spores can cause fatigue or confusion.
author: curazy

entry: Feeling the various textures on POKENAME's body has been shown to be beneficial to the brain development of small children. Though POKENAME has a plushy appearance, it is possessed of one of the hardest skulls known to science.
author: .realthree

entry: The large sleeve-like flaps over a POKENAME's arms are to make it appear bigger than it actually is. If its intimidation fails, it will wildly flail the spiked sleeves to disorient and hopefully scratch its foes, finishing them off with a headbutt.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME lift the excess skin from their lower body as an excuse to flare out the spikes on their arms and threaten foes. To prevent their exterior from coming loose, they hook the spare skin onto their spikes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME rapidly bursts up from the sand to knock litter or intruders into the air. It repeats this process over and over until its target has either learned their lesson or been properly disposed of.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME has an elastic slime mold growing from between the plates of its exoskeleton. It can stretch out this fungus to absorb the force of attacks directed against it.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME collects large nuts and takes them back to its den, using its blunt teeth to break through the tough shell. It is quite timid and will quickly flee into its den if spotted by another Pokémon.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are common partners for arctic explorers as their thick coat can resist air temperatures of -30 degrees. However, in the warmer months, POKENAME has a high risk of overheating.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is tiny and mostly covered in fluffy, sweet-scented fur. It demands sugary treats from other Pokémon, using quick kicks to enforce its will.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME often damages its crest due to its habit of headbutting anything it sees. It always wears yellow skin over its head to make itself look tougher than it actually is.
author: soup1900

entry: With its small pupils, POKENAME's night vision is very poor, so it lights its way using the fire contained by the skin on its tail. The yellow light this casts washes out color, making it harder to see the bright red markings on this Pokémon.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon that prefers to only emerge from the ground once it is completely dark outside. Its large eyes help it see in low-light conditions, and its hard skull protects it from cave-ins.
author: .realthree

entry: Although POKENAME can stand upright, it prefers to move on all fours to support the weight of its skull. When threatened, it fully extends its coiled tail to make itself appear larger.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME loves to flex its strength to an audience, often engaging in extravagant bouts with others of its kind. While its stretchy skin provides valuable protection, it often gets drenched in large amounts of sweat.
author: mistymagius

entry: As it is constantly trying to become stronger and stronger, POKENAME is also constantly shedding its skin to make room for its growing body. If the rubbery skin on its lower half breaks, it becomes deeply embarrassed and it starts shedding en masse.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's leaves are surprisingly muscular, allowing them to spar with one another. After a fight, it will shed its rubbery skin and patiently waits in the trees until it regrows.
author: mistymagius

entry: The two heads of POKENAME constantly get into squabbles, headbutting into each other in order to settle their debates. The body often trips over itself from the force of the impact of each collision.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: In the wild, POKENAME picks fights with cliffs and boulders, mistaking them for rivals. Despite its size, it naps often, usually after headbutting something too hard.
author: curazy

entry: This POKENAME tries to put others to sleep with hypnotic stares and muttered threats, but often ends up dozing off mid-sentence. It's common to find it asleep in the middle of a battle, snoring while still clenching its fists.
author: curazy

entry: A POKENAME will sometimes claim a small forest clearing or a city block as their territory. Anyone who disrespects their authority is met with a brutal Beat Up by each of POKENAME's equally cruel heads.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Although they nest far outside of urban areas, POKENAME often venture inside to steal whatever food they can. Their tongue consists of powerful and well-developed muscles that allow them to move and pilfer heavy objects effortlessly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: During battle, POKENAME tosses its egg into the air. While the opponent is distracted, it lands a surprise Headbutt.
author: .izik

entry: When a foe enters its domain, POKENAME entangles them and shrieks loudly. Its kin gather quickly to attack in unison with Beat Up.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gleefully joins any fight, where it sings a battle hymn and swishes its skirt of shed skin to distract foes and protect allies. It rejects most authority, making it difficult to train, but becomes a merciless defender of those it trusts.
author: pjporwoll

entry: If an intruder approaches, the gems on POKENAME's tail glow yellow. It summons thunderclouds as a show of power.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME doesn't use silk to make its webs, it instead uses a rubber-like polymer that acts more like a thick tarp than a net. During the night, POKENAME will wrap itself in its web to sleep.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME builds static in the folds of skin on its neck as it walks. It unleashes bursts of electricity through the frill atop its head.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sways calmly in the sunflower field it calls home. Fiercely territorial, it unleashes Bullet Seed at any Pokémon that tries to feed on its surrounding flora.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides shiny objects in its loose skin after scavenging. At night, it picks one to display proudly in its nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are often seen loitering around in dark alleyways and on abandoned train lines. They mark their territory through unique tags, with territorial disputes settled through art competitions.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: As danger nears, POKENAME beats its tiny wings rapidly to show dominance. If the threat gets too close, it retaliates with a Sand Attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tunnels between mountain peaks to survey its territory. It challenges rivals with a fierce Headbutt to claim their turf.
author: .izik

entry: It attacks unfortunate individuals who venture onto mountain trails to rob them of all their belongings. It is a very territorial creature and marks stones with symbols associated with its group to let everyone know that the place belongs to it.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Before battle, POKENAME pulls its hood over its head to guard its cave. It growls deeply as it fights, using Scary Face to intimidate foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME marks its territory by painting on walls with the fluid from its tail. Territorial wars between POKENAME leave entire areas coated with paint.
author: hophoppip

entry: Clusters of POKENAME cling to cave walls as sentries. They use Scary Face to drive away intruders from their domain.
author: .izik

entry: Over the course of their lives, POKENAME form tightly-knit groups with other wild Pokémon. During the winter, these groups will raid nearby cities in search of food, medicine, and valuables.
author: turron_turron

entry: The acid from POKENAME's tail marks its territory with ease. If threatened, it retaliates with a powerful High Jump Kick.
author: .izik

entry: Metal frills along POKENAME's back enhance its focus. Its Confusion attack can leave opponents dazed for hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is fiercely territorial of its desert oasis home. If it spots an intruder, it traps them in a Sand Tomb before swiftly finishing them off.
author: .izik

entry: The frills on POKENAME's rear mouth detect moisture in the air. This helps it locate underground water sources in deep caves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's shed skin is as hard as steel. When attacked, it will pull up its skin to defend itself, then retaliate with a powerful kick. Anyone who tries a sneak attack from behind will get chomped by its jaw-like horns.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME claims large areas of jungle as its territory and will violently pummel anyone who enters it. Its loose skin acts like a pouch, allowing it to carry large amounts of berries.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is a natural rebel and will intentionally disregard commands just so it can stand out. If it encounters another POKENAME, it will try to avoid copying their behavior so it can be seen as non-conforming.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hides out in populated slums, cruelly bullying any people or Pokémon weaker than it. It will often disguise itself as a regular baseball bat, trying to trick unsuspecting children into picking it up.
author: mistymagius

entry: The scarf-like skin of POKENAME detects subtle temperature shifts. When rain nears, it hides its metal body to avoid rusting.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are notorious thieves, swiping valuable items such as Poké Balls from Trainers and smuggling them to others in cloaks of their molted fur. Attempts to steal from them instead, however, will be met with a retaliatory Headbutt.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME gather in packs, where they trade ideas for how to create the coolest custom clothing and accessories. The leader of the pack is the one with the toughest-looking fashion.
author: alestrius

entry: POKENAME fills its thick skin with hot air to drift across desert skies. It searches from above for unaware prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fights with attitude, leading with slaps from its large ears and following with heavy kicks. Its use of colorful skin sheddings as armbands, legguards, and a facemask has inspired a vibrant fashion style in the Unovan punk scene.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's fused eyelids serve as an intimidation tactic and eye protection from sand grains and sunlight. When raiding a Pokémon's den, it pulls the shedding over its snout, hiding its features and signaling confidence it will not need its jaws.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is fueled by pure anger, destroying entire forests in fits of rage. Its axe is nearly indestructible and POKENAME can swing it with enough force to level a skyscraper.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME loathes sunlight, draping its loose skin over its heads like a hood. Bright light worsens its already poor eyesight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rams trees with powerful Headbutts to dam rivers. After completing its dam, it proudly cheers atop it at dusk.
author: .izik

entry: The skin on POKENAME's head and back hardens into golden armor. This shields it from attacks and even falling debris.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very self-conscious and will usually keep its skin tightly closed when others are around. However, when no one is looking, it can be seen destroying property and generally being a nuisance.
author: mistymagius

entry: In an attempt to demonstrate its toughness, POKENAME simply leaves its shed skin where it falls. Despite its indifferent attitude, if it sees anything bothering a Sandile, it will attack the offending presence.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME swings its tusks in octagonal arcs to intimidate. If the warning fails, it strikes with a devastating Focus Punch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is not the best flyer, as it has to hold up its loose skin while it flies. It is quite a territorial Pokémon and will try to damage its opponent's wings in the hopes of immobilizing them.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME sheds a slimy layer of its skin every day or two, keeping its body from drying up. The leftover skin carries anti-bacterial properties and is often sold as a special type of face mask.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's clothlike skin absorbs blows with ease. If it sees a foe stagger, it and its allies will Headbutt in unison to overwhelm them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's loose skin unfurls into long wings. It uses these to execute complex aerial combat maneuvers.
author: .izik

entry: When it spots a group of wild Pokémon, it challenges the leader for a one on one duel and robs the group of the food supplies if POKENAME wins. It has a symbiotic relationship with Scraraid and uses it as a shooting weapon.
author: milchik

entry: When scales fall off, POKENAME stores them in its loose skin. New ones regrow in under an hour, making it nearly impossible to wear down.
author: .izik

entry: This troublemaking POKENAME steals nearly anything it finds, favoring shiny objects and food. It has an odd preference for lasagna.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME can detect even the most subtle scent of food with its nose. If it sees another Pokémon eating, it will fume into a rage—often triggering nearby Mankey to join in and coordinate to Beat Up the foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is known for its large muscles and seemingly pointless cruelty, beating up creatures it views as lesser on a whim. This description includes humans.
author: dylonk25

entry: Perhaps due to its more humanoid appearance, it has begun mimicking human behavior. Each POKENAME engages in different human activities, such as listening to music or even sports. It is still deadly powerful.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are incredibly territorial as they will beat up any other Grass Pokémon that enters its territory. Because of this, POKENAME are considered an invasive species.
author: mistymagius

entry: When floating dormant beneath a stream or pond, wild POKENAME are nearly impossible to distinguish between the surrounding lily pads. The leaf on its back is poisonous to ingest, serving as a defense mechanism against any potential predators.
author: thheartemis1

entry: It contentedly paddles around lakes and ponds, offering transport to any nearby people and Pokémon. Small Pokémon can ride on its head, and people and larger Pokémon can sit with the water lily.
author: pattybgoode

entry: The lily pad atop POKENAME's head throws off its balance during flight. It often requires several tries to pluck even a single Green Apricorn from trees.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME sleeps face-down in ponds. In the morning, it grazes lazily on nearby flowers growing along the banks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spins intricate webs stretched across ponds. The sticky nets are designed to catch flying Pokémon gliding too close.
author: .izik

entry: Its “wool” is actually made up of millions of tiny plant fibers it creates through photosynthesis. This material is very versatile and used to create a lot of plant-based textiles.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: When floating dormant beneath a stream or pond, wild POKENAME are nearly impossible to distinguish between the surrounding lily pads. The leaf on its back is poisonous to ingest, serving as a defense mechanism against any potential predators.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME draw many Bug-type Pokémon to the water lily on their back to pollinate it. In exchange for pollination, many Bug-type Pokémon are given a moment of respite on the pad on their back.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME nests deep in lakeside reeds. If disturbed, it will immediately retaliate with a forceful blast of water to drive intruders away.
author: .izik

entry: The flower on POKENAME's tail secretes pink ink with a foul odor. It uses the ink to paint strange markings on stumps and rocks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME channels electricity through its lily pad before it attacks. Its Thunderbolt is strong enough to take down a tree in one strike, showcasing its powerful electric abilities.
author: .izik

entry: It wins battles with the expectation that it gets fed afterwards. As such, Trainers opt to feed it packets of Packaged Curry because it is cheap and easy to find.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is surprisingly strong, so it can ferry any person or Pokémon that can fit on its head. It prefers to live in muddier waters.
author: torterraguy26

entry: They swim on the surface of lakes and rivers, as they require clean water to wade in. They float to people who are having picnics or fishing by the water's edge, eager to join in on the fun.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a special flower atop their backs that releases a cloud of pollen when disturbed. This does not stop many POKENAME from using their backs as a springboard, as many are too nimble for the cloud to cling to them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It hides beneath the surface of ponds, buoyant through the aid of a floating cloth lily pad. When a Pokémon is swimming beneath it, it hurriedly scurries to the water's edge to avoid being seen from below.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME channels electricity through the lily pads on its head. It shocks small Pokémon like Caterpie when they approach its pond.
author: .izik

entry: Bartenders work alongside POKENAME to serve delicious drinks. Its nectar is an important ingredient for many sweet beverages, and its head provides a flat surface for patrons to rest their glasses on.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME joyfully flies over ponds, singing as it glides. It prefers to sleep floating peacefully on the water's surface.
author: .izik

entry: When submerged, POKENAME's cotton-like innards expand. This bizarre adaptation greatly boosts its physical strength in the water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME catches rainwater in the lily pads growing from its back. If it walks carefully, it can use them to transport small amounts of water from one place to another.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME often uses the overgrowth of its marshy home to hide its lower torso from view. Its reason for doing so is unknown.
author: .realthree

entry: Although POKENAME are commonly seen ferrying other Pokémon that can't swim, it's a rare sight to see them carrying each other. After much research, it turns out they're simply having fun.
author: metcassette

entry: POKENAME swim through meandering rivers, taking a languid approach to their life. They are amiable toward other wild Pokémon and offer to help carry them across the water.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME floats on still ponds, occasionally howling in its sleep. This noise creates bubbles that rise gently from beneath the surface.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can hold its breath for up to half an hour. It sticks its head under the water's surface so only its lily pad is visible as it waits to drift closer to its prey.
author: .realthree

entry: Despite their cute appearance, POKENAME are fiercely territorial. They are known for clashing with other Pokémon in marshy climates for warmer burrowing spots.
author: retrodox

entry: In the early days of Fusion technology, it was believed that the color of POKENAME's lily pad indicated what it evolved into. However, this has been proven to not be the case. It eats a variety of flora and loves damp places.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Trainers are advised to keep an ear out while walking through areas where POKENAME live. They enjoy popping out suddenly, spooking people and Pokémon alike. They can often be heard before they pop out by a hollow wood-esque jingling noise.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME chews on reeds along pond edges. Once full, it stores the leftover reeds atop its lily pad head to dry for later.
author: .izik

entry: When the lily pad on POKENAME's head dries out, it swoops to the sea's surface. It dunks itself underwater before flying off again.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are capable of ferrying other Pokémon across bodies of water without breaking surface tension. They are offered berries in exchange for their service, but refuse the gifts since they are always willing to help others.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When suffering from intense headaches, the lily pad on POKENAME's head turns brown. Eating berries can ease the pain temporarily.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME relentlessly hunts Seviper with powerful jets of water. Spotting one sends it into a frenzy as it charges forward to attack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swim across the water by slithering in a unique wave-like pattern. This allows them to access aquatic prey and gives them a way to escape from local Zangoose that they may encounter.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When enraged, POKENAME detaches the lily pad from its head and hurls it like a shuriken at its foe with surprising force. Its balance improves dramatically when the lily pad is off of its head.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in ponds and use the tiny lily pad on their head to convert sunlight into electrical energy. If an individual dives, others in the group instinctually follow them, fearing danger from predators on the surface.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME is weak by nature and can only build up its strength by lifting cattails. Afterward, it eats the cattail for a boost of protein and potassium.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME anchors its roots at the bottom of ponds, exposing only its head by stretching its vine-like torso. It fires Acid at passing prey like Pidgey to knock them into the water.
author: .izik

entry: Drifting placidly in the sky, POKENAME use the leaves on their heads as sails. These leaves double as a raincoat, shielding their magnets from rust.
author: hortensia_xxiii

entry: The three heads of POKENAME take turns bobbing down into lakes, gathering water in their large shared lilypad to save for later. The lilypad filters the water as it falls, moisturizing POKENAME's central body.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME extends its vines through the pond water, using them to detect and capture prey like Poliwag. Once captured, it repeatedly slams the prey against shoreline rocks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cares for the adolescent Pokémon in its community, creating games in the shallows and splashing them with water from its crown. During wildfires, it shepherds young and injured Pokémon to the water, where it tends to those it can help.
author: pjporwoll

entry: If it senses intruders near its pond, POKENAME will quickly erect invisible walls to protect its territory. The walls can be as strong as steel.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves on POKENAME's wings allow it to reach high speeds while swimming under a lake's surface. Its swift movements make it an excellent swimmer and a fast hunter.
author: .izik

entry: While standing motionless in a pond, POKENAME gains uncanny insight into the future of anyone nearby. Somehow, the water enhances its precognitive abilities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's lilypad-covered head and tail are extremely buoyant, preventing it from drowning if it falls asleep while swimming. This is especially useful on days where it gets little sleep.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME stores water inside the lilypad on its head. It flies with such steady grace that not even a single drop is spilled, no matter how fast it moves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends its days playfully splashing in ponds and streams, bringing festivity to all Trainers. At night, it sleeps upside down, using its lily pad as a buoy to float gently across the water's surface.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Water that flows out of POKENAME's lily pad accumulates nutrition from the oils that come from its body. Many pharmacies stock cough syrups that contain this ingredient, which is known for its soothing properties.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's water-soaked body absorbs attacks with ease. It remains calm and passive in most situations, especially when it's quietly eating.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME suspends itself from pine trees with white silk. It collects rainwater in its lily pad during storms to avoid traveling for hydration.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gathers seawater in its fins as it ferries small Pokémon like Corsola. This keeps them safe from predators like Mareanie between reefs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME paints as a hobby, particularly enjoying landscapes. If the subject includes lily pads, like the one on its head, POKENAME becomes ecstatic.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: When hungry, POKENAME releases pulses of electricity from its head to cook water herbs nearby. It stores uneaten herbs at the bottom of its pond.
author: .izik

entry: The lilypad atop POKENAME's head radiates intense heat, boiling the pond it lives in. Other Pokémon avoid the scalding water it calls home.
author: .izik

entry: With grace and flair, POKENAME brews strange teas by steeping rare herbs in the bowls it balances. The aroma of its concoctions can soothe even the most irritable foes.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME travel in groups of five, beaching themselves at night with water stored in their lily pads. This keeps them safe and hydrated until dawn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is always eager to please because of its servile nature. It makes a great restaurant waiter because the pad on its head helps it carry dishes to customers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When they enter Pokémon contests, a Trainer may include a Green Scarf to help foster innovative displays of brilliance. They are known to excel at providing new ways of aquatic entertainment, utilizing the Green Scarf to amaze audiences.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To meditate, POKENAME balances on one leg atop lilypads, channeling psychic energy to promote inner focus and muscular strength. It makes a humming noise during this time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sleeps in ponds during the day, camouflaging every part of its body except for the lily pad on its head. It is very skittish and will run away to hide if it senses danger.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME lives close to the water's edge. It enjoys being a nuisance to fishermen in its territory, using its sharp teeth to cut their lines.
author: mepp.

entry: It floats along the surface of the water to steal snacks and vegetables that fall into the water. It prefers bland and watery food, which is why it goes for cucumber slices first.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It wanders into schools or parks to seek out picky eaters to steal undesired food from. It loves bland and watery treats, so these picky eaters remove cucumbers and other vegetables from their salads for it to eat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often seen peacefully sleeping in calm bodies of water during the day. When night falls, POKENAME will often elegantly dance and cause mischief around the lakes they sleep in.
author: krivaswell

entry: POKENAME uses its large lily pad like a sail, catching winds to drift across great distances. It uses this to find secluded swamp nesting spots.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bursts from marsh water in a dazzling shower of lily pads as it unfurls its watery wings. In wetlands, seeing a wild POKENAME flying with the sunrise reflecting off of its wings has become a sign of a happy day ahead.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The lily pad on POKENAME's tail grows based on its nutrition. It will eat cattails at the river's edge when it feels too lazy to hunt, using them to replenish its strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's gelatinous outer layer thickens when it touches swamp water. It uses psychic power to lift cattails and devour them when hungry.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drinks nutrient-rich swamp water to survive. At night, its lily pad heats up significantly, keeping predators away while it sleeps.
author: .izik

entry: As it glides over marshes, POKENAME spits jets of swamp water at prey. Once stunned, it uses Leech Life to drain their remaining strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rolls through marshes at high speed, spinning its lily pads like wheels. It searches eagerly for cattails, its favorite snack.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a little pest inhabiting jungle riverbeds. Floating around pretending to be a lily pad, it pops up suddenly when others are near to spit a mixture of water and seeds it has gathered, solely to irritate them.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME bounces its lily pad between its talons while it dances, cheering on its allies during combat. This rhythmic motion boosts morale, helping its team stay energized.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME waves its leaf-like wings back and forth while it dances on the water's surface. Most of its dancing only happens at night, adding to its mysterious allure.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wander along swampy shores to ensure that no intruders threaten the safety of the marshlands they call home. It is believed that POKENAME are vengeful spirits from ecosystems polluted beyond recognition.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is found living near clean streams and ponds. It is known for its mischievous antics, which include spraying water on unsuspecting fishermen.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME fly over rivers and other bodies of water, performing sweet melodies. It only stops singing when it comes to the ground to eat and sleep.
author: bee4082

entry: The water in POKENAME's cotton-soft lily pad was once used in poultices. Herbalists claim it healed cuts and migraines with surprising speed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats on its back in ponds, its fluffy body absorbing water like a sponge. When disturbed, it delivers powerful kicks to drive intruders away.
author: .izik

entry: Each of POKENAME's tentacles has a set of pink toxic claws that grab onto prey. Even a small scratch can cause seizures, making it a highly dangerous creature to approach.
author: .izik

entry: Some say that near a lake at night, you may see a POKENAME dance, swaying as if in a trance. It will close its eyes and move like the wind itself guides its body, only the sounds of nature acting as its accompaniment and the moon as its spotlight.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME are native to swamplands and tropical coasts, where it uses its lily pad mimicry to stealthily make mischief. It delights in biting through fishing nets or psychically causing headaches in boat pilots so they run aground.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's shell contains water and consumed herbs that steadily brew while it basks in the sun. A steam cloud billows from its shell when the mixture has reached the perfect temperature, with the resulting tea being considered a delicacy in Hoenn.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME sits at the bottom of the river, patiently waiting for other Pokémon to land on its lily pad. Once they do, it will drag them underwater with its arms and slowly drain them of their life force while still submerged.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live in still ponds and are indistinguishable from Lotad whilst submerged in the water. They are very lethargic and are hard to motivate, preferring to just sit in the sun all day.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME alternate which of their two heads they keep above the water, taking turns to have the head underwater feed on pond weed. Their heads have different temperaments, most commonly one is friendly whilst the other is cantankerous.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME digs its way into ponds within home gardens, waiting for owners to inspect the newly-appeared lily pad. Once they come close, it pops out and spits water in their face.
author: sk372

entry: Legends claim drinking pond water from POKENAME's lilypad while thinking of a loved one ensures returned affection. In truth, it only causes stomachaches.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather in groups of three within lakes. When disturbed, they trigger a chain of explosions across the water to drive intruders away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fires seeds at fruit trees to knock ripe produce loose. It drags the fruit back to its pond and eats safely underwater.
author: .izik

entry: While POKENAME can travel across the surface of water without causing ripples, their lily pad is too small to carry other Pokémon. This does not stop other Pokémon from trying to hop on, which ends with both Pokémon getting wet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is known to help gardeners sow and water many types of berries by carrying water on top of its head. However, it digs up spicy ones such as the Figy Berry and tosses them aside instead.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be highly territorial whenever anything enters their swamps. Their tough fur is ideal for moss to grow given how long they spend in their swamps.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME make underwater nests to prevent local Zangoose from destroying their eggs. When it is raining, they can absorb fresh water to rejuvenate their bodies and keep their scales well-hydrated.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They become intoxicated on a Hopo Berry whenever they find one, which helps calm them down before they sleep. When they wake up, they may become confused and unable to recognize where they are for a moment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can detach the lilypad from the end of its stick, hurling it like a discus. The blow is strong enough to topple a willow tree.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME bellow out melodic tones loud enough to ripple water around them. The bubbles that surround their bodies echo with the notes of their songs, creating a chorus singing along to their tunes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME frisks playfully around anyone who approaches while playing music. Because it's so easy to lure this species out of marshes this way, POKENAME are endangered due to the actions of poachers.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME hears the sound of a Rain Dance, it jets swiftly from a thundercloud to join in the frolic, bringing a downpour with it.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME lives near lakes and loves to socialize with Pokémon and people alike. It produces a warm, invigorating aura as it dances.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME's tail-light can flash at varying different intensities as well as colors, and its sense of rhythm is almost unparalleled. It's very popular to include in raves and other similar venues.
author: sk372

entry: Though exceedingly rare to find in the wild, POKENAME appear to be comfortable living just about anywhere, from the rockiest mountains to the busiest cities. It is highly social and often lives with other Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can ameliorate boring parties by bringing a lot of happy festive energy. It encourages others to sing and dance at parks, picnics, or wherever there is space outside.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME hears the melody produced by rain, all the cells in its body are galvanized, and it begins moving in rhythm. Because it gets its nutrients from the water, it can dance on the mud all day long without feeling hungry.
author: ._term.

entry: POKENAME surf along water and electrical currents with their lily pad surfboard, searching for berries and nuts to feast upon. When at least two wild POKENAME meet, they will compete with each other to see who surfs best.
author: infinex21

entry: Singing a cheery dirge, POKENAME lures prey to its pool to consume 108 souls, upon which it will rest in its keystone for 108 days. Jaunty music causes it to dance, so hikers in Sinnoh marshes play music when a POKENAME has been reported in the area.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lumbers about in a steady rhythm, shaking its maracas with flexible vines. It invites small Pokémon to swim in the refreshing pool on its back.
author: kilough_kc

entry: No matter how much POKENAME wants to, it is unable to dance with the torso section of its body. To make up for this, it will dance with its head and tentacles extra vigorously.
author: soup1900

entry: To calm their young, POKENAME will place them in the brim of their hat and joyfully dance around. Although silly and not a very strict parent, POKENAME becomes dead serious at the sound of its young in distress.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: It will dance in front of people at parks or picnics in an effort to steal food. It especially goes after salads, which is its best chance at a few courgette or zucchini slices.
author: quackquackattack

entry: As POKENAME sings, the Lotad-shaped companions it possesses all twirl and circle around it, spraying water in time with the music. No two ballads are alike; each POKENAME has its own unique song to sing.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME deliver histrionic performances in front of audiences at theaters across the world. Their emboldened passion gives them the vigor to dazzle audiences with their dance and flurry of petals.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Legends from the past claim that the fountain on POKENAME's head contained water that would make those who drank it younger. While the water does not have these properties, it is exceptionally pure.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are drawn to festivals and celebrations, revelling in the positive energy. They feed off the atmosphere and push people to continue partying beyond their limits - their presence can cause dangerous exhaustion.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The object in the center smells like a perfectly ripened Pinap Berry. If a Pokémon touches any of POKENAME's touch receptors, it clamps up like a shell, crushing the prey inside the trap, where it will later be digested.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME appears before others and performs a strange dance that compels viewers to join in. Those who don't dance well enough for POKENAME's tastes will be frozen into statues for their lack of rhythm.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's trance-inducing dance binds observers in rhythm, forbidding escape until its ritual concludes. Legends claim interrupting its performance invites calamity, as vengeful spirits torment the offender with relentless misfortune.
author: vhscopyofmeangirls

entry: POKENAME makes odd clicking and bubbling sounds while exploring. Though most hear only gobbledygook, some claim the noises follow a repeating pattern or hidden message.
author: jaminmcready

entry: As the draining of wetlands continues, this already-rare Pokémon has had fewer and fewer sightings. It is very peaceful, acting as a gentle friend to all of the other wild Pokémon in its marshy home.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME seek out festivals and parties that are attended by large crowds of people. They are drawn to the wealth of positive emotion within the gatherings, their rhythmic dancing said to bring good dreams to those they dance with.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its outer coat is made of coarse, stiff hairs that do not absorb water. After a swim or a jaunt in the rain, POKENAME does a drying dance and instantly shakes off all the moisture on its coat.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME is an incredibly cheerful and festive Pokémon that often invites others to dance with it under the sunlight. If someone is in danger, it shields them with its body without ever losing its trademark smile.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME hears festive music, super-heated foam pours from its nostrils which can severely burn those it touches. When the music dies down, the foam stops too and POKENAME searches for coal to refuel.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME charms Trainers into joining it in complex line dances to distract them while it pilfers their valuable items. By the time the Trainers realize they've been swindled, POKENAME has already fled.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME is native to a distant, ore-rich region where it wanders gathering Pokémon followers to teach elaborate dances. Its passion is dance and will prioritize a flamboyant and eye-catching performance over tactics in battle.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME can combine smooth dance moves with fierce fighting techniques. Cheerful, festive music is always enough to put a POKENAME in good spirits.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME can combine smooth dance moves with fierce fighting techniques. Cheerful, festive music is always enough to put it in good spirits.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME dances relentlessly throughout the day and night, not even stopping when it sleeps. Trainers who accidentally look into one of its many eyes will dance until they collapse from total exhaustion.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME is a carefree Pokémon that performs silly dances regardless of the situation. It can even force others to dance by manipulating their muscles with its psychic powers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is always full of a sour, fruity liquid and so it must bounce to get around. Although it tries to share this liquid with its friends, it is so sour that most cannot withstand it.
author: infinex21

entry: Wild POKENAME laze about whenever it rains and lets the water collect in the grassy plant seemingly attached to its back. When the sun shines bright, this plant trembles and the POKENAME will resume its journey.
author: infinex21

entry: As POKENAME dances underwater, the icy surf around it stirs up bioluminescent algae. The rhythm of its movements produces the appearance of a brilliant azure aurora.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME uses parts of broken meteors from outer space as a helmet and a makeshift club. The end of the club will occasionally pulse with a strange energy and gift POKENAME with a temporary surge of great power.
author: sk372

entry: Ordinarily, POKENAME stands motionless, barely responding to outside stimuli. If something tries to strike at it, however, it suddenly springs to life, making quick dodges and even quicker punches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME primarily lays quiet and dormant, preferring small amounts of company at most. If it detects the cry of a child, however, cracks form in its shell, and a strong glow forms within its hollow eyes.
author: sk372

entry: A popular children's book features this Pokémon as the main character. It tells the story of a timid POKENAME who hides behind its mantle but, over time, makes friends and begins to come out of its shell, revealing its colorful core.
author: _pixelar_

entry: When a POKENAME falls from the ozone layer down to the surface, it is often adopted by hospitals or care facilities. They like to gather the water it creates around its tail, as the water is free from any air pollution or allergens.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Should a POKENAME ever lose its protective outer shell, the massive amount of electrons stored in its now-exposed inner core will immediately result in a lightning strike. Afterwards it will flee as the enemy either fainted or is left paralyzed.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Underneath its hard outer shell, POKENAME's molten core can reach temperatures up to 900 degrees Celsius. Any part not obscured by its shell glows a soft orange hue due to the immense heat.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen streaking through the sky on meteor shower nights, creating a mesmerizing, otherworldly glow wherever it flies. It is made of rock and a glowing cosmic substance yet to be identified.
author: evilgammon

entry: The cracks in POKENAME's rocky exterior allow its core to vent fire-like plasma. The heat is so intense that standing nearby can cause burns. It is known to stay around the upper stratosphere eating dust and other particulates.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME constructs a specialized shell of meteoric rock to contain its overwhelming powers. If it impacts on a planet, the unleashed abilities could prove catastrophic without caring individuals to help POKENAME tame its power.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Rivulets of lava constantly leak from the pores in POKENAME's body. Bathing in the magma of its volcanic habitat is common, as it helps keep its carapace clean and warm.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its rocky shell for insulation while flying in winter skies. If cracks form, it folds in its wings and rolls through mud to repair its casing.
author: .izik

entry: Its wool stores static from meteor storms. During intense geomagnetic shifts, the cracks in its shell flicker violently, releasing bursts of radiant discharge.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME often get buried in mud when they crash into swamps. The stagnant waters prevent their rocky bodies from decaying so many POKENAME remain in these swamps until awakened by a Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: People used to predict a nearing eclipse by looking out for POKENAME in the open blue sky. It lives much higher in the ozone layer than most Minior, doing so for the increase in sunlight. It relies on this sunlight to power all of its Psychic moves.
author: _pixelar_

entry: People used to predict a nearing red moon by looking out for POKENAME in the night sky. Writings of POKENAME falling from its home in the sky and being confused for a shooting star are common all around the world, dating back hundreds of years.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Many old astronomy tomes have at least one POKENAME living inside the pages. Its flat body allows it to hide within the folds of paper, remaining undetected by all but the most observant.
author: .izik

entry: Living in the ozone layer, POKENAME protects its fellow Minior from other predators in the atmosphere by eating the predators first. The more POKENAME eats, the more something stirs within it, as if it's about to burst out of its shell.
author: beatdoof

entry: POKENAME perches on statues at night, its orange feathers glowing faintly. If approached, it attacks with a sudden and precise Drill Peck.
author: .izik

entry: It blends in with undersea rocks to avoid notice. Its location is revealed by a blinding flash of light before it fires an energy burst at its prey.
author: hophoppip

entry: While used very little, POKENAME's wings retain a constant sharpness. It seemingly lacks the energy to fly, staying to the ground and cutting down berries from trees to eat.
author: sk372

entry: With one eye always fixed on the ground, POKENAME dives from orbit with pinpoint precision upon spotting prey. Once it lands, its powerful legs launch it back into orbit - the sheer force has been known to trigger localized earthquakes.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Minior and Munchlax's diets are extremely different; POKENAME is known for overeating foods its body cannot perfectly process, eventually leading to toxicity. Trainers must make sure POKENAME eats small portions of mineral-based meals.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can only move by rolling, but it becomes completely still when asleep and cannot roll at all. Due to its tremendous weight, a Dolly is the only way to move one while it slumbers.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME soars through the atmosphere, its wings beating rapidly to increase its flight speed. It eats dust in the sky to keep itself satiated, using the particles to fuel its high-speed flight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME grows leaf-like appendages to gain energy from photosynthesis. Their leaves are capable of enduring the conditions of the ozone layer. Due to this, many scientists study this Pokémon to see how other plants could stay alive in outer space.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Any water molecules in the immediate vicinity of this Pokémon freeze into tiny snowflakes. When light hits them just right, it appears as though POKENAME is surrounded by a radiant cloud of mist.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Silently, POKENAME hangs from a rocky overhang or cave ceiling, storing energy. It can fight as it is, but it is defensive and slow. When in danger, POKENAME bursts from its rocky shell, trading protection for power.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME's rear mouth leads the way while flying. It tries to chase any shooting star it sees, fascinated by the celestial objects streaking across the night sky.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME flies over long distances, parts of its rocky casing flake away. It lands in bogs to coat its scales in mud and rebuild its armor.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME waves its violet-glowing hands during battle to disorient foes. Once distracted, it strikes with a Confuse Ray to incapacitate them.
author: .izik

entry: Some scientists believe that underneath its shell, POKENAME contains enough energy to make a star explode, but not enough research has yet been made to support this theory. Some of this energy leaks through the cracks in this Pokémon's armor.
author: milchik

entry: As POKENAME travels through space, it accumulates chunks of meteors due to its large mass. Its strong gravitational pull can sometimes trap random debris in orbit.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's ribbons are encrusted in a hard stone that does not blow in the wind, instead staying perfectly still on its body. At night, it finds joy in dancing in the sky, its movements graceful and mesmerizing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's feelers become most active when it senses or interacts with a Pokémon from space or the upper atmosphere, where it originates. Some recorded spikes in such activity have yet to be explained, but scientists are working on it.
author: _pixelar_

entry: When POKENAME is locked in combat, a poisonous ectoplasm seeps out from its rocky shell. It rampages across the land, its ectoplasm leaving entire forests barren.
author: mistymagius

entry: These Pokémon are often depicted as being quite large, though they are only about the size of an Onix. They live within the layers of the planet's atmosphere. Those in the lowest layer are the heaviest, as their shells have become incredibly dense.
author: infinex21

entry: During full moons, tiny white glowing cracks spread throughout POKENAME's body. These ethereal lines glow brightly, giving it a mystical appearance under the moonlight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats in the night sky during the full moon without changing its pose. It can levitate for up to 3 miles without rest, maintaining its serene and graceful form.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are man-made Pokémon created a long time ago, ordered to protect humans. Legends state that they did the complete opposite, forcing the best sorcerers to trap them in a stone statue.
author: eminemace

entry: POKENAME's body is mostly hollow, allowing it to float among the clouds. Even though it is quite light, it has been known to be a major hazard for commercial airplanes.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hunts other meteor Pokémon until it has consumed enough that it hurtles toward the world. It is rumored that one not living in the planet's orbit could grow to immense sizes and density as it hunts across the cosmos.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's brightly blinking azure jaw disorients prey mid-hunt. Once close, it bites with a crushing force strong enough to shatter granite with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's outer shell is formed from frozen clay. Prolonged contact with its surface can result in severe frostbite within seconds.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its rocky appearance, POKENAME's shell is ice-cold to the touch. Even brief contact may result in painful freezer burn.
author: .izik

entry: They are typically found deep in the sea; some suspect Minior that have fallen from the sky manage to fuse with Carvanha, creating POKENAME. They can leap incredibly high from the water, although this has not been observed in natural conditions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: To rest safely, POKENAME encases itself in swamp mud. While asleep, it reflexively controls nearby trees to ward off intruders with violent force.
author: .izik

entry: When the crystals around POKENAME's neck glow, it is about to unleash a loud screeching to attack. This sound is powerful enough to break stone easily, making it a fearsome force.
author: .izik

entry: Its dense outer shell vibrates with trapped pressure, releasing faint pulses of sound. When it descends through cloudbanks, the air around it stiffens as if resisting its passage.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It's often placed near the entrances of old homes, unmoving and silent. When danger approaches, it emits a deep, cracking groan and the fissures in its shell begin to flicker violently.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The brittle stone that comes off POKENAME's body while it does martial arts moves is frequently ground into powder by apothecaries. When mixed with water, it can boost strength and stamina in those who imbibe it, making it a sought-after tonic.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME that fall onto the planet from space are unable to return due to their heavy exoskeleton. Though the plummet doesn't injure them, fallen POKENAME can be seen gathering on the tops of trees on clear nights to gaze at their old home.
author: .realthree

entry: Its glow deepens and its cry takes on a mournful echo when certain constellations align. On those nights, light bends strangely around it, casting sharp rings into the cold.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its mane glows brighter with each opponent it defeats. Despite being weighed down by a heavy shell, it moves with the speed and savagery of a bloodthirsty beast.
author: h0bojoe

entry: POKENAME hides its bright colors beneath a dull shell in order to blend with the bottom of the sea and become less noticeable to potential prey. As a trade-off, the armor limits POKENAME's mobility and psychic powers.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME floats in the atmosphere eating dust. When it gets tired, it plummets to the ground at high speeds, letting loose a pumpkin scent as it smashes to the ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's vulnerable body is protected by a hard shell. Ground-off dust from the shell has a salty, cocoa-like flavor, and is used in some fancy desserts.
author: hophoppip

entry: When POKENAME's shell grows too heavy to stay aloft, it comes hurtling down with destructive force that often leaves a burning crater behind. The energy of its core is so immense that even its shell is veiled in pure energy.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME falls from the atmosphere, they quickly burrow underground while in this vulnerable state. They make their homes in tunnels created by Onix, hiding away at the first sign of danger.
author: mepp.

entry: It hangs from trees, rarely moving unless knocked onto the ground. Though POKENAME is shaped like an acorn, its hard rocky shell protects it from the jaws of nut-eating Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's tail floats behind it because the form inside of its tough shell isn't affected by gravity. POKENAME playfully bats at the tail, sometimes striking it hard enough to crack the rocky outer layer.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME often lie flat on their stomachs when dormant because it is the softest part of their body. When they are attacked, they release psychic waves that cause headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are easily tricked into running in circles, and the dizziness can often lead them to get a headache. The best way for them to recover is by landing on their stomachs and resting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are superb swimmers that zip through the water to avoid predators. Once they find a suitable spot to rest, they go dormant and tuck their limbs close to their bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release a trail of stardust wherever they swim. These trails are particularly mesmerizing underwater, where they create a beautiful glowing display of stardust.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When another Pokémon runs away from POKENAME, their instincts urge them to chase after the escaping Pokémon. When they reach their max speed, they release a glittery stardust behind them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are surprisingly limber Pokémon that love to chase others. After a long chase, POKENAME follow the trail of stardust they left behind to return to their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME descend from the ozone layer when their shells have grown too dense to stay aloft so high. Once they have descended, they will seek out opponents to test their strength against.
author: infinex21

entry: When POKENAME stays motionless and meditates, it's said it astral-projects itself far into the depths of space to parts unknown. On the evening of meteor showers, it gazes upward and regards the display with its eyes glowing bright.
author: sk372

entry: Some say POKENAME's outer shell was created to limit the unparalleled strength it possessed. Its shell makes ominous rumbling crackles with every flex of its muscular body.
author: sk372

entry: When tired, POKENAME floats through the night sky much more slowly. It regains its vigor after eating copious amounts of rocks, using the minerals to recharge its energy.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME is high up in the atmosphere, it sometimes shoots highly powered jets of water from its cannons to propel itself. The water immediately freezes in the cold, instead of quickly falling to earth, it seems to drift down in slow motion.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: When its hard body glows purple, POKENAME can walk through solid objects. It uses this ability to hide within small crevices during daylight hours, making it nearly impossible to find.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shine bright with a celestial, bone-colored glow. Their boney boomerang can be tossed high into the air, high enough to be mistaken for a shooting star.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This Pokémon devours all kinds of things, edible or not, and digests them into a colorful sparkling mass. Storing it in its belly, POKENAME pukes it out as a means of self-defense, and while it looks stunning, it also smells terribly.
author: milchik

entry: This Pokémon devours all kinds of things, edible or not, and digests them into a colorful sparkling mass. Storing it in its belly, POKENAME pukes it out as a means of self-defense, and while it looks stunning, it also smells terribly.
author: milchik

entry: Rather than poison gas, POKENAME is filled with interstellar gas and dust that allows it to remain buoyant.  However, this still causes major respiratory problems in others.
author: bostroms

entry: POKENAME's body glows brightly while it drifts through the atmosphere. Some old cultures thought sightings of this Pokémon were a shooting star that gave luck to new mothers, a symbol of hope and protection.
author: .izik

entry: Often enough, what people think are shooting stars are actually a space-bound Pokémon known as POKENAME dancing across the night sky. When they spin their bodies, their cores shine increasingly brighter, like the stars themselves.
author: infinex21

entry: The lights on POKENAME's shell change colours based on which note POKENAME is currently singing. Its voice is so melodious that tour groups frequent POKENAME's environment during mating season to hear their cries.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: To heighten the effects of X Speed, scientists now use stardust gathered from a POKENAME. With such incredible speed, its dust holds faint energy from its movements.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's body is so large that it has a minor gravitational field, which researchers believe is also what allows this Pokémon to stay aloft. To defend itself, it can launch all debris caught in its gravitational field.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME absorbs lightning as a source of power, with each bolt hardening its outer shell. Its volatile core burns radioactively, decaying its body, so it lives in thunderstorms to recharge and delay disintegration.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME absorbs lightning as a source of power, with each bolt hardening its outer shell. Its volatile core burns radioactively, decaying its body, so it lives in thunderstorms to recharge and delay disintegration.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Rarely, on the peaks of tall mountains, POKENAME can be found. The light that emits from its body is warm, but not dangerously hot. When POKENAME rests, its shining light dims to a softer glow.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME can barely contain itself in its rocky shell due to its overwhelming rage. When its anger rises, its fire burns a deep crimson and spills out of its casing, as its power becomes too intense to be contained.
author: evilgammon

entry: Even after landing, POKENAME's blue-glowing wings continue to flutter. It sheds luminous feathers prized by jewelers and collectors alike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is durable, allowing it to bounce off of objects it impacts while floating around in space. It is easily upset, and when it cries, it hurtles to the ground at an intense speed.
author: pjporwoll

entry: While floating through thunderstorms, POKENAME redirects lightning to predators. It uses this ability to protect itself and its fellow Pokémon from danger.
author: .izik

entry: Most often mistaken for a comet, POKENAME orbits planets and can be seen every planetary year, flashing bright, colorful displays.
author: musicsheep.

entry: Often mistaken for a shooting star, POKENAME fly through the sky so fast that it glows. When it reaches the ground, it uses its tail to spring back into the air. Newborn POKENAME do not have the strength, and rely on other Pokémon taking them in.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME sit at rest on the seabed, gathering energy. They are vulnerable in this state and cover themselves in a toxic film. Once enough energy is gathered, they evolve and shoot up into the atmosphere.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It's said that gazing into POKENAME's core gives a glimpse through time and space, possibly even dimensions. Research is inconclusive, as all who look for protracted periods fall unconscious and remember little of what they saw once awake.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's shell can produce 200 pounds of Stardust daily. The color of the main body determines the color of the dust.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME streaks through the night sky with wings outstretched, trailing glittering stardust that shimmer like glowing clouds in its wake. Many travelers mistake it for a shooting star.
author: .izik

entry: It glides through the upper atmosphere with an eerie calm, wings outstretched and glittering with debris. In its wake, metal shavings scatter like shooting stars.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME crash to the ground from outer space. They are found in meteor craters and have a joyful demeanour. Researchers speculate that whilst in space POKENAME use debris and rocks to protect their bodies, though this has yet to be observed.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Spotting POKENAME under a starry sky is considered a sign of great fortune due to its incredible rarity. For centuries, scientists mistook this Pokémon for a constellation in the night sky.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME paint with a bioluminescent substance, which produces beautiful colors and light. This paint is very expensive and is only sold to famous artists.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME absorbs space dust and debris with the miniature black hole contained in its flowing mane to fuel its cosmic magic. When it is seen streaking across the night sky, people superstitiously chant wishes in hopes it will cast a spell for them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME absorbs space dust and debris with the miniature black hole contained in its flowing mane to fuel its cosmic magic. When it is seen streaking across the night sky, people superstitiously chant wishes in hopes it will cast a spell for them.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When this form of POKENAME is visible in the wild, POKENAME is in a critical status. It must devour a large but healthy amount of rocky material in order to be able to naturally reform its hardened shell; without it, POKENAME will eventually perish.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Constantly crackling with static, POKENAME glows due to all of its excess energy. It focuses the majority of its power into the tips of its tails, only wielding them to share electricity or defend its friends.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: When high in the atmosphere, POKENAME curls up and slows the effects of time on itself, almost completely stopping aging. When it falls to earth, researchers seek it out to determine how old it is.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its wings beat in sudden bursts, sending crystalline dust spiraling through the sky. The sound it emits rises and falls like a siren, disorienting anything that flies too close.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME has a field of radiation around it, which it uses to hunt prey within caves. The radiation is so strong that it melts cave walls, which is why POKENAME has very weak claws.
author: animecreep4

entry: Now free from its shell, POKENAME attacks in bursts of speed and agility that it previously couldn't manage. The bright, eye-catching light from its body was the reason it hid inside the shell.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME protects the trees of the jungle by balling itself up and hurtling to the ground at anyone it believes is harming the trees. Otherwise, it spends its time serenely floating around the sky.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Its long light trails can be seen from miles away in the night sky. What people don't realise is, if they get too close, POKENAME will dive towards the ground like a fiery spear, wanting to protect its home jungle.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The ultimate protector of the jungle, POKENAME will scout in the night sky. Workers looking to fell trees don't even see what hit them when POKENAME plummets to attack.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Upon breaking its shell, POKENAME starts levitating off the ground, rarely burrowing down again unless slumbering or feeling threatened. Its spikes glow in the dark, unless covered with dirt from digging.
author: krune

entry: When in combat, POKENAME extends blades made of pure energy from its elbows. Every swing of these sharp blades leaves a sparkling, multicolored trail of stardust behind.
author: sk372

entry: Dwelling within ababdoned Minior shells, POKENAME are often confused for miniature nebulae when spotted from telescopes. They enjoy gathering stones to form their own orbits.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME makes its den in dark caves, its body shining brightly to light up the area around it. This light causes Pokémon that enjoy the darkness to leave its immediate vicinity, as it disturbs their natural habitat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME soars between mountain peaks, its horn flashing brightly before descent. It uses this as a display while patrolling its domain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body glows a bright orange in cemeteries when it spots grave robbers. The eerie glow helps scare off intruders, protecting the sacred grounds.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is said to swim through the very cosmos, swallowing dying stars and releasing the excess energy as a brand new star in its wake. Supposedly, this also helps to keep its own energy stable until its protective shell finally reforms.
author: infinex21

entry: Very few people have ever seen this Pokémon with its shell shed. POKENAME travels through open space with the speed of a meteor, drawing energy from the stars it passes and shaping new ones in its wake.
author: milchik

entry: Very few people have ever seen this Pokémon with its shell shed. POKENAME travels through open space with the speed of a meteor, drawing energy from the stars it passes and shaping new ones in its wake.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME can shed their meteoric shell at will. Their finishing move is to fly into the atmosphere, encase themselves in their shell, and let gravity drag them down where they will cast away their shell and strike their foe with their massive blade.
author: infinex21

entry: Its ribbon whip forward with surprising force, launching star fragments high into the sky. Some are said to reach the mesosphere, where they burn silently above the clouds.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME leaps into the sky with joy, trailing stardust behind it. When it crashes down, it leaves glittering craters that can shimmer for days.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Scientists say this is the true form of POKENAME that is only revealed when most of its shell has been broken. This Pokémon has long since become a being of pure, cosmic energy and it is capable of wielding said energy to destroy any of its foes.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME are large Pokémon that fly within the outermost layer of the planet's atmosphere, gorging themselves upon planetary debris. The more they feed upon, the more they develop a thick shell around themselves that eventually weighs them down.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is constructed from an otherworldly cosmic energy. It flies through space by warping gravity around it, pulling in shards of mteors and other debris to try and form its own nebula.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: While staring at a full moon, POKENAME's glowing body shifts colors rapidly. It cannot control this change, so it is a captivating sight during moonlit nights.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to float in the ozone layer, absorbing small space debris and peacefully floating around. POKENAME, when disturbed, are believed to be why your ears pop when your airplane leaves the ground.
author: tlord

entry: POKENAME's body rapidly changes color during the night of a full moon while it floats through the night sky. This transformation is a magical display of its energy and connection to the lunar cycle.
author: .izik

entry: To heighten the effects of X Sp. Atk, scientists have begun using stardust from a POKENAME. Because of its naturally high attack speed, the dust carries traces of its power.
author: jaminmcready

entry: To heighten the effects of X Sp. Atk, scientists have begun using stardust from a POKENAME. Because of its naturally high attack speed, the dust carries traces of its power.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It's said that those who are able to catch a glimpse of POKENAME flying across the cosmos on its burning wings will be blessed with great prosperity.
author: mepp.

entry: The colors from POKENAME's wings radiate as splendidly as the sun. As it soars, dazzling multi-colored embers are scattered.
author: mepp.

entry: Prone to clumsiness, POKENAME break their tough shell by crashing into rocks. Unfortunately, with their colorful core exposed, they tend to die off quickly.
author: whimsi_call

entry: POKENAME's heads are constantly fighting over food. Theorized to originate in space, their diet consists of atmospheric dust. The color of its core depends on what types it consumes.
author: whimsi_call

entry: Only found deep in space, POKENAME are thought to bring very good luck to interstellar travelers. On occasion, these Pokémon try to use their supernatural powers to help these travelers return home safely.
author: garliclol

entry: POKENAME is popular with coordinators due to its stunning fur colours and the dazzling beauty of its fire. It's said that a POKENAME can grant a single wish in its lifetime to a human it truly loves.
author: nyoomymph

entry: When POKENAME sings, its heavy, rocky shell steadily breaks away.The louder and longer it sings, the higher it flies, making this Pokémon a popular symbol for young artists.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAME sings, its heavy, rocky shell steadily breaks away.The louder and longer it sings, the higher it flies, making this Pokémon a popular symbol for young artists.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAMEf sings, its heavy, rocky shell steadily breaks away. The louder and longer it sings, the higher it flies, making this Pokémon a popular symbol for young artists.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME rises from its shattered shell towards the sky while singing loudly. The shattered shell of POKENAME is collected by space enthusiasts and luxury jewelers alike due to the beautiful flecks of its rainbow coat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With its protective layer shattered, POKENAME hastily hunts down rocky Pokémon to eat to stave off its body burning up and fading away. Reforming its rocky coat will protect it for some time, but the shell is unstable and steadily crumbles.
author: pjporwoll

entry: With its protective layer shattered, POKENAME hastily hunts down rocky Pokémon to eat to stave off its body burning up and fading away. Reforming its rocky coat will protect it for some time, but the shell is unstable and steadily crumbles.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its roar splits clouds and can echo for miles. Long after POKENAME vanishes, cracks in nearby stone glisten with strange cosmic ore.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The icy blue glow coming off POKENAME's body will turn red if it is overheating. It blows ice around itself to rapidly cool down, ensuring its body temperature remains manageable.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's icy blue glow is extremely visible at night, making it a haunting sight. It floats through the sky, leaving trails of cold mist behind it as it travels.
author: .izik

entry: Also known as "The Comet of the Sea", POKENAME typically lives an idyllic life living off sand and particles from hydrothermal vents. However, if an object catches its eye, it bolts towards it with blinding speed, collecting it in its mouth.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It strips bark from nearby trees and layers it over its glowing body, hiding its light beneath knots and rot. When startled, the bark splits slightly, revealing a flash of violet fire.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME uses high-pitched vibrations to locate hidden star fragments. The tone draws flocks of nocturnal Pokémon, who hover motionless in awe.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Due to its magnificent wings, POKENAME are loved by kids. So much so that a racing game has a track based on them.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME greets intruders to its mountain den with a crushing hug. It follows up with a devastating Power Gem attack to ensure their defeat.
author: .izik

entry: The glowing green portions of POKENAME's cape flash brightly while performing martial arts combinations. The flashes add flair to its movements, dazzling its opponents before landing a decisive strike.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME that break free of their heavy, protective exoskeleton are light enough to return to their starry home, but they only have a short time to do so before they are extinguished. The glow of their return journey can be seen from miles away.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME glows brilliantly as it leaps across night clouds. Mistaking it for a UFO is common, but a sudden blizzard reveals its true nature.
author: .izik

entry: The loss of its shell has made it far deadlier, but at the cost of an exponentially shortened lifespan. It fights with reckless ferocity, unconcerned for its own survival.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Its teeth are strong enough to crush even the hardest minerals and shells; even pieces of meteors are no match for POKENAME's jaw. The colors of the sparkling dust it releases through the protuberance on its head are determined by what it eats.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME's body is quite delicate, so it uses its rocky pincers as a defensive shell. When threatened in battle, it fires powerful beams of cosmic rays from its pincers.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's eyes are very strong, possessing acute vision and the ability to fire long-range beams of light. These shots are so fast and accurate even from extreme distances, some wonder if they possess homing capabilities.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gifts meteor-shaped charms to Trainers it likes. These rocky trinkets are warm to the touch and sometimes shimmer faintly under moonlight.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME uses a wand made of hardened stardust to cast sparks in the air. When the sparks fall, they leave behind a trail of glitter that clings to the ground like sand.
author: jaminmcready

entry: With its meteor-clad shell broken, POKENAME reveals its true form as a manifestation of pure astral energy. This Pokémon is said to have once had a corporeal form that it shed after becoming one with its soul.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME sleeps at the bottom of quiet rivers, its still body mistaken for a blue sapphire. Light passing through the water makes its surface shimmer like a jewel, drawing curious eyes.
author: jaminmcready

entry: At dusk, POKENAME skips across lake surfaces with barely a sound. Each landing leaves behind a glittering patch of foam that fades before morning.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Anyone who sees POKENAME's true form is dazzled into stillness. Its body seems to refract the stars themselves, locking its targets in place.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's smoke trails contain flecks of cosmic dust. It rarely moves, conserving its core's heat until it erupts with sudden, radiant blasts.
author: jaminmcready
