entry: POKENAME reflect light off of their jewels in order to disguise themselves as diamonds. In reality, their gems are made of cinnabar. If a miner gets too close, POKENAME will purposefully shatter spare gems to release liquid mercury.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It twirls its soft pink vines into heart shapes to charm others, often using them to lure in companions. These vines also release a sweet fragrance that calms nearby Pokémon.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It hides among blooming flowers, blending perfectly with heart-shaped patterns along its back. When frightened, it releases a sugary scent that lulls predators into drowsiness.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its been observed that after a POKENAME explodes in the wild, the breeding rate of other Pokémon sees a sharp increase for a time. It's believed that a certain type of Pokéball is based on POKENAME's appearance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME resembles a Love Ball, and has a sweet behavior to match. It is known to be dangerous due to exploding into glitter at the slightest shock.
author: aberry8286

entry: Though it presumably means well, the effects of a POKENAME explosion are considered dangerous, as it could render an entire city's population too focused on amorous relations, to the detriment of every other facet of life.
author: sk372

entry: Its glossy shell gleams faintly with soft pink hues, resembling a ripened fruit. Forest dwellers believe spotting a POKENAME during spring will bring a season full of love and abundance.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When POKENAME attacks, its bubbles always take on perfect heart shapes. These bubbles are sometimes harmless but nevertheless often dazzle foes.
author: .izik

entry: It is known to wrap its tail around another POKENAME when it feels lonely, which helps it feel safe in the seas. If it wraps its tail around a Trainer, it is said to be a gesture of true comfort and affection.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spits heart-shaped bubbles at scuba divers who wander too close to its underwater cave, warning them away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live in lakes near wedding venues, their pigmentation derived from the petals that are eventually swept into the water. When weddings occur, they float to the top of the surface and watch the event with keen interest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swim in lakes near wedding venues, the petals giving their scales a pink tinge. They celebrate alongside couples and release pink bubbles into the air when excited.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Areas where swarms of POKENAME roam are popular romantic getaways. It's said that should a wild POKENAME follow and flutter close to a couple, they will have a long and blissful life together.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are mild-natured and do not mind the presence of people. Sometimes, poachers prematurely rip off POKENAME's heart-shaped limbs and sell them as decoration. Thankfully, they can regrow back over time.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It floats close towards beaches in summertime, observing passerby. If it detects a group of people having a happy time together, the orb on its body begins to glow with a radiant light.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It floats close towards beaches in summertime, observing passersby. If it detects a group of people having a happy time together, the orb on its body begins to glow with a radiant light.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It can create invisible objects by pantomiming them. It tends to use these powers to set up romantic dates for random pairs of humans.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME dance provocatively to draw attention to themselves. Once a crowd has gathered, they release psychic energy that instills kind and affectionate feelings in the audience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME was once used to scam those who couldn't afford a proper Luvdisc to give to their loved ones. Its affectionate personality and cute appearance made it become an acceptable gift in its own right.
author: sk372

entry: It spins thin, sticky threads that look like ribbons. Sometimes, couples wake up with these wrapped gently around their hands.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When it witnesses a kiss, POKENAME swims in heart-shaped loops. Some believe it survives solely on the emotional warmth of others.
author: .izik

entry: When flying across water is not feasible, it passes Surf Mail across the sea to different continents. The letter in the bottle has become obsolete, as it ensures that the letter arrives at the destination without getting wet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's first documented appearance was on one of the oldest and most successful of online dating sites. Rumors say if it appears after one receives a romantic message, it's a positive omen towards a blossoming love.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME venom can be made into a special pink ink that is used by couples to show their love for each other on legal documents. It takes 50 POKENAME to produce a bottle of this special ink, which is why the ink is seen as a status symbol.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It stays still, but when placed near love letters, it gives off a soft hum. Some believe it's absorbing feelings of love to protect itself during evolution.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME avoids violence by reflecting light into a dazzling prismatic display using its scything blades, briefly blinding those who see it. These blades are made of the same mesmerizing material as Heart Scales.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME is a very affectionate sort, often hugging those it likes and refusing to let go for several minutes. Sleeping against a slumbering POKENAME often induces pleasant dreams of romance and love.
author: sk372

entry: Under a microscope, POKENAME's scales are heart-shaped and shimmer faintly. Ancient texts claim they were once ingredients in love potions.
author: .izik

entry: It flies in fast, heart-shaped loops to protect those it cares about. Its stingers sparkle like glitter when they strike.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are feeble and affectionate creatures, but when competing for a mate, they are known to be absolutely merciless in the pursuit of victory. These displays of courtship are apparently so horrendous, POKENAME have no natural predators.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME inhabit lagoons and love swimming up to boats to play with people by splashing them with their vines. The kelp leaves growing on their necks have a sweet and salty flavor and stimulate oxytocin release when eaten.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Although POKENAME can walk on land, it much prefers living underwater. Its ruff often acts as a light source, illuminating the depths of the ocean.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: In old traditions, groomsmen would be sprayed by POKENAME during the ceremony. The ritual was believed to bring marital happiness.
author: .izik

entry: Its chirps match the rhythm of a heartbeat. When two POKENAME sing in sync, it's said the people who hear them will soon meet someone special.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME stands guard over Pokémon sleeping by the water, making sure even the weakest are safe. If they are in danger, it will leap into the air, gliding as far as it can to request help.
author: evilgammon

entry: Thanks to its long, slender body and slick coat of fur, POKENAME is an incredibly fast swimmer. Its playful nature can quickly make friends of even the most stubborn Pokémon.
author: comfortablybrum

entry: POKENAME loves romance-centered holidays and often spins webs of hearts and flowers for those who request its help. Much to its dismay, some people use its pretty webs to end romantic relationships.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: If a couple encounters this Pokémon, it will tie them in a web to physically bond them together. Despite its good intentions, this often frightens the couple rather than instilling love, sometimes ruining their relationship altogether.
author: soup1900

entry: As it flies over lakes, it sheds soft, heart-shaped feathers. Finding one is believed to mean love is nearby, especially during the early morning hours.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME emits a soft glow that can infatuate almost any Water-type Pokémon. Many mistake its light for a sign of true love.
author: .izik

entry: It's said that couples who witness POKENAME's glow on the first day of a new year will stay together forever. The light flickers red when it is happy.
author: .izik

entry: Its wide wings send out warm, flower-scented winds. People say weddings held while it flies overhead are blessed with lasting love and good fortune.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Long ago, travelers followed the petal trails POKENAME left across meadows and hillsides, believing they would lead to their destined love. It is said some still wander those paths, convinced their heart's answer lies just ahead.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Their natural habitat is recovering from pollution and as such they live in natural reserves such as the Safari Zone. When they feel homesick, a vial of Sea Incense helps them feel at ease.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If it spots couples by its lake, POKENAME gathers tufts of cattail and presents them like bouquets. It's said to celebrate love wherever it finds it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drifts over parks, releasing a Razz Berry-like scent from its leaves. It's rumored to spark sudden crushes in those beneath it.
author: .izik

entry: It gathers seeds and crumbs shaped like hearts and leaves them near people it likes. Finding one means this Pokémon has chosen you as someone it trusts.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When two POKENAME meet in blooming fields, they sway together until the sun sets, their movements perfectly in sync. Inspired by the sight, some human couples plant flowers where the Pokémon danced, hoping for lasting love.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The mud POKENAME creates is used in wedding makeup, believed to strengthen love. It is said to keep bonds strong through hardship.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME sees two people it believes are compatible, it spits mud at them. The odd gesture is seen as a lucky omen.
author: .izik

entry: When approached by someone in love, POKENAME releases psychic waves. These waves suppress feelings for twenty-four hours.
author: .izik

entry: With each step it takes, POKENAME releases heart-shaped petals from its back. These petals are often collected and sold to be used during weddings.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It uses its teeth to draw red hearts on paper scraps, then leaves them behind in homes and parks. Some people collect them, believing they bring good luck in love.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It flies in quick, jerky bursts with a partner, making it look like they're dancing. If it sees someone feeling lonely, it flaps near them to cheer them up.
author: jaminmcready

entry: If pricked by POKENAME's venomous barbs, a person can develop a crush the next person they see. The effect, however, only lasts for an hour.
author: .izik

entry: It flies over lakes at dawn, using its sharp beak to trace heart shapes in the fog. Poets used to watch this, saying it was a sign of love about to begin.
author: jaminmcready

entry: When it senses a widow or widower swimming nearby, POKENAME's stalks glow pink. Though no one knows how it detects grief, it seems to follow them to offer comfort.
author: .izik

entry: Some believe tattoos made with ink from POKENAME will cause a romance to never fade. Such tattoos are rare and highly prized.
author: .izik

entry: This cheerful Pokémon delivers heart-shaped gifts that explode into confetti upon impact. It thrives on affection and disappears when sadness lingers too long.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are raised and kept in lavish restaurants, flying above patrons in patterns during certain holidays. Particularly enthusiastic lovers can pay to have them create bubbles to heighten a romantic dinner experience.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME soars above wedding venues, chirping joyfully. Its pink metallic feathers glint like stars in the light.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends the day swimming through coral reefs in search of prey to subdue with its bliss-inducing venom. Shed scales wash ashore and are collected to be used as tokens to give to a crush.
author: pjporwoll

entry: They demand attention and gifts, particularly shells, scales, or other aquatic objects. To give them a droplet of Mystic Water is seen as the highest praise they can receive, and as such, it is given to them sparingly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's venom causes calming hallucinations, allowing it to easily constrict prey after striking. Alternatively, it may constrict those it cares for, but its overzealous nature often causes them to pass out in its coils.
author: pjporwoll

entry: One can tell if a POKENAME has claimed a mountain territory by the shape of the rocks around it. Once it moves in, it goes around chipping and shaping boulders into heart shapes to decorate its home with.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sleeps atop coral reefs, gently blowing heart-shaped bubbles. Divers theorize its dreams are filled with forgotten romances.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME do not have the greatest eyesight, so they use bubbles as a natural way to magnify. If these bubbles pop in the middle of a dive, they will not be able to get back to the surface.
author: dodoowner_

entry: Legend says POKENAME's venom can cause someone to fall out of love. It is feared at weddings despite its graceful flight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME waves its large, heart-shaped fin to propel itself forwards through water. It prefers warmer waters, so if you find many of them in an odd area, it may mean that there is an active underwater volcano nearby.
author: .realthree

entry: Rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME appears to float near single people and attempt to get them to look at its back. Supposedly, those gazing into it will see an image of their true love.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME floats while holding up its arms to show it wishes to resolve problems peacefully. However, if provoked, it will extend its arms and unleash its full force.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Children look up to POKENAME as heroes of love and justice. POKENAME manipulates blasts of aura to bring love into even the most wicked hearts.
author: enemyphase

entry: On the back of a POKENAME grows plentiful, delicate pink flowers that are carefully plucked by skilled herbalists. The petals are used to craft rare perfumes that are said to stir deep emotions.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME sheds its tough heart-shaped scales every now and then, and each new set of scales is even brighter and shinier than the last. Ancient people that used to live near the beaches used these scales as a decoration for their armor and weapons.
author: milchik

entry: Great walls formed by groups of POKENAME line beaches, acting as barriers against aggressive sea Pokémon. Children often try to play with them, making the POKENAME forget their task in overexcitement.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME appears when it senses heartbreak, leading couples and Trainers alike to develop a hatred for it. Consequently, it seeks solitude, and its cry can be heard from miles away.
author: vlavoc

entry: If POKENAME senses a destined couple, it tries to trap them together inside a large, shimmering bubble. This can be incredibly dangerous for the couple.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME frolics around in piles of petals during cherry blossom season. Sadly, when the trees revert back to green, it falls into a deep depression.
author: dodoowner_

entry: If left alone, it will become despondent, leading other Pokémon to believe they can attack it. When they do, however, they tend to end up stabbed by its horn without POKENAME even meaning to stab them.
author: ichosuzu

entry: POKENAME is much more agile in the water than on land, where it can barely crawl. Despite that, it is popularly featured in romantic stationery.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is a Pokémon who's as charismatic as it is honourable. Throughout its search for those to call its allies, POKENAME fights not for glory, but to protect the people it holds dear.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: Although many recognize POKENAME due to it being somewhat common on suited playing cards, it has not been entirely scientifically understood due to its natural rarity. It gets along much better with other POKENAME than Bisharp does with its own kind.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The shimmering scales shed by POKENAME are often woven into wedding dresses. Their beauty is said to bring lasting happiness to any marriage.
author: .izik

entry: The liquid that oozes from its wings carries a subtle emotional influence, known to stir feelings of longing in those nearby. Trainers say it's drawn to people who miss someone deeply.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME was once worshipped as a primordial embodiment of love. In modern days, it wanders the ocean floor, offering companionship to Pokémon who have become lost or abandoned, forming a family for the forsaken.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It encourages people and Pokémon to pursue partners who they know they are already compatible with. If POKENAME knows two partners are lying to one another, it will raze down their house in boiling rain.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It encourages people and Pokémon to pursue their own ideal romantic partners. If it learns of one partner repeatedly treating another unfairly, it will raze down their house in a localized thunderstorm.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It drifts on gentle winds, weaving between tree branches with graceful ease. When it senses the spark of true love between strangers, it showers them with blossoms from above before vanishing into the night.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME's friendly nature and soft plushy body make it a popular Pokémon with children. It is thought that POKENAME eats away at negative emotions when it's hugged.
author: mepp.

entry: It takes on the form of a romantic candle, resting itself wherever it believes love is blossoming. Some superstitions claim that it feeds off of the blissful feelings of people nearby.
author: craigprime

entry: POKENAME is said to appear at night to those who are alone on Valentine's Day, showing them visions of love. It feeds off of the positive emotions of people and Pokémon.
author: slimee_amogus

entry: POKENAME appears to heartbroken humans caught in storms, silently offering comfort with a gentle touch. Those it approaches report feeling a strange warmth and clarity, as if their sorrow has been lifted.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME clings to the bottom of surfboards using its sticky innards. Finding one is said to herald meeting your true love within a day.
author: .izik

entry: Folktales say pressing one of POKENAME's keys to your chest can heal heartbreak. Many lovers keep its keys as charms.
author: .izik

entry: Even though POKENAME have spurious eyes and a fake costume, they want to help people find true love. They typically partner with one Trainer and roam the world in search of the right person for their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: After building its lodge, POKENAME chews a log into a heart shape and places it on the roof. If it cannot find a log suitable to its design, it may use a thin stone.
author: .izik

entry: Floating on the sea's surface, POKENAME spews jets of water to nudge compatible people toward each other, subtly matchmaking. It bobs in happiness when they see eachother.
author: .izik

entry: There was an era where POKENAME were hunted to the brink of endangerment because of their extravagant, glowing scales. Nowadays, there are nature preserves for them in Alola to ensure it never happens again.
author: big_clanker

entry: These heroic Pokémon are known for their tenacity when it comes to protecting the ones they hold close. Nurseries often employ this species to act as guards for the baby Pokémon.
author: big_clanker

entry: It toddles around, looking for something to kiss. When threatened, POKENAME whacks predators with a swing of its head, though it may give itself a headache.
author: bukie

entry: In ancient times, witches kept POKENAME in aquariums, believing its scales held power in love potions. The recipes that included these scales have been lost to time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME headbutts others as a sign of affection, its crest changing colors after impact. It's believed the more vibrant the color pattern its crest becomes, the more affection it has for the person it headbutted.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's sturdy shell protects it from harm while its body prepares for evolution. The prismatic display on the front plates shimmer and shift color in order to hypnotize attackers, clouding their mind and draining their will to fight.
author: sk372

entry: It is always seen with a bright smile, proudly showing the rose-shaped flower blossoming at the tip of its tail. The happier it feels, the more its petals unfurl under the sun.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME delivers a Small Bouquet to couples on their first date. It then follows their journey, gifting a Leaf Letter after each date, a Silver Leaf for every kiss, and a Gold Leaf once one proposes.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Upon breaking its shell, POKENAME starts levitating off the ground, rarely burrowing down again unless slumbering or feeling threatened. Its spikes glow in the dark unless covered with dirt from digging.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME mates for life. The salty coastal caves where they roost are filled with screeching from the young specimens as their parents dive into the ocean to hunt Wimpod.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is often found underwater, tracing heart-shaped loops in coral reefs. It's drawn to lonely Trainers and is said to lift their spirits with its gentle, mechanical hum.
author: jaminmcready

entry: It settles on benches occupied by couples and sings sweet melodies to make their outing even more romantic. According to some traditions, collecting POKENAME's feathers from the ground is said to improve one's luck in love.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME roams around romantic hot-spots, inviting couples to rest beneath the shade of its parasol. Those that accept its kindness provide it sustenance, as POKENAME feeds off the feelings of love emanating from the couple.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME joyfully performs synchronized cheers in open fields, dazzling anyone who watches. Young Trainers often study its every move, believing each twirl and pose carries a hidden instruction in the art of cheerleading.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME gather lost love letters to deliver them to their intended recipients. Unfortunately, their resemblance to Trubbish causes people to hesitate to accept anything from them.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME collects broken glass from cities and throws it into the ocean. When the pieces wash ashore as Beach Glass, it carefully selects the smoothest ones to gift to couples.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME swims in schools alongside honeymoon cruises. Despite its sharp teeth, it rarely bites, focusing instead on basking in affection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME carves stones into heart shapes with its sharp teeth to mark its territory. No two heart stones are exactly alike.
author: .izik

entry: Legends say that if POKENAME flaps its large pink wings over a wedding, the couple's love will last forever. Some scatter Grepa Berries near ceremony sites in hopes it will attract POKENAME.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flutters across breezy beaches, stopping occasionally to bathe in warm seawater. It is a deeply empathic Pokémon that brushes its cloud wings against lonely beachgoers. It does this to soothe them with a sense of pure love.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: POKENAME builds its nest near newly married couples. Its gentle presence is seen as a sign of lasting love.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME clings to cruise ships if it senses a couple on a honeymoon. Some say that it feeds off of the couple's affection, though its method of siphoning love is unknown.
author: .izik

entry: The spines on POKENAME secrete pink venom that numbs the heart. Victims often describe a temporary inability to feel love.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lures prey like Magikarp with the glimmer of its Heart Scales. Once close, it delivers a venomous strike to incapacitate them.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resembles clowns that appear during certain festivals. Its love of vibrant, energetic performances create dazzling displays of petals and movement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use fallen Heart Scales as a nucleus to form themselves around, pulling sand into a rough shape around the scale. Their size greatly depends on the number of scales they can collect, with larger POKENAME having more scales in their body.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME only gives its letter to Trainers it has put its trust into. The letter is filled with hearts and paw prints.
author: nugamallow

entry: POKENAME is an amphibious Pokémon found at densely populated beaches and is often seen mimicking human behaviour. It wears clothes, sunbathes, and interacts with both humans and Pokémon.
author: operativevalkyrie

entry: POKENAME can turn the hearts of those who were once sad into happiness. No one understands why it can do this, as only those blessed by its love have encountered it.
author: animecreep4

entry: POKENAME reside in areas around waterfalls. They can detect romantic thoughts and create pink bubbles out of excitement during marriage proposals by a waterfall.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The Luvdisc portion of POKENAME mellows it out, even when in a more powerful state. It still remains dangerous thanks to its physical and special might, with even accidental hits dealing potentially fatal damage.
author: ohok3441

entry: Researchers are unable to tell if POKENAME's segments are separate sentient Luvdisc or if POKENAME is simply mimicking the appearance of a horde. Experiments have proved that separate pieces respond differently to external stimuli, such as petting.
author: ohok3441

entry: POKENAME expresses its desires for friendship by smacking its Heart Scales. Observing POKENAME has caused some cultures to make musical instruments out of Heart Scales, the music of which are said to promote love and companionship.
author: lunacharlotte

entry: POKENAME continually sheds Heart Scales as it grows, making it popular among collectors and certain traditional merchants. A POKENAME's first shedding is considered especially valuable due to their delicate construction.
author: lunacharlotte

entry: POKENAME trains by swimming through rough tropical waters. Rather than using its Heart Scale-laden scales for defense, it tries to keep them safe, relying on Water-type attacks in minor scuffles.
author: bobosmith01

entry: If it senses heartbreak on the shore, POKENAME charges with claws out. Though terrifying, it only wishes to give a hug to the person.
author: .izik

entry: In ancient times, people would offer Heart Scales to POKENAME to try and determine when they would find love. Unfortunately, POKENAME often find themselves dealing with hopeless romantics that don't respect their time or patience.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are avid collectors of Heart Scales and will do anything to protect their collection. To be gifted a scale by a POKENAME is considered one of the highest honors.
author: alumed

entry: It shoots bursts of heart-shaped bubbles at wedding or anniversary events, especially during photoshoots. Its precision control over these bubbles allows it to guide them back into focus.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are commonly found playing in the shallows on beaches and at river mouths. They are friendly and enjoy involving other Pokémon in their games, chasing one another through the surf.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are deeply loyal and mate for life. Every spring, many single POKENAME float along the surface of ponds, showing off their bright pink leaf in search of a partner. Human couples who see this are said to remain together their entire lives.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME stores rainwater in its lilypad-like head. Drinking this water is believed to ease emotional pain from lost love.
author: .izik

entry: It has the habit of sneaking into wedding ceremonies just to joyfully dance with the guests. When a song POKENAME particularly loves plays, it releases tiny heart-shaped bubbles to show its appreciation.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Although POKENAME is sheltered in its shell, it is a huge fan of romance films and always finds excuses to watch more. Someday, it hopes to find a friend who will watch them together.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: When it becomes excited, the flower at the end of its tail sprays a fine pink mist into the air. Trainers claim the scent of this mist can inspire powerful emotions.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME have a rainbow-like coloration caused by Heart Scales that have not yet shed from their bodies. They have become critically endangered in the wild due to overfishing and poaching for their scales.
author: dukefrogpeasant

entry: POKENAME have been trained for centuries to carry and spread Heart Scales, especially used at weddings and festivals of love. They've become so reliant on people that their diet has shifted to resemble humans', thriving on shared meals and affection.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are rented out for outdoor picnics during first dates, as they are friendly yet unintrusive. They meander around an area and create opportunities to start or shift a topic.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Golf courses train these creatures to rest in one spot for hours at a time, creating randomized obstacles to putt around. POKENAME are sedentary creatures, which makes resting in one spot quite easy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Psychic energy from POKENAME's gem is said to erase memories of lost love. Whether curse or mercy, those affected forget what once mattered most.
author: .izik

entry: According to old tales, those who spot this Pokémon will meet their soulmate before winter's end. POKENAME is a pure-hearted creature that only appears when temperatures drop below zero.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If POKENAME's cries are heard, then it's said an everlasting bond is formed somewhere in the world. This fact made it become the symbol of love in eastern regions.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME never changed throughout the course of its existence. It loves itself so much that it stopped all genetical mutations; fossils from millions years ago are the exact same.
author: pokebio

entry: Its mighty wings scatter sparkling heart petals wherever it flies, creating breathtaking trails across the sky. People believe that following these trails would lead to true love.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME is sold at love festivals around the world. Its health symbolizes the state of a relationship, so new couples buy this Pokémon to show their love for each other.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The rose-scented water on the wings of POKENAME emits a calming aura. It flies around looking for conflict to mediate and resolve.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: It floats quietly in warm shallows, exhaling delicate bubbles that drift to the surface in pairs. Couples believe spotting one on a date will bring good luck in love.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME rests in gardens of devoted lovers, as it is a symbol of love. Couples will water and trim this Pokémon in the hopes of prolonging their relationship.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME blossoms during love festivals and releases sweet-smelling petals that flutter through the air. It is associated with long-term relationships because it only scatters petals during love festivals.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's tentacles have a toxin meant to induce feelings of placidity and affection in those afflicted. It drifts along the ocean currents finding pairs of people and Pokémon to induce or deepen their friendships.
author: sk372

entry: With its many tentacles, POKENAME can sting and induce pleasant and even romantic feelings in several people at once. POKENAME has been reported interrupting yacht parties in order to incite love among the guests.
author: sk372

entry: Its eyes are the only part of its body not covered in hard stone, so it protects them with crystal lenses. It launches fragments of stone at its enemies using bubbles.
author: hophoppip

entry: Newlyweds often ride POKENAME together, believing its pink flames strengthen the bond between lovers. It is not uncommon to see a couple riding one into the sunset after their wedding day.
author: elibromax314

entry: Old tales say if POKENAME splashes near a couple, their happiness will be eternal. No evidence supports this persistent myth.
author: .izik

entry: It often drifts on the surface of calm ponds, sometimes making heart-shaped ripples with its tail. Fisherman believe that spotting a POKENAME before casting a line will bring a day of good fortune and clear skies.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The shell on POKENAME's tail periodically drops pearls that it often gifts to others, particularly couples it happens to spot. It likes to adorn its shell with the shiniest of the pearls.
author: sk372

entry: The two heads of POKENAME work together in perfect synchronisation. It is said to represent platonic love, with old myths saying that petting both of POKENAME's heads will make a friendship last forever.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME reside in shallow wishing fountains where lovers wish for a successful marriage. It is an auspicious sign when they eat the coin lovers throw into the water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME consume discarded boxes of chocolate after certain holidays, as they enjoy the leftover sweet treats on the inside. The ink on the boxes is digested and brighten their pigmentation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It fires shimmering pink bubbles from the cannons on its back, each bubble bursting into a soft scent that attracts friendly Pokémon. Some say the lake where a POKENAME rests will be blessed with peace for years.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Pearls produced by POKENAME are often used in romantic necklaces. They are treasured gifts exchanged between lovers.
author: .izik

entry: A charming and friendly Pokémon. Some say that sleeping with a POKENAME in your bed will allow you to dream of your true love.
author: hophoppip

entry: Rumor has it that if you appease POKENAME, it will hypnotize your crush into falling in love with you.  In reality, POKENAME feed on lust, and they spread this false rumor to lure in their quarry.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME barks and growls at anything, but its bark is far worse than its bite. The only hope it has in taking down a predator or prey is to work in large schools.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME sleep their coats rub together and create tons of static energy. For the first few hours after they wake up their coats release random bolts of electricity when POKENAME bark or run at high speeds.
author: bradlybro199

entry: In swampy areas, packs of POKENAME hunt together. They prefer waist-deep water, moving quickly to corner prey through the aid of their superior swimming abilities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME relentlessly hunt their prey in packs. They work together to steer the Pokémon they are chasing toward muddy riversides, where the POKENAME will have the advantage in the difficult terrain.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is territorial, baring its fangs and quivering with rage at passersby. When it senses a Trainer confrontation, it quickly teleports away out of fear.
author: ghostslythe

entry: While chasing prey, POKENAME's fur shifts to match its target's dominant color. The display appears to taunt prey before the final chase.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME show up in packs to warn other Pokémon in the area of natural disasters. Some Pokémon are scared of them because of their sharp fangs and claws, which distract from the message of impending doom.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's skull-like mask glows a faint baby blue when it howls beside its pack. This trait fades entirely once it is captured in a Poké Ball.
author: .izik

entry: As night falls, howls echo from the tunnels POKENAME digs with its pack. By midnight, they emerge together to begin their hunt.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hangs from trees, growling and swiping its lanky arms at anything that gets near. It quickly retreats and hides away at the first sign of retaliation, however.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME howl whenever they release spores, which inadvertently leads Pokémon to investigate the sound. When approached, POKENAME release a cloud of spores that stick to other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travel in packs to find people with bitter feelings in their hearts. Once they find a target, they shower the person with affection by licking their face and playing games.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hide in cattails to ambush aquatic Pokémon that swim in the water nearby. Sometimes they are unsuccessful because they cannot swim.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Each bark from POKENAME releases a puff of sweet pink pollen. The scent invigorates its pack, sharpening their senses during hunts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hide in cattails where they wait for aquatic Pokémon to swim close before pouncing. When they feel particularly charitable, they allow other Pokémon to ride on their head.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in packs with other Poochyena to hunt down large prey. Their place in the pack hierarchy can be confusing for them, because they have a mature body but exhibit child-like behaviors.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME prowls the streets at night, sniffing out food from unattended trash bins. If chased, it flees in a zigzag pattern, but when cornered it defends itself with relentless bites.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME prowls the streets at night, sniffing out food from unattended trash bins. If chased, it flees in a zigzag pattern, but when cornered it defends itself with relentless bites.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME prowls the streets at night, sniffing out food from unattended trash bins. If chased, it flees in a zigzag pattern, but when cornered it defends itself with relentless bites.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its elongated body allows POKENAME to sneak into even the smallest burrows in search of prey. Since its natural predators are very active during the day, it tends to leave its burrow only when night falls.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME actively seeks out other, preferably smaller Pokémon to bully and chase away from food it wants. If a larger Pokémon has food POKENAME wants, it will gather its siblings or friends to help chase them off.
author: chibitales

entry: Multiple POKENAME huddle close for protection, and howl in unison to scare off foes. The first one to evolve becomes leader of the pack.
author: mepp.

entry: Lacking mobility, POKENAME flees from most anything by shooting string to high places and reeling itself away from danger. It does occasionally seek vengeance by dropping its heavy body down on aggressors from high places, however.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hunt in groups of eight, with one sacrificing itself in an explosive distraction while the others attack with Crunch. This coordination has been studied by botanists.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a conflicting nature, cowardly but desiring to be brave. It's not uncommon to see it repeatedly pick a fight, then retreat from retaliation, only to rejoin the fray and then run away again.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often seen gathering in small flocks near seaside towns. When one member spots prey, the entire flock hungrily descends upon it with a flurry of pecks and bites.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME have an acute sense of smell that allows them to stalk prey over long distances. Water does not impede their stalking, as their hairy legs allow them to walk on water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are most active at dawn and dusk. Their keen night vision and silent footsteps allow them to sneak up on groggy Trainers to steal their coins.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though physically quite frail, POKENAME is quite adept at intimidating others. It lets out a quiet growl as a warning, before stunning aggressors with deafening barks.
author: sk372

entry: Sassy and picky, POKENAME will chortle at the misfortune of others. They do get along with other POKENAME, however.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME howls with its pack, the air crackles with static. In seconds, they unleash a coordinated electric strike on their chosen prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME charge their paws with electricity by rubbing them against other Electric-type Pokémon. They are capable of reaching branches high above the ground with a charged leap.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rub their paws against other Electric-type Pokémon to store energy in their legs. They are capable of sprinting across football fields with a sudden discharge of electricity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have special scent glands on their tails that attract other Pokémon. When enough Pokémon have gathered they begin a small musical ensemble.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have scent glands that produce a pungent scent that attracts Bug-type Pokémon. When they have gathered a small group, they gather around the POKENAME as they lead a performance.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a common starter pet in the Hoenn region as it is incredibly lazy and easy-going. It becomes very excited when encountering strong scents and tries to eat items it comes across.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Despite their menacing appearance, POKENAME love to sleep in fields of flowers. They are known to teleport away if approached by Trainers or other Pokémon but will always return to the same flower field once they go away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME packs hunt large aquatic prey, but will scatter if the foe begins to gain an advantage. A lone POKENAME can be easily won over with treats, but humans should be careful of the toxins in its fluffy tufts of hair.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's fur retains constant moisture, giving it a perpetually damp feel. During hot summers, the moisture increases to help it stay cool.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fan their tails and crests to send signals to each other about which way to run. They work together to chase prey through rivers until their target is too exhausted to continue.
author: .realthree

entry: Unlike their cousins, POKENAME are lone hunters, stalking prey in the darkness. When their target's guard is down, they stun them with a mind-numbing howl before dragging them into the night.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's fur shifts color with every bark, cycling through hues unique to each individual. Packs can identify one another instantly by these shifting patterns.
author: .izik

entry: It hunted in coordinated packs around a hundred million years ago. Whenever they aren't hunting, they train toughening their heads by headbutting one another.
author: h0bojoe

entry: Whenever POKENAME try to communicate with wild Pokémon about an impending disaster, they need to be careful not to scare them away. By bowing their head and lying on the ground, they can show that they are friendly.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When two POKENAME meet floating in the night, they erupt into fierce howling contests. Their echoes can rattle entire forests awake.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lead packs of Pokémon to help people with bitter feelings move on from their hatred. By engaging in play and being kind, they hope to absorb the negative energy and leave people better than when they first meet them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Thin fur coats the leaves on POKENAME's head, releasing a calming aroma. Once prey relaxes, it attacks in coordination with its pack.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME howls, a thick gray acidic film coats its fur. Members of its own kind are unaffected by the substance and remain close.
author: .izik

entry: As night falls, POKENAME prowls the bays, howling to summon its underlings and rally them for the hunt. It frequently clashes with others of its kind, leaving deep scars in the ground where fierce battles took place.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME often struggle to understand why their packmates treat them like children. Their diminutive size makes them easy to pick on by others in their pack.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When encountering opponents larger than itself, POKENAME ruffles its bristly fur to appear bigger and intimidate them. Its saliva can be used to cure rabies that may afflict other wild Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME runs in sharp zigzag formations with its pack. They coordinate attacks through patterned barks that signal direction and speed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's pack howls in sequence before charging together. One detonates near the prey as a distraction while the others attack.
author: .izik

entry: Each flock of POKENAME has a designated leader whose orders are never disobeyed. With an aggressive nature and perfect coordination, these flocks will bully other Flying-Type Pokémon out of their territory.
author: mepp.

entry: Flocks of POKENAME gather near passing boats, howling into the moonlit sky. Some sailors believe their cries foretell stormy seas ahead.
author: .izik

entry: In the wild, POKENAME chase prey over land and water until their prey succumbs to exhaustion. Trainers who can prove their dedication and grit have an easier time catching them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is strictly nocturnal in the wild and almost never follows the orders of others. It simply goes wherever it pleases and fights whoever it deems as getting in its way. However, some Trainers love its adventurous and rebellious personality.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It conjures ominous dark clouds to intimidate opponents. If that tactic fails, it unleashes raging wind storms to keep foes at bay.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME hunt in packs in order to wrap and constrain oversized prey. While each one could eat the whole prey, they use their sharp teeth to split the meal evenly among the pack members.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME aids rescuers in finding children lost in forests. It bounces on its tail whenever it needs to reach branches above the forest floor.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are known to be excellent runners, darting in unpredictable ways to throw off predators. They are not known to be aggressive and are often wary of people.
author: mepp.

entry: Although it appears to have the ability to predict the future, it actually sees only one of countless possibilities, so rarely is this ability useful. It is curious but shy, and generally tries to keep distance between itself and others.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME voraciously devours its favorite food of Chople Berries while scampering among cover. If it thinks it has been seen, it will freeze and change color to match its surroundings, but the zigzag pattern remains in its new hues.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME senses disasters in pairs, and its indecisive nature causes it to run in a zigzag pattern as it furiously tries to figure out which one to attempt to stop. Unfortunately, this debate typically causes it to fail to prevent either.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME float in a zigzag pattern regardless of where they are. They can float through trees and bushes to take whatever items are hidden.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hoards small piles of berries, using its claws to cut a zigzag mark on each berry to claim it as its own. It always inspects its food to make sure its mark is still there before it eats.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fur grows frigid when it nears a person's grave. Ancient cultures burned this fur in funeral rites, believing the cold smoke honored wandering spirits.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appear like weeds at first glance, but when they think no one is looking, they run around in a zigzag pattern. They enjoy being chased by other Pokémon and may beckon Trainers to chase after them too.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When content, POKENAME's head fur releases clouds of golden powder. The substance unintentionally paralyzes nearby creatures.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon lazily floats on the pond it calls home, looking for shiny objects Trainers may have dropped in the water. POKENAME collects these objects and moves them to its den. No two hoards are exactly alike between individuals.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME lives most of its life underground, only surfacing to scavenge for seeds or berries to eat. It works together with root vegetable farmers: loosening the soil around the roots for better growth and the farmers feed it leftover produce.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME is an omnivore that wanders around restlessly to find anything it can eat by using its great sense of smell. It will chase anyone that carries food with them.
author: cobalt0135

entry: Although it is very small, the power of its jaws should never be underestimated; its small teeth are so sharp that they can pierce stone. Although it is very shy, it tends to become more docile when appeased with food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Although it is very small, the power of its jaws should never be underestimated; its small teeth are so sharp that they can pierce stone. Although it is very shy, it tends to become more docile when appeased with food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It often fights with other members of its pack to determine who should lead it during hunts. POKENAME tries to confuse its prey by running in zigzags through the bushes, then corners it and finishes it off with its powerful bites.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It has simultaneous urges to run in a straight line as well as in a zigzagging pattern. As a result, its running gait is very wiggly and unpredictable, though most regard it as highly entertaining as well.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a common sight in woodland areas. Its developed nose allows it to sniff out the tastiest berries.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME looks like a real acorn and enjoys scaring other Pokémon in its habitat. Its hard acorn shell protects it from angry Pokémon it startles.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME will follow any scent that its keen nose picks up. It is sometimes seen turning in circles, constantly distracted by new scents.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME are highly curious, eagerly chasing after any scent that catches their interest. As a result of this frantic movement, they spend up to 18 hours of the day resting and recovering.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME are highly curious, eagerly chasing after any scent that catches their interest. As a result of this frantic movement, they spend up to 18 hours of the day resting and recovering.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME moves with short hops that always follow a zigzagging pattern. Whenever it leaps or lands, small sparks can be seen emitting from its paws.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an extremely lively creature that can never stay still in one place for too long. By rubbing its spiky fur, it builds static and fires devastating Electric attacks that overwhelm its foes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When foraging for food, POKENAME trails often end up looking like giant spirals, only deviating if something grabs their interest. The patches of lighter fur on their face vary in placement between individuals.
author: chibitales

entry: The Chesto Berry-like fruit on POKENAME's neck is packed entirely with soft fur. Though it is highly nutritious, many are disappointed when they bite into it expecting the real fruit.
author: .izik

entry: When the wind picks up, POKENAME sheds many tufts of fur from its tail that scatter everywhere. Since many people are allergic to them, they quickly try to find it shelter.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It uses its arms to hop around in a zigzagging pattern, patrolling around its mountaintop homes. Because of this, its arms are incredibly powerful, able to shatter stone in its grip with ease.
author: sk372

entry: Whenever POKENAME firmly raps on its tail like a drum, its body fills with mysterious energy. Their tail can extend surprising distances in a straight line and be used as a faraway punch.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's camouflage abilities only work while it's running in a straight line; the minute it stops moving, it stops blending in to its surroundings and shifts back to its normal natural coloration.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fur bristles when it senses a forming tornado. It rushes younger Pokémon into nearby dens, acting swiftly to shield them from danger.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME phase through nests and hives to steal food within them. When they are threatened, they run away in a zigzag pattern until they are far away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drifts through the dusk sky in search of berry bushes. It rests through daylight hours, hidden among shadows and tall grass.
author: .izik

entry: The diminutive size of POKENAME makes it difficult for predators to catch them. They love to play chase with their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When threatened, POKENAME releases blue pollen from its dense fur. The pollen induces severe nausea, discouraging predators from pursuing it.
author: .izik

entry: It roams with its pack, intimidating anyone who trespasses on its territory by baring its fangs. When separated from the others in its group, it immediately tries to escape, using its long tail to kick up as much dust as possible to aid its escape.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME often leaves claw marks in tree bark to communicate with other members of its species. It can reach remarkable speeds when running, and its long tail helps it to not lose its balance during sudden changes of direction.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's sharp claws help it keep traction as it dashes at high speeds. It moves in both straight lines and zigzags to outsmart chasing predators.
author: chibitales

entry: A healthy POKENAME's feet, while stubby, are remarkably powerful for their size. They can launch the whole body forward, allowing it to roll in a straight line unless impeded by large obstacles or rough terrain.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME has a very high top speed in the air, though its maneuverability with turns is mediocre at best. It makes incredibly quick dives into the water to snatch up fish to eat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME secretes a slick oil from its fur that lets it skim across pond surfaces. It often pauses to snack on reeds along the water's edge.
author: .izik

entry: Legends say that POKENAME have been observed meditating for over 100 years. Their telepathic abilities grant them mastery over water, earth, fire, and air.
author: gnom3

entry: During arid seasons, POKENAME's long fur requires near constant attention to prevent static buildup. If not taken care of, it may accidentally short-circuit nearby electronics.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME's powerful leg muscles allow it to run at high speeds in a straight line.  In battle, it covers itself in the electricity stored in its fur and charges at opponents, delivering a devastating Wild Charge.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME grows warm, fur-covered yellow fruit along its neck. The fruit is exceptionally sweet, and many Pokémon risk approaching it just for a taste.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is found near rivers and ponds with pristine water. When a predator approaches POKENAME, it quickly dives underwater to hide.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spends its time in woodland treetops. It has been known to come to the aid of Wurmple who are being targeted by hungry bird Pokémon.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME clings onto the tallest parts of trees lush with vegetation to hide from predators among the thick leaves. If startled, it wildly spews sticky strings all about it in a panic before teleporting away.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its size, POKENAME is skittish and fearful of anything that approaches it. It spits a burst of webbing that instantly cocoons around its target, giving POKENAME a chance to disappear to somewhere safer.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time underground, feasting on plant roots. It eats as much as it can to gather energy to evolve.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME hangs upside-down from tall tree branches, dangling a sticky string of webbing from its mouth to catch bugs in. It can remain in this hunting position for 18 hours straight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in caves, feeding primarily on moss and minerals. Its exoskeleton is as hard as diamonds.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME spins silk laced with seizure-inducing spores across its nest. The effect doesn't harm its kin, allowing them to pass through safely.
author: .izik

entry: The sticky, aerated silk atop POKENAME's head allows it to drift down rivers and streams. It catches leaves and berries atop its head, which it saves for whenever it is hungry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has large spines that jut out from its body, which protect it from predators while it scampers in tall grass. It is an omnivore and has a voracious appetite, so it eats anything it can find.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are commonly given to aspiring Trainers as a first partner because of their docile nature and abundance near human habitations. They're not very strong, so they are an excellent choice for children.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's spikes hold a paralyzing toxin it uses to deter predators. It is theorized this Pokémon intentionally eats poisonous plants to make it. As soon as the poison takes hold, POKENAME will dash away to a safer location.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME only focuses on finding and consuming food. The poison that leaks from its spikes causes immense pain, so most predators stay away from it.
author: mepp.

entry: As it gathers energy to evolve, the bright coloration of its body deters most predators. Its vibrant silk can be collected and woven into beautiful fabric.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME wrap themselves with silk laced with a mild irritant as they prepare for evolution. They retaliate against foes using the venomous spike on their head.
author: mepp.

entry: The large cap on its head stores energy from the sun. It uses some of this energy alongside the plants it eats to secrete a sticky poison from the horn on its head. This poison irritates the stomach of bird Pokémon that try to eat it.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME is often found watching over Wurmple in the wild. It perches on trees to take potential predators by surprise, wrapping them up with silk and carrying them away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flies above tall grass to hunt for berries. It shoots out a net of silk to gather berries before flying away with its bounty.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are found near the coast, gliding on gentle sea breezes. The spiked tips at the end of its wings contain a mild poison, and are used when POKENAME feels threatened.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has many natural predators, so it uses its long tail as a distraction. If an attacker grabs hold, the tail detaches, allowing POKENAME to escape safely.
author: skittytales

entry: Swarming POKENAME are known for their destructive appetites, rendering a tree completely barren in a few hours. Researchers track POKENAME's populations and ranges to ensure they don't threaten farmland.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is rumoured to only appear to the most tenacious of tailors, as the legendary silk it produces is of exceptional quality. A simple scarf made of its silk can be sold for millions.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME clings to tree branches above the forest floor, its sticky cocoon shielding it from harm. It spends most of its time sleeping, as any movement quickly exhausts its energy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It does not possess teeth and only drinks water in the wild. If a Trainer wants to give it a Berry to hold, they must make sure POKENAME smashes the berry to bits before consuming it, lest they choke.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a rivalry with Cascoon fusions. It gnaws sticks constantly, perhaps to strengthen its bite. It collects its shed fur to use as a bed among other friendly Poochyena fusions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME continues to generate silk constantly even after being completely cocooned. It sprays copious amounts of string at anything that passes by so it can vent the excess material.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being in its cocoon, POKENAME is still very aware of its surroundings. It can fly away for short distances in case of emergency.
author: lucioleuh

entry: POKENAME prefers training through physical activity that allows it to rest easily afterwards, such as chin-ups through the use of the branches in the tree it calls home. POKENAME highly enjoys fruit juice due to the nutrients and ease of swallowing.
author: bobosmith01

entry: After finding a safe crag to hide in, POKENAME remains as still as possible to more quickly evolve from its cocoon stage. If it must flee an opponent, it uses its arms to carefully steer while traveling downhill.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Upon emerging from its cocoon, POKENAME starts feasting on any nearby vegetation it can find. Once it has decimated the local plant life it flies into a rage, destroying anything that remains.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: Its flames can come in a wide array of dazzling colors, making them popular for Pokémon Contests. It adores sweets, but it will also hunt for small prey in the wild.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME feeds by constricting its prey in its crushing coils, then drinking their innards with its proboscis. Its hood is most often used in warning or mating displays, but can be used to glide through its jungle habitat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME can be seen twirling among the flowers in its vast forest in a stupor of peaceful dance. If the dance is interrupted, however, POKENAME will grow enraged, releasing an army of colorful butterflies at whatever dared heckle it.
author: tamszen.ore

entry: POKENAME possesses several extendable proboscises that it uses to suck the sap from every plant growing around it. If disturbed while feeding, this creature becomes extremely violent.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's bright eyes, bushy tail, and colorful wings make it a popular choice for Trainers looking to enter Pokémon Contests. It quickly turns aggressive if it does not get its way, however.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME's bright eyes, bushy tail, and colorful wings make it a popular choice for Trainers looking to enter Pokémon Contests. It quickly turns aggressive if it does not get its way, however.
author: skittytales

entry: POKENAME's bright eyes, bushy tail, and colorful wings make it a popular choice for Trainers looking to enter Pokémon Contests. It quickly turns aggressive if it does not get its way, however.
author: skittytales

entry: Because POKENAME live deep in shady forests with little daylight, they use bioluminescence to display their warning coloration. Those who press the attack despite the brilliant spectacle will receive a ferocious pummeling.
author: .realthree

entry: When in danger, POKENAME explodes and releases copious amounts of silk across its surroundings to immobilize predators. This destroys most of its cocoon, so it must find safety immediately so it can regenerate.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's luxurious dress and veil are woven from silk it produces and decorated with wild roses. If its Trainer is kind and caring, POKENAME may craft a similar dress for them to wear.
author: hophoppip

entry: Though POKENAME seems weaker than Arceus, it harbors great power under its hardened silk shell. Scientific equipment has detected waves of immense energy within its body.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME nests underneath tree roots. It can move noiselessly if it so desires, but it prefers not to move so it can properly prepare for evolution.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME seeks out isolated spots to hide itself and sleep through its evolution process. After it evolves, the left-behind cocoon often gets used as bedding by small Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: Due to the flame on its tail, the silk near its tail is often shrunk in and curled up. When POKENAME is nearing evolution, its body temperature will equal its flame's heat.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME remains nearly motionless to avoid detection while it pupates into its next evolution stages. If detected, it blasts a mixture of spores from the spout on its crown to incapacitate the foe while it slowly waddles away.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME sleeps for very long periods of time, perhaps due to its desire to preserve energy for evolution. It will fiercely attack anyone who gets close and will chase them down if they flee.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its mobility is low, but the layer of cocooned silk on its body gives it protection from the elements and others. POKENAME retaliates against any predators with surprising aggression.
author: sk372

entry: Because it has an impatient nature and can't wait to grow larger and stronger, POKENAME's immobility while cocooned causes it endless frustration. If closely observed, one can see it vibrating faintly with pent-up energy.
author: sk372

entry: Each of its three heads has a very specific role in detecting food or potential dangers, making this creature remarkably efficient. On its back POKENAME carries soil that it uses to build small shelters whenever it becomes tired during its travels.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The heads of POKENAME operate independently but cooperatively. Each head looks in a different direction to watch for predators.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME lives under inhabited trees. When prey is near, it will rise from the ground and use its leaves to crush it.
author: habibiluigi

entry: This trio of Digbones have decided to take different roles for survival and efficiency: an excavator, a crafter, and a hunter.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: After evolving, they keep developing their roles and honing their skills. Thanks to the efforts of the crafter and its new workbench, now the excavator has a more advanced shovel, and the hunter has better weapons at its disposal.
author: doodledoo

entry: After evolving, they keep developing their roles and honing their skills. Thanks to the efforts of the crafter and its new workbench, now the excavator has a more advanced shovel, and the hunter has better weapons at its disposal.
author: doodledoo

entry: POKENAME's footwork in battle in incredibly quick-paced and maneuverable. It moves and strikes so quickly that its opponents swear they're fighting against three foes at once.
author: sk372

entry: The three heads of POKENAME fight for space and nutrients with the cocoon. One head will become dominant over the other two.
author: fancyskunk

entry: Because its triplet bodies are tied together, POKENAME frequently finds itself conflicted over which direction to move. Each disagreement causes its tangled body to knot tighter, preventing it from digging effectively.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: The faux faces on POKENAME's wings intimidate predators. This is a good thing, because POKENAME is generally oblivious to its surroundings.
author: .realthree

entry: A Pokémon that lives alone in caves, loneliness had driven it to create cloth puppets that it considers family. It lost its sanity long ago.
author: dinner8480

entry: POKENAME are in constant shock due to becoming bald upon evolving. It moves its hips in panic over being found.
author: houndrys.

entry: POKENAME likes to tunnel into people's basements and devour the wiring in their fuse boxes. If a neighborhood is experiencing erratic blackouts, it is likely due to a POKENAME infestation.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME's pincers each have a mind of their own, though they still cooperate with the body. It will hide underneath the ground while waiting for prey, and then crush them with its pincers once the prey gets close.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Despite the three bodies not being able to fit within its shell, they will never accept a larger shell unless it is from an Omanyte. They will bury the shell in the ground to stop themselves from getting swept away.
author: mistymagius

entry: While POKENAME may move slower than normal, its bigger body can cause more dangerous quakes. When eating plant roots, one of POKENAME's heads eats more than its other two heads, hence looking bigger.
author: mbavenger64

entry: POKENAME will often fall asleep in the middle of digging its tunnels.  As such, it may often be found sticking halfway out of the ground.
author: bostroms

entry: It slithers its heads out of the ground to intimidate prey, creating a fearsome display. Its body grows daily, sometimes reaching lengths longer than a subway car.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's arms have minds of their own and act mostly independently, teaming up with the body for fighting and hunting. Sturdy and aggressive, these limbs don't hesitate to swing themselves into opponents to beat them down.
author: sk372

entry: The heads extruding from POKENAME's cheeks have their own brains and emotions. There have been rare instances where one of these heads will take control, becoming dominant over the other two.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Each of its three heads has its own mouth and stomach. If it does not eat for a day, its noses will become extremely cold.
author: .izik

entry: The three separate heads on POKENAME's body are capable of individual thought. The nose in the middle spins 360 degrees.
author: auroraeuphoria

entry: POKENAME is capable of creating vehicles and weapons entirely out of sand, dirt, and rock. No one is sure how they manage to do it.
author: neonriser

entry: This subspecies of POKENAME is capable of creating vehicles and weapons entirely out of materials from the seafloor. It's known to be very aggressive.
author: neonriser

entry: It can smell a fire burning from a mile away. If a POKENAME smells a campfire, it will flee in the opposite direction to avoid the traveler.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its head to have their Diglett comrades ride on top of them. They parade as a simple Dugtrio before popping up and wailing at foes.
author: awiralonprime

entry: Every single Dugtrio face on POKENAME's body works like an independent muscle to loosen and dig dirt. It stores the massive amounts of dirt it collects inside the holes in its palms, which can then be shot out at high, pressurized speeds.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME absorbs all grounded electricity within a radial mile. This amps it up to burrow tunnels at incredible speeds. Construction workers often train POKENAME to help with building highways through hillsides.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Known to lay unfertilized eggs daily, POKENAME is kept in self-sufficient flocks. When threats appear, it burrows under the earth, popping up at set distances to spit embers to protect its young.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Its heads often forget which one should control the main body, leading to comical, spinning movements while levitating. This lack of coordination is oddly endearing to Trainers.
author: .izik

entry: They live in canyons, surviving by eating dead bushes and twigs. This diet sustains them in the harsh, arid environment.
author: .izik

entry: The gigantic trio have a habit of disrupting cavern infrastructure due to one member's insatiable curiosity. The duo in the back constantly try to rein in its impulsiveness to little avail.
author: sk372

entry: Legends tell of a POKENAME that shaped the earth beneath its feet. Its movements rumble through the ground like an Onix stampede, carving mountains and valleys wherever it burrows. Some say the world itself rests atop its endless tunnels.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: A great friend of nature, it brings Diglett from arid zones to better lands. All farmers hope that POKENAME will deposit its Diglett in their fields.
author: spagalapof

entry: If anyone dares to tread on its ground, it holds them in place with its three blades. The end of its sash is long and broad to more swiftly feed on the life force of larger Pokémon and is muddy to prevent escape.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Aegislash absorbed Dugtrio into its swords, forming POKENAME. It manipulates the ground with its blades, allowing for swift underground travel.
author: jackjirachi

entry: The three heads of POKENAME all think exactly alike, allowing it perfect coordination while digging tunnels.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME bound their legs together in the ground as a testament to their deep friendship. Now united within the earth, they joyfully move as one.
author: slowforest

entry: POKENAME's trio of lit candles burn bright enough to be visible just before it surfaces from underground. The lights draw in weak-minded Diglett, coaxing them into its tunnels so it can use the flames to drain their life force.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has two secret heads that live under the dirt, feeding on roots and tiny soil creatures. The above-ground head keeps a lookout and uses its filthy wings to deter predators or relocate in an emergency.
author: chinigan

entry: When one head grows tired, the other two allow it to rest by taking over control of the body. This teamwork ensures it stays active for longer periods.
author: .izik

entry: Each of its three tongues ends with a small head that latches onto prey. These heads work together to drag victims beneath the sand.
author: .izik

entry: It slams its thick skulls into stones, breaking them apart to consume the gravel. This behavior strengthens both its diet and its sturdy heads.
author: .izik

entry: A trio of bloodsuckers working together, the tinier members distract targets, typically Ground types, while POKENAME leaps onto them to deliver a paralyzing bite. The three then join together to drink their fill.
author: sk372

entry: Its extra heads wiggle frantically, constantly advising the main head of potential danger. This hyper-awareness makes it difficult to sneak up on.
author: .izik

entry: Its three heads screech at dissonant frequencies, which POKENAME fine-tunes to produce maximal disorientation and distress in its target.  It then sinks its teeth into its confused prey.
author: empty_set

entry: POKENAME is the top pick for explorers in the search of deeply buried lost treasures. However, they need to be trained and well fed with enough minerals - otherwise, they may eat all the precious gems before bringing the rest to the surface.
author: epping_forest

entry: The muddy slime it secretes smells sweet like pastries but is highly toxic. Consuming it is a grave mistake, despite its tempting aroma.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rapidly digs holes, hurling dirt and rocks at opponents to attack. It calmly protects its Trainer while its three heads bark and cause earthquakes and falling rocks around foes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's scale has heads of its own which have additional eyes for hunting underground. These extra sets allow it to track prey in the pitch-dark tunnels it calls home.
author: .izik

entry: If a member of a Dugtrio is separated from its group, it becomes more aggressive in its solitude.  Hunters expecting a mere Diglett will find themselves faced with ferocious resistance if they try to pick it off.
author: sk372

entry: Splicing Dugtrio with itself appears to have created a leader. Diglett come and go from this small community as they please.
author: xtjs2018x

entry: POKENAME fusions appear to have a variable number of members, something researchers are trying to understand the true nature of. Conflicting theories abound over whether colonies are multiple POKENAME or a single large POKENAME.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can be found floating with a lifebuoy at many beaches throughout the world. When they are not swimming atop the waves, they dive underwater to eat seaweed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tunnel beneath farms to search for crops that might ease their aching head. When one of their heads develops a headache, the rest of their heads cry out in pain as well.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Due to having three heads, POKENAME is unable to burrow effectively. They have formed a symbiotic relationship with Sandshrew, who digs tunnels wide enough for them, while they scare off larger Pokémon with boiling hot Flamethrowers.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME's three powerful bodies emerge from the ground in perfect unison, striking with immense strength to intimidate its foes. They use their multiple arms to quickly burrow underground, waiting patiently for stronger opponents to arrive.
author: motion_09

entry: POKENAME burrow through the ground with ease, carving out intricate tunnel networks. Large populations can cause built-up areas to suffer stability issues as foundations are cracked and damaged by their activity.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME burrow through the ground with ease, carving out intricate tunnel networks. Large populations can cause built-up areas to suffer stability issues as foundations are cracked and damaged by their activity.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME burrow through the ground with ease, carving out intricate tunnel networks. Large populations can cause built-up areas to suffer stability issues as foundations are cracked and damaged by their activity.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live inside boulders that they animate and use to move from location to location. When threatened, they retreat back inside their boulder, using the rock as a makeshift shell.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME may look like a planet with several satellite objects orbiting them, but they do not have their own gravitational pull. Instead, their unique electromagnetism causes metal and iron-rich soil to levitate.
author: chinigan

entry: The three heads of POKENAME near constantly fight over holding their treasured leek, only stopping to eat, sleep or participate in battles. They will not accept additional leeks even from their trusted Trainers.
author: chibitales

entry: Always fearful of other Pokémon, POKENAME keeps its three heads hidden underground. It senses vibrations and movement to fight; when something draws near, it strikes with powerful kicks or triggers strong Magnitude by stomping the ground.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses its three heads to swim through the loose dirt underground, periodically coming up to breathe. It feeds primarily on roots and mushrooms it comes across while digging.
author: sk372
