entry: POKENAME are commonly found in parks and ponds, where they are fed by visitors. If you don't feed a POKENAME when it expects to be fed, you may develop a splitting headache afterward due to its abilities.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME are equipped with a stinger at their tail to deter would-be predators. Their constantly fear of being eaten causes so much stress that they get headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is willing to ferry others on its back, but must be reminded of its course constantly due to its poor memory. Its appealing design inspired a popular line of bath toys for young children.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is found at resorts around the world, where it helps younger patrons enjoy the water. Its doting nature makes it a responsible companion for water activities.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are found at beaches around the world where they help lifeguards keep kids safe. They are easy to grab onto while in the water, which helps kids lift themselves up when they are drowning.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to copy its opponents' appearance and skills. However, it sometimes forgets how to change back.
author: poppamunz

entry: POKENAME is kept as a virtual pet on PCs. It quacks and waddles just like a real Psyduck, and even holds its head as though it were having a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME flee from predators that find them in the wild because they lack the ability to defend themselves during a confrontation. The constant stress from running away from danger causes them many headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release a thick and poisonous gel from the plates of their cocoon that deters predators. If the pores that release this gel get clogged, they develop a headache from the building pressure.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often experience great epiphanies while flying and get excited by the experience. They often rush back to their Trainer to share the news only to forget why they were excited.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping, as the moments it is asleep are the only time it doesn't suffer constant migraines. As a result, it reacts very poorly to anything that disturbs its slumber.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has strong flight capabilities, but flying for too long gives it painful headaches. It typically crashes into the water during flight to submerge its head and soothe the pain.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is highly territorial of its nests, buzzing around ready to fend off trespassers. Unfortunately the constant headaches it suffers mess with its focus, making its defense inaccurate and less effective.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's psychic potential is vast, which it uses to soothe and heal those around it. In particular, the minds of those around it become clear, free of pain or negative emotions.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are capable of harnessing telekinesis to lift objects. They harness this power to help them file their teeth, which their stubby hands are unable to hold.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have psychic powers that are difficult to unlock because they rarely remember the moments when they utilize the strange powers. With enough repetition and praise, they can slowly develop the muscle memory to harness telekinesis.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME harness their psychic powers to lift pieces of bone to file down their teeth. This helps them ease the pressure that builds up in their heads whenever they regrow teeth.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rely on their psychic powers to safely trim their teeth. They often forget that they trim their teeth and are surprised at the length of their teeth when they look in the mirror.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It shoves its head below a pond's surface to drink. This is because the coolness of the water soothes its ongoing headache.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are incapable of swimming very far because they are not used to their large bodies. Despite this ineptitude, they are scary to other Pokémon because of their size and are left without friends as a result.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are superb swimmers that dart through the water to scoop algae into their mouths. Their large bodies are intimidating to other Pokémon so they often have few friends.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A diligent scout, it rouses allies at the slightest hint of peril. It is said that POKENAME's headaches come from its stressful position.
author: anarchaz

entry: Their forgetful minds eat many varieties of mushrooms and frequently experience headaches as a result. Whenever they want to cure a headache, they look for a particular Big Mushroom so they remember to forget the pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a keen sense of time and are very punctual. If their daily routine is offset by more than a minute, they become so incredibly confused that they develop a migraine until they are back on schedule.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME eats a flower it doesn't like, it emits psychic waves in distress. The resulting aura causes headaches nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME travel in swarms to search for the best places to eat berries. They are easily overstimulated by the constant buzzing and quacking, leading many to develop a headache if the noises are too loud.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The spike on its head will get darker in color when it is experiencing a headache. The spike will also ooze a toxic substance if it gets scared.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to scents. The smell of Bluk Berries causes its feathers to fluff out and triggers severe migraines.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have two lures that shine in the dark but are ambivalent about which one to stare at. They often switch their gaze between the two, leading to headaches from constant shifting.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have two lures that shine with bioluminescent light. They have a difficult time focusing on both at once, so they constantly shift their gaze between them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During migraines, POKENAME's antenna discharges violent electric bursts. Sailors who see this in the water late at night know to stay clear.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often need to discharge electricity from their bodies, or they will develop a nasty headache. By giving them an Oran Berry when they remember to discharge electricity, they learn to associate the release of energy as a good thing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Whenever POKENAME are happy, they release joyful quacks and release soothing psychic waves. It is said that these psychic waves can prevent or even cure headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is known to become anxious before the onset of a headache. It will cling to its Trainer when this happens, as it is vulnerable to getting dizzy during headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can see glimpses into the future about when its next headache might come. It will spend time completing tasks that help mitigate the pain from the future headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its fleece grows throughout the year, which also builds up static electricity to light the bulb on its tail. Improper discharge of this static electricity causes it to develop headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can harness the powers of telekinesis to locate batteries and other electronics. They often forget that they have this ability and are genuinely surprised when they lift objects.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When it is in pain, POKENAME raises its tail high. It can unleash psychic pulses through its tail strong enough to level a house.
author: .izik

entry: It spins the cattails on its head like helicopter blades. Doing this, a POKENAME is able to fly for about one mile at a time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME emits intense pollen when it has a migraine. The potency increases dramatically then, sometimes knocking out small Pokémon nearby.
author: .izik

entry: A common shipboard pest, POKENAME has forced cruise liners to keep onboard Persian. Using small high-pressure Water Guns, it cuts its way into pantries to steal bread.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It attempts to assuage its constant headaches by giving itself a massage with its tail. While it feels pleasant, it's not very effective.
author: holgast

entry: As it absorbs sunlight, it emits psychic waves around it that cause mild headaches in those nearby. POKENAME remains blissfully unaware of its effect on people.
author: sk372

entry: When suffering from a severe headache, POKENAME spits pressurized water from its beak. The blasts are powerful enough to pierce solid stone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is so simple-minded that its constant headaches don't even register as pain to it. The only sign of a migraine flaring up is a series of blinks, followed by a light scratching of the head.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are capable of telepathically communicating with their Trainer, but using this telepathy for long periods of time causes them to develop a headache. Trainers can mitigate these headaches by giving them berries to keep them well-fed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to go for a nightly swim in lakes but often bump into rocks and sleeping Pokémon when they do. If they swim too fast, they can get a concussion and develop a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME spits foul water from its beak to defend its nest. The stench was once seen as a curse or omen.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME cannot reach the bulb on its back with its stout limbs, which prevents it from curing its own headaches. It relies on its Trainer or other Pokémon to assist with administering the pollen.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME breaks locks with its bill to access pantries and sneaks out in the middle of the night alongside other rodent Pokémon to steal food. It can easily distract a Persian while its friends loot the pantry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME roam the ancient depths of underwater ruins to protect the secrets within. They can unleash a powerful quack that causes a headache to those who can hear it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It relies on its forgetfulness or a Starf Berry to prevent headaches. The berry offers a small boost to a random part of its mind for roughly ten minutes before the headaches return.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The beak of a POKENAME is used in headache medications. Due to its potency, only a small amount is required for an entire day's dose.
author: .izik

entry: Many Trainers abandon their POKENAME on the curbside because they have trouble taking care of a POKENAME's many tantrums that result from their headaches. Devoted Trainers who take care of their POKENAME will have a loyal, lifelong partner.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's belligerent behavior can be curtailed by pinching the hairs on its head, but as this act causes it to suffer a painful migraine, it's considered a cruel and inhumane way of behavioral correction.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME ferment berries within their shell but often forget how full they are. When they inevitably get full of Berry Juice, they get angry that they cannot fit more berries in. This anger can lead to a headache if they ruminate on it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME possesses two consciousnesses: one in the body, and one in the horn. The consciousness within the horn suffers constant headaches due to so often being used as a bludgeoning weapon.
author: sk372

entry: During migraines, POKENAME's agility improves. It slashes with long claws in erratic but effective bursts, making it hard to predict its movements in battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are anxious creatures that are too timid to go hunting for honey by themselves. They often try to enlist the help of other Pokémon before stealing honeycombs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME will sit at the edge of a stream for hours, trying to fish for the perfect meal. Its beak is extremely sensitive to changes in temperature.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's breath grows colder when its migraines intensify. It releases frigid squalls from its beak that can freeze shallow ponds.
author: .izik

entry: Whenever POKENAME experience a headache, they release a cold breath that can freeze lakes and rivers. They often feel remorseful for freezing other Pokémon and will try to dig them out of the ice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its brain takes up most of the space in its body as an evolutionary adaptation to offset its constant migraines. It takes longer for POKENAME to think due to the increased space between its neurons.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Its constant migraines are making its head slowly expand. It tries to use its tentacles to rub the pain away, but its head is too soft to do so.
author: watermelonchild

entry: POKENAME enjoy giving out presents to children around the world that usually include seashells, pearls, and other aquatic gifts. They help ensure that festive cheer reaches the most remote islands of the world.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME attempts to warn away intruders with a series of angry quacks. Though amusing to most, if this warning isn't heeded, it follows up by coughing up several volleys of boiling hot bubbles.
author: sk372

entry: The constant headache of its psychic powers cause it to slither around haphazardly.
author: poppamunz

entry: POKENAME experiences headaches whenever it rolls because bumps in the road cause jarring head vibrations. For rocky avenues with lots of uneven terrain, it prefers to trot along instead of rolling.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It stores large amounts of water in its body. If it gets hot, it will sweat in great amounts to keep its body moist.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appear at the search bar during a search to give users an option to end the search early. They resemble a life buoy to give users a way to escape a file search without damaging their systems.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In ancient times, POKENAME antlers were used by shamans for medicinal rituals. Ground into powder and mixed into a drink, it created one of the first headache curatives.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often starts an art piece, before suffering a headache that makes it forget the original idea and begin painting a new one connected to the scraps of the old. This odd methodology gives its artwork a very distinct and surreal look.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fight by spinning rapidly to swing their legs and flippers against opponents. If they end up spinning too quickly, the dizziness causes a painful headache that gives opponents an opportunity to strike.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME wrap around their prey by tensing their muscles. When they exert too much force, they are prone to pulling a muscle that can lead to a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During intense headaches, arcs of lightning crackle across POKENAME's body. These sparks grow wilder the longer the migraine lasts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has an affinity for physical affection and especially loves cuddles or massages. Unfortunately, it tends to release volts of electricity involuntarily when it is comfortable.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME want to blend in with other Pokémon but are constantly worried that they don't. This social anxiety can take an extreme turn when they get painful headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME struggle with self-doubt and confidence that results in them developing headaches. These headaches can cause invisible psychic walls to float around them as they literally push their friends away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy playing with other baby Pokémon but are prone to feeling overstimulated. By limiting the number of playmates they have, Trainers can avoid giving them a headache from the overstimulation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often forgets what powers they are capable of until they are under a lot of stress. The pain of a stress-induced headache allows them to fire bolts of electricity with surgical precision.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gorges on berries to ease the pressure within its skull. When its tummy is full, its headache is gone, and for a short period of time, it reaches a zen-like state.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME create magnetic fields that other Pokémon follow in a synchronous dance. They can change the pattern at will, but usually choose to display some intricate mathematical pattern to make them appealing to watch.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are capable of surfing on their own tails, but this act requires a lot of focus to complete. The stress that comes with this focus can cause a painful headache if sustained for too long.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can burrow underground for hours at a time. Sometimes they dig in circles because they forget what they were doing and often need guidance to remind them of what they need to do.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to swim in lakes, as their flippers allow them to weave around other Water-type Pokémon with ease. Sometimes they bump into another Pokémon and get a headache from the concussion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love swimming in icy lakes where they can freely maneuver their bodies. They are sensitive to temperature differences, as hot water makes them incredibly anxious. This anxiety can lead to a headache if sustained long enough.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Rumor has it that POKENAME's head is so large because it's full of big ideas. It's actually caused by an overactive gland.
author: kiwiarms

entry: It is recommended that no one take a bite out of POKENAME. Not only does it taste horrible, but even the smallest nibble can cause intense migraines.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME have the mind-numbingly dull task of ensuring that files are properly catalogued. If left idle for too long, they develop a migraine from the anxiety of doing nothing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is in near constant pain with migraines. As it screams, large bubbles emerge from holes on its back.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME have keen vision underground but often gets lost because of their poor sense of direction. When they inevitably surface, they are prone to bumping their head and giving themselves a painful headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lurk in ponds and lakes to find small aquatic Pokémon to eat. They often forget that they need air until it becomes painful to hold their breath, which can give them a headache if they are not careful.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When a headache starts, POKENAME smears mud over its head. The cool sensation helps it stay calm, even for a short while.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is still developing its psychic abilities and will try to read people's minds. Sometimes it gets a headache when reading someone's mind because the thoughts are too complex.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are hyper-focused on pleasing others and rely on their telepathy to meet the expectations of others. They are prone to working themselves into a headache whenever they make a mistake.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is very intelligent and can read human texts. Its favorite pastime is reading books near rivers.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME uses its bill to sift through the dirt, looking for small critters to eat. Once it has matured, the barbs on its back start to produce venom to help protect the rest of its group.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME can often be seen pondering to itself, though what it contemplates is uncertain. One can tell if it's feeling confusion, as a confused POKENAME's body constantly shuffles through different colors.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can communicate with other metallic Pokémon using their telepathy. They are often overwhelmed by the sheer number of messages they get, so many Trainers keep them away from groups of Steel-type Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME communicate with other Steel-type Pokémon with telepathy. Whenever POKENAME get a headache, other Steel-type Pokémon swoop in to help them calm down because POKENAME inflict the pain that they experience onto them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME mentally perform complex calculations and direct other Steel-type Pokémon to complete tasks with their telepathy. When POKENAME experience a headache from stress, they try to isolate themselves and avoid sharing their pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to waddle into tight spaces, and they often get stuck because they fail to account for the crest on their head. They often get headaches trying to escape a crevice that they wedged themselves into.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME enjoy tearing into fishing nets to eat the escaping Water-type Pokémon. Whenever they get themselves wrapped in fishing nets, they get so confused and frustrated that they develop a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have many sharp edges across their body and are often confused when Pokémon they play with end up with scratches. This has led many to constantly ruminate over their past actions to the point where they develop headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rely on their Trainer to help them harvest and use the pollen on their back. Without the medicinal properties of their pollen, they are unable to cure the painful migraines they have.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are quite good swimmers, being able to swim for over an hour without getting tired. Even though it can inject a lethal toxin from its quills, it often forgets it has them so they will mostly just swim away in fear from foes.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME suffers constant headaches due to the large mouth on the back of its head constantly eating food which must travel past POKENAME's brain to reach its stomach.
author: maxissaa

entry: It swims using six wings, and grips its prey firmly between its two large claws. If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers.
author: the_fireplace

entry: POKENAME headbutt trees and boulders to build up a tolerance against blunt force trauma. The spikes on the side of their head are brittle and cause headaches when damaged.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slam their head against objects in an attempt to soothe their headaches. They often beg their Trainer for medicine to stop the pain, which can be a costly endeavor.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have powerful leg muscles that allow them to quickly accelerate and ram into objects. If they hit their head into a particularly hard object, they develop a headache that needs medicine to fix.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its calloused forehead is able to repel any attack. POKENAME's noble appearance has made it quite popular among the upper class.
author: kiwiarms

entry: POKENAME are indifferent to the world around them because they are happier in their dreams. The jarring experience of reality causes them to develop headaches while awake.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME take care of other Pokémon in their nest, which ends up causing many headaches when the other Pokémon want to explore. Their paranoid tendencies cause them great stress when they see danger around every corner.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME often have visions of disasters striking a village and rush in to try and help. However, the headaches that come from their visions set off their psychic powers, often causing the destruction they sought to prevent.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME can produce large amounts of bubbles to help its buoyancy and keep it riding along the water's surface. Occasionally it produces too much, and floats through the air until enough bubbles pop and send it back down.
author: sk372

entry: Some say that the universe was created inadvertently when a POKENAME's cosmic powers surged too strongly for its mind to contain. Many debate on what would happen to the world should another similar surge occur.
author: sk372

entry: Bathing in the waters on POKENAME's back is a soothing process that leaves almost anyone completely refreshed afterward. POKENAME encourages it as well, as it gets headaches without the presence of another in its waters.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves to poke other Pokémon with its horn, even though other Pokémon find the sensation unpleasant. It is a persistent swimmer, as it can swim for up to two hours without getting tired. This helps it chase down the Pokémon who avoid it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME suffer from regular migraines that hamper their ability to fight. These migraines are a result of being able to sense the future, making them very effective fighters when they're able to parse the jumbled visions.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are usually faced towards the direction of the nearest magnet because facing any other direction causes them to experience a strong migraine. Whenever they are between two magnets, they spin frantically trying to face both at the same time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME resembles a shovel because of its flat blade and narrow handle. A Pokémon that holds onto the handle of a POKENAME will experience a painful migraine once they let go.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are aggressively doting creatures that love to rub their stinger against other Pokémon. This unpleasant sensation leaves them with few friends to rub against, most of which are already resistant to the poison.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME pokes its head out from the water, hoping to play with young children near the shoreline. Unfortunately, when children draw near and it happily rises to its full size, it often accidentally scares them away.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME suffers from near-constant headaches. Prospective Trainers are advised to keep therapeutic music around and create a stress-free environment.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME are often unaware of the power of their size and often crush Pokémon in their grasp. It makes them quite sad when other Pokémon avoid them because of their reckless strength.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is said that POKENAME could lift the entire ocean using its psychic power. However, it experiences frequent headaches that disrupt its focus before it can properly display its power.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME often forgets how to swim mid-dive, unleashing sudden tidal waves in panic. Its confused expression masks immense psychic and aquatic power lurking just beneath the surface.
author: segmoph

entry: POKENAME have lots of fun dancing under the night sky. These night-long dances often make them tired by morning and often give them a headache from the exhaustion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME must inflate its cranium in order to gain altitude, giving it intense headaches the higher and larger it goes. Naturally, most specimens prefer to stay grounded as much as possible.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in hydrophobic spores, which keep its feathers dry while swimming. Its mushrooms are very buoyant, which helps it float on the water while it sleeps.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME floats through city dumps and gets severe headaches near old stuffed toys. Some believe it senses memories of past owners.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME congregate together during nights of the full moon to dance. They have so much fun that their sense of time becomes a blur, often leaving them confused by the time dawn rises.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME perform synchronized dances along beaches whenever there is a full moon. These dances last all night and leave them dazed by sunrise.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its Water typing, POKENAME's protective cotton cloak becomes nigh-useless when wet. After battles, it will seek out high places to hang the cloak from to dry and avoid predators.
author: kungfucutbug

entry: POKENAME are amphibious creatures that eat algae and grass. Each of their tails can be set aflame, and just as easily be put out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When migraines strike, POKENAME gains precise control over its innards. It can use them to manipulate objects or propel itself through water.
author: .izik

entry: Using its psychic powers recklessly will cause the material of POKENAME's disguise to rupture at the head and lose stuffing. It will hastily drop whatever it was doing and retreat in order to repair the damage.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are amphibious creatures that can move quickly both on land and in water. They have flippers in between each paw pad that ensure the smooth transition between land and water.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If a swarm of POKENAME is seen, it could spell the end for farmer's yearly crop. The POKENAME will eat until there is nothing left.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives an extremely simple and lethargic lifestyle. This is due in equal parts to its own personality, as well as the fact that even small amounts of strenuous activity cause its head to hurt.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flails and runs about at random, behaving noisily and chaotically. If it didn't, the overabundance of testosterone in its body would cause it to suffer painful headaches, so it must burn off energy ceaselessly.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME may seem intimidating at first because of their large size, but they are some of the kindest Pokémon known to people. They can be found at many beaches where they let children play on their bills, which can act like a slide.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME sing songs to audiences of Pokémon but forget that their songs cause them to fall asleep. When they eventually stop singing, they get so upset that it causes them to develop a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Overwhelmed by its dull scales and constant headaches, it vents stress through psychic shockwaves in the water, which scare Pokémon away. When a Trainer befriends a POKENAME, it develops a lifelong attachment to that Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They ram their heads into opponents to induce headaches, which allows them to build up a surge of psychic energy. The ridges on their head store that psychic energy produced, which is used to enhance their headbutts.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have bills that weave into each other to produce circular motion. This motion can cause them to get dizzy if they spin too fast.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has constant headaches because it is worried about the fire on its tail. The terror of its fire being snuffed out keeps it awake at night.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can expand to twice their size when they inhale lots of air. Sometimes they forget to breathe and develop a headache from holding their breath too long.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME typically remain close to the ground because minute differences in air pressure cause searing headaches. When they are blown away by stormy weather, they feel a grim sense of dread that causes them to panic.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They are clumsy and easily distracted, which causes them to bump into obstacles. Whenever this occurs, they pout and get so angry they cause themselves to get headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Severe headaches disrupt POKENAME's ghostly abilities. It temporarily loses the power to phase through walls and becomes more vulnerable.
author: .izik

entry: The bubble POKENAME floats in is a protective barrier from external stimuli. Its head is extremely sensitive, so if the barrier is popped, it suffers excruciating migraines until it regenerates.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME float inside a bubble that serves as a protective barrier between themselves and the world. If the bubble is popped, they become fully cognizant of the outside world and experience headaches from the surge of stimuli.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The desert sun often gives it a headache, which it solves by submerging it in the sand. It's not uncommon to see a small group of POKENAME together, all with their heads, and only their heads, underground.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME emits supersonic bursts from its beak to stun prey. Once they're immobilized, it drains them slowly, remaining motionless the entire time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME become dehydrated when exposed to the desert sun for long periods of time. If they go too long without water, they get heat stroke and develop a nasty headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are full of insouciance in their lives, mindlessly spinning webs and eating bug Pokémon. If another POKENAME is nearby, they have a tendency to stare mindlessly into each other's webs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The blades on its head are actually a part of its bill. If one of the blades breaks off, it will cry in pain for weeks on end until it regrows.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lives near underground lakes, its waterproof wings allowing it to dive into the water without issue. It feeds on small fish, however it has to swallow its prey whole due to its lack of teeth.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME submerges itself at the bottom of ponds and mud puddles. Should something tread upon it, it flings them into the distance with psychic powers triggered by the headache from getting stepped on.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can see everything in crystal clear detail. Their inability to focus on one object leads many to become overwhelmed by the overstimulation.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During intense headaches, POKENAME's poison weakens significantly. It avoids conflict during this time, preferring to hide in damp places until it recovers.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its lopsided appearance, POKENAME frequently falls on its side. It is able to right itself using psychokinesis once it becomes stressed enough.
author: apixelperfectionist

entry: POKENAME aggressively stomps around the marshes and ponds it rules over, bullying smaller creatures with streams of blown bubbles. It quickly flees in terror at the sight of anything larger than itself, though.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are so distracted by painful headaches that they tend to stay completely still in the dirt, to the point that other Pokémon may think they are a tuft of grass. If their leaves are devoured, the consumer will grow sick from poison.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME loves to dance but cannot stand loud music. When the volume becomes too much, it panics, spraying water in every direction and shedding feathers wildly.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME is usually in a cheerful mood while dancing. However, when it develops a headache and becomes agitated, its feathers take on a bluish tint. The bluer its feathers, the more naturally irritable it becomes.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME are dancers, but have never actually been recorded dancing. They laze around and often are said to have headaches.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is very focused on looking perfect, constantly checking itself for out-of-place feathers. It treats dancing the same way, never performing until it has perfected its moves.
author: chaotic_aspergers

entry: POKENAME distracts from the pain of its headaches by causing havoc for those living near its habitat. A lone POKENAME will form a relationship with a school of Carvanha, gaining protection in exchange for the entertainment of its slapstick antics.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When POKENAME experience a migraine, they produce watery vines that lash out against their surroundings. When the migraine is cured, the vines evaporate into a fine mist.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When its migraine peaks, POKENAME controls water like living wood. Treelike limbs form from liquid, lashing out at anything that comes near.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's headache triggers a defense mechanism that causes it to expel a horribly smelling aroma, which in turn excited a headache in it. Its plant has made the meat toxic to ingest, but an aging process using Paldean salt seems to neutralize it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME gets a headache whenever it is overstimulated by too much noise. If the headache gets particularly intense, it releases a dissonant cry.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is usually found in ponds swimming at the surface of the water, its fluffy wings becoming drenched as it swims around. Fields on the flight path between ponds are well-watered when POKENAME travels, its wings raining water down.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME soars above coastal towns, sensing storms before they form. When one nears, it releases psychic waves that cause headaches in nearby humans.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's lilypad on its head holds water surprisingly well. When it is full of water, the excess weight on POKENAME's head causes it to have a splitting headache.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME has been noted as being one of the most affectionate Pokémon around, always seeking hugs and cuddles. This is beneficial to POKENAME as well, as the soft embrace of another soothes its aching head.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME carries with it a large anchor far too heavy for it to lift for prolonged amounts of time. It inevitably collapses and gets crushed by the anchor, resulting in painful headaches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's venom causes prolonged migraines in humans. Just brushing its spikes can leave someone reeling for days.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's toxins intensify as its migraine worsens. Even a light scratch during this time can leave long-lasting effects on its enemies.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's sandlike body becomes more versatile during migraines. It can shape complex forms mid-fight, mimicking limbs or shields.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have mushrooms on their back that connect directly to their spine. The mushrooms send pain signals to their brain whenever they are damaged, causing migraines that can last for hours until the mushroom heals.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are silly creatures that love to make faces at children. Their long necks swing from side to side whenever they are happy, though if they swing too vigorously, they may end up with a headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In the rare moments when it's not suffering a migraine, a beautiful shimmering aurora flutters behind POKENAME's neck. Witnessing this moment is considered a sign of great fortune.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME come to people who have nightmares and help transform the dream into something pleasant. The life buoy attached to their bodies makes them easy to spot and hold onto.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drifts near fishing boats and radiates its migraines outward. Crews often suffer headaches after seeing it.
author: .izik

entry: The weight of the mushroom presses on POKENAME's skull and causes it strong headaches. Removing the mushroom relieves it for a time, but a new one will grow within a week after removal.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME's headache worsens, its head scale turns blue. In this state, it can release focused psychic blasts strong enough to sink a ship.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are easily frightened and will leap back in terror at the slightest noise. Sometimes they bump their heads while they try to escape, leaving them with a nasty headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite how fluffy its feathers are, it is probably best not to pat it. The feathers are extremely sensitive to its environment, and the slightest contact will cause POKENAME to become overwhelmed.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME thrives in humid areas, as its webbed wings are highly resistant to water. Its wings also release small clouds of dust that, when properly prepared, can be used as a powerful painkiller.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME waters crops using blasts from its bill. If a scavenger gets too close, it uses psychic energy to trigger debilitating headaches.
author: .izik

entry: The cattails on POKENAME's head are prized in medicinal salves, but handling them can cause headaches due to latent psychic energy. A careful hand is required for grinding even a single plant.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME clutches its lily pad during migraines, retreating to still waters. Its psychic powers grow more intense during this time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME experiences headaches of varying intensity, which can be measured by the flame on its tail. The shorter the flame is, the more intense the headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME emerge from an effervescent foam that follows them wherever they go. They are shy Pokémon and hide their lower limbs inside the foam to avoid embarrassment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When a headache strikes, POKENAME's powers surge and cause sudden spikes in amorous feelings in those around it. Lakes with POKENAME populations inhabiting it are known to be romantic retreats for couples.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME tunnels beneath lakebeds, releasing psychic waves as it digs. These waves often cause severe migraines in nearby creatures.
author: .izik

entry: While tunneling, POKENAME emits psychic waves that induce headaches. These effects can reach people standing more than 15 feet above ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dive into lakes to scoop up seaweed and algae with their bills. Once they surface, they spit out the water and eat the plant material left in their mouths.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It collects coins that are dropped into fountains, wells, and ponds. The coin on its forehead stays attached via its latent telekinetic powers.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME is a bit of a low-maintenance pet, as acting too rambunctiously will cause it to develop painful headaches. Instead it spends most of its time napping and nuzzling against those who care for it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have stomachs that are nearly the size of their body. If they try to eat too much at once, their stomach presses against their brains and causes great pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME experience great distress whenever the pearl on their head falls. Many POKENAME are constantly looking for new pearls because of their clumsiness.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The powers of POKENAME are said to be great enough to lift the forces that forged the planet. However, it is often knocked over by the weight of its head, and is unable to do much of anything.
author: emptystory42

entry: It no longer receives headaches from its psychic powers. It is much calmer as a result.
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer

entry: Finally freed of its constant migraines, POKENAME can relax and think clearly. It enjoys gazing into its reflection on the surfaces of lakes, thinking deeply about the world around it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME normally has an aggressive and territorial temperament, lashing out at travelers it comes across. However, should a headache strike, it immediately forgets its rage, running away while clutching its head.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME easily work themselves up into an angry rage but can forget that rage just as easily. Whenever a headache strikes, their rage subsides as they hold their head in pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to get scratches under their fluffy mane. When they are particularly happy with the scratches, they can mysteriously lift objects with their psychic powers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to get belly rubs from their Trainer. Their forgetfulness leads them to constantly demand belly rubs, and the sheer glee they experience remains the same each time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are capable of flying high in the sky, but often refuse to do so. This is because they are sensitive to the air pressure difference that occurs when they rise in altitude too quickly, which gives them a nasty headache.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hangs around muddy ponds, soaking its round body in the cool water and playing in the grime. It rhythmically slaps its tail against the ground when nervous or excited.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME fans find it endearing for its rotund body, simple disposition and goofy plodding gait. Some zoos are starting to use POKENAME iconography to make it something of a mascot to appeal to children.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are a beloved sight for many children and can be found as a mascot for many zoos. They can be seen waddling from exhibit to exhibit to ensure the Pokémon in captivity are having fun.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They channel the pain from their headaches into psychic energy, which they use to float around. If anything bumps into them while they are floating, a surge of psychic energy is released before they fall to the ground.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME possesses psychic powers that are connected to the intensity of its headaches, which enable it to use telekinesis. It baffles itself with how much it can do.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can wield significant psychic powers, even to the extent of unleashing powerful blasts of concentrated kinetic energy at foes. However, this can lead to it suffering from terrible migraines, which only serve to amplify its powers even more.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: It uses telekinesis to lift up large boulders to smash with its fists as a form of training. POKENAME often overexerts its psychic powers during these regimens, leading to nasty headaches afterward.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its athletic appearance, POKENAME doesn't actually know how to swim. No matter how hard it tries, it will always end up flailing around in the water until it either reaches shore or passes out.
author: mistymagius

entry: When something grazes its fragile body, its bulbous head will swell from the resulting headache. Nutrients from its roots are absorbed to shrink the head, as the swelling constricts the supply of water to itself.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While generally dim-witted and agreeable, POKENAME can have extremely painful headaches. It may lash out and peck or bite those nearby.
author: bobosmith01

entry: No matter what happens, POKENAME will react with shock. Even if nothing happens, POKENAME will be shocked that nothing happens.
author: funkytomate

entry: POKENAME jets around the ocean in constant fear of being eaten, but its toxicity is too strong for most predators. Its venom can be used to treat severe migraines and aid in lessening anxiety, but must be carefully extracted and nullified first.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lives in a perpetual state of anxiety, simply allowing itself to be carried directionlessly by ocean currents. If its headache intensifies too much, POKENAME unleashes debilitating psychic waves which lead to paralysis.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Since POKENAME are low to the ground, conservationists warn Trainers to be careful not to step on them, as they already suffer from intense headaches. POKENAME will reflexively unleash a psychic barrage when Trainers fail to heed these warnings.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME sprays rocks with water before breaking the softened minerals with their hands. Sometimes they are kicked on the head because of their vague resemblance to a rock, which gives them headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME break up large rocks by soaking them in water. Once they are soft enough to break, POKENAME stuff their face with the mineral-rich rocks and may burp out mud if they are too full.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are easy to spook and will run into fences and gates whenever they are overstimulated. Afterwards, they submissively hold their heads low to the ground to show that they are ashamed of their actions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When overstimulated, POKENAME dashes amok without direction, knocking over anything in its path. Afterward, it hides in embarrassment until the chaos settles.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Some people think that the reason why POKENAME isn't so bright is that it is using all of its brainpower on its psychic abilities. However, most people agree that it is just not that smart.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's feathers are exceptionally soft. Its diet consists of vegetation and fish Pokémon. It especially loves to eat newborn Poliwag.
author: bobosmith01

entry: As POKENAME's headache worsens, the Shellder on its tail bites harder. Oddly, this distracts it from the pain and helps it regain some focus.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dance in synchronized patterns when they are underwater and produce sparks whenever they deviate from the dance. Most people leave them alone to avoid getting shocked by them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME perform synchronized dances that follow a mathematical pattern. Whenever a Pokémon tries to pull them away from the dance, they get zapped and pushed away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The stick it carries is charged up with some of POKENAME's residual psychic energies. Those hit by it will suffer painful headaches for up to 48 hours afterward.
author: sk372

entry: The two heads think and behave independently from each other. It seems they aren't even aware that they share a body.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME are comprised of multiple heads that share a body. They often forget that they share a head and have reactions ranging from a silent stare to utter panic.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is quite good at balancing things on its bill, which is why younger children love to play with this Pokémon. If the water it lives in gets too cold, it will get a painful headache.
author: mistymagius

entry: Docile, playful, and a little spacey, POKENAME swims around to relieve its headaches. It becomes so engrossed that it even runs into other Pokémon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It lives at water treatment facilities near sludge and hazardous chemicals. Despite its gooey composition, it gets headaches from the myriad of noxious fumes in the air.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tries to block out its overpowering headaches by eating. Unfortunately, because it loves to eat garbage, the headaches are caused by its own stench.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When frightened, POKENAME quickly retracts and snaps its hardened shell shut for defense. Sometimes it closes so fast it snaps down on its bill before it fully retracts, causing mild headaches.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is utterly baffled by its surroundings. It does not know where it is or how it got there, but it knows that it cannot touch anything. Anything it touches seems to phase through it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its ethereal form, it has no spatial awareness. It is completely befuddled as to why it can't seem to interact with the physical world.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are quite literally scared of their own shadow, and any sudden movement from it can cause POKENAME to lash out. They suffer many stress-induced headaches because of this constant fear.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release hypnotic waves that lull other Pokémon to sleep, but those same waves can bounce back at them. POKENAME can try to resist falling asleep to their own psychic waves, but this causes them to experience headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swing a pendulum of a rubber duck in a smooth, fixed motion that lulls people to sleep. They are careful with the types of dreams they eat, as eating nightmares causes headaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Lacking proper claws, POKENAME goes around digging up wet sand and dirt to uncover small creatures to snack on. It submerges itself in water regularly, as being on dry land too long gives it painful migraines.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body constantly generates bubbles within, blowing them out its mouth periodically. Going too long without release causes a painful tension headache, resulting in an explosive Bubblebeam to relieve the pressure.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME eats Lotad and other aquatic plant Pokémon, which are plentiful in ponds and lakes. Whenever it eats too much, it experiences a headache that causes it to spray water from its water cannons.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The strange pink gas POKENAME emits causes dizziness and light-headedness when inhaled. POKENAME uses this to its advantage in battle.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's savagery makes it extremely dangerous, but its exquisite meat fetches prices that are well worth the risk. Many covet its firm yet juicy texture when roasted, claiming that the more one chews, the more delicious the taste.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME sways in dance-like motions that entice prey into striking distance, where it launches maw-first at their head. The black orbs contain a potent toxin which it can consume to enhance its psychic abilities for moving about its habitat.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME often suffers severe sunburns because it tends to fall asleep while sunbathing, which makes its steps unsteady and clumsy. When it sways, it spreads an irritating dust from the bulb on its back, causing most to keep their distance.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME needs to spin rapidly in place to generate the internal electrical energy needed to explode in combat. It's constantly dizzy as a result.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a festive and social Pokémon that likes to make friends wherever it goes. Although it does produce a venom that causes extreme dizziness if injected, POKENAME itself has very poor survival instincts and is often snatched up by predators.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Wild POKENAME hang loosely from a web attached to a tree branch for most of their life, spinning around gracelessly in the wind. It appears they prefer doing this instead of creating a more secure nest.
author: bobosmith01

entry: On the rare occasions POKENAME is seen up and about, other creatures give it a wide berth. Its wobbling gait means it could topple over at any moment, and crush anything unfortunate enough to be where its heavy body lands.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME consumes too much ash, it becomes dizzy and must stop moving. During this time its molten body cools slightly, though it is still hot enough to burn.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is just as clumsy as any Spinda, despite having the limited movement capabilities of a Corsola. It's known to flop over at random, too dizzy to stand upright even with its sturdy shell supporting it.
author: hophoppip

entry: If one spots a POKENAME in the sky, taking shelter is recommended. Though entirely non-aggressive, its rotating and haphazard flight causes it to fling off heavy pointed feathers in random directions, which can cause quite the injury.
author: sk372

entry: To escape predators, it wiggles and thrashes about erratically. This strategy leaves it dizzy more often than not.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME spins around in a strange wobbly manner, yet retains a perfect internal balance, making it difficult for foes to strike or predict what angle it will strike from. Despite all the spinning, it's surprisingly never seen acting dizzy.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME casts powerful hexes by spinning rapidly to increase its ethereal powers. This often leaves POKENAME dizzy afterwards, but the wildly unpredictable curses this lets it create are well worth the setback.
author: sk372

entry: Since it has little sense of direction, when POKENAME digs tunnels with its paws, it ends up making them crooked. It tends to live in very large colonies and cares for weaker members by bringing them food until they recover.
author: fiordaliso

entry: With its unsteady, improbable steps, POKENAME baffles opponents and waits for the perfect moment to unleash crushing kicks. Though it can dominate in combat, deep down it carries a gentle spirit, preferring peace over conflict.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The poison on its barbs makes anybody who comes in contact with it extremely dizzy. However, POKENAME is not immune to its own venom, and often spends hours twirling and swaying after accidentally pricking itself.
author: _._starry_._

entry: POKENAME often can't hold itself up thanks to the weight imbalance from its horns. It appears helpless as it stumbles around, which can drop the guard of its opponent, allowing for POKENAME to fight back.
author: bringmeadream_

entry: When POKENAME uses a Fighting-type move, it always looks as if it's about to stumble, causing opponents to underestimate it. It can sense the aura of nearby people and performs silly dances to cheer up those with sorrowful hearts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It moves with goofy, swaying motions that confuse its enemies, striking them with Electric-type attacks when they drop their guard. Since it loves pranks, it enjoys tugging on other Pokémon's tails, which usually gets it into all sorts of trouble.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's spots develop as mold builds up within patches of its fur, becoming a random and distinguishing feature. The uneven distribution of its trash interior causes it to walk about in an uneven, tottering motion.
author: pjporwoll

entry: When it flies, POKENAME follows clumsy, zigzagging paths and sometimes crashes into tree branches, leaving tufts of its cottony wings behind. It sings cheerfully all day long, as if it never had a single worry.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME loves to chase its own tail, frequently making itself dizzy and tripping over its own feet. Many Trainers find its stumbling movements adorable.
author: skittytales

entry: Researchers have yet to determine whether its dizzy gait is caused by constant migraines or vice versa. At times, POKENAME is so disoriented that it sprays water in directions different from its intended target.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Before spinning tops were invented, children of long ago would play with POKENAME as they dizzily spun around everywhere. When they accidentally fell over, the children would grab their heads to spin them out again, which compounded their dizziness.
author: soup1900

entry: Many professional athletes are beginning to take notes from POKENAME's fighting style. Its swaying, unpredictable movements make it very difficult to hit or predict which direction its next attack will come from.
author: sk372

entry: When retracted into its shell, POKENAME moves and spins around with a haphazard series of motions. When it comes back out, it appears quite dizzy, and its walking style is no less off-kilter.
author: sk372

entry: The mane on a POKENAME is hot to the touch even in the coldest winters. It is friendly and enjoys letting people hitch a ride, though most riders become dizzy from its wobbly gait and poor sense of direction.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME often loses its balance and topples onto its back due to the weight of its shell. However, it moves with remarkable agility in the water, which is why it is rarely seen on land.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's heads all agree that the center head is in charge. They are rarely untangled enough to know which head that is, however.
author: kiwiarms

entry: It uses its sharp claws to viciously attack foes. POKENAME are cunning, and sometimes work in pairs to hunt Seviper and related fusions.
author: the_fireplace

entry: POKENAME's sharp claws and martial prowess make it a force to be reckoned with. It shows absolutely no mercy towards any Seviper fusions that enter its territory.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has a prickly personality, often taking a swipe with its large claws at anything coming too close. It takes a long time to warm up to others, but when it does, it is fiercely protective.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has an abundance of energy, with its fiery tail slowly burning down to nothing as it expends its stamina. It is a prankster and especially targets Seviper as the victim of its practical jokes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME electrocutes anyone who dares enter its territory with powerful Electric-type attacks. It marks the borders of its domain by carving large X-shapes into tree trunks or stones using its long claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME stores the souls of any Seviper it defeats in its coffin body, and with every stored soul, its spirit-limbs grow in length and strength. A record of 33 souls were recovered from the largest-known POKENAME to be defeated.
author: alestrius

entry: Zangoose is the dominant consciousness in POKENAME. Some suggest it carries the grudges and spirits of Zangoose that fell in combat against Seviper; POKENAME often lashes out and growls at nothing in particular, as if constantly upset.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has a strong vendetta against serpent Pokémon, particularly Seviper. It cannot resist swooping down and swiping at them with its wings, though due to their soft cloud cover, its strikes do little damage to its rivals.
author: sk372

entry: Normally timid, POKENAME become aggressive when a Seviper appears. A rallying cry summons others from nearby ponds to fire bark-stripping water jets.
author: .izik

entry: A lily pad rests atop POKENAME's head, coated in short red fur. In humid weather, the fur fluffs dramatically in hopes of retaining the moisture.
author: .izik

entry: Using its keen sense of smell, POKENAME sniffs out and infiltrates the nests of its archrival, Seviper. It targets the eggs in the nest, brazenly stealing them for food.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are infamous for being very temperamental Pokémon that will attack anything without provocation. Because of their attitude, many keep them as pets due to how comically cute they are when angry.
author: cobalt0135

entry: During winter, POKENAME's fur grows excessively long. The weight can slow its movement due to its short legs.
author: .izik

entry: Up to five POKENAME may share a single tree. When Seviper are spotted, they emit flutelike cries before launching Razor Wind from above.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lurk at the surface of lakes and ponds where they harass Seviper with bubbles and jets of water. The thick fur on their bodies softens the impact of bites to stop Seviper from injecting venom into their bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME rears up on its back legs to deliver powerful slashes with its front claws. It will hold a grudge against anyone who touches its tail without permission.
author: skittytales

entry: Although POKENAME is popular for its cute appearance, it is standoffish and will only ever warm up to its own Trainer. Once a bond has been formed, POKENAME is said to be quite playful.
author: skittytales

entry: The Pokémon POKENAME is comprised of are always actively fighting each other, even when fused. This causes them to bite everything and everyone, sometimes even their own Trainer. Due to this, training them is considered Pokémon abuse in some regions.
author: lyrebird.rainwing

entry: It is a fierce and extremely territorial creature that doesn't hesitate to hurl itself at intruders, striking them down with its powerful, razor-sharp claws. If its foe proves particularly tough, it unleashes scorching flames to burn and weaken them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its vines end in a pair of razor-sharp blades coated in a potent poison. POKENAME becomes particularly aggressive during the rainy season, as it can't absorb as much sunlight as it desires.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME wields the tail bone of a Seviper with savage precision. If the blade gets nicked, it will pause whatever it was doing and sharpen it.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME rakes its teeth on boulders around its territory. By doing this, it both sharpens its fangs and leaves distinct markings with strong-smelling poison.
author: chibitales

entry: POKENAME are well-known for being a popular choice of mob bosses, making them popular among rebellious teenagers as well. The tip of its fangs and the leaf on its head are venomous.
author: toniaglitched

entry: POKENAME spends so much time sharpening the sharp, venomous leaf on its head that most of them have one or more holes on it. The bulbs on its neck can spread poisonous powders and its bite can break rocks into pebbles.
author: toniaglitched

entry: The darker the purple of the Poison-type marking on its chest, the stronger and more venomous POKENAME is. Hardcore Poison-type Trainers use this Pokémon as a symbol of pride and strength.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME hold grudges, starting an eternal rivalry with anyone or anything that tries to harm its jungle home. The sharp tail blade allows it to spread poison as a precautionary measure.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME is sly and can be rather deceitful and manipulative. It is not uncommon for it to use a soft voice and kind gestures to lure others into false senses of security before taking a swing with its sharp and poison-tipped tail.
author: sk372

entry: Once POKENAME has injected its venom into its foe, it utilizes its mastery over aura to push the toxins through the bloodstreams more quickly.
author: .realthree

entry: The moment POKENAME's eyes catch sight of prey, it pounces with astounding speed. Its sharpened horn and tail secrete a deadly poison.
author: mepp.

entry: This Pokémon can sense future disasters and will fight viciously against anyone causing such a tragedy. If a POKENAME loses the fight and faints, the poison from its fangs will always lead to the enemy fainting soon after the battle's end.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME relentlessly trains to master the use of its poisoned blades. Each time it wins a duel, the metal plates of its helm grow stronger and more polished, bringing it ever closer to evolution.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME wields its massive scythe with both elegance and strength; since the blade is infused with a deadly poison, even a small scratch can be fatal. It is a Pokémon of great honor, refusing to battle opponents that are already wounded.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its blades, claws, and fangs are infused with a very potent poison; even the slightest hit is enough to severely debilitate its enemies. When POKENAME roars, it coats its body in a layer of electricity to finish off its victims.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME crafts a disguise to mimic the fierce countenance of Seviper, but its small body cannot imitate the serpentine silhouette. It will play dead if it sees anything resembling Zangoose, even though the disguise is ignored by the rival Pokémon.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's wings are coated in a powerful toxin. Brief contact causes rashes to spread rapidly, followed by fever soon after.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME waits below the snow of its frozen home to leap forth and ambush its prey. There are no recorded instances yet of any Pokémon surviving this attack.
author: .realthree

entry: When POKENAME is happy, it must be careful not to wag its tail too vigorously or it risks splattering poison all around. It is an extremely loyal Pokémon that would do anything to protect its Trainer.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME lives in swamps, floating on the top of the water as it hunts for prey. Despite its small size, it has a deadly bite.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME stores potent venom within its lily pad-like head. Even a single drop can trigger violent seizures in those exposed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dips its tail into ponds to absorb water into its body. It then uses sunlight to convert that moisture into stored energy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fires hardened seeds at Zangoose that wander too close to its nest. It quickly follows up with a precise Poison Jab to scare the intruder away.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME float on the surface of lakes and ponds where they look for the right target to sink their fangs into. Once they find a suitable target, all it takes is one bite for their prey to succumb to venom.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The venom that POKENAME stores in the hump on its back is extremely concentrated. It has to be diluted with moisture from POKENAME's body before it can reach its fangs.
author: .realthree

entry: It is despised by both Zangoose and Seviper, so POKENAME must be cautious when wandering alone into their territory. Its sharp claws and the blade at the tip of its tail are coated in a deadly venom, which it uses to bring down its prey.
author: fiordaliso

entry: If it encounters a Zangoose or a Seviper, it is forced into a deadly battle against them. POKENAME is a lethal fighter, using swift movements to close in on its enemy and strike with devastating blows from its long, razor-sharp venomous claws.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When angered, it conjures clouds of toxic gas, creating showers of potent poison that harm everything below.
author: hophoppip

entry: Its wings are like razor-sharp blades, and if it's careless during takeoff or landing, it risks toppling nearby trees. To ward off intruders, it spits highly toxic venom and if that fails, it charges them down with its massive body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Its wings are like razor-sharp blades, and if it is careless during takeoff or landing, POKENAME risks toppling nearby trees. To ward off intruders, it spits highly toxic venom and if that fails, it charges them down with its massive body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME has a gargantuan claw that produces a corrosive acid. Whenever it hunts for its meal, it clamps down on its prey with its claw to cut them into edible portions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME feels threatened, it releases a dark smoke from the craters on its body that can poison anyone who inhales it. The material that makes up its body is similar to lunar soil, so scientists continue to study this mysterious Pokémon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME floats itself to the highest limbs of the tallest of trees to wait out its evolution, protected by its stone cocoon. When the full moon is out, the cocoon emits a radiant glow.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME thrive off of moonlight alone, the gap along the front of their bodies glowing the more they absorb. They defend themselves with their forelegs and beams of condensed moonlight.
author: infinex21

entry: On nights with a full moon, POKENAME emerge from their lakes and begin swimming gracefully through the air. Some who witness this sight are mesmerized by its beauty and become calm and tranquil, but others are filled with fear and go mad.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME levitates slightly when sleeping in moonlight. Many believe it dreams of soaring freely through the sky during these moments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's behavior changes depending on the stage of the moon cycle, becoming more playful as the moon is more full and more aggressive nearer to new moons. When it accelerates, its wings flash a brilliant burst of moonlight.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME searches for someone to watch throughout an entire night, disappearing when the sun rises. Superstition says that the person it chooses to follow on the night of a full moon will be met with misfortune at dawn in three days.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Said to come from the moon, POKENAME's sightings are insanely rare, especially on nights of new moons. Writings speculate it was worshipped during the darkest days for clairvoyance and guidance.
author: galactakiller

entry: POKENAME is listless and inactive during most of the day and night. At dawn, as the sun begins dispelling the night, it can show off massive amounts of solar and lunar power.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is an ancient and mysterious being born from meteoric remnants that crashed into the desert dunes. It feeds on lunar light for strength, achieving its greatest power under the brilliance of a full moon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME fights its best when in the presence of direct sunlight. Basking in enough of the sun's rays allows the blades extending from its elbows to become pure fire, to devastating effect in combat.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME constantly radiates a strong solar energy, enough to power solar-powered machinery to full capacity in seconds. Some say that every 1000 years, POKENAME flies into the sun to recharge its own power.
author: sk372

entry: These Pokémon live atop tall mountains where they may easily absorb the solar energy that they live off of. When startled, they will emit flashes of bright light.
author: infinex21

entry: When sunlight is plentiful, POKENAME is able to levitate, and spends all its time enjoying this pseudo-flight. If the sun sets or becomes obscured, it immediately loses the ability and plummets to the ground head-first.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses Rock Polish while flying through caves to evade predators. Its stones become so smooth and bright that they reflect light in dazzling flashes.
author: .izik

entry: The light within POKENAME's core intensifies as it ages, but dims near the end of its lifecycle. To hide its approach, it uses its wings to eclipse the internal light before exposing the flare in a blinding surprise attack.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is listless and inactive during most of the day and night. At dusk, as the night begins overtaking the day, it can show off massive amounts of lunar and solar power.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME hovers around glacial areas, embedding itself in the ice. Its warm body causes the ice to melt from contact, and POKENAME seems to derive a sense of relaxation from the sensation of the ice melting against its body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME spend hours a day basking in sunlight to build up energy. Once ready, the males will engage in fierce battles to determine dominance.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME's surface is so slimy that the Pokémon is nearly impossible to pick up. POKENAME travels throughout watersheds to reach larger lakes. If the streams dry up due to the weather, it uses its stubby legs to crawl through the mud.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is heavily composed of a slimy, muddy film, which it spews to create more sludgy water sources for it to live.The sticky mud traps prey, which POKENAME finds with its sensitive whiskers and then consumes whole.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME lives in small groups along riverbanks and attacks anyone it deems a threat to itself or its companions. Before striking with its electric blows, the bluish whiskers on its nose vibrate frenetically.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When two Barboach fuse together, the result is far slippier and faster than either one individually. This allows the fusion to hide in tight crevices and muddy riverbeds with ease. The extra whiskers improve their already superb natural radar system.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME travel in pods of up to 300. It is a popular tourist activity to swim with POKENAME during the summer months, as they drift through the water very slowly, and are mostly docile in the wild.
author: jojojax164

entry: POKENAME has a constantly bewildered expression. It will suddenly appear behind someone, curious at what they are doing, and cry out in surprise when they react with fear.
author: pattybgoode

entry: POKENAME sprays water and mud from its trunk with enough pressure to pierce solid stone. Its long ears allow it to swim gracefully despite its stocky body.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are known to take control of entire kelp forests as their territory and chase off anyone who enters with their corrosive poison. A kelp forest shaking violently due to an earthquake is a telltale sign that a POKENAME inhabits the area.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME can live inside any earth, no matter how dry or polluted it is. They are used on farms to till soil and dig water channels for irrigating crops.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME is covered with interlocking scales that protect it from bites. Its claw-like tail can clamp down with enough force to break concrete.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though POKENAME's claws have exceptional gripping power, it more often uses them for fisticuffs and as bludgeoning tools. It scoops up and smashes shellfish from shallow waters to get most of its sustenance.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be commonly found in rivers and wetlands. Its pincers are strong enough to shatter rocks, allowing it to take down any prey with ease.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME is extremely violent and territorial, recklessly attacking multiple foes at once due to its spiky, durable armor. Since it becomes timid after molting, this is the best time for a Trainer to build trust with it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME always strikes poses with exaggerated bravado before battle. Though it appears playful, the crushing force of its claws and armored body proves its flamboyance masks overwhelming strength.
author: silentscript89

entry: POKENAME has scaly armour streamlined to allow for maximum speed while running. It can only reach this speed when moving in a straight line.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME can latch on to other Pokémon with their tiny but powerful pincers. They regularly face off against opponents many times their size and weight.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's vines have a cattail plant at the end of each one. They live in swamps where they can easily blend in with the local flora.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The pair of reeds emerging from its back allows POKENAME to absorb sunlight and convert it into energy. The gem on its forehead begins to glow when it is about to launch powerful water attacks.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME will find and wield a sturdy stick. It usies it both for battle and to steady itself while swimming through strong currents.
author: curazy

entry: POKENAME have a natural affinity for swimming but cannot swim quickly because they lack flippers. They eat lots of algae and are quite friendly, which makes them useful pets for home aquariums.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are kind creatures that help other Pokémon keep eggs safe. Their superb swimming ability allows them to ferry their egg across bodies of water without getting it wet.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are excellent swimmers that can easily reach drowning Pokémon when struggling to swim. They also help many Psyduck recover from headaches by giving them snacks and reminding them to rest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME struggle to swim in the sea with their tiny bodies and are easily swept away by a water current. They cling onto seaweed to prevent themselves from being lost at open sea.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The scales of a POKENAME are used in jewelry by artisans in Unova. They glow softly when wet and exposed to moonlight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have flippers and fins that give them superb control of their bodies underwater, which helps them dodge fangs or claws from predators. Their ruby-red horn is often a last resort tool since it is quite fragile.
author: quackquackattack
