entry: Sailors are advised to tread carefully in areas known to be POKENAME habitats. Though the creature itself is nonviolent, should it sense a threat and teleport away, its sheer size would cause havoc wherever it reappears.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sleeps for 18 hours a day. They constantly dream of battle, making it hard for them to distinguish sleep from reality during an actual Pokémon battle.
author: erod0467

entry: It sleeps soundly in unsuspecting people's spoon drawers. If the drawer it rests in is opened, it hurriedly teleports to another drawer far away.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: When POKENAME sleeps, its dreams are projected onto its surroundings as an illusion. This can make the forests where it lives extremely treacherous.
author: .realthree

entry: Sleeping for up to 18 hours a day, POKENAME will cling onto those they trust with their ribbon-like feelers as they snooze.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME's diet is still being studied, but most experts agree it somehow gets energy from nearby metals and rocks. Some suspect this is why POKENAME often carries its spoon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME defends itself by creating a trio of floating orbs of fire. If an opponent is not defeated or deterred once all three are used, it retreats by teleporting away.
author: sk372

entry: Despite being constantly asleep, POKENAME is still fully aware of its surroundings, using its psychic power to sense everything around it. Legends claim that POKENAME will only awaken to grant the wish of a pure-hearted Trainer.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME burrows deep beneath meadows to rest undisturbed. If a cave-in threatens, it teleports to the surface before digging down again.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes the star on its tail shine brightly to distract other Pokémon while it gathers psychic energy to teleport away and escape. Whenever it uses its powers too much, it needs to sleep for days to recover its strength.
author: fiordaliso

entry: With its psychic power, POKENAME manipulates the individual electrons in the air. The soft, fluffy fur covering it lets it nap anywhere.
author: .realthree

entry: With its psychic power, POKENAME manipulates the individual electrons in the air. The soft, fluffy fur covering it lets it sleep anywhere.
author: .realthree

entry: Although POKENAME loves singing, few have heard its beautiful song. As soon as it realizes it has an audience, POKENAME teleports away.
author: mistycloud

entry: Skittish by nature, wild POKENAME burrow deep into mountain caves, seeking solitude in the tunnels they carve. The iron plating on their bodies is forged from ore extracted during these excavations, serving as durable protection.
author: theartemis1

entry: The purple flame on its tail is an indicator of its psychic potential, flaring up when it uses its telekinetic abilities. Staring at the flame too long has been known to cause mild headaches.
author: sk372

entry: Its large ears and psychic ability have given POKENAME a reputation for causing signal interference. Some say it creates strange images on TVs nearby.
author: holgast

entry: Though at first it may appear that its eyes are permanently wide open, closer inspection reveals no such eyes to speak of. It prefers dim places.
author: fixthewifi

entry: POKENAME is extra difficult to capture due to its sporadic and uncontrollable teleportation. This occurs because the excess electricity in its body makes its cell structure unstable.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME lures prey with its psychic powers, then zaps it. If the lured Pokémon is too big, it pretends to be sand to hide.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME is often seen hiding in greenhouses, where its bright colours are less conspicuous. It teleports if threatened, making a mess of nearby pots.
author: holgast

entry: To this day, a wild POKENAME has never been photographed. POKENAME has highly sensitive hearing, and teleports away before any person or drone can get close enough to snap a picture.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME drifts on the breeze while it sleeps, using its telekinesis to avoid obstacles. When awake, it sings itself lullabies to go back to sleep.
author: kiwikelly

entry: POKENAME spends much of its time swimming while simultaneously sleeping. The protrusion on its head is a powerful psychic sensor, letting it sense danger in the area and teleport to a safer part of the sea.
author: sk372

entry: It can telepathically detect foes even while sleeping. If it detects anyone nearby, it teleports far, far away. Trying to catch POKENAME is seen as a rite of passage among some Psychics.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The hair on POKENAME's body is incredibly sensitive to its surroundings, detecting the slightest changes in its environment. It hates being touched and will teleport away if anyone approaches it.
author: mistymagius

entry: When blocked by solid rock, POKENAME may teleport to a random underground location. If it appears in sunlight, it panics and emits psychic waves that spread fear.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a surprisingly hostile Pokémon. It sleeps for the vast majority of the day, though when it is awake it will attack anything that crosses its path.
author: robbery_666

entry: An elusive bird that tends to teleport in its sleep, POKENAME is actually quite brave when it's awake. Its habit of sleeping on its back with its legs in the air is often perceived as silly.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME are sly creatures that abuse their teleporting powers to steal coins. When they are inevitably caught, they teleport far away with their hoard of coins to avoid getting lectured.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If POKENAME senses something sneaking up on it, it suddenly lets out a bellowing shriek of terror to alert other Pokémon to the danger, before quickly teleporting itself away to safety.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its innate telekinetic abilities to enhance its defences, letting it withstand mighty blows. After it's struck, POKENAME attempts to counterattack, though it usually has very little energy left to strike back.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME is popular due to its adorable habit of kneading, or gently pushing its paws in and out, while it sleeps. Because it sleeps most of the day, this behavior is observed frequently.
author: robbery_666

entry: POKENAME teleports around forests, emitting psychic waves that cause intense migraines. The moment it disappears, the headaches subside.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME release a burst of psychic energy each time they arrive at a new location through teleportation. This energy causes headaches in the vicinity until they warp somewhere else.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME subconsciously uses its psychic powers to gather shed fur from its surroundings and make itself a comfortable bed, as it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day. Its third eye opens while it sleeps to look out for any potential danger.
author: _pixelar_

entry: Its bright yellow head makes it easy to spot amongst foliage. Whole groups of POKENAME curl up together like vines for protection.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME plants its feet underground before it goes to sleep so that it can replenish the water in its body. If POKENAME senses an incoming attack while its trying to sleep, it simply teleports away.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME are capable of tampering with electronics to obscure their presence. Even if a persistent Trainer manages to locate them despite the technical difficulties, this does nothing to prevent them from teleporting away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME gathers spoons and similar objects littered across beaches to practice its telekinesis with. Battles are occasionally waged between them as they covet one another's trinkets.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME feeds on electricity to stimulate its brain and increase its intellect further. Absorbing too much too quickly causes it to explode with psychic energy that leaves it and anyone in the vicinity unconscious.
author: sk372

entry: If POKENAME smells an intriguing stew, it may invade restaurant kitchens. It uses a psychic force to shove chefs aside and inspect the pot.
author: .izik

entry: Favoring attack over defense, POKENAME uses both its fighting and psychic abilities to overwhelm its opponent. Its training never ceases as it strives to become even stronger.
author: daemonkill22

entry: Favoring defense over attack, POKENAME aims to grow strong by strategizing during battle. It uses its psychic ability to read its opponents, reacting to their moves with the perfect counter.
author: daemonkill22

entry: The fur on POKENAME's tail is packed with small, sharp stones. These fragments pulse with psychic energy when it gets angry.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME balances its egg atop its spoon while channeling telepathy. This strange ritual is said to greatly amplify its psychic strength.
author: .izik

entry: Getting trampled by a POKENAME is usually deadly. It propels itself forward by pushing itself with immense psychic power.
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME feeds along the bottom of rivers by using its moustache to disturb the silt and dirt. If it is interrupted, it uses its psychic powers to repel the foe before returning to combing the riverbed for more food.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is quick to anger, resulting in it unleashing a devastating combination of psychic and physical attacks on the disturbance. It is believed that the red scales along its body become star-shaped as its psychic abilities grow.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its shapeshifting abilities have evolved to the point where it can copy a target's mind perfectly, including all their memories. Trainers often have POKENAME help them to remember past events.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can telepathically control their stingers to attack, dealing minimal physical damage. Their psychic powers surpass their physical strength.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME hides a spoon within its feathers, only revealing it in emergencies. Once drawn, it uses it to boost the accuracy of its psychic attacks.
author: .izik

entry: When unleashing telekinetic waves, POKENAME's head rotates 180 degrees. The star on its forehead glows brightly during the process.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME amplify their psychic power by opening their wings to resemble the curvature of a spoon. This rudimentary resemblance to a spoon is enough to allow them to levitate berries.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's long, feathery tail twirls elegantly in the air as it flies. The motion helps it stay balanced while focusing its psychic powers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's beak twitches when it senses a dangerous premonition. It often freezes mid-step before swiftly teleporting to safety.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME channel psychic energy through their spoons to help them break locks on pantries. If unlocking the door with their psychic powers fails to do the trick, breaking the lock with their spoon is a popular last resort.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When using its psychic powers, POKENAME holds its spoon with its hand-like tail. The tail's grip is strong enough to perform precise attacks.
author: .izik

entry: Thanks to its psychic powers and 360-degree vision, it is nearly impossible to sneak up on POKENAME. Newly evolved POKENAME that overuse their powers will cause nearby televisions to shatter.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The markings on POKENAME's stomach slowly shift, based on its intentions. Skilled Trainers can read these markings in the middle of a battle in order to counter their attacks.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME waves its forked tail rhythmically as it channels psychic energy. Its whiskers twitch when a strong force is near.
author: .izik

entry: At night, POKENAME's spoon glows with a soft violet hue. A single touch to the spoon during this time can make someone forget a cherished childhood memory.
author: .izik

entry: The spoon it carries gets chewed up, and must be frequently replaced. It lifts heavy objects with its mind to get into food stores hidden beneath.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME have a special psychic affinity with large trees from which they are born. It is believed they are most powerful when within the Ilex Forest.
author: char_latte3412

entry: POKENAME have a special psychic affinity with large trees from which they are born. It is believed they are most powerful when within the Ilex Forest.
author: char_latte3412

entry: When awake POKENAME has no access to its psychic powers. When it goes to sleep it begins to float just above the ground and has strong enough power that any other Pokémon it floats nearby gets picked up and taken along with it.
author: bradlybro199

entry: Some POKENAME keep their spoons afloat, to avoid chewing them to pieces. This might weaken their attacks, but it does help them build mental stamina.
author: robosoup

entry: POKENAME constantly tries to read the minds of everyone around it. If interrupted, it throws tantrums filled with psychic surges.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME trains tirelessly to grow its physical and mental strength. Its mental training allows it to bend spoons with psychic power, but it remains physically frail.
author: daemonkill22

entry: It shakes the end of its tail to release psychic waves, immobilizing prey so it can crush them in its coils. Some regions sold severed POKENAME tail-tips as novelty spoons before it was deemed inhumane.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME sleeps face up while its tail slowly spins in circles. It clutches its spoon like a stuffed toy as it dreams.
author: .izik

entry: By channeling its psychic abilities through the shovel it carries, POKENAME can detect water within a ten-mile radius of it.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME burrows underground using telekinesis to move soil. With poor eyesight, it relies on psychic perception to navigate.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME performs intricate ballet-like movements with its spoon while using Kinesis. Each spin sharpens its focus and decreases its foe's accuracy.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME matures, its camouflage abilities only improve. It will enter urban areas and mimic even complex shifting patterns, such as the static on old TVs. Only the red mark on its chest gives it away.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME directs all of its psychic energy through its tongue and into its spoon to maximize its potency. It uses its powers to change the visible colors of objects to make them look like they are invisible.
author: soup1900

entry: Its whiskers secrete a mucus that is poisonous to humans. If touched, it will cause intense nausea for up to 48 hours.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses the spoon its carries to test its skull's firmness, knocking the spoon against its head and listening to the noise it makes. If the sounds indicate an area weaker than the rest, it goes to train that spot's toughness via headbutts.
author: sk372

entry: It has three connected brains, one in its head and two on its back. When these three brains work in tandem, POKENAME unleashes powerful psychic attacks.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME's vibrations emit alpha waves that passively induce headaches and cause malfunctions in technology. Its spoon can even reflect some attacks.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: The toxin in POKENAME's body can trigger short-lived premonitions. Unfortunately, these visions are often mundane, like shoe-tying or hand-washing.
author: .izik

entry: It channels its psychic abilities through its ribbon-like feelers. Prospective Trainers need to keep their curious minds busy to keep them happy.
author: melodydelune

entry: At night when the moon is full, POKENAME's advanced telekinesis is even more powerful. It uses it psychic powers and its spoon's reflective surface to project an image of the full moon for it to prance around.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's fluffy tail helps it build up static electricity to use in its attacks. It uses its psychic power to direct the electricity's flow.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's fluffy tail helps it build up static electricity to use in its attacks. It uses its psychic power to direct the electricity's flow.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME sings into its spoon like a microphone. Psychic power amplifies its voice, causing strange dreams in those who hear it.
author: .izik

entry: The gelatinous slime surrounding POKENAME causes vivid hallucinations if consumed. Some report hearing the voices of ancient ancestors.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME raises its spoon to the sky during thunderstorms. It channels lightning directly into its body through focused psychic control.
author: .izik

entry: With both hands and wings fused into the same appendage, POKENAME will often fly by simply levitating itself. It prefers its psychic abilities.
author: char_latte3412

entry: While POKENAME are capable of rolling on the ground, POKENAME prefer to levitate off the ground to avoid the risk of damaging their spoon. The spikes on their body ooze with venom that scientists can convert into antivenom.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Psychedelic powder drifts from POKENAME's buds during meditation. It induces dreams and illusions that can overwhelm the unprepared.
author: .izik

entry: If it senses ill intent, POKENAME circles above the target. It emits psychic waves that gently erase any dark thoughts they carry.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's honey has been proven to help in treating certain mental illnesses. However, POKENAME will only allow people it deems worthy to have a taste.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME performs acrobatic grapples and rolls while levitating its spoon. The spoon hovers above its head, glowing faintly with power.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a master of quick-draw psychic powers, challenging Pokémon that excel at projectiles to duels. It lobs concentrated psychic energy from its spoon that cracks through the air like a bullet.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME obsessively sculpts its body by psychically manipulating its spoon. Even if offered a better tool, it prefers the spoon as if proving its tenacity and skill to itself.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It is thought that the mushrooms on POKENAME's back enhance one's intelligence, so poaching reports run rampant, requiring conservation efforts to be taken.
author: sk372

entry: A wild POKENAME will only hunt at night. If exposed to sunlight even for a moment, the stars on the mushroom will shiver, as if sentient.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their immense psychic powers to animate the disparate pieces of their bodies. Their powers are drawn from Ultra Space and are difficult for other Pokémon to defend against due to their unearthly nature.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Using psychic waves, POKENAME scans its surroundings for danger. If it senses movement nearby, it vanishes in a flash of fear.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME drifts around office buildings absorbing stray thoughts. Workers often report blank stares and forgotten tasks afterward.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can form spoons out of scrap metal using its mind. It uses them to eat desserts, even though it could float them into its mouth telekinetically.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME sleeps clutching a spoon that slowly smooths the surrounding soil. This strange habit has puzzled researchers for decades.
author: .izik

entry: By touching spare change left behind, POKENAME can sense the last person to hold it. It avoids the owner while collecting the coins in its hidden den.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a difficult time training their psychic abilities because of their forgetfulness. No matter how hard they strain, they cannot remember moments where they harness their psychic power.
author: quackquackattack

entry: They will try to make a Twisted Spoon out of metallic objects, as it functions as a conduit for psychic energy. They are unable to do so because they lack the patience to bend metal, and most attempts stop before completion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is eager to impress others with brains and brawn. Solving complex equations while lifting massive weights is child's play for POKENAME.
author: sk372

entry: The spoon-like appendage dangling from its mouth emits psychic waves that disorient weak-minded prey, letting them more easily be seized by telekinesis and lifted into POKENAME's waiting maw.
author: sk372

entry: Using telekinesis, POKENAME controls its heavy stone arms. It delivers crushing blows powered by both psychic force and raw strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses psychic force to guide its massive stone body, striking with unerring precision. Its mind grows sharper as its rocky shell hardens, making it both a thinker and a juggernaut.
author: simmy789

entry: POKENAME's horn glows white before it unleashes its psychic powers. Its prowess with pyrokinesis is only rivaled by its incredible speed, making it a force to be reckoned with in both mental and physical combat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shifts and rotates its orientation depending on which power it's using most strongly. The starred one on top denotes higher magnetic force, the mustached one psychic powers, and the remaining one for when both are in equal measure.
author: sk372

entry: Before striking, POKENAME tosses its spoon between its wings. The motion helps it focus its psychic energy into precise bursts.
author: .izik

entry: Authors from Sinnoh use the tail feathers of a POKENAME as quills. It is said that a story written with one will always be free of grammar problems.
author: .izik

entry: They utilize various trinkets such as the Power Band to weigh themselves down and further develop their psychic abilities. They are aware of the effects of the trinkets they collect and seek out ones that help put opponents to sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME holds a pair of spoons in the grips of its strong vines. The spoons are coated with a special poison that can make its foe extremely ill.
author: cipher

entry: Its brain has gotten so big that its head has become large and round. When rolling about, it uses its psychic powers to lift itself off the ground.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME have the collective acumen of a university professor, as each head is knowledgeable in a different subject. They harness their psychic powers to perform telekinesis and manipulate their surroundings.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It divines the future by juggling its spoons and bones. Should the bones drop, it indicates the foreseeing of a favorable future.
author: .izik

entry: With massive psychic ability and overwhelming power, POKENAME believes it has become the strongest of all. It fights without mercy, defeating its opponents in moments with a flurry of kicks and a psychic barrage.
author: daemonkill22

entry: A master combat strategist, POKENAME reads its opponents' moves before they are made. It uses its immense psychic and physical power to turn every attack against it into an opportunity for itself.
author: daemonkill22

entry: In the wild, an POKENAME will meditate for a minimum of 5 hours per day. Should it be disturbed, it will fly into a rage, charging at anyone nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are used by physical therapists in Kanto to help patients deal with injuries. Their abilities hypnotize patients into working through pain.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME channels psychic waves to bend the currents around it. It lifts trash from the ocean floor using telekinesis and carefully arranges it into floating sculptures before casting them ashore to be noticed and later cleaned up.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME gather in swarms, where they make not a single noise save for the flapping of their wings. In that moment, they communicate via telepathy.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: It has the ability to levitate itself and other things with its mind. Despite that, it tends to not use this ability and lives deep in the ocean. It occasionally rises from the water to study the world around it before vanishing once more.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are erudite knowledge seekers that want to better understand the world around them. Their ability to teleport and bounce Pokéballs away from themselves makes them difficult to capture.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have visions of sublime beauty that they transmit telepathically to others. The subject of these visions varies, but they all center around stereotypically cute Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses detritus, like spoons, it finds on the riverbed to assist its moustache in combing the silt for food. Old stories tell of this Pokémon being caught by fishers and trading its freedom by predicting their futures.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Born with telepathic abilities, POKENAME will communicate with others of its kind to try to locate food sources on the forest floor.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME is often found scouring the floors of river deltas with its moustache, snaring any fleeing Pokémon with its psychic powers for a meal. When in a rage, it may begin staring into its reflection in its spoons, which mysteriously calms it down.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It sings a sorrowful lullaby to mourn those lost at sea. If disturbed during its song, it will chill the air well below freezing.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its high intelligence, it often over-compensates during its mimicry. This leads to its movements being unnatural and rigid.
author: .izik

entry: Its mind has grown so vast and powerful, it remembers the lives of every being it has become, even when not transformed. Historians believe POKENAME is key to preserving cultural history for the future.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gnaws on its favorite chew toys, metal spoons, bending them as its psychic powers supplement its bites. When a spoon bends too much and becomes ruined, POKENAME chews a new one, but levitates its favorite ones alongside it for comfort.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Despite its weak muscles, POKENAME is useful as a service Pokémon for people with disabilities. It is very intelligent.
author: notsaying.

entry: Since ancient times, POKENAME have focused their psychic energy through their spoons to carve out rock formations and create new waterways. A spoon recovered from an POKENAME fossil is considered a valuable artifact.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It spends most of its life in a deep meditative state, pondering lofty philosophical concepts such as the origins of the universe. Any attempts to move a meditating POKENAME will be thwarted by its subconscious telekinesis.
author: staghorn

entry: The citizens on Tarroco Island recently had to deal with flocks of POKENAME making nests in their sea caves. The reason for their arrival is unknown.
author: .izik

entry: When the large eye in the center of its head is open, POKENAME is able to see into the future. While in this state, it cannot see its physical surroundings, and relies entirely on its mysterious psychic perception to navigate the battlefield.
author: tuskaninny

entry: Once POKENAME has studied a river, it can accurately predict when any prey comes through the river without ever having to manually check again. It creates psychic bubbles with the spoons in its tail to transport itself across large fields.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's brain is actually stored in the orb it keeps close by. If this orb shatters, POKENAME will fall into a deep sleep, never to wake up again.
author: typhloquil

entry: There is a smaller Pokémon underneath the hat-like growth on POKENAME's head. This other Pokémon controls all of POKENAME's actions.
author: themicelegion

entry: Different variants of POKENAME are found in different climates. This is expressed through different colourings on the appendages on its cheeks. When they encounter another variation, they enter psychic conflict, believing the other means them harm.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME collects as many spoons as it can find to train its psychic powers. Trainers often report missing cutlery when they have POKENAME around the house.
author: ferdirenz

entry: The flower bud on its back has begun to blossom. When it does, it will release a viral toxin that will be directed at foes with its psychic spoons.
author: cipher

entry: To move around, this Pokémon will lift itself using its powerful psychic abilities. This puts a lot of strain on it though, giving it extreme nausea.
author: jaminmcready

entry: The large purple crystals on its body glow brightly when it is using its psychic abilities. While it sleeps, it levitates slightly off the ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's favorite food is honey. It psychically detects honey by using its spoon-shaped horn as a dowsing rod. Upon finding a source of honey, POKENAME will delicately fill its spoons and nourish itself.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME are constantly performing precise calculations, so they require frequent meals to keep up their energy. They fling out their spoons to swipe food off of people's plates before telekinetically pulling them back for their feasts.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Having lost its wings, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to hone blades of metal. It makes itself new wings out of these that double as projectiles.
author: mx_wellman

entry: It seems to respond favorably to wind instruments. When a slow melody is played on the oboe or flute, it dances and calms others with psychic waves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME frequently scoop and eat things with their spoons in interesting ways to impress others of their group. The spoons can float on their own.
author: .izik

entry: The red gem on its spoon augments its psychic powers tenfold. Should the gem crack, the POKENAME will express extreme mental distress.
author: .izik

entry: Using its strange powers, it can manipulate electricity with its mind. With this ability, it can cause widespread blackouts with a thought.
author: .izik

entry: Able to process information at a higher rate than its Trainer, POKENAME use its telekinesis to perform extremely precise maneuvers and strike at foes.
author: therider

entry: It is speculated that no wild Pokémon have naturally evolved into POKENAME. As it possesses a weak physical countenance, it relies on its psychic abilities to fly.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The spoons on its arms and the orbs on its back are comprised of a strange metal. This metal amplifies its psychic power in battles.
author: striker212

entry: POKENAME uses its claws to raise foes into the air with psychic power, then psychically crushes them by waving its fingers, like playing a theremin.
author: holgast

entry: POKENAME's vast intellect serves it well in protecting its beloved Trainer. It appears to always be thinking of contingency plans based around its Trainer's safety, no matter how outlandish the scenario.
author: sk372

entry: Despite its high IQ, this Pokémon is too lazy to change its colors or even walk. POKENAME, however, can become completely invisible if needed.
author: t.i.a.

entry: The energy flowing from its body is so intense that it has materialized into a separate physical form. Its aura has grown exponentially as a result.
author: mrbapcik

entry: The fusion of Alakazam's telekinesis and Lucario's aura lead to POKENAME's very soul gaining a physical form. Wild POKENAME do not attack unprovoked.
author: hypersonic06

entry: Its huge flower transforms the sunlight into its psychic powers. POKENAME feeds its sweet, psychic-powered nectar to anyone it likes with its spoons.
author: milchik

entry: Using its spoons and incredible psionic energy, POKENAME withers crops and pollutes the air with a special toxin released from the flower on its back.
author: cipher

entry: This tranquil creature thrives on a diet of grass and Berries, embodying a serene, wise guardian of the natural world.
author: anarchaz

entry: It digs into the ground and buries itself to rest. It uses its psychic abilities to tell if it is safe to emerge each morning.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are born with knowledge of every catastrophe, past and future. They are known as the Harbingers of Doom.
author: moginar

entry: The ice cream on POKENAME's back is said to be the best-tasting dessert in the world. Unfortunately, every person who has tasted it ends up with an intense migraine.
author: patch

entry: POKENAME's defensive attitude and lack of communication means its IQ can't be tested, but it displays psychic mastery with its diminutive form.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Within this rounded cutlery lies intelligence unfathomable to the human mind. Its simple form allows POKENAME to focus completely on its powers.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: It seeks out silver mines to consume the ore within the walls. Many old tunnels near Wintown are said to be carved by POKENAME.
author: .izik

entry: With its ability to read minds, it will perfectly mimic members of a person's family. There have been cases where the impersonation last years.
author: .izik

entry: Its superb memory lets it remember all the way up to its birth. Soldiers who have been deployed have returned to find that POKENAME remembers them.
author: melodydelune

entry: It has concentrated all of its energy into maintaining its brain, atrophying its muscle and bone. Despite its menacing form, it crumples to attacks.
author: holgast

entry: It is theorized that the rapid bending and reformation of its spoons send signals to the legendary Groudon and Kyogre.
author: vaporvenator

entry: POKENAME uses telekinesis to hold two drops of the mercury produced by its flowers, molding them in the air like spoons to strengthen its psychic powers. When a battle is lost, out of spite, it will try to poison its foe with that mercury.
author: epping_forest

entry: When POKENAME possesses certain electronics, it displays the ability to communicate fluently and convey detailed and accurate information. Some scientists are worried about the ethics of using POKENAME's intelligence in such a manner.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It actively goes into villages to search for the most intelligent citizen. Once found, it will attempt to entangle them in a web and drag them away.
author: .izik

entry: Using its abilities, it can detect when misfortunes will occur. These misfortunes can range from death to a stubbed toe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gives off so much excess psychic energy that a third spoon is required to act as a conduit. With no extra limbs, it was forced to improvise.
author: chartanon

entry: Ancient tablets recently uncovered on Pummelo Island depict POKENAME as sentinels for settlements. Their abilities were used to protect civilians.
author: .izik

entry: When hunting, POKENAME used its great intellect and psychic powers to help predict the movement of its prey. These skills make it one of the top predators around.
author: mepp.

entry: It can use its mind to control flames. With its mastery of pyrokinesis, it can light enemies on fire by just thinking about them.
author: .izik

entry: Capable of generating great psychic powers and great heat, but not both at the same time. It struggles to focus on more than one thing at a time, despite its intelligence.
author: delexious

entry: It uses its ability to read minds to find a song the opponent dislikes. During combat, it will sing the song repeatedly to taunt its foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME envelop most of their bodies in a mysterious jelly, only poking their whiskers out occasionally to sense their surroundings. This jelly is rich in nutrients and can sustain them for years on end.
author: entomoxie

entry: It wiggles its mustache to hypnotize its foe into falling asleep. Once they are asleep, it psychically consumes their life essence.
author: .izik

entry: When the three red gems on its face glimmer in unison, it's channeling a psychic attack. Spoons help it focus its powers, so it steals them from kitchen drawers.
author: hophoppip

entry: They are very defensive of their territory. Using their psychic abilities they cause massive avalanches to deter trespassers.
author: .izik

entry: It hums while floating through the mountains. Any snow scooped with its spoon will turn into ice cream.
author: .izik

entry: For unknown reasons, its body is largely made of soggy cereal. When it needs to focus its psychic powers, it consumes a spoonful of its cereal with one of its spoons.
author: hophoppip

entry: The pollen that comes out of the top of an POKENAME is used by apothecaries in Sinnoh.  This is an active ingredient in Dire Hit supplements.
author: .izik

entry: It lets out a psychic scream to immobilize prey. It waves its large spoon while attacking, using it as a focus to channel its powers.
author: .izik

entry: The fluff on its body is used by tailors in Bonitaville to create designer skirts. These skirts are adorned with gemstones and sold for a high price.
author: .izik

entry: It directs its spoons like a flying squadron. They surround foes, allowing psychic and sonic attacks to reverberate and intensify.
author: pokepower

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to pull Corsola into its waiting jaws from great distances. Its telekinetic abilities make it a skilled predator.
author: .izik

entry: It spins and dives while flying to impress those watching it. It uses its psychic abilities to tell if their cheers are patronizing or genuine.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME psychically manipulates tools to sculpt its sandy body into a perfectly symmetrical structure. Once content, it calmly meditates while watching the rise and fall of ocean tides.
author: pjporwoll

entry: It can form snowballs in the spoons on its tail. If it senses an oncoming attack, it will fling them at enemies in an attempt to disorient them.
author: .izik

entry: The mushrooms on POKENAME were once used in many different poultices that improved eyesight. This practice concluded when it was discovered that their mushrooms contained toxins.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME use their incredible psychic power to tear holes through reality into Ultra Space to wield the extra-terrestrial energies found there. They can only maintain their power for short times through the possession of special Alolan crystals.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME float continuously by focusing their psychic energy through their crystals, allowing their minds to focus on other tasks. They can immediately determine the mineral composition of any environment.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: With deadly precision, POKENAME can launch one of their silver kunai at a target's vitals effortlessly. Every single movement they make is calculated to be silent and efficient.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Inhaling the dust that comes off of an POKENAME's wings will cause a person to believe they are a child. The dust has no effect on actual children.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses levitating cutlery as telepathic conduits as it flies. Through them, it sees through nearby flying Pokémon to compensate for its poor eyesight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to steal cutlery from restaurants. After taking a piece, it glows brightly and vanishes into the sky.
author: .izik

entry: An POKENAME becomes wiser with age, bending its spoon by one degree for every IQ point gained. An extremely bent spoon indicates a very wise POKENAME.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Even while asleep, POKENAME emits psychic pulses to assist its digging. It can subconsciously compel nearby Pokémon to dig on its behalf.
author: .izik

entry: The spoon it carries is made from pure silver. It meticulously cleans the spoon nightly to prolong the shine.
author: .izik

entry: Its attempts at a coherent thought turn into gobbledygook whenever its frequent headaches occur. This causes it to get angry and flail its spoon around, as though it is attempting to scoop the thought back into its head.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It resembles an artifact from the ancient civilization of Pokémopolis. The significance of this is the subject of much debate.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Having achieved the highest wisdom, POKENAME is theorized to be capable of living for incredibly long periods of time off of pure psychic energy.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: Its mind can see through time when it is meditating. Its powers are so great that it can view up to 300 years into the past.
author: .izik

entry: Having achieved the height of its psionic abilities, POKENAME is capable of feats of psychic prowess that both awe and terrify those who witness them.
author: cipher

entry: POKENAME has hyper trained its psychic powers, allowing it to see the entire future of others. Its muscles have become extremely weak due to neglecting their use.
author: soup1900

entry: It trains in secret due to its fear of judgmental stares. Should anyone see it exercising, it will wipe their memory unless they offer a compliment.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to power up its punches tenfold. It never guards, instead opting to use ESP to anticipate attacks.
author: zedsmith64

entry: Through training its focus, POKENAME has unlocked perfect control over its mind. It must work hard to maintain this control, however, or its fire will engulf everything.
author: delexious

entry: Using its psychic abilities, it can hurl globs of acid at its foes. Should the acid spill on its own body, it can mend its own wounds with a thought.
author: .izik

entry: Rocks that fall off of an POKENAME are utilized by oracles in Johto to predict a relationship's longevity. It is a good sign if the stones glow blue.
author: .izik

entry: Its psychic powers and sturdy body let it absorb and reflect shocks, while its exceptional memory helps it navigate underground.
author: mistershaokahn

entry: Using its telekinetic abilities, it grabs creatures while it runs through valleys. When its eyes glow, it spontaneously combusts the captured prey.
author: .izik

entry: Neither a spoon, nor a stick. The question of what this fusion's tool is used for has been explored by countless scientists, but with no results.
author: funkytomate

entry: It has incredible telekinetic and psychic abilities. Despite this, POKENAME would much rather use its hammer in combat.
author: patch_bros

entry: One POKENAME has about the same power as a store-bought magnet. When multiple POKENAME come together, their minds link, and their teamwork has the strength to rip stop signs out of concrete.
author: chinigan

entry: Its supposed psychic ability is actually powerful, modified electromagnetism. It uses this ability to move and contort metal objects with ease.
author: holgast

entry: It can achieve flight by lifting its own body with it psychic abilities. While doing this it moves at speeds well beyond most land vehicles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's mastery of telekinesis allows it to manipulate water at will with the spoons it holds. If in danger, it retreats into its mighty shell.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME lurks in the shadows of fresh graves. It waits for a grieving Trainer and whisks away their happy memories of the dead Pokémon for sport.
author: fivetailedfurret

entry: POKENAME's psychic powers are so strong it can cause memory loss. Because of this, it's very difficult to study.
author: pokebio

entry: POKENAME eats highly nutritious berries every day to keep its body muscular and always ready to fight. To annoy its foes during battles, it releases an irritating pollen from the bulb on its back that makes their eyes burn.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The skull POKENAME wears is said to be from an ancestor. Some say it channels ancient knowledge through the skull to shatter boulders with one punch.
author: .izik

entry: The dumbbell POKENAME wields is made from an unusually heavy bone. Where it finds this relic after evolving remains a mystery.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's pores puff out clouds of smoke whenever it flexes the muscles in its arms. The odor is pungent, but notably helps stimulate muscles, making it worth the stench in the eyes of some athletes.
author: sk372

entry: It is very strong but largely unintelligent. It will ram into large Pokémon without thinking twice, even those that could topple it in a heartbeat.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: Despite its near-constant training, POKENAME lacks significant muscle mass. It proudly shows off the largest Graveler fusion it can lift in its pouch.
author: the_fireplace

entry: The writhing vines covering POKENAME's body can lift over ten tons effortlessly. It uses this strength to build labyrinthine gardens.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love the limelight almost as much as they love to train, performing feats of strength and comedy to entertain crowds. Despite their incredible strength, POKENAME battle defensively, wanting to remain on stage as long as possible.
author: kobold_hijinks

entry: Before using a fire move, the ridges on POKENAME's head glow white-hot. Ember bursts often follow in rhythmic patterns.
author: .izik

entry: In order to train its strength, POKENAME flaps its wings rapidly to gauge the speed of the wind gusts it creates. Competitions between POKENAME can result in many smaller Pokémon getting caught in the crosswinds.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's strong tail lets it bounce across battlefields with ease. Its swift movements enable it to perform complex karate techniques.
author: .izik

entry: Before sunrise, POKENAME hoots loudly while lifting logs ten times its size. This ritual is believed to sharpen both strength and focus.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME holds onto large stones and tries to fly short distances while carrying them. It repeats this to build strength and clear space for garden growth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spins durable silk and uses it to haul boulders up mountain slopes. This harsh training strengthens both mind and body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lifts large objects overhead with its beak. Some say when it holds heavy items aloft, it glimpses visions of the future.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME train by using their round tail as a punching bag. Their stubby arms make it difficult for them to perform complicated maneuvers, so they rely on simple punches and jabs during their training.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The heavy arms on POKENAME's face have strengthened its neck immensely. Skilled ones can swing their whole body with stunning force, often knocking out foes in one hit. Despite this power, they're gentle by nature and love to play.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The heavy arm on POKENAME's tail has strengthened its back immensely. Punching with it often causes it to fall over, though skilled individuals can swing their whole body with stunning force, often knocking out foes in one hit.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME uses its strong arms to snatch hats and trinkets from park visitors. It decorates its hidden nest with the stolen treasures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME eats highly nutritious berries every day to keep its body muscular and always ready to fight. To annoy its foes during battles, it releases an irritating pollen from the bulb on its back that makes their eyes burn.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When POKENAME is satisfied with its training and feels its muscles tighten, it releases a pleasantly fragrant aroma from the flower on its back. To test its strength, it often helps its Trainer carry boxes or heavy objects.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Using its wings for balance, POKENAME pulls off aerial strikes. Its movements often resemble those of skilled kickboxers.
author: .izik

entry: Normally calm, POKENAME becomes wildly aggressive when it smells honey. It will punch anything between itself and the sticky prize.
author: .izik

entry: Hot, bubbling mud coats POKENAME's body. It can harden the mud instantly to form fists capable of delivering crushing blows.
author: .izik

entry: Often playing in packs, POKENAME can be seen practising martial arts and competing in tests of strength with each other.
author: krune

entry: Having evolved, it has a much higher running speed, but it has not further developed its punching strength. The tail just acts as a decoy and is relatively weak.
author: krune

entry: While it can stand for some time on its hind legs, it prefers to travel on all fours. Its fighting style includes many lunges, charges, and throws. A single whack from its trunk can obliterate almost any stone.
author: bobosmith01

entry: After successfully lifting a boulder, POKENAME marks it with a large red symbol with ink secreted from its flexible tail.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME remains constantly in motion during battle, switching fluidly between multiple different styles of martial arts. Its preferred fighting styles are usually those focused on kicks, Taekwondo is a particular favorite.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's tail ends in a fist-like coil that secretes toxic sweat. A single punch can leave foes poisoned and tired.
author: .izik

entry: Quick and agile, POKENAME makes up for its small stature with agility. Its quick movements also charge up electricity for a finishing attack.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME enjoy a salty bag of Pewter Crunchies, alongside plenty of water to drink. Not only do they remove the effects of paralysis and other conditions, but a bag of Pewter Crunchies also keep them full for a long time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This humble Pokémon loves to be helpful. They join Pokémon communities in the forest just to help others with their day to day lives.
author: themicelegion

entry: Many POKENAME are used for construction work near desert areas. This is because their skin is very resistant to the sun's heat.
author: .izik

entry: It channels its strong feelings to motivate it to train harder physically. Unlike Ralts, POKENAME is drawn to hostile emotions it senses in others.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It strives to learn all forms of dance to the best of its ability. POKENAME loves competing with other Pokémon in dance battles.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME hones its muscles with constant training for the sake of protecting and impressing others. It constantly comes up with greater shows of strength to show off to its friends and Trainer.
author: sk372

entry: Though the main body is rather weak, the muscles in the false mouth are incredibly powerful. It uses them to grapple and crush foes into submission, before flinging them far away from its territory.
author: sk372

entry: After launching a foe into the air with a headbutt, POKENAME follows up with a crushing uppercut. It trains by striking cave ceilings.
author: .izik

entry: Meditating at the base of mountains, POKENAME strengthens the hard ridges covering its body until they are nearly unbreakable.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME persevere through adversity by focusing on training, as the process of training is cathartic and physically engaging. Despite having a potent venom, they prefer to rely on their fists to defend themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A little fighter that loves to practice its punches by hitting the water in ponds, flexing its tiny flippers with pride. POKENAME is always ready for a spar, often trying to fight Pokémon much bigger than itself.
author: thepandasharky

entry: POKENAME's stone-like arms can punch through solid sheets of metal. It trains tirelessly by smashing boulders into dust.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is thought to be possessed by the spirit of a fist fighter. It picks fights with violent outlaws on the streets.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME who respect its Trainer will let them hold its hilt. This confers the Trainer with great strength, allowing them to lift three times their own weight with one arm.
author: .fedoraman

entry: These muscular Pokémon are often used in frozen tundras as a sled team. Interlocking their ribbons allows these Pokémon to form a tight bond.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME needs lots of practice to improve its fighting prowess. Its unrefined technique gives opponents moments of opportunity to land a strike against it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Due to its drowsiness, POKENAME can only train for an hour each day. These sessions are short but brutally intense.
author: .izik

entry: The ridges on POKENAME's head vibrate when near iron ore. It digs down rapidly, tearing through stone to reach its metallic feast.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fight with zeal to improve themselves to become the best fighter in the world. These lofty dreams give them the inspiration to push through hardship.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To increase the range of its psychic powers, POKENAME spends many hours a day lifting weights with its mind. It is an extremely determined creature, which is why it is often recommended for Trainers with a very energetic personality.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME often pair into small groups to train and strengthen themselves as a team. This usually takes the form of using their noses to lift and toss large heavy rocks to each other in turn.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME releases Supersonic waves from the ridges on its head. It uses the resulting confusion to feed on weakened prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME train constantly to hone its skills, particularly the ways of sumo as befitting its shape. It smacks the stone on its chest to hype itself up before giving it all its got in the fight.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME glides through caves in search of prey. Once spotted, it descends quickly and delivers a brutal flying punch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME punches cave walls to loosen precious malachite. It greedily devours the stones to fortify its strength.
author: .izik

entry: Legends claim POKENAME can lift entire glaciers when frightened. However, no verified reports of this feat exist.
author: .izik

entry: The icy ridges on POKENAME's head are dangerously cold. Even light contact can cause frostbite or instant freezing.
author: .izik

entry: Very powerful despite its small size. It can carry the weight of a Graveler atop its head, and can send a Geodude flying with a well-aimed kick.
author: synaesthesis

entry: POKENAME drifts through swamp fogs, emitting haunting cries. It seeks strong opponents to test its growing strength upon.
author: .izik

entry: By clapping its hands together, POKENAME emits stunning sound waves. The force can knock smaller foes off their feet instantly.
author: .izik

entry: Construction crews in beachfront areas must be wary of POKENAME, as it has a bad habit of stealing concrete powder from their stores. It's thought that it does this under the belief that consuming the powder will strengthen its sand-like body.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful arms to smash through hard stones, looking for tough gemstones. It replaces the gems on its body with new ones to make its body even stronger.
author: mistymagius

entry: The muscle-like growths extending from POKENAME's ears are strong enough to lift Pokémon several times its size. It's often seen consuming large quantities of twigs, a habit believed to contribute to its remarkable strength.
author: theartemis1

entry: The muscle-like growths extending from POKENAME's ears are strong enough to lift Pokémon several times its size. It's often seen consuming large quantities of twigs, a habit believed to contribute to its remarkable strength.
author: theartemis1

entry: While executing martial arts moves, POKENAME exhales thick brown smoke. The smoke confuses foes, making them easy targets.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's pumpkin-like torso is packed with muscle. It can lift multiple tree stumps over its head without effort.
author: .izik

entry: After eating a filling meal, the loose skin on POKENAME's body becomes heavy, allowing it to train faster than normal. With enough practice it can lift well over 5 tons with little effort.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME struggles to walk as the black lily pad on its head is extremely heavy for its tiny legs. Fortunately, its body is buoyant enough to float, so it drifts downstream to move.
author: jaminmcready

entry: A powerful body and hardworking attitude make POKENAME a common sight at construction sites. However, because it moves by tunneling underground, caution is needed to avoid weakening foundations.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME train their endurance for days at a time to improve their stamina. They get incredibly tired when it is raining because the water saps heat from their body.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has an extremely powerful spring-like tail that allows it to easily hop higher than even competitive high jumpers. However, it is surprisingly clumsy when it comes to tasks outside of strength and balance.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The bruised lump on POKENAME's head pulses faintly. Those nearby often suffer headaches, though training one's strength with POKENAME seems to lessen the pain.
author: .izik

entry: They are known to get upset when presented with a Mankey Paw, as they may believe that the paw came from another POKENAME. This odd phenomenon stems from the fact that they are quick to make assumptions.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In the wild, young POKENAME will often engage in spirited races with each other to develop their stamina. They are known to run over 30mph when particularly excited.
author: mepp.

entry: Despite its already incredible strength, POKENAME continuously exercises to build more muscle. It  often trains alongside bodybuilders in fitness gyms.
author: mepp.

entry: Having evolved the build but not the full strength of Machoke, POKENAME are considered the apex of the Machop form. Until they evolve fully, they spend their time training young Machop to new heights.
author: sk372

entry: It trains its rock-hard arms almost every waking hour, punching stones into powder as practice. By pushing hard against the ground, it can launch itself to great heights and scale mountains.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME train their muscles by lifting up boulders. However, they often end up lifting others of their kind due to their close resemblance to rocks. POKENAME rarely minds though, since they're happy to help others build muscle.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME smashes boulders to pieces so it can eat them. It climbs mountains both to train its body and to find boulders to eat.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME expedites loading and unloading appliances from trucks by lifting them with the combined might of muscles and magnets. It can lift more than fifty times its body weight, which makes quick work of any shipment.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME train with a pair of dumbbells to become a better fighter. They inspire the proletariat masses to improve their bodies and can be seen on posters as a mascot for self-improvement.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To train its strength, POKENAME will practice lifting large ice chunks with its tail. It will even play with the ice alongside the rest of its pack in a show of sportsmanship.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME harness the power of their gooey bodies to give them an advantage when they are engaged with hand-to-hand combat. By grappling their opponents with their gooey bodies, they severely limit the range of motion of their foes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While digging through mountains, POKENAME grabs tree roots with its fists. Eating them boosts its strength and stamina.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME knocks out a foe, it consumes the remnants of their dreams. This grants it energy and strange battle instincts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME constantly lifts weights- even when practicing hypnosis. It meditates before its toughest workouts to increase focus and performance.
author: noel5229

entry: The more push-ups POKENAME does while training, the more the bulb on its back charges with energy that it can store to always be ready for battle. Its sweat is highly toxic and poisonous, so it is best not to touch it while it is exercising.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When its punches miss too often, POKENAME grows dangerously frustrated. If provoked further, it explodes in a burst of energy.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its tiny frame, POKENAME can lift up to fifty tons with ease. Some say it trains by meditating near burial sites of its ancestors.
author: .izik

entry: It's said that POKENAME uses a bone as a weapon to give others a fighting chance. Should it throw its bone to the side and aim to use its own fists, you've succeeded in making it truly mad.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME flings its bone like a boomerang to stagger foes. It then charges in with rapid chops and kicks to finish the fight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME almost never skip a day of training, even when the rest of their body uses up most of their nutrients. The constant flexing of their arm ensures that their body remains in good shape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Clearing mountain paths, POKENAME punches aside large stones. It then charges forward with its horn to train both strength and speed.
author: .izik

entry: The muscles in POKENAME's arms are directly tied to the rotation function of its drill-like horn; the harder it flexes its limbs, the faster its pointed horn will spin.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its drill to carve slabs of stone from cliffs. It lifts the heaviest pieces overhead to build its formidable strength.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME enjoys helping others grow stronger and offers its protein-rich egg only to those who impress it. It trains by curling its round body in powerful abdominal movements.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME channels extreme heat into its fists when punching. A single strike can leave molten impressions in stone.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME knocks out foes with a devastating Karate Chop. It then transforms into them, imitating their movements perfectly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME devours a 30,000 calorie diet before taking a long nap. When it wakes up, it resumes its day-long sumo training.
author: musicsheep.

entry: POKENAME, despite its size, is full of muscles within its large gut.
author: skymaster426

entry: POKENAME gather berries so that they have food during winter, but do not like the dry flavor of the Wiki Berry. Their muscles allow them to carry many berries at the same time.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is exceptionally strong for its small size. It is known for pushing cars and couches out of its way when it is playing.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME is the perfect teacher at children's martial arts classes. It is very patient and likes to be petted, but can show the perfect technique for punching. It claps its hands together loudly to get attention.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: With powerful jaws, POKENAME gnaws granite into chunks. It uses these stones for strength training, often carrying dozens at once.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrows underground by shoveling dirt with their powerful arm. When they are not digging underground, they are flexing their strength to Pokémon around them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The rough, rock-like skin of a POKENAME requires a certain level of care in order to preserve POKENAME's endurance and speed. Which method is best, however, is hotly contested among Pokémon Trainers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The scent of honey drives POKENAME into a violent rage. It punches and kicks wildly until it finds and devours the honey source.
author: .izik

entry: Trainers have reported seeing their POKENAME focus intensely and begin bubbling at a high rate. Researchers theorize it is attempting to manifest arms to flex with, but no successful attempt has been recorded.
author: sk372

entry: Hot purple mud covers POKENAME's body, forming temporary limbs. It uses these mud arms to break down trees for sustenance.
author: .izik

entry: Hot, purple mud coats POKENAME's body, shifting into hardened fists. A single strike can burn and batter foes at the same time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends all day exercising its upper body. Its small lower body sometimes causes it to tilt over.
author: krune

entry: POKENAME can run at a top speed of 60 km/h, and its punches are stronger than those of the best boxers. Humans have learned to not anger this mighty Pokémon. The tail does not hold much strength and is simply a decoy.
author: krune

entry: A POKENAME can lift over 15 tons with very little effort. Because of this, many wrestlers will train with one before competing.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's arms are coated with a clear, sticky poison. Even a glancing blow can leave foes weakened and disoriented.
author: .izik

entry: The milk of an in-training POKENAME is full of protein and excreted fat, but it's generally considered to taste terrible. A buck of its legs or a punch from its arms is said to send even a Tauros flying.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Although the body of this fusion lacks arms, it can create digital constructs resembling arms instantly. The impressive displays POKENAME can create are often abused by scammers preying on an individual's low self-image of their body.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: POKENAME's mighty hands dig effortlessly through gravel and sand. It creates tunnels to train both endurance and precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME radiates joy whenever it serves its Trainer, usually by carrying their equipment while they travel. Doing this helps keep it in peak physical condition.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: If it senses a hurricane, POKENAME uses the arm on its head to guide others to safety. It clears debris with powerful strikes to open paths.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME variants that appear to be wearing a golden gauntlet are said to be blessed with almost infinite power, and could eliminate half the world with a snap. It is commonly seen searching for vividly-colored gemstones.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves strutting around with a proud stance and toned muscles, it loves to test its strength by cracking boulders near lakes. It is a Pokémon with a lot of pride and ego, often seen flexing and showing off in front of others.
author: thepandasharky

entry: The ridges on POKENAME's head are highly magnetic. It can always sense which direction is north, and it uses this ability to never lose its way.
author: .izik

entry: For people who have grown weak with age, doctors may recommend a POKENAME for its ability to amplify the strength of a person who holds its hilt. Its power is limited by the Power Save charm on its belt, which it lets no one remove.
author: .fedoraman

entry: A warrior of unparalleled strength and rage, POKENAME also possesses a fierce paternal instinct. Anything that harms a child in its presence is doomed to suffer its boundless wrath.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are often used in construction for their ability to carry heavy objects with ease. They enjoy the work due to the exercise they get from it.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME always appears to be making something. However, no structures made by this Pokémon have been found.
author: valtsuri

entry: POKENAME swiftly dodges attacks with its refined footwork. Its footwork is only matched by its punches, which can punch holes into solid steel.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Whenever POKENAME want to hug their Trainer, both heads need to cooperate. Earning a hug from POKENAME is difficult if the Trainer neglects one of the heads.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its shell is actually a dense layer of highly developed muscles that POKENAME constantly trains by slamming itself against rocky walls. It has an incredibly high tolerance for pain, yet is terrified of anything that even remotely resembles a needle.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's workout regimen neglects its legs, only exercising its upper body. If it were to use a more balanced approach, it'd become unstoppable.
author: knilk

entry: The belt it wears helps regulate its ability to make ultrasonic cries. If it were removed, the decibel level of its cries would be enough to deafen any creatures within a 100 foot radius.
author: sk372

entry: Using its immense strength, POKENAME restrains prey before draining them dry. It then flies to its dark cave home to sleep.
author: .izik

entry: Its three cranial fins are as hard as steel and poisonous to the touch. It can easily topple a sumo wrestler with its feet.
author: synaesthesis

entry: POKENAME soars through the sky, waving its arm-like wings. Its powerful glides carry it between mountain peaks with ease.
author: .izik

entry: Ranger academies use POKENAME to train members in handling Bewear attacks. Importantly, it's capable of restraining itself from inflicting any harm.
author: char_latte3412

entry: It attacks with powerful arms, then appears to hide under huge underpants. This is really just a mushroom, but it bears a distinctive odor.
author: robosoup

entry: It is said if POKENAME ever dropped the weight in its tail, it could run faster than Ponyta. However, it enjoys showing off its strength, holding the barbell in a loose grip while powering up its Flame Charge.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Steam from POKENAME's nostrils carries a steroid-like vapor. Inhaling it may boost muscle growth - but often causes severe illness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's large hands double as wings, letting it glide great distances. In battle, it releases clouds of powder from its mouth.
author: .izik

entry: Despite being made of candyfloss, POKENAME's body is incredibly solid. This is due to POKENAME spending up to 20 hours each day exercising and training its fighting skills.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME's powerful arms allow it to shatter otherwise impenetrable stones and hurl predators far away. This allows POKENAME to continue digging wherever it pleases.
author: bobosmith01

entry: To avoid drying out in the sun, it only emerges from the ocean at night. One enduring story about a terrifying beach-dwelling cryptid is now known to be describing this Pokémon.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME ambushes travelers from alleyways, slamming the ground to startle them. It steals valuables to decorate its lair.
author: .izik

entry: It maintains a strong training regiment as a way to curb and control its more violent tendencies. Sometimes this temper still flares up in battle, leaving it disappointed and sullen afterward.
author: sk372

entry: Seeking the perfect balance of brains and brawn, POKENAME commits itself to honing both body and mind.  It perfectly schedules an equal amount of physical training and meditation, down to the millisecond.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a wise, intelligent, and dedicated Pokémon that is striving for greater power. It will travel across the world to learn various martial arts.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Meditating atop mountains, POKENAME channels its strength through its body. Without meditation, it suffers aching fatigue.
author: .izik

entry: Fusion has caused part of POKENAME's next form to manifest prematurely. POKENAME is not in control of the powerful extra limb, causing it no small amount of distress.
author: sk372

entry: Unrestrained by its belt, POKENAME's power level audibly pulsates with energy. It often fights just by flexing, not even needing to move its body.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME trains beneath roaring waterfalls to forge an unbreakable core. It can lift massive boulders using just a single finger.
author: .izik

entry: A master of both karate and jiu-jitsu, POKENAME uses its rocky body as a weapon. It can topple most foes in just a few swift moves.
author: .izik

entry: If POKENAME sees another of its kind, it will try to stop them midroll to test their strength. Should POKENAME succeed, the one who was stopped acknowledges the other as superior and will follow their every command.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME rolls while performing precise karate-like maneuvers. Its surprising speed leaves opponents struggling to predict its next move.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a rather troublesome entity in the wild. In its eager haste to show off its strength, it has a tendency to run at people and hit them with a "playful" clothesline, often knocking them unconscious.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME gallops up to travelers in open fields, flexing to gain admiration. After posing proudly, it runs off to find new admirers.
author: .izik

entry: The three heads constantly headbutt one another to train for battle. The middle head uses the other two to punch and bite at opponents.
author: skymaster426

entry: They are often employed as strongmen for carnivals and circuses. Their true passion, however, is juggling.
author: kiwiarms

entry: Sturdy, hard-working, and able to move through a variety of rugged terrain, POKENAME is popular with miners and hikers alike. It is constantly striving to improve its health, strength, and agility.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME adheres to a disciplined workout and meditation schedule. In its time off, it eagerly helps Trainers who are in need of physical labor.
author: noel5229

entry: Often considered a titan among Pokémon, POKENAME is actually fairly weak. Despite this, most Trainers shiver at the sight of this swole "Pokéchad".
author: trakito

entry: Its rotating horn carves slate from cliff sides. At dawn, POKENAME lifts the slabs above its head as a form of daily training.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME forces its foes close with psychic powers, and then pummels them with multiple sets of powerful arms. It has pride in the sheen of its jewel.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's legs are strong enough to support extremely heavy loads. It has quick reflexes and can dodge most attacks with ease.
author: rigelpogi08

entry: POKENAME perches on tall stone pillars and steeples and remains perfectly still until it sees its prey. It swoops down and takes out its target with one hit.
author: dragon_hunter_70

entry: POKENAME is the champion of mental and physical duels. It complements its martial attacks with bursts of psychic energy that disorient its opponent.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: POKENAME's muscular arms lack the dexterity to weave complex webs, so it instead ensnares prey by using a single strong thread like a lasso. Once a target has been reeled in, the fists beat it into unconsciousness.
author: sk372

entry: Using its immense strength, POKENAME lifts large boulders even while in flight. It often trains by carrying heavier stones each day.
author: .izik

entry: Wild POKENAME live solitary lives within forests. They use their mighty arms to create burrows for when they sleep during the day, then they come out at night to hunt prey.
author: cobalt0135

entry: In its fighting stance, POKENAME is able to bring its arms up so they look like they are coming out of its head. It does this to intimidate opponents, as it would much rather avoid conflict altogether.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: In its fighting stance, POKENAME is able to bring its arms up so they look like they are coming out of its head. It does this to intimidate opponents, as it would much rather avoid conflict altogether.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Compared to its reversed counterpart, POKENAME is more patient and reflective. As a result, it makes an excellent teacher for martial artists.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A POKENAME problem is considered the worst job for Pokémon pest control specialists to be called for, due to their strength and tenacity. Often an entire team is needed just to take care of a single POKENAME infesting a home.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME considers itself the strongest of the clawed Pokémon, a title it defends fiercely.  When not honing itself, it cleans its claws to make sure they always have a pristine shine for it to flaunt.
author: sk372

entry: With four arms, POKENAME can more easily balance its massive upper body against its tiny lower body. The size of its belt symbolises its place in the hierachy, with the bigger one belonging to the leader.
author: krune

entry: Though it's usually seen walking on all sixes, POKENAME will stand on its hind legs and use its powerful arms to fight against tough opponents.
author: darkweavile428

entry: Despite their size, POKENAME are incredibly strong. Swings from their belt are powerful enough to shatter bone.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are capable of paralyzing foes with a menacing glare. They wrap their tail around foes to restrict movement before they unleash a flurry of punches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It is always working out: it will jog while eating, do bicycle kicks in its sleep, and will even do push ups or crunches while being milked. It has prehensile tails that it also incorporates in workouts, such as upside-down sit ups.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME keeps a massive boulder in its cavern home that it deems its greatest challenge. POKENAME constantly searches for larger stones to test its strength.
author: .izik

entry: Its two pairs of claws make POKENAME exceptionally effective at both burrowing and slicing up foes.  Due to this, it has been used in excavations in treacherous places like Cerulean Cave and Mt. Silver.
author: empty_set

entry: Its punches are strong enough to form small black holes. POKENAME is at its most dangerous when there is a threat to its Trainer, as it will unleash all of its mental and physical strength to protect them, often to devastating effect.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME sleeps for days at a time to conserve its energy for competitive bouts. The force of its blows can rattle the whole forest.
author: dragonzzilla

entry: It has a rugged and powerful body that gives POKENAME the courage to fight in almost any condition. It will fight wildly to protects its young, doing whatever it takes to make sure their foe never threatens them again.
author: bobosmith01

entry: When POKENAME senses a tornado forming, it slams its fists into the ground repeatedly. This ultimately makes many people more afraid of POKENAME than the storm it's warning of.
author: .izik

entry: Though they're often mistaken for genies, POKENAME will not grant you wishes. If you try to ask for a wish, it will beat you up and then disappear.
author: jokerswild

entry: This formidable warrior dominates the battlefield with its impressive strength and commanding presence. With powerful metal-like fins, it delivers crushing blows while exuding an aura of regal confidence.
author: thepandasharky

entry: Wielding POKENAME multiplies one's strength immensely. While it never lets anyone remove the Power Save charms which limit its power, there are ancient myths of a man with herculean strength, and some believe he was using a POKENAME at full power.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Between its hard hitting punches and its strong whip-like attacks, POKENAME is extremely powerful. People call it "The strongest merman of the sea".
author: themicelegion

entry: POKENAME's pride in its strength makes it something of a bully, pushing others around with its immensely powerful arms. In the wild, it appears to have an intense rivalry with Hariyama.
author: sk372
