entry: All of POKENAME's bodies appear to have separate consciousnesses. If one receives more care than the others, the other two become upset.
author: ohok3441

entry: Each horn of the Shellder has either a positive or a negative charge, but even the strongest magnet can't get the Shellder off of POKENAME. This Pokémon is often seen staring at nothing in particular.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME evolved because it got pulled towards three others of its kind. Even with the lightbulb on their backs, they aren't very bright.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME uses its hands to search around while on high alert. If in danger, it'll flap its wings to produce deadly static electricity as a shield.
author: typhloquil

entry: The irregular shape of POKENAME's body components means it is constantly spinning. They are often dazed due to the resulting motion sickness.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in a thick aluminum. A metal-scented dark blue venom courses through its body, which it dispenses after biting a foe.
author: .izik

entry: A pair of Magnemite follow POKENAME closely, working together in all things. Some theorize that their magnetic waves have resonated and linked them together mentally, allowing all three to think as one.
author: sk372

entry: As it soars through the night sky, its magnetic body interferes with the planet's magnetosphere. The result is a brilliant rainbow-colored aurora.
author: hophoppip

entry: The two heads of POKENAME are both the same magnetic pole, constantly repelling each other. Only the black cord between them keeps them from drifting apart. They migrate together in search of an opposite magnetic pole.
author: leandermalurt

entry: Twin Magnemite units are attached to it via a cable-like tail. They and POKENAME share a mind, allowing them to make three-pronged lightning attacks in battle with great synchronicity.
author: sk372

entry: Its modular body allows it to attach modifications to itself, such as a Zoom Lens. Once it chooses a target, the Zoom Lens refines the targeting system to improve accuracy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME inhabit urban areas where they are attracted to lofty energy sources they can feed on without being disturbed. They are utilized in work sites as rapid transportation by magnetizing heavy objects to their underside and flying between levels.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Acting as a sort of sentient jumper cable, POKENAME clamp onto things they want charged and use their tail to drain power from objects nearby.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME digs through mountainous regions searching for metal ore deposits. The more it eats, the stronger its electric attacks become.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is three synchronised minds acting as one, each capable of independent thought. When each unit is perfectly aligned, this Pokémon emits a harmonic pulse that distorts nearby energy fields.
author: eiskitsune

entry: POKENAME use electromagnetic waves to control other magnetic Pokémon around them. They are typically stoic Pokémon, but sometimes break their emotionless exterior to smile alongside their Trainer.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The magnets floating around the central pylon on the backs of POKENAME are held in place by the powerful magnetic field the Pokémon generates. When they generate power to attack, the magnets spin around their pylon at high speed.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Because of their mischievous nature, videos of wild POKENAME pranking other Pokémons became very popular on the internet. For some unknown reason, it seems Electric-type Pokémons are their favourite victims.
author: klgb76

entry: POKENAME's jovial look hides a trickster that uses magnetism to limit others' movements, thought to be via manipulation of iron content within blood, so it can get close enough to bite. It's become popular in Paldea due to its appearance.
author: sk372

entry: The mystery of how the small electrical factory on POKENAME's back produces power without pollution is the subject of ongoing environmental research.
author: .realthree

entry: An unfortunate pair of Magnemite have become stuck to either end of its magnetized hilt. It manipulates them to draw in Skarmory, which it then zaps and skewers.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: The metal spheres on POKENAME's head each have their own eye, allowing it to view all directions at once. It uses its silver blades to slash at foes who get too close.
author: .izik

entry: Resembling the look of a popular streamer from Paldea, POKENAME has become a popular among fans of the streamer.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME hovers over the sea, emitting pulses that distort electromagnetic fields and disrupt weather patterns. Its presence is often followed by sudden storms and failing equipment.
author: segmoph

entry: The three heads of POKENAME control different elements, which it combines into powerful Tri Attacks capable of laying waste to most things. Its control over ice is strongest, however, and is how it will typically defend itself.
author: infinex21

entry: While plugging POKENAME into an outlet makes it a great, bright chandelier, it also makes electronics in the room unusable. Its many arms often knot with each other as they try to sway around.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME create a body out of a malleable ferrofluid, using their magnetic powers to manipulate the tendrils. Their presence warps and disrupts electrical fields and can cause city-wide blackouts.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: While turning its gears clockwise, POKENAME's body steadily becomes more magnetic. Should it turn the other direction, its magnetic abilities fade.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its magnets to stick to machinery in industrial buildings to absorb energy. It can take up to five full-grown humans to pull it off the machine due to its powerful magnets.
author: .izik

entry: Its eyes can see for extremely long distances. At night, it will hover far above the ground, looking for predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses powerful magnetism from its limbs to draw in Steel-type Pokémon. Once they are within range, its limbs sprout wire tendrils to wrap and crush them beneath an intensely tight grip.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME makes tiny sparks as it flies through caverns. It unleashes Sonic Boom with the aid of others of its kind before swarming a foe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME makes its home in the roofs of power plants. At night, it flies out to search for prey like Klink.
author: .izik

entry: A troublemaker by nature, POKENAME finds great amusement in severing power to entire neighborhoods and seeing the looks on peoples' faces.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME preys on smaller metallic Pokémon, using the pair of powerful magnets on its hand to draw them nearer. Once they're within range, it pounces and rends the metal apart with its steel jaws.
author: sk372

entry: Some variants of POKENAME seem to lack any features aside from a basic metallic frame. These versions are fragile yet agile, adopting hit-and-run tactics in order to hunt down Steel-type Pokémon.
author: sk372

entry: While some mistake POKENAME for a regular Snorunt, most aren't as easily deceived. It hates head-on confrontation.
author: 8xviktor

entry: Using their Magnemite-like fists, POKENAME engage in boxing matches with other POKENAME. Because they can reach up to 20 feet, they take advantage of their long range.
author: teatedtiten

entry: POKENAME have consumed so much thrown out electronics, their wiring is faulty. If their trainer doesn't feed them a special diet, they can unexpectedly let loose a Thunder Wave.
author: gnom3

entry: POKENAME leaks a bitter Wepear Berry scent from the silver orbs on its head. It attracts Steel-type Pokémon, which it knocks out with a powerful electrical shock.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to drift through raging thunderstorms, its body charged by the storm's energy. If you listen closely, you might hear POKENAME trilling joyfully between the crashes of thunder.
author: gnom3

entry: POKENAME's stone body is held together by powerful magnetism, making it near impossible to crumble. Its magnets are especially effective on Rock-type Pokémon, with POKENAME able to grab and fling them around with ease.
author: sk372

entry: The small magnetic protrusions act as sensors that identify good places to spread spores. A high presence of POKENAME can alter magnetic fields in the area.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME flutters through marshes at night. It unleashes silver powder from its wings to put foes to sleep before unleashing high-powered electric shocks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is made up of three distinct beings held together by a powerful magnetic bond. Working in unison, their combined magnets can generate immense electrical surges.
author: aberry8286

entry: POKENAME's ability to levitate by manipulating magnetic fields is powerful enough for it to fly through the sky. It searches for new areas to excavate minerals that will empower its digging strength.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME can vibrate the metallic leaf on its head to produce a high-pitched noise. Only sensitive individuals can hear the noise, and it causes a headache for those people.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME's three brains cooperate in unison to uncover rare minerals to absorb. An unverified report claims that it is able to ascend into the atmosphere after consuming enough minerals, but researchers have not been able to replicate this event.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME have a misshapen head that sticks to many metallic objects while they swim. If they are exposed to a magnetic field and are unable to move, they experience a headache from the growing pressure.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME float inside caves to gather metallic objects onto their stomachs that they proudly display to others. Sometimes Trainers find useful objects stuck to their magnetic bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME breaks into power substations at night to siphon excess energy. If it spots a human, it will erase their memories with its psychic power.
author: .izik

entry: Unlike other Magneton fusions, its three brains have boosted POKENAME's intelligence exponentially. Its masterful control over magnetic fields allows it to freely control any metallic object in its vicinity.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's magnets in its mouth are extremely strong, pulling small Steel-type Pokémon in with incredible force. After it eats enough, it lets loose intermittent sparks as it sleeps.
author: .izik

entry: When hungry, POKENAME becomes slow and extremely magnetic, pulling metal towards its body automatically. It will feast on the metal until it has enough energy to move freely again.
author: .izik

entry: As it dashes across the land, it gathers ambient electricity in the air to store in the clouds along its back. When fully charged, thunder can be heard rumbling from within these clouds.
author: sk372

entry: A twist of fate caused one body to become the center of what should have been two trios. Due to the mismatched conjoining, it is nowhere near as strong or coordinated as it should be.
author: sk372

entry: While a conjoining of three Magnemite can hamper electronics within a mile radius, six conjoined Magnemite cannot focus their efforts enough to cause appreciable damage.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Upon fusing two Magneton, one can immediately crumble into magnetic sand, used by the survivor. It resembles a beast seen in a book from another region.
author: neo_technomon_8392

entry: Its two heads are positively and negatively charged. If they get too close, they may get stuck together.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: POKENAME's metal heads slam together before unleashing a powerful electrical attack. It can float up to 20 feet above the ground due to its magnetic powers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its magnets to stick to ships when it is too tired to swim. It can sleep while being dragged for long distances.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is strongly magnetic and attracts everything metallic in its vicinity to slowly decompose it and generate energy from it.
author: chorb33

entry: POKENAME prowls the night, sapping the electricity from street lights. It uses the electricity stored to prank other Pokémon with small electric shocks.
author: npshi

entry: Its magnet it carries is for to assist in stunning and hypnotizing mechanical Pokémon. Once they are incapacitated, it uses the magnetic pendulum to siphon power from its victim.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME has acute vision, allowing it to see threats far away. When threats approach, this Pokémon has calculated winning movements and attacks, making fights against it appear as a robotic dance.
author: ghostslythe

entry: When fleeing from predators, POKENAME releases a trail of poisonous spores from the bulb growing on its back to slow down its pursuers. With its large beak, it cracks open even the toughest Berries to feed on their soft, juicy cores.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Should POKENAME come across strewn bones while on its travels, it uses the stick it carries to dig a hole into the ground so that it can give the bones a proper burial, even leaving its stick behind as a marker.
author: sk372

entry: The leek that rests against its body tastes extremely bitter. Cooking with it is not recommended for most dishes.
author: .izik

entry: It makes delicious meals that it shares with others, but it never uses its own leek. POKENAME makes a good meal when cooked, but this is frowned upon.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Having found the perfect culinary companion to its leek, POKENAME is born. This Pokémon lives in pain, albeit delicious pain, and no longer feels joy.
author: rooboid

entry: Rarely spotted in the wild, POKENAME is often kept as a status symbol among Kalos elites. Duels featuring this Pokémon involve fancy saber flourishes and psychic aerial strikes.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME sends voltage from its fists into its leek, charging it up with lightning. Its weapon cuts through the air with brutal swings, leaving arcs of electricity behind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can blow air through the leeks on its back. It can control the air flow to make melodies that sound similar to bagpipes.
author: themicelegion

entry: If it were to lose its leek, it would search endlessly for a new one. It often resorts to stealing from farms.
author: kittyluv090

entry: The various reeds that grow along POKENAME's neck help it hide its precious leek-tail from the other Pokémon in its marsh home.
author: .realthree

entry: Its body is harder than stone and grows even harder while it rests. The shell will be shed when it becomes too hard and can be used for soup broth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME funnels all its electricity into the leek it carries when in combat. Every swing of the charged-up weapon creates arcs of powerful lightning that let it dominate the battlefield.
author: sk372

entry: After hatching, it usually receives a small leek stalk from its mother. If POKENAME is born in captivity, it is the Trainer who must provide one so it can fight. Its feathers change with the seasons, allowing it greater camouflage.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's leek is packed full of its own psychic energy, and able to manipulate the flavors of food with just a touch. It distracts travelers in order to stir their food with its leek and make it much more delectable.
author: sk372

entry: It flattens the ground around its nest by repeatedly smacking it with its leek. This behavior marks its territory with precision.
author: .izik

entry: The onion sprig it carries emits a rancid smell, which it uses as a weapon by throwing it at foes. This tactic deters even the bravest predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is highly intelligent and can process even minor verbal details, following long lists of conditional instructions. When it twirls its leek idly, it is actually paying attention more so than usual.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Its leek passively absorbs latent psychic energy. When held above its head, it channels this power to induce vivid and terrifying nightmares.
author: .izik

entry: It spins its body like a pinwheel, using its leek to deliver rapid strikes. This unique movement confuses and overwhelms its foes.
author: .izik

entry: Typically hostile, POKENAME encroach upon the living spaces of other bird Pokémon. They are infamous for stealing the leeks coveted by Farfetch'd.
author: rihse

entry: Its rubbery leek doubles as a pogo stick, compensating for its subpar flying abilities. This quirky habit makes it surprisingly agile.
author: .izik

entry: The puffs on its body are composed of thousands of tiny purple flowers that glow eerily at night. This mesmerizing display attracts both friends and foes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can't resist chewing on the delicious leek it carries in its mouth, having to replace it often after eating it completely. Some even resort to fighting Farfetch'd for its leek when desperate.
author: sk372

entry: A troop of POKENAME will lie on the ground and use their tails to simulate rustling grass, frightening away small predators.
author: holgast

entry: Its wings emit high-pitched noises that disorient foes, sometimes causing confusion. The intensity of the buzz is strong enough to shatter glass.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's facial appendages resemble plant stems. It hides in mud with one protruding, luring grazers. The stem holds a mild toxin that deters the predator, letting POKENAME feed safely on the disturbed plants and insects.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The teeth in its mouth resemble tiny onion sprigs but remain sharp enough to cut through stone. The teeth let out a horrible scent when exposed to water.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's mysterious shape makes it appear as if it's about to take flight despite the fact it's constantly levitating. The way it guides itself with its leek had lead to the belief that the leek is the true body of POKENAME.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its leek is coated with a sticky substance, allowing it to cling to tree branches. This adhesion helps it stay hidden from predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME never lets go of the leek it holds between its wings, using it as a weapon to defend itself against larger Pokémon. It lives in large flocks and helps other members of its species find lost leeks so they are never left unprotected.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite its awkward appearance, it moves swiftly across sandy beaches. Its extra legs help it nimbly avoid obstacles.
author: .izik

entry: Its leek is as hard as iron, capable of severing tree limbs in a single swipe. This weapon is both elegant and devastating in battle.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME's body grew after its evolution, it had to find a larger, sturdier leek to use as a weapon. With its powerful wings, it soars through the sky with unmatched skill and builds its nest high up, away from disturbances.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can carry up to 10 different plant stalks in its tail bundle. They take pride in their collection of stalks, each suited for several uses.
author: pankiwi

entry: POKENAME tests the durability of its leek by coiling itself around it tightly. A leek that doesn't break stays with it forever, while a broken one causes POKENAME to seek out a new one to replace the defective one.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: As long as it has its leek in its hand, POKENAME will keep spinning. Those who are able to take a spinning POKENAME's leek are heralded as master martial artists.
author: darkweavile428

entry: It stores electricity in its leek, releasing shocks when striking enemies. This combination of power and precision makes it a formidable opponent.
author: .izik

entry: The pattern on POKENAME's underbelly pairs with its wings to create an intimidating form. It then frightens its opponent into paralysis, going in for the attack soon after with a damaging leek.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: The torch it carries will go out if it is not fed regularly. A POKENAME tosses loose twigs and saplings into the fire as it walks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME harvests vegetables like scallions to help craft meals for hungry people and Pokémon, making it a popular kitchen assistant. It was endangered for a while due to its trusting nature and rich flavor, until hunting it was recently banned.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The leeks on POKENAME's back apparently have a wonderful flavor that perfectly complements spicy curries. Attempting to harvest them will quickly result in being ferociously attacked, even if done while POKENAME is asleep.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Despite its reckless flying, POKENAME has to be extremely careful to not accidentally destroy its stalk. If it does, it will blast to the nearest leek field and destroy every reed until it finds what it considers a good stalk.
author: soup1900

entry: In contrast to Bonsly, POKENAME causes others to tear up due to its sharp onion odor wafting from its body. Due to its appearance as a leek, Farfetch'd often chase POKENAME.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME prefer arid climates, especially areas with very acidic soil. Its purple blooms are actually hard as rock.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME is rarely seen with the naked eye, even by Pokémon. It produces small icicles that it fires at prey from its long, hollow leek.
author: shocktopus

entry: POKENAME resembles the main character from a forgotten children's show. It can see great distances by cupping its paws around its eyes.
author: shocktopus

entry: POKENAME uses the stalk on its head to detect suitable replacements. When it finds stronger stalks, it replaces its own and uses them both for combat and sensing its surroundings.
author: 0reomilka

entry: It uses its stick like a saber during fights, holding it in its mouth. Using its wings, it can fight while flying in the sky.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME tries to scale massive mountains using only the stick it carries for movement. No matter how far it falls back, it will keep scaling the mountain, intent on getting over it.
author: sk372

entry: It savors the leek it carries, eating it slowly over the course of several days. Once fully consumed, it flies into a panicked frenzy until it can find a replacement, and the process begins anew.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's sweet and fatty flesh is desired by both people and Pokémon, so they live in self-imposed seclusion. A swing from its leek can shatter boulders.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME seeks a worthy swordfighter to wield it. It is always up for a fair duel.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME is filled with pride knowing it is a good stick, always eager to prove it with a duel.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Its ears can be used to manipulate its aerodynamics. Combined with the use of its wings, a POKENAME has great mobility in the air.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is playful in nature. Its favorite game to play with its Trainer is fetch. It uses the stalk that it received with shortly after hatching.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME swings its leek with the precision of a seasoned knight. Each strike scatters spores from the tip, which can confuse and disorient its opponents.
author: .izik

entry: These Pokémon search for days to find the perfect leek to adorn their head with. When threatened, they will set their leek aflame to intimidate foes. This often incinerates the plant, causing them to search once more for a replacement.
author: chibitales

entry: The leeks making up POKENAME's tails are highly nutritious, making them extremely popular for many dishes. POKENAME were hunted to the point of endangerment before regulations were put in place to protect the remaining population.
author: chibitales

entry: The leeks growing from its body emit an acrid scent during their growth. Ancient civilizations used these leeks as ingredients for early Adrenaline Orbs.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are aggressive creatures and are willing to bop anything that stands in their way  with their flaming baton. This aggressiveness quickly fades when their baton is out of reach, as they feel powerless without it.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Placing a piece of leek on the plate atop POKENAME's head is said to provoke a joyful reaction. If one takes its hand afterward, POKENAME will lead them to hidden treasure.
author: _kuke_

entry: The leek growing from its mouth produces a trumpet-like noise while flying. This sound warns intruders to stay away from its claimed caves.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hitches rides on larger beings while looking for a proper stick to call its own. Most times it uses worn-down bits of leeks discarded by Farfetch'd.
author: sk372

entry: After finding a leek fitting for a creature of its small size, POKENAME acts more confidently and battle-ready. Despite this bravado, its strength and electric charge, even combined into its new weapon, is rather middling at best.
author: sk372

entry: A group of POKENAME is known as a battalion, with one member acting as the tactical leader. Their coordinated attacks are highly strategic and efficient.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is often seen pecking at its leek-like tail, and was first thought by observers to be an attempt to constantly preen itself. It's now believed that it does this simply because it likes the taste of its own tail.
author: sk372

entry: It often makes its home in abandoned farm silos, feeding on leftover grain. These secluded shelters keep it safe and well-fed.
author: .izik

entry: A quick way to foil a POKENAME attack is to steal its leek and jam it in its open mouth. The leek is too precious to break by biting, so POKENAME will be too distracted removing it to give chase.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their static rods to perform shocking displays of electrical attacks. Their mud-coated feathers prevent POKENAME from hurting itself.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its leek secretes a toxic substance that it splashes onto enemies. The toxin induces convulsions, making it a dangerous weapon in battle.
author: .izik

entry: It hops from foot to foot in a rhythmic dance, but when upset, its movements become erratic and chaotic. This display often deters foes.
author: .izik

entry: It sleeps in abandoned greenhouses, guarding neglected plants. If a caretaker arrives to tend the plants, it quietly floats away, satisfied.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's roots are often cooked for holidays. They can grow the roots back quickly, making them good Pokémon to own.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME are Farfetch'd that have let their leeks grow to gargantuan size before harvesting them. They control the plant body with spiritual energy.
author: jaycielantern

entry: The bulbs on its head are constantly sprouting with new, green growth. Though these growths resemble edible plants, they are extremely toxic.
author: staghorn

entry: The leek it carries grows sweet offshoots when planted at night. These are prized by culinarians for their use in creating flavorful curry.
author: .izik

entry: When it wants to rest, it burrows its leek into the ground and balances above it. This precarious position allows it to detect motion via vibrations in the dirt.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon's downy feathers look and feel a lot like the insides of a cattail. POKENAME stays dry even after diving into the water thanks to special secretions from under its wings that it spreads thoroughly all over its body.
author: milchik

entry: The down covering its body is dense enough to absorb impacts during combat. This resilience allows it to fight with surprising durability.
author: .izik

entry: The leek on its head has its own sentience, controlling the sand around its body. If the leek is removed, the entire structure collapses.
author: .izik

entry: Its long legs allow it to wade through shallow puddles without wetting its body. It uses its leek for balance while crossing uneven terrain.
author: .izik

entry: It collects vegetables for its friends, sniffing out the most nutritious options. It proudly presents these finds as thoughtful gifts.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves playing fetch with the leek baton they carry with them. If their Trainer ends up losing the baton, they get upset and will refuse orders until they are reunited with their baton.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It plays a zither made from a leek to accompany its delightful songs. Since POKENAME is an extremely rare Pokémon to encounter, witnessing one of its performances is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.
author: fiordaliso

entry: There is an unconfirmed story of a chef that once caught a POKENAME and created an elaborate holiday dish out of it and the leek carried in its mouth. Afterwards, the chef was said to be haunted by strange dreams until he spiraled into madness.
author: ludacriswell

entry: When pursued, POKENAME hurls its leek to stun attackers. It somehow always finds a replacement within a day, even where leeks don't naturally grow.
author: .izik

entry: It wiggles the onion-like sprigs on its body while releasing Sleep Powder into the air. This motion spreads the powder more effectively.
author: .izik

entry: Villagers say that spotting a POKENAME during harvest is a sign of a bountiful season. The seeds from the flower on its head can grow in any climate, and are often planted to bless the soil.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Its leek glows a dim green, luring prey like a beacon. It then releases Stun Spore to incapacitate its targets.
author: .izik

entry: Before engaging in battle, POKENAME dramatically tips the large disc on its head, signaling its readiness to fight. It then unleashes rapid, sword-like flurries with its leek, striking with precision.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are hostile creatures that ferociously defend their flaming baton. They attack potential thieves by lighting nearby grass and bushes on fire to scare other Pokémon away.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME lives beneath leek farms, enriching the soil as it tunnels. It gathers decaying plant matter and mixes it underground, greatly improving crop growth over time.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME shine with the resplendent power of their emerald leek. They cook in cauldrons made of crystal deep below the surface waiting for the right Trainer to savor the flavor of their stew.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Often seen as an embodiment of the love a Farfetch'd has for its stalk, POKENAME often swim in ponds close to Farfetch'd nests. It likes to nibble at reed stalks and present them to Farfetch'd as a gift.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: This Pokémon's diet consists of mostly human food, creating a savory blend of flavors that waft from their mouth after using Water-type attacks. POKENAME's presence makes people hungry, so fancy restaurants keep one around and feed them scraps.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: Old writings of a leek-flavored Pokémon that was large enough to feed a family for a week and had targets on its side were dismissed as a tall tale for centuries. Recent experiments with fusion technology have rediscovered this bizarre species.
author: .realthree

entry: It channels its frequent headaches into a foe's mind by using its leek as a psychic conduit. This transfer leaves the opponent disoriented.
author: .izik

entry: It battles with a sharpened leek, which POKENAME controls with its mind. If the leek is broken, it loses all motivation to continue battling.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME tends to spar with others using the two leeks it holds. While most only know primitive fighting skills, a rare few have developed techniques from traditional martial arts.
author: soup1900

entry: To stay in shape, it asks its Trainer to throw a celery stalk so that it can run and fetch it. If it gets nervous, its beak becomes very hot, and anyone who touches it ends up getting burned.
author: fiordaliso

entry: A very cooperative Pokémon, POKENAME get along well with good Trainers. They love fetching things for others as well, and seem to do so instinctually.
author: frokachu

entry: It always carries a stick in its mouth. There are no documented cases of it growing tired of playing fetch, and will continue to play for days on end.
author: greystorm101

entry: POKENAME are often chosen to light torches at certain sporting events because of a story involving POKENAME. The story involves a brave POKENAME lighting the way for many Pokémon behind them by flying blindly into a storm to create a path forward.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The spiral on its belly glows green and pulsates when it attempts to put foes to sleep. This hypnotic effect is surprisingly effective.
author: .izik

entry: The enormous leek it holds has remarkably high nutritional content.  However, those foolish enough to try to take it from POKENAME are liable to be badly bludgeoned by the very leek they seek.
author: empty_set

entry: It telekinetically controls its leek, allowing it to strike from multiple angles simultaneously. This psychic enhancement makes it nearly impossible to predict.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to levitate leeks around itself. In battle, it deflects most attacks heading its way, and it is a master at swordplay. The leeks it has are all offspring of its original leek.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: POKENAME helps farmers throughout the world water and tend to plants. All it asks for in return is a small plot to grow leeks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The vegetables POKENAME carry are dense and heavy, and are rarley good to eat.
author: staghorn

entry: The leek stalks it wields are heavier than they appear, so it must stay well-trained to handle them with precision. To maintain its muscular body, POKENAME does at least two hundred push-ups daily.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME uses a fighting style that combines two bare fists and two that wield a pair of solid leeks. The style is a bit showy, often involving flexing poses or leek-twirling before every strike.
author: sk372

entry: While they appear to be separate, distinct organisms, both the bird and plant body of POKENAME are one mind, controlled by a colonial organism. It is unknown precisely how they accomplish this.
author: holgast

entry: It rotates its leek-like arms to kick up dirt at its foes. When caught off-guard, it spits Acid as a quick defense.
author: .izik

entry: The parts that appear to be plants are actually powerful magnets. No one knows what POKENAME's diet consists of.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Fusion appears to have unlocked latent DNA in POKENAME, bringing its form closer to one found in Galar. Unlike its Galarian counterpart, POKENAME forgoes honorable combat and favors dirty tactics.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME looks similar to its Galarian counterpart, seeking out exceedingly large leeks to wield. It has the vicious temperament of a bully, aggressively swinging its weapon at anything it deems weaker than itself.
author: sk372

entry: During winter, POKENAME flies to warmer climates to stuff its shell with fruits, vegetables, and nuts. Unfortunately, it becomes so heavy that it has to make the journey back by foot.
author: .7soul

entry: POKENAME have become a symbol of extreme convenience. Few hungry travelers can resist its savor, so you're unlikely to find them in the wild anymore.
author: .realthree

entry: POKENAME have traded the wings that most Farfetch'd possess for resilient armor that stymies their many predators. They sleep with their shells clamped shut, protecting their soft bodies and precious sticks.
author: wormspawn

entry: When sleeping, its heads point their beaks inward to form a protective circle. This stance helps it stay safe from predators while resting.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME keeps the three skulls of Dodrio with it to stave off loneliness. At times, it can be observed chirping at the heads, waiting for a response that will never come.
author: sk372

entry: The tongue of a POKENAME is extremely dry and molts constantly. The feathers that fall from it are extremely coarse and shouldn't be used in pillows.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME will peak its heads out of its shell if it detects prey. It then hides its heads back inside the shell, waiting to strike.
author: .izik

entry: The twin heads of a POKENAME play with other Pokémon around them by chasing them with their beaks. Their long beaks resemble horns, which they use to tease other Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When hunting, it will throw its baby as a distraction. Despite its size, the infant can hold its own in most combat situations.
author: .izik

entry: If it spots prey while flying, it will immediately descend on the creature. Using its second head, it will peck viciously until the prey is immobile.
author: .izik

entry: The beak on its right head is noticeably sharper than the left, giving it a slight advantage in attacks. This asymmetry is useful in combat.
author: .izik

entry: It primarily hunts on foggy nights. When it spots its prey to will dash wildly towards its victim, arms extended.
author: .izik

entry: It is constantly pecking at the ground, looking for food. Its tails can detect temperature changes, whipping wildly in hot weather.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dig at the base of trees with their sharp talons to unearth bitter roots to eat. They are capable of uprooting stumps once they get a secure hold on the roots.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It hangs from large trees with a thin, translucent string. If it spots an enemy, it will notify any other POKENAME in the area.
author: .izik

entry: Incredibly friendly and helpful, POKENAME will try to solve problems with its two heads. No one has ever seen the heads disagree or fight with one another.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME make an annual migration to a more temperate climate and travel in flocks to protect their young. They reserve their flying ability for emergencies and prefer to roam about with their legs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its body stretches and contracts like an accordion as it moves, allowing it to slip through tight spaces. This unusual flexibility helps it avoid obstacles effortlessly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have long legs that carry them for long distances without rest. They often wander far from their flock to find grassy green patches of grass, hoping to find some edible Bug-type Pokémon.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It will let loose a cry that sounds like an infant. The cry is slightly distorted, as if being played over a radio.
author: .izik

entry: The heads are joined and share a single central eye, giving them a unified vision. This connection helps them coordinate perfectly in all actions.
author: .izik

entry: It charges electricity while it runs. The orb on its rear head preserves the power for later use much like a battery.
author: .izik

entry: The leaves that grow on its body are as hard as stone. It makes an active effort to never go near sources of water.
author: .izik

entry: The head at the end of its tail constantly watches for danger, often causing it to lose sleep. Its vigilance keeps it alert, even when exhausted.
author: .izik

entry: Due to its heads being beneath it, walking is a struggle for this Pokémon. It prefers to rapidly flap the leaves it has for arms to try to fly.
author: cipherlingarde

entry: POKENAME has a face on both sides of its head. This leads to much confusion, as both faces believe they are looking straight ahead, so it struggles to get anywhere.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The rear head moves on its own and keeps a lookout for predators. Should it see one, the head will take primary control of the body.
author: .izik

entry: The head on its tail is always grooming its fur, keeping it tidy. This habit helps it stay sleek and presentable in its natural habitat.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME absorb many hard-hitting attacks during a Pokémon battle. When they find an opening, they launch a counterattack by pecking with one of their two heads.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It stands on cliff edges, scanning below for predators, and releases a psychic blast when threatened. This quick reaction provides a chance to flee safely.
author: .izik

entry: Both heads of POKENAME are unaware of which is the head and which is the tail. They often pull each other back and forth, making it impossible to move quickly.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME's short legs are good for holding onto unstable branches. They run along treetops, chasing the Bug-type Pokémon that like to feed off of dead or dying trees.
author: .realthree

entry: Its beaks can spit sharp balls of needles, which it uses to line its nest. This spiky barrier deters intruders from disturbing its home.
author: .izik

entry: The beak on the end of its tail is extremely sharp. Certain POKENAME have been found to be able to break through steel with little effort.
author: .izik

entry: Its body may look hard, but it has a decently thick layer of fluff covering its exterior. The heads hide in the skull-like shell when resting or feeling threatened.
author: krune

entry: Its feathers were once collected to stuff mattresses due to their softness. This legacy is still remembered in folklore, despite rarely being used.
author: .izik

entry: The eyes on its main head are unable to see light, instead only being able to view heat patterns. With this sight it can hunt at night with ease.
author: .izik

entry: A parasitic being, POKENAME quickly outgrows its shell, needing to hunt for another host.
author: pory

entry: The horn on its face is actually one large feather. In combat, this feather will become harder than granite.
author: .izik

entry: The heads of POKENAME constantly fight over which head is dominant. The bickering can get so intense that it loses focus on battles with other Pokémon. Trainers with a calm POKENAME are seen as highly skilled.
author: chibitales

entry: The bubbling mud covering its body heats up intensely when it becomes angry. The mud itself is used in beauty treatments throughout Sinnoh.
author: .izik

entry: It clings to trees and pecks at the wood to access the sweet sap within. This favorite treat keeps it coming back to the same trees daily.
author: .izik

entry: Both of POKENAME's pig noses have a keen sense of smell. Farmers use it to sniff out truffles in the coldest conditions.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME is mischievous and will sneak into camps, steal an interesting item, and slither away extremely quickly. The two heads may bicker often, but they coil their necks around each other as a comforting method.
author: pjporwoll

entry: Its front talons are extremely sharp. It uses them to consume large quantities of dirt for future use in combat.
author: .izik

entry: It will rapidly roll up canyon walls if it sees anyone get too close to its nest. It can reach up to 120 mph rolling this way.
author: .izik

entry: It primarily stands on its rear legs while hunting. Doing this, it will be able to move in complete silence before it strikes.
author: .izik

entry: Each of its sharp beak tips contains venom that can immobilize prey. A single jab is enough to render smaller Pokémon helpless.
author: .izik

entry: It converts the sap it drinks from trees into an extremely sweet milk. This milk can cause insomnia if consumed in large quantities.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME heads each have a separate diet and often argue about which direction to go for food. Their varied diet of Bug-type Pokémon, berries, and mud keep their body strong and healthy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Only the head on the tail of POKENAME can see. It will chirp directions to the main head to guide it while moving.
author: .izik

entry: Both of POKENAME's beaks are extremely hot, glowing faintly when it gets excited. It uses them to ward off predators and defend its nest from intruders.
author: .izik

entry: While digging, it will pull its heads close to its body. Its heads will poke through small holes to the surface, waiting for prey to get close.
author: .izik

entry: Upon fusion, POKENAME become too unstable for all but a few particles to remain in the physical realm. Their minds, while split, function perfectly.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME search for prey late into night. It will chirp cutely if it sees a campfire, goading travelers to investigate the sound.
author: .izik

entry: Its feathers change color to match its environment, providing remarkable camouflage. This adaptation allows it to remain hidden from both prey and predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a peaceful scavenger Pokémon. At the sight of danger, POKENAME will bury itself underground and leave its false head above.
author: weirdtux

entry: POKENAME has an insatiable hunger. It is known to fly around in large gatherings searching for abandoned meals or injured Pokémon.
author: weirdtux

entry: POKENAME will bury its main body underground, leaving its false head above. Should anyone be unfortunate to stumble across it, POKENAME will quickly leap above the dirt and attack the offender.
author: weirdtux

entry: Despite only having one head, POKENAME has two hearts. It can easily run at high speeds, rub their poisonous spines up against Grass-type Pokémon trying to escape, and wait for them to collapse.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It digs its talons into cavern ceilings while hunting. When it strikes, it clamps prey with its beak and pulls it up into its main mouth.
author: .izik

entry: The fur on its body grows without stopping, slowing its movement as it ages. The fur itself is extremely soft and coveted by merchants in Hoenn.
author: .izik

entry: According to all known laws of aviation, POKENAME should be too massive to fly. Yet, this simple-minded, two-headed Pokémon is always seen airborne.
author: akujules

entry: Its body is extremely light, allowing it to jump between trees without a sound. If it sees travelers, it will hide until they make camp, then strike.
author: .izik

entry: The legs on the top of its head are much faster than the legs on the bottom of its body. When startled, it will flip over and dash away.
author: .izik

entry: Blending in with the trees, it dangles its feathers like dead leaves. When bug Pokémon approach, it whacks them with one of its two hardy handles.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: It has copious amounts of venom in its beaks. Should it see a foe, it will alternate pecking with each head then finish them off with its horn.
author: .izik

entry: The beaks on its arms are extremely sharp. Using them, it latches onto its prey and cuts into its victim with its center blade.
author: .izik

entry: Its two heads contain nearly identical brains. The heads rarely ever fight, with one exception being over pets from their Trainer.
author: melodydelune

entry: The color of the fins on its head changes as it ages. If the fins are black, it is considered elderly and spends most of its time resting.
author: .izik

entry: The color of the fins on its head changes as it ages. If the fins are green, it is still an adolescent and quick to anger.
author: .izik

entry: The color of the fins on its head changes as it ages. If the fins are tan, it is considered an adult and spends its time looking for a place to nest.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME freeze over large swaths of land to make themselves a comfortable home. They are hard to surprise because of their hypervigilance and their twin heads.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It has enough strength in its rear head to support its entire body. During a fight it will extend and swing both necks in a whip-like fashion.
author: .izik

entry: It is mostly nocturnal, hunting after nightfall. It will grab prey with its beaks then fly high in the air before dropping them.
author: .izik

entry: Each of the beaks on its body have their own stomach. It will passively open and close its beaks while sleeping, hoping for an easy meal.
author: .izik

entry: It wraps its long body around tree branches before falling asleep, secure from ground-dwelling threats. This habit ensures a peaceful rest in the treetops.
author: .izik

entry: It will wait in trees for days at a time, waiting for weak prey to pass by. Once it spots a victim, it will extend its tail and snatch it.
author: .izik

entry: The tufts of fur that grow out of the feathers on its head fall off every summer. Some artists in Johto use this fur for making paintbrushes.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is filled with air. If it decides to jump for any reason, it will struggle to descend back to the ground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunt for slow Bug-type Pokémon because their bodies are heavier than gold. They strategically peck at their target to goad them into exposing their weak spots.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It uses its beaks to dig through sand at a rapid pace, allowing it to bury itself quickly. This trait provides an escape route from danger.
author: .izik

entry: The lower head picks up bits of food and passes it to the other as the gears rotate. When one head sleeps, the other exerts twice as much energy to keep the gears turning.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are always vigilant, keeping their eyes on their territory. The head on the end of its tail can spew flames at trespassers.
author: _snakeywakey_

entry: While it has trouble hearing, its eyes can see for miles. It will hop rhythmically when chasing its prey, while screeching like a creature in pain.
author: .izik

entry: Its upper head peeks out from tall grass to scout for predators before emerging fully. This cautious behavior keeps it safe in the wild.
author: .izik

entry: One head is always alert when eating or sleeping. The heads communicate to pinpoint prey. Trained POKENAME make excellent alarm systems and sentries.
author: totodile.

entry: POKENAME runs at high speeds, poking anything it comes across with its sharp thorns. It never stops running.
author: themicelegion

entry: Each beak on its body will squawk in unison if it sees food. It will then lay down on the food and roll, allowing each mouth to have a taste.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hunt for Bug-type Pokémon by uprooting logs and stumps with their claws. Once the Bug-type Pokémon begin to run away, they peck at the ground with their twin beaks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Depending on the time of the year it prefers, a POKENAME will grow different colored remiges. The flight feathers will be green if it prefers summer.
author: .izik

entry: Depending on the time of the year it prefers, a POKENAME will grow different colored remiges. The flight feathers will be tan if it prefers spring.
author: .izik

entry: Depending on the time of the year it prefers, a POKENAME will grow different colored remiges. The flight feathers will be brown if it prefers autumn.
author: .izik

entry: Depending on the time of the year it prefers, a POKENAME will grow different colored remiges. The flight feathers will be white if it prefers winter.
author: .izik

entry: The weak venom in its beaks becomes much stronger when faced with a life-threatening situation. This defensive mechanism gives it an edge in desperate moments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can jump surprisingly long distances. When both heads tuck into the shell, they can exhale freezing breath that can turn lakes solid.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon is capable of racing at high speeds. It emits poisonous spores in its wake to deter chasing predators.
author: synaesthesis

entry: Despite its appearance, POKENAME can move remarkably fast. It leaves behind large clumps of trash that smell so putrid they can render people unconscious.
author: darkweavile428

entry: POKENAME uses one head to eat trash it likes while using the other head to throw away trash it doesn't want. It uses the trash bag it was born from as a sack to store extra trash for later consumption.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's two heads share responsibilities - one watches for danger while the other eats. If a foe approaches, the watchful head releases a cloud of toxic pollen as a defense mechanism.
author: .izik

entry: It balances perfectly on either of its two beaks before launching into a powerful kick. This move is both impressive and effective in combat.
author: .izik

entry: It absorbs sunlight directly into the crowns on its heads to fuel its energy. During sunny days, it becomes more active and agile than usual.
author: .izik

entry: Its feathers are actually trillions of tiny needles, providing both protection and insulation. These spiky needles make it difficult for predators to approach.
author: .izik

entry: The "sand" covering its body is actually composed of tiny feathers. These feathers provide insulation and a unique texture for camouflage.
author: .izik

entry: The heads are connected internally to the fungi growing on its back, which control its limbs entirely. This symbiosis allows it to move with precision and efficiency.
author: .izik

entry: While integrated with the fungi, the heads are not fully sentient, emitting passive chirps. They spread spores onto other creatures as a natural behavior.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves planting crops and often sits beneath Pinap Berry trees. It uses its heads to peck off ripe berries, which it then plants in the soil to grow new crops.
author: .izik

entry: Their feathers are quite fluffy, and only get more voluminous as they grow. POKENAME defend themselves and hunt prey with their long beak; they have a preferred diet of small Bug-types.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME release billowing smoke from their beaks, which helps them burn through cocoons and secure them a meal. On rare occasions they carry an egg atop their backs and nurse the egg until it hatches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It sheds an odd powder from its wings while it flies. Should the powder land on a human, it must be washed off thoroughly to avoid infection.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fully sheds its skin frequently during this evolutionary stage. It wears its most recent shedding to appear as multiple POKENAME, deterring predators.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The dirt-colored feathers covering POKENAME's torso closely resemble soil. When fleeing, it scatters these feathers to confuse predators and obscure its escape route.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wander into mineshafts to peck at the rare metals within the cavernous walls. They take turns poking at the rocky walls to eventually reveal the shiny ore.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME pecks at enemies with surgical precision when in a rage, targeting vital points. Any interruptions only serve to make POKENAME even angrier.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's powerful legs allow it to run hundreds of miles a day. When resting, the two heads meticulously groom its thick plumage with their beaks.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME has a combative personality, but its two minds are simple and lack a bit of cohesion. It often tries to take on two different opponents at once, and becomes unable to properly focus on either in the battle.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME eats meals high in protein and creates the most comfortable nest it can, all to prepare itself for evolution. If a Trainer's POKENAME is behaving unlike its usual self, it may be about to evolve.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME train in wild, unpredictable bursts - flexing their limbs, bending their knees, and jumping here and there. These sudden bouts of activity are considered humorous and lovable by many Trainers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME train in short bursts and are easily distracted. Athletes enjoy having arm wrestling matches and races with POKENAME because they are magnanimous regardless of whether they win or lose.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When the head on POKENAME's tail opens its beak, a burning flame can be seen within. This secondary head helps keep POKENAME aware of sneak attacks and provides a second mouth to breathe intense fire blasts from.
author: sk372

entry: Its large feathery pod-like body is commonly seen pulsating in potato fields, its roots drawing nutrients from the crops. Farmers regularly remove these pests, fearing what creature could emerge from the quivering structure.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sprints through jungles, scattering tiny feathers as it moves. Researchers believe these feathers carry spores that allow it to parasitize other plants.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appear where many people are gathered in celebration. Its heads take turns sleeping, so it never fears missing out on a good time.
author: laughing_dan

entry: Its talons enable it to travel across the roughest terrains with ease. This adaptation makes it a resilient and agile explorer.
author: .izik

entry: The talons on POKENAME's back feet allow it to climb near vertical cliff faces. Its blazing manes can be seen on nighttime mountains miles away.
author: rihse

entry: The two heads at the tail are more intelligent than the main head, but lack control of the body. The duo takes turns between hunting or fishing for food and trying vainly to get POKENAME to move around.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often trip over themselves often because of the unwieldy shell across their body. Getting up after a fall can be difficult because they need to keep their heads in a balanced position.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The foot on its head conducts electricity with ease. They flock en masse to power substations to absorb electricity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's long legs allow it to silently creep into shallow lakes while its body provides shade to lure fish Pokémon. One head remains vigilant for danger while the rest feed. It can flee at speeds around 65 miles per hour when threatened.
author: chibitales

entry: The middle head is incapable of eating and receives nutrients from the two heads on either side. This unique adaptation ensures all heads remain nourished.
author: .izik

entry: The claws on its flippers are mainly for show and seldom used in battle. It waves them around haphazardly to dissuade predators.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME maneuver their beaks with surgical precision when hunting for shelled Pokémon. One head will apply pressure to the back of their shell while the other tries to pry their prey open.
author: quackquackattack

entry: If it trips while running, it will roll away on its orb-like body until it escapes a predator. This motion often confuses enemies, giving it a chance to flee.
author: .izik

entry: It is obsessed with using the feathers at the tip of its bone to meticulously dust its den. This strange habit helps it keep its home spotless at all times.
author: .izik

entry: The feathers that grow from its body are hard as stone. Despite their firmness, they are very light and easily plucked.
author: .izik

entry: The egg of a POKENAME is extremely bitter in taste. Should it lose its egg, it will find another one within days from an unknown source.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are capable of travelling far from water with their two taloned feet. This allows them to access berries and other snacks that are hard to access close to beaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME run past beaches to access forests where a variety of berries are present. They love trying out new food so much that they travel far from their homes to do so.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Although the feathers at the tip of its tail resemble flames, they are surprisingly cool. However, they flicker and sway, giving the illusion of fire.
author: .izik

entry: It has the ability to split into three separate globs, each with its own personality. However, it must rejoin within a day, or it will perish due to overwhelming loneliness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME defend themselves against predators by unleashing a pecking assault against whatever may come close to them. The painful pecks of a POKENAME cause many to leave them alone.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME release a pleasant aroma to lure Bug-type Pokémon towards them. Once the Bug-type Pokémon is close enough, they peck their prey in rapid succession to secure their next meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME burn small shavings of wood to lure Pokémon out of their burrows. If they find a suitable target, they unleash a flurry of pecks to take down their next meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME appear like a sick Totodile to get close to a meal from a Feraligatr. Once they are close enough to the leftovers, they sneak chunks of the food to their many heads.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travel in packs where they keep watch for their predators. If a bold predator decides to attack, they have to endure the pecks from the entire POKENAME horde.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME travel in large groups to protect themselves from predators and hunt large prey. Their speedy bodies are capable of outrunning a bike while their heads are able to pluck a Butterfree mid-flight.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME cannot fly very well, so it relies on hopping long distances at great speed. However, this requires great coordination between each head, as they possess individual brains. Therefore, newly evolved POKENAME are clumsy.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME can peek into the future. Unfortunately, each of its heads report different instances of the future, making predictions extremely erratic.
author: gottkroprinziii

entry: POKENAME is a perfect companion for those who enjoy relaxation. When it is well-fed and has formed a strong bond with its Trainer, it secretes a fragrant lotion and uses Acupressure to soothe aches.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: The middle head frequently forgets to eat. Because of this, the other two heads are always foraging for food.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME peck at the base of trees to coax Bug-type Pokémon out of their homes. For particularly stubborn prey, they flood the burrows with poisonous pollen to force their prey out.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It extends its heads underwater to hunt for aquatic prey, catching small prey with ease. Its ability to hold its breath for extended periods makes it a skilled swimmer.
author: .izik

entry: The main head of POKENAME gets to control the front two legs, while the other two heads only get one leg. The back heads think this is very unfair.
author: dodoowner_

entry: During combat it will break apart into separate portions. Each moves on its own, with tactics that resemble a sports team's.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's heads still don't cooperate, which often leads to them missing attacks and leaving themselves open. However, if they do decide to work together, they are a force to be reckoned with.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME act demure to lure other Pokémon close to them before unleashing a feral assault of beaks. The painful pecks from a POKENAME cause many Pokémon to become more vigilant of the friends they make.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It roars loudest when someone is watching. The noise becomes progressively louder for each person watching it.
author: .izik

entry: Its brown, mud-like body radiates intense heat, making it dangerous to touch. The heat can even scorch the ground it walks on.
author: .izik

entry: The limbs sprouting from POKENAME's side are too weak to lift it. Instead, it pulls itself forwards with these legs.
author: .realthree

entry: Despite its rough appearance, the metal that covers its body is extremely weak. The texture is similar to aluminum and easily torn.
author: .izik

entry: Hieroglyphs in ancient ruins depict creautres very reminiscent of POKENAME. What has been translated of them thus far refer to them as beings tasked with dragging wicked souls to the afterlife.
author: sk372

entry: It uses its sharp front claws to attack its enemies. The nails themselves are as hard as steel and able to rend foes in two.
author: .izik

entry: It will cover itself in mud and sleep for days. Should it spot prey, its heads will sprout up out of the mud and make a horrifying cry.
author: .izik

entry: Ancient depictions of POKENAME predate the invention of DNA splicers. It's capable of loud, angry noises, but prefers to communicate via small paintings it assembles in a way that resembles writing.
author: sontyp

entry: There are two columns of serrated fangs inside its beak, each filled with potent venom. A single bite can paralyze prey almost instantly.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its head to peck at the rocks near its home in hopes of finding a geode. Should it crack one open, it will consume the crystals inside.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appear as forest guardians at a first glance, but whenever anything comes too close to them will get pecked by a barrage of beaks. They travel through time to feed baby Doduo until they are ready to feed themselves.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Sometimes, the tail of a POKENAME can get entangled with the two secondary heads - this causes it to run about in a panic, discharging electricity as it goes. Because it has larger organs to sustain three heads, these outbursts can last for hours.
author: thatdanguy23

entry: It has scales all over its body that are extremely sharp. Using its beaks, it will skillfully scale walls with ease.
author: .izik

entry: It can extend each of its necks up to 15 feet away from its body. Should it detect prey, it will lunge at it wildly, each head moving independently.
author: .izik

entry: Upon fusion, some POKENAME becomes too unstable for all but a few particles to remain in the physical realm. Their minds, while split, function perfectly.
author: entomoxie

entry: Many are captivated by the unique sound of POKENAME's song. Though it only sings by itself, it sounds like a choir of three voices singing in perfect harmony.
author: sk372

entry: Although weak, POKENAME is known for its ferocious tendencies in battle, often ignoring its Trainer in favor of attacking how it pleases.
author: weirdtux

entry: POKENAME will hide its main body inside a bush while poking its two false heads out to draw attention. Once a curious Pokémon gets too close, POKENAME will attack ferociously.
author: weirdtux

entry: POKENAME will burrow itself underground, leaving its two false heads on the surface. POKENAME's false heads smash against the ground until a curious Pokémon comes across them, at which point POKENAME will attack.
author: weirdtux

entry: Should POKENAME sense an approaching tornado, all three heads swing in circular patterns while squawking loudly. However, it also does this when hungry, sad, sleepy, or angry, making it a rather unreliable warning.
author: .izik

entry: Despite its unwieldy form, POKENAME is an effective hunter. It flies into swarms of Bug-type Pokémon, flailing its body wildly to incapacitate multiple targets at once.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Pokémon Rangers claim that POKENAME makes for the ultimate scout. Its eyes can apparently see through anything, and at least one of its three heads is always awake regardless of the time of day.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Seeking its Trainer's praise, its three heads execute complex plans between them. When one is being petted, the other two heads will be jealous.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME are capable of harnessing their powers to unleash a flurry of pecks at their target. It is said that whoever angers a POKENAME will be sent into a dimension where they are pecked non-stop.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It barely floats off the ground. The head sprouting from its bottom gets pulled along through the dirt.
author: capwolfbane

entry: Each of its three heads has a specific role during flight. The middle head breathes fire at any threat, while the other two coordinate direction and altitude.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Most of its blood flows to its four heads, leaving its body immobile and fragile. The heads strike with terrifying power and speed.
author: slowforest

entry: POKENAME shoot embers at the base of stumps to create smoke, which causes prey to rush out of burrows. As the prey frantically try to escape, POKENAME unleash a three-headed assault of pecking in an attempt to skewer their next meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It will sing an eerie lullaby to lull its prey to sleep. Then, it extends its long legs to sneak up to the victim, consuming it while still humming.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME fly silently through caves to find nooks and crannies to peck into. More often than not, they are able to locate a Bug-type Pokémon hiding in the crevice.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The three masks it holds each depict an aspect of its former life as a human. One depicts the face of the body, another the face of the mind, and the last the face of the soul.
author: sk372

entry: The barbs on a POKENAME are made of small beaks. They swirl their heads to smack their beaks into their target, causing painful stab wounds.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A POKENAME prefers to make its nest deep in caverns. It hates the sunlight, as exposing it for long periods of time will char its feathers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME flies using its tail feathers. Scientists are baffled by this, as according to all laws of aviation, a POKENAME should not be able to fly.
author: krune

entry: It slowly levitates in the sky. When it spots prey, its three necks stretch out to nearly double their usual length and nab prey with their beaks. Oddly, POKENAME will then use the beak on its hard shell to devour them.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME has evolved to possess higher stamina than its predecessor. It can run long distances across grassy plains without rest.
author: synaesthesis

entry: When a POKENAME is excessively hungry, its other heads will emerge from the feathers on its chest. When food is found, only the main head will eat.
author: .izik

entry: Extremely skilled POKENAME can create copies of itself made of flame to serve as backup dancers to its performance. Notably, the two simulacra exhibit differing personalities and dance moves compared to their creator.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dance with style but often stumble over themselves trying to impress their Trainer. The moments they dance in unison are as fleeting as they are mesmerizing.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A well-fed POKENAME will never need to have its other heads emerge. If it is too full it will dance emphatically to lose weight.
author: .izik

entry: The feathers on its head are filled with a pollen that induces drowsiness. Those who inhale it often fall asleep within moments.
author: .izik

entry: The symbiotic relationship between POKENAME and its mushrooms is mutualistic: The mushrooms distract predators in exchange for nutrients.
author: .realthree

entry: Two of POKENAME's heads are aggressive and territorial, while the third is more amiable. The middle head often tries to dissuade and interrupt the others' attacks so that the target of their ire has a chance to flee.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rely on the element of surprise to skewer other Pokémon onto their beaks. Their razor-sharp teeth allow them to tear up their prey so that their heads have an easier time chowing down.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The center head collaborates with the sentient mushroom growing on its back. Together, they maintain complete control over the other two heads, ensuring perfect coordination.
author: .izik

entry: When enraged, POKENAME shoots fire from its ears, enveloping its two secondary heads. Their feathers can withstand the heat, allowing them to deliver powerful, heated pecks to opponents.
author: .izik

entry: While the three heads of POKENAME often get into squabbles over minor things, they will fiercely work together to protect the nest on their main bodies. They make up for their low walking speed by rapidly extending their long necks to peck at foes.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: It releases psychedelic spores from its wings, making those exposed believe they have three heads. This confusion leaves foes dazed and vulnerable to further attacks.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME claw at the base of old trees to create enough wood shavings to start a fire. The crowds of prey that escape the burning tree are subject to a three-headed pecking assault.
author: quackquackattack

entry: During winter, POKENAME's dirt-like feathers grow unusually fluffy. It lines its underground nest with them to retain warmth through colder months.
author: .izik

entry: When it discovers silver or gold ore in caves, it obsessively pecks at the stone until the treasure is loosened. It stores shiny objects to display proudly in its nest.
author: .izik

entry: The middle head has a migraine, while the other two do not. Depending on their moods, they will either try to comfort the middle head or try to ignore it.
author: kiwiarms

entry: All three of POKENAME's heads can spit powerful flames, though only one can do so at a time. Despite its stout appearance, it is a natural-born runner and is often chosen as a racing champion in the Pokéathlon.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It uses the psychic energy stored in its spoon to enhance its speed when dashing. This energy boost allows it to outmaneuver even the fastest foes.
author: .izik

entry: By using its three separate brains, it can read three minds at once with ease. This unique ability allows it to predict movements and stay one step ahead of its opponents.
author: .izik

entry: Each beak has the strength to lift over 800 lbs with little effort. Its power makes it a formidable opponent in battle and competitions.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon lives to fight, though it mostly fights itself. If seen not fighting and at peace, it requires therapy, as it may not have long to live.
author: cyprexx

entry: POKENAME'S heads never get along with each other and always bicker. To settle arguments, they punch each other until only one head remains conscious.
author: typhloquil

entry: Wild POKENAME very rarely consume anything but vegetation. If it spots an herb it wishes to eat, it will spit acid onto it before taking a bite.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its beaks as pitons for climbing up steep surfaces. It stays away from loose rubble or mud, fearing the fall if it loses its grip.
author: .izik

entry: Sometimes Pokémon will take shelter in the shells that Graveler leave behind after evolution, which results in fusions like POKENAME.
author: bee4082

entry: Its three capricious minds often cannot decide where to take it. When they do think alike, it runs frighteningly quick.
author: clickonflareblitz

entry: POKENAME uses its three sets of heads, lungs, and hearts to run for far longer than normal. Its fiery hair grows dimmer the more heads are asleep.
author: ziggaway

entry: Its feet are extremely magnetic, allowing it to cling to metal surfaces. It can even attract small objects from a distance without noticing.
author: .izik

entry: It can climb up cliff walls by digging its five beaks into the stone surface. This ability makes it an expert at scaling difficult terrain with unmatched agility.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME retained the heads of Doduo while growing the three heads of Dodrio. The trio is rather protective of the duo, and works together more harmoniously than usual for the sake of their less-evolved kin.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swim through icy water to find small fish Pokémon to skewer. Once one head has secured a meal, the other two stop their hunting to share the food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME hunt below the sea by releasing freezing cold beams of ice against fish Pokémon. Once they freeze a fin or flipper from their prey, they unleash an assault of pecks to tear into their meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Wielding multiple pendulums simultaneously, POKENAME has massive levels of hypnotic strength. Unfortunately, during hypnosis, it can occasionally hypnotize some of its own heads, leading to chaos.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's body has perfectly adapted to let it swim swiftly through the icy waters it inhabits. Within the frozen bulb growing on its back, it stores poisonous spores that it uses to lull its prey to sleep before finishing them off.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME swims with high speed and maneuverability thanks to its long, springy legs. It loves to play games where it can use its kicking prowess to its fullest potential.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful punch to break through ice chunks. Since it is not the greatest swimmer, it prefers to hang out on icebergs, training its strength by trying to break through the ice.
author: mistymagius

entry: Curious and affectionate in nature, POKENAME happily swims up to divers and others in the water. It likes to tag those it is particularly fond of by spitting a jet of ink at them to mark them as a friend.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's horn glows before it summons a powerful Twister, which can fling predators skyward while it slips away unnoticed.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME chisels holes in the surface of the frozen lakes it inhabits, providing it spots to leap to and fro quickly. Its strength in aquatic leaps makes it popular as a performer in aquarium venues.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME swims upstream at speeds of up to 30 knots. When exhausted, it pants heavily, revealing its sticky tongue.
author: .izik

entry: This Pokémon is both predator and prey: while its horn allows it to easily overwhelm smaller lifeforms, larger and fiercer hunters of the north, such as Walrein, find its fatty flesh most delectable.
author: bobosmith01

entry: This Pokémon is both predator and prey. Its horn allows it to easily overwhelm smaller lifeforms, but larger hunters of the north, such as Walrein, find its fatty flesh especially delectable.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It habitually counts icicles near its nest. Should it ever lose count, it will start from the beginning without a second thought.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are not very smart, often mindlessly following other Pokémon with little regard for their safety. They are surprisingly fast swimmers, using their strong flippers to propel themselves through the water.
author: mistymagius

entry: A playful and friendly Pokémon, POKENAME enjoys lazily swimming alongside ships and performing for the passengers. Sailors adopt it because its intimidating size and appearance scares away trouble.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME sings a haunting song deep beneath the waves at night. Its tail gently rises and falls as it drifts through the ocean currents.
author: .izik

entry: Using its horn, POKENAME uproots seaweed from the ocean floor. It can consume over 200 pounds of food each day.
author: .izik

entry: When threatened, POKENAME use their powerful tails to stand upright to seem more imposing, or launch themselves out of the water. It is not uncommon for them to land on boats. POKENAME have tongues too big for their mouths.
author: roniodove

entry: POKENAME hunt in large flocks, usually going after schools of Magikarp. Their wings are covered in absorbent fur, allowing them to get wet without worrying about freezing over.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's tongue and antennae blink in patterns to communicate. Each sequence signals a message to others in its school.
author: .izik
