entry: While dashing through frozen seas, POKENAME fires electricity to break ice. The faster it moves, the quicker its power returns.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are pure-hearted creatures that love spending time with other Pokémon. The eggshell covering their stomach allows them to quickly slide across smooth surfaces.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is incredibly playful and will sometimes play with young children at the beach. Its scales have the strange power to purify water. However, this process does take quite a bit of time.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME make their nests on beachside cliffs, diving from the cliffs to catch small fish. If they end up getting knocked out while over the ocean, their spherical bodies allow them to effortlessly float on the water's surface.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME flies high above the sea, scanning for prey. It dives with blinding speed, catching Magikarp even if they're beneath the surface.
author: .izik

entry: It gnaws away at frozen driftwood with sharp teeth, carving tunnels in lake ice to escape predators. During winter, its muffled squeaks echo beneath the surface like distant chimes.
author: jaminmcready

entry: POKENAME spends most of its life in icy shallows, using its smooth, slippery skin to glide through water with ease. It stores a layer of mucus beneath its hide, keeping it warm and preventing frostbite even in subzero temperatures.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are playful yet intelligent creatures. They prefer to dumb down their responses to inquiry because they love to play games more than they enjoy answering questions. They are particularly happy with a ball to play with.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME live in cold water environments and have a specialised growth on their back that causes ice to crystalise on it. They use this growth as a buoyancy aid, the ice helping to keep them near the water's surface when they swim.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Despite its weird appearance, POKENAME makes for a pretty good pet. They adore swimming and having baths, especially in cold water.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have been used as thermostats to determine the temperature of walk-in freezers. If its tongue becomes warm, the food is unsafe.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lives on ocean cliffs, swooping down from the cliff face to catch fish from above. Its stinger contains a mild poison that can cause numbness and a high fever.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME loves fish, but since it struggles to catch many, it will often harass fishermen in hopes of snagging their catches. Flocks of POKENAME can be seen following larger sea predators so they can feast on their leftover meals.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live in small packs without their parents, who leave to rest atop icebergs once they reach the age of maturity. The youthful POKENAME become tired easily and enjoy taking naps.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are gullible Pokémon that always approach Trainers or other Pokémon with trust and respect. They are vulnerable to deception, so their Trainers need to teach them how to be cautious around strangers.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are deceptively proficient swimmers and can swim long distances to find new sources of food. Many who are kept in captivity become overweight because they lack the exercise they would get in the wild.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a majestic Pokémon that prefers nesting in frigid temperatures. The hard spikes on its head aid in breaking through the ice so it can fish.
author: princessmilandria

entry: Despite having very short legs, POKENAME can achieve greater speed on ice by sliding on its belly. When swimming, it floats on the water surface akin to a small iceberg.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME has a unique method of defending itself. By freezing the water inside of its mouth, it fires sharp icicles with such force it is able to pierce through steel.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME mimics a Seel to lure Carvanha close. It ambushes prey with Octazooka, then hauls them ashore with its tentacles.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME loves to catch fish, often storing large amounts in its tail. It tends to give out these fish to its Trainer; luckily, it has a gland in its tail that keeps the fish nice and cold.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is a fatty, carnivorous, and amphibious mammal that is most active during the cold season. While unpredictable in the wild, they are generally very affectionate with their own Pokémon Trainer.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME rolls across the ocean's surface at high speed. It loves launching itself over large waves like a playful cannonball.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME blends horn and tail strikes into flowing martial arts. Before unleashing Icy Wind, it performs a full backflip.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has a voracious appetite, and is able to subsist entirely on the chunks of ice it consumes. It is always sufficiently hydrated as a result.
author: tuskaninny

entry: POKENAME withstands the cold of its glacial habitat by encasing itself in a shell until it is ready to evolve.
author: tuskaninny

entry: The thick fur coating POKENAME's body acts as a layer of protection against both physical attacks from opponents and the bitter cold of its habitat.
author: tuskaninny

entry: By absorbing stray lightning with its horn, its fur becomes charged enough to stun attackers. In water, it steers with its tail to swim swiftly, even in storms.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME coats its white fur with a thin layer of electricity to paralyze anyone who tries to touch it without its consent. It spends most of its life underwater and only comes ashore when it needs to eat the food it has found.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME can often be seen on populated beaches, trying to gobble up any leftover food scraps. It is best not to offer any of your food to it as it will then attempt to devour every edible item you have on hand.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME appear in frigid open waters during snowstorms to guide lost sailors home. Their angelic voices lead sailors to the nearest port, saving many lives each year.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To sleep, POKENAME flattens against the sea floor and blends in with the sand. When still, it becomes nearly invisible.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is very friendly, playfully licking anyone it likes. Its whiskers cool the air around it, causing small ice crystals to form on its body.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's thick fur allows it to survive in freezing cold waters. It spears fish with its sharp horn and brings them back to its children during harsh winters.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's ears are sensitive enough to hear the movements of prey even through solid ice. It sits atop ice floes until it senses fish come close, before diving into the water to poison its target with the horn on its head.
author: sk372

entry: Its incredibly soft feathers keep POKENAME warm while swimming in arctic waters. Its small horn is cold to the touch, which it uses to deter predators.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME's metallic horn can pierce solid stone. It grows sharper through constant sparring with others of its kind.
author: .izik

entry: To recover its energy after swimming for a long time, POKENAME takes long naps on the beach. Its dark fur constantly traps particles of energy, allowing it to unleash majestic Electric-type attacks when needed.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It prefers colder climates. Trainers should check its health to see if its nose is cold; if not, it should be brought to a Pokémon Center immediately.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME adores beach balls and often washes ashore with tourists. It uses Icy Wind and its own innards to launch balls skyward in play.
author: .izik

entry: When one of POKENAME's tusks falls out, it will attach it to the rings on its body as an extra line of defense. It often struggles to swim, having to constantly switch which side its flipper is on to stay straight.
author: mistymagius

entry: The horn on its head is as hard as iron. It uses it to break icebergs in half while playing in the ocean.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are very playful and can often be seen carrying young Spheals on their backs. They mostly live in arctic waters but can sometimes be spotted bouncing up onto coastal beaches.
author: mistymagius

entry: Small colonies of POKENAME can be found on large icebergs, feeding on the minerals frozen in the ice. Luckily their bodies are buoyant enough that if they fall into the water, they can float back to dry land.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lurks in the shallows of the ocean, keeping just its eyes above the sand. When prey swims close enough, they launch upward with their powerful jaws and attempt to drag it into their burrows.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME lies hidden in shallow reefs, waiting for Wingull and other prey to approach. Its jaws can crush stone with a single bite.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swims around in circles due to it constantly forgetting where it is going. They have plush scales that make them highly prized among collectors.
author: tonarinokaibutsu

entry: While POKENAME's tail looks like scorching fire, it's actually extremely cold to the touch. Prolonged contact causes a severe case of frostbite.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME emits powerful sonar from its horn while flying above icy seas. The sound is loud enough to disorient predators.
author: .izik

entry: It usually has a calm nature, but when it fights it becomes aggressive. Although this Pokémon can fly, it is also a skilled swimmer. POKENAME uses the horn on its forehead to cut through the waves of the sea, and to hunt prey underwater.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While swimming, POKENAME appears to fly underwater with grace. When angry, its wings boil the water around it.
author: .izik

entry: Its fatty and hefty body requires tons of nutrients, so it recklessly hunts almost any Pokémon it comes across. Being bitten by a POKENAME can cause severe frostbite.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is clumsy on land, but as fast as a rocket in the water. Because of this, it only surfaces to rest and to eat the snow and ice its diet requires.
author: _._starry_._

entry: The saliva on POKENAME's tongue instantly freezes what it touches. It licks its cave walls to maintain the frigid temperature.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME freezes intruders with Ice Beam and displays them as icy trophies in its cave. It takes pride in showing them to others.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME spends hours on the shoreline practicing its dancing. Despite all the effort, others often perceive its dances as "silly" or "goofy".
author: robbery_666

entry: Despite its intimidating appearance, POKENAME is actually playful. It can be seen playfully gnawing on passing ships, hoping the sailors will stop and play with it.
author: mistymagius

entry: The clouds on POKENAME's arms are so buoyant that it struggles to dive underwater. It instead spends most of its time relaxing on the ocean's surface.
author: chartanon

entry: Its cloudy body acts as an effective buffer against attacks. It dislikes fighting, and is often content with smaller Pokémon bouncing on its belly.
author: chartanon

entry: POKENAME stores lots of blubber in its body, which makes up eighty percent of its rotund body. It relies on this mass of blubber to keep warm in sub-zero temperatures.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME regulates a warm temperature under its flippers. Arctic explorers have been surprised when a snow pile has risen, revealed to be the flippers of a friendly POKENAME.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME soars above cold oceans, searching for the largest fish it can find. When it locates one, it dives into the water, beating the fish into submission before preparing it to eat.
author: evilgammon

entry: During the winter, POKENAME migrates towards the sea so it can find food. Its thorns are actually made out of ice hidden underneath its thick fur.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME live in deep arctic waters as their thick layer of blubber protects them from high pressures and frigid temperatures. They are rarely seen at the surface, so no one knows how many remain in the wild.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME is as excellent at running as it is at swimming. It typically can be found in packs, either on land or in the sea around beaches.
author: justjackorwhatever

entry: POKENAME channels psychic energy through the fins on its head. With one thought, it can shift entire icebergs from its path.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have a thick layer of insulating fat that keeps them warm even in the coldest arctic waters. During lean months where their fat reserves run thin they can supplement their body heat by creating fires to huddle around on the beach.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Some believe a single lick from POKENAME's tongue can inspire love. Travelers often seek it on beaches, hoping for a fateful encounter.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME digs near shoals in small groups and surfaces during the day. It spends hours basking in sunlight, seemingly enjoying the warmth before returning underground.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's doesn't like walking, so it will instead slide on its belly to get around. Its feathers are coated in oil, which allows for it to slide wherever it pleases.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME races through icy waters while using Aurora Beam from its gem. It fends off predators like Sharpedo with precise blasts.
author: .izik

entry: The body of a POKENAME is mostly made of blubber, which helps it warm in frigid temperatures. When it reaches the point where it trusts with its Trainer, it will expose its soft and vulnerable underbelly for belly rubs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is a mischievous nuisance in port cities because it hangs out near docks and gets in the way while begging for food and attention. If it is ignored, it flies into a tantrum where it seeks to cause destruction until its demands are met.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME is incredibly aggressive, thrashing around violently if anyone enters its territory. However, since its feet have adapted to walking on ice, it struggles to walk on solid ground.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME coalesce into groups whenever temperatures fall below freezing. They huddle together to preserve body heat while also defending against predators.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In the regions far to the cold North, POKENAME hunts Spheal and its evolutions for their nutritious fat and warm fur.
author: malxire

entry: POKENAME mimics the head of a Seel to keep that evolutionary line from predating it. The tongue-like organ is actually an exposed stomach which it uses to easily and efficiently feed on plankton.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's large eyes allow it to hunt even in the darkest arctic waters. It uses its horn to carve a hole in an iceberg so it can sleep, blocking the entrance with its camouflaged bell.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME rolls on the seafloor, feeding on large amounts of seagrass. The rock that makes up its body is quite porous, allowing it to somewhat float in saltier waters.
author: mistymagius

entry: The liquid on its body contains samples of every water source a POKENAME has ever been in, allowing scientists to trace its movements since it hatched. As a POKENAME grows older, this water becomes either boiling hot or ice cold.
author: sautomagically

entry: A lazy and slow-moving Pokémon that prefers to rest on cool shorelines. It only hunts when it becomes very hungry, and thus, motivated.
author: bobosmith01

entry: If it gets cold, the shell on its tail will tremble. During warmer seasons, the shell drools a blue fluid to keep cool.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME floats around the seafloor, using its magnetic arms to grab small metallic particles to eat. While rare in most areas of the world, its numbers are greater surrounding the poles.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have an unusual diet of both electricity and fatty fish, so they tend to gather at fishing towns. Their chorus of joyous yelping tend to be beloved by tourists and be reviled by the local populace.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses both horned heads in combat to overwhelm foes. If outmatched, it flees with impressive speed.
author: .izik

entry: This Seel can easily be spotted via its grey spots and the gem on its forehead. It has mastered Ice-type moves.
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer

entry: POKENAME lives in extremely cold areas, its thick layer of fur and blubber helping to protect it from the cold. It spends most of its time lazing around on the ice sheet and only goes in the water to hunt.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME hide in the frigid darkness of the northern seas. They sleep for twenty hours to keep their body temperature low, then spend the last four hours tearing apart dead fish with their magnificent teeth.
author: leandermalurt

entry: POKENAME sticks its tongue out from within its closed shell to sense its surroundings. Shy by nature, it only opens its shell and explores an area if the coast is almost completely clear.
author: sk372

entry: While swimming, POKENAME spins through the water like a drill. It can outpace most commercial ships with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME burrows into sandy beaches and defends its home with Icy Wind. The blast is usually enough on its own to dissuade predators from attempting to pursue it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swings its massive claw like a flail in battle. If it misses, it follows up with Aqua Jet to keep foes unsteady.
author: .izik

entry: Although POKENAME is primarily an aquatic creature, it enjoys spending much of its time under the sun, recharging energy that it stores within the bulb on its back. It fights using powerful combinations of Water and Poison-type moves.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME tend to huddle together in tight bunches to keep warm in their frigid environment. These round Pokémon are extremely friendly, and will welcome all species into their group cuddle.
author: moopse

entry: Schools of POKENAME cling to sunken freighters, using the wrecks for shelter. These underwater havens offer protection from larger predators.
author: .izik

entry: While swimming, it leaves a trail of sparkling ice crystals that shimmer in the water. This beautiful path attracts both friends and curious onlookers.
author: .izik

entry: The scales on its body taste like turmeric, making it popular among chefs. This culinary curiosity has made it a rare delicacy.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is an outstanding juggler and acrobat, dazzling audiences with its graceful dives and poolside performances. The laughter of children fills it with energy, so it does everything it can to make them happy.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It whistles an alluring tune that tricks sailors into navigating dangerous waters. Many legends warn of this song, which has led countless ships astray.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's thick coat allows it to shrug off the cold. Teams of POKENAME are used to pull wagons and other vehicles in arctic climates.
author: mepp.

entry: When excited its fins glow brightly, lighting up the surrounding water. This shimmering display attracts attention from nearby Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: Its smooth body reduces water resistance, allowing it to swim at incredible speeds. This streamlined physique makes it difficult to catch or outrun.
author: .izik

entry: With ease, it swims through powerful whirlpools, unaffected by their pull. Its strength in turbulent waters is unmatched.
author: .izik

entry: With the beat of its wings, POKENAME cools melting ice caps, protecting the polar ecosystem. Underwater, it moves with incredible speed thanks to its sleek, snow-white tail.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are peaceful, but will fiercely defend themselves or their offspring with the sharp horn on their heads. With their ability to alter the weather, they occasionally help aid lost explorers by dissipating snowstorms.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME resides in frigid arctic areas, watching over the other denizens from a distance. If something intrudes upon the natural order of its habitat, it creates orbs of frozen psychic energy to take the problem out.
author: sk372

entry: The fiery collar is hot enough to remain lit when POKENAME swims and frolics in arctic oceans. Once it burns a hole through frozen sea water, it curls up for a nap in hopes that someone will share their fishing catches with it.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The fastest way to give POKENAME a moment of felicity is with a few cuts of Magikarp and a belly rub. They may bring pearls to people who consistently give them food and affection.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME doesn't have nerves that can detect temperature, so it is able to live in the coldest environments. Scientists have even kept them in thermo-regulated rooms, and they are able to survive comfortably at -80° Celsius.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME clusters together during low tide on cool muddy beaches to nap and practice Mud Slaps. When caught, it has extreme separation anxiety and must have a hat from its Trainer to feel safe.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME has recently become a large icon in the fashion world for its beautiful patterns and coloring. Entire shows dedicated to this Pokémon have recently become trendy among the wealthy.
author: rakunk

entry: A friendly Pokémon that helps almost anyone in need as it wanders icy environments. If you touch its ice crown, you'll be frozen in an instant.
author: pokepower

entry: To keep the ice seed on its back intact, POKENAME cannot stray far from the icy waters it lives in. When it gets very agitated, its body secretes toxins that can put nearby Pokémon to sleep or paralyze them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Despite spending almost all of their lives underwater, POKENAME need air to breathe. The leaves on their back are able to produce oxygen bubbles from the seawater surrounding them, providing a portable air source.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The feather on POKENAME's head is cold as ice, and is coveted by collectors. The darker the feather becomes, the more valuable it is considered.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME wash up on shores across the world because they fall asleep on icebergs. When they finally return home, they climb to the top of another iceberg, repeating the process.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME seem intimidating because of their massive size but are rather playful. They enjoy tossing balls back and forth and love to chase after smaller Pokémon. When they inevitably have to part ways, they offer tufts of fur to those they play with.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its soft white feathers are used to stuff various kinds of jackets and pillows. Though POKENAME usually travels by flying, it can also swim skillfully using its webbed tail to chase prey hiding underwater.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME are incredibly playful. They can be found playing hide and seek with others by burrowing into the snow with their flippers.
author: rhysanthemum

entry: This Pokémon's thick fur allows it to survive even in the coldest environments. If it senses a danger nearby, POKENAME hides by covering its face with its big ears, making itself look like a big pile of snow.
author: milchik

entry: The coldest part of its body is its horn, which remains icy even in warm climates. This frozen horn can chill anything it touches.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's songs can be heard all across the tundra, enchanting its prey to move closer. Its speed and power are more than enough to overwhelm its prey, as well as its competition.
author: patch

entry: It expels clouds of foul-smelling fog to confuse enemies. This stench lingers, discouraging pursuers from following.
author: .izik

entry: The ethereal mist that surrounds POKENAME can make it seem to vanish when in snow or water. Few are those who have seen it before it disappeared.
author: kiwikelly

entry: The solid ice adorning POKENAME's body becomes sturdier as it grows. It uses its horn and two front teeth to chip away at chunks of ice for its meals.
author: tuskaninny

entry: The ice in POKENAME's body has hardened into a rigid outer shell. Much of its time is spent sleeping, as there is little else it can do in this form.
author: tuskaninny

entry: POKENAME is covered in an incredibly thick coat of fur. It can break apart even the toughest of glacial ice by using its formidable tusks.
author: tuskaninny

entry: Its thick fur protects it in even the most extreme climates.  It is jovial in temperament but ferocious when defending its Trainer.
author: bostroms

entry: Underneath its thick fur coat is armor made of pure ice. It may look soft and squishy, but direct blows to POKENAME rarely harm it thanks to its undercoat.
author: typhloquil

entry: Its fin-shaped ears allow it to move through water as swiftly as a speedboat. The horn on its forehead channels its Electric-type attacks, which it uses to fend off aquatic predators while searching for food.
author: fiordaliso

entry: The horn on its forehead channels its Electric-type attacks, which it uses to fend off aquatic predators while searching for food. Its magnificent white tail allows POKENAME to swim in any aquatic environment without difficulty.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME live in rivers throughout the year, lurking below the frosty surface during winter. They help save children who fall into the water by digging through the ice with their claws.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The air around its tail is always frigid, leaving a frosty trail behind. Other Pokémon enjoy the refreshing cold it radiates.
author: .izik

entry: Scientists believe that POKENAME is distantly related to Cetitan due to their similarities. Despite its cute and friendly appearance, this Pokémon is very territorial and will protect its herd from invaders no matter the cost.
author: milchik

entry: POKENAME live in alpine lakes, spending most of their time beneath the icy surface of the water. The cold causes ice crystals to form on their skin. When the growths become too cumbersome, they scrape them off on nearby trees.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It's very protective of people it's fond of. There are many stories of POKENAME guiding sailors through frigid storms.
author: geminib

entry: POKENAME live near cold, wet environments and use their tough tusks to carve sharp swords out of NeverMeltIce formations. They are relatively docile POKEMON but they become fierce fighters to protect others.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME's body is incredibly sleek, made for cutting through the water at high speeds and for unparalleled maneuverability. It prefers retreat to battle, disappearing from sight in mere seconds if it feels conflict is brewing.
author: sk372

entry: Where shallow rocks, coral, or icebergs choke shipping lanes, POKENAME can be found. Unlike their cousins, they are very playful, swimming up to boats to guide them through hazards. Sailors especially ensure these Pokémon are protected.
author: ghostslythe

entry: POKENAME take great care of their creations and live among them in the form of a majestic aquatic Pokémon. They protect aquatic life from poachers by freezing the surface of the water and shielding their kin from harpoons.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be distinguished from a glacier by its swift swimming, as glaciers barely move. Ships will often follow behind this large Pokémon to safely traverse through frigid waters.
author: soup1900

entry: Its tail is incredibly strong, capable of propelling it through currents effortlessly. It also uses its tail to defend against attackers when needed.
author: .izik

entry: It waits in icy caverns, disguised as an icicle. When unsuspecting prey walk underneath, POKENAME drops itself on top of them.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Often disguising itself as a Swimmer or Sailor, POKENAME has been known to accidentally attract rescue attempts on the high seas. On calm nights, it sheds its disguise completely, diving for Psyduck meals.
author: ghostslythe

entry: The aurora that makes up its ribbons is cold to the touch. The better its health, the more vividly these ribbons appear.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME live high above the poles, circling the skies in the upper stratosphere. Their dorsal fins glow with the light of the aurora, illuminating the night sky with their dances.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME live high above the poles, circling the skies in the upper stratosphere. Their dorsal fins are formed from ice condensed from the atmosphere around them, glinting in the sunlight and letting them see one another from miles away.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME enjoys working at laundromats, especially helping with the cold cycles. Even if it isn't the most energy-efficient, its jovial nature is enough for customers to enjoy their visit despite the high costs.
author: inquis1

entry: POKENAME are apex predators that hunt other Water-type Pokémon. When their prey is trapped within their jaws, they have little chance of escaping.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's large tail helps it greatly in maintaining high speed and maneuverability underwater. Though quite friendly, it dislikes having its tail touched, dispelling those who try with a blast of icy wind.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's thick blubber allows it to withstand the sub-zero temperatures of its home. Unfortunately, this also makes POKENAME slow and cumbersome in the water, forcing it to rely on vegetation and slower fish for sustenance.
author: chibitales

entry: Kept as symbols of status by aristocrats, POKENAME is a charming Pokémon that is relatively low maintenance. They're native to colder climates and can produce beautiful auroras from their single horn.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME skims over the icy waters of the polar oceans, flying low to the surface to help it blend in with the ice floes. Its wings match the colors of icebergs to help it camouflage when resting.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: It refuses to drink warm water, preferring only the coldest sources. Its aversion to warmth is a defining trait of its personality.
author: .izik

entry: This typically docile Pokémon loves to rest its large body on cold, icy surfaces. When threatened, POKENAME can run at deceptively fast speeds and sink its large fangs into its foe, administering a powerful venom.
author: octability

entry: When POKENAME walks on land, the fin on its head radiates a chilling cold. This icy presence allows it to stay comfortable even in warmer climates.
author: .izik

entry: With a haunting howl, it can summon a fierce hailstorm. This weather-changing ability makes it a force to be reckoned with during winter.
author: .izik

entry: It lives deep within submerged, icy caves, hidden from the outside world. These secluded caverns provide it with both shelter and solitude.
author: .izik

entry: Sailors once got tattoos of this Pokémon before embarking on long journeys, believing it would bring them good luck. This tradition persists among some maritime communities to this day.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME resides on ice floes and can exert control over them, manoeuvring them to move along water currents to find new hunting grounds. Despite its friendly face, It relentlessly pursues whalers and poachers who ply the arctic seas.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: Since it is so light and buoyant, POKENAME enjoys bouncing along the ocean's surface. Groups of POKENAME will often race against each other for fun.
author: chartanon

entry: POKENAME resides in the water around portside towns and performs acrobatic tricks for bystanders. It is a popular tourist attraction.
author: chartanon

entry: POKENAME boasts tremendous physical strength. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to the beach, then sunbathes after its meal.
author: the_fireplace

entry: If injured, POKENAME can heal by exposing its body to snow. This regenerative ability makes it thrive in icy environments.
author: .izik

entry: It playfully spits cold water at its friends, showing affection through these chilly splashes. Despite the cold, its companions enjoy these friendly interactions.
author: .izik

entry: It stores thermal energy in its body when its hot, then uses that energy to keep itself warm in freezing-cold areas. However, if it stores too much energy, POKENAME will release it by performing difficult yet mesmerizing dances.
author: hello_i_exist

entry: POKENAME extend the range of their blades by freezing over their arms. This icy structure allows them to slide down hills by using their blades as skis.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Often referred to as the Ice Regent of the North, POKENAME is found predominantly in freezing mountain lakes. Wherever it points its staff the temperature drops noticeably, though many think it uses its psychic powers to trick the mind.
author: ghostslythe

entry: If POKENAME sees a group of people gathering, it claps its hands and moves rhythmically to try and get them to dance. Many have trained groups of Seel in the wild to groove to their personal beats.
author: sk372

entry: Its perpetually warm body allows POKENAME to live even in harsh, freezing habitats without ever feeling cold. Its long tail lets it swim at incredible speeds, and it's so strong that it also uses it in battle to lash out at its foes.
author: fiordaliso

entry: When threatened, POKENAME lashes its tail fin from the soil to splash mud at foes. The sudden spray can blind enemies long enough for it to burrow away.
author: .izik

entry: It channels psychic energy into its horn before releasing it in bursts. This powerful attack leaves foes stunned and disoriented.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are extremely capable divers. They're often seen leaping from icy sea cliffs, surprising their prey from above.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME communicate with others with a series of barks and belly taps. Whenever they are in danger, a sharp whine signals others of their species to come to the rescue.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME inhabits frigid bays, proving to be a danger to shipping vessels if they get too close and anger it. It is much more graceful when swimming, so it often launches itself from the water in a flurry of blows before diving below again.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The heat stored inside its body can be expelled as a blazing fire. Its tail and legs make it capable of both running and swimming at high speeds.
author: punkermachine

entry: Its immense psychic power can be felt radiating from its head. To keep its brain from overheating, it has external veins that serve to cool off and stabilize its temperature.
author: mx_wellman

entry: A POKENAME changes its colors based on the climate it grows up in. If it is raised in a colder climate, the body reflects colder tones.
author: .izik

entry: A POKENAME will change its colors based on the area it grows up in. Its skin will reflect a warmer tone if it grows up in a warmer climate.
author: .izik

entry: The large fin around POKENAME's body is actually made up of trillions of translucent tentacles. These delicate structures allow it to move gracefully through the water.
author: .izik

entry: The blubbery and sweet tail of POKENAME is a melt-in-your-mouth delicacy. However, as POKENAME needs it to swim, it takes even longer to grow back compared to Slowpoke, so cutting it off is illegal.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It becomes lonely when separated from its pod, preferring to swim in groups. These pods provide comfort and companionship during long journeys.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME, through Pokémon fusion, has sprouted an impressive horn. It will diligently sharpen it on coarse stones in the rocky shores it calls home. Most POKENAME will take on a protective role over its herd of unfused Dewgong.
author: lupa

entry: The clamp of POKENAME's shell is powerful enough to sever limbs with ease. This dangerous trait makes it both feared and respected in the wild.
author: .izik

entry: It swims in a clockwise spin, using its horn as a drill to clear any obstacles in its path. This unique motion allows it to navigate icy waters with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME gather on ice shelves under the northern lights. Experts theorize that the auroras strengthen its hypnosis abilities.
author: noel5229

entry: Colonies of POKENAME travel across icy seas by burrowing into icebergs with their frigid claws.
author: kittyluv090

entry: Its hard exoskeleton protects its soft and chewy innards. It makes its den by digging through glaciers with its huge claw.
author: mx_wellman

entry: It can detach its big claw at will. It traps prey by hanging upside down and dropping its claw onto them.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME are often seen trying to morph their gooey limbs into different shapes. Some are unable to return to their original shape afterwards.
author: rooboid

entry: Before fusion was discovered, POKENAME were thought to be Voltorb that survived attempted consumption by Grimer, but were left permanently tainted by the poison sludge as a result.
author: sk372

entry: One egg within a clutch has become toxic, leaking from its shell. Its psychic powers let it remain functioning despite spilling out, though its appearance causes disarray amongst its clutch-mates.
author: sk372

entry: Its tongue has been colored by all the filth it devours. The smell left behind from its saliva after it licks something is almost impossible to remove completely.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME's sludge releases dense swirling toxic smoke. The fumes conceal it completely as it sleeps, warding off intruders.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME forms in highly polluted areas, commonly arising in areas of heavy chemical runoff and fossil fuel emissions. Their internal gasses spread this pollution to the local area, environmentalists view large POKENAME populations as a danger.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME produce a thick, oily gel around their bodies that diffuses force from attacks throughout their body. Scientists are testing products that mix with POKENAME gel to produce an alternative to diesel.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It floats through the smoke of coal power plants, dripping purple acid as it hovers hundreds of feet in the air. The acidic slime causes damage to buildings below.
author: .izik

entry: The purple paste covering POKENAME's body won't wash off while it stays in the water, and is very slippery. This allows it to easily escape should it be attacked by a Mareanie, slipping through the water with ease.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is a highly invasive species in the Johto region. Its goo can contaminate plants and quickly kill them.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME have been largely derided as being "even uglier than a Feebas," but despite those claims, a surprising number of people are endeared to it, citing it as having a strange charm to its odd appearance.
author: sk372

entry: It tries to emulate Ditto to endear itself to Trainers and Pokémon. No matter its actions or what form it takes, POKENAME can never hide the foul, repellent stench it emits.
author: sk372

entry: An Eevee whose DNA becomes too unstable is subject to melting. Fusing with a Grimer allows it to prevent a tragedy by fully embracing its viscosity at the cost of its popularity.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: It enters cyberspace, thriving on questionable websites by absorbing faulty code and viruses. If interrupted, the viruses leave its body and into connected computers.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME hides in quiet corners of sewers to ambush Rattata when they skitter by. Its shell is covered with a viscous gel that sticks to its prey.
author: quackquackattack

entry: This sluggish Pokémon is made out of toxic sludge that seeps into the ground beneath it. It rarely moves, preferring to sleep and consume mass amounts of waste surrounding it.
author: motion_09

entry: POKENAME was first discovered in what remained of an old power plant infamous for its pollution amount. Machines touched by its goop will malfunction as the goo seeps within and overcharges them with electricity.
author: sk372

entry: When POKENAME flies, it drapes the skies in a cape of murky smog. Many remote villages blame this Pokémon for periods of acid rain.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: Great care must be taken when raising and handling POKENAME. Its playful bites of affection are highly prone to infection; a single untreated bite could lead to a week of nausea and dizziness at the least.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME was first discovered in a forest where illegal toxic waste dumping occurred. It feeds on detritus left behind by dead rotting trees as well as certain pungent fungi.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME restores its body by swimming in dirty, heavily polluted waters, which is why it's often found in sewers. It can spit a highly corrosive liquid from its mouth, strong enough to even melt solid rock.
author: fiordaliso

entry: In a last-ditch attempt at self-defense, POKENAME can fling all four of its gooey wings at an opponent, covering them with muck and poison while it falls to the ground and attempts to slip away, hiding until the wings regenerate in a few hours.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's semisolid body composition makes flying difficult, and it spends about half its time grounded before fluttering off. On rare occasions, the pools of grime it leaves behind can gain sentience and become new Grimer.
author: sk372

entry: It flies through city streets searching for discarded newspapers and cans. The moment it sees trash leave someone's hand, it swoops down to collect it.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's grime is strictly made up of ooze from polluted oceans. Overpopulation of POKENAME usually means pollution is worsening.
author: dodoowner_

entry: It lives near public parks, feasting on litter left by visitors. The slime that drips from its body acts as a powerful fertilizer, nourishing nearby plants.
author: .izik

entry: The slime it drips is highly beneficial for plants. It makes its home in rain gutters, compressing its body to fit into tight spaces.
author: .izik

entry: It oozes its way into people's homes by sliding through even the tiniest of gaps. If a pungent smell starts infesting a home overnight, a POKENAME infestation has begun.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME makes its home in muddy, filthy waters, nourishing itself with pond scum and discarded trash. It enjoys "sharing" its beloved stinky water by splashing those who pass by.
author: sk372

entry: Its feathers shed off in large quantities if it is exposed to clean water. In order to regrow the feathers, it will actively consume garbage.
author: .izik

entry: It launches globs of sticky sludge like spitballs from the bulb on its back. These foul projectiles harden over time, leaving behind trails of gunk that fossilize into strange, rubbery mounds.
author: jaminmcready

entry: Host to a flesh-hungry fly trap, POKENAME is rarely raised by Trainers because of its putrid smell. The fly trap on its back acts on its own volition.
author: rooboid

entry: It happily consumes rotting organic material in sewer systems. Despite its grim appearance, it plays a key role in keeping these areas clean.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME love to hang around trash cans and dumpsters. The gems around their neck glow brighter the more garbage they eat.
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher

entry: It makes its home near landfills, looking for discarded books or paper. It will consume any literature it finds in order to multiply.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME produce a viscous oil that smells like gasoline. Scientists treat POKENAME with utmost care to prevent them from exploding.
author: quackquackattack

entry: It flies near hospitals to steal medical waste, which it devours in nearby trees. It discards pieces of the waste it doesn't want eat in nearby bushes.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body is constantly bubbling and oozing due to the high levels of heat and energy it contains. POKENAME constantly smells of burning coal and occasionally burps a black smog.
author: bobosmith01

entry: The ooze seeping from POKENAME's body shows signs of independent movement. When stressed, cracks form in its shell, releasing slime that seeks a new shelter.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's oily body takes the shape of coral to blend in with reefs and avoid predators. It only moves when necessary, feeding on debris that falls from passing ships.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME has adapted to the pollution in its environment by eating toxic sludge that hurts other aquatic Pokémon. When it inevitably cleans up the pollution in one coral reef, it migrates to other coral reefs to clean them up as well.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME tidies up sewer systems, scrubbing grime and packaging waste with its Trubbish assistant. The residents of its home city endure its smelly gifts in exchange for exceptionally clean pipes.
author: ozydamians

entry: POKENAME packs harass garbage workers in tandem in order to steal bags of trash and eat the rotten contents. They have even been seen harassing and hunting Trubbish in some areas.
author: sk372

entry: The sludge-like body of POKENAME has powerful corrosive properties. Team Rocket will often use this Pokémon to help destroy padlocks.
author: mepp.

entry: It spins on its top horn. When it does so, poison sludge is flung everywhere. It doesn't do this on purpose, but people don't like it for that reason.
author: themicelegion

entry: It generates its own electricity through an unstable chemical reaction within its body. Because of this, it regularly feeds on toxic substances.
author: mx_wellman

entry: It is said that POKENAME was created when a Mime Jr. fell into a pit of toxic sludge. Instead of dying, it fused with it, creating this Pokémon.
author: robbery_666

entry: The body of POKENAME is merely a host to the viscous, toxic sludge upon it. The sludge steers the body to eat voraciously to prepare it for evolution.
author: rooboid

entry: It makes its home near restaurant dumpsters, consuming leftover food. After eating, its slimy body begins to radiate intense heat.
author: .izik

entry: It eats discarded trash near ponds, keeping the water clean. Its sludge-covered body hardens if it stays out of the water too long.
author: .izik

entry: Amid the septic aromas of sewers, POKENAME trudges along. Rumored to have been cursed to live among its weakness, it has adapted to absorb toxins and purify them within its body.
author: ghostslythe

entry: Due to most of its body being viscous and slimy, many underestimate how solid its skull actually is. It laughs deviously when something attacks and ends up hurting itself against its skull.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME can be found after large oil spills, using their gelatinous bodies to absorb the pollutants in the water. However, POKENAME will sometimes wash up onto the shore, devastating the local environment.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME rule over swamps and bogs, often expanding their territory by turning land into marsh. They can hold an elemental plate in a slot on their chests.
author: iolitetigerdragon

entry: A wound from its polluted blade is sure to cause a nasty infection. When melee combat doesn't do, it throws a chunk of its putrid tassel instead.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME are used in sewage treatment plants to help remove pollutants. They eat the hazardous material, leaving behind only sterile water.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME hide in their steel helmets while they sleep. When they sense danger, they will fire steel spikes coated in toxic sludge at the perceived threat.
author: robbery_666

entry: It will actively search for toxic substances so that it can eat them. The sludge that drips off of its skin is used in old Repel recipes.
author: .izik

entry: It uses its innards to grab trash cans from the shoreline, dragging them into the waves. Once underwater, it devours the contents with glee.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME collects lost or discarded keys amongst garbage and filth and seeks out their former owners to return them. Due to its stench permeating on the keys it collects, those it finds are reluctant to take their keys back.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME thrives in dark, damp, and moldy environments. It licks and bites anything it desires, with its amorphous body and immunity to poisons keeping it from harm.
author: bobosmith01

entry: In spite of its slowness and unassuming intelligence, POKENAME are extremely dangerous and known to devour minds and machines alike.
author: cyprexx

entry: It collects discarded soda cans from landfills to build its den. The structure is surprisingly sturdy and often glimmers in the sunlight.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME form where industrial sewage is pumped into formerly revered natural sites. They gather into groups and eventually follow the sewage back to its source, often resulting in blockages and problems with sewer pipes.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME can retract its gooey form into its iron shell for defense and resemble a normal Aron. Staying that way requires effort, however, and it will inevitably need to ooze out and relax once danger has passed.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dreams of being a beautiful serpent deep in the sea. Unfortunately it is condemned to live in swamps only as it cannot survive in clean waters.
author: speciessaladmallory

entry: Though it means no harm and only wishes to help, POKENAME has become a problem in factories by working its way into machinery, attempting to replace cogs and mucking up machines.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is covered in an incredibly caustic protective membrane. Interestingly, it is thought that POKENAME's membrane is capable of transmitting thoughts when touched, but few have been able to withstand contact long enough to test the theory.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: It multiplies uncontrollably, threatening to pollute vast stretches of land or sea in mere days. When multiple POKENAME are together their minds create a powerful psychic field.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME are commonly found swimming in pools of waste. Filthy liquid accumulates on their bodies and forms a thick, slimy, rancid protective coating.
author: alliveir

entry: POKENAME get bigger by eating a town's grimy waste until they evolve. Bigger POKENAME get more territorial, and will absorb weaker POKENAME into them.
author: totodile.

entry: It pretends to be a harmless puddle on a cave floor until prey like Sandshrew wander too close. It then uses Supersonic to stun them before attacking.
author: .izik

entry: The mucus-like slime coating POKENAME's body stores an electric charge. Even brief contact can leave a person or Pokémon stunned for hours.
author: .izik

entry: It flies near oil tankers, biting into barrels of oil to feed. It can swallow up to 10 gallons at a time before gliding away, leaving behind small puddles of purple goo.
author: .izik

entry: If stepped on, it sticks like glue to a person's boot. It releases a terrible stench so that the person never wants to return to the area.
author: .izik

entry: Its body is composed of several flat segments joined together by a thick, toxic goo. Though POKENAME looks like pancakes, eating it is not advised.
author: tad

entry: POKENAME oozes its limbs into cave crevasses to dig out gems and minerals to consume. The crystals it eats pass through its body and become mildly radioactive once left behind.
author: sk372

entry: It freezes trash in landfills with an icy breeze before taking large bites. This chilling process neutralizes the foul smells as it eats.
author: .izik

entry: It hides in greenhouses, dissolving bags of fertilizer with acid before consuming them. The slime it leaves behind enhances plant growth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are comprised of multiple kinds of pollutants which they sweat out and leave everywhere. These pollutants can be used to mark territory, though some other POKENAME might like the odor and flavor of this ooze.
author: entomoxie

entry: It swims near freighters, eagerly waiting for fuel leaks. It gleefully drinks the spilled fuel, growing more energetic with each gulp.
author: .izik

entry: It makes its home near playgrounds, eating trash children leave behind. This odd habit keeps the area clean and safe for play.
author: .izik

entry: It lies in puddles of spilled oil, absorbing the liquid with glee. Once full, it releases pollen clouds that invigorate nearby plant life.
author: .izik

entry: It pierces the sides of cruise ships to cause fuel to leak out. It happily slurps up the liquid, leaving the ship with a sticky violet trail.
author: .izik

entry: It moves along the ocean floor consuming discarded trash. The more putrid the garbage, the more toxic the spikes it fires become.
author: .izik

entry: Its slimy body hardens in cold temperatures, making it difficult for it to move during desert nights. During the day it moves surprisingly quickly in the hot sun.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME often appears in locations where beaches have been spoiled by chemical plants. Some say POKENAME is born from the lonely spirits of sandcastles made long ago on those beaches.
author: lordjoostmeister

entry: It uses its sharp teeth to chew up and consume plastic bags floating in the sea. This behavior helps clean polluted waters.
author: .izik

entry: It thrives in industrial areas, using its sharp eyesight to locate hazardous waste spills. When it finds one, it immediately gorges itself on the toxic fluids.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME release noxious clouds of smoke from their bodies that scare away other Pokémon. They crawl along the ground searching for friends that can tolerate the smoke they create.
author: quackquackattack

entry: While consuming sewer sludge, POKENAME emits a surprisingly sweet pumpkin scent. Prolonged exposure to the aroma can cause dizziness and confusion.
author: .izik

entry: It flies through forests at night searching for prey like Bellsprout and Sunkern. Upon spotting one, it ensnares them in its sticky body with just a touch.
author: .izik

entry: Before further research, POKENAME was thought to be a result of pollution affecting Luvdisc colonies. Superstitious folk believe that fishing one up is a sign that their love life will turn sour.
author: sk372

entry: The soil POKENAME leaves behind is coated in a sticky residue that can cause violent fevers on contact. Once fully dried, the film becomes harmless.
author: .izik

entry: It loves to collect filthy coins scattered amongst garbage and other dirty corners. If it comes across shiny pristine change, it promptly goes about dirtying it so that it can properly join its collection.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are not very bright and often get their bodies stuck in crevices of rocks trying to look for food. Thankfully, their sludge-like bodies eventually melt through rocks and allow them to escape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME consumes garbage and sludge to soothe its aching head. If it eats too much in one sitting, however, its headache will worsen and it will lose its solid shape, becoming a toxic puddle until it recovers.
author: sk372

entry: Born of toxic sludge and industrial discharge, POKENAME are aggressive and hostile toward humans. Researchers have observed that the more poisonous the sludge they arise from, the quicker they are to attack.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: Its sludge-like body is extremely toxic, so much that any grass it steps on dies instantly. When enraged, POKENAME hurls chunks of poisonous mud at others.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is a very friendly and loyal pet, but its noxious aroma makes it difficult to find an owner. Garbage dumps often adopt it as a mascot and to easily feed it its favorite meal of stinky trash.
author: sk372

entry: The spiral in its mouth is made of black and white sludge. It slowly spins and pulses even when the POKENAME is knocked unconscious.
author: staghorn

entry: It hypnotizes oil truck drivers to dump their loads onto the street. It then rapidly drinks the spilled liquid, leaving the area spotless and fueling its poisonous body.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are usually found in cities with lots of salt water. Their sticky sludge makes catching prey easier, and they fight for any food they find.
author: gerakobitz

entry: POKENAME are coated with a thick sludge that softens their punches, so they have to train hard to ensure their punches hurt. They train nonstop by repeatedly punching rocks until they are exhausted.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME roots itself near other plants and absorbs any toxins in the soil as sustenance, helping the nearby plants grow. However, in areas that are uncontaminated, POKENAME may be forced to sap energy from the other plants directly to survive.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Vines extend from all over its slimy body to ensnare prey like Teddiursa and Meowth. Once captured, it pulls them into its gaping mouth.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME have been deployed in large numbers to clean oil spills at sea. They swarm the spill en masse, absorbing and consuming the oil, even removing it from other Pokémon that may have been coated by the spill.
author: sk372

entry: While formed in the sea from excess water pollution, POKENAME will climb up coastal cliffsides with their sticky sludgy arms, eventually emerging onto land.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME is unable to gallop because of the slime it produces near its hooves. Trainers can remove this substance to donate to factories, which turns the slime into adhesive for stickers or tape.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a friendly nature, content to linger among human garbage to seek food and companionship. It seems unaware of its repugnant smell repelling most it tries to cuddle up to.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME coat their bodies in a toxic, alkaline fluid to ward off predators. They keep this fluid away from their magnetic appendages, however, so that their magnetic properties aren't disturbed.
author: frokachu

entry: POKENAME are actually a welcome sight for factories where polluted runoff is inevitable. They consume every drop of the toxic waste eagerly and are remarkably friendly to humans.
author: sk372

entry: It is said that wild POKENAME are spirits of people who died in polluted areas, trapped in sludge. These POKENAME do not seem content with their predicament and are jealous of humans.
author: notmax22

entry: It uses its long tongue to lift clumps of refuse from city dumps, consuming them with glee. The tongue is coated in a protective slime.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME can coat its long tongue with a highly acidic saliva capable of melting even iron. Since it requires humid and dirty environments to survive, it often infests city sewers.
author: fiordaliso

entry: Pungent fumes and toxic sludge wrap around a central core, their bodies releasing a noxious scent that resembles Lax Incense. They create a feeling of nausea in creatures around them, making them harder to hit in a battle.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its appetite for garbage and pollution is endless, devouring it all quickly and processing it in bursts of gas around it. Some POKENAME have even been seen attempting to inhale and consume their own gaseous expulsions.
author: sk372

entry: Toxic runoff from factories polluting ponds where Magikarp reside resulted in the creation of POKENAME. Though they look deformed and ill, they are actually stronger and more hardy than the average Magikarp.
author: sk372

entry: Its body is comprised of a viscous, foul-smelling sludge that drips off in globs as it walks. One droplet of sludge from a POKENAME is enough to render 500,000 gallons of pristine water undrinkable.
author: fancyskunk

entry: The cocoon helping POKENAME evolve further is not very sturdy, but its body generates so much incredibly pungent and toxic muck that few dare risk approaching it.
author: sk372

entry: This lazy, toxic Pokémon spends most of its life eating or sleeping. Wherever it rests becomes a poisonous wasteland, and its vast belly shelters other Poison-type Pokémon.
author: motion_09

entry: POKENAME are viewed as heralds of environmental collapse, their presence resulting in oppressive smogs and acidic rains. When POKENAME linger in an area for too long, they cause extensive damage to the natural environment.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME has trouble flying long distances due to the weight of the sludge along its body. The slime covering its body is highly poisonous, repelling predators and allowing it to roost safely.
author: .izik

entry: The purple slime covering POKENAME's feathers is extremely corrosive. Despite this, it can still fly with ease, using the protective slime to shield itself from potential threats.
author: .izik

entry: When POKENAME swims around, it emits a toxin that pollutes the water. These toxins can create Grichou, which then evolve to repeat the cycle.
author: dodoowner_

entry: While in flight, POKENAME drips toxic droplets from its body down to the ground. Even if immediately cleaned up, the spots its goop touched become black and barren for years afterward.
author: sk372

entry: A troublesome pest due to its malleable body allowing it to infiltrate any tight space in a home, POKENAME gnaws around inside walls, weakening structures and leaving a pungent aroma lingering anywhere it nibbles.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME loves to stand among flowers in fields and soak up the sunlight, but its toxic body quickly causes the plant life around it to wilt. This has given it a very sullen personality as a result.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME only fully forms in cold environments. Cities that never used to see POKENAME are now beginning to, as rising temperatures displace them. They carry new diseases local fauna are not accustomed to, threatening local ecosystems.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME are dim-witted, toxin-coated creatures whose careless nature often poisons those around them. They wander aimlessly and flock to toxic areas, blissfully unaware of the havoc they leave in their wake.
author: jonclyd

entry: POKENAME's psychic abilities are most potent during daytime battles. However, its sludgy body emits the foulest odor when exposed to the sun.
author: char_latte3412

entry: A result of Raticate infestations within highly polluting factories, POKENAME will use its amorphous body to more easily infiltrate buildings, gnawing endlessly on anything that comes close to its oozing maw.
author: sk372

entry: It glides over landfills in search of rotting furniture to make its home. The smell does not bother it in the slightest.
author: .izik

entry: Said to have come from the far reaches of space, POKENAME seems to have no regard for non-mammalian lifeforms. Coming into contact with its toxic sludge will cause uncontrollable hair growth.
author: mistymagius

entry: People have used this Pokémon's excretion as a beautifying agent for centuries. However, professors have found that it actually ages the skin at a rapid rate, causing long-term damage to the body.
author: big_clanker

entry: POKENAME makes its tail gobble up trash they come across, while it also eats trash with its mouth. Sometimes they eat the same thing twice.
author: pankiwi

entry: During the holidays, POKENAME inspects the sewage system for damage and neglect. It patches up leaks with ribbons of sticky grime, or clears blockages with explosive garbage.
author: ozydamians

entry: Despite the semifluid nature of POKENAME's body, it can stand on the surface of water without deforming. It dashes around the world looking for polluted water sources, absorbing the pollution into its body and leaving pure water behind.
author: chibitales

entry: Though it resembles the body of a Munchlax, POKENAME has merely morphed to imitate its form, enabling it to deceive those who attempt to care for it.
author: rooboid

entry: POKENAME is able to turn itself into a puddle of purple goo. It waits until other Pokémon come by and then it attacks with its sharp claws.
author: watermelonchild

entry: Preferring a warm and humid environment, POKENAME will sit as a puddle in the jungle. Anything that steps into this puddle will be consumed.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: Smelling of sludge and runoff, POKENAME oozes through landfills trailing ribbons of toxic leachate. Despite its grotesque appearance, it filters pollutants from the soil as it crawls.
author: jaminmcready

entry: This cruel Pokémon likes to bury its opponents under poisonous mud. According to legend, the mouth on its lower body can whisper your future.
author: altius

entry: This Pokémon is commonly known to manipulate large amounts of sludge using its psychic power. Unlike other variants of Muk, this Pokémon smells faintly of cotton candy; researchers have been unable to determine the reason for this.
author: cinnamoone_redfield

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to control the ooze that envelops its body. It can harden this ooze into a protective coating or even animate some of it into a separate minion to do its bidding.
author: wormspawn

entry: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is incredibly friendly by nature. Sadly, returning POKENAME's hugs is ill-advised.
author: rooboid

entry: While it is capable of swiftly clawing at its foes at breakneck speed, the sludge engrossing the lower half of POKENAME hinders its movement speed.
author: rooboid

entry: Feared for its relentless power and ghastly looks, POKENAME can morph its viscous skin into any shape, be that a helping hand or a razor-sharp blade.
author: rooboid

entry: This fusion is the aftermath of a lab accident. The toxic waste inside multiple barrels has given life to this creature.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME floats around more polluted sections of the ocean, its wide mouth emanating a foul odor. Anything unfortunate enough to swim into its mouth or get caught on its sludgy body will be absorbed into it slowly over time.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME uses its amorphous form to take the shape of any weapon. While creative in its choice of form, regularly morphing into nunchucks or claws, its strategy remains simple: throwing itself at targets until they succumb to its noxious sludge.
author: .fedoraman

entry: POKENAME flings goopy toxins each time it swings its two blades. As its blades are actually hands, it employs the defensive strategy of grabbing the foe when they try to attack and seeping smelly poisons into their body.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's malleable arms allow it to stretch and propel itself forward at remarkable speed. It utilizes this to deliver devastating toxic cuts and slashes that often prove to be fatal.
author: ragingarthritis

entry: POKENAME's rocky exoskeleton struggles to give its sludgy body form. It can often be seen scooping lost slime back into itself.
author: dylonk25

entry: POKENAME resides in polluted bodies of water. It tries to act regal and graceful, but many people are repulsed by its appearance.
author: kittyluv090

entry: POKENAME has been employed in recent years by landfills to clean up the garbage; they will eat anything that has rotted or is a pollutant.
author: melodydelune

entry: POKENAME oozes through the deep sea, dripping with toxic sludge and leaving a glowing trail of bioluminescent waste. Its body constantly shifts, and the ocean around it churns with a sickly green glow wherever it swims.
author: segmoph

entry: POKENAME is said by some to be a manifestation of the planet's rage against human pollution. The molten muck it flings from its body coats and erodes anything it touches until nothing is left but a bubbling toxic ooze.
author: sk372

entry: A sickening creature, POKENAME animates its amorphous body with the psychic power of its central nucleus. There are rumors that ingesting ooze from POKENAME will reveal secrets to the universe, but any who have attempted this have simply perished.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The substance surrounding POKENAME has developed to become highly corrosive. However, its psychic presence is still just as strong, even with its more unstable body.
author: evilgammon

entry: POKENAME has absorbed so much contamination that its body suffers from disproportionate anatomy. Only its tails remain unchanged.
author: houndrys.

entry: POKENAME uses its poisonous slime-covered innards to stun larger predators before it flees along the sea floor.  It quickly retracts its innards as it runs, wanting to avoid getting caught on anything or damaging the environment.
author: .izik

entry: Slow and unassuming, POKENAME uses illusory psionics to trap victims before devouring their minds. If the walls appear to be melting, one may be near.
author: cyprexx

entry: Pollution in areas where Feebas live has resulted in this deformed, unfortunate Pokémon. POKENAME lashes out at any who view its misshapen appearance, forever enraged at becoming more hideous.
author: sk372

entry: It lives near electronic factories, feasting on discarded or malfunctioning batteries. Its slime-covered body hums with excess electricity.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to lift debris and pollution into its body to eat them. It absorbs the toxic material to strenghten the membrane that protects it.
author: .izik

entry: A new POKENAME struggles maintaining a consistent form, so it creates mindless flying drones to deliver anything nearby into its waiting maws. The drones use their ears to return to the gurgling mouths, where they reabsorb into the main body.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME prefers to live in muddy or swampy areas where its gooey body can more easily soak into its surroundings. Its tusks are rigid and pack a potent punch when swung, and just a scrape will cause a nasty case of poisoning.
author: sk372

entry: The two mouths of POKENAME appear to feed and digest separately from each other. Feeding the top mouth more apparently makes it smarter, while feeding the bottom more seems to make it stronger.
author: sk372

entry: It hides itself in grimy, filthy areas such as landfills and other polluted areas, laying in wait amongst the refuse. Should something step on it, it grabs hold and delivers paralyzing jolts of electricity.
author: sk372

entry: Upon evolving, POKENAME develops fruit-like protrusions to attract prey. These protrusions are just as toxic as the goo holding its body together.
author: tad

entry: POKENAME hunts by flattening and obscuring the toxic sludge of its body and pretending to be nothing more than old bones. Anything that gets too close gets sucked into its gooey body and absorbed for sustenance.
author: sk372

entry: Composed of icy sludge, POKENAME's outermost layer of toxic ice constantly thaws and drips as it floats around. If enough of the sludge pools during winter, Grirunt may form from within the ooze.
author: sk372

entry: Despite smelling horrible, the leaves growing from POKENAME are exceptionally useful in medicines. Some people even keep them in composting bins, feeding POKENAME scraps while trimming its leaves.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME bounce and hop in hypnotic and dizzying rhythm. Their unsteady performances are often accentuated by spewing a fountain of iridescent goo from their wings.
author: metcassette

entry: It swims near sewage runoff locations. POKENAME thrives in hazardous chemicals that would dissolve most Pokémon.
author: .izik

entry: After eating putrid trash, the leaves on its head release a pleasant aroma. Some say this scent helps mask the stench for nearby allies.
author: .izik

entry: The black sludge on POKENAME is strong enough to corrupt your body and soul. Scientists are unsure of what this sludge is, though, suggesting it is from a wasteland-esque Ultra Space.
author: loikthescreamo

entry: Small ponds it inhabits become extremely acidic over time. Few creatures can survive long in its territory.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME's body continuously produces large amounts of toxic sludge, which it uses to absorb attacks or hurl at enemies. Its temperamental and violent attitude makes it feared amongst both Pokémon and Trainers alike.
author: ragingarthritis

entry: POKENAME has been spotted deep in the depths of waters troubled by heavy pollution. Extremely antisocial, it uses psychic powers from the gem it carries to repel anything that ventures too close to it.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME rarely uses its feet, preferring to slink along the ground. Despite the horrific smell, POKENAME's sludge is very good at treating head lice.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME stealthily infiltrates the nests of rivals by slinking along as a puddle of sludge before revealing its true form for combat. Its unpleasant odor inhibits some of its stealth, but debilitates foes.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME stealthily infiltrates the nests of rivals by slinking along as a puddle of sludge before revealing its true form for combat. The crystallized poison shards embedded in its body are used as paralytic or disorienting weapons.
author: pjporwoll

entry: POKENAME's body is coated in a poisonous berry jam that is incredibly dangerous to consume. However, other Poison-type Pokémon adore the taste of POKENAME's jam.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME tunnels near city outskirts and defends itself by spraying corrosive sludge. Its burrows are soaked in a viscous fluid that is dangerous to touch.
author: .izik

entry: As POKENAME inhales air with its tubes to generate intense bass sounds, its gelatinous body reverberates. It scavenges junkyards for discarded pipes to incorporate into its body with the goal of creating more intense sounds.
author: pjporwoll

entry: The slime that drips off POKENAME's body causes migraines on contact, leaving those around it dizzy and nauseated. Strangely, the symptoms seem to naturally fade once people are out of POKENAME's vicinity.
author: .izik

entry: The slime covering its body is highly flammable and can combust at the slightest spark. There is talk of it soon being banned from entering power plants across Kanto.
author: .izik

entry: It is rumored that POKENAME was born from toxic waste burned in arson fires. This Pokémon can travel from city to city, flying with its wings of poisonous sludge in search of new filth to feed its body. It contaminates anything it touches.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME rotates the spiral on its tongue to lull prey to sleep before it covers them in thick, viscous slime. This sludge immobilizes prey, allowing POKENAME to consume them effortlessly.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME uses its hands to uproot poisonous plant life near its pond. It shoves these plants into its mouth to strengthen the poison slime coating its body, making it even more dangerous.
author: .izik

entry: Formed from melted waste and burning chemicals, POKENAME soars across polluted skies in search of refuse to consume. Everything it touches is left corroded and lifeless.
author: fiordaliso

entry: It is rumored that POKENAME was born from toxic waste burned in arson fires. This Pokémon can travel from city to city, flying with its wings of poisonous sludge in search of new filth to feed its body. It contaminates anything it touches.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME's flames are so hot, and sludge is so poisonous, that it's known for accidentally destroying villages. This leads to POKENAME feeling quite lonely.
author: lorddino.

entry: POKENAME thrives in areas ravaged in pollution, swallowing any contaminated object whole. For anything that doesn't fit in its mouth, it spews out a powerful acid that melts them into a thick sludge.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME eat a plethora of trash daily and live in junkyards and landfills to remain close to their food source. They melt garbage in their large bell to turn objects into dark sludge.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drifts through sewers, using its long tentacles to grab discarded items. Anything it dissolves contributes to the slime on its body, adding to its growing, sticky mass.
author: .izik

entry: Some say the first POKENAME was created when chemical runoff spilled onto an unlucky Tentacruel. POKENAME is an undulating mass of toxins and tentacles. The black sludge that drips from each limb can dissolve the toughest material in seconds.
author: sk372

entry: Many theorize that the fusion is incomplete, but thanks to Slowpoke's dim mind, it hasn't even noticed. It lazes near polluted rivers, living in blissful ignorance of its own mismatched form.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME dips its tail into ponds, releasing a thick purple fluid that clings to everything nearby. Despite its lilac scent, the substance is highly corrosive and dangerous to touch.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME slowly clean up garbage from beaches throughout the world. Their tail acts like a shovel that helps them scoop garbage into their mouths.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The thick sludge that makes up POKENAME's body produces a vile stench. It slowly lumbers about in landfills.
author: mepp.

entry: The ooze coating POKENAME's metal body is harvested and boiled down into a thick paste. After the poison is boiled out, the paste can be mixed with mashed Watmel Berries and placed on crackers for a delicious yet tangy treat, enjoyed across Kanto.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME appeared from scenes of massive pollution spills in the ocean, absorbing other Grimer that formed at the same time. Their putrid odor is matched only by their appetite for the foulest of garbage.
author: sk372

entry: It can retract into its shell in under three milliseconds. It takes effort for POKENAME to maintain its shape constantly.
author: creeps_jr

entry: It uses its sharp pincers to break apart glass and metal before consuming the trash. No dump is safe from its appetite.
author: .izik

entry: It is famously known to fire a Seed Bomb from the mortar on its shell. The more it grows, the farther and more accurate these shots will become.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME shoots jets of water with its small antennae, which distracts its foe long enough to hide in its shell. The shell barely fits its body, so it relies more on its water jets to avoid getting eaten.
author: quackquackattack
