entry: POKENAME hops and spins gleefully when it uses Hypnosis. Researchers believe that its happiness comes from sharing pleasant dreams with others.
author: noel5229

entry: A terrifying amalgamation born of incomplete fusion between Hypno and Scyther. POKENAME hypnotizes unfortunate victims into a stupor, before putting its scythe to grisly work.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME moves with a strange yet hypnotically soothing rocking motion that lulls all who watch it to sleep. In battles against POKENAME, even skilled Trainers struggle to keep themselves and their Pokémon awake.
author: biblecampvictim42069

entry: Its horns have fused into a pendulum-like shape.  POKENAME traps foes' heads inside the circular horn and applies pressure to their neck until they fall asleep.
author: empty_set

entry: When this Pokémon sings its hypnotically beautiful song, small Pokémon from the waters around it will flock around. On the rare occasion that this attracts a human, POKENAME will ferry them back to shore.
author: quietcognition

entry: POKENAME lull their targets to sleep and transform into them. They can even copy the dreams of their targets, though they will only ever partake in the sweetest dreams they can find.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME's pendulums have sharp edges. It swings them constantly, mesmerizing enemies before it closes in to attack.
author: snescontroller

entry: POKENAME are constantly putting themselves in a state of trance. They are very rarely spotted awake.
author: theartemis1

entry: Having mastered hypnosis, POKENAME is able to retain a balanced sleep schedule, eating both while awake and at rest. Avoid it while it's awake - it'll hypnotize you into bringing it more food.
author: bigblue

entry: The honey it produces is a biological byproduct from when POKENAME eats too many dreams. It can make even the most alert foes drowsy with a jolt of psychic energy. Otherwise, it can defend itself with poisonous stingers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME uses its pendulum flower to reflect attacks. The reflected attacks gain hypnotic properties, giving enough time for it to safely escape.
author: noel5229

entry: The "flames" on POKENAME's back are merely an illusion and are a result of its overwhelming psychic energy.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: POKENAME is highly intelligent. Researchers have observed POKENAME using its pendulum to hunt, utilizing the reflective properties to attract fish to the water's surface.
author: mepp.

entry: While it sleeps, POKENAME tucks its pendulum deep within its feathers. Even unconscious, it remains alert to distant sounds.
author: .izik

entry: Rather than battle, POKENAME prefers to play with its pendulums. A pendulum trick competition is hosted in Celadon City for these Pokémon annually.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME keeps its long, pendulum-like tongue extended from its beak at all times. It sways gently as it walks, lulling nearby creatures.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME lures young children away from their parents through moves such as Sweet Kiss, its hypnotic abilities, and its outwardly cute and playful demeanor. It tries to play with those that it has spirited away for as long as they can.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It delivers Dream Mail when a family is hypnotized in a safe and comfortable space. For those who lose access to the ability to speak and write, this is one of the few ways family members can remain connected to elderly loved ones.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Their dances are literally hypnotic and can throw even those with hardened wills into a trance. If many wild POKENAME are in one place and create a pack, they begin systematically attacking other nearby Grass-types and form a distinct territory.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME's aerial speed and maneuverability is so great that it can hypnotize several targets in a few minutes. Entire forests worth of Pokémon have had their meals stolen from them due to POKENAME's antics.
author: sk372

entry: Those that spend significant time with POKENAME are always very happy and docile. They have been kept in prisons to keep dangerous prisoners under control, though this was scrapped when it was determined that they were being brainwashed.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: It can project a pendulum image from the circle on its forehead, full of psychic energy for hypnotizing foes. On full moon nights, its power grows enough to project multiple pendulum images at once.
author: sk372

entry: Using its hypnosis, it entrances other rat-like Pokémon into doing its bidding, finding food for it so it can avoid any risks.  Most POKENAME are rather fat and lazy as a result of relying so much on their thralls.
author: sk372

entry: If one matches their gaze with POKENAME, they're already caught in its psychic grasp. Victims speak a nonsensical gibberish language while under its sway, but after being free, none remember what they were trying to communicate.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME's stinger can put an adult to sleep in a manner of seconds. As a result, it is often chosen to help surgeons with minor procedures.
author: noel5229

entry: Despite how slowly it moves, the pendulum-like rock on POKENAME's back makes anyone observing it feel intensely lethargic.  Everyone nearby ends up moving just as slowly as POKENAME does.
author: empty_set

entry: It subtly and rapidly shifts its antlers to vibrate the pendulums hanging off of them. Differing vibrations and frequencies allow for it to put its victims into different types of trances.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME marks territory by dripping multicolored ink from its pendulum. Each hue signals a different emotion or warning.
author: .izik

entry: A novice hypnotist, it pranks others by putting them to sleep. Its trances are so weak that they wear off in mere minutes.
author: jackythewannabe

entry: POKENAME paralyze their foes with fear by flashing the patterns on their chest before slowly waving the pendulums on their tails. The victims of their paralysis are even more susceptible to hypnotic suggestions.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME are helpful in places where hypnotherapy is offered. The sleeping trances induced by POKENAME are so potent as to remove months of stress in just a few minutes of rest.
author: sk372

entry: If POKENAME rubs its cheeks against you, you will feel compelled to listen to its commands for around 15 minutes. It makes nests in areas with particularly tall grass.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It feeds on the electromagnetic signals emitted by the sleeping brains of Pokémon and humans alike. Touching its pendulum may result in a light shock.
author: mx_wellman

entry: The magnet ring inside of POKENAME generates immense amounts of electricity. Once enough has been built up, it releases all of that energy at once.
author: grassy311

entry: The magnet ring inside of POKENAME generates immense amounts of electricity. Once enough has been built up, it releases all of that energy at once.
author: grassy311

entry: POKENAME uses its shimmering pendulum to lure prey deep into the jungle. Once it has dispatched its prey, it uses the remains as fertiliser to grow trees.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: The large spines on POKENAME's back were once ground into fine dust and used as sleep aids. The practice is now considered dangerous.
author: .izik

entry: As it dances and twirls, those around it will catch glimpses of its pendulum and be hypnotized, watching the performance to the end. When POKENAME bows at the finale, its audience falls into a collective slumber, ripe for dream-eating.
author: sk372

entry: Drawn to traumatized individuals, POKENAME uses hypnotherapy to aid with their psychological recovery. If its patient is threatened, it will destroy the foe by making them lose their sanity.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It uses two heavy pendulums as flails in battle. Powerful enough on their own, striking them together causes a shrill chime that sends foes into a trance, leaving them wide open to POKENAME's attacks.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is a skilled psychic and a weapons master. It uses its mental skills to distract and disorient its opponent while it uses its physical abilities and flails to deal heavy hits.
author: nyoomymph

entry: POKENAME's flower has fully opened, allowing continuous access to its sleeping gas. Prolonged exposure causes deep sleep that is difficult to wake from.
author: atlas3339098

entry: POKENAME are devious tricksters, luring in prey by hypnotizing them with their pendulums. However, they only go after prey larger than themselves, as they are fiercely protective of smaller Pokémon and want to make sure they have enough to share.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: This massive-snouted creature uses its superior nose to smell healing incense. By breathing in deeply, it clears both its mind and its nose.
author: xenophacilus

entry: POKENAME sniffs outs the subconscious of quality dreamers using its sharp nose. It then puts them to sleep with its pendulum and inhales their dreams.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: Thick mucus drips from POKENAME's large nose, laced with potent poison. A single drop can paralyze small prey.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME sneaks into the domains of Aggron and waits for the perfect moment to hypnotize it, making it abandon its former home so POKENAME can take it without a fight.
author: sk372

entry: Extremely elusive, POKENAME hypnotizes anyone who manages to gaze upon its beauty. The hypnotized instantly forget it, only recalling strange dreams.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME swims in mesmerizing patterns with incredible grace, hypnotizing those who see it. People caught in its trance find themselves staring at it for hours.
author: evilgammon

entry: It may first appear in your nightmares, then in the corners of your vision. It will wait for you to stop believing in what you see before it approaches and hypnotizes you into a deep, deep sleep.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME is used in hospitals to help put patients to sleep; the longer they swing their pendulums, the longer the patients remain asleep.
author: melodydelune

entry: It uses the pendulums for physical combat rather than hypnosis. The blue flower on its other arm releases a scent used for hypnotizing weakened prey.
author: patch_bros

entry: POKENAME's head bobs to the rhythmic swing of its pendulum. When its target is hypnotized, it kicks hard enough to shatter bone.
author: ghostslythe

entry: It waves an odd mushroom around on a string, scattering its spores in the air. Those who inhale the spores are lulled to sleep, allowing POKENAME to feed on their life energy.
author: hophoppip

entry: POKENAME live in homes almost entirely unnoticed. There, they subtly change the messages in their TVs' programming, leading their victims to confusion and false beliefs. There is a popular belief that the Elite Four plant them in homes deliberately.
author: inquis1

entry: POKENAME's soft fluff can put others to sleep. Because it sheds frequently, Trainers with this Pokémon often make pillows with this material.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME weaves webs infused with sleep-inducing properties. Anything caught in the strands falls into a deep slumber within moments.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME rocks back and forth, suspended in midair by its psychic powers. It uses its middle pendulum to guide the target's eyes back and forth between the other two, making sure they are thoroughly hypnotized.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The mysterious flames that POKENAME produce illuminate their odd floating pendulums in a myriad of dazzling patterns. Anyone that stares too long at this display will become transfixed, unable to even think of escape.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Its rings and pendulum are made out of an unknown type of metal. It hypnotizes weaker foes and orders them to leave; against stronger foes it uses the pendulum as a bludgeoning tool.
author: sk372

entry: During the day, POKENAME's pendulums absorb sunlight to power its fire-based attacks. They glow faintly at dusk and before battle.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME is merciless during a fight. It grabs its opponent with one of its long tentacles then uses its pendulum to put it to sleep.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: The pendulum on POKENAME's tail helps it focus and channel electricity. It swings rhythmically as sparks build up along its fur.
author: .izik

entry: When swinging its pendulum, POKENAME sings a lullaby in a low voice, enhancing its capability to put something to sleep before it eats their dreams. Those who've been hypnotized wake up with the lullaby stuck in their head.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME avoids performing in front of others due to its shyness. Those who manage to hear its song are instantly soothed and lulled to sleep.
author: noel5229

entry: For some reason, it uses psychic energy to act like it is puppeteering itself around. POKENAME is used in hospitals, as it can put those in need of rest to sleep and feed on their negative emotions, allowing patients to wake up refreshed.
author: bobosmith01

entry: A POKENAME's pendulum becomes part of its brain as the body compacts upon fusion. With this, one part of the brain hypnotizes targets while the other reads the target's dreams with perfect clarity.
author: entomoxie

entry: Many superstitions surround POKENAME. One of the most persistent is the belief that using one as a cushion will result in prophetic dreams. POKENAME are willing to be close to their Trainers this way, but will inflict nightmares on strangers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME inhale and puff out their chest before each performance, where they sing and lull others to sleep. Once asleep, they consume the dreams that emerge.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME swing their tails back and forth in a hypnotic, distracting motion. They lull people and Pokémon into a false sense of security, using their hypnosis to allow them to steal away food without being interrupted.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME use electromagnetism to levitate small, shiny coins. They use these coins to enchant larger Pokémon into giving them rides and protection.
author: staghorn

entry: POKENAME first terrorizes its prey with its frightening appearance and piercing shriek, before using its pendulum to ensure there's no escaping the incoming bite and blood-draining.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME appears to get most of its energy from synthesizing the light of the full moon. It dislikes aggression: directly looking at a POKENAME or bumping into one will cause it to attack relentlessly until its target is unconscious.
author: bobosmith01

entry: It uses its pendulum to reflect light rays underwater into the eyes of swimmers above, hypnotizing them. The victim believes they're swimming towards an undersea paradise, but in reality, they're headed for POKENAME's jaws.
author: sk372

entry: The powerful and nauseating scent that POKENAME produces is so strong that it can cause unconsciousness. POKENAME will eat the dreams of anyone who passes out around it.
author: bobosmith01

entry: There is a distinct, quiet, metallic noise wherever POKENAME is frolicking thanks to its metallic petals. Those who listen to it for too long fall asleep. It is carefree and nonaggressive, preferring instead to poison competition in their sleep.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Inexperienced in hypnosis, POKENAME's strength causes it to swing a pendulum too strongly to properly hypnotize people or Pokémon. In a tantrum, it tosses its pendulum with incredible force, as it is its only known way to put people to sleep.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: Despite its appearance, POKENAME happily helps other Pokémon fall asleep. It can sometimes lose its patience trying to use hypnosis and decides to knock its patient out with brute force.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME lives in the deep sea, waiting for moonlit nights. It uses the light reflecting from its body to hypnotize other undersea Pokémon and command them to attack and sink passing ships.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lulls prey like Corsola to sleep with its pendulum. It then injects venom and drags its victim back to its den to feed in peace.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME are dishonest fighters, using their psychic charm to put opponents to sleep. The charm even doubles as a whip, but these Pokémon still lose quite often despite their advantages.
author: mcnchsschl

entry: Old folklore describes that this Pokémon is born on the dark side of the moon, coming down to earth to haunt the dreams of humans and ensnare their minds. In reality, it is a rather shy creature, living in solitude on forgotten beaches or islands.
author: _pixelar_

entry: POKENAME are oddly entranced by objects that swing back and forth like a pendulum. When they wag their tail, people nearby also become entranced by whatever has caught POKENAME's attention.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Packs of POKENAME will often stalk their prey for weeks before attacking, howling at night to fill the target's dreams with nightmares, which they relish. When their prey is delirious from sleep deprivation, they finally attack.
author: joeofthealps

entry: POKENAME can be picky about their Trainers and demand a lot of attention to prevent troublesome behavior. Despite that, they are known to be extremely affectionate. There are a group of Poké Maniacs who compete in POKENAME grooming competitions.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME lulls victims to sleep with a combination of pendulum movements and a whispered song. Those it sends to a slumber wind up singing in their sleep while POKENAME feeds on their dreams.
author: sk372

entry: The large pendulum on its back emits faint psychic waves to aid in hypnotizing prey in the forests. When hit, they intensify and radiate around POKENAME with a shrill tone, stunning prey so they can be struck down.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME use their psychic powers to detect their surroundings for signs of approaching predators. If anything manages to catch them off guard, they will startle with a burst of poisonous spores and psychically project their fear to their foe.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME hide within a mist of poisonous scales from their wings, using their psychic powers to detect the fear of their prey. They appear from the mist only to hypnotize their target, feeding on the fear before disappearing into the mist once more.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME's strange tools impart some of their power into any cookie they help make, putting whoever eats them to sleep. They're popular with young kids that have trouble sleeping, and pair well with a warm glass of milk.
author: icelevelincarnate

entry: In extreme cases when babies can't seem to sleep, doctors will hang a few POKENAME on strings similar to a mobile above their cribs. The coins that hang off of POKENAME make a gentle ringing sound that has a calming effect on newborn children.
author: bradlybro199

entry: If POKENAME detects a predator underground, it releases a sleep-inducing aura. It then digs as deep as possible to escape danger.
author: .izik

entry: In the past, unscrupulous sorts thought to use POKENAME as a charm to hypnotize others into loving them. Fortunately, POKENAME abhors false love, and will never use its hypnosis to force attraction.
author: sk372

entry: When in battle, it pretends to use its weapon as a tool for hypnosis just to throw it at its enemy when they least expect it.
author: funkytomate

entry: Although it never means any harm by this action, POKENAME often hypnotizes others around into playing with it for hours on end using its psychic powers. It loves to sleep curled up by those who sleep deeply.
author: bobosmith01

entry: While it is strikingly majestic, the details of this Pokémon's appearance are extremely hard to remember for a person it doesn't trust. It sometimes gives a tuft of its mane as a gift of friendship, which insures good sleep if put inside a pillow.
author: quietcognition

entry: It swings the spoon it carries against its metallic chest, creating a sharp echoing sound that disorients opponents. It feeds on their confusion, weakening them before defeating them with psychic powers.
author: sk372

entry: It is never safe to look directly at a POKENAME, as it uses telekinesis to accelerate the swing of its hypnotic rings faster than the eye can see.
author: kandyman

entry: POKENAME thinks so fast that it easily loses its patience when hypnotizing someone. Instead, it flips its pendulum like a coin, and the flash of sunlight reflecting from it temporarily stuns those who see it.
author: epping_forest

entry: During a fight, it uses one hand to grab its opponent, two hands to hypnotize it with its pendulums, and the last hand to throw punches at it.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: At night, POKENAME roams quiet towns and releases a sleep-inducing powder. Once those in the area slumber, it feasts on the dreams of those nearby.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME swing their pendulums simultaneously to increase the range of their psychic powers. While they prefer attacking from a distance, they are able to swing their pendulums hard enough to shatter stone when gathering minerals for meals.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: Once it hypnotizes someone with its pendulum, POKENAME strikes its body with it. Each stone on its torso creates a different chime, triggering different commands for the thrall to obey.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME is popular to travel with, as it can safely secure riders using Psychic. It makes overnight trips easy and restful with its mane of dreams.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME are powerful hypnotists. However, their lack of focus means they are prone to accidentally putting themselves and their Trainers to sleep.
author: autoregenesis

entry: POKENAME converts psychic force into electric power by rapidly spinning its magnet rings around its body.
author: grassy311

entry: POKENAME swings the two magnet rings at each end of its body back and forth in order to generate electricity.
author: grassy311

entry: POKENAME steal hypnotic coins from other Pokémon to use as their own. They swing the coin back and forth in a rhythmic pattern to entrance others.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Though it is skilled at hypnosis, the three heads often argue on what to do with a victim once they have entranced one. The hypnosis often wears off and the victim escapes before they come to a decision.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME often swims to places that it has seen glimpses of in eaten dreams. This habit has caused it to be spotted in unexpected locations.
author: noel5229

entry: POKENAME is a master hypnotist. It uses the spirals in its mouth to lure food in, then devours them without a second thought.
author: toxicrown

entry: POKENAME flings out small ghostly pendulums, hiding them among the places it haunts. It then waits for the perfect opportunity to make them pulse with hypnotic waves, and send everyone within into haunted, nightmare-filled slumber.
author: sk372

entry: Bearded variants of POKENAME are noted to be less overall malevolent in their behavior while haunting, but are subsequently more stubborn and difficult to exorcise out of one's home.
author: sk372

entry: Its hypnotic power is so strong that it hasn't yet grasped full control over it. On occasion the psychic powers it sends into its pendulum may reflect back on itself and put it into a trance.
author: sk372

entry: This creature is a master of hypnosis. By swinging its dual pendulums, it is able to control the minds of even legendary Pokémon.
author: thefinalkalgonus

entry: Lurking amidst the shores of beaches, POKENAME are highly territorial. The Mystic Water they dangle can lull unsuspecting beachgoers and swimmers into a gentle sleep, one that moves from a soft tide into a raging whirlpool of nightmares.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: POKENAME is naturally violent and seeks torment upon any prey it may see fit. The large claw traps its victims into a bound state, where it then swings a pendulum to toss them into a nightmare of hurricanes and floods.
author: pixlhoopa

entry: The brightly colored ball on POKENAME's back expels noxious powder when popped, deterring attacks from predators. This defense has inadvertently led to the injury of many a clueless beachgoer.
author: imademyselfdothis

entry: The tongue on a POKENAME is constantly out of its mouth, and its pincers are constantly opening and closing. Unfortunately when moving quickly it is not uncommon for a POKENAME to pinch its own tongue.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME waddle along tropical beaches, sleeping under the shade of palm trees. They like to pinch anything they find, from berries to coconuts. This usually leads to POKENAME accidentally pinching another Pokémon.
author: imagine1.

entry: Since Pokémon Fusion has become more widespread, more and more fishing lines have been cut thanks to POKENAME. Their hefty pincers prevent fast movement, so they often drift with the current.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME float in the ocean, using their fins to glide through the water with ease. POKENAME will dig into rocks using their powerful claws whenever they need rest.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is popular among young fishers due to their vibrant colors and moderate difficulty to catch. Among these circles, hooking up POKENAME is seen as the symbol of a new level in skill. Each POKENAME varies wildly in personality.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are regarded as unlucky by fishermen, as their crab arm is thought to scare away good luck. As a result of being underfished, POKENAME are widespread and populous, found in many aquatic places.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME isn't normally aggressive or territorial, but it will make an exception when gathering honey for its young. It uses its sharp claws to chase away rivals, but if proven weaker, POKENAME will blow bubbly wings to fly away.
author: ._term.

entry: POKENAME scuttle along the seafloor, snapping their claws as warnings to predators. They quickly tilt their bodies to strike with their claws, using their arms to catch themselves and push back up onto their feet.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: POKENAME live on small beaches located on remote islands, dancing from dusk until dawn. POKENAME wave their claws in the air during the dance, releasing ecstatic psychic energy that keeps them awake.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The fusion of Krabby and Magikarp has almost nothing to distinguish it in battle or behavior. Most POKENAME are created solely to be a high-priced delicacy in restaurants serving fusion cuisine.
author: sk372

entry: Using their many legs, POKENAME scuttle across the ocean floor in search of food. When pulled out of the water, POKENAME become enraged and soar into the sky to sink ships, slamming into them.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can be found in aquariums, as they are caring and gentle. As a result, POKENAME are trained to dive and ferry folks down underwater, using the air vents on their shell to maintain an air bubble to breathe.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME becomes especially fond of its Trainer, it brings every shell it finds on the beach as a gift. It loves digging small holes in the sand and resting inside them.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While the antennae on its head no longer attract prey, POKENAME does not notice. The pincers now snatch unwitting victims around it without effort.
author: ziggaway

entry: POKENAME use their eggshell to protect themselves, along with their baby claws. POKENAME will make a high-pitched gurgle to call for help when in danger.
author: quackquackattack

entry: In its coastal habitats, POKENAME boasts a crustacean shell with curious wings. Its graceful charm captivates those who encounter it along the shores.
author: anarchaz

entry: POKENAME fly extremely erratically and constantly crash into their surroundings. Fortunately, even its most delicate components are very durable.
author: staghorn

entry: Floating in the sky above beaches, POKENAME use a large cotton spore to hang from as they sleep. POKENAME only descend from the sky when it is time to eat and always have one claw gripping onto their cotton spore.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME delicately processes food with their claws, peeling away seafood from their shells, stripping off pieces of seaweed, before using them to feed itself. Should another Pokémon approach them, they will loudly snap their claws in intimidation.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: POKENAME unleash a flurry of claws and vines to protect the beach ball on their back. Why they are fond of beach balls is still being studied by scientists.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Its chitinous shell is extra thick to protect it from predators. It will burrow a hole in the sand and lie still, waiting for an opportunity to ambush prey.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME use their claws and barbed body to protect themselves. To dissuade predators from biting them, POKENAME grip onto the predator with their claws before stabbing the predator with their barbed bodies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's powerful pincers are strong enough to crush Shellder shells with little effort. Its body produces a lot of heat while in combat, so it stays in the water to keep its body cool.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME are keen-eyed hunters of the icy tundra, stealing eggs and food from other Pokémon when they are away from their burrows. POKENAME will monitor the activities of another Pokémon before burrowing straight towards their meals.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a large beak that they use to pierce prey. Their crustacean-like legs give POKENAME more stability when hopping on land, allowing them to waddle into tight spaces.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When resting, it freezes the water around it. It uses this ice as a protective barrier, ensuring no predators disturb its slumber.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME live together with coral that grows on their shell, as the coral helps strengthen their claws. In exchange for this, POKENAME help the coral spread, migrating from one coral reef to another.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use their fins to swim along the ocean floor, using their claws to grab onto food. Despite having legs, POKENAME do not use them, preferring their fins.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use their tentacles to wrap around shelled prey before prying open their meals using their hooked claws. When two POKENAME fight over the same meal, they smack their claws against each other until one of them gives up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME float above the ocean floor, their wingspan casting large shadows below them. POKENAME have claws attached to arm-like antennae that they use as extra protection.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME curls up motionless on the sandy seafloor, concealed among clusters of orange coral. It waits patiently for prey to wander near, then ambushes them with a single, swift claw strike.
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder

entry: Making canvases out of stone instead of parchment, POKENAME use their sharp claws to carve into stone. POKENAME utilize many art styles, ranging from realistic to abstract to stylized statues.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME kicks up sand using its claws to burrow into the sand. Once a suitable burrow is made, it tucks itself into its shell and takes a nap.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME entertains itself by picking up small objects from the ground like shells and acorns, then tossing them into the air to shoot down with lightning bolts as a method of target practice.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME likes to pinch itself with its claw to stay awake or to focus. It doesn't hurt POKENAME because it is used to the feeling. Besides the big claw, it also has two smaller claws that are always closed.
author: gamelord64

entry: POKENAME use their claws to swing from vine to vine, leaping across branches in the jungle. Their claws are sharp and can break open coconuts, allowing POKENAME to eat the fruit inside.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have large mouths that munch on berries, preferring ones that grow closer to beaches. POKENAME prefer wide-open spaces, as their wings get tense if confined for too long.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its eight shell-hardened wings like paddles to swim across the sea. When it comes to land, it can skitter onto the beach like a crab.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: The pincer extending from its face is actually a mouth. It clamps onto unsuspecting Pokémon and sucks out fluids like a bug's proboscis.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME is quite the prankster. Its favorite activities are stealing trinkets and scaring strangers, only to reveal its face from behind its mask and giggle.
author: leonian1586

entry: POKENAME can carry hundreds of small Krabby on its back. If you play music around this Pokémon, the Krabby will cheerfully click their pincers to the beat.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME have been observed forming complex rivalries and social cliques with other POKENAME. Typically, the ones with the biggest pincer-ears are the most popular.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME waddle in flocks to preserve warmth. They huddle together and protect the weaker POKENAME by having them stay in the middle of the group.
author: quackquackattack

entry: When POKENAME buries its shaft in the sand, it appears to be just a discarded claw. Alerted by its ribbon, the axe flips to execute its victim.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME use the spray of bubbles from their body to reflect light off of themselves, creating mirages to blend into their surroundings. If anyone gets close enough to see through the mirage, POKENAME will ready their claws as a warning.
author: wildheartrazorfangs

entry: The pincers on its head make excellent weapons. When threatened, it will bash its head into targets and clamp its pincers onto foes.
author: melodydelune

entry: Using their aquatic wings to soar through the air, POKENAME slam their claws into opponents. POKENAME also use their grip strength to pinch opponents.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME snaps its claw to ignite a flame within its pincers as a way to frighten off attackers. Older members of the species tend to have charred edges to their claws from constant fire-starting.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME have a rotund shell that has spikes and extends its innards to form a claw to grab onto meals. Their claw is slimy to the touch, sticking onto berries and snacks.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Many avoid POKENAME when they see it scuttling around with dangerously sharp scissors. However, it has been witnessed using them to free washed up Pokémon that are ensnared in discarded fishing lines.
author: mepp.

entry: The water channeled through POKENAME's back is constantly dripping as it flies. This often poses a nuisance to beachgoers whenever it passes through the area.
author: theartemis1

entry: POKENAME uses its melodic voice to lure its victims into holes it digs in the sand. The sound waves of its singing voice lure only the tastiest prey.
author: mrpeach774

entry: POKENAME swim in the sea, finding rocky reefs to lurk in. POKENAME can be found rubbing against rocks, scraping debris and filth off their scales.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME latches onto rivals with one pincer while the other delivers devastating blows. It cloaks its body in foam to absorb counterattacks.
author: cresselia8themoon

entry: POKENAME bury themselves in wet dirt and sand, protecting their soft underside. If anything moves near one's claw, it'll be grabbed and dragged into POKENAME's shell to either be eaten or discarded.
author: ohok3441

entry: Fluttering in dark caverns, POKENAME travel in colonies, overwhelming both prey and predator with their sheer numbers. It is said that POKENAME colonies can gather up to 50 individuals before splitting off.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are found in factories, using their bodies to absorb excess electricity. Scientists rely on POKENAME as a failsafe if any electrical equipment is damaged.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a large mouth that can stretch as wide as its head, which it uses to swallow food whole. POKENAME do not use their claws, as they are tiny and cannot reach very far.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME dance by swaying and scuttling side by side. The good vibes of these dances often mesmerize viewers and amplify psychic abilities. People often bring POKENAME to festivals for this reason.
author: entomoxie

entry: POKENAME uses the bubbles on its back and tail to seem bigger, with little-to-no success. It uses its powerful jaw and claws to attack if threatened.
author: ._term.

entry: POKENAME have claws attached to their aerodynamic fins. While this does slow POKENAME down, they remain some of the fastest creatures in the sea.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use their claws attached to the center of their tentacles to attract prey. Once ensnared, POKENAME inject poison to secure a new meal.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have soft tentacles that can harden into sharp barbs to capture prey. When not on the hunt, POKENAME prefer to hide under their large shell.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME carry the shells of once-living Pokémon as they scuttle along shores. Many children feel a deep sense of nostalgia when they are around these creatures, as though a familiar pet has returned.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are a popular delicacy in island regions as their flesh has been described as sweet and tender. They are often cooked with their scales as they have a nice, crunchy texture when soaked.
author: mistymagius

entry: POKENAME spend days patrolling thermal vent ecosystems for food, often picking fights with larger prey than they should.
author: noblenobody

entry: POKENAME uses its powerful pincers to seize foes while burrowing. It drags them at extreme speeds until they lose consciousness.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME scuttle across beaches to look for shiny coins or trinkets they can add to their collection. They become hostile if anyone tries to take their newfound possessions and are not afraid of pinching people.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are docile and calm, communicating using quacks and waving their claws. This method of communication is sophisticated enough that local sailors can tell if a storm is coming by observing POKENAME that are on beaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME is more than eager to throw its weight around with its large size and strong claws. Because of its bullying nature, it's not held in high regard by the Krabby or Corphish lines.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lives in warm seas. It is considered a delicacy, but its powerful pincers and sturdy shell make catching it no easy feat.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME are friendly and clever, using their quacking and claws to guide each other to patches of litter. POKENAME then clean up that area so that they can invite tourists to their beaches, beckoning ships from their sandy shores.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME use their sturdy claws to dig out small holes in sandy beaches to use as their homes. These watering holes that POKENAME create allow Pokémon typically found in more swampy areas to make their homes closer to the beaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A few pieces of Clever Mochi are all it needs to be happy. It knows it needs to slice and share its mochi because its mind reading powers can detect the slightest of envy.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The bulbous heads of POKENAME are protected by a hard shell and are difficult to penetrate. Their claws are small but nimble, burrowing deep into the ground to protect their soft underbellies.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a shell-like helmet and two large claws that excavate the earth beneath them. Once POKENAME create suitable burrows, POKENAME will rest in those burrows before starting the process over again.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have sturdy arms and sharp claws used to dig deep into the ground. POKENAME are picky with their sleeping habits and refuse to sleep unless the ground is freshly dug up.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are sedentary Pokémon, sleeping for up to 22 hours a day. They use their tails to slowly drag food to its mouth before falling back asleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to lure Pokémon in the area to sleep before taking food from sleeping Pokémon. It is said that POKENAME is oblivious to the pain that its tail feels, as though the tail was put to sleep.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are often utilized in the maintenance of submarines in tandem with Magnety. POKENAME float around in the water surrounding the submarines and use sound waves to run constant diagnostics on the health of their particular vessel.
author: bradlybro199

entry: POKENAME crawls on its stomach across the ocean floor, using its claws to grab onto food. POKENAME prefers warmer climates, as it has yet to develop enough body mass to preserve enough heat.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slides across the ocean floor by freezing the water in front of it. POKENAME prefers colder climates as it is easier to freeze water in such climates.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME scuttle into factories to seek out nutritious sludge. They use their large claws to scoop sludge into their mouths until full.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME drag themselves around with their weak claws, crawling around to gather seaweed on the sea floor. POKENAME are unable to move quickly, as their shells inhibit their range of motion.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has a heavy shell that makes it slow and relatively immobile and is vulnerable if flipped on its side. However, POKENAME can still move due to its claws and small legs helping it crawl and remain upright.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME blows bubbles in a hypnotizing rhythm. In this way, it lures unwary targets into its lair, which is often located in dark caves.
author: chorb33

entry: Fusion has caused POKENAME to exhibit much more aggressive hunting techniques, viciously snapping at and crushing fish and clams alike. There are signs its claws are beginning to develop minds of their own.
author: sk372

entry: Only the bulkiest of POKENAME will be able to yank the hefty anchors off of a passing ship. Those who do so are able to use it as a weapon to defend against hungry Carvanha.
author: avidclown

entry: POKENAME have two sets of claws, their front claws able to crush steel beams. If pollution is present in the ocean, POKENAME will attempt to claw at it in vain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME has adopted a patient, defensive fighting style. Its tough carapace allows it to easily withstand many blows while waiting for the opportunity to land a haymaker with its massive claw.
author: fancyskunk

entry: POKENAME, armed with colossal claws and a formidable horn, prowls the deep ocean floor, hunting down ocean Rock-type Pokémon as its prime prey.
author: velvetmitsu

entry: POKENAME love bumping against palm trees, then opening and drinking the coconuts that fall from them. Groups of POKENAME are commonly seen dancing, though it's unknown why they do this.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKNEAME keeps its singular pincer in great condition; if it falls off, POKENAME will fall into a deep depression. The pincer is known for being extremely flavorful, so POKENAME is often targeted by poachers.
author: bobosmith01

entry: POKENAME are somewhat territorial and live together in groups. They cut through fishing lines and nets, so they are difficult to catch. Their pincers will begin moving again for a short time if cooked.
author: bobosmith01

entry: They tend to prefer swimming in high-current estuaries, hunting down small and weak Water-type Pokémon. In the winter, POKENAME tend to flee to the ocean.
author: bobosmith01

entry: Able to regenerate their limbs, POKENAME sometimes lose an arm in a tight crevice or when hurt. POKENAME are able to regrow such limbs quickly, some doing so in only 24 hours.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A ferocious undersea hunter, POKENAME possesses incredible crushing power in both its claws and its jaws. Even the strongest shelled Pokémon are crushed in mere seconds if caught.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME are a favorite of the tourism industry, as their air vents on their shell can be used to maintain a bubble for tourists to breathe in. In the event of emergencies, POKENAME are also known to defend tourists and bring them back to beaches.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME love to use water to play with others, especially being fond of creating giant bubbles via the massive pincer at the end of their tail. This pincer is also their best weapon, which they will use to defend their friends rather fiercely.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME is a vibrant and social Pokémon. It often hunts together in small packs, and it has been known to take down large prey such as Swampdos.
author: thatguy4115

entry: A majority of POKENAME's psychic power is centered within its oversized claw. It pulls opponents towards itself with potent telekinesis, before crushing them with the giant claw's raw might.
author: sk372

entry: Due to having an oversized claw attached to a diminutive body, POKENAME floats around at an odd angle. The large claw can fire bubbles that whittle away an opponent's fighting spirit with each hit.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME lurks in murky riverways, remaining stationary for days on end on the river bed while it waits for passing prey. When it senses something it can eat, it bursts into motion using its powerful pincers.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME rely on their bright and shiny hook to lure other Pokémon into their claws. The alluring glow of the hook draws in many aquatic Pokémon to their doom.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have two large claws that are the size of their torso and hug itself when in danger to appear larger. If POKENAME hear a cry for help, they will rush over to render aid to those in danger.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Found in silty rivers, POKENAME spend most of their time hidden in the mud, filtering through it to extract any nutrients. They expel a mucus that disperses through the mud, which is picked up by other POKENAME in a form of communication.
author: whatagooddaytodie

entry: Its claw-like tail is quick to grab and crush prey, but is too short to feed its own mouth. POKENAME tosses its meal into the air, then scuttles beneath to try and catch it in its jaws.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME must shed its skin every month to keep its body healthy and shiny. The exoskeletons taste very similar to Klawf Sticks.
author: dodoowner_

entry: POKENAME exist in a symbiotic relationship with coral, as the coral provides extra defense for POKENAME. In return, POKENAME ensure the coral are protected from predators and pollution and collect garbage into piles away from coral reefs.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME uses the magnetism inherent to its claws to pull small Steel-type Pokémon off the ground. It crushes the seized prey with its singular massive pincer.
author: sk372

entry: Its claws are strong enough to snap metal in half. Outside of combat, Trainers bind its claws so it can't hurt others.
author: the.the.the.the.the.the

entry: These Pokémon love helping out other Pokémon and even humans with whatever they need. Lots of Pokémon tend to sleep next to POKENAME, as it's a great protector.
author: imagine1.

entry: It gathers sand, mud and other materials in its super-heated claws to mold into projectiles. This molten ammunition impacts opponents with the force of meteors.
author: sk372

entry: The many legs on the back of POKENAME allow it to climb the trees of the jungle efficiently. It will sleep in these trees, tired from waving its heavy claw around for communication.
author: dragodigitalstudios

entry: POKENAME develop their fighting prowess by sparring with other POKENAME. They are best suited for powerful kicks and grappling with their claws. After a long sparring match, they lock claws as a sign of solidarity.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME can snap its big claw at the underwater speed of sound, creating a sonic boom that destroys the eardrums of everyone within a 100 km radius. Doing this leaves its arm completely destroyed, taking weeks to regenerate.
author: epping_forest

entry: Despite POKENAME's appearance, it is quite friendly and loves to play around at the beach with humans.
author: kcjole

entry: POKENAME's shell is one of the most durable materials in the known world. Ironically, its gigantic claw is one of the only things with enough crushing power in order to damage it.
author: foolish_weasel

entry: POKENAME hustle around tundra environments, looking for fish Pokémon to eat. POKENAME rely on catching up to slower Magikarp.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME's overgrown axe head also means it's outgrown its previous hunting method. It can now cleave slow, well-armored victims in one fell swoop.
author: abstrusepaladin

entry: POKENAME cuts off portions of its own claw to feed its offspring. So, the babies are left alone for some time, well fed, while POKENAME goes hunting and regenerates it.
author: epping_forest

entry: It flies around beaches looking for food. Its size makes hunting difficult, so it has adapted its claws to extend from its sides to hunt from the sky.
author: patch_bros

entry: The claw on its tail is incredibly powerful. However, due to the weight of its claw, it relies on dense limbs made of bubbles to keep itself balanced.
author: melodydelune

entry: Capable of both flying and swimming at incredible speed, POKENAME can strike fast and hard with its large claw, both underwater and in the air. They are only vulnerable if caught on the ground, as their lightweight shells are not very strong.
author: occulusmalus

entry: It lures Krabby into its mouth and traps them. If it fails to capture anything, it will scurry across the shore with its claws.
author: imagine1.

entry: POKENAME hides in ocean caves, resting peacefully. It only comes out to scare away fishermen that interrupt its sleep.
author: imagine1.

entry: The timbre of POKENAME's voice lures in prey twice its size. It uses its oversized claw to crush foes larger than it.
author: mrpeach774

entry: The bladed dorsal spines on a POKENAME's carapace can cut even thick boat hulls to ribbons. Caution is advised to sailors in POKENAME-infested waters.
author: occulusmalus

entry: Flying in damp caverns, POKENAME flap their wings to glide silently through the dark. POKENAME crush rocks and shells with their claw-like mouth in search of food.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The extinction of the massive and powerful POKENAME was a mystery until it was revived from fossil fragments and it was discovered to taste absolutely delicious. Ironically, this fatal flaw has encouraged their revival, as the meat is in high demand.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME dance from dawn to dusk, waving their claws into the air. It is said that these dances change the weather, summoning rain to a given area.
author: quackquackattack

entry: A wretched mess of deformed chitin and crooked limbs descended from mutated Kingler colonies in polluted waters, POKENAME is so hideously toxic that nothing will prey on them- thus ensuring their survival and thus continued misery.
author: occulusmalus

entry: POKENAME have a sleek shell atop their head. Despite the shell weighing as much as another POKENAME, the aerodynamic shell does not encumber its speed.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The bodies of POKENAME play host to an aggressive fungus that hijacks their nervous system, making them move against their will. The spores of the fungus thrive in water and will infect freshly laid POKENAME eggs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: POKENAME are deceptively fast, capable of propelling themselves tens of meters onto the shore to snatch prey with their oversized claws. If they miss, they scuttle backwards back into the water, dragging their heavy claws gracelessly after them.
author: .fedoraman

entry: Natural hydraulics allow POKENAME to launch its sturdy body at speeds exceeding 150km/h. Due to this strength, few are willing to disturb the calm, peaceful life POKENAME leads.
author: turron_turron

entry: The bodies of POKENAME play host to an aggressive fungus that hijacks their nervous system, making them move against their will. The spores of the fungus thrive in water and will infect freshly laid POKENAME eggs.
author: katieplaysgames

entry: The intense heat within the shell of POKENAME creates thermal vent systems as they rest on the seafloor, waiting for prey to stray too close.
author: noblenobody

entry: From its pincers, POKENAME releases scalding bubbles that burn on touch. Its larger claw is strong enough to crush boulders and pry apart the armor of the sea creatures it hunts.
author: fiordaliso

entry: While digging, POKENAME fires pressurized bubbles from its larger claw to move faster or strike prey. Once a foe is stunned, it subdues them with Vice Grip.
author: .izik

entry: POKENAME dig into the sand at beaches to find coins and shiny objects. If they encounter another POKENAME while searching for shiny objects, they spar until one of them gives up their collected horde.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are cunning, as they wave their claws and quack to communicate when ships are arriving. When ships dock at the port, POKENAME wave their claws, hoping for snacks from various sailors or tourists.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME have a fully developed language, using their quacking and claw movements to detect changes in temperature and humidity. In some laboratories, POKENAME work alongside scientists to predict stormy weather.
author: quackquackattack

entry: Despite its cute appearance, POKENAME has a bite force of 10,000 psi. This massive jaw is quite heavy, however, and causes it to often stumble about.
author: mepp.

entry: POKENAME dwells on ocean atolls and bravely challenges anyone who arrives to duel it. Its massive claw is used not only to fire high-pressure jets of water, but above all to deliver crushing blows that can shatter huge boulders in a single strike.
author: fiordaliso

entry: POKENAME is quite intelligent and possesses great psychic power. It creates bubbles with its claws that are brimming with enough telekinetic energy that a single one popping would knock out anything in a 100 km radius.
author: sk372

entry: Anyone POKENAME's claws snap down on is knocked out in one hit. If threatened, it will crawl on all six of its limbs, moving at a tremendous speed.
author: hampterbychoice

entry: It grips onto its opponent using its large pincers and swings them around to tire them out. While its pincers are clamped down, it releases a burst of bubbles onto its target to secure victory.
author: quackquackattack

entry: The pincer on its tail catches prey on instinct and drops it in front of its face when its at leisure. It may take hours for POKENAME to realize food has been delivered, however.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME scuttles around the shallows of beaches, picking up small creatures to eat. The shell-like organism surrounding its body derives sustenance from the scraps that fall from POKENAME's mouth as it chews.
author: sk372

entry: POKENAME crawl on the ocean floor with their claws clearing the debris in front of them. POKENAME do this because they prefer to slide on smoother surfaces, as debris and other irritants cause them pain.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME slide on their stomach along the ocean floor by freezing a path in front of them. These paths allow POKENAME to wander without worrying about colliding with debris on the ocean floor.
author: quackquackattack

entry: These Pokémon are rather territorial and often clash with each other using their giant pincers. Against stronger opponents, POKENAME will typically use their pincers to hold their opponent and then shoot them with their waterspouts up-close.
author: infinex21

entry: POKENAME use one claw to help them crawl along the seafloor and swap claws to give the other one rest. One claw can lift twice their body weight above their heads, but POKENAME requires great effort to do so.
author: quackquackattack

entry: POKENAME are heavy and bulky, but their protective shells and hefty claws help protect them from attacks. However, POKENAME can use their claws to smash and pry off parts of their shell, shedding weight for speedy escapes.
author: quackquackattack

entry: To avoid scaring off prey with its fearsome claws, POKENAME hypnotizes them with its pendulum. Its claws and jaws can crack even the toughest armor.
author: chorb33

entry: When strolling across beaches, Trainers may find POKENAME scuttling about in the sand. They often have competitions to crush the largest rocks they can find with their massive claws.
author: avidclown

entry: POKENAME's left pincer can pulverize almost anything due to its sheer ginormous size. Its beard is made of bubbles it made itself and therefore could be made in many styles and sizes.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME typically lives on sheer cliffs next to oceans. Its entire body is rock-hard, making it difficult for predators to effectively attack this Pokémon.
author: soup1900

entry: POKENAME's bubbles can quickly melt opponents' bodies due to their high alkalinity. It is therefore recommended to avoid ever touching its bubble beard or mustache.
author: soup1900
